reviews.comment: Great professor, but get ready to read 3 long readings a week and participate because most of the class is about how well you understand the material and to get an A. You have to go above and beyond, but he is decently fair once you get through the first few weeks, he really lets you grow as a student with the material.

Literally all you need to do to pass this class is a few fun readings every week and have critical thinking skills when you come to class. Be willing to throw out new ideas, share philosophical notions about the readings and you'll be fine. Yeah. This class is for nerds, but isn't that awesome? Take this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: More work than my major. Nothing was ever good enough for him. It felt like he expected you to be on professor knowledge. Have perfect responses and you were never allowed to have an "off day" in his class. He expected so much from his students. I would never take him again. You will probably never get an A in his class.
Great guy, really cares about his students and their education. Lots of reading, but it's because he wants you to actually engage with the class content. I really feel like I learned from his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Great professor, had fun in his class. Readings are enjoyable and we have good discussion. I am thinking about switching my major because of this class, very inspirational.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Adam is my favorite professor I've had at UK. He is so insightful, very caring about his students, and a genuinely good person. Lectures are based off of the class readings, which are about 10-20 avg. He genuinely wants his students to learn from them and his lectures. I will be taking as many of his classes as I can while at UK. Spectacular!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: By far the worst academic experience of my life. His grading depends on how you view the topics he discusses in class. If you don't talk in class enough, de drops your grade one whole letter grade at the end of the semester. Every night you're expected 30+ pages of reading, and exams are almost impossible to get a decent grade on. Don't take!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This class is so needy and honestly not worth it. Every night there are 20-30 pages of reading and he grades very tough, hardly ever gives out an A. He is quite harsh and you are not able to have an off day (not talk) in his class or you will fail. I do not recommend this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I enjoyed taking Karl's class. He was a tough grader and harsh at times, but only because he wants you to understand the material. Honestly, as long as you show him that you are putting in the effort, you will do well. He is easy to reach outside of class and is always willing to chat. He is very blunt, but one of the nicest professors I've had.

By far one of the worst professors I have had! This professor does not have a rubric for any of his assignments, including major projects. The amount of reading in this class is absurd, 15-25 pages of reading before every class. He also grades very poorly based on what you discuss in class, and gives no feedback to why you got that grade.

Karl is a nice person, but a harsh professor. The class is very reading-heavy; one to two readings are required before every class, and the readings are around 20 pages long. This class is mostly an elective for many health-related majors, so if you're looking for an easy A, DO NOT TAKE! A in his class is a 100%, which he does not give out easily.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: There is no rubric to grade ANYTHING. This course was awful from the start. His critiques make you not want to speak in class, which is what the grading is based on.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He makes me never want to take another philosophy class again. The readings for class can be painfully long and if you want a good grade be prepared to talk. Professor grades nothing else but what you say in class and with zero feedback to explain why/what you did wrong. He also refuses to insert due dates on any assignments on canvas. Good Luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This review is actually for MKT-610. If you are a graduate student who also works, stay far away from this guy. Makes zero accommodations and expects students to fully participate during the middle of the work day. Myself and many others dropped this course before the first day. Probably should be the last semester he teaches grad level courses.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This class is great. You can't use laptops to take notes but his lectures are really good. The videos he makes you watch outside of class are interesting. He keeps lectures fun and casual. Speaking up in class will help your grade a lot but attendance isn't mandatory. The homework outside of class is easy but the tests are pretty hard.

I will be honest, I was lazy throughout the semester in Dr. Craig's class. However, I did attend class and took notes. I also spent a few hours studying for each test. However, in the end, it was his class participation grade that hurt me the most. I'm not a very outspoken person and aren't entirely comfortable speaking up. This hurt my grade a lot
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Craig was my favorite professor this semester. Not only did I find the material interesting to begin with, but he made it even more so. The class does require a lot of reading and you need to participate everyday in class, but as long as you are trying your hardest, he does everything he can to make sure you succeed. 10/10 would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Really interesting classes. You aren't allowed to use a laptop or your phone, but you hardly notice because you are learning very interesting stuff. His tests are tough, but if you attend class and have a broad grasp of the material, you should get at least a B. He doesn't take attendance, but he has pop quizzes often, and participation is graded.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Tests are tough--Would take again

reviews.comment: One of the best teachers I've had at UK. He's super passionate about what he teaches, and the material is pretty interesting! Really intelligent guy. Tons of outside work, but videos are somewhat good. Participation matters a ton, I talked almost every class and got a C for participation. Also, he looks like a skinny Dr. Owen Hunt from Grey's.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: On the very first day, he pointed out that he thinks he's a psychologist which was weird, because what we learned was nothing close to psychology or even connecting psychology to marketing. He knows his stuff and if you just try you can get a B. A lot of reading and outside work for lectures.

One of my favorite professors at UK so far.  Makes classes interesting by relating topics to things college kids actually care about.  You do have to watch a lot of videos and read articles because there is a good chance there will be a pop quiz the next day but you usually get full credit if you're in the ballpark.  Also, participation matters.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Craig has the potential to be really cool because he's young but he tries to compensate for his youth with this weird sort of arrogant attitude about the class. Some days hes chill and others he just kind of cuts anyone who answers down. Attendance isnt mandatory but with labs, quizzes, etc. you have to go. Overall harder class than it should be.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: One of the best teachers I've had at UK. He's tough but he's willing to help. Don't bother bringing your cell phone to class, he has a strict policy on it. He's passionate about the class which means he puts forth the effort for you to learn. He's a great teacher and I wish I could say the same about the rest of the teachers I've had at UK.

Most interesting lectures out of any class I've taken, you will actually want to attend class. He always uses real world scenarios and makes you think. The tests can be a little tricky but nothing terrible if you study. If you really want to LEARN about consumer behavior and do it in an enjoyable and applicable way, Craig is the teacher.

Craig is a good teacher and knows what he's talking about. The tests cover a lot of material. You have to read 3 books, articles, and watch a few videos in your spare time. If a phone goes off in class, get ready to take a quiz. I don't think it would be possible to fail this class.
Great professor, lots of reading but as long as you follow the syllabus you're golden

Honestly the first day he will worry you and so will getting on here looking him up. He comes off as a harass but is not. The tests are based on class discussion, notes, and the books you read throughout the year. The guy really loves what he does and is very good. One of my favorite lectures. If you don't like this class you're just being lazy.

Test really aren't bad if you take good notes and study. He makes it super interesting and forbids phones in class which makes you pay attention. Don't read the books, I never got below an 18 on a book quiz by simply reading online summaries. If you participate in the class he will like you, and grade easier, so SPEAK UP! Not an easy A, but doable.
this class is ridiculous. makes the tests and quizzes WAY more difficult that they need to be. i do not recommend taking him. he does not want you to do well in his class which is very clear

Although I enjoyed the class and the subject matter was interesting, he goes out of his way to make the class much more difficult than it needs to be. He assigns 4 books (250 pg) to read through-out the semester and then quizzes you on "big picture" ideas of the book. FALSE. Prepare yourself to score LOW on these quizzes,  AVG 520 for all students

Tries to make tests unnecessarily hard and tricky when it is a simple subject. Attendance is not mandatory, but a lot of the test questions come from his lectures. He makes the subject more interesting but I would probably suggest taking another teacher because of how ridiculous he tries to make the tests. Everything else in the class is easy.
material good teacher bad
cool class bad teacher
drop this class asap or at least change who teaches it
its a good class so take it with anyone else but her unless you want to be miserable
My favorite professor I have had so far. She is very sweet and you can tell that she really cares about her students. She doesn't assign a lot of work either and is very understanding.
Seriously horrible. no other words.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nice person, terrible professor. Gives vague instructions on assignments, but then grades them harshly. No examples provided of what is expected. Just vagueness and platitudes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors. Assigns no work that is not useful to you as a student getting ready for the professional world. Would absolutely recommend trying to schedule her as your professor.

Really wants to motivate you to do well, but support outside of class was subpar. Feedback on assignments was very vague and didn't give me a good idea of what needed to be improved. Constantly said she cared about our success, but struggled to fulfill that. Class and its content is fairly common sense.
Amanda is literally amazing, so understanding about personal situations. She is an easy grader and one of my favorite professors.

Dr. Lawrence was hands down one of the best professors Ive had in my time at UK. Shes very open, and clearly cares about her students and their success. Not sure how you could have something negative about her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you follow the rubrics for every assignment, listen to lecture, and get good grades in other classes, this is an easy A. Resume/Cover Letter and the Group Project were the hardest assignments. She grades hard and her feedback on said grading needs improvement, but she is personable, caring, and open to helping you with any assignment.

This class has no exams or quizzes but does have a fair amount of homework and a pretty big group project. Honestly, if I were to do it again, I would take it online. Dr. Lawrence is really nice, caring, and knowledgable but her lectures tend to be dry. This isn't as much her fault as it is just a boring topic (to me). An easy class overall.

I'll start off by saying Amanda is a considerably tough grader. *However*, she gives a detailed rubric for every assignment. USE IT! It's an invaluable tool for her classes. That being said, you have to work for the A, and it'll be worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Overall she was a fairly decent professor, but she grades papers extremely harshly and takes off an arbitrary number of points for minor errors. Very inconsistent grading and moderately inconsistent directions on assignments. Also does not provide feedback/suggest corrections on paper drafts. I would not recommend taking her if you have a choice.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I loved her so much that i chose to take her again the next semester. She cares about all of her students and is willing to help you get the grade you desire as long as you are willing to try your best!
She is honestly the best professor I've ever had. She really cares about her students and wants them to succeed. She is also very funny and makes the class interesting!
She is a really good professor who cares deeply about how well you do. You have to work for an A, but if you put in the work she will help with the rest. Overall great teacher.

Dr. Allison cares about his students and is a great professor. He is often willing to help out by writing letters of recommendation.  The class itself was what you'd expect from a quality college course- you need to read the requirements and be prepared to discuss, but with the main text (Ulysses in this 330's case) it's great to ask questions

Due to Dr. Allison's humor and vocalization, I stayed engaged during his 9:30. On the first day, he asked everyone to share their favorite book which created a welcoming environment. I appreciated that he gave essay prompt choices and I found his feedback helpful. Quiz questions were given ahead of time which made those straightforward as well!

I really really liked this professor until I found out that he won't give 100% on papers because "its an english class" I was constantly getting 90% and he said that it was the max he would give. BESIDES that, he was funny, kind, and a great professor who engaged with the class and knew what he was talking about. i would take again but grading meh
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Awesome Professor!
He's such a good prof, he's so funny and is super understanding. The class itself isn't that exciting but if you have to take the course choose him as a prof. He also cancels class for bad weather.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: A freshman here at UK, one of my favorite professors this semester. Attendance is mandatory, making it pretty easy to get a decent grade in the class. The quizzes are a little tricky, but nothing crazy hard. Pretty easy grader on papers and will literally help with anything. He's funny, easy class, great professor.

Dr. Allison has been my favorite professor in the UK. He's a gentle, middle-aged man with no ill intentions toward his students. He truly wants to see his students understand the material. He had four assigned readings, but all related to a central theme that he believed his students should resonate with. Take any of his classes!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: He was amazing! Super encouraging with great feedback. He brought us doughnuts!!

Dr. A is amazing and accommodating. He is a tough grader on papers but gives specific and helpful feedback before each due date. He also values student input when deciding what content will be on quizzes and cares more about our understanding of course content than a grade. He also brought us doughnuts on the last day of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Allison was a fantastic professor. He is very kind and approachable, cared about our input during lectures and regarding assignments, and presented material clearly. He was happy to provide feedback for our drafts before turning them in. I really enjoyed his class and would take any of his courses again. Highly recommend him.

This professor was absolutely amazing! He is super sweet and helpful. He was always willing to read rough drafts of papers and offer advice. He helped and gave extensions on paper if we needed them and was always positive during class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Caring and flexible, Dr. A gave students control over aspects of the course like page counts for drafts, when quizzes were scheduled, and prompts for our papers. Dr. Allison can be tough on grading papers, but he gives generous feedback if you send in a draft for his review. Follow his feedback, and you will do well.

I was so excited to take his course on James Joyce, but I left feeling confused and dejected. Can be harsh with feedback but let him review your papers! He is so specific about what he wants that the only way to make a high grade is by letting him tear your paper apart. Only gave a couple As for papers. Other assignments were pretty easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Allison is such a sweet man. He comes off as strict at first, but he means well because he cares about his students and wants them to succeed. His class is lecture-heavy and sometimes unorganized and hard to follow. He does expect everyone to participate but makes everyone feel comfortable in doing so. He's awesome.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Allison is a super knowledgeable professor and class was never boring. My only complaint is he is a fairly tough grader and gives little feedback on what to improve on in regards to papers. He always tells you what you do well, but fails to address why points may be counted off. He is a nice professor and I should end up with an A- or B+.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Allison is a great  professor!! He really cares about his students and what he is teaching! I loved coming to class and I actually read the books that were assigned for class and thats the first time I've done that in my three years at UK. I DEFINITELY recommend taking his class! only 4 papers & he lets you choose how final paper is set up!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Participate, read, and write good papers and you will pass just fine. He is a fair grader. He has high expectations and you must have read before coming to class. Don't ask stupid questions; those definitely exist in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Well, I've found my favorite professor at UK. Professor Allison is extremely knowledgeable and is willing to give his students as much extra help as they want. He won't ask too much of you, keep up on the reading and be prepared to answer questions about it in class and you'll be all set. Also, you definitely have to attend- he takes roll daily.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: I have taken three of Dr. Allison's classes and I've loved them all. Dr. Allison is fair in his grading, BUT will call you out on your mistakes; your grade will reflect that. The class and material are very interesting.

Dr. Allison is very smart and funny, but he does like to ramble and get off topic often. He also rarely released my class on time. He seemed to have favorites in the class and I believe his grading reflected that. No quizzes or homework; just a few short essays, but he is a very tough grader and was a little unclear on his expectations.

Dr. Allison is best English professor at UK.  His papers are always the same format so it is not confusing. He is very helpful and open to providing suggestions on your work. The lectures aren't boring, and he's actually very funny.  He will call you out multiple times to speak so be up to date on the readings (ends up being a good thing for you).

One of the best English professor's I've had. He's well-spoken, and his Northern Irish accent is charming. There's a lot of reading required, (this is an English class, after all) but it's not difficult if you put the work in. I've taken two of his classes: no testsno quizzes and three short papers which need to be well done.

This is for Professor Allison's Text and Context course over Orwell's Nineteen Eighty-Four: Brilliant man; open for discussion among students; nine pages total, if you wish; fascinating subject, and I'm not an English major; will be taking another of his classes as soon as my schedule permits.

I really enjoyed Dr. Allison's 330 class on George Orwell. One of the Funniest people I know and really knows what he teaches. You will leave his classes learning something new everyday. There are assigned essays, but he is very relaxed with deadlines. I recommend his classes to anyone. When you speak, though, be prepared to back up your argument.

Allison can be very funny, in which makes his classes seem interesting at times, he often rambles on about the topic and goes into tangents. He is an unbelievably difficult grader and he will make you feel small and low about your writing. If you have thick skin I say to take it, but I feel as though he is very harsh with his critiques and grading

One of my absolute favorite teachers! He was by far one of the most helpful professors I've ever had. He tells funny stories during class to keep you intrigued and is available for help during office hours. He'll even edit rough drafts and help you get an A. One of my favorite teachers, don't hesitate to take him!

Allison is great. He is really lenient on deadlines for papers and our final exam in this class was take-home. Papers are usually 2-3 pages with a few quizzes scattered throughout the course. Such a fun guy, you won't get bored in his class. Take him if you get the chance!

Dr. Allison is a great guy. You can tell that he thoroughly enjoys what he does and he honestly wants his students to succeed. Come to class prepared to discuss the day's readings (he will call on you!). Chooses extremely interesting books and is incredibly enthusiastic about what you read in class. Definitely take him if you get a chance!

Dr. Allison is a great guy. He loves teaching and you can tell when in class with him. He is so lenient on due dates and an easy grader. He has such a great time in class and is a hilarious old Irish man. Take his class if you ever have the chance. I am taking my second in the fall.

Professor Allison is one of the very few classes that I can truly say that I honestly learned something.  He makes lectures fun and interesting, and is very humorous.  He is a very fair grader and will assist you with your paper beyond expectations!
Professor Allison loves what he does and it shows. He is enthusiastic about his class and is very helpful. He cares about his students and the topics he covers. I enjoyed his class.

Overall, a really great professor. Dr. Allison seems passionate about his work and the text. You are forced to speak during class. He will call on you...so be prepared. The reading load is not too heavy. I'm happy that I took his class.

A great professor. Comes across initially strict, but after showing him that you are willing to work, he will not only help you, but will help you learn all sorts of cool aspects about the subject and he is very understanding. 3 papers, 5 pages each, and great selection of Scottish lit for my Intro to Scots. Lit. class. Grades HARD on wordy papers.
I think those who give bad comments cannot put good amount of time into studying themselves. He is a truly good Professor.
I enjoyed this class a lot.

In the two classes I've had with Dr. Allison, I've grown greatly in my appreciation of lit. in general and poetry in particular.  He assigns a reasonable amt of reading, but be sure to keep up.  He makes careful, thoughtful and helpful comments on papers, and has taught me much about how to lead good discussions about literature.
Very good teacher in the classroom, and very helpful with graduate school applications!

Dr. Allison is a very knowledgable, personable and approachable professor. He has been an asset to UK's English dept. for many years. He is funny and interested in his students' preferences. He even incorporated material from YouTube into our class on 1930's european poets class. I looked forward to attending his lectures.

Dr. Allison is an excellent professor! His classes are engaging and he is very approachable. The reading assignments and papers for his class were also very reasonable. I would highly recommend this professor - He is one of the best at the University of Kentucky!!!

I heard the beauty of the English language. I finally understood what is meant by close reading. I made huge progress in learning how to write, how to organize my thoughts. We had purposeful, thought-provoking class discussions which were fun--I didn't want to miss class. If you have an opportunity to take a class with J.Allison, don't miss it!

Allison is without a doubt my favorite English professor. He always teaches excellent material. He is extreamly helpful in and outside of class and willing to work with you. I would definately recommend taking his classes if you get a chance, you won't regret it.
Dr. Allison is the most helpful and intelligent professor I have met at UK!
No Comments

He's great (pretty funny and has a fun accent) and he knows what he's talking about, but just the structure of his class is as boring as hell. The class makes me feel like im back in grade school. Very repetitive.
No Comments
His classes were the most fun I've had at UK.  He cracks jokes all day and really makes the material interesting. The amount of reading is reasonable; so are the papers. I even bought his book!

Sweet professor. The exams are difficult, especially if your on the online class. On Sunday, you have notes and homework due, and then exams on Wednesdays. Only 4 exams, but they are worth 60% of your grade. She does let you use a cheat sheet on exams which is super helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Brock makes stats so easy! I am not a math person at all but she makes everything extremely accessible. Her tests are also easy and cheat sheets are allowed (yes, even for the final). 10/10! Take her classes if you EVER get the chance.

she is one of the kindest people I have ever met. she wants you to pass. her exams are easy with the right preparation. I am not good at math and she explained it in a way that was easy to understand. she makes stats make sense!

Amazing professor! I was nervous about her BST 230 course because math and statistics are not my strong suit, but her class felt very manageable and straight forward. She is really good at explaining the concepts during lectures, and while attendance is not required, it is super helpful. Lets you have a page (front + back) of notes for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took her class online but she's so helpful and caring when going to her office hours. The class is pretty easy if you stay on task, there's 4-6 assignments per week due on Sundays 11:59pm. Love her lots

Love her! She was always kind and accommodating and always willing to help. Sometimes getting a hold of her is hard, but just follow up and she'll figure it out. Class is easy and you can turn stuff in late if needed and will get credit for it still (thank God). Would recommend her to anyone and actually cares for her students.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Best professor I've ever had. She genuinely cares about her students and is always willing to assist you if you come to office hours. She made me learn how to believe in myself as a student. So kind, caring, and will absolutely do anything she can to help you learn the material.

I took this class online and I did have trouble getting ahold of her multiple times (around 5-7 days for an email response). Once I got ahold of her though she was very kind and caring! She was always willing to help no matter what my situation was. There are a lot of assignments for this class (4-6/week) but they aren't necessarily difficult.
She is a great professor. I took her online class and I would recommend to anyone. Super sweet and her class was very easy to pass if you put in the time

Professor Brock was great, clear grading rubric on every assignment, showed a clear effort in wanting students to succeed, and even provided an option for extra credit when the class did bad on an exam. Very nice lady, would take another class taught by her.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: My 75 min frequently let out 15 minutes early but students could stay to ask questions. There are MANY opportunities for bonus points, if anyone from your table speaks to the class, everyone there gets a point. There are easy homework and easy attendance grades alongside 2 projects, a midterm, and a final. Her accent did not bother me.
She is very nice and caring! Lots of chances for extra credit! The course material can be confusinf because there is so much but she is a good prof
Dr. Karkelanova was a fantastic teacher. She was very understanding and the class is not difficult. If you get a bad grade than that is on you. She is also funny and gives random bonus opportunities.

I took it online it was only an 8 week course. I did have to buy an additional workbook for some of the class homeworks but besides that it was a fast and easy class. Material was explained well and the exam questions were not tricky and were on canvas!

I am truly so grateful that I had Dr. K for STATS296. I genuinely enjoyed this class and made good friends at the table that I sat at. The content is not easy but she makes it easy, also attendance is mandatory but I was never mad to go to this class. Take her if you can!!!!!!!
Good teacher and likes what she's teaching. Very easy class. Must go to class because attendance is apart of your grade. Would suggest taking this class with her.

I have never had a better math teacher at this university. She does our homework with us if we have questions and has a whole day before the exam for review. I like that she has our tests online. Like honestly such a good teacher.

Dr. Karkelanova is AMAZING! She makes the content of this class easy to understand. Every assignment is relevant to what we are learning. Also every exam is open note/book. She really does want all her students to be successful in her class and goes out of her way to make sure students understand the content.
The goat!!!

Dr. Karkelanova is exactly what professors for classes like statistics should be. She teaches the material thoroughly and well, expects attendance, and gives relevant assignments. She also is very understanding about extensions and very willing to work through any problem with you. Exams are open note, open book, can't recommend her enough.

Class was a very easy online part of the term. Exams are open note, and homework has 4 tries on each problem! Take this class with her if you can. Other professors who teach STA296 do not have open-note exams.

I took this class online so I don't know the professor too well but she is easy to reach and really sweet. She is super passionate about statistics. Gives two tries on homework which is helpful for quizzes. Her announcements every week were clear and helpful. Put everything in modules and not assignments which wasn't my favorite but it worked.

Weekly homework, and quizzes. Midterm and one final. One big project. Super easy to take online just don't expect to come out of the course understanding any of it. Rely on your open notes for everything and youll be fine.
STA210 was fine to take online. I wish I tried harder the first few quizzes because now I may not be able to pull off an A. If you take STA210 online, all the answers are on quizzlet.

Professor. Karkelanova is such a great professor. Her accent isn't the best but she tries to make sure that students are learning and understanding the course subject. Her class can be easy, if you study and pay attention (especially with directions). I had great fun time completing the projects. 

I would recommend her class for STA 210.

Very sweet lady and really cares about students. I wish I could give her a better rating but she honestly is not a great teacher and I don't know I nicer way to say that. I rarely understood the material and felt like I had to teach myself. She makes the content as easy as possible though. Lectures are painfully boring and felt useless.

She is an easy grader but there is a lot of homework and she doesn't clearly explain what needs to be done for, lectures, homework, projects, and tests. I would not recommend taking this class if you have a hard time understanding even basic statistics, she doesn't provide insight on how to complete anything.

Dr. Karkelanova is extremely caring of her students. She is always checking her emails and is always happy to answer any question you may have. Exams have so many questions that they become easy. Her accent is not as bad as a lot of people say. As long as you go to class and follow along, you will do great in her classes. I absolutely recommend her

The class is so hard to explain. You can go to class and try and pay attention and you will still be confused. Her accent makes her hard to understand, and she goes over a lot of stuff that is not even on the exams. I would take this class with caution, it is not bad but you are basically trying to teach yourself every topic. s

I appreciate Dr. Karkelanova's class, but would not recommend this class to anyone who does not like math, as there are many homework assignments, group projects, and individual projects, as well as 2 exams, that are on paper with most of the answers being free response.We are not really prepared in class to take the exam and she moves quick.

Dr. Karkelanova is a great professor, but it is often difficult to understand what she's saying due to her accent. A lot of her class feels like busy work, but attendance is checked and monitored. However, all of the homework and quizzes are online with only two in-person exams, which I appreciated.

For someone who hates math, I actually enjoyed this class. She obviously cares about what she teaches and is super nice and understanding. Attendance is mandatory, but the class itself is not hard. As long as you do the homework and study for the tests, you will get an A.

When I was looking at STA professors to take Dr K is one of the best and most easygoing. She is no doubt super sweet and starts every class with a Stats joke. The work for her class was in my opinion very difficult and super long, almost all of her homework assignments were over 50 points each, and her tests and projects were graded heavily.

I was so worried about statistics, but couldn't be happier with my experience in Ms. Karkelanova's class over the summer intersession. The exams were weighted pretty heavy, and the wording on some of the questions made them confusing at times, but as long as you do well on the homework and quizzes, you'll do fine.

Dr. Karkelanova was a delight! She's easygoing and laidback. I took AP Statistics in high school and hated it, but this class wasn't bad at all. Just keep up with the homework and quizzes, and you'll be fine. My only advice is to pick a good table at the start of class. We had assigned seats and there's a group project that's worth a large portion.

She is a very nice professor! If you don't understand something, she is great at helping you out. She gives lots of chances for bonus points! I took AP Stats in highschool and found her course to be very easy.
She is great. Super sweet and supportive, and will make sure you fully understand everything. Homework is all on Quizlet, and there are extra credit opportunities for each class.

She is great! But if you are taking STA210, prioritize having an online section, the instructor does not matter that much. Attendance is mandatory so got to be there tice a week in person at 9am and exams are in person and paper. If you have the chance, take it with her but your top1 priority should be taking it online.

She is the best!! SO sweet and kind. Definitely a good class if you are bad at/dislike math in general. She gives thorough explanations and is super willing to offer help outside of class time. Lots of homework, but nothing unbearable.

Dr. Karkelanova was an outstanding teacher! I am terrible at math but she was so helpful with everything. She accepts late work, has a lot of group projects, and homework is ALL on Quizlet. Attendance was mandatory but you get extra points for coming to class sometimes!

Attendance is mandatory but she tries to make class interesting. You get to pick your table for the semester but you do all your quizzes and projects with your table. If you participate in class out get extra credit on tests for your group. You'll have weekly homework but its all on Quizlet and isn't too hard.

Pretty good experience with Dr K. Her accent is thick so it can be hard to understand her at times, but not often. Each week had homeowkr problems and a quiz. The projects had vague grading criteria, but exams weren't bad. Good experience overall.

Dr. Karkelanova is probably my favorite professor I have had so far. Attendance is extremely mandatory. However, I was given a lot of bonus points for having 100% attendance. There are also a ton of opportunities in lectures to receive bonus points for the midterm and final. So if you show up to class you will likely succeed in this course.
class set up is she teaches you about the concept then you guys do examples together as a class to make sure you all understand! shes a really sweet and funny professor

Professor Karkelanova is a really sweet lady! Her teaching style is really easy to follow for those who are not that great at math. There are several projects that do take awhile but are pretty simple. The exams are a bit hard but you will find that with any math class. She is super funny and very understanding!

Dr. Karkelanova is a very empathetic professor who realizes most of her students are not STEM majors (she doesn't make you memorize equations). Her class is pretty easy so long as you pay attention during her lectures. However, she is not the best at explaining concepts one-on-one. My advice is to pick a good table.

She is super sweet and really wants you to do well in her class but is not the best or most clear teacher. I could not pay attention in class because she is just so hard to follow sometimes. I had to teach myself almost everything before the test. Class isn't impossible tho. Super sweet and understanding professor but not the clearest in my opinion
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: she was an awesome teacher. i didnt really listen in class like i shouldve, so i ended with a B in the class. was still a very easy course. grades are mostly homework and group projects, so do all your homework, go to class, and pick a good table and youll be set!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: My fav professor during my first semester. She does have an accent which is kinda hard to understand. She is so sweet and just wants you to pass her class. I barely studied and still made above 85s on tests. Attendance is a 5 point grade but ive skipped a few and it didnt hurt my grade much.

One of the most caring people I've ever met. I had her for UK CORE so I'm not sure how she is during a real class. But she wants everyone to succeed and do their best in her class, she provided me several extensions without a big penalty. She just wants to see her students happy.

Karkelenova was my favorite professor my first semester at UK. She is very caring, and a nice lady. Class attendance is taken almost everyday, so make sure to be there. Test are the hardest aspect of the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: She seems very kind in class, but 1-on-1 she is a bit dismissive and unfriendly. You will need to do work outside of the class to understand the material. I had high hopes from the reviews, but my experience was just "fine." You should strategically plan which table you sit at on the first day, because you will be working with those people forever.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Im not sure what happened but I heard amazing reviews but it was bad. Her class was really hard and everyone was struggling. I dropped out of the class. Her accent made it really hard to understand her but she tries her best (you can tell). She is supper sweet but Im not sure why it was so hard. Maybe because it was the semester after covid?

Karkelanova is super sweet and is good at explaining the content at hand. Attendance was only mandatory once or twice a month, and the rest were asynchronous. Make sure you do all the homework and reading, otherwise you'll find it hard understanding what's going on. The only thing was communicating with her was kinda hard via email.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: She was a great professor. I would recommend her over any other STA 210 professor. She gives so much extra credit, it makes the class hard to fail. She is kinda weird, but she loves stats and she always ends class early. Would highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Did I learn stats ? No. Did I get a 97% in the class ? You bet. This class is so easy, you have to learn a tiny bit of material but you can EASILY get an A.

LOVED MS. K! My favorite professor this semester. She is really sweet and just wants all of her students to do well. Show up to class, participate as much as you can (she gives out bonus points like candy even when you're wrong!), do the homework and you will be golden.

I loved this class even though I was not a fan of the material. She made class enjoyable and understandable. She does give homework almost every night though so be prepared for that. My favorite part about the class is how much extra credit she gave out, almost everyday you could get bonus points. You also take a few group pop quizzes so show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Mrs. K is an awesome professor, her class was easy for me even though I suck at math I passed with an A! Required course but taught in real world situations. 3 tests only 15% and so many daily assignments and extra credit it's HARD to FAIL her class! She is also hilarious in her questions and gives students the tools to succeed!

It would be really hard to fail this class. Mrs. K is super sweet, and she is very helpful. She gives so much bonus out like its candy. The content is really not difficult at all. Attendance is mandatory, so make sure you show up to class, pay attention, and do the workbook assignments. Would definitely take this class again in a heartbeat.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Ms. K. is the sweetest stats teacher I could ever ask for! I'm terrible at math (took MA 111 before this) and passed this class with a 98%. She always gives a lot of extra credit and grades easily. She is very helpful and encourages you to try your best even if you are unsure of your abilities. Take her!
She is so nice and gives a lot of extra credit and bonus opps! She wants you to succeed, and she cares a lot. Def a good teacher for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is one of the best professors I had here at UK. You can easily get an A if you just come to class and pay attention, even if you are not good at math.

Take STA210 with Mrs. K!! She makes it so easy and is a great professor. She is also always happy to help in any way she can. There is plenty of bonus opportunities throughout the semester too. You would have to try to fail

this was the easiest math class I have ever taken. she is very nice and will do anything to give out good grades. there was extra credit opportunities for almost all exams. homework is for completion and exams are fairly easy. she does give out a lot of points for attendance so make sure you go to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is by far one of the best professors I have had so far. She makes her teaching as simple as possible for understanding. Attendance is 5 points per day so do not skip

There is homework every night but it's very easy. As long as you do homework and show up to class, you should do well on exams. There are three projects, all very easy. Teaching is very clear and there is plenty of chance for extra credit. It's not a hard class at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She explains things super simply in class but doesn't upload a single powerpoint or example to canvas. She is helpful in class and exams are easy. Just show up to class everyday and kinda pay attention and you'll get an A.

This class was relatively easy as long as you showed up to class and payed attention. Attendance is absolutely necessary and there were often random pop quizzes worth lots of points. Ms. Karkelanova is super nice and understanding but her class seems a little unorganized at times. It's an easy A as long as you put the effort in!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: if you have to take STA210 take this professor. She is so worth waking up for an 8am because her class is painless. She makes the material easy to understand and really cares about her students.
She made stats a breeze. Sit with good people because you will work in groups plenty and having a good group makes the class easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: You have to come to class, however, she's really nice, gives plenty of extra credit, and makes STA painless. She genuinely cares. English is her second language, but she is clear, and catches herself if she makes a mistake. If you show up, do the daily homework, and participate in class, you'll get an A.

Probably like many of you, I'm not good at math what so ever. I was pretty nervous about taking STA 210. I was recommended to Ms. K because I heard she was the only good STA 210 professor. I passed STA210 because of her. She tries her hardest for you to understand and gives a lot of extra credit in class. I loved having her and one of my favorites
Nice lady for sure. The way she lectures is just the basis of what you need to know and usually it helps but you need to complete your homework correctly and just study before exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She makes stats as fun as she can make it and gives away extra credit like crazy. Highly recommend!

Mrs. K is easily one of the sweetest professors there is! She is always willing to help! This class was pretty simple and she taught you in the simplest way possible. She's very funny and loves to help students learn more about stats! Definitely recommend!!!

Love Mrs. K! So sweet! I usually can't stand math because I'm not the best at it but she makes it easy to understand. She gives a fair amount of extra credit too which helps. Don't take this course if you are the type of person to miss a lot of class, because you only have 1 unexcused absence! (8 ams are death so take this class in the afternoon)

Professor Karkelanova makes a mandatory class a positive and knowledgeable experience. By far the most important way to be successful is to complete the study guide before each Test. Also attendance is taken each class for easy points and expect nightly homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Lots of extra credit and you will have homework after every class,  3 exams 10% 15% 20%  pay attention in class there r 3 projects put some time and work for the second project coz this is what matters most to her you will need to buy the book she cares a lot about her students  do what she tell you and you gonna get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I really liked Prof. Karkelanova. Math doesn't come easily to me, so I was really nervous to take STA210. However, Karkelanova does a good job of explaining things and, from what I've heard from my friends, is much better than the other stats professors. Warning- attendance is weighed pretty heavy, so make sure you go to class!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Easily my favorite teacher so far at UK.  I had her first year of Stats 296 and she taught the material great. She doesn't try to trick you with anything, and is super nice and funny.  If you forgot to do something or were unable to do something go talk to her.  She's cool about it and will most likely give you credit unlike most teachers.

Mrs. K is, in my opinion, the best professor for STA210 at UK. I didn't know anything about statistics before taking this class, and was able to get an A by attending class, paying attention, and doing the homework. I never really had to study for the tests (there are three), because she always provides the formulas you need for each exam.

Mrs. K is one of my favorite professors I have had at UK so far. I really hate math and statistics so I dreaded this class, but she makes things super easy to understand and  I feel as if I now have a better appreciation for the class. Her English is pretty good, she's super fun, and really enjoys teaching.

I loved her! She did great job teaching in a large lecture hall. Her lectures were clear and included several examples. She clearly indicated what would be on the tests, and the tests were not very difficult. Compared to other STA 210 sections, I think we used CPR minimally (only 3 assignments). Would definitely recommend.

Her class was a breeze, there are a lot of short, easy assignments and a few projects.  The projects are easy A's if you follow the criteria and correctly grade your classmates using CPR.  Gives good reviews the day before the exam, so go even through attendance those days isn't mandatory. Recitation was a waste, the TAs are too hard to understand

Here's the advice that I wish I was given before taking Mrs. Karkelanova: 1. This class is super easy. I got an A and barely studied. 2. There is homework every night but is easy and takes less than 10 min. 3. She gives EASY extra credit for your exams. 4. Do all of the homework because it will add up at the end of the semester

Takes her time explaining concepts and incorporates fun activities. Attendance counts and is a way to get easy grade boosters. Give lots of opportunities for extra credit by answering questions in class. Accent a little hard to understand at times, but overall great experience.

Mrs. K is very sweet and knows her stuff! Her lectures usually let out ten minutes early and recitation usually lets out 15-30 minutes early. Try to get her as both your lecture and recitation teacher because it will help you in the long run. She's great! Attendance is 5 points per lecture, but it won't kill you if you have to miss a few.
homework every night, even if its not that hard. she's very sweet, but is confusing sometimes
Supportive and attentive. Knows her stuff.
Shes an amazing teacher. Module 3 is hard and made me end up with a C in a class. You will do busy work. She is not really helpful.

The class is fair and professor Karkelanova is fair in her teaching and grading. An A is very attainable. Remember to watch All the videos and do all the homework.  Also, take the projects seriously. They're worth alot!
She is a very good lecturer. Just make sure you attend classes and watch the videos.

Saved my butt! Dropped a couple of assignments and made it possible for me to receive a B the week that grades were posted. Hard to understand her sometimes but she is very nice. Be consistent from the beginning and you should have no problems.

Professor K is the best. She's Russian and has a hard time pronouncing some words but there isn't a problem understanding her. She is funny and SUPER helpful. As long as you listen in class you are almost guaranteed an A.  The test are really easy and she posts a review w/ answers a week before. She ends class early a lot which is great!

He is a wonderful professor who loves the content he teaches. The exams are difficult but he only writes a few questions, so it is not really his fault. Go to his office hours, he will do anything to help you understand. 107 is hard but Dr. Nunez is your best bet at succeeding.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Nunez makes Gen Chem manageable. He really knows his stuff, and it shows when he's teaching. He's able to break down complex concepts into digestible chunks. He does assign quiet a bit of work, but he only does it so you really understand it. Considering most of the alternatives, if he's not available I would wait or take Gen Chem elsewhere.
Style of teaching will get you through the exams, he's awesome. The chem exams are evil by default so the fact that his way of teaching reflects the exams really well makes the class easy.

He genuinely wants you to learn. He is extremely knowledgeable. His classes are often a flipped style with video lectures and practice in class. There is a decent amount of homework but it is not abnormal. The homework is always beneficial in understanding the skill. He doesn't want his time or yours to be wasted.

Dr. Nunez was an amazing professor. I had already taken AP chem and there were some things I didn't understand, but the way he taught it helped me to understand. I was in the honors section, so we did have a final group project but it was honestly so easy. There was a lot of homework but it honestly took like an hour to do. Flipped classroom.
An okay prof he was chill I almost failed tho

Almost failed the class, asked for help, and was denied and told to "figure it out," or I wouldn't do well on the exams. Grades are unfair, he doesn't curve, and he isn't willing to help. Would NOT take again. Was also brought in front of the board because over half of his 350+ student class either dropped out or failed out.

One of the most organized classes I've ever taken in my entire life. Make sure you go to class as participation is graded and lectures are important even if you're watching the pre-lecture videos. Tests aren't too bad except for the third test + final if you don't review enough. Dr. A is great!

I rarely showed up and barely got a B. Don't do what I did, it is not worth the stress cramming before exams. Show up to class, more importantly watch the pre lecture videos, his lectures are not beneficial if you don't do so. This is the most content packed 4 credit course UK has to offer.

I loved Dr. Nunez. I had a lot of questionable professors this semester and let me tell you he was my best professor by FAR. He can be a little intimidating but he truly does want the best for everyone taking the class. I would also say you should absolutely go to lectures they help TREMENDOUSLY especially on test days because he does a review.

When I took 109 freshman year, I honestly didn't love Nunez simply because the class was hard and I blamed him. Now that I'm taking 107 with another professor, I would do anything to have Nunez's teaching back. He actually teaches how to calculate problems, and the reverse classroom method actually works bc he just goes through examples in class
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is really funny but wants you to participate. He will wait for you to answer when he asks questions during lectures. He's great, though.

The exams will affect your grade so much, especially the final. He's a good professor though, the class is very lecture heavy. Attendance matters a lot, you will be graded on in class assignments and he uses iClicker.
Like most, studying outside of class is recommended in order to pass. His explanations are easy to follow but a tad quick paced. A good professor.

class made me switch my major knowing i would fail. don't even bother emailing him it feels like talking to an ex that has me blocked. explains things in a way more difficult way than it needs to be yet doesn't give any context at the same time. tests are hard and has you staring blankly at the screen
Great professor. Somewhat difficult class if you do not take the time to go over content outside of class.  He explains the easiest way to memorize the content.

He was a very clear instructor, attendance in lectures AND recitation is mandatory as you have an iClicker quiz at the end of most lectures. The content does get hard but there are prep videos due the night before each class to help you get a good understanding of what you'll be looking at. Exams are similar to in class material.
He was good at making class fun and entertaining
Funniest prof at UK. Great at explaining material. Anyone who says otherwise is not very smart or did not watch the videos.

You have to watch playposits before class which SUCK but his lectures are very engaging. CHE 107 is just a really difficult class, but Nunez does a great job explaining tough concepts. His humor is a little rude tho, I once went to his office hours for help and rather than helping me bro just made fun of me, but hey some people like that idk.

If you do not take the time to watch the notes you WILL struggle, but if you pay attention you will be fine. Dr. Nunez is an amazing professor and I learned a lot from his class. He can be intimidating, but don't be afraid to ask questions. The exams are very hard, I highly suggest using the practice worksheets and old exams to study.

This is a difficult course, but Dr. Nunez is a very funny and caring professor. He teaches as a flipped classroom, which is very helpful. I was in the honors section, and we had a group project where we had to write a procedure to identify salts based on what we had learned. It was pretty easy to do. I would 100% recommend him to anyone taking 107.

He was the reason I got an A in chemistry. He explains everything with a lot of detail and cares about helping. Before exams he'll do review sessions for just his students and always offers office hours. He's a little scary at first but he cares a lot about having students being successful in the class.

He was my favorite this semester. Chemistry is so hard and boring, but he makes it more enjoyable than it is. After lecture, you'll do a 2-4 question iclicker assignment and he will help if you need it. So nice and so funny.
He can come off intimidatin g but he explains math and calculations pretty well. HE will explain things to you if you're confused you just have to not be intimidated.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Nunez is honestly a sweet guy. He is always willing to help and give advice. The reason for my lower rating is simply the teaching style; he uses a "flipped" classroom method which doesn't jive with me at all. I had to teach myself almost everything because class-time consisted of 3 practice problems & a quiz.

I literally don't know where to start. I had him my first semester of my freshman year. Let's just say he was on of my favorites. He is funny during lecture which is handy while sitting for that long. Along with this, he held office hours multiple hours a week open for questions or concerns.  I would say the material was reflective of the exams.
Wasn't the best at teaching and just straight up rude

Although the class can be difficult, I think that Dr. Nunez does a great job at preparing students. When you make time to talk to him, he will give you tips/ advice for the exams. Compared to the other chemistry professors I've had, Nunez made chemistry the most understandable.
rude, not helpful, awful experience.

I loved this class. There's a lot of playposits and achieves but they were grade boosters and helped a lot with learning the material. The lectures are great and very helpful. He is very responsive. I enjoyed this class and would like to have him as a professor again.

I learned a lot in his class and thought he was a great teacher. I retained the information really well. However, his exams are a lot harder than my current chem professor's exams. I was able to get an A due to the final. The class was hard, but definitely not impossible! Just study and put in the work, and you should be fine.

Well, Nunez may come off as mean and not understanding students' issues, but his teaching ability is outstanding. He's very clear in his lectures. I thoroughly enjoyed his flipped classroom teaching style. If you have the opportunity to take him as a professor for this class, I highly recommend him.

One of the few decent profs for gen chem. He uses a flipped classroom & the homework is significantly harder than the tests, but if you understand the homework you will do well on the tests. His lectures are straightforward and easy to understand, though sometimes the in class worksheets can drag. Pay attention and do the work and you can succeed!

Nunez helped me so much. Even when I wasn't in his class anymore. His door is always open and he cares about his students. He's the only reason I've done well in chemistry and I would gladly take his class again. Very good professor and supportive person.
Dr. Nunez cares so much about his students, and truly loves teaching. His class is definitely hard, but he's willing to help if you reach out and he's super helpful!!
Dr. Nunez set up his class to be much more difficult than the exams, however, his class is quite work heavy, requiring pre-lecture videos, in-lecture quizzes, and in-lecture worksheets.

Dr. Nunez is a nice person and always welcomes questions during lectures. Sometimes he is hard to understand but overall this was not an issue. Put in the work outside of class and you will be fine because he covers all the content you need to know for the exams. Try to take his classes if possible.

This course is flipped style so you watch a video before class and do a worksheet with him during lecture. Then you have an online assignment due about a week later. You will easily succeed if you watch the video and don't do the assignments last minute. I did better in this class than I did in my honors chem in high school. Nunez is 11/10

Nunez was a very good chemistry professor! I felt that he taught well with lots of detail. He taught it in reverse by having us watch videos the night before our lectures which truly helps you learn more about the topics. He also did a very good job at preparing us for the exams and I felt his grading scale was fair.

It is a flipped classroom model, meaning you are expected to have an idea of the material before lecture. The playposits are relatively vague, but he is in-depth with his lectures. The hw is exponentially more difficult than the exams. The practice worksheets help a lot. You should pass this class if you do EVERYTHING you are expected to.
You learn online and then during class go over what you learned. Its confusing and hard to follow along. Exams were hard

Your homework will ne slides about the topic and he will do a worksheet in class with you. I found it difficult to ask questions because sometimes he'd completely ignore you. The achieves were 10x harder. You learn new topics a day or two before the exam and are expected to know it.

Dr. Nunez is a great teacher if you like visuals and detailed explanation. He runs a flipped style classroom which means you will learn most of the material on videos that are posted for you to watch outside of class then go over video material deeper during lecture. Dr. Nunez is flexible with office hours and is good at answering your questions.
I came into college not knowing anything about chemistry, but Dr. Nunez turned that around. He's super funny and I loved his lectures!

This class was my worst enemy. Chemistry is hard enough as it is and he just makes it even harder. He is not very helpful in class and will get mad at the class when they do not respond, he will look over your shoulder and makes fun of you/ make you try and feel dumb. The iclicker attendance he does is pointless. Overall not a good time.

He's just unnecessarily rude and not helpful at all. He'll look over your shoulder and try to rudely make comments about my work instead of helping where the issue is. His videos are very vague and he over complicates a lot.

HW playposits are supposed to follow into the lectures, but Dr. Nunez's videos were so vague and in-descriptive, they didn't help me learn, visualize, or grasp our material. Therefore in lectures, he would passively solve 4/10 problems on a worksheet, and then send you off to complete the rest for attendance (I got a B with the other che professor)

The lecture heavy part of this course is online PlayPosit lectures. LOTS of in class practice with worksheets reflecting test questions. Take the practice exams, do the extra worksheets, go to office hours, and you will be just fine. Dr. Nunez is hilarious and loves giving experiment demos with student participation to reinforce concepts.

He was a good professor. He helped me understand the material better than my last professor, to be clear have taken this course twice now, I previously had Presnell, and now I had Nunez, as a personal preference Nunez helped me understand clearer. If I had to take the class again I would definitely get Nunez.

Nunez is a difficult individual. He is very stubborn on what he believes is correct, even if you have proof/sources to show he is not. I was in the honors section so the experiments were often extremely difficult but he would give the smallest hints for help. The class is not that bad, but attendance seems pointless

Dr Nunez was one of my favorite professors of all time. He made chemistry fun for someone who struggled in it, which is saying a lot. He comes off as serious, but he is compassionate and very willing to help his students. He teaches using a flipped classroom and does a lot of demos!
will be retaking

His lectures are basically pointless unless you need a little help with practice problems. He likes to over explain things from the play posit videos which gets annoying. He also is kind of taunting and if you get something wrong he will force you to figure it out instead of actually helping.
he uses a flipped lecture style that i looooved!! he has a dry sense of humor but wants everyone to succeed. I love him and will miss not having him as a professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He can be very intimating at first but his class is very enjoyable. He uses lots of examples and visual representations which I found helpful. He's a really funny guy too. I would go to office hours for sure

I absolutely loved having Dr. A for CHE105. His swapped teaching style really helped me remember the content. That being said, if you have no background in chemistry, it is going to be tough. He will absolutely work with you to help you learn, but being a weed-out class you will struggle if you haven't already had chemistry in high school.

Dr.Nunez makes you watch videos outside of class and then he does a worksheet during class. i found that this was extremely hard to learn from because i felt like i had to teach myself all of the material. i also think that the tests were very different from what we were learning in class,

He's very funny and makes class fun. Gives good feedback when you have questions. Interns were amazing too. Chemistry isn't easy, but he is a great professor. He really wants the best for his students.
Great teacher. Very helpful. Quite personal and a little funny. Overall my one of my favorite professors.

Dr. Nunez is a great professor, but also seems like a good person in general. He provides clear teaching and is willing to help his students. Not to mention, he's also pretty funny. He always walks through the class to answer questions, instead of just making the interns do everything. He is very involved and overall an excellent 
 instructor.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. A is a great professor that is really good at explaining chemistry and, in his own words, "making students hate chemistry less." He is good at making sure we know exactly the kinds of problems that will be on exams. He is also accessible, friendly, and caring. As far as the workload goes, it will be the same for every section of CHE105.

He is the best. He still tutors me in CHE 107 and even the lab, and he's not even my professor anymore. He doesn't pretend he's "inaccessible" like most chem professors, he goes above and beyond to ensure the success of his students. If you want to pass CHE, pray you have Nunez or Woodrum. If not, I wouldn't even take the course. 10/10 professor.
I actually hated this class

This man is so funny and truly an exception to the standard professor. The course itself is very difficult to grasp but the way his class is set up with reverse lecture style honestly really helped me learn CHE 105 this semester.

Tough guy persona, but good guy. Big soft teddy bear, you might say. His lectures sometimes aren't the best and he beats around the bush until telling you what you actually need to know, but a great guy. One of the best CHE105 professors so take him

I loved the way the class was set up with lecture videos outside of class and then practice problems during the actual lecture time. I felt prepared to do homework and for the exams and he was able to explain some difficult concepts in a way that made it make sense! I really appreciated what he did for the class!

Dr. Nunez is a good teacher. He teaches with a flipped classroom style, which I liked. It was not difficult to do well in his class if you put effort into taking notes, and paying attention in class. As long as you prepare for the exams, you should do just fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Nunez was a great professor! I recommend doing some extra work outside of the class to succeed like going to office hours, the study, and review sessions. I could have received a better grade in this class if I had gotten help from the beginning. Also don't miss class if possible, graded by attendance and it can help you out in the end.

He is entertaining but not very helpful when it comes to teaching. Content comes from video lectures and classes are spent going over a worksheet. The actual class feels useless other than he sometimes makes funny jokes. Definitely take advantage of office hours, the GCLC, and The Study. Recitation is somewhat helpful.

I genuinely enjoyed his playposits(video lectures). At first, I was not a fan of this concept, but Nunez's use of them is done well. The worksheets and answer keys to the problems done in class are posted before every exam and are helpful when studying. These focus heavily on math, so memorization/concept questions must be done on your own time.

Nunez is a really good professor. He teaches through videos you watch on your own time and has you work on problems in class. The videos are pretty in depth and can be sped up to 2x speed. The problems worked on in class are similar to what's on the exams, but there is a bit more of an emphasis on concepts on the exams. He responds to emails quick.

i loved dr. nunez. he ran a flipped classroom so we watched videos outside of class and did worksheets in class. his teaching style was perfect for me and i used in class to practice active recall. i think he is the best che prof!!

Dr. Nunez is a very nice person. He genuinely cares about his students and wants them to do well. However, I was not a fan of his teaching style. Online lecture videos were to be watched before class, sometimes near an hour long. With other classes and homework, this was very time consuming. It reminded me of virtual learning, not a fan of it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Behind the tough guy persona, Professor Nunez cares about his students and their success. He puts more effort into making sure his students understand the content than most professors I've had for large classroom lectures like this. I would take him over most other options.

Honestly, if you want to succeed in the UK Chemistry department do not take Nunez. He uses online lectures that are not clear at all. The class time is spent doing worksheets. He does not teach nearly the amount that the other chemistry profs do.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
I dropped out of the class because I didn't take it seriously the first time.

But, with what I had saw so far he seemed like a decent professor. The class will mainly be watching videos before the lecture, and the actual "lecture" will be just going over a worksheet. The videos help though. He's an alright professor. 

A decent pick.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He is an amazing teacher! While his class is hard because it is Chemistry, he does a good job at trying to make it engaging and his discussions in class really help you understand the play posits. He is very accessible and helps go over things you do not understand after class and during review before each test. Take him for chemistry!!
Take Nunez at ALL costs. He makes the class a bit more engaging with in-class experiments. The playposits are tough but the in-class discussions help understand them.
The class was only difficult because I had never taken chem before. Watching the playposits really helps get through the class. Nunez is also a fun and cool teacher. TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN.

The class is almost entirely weighted by exams, so if you take the class, start preparing for exams almost immediately. The content is not the worst, but the class moves very quickly. Professor Nunez prefers to use lecture outside out class and worksheet within class, so skip homework or cheat and you are not passing.

He prefers flipped classroom (watch lectures on your own time, do worksheets in class). He's a little egotistical, but if you really put in the work, you will do fine. For the love of god, use the practice tests!! They're on the UK Chem website. Get used to the style of questions because they are not easy. Not terrible for UKY Chemistry. Solid 5/10

Pros: Worksheets are helpful for studying. Dr. Nunez presents everything needed for the exams, and his video lectures are well made. 
Cons: Dr. Nunez has no respect for students. He is very condescending. Do not ask him questions, answer questions in class, or go to office hours unless you like being humiliated.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nunez is nothing special. Pretty average professor and the for the most part I understood the content being taught. The most difficult thing I would say about learning from him is just trying to understand what he's saying with his difficult accent. Be prepared to spend multiple hours doing homework for this course. Overall, he's mediocre.

Dr. Nunez was not a particularly bad professor, he just tends to focus a lot of time and effort on math only. Exams in this class make up the entirety of your grade and are very difficult. Dr. A has no control over the difficulty of the exams, though. Overall, he is a solid professor who could afford to take a few notes from Dr. Woodrum.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I love Dr.A! He works so hard to help you succeed and genuinely cares about each of his students. I attended his office hours and he immediately learned my name and frequently checked in on me. When I missed a class he checked to make sure I was ok. This class is hard but he makes it manageable. Take him if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you want to do nothing but watch someone do chemistry algebra, then by all means take this man. But, if you want to learn the content to pass the course, Id consider someone else. He only knows how to do math and thats all he will do is math, and then maybe with a little extra math, but not even completely show you how to do the math.

The class can be tough if you never took AP Chem, but if you did it is just like the second semester of that. Nunez is a caring professor and is always there to answer questions outside of class. The class is flipped so there is more opportunity to ask questions during the work time than in other classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Great proffessor.
