I had Dr. A for CHE 105 and 107 and really liked him, and this semester I was one of his interns for CHE 109. This man could not be more understanding. He cares about how you're doing in the course and will do anything to help you. The courses are difficult, but I'd gladly recommend him to any new student.

Dr. Nunez was the hardest professor that I have ever had. It was almost impossible to get a good grade on anything because he does not teach. Graded a lot on playposits which I do not think is fair. The material on the exam is not like it is on the exam prep sheets. Take another professor if you have the option

He makes all the lectures online then you go to class the next day and do a worksheet. The class goes really fast so its easy to get lost and get caught behind. He isn't a huge help if you ask for help in class, he'll look at you like you're dumb. I would personally choose a different prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: If you have the option to pick a different chem professor, do it! Ive never struggled with science until I had him. He is very smart but teaches extremely fast. You dont learn anything in class, just lecture videos outside of class for homework. He can be a nice person but if youre struggling he will look at you like youre stupid.

In all honesty, Dr. Nunez is a decent teacher. He is smart and has some good lectures. After having Dr. Peters previously though, it is hard for anyone to even hold a pin to her teaching abilities. He was good but this is a tough class. It is much harder than CHE 105 is my opinion as well. You will need to focus on this class a lot to do well.

Dr. Nunez is a good professor to have for a difficult class. Personally, I thought he was nice and understanding, and if you participate in class, he will be easily accessible to you outside of class. Lectures are helpful, and you should definitely do office hours if you're struggling. Explains very thoroughly.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The professor will not email back and doesnt do much preparation for tests and finals. Take advantage of other teachers content that they post on Canvas
This professor made me want to drop out of college entirely. If you can avoid taking him then do so, especially while its all online. I had to teach myself via google because he didnt do lectures.

Dr. Nunez was a great professor for this class. He put effort into his lecture videos, and explained everything clearly. He was also quick to respond to questions outside of class. This class is very test heavy, so make sure you put in time to watch lectures, take notes, and study!

This class is terrible. He wasn't very good at explaining things so basically have to teach myself. Tests had questions that were not taught nor were like questions asked on lectures or homework. Basically be prepared to use youtube to help you understand the content because the prerecorded definitely does not help.

You'll be teaching yourself this class. He turned all of his class time into office hours this semester, so there were no lectures. There are always at least five assignments a week that you'll have to teach yourself how to do. The exam reviews barely match the actual exam content. Your book will be your bestie.
Not bad, reading the textbook helped a lot
Very bad teaching.

you could barely understand him at some points. he tries to do funny things at the beginning of class to show what were learning but it didn't help. good luck trying to receive an email back or canvas message bc he doesn't respond. I changed my major because they made an intro class so hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dont go to class. You will only learn on exam review days. Ive taken 5 chemistry classes and have received an A in every one but this one. He didnt care about teaching.

Professor Nunez is probably one of the sweetest professors Ive had so far. Im kind of sad that this school year got cut short, and I only had him for a short amount of time. The course does require a lot of work outside of class,but theyre all doable as long as you pay attention to lectures and watch the playposits. Very considerate with grades!

Dr. Nunez was very helpful in making chemistry easy to understand. He worked out lots of example questions which helped a lot when preparing for tests. Overall, he made class very fun and made a really hard subject a lot easier.

Dr. A is a great professor. He makes lecture fun and cracks a lot of jokes. I could understand where people have trouble understanding his accent, but I didn't have any trouble. CHE 105 is a really hard class, but he tries to help as much as he can. The tests are hard (beware exam 3) but he doesn't make them, the CHE department does.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: My rating of Professor Nunez is heavily impacted by the immense homework/work load required outside of class. There is online homework nearly every day and it really adds up if you are also taking other challenging courses. Also. no offense to Professor Nunez, at times it can be very difficult to understand what he is saying due to his accent.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very caring person but hard to understand sometimes.

Dr. Nunez got frustrated with us for not picking things up easily. He eventually asked for feedback and apologized to us which made things much better. He tried to show he cared about us but he was still very unapproachable and no one wanted to ask him questions. There was little homework and exams were hard. He means well but is intimidating.

Nunez is a decent guy but he is very hard to understand in a big lecture setting. He is really smart so I think he has a hard time teaching those that don't get it Chem right away. Towards the end of the semester I started skipping class and teaching myself because I couldn't follow him in class.

He is not good at explaining things and can be very sarcastic and even rude at times. He doesn't seem to grasp the fact that some people need more time to understand the material. He can be somewhat funny, but I'd rather have a very serious but good professor compared to one that can't seem to teach very well at all.

Andres knows a lot about chemistry but just isn't good at explaining it. His attendance is mandatory, even though you get much more out of studying on your own. He has a slight accent but speaks English very well. He's not accessible outside of class and never answers his emails. Tests are the majority of your grade and can be very difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is a very funny guy that knows a lot about chemistry. Sometimes his lectures became confusing and hard to sit through but he always tried to make sure everyone knew what was going on. Overall, good professor that is available for his students.

Dr. Nunez is a great guy. His teaching style isn't for everyone and he can sometimes be difficult to understand, but if you try to sit in the front and actually pay attention during lecture you will be fine. This is a difficult course but Dr. Nunez wants all of his students to succeed and is very helpful during office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Nunez is funny and makes a hard class as fun s it can be. At the end of the semester he did a magic trick just for fun. He really tries to make chemistry enjoyable which is pretty hard. I would take him for chem 107 one hundred percent. I probably would have failed this class if I had another professor.

Nunez is a really nice guy and a great lecturer. I disagree with the complaints about his accent, I think his teaching is clear and organized. Past exam questions are worked out in class. I would recommend trying not to miss class often because the subject can be difficult BUT Nunez does a great job posting lectures online for if you do.
He has a thick accent. He only reads off the slides. Take someone else. You might as well stay at home and read the slides.

Dr Nunez is one of the better chemistry professors I've had. He really takes time during lecture to go over material instead of just flying through it. There is a lot of backlash for how hard this class is. Dr. Nunez is a good option for CHE 107! He is very willing to explain things to students and will work with you in office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He has a thick accent that makes learning difficult. He only reads off the slides. Take someone else.

Dr. A is a great professor. He gets a lot of backlash because of how difficult the course is. He is very willing to work with a student after class hours to help them succeed and doesn't rush through information in class. He wants to make sure students understand material. Also, he's funny.

Not a very good professor at all!!!! Yells at is the whole class if nobody answers our questions and calls us dumb! Doesn't explain important things very thoroughly and spends way too much time on simple concepts that ends up confusing you more than when he started. Lectures and notes are laid out very weirdly and doesn't like to help students.
Great guy, has a very thick accent but hes is still very understandable. One of the few lectures I actually enjoy going to, despite the 250+ people class size.

For being foreign, he is pretty easy to understand and I think his lectures featured important content. From what I've heard of other chemistry professors at UK, I think he is a safe bet for CHE 105, and if he taught it, I probably would have taken him for 107. Chemistry is a difficult subject so be prepared to study, but I with Dr. A I got an A.
He was not good at explaining things. He would explain simple things in the most confusing way so I was more confused by then end than I was to begin with.

Dr. A was an amazing professor. The class material itself is very difficult and exams are very intimidating. However, Dr. A made sure to explain the materials the best he could. He was so interested in what he taught and genuinely wanted us to enjoy chemistry.

Nunez is pretty entertaining as far as chemistry professors go. Especially in comparison to the rest of the chemistry department, he's the move for sure. He is a good professor, the reason for bad grades is lack of studying. The material is difficult for sure, but Nunez is a pretty great prof.

Never missed a class, always took and studied notes, and still did not pass. However, from what I've heard about other 105 professors, Dr.A is god-sent. He knows the material very well, and he's really great about explaining things multiple times. If you have to take Chem105, take Nunez.

Dr. Nunez is without a doubt the best chemistry professor that we have here on campus. He gets a lot of hate but that's generally from student's who aren't trying to get the help they need, and instead blame it on the professor. Dr. Nunez provides all of the information that we need to succeed in his class.
He's a good professor, a lot of kids don't like him because they are not willing to put in the work for a good grade.

Dr. Nunez really does care about his students, you just need to be willing to ask for help outside of class. Chemistry is hard, and often students blame their professor for things that aren't their fault. Dr. Nunez provides everything you need for the exams, it's just up to you whether you study outside of class to be successful.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This professor does not go over everything on the exams in lecture. He is not thorough with his explanations and is unwilling to help students. 10/10 would not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: If you pay attention this class is super easy. Dr. Taylor takes time before and after class to talk and get to know you. She really cares about American history and she's passionate about teaching it. Probably one of the best people to learn about this subject from.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Taylor was amazing! She deeply cares for her students and wants to get to know each person. She kept lectures engaging and encouraged deep thought. I loved her and her class and would definitely recommend it to anyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I love this class. You have to attend class and recitation if you want to pass. Exams can be tough but if you take good notes and just look through them before exam you will be fine. She is great at explaining things and we learn about interesting things like Hamilton, slavery, Revolution, etc. If you like history it will also make it easier.

Dr. Taylor is one of my favorite professors. She cares a lot about her students and their participate and gives really good feedback on papers. I would recommend taking her for any History courses she offers.

She was a great professor and made the class very interesting. You do have to go to class and the discussions if you want to pass. Reading the textbook is also essential, but its not a bad text and the readings are reasonable.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Mandatory readings every week, and information from the readings are heavy sections on the test. Tests are long, but manageable if you pay attention and take good notes during the lecture. She's overall an amazing professor, makes the long lectures enjoyable.
Loved coming to her lectures. She made learning history fun. Very sweet and definitely would take again.

Very well respected professor. Focuses a lot on the big picture as a whole. Does go fast at times during lecture. Be ready to take a lot of notes. She answers any questions you have about the material. Very passionate about history and makes the class a lot of fun with examples and videos.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Taylor is very passionate about History. Attendance is mandatory and lectures are always packed full of information. There were 2 papers, and 3 tests that were all relatively easy. As long as you show up and do the assigned reading, the class is pretty easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is very passionate about history and really wants you to learn and succeed. Saying that, you have to put the work into it and don't skip class or recitation!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is a really great teacher. Yes, there is a lot of work in her classes, but you will learn and you will love it. Her lectures are easy to follow and are very organized. She makes the class fun. There was a group project and a 10 page paper at the end of the semester but it was well worth it.

Amy was extremely engaged in what she was teaching.  I always enjoyed her lectures because she made them interesting.  If you don't like to read, I wouldn't recommend her class because reading is a huge part of the grade and discussion.  She always taught until the very last second as well. But if you don't like history, Amy will change that.

Dr. Taylor is by far the best professor I have had at UK so far. You need to go to lecture so you don't get behind, but I loved her lectures! You will write a lot in class, but as long as you pay attention and study hard you will do fine. I hated history before I took this course, but Dr. Taylor made me love it. An A is very possible in this class.

Not going to lie this class was very tough. There was a lot of reading, a lot of research, and a lot of work involved. However, she is an awesome lecturer and is extremely organized. It is very easy to take notes. Attendance is mandatory and this class does involve group projects. However if you put in the work it is a wonderful learning experience

I usually hate 100 level history courses, but Dr. Taylor was a great lecturer and helped make class interesting. Grades consisted of 3 tests (essay format in a blue book), 2 papers and attendanceparticipation in recitation. She was super helpful the three or four times I stopped by to talk to her in her office. Would definitely recommend her.
Very organized and an awesome lecturer. You will definitely learn what you came to learn. There is quite a bit of work and reading though.

Dr. Taylor is a pretty good professor. She doesn't use Powerpoints so be ready for a tired arm. If you can't write and listen at the same time, you won't survive notes in her class. There is between 50 and 150 pages of reading every week for recitation and a quiz over the reading. If you aren't a reader, pick another class.

I usually hate history but I actually enjoyed her class. She really tries to make class interesting and does a good job of explaining the material. Even having her early in the morning I was able to pay attention. Take good notes and follow the study guide and you'll do good on tests. She's a great professor and really cares about her students

She is very engaging as a professor; I like the way she lectures a lot. She's young and fresh and knows her material. She is very nice and wants her students to do well it seems. Attendance in lecture is not mandatory but for recitation it is. This is where you get your grades anyway-TA does the grading but my TA, personally, was super great.
Good professor, office hours are only on zoom unfortunately.

I love the professor. I'm not a political science major, but she actually helped me understand it completely. She keeps her lectures as short as she can, everything is open note, and she is so reachable.
Dr.Baricovich is a great professor and she also cares for students who cares about themselves too. As long as you stay on on top of your work and pay attention to the lecture, you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Attendance is only mandatory for PS101 on Fridays (at least for Spring semester 2022) and that's when you read material such as news articles and discuss with the class/group. The tests are very easy if you go to the lectures and take notes from her presentations, very kind, is willing to talk over issues, and is very unbiased about politics.
There are better options at UK for this course.

She genuinely wants you to learn. The class does not have many assignments but they are not particularly hard. She also offers extra credit for just attending certain class exercises or simulations. Overall, a great time in her class and learned a lot. Go to class even if attendance is not mandatory. True crime week was super cool.
I highly recommend this professor over Hanson. His lectures are clear and translatable. His assignments may be difficult, but they are not too difficult.

Truly the best Statics professor you can get at UK. Always willing to help and very consistent. If you understand 3D vectors BEFORE the course, you'll do well. Weekly homework can be lengthy. Tests have curveballs, but nothing unfair. Final was comprehensive but kinda easy. Best professor I've had at UK so far. I would highly recommend his class!

Honestly the best professor I have had at UK. He is really good at lectures and he is always willing to answer questions. I think he is a tougher grader for statics, and a little softer on grades for solids. Highly recommend to take him for any class you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. Able to explain complex topics very well. Homework is difficult. Each homework had about 8-10 problems with each taking around 1 hour each. Office hours are excellent. Best advice for this class is to do and understand EVERY problem on the homework. If you can do the homework without outside help, you will do fine.

It is evident from taking his class that Dr. Boyd wants his students to pass, however the content and class will be difficult. This class is difficult because of how heavy each exam is and the length the homework takes. If you do every homework, go to hours and pay attention in lecture, the exams are not overly hard for focused students.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Boyd is one of the best, if not the best lecturer I have had while in school. His classes are well organized and provide content that is relevant to the topic, as well as examples that are the same difficulty as the exams. If you want to pass Statics with Dr. Boyd, GO TO CLASS and TAKE GOOD NOTES.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great lecturer, easy grader

I had professor Boyd for his first class of Statics at UK. He clearly was hired to shake up the game of old head tenured a***** looking at you Hanson. He expects you to participate and perform not give excuses. His office hours are helpful and non-intimidating. He CAN talk down occasionally but imo he only did to those clearly not paying attention.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Boyd is a great professor! I took statics with him and it's naturally a very hard class. He explains the concepts very well in class and if you are struggling he can help at his office hours. If you don't go to class it is extremely hard to understand the concepts, but as long as you follow along to what he is saying you will do great!

I have Dr. Boyd for Solids, He's a great professor and uses very good analogies for each type of stress. The exams are really apply your knowledge based and can be super challenging, but he grades based off how well you know the actual concepts not just the answer. Homework's are through McGraw hill and are super long often. Overall he's awesome.

He comes to class unprepared and will often struggle to teach difficult concepts. Exams and homework are reasonably demanding for the difficulty of the content, but his teaching is not strong enough to rationalize the workload of this course. He also has a tendency to talk down to students who ask questions in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: By nature this is a weed out class so you are going to have the hardships from the class that comes with it but by far if you go to Uk and you have one teacher you have to pick this is the guy. Never seen someone get so excited and ready to teach. His lectures involve straight up practice problems which applies you learning the building blocks bys.

He grades very tough and there are very few points in the class for example if you missed one or two points on an exam you would already be sitting at a low to mid B. He will also put things on the exam that were only lightly touched on during class and sometimes things that were heavily covered in class were not on exams
Pay him more money. This guys passion for statics is contagious. He's always prepared and really wants his students to succeed. Made his students feel capable.

Dr. Boyd is very good at connecting with his students and explaining engineering concepts in a straightforward manner. I gained an appreciation and like for force diagrams and mechanical concepts because of his class. Taking his class will improve your understanding of branching concepts. Do the work, ask questions, and work together.

Dr. Boyd is one of the best professors I have ever had. He is super genuine and wants you to succeed. It is a hard class, but if you show up for lectures and pay attention, you will do well. He is a great and super engaging lecturer. His practice exams are just like the real exam, so if you can do those, you will be fine.

Dr. Boyd is one of the most genuine professors you will meet. He cares so much about his students success. He will use the entire hour and 15 minutes allotted to him and if you pay attention you will learn. It's a difficult class but Dr. Boyd tries and succeeds at making it more practical and easier to understand.

He was amazing and very good at teaching super difficult content really clearly. Before exams, he outlined exactly what was going to be on the exams so as long as you study what he tells you and make sure you can complete the practice exams, you'll do well.

Statics is a very hard class but Dr. Boyd taught the class extremely well. I think he is my favorite professor thus far at UK, because the way he teaches the material and goes through practice problems is unlike any professor I've ever taken. Tests weren't too bad either; he always elaborated what was going to be tested and had great practice exams
Dr. Boyd is a phenomenal teacher who is passionate about his students understanding the classes teaches. Would definitely recommend taking him.

Do not let the low reviews scare you!!! Dr. B is intimidating, and class does not include discussions. But if you need to ask a question after class etc., he is super kind and cares about his academic interests a lot. Do not be afraid to speak to him!

In the beginning the class feels overwhelming but it'll get easier. There are many movie genres, everyone should find something they like! The pop quizzes have some tricks but otherwise, questions were answered in lecture and he drops the 2 lowest graded. 4 stressful timed exams but they are open note! Attendance is graded but he gave 6 freebies!

The movies were decent, but the lectures were so boring. I started skipping the lectures half way through the semester and got by fine. You really are only in contact with your TA. Its a lot of writing in section, but the only homework is watching the films. Exams are graded harshly.

You will watch some great and very interesting films in his class. You will also do a lot of writing about those films. Don't assume that your homework will just be watching a movie. You will write whole essays in response to one question. And he will grade it harshly. Lectures are interesting. He's kind of a jerk if you ask a “stupid” question.

reviews.comment: A little on the tougher side for grading. Decent amount of homework too, but it isn't too difficult as long as you don't procrastinate too long. Lectures can be a little boring but would still say it's a decently easy class and he can get you interested sometimes. You don't even need to really watch the movies, I got by without. Fine class.

Dr. B is a generally great professor who really dives deep into the content and readings, and has great attention for detail. The reading and assignments are dense, and he is a hard grader, but if you like literature and English then his class is perfect for you. Genuinely learned a lot and plan to take more classes with him. Lecture style classes.

reviews.comment: This professor was very challenging but is a solid choice if you want to genuinely know more about English. He is very intelligent and expects a lot from his students. One class period he ended class early out of frustration with our lack of participation. He is hard but worth the struggle.

Dr. Bengtsson is a horrible WRD teacher who lectures daily, rarely gives feedback on assignments, and has very high expectations. I would not recommend taking him, and if you have to, do not buy the books he requires(different from normal WRD class!) I luckily got a good grade in the class but had not grades except midterm grade before final grade.
Total POS!
He has high expectations, but if you are willing to work, you can learn much from the case discussions and textbook lectures.  He blends strategy theory and real world experience.
Don't know how to teach the class. I have never had an awful professor like him before. No one know our grades until the last couple days of class.
Horrible Teacher, not clear at all of what is expected, did not even get a mid term grade!

I think in my whole time at UK I learned the most useful things for real life in Professor Barlow class you will need to know how to use Excel which is the whole point of the class and he will teach you and guide you step by step and had a lot of patience for us even if we were slow or not understanding things. Overall a great professor.

Brad was an amazing professor. He is very laid back and does not require attendance. We walk through all the homework during class so most of the grade is just effort. I would highly suggest taking either Fin 490 or 300 with him.

I would highly recommend taking FIN 300 from Professor Barlow. He really cares about how you're doing in the class, checks in about whether students are understanding content during lecture, and sticks around after class for questions. He also goes over a lot of practice problems during class.

Truly a professor who is passionate about what he teaches. He always made sure to see how the class felt about the material and continued to support us throughout the whole year. If you have the opportunity take his class!!

Excellent Professor! If your not gonna show up to class probably best you give your seat to someone that actually wants to learn. Attendance is not required, but when you do show up he will notice and he will take the time to make sure everyone is following along. You will learn a lot on Excel and become able to navigate Excel without a mouse!

Great professor! Only had 1 exam, which was open note, and left most of the class grade up to assignments that he prepared you for and went over during class. Very fair grader. Most of all, he genuinely cares about his students and makes sure each student understands and can get the grade they desire.

Brad Barlow is a fantastic professor. He presented the material at a great pace and walked us through numerous problems each class. Review day the class before test in which he goes over exact problems that end up appearing on the test, tests are basically recycled questions from homeworks and review assignments, final exam is optional.

Professor Barlow was the best professor I've ever had in my four years at Kentucky. He tells you what is going to be on the exam and bases his lecture on what you will actually be tested on. Straight-forward, awesome teacher. Also a super kind individual who wants the best for his students. Please take him if you want to learn and enjoy finance.

Probably the best finance professor UK has to offer right now. Lectures are a bit iffy but he is very passionate and cares about the students. What he doesn't teach in the lectures he goes over on the exam questions and basically gives you what you are gonna see on exams in class. Highly recommend.

Not only is he knowledgable, but he has experience. I cannot recommend Barlow enough and would argue he is one of the best professors I have ever had.

Exams are worth a lot but he's really nice and lectures are helpful. He goes through the homework questions in class so you understand how to do them, and the questions on the exam are straight from the homework

He doesn't read off the slides but instead skims over the parts that are relevant to the exams and what he used as a Financial officer. He cares a ton about what he teaches and presents it in a way that is easy to understand.

Had him for FIN 300. He's very passionate and so nice. If you need help he will be there for you. He teaches really well and cares about the pace of teaching. This is the only finance class I had to take and I highly recommend his smaller class rather than a huge lecture.

Attendance not mandatory but a majority of the grade is based on the models that are done in class. Prof Barlow cares about each student equally and makes sure everyone is on track. Even if you are not interested in investment banking the class is still interesting and will improve your excel skills.

reviews.comment: Not a lot of homework so exams count the most. Exams are difficult and some questions don't even reflect the material. I don't understand why so many people like this professor.

This class is test-heavy; attendance and homework points do nothing for your grade.
85% of your grade is from exams. Ive been a straight A student for 3 yrs and this is the first class i got a b in. Exams aren't really like the study guide. Good luck

the final is worth 35% and its literally the hardest test of your life. he might be a nice guy and the homework are all easy but you can do well on everything and not do good on the final and fail the class.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS.
The final is worth 35% of your grade
Attendance is mandatory and after both prior exams being online, the final was in person and worth 35%. Half the class failed because he did not give any way to prepare for it. Do not take this.
Final exam is cumulative and worth 35% of your grade. He does not prepare you at all and none of the practice tests help. Prepare to learn everything yourself.
Don't take not gonna help and final exam had the worst study guide ever which is worth most of your grade.

He is very direct about what the class is and what you have to do, but is also very patient about the content and goes over it very well. If you have taken Statistics 296, the first unit will be very similar, but after that it moves into different content. Overall, a very caring professor.

Alejandro is not a bad professor by any means. But I will say his lectures are very boring. He teaches the material well but it's hard to stay focused because it is a very slow pace. Not hard to do well if you're able to pay attention and he's a very nice dude. Practice exams are unbelievably mid though aren't like the exams.

Loved Dellachiesa he was awesome and so helpful and pretty funny. I dont see any reasons why someone wouldnt want to take him. His lectures can be boring but I mean no econ class is exaclty entertaining. Attendance was only taken at the beginning of the semester as always but stops after the mandatory period. He is always willing to help students out and really does want his students to be successful in this class. His lectures can be a bit boring, but he makes the content easy to understand. reviews.comment: He is a very knowledgeable professor and spends much of the class making the economics material practical and valuable. He is very funny, and if you talk to him outside of class, he will remember your name. Would take again.

Professor Dellachiesa is a kind and caring man. He is soft spoken and definitely wants to help his students. The material for this class is not interesting at all. I enjoyed taking AD's course, he does all he can to keep boring content as entertaining as possible. Grading was fair, the exams are weighted pretty heavily but fair. An A or B is achievable with proper preparation, old exams as a practice tool are very helpful. Enjoyed him and will take 391 with him next semester.
The nicest professor ever. Loved having him for class. Open to students' concerns and is willing to help you. Would 100% take again.

Literally the sweetest professor I have ever had. He is one of a kind. He truly loves and cares about his students. LOTS of homework but that is how you learn this material by practicing it. Take him if you have the opportunity.

I've taken Professor Dellachiesa for two courses now and have loved him for both. There is ample material provided for you to understand the material. The class has been enjoyable and not incredibly stressful. He's an excellent professor and I highly recommend him.
AD is always willing to clarify and find new ways to explain something so that it is simpler to understand. I would take 202 with him.

Overall this professor seems like a nice person in general, but not a good econ professor. I cannot really understand him in lectures and he doesn't make sense a lot to me, he tends to over explain to the point where you forget where he started. Tests are about the only thing that is actually graded so you have to do good.

He is a great teacher. All assignments are online and easy to do! Attendance is technically mandatory but he is very lenient if you need to miss class and at some point he stopped taking attendance for my class.

Genuinely enjoyed this class. For some reason, it definitely feels easier than Econ 201. He's a tad bit hard to understand with his accent at first, but over time you get used to it. Great professor, and already planning on taking him for ECO391

I had him for ECO 202 and ECO 391 in the same semester. He was very kind and understanding and did a good job teaching. If I had to pick, I'd say he was better at teaching 391, which is really a statistics class. That seemed to be more his thing. But I still liked him for both and would take his class again.
Econ 391 is difficult if you don't put in work. Other than that he made the exam very simple and straightforward and gives tons of practice. But his very sweet

I took Professor AD for 202 and decided to take 391 because I felt he was a decent teacher. He is so kind. I cannot recommend him more. He is super understanding, lectures are actually informative, and he teaches in a way you can learn. Homework and exams are directly reflective of lecture content. Great guy and overall recommend him for all econ courses!

Professor AD. is very engaging and passionate about the material. The lectures are fast-paced but he provides great review resources, including past exams and study tools like Unstuckstudy, to help you succeed. Attendance is a must, but the workload is manageable.

This course is pretty straightforward. A good chunk is a review of STA296, and the remainder is "new" content, but it is not hard at all. AD is a great professor; he explains the concepts well, makes it applicable to the world, walks through things that may confuse you/has for past students, and is a really caring guy. He wants you to succeed fs.
The nicest professor ever. Loved having him for class. Open to students' concerns and is willing to help you. Would 100 percent take again.
Professor AD. cares very much about his students and makes that evident through his teaching. He is a fantastic teacher!

A.D. is a very sweet guy. He is helpful and kind when questions are asked. But I will say, while he provides a lot of study materials for exams (10+ past exams), I found it to be too much. Even when I would do all of them, there were still questions on the exam I hadn't seen before. Other than that, this class was pretty ok and not too bad.

He tries to make the lectures as interesting as he can and uses great examples. His grading is very clear, he gives you everything necessary to succeed. He has outlined notes for the semester to fill in during lecture which I found very helpful. He also gives access to past exams Q&As with explanations which is a great resource.
The class can be difficult but he is very friendly and extremely helpful if you go to office hours. Exams were online, but attendance in class everyday
Terrible. Do not recommend him to anyone. Not helpful. Always busy. His Ta's do everything.

Great professor, really wants to make sure everyone understands the class. Only 3 exams throughout the semester, but he reviews before the tests and the exams are similar to what was in class and in the homework.

AD is an amazing professor. Do the assignments and pay attention to lecture and you are good. Highly recommend taking him!
Professor delachiesa is one of the best professors I have had at UK.

Decent class the only thing is that he doesn't go into detail with his examples. The examples are not relevant to the students he is teaching, so what he is talking about is confusing. Also, he does not go into any depth about the math part of this class. Overall if you are actually trying to learn from lectures I would not take this professor.
Cares very much about his students and makes that evident through his teaching. He is a fantastic teacher!

Very good speaker and very open to questions. He was always happy to help when anyone was confused. The only complaint I would have for his course is that his lectures were a bit bland and uninteresting at times. I found it hard to focus when this happened. I would definitely recommend him for any economics courses.
Great professor. He really wants you to understand the material. If you go to class and do your work you should have no trouble getting a B or an A

Dellachiesa is a good, but dry professor. He presents the content slowly and clearly, and usually ends class early. However, ECO391 is the most boring class I have ever taken and I wanted to fall asleep every lecture. Weekly homework assignments and tests which are a bit harder than the homeworks but still manageable. Easy but boring class.
Great professor! Very helpful!! Attending class is important. Practice the old exams. Tests are straightforward but still a bit difficult.

The class itself is challenging, exams are often not reflective of homework content however the professor himself was very pleasant. He seemed to genuinely care for the success of his students, I would recommend him and take his class again.

AD is fantastic about explaining the material in class. He is very good at making the material easy to understand and giving real world examples. If you use the study guide, study the previous exams, you can get a good grade.
Best professor i've ever had, makes it so easy
Best professor ive ever had, makes it so easy

As long as you take notes and go to most of the classes, you will be fine. He goes slow in lecture and explains everything very well. He is super helpful and willing to work with you. For exams, just study the many past exams he provides and you will get an A.

Would rather watch paint dry but other than that not too bad. You might get lucky if he cracks a joke or smiles once a week. Easy to do well in if you pay attention, take good notes, and put in some effort on the one homework a week.

reviews.comment: Very good professor his lectures are structured well and the exams directly reflect them, If you go to class you should not have any problem getting an A.

I learned so much from this class. He gives amazing lectures for current world situations. You just need to pay attention in class to do well. If you take notes and study them for the class you will get an A. He drops the lowest  2 homeworks and gives extra credit.
Great guy; really wants students to succeed. Very fair teacher who uses real world examples to supplement his lectures.

GREAT professor. You do have to pay attention and learn, but he will give you every chance to get a good grade. Really cares about how you do and will always answer questions and clarify if you need it.

Definitely choose him, he's caring and kind. The lecture videos with regression examples can sometimes be long. He speaks at a slower pace so I speed up the video. Homework helps you understand the topic. He lets you access all the previous semester's practice exams. He gave extra credit.
Dellachiesa was absolutely fantastic. He is one of the nicest teachers that I have ever met. He made Statistics bearable for all of us. Take him if you have the chance but take in person.

One of the most caring professors I ever had. The homework was difficult, but really helped me understand the content well and it helps prepare for the exams. He allowed a cheat sheet on exams which was an amazing help.
He did a great job. He made macroeconomics enjoyable and fun.

Not a fan. He speeds through lectures and reads off the slides without teaching a thing. You practically have to learn the material yourself. Because I didn't.

Lectures are extremely boring and he sits and reads from the slides. Not impossible to get an A or B but be prepared to teach yourself the material. Not tech savvy at all and his handwriting is not great. Would recommend taking another professor. Exams are pretty difficult.
You get out of the class exactly what you put into it. I learned more about statistics in this class than I did in all my other statistics coursework at the university.
I had AD my second semester and so far he has been the best professor I've had easily.
Love Alejandro Dellachiesa and the care he has for his students and their success both in and out of the classroom!
Take this class! A.D. is so caring and an amazing professor!!
Great professor who cares about his students. Definitely take him.
Take his class. He is extremely helpful, very nice, and approachable. he loves to teach and it shows.
I would recommend Dr. Dellachesa to any student. Excellent professor, obviously loves teaching. He teaches the material well and is always available to help me with anything I don't understand.
Prof AD is the best economics professor I had. I thoroughly enjoy his classes since he relates economics to current events. My favorite economics class.

Disclaimer - I'm not good at stats. 
For me this class was ROUGH, tho 391 is only stats. If you really want to learn and want to actually be able to use his lectures or ask for help take 391 in person, online won't be for you. He is a very nice guy and a sweet professor. Very knowledgeable but he is just not good at getting his point across and teaching the material. Professor A.D. was a very nice guy. However economics is not my best subject and I got very bored in class. AD is very understanding, and enjoys helping students. He stops the class and makes sure everyone is on the same page. He also knows how to hold student's attention with slight humor.
TAKE AD's class!!!!! You will not regret it. He makes class fun and I actually enjoyed his 75 minute class.
Professor A.D. was always willing to meet and work with me to help me better understand the material. I can tell he really cares about his students and wants everyone to succeed.

This class was extremely difficult.The professor would go over class time making me late for my next class, and would start his attendance quizzes as late as 9:48 am for a class that was supposed to end at 9:50. Dr. Dellachiesa cares tremendously about his students. He makes himself available at all times to help his students. Many times he has spent a long time to sit down with me and go over problems showing me the mistakes that I was making and how to use my intuition to solve problems.

Best professor that I have ever had. Too bad I just met him now! He takes the time to go above and beyond and get to know his students and care about their success. You can also tell that he knows so sooo much about the topic and is able to give examples and talk about it in an interesting way.
Dr. Dellachiesa was a great professor! The course was not that hard and I learned a lot. Attendance in lenient and he provides many resources.

Alejandro was without a doubt, the best economics professor that I have ever had. He is dedicated and truly invested in making sure students understand the material. I thoroughly enjoyed covering economics that was related to everyday life.

Professor Dellachiesa is just like a common professor. Though, a couple of things that I really liked are that he gives guided notes, and he posts all of his past exams. If you study those, you'll do fine on the actual exams. Also, homework is minimal and easy.

Dellachiesa is a great professor and genuinely cares about how his students perform. I didn't realize until the second exam that he posted previous semesters' exams for practice, do these a few times and get comfortable with those and you'll ace the exams. Your final grade is pretty much an average of your exams.
