reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Carter is an alright professor. There were assigned readings twice a week, sometimes with (very surface-level) pop quizzes after. The lectures felt irrelevant and boring which sucked because attendance is a big grade. I preferred the Friday breakout sections because they focused more on writing our three pieces, which was more fun than reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: He is quite rude and condescending, always making sarcastic comments. His lectures are so boring and teach you absolutely nothing but attendance is mandatory. You grade is based on your TA because Michael doesn't grade anything. There is probably about 50 points worth of assignments for the entire semester so every point counts.
He has to be the worst teacher at U.K. He must have stopped caring a long time ago. Very rude. Very condescending.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Avoid this guy at all costs. He's very condescending, and rude. If you ask him a question, he'll just tell you to ask one of the graduate students. He comes to class unprepared. In lecture he just plays Youtube videos and rambles on about himself and his garden. He takes attendance by a seating chart that doesn't work. Watch your attendance grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class is super easy and not a lot of work. Attendance is mandatory though and his lectures were pointless 90% of the time, which was annoying, but the class itself is not hard. As long as you try on the assignments and go to class you will get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: the only assignments are 3 papers then a final portfolio. lectures are very boring and seem unrelated and confusing. hes very odd dude but funny at times.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Carter is a nice guy and funny too. For a 400 level class, I didn't think the workload was crazy. The readings every week are usually pretty short and so are a majority of the writing assignments. The class is discussion-based most of the time, so it helps when people participate. I read lots of great writing in this class and would take him again!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: lectures are so boring and unclear what the point of even learning the content is. If you miss class your grade will suffer, he counts participation based on assigned seats every single day. you MUST have textbook, he gives pop quizzes and randomly calls on people in class to answer stuff about the reading homework. Just a super odd guy in general
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor likes to call students out if no one is talking. There's TONs of readings and the assignments are spur of the moment such as reading quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I really like Prof. Carter's sense of humor, but if you don't like dry wit and sarcasm you might not like his class. If you stay on top of reading and participate in class it will make the course a lot more enjoyable. Put some quality effort into the papers and you'll survive.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--So many papers

reviews.comment: I was intimidated by the 425 label and creative nonfiction as a style, but Carter made it really fun. Our class was small and our discussions were great. He gave great feedback and was open to a lot of flexibility. I would take him for any creative writing class. Just show up and participate and it will be easy.
I took this class just to fill my credits up, it is very easy, the professor cares and wants you to do well.

The class was a bit tough but if you put in the work and attend class then you should be fine. Classes are a bit boring but the lectures help with the essays and tests. The grades on your papers depend on your TA. Dr. Carter is super nice though. He offers a bit of extra credit as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I have mixed feelings bc his class is honestly so boring. I hate to say it, but sitting in a big empty room for over an hour listening to how to rhyme poems feels redundant. Lots of writing but he gives you plenty of time. This class is easy, although the grading criteria was very unclear and points got taken off randomly (by TA). Nice guy though.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He said he hates grading ON THE SYLLABUS and said that he will not be grading ANYTHING until the end of the semester. Expect the check mark system instead (like in Kindergarten) and youll never know your true grade. He WILL call on you in class if no one is talking and assigns insane amounts of reading for a class who is mostly ENS majors.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: It's week 2 and he has assigned 100 pages of reading in between Tuesday and Thursday along with a two page (not double-spaced) informal writing piece. We are also expected to be "keeping a journal" (graded) in which he does not even specify what to write about? We spend all of class discussing the reading where none of us seem to impress him.
One of the nicest professors I've ever had. As long as you're willing to do some class discussion you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed his class. I don't recommend taking this class if you don't like to read or write essays. He's a really cool guy and his classes are all just conversations about what you are reading. All the books we read were interesting and not all hard to understand. Definitely have to work for your grade as he is a tough grader.

He is very inconsiderate when it comes to attendance, especially during a pandemic. He locks discussion boards quickly and when you try to email him to get your points for the day he won't respond back. The only time he responded to me was a rude announcement sent to the entire class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prof Carter is honestly the sweetest man you could take an English class from. He is very much an old "Kentucky Hippie" as I say. He is alway so kind & allows everyone to express their opinions (and acknowledges them!) He doesn't lecture hardly ever- its usually a class conversation. Be prepared to read and write a lot & take a few mini pop quizzes
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Carter is a bit too eccentric for the classroom- but that also makes it fun. Class is easy and often the readings are interesting. Do the work and you'll pass with at least a B.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Carter is knowledgeable in the subject matter and always has cool facts and tidbits to share, too. He's hilarious and eccentric and a pleasure to have as a teacher; he seems to genuinely care about his students. While he's insightful and you can learn a lot from him, he's not very organized and the course doesn't follow the syllabus dates.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Michael is a very nice guy that makes class very enjoyable. You will have a reasonable amount of reading but it is not the end of the world if you do not complete it. He is very easy to talk to and is super flexible. This class is definitely not an easy A due to the fact that there are so few points in the course. He is a pretty easy grader though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: This class is much more difficult than it needs to be. You have to write 2-3 papers, which wouldn't be hard, but he is such a tough grader. There are only 100 points possible for the entire semester, so every point counts. There are about 6 pop quizzes over the course of the semester, so keeping up with the reading is important.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Michael is very passionate about English and definitely shows it. I heard some negative things about him before class, but he turned out to be great. He was fun and always tried to make the class enjoyable. You write 4 short stories, which the TA's grade, and I think they grade harder than Michael himself

You have reading homework before every class. The quizzes consist of one-two questions each. But they are about the smallest detail in the readings. Claims to be an easy and generous grader since it is a 100 level course, but that is far from it. Will take off for the smallest of things on assignments and quizzes/midterm.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Mr. Carter is one of the funniest professors that I have taken. There are a few pop quizzes, but if you read the assigned readings then you will be fine. He cares about the students and truly wants everyone to do well. He gives good feedback on papers, and isn't too tough of a grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Mr. Carter was a bit old fashioned (did not use PP, but rather pieces of paper he held up for us). I took the class after taking much higher writing classes (I just needed one more and it was the only option). From this position, I found this class to be a poor intro to the subject. It focuses too much on dead writers instead of modern work.
Great professor. Really funny and willing to be generous. Also wants you to succeed.

He is such a gem. He is extremely intellectual and knows his stuff. I don't see why his rating isn't higher. He's good with every student, puts in a lot of effort to get us to talk, and is really funny. I will say he pushes you, but a good prof will do that.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: The lectures are very boring and pointless. I learned nothing in lecture. He just babbles the whole class and makes pointless assignments. I only went to class because he took attendance but I will take him again because he is a very very easy grader and has a open mind when grader. The midterm was kind of tough to.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Definitely an enjoyable class! I would take it again in a heartbeat. You write two papers and some poems. You get graded on them, and get very clear and distinct feedback. You just revise those and turn them in for a portfolio at the end of the semester. There is readings, but they are enjoyable and worth while! HIGHLY RECOMMEND 10/10.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: WORST CLASS IVE EVER TAKEN. They treat this 100 level elective like you are an English major. I never received a 100 on anything in this class and the class is only out of 100 points total, so literally every point matters. His lectures make no sense and the mid-term is very tedious. Wouldn't recommend.
His lectures are absolutely pointless by no means am I a "better writer" than i was before.

Professor Carter is not a good professor. His lectures have no meaning and every class I think to myself "what is the point of this?" In no way have I become a better writer, and his TA grade very hard for no reason. Not recommended.

He is a very laid-back professor and easy to get along with. He's very understanding if you have to miss class or you forgot to bring an assignment - just email him. There was 1 test - the midterm - and it was very straightforward. We read more than anything but the books were enjoyable. VERY easy class, very enjoyable professor.

Carter is not profound by any means. He neglects delving into the plot and shuns deep analysis of literature. While he is good for a laugh or empty comment or pointless tangent, he is absent of any depth regarding literature. If you want to analyze and understand Cooper, expect a 20 minute YouTube video of Mark Twain criticizing Cooper instead.
Carter is a great professor!  If you appreciate literature, you'll love his lectures!!

Dr. Carter is an outstanding teacher and friend. He was very helpful throughout the semester. His class was a time to break out of your shell and talk with your classmates. He is very driven and wants you to do well. There is a lot of reading, but it is enjoyable and interesting.

If you can, take him! He's such a brilliant man who truly cares if his students understand what he's teaching. He expects a lot out of his students but is very good at breaking down exactly what he wants from you. Although there was a LOT of reading, it was all very interesting!

Carter was full of interesting information. The class is about controversial works of art and it can be a bit boring at times. You must read the books because he expects you to participate and answer questions. The books aren't expensive, so this class will save you some money as well.

I really enjoyed this class. Michael asked us to read quite a bit, but the grading wasn't too hard and you can get away with not reading everything. I read about half of the material and worked hard. Definitely take advantage of the fact that he is willing to proofread major assignments before you turn them in. Quizzes in here were sometimes tough.

The class was about vampires so obviously the pop culture aspect alone was incredibly interesting. We worked on creating a website. We wrote papers;& discussed a plethora of interesting aspects of the origins, motifs, and characteristics of vampires. Not only was the class fun, but he was also a great guy who gave people breaks they didn't deserve.
Super easy.  Show up, do the homework.  Participate.  Easy A.
Bring your pillow to class because you will want to sleep through Carter's lectures.  He can be funny at times, but overall I think he's just sarcastic and arrogant.

Carter is unique. That's the one word to describe him, but it's certainly in a good way. He's a hilarious professor that's incredibly laid back, but also has a passion to see his students learn. Carter gave me an an admiration for Steinbeck, and I truly wish I could take more of his classes.

Professor Carter is the best. He's absolutely nuts, but is completely fascinating.  I loved his course and he was really relaxed during conversation. As long as you do the reading and contribute in class, you'll do well.

Horrible!! So many people from my section dropped his class because no one liked him. He was very opinionated and made some people, including myself, feel uncomfortable and irritated. He was unreasonable and not at all helpful.

This teacher could be great or terrible. He grades relatively hard, but if you engage in class, the actual class will be your favorite. He always does something funny every class, and is very entertaining.

I have taken both 104 and 232 with Prof. Carter, and it's probably the easiest B you will ever get, but don't have huge high hopes for that A. You learn a lot during any class you take with him, and he loves participation. He's so nice in office hours too, don't be afraid of speaking up.

Carter will push you but he will also help. He's always available to meet with and knows what good writing is and how to teach it. I've had him for two classes and enjoyed both immensely. He is a bit nutty and thrives off class participation. He likes creative topics for papers and may let you go off the syllabus if you ask.

A lot of people on here have been giving him a bad wrap, and it freaked me out before I took this class. Carter's not a bad guy at all. He's actually a really nice guy, and pretty goofy too. In terms of difficulty, yes, he pushes you. But in return you become a better writer. I recommend him. Not an easy class, but a good professor.

The class itself is pretty boring but you are going to get that with any ENG 104 class. If you go to Carter for help he will tell you exactly what he wants. I got an A on my first paper because I put in the time and met with him outside of class.
Professor Carter is an awful, unfair teacher.

I loved this class. Interesting topic (controversial and banned texts) which prompted some great discussions. A shame more class members didn't participate in the discussions though. MWC held a lively, thought-provoking class and was always willing to talk through ideas outside of class. Be prepared to talk, work hard and think outside the box.

This is an interesting class focusing on controversial issues found in literature. Warning: If your opinion does not agree with his opinion you won't get your point across out loud in class so unless you want to shout, just drop the class or get used to being quiet.
Great professor, but demanding.

This teacher was not for me.  Took it in my 4th semester.  This has been my only B my college career.  I had a 4.0 beforehand.  I just really couldn't get his style and what more he wanted out of our papers.  I stressed out so much over this class because nothing was ever good enough.
ok class
Amazing teacher, he made me (a math major) interested in English! That's impressive. If you do what he asks you will do fine. But this class is not for slackers.
I had him for English 104 my first semester in college... his class was incredible hard for me and should not have taken it so seriously... i mean it is just english right??
he's aight
This guy is very hard and gave a basketball player with a 4.0 a B and ruined his GPA

I learned more in this class then any other that ive taken. I know I am a better writer then I was! I thought his class was going to be really hard, but as long as you do what he asks, hes a very very fair grader. Im taking him again for my 2 teir course!
Prof Carter was an outstanding teacher. I got a lot out of his class. He wants you to learn and you do have to put forth a lot of effort, but its worth it. I highly recommend him!

This guy was quite a character. The class discussion rarely went far off topic, and the class was focused. I just retook eng104 with him and it was a lot better than the first round. He is always available for help. Although eccentric, he helped us all be better writers.
Great teacher, I hate english, but he made it interesting and fun.  This discussions were great. I learned a ton in that class, I highly recommend him.
Carter is an awesome guy! His class seemed hard at first but I definetly learned a ton! Definetly take this guy! Not to mention he had a goatee down to his chest when I had his class!
Great teacher and very helpful. She makes sure that you get the concept down and is very accessible if you have any trouble. sometimes she'll send you e-mails just because she's bored.
Wow  This guys is so dry .........he need hypothetical lotion!!

I really liked the class. He was funny, and I liked the discussions brought up in class. Yes, he required you to work, but that's fine. He wasn't as bad (I don't think) as some people portray him to be.
He is horrible, he is mean and would try and make girls in my class cry.  I would suggest staying away from him!!
Great teacher - best 104 english class you can take. Makes it interesting and fun. Watched music videos/Simpsons for research IN CLASS. Big points for participating in class.
When writing a paper in his class, write about topics that go against anything normal in society that you can think of and he will like it. His classes were long,boring, and not entertaining. Beware!
very good, very smart, very funny, very interesting, very very

Good teacher, easy to get along with.  He grades really hard and be prepared to work.  If you go to every class and read the required readings, you should be able to get a B. No extra credit opportunities.

To this day I'm amazed how the incredible weight of his own failures refuses to personify itself physically. A bitter old weasel of a man, it's astounding that the gravitational field created by his own ego hasn't sucked him into another dimension.
I am still amazed that he can fit in the same room with his ego.

Carter is a great teacher - he takes a required class and makes it fun and interesting.He asks difficult questions in class and encourages discussion, which seems to throw off some people. Take him if you like quirky, intelligent teachers.
Very hard grader, but very entertaining in class.  Very helpful with writing!  But you know what he expects - ALOT.
No Comments

REALLY hard grader, but a wonderful teacher. I knew how to write papers before I took the class, but I REALLY knew how to write afterwards. Expect to work hard and spend LONG hours writing papers, but you'll get a lot out of it. Slackers, stay away!
I enjoyed his classes, although the books that he had us read were very boring. However, I always learned a lot while in his class. He's a really nice guy too.
BBOOORRING!!!
Awesome teacher with a lot of leniency towards grading.

Mr. Knight is an awesome professor who really cares about student's wellbeing. Lots of in class group discussions and likes to hear students own experiences. Very lenient on late work and will not change your grade over it being a little late especially if you ask for an extension.

Dexter Knight was such a wonderful professor, he always told great stories and cared a lot about our students. He took time to learn the students names and extra facts about each student. He is very personable and friendly, he always took us on field trips and was very passionate about his job! Highly recommend.

Dr. Knight is a great professor! He takes the time to learn everyone's names. He is very lenient when it comes to absences and late work. He schedules several on-campus fieldtrips that make the class more exciting. Every couple of weeks there is a paper do, but they are very doable! Strongly recommend him!

Professor Dantley so far and from what I have gathered is not a bad professor. But she does not put forth very much effort to be accessible to students. Gave me a 20.5/40 on a teaching project and gave very vague criticism on how to fix it on the next one. On multiple occasions I sent an emails to her and multiple times she would not respond at all

Not a bad lecturer, but not a great teacher. It's obvious that she used ChatGPT for most, if not all class materials. She uses AI to grade exams, which cost many students to lose points on written portions of exams. Make sure you really look over the graphs and visuals she provides in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I loved having Dr. Danley as a professor! If you are someone that is passionate about biology this class should be no problem. I would highly recommend going to the weekly SI sessions or the bio table in the study! They are very helpful!

Honestly, she is not that bad of a professor just goes through things very quickly, and grades very weird. She took off points on several of my handwritten summaries, without giving feedback. She wants to be funny and it comes off as very awkward and makes some people feel uncomfortable. STUDY the given open responses from old exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Danley's class is challenging but fair. The exams matched the posted learning objectives. There were lots of Canvas resources, and drops of low scores for every assignment type. I went skimmed the videos and pre-lecture homework, did the activities in class, and put time in the study every few days. Easy A.
Avoid at all costs. Thinks her class is the only one that students are taking. Will take off points for the smallest of things that don't make sense.

If you are considering taking her class, prepare to be rage baited every time you speak or listen to her.  She claimed she seen a shadow on my lockdown browser and from that point on I was required to take my exam on her time regardless of mine, while setting her up on zoom to stare at me. She does not care about her students. Take at your own risk

She is so annoying. She assigns at least an hour and a half worth of lecture videos to watch outside of her actual lecture, plus pre-lecture questions. She wastes so much time in class doing activities, and while they are helpful sometimes, she tries really hard to make the class laugh and it just comes off so weird. SO MANY ASSIGNMENTS!!

Has the attitude that her class is the only important one. makes you handwrite everything, while she types everything. hours and hours of lecture videos OUTSIDE of class. in class "activities" that are usually pointless. hand written summaries that take forever to do and they're due like every other week. avoid at all costs.

I love the class even though I find the content difficult. Definitely read the before lecutre chapters and take notes, so in person makes a little bit more sense. I don't like that sometimes she has us fill out a slide, but she does not go over them. Good professor, but LOTS of studying to do well.

Her class is so easy but she acts like it is the most important thing you will ever do in your whole life. She has you watch videos outside of class, iclicker in class and an in lecture assignment that you only have 15 minutes to submit after class. one of my most hated professors at uk...even up there with April French and thats saying something.

Has the attitude that her class is the only important one. Makes you do iClicker AND written participation, but she waits until the last minute to tell you what you need to submit and then gives you 15 min to submit it...I have another class across campus right after and I feel like that's unfair. You have to watch many hours of "lecture" videos.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Instead of teaching, she regurgitates information from her powerpoint. Not passionate, and has TA's for everything. Goes through the content extremely fast, and skips over the “content review” slides stating she will “give us the answers before the exam”, not allowing enough time to study. You also have to pay for the IClicker subscription. AVOID!

Honestly, she is a good teacher, she does interactive stuff that helps you learn the hard concepts. She only accepts 13 after lecture written participation so if you miss one DONT worry, just make sure you do 13 throughout the semester. SHE WILL TEST YOU ON THINGS SHE MENTIONED ONE TIME, im not kidding, listen to literally every word she says.
Dr. Danley coordinates BIO 350 Lab. Rude and will accuse students of plagiarism when written results are 4 individual sentences with a strict rubric to follow. Ridiculous.
Honestly idk why people think shes terrible, I loved her, class was a easy A and engaging, if you can take her for BIO 152 I highly recommend her!
great, easy A, would recommend to take for bio 152

She has seriously gotten so much better than last year. You don't have to attend class in person, you can do it on zoom.  Her multiple choice on exams is terrible but the written response makes up for it. Even after failing the multiple choice on the first 3 exams, I still have an 85. Just do the homework and you're grade will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I genuinely don't think I've ever had a worse professor. If you cannot make it to class (regardless of Zoom option), do not expect to get credit. Will end lecture before telling you how to receive credit for the day. Expectation is to watch hours worth of videos before class that aren't directly related to the textbook. Avoid her at all costs.

Genuinely might be the worst professor I have ever encountered. Do anything to avoid having to take her class. Claims to use a flipped classroom model, but never goes over any material in class and just gives IClicker questions. Post hours worth of pointless videos and expects you to watch all of them and then write handwritten summaries about it.

Dr. Danley is seriously underrated! She explains the material clearly, is super organized, and actually cares about her students. Compared to Dr. Jones, she's a huge improvement. If you have the chance, take this class with her during the summer—it's fast-paced but very manageable with her teaching style. Highly recommend!

Dr. Danley is seriously underrated! She explains the material clearly, is super organized, and actually cares about her students. Compared to Dr. Jones, she's a huge improvement. If you have the chance, take this class with her during the summer

DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS. She is so rude and passive agressive. Accuses you of using AI instead of actually teaching us. No office hours, we have 6 exams (one every week) and expects us to spend 3-4 hrs a day on the class. The canvas page is so hard to navigate and she is so late on grading and doesn't give clear instructions for any assignments.

Dr. Danley was the lab coordinator for BIO 350. Her labs really correlate to lecture material and make tough concepts easier to visualize, which I appreciate. However, her lab reports are TOUGH and the grading is not always clear. Be prepared to spend a lot of time on this lab.

I did not benefit at all from attending Dr. Danley's lectures and the homework is useless busywork, so I had to teach myself everything. She does not hand back exams so it is impossible for students to learn from their mistakes, and the fact that she does not have office hours gives me the impression that she does not care about her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She tests on concepts from lecture but also details and application type questions that you probably skipped over because you didn't thing it was important. So study literally everything. The textbook is not very helpful. Pay attention in class and write down even the things that she didn't write down. There are a few extra credit opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: dont take her if u dont wanna suffer
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Danley was the lab coordinator for BIO 350. The labs were interesting, but they were very confusing and sometimes all over the place. Post-lab due every week which seems hard at first but its easy to get used to.

The tests focus on minutiae from the slides (not the textbook!), so reading the textbook doesn't assist in studying. You will need to put in a lot of work outside of class to memorize the diagrams provided on the slides (which often are irrelevant to the overall concepts). Written assignments are spontaneous, so attendance is mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She was a good professor given the class size. Not super accessible outside of class. As long as you pay attention or watch the recorded lectures the class really is not that hard. She is very clear and she clearly is passionate about biology and teaching.

Really terrible teacher. Goes 100 miles per hour while her students are scrambling to write notes down, but then gets annoyed when she asks us a random question in class and everyone is quiet. No one is understanding what she is saying because we are just regurgitating information on slides. Super disappointed.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Danley has good intentions; however the difficulty of this course compared to BIO148 is astronomical. She teaches the content in a very specific way, & the tests heavily focus on miniscule details. Attendance is basically mandatory, due to the fact you never know when the in-class written assignments are. Take BIO152 with the other instructor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Danley really knows bio like the back of her hand. Her lectures are what determine what you get in the class. The homework doesn't really help and are almost like busy work. on top of that, somedays she'll warn you about in class written assignments and other times she won't. the exams are almost word for word of the lectures.

You can tell Dr.Danley knows what she is talking about and I believe she expects us to know the material as soon as she says it. The exams are honestly extremely difficult and are tested on the most miniscule details. I believe I learned a tremendous amount in this class, but the other professor is not even close to being as hard as Dr. Danley.

Dr. Danley definitely will test how much you know every single detail of the concepts on the exams. She will put one piece of information on a slide, barely go over it, then have several questions going in depth on that topic on the exam. She is a nice person but the exams are mean sometimes and require a lot of studying to do well.

This teacher will just lecture the whole time, and the only resources you will get are PowerPoints or various YouTube videos she tags into Canvas. She would sporadically make assignments due 30 min AFTER class, which was impossible for people like me who had to trek to other buildings. She is nice, but not great at teaching or making content clear.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Though Dr. Danley is somewhat disorganized and difficult to reach outside of class, she is a good professor who moves a content-loaded course at a decent pace. I personally found her lecture slides and practice exams very helpful in preparing for exams (she re-uses questions for exams!). This course is definitely a reflection of YOUR OWN effort!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Danley is an okay professor but her lectures seem to be a little unorganized. You can tell she is very passionate about biology and the labs she does so maybe take her for those. She also is not the easiest to reach outside of class so make sure to ask any questions you have in person.

Personally, I adore Dr. Danley. Her teaching style worked amazingly for me, and her slides are built so you can take notes on top of them as she teaches. She has the slides uploaded before class, so you can do some pre-lecture browsing. She also is really fun to talk to and is very caring and understanding.
Sometimes contradicts herself but the exams are very similar to practice exams and the notes will get you good grades on the exams. Not bad.

She teaches very lecture heavy but is genuinely a good person. She cares about her students and wants to help as much as she can. Her lectures do get boring but she is very sweet and will help you if needed. The class is a lot of memorization and hard which isn't her fault, she teaches well and cares a lot about her students.

Dr. Danley is the lab coordinator for BIO 350 and doesn't want students to succeed. She made the TAs regrade our lab reports because they weren't being strict enough, so now the averages are like a 50%. She's too harsh on grading the post labs and barely gives feedback. It also takes forever for them to be graded so we never know what to fix.

Professor Danley really does seem like a nice person, but she is a horrible teacher. She completely overcomplicates every single topic and makes the exams virtually impossible. Not too mention her lectures are you teaching yourself by the "activities" she has for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It's mostly test/quiz/iClicker based. The tests were really hard in my opinion so be prepared to study hard for those. There's iClicker every single lecture, and there's a minimum of points you need to get to satisfy that requirement. She does provide you with a ton of material for the exams, so make sure that you're making use of it

Dr. Danley was the lab supervisor for BIO 350. She clearly answered questions asked of her in lab, and she wrote clear, detailed instructions for post-labs. However, I got COVID, and she was very strict with deadlines and insensitive to my needs while struggling to recover. She sometimes seemed simply inconvenienced by students.

She is not a great lecturer. She reads from powerpoint slides and gives iclicker questions that zero people know the answers to. It is extremely frustrating. However, she posts every material online that you could ever need about a subject, which makes studying easier to make up for the bad lectures. Shes not the worst, but definitely not the best

So I have to take BIO 152 for my major and I choose the worst possible professor. She could care less about her students. She does not use a mic in her huge classroom so you better sit upfront. Classes are long, boring, and make you want to die. I recommend any other Professor besides her.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Danley has zero sympathies for her students. She does not care about your grade and makes it virtually impossible to do well. Pay attention to her grading scale in her syllabus in the beginning so you don't get screwed over in the end. The lectures do not follow the textbook at all so read. the. textbook.

BIO152 was asynchronous during the COVID situation, but instead of making videos for class, Prof Danley re-used lecture videos from when this class was offered online in Summer 2017. The lectures were decent, but didn't always follow the guided notes. Tests were open note (paper copies only) and the quizzes on each topic help to retain info.

Biology is not my strong suit, so I wasn't expecting an A. It takes a lot of effort and hours of studying to get a B or even a high C. Dr. Danley's lecture are not amazing, but she is very helpful in office hours. The quizzes are automatic 100s but the exams are tough. I studied for at least 12 hours a day for a week and was happy with a C.

She is by far the the most incompetent and unfair professor in the BIO department . The exams were made up of 90% material from the 15 hours of work she wants you to do per week and even then the other 10% is untaught material you can't prepare for. I am not mad just disappointed in whomever allowed this tyrant to take over the BIO 152 course.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I have been a nearly straight A student until now. I got my second B in this class even though I studied for hours because the exams were pretty tough and didn't exactly match what we learned or how we learned it. I'd recommend reading the book instead of doing the packet. The averages were always Cs for tests and tests are worth 80% of the grade.

Was in charge of the labs in Animal Phys in Dr. P's class. She was unreasonable, strict, totally unhelpful outside of and really does not care whether you pass or not! Personally seen so many people cry over her adamant nature. Just pray you get a good TA for the labs and try your best to stay out of her way!

I never say this about anyone, but she absolutely SUCKED. Would not help outside of class, did not care about students and contradicted herself every single lecture. If biology is required for your major, i beg you, please take ANYONE else.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Melody Danley gets a lot of bad reviews on this page, but she is an amazing professor. Not only does she post ALL of her materials and and lectures, but she takes the time to explain topics and even draw them out on the boards. She always lets her students know that she is happy to help during her office hours and her tests review class content.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took her class Fall 2018. It was as straightforward as intro bio courses come. Everything was posted online in advance including a course packet and two sets of practice exams for each exam. Late afternoon lecture time wasn't the best, but not the professor's fault. Overall, good class.

Not only did I have her over the summer, I also retook her class this semester. I have no idea why she makes her exams hard af and unable to understand. Shes the reason why I will be changing my major.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Danley treated me very poorly when I met with her outside of her office hours. He gave helpful feedback, her lectures are boring and be prepared to study study study.

Dr. Danley is arguably the worst teacher I have ever had. I honestly don't know who hired her or why. She does not know the material, and contradicted herself so much it was nearly impossible to keep up. Lectures are mandatory for participation points, but she just reads her slides and the tests are nothing like the material covered.

Dr. Danley is a great teacher, definitely one of the better ones in biology. She actually gave me feedback on my exam which made me want to do better. I liked the frequent online quizzes because it helped me keep up with the material. You can take them as many times as you want which is a bonus. She offered an exam replacement option.

Professor Danleys teaching methods are difficult and boring. You have to show up for participation points but her lectures are so boring that it is diffult to pay attention. She does not care about her students and could care less if you pass. I would not recommend taking her.

I think she knew the information well, but her teaching style is very hard to learn from. Her lectures are extremely boring and hard stay awake. She uses blank power point slides to write on during class which slows her lectures down dramatically. Attend class and you should do fine. Her exam are also very hard and require a lot of studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is really good at explaining the material. She tries to use a lot of real world examples to help the students better understand. Sometimes the exams did have some tricky questions.

She was a great teacher in my book. She explained topics in a way where a student can understand. She offered a lot of extra credit, 5 points after every test if you fill out a survey. But unfortunately she didn't do grade replacements on tests Spring 2016. All of the other teachers had them besides her, so that was a disadvantage.

I liked the lectures.  Shes not funny but she is very clear.  I came to lecture and earned a fair grade.  I never used the book.  She gave us her lecture notes, study guudes and practice exams with answer keys.  No complaints for this teacher.

She is honestly one the most frustrating Professors Iv have. When you go to talk to her she doesn't want to seem to help you. She very much likes to throw curve ball questions that some would say were trick questions. She does NOT allow exam replacement. I believe the other Professors do. She likes to show off her intelligence. Annoying but doable.

Personally, I did not like her teaching method. In most of the slides on her lectures, she just has pictures with a few words on the slide and then just draws/writes on them. I like to have all the information clearly stated on the slides but the way her lectures were made it hard for me to learn the information.

If you pay attention is lecture and study your lecture notes you will do fine. The class has some challenging content but she teaches in lecture everything you need to know. Studied the textbook for the first test got a B, studied only lecture notes for the next test got a high A. She tells you everything you need to know, its up to you to learn it

I absolutely love Dr. Danley!! She was an amazing and inspirational Professor. Her lectures are so organized and she explains it throughly and step by step. She writes/draws on her slides ALOT (which helped bc I'm a visual learner) so I'd print out the slides before class. If she taught any other class other than 152, I would definitely take it!!

Absolutely love Danley! She's a great lecturer & is mostly clear.  The course load is VERY light but whats assigned will help you learn.  If you study your notes and take advantage of the pp, the echos, and study guides you'll do great on the tests. She is very into asking "critical thinking" questions but if you truly know the material, no problem

Dr. Danley's class is very different from the other 152 courses, she assigns handwritten homework assignments, but they do help you learn. She does not cover information as in depth as the textbook, but this makes the course easier. She is very strict about turning assignments in on time, but I really liked her lecture style. It was very clear.

Danley is definitely the better option to take for 152. She gives A LOT of extra credit opportunities. Her homework activities are basically participation points. That being said her tests are fairly hard. KNOW THE DIAGRAMS! Her lectures are fairly easy to follow. NEVER come late when summaries are due, she will not accept late homework--AT ALL.

Her lectures were boring and it's annoying when a biology professor can't correctly pronounce fructose, but if you learn through practice worksheets and think-pair-share then this would be the one to take. Just not my cup of tea.

I HATED having her teach this class. Her tests were too hard, and I studied for HOURS.  She asks about trivial material and not to make sure you understand what is actually being taught.  She also refused to use anatomically correct terms when lecturing, and it is impossible to respect a biology professor that can't do that. AVOID IF POSSIBLE.

Dr. Danley knows a lot about what she teaches, but don't be afraid to go to her office hours. She will ask you questions to see what you know, but make sure you study her notes!! You'll barely ever have to look through your book and her tests are fairly comparable to her lecture notes! I suggest to print off the slides then take notes that way :)

Wow! I can't believe these neg students.  I thought Dr. Danley was great.  She gave us study guides way ahead of exams, and questions came straight from the study guides.  I loved the participation points, too.  Kept the lecture from getting boring.  Great teacher!
Melody danley speeds through lectures. Is not helpful in her office hours. She simplifies the material and then tests on complicated level. Can't stand her in class.
Horrible tests, don't survey knowledge but instead ask trick questions based on passing remarks she made in lecture.

I have mixed feelings about her.  Her tests were extremely hard (a lot of "more than one of the above, none of the above" answers) and lectures sometimes dragged on. Granted, the material wasn't very exciting.  Sometimes she could be helpful but sometimes she was just plain rude and sassy when I asked for help, often making me feel stupid.
Class averages were in the mid-70's, not in the 60's this semester.  I learned alot in this class, and it helped clear up things other classes didn't bother explaining. Great class!
I liked this teacher.  She made lectures interesting by doing different things like demos and clickers.  Her tests were challenging, but I did fine on them just studying from the lecture notes.

This class was very difficult. I took AP biology and got a 5. While the material covered is not difficult, the manner by which it was tested was. The tests given were of very poor quality and did not fairly test the material covered. Would not recommend.

Danley is a horrible professor! Do not take her. Her lectures do not go along with the exams at all. She never answers questions straight forward. Her reviews are stupid because she never answers the review questions given. Participation points are done in a terrible manner. Do not get the book because she clearly says the info in it is wrong.

Goes way too fast in lecture. "Participation points are really knowledge based to obtain the points" You will NEVER receive a straight forward answer from this woman.  Tests are sorta based on lecture, but she likes to make random things up. The reviews are not helpful because she only provides student answers.
Dr. Danley is a great professor. She makes her lectures interesting and is very straightforward. Grading and assignments are very fair.
Great teacher. Tests straight from class. You have to go to class to do well but pretty easy for the most part.
Dr. Danley is a very straight forward professor.  Come to class, listen, go to office hours and study and you'll be fine in her class.  I enjoyed it overall

Danley is a great teacher.  She gave an outline of topics at the start of the semester and went right through the list.  She also gave an outline at the start of every lecture, so don't know where the lame comments about her being disorganized are coming from - a student that doesn't want to work, maybe? Exam questions came straight from lecture.

Absolutely cannot stand this class or her. Exams contain material not covered in class and lectures are not helpful and extremely unorganized. There is literally no effective way to study for exams. Also, I hope you love lame, inappropriate, and stupid jokes because she keeps them coming.

Got nothing, but As in the class, but did bad on the final and ended up with a B. Dr. Danley tries to be funny, but just ends up annoying everyone with her attempts. The reviews were not helpful at all, but apparently she is better than the other teacher, so I would recommend her.

Do not recommend.  She goes way too fast for you to comprehend anything.  She puts online reviews up before tests that you think are going to be helpful, but don't worry about knowing the stuff on the reviews because it won't help you on the tests.  She puts a lot of random material on tests, some of which she has never taught.  Avoid her!

Dr. Danley in lecture moves extremely fast and you are responsible for writing down what you think is important and because she moves so fast it is sometimes hard to do so. Her test are somewhat difficult because she gives you no study guide. You have hardly any homework which means you have to do well on the test to pass the class.

Biology is probably one of the most boring classes to me, but dr.danley tried to teach it in different ways to make it easier to remember through charts and pictures rather than just straight notes. She also tries to make the grading better by incorporating outside credit rather than all based on tests, since those were challenging

Professor Danley is definitely very knowledgable and enthusiastic about biology. She posts student versions of the lecture PowerPoints online that you can download and use to fill in the lecture material. Her tests pretty accurately represent her lectures but sometimes their wording is a tad tricky.

Her tests were challenging & 'the lightbulb' never really went off for me. I went to office hours & my grade never improved. I gave this class my all, and did not get the grade I was hoping for. Though her lectures may not be as painful as Bonner, her tests are death & are hard to recover from since they are basically the only grades.

Very knowledgable and knows what she is talking about. Tests aren't too tricky if you know what you're doing.  Definitely would take over Bonner. Make sure you go to her office hours because it really helps.

Her lectures are fluid and she connects topics pretty seamlessly. Attendance isn't technically mandatory but she has clicker questions for participation points. Test questions are sometimes not worded very well. Even if you memorized the powerpoints word for word, the test will still have stuff on it that requires some critical thinking.
I love Melody Danley! What a smart lady who truely works so hard and is clearly brilliant! Her classes are hard because she expects more out of you!!

Not really understanding the negative feedback on Dr. Danley. She's pretty hilarious during lecture and engages well with the class. Exams have reflected everything taught in lecture and on power points. Takes awhile to grade exams but other than that I would definitely recommend her.
Danley is a really nice lady and always helped me whenever I asked. Her tests did seem to be at a higher level than her lectures, though. Overall i thought she was a pretty good teacher

Lectures are at a high school level, her exams seem to come from some other class they are so hard. She doesn't curve only gives bonus points and can only cap those at 30. Very defensive if you ask about grading. An unpleasant woman, stay away from her courses.

BIO 102 was a very hard class. Attendance not required. Very hard tests that have around 20 multiple choice ?'s so if you get just a couple wrong it hurts your grade. Not a very nice teacher but did go into a lot of depth trying to explain things to class. Study powerpoints really hard for tests
Makes everything more complicated than necessary. Doesn't feel like a 100 level class.

Lecture - not mandatory. Power points posted online. If someone was not paying attention, she stops lecture calls them out and makes them leave in front of the class. This class did not feel like a 100 level class. The projects are very hard/time consuming. If you memorize the power point slides before the exams, they should not be too bad.
She cannot teach. Her power points are blank, and you will not be prepared for the exams. Class is easy, and she gives extra credit, however the exams have nothing to do with what she does in class.
Attendance is not mandatory but there are occasionally extra credit opportunities in class.  Also there is not much homework but there were 3 extremely time consuming projects.

Awesome person and professor. He knows exactly what he is talking about but if you don't watch the lectures it will be hard to follow and keep up with the material. Overall the course is difficult but he would do his best to help.
Good teacher

He truly cares about how well his students preform and tries his hardest to be available and helpful. He is also very accommodating to students plans and other classes course loads. I highly recommend taking his class, every class is a lecture style and attendance is not mandatory but showing up definitely helps with understanding of concepts.

Mr Patel is a really nice guy and wants his students to do well, but I do not think that he prepares us well for exams. He knows what he is talking about, and if you talk to him, he is really willing to help.
Great professor and person, truly cares about his students. Happy to help in office hours, would highly recommend taking him.
So easy, as long as you pay attention and actually watch the lectures. Just take notes, even if you end up missing class.

My Patel.I couldn't sleep last night because I know that it's over between us.I'm not bitter anymore, because I know that what we had was real.And if in some distant place in the future we see each other in our new lives I'll smile at you with joy and remember how we spent a semester beneath the ceiling,learning from each other and growing in econ.
Patel is the best professor ever! He is so engaging and truly wants everyone in his class to succeed. If you need to take this class I can't recommend him enough.

Attendance isn't mandatory but you should go. Three tests, heavy grading, but they're very similar to the practice tests he posts. The lectures aren't boring because he makes them entertaining and related to pop culture. Would definitely recommend.

Dr. Patel truly cares about his students. He engages them in class and wants every single one of them to succeed. His lectures are clear and easy to follow, and he often relates them to something we can all understand or pop culture!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I have so much to say about him I couldn't even fit it in this all I have to say is he's amazing and I would tell everyone to take him if I could. He is the literal best.

Patel was awesome. I love this guy, he's a great professor and person in general. He is very passionate about econ and his students he wants everyone to succeed and very helpful. The exams are tough but if you study notes, practice exams, and other materials he gives it's easier. I couldn't say enough good things about him definitely take him!

He cares about our success! There is a lot of material and he pushes us to apply it in our daily lives. He has a few rules such as no headphones in class and calls out students who are constantly on their phones or computers!

Patel was such an incredible teacher, seriously such a great professor. However this doesn't change the fact I can't stand and am horrible at economics. But seriously, if you need this class, take him.

Lectures are always so entertaining. Learned a lot in this class, 1. his biggest pet peeve is ppl wearing headphones in class 2. He somehow has an economics related music video for every class which is impressive. Would grab a drink with this guy

Patel is an amazing professor, take him!! He is always accessible to answer emails and his door is open for any questions. H truly cares about his students and wants them to succeed. Lectures the entire time but is very engaging and fun. He is great!!!

Patel is the best teacher for Econ 401. He explains things very clearly and makes it easy to understand the challenging concepts of the class. Study the practice exams and go to his office hours if you have any worries.

Professor Patel is engaging and makes lectures fun. The workload is manageable, and he offers extra credit. Unstuck AI was a great study aid alongside the free textbook. Definitely take his class if you can.

Great Professor. His lectures always help you absorb the material. Always there to help you when you need it. Average amount of homework. which helps for a good grade, overall. Attendance isn't mandatory, but necessary to excel in the course. Definitely wants his students to succeed.

Highly recommend. He cares about his students and truly tries to make this an enjoyable course. The homework can be pretty tough but you do get multiple attempts. The exams can be hard if you don't study but if you take this course how he tries to get you to, you will enjoy it and get a good grade. Likes to crack a joke every now and then too.
He really does care about his students. He wants you all to succeed. The homework can be a lot at times.
Very engaging with the class. Homework is a little heavy but it is doable and he sometimes gives us time in class to complete.

One of the best professors I've ever had. Would and plan to take any class he teaches. Made me want to switch my major to Econ. If you have the opportunity to take his class do it. Attendance counts and if you listen and retain lectures you'll pass the class no problem. So approachable and easy to talk to.

Dr Patel is super awesome, he's hilarious, he does fun demonstrations, talks about his dog a lot, one of the better professors at UK for sure. The course content isnt bad and the exams were fairly easy. Genuinely enjoyable class and enjoyable dude, I would've taken other econ classes with him if he taught them.
Very cool guy makes lectures fun. Curves the test grades most of the time. 2 assignments a week nothing to crazy for homework. Even offers extra credit at end of semester.
Great professor. Good feedback via email.

Must Take! Amazing lectures that made me excited for class. Exams are not that bad and you have multiple attempts at the homework. A really great guy that made my first semester at UK great. Couldn't say enough great things about his class, just take him.
He is the best professor. I didn't know much about Econ but he was fun so it made it better. He gives out extra credit and starts the class with a music video each lecture.

Patel is amazing! He is genuinely funny and teaches his subject very well. There are 2 homework assignments a week and he takes attendance by having in-person questions/papers but he drops a lot of the assignments. If you go to class you will not have a hard time in his class and he gives a lot of extra points on exams!!
Dr. Patel was a good professor, except he did not explain concepts as well as he should have- especially for people that aren't ECON majors.

Dr. Patel always made the class so funny and entertaining. He does concept checks every class so you do have to attend to get those points but you get 8 freebies. I only did so bad because of my struggle with economics.

As a professor, he is great! I enjoyed his class because he had so many activities you could participate in (I think I did participate in all of them), like Karaoke, Auctions, and other fun stuff that brings economics to life. I tended to struggle with the material and often had to teach myself, but I think that it was more of my distaste for eco.

Incredible!! Super thoughtful, open to help students, and his lectures are super innovative. He makes auctions, karaoke, and other engaging things to explain Econ. If you study the textbook, his exams are pretty similar. One homework per week due every Friday, great to keep track of what you learned during the week.
The tests cover every single piece of material covered in class. Must study hard for tests, but overall a very nice and funny professor!

Dr. Patel made lectures as fun as he could, however, econ is not an easy subject for everyone. He gave many opportunities to bring up your grade which I was really thankful for. You have to come to class or you'll be behind.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Patel is an amazing professor, and I genuinely really enjoyed his class. Econ is a lot of boring vocab and graphs, and Patel manages to make it engaging and interesting. Easily the most organized and well planned class/professor I have ever had, and I would absolutely recommend that you take him.

Dr Patel, is the best! Econ is a hard class on it's own but he makes it so engaging and fun. The layout of the class is easy to follow and he gives practice exams for every test! He truly cares about his students and is such a funny and nice guy! He also offers extra credit! I 1000% recommend!
He takes out what a few students are doing on the whole class. Which I see as unfair, he can be fun but lately has been passive aggressive about how a small number of students act.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Patel is awesome. Super funny guy that always made the lectures entertaining. He is truly passionate about the subject he teaches, but more importantly for the students that he has. Layout is super easy to follow, homework doesn't take more than a couple of hours, and always gave us prep time and practice exams before every real exam and final.

Dr. Patel is the best Econ teacher! His lectures are clear, concise, and fun. He provides everything you need to study and succeed in the class. He gives out weekly quizzes where most of the quiz questions are on the midterm and final. Easy A because he provides so many opportunities for extra credit.
Great
Patel is the best. He genuinely cares for his students, and helps wherever he can. He does his best to make the lectures entertaining and engaging. If you have to take ECO 201, he's your guy.

Dr. Patel is a great ECON professor. If you are taking ECO 201 you need to take it with him. There are 4 exams which aren't that difficult as long as you study (he gives practice exams). He's also almost always available if you need additional help. Lectures are also fun.

Dr. Patel is the best prof I've ever had. He tries to make the lectures entertaining and he's super nice. This class was hybrid bc of covid so attendance wasn't required, but he said it won't be like that next year. He provided a lot of resources for studying and was always available to help that if you actually try it's nearly impossible to do bad
One of the most caring and passionate professors at UKY. Lectures are very entertaining, he also challenges you in exams.
Would take Darshak again in a heartbeat. Great professor and very helpful. I would recommend going to his office hours because he gives so much amazing information.
Good funny man. Lectures aren't mandatory but are strongly beneficial. He makes everything easy to understand, I strongly recommend him.

Patel is one of the rare professors that you come across that genuinely enjoys teaching and helping students. Definitely take his class. He truly wants to see his students succeed and goes to great lengths to help make sure of that.
Take his class

Dr. Patel really knows how to give a good lecture. Very entertaining and interactive way of teaching class. Plus, his dog (Tusker) makes appearances sometimes to brighten your day. Really genuine and cares about his students.
He was by far my favorite professor freshman year. He gives access to past exams which helps a lot for studying. He is a very caring professor and makes the class fun.

Dr. Patel is an incredible professor. He truly cares for his students and is really understanding. He is quick with email responses and is always willing to help if you're struggling. The class itself is difficult, but he makes it enjoyable. This was by far my favorite class freshman year. Oh, and he has a really cute dog.

Patel is a very understanding professor that makes it obvious that he loves teaching. IClicker is a part of your grade, so attendance is mandatory but he tries to make his lectures entertaining and funny. He offers extra credit opportunities and as long as you go to class and do the homework, exams aren't too bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor but the lectures can be long and boring. He can also be hard to understand and I usually end up having to come back to my dorm and teach myself the material.
Funny, relatable professor. Take notes, pay attention, do homeworkyou get an A.

This large of lecture class was very intimidating to me, but Patel does a great job of making his class personable and him being accessible. He really is a great teacher/lecturer and tries to make sure his students have a full understanding of the topics. His grading is very reasonable, as he drops some of your lowest class concept check and hws.

Dr. Patel is a very nice teacher and you can tell he cares. He tries to make the class more interesting but in turn it makes him not go into depth in the lectures. He then expects you to know everything when it comes time to turn in your HW. Especially in Mindtap there are extremely detailed questions that are like ?? How can I possibly know this..
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: His teaching ways, is weird. He words things so weird so when it comes times to exams, you're always confused. He gives extra credit to bump up grade but besides that whatever your grade is that's what it is and he doesn't except late work either. I wouldn't take this course again he is too confusing in his teaching ways. Oh yeah Mindtap sucks.

Amazing professor. Econ for me was hard but if you take the time to study and actually listen in class you will pass. As for attendance it is required but I know a few classmates never actually showed up and watched from home and they did fine. For the readings you dont really need to read (I just skimmed) but do watch the pre recorded lectures.
Great at lecturing. Turns boring topics into something fun! I had trouble understanding economics, but Patel does a good job simplifying tough concepts. I definitely recommend his class!!

I liked Dr. Patel as a person, but when other students wouldn't show or didn't do an assignment he took it personally and became very passive aggressive. I also hated the online HW format. It's a necessary evil in a class of +300. He wasn't a hard grader. Just do the work and you'll be fine, be prepared for some sass though.
Dr. Patel was a good professor, but taking an online course with him is probably not the best way to go. I feel like his class would have been a lot better in-person.

Patel is really good person; he's caring and funny. This shows in his lectures. I have sympathy for him in that he had to teach a class with 300+ students over Zoom. Sometimes his lectures did not follow the concept checks very well but I don't know how he could have done a better job given the circumstances. If you need to take econ, go w Darshak!

Professor Patel was a great guy, he worked humor into his lectures and we all loved seeing his dog in every video. He was also very helpful and responded to emails quickly. The tests were fairly straightforward and, although worth a lot, were passable with minimal studying.
I had him my very first semester and so far he has been the best professor i've had easily.

Dr. Patel is very understanding and cares a lot about his students but You need to go to class and pay attention during the lectures to do well on the exams. I only missed class once and went to Leap hours everyday and still got a B.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Patel is awesome! I was nervous to take this class because it was my first business course and everything is online, but I really enjoyed it. Dr. Patel is really caring and wants to make sure everyone understands the material. Guided note documents are given making it really easy to follow along. His dog Tusker is adorable and makes class fun!

Dr. Patel is a really caring professor that really wants you to do well. Taking it online there was no attendance taken for zoom and you could watch them whenever. Make sure to study for test as they are not terribly difficult, but it will show if you don't know your stuff.

Dr. Patel is an awesome professor. This was my first business-related course and I'm really glad I took it with him. He gives material in a way that is easy to understand and is great at answering any questions we had. It's clear that he really cares about his students and wants them to do well in his class. He's also really fun and has a cute dog.

Patel was a great professor. I could tell that he really tried his best to help students understand the concepts, but I think that I, personally, would have done better with a different professor in this class. Just definitely go to office hours if you aren't understanding something.
An amazing professor. Well organized lectures, gives many examples, extremely easy to work with, very nice and understanding.

Dr. Patel is great, the pictures he adds to lectures of his dog Tusker really make the lectures bearable. Sometimes I found the material to be hard to follow, so you really have to take time to listen to lectures and take notes. If you put in some effort, there's no reason you shouldn't get an A. The worst part of the class was the MindTap hw.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Coming into this semester I was very scared because everything is online. But Darshak made it awesome! He really seems to care about his students and wants to make sure that everyone that takes his class passes and understands what is going on! Tusker is also an awesome added bonus!
Darshak is the man! Hes an awesome professor and is a really nice guy!
Dr. Patel is awesome! He is extremely helpful and easy to reach. His lectures are awesome and extremely entertaining.

Professor Patel is great! He explained all the concepts really well and not in a confusing way. He uses follow along notes so note taking is easy. He is really understanding of students and will round up grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Darshak is easily one of the best professors in the Gatton College. He is incredibly knowledgeable about economics, he is incredibly accessible outside of class, and genuinely wants all of his students to do well. On top of this he has some hilarious stories which definitely help make the lectures more enjoyable. If you have the chance, take him!

He is such an amazing professor and very caring. Although the class was a bit difficult for me, he had amazing lectures and cared about his students success. He uploads so many resources for you to improve your knowledge of the class. Definitely one of the best best and most thoughtful professors at uk.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Patel is a great teacher and he's hilarious. You'll have a good time in his class and as long as you pay attention and do your homework an A shouldn't be a problem. I highly recommend taking his class. He really cares about his students and wants them to do well in the class. His lectures are easy to follow and he gives extra credit.

An amazing professor and lecturer, makes coming to class worth it. The content isnt hard but there are only two tests then the final so if you do bad on one you can't really save your grade. There is extra credit for picking up exams and a rockonomics video at the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Patel is awesome. I took him for ECON201 and he made the material super easy and interesting. He loved engaging with the class, which made me look forward to going to class. Attending is pretty important to understanding the material. He really cares about his students and gives plenty of extra credit opportunities. Overall a really cool professor!

Love Patel!! He's the best econ professor, and he always keeps his lectures interesting. Sitting closer to the front definitely helps in a 450 person lecture hall because it's easier to ask questions --that he's always more than willing to answer. Attendance is such an easy grade booster because he gives clicker questions throughout class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Patel is awesome and made every day better. Textbook- semi-mandatory; there's a note taking guide you'll want to get in order to better take notes and do well in the class. Three big exams - test 1, test 2 (midterm-ish), and test 3 (75% new material, and 25% cumulative). Really incredible man, respected teacher, and ridiculous stories
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Patel is a G ... he makes lectures really engaging and interesting, even when the topics aren't interesting at all. He really has a passion for economics and brings that enthusiasm to each lecture. The tests are heavy (70% of your grade), but he's accessible outside of class and the lectures provide almost everything you need to succeed.
Prof. Patel is a really nice guy and genuinely cares about how you do in this class. He is really great at explaining the concepts taught and his tests are pretty easy for the most part.
HES AMAZING! 3 exams (counting the final) he seriously wants you to get an A, definitely curves (bumps from B to A if close) too! its not an easy class but most people pass with a B
great person

Darshak Patel is hilarious and the classes are actually really fun to attend. That being said, the exams are hard and you have to study your butt off to get an A. He also offers a few extra credit projects throughout the semester. I definitely would take him again.

Darshak Patel is hilarious and the classes are actually really fun to attend. That being said, the exams are hard and you have to study your butt off to get an A. He also offers a few extra credit projects throughout the semester. I definitely would take him again.
Professor Patel was great, plan to attend every lecture if you want to learn the content and do well on the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Patel was absolutely amazing. His lectures were very interesting, and he made learning economics fun. I would definitely recommend him as a professor.

Attendance isn't mandatory but you will be missing out on lecture/information and you will hurt your grade because of the in class reef clicker questions. Loves to bring his dog, which brightens up everyones day and tells some of the funniest stories from his past!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Patel is great. He explains concepts really well and keeps classes upbeat and entertaining. He is always available for help, and is happy to work with students.

The advantages of taking Econ 201 with Dr. Patel are: lectures are excellent, entertaining and full of substance ( your learning experience will be less if you do not go). Disadvantages: test questions can be subjective, but there are resources outlined in the syllabus for this. Tips to succeed: Read syllabus, study practice exams.

Patel cares a lot which is really hard when you have 400 students in one class. Attendance via clicker is 15% of the grade so showing up counts. Tests are 70% and they're tough. But if you pay attention and do the homework you'll get an A.

Patel is one of the most amazing professors I've ever had. He gets on a personal level with his students and really cares about you as an individual. He is a fabulous teacher and if you follow his class exactly the way he has it set up, you can't fail. Attendance is a huge part of being successful in this class but Patel makes class fun!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Darshak is the GOAT when it comes to teaching and econ. He definitely knows what he's talking about and makes it relatable using personal experiences. He can be a bit tough when it comes to grading, but he wants you to understand it. Really recommend taking him.
he's a cool guy. you get used to his accent really quickly

Patel is a great teacher for eco 201. I had him in a small lecture, and he really cares about his students. He really loves Econ. He loves to tell stories about his life and somehow find a way to relate them back to Econ. He will have you seeing Econ in your everyday life. The textbook isn't necessary, but make sure you buy the supplemental notes!!

I would highly recommend Dr. Patel. He's knowledgeable, funny, and always willing to help outside of class. He often says he's willing to drive to campus on the weekends just to help a student out. His exams are not easy but if you study, you can easily get a B on them. Lecture is mandatory because of poll quizzes.

I don't like economics, but I REALLY enjoyed this class. It's a little confusing at times, but Patel does his best to make the material fun and interesting.
