Attendance is mandatory, but i enjoyed going to class. He isn't a stickler about electronics, and he makes note taking easier with his supplemental handbook. Definitely take him if you can!

Dr. Patel was the first professor I had in college that made learning fun. He told stories about his life, all while somehow connecting it back to Econ. We do quizzes during every lecture so attendance is pretty mandatory although the quizzes aren't hard. The exams are exactly what you expect so they are an easy A if you study.
AWESOME professor. Definitely makes coming to class easily.
Great class, Dr. Patel is very accessible outside of class providing us with two review sessions for every exam. If you work hard in class and study two or three times a week you should do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Available outside of class no matter the reason. As long as you pay attention in class, you will do fine on the tests. One of the funniest, most genuine professors I have ever had and he truly cares about every students needs,

I LOVEEE Darshak. Not only is he hilarious, but he truly cares about his students. He is willing to leave his own house (and dog) to come to campus and help you out with anything dealing with his class. I did not buy the textbook, but if you do not BUY the notes, you will be left behind (plus the notes are so much more helpful and organized).

awesome teacher. cares about econ and his students like no other. will go out of his way to help you. Exams are tough, buy his note packet and keep up with the notes. dont rely on group me for all the answers on homework and try to cram. best to keep up and grasp the concepts as they come.  he is very personable and funny. dont be afraid to speakup

Dr. Patel is overall a good professor! He loves what he teaches and tries to make class fun. His class isn't super easy, but if you show up, take notes, do the homework, and study, it's not too hard to get a good grade. Seek out help if you don't understand the material. Dr. Patel makes it known that he will help you, if you contact him.

Probably the best teaching experience I've had in college. Clear, easy to understand, and wonderful to speak to outside of class. Coursework itself requires thought and studying, but the class is worth it. Very funny and intelligent man! Keeps everyone involved and has great class exercises.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He was great. Even though attendance counts for credit, you can skip 1/4 of the classes and have it not effect your grade. He made new concepts easy to understand and you can really tell that he enjoys teaching.

Dr. Patel is one of the best professors I ever had. He is very passionate about economics and finds ways to teach the subject in a fun manner. His tests are fairly difficult, but if you read through the notes and attend class, they are manageable.

Darshak loves what he does and it reflects in his teaching. He cares about each and every one of his students. Any help you need, do not be afraid to ask. He is a very entertaining teacher who makes funny, real world references. I loved lectures. He isn't there to hand out easy A's but if you pay attention and put time in you can get them.
He is awesome.

He is hilarious and knows what he's talking about. Finds ways to engage with students during the lecture through clicker questions and hilarious stories that he can relate back to Economics. Definitely one of the best Econ teachers I have ever had.

Mr Patel is one of the best educators that I have ever had the opportunity to take. He is absolutely hilarious and really connects with his students because he is so young.  Prepare yourself for interesting lectures, witty jokes, and stories that will rival even your craziest college adventures. Straight G.

Dr. Patel is a great teacher. He will explain anything to you as long as you give an effort to reach out to him. His grading is what you'd typically expect. As long as you pay attention in class, you will be fine!

He has clicker questions almost every class for credit. He offers an extra credit project that was worth 4% total. He likes to add stories to his lectures which make it a bit less painful. Not too hard of a class. Never used the actual textbook really, but I did use the note-taking book from Johnny Print he recommends (helpful).

He clearly is passionate about the subject. He teaches you not just the material, but its applications and how to analyze. Definitely recommend attending classes and reading. He is down to earth so be vocal and ask him questions. He was always willing to help me during office hours.

If your not interested economics than this class will more than likely you will find this class hard. The tests are hard but not impossible. Sometimes he can be unclear but if you read the book it can clear things up!

Dr. Patel is an amazing professor. He's hilarious and tells great stories regarding his life and relates it to  his stories to his life.   In my ECO 201 class, the class average has been 77% and 73.5% for the first two exams. I've been to class everyday and have gotten an A on both exams.  Exams are fair and require some studying.

He rarely dismisses early. He is really funny and makes class intersting, but I didn't get anything from his teaching. His tests are incredibly hard and nothing we were prepared for. The class average on test hasn't been above 70% all semester. I would not recommend taking his class if you want to pass.
Dr. Patel was very helpful and made this economics class very entertaining. I would highly recommend him for ECO 201.
Great professor, easy course if you pay attention and take notes. Fill up the cheat sheets for exams and you will be fine

Dr. Herrig is a very kind professor but she often runs through material too fast. Especially the stuff that is more difficult. Exams are worded weirdly which is annoying. Watch the videos provided for each lecture. It is more of a flipped style course which isn't the best but put in the work and make a good study guide and you will do fine.

Dr. Herrig is sweet and understanding! I recommend going to at least one or two of her student hours, especially after an in-class worksheet or before an exam (or if you are timid to ask clarifying questions during lecture!). She is caring if you speak with her individually and she is very kind when answering any questions. One of my favorites.

She is one of the kindest instructors I have had. She really cares about her students and makes sure we actually understand the content, not just memorize it. She also offers extra office hours based on student availability and will even look over your cheat sheet. Her classroom feels very inclusive, safe, and respectful.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Herrig is TRULY the most precious soul on UK campus. She's kind, compassionate, and truly wants her students to succeed. Going into her class, be prepared to take a lot of notes, BUT they're to help you! Her office hours are based around what hour works for you. She's the best prof. i've had so far!! Love her!!

Dr Herrig is great. She genuinely cares about your wellbeing as a student, not just the grade you get in her class. If you get stuck on a topic or concept, you can schedule a student hour with her to go over it and she will explain it to you until you get it. All of the lectures are posted online, so you don't have to go to class often.
Likes to act stuff out in class, which can be really helpful at times to understand stuff. Exams were pretty easy as well.
Dr. Herrig is awesome! Her class is not very difficult, but she still does a great job teaching you biology.

For a general biology professor, Dr. Herrig excels. If you forget to turn in attendance, she will be more than willing to accept it after the due date. If you need help, she will help you during student hours. The group work unit wrap-ups are difficult as you can only use yourself and those around you, but if you review, it will work out.

SHOW UP TO CLASS. This class covers 7 units. After Mrs. Herrig finishes a unit, the following class day you get in groups of four to do an inclass worksheet, no phones, electronics, just your brain. These wrapup worksheets make up 17.5% of your grade. Show up to class so you know whats on those worksheets, dont rely on random teammates to carry you
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is great but standardized tests not indicative of what was taught. Thankfully tests don't count for much of grade. Allows you to watch echo if you miss class and allows cheat sheet for tests, but again tests didn't match what was taught. Students routinely cheated on exams using phones and nothing done about it. Frustrating!!

Dr. Herrig wants to see you succeed in her class. Lots and lots of material covered each lecture but you can manage and learn well if you do the extra homework assignments and go to SI sessions. Exam questions are difficulty worded but if you ask specific questions during the exam she will help you.

Dr. Herrig is very nice but talks extremely fast during lectures and is therefore hard to follow. Her teaching style didn't work well for me, but if you do the practice questions/exams and attend SI Sessions you will be fine. She also assigns a good amount of homework which cushions your grade some.

Amazing and caring professor that tries to make biology fun. Accepts late work and the work that can be submitted late is easy. Get a front and back cheat sheet on exams, which generally aren't very difficult anyways. Go to her office hours and she'll explain content very easily. Can't make them? She'll schedule another additional hour that works.

Dr. Herrig is AMAZING. I'm a visual learner, and she likes to draw out a lot of her material. It is so helpful to copy her drawings on your iPad because we get cheat sheets on the exams. If you copy and paste your drawings to your cheat sheets, you'll get an A on every exam. She explains everything so well and I would take her again if I could.

She is a really nice teacher and is great for visual learners. this course is very heavy content so there is a decent amount of work and there's daily participation points but you can watch the live stream at home so in person attendance isn't mandatory everyday.
Best professor I've ever had. Biology is always going to be content heavy but Dr. Herrig makes it easy to comprehend and adds fun ways to learn.

I like Dr. Herrig, but the class style isn't for everyone. It relys on watching lecture videos on your own and submitting notes for a grade, same with in-class participation. Then, there is a lot of homework quizzes that end up being busy work. The assignments will save your grade if you don't do well on exams.

This teacher is nice, but her teaching style doesn't work for me. She doesn't really teach; instead, she just reviews another teacher's video recordings. We take notes on these videos before class and then draw for participation in class. I end up learning from a different textbook because the notes and lectures don't make sense. Wish it was online

Loved Dr. Herrig! She's super kind and compassionate. Her class is a little difficult since there is a lot of homework and you watch the lectures at home and practice in class. However, her teaching style is super fun and most of the class loved it! Plus she lets you have a cheat sheet on the tests! Would recommend her for anyone taking BIO 148!!

my literal queen she is so sweet and so good at teaching and so passionate about biology. she makes class fun and interactive which I really appreciated. fav professor so far would do anything for her
LOVE HER!!!

One of the best professors at UK! She truly cares about her student's success and it shows. Her lectures were sometimes a little fast-paced, but it was because she wanted to cover as much content as possible.

I loved being in Dr.Herrig class. You do have homework due every night before class, but it doesnt take long and Dr.Herrig really doesnt believe in late work, as long as you get in any missing assignments before the exam you get full credit! Participation matters but she streams all her lectures so youll be fine. Overall great class!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very nice and not a super difficult class, I loved her. She also livestreams all lectures so you can watch.

She is so so sweet and genuinely such a good person! She is very accessible and wants all of her students to succeed! There is a decent amount of homework, but most of it is just notes so it's very easy. You get a cheat sheet for all exams and they aren't very difficult either. Attend class and you'll be fine!

Had to have surgery during the semester which means I missed about 3 weeks of lectures. She was incredibly helpful with makeup work and offering me resources to help with missing in person class. Very caring about how I was doing and what I needed even though I was one in 200 or more students. Fast to respond to emails and responds thoroughly.
Great professor. I honestly though she did a very good job at teaching, and although there is a lot of homework, it helps.

Dr. Herrig is amazing at what she does. There is a huge adjustment to the large amount of homework, but it is all useful for the exam. You even get to create a 1 piece cheat sheet. She lectures similarly to a highschool teacher, which I love. It keeps me engaged and drawing out things like meiosis is really helpful. You even can retake an exam.

She is a very sweet person which is why I would rate her a 2 but her lectures are utterly stupid. If you learn through drawing "doodles" she's great. But if drawing pictures does absolutely nothing for you like it does for me DO NOT take her as a professor. She just makes you watch Dr.O's videos and take notes and even that is rough.

This professor was my least favorite professor I have ever had. She is very unfair with her grading and takes points off for participation assignments no matter how much work you put into them. I did not enjoy her class and felt like she was personally attacking me and some of my friends from the class. FIND A DIFFERENT PROFESSOR.

Dr. Herrig is very kind and caring. She is very passionate about what she teaches, and she tries to make the material as easy to understand as possible. It is a very hard class still with a lot of concepts to memorize and understand. She is very easygoing and is more than willing to help you with whatever you need.

Ms. Herrig is a great teacher,  she spends a lot of time drawing pictures or having you draw pictures which can be annoying but it honestly does help you understand the material.  She is extremely nice and if you go to her office hours she will explain things in a very easy-to-understand manner.

She was accessible outside of class and made herself available at student discretion to answer questions and set up office hours. The class is content-heavy, but the more you put into it, the more you get out. She explains things clearly; if it's not clear the first time, she will find a different way to explain it or pull other resources.

Dr. Herrig is the best! She has such a passion for Biology and it helps to make the class more enjoyable. She is always willing to help you outside of class. Really already a solid class, I would recommend taking!

Dr. Herrig has such a passion for bio it makes the class more enjoyable. However, the class is done in a flipped style so you watch videos and take notes outside of class and then come in to discuss. The points do add up and the exams have a lot of application on them but she is always willing to help

Do not take her for Bio 148 she teaches awful her lectures do not make sense at all for every unit section she would make you watch Dr.O videos upon the unit which is completely different then what she would teach in class. She gives so much HW but worth only 1 point assignment. Her exams are very difficult some of which we did not learn in class.

She is an extremley caring person who you can tell she is passionate about the material and lectures well. But there are lots of videos that you have to watch outside of class and are worth small point values. Going to class is kind of pointless but helps with exams on which you get a front and back cheat sheet which makes the exams quite easy.

You watch lecture videos before coming to class, and then in class its a continuation of what you already learned in the video. You also test your knowledge in class with poll everywhere questions she gives, which is essentially like iClicker. Many of the grades were just participation grades but they are essential to complete to understand class.

She taught the lab portion of 304. She doesn't usually teach the main genetics lecture so I can't rate her on that. However, she makes the lab so enjoyable, and not only that she was really understanding on grading. She really helped me and my friends succeed.

These classes are exactly how college classes should be. Show up, pay attention, and do the work, and you will THRIVE in Dr. Engle's classes. She is kind, helpful, and incredibly knowledgeable in her field. Appalachia is one of the most overexploited and underinvested places in the United States, what may seem controversial to some, really isn't!
Sweet professor, there is homework obviously. Wants you to succeed, just actually care about the course and you'll be fine!

I have attended 4 higher educational institutions - I have never left a review for a professor until now. Yes, Dr. Engle is opinionated, yet very rarely did I feel like those opinions were forced on others. My advice is this - if you do not know how to articulate your position or give adequate pushback to ideals/ideas,  take another course - Simple

I disliked everything about her class. From the way she taught, to how many assignments she gave us. If you're just taking it as an elective, Don't. she is the toughest grader and assigns so much work for a class that isn't even apart of your major. I spent the most time on this class just to end up with a D.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The workload is heavy, and if you don't answer exactly how they want you to, you will be getting points off. Both the professor and TA were rude and disrespectful, imo. The film reflections and exams were awful. 0/10 I would not take this course or professor again.

The material is pretty tough at times, even though I had a near perfect score in the class I would never take this again. Lectures ran past time, countless nights writing those meaningless 4 page movie papers and the discussion boards...never again. She also wouldn't post slides. Shelby was the best TA ever I hope she does good things
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Had her for APP 200, that class is the worst. Insane amount of heavy reading/writing every week. Tests were lengthy and tough, even with lots of studying. Grading took months to get back. Class was very political and boring. TA's (specifically Shelby) made it better though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Engle was not bad. She is very opinionated, but she is a good lecturer. She only graded one thing and it took her months to get it back to us, but the TA's were great! Dr. Engle was very helpful whenever I did have questions, and as long as you paid attention to the lectures and study, the tests weren't very hard. Lots of discussion posts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures ran past time, workload heavy. It was awful
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: This was probably the worst class I have taken in my entire life. Not only did I not feel respected by my professor majority of the topics we discussed in class had nothing to do with Appalachia. The lectures were poorly run, and for an elective the workload was very heavy. I do not recommend this course, or any course taught by this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: this class is genuinely the worst

Don't take APP200. While the professor isn't necessarily bad it is just the course load on top of the not posting lecture slides. Papers every week. Class is way too political. STUDY!!!! For every exam or you WILL fail. TA's were amazing tho
Class was horribly ran and had nothing to do with the topic that I signed up to learn about. Course was very hard to follow and she made it very difficult to access ,materials.

Ratings are too low ... TA's are amazing and the main professor is opinionated sure but it really isn't bad. Weekly essays? Sure. Sometimes there are 2 essays in a week and it is for sure busy work intensive. It isn't the hardest class I've taken ... Just do the papers, study a few days before exams, you'll be fine. Plus there's extra credit too.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: She is very opinionated and political. The class feels more like a politics/social justice course that uses Appalachia as an example instead of actually teaching about Appalachia. Workload is somewhat heavy for a non-major course, but goes fine if you can bs it. Def would recommend taking a different course for your core.

Dr. Engle has lectures twice a week, and it's a relatively easy course if you show up and take notes. However, she is very opinionated, and a lot of the course winds up veering away from Appalachia and turns more political. Overall, would not recommend. You could get points docked if you don't agree with her opinions

Would never take this class again. Class does not only focus on Appalachia but gets very off topic and political to the point that it takes over the entire class. Discussing inappropriate things for an Appalachian class nearly everyday. Teacher gets very upset if you do not agree with her opinions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Very educated in her field however is very opinionated in her teachings. Assignments are long and strenuous, graded heavily, and way too much work for a non-major-related course.
Focuses on wrong things

Not worth it just a bunch of busy work. As a freshman I hadn't realized people often dropped classes, I surely found out why all my classmates were disappearing and it was because of how bad her class is. If your over credit for the semester wither its due to your major or an addition minor DO NOT take her classes you will end up dropping it fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Although the topics covered were interesting, I did not enjoy the execution of this class at all. You had a 2.5 hour "quiz" every week which were so specific to direct quotes in the textbook, it wasn't really about if you understood the material. Everything seemed to only be to "prove" you read the material/ watched the assigned films.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This was my only class this semester I had the most homework in. We had weekly reading assignments that took hours to read. Then you had to answer questions based off these 10-12 page reading assignments. She made the class very political and at times she talked about things that were never on the exams. Made her political stance very well known.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Honestly not super sure why her ratings are so low. If you come to class (seriously, show up), copy down the notes from her lectures, and skim over the weekly readings, you should do fine. However, I will say that this is probably the most "busy work"-intensive 200 level class I have ever taken and ever plan to take.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Probably my least favorite class I've taken so far. The weekly discussion posts take multiple hours to complete, and some of the readings are outrageously long. She often teaches her opinions as facts, and some lectures aren't relevant at all to the topic of the class. The only perk is that she gives study guides and the exams aren't too hard.

Overall, this class wasnt difficult. The readings were super dull and long. The class was structured around discussion writings that were long, but easily BSable, and awful discussion sections. Dr. Engle often got exasperated when students didnt agree with her politics and never took the time for an open dialogue outside of surveys.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class has a lot of information, but Dr. Engle makes it easily digest-able. There are weekly writings about readings but these are easily completable and dont take a ton of work. Dr. Engle is very passionate about the Appalachian region and does a great job at exploring various aspects about the region. Only 2 exams, midterm and final.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Tbh I passed this class with a 99% A and I couldn't tell you anything about anything in the class. If you know how to BS assignments, you can pass this class. She gives out many opportunities for extra, too. The discussion board posts are very lengthy and can take some time. She also tends to get overly political, kind of obnoxious.
Way too political, tends to rant during lectures. Assignments take way too long to do.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: worst class I have ever taken at UK. This course expects way too much and is very boring. No one should ever take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Way too much work for a 200 level course. Weekly discussion posts take over an hour to do, had assignments due over thanksgiving break, gave assignments over dead week
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy class overall, professor gets overtly political at times and gets angry when she gets called out on it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I took this for CORE and it was not too bad, first semester was review of HS sociology. A few short essays and enough extra credit to bump up a letter grade. Quizzes are on quizlet. Tests are multiple choice (same q's from quizzes) and essays over major topics. She is nice, but is not lenient on grades because there is so much extra credit.

"Lectures" were rambling. Group work was absurd. Total of 12-14 pages for papers. Weekly quizzes, and 2 tests which consist of long essays. Unrealistic expectations placed on a 300 level course (no pre-req needed, open to any major, sophomore can enroll). NOT accessible. Grading took over a month. Gave instruction for final paper 10 days before due
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: You should probably take this with a different professor. She doesn't put up lecture notes, hard test with a lot of information usually consists of short answers and essay, pop up papers,  hella extra credit but you have to work for it, lots of readings!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Must have perfect attendance and participate. Lots of feedback and critiques.
Multiple instructions, so expectations for assignments were unclear. Participation appeared to significantly impact grades, even with perfect attendance. I'd take another elective.

Lectures were largely unengaging and often followed notes with frequent tangents. There were no clear rubrics, so expectations for assignments were unclear. Participation appeared to significantly impact grades, even with consistent attendance.

Emily is my fave professor I have ever had! She is so easy to connect with and is so eager to help students do well in her class and beyond. The content was fun and the work all felt worthwhile and manageable. As long as you show up and put in effort you will do well! It was well worth the 8AM and I would take this class again in a heartbeat!

Love this lady! She is new to teaching but is so chill and knows a lot about the sports world! Great speakers and a lot of group work. As long as you show up and complete the assignments you will do good

Class graded by 4 exams only. Nothing else. Very tough exams. Lectures can be confusing, but reading the textbook helps put the pieces together. Dr. Riggle is very knowledgable but lectures could be dry if you aren't very interested in law. They give clues on what will be on the exam in lecture so make sure you don't miss a class!!!!.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She doesn't use slides, but rather just writes a few terms on a google doc, that she goes over so fast and merges each talking point with one another, so it is extremely hard to follow. She leaves everything up to you reading the textbook. Her exams are the hardest and most tricky exams I have ever taken at UK, and I have taken challenging courses.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH HER. If you talk to anyone else who took this class with another professor they says it's like a 300 level introductory easy class. However her exams are so hard and I am a good test taker. She gives no opportunity for extra credit and even if you study for weeks you will unlikely get above a B. Trust me. just don't.

Syllabus is scary, but she herself is fine. You will be reading for hours, and if you don't, you wont pass. I put in hours studying for the exams, but the tests are tricky. Your grades are literally 3 exams and a case brief exam. If you are not a good test taker, you will fail. Again, if you don't read and take notes, there is no way you will pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are as dry as dust. She doesn't care about students only how she herself feels.

Dr. Riggle comes off as very intimidating at first, but with time you realize that she's really super nice and a great professor. Her humor really makes the class entertaining. I'd highly recommend this course.

Her syllabus is scary, but she's great. She's very forgiving when it comes to quizzes, and on tests she adds extra questions but still grades on a 100 scale. She knows what she's talking about,  her lectures are interesting, and she's funny. She's one of my favorite professors, ever. There is pretty much always homework to turn in, so don't miss.

Professor Riggle was one of the toughest I had at UK, but she was by far my favorite. She is brilliant, and you learn so much from her. She does not take any crap, but in the best way ever. Everything you learn is applied to real life. You get a page of notes on every exam, two pages on the final. If you are considering law school, take her!!!
She lets you have a full page of notes on the exams. She is very smart and even though she is feisty she is an awesome person. I have an A and the homework is so easy. TAKE HER!!!

Look out! The tests are crazy hard. Literally, they are nothing but a bunch of blank spaces and fill in the blanks. Basically, you have to rewrite phrases and words and certain amendments word for word. She grades the tests to toughly. She rants in class and never gets to the point. The home work is busy work that is too long! Tons of writing!!

She lets you know exactly what she expects from you.  Homework is grade.  She gives you a few chances to understand how she grades before taking an actual grade.  Gives quizzes to show what the test will be like.  Favorite political science class and professor so far.

She is very interactive and tells you exactly what she expects. She also gives you multiple chances to get a feel for the class and what she looking for on the assignments. I thoroughly enjoyed her class!

One of those instructors that lectures straight out of the book, but makes attendance mandatory.  The way she teaches the course is dry and borders on lazy.  If you are looking for a course that analyzes cases this is not the course for you.  Test questions are 25% obscure questions.  Very disappointing class.  I will not take her again.
I would not recommend this professor at all I am a PS major and her and her class did nothing for me.
Tough teacher, come prepared. She knows her stuff and will put you on the spot. Worth it.

Riggle is a great teacher! Took her for 360 as well. She is very straightforward in what she expects, and if you do the work, I do not see how you cannot get an A. Tests can be difficult, but just do the readings and make a solid study guide and they are not that challenging. I wish she would teach more law/court classes!

Criminal Law...this class was fun, honestly she didn't teach us much. The tests are hard, they're all fill in the blank and are based off the book but the answers are very subjective because you're not given a word bank and a lot of words are interchangeable in criminal law. But she does let you use a paper of notes to use on the test.

Do the study guide questions.  Use them as your note sheets on the exams.  This is the only way to ensure a good exam grade.  The exam questions are 10% lecture & 90% study guide questions.  I found her very helpful when I was worried about my grade.  Again, class attendance is not enough, you really must do the study questions.  I liked her class.

As long as your interested in the subject matter and don't mind doing the outside reading Riggle's class is a breeze. The hw is easy and is helpful when studying for exams. The outside videos were not entirely related, but were entertaining.

She knows her stuff, but does not seem to want to help students learn it. The study guides for Exams are the only saving grace for this class. Be sure to have assignments done and go to class regularly or you miss out completely on that portion of the grade.  In the middle of the semester she started giving quizzes and called them "participation"

Beginning of the semester she is extremely scary. She demands alot and wants to seem tough but she does ease up towards the end. KNOW the lists for her exams and make sure you turn in short assignments and paper because it will help. She does help on the second exam. Although, lecture is boring and be prepared to feel inadequate.

The woman uses this class to boost her own ego, installs no motivation to her class, and enjoys seeing everyone fail and hearing about kids getting arrested in order to feel good about her self. She thinks she is smart and her test skilled reflections of what she thinks she has taught but in reality they are poorly written vague worthless!!!
Terrible professor.  You're better off not going to class, because her lectures contradict most of what's in the textbook--which is all the exams are really about.

Riggle is ridiculous!  We spent half the semester watching pointless videos.  The test are hard even if you attend every class.  Find a different professor and you might actually like this class.  Otherwise be prepared for a weekly trip to hell!
She's teaches more than she puts on the tests but the only thing on the tests are the subjective lists that you MUST memorize to do good. Class is pretty easy as long as you know whats on the test.
Class is not hard if you read the book, if you rely on the teacher you're screwed because she can't teach worth crap. Completely useless teacher...do not recommend taking this class.

Tests are very very factual. Lectures are straight forward.  Shes kind of odd...not very chatty when I tried to talk to her.  she did the shuffle and look at the desk, rather than talk about my question/problem.  Screwed my final grad over bc I didnt put enough effort into my paper...
Very factual class.  Lectures are straight forward and interesting.

I loved Professor Ehrenborg's class! He is funny and really cares that you learn. He has quizzes every Friday, but you can usually guess what they are going to be about. I didn't find the coursework to be too difficult and he was always open to answering questions after class. Applicable algebra was amazing and so much fun!

Professor Ehrenborg is really outgoing and one of the best for math. His handwriting is hard to read at times, but gives a lot of extra credit and helps you through the course. Quizzes and exams are not too difficult if you pay attention during lectures and exams do have review.
This professor isn't too bad, but the actual coursework was difficult. About halfway through the semester, I started having to teach myself the topics because he was hard to understand.

If you struggle with math, I would not take this professor. However, if you have a decent understanding, this is a really good professor. He is knowledgeable and you can tell he is really passionate about math. He does have a heavy accent and can be a little hard to understand sometimes, and his handwriting isn't the best, but he is really funny.
He is very passionate about what he does, but that tends to leave moments where you feel like you can't catch up. Go to recitations because you need to if you want to learn most of this.

He doesn't have slides for students to go over, and his writing on the whiteboard ends up scattered everywhere. Ended up having to get Cram Better and other online sources like The Organic Chemistry Tutor to actually know what is going on in the course, which helped. If you get a good TA then it is definitely a big lifesaver, but avoid if possible.

He is not the greatest professor at all! I do not recommend him! I have a learning disability that he did not accommodate to. I emailed him three times about these accommodations and he did not email me back. When I mentioned it in person, he said, “yeah yeah.” And left the classroom. His exams are also heavily graded with a lot of small grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: he CANNOT teach a class or even help students when it comes to exams. His lectures have NOTHING to do with the class work and especially nothing to do with exams. Please for the love of god and your sanity do not take him or switch if you got stuck with him Or you'll have to do all the learning outside the classroom. TRUST ME!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

I had no clue what he was saying in any class. What he would talk about in class wouldn't be math at all, and if it was math, it wouldn't be what we were supposed to be learning that day. I would have failed if I hadn't used outside resources to learn the topics. Lectures are pointless and your grade depends on your recitation teacher.

Dr. Ocho Cinco Ehrenborg has THE funniest lectures at UKY. Unfortunately the class is designed where a lot of students hate him due to the nasty percentage exams make up for everyone's overall grade. I personally skipped 70% of the lectures and ended the class with an A, so as long as you do EVERY practice exam youll be fine given you're not an egg

I'm sorry, but I simply DO NOT understand all these 5s. Literally I am a 3.8 student (3.74 thanks to this class), and Calc III with Ehrenberg is literally impossible unless you rely on TAs or Study Tutors. Being funny literally does not matter when he can't (AND WON'T)TEACH the material. He literally just did magic tricks on Divergence Theorem Day.

Dr. Ehrenborg was a hilarious professor with witty jokes that made the lectures enjoyable. They are very hard to follow sometimes because he doesn't use guided notes or anything, but it's worth it for the Perry the Platypus jokes and juggling.

If you want to learn Calculus 3 steer away. He is a funny guy, however, he can not explain Calculus 3. I asked for clarification and he said I just know that. His handwriting is atrocious and can barely understand the way he talks because of the Swedish accent. Loves to waste class time teaching matrix algebra which is not useful for Calculus 3.

Lectures are little to no help, as he gets off topic frequently and even when he is on topic, he offers little help. While he might not be able to control his thick accent and illegible hand writing, these both make it almost impossible to learn anything from the lecture, as he tends to ramble with little explanation on what he is working.

You cannot and will not be able to read his handwriting, let alone understand what he is saying due to his thick Swedish accent and bad handwriting. Half of the time during the lecture he does not work on problems relevant to the topic you are currently working on.

Really funny, kind, and fascinating guy who knows his stuff. At times can be a little difficult to understand because of thick Swedish accent and bad handwriting when he is writing actual words, but you can always ask him to clarify and he happily will. Make sure not to miss a lecture because you will get behind, as he packs a lot into each one.

He is really passionate and it shows. Shows tons of real life examples and he's really smart. He is willing to help students and is very kind, he always says "welcome" to everyone coming into his class.

Do more than the bare minimum, especially in higher-level classes. You need to understand the concepts decently well to pass. Handwriting is also not the best, and he openly admits to that, but he says what he is writing so it's not difficult to understand what is on the board.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Ehrenborg was a really cool prof. I didn't do that great in the class and the material was hard but he routinely rounded my grade up. Really great guy, class is tough if you don't pay attention. There is no book, test is based off what he teaches. 9/10 prof, 6/10 class

Take Dr. Ehrenborg if you pick up math quickly. He touches lightly on theory before doing examples in class, but he does every step and often shows helpful shortcuts. Up to three hw assignments from textbook per week, all done on paper. NO CANVAS PAGE, so you will not know your grade, and final exam is HEAVY (30% of grade), so do ALL the work.

I would tread with caution when taking a class with Dr. Ehrenborg. He is an amazing professor, and extremely smart when it comes to math, however, my belief is that he is not the best professor for everyone. If you struggle with math, I would not advise taking him, however, if you don't, 100% take a class with him. It is an amazing experience.

Had quizzes every week, 2 midterms and 1 final. I don't think he actually graded the quizzes. All exams had heavy curves because this course was very difficult. He's very nice and likes to joke but his exams could be pretty difficult. I would study hard for this course with him. I know a lot of other students had trouble with this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: His internet connection is horrible but he refuses to do anything about it so the lectures are way too blurry, he doesn't provide office hours and doesn't respond to emails, and we're three months into the semester and have 1 grade in canvas even though we've had weekly quizzes. He completely expects you to make up for him having to teach online.

He wants us to remember to take derivatives. I have not done that since Calc 1. Also, we have to be able to know the quadratic formula. I don't remember this and don't see the point. WHY DO I HAVE TO REMEMBER STUFF FROM FRESHMAN YUEAR?

An idea of his inimitable style: Every day, he waltzes into class with a lab coat. He explains the proofs he's writing on the board with a thick Swedish accent. Catchphrases: "Isn't that cute?" and "Agree?". Best math prof I've ever had - if you enjoy math, he engages you and makes you think while you simultaneously laugh your head off.

Awesome teacher! He was certainly not the easiest teacher of Calc 3 that we have, but he did a really good job of ensuring a good understanding of the material that was covered. consequently he expected you to have an in depth understanding on tests, which were always 5 questions with an easy one, and a hard one at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class ended up being okay in the end, but there was no homework given for credit, tests/quizzes were 90% of your grade, and half the class didnt understand what was happening. If the course wasnt curved before grades were posted, I would have done much worse. Hes funny and makes lectures enjoyable, but its hard to obtain a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Richard is a complete genius and you can tell just by watching him work. Half of the content used in lectures are unnecessary, however very interesting. Although his lectures and study guides make the content seem impossible, tests are very reasonable. Easy grading and he is a reasonable man if you have questions. He is a joy to have as a prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Would take again

reviews.comment: VERY difficult to find outside of class and very random during lecture, can be funny though.

Easily the best math professor I've had at UK. He keeps things interesting with his strange jokes and does tons of examples. Lots of homework, but graded only on completeness. Exams/quizzes are fair and reflect examples, HW, and review sheets. His handwriting's bad, and occasionally he'll rant, but don't let that keep you from taking him.

He sometimes lectures over extra information that he finds interesting but you wont be tested on so be aware of that but hes very nice and funny. His homework is not very long and his quizzes are fair. His exams were only about 5 questions but he has good review sheets that are reflective of exams.

He's definitely in my top 5 favorite professors of all time at UK. Great lectures, and he makes them enjoyable, so I really love coming to class. His accent and handwriting are sometimes hard to understand, but you figure it out as the class continues. Grading on tests is very fair, and 3 assignments a week to see how you understand the material.

He's a goofball and a solid choice for a lecturer. He can be a bit unclear at times, especially his handwriting, but does a good job to keep class engaging. Homework is assigned randomly and is all done on paper, quizzes every Friday, but the tests are easier than the homework and can be done without a calculator.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious

reviews.comment: This professor is one of the smartest people I have ever met. He knows more about mathematics than I will in my entire life. However, all he does in class is proofs of theories. He does not teach the students how to actual WORK a problem. He also does not use Canvas or grade the tests until about two weeks after they were given. Not Recommended.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Simply amazing professor. Lectures are engaging and clear, and he's incredibly enthusiastic about the topic. I don't like math very much but he made the topic interesting and easy to follow. He's super friendly and accessible. 6/5

Was surprised to see a lower rating. He's hilarious and really trys to make Mathematics somewhat bearable and enjoyable. Yeah his accent takes some time to get around. But he's very kind heart-ed and quite amusing; which is rare! The material in this class is quite dense, so prepare yourself. Ehrenberg is a genius and you'll see it in his teaching.

Being from Sweden, he can be a little tough to understand at times  but is still a great lecturer and tells many great jokes.  Writes quickly and somewhat messily but still legible. It's evident he really cares about calculus. You can skip a few lectures here and there and be okay. Just make sure you attend the last class, it's great.

He's not bad. A little confusing. You're TA is more important for this course than the lecturer is. His lectures will make more sense if you took calc in high school. Tells funny jokes. Cancels class day after exams.

Really fun lecturer. He's from Sweden and has a slight accent,but it makes his jokes all the better. Fast writer and somewhat sloppy handwriting. I had no calculus background before taking this class and I actually understood it from his teaching.

Funny.  Swedish accent, but most people should understand him clearly.  Good teacher.  Gives fair exams.  My only issue was with grading.  I answered one question correctly using an alternative method from the one given in class (not the derivative shortcut), and it was counted completely incorrect because it wasn't done using his method.
Yo Great Prof, but needed a grader.   Liked his lab coat.  Very funny.  Covered all the book.  He could put the material at our level.
Great and entertaining prof.  Very funny, too.  Love his white lab coat.  You will learn a lof in applicable algebra and will also have fun.  Ehrenborg rocks!

He originally said he'd take attendance, assign homework, give weekly quizzes, and give 2 midterms. So far, there's only been 4 homeworks (which he didn't grade) and no quizzes/tests. He pretty much said he'd just give us all As. I still love going to his class though, because he's excited about what he's teaching and he picks fun topics.

This was my favorite upper level math class. I have heard horror stories about MA 340. But if you take it with Ehronberg, you will enjoy it! He's an awesome professor. He gives quizzes every Friday and you can almost always guess what they are going to be over -- study for these every week to keep up with the class and its relatively easy.
Attending Lecture is pointless, but its not mandatory. He was difficult to get in contact with outside of class. take someone else if you can.

Funny guy and an okay professor - probably one of the better ones in the math department at UK. Homework is assigned but not required, but you should do it because there are weekly quizzes. Exams can be a bit tough, but he curves very generously.
He's a funny Swedish guy. A little hard to understand sometimes but he is fun and crazy. Pretty easy and WAY FUN.
Ehrenborg is the funniest teacher on campus. Not easy, but helpful if you need it. He is hilarious!
Ehrenborg is my hero! He is so funny, just because he's tall, awkward, and Swedish. His tests are pretty hard, but he gives GIANT curves. Like, a 67 was a B+. I learned a lot from him.
man cant even speak english,  and expects you to understand by the ramblings of himself and poor examples he gives  worked my ass off and got a c   dont do it
Very hard to understand. You must know every theory and how to use it. Very nice tho.
He is a nice teacher but his tests are insane.  although he does curve a lot.
He is nice and knows his stuff.  He can be hard to understand at times and be sure your cell phone doesn't ring in class... otherwise he'll answer it and ask for a pizza... take my word for it....
Extremely nice.. but.. hard to understand.. and if you ask a question.. good luck w/ the answer you get.
Nicest man you will ever meet.  Sadly, the man is just to smart to teach.  He does curve, but still.. avoid if you can.

She is very capable in terms of knowledge in anthropology but isn't that great of a professor

If you're wondering why Dr. Koch has so many awful reviews... just trust. Tests are nothing like class material or lectures. She talks so unbelievably slow and robotics it's a miracle I got through a semester with her.

I would not take this professor again. Class was interesting, but she does not teach well. The lectures were long and wordy. The class is based on just a few assignments, so you better do well on all of them. The exams are NOTHING like lectures, notes, or study guides. There's fill in exam questions with no word bank, so good luck. Don't recommend.

reviews.comment: Professor Koch seems like a very nice person; however, not a great teacher. Very, very long lectures. Study guides, readings, or lecture notes will NOT help you for the exams. She puts random questions we have yet to learn about on there. The TAs have called her crazy multiple times. Hopefully, you get a good TA!!

holy worst class i've ever taken. she probably won't show up for the lectures but you won't know it's been cancelled until you show up for class. Exams cover topics that aren't covered in any readings/study guides/lectures. she expects you to be able to remember specific quotes SHE SAYS during lectures for exams. Pray for a good TA

never shows up to class, lectures are the most boring thing known to man, politizes topics and blames men for a lot. TA's even said she was crazy multiple times. Has the worst worded questions on tests of any teacher I have ever had. Makes an entry level class feel like a 300 level class. 100% don't recommend taking ever.
Horrible professor and teaching style, but interesting subject. Hope for a good TA and pray she comes to at least one lecture every two weeks.

reviews.comment: Lectures are very long and unhelpful. Goes over wordy slides very quickly and doesn't allow pictures of them. She'll talk so much but not say anything of substance. reviews.comment: so bad

I have never been more mislead by someones rate my professor rating than I was by this one. I came into the class prepared for the worst but prof K is one of kindest, most understanding profs I've had at UK. The class itself is lecture heavy, but so easy if you just put a little effort into it.

Always misses class but expects you to come to all lectures. Gets mad when no one pays attention to boring lectures. Her lectures are incredibly boring and pointless. She genuinely comes across as if she has no idea what she's talking about. reviews.comment: It's a very easy class, however I had a problem with the professor and the TA. If you are a republican/conservative, beware. This department injects their left wing ideas into the curriculum. Whatever you do, do not disagree with professor/TA beliefs. Also very rude!

Prof. K is the worst professor I've had. She assigns readings for every lecture and then teaches useless information. I promise you I did not learn one thing in her class this year. reviews.comment: Lecture is the most unbearable thing you will ever have to go too. Prof. K thinks her ANT160 class is the most important thing on campus and that if you aren't bright eyed and cheery for her lecture, she will call you out. Her lectures and wordy and long and the best way I can describe it is that she talks a lot but doesn't say much. very rude prof
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She's actually the worst teacher I have taken at Kentucky. She whines like a toddler when someone on their phone. She expects everyone to do the 60 pages readings for lecture and just rambles about useless things. She acts like ANT160 is the most important class on campus. She also doesn't let you take pictures of the slide and will call you out.

Its clear she has a passion for her work that isnt always shared by those in her class, however she does expect and require collegiate-level academic professionalism and respect. She is smart and has a lot to say, but usually leaves a good portion of class for student discussion. She can be anal about distractions, but she accepts late work.

DO NOT TAKE HER CLASSES. RUN. Most rude, vindictive teacher I have come across in four years at UK. Constantly calling people out for unimportant things. Acts like she is teaching 5th graders. Is crazy about attendance but hardly shows up to class herself. Would NEVER recommend unless wanted to see someone miserable. Horrible teacher! SO BORING

reviews.comment: She's quick to call you out when you don't do your work, but it's because her classes are mainly based on discussion from the reading/homework, so I wouldn't think it's necessarily unreasonable. reviews.comment: Long, BORING lectures. Class is mandatory. However, she is hardly ever there herself. When she does miss, she assigns the TA to play an "educational" video for the class. She never gives clear responses to questions, and you better be ready to read. The papers she assigns are too lengthy for an introductory course and her quizzes are way too wordy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Really, really hated her. Probably the least favorite professor I've ever had. Tedious lecturer, overbearing teacher, incredibly type-A personality. Didn't seem to understand she was teaching a 100-level gen-ed.  She sent the TA around to check if anyone was using a phone in a pretty big lecture hall, once. She brags if she catches anyone.

She's literally the worst teacher I've ever had. She's extremely rude, boring, and not passionate about her work. She will yell at you in front of the whole class if she wants. I would not recommend her to my worst enemy.

She's boring and I felt like I learned absolutely nothing. There is no real incentive to do the reading or attend lecture other than three quizzes that you can get a decent grade on just by glossing over the key terms. Worst thing is the grading breakdown. There really aren't enough points in the class so one mess up can really damage your grade.

She is completely aware how boring the subject of Anthropology is and takes full advantage. It seems like she's attempting to put you asleep during lectures and completely overuses vocabulary. Having said this, if you can push through sleepy eyes the grading itself is very easy. Do the assignments and you'll get at least a B no matter what.

Terrible teacher. She is mean and rude. She will call you a liar to your face even if she has proof that she is wrong. It is an easy class but if she does not like you she will give you terrible grades. She also loses papers that you turn in so keep everything!! She literally chewed my class out one day for being bored. WATCH OUT!

I've taken three of her classes, and have greatly enjoyed them. Yes, they can be tough, but college students should be expected to study and THINK about the material.  She is a wonderful professor, a great asset to UK, and is very passionate.  Take her!
Professor Koch was extremely boring and vague. Most of the course was about anthropology which the entire class cared very little for. Do not take her unless you have no other choice.
She is an awful teacher. She comes off as nice at first, but look out because that is just a mask. She might like you if you suck up to her, but most likely she won't. She's very rude also!

Dr. Koch is a nice, and absolutely loves you if you come and talk to her. But she can get super testy if you don't live up to her standards and is extremely irritable. If she thinks you aren't paying attention she'll call you out. Otherwise, she is clear about her expectations and it's fairly easy to do well.

Easily one of my favorite professors. She may seem tough, but it is just a passion for teaching, a passion for the subject, and a reasonable expectation of students in higher education to be responsible and to want to learn.  She is extremely helpful, and once approached, will give you great advice.  She recently won a university teaching award.

Most horrible anthropology professor at UK.  She will absolutely embarass you in front of everyone, even when you do nothing wrong.  Makes a complete boring subject even more horrible because she's the one teaching it.

Do not take this professor! Anthro majors, try to hold out for a different one. The actual class part isn't so bad, but this woman is absolutely the most unhelpful, vindictive person. She spends half of the class berating everyone for minor errors in the papers assigned and for attendance yet she was constantly cancelling class! Oh and don't expect

warning!! Do NOT take this lady. She will cut U down in class in front of everyone. She will take off a full letter grade on any paper if U are even one minute later. She changes the syllabus 3 or 4 times.  Misses class herself but still expects U to be there and on time as she leaves a note to the sub to mark U down if you are late.
Anthropological theory in itself is completely boring.  But she is knowledgable of the subject matter and tries to make the class as painless as possible. Fairly easy to approach.
good teacher, expects a lot but is a genuinely nice person and wants students to get the material. looks good in them glasses too ;)

Very sweet. Class is based on exams and the assignments done in each class period. Exams can be more difficult than PowerPoint presentations in class, so it's important to pay attention to her lecture.
Don't procrastinate because everything is due on one day. Not a bad professor, but definitely not memorable.

reviews.comment: This online class was fairly simple, the easiest bio class you will get for sure. Don't procrastinate because everything for the entire module is due on one day. She posts lecture videos and be sure to actually take the time to watch them.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Great professor. Class is informative and well taught by Dr. C. Exams are all online and the final is optional, so it's pretty easy. Some homework here and there but it's not hard. I say attendance is important because she can help with the homework a lot and the slides might not be very useful if you don't go to class.
Such a sweet person and truly wants you to do well. She was always very very helpful to everyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. C is awesome. She's a very intelligent but approachable person. Her labs are so different from all the others I'm in in the best way. She's calm and patient and genuinely wants her students to learn. She's also very responsive and answers questions even when I emailed her at the strangest hours.

Dr. C was honestly awesome! As a professor I think she did a great job. The class is really fun and the labs are really cool. The only downside is the paper. The paper we wrote in class was really challenging, especially if you have minimal writing experience. The TA's grade hard but it is so worth making sure your final paper is solid.

Dr. Croteau was not a horrible professor, but is definitely not accommodating under any circumstances! Class is not mandatory, but I would recommend going if you want to truly understand what is going on! She has assignments due month by month, and you better make for sure to get them done! A missing 2.5 point assignment will drop you grade 3%...
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Her teaching style is one that makes you not want to show up to class. You do not have to go, but assignments are definitely easier to do if you do go. 

It is an easy class to pass, just do the assignments and take the exams. With the way assignments are weighted, if you were to miss a couple it is IMPOSSIBLE to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I have enjoyed Dr. C and BIO 198. The labs are not too difficult, and if you get stuck you can ask. She grades easy as she expects you to make mistakes. Makes you think, but not too bad. Highly consider this class.

For BIO 103, I expected to learn anything other than evolution and basic science. Yes, it is BIO 103,  but I didn't feel motivated to go to class. Exams are SUPER easy and she has only one assignment per class which takes five minutes to do. Don't expect her to grade any of it though. Otherwise, she likes what she does.

Having previous experience with scientific writing is essential for a good experience with this course. There is minimal help for students without experience writing a research paper. However, my TA was EXCEPTIONAL and gave me feedback on my writing frequently. Be prepared to spend time on this course and start working on the paper early.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you are taking "Scholars Biology" you need to have a background in writing scientific papers. This class does an OK job of teaching you, but having preexisting background is important. The lab is honestly super fun, and is a breath of fresh air compared to Chem lab. Put A LOT of effort into making your papers match the rubric and you will be Ok.

I would recommend anyone who wants to do research early to take this course. If you keep up with the due dates, start working on it kind of early, and talk to your TA, you should do well in the class! There are no exams, but a final lab report and infographic that are worth most of your grade.

Dr. C is such a great professor! She was always so kind, helpful, and knowledgeable. She found a variety of ways to teach us about research and the honeybee gut microbiome to keep things interesting throughout the semester. She was also super helpful in taking us through the steps to prepare for independent research in BIO 199
Dr. C is really great at answering questions, and she helped me with opportunities for BIO 199.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Honestly Dr. C is amazing, and this lab would have been a lot more enjoyable if I had a better lab partner. The labs are extremely enjoyable and you actually feel as if what youre doing is important. There is a drastic switch halfway through and the lab report is extremely difficult to write as she thinks we should know what the data means.

This class was a lot of fun. It is definitely work-heavy towards the end of the semester, but it is based on the work you do all semester, so you are familiar with the information. The common hour lectures are helpful so go to them so you understand the lab work.

I like Dr. Croteau as a person, however we went from building legos for a lab to writing a research paper over our bee experiment. Whenever you get something wrong on the labs, your correct answers are hidden. I only took the Course because it was called "Scholars Biology". If this is also you, it's not worth it. Take 1-2 intro BIO classes first.

The first half of the class you just do experiments on bees. They start sooo easy and then get fairly complicated. There is little to no instruction besides the written procedure. Don't bother asking questions she will either make you feel stupid or ask "Well, what do you think?" or "Everything you need is in the procedure". Honestly, don't take.

The first half of the class is very easy as you just do experiments with no homework. But in the second half you work on a final research project that takes in everything that you did in the semester and it is really hard. She's fair and does a rough draft and lets you edit it but prepare to spend a very long time on this paper.

Dr. C is very intelligent and knowledgeable. However, she didn't provide a lot of help when you were confused. In fact, she could be judgy when you were confused. It's like she already expected you to be familiar with the material. I knew the class was going to be more difficult, but I was expecting more support.
Dr. C is an awesome professor. Definitely take 198 over 155 if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This was just a super easy class and Dr Croteau was great! Lectures were quick and easy, attendance wasn't crucial, and grades were reasonable. Tests sometimes had others things in that we didn't touch on, but the final was optional. Would recommend her.

I had Dr. Croteau for BIO198 and she was an amazing professor. I really enjoyed the class and the way she taught it. The hands-on labs were very fun, and though the research paper took a while to write, the class taught me a lot about what research looks like. I highly recommend Dr. Croteau, she was very nice, helpful, and made the class enjoyable.

I was so surprised to see her current rating. She is genuinely the best professor I have this semester. She has such an infectious enthusiasm about this class and is genuinely likeable. She is also always willing to help during labs, in a way I haven't experienced in any other course. If you have the opportunity - TAKE THIS CLASS. It's the best.

If you take good notes and attend every lecture be prepared to get a high C/low B. Exams are worth vast majority of the grade and much of the information on the exams are not covered in lecture/skimmed over. Highly recommend another professor.
Dr. Croteaus BIO 103 is extremely lecture heavy. Lectures dont really help on exams. Exams are your entire grade so if you dont do good, rip.

reviews.comment: Don't have to show up to lectures at all as long as one group member does. Extra credit on every test. Very nice and is genuinely concerned with students knowing the material. Lectures range from being long to super short. Like 5 minutes short. This more of an into to science class so a lot of it is common sense. Take her!

Dr. Croteau is an awesome professor. She is very kind, nice, and understanding. There is a big midterm review paper that can be daunting, but she does a great job explaining the requirements and is always available to help. Definitely take 198 over 155 if you can.

reviews.comment: Dr. Croteau is super nice and will help. Definitely would take her again. The class is pretty chill at the beginning, but there's a huge research paper after midterm. No exams or tests which is nice.

This course isn't that bad as long as you pay attention to the slides. She always posts Echos of the lectures and gives extra credit after every exam as long as you show up to class. There's one project that's super easy and the final is optional.

She is a great professor, I hate that she has so much bad feedback on here. She is a fun teacher who cares about biology. She wants all of her students to pass. Im glad I got a chance to take her class!

I didnt have much interaction with Dr. C other than she graded my paper. Shes kind of intimidating & definitely grades really tough. But, she does give good advice when grading or when you ask questions. Dont procrastinate anything in this class. It will hurt you. Super easy going at first but extremely assignment heavy at the end.

Dr. Croteau is amazing. She's very approachable and understanding. Be prepared for an easy-going first half of the semester and a stressful second half. The experiments were cool and she played a lot of good music during lab.

Her class was literally the hardest class I've taken as a freshman. Her powerpoints do not reflect her test, we spend all of class time going over a powerpoint that literally serves no meaning to what we are being tested over. The only good thing is she gives extra credit, and I honestly think this is because she knows her test are extremely hard.

This was a really easy class. Attendance isnt mandatory. No textbook at all. There are some group assignments that need to be uploaded to canvas, show up these days which are listed on canvas. Go over the powerpoints before tests and youll pass this class easily. Theres a research project at the end - CAKE!!! Such an easy class
I heard a lot of negative things about her as a teacher but once I was in the class I really liked her, shes a great teacher.

Easy class as long as you take notes over the powerpoint everyday!! Tests range from 30-40 questions, and she always gives 8-10 questions back if you attend the class after the test. No homework for this class, a lot of group work, test grades basically make up your score!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Very easy Biology class. Work in groups a lot for class participation. Final exam is optional. Super nice

The research project is super easy and the final is optional, which is nice, but the exams get substantially harder throughout the semester and there are no study guides for any of them. Other than that, she's an alright teacher and the class isn't too bad.

SHE IS THE BEST! Really nice lady, she gives extra credit after every test. The tests are more difficult than what they should be but the extra credit makes up for it. No homework, just one project which is really easy. I recommend taking her.

This teacher is horrible. The Class is very lecture heavy and you work in groups every day to do busy work that is pointless. The final is optional but you really have to study for the exams (there is 3 of them). She has no study guide and you have to study off the objectives. I wish I had a different professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. C is a great professor. Her ratings do not reflect her course at all. Three exams, with the final being optional. After each exam, she gives you a bonus assignment which is an easy 8-10 points back on your exam score. This class should not be difficult whatsoever. She gives you study objectives which is exactly what she tests on.

I was nervous coming into the class because I had heard she was tough, but she was a great professor. The final was optional so I didn't have to take it. You do need to study to pass the exams, but the class after every exam if you show up, you'll get points back on the exam. Other than that, attendance really isn't mandatory.
She was one of my favorite professors, she lets you fix your exams to get some points back, you have a paper but the outline tells you exactly what to do and she does not make you take the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: A lot of people try to hate on her, but they probably just didn't go to class. Go to class, pay attention, and you'll be fine. Read ALL the directions on the project to get a good grade on it and boost your class grade. Although she lectures a lot she takes little breaks to let you talk about class material through examples in groups.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I took this class as an intro bio, and it was SO unnecessarily hard. Some of my friends taking the same class w/ a diff prof got easy A's and I was struggling to keep a B. Seriously pick someone else for this class. She tests on an extreme amount of content and her study guides are so vague and really don't help. Save yourself the struggle.

Dr. Croteau was very focused on helping students understand research in the fields within biology. If you take this class, be prepared for a quiet first half of the semester, but a hellish second half; there were several grades, many counting for 12 and 25% of the overall grade, given. She often played music in lab and hid bonus in the syllabus.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. C is a nice women but the class was not laid out very clearly so sometimes it was confusing what we were doing. She is approachable and will help you if needed. I would take her again!

Dr. Croteau really isn't that bad at all. Lectures of a lot of analogic content that you don't need to remember, she posts study guides that tell you what you should know. I stopped going to class halfway through the semester cause she posts echos and slides. Easy honestly!

BIO 198 is a cool class. Two big papers determine a big part of your grade! Everything is weighted equally at 25% so thats a little odd. Croteau is is good but get ready to teach yourself!! I like her though

Personally, I wouldn't advise anyone to take this class unless you're a bio major or enjoy the subject, class is hard, lectures are heavy, you work in groups, but the group work doesn't help with learning any of the material. Shes a nice professor but if I had known based on her teaching skills, I would've taken it with a different professor.

Tests are really difficult and the lectures are not helpful to the tests. Lectures focus more on real life application rather than the actual content, but the exams are solely content based so you basically have to teach yourself the basics to even understand what she's talking about during lecture. Wouldn't recommend for non bio majors
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Croteau has been very unfairly graded. As a freshman, she was one of my best professors. She is very laid back and caring. Her tests are very straight forward, and if you look at her study guides and take notes during her lectures you will easily pass. She also gives extra credit after every test, offers a retake, and optional final.
Test hard, work in groups, but get 4 points extra credit after each test. Wouldnt take her class if you actually wanna know about bio

You can definitely get an A in this class, however, I would advise looking at other professors. I learned that other classes had to do less work and were graded easier. She is a good teacher and ready to help, but her tests are hard.

Bio 103 should not be hard. It's basic Bio that you learn in High School. However, with Croteau it's very hard. Her tests are way harder than they should be. Some of the questions are so misleading! Her lectures are long and boring if you don't go back and watch the echo's and copy her word for word you're in trouble. Very hard to class bad prof.

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class. She puts all lectures online and class is not mandatory. Very flexible with grading and kind and understanding towards her students. The material itself was a little difficult toward the end, but she was very helpful throughout.

SUPER EASY research project which is a large portion of your grade only about 5 homework assignments 10 questions ea. & super easy to complete! reviews.comment: I did not learn much from her lectures, but all the material covered on the tests are in the powerpoint she provides and the textbook. Studying is necessary for this class; it was not an easy pass.

DO NOT TAKE! She in no way prepares her students for the exams. I went into her office twice and she had no idea what to tell me. She is not helpful and blames everything on us rather than understanding she is horrible at explaining material.

I had Dr. Croteau for the lab portion of the class, and she was awesome! She wanted to help students boost their grade in the insanely difficult class and helped everyone whenever they needed help. This was the most relaxed, fun lab I have ever taken, and it helped me learn the material.

While her class does require a decent amount of studying, it is NOT that hard. The research project and minimal homework is SO easy. Amazing professor. Every lecture was enjoyable and interesting.
