This class is made significantly more entertaining and interesting than you'd think because of dr. myrup. you can tell he clearly loves history and his lectures are very engaging. be aware, its all auditorial. no slides and nothing on canvas. One of the best professor at UK. Good lecturer, engaging, and a balanced workload.

He is kind, funny, and very understanding.

reviews.comment: Dr. Myrup is really nice and always has an upbeat attitude. The class is very lecture- and recitation-heavy, with weekly readings and quizzes that refer to the lectures and readings of the week. Overall, great teacher.

He was an amazing professor who gives engaging and interesting lectures. He is pretty funny and very caring, often postponing deadlines for papers when students need it! This class has roughly one quiz a week, two papers, a midterm, and a final exam. My only complaint about this class was that the grading was not put into canvas until the very end.

Dr. Myrup is an amazing professor. His lectures are well organized and interesting.  He extends deadlines and is easy to contact. He is also very knowledgeable about the content and makes it easy to understand. There are somewhat lengthy readings for recitation, but the quizzes are pretty easy. Overall, I would recommend taking his classes.
super nice professor. you have weekly readings you will have for this class. recommend having your recitation on a Friday so you have a full week to do the readings.

AMAZING. He is literally so happy all the time its very refreshing, recitations help a lot and he extends deadlines for students, he genuinely cares about student success. take him if you have the chance! super nice guy and so funny and entertaining.

He is awesome. His lectures are so captivating and he really makes history come to life. You can also tell he really cares about what he is teaching and that he wants you to do well. His TA's are also very nice and helpful. The recitations aren't bad, you just have to make sure to do the readings. Overall great class and a great professor.

Definitely a professor who loves his job. Even though history may not be the most exciting class, he definitely makes me happy to go to his lectures as well as it's very easy to take notes in his class. There are weekly readings which tend to be pretty long, but it's easy to split up and finish. 10/10 teacher.

Mryup is a good lecturer. Though lectures are not mandatory attendance it's important to go to not fall behind and do well on the weekly quizzes in recitation and exams. There is also A TON of difficult reading. There are also weekly quizzes in recitation that are mostly about the readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I really enjoy history so this class was super interesting. Myrup is a great teacher and is passionate about History. There is a quiz once a week based on readings assigned and lecture. There is an essay and mid term/ final. The test has vocabulary and a written essay. Overall, not bad the lectures are 50 minutes. Would take again

He is an absolutely incredible professor. The class is very lecture-heavy, but he provides outlines for them and is incredibly engaging. He's also very kind both in and out of class, including allowing extra time to complete the midterm. I definitely recommend taking one of his classes if you get the opportunity.
Favorite professor so far. So funny and cares about his students, really passionate too. Grades relies very heavily on recitation quizzes but always pretty easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Respected

reviews.comment: Myrup is so passionate about history. His lectures are very fast with no visual aid which makes taking notes difficult. His recitations also require a lot of reading. However, if you do everything it is very easy to get an A. Also, he is extremely helpful if you visit his office hours and loves getting to meet his students.

My favorite professor I've had so far. Your grades are heavily dependent on your TA and there are readings every week, but the lectures are very engaging and informative. He is energetic, fast talking, and passionate about history. The PowerPoints are just pictures but he has an outline available for every lecture. Overall great course!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Myrup is a cool guy. He is energetic and invested in the class. The work is not easy and you will be reading a ton. You need to study for exams and the paper is hard - brush up on how to do footnotes. Your grade will depend on how difficult your TA grades.
Great professor!
He is one of the best teachers I've ever had

reviews.comment: The material in this class is hard. Grading is relatively easy though but this may be dependent on the TA. It's a lot of reading, most of which is pretty confusing. Dr. Myrup is very nice and passionate about History. If you enjoy history you will love this class.
He was ok he doesn't use PowerPoint unless its pictures and he talks fast so you have to try to keep up with him.

reviews.comment: Amazing teacher, would 100% take his class again. His lectures are great and he's very detailed. You have 2 papers and quizzes on the readings that you do. Tests are a detailed definition of vocab words and an essay portion.

reviews.comment: He was a super good professor and really engaging

Dr. Myrup makes his lectures very entertaining. He does talk very fast so taking notes can be stressful at times but his TAs will give you any missing info. This course is very material heavy so studying for the tests can be overwhelming but if you study, tests are an easy A. A quiz is taken every week in recitation to count as weekly attendance.

Absolutely amazing professor, made the lectures very fun and interesting especially with his connections to pop culture. The recitations are easy, you just need to read, would recommend going to recitation because it can help if you are struggling with any of the material and you can get clarification. He is very easy to talk to and helpful.

reviews.comment: Greatest of all time. This man is what every history teacher in every school should strive to be like. He's the most passionate teacher I've ever had a genuinely cares so deeply about his work and his students. Everyone should take one of his classes at least once while they're here.

Dr. Myrup was immediately my favorite teacher. He makes Star Wars and Star Trek references that actually really help you understand the point of his lectures. He is so kind and truly cares about his students. You will have a quiz every week but they are easy 100's if you actually listen in all lectures and do the weekly readings.

dr. myrup is an absolute GEM; you can tell from his lectures that he truly loves it. i talked to him about switching recitations, and he was happy to do it (alex was GREAT). if you go to class, you will do good on weekly quizzes in recitation, and then there is a midterm, paper, and final. it is hard, but if you do the work, you will succeed.

I love Dr. Myrup. You have to try in his class but an A I attainable if you want it. He cares so much and has respect for his students which goes a long way.  The best history professor I have ever had.

super super nice guy, loves teaching very easy to talk to and converse with, very enthusiastic about history and what he is teaching very, do the readings, because his in class slides are just photos with little to no context, i had the one recitation where he was the teacher for it so the slides was just the same as lecture no added benefit.
goat.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER, I LOVE DR. MYRUP!! Dr. Myrup is the most enthusiastic professor that I have ever had and he puts so much care into each lecture. Lowkey cried on the last day haha.

reviews.comment: He is the best history professor at UK. His true passion for history resonates with his students. Classes are reading-heavy, and you have weekly quizzes on the readings, but they are not strenuous. He brought homemade Brazilian food in for one of our last classes!

I LOVED DR. MYRUP! He's passionate about what he teaches and it shows. The way he teaches does take a second to get used to, but once you figure out how to take notes and keep up it's very understandable. Heavy on reading, but that's part of history. I feel like I would've struggled in this class if someone else taught it

Lots of reading. All you HAVE to do is show up for recitation. I recommend going to the lectures because that is the only way you'll get the material for the test. The tests aren't hard, but they are long. He's so funny and really cares about his students. You can contact him at ALL HOURS of the day/night. Not even kidding. Taking him again!

If I could rate higher than a 5, I would. Dr. Myrup is very energetic and passionate about history it made me excited to learn about it. He brings in tons of fun stories and examples to a class that could easily be hard or boring under different circumstances. It's very lecture heavy but definitely worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took his class ages ago, but never filled out a thing on here: he's my favorite prof at UK and im not even a history person; worked with me to get caught up, super respectful that students have lives outside class. all u do to pass is go to lecture and do the homework, he doesn't trick u on exams. dr myrup if you're reading this, thank you!!!

I absolutely LOVE Dr. Myrup. He's so caring and respectful of every student he has. Short quiz every Friday but super easy if you do the readings for the week. He does take attendance and there's not very many grades so, it's super important to get that quiz grade every Friday. Lots of studying and reading but overall amazing class!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Lectures and notes are a MUST if you want to do good on the exams. Recitation is a big portion of your grade (there is a quiz every time). However if you could not attend or received a bad they are very good with make up quizzes (the TAs). This professor is so funny and interesting to listen to which made the class so enjoyable.

Professor Myrup is one of the best educators I have ever had the privilege to learn from. His lectures are always funny, well thought out, and interesting. There is a good amount of reading that you will take a short quiz on the next day though it's not a big deal. Besides that there was no homework. I strongly encourage everyone to take the class.

Very kind and polite teacher who is easy to approach when have question. There is a lot of reading, but majority time you can go without it for the weekly quizzes. The weekly quizzes are easy and short and if you do bad on them you can retake it. Offers final and midterm review session as well
Go to lecture, and you'll pass.

reviews.comment: THIS IS THE BEST PROFESSOR EVER!

Dr Myrup is awesome. His lectures are engaging and entertaining and he cares about his students a ton. I will say though, he does not upload any grades onto Canvas so you don't really know your grade. but he does pass back the weekly quizzes so that can always give you an idea.

Myrup is a nice professor who cares about his students and his work. However, there is reading assigned every week; you're graded on these for attendance in weekly recitation. My one warning is the final and midterm consist of an ID term section in which you must know 100 terms, he chooses 9 of them, and you have to write a paragraph on 4 of them.
This professor is really nice and you can tell he genuinely cares about what he's teaching. Be aware however that the exams are 50% of your grade. The exams are all writing questions.

reviews.comment: I genuinely loved this class so much. Myrup is a great professor and really tries to make his lectures interesting. PLEASE be nice to this man he is a national treasure. He was amazing! I had some difficulties during the semester and he worked with me and helped me drop even when the deadline passed. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS OR PROFESSOR. You will have to read 100 pages of boring history every week. 2 hours to complete. Take a quiz over the reading which is graded hard. reviews.comment: I dropped Mark Summers to take this class and I don't regret it, I love this class! I'm no genius (Business major btw), so don't worry about that. He's an amazing professor, gives great lectures, and cares about his students. He'll go out of his way to even call students! Take notes in class and read the weekly lectures and you should get an easy A

By far the best professor I have had at UK. Lectures are interesting and he makes class very engaging! Grade consists of 2 papers, weekly quizzes from the readings, the midterm and the final. He is very approachable and seems like he genuinely cares about his students. Would recommend!

i have absolutely no interest in history but had to take one & drmyrup kept me so interested in every topic we covered. honestly the best teacher i have ever had. the midterm/final seems intimidating, but if you study & take notes during lecture, its absolutely nothing to worry about. 350 words isnt enough to say how good of a teacher drmyrup is!

Dr. Myrup is such an amazing professor. He is so knowledgeable, and he is engaging in lectures. He makes note-taking easy, and he is very approachable with questions. Also, his impressions are fantastic!

Dr. Myrup made me interested in a topic I had no interest in with his amazing lectures. However, he rarely uses power point and info from the lectures are absolute required to get a good grade.
