A lot of homework. Lectures are boring. Gaynor

He is honestly a good teacher, but he is new so obviously has his flaws. He graded small assignments kinda hard. My final grade ended up rounding to an A but if he hadn't have graded our small assignments so hard it wouldn't have been worrisome. He puts in a amazing effort for his students though

Class was relatively easy if you utilized the video lectures. Nice guy and easy to get into contact with, he schedules office hours by request. Will clarify content if you ask. He seemed genuinely interested in what he taught and wants his students to succeed in understanding it. Some Bio Connections assignments were a waste of time however.

Dr. Gaynor is a very nice man but I didn't love his teaching style. Be prepared to teach yourself a lot of the content and I would highly recommend watching the course pack videos to understand topics better!

the content isn't very difficult but sometimes it's hard to understand his lectures, but he does try his best. easily goes on tangents and leaves little time to actually teach. easy and quick to reach outside of class. exam review sessions are very helpful. i think it was his first year teaching so give him some grace, he'll get better.

Gaynor was honestly a good professor. Sometimes his lectures were a little confusing, but he does a very good job at clarifying if someone is confused. He is easy to reach outside of class and the SI sessions are very helpful so go! Very sweet guy with an easy class.

The professor is wonderful and has amazing lectures. She's extremely caring and wants her students to succeed. This course is difficult, the tests are hard and there are quizzes every week. Recitation is beneficial to understanding the content so I recommend going to them.

Her lectures weren't mandatory technically, but there was a 'lecture participation' assignment due by the next lecture. I personally enjoyed the way the lectures were set up. reviews.comment: Dr. George was probably one of the best math teachers I've ever had. She truly cares about her students and wants them all to succeed. If you are struggling in her class and let her know, she will do everything in her power to help you. She drops lots of your lower grades so it's hard to get below a B. But you have to show up and do the work.
should be your number one aim to get her

Dr. George was amazing. All lectures were very informative and covered material clearly. Her notes would always be very descriptive and help us visualize what was going on. She does a great job at explaining the theory. As long as you can critically think, and understand the concepts at a high level you will be fine. Highly recommend Dr. George!

I would recommend you go to class because for test and quizzes you need to be there. Tests are with groups and super easy and she doesn't let you leave until you have 100%. She is very clear in lectures and always willing to help, and answers emails within minutes with any questions.

This class is only hard if you make it hard. Complete the homework assigned that is related to the quiz your taking the day before the quiz and you will never score below a 90. Her lectures in class are very easy to follow along with and understand, if you pay attention. Very easy to contact if you have any questions. Extremely sweet professor.

reviews.comment: Her lectures are so helpful and very easy to follow. She goes through topics step-by-step, and does plenty of examples to apply the concepts. Amazing professor and her office hours are very helpful. She is always happy to help and wants all students to think more positively. She cares about everyone, and the exams are pretty similar to previous exams. They always throw in a difficult question and thats why i struggled but the homework is pretty easy and just need to be reviewed b4 exam.
She is a great teacher! She teaches in a way that is easy to understand and is great at answering questions. She is really easy to understand

She is truly so awesome. Calc 2 is such a hard class however she takes the time to make sure we understand the content. She asks after every step if we have questions. You can tell she loves what she is doing/teaching.
She was always so kind and understanding. If you were willing to try, she was willing to help in any way that she could. Highly recommend!!!!
Good teacher who wants to see her students succeed. She always answered my emails quickly and was really helpful when I had a question.

I liked taking this class with her. She always posted notes on canvas, her handwriting was a little difficult to read sometimes but not as bad as others. The exams weren't too bad either. Took this in Fall 2025.

I LOVE Dr. Lueerssen! She made Calc 3 easy. Once you get used to the German accent she is very clear and easy to understand. She is also very caring and considerate and really wants you to do well in her class.

Great professor! I took her for modern algebra, which is a proof based class. Very thorough and went slowly enough in class for us to have great notes. All exam questions were from notes, so as long as you took notes and understood the steps you could get 100%. Each test had extra credit of up to 20%.

Dr. Lueerssen was a great professor-one of the best calculus professors in my opinion. Her lectures are long, but she does several examples in class. I highly recommend her if you have to take calc 2.

She's a great lecturer and makes Calc II as easy as it can be given the difficulty of the material. German accent isn't too thick, so she's easy to understand (and I enjoy her English like saying "pi-half" for pi/2). She's very kind and helpful when you need it.

PROS: Curves exams, very nice to talk to, helpful, shows up to class, teaches every single second of the 50 minute lectures, funny, uses 3 boards to write instead of 1. CONS: Hard to understand sometimes, writes sloppy, sometimes make algebra mistakes, does not finish examples and leaves you wondering, goes VERY fast

She is a great professor. Best of the calculus professors in my opinion. She explains things well and is compassionate because she knows the class is hard. She is also very funny and has a relaxed teaching style. Go to class and pay attention to her examples. They end up on tests and homework.

She has a funny accent and she seems very nice. I think she sometimes skips over details in lecture that leave you thinking "Where in the world did she get that?" She is very helpful and invested in the class.

Makes Calc II, a normally difficult class, very easy. Explains theorems in detail and gives examples of exam questions. Has an accent, but is easy to understand. A real desire to see her students succeed. I would recommend her for any math class.
Pretty good teacher. Go to the Study/Mathskellar for help with webwork and written assignments.
She was a pretty good teacher. Go to the Study for belp and Mathskellar for written assignments.

I loved having her as a professor. Her accent isn't an issue at all as she speaks clearly. As long as you take notes and pay attention, you should do well on the tests. I didn't use the book at all, but it could be helpful if you've never taken calc before. I really enjoyed her teaching style, humor, and pleasant personality. Take her class!
Explains Calculus I very well and gives lots of practical/helpful example problems during lecture.
Heidi was an excellent professor.
Take her!

Heidi, or "German Lady", is a fantastic teacher. Don't let her accent steer you away, it's not that bad and you'll get used to it. Had her for 113  and then made sure i got her for 114. i wish all math professors taught like her! she can be funny too. i highly recommend her
She is amazing. I wish she teaches all my math classes

She literally makes everything about this class soulcrushingly difficult just for the fun of it, I swear. It's like she actually gets off on this. Just a despicable person.

This class can be ok but it's a 50/50 chance. Good luck.

Unable to take the midterm, as I had a conflicting exam. My 95% suffered after I did mediocre on the ONLY exam (the final). She doesn't allow students an alternate midterm time. I am honestly surprised that April still has a job with UK. Everything said about how horrible she treats students and her TA's are 100 % correct. Do yourself a favor and take the Chem labs at another school. Yes, you are responsible for your own success in college but the way she has everything set up, sets students up for failure in the beginning

She is very arrogant, disrespectful and completely unreasonable. By desperately trying to be officious, she puts away reason and common sense. No matter how sensible you're trying to be, she totally lacks connection with students (and probably TA's), and will most likely misinterpret your good intentions as inherently dishonest and deceitful.

Dr. French is not a nice person. She is very rude to both students and TA's. Luckily, students do not have to deal with her very much. The class is taught by a TA and the grading criteria is clear, however, there are a lot of assignments. Get ready to spend a lot of time doing pointless assignments like pre-labs and syllabus quizzes.

This is not only the worst professor I have had, but the worst overall teacher. I have never had to deal with someone that does not care about her students as much as her. She is extremely cold and bitter. I was 1 point away from getting a B (the class was out of 1100 points) and she wouldn't round it up. Also, she uses a tougher grading system.

Also, she uses a point system that requires you to have a 92% to get an A. Also, be sure to study for the midterm; doing badly on it is hard to recover from.
She has a condescending attitude and is not pleasant to talk to.

I don't understand all the hate for Dr. French; she does not even teach the class and most of the experience you have is because of what your TA does. The expectations are made crystal clear, and while there is a lot of work expected, it is nothing extreme. I emailed her when I had trouble with my TA/grades and she fixed the situation right away.
You have to take her. But prepare to be miserable

The whole class it taught by the TA. The homework is always confusing and difficult if you haven't already done the lab in high school. There's usually a lab report, data entry and calculations, pre lab assignment,  and procedure write up each week. The programs she uses for class are not user friendly. Good luck finding any other teacher though.

Everyone complains that she is the worst, but she doesn't teach the labs. The TAs teach it and she is just a supervisor. You never see her unless you go to her in her office. I heard she's mean though. Class was hard. I had a C at midterm, but ended up with an A! Final was easy
She is the worst professor that I have met at UK.  She does not care about her students or their success.  Students should not be heard or seen or alive in her opinion.
Awful. Super strict, but does not fully explain what the criterion for this strictness are.
Dr. French is never wants to meet during office hours and makes it very hard to get an A in the lab because she grades so tough. If there is any way to get another instructor, do it.

If you have to take this class, prepare yourself now for a long miserable semester of pointless lab reports and a horrible lab supervisor.  She will not help you at all throughout the semester, and if she takes the time to stop sitting around and actually talk to you, she will probably be one of the most condescending people you ever meet.

Dr. French is the worst teacher I've ever had. I understand that as a lab supervisor she has to be strict but there is no reason to be as heartless as her. she was very unhelpful, condescending, disorganized, and just plain mean.

Dr. French does not care at all about what you have to say. The only time she will ever even consider helping you is if you e-mail her 20 times about your problem.  I personally saw her open a girl's backpack, take out her camelbak water bottle and throw it in the trash. She is quick to snap at someone and the LAST person on campus to offer help.

Expectations are made extremely clear and the labs she made are generally relevant to lecture material. She was not very helpful at all out of class, but I guess that's what a TA is for. She could still be more friendly, to say the least. At least she was very clear in what was expected of us and frequently updated the course website (blackboard).

Dr. French carries a bad reputation for the chemistry department at UK. Although I had no personal encounters with her, other students in my class were treated harshly by her. Don't bother asking for help. In my opinion, if you're going to be a supervisor over a whole CHEM Lab Department, you should be willing to help students. Good luck w labs.

She seems very specific, thorough, &  maybe even nice on Blackboard. But believe me, it's all a trick. I went to her once in person and she almost made me cry. She acted like I ruined her day for even showing up to her office hours she has for HER STUDENTS. Ended up getting .09 away from an A & wouldn't round. One word to describe her: condscending

People may think she has a broomstick parked out back, but she is clear on what is going to be graded and sends out weekly emails. Read the syllabus and the Lab Manual and you are guaranteed a B at least. Take a lab at the end of the week so you can ask other people before you of what is expected!
She is by fat the most unpleasant person ever and unfortunately I have to take her again next semester.  She offers no help for things that could be fixed by her in minutes.

Dr French is extremely unhelpful. If you have to speak with her for any reason she'll talk condescendingly to you as if you're extremely dumb. It's patronizing and shows she clearly has no interest in helping student succeed. The class is extremely disorganized and French doesn't communicate with her TAs so everyone ends up confused.

I have never taken such a confusing class. The material itself was not that bad, but I was never sure what assignments were due, what the criteria was, or how to do well in the class. Worst professor ever.

Basically the most miserable experience I've ever had with a teacher. The one time I had to speak with her for help, she was utterly rude and lacks a personality. She sent me out without helping me and I received no points for my given question. I regret to say that I will have her again next semester. I hope you get a good TA.

Absolutely awful. I never had to meet her in person, but I have had to email her and she has been extremely rude. Once, when I submitted a lab report into the wrong slot, she told me I had to take a zero for it. Hope for a good TA, they will save your life.

Meanest human I have ever talked to in my life. No getting around it she is the grumpiest people you will ever have to talk to. Its not a one day thing its an every time you ever see her thing.  Avoid her at all costs.

She's the worst professor I've ever had. When she came into class the ONE time during the semester, she yelled at a girl wearing a long skirt (which she was wearing for religious reasons) and made her go change. Absolutely unacceptable honestly.
Dr. French is one of the meanest people I've ever had to encounter.  She's extremely rude and unhelpful.  Avoid her at all costs even though that's basically impossible.  My TA saved my life in lab.
Very rude and lacks care for students in her classes.

I took Dr. French for CHE 111 / 113 and her help was, for lack of a better word, nonexistent. At the end of the semester I had an 80 percent(B), but she still gave me a C. Not worth the amount of time you have to spend.

Well, I had a few personal exchanges with her when I had to turn in excused absences for her class, and one time she hardly accepted my note. Sadly, I have her again this spring for 113
She is one unhappy camper and it is reflected when students ask her for help. A computer generated response system would do a better job.

Terrible teacher. She was not helpful IF she responded to your emails. She was extremely rude and was never available for help. The course is not extremely hard. Dr. French made it harder than necessary. Don't take this course with her!

Such a poor excuse of a "teacher". Not helpful at all and incredibly rude. You pretty much have to learn everything on your own. It's almost impossible to avoid taking her if your in chem lab. Make sure you ALWAYS wear the appropriate clothing or you will get thrown out and use all the resources provided it will help.

Chemistry Lab at UK is honestly sink or swim. April French is over thousands of students. I don't blame her for any inflexibility. I made an A in her class simply by reading everything she posted on blackboard and going to the learning center. Her exams are also very easy. I made a C in CHE 105, A in lab. Lab is all about the effort.

Dr. French is one of the most rude and unhelpful people that I've ever met. She doesn't seem to enjoy her job or care about how the students are doing in the class. Confusing layout of the class and very unpleasant to talk to in person or through email. Terrible professor.
extremely confusing layout of the class, very poor design.  She is terrible to deal with in person.  My TA is great and is the only saving grace of the class
Chem21labs shouldn't be used at UK Chemistry Department. It doesn't relate to the lab at all.

While I never personally met Dr. French, I did exchange a few emails with her at the beginning of the semester, and let me tell you, they were unforgettable. I emailed her one time because my chem 21 account said I was absent (I wasn't) and I couldn't put in the data for the lab until she fixed it. She didn't email me back until after it was due. She said there was nothing she could do about it and I got a 0 on the lab for a mistake that SHE made. Just hope for a good TA…

She is too smart for all of the students combined at UK. She's so smart that she just cant help any of her students and is instead mean to them. She makes everyone feel really stupid because she is the smartest human being ever.

Dr. French is one of the worst professors I've ever had. She truly seems to be intentionally rude. She seems to be a women who feels the need to show that she is in power, regardless of how she is as a professor. I've never had a worse professor.

Terrible professor. She's rude and literally goes out of her way to be UNhelpful to her students. She lets the students know she doesn't care about anything they need, and very condescending in demeanor. She should NOT be a professor.

Dr. French literally terrifies her students. All I have ever seen her do is yell at students in the halls and the one time I asked her for help she told me to come back later and that she was "busy". If you need any help in the course AVOID talking to her at all costs.

Dr. French is very very rude whenever I go to her for help. If she went about talking to students nicer she would be a better, but not perfect, professor. She needs to be removed from this university. She is little to no help and has a huge attitude problem towards students.

Dr. French is very helpful. This is my first year at UK and I am a junior. She is very clear with her instructions, she informs you of what to read and do before lab, during lab and after.I emailed her yesterday about my grades in other classes and it literally took her 2 minutes to respond. She is on top of things. If you do the work you'll pass.

She is never in lab, you will always see your TA.  She does not care about how well you do in the class.  I went to see her for a problem I had with a lab and she laughed at me and told me even though it was the TA's fault I screwed, i shouldn't have listened to the TA.  Do not go to her with a problem, talk to your TA first.
She couldn't care less how you do in this class, and is unwilling to help you with absolutely anything.

Completely rude, cynical, condescending, will not help students no matter what their situation.  Honestly, she seems to enjoy making students suffer.  Seems to hate her job and everyone around.  Really frustrating.

Dr. French does not seem to care about the students, simply conducting the labs. On occasion when I would go to her office to ask questions she was of no help and seemed to be intentionally difficult. The only reason I put up with her was because it was a required course for my major. Avoid at all costs.

Absolutely miserable at her job. She is not helpful and almost seems to go out of her way to be difficult. Answers questions with attitude, not advice. If you think you're going to have her for any class, do everything you can to get a different teacher.

She's awful. She doesn't enjoy her job & is useless. If you go in to ask a question, even if you are prepared with all of the materials & ask questions in a very straightforward & concise way, she wont give you any information but will stare at you like a blank slate. There is a difference between spoonfeeding answers and refusing to help at all
One of the least helpful and most condescending teachers I have ever had. I'm just glad we didn't have to deal with her every class.

This low rating fits her well. Very rude unhelpful lady. Why hire someone that seems to not enjoy their job? I could honestly see her being replaced in the near future. And about 85% of people scored a D on the chem lab practical or lower.. I still bet she won't curve it

You have class with a TA, but when you have a problem and go to see dr french, she is an absolute witch! she does nothing to halp you and in fact gets an attitude with you and seems to think that she can never be wrong. she sucks
she is really mean teacher ever!!!
Great guy. Great class.

He genuinely cares about his students and is truly invested in their success. As long as you show up, participate, and ask questions, this class will be one of the most valuable experiences of your academic career. If you have the option, take it in person because the difference is night and day. Be kind and he will be kind back!
Really good guy. The class was fine, he makes it more enjoyable

Professor Haggerty is the best professor that the University has. It has been two years since I took a class with him, and I saw him today. He truly cares about every student who takes one of his classes and wants to see you succeed. !00% recommend taking a class with him!

Mr Haggerty is an interesting character. He cares about his students very much and is truly invested in their success. He asks us to share good news at the start of each class. Asks for details about peoples job interviews and similar things, I didnt love that part but thats just me. I would recommend taking him. Lots of speaking in front of class.

Mr. Haggerty is the best professor and teacher I have probably ever had. He cares about his students so much and all he wants is for us to do well in our professional lives. He came into class every day with a positive attitude and that is huge for students to see. Anyone who does not like him just does not appreciate a professor giving their all.

Professor Haggerty is one of the most kind and caring professors I have ever had. He genuinely cares about your future career and will do his best to prepare you above the rest. Lectures are fun and engaging and I recommend taking this course in person.

I did not like this course. Online class and a group project do not work well together because everyone has different schedules. Would not take online. He is tough grader and talks way too much in his Canvas annoucments & doesn't get to the point. Not very accesible out of class because he has a window of time he checks his emails and it's small.

THE ABSOLUTE BEST! You will not find a better guy and mentor than Professor Haggerty! Thankful to have taken his class. He expects your best, but you will get his best each and every day! He pours everything that he has into his students and making sure they succeed! Grateful for him! Take his class!

Class is so easy, but made difficult for no real reason. Take online if possible. Haggerty is a guy who cares, 1000%. I interpret his caring and intensity as annoying at times and over the top, but he really does want us to succeed. He can be a lot and expects a lot from you. He is helpful and gives good feedback on your assignments. Mixed bag.
Easy class and honestly the biggest waste of time. Take it online there is no reason to take it in person where attendance is mandatory.

Dr Haggerty is the best professor I've ever had, and he creates the most fun atmosphere in class. He seems to be a professor who refuses to give out 100s, but I still love everything about him and this class. If you're able to take this class in person instead of online, DO IT!
Besides the roleplaying, he is very chill! Awesome feedback and he wants you to succeed in the class!

Professor Haggerty is one of the best & kindest professors I have ever had. He truly cares about all of his students & wants everyone to succeed. He gives good feedback that is valuable & helpful. He is very quick at responding to emails. I struggled with my group for our final project & he was understanding & patient. I 110% recommend his classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Mr. Haggerty is a great professor. He takes the effort to truly get to know each and every one of his students. His class was fun to be a part of a probably the most beneficial class I have take. in college. If I could have every class with him, I would. Very enthusiastic and makes lessons fun and interesting! Great person through and through.

Great guy really cares about his work and his students. One of the best professors I've ver had. Gave me a B because I forgot to do some surveys that were required, this tanked a lot of people's grade a whole letter and he would not round. Not an easy class but very interesting and a caring professor.

I can't say enough good things about Professor Haggerty. He's honestly such a kind and genuine man who *wants* his students to succeed and gives them ample opportunity to do so. He's very informative and clear and he is there to answer questions and offer support 100% of the time. He was the best teacher I've had in college so far. Would recommend!
I had him for CIS 300 and it was a really fun, engaging class. The material is very relevant for the future.  Participation is vital but he's a great professor. Have fun with the class.

He is a really caring professor and is passionate about the material covered in class. He loves to help and provide feedback. However the homework can be a little overwhelming for the class and he is personally offended if you miss class. Lectures can be boring since he just reads from a PowerPoint, but tries his best. Learned good things in class.

Professor Haggerty is one of those professors that really wants to see you succeed. There is a lot of work in this class, but it is all work that will be beneficial in the long run, like creating a resume and mock interviews. The crisis project at the end of the year is really fun. Start early on the final project! There is a lot of work involved.

BEST PROF I'VE EVER HAD! He is a genuine, great guy who truly cares about each and every one of his students. Will help you get a job or internship in any way he can, and prepare you for professional life. This class is a great asset in general. Was there for me when I was going through a rough time. Show up and give 100% and you'll get an A.

Stephen gives a lot of work. Having this class online made it very easy to do the work, but there was still a lot of it. The final project is a group project and you don't get to pick your group. Just hope you get people in your group who will actually do some work.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Group projects

reviews.comment: He is really uptight about nearly everything. He thinks his class is more important than your other classes and expresses that pretty openly. He is hard to reach out of class and will not go out of his way to help anyone. He seems to get a certain level of enjoyment out of telling students that they messed something up.
Unwilling to work with students to succeed. Will not help you out ever.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: An easy class if you turn all your assignments in on time. He is available outside of class & willing to communicate with you about your grade; however, he will not change grades & you are bound to miss many points for the smallest of errors. One possible good thing, he is constantly sending emails, making it hard to miss any assignment due dates.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Man, this guy is awesome! I had the best time in his class and was challenged in many different ways to become a better communicator. Also, Steve gave me the confidence to speak in front of people clearly and professionally. He does want you to be in his class, so don't skip, but trust me, you will want to be there. He will be a blessing to you!

An absolutely fantastic professor! Very good at communicating in class, as well as outside of class. He really made you want to listen and had a way of making it feel like he was talking specifically to you. The way he presented material was completely understandable. Although the course load is a little heavy, the work itself is easy. 10/10 class!

The course moves really fast and there are a lot of assignments. Really though, you just have to do well on the big projects and show up. He loves rubrics and is a really honest guy who takes his subject seriously. Not much reading at all, but if you don't like doing speeches, don't take CIS.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: No tests. One major paper and one major presentation. I absolutely loved this class. Mr. Haggerty is such an inspirational professor and honestly the best teacher I have had in my entire life.

While his class had a lot of work, Mr. Haggerty was a great professor who did an excellent job of communicating the information in a way that was helpful to everyone.  He's a fun guy who makes his class very enjoyable.  I genuinely loved showing up to class.  He also cares a great deal about what he does, which means a lot to his students.

Mr. Haggerty was not only my favorite professor, he was my favorite teacher I've ever had. He has a HUGE amount of passion for what he does, and even though CIS 112 is "boring" content, he made sure every student left with a smile on their face. An absolute joy to be in his class. I'd take him every semester if possible.

The surprising part of this course (as in all CIS 112 courses) is the "service learning requirement". At the beginning of the semester you are given an organization that you must volunteer at and nearly all assignments through the semester are based off that service. Expect a lot of papers, blog posts, and papers, but for a 112 course, not bad.

Mr. Haggerty is a great professor. He's about helping you grow as a student, not just teaching English. He takes his job seriously and genuinely cares about his students. He assigns a lot of work, but he's the most freakishly organized person ever and shows you an agenda of the upcoming weeks everyday. I hate the subject but he made it bearable.

I had Mr. Haggerty during a summer course, which is 2 hours and 15 minutes long M-R. He is a very good teacher who keeps you interested in the class and wants you to succeed. That said he can be very condescending to his students at times and wanted the class to ask permission before leaving to the bathroom like they were 1st graders.

Not very fond of the class material but he's one of the best teachers I've ever had. Extremely passionate about his work, posts calendars with due dates for the entire month. Sends out weekend reminders for homework. Huge jokester and makes the class very relaxing.

Mr. Haggerty is a great teacher! He gives you a forest view of your work and is willing to answer all questions. You can tell he really wants his students to succeed. There are no tests in this class.

I would highly recommend taking him. He gives you a concise outline/rubric for everything. He's VERY organized, so you always know what's due (usually with a 2-4 week notice). He has given extra credit points, but not many. He seems to genuinely care about the class. His grading is very fair and usually works with students struggling.
If you're willing to talk to him, he'll work with you. Responded to his emails quick. Definitely cares.
Don't understand why some are down on Mr. Hoyle. His class was good.
He helped me with my resume.
Mr. Hoyle's an alright guy. Made the class interesting.
Very difficult to communicate with. Responds slowly to email. Class was easy, but he made it uninteresting.

Class was okay. Only took it because of the school's requirements, but I think I learned a little about the job world, since he had us write cover letters and stuff. His WRD class was about work. Kinda strict about attendance, but he'll work with you.
Mr. Hoyle structured his class around jobs. Was kinda neat. Was helpful for me. Probably wouldn't have taken it if I didn't have to though. Good guy. Answers his emails.
He really cares about the material he teaches and it shows. Gave me an extension when I really needed it. Answered my emails quick. Just wish there was more variety in the lectures.
Mr. Hoyle wants you to succeed. Was pretty funny. Easy class, as long as you participate. Bit hard to reach sometimes, but he does his best.
Mr. Hoyle was a genuinely good guy. Really does care. As long as you do what you're supposed to do, you should pass. I do wish he could be more clear about how you're graded though.
Not easy to talk to and if you miss class expect not to pass. He will drop you letter grades even if you show him proof of being sick.

Mr. Hoyle is a great person and cares about every one of his students. If you do everything you are supposed to and do not completely disregard any projects, you will most likely receive an A. The class WRD 110 was slow and it seems like you are doing the same thing in almost every class.

He was a pretty nice guy. His lectures were fun and interesting, and he did his best to engage with people. He always answered questions and explained to the best of his ability. I did have one incident where he essentially made fun of me for asking a question. I didn't feel comfortable talking to him again after that, but overall good professor.

Gives extra credit out like candy, likes to make jokes during lectures, and attendance matters. Participation doesn't count towards grades, but I mean connecting with professors can help in the long run. There are no mandatory readings, but skimming the textbook before lectures helped me understand the material better.

Great professor, involves the class and connects in class content to real life situations. Gives many opportunities for extra credit. Show up and pay attention in class and you will do well. Respectable professor who knows his stuff.

Very good professor, would recommend him to anyone, genuinely cares for all his students and tries to remember your name even though his class huge. Go to class and take notes though his content in class is very helpful, if you do miss a class try to get notes from a friend as everyday usually has important content.

Engaging and well-educated. Will call randomly on people in class and you can tell he likes what he does. Intro class, so content itself is easy (up until chapter 9, for me at least). Medium difficulty events, must know material well. Great professor and great class.

he's a cool guy and makes econ as interesting as it could be, which isn't much. they drop a lot of grades which is nice! the exams are eh, it's the kind that's lowkey trying to trick you which is annoying but justin is cool, he also talks to students in lecture which is fun

I love this man. I previously took ECO201 with a different professor and hated it, but Heflin is the BEST. He genuinely cares about you and will take time to get to know you - even in a lecture hall of 400. He breaks things down so well and makes economics fun and engaging. He is the epitome of what a professor should be.

Hef is the goat- he teaches at the perfect speed and is very easy to understand. his lectures are also interactive in a good way and he's got a sense of humor. Attendance is mandatory but you get 6 free passes a semester. Literally the best ever I recommend

Heflin is the best professor I've had! I legit fought to get him for ECO202. If you pay attention in class and study outside of class, you won't have much trouble. The homework is stressful sometimes because of the layout but other than that he is amazing. I went into econ stressed and he helped out a lot! He wants you to do good!

good teacher, would help if he taught this class MWF as towards the end of lectures you can sorta zone out as he gives alot of information and such, gives a decent amount of bonus points too,Exams are kinda hard as the study guides and practice exams dont really reflect how the exams would be worded.
Take this guy.
Great guy. His lectures are engaging and he's available for help outside of class. Takes attendance every class but not worth much and you have like 6 classes of free absences.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Heflin is the best! He's super engaging in class and teaches with comprehensive examples. He has concept checks that you fill out in class that are essentially your attendance points. If you take notes during class and study, you'll do well. He's a great guy!
He made this class very easy and makes an otherwise boring subject much easier to sit through. Assignments are easy and helps you prepare for the exams well.

Genuinely the best teacher at the University of Kentucky. He is a phenomenal guy and can explain anything very well. He also incorporates real-world applications to everything he teaches, making it much easier to understand. If you have the opportunity, take his class. He is also a caring person and remembers everyone's names that he talks to.

Really great guy who even in a lecture of 400 people, makes effort to get to know his students. His lectures are really engaging and break down the concepts in real-life scenarios that make it easier to understand. The exams are really important when it comes to your grade.
Your grade us basically exams but they are easy
Easy to follow lectures and cool teacher, not too much work if you keep up

ECO 202. The class wasn't hard at all but the lectures were kind of boring. Make sure you go to the lectures because he gives you a worksheet to fill out during class, but it's easy. The tests have some recycled questions from these worksheets. (Took Spring 2025).

Heflin is the best professor I've had at this university. Attendance is graded, but he makes his lectures very engaging. His quizes/homework line up with the tests. The final is all questions from previous tests.

Professor is genuinely just a cool, friendly guy. He explains every economic concept we learn with real world examples that make sense. Engaging lecturer. So if you go to and listen to the lectures, it is not too hard to grasp the concepts.

One of the best professors I've ever had! He kept all the students engaged by asking them questions throughout the class and creating real life scenarios! Super kind and respectful to all his students. Explains Econ very well and made sure everyone was on the same page! Test were just like the review but easier than the homework.

I loved Professor Heflin and have taken many of his classes. He is fantastic in lectures and always keeps you engaged. This class is a little more complicated because only eight assignments were graded for it. Take well-written notes and stay engaged in class to do well on quizzes. Would 10/10 recommend.

I absolutely loved Professor Heflin. He is fantastic in lectures and always keeps you engaged. I recommend taking notes because it will help you with studying. He is very understanding and well-respected. It is an easy class if you pay attention and go to class. I loved him so much that I continued to take every other class he taught!

Mr. Heflin is one of the best teachers I've ever had, he keeps you entertained and attentive during the lectures while making sure you understand the concepts. It is easy to fall behind if you don't understand something fully but he always sticks around after class to answer questions. 10/10 recommend to anyone.
He is a very good professor, you do have to take notes every class but it is very worth it.

One of the best professors out there. He somehow manages to engage with an entire lecture hall of 400 students. As far as the class goes, the exams are pretty hard in my opinion, lectures are loaded with information that you think you comprehend but forget it after class lol. Lots of studying required, but professor is 10/10 amazing.

A dawg. Probably one of the professors I've enjoyed the most. Does a good job explaining topics, but at the same time, if you dont put effort in outside of class, you wont get an A. So it depends how you feel on that. But he's a great guy

He is a great professor and makes an effort to get to know his students! Every class, he related the concepts to real life and was able to interact with the class. Easy class and if you need any help, he always makes time to explain it to you thoroughly.

Great professor! Attendance not mandatory, but need to attend regularly to get assignments done, which you do in class for credit. Always willing to help if you need it, in or outside of class. Seems to care about his students and wants them to succeed. Even gives class a chance for extra credit. Would definitely take him for any economics class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed professor Hefflin, he is a younger professor so it is easy to connect with him and he is very patient respectful with you during class. I was in a small class so the lectures weren't mandatory but I enjoyed going to his class and never wanted to deliberately miss one. All in all great guy and I would recommend his class.

Heflin is such an amazing professor. He makes lectures interesting and makes it a point to try to get to know everyone in the giant lecture. 100% one of the best professors here at UK, definitely take his section.

Dr. Heflin was my favorite professor I've had so far in my 3 semesters at kentucky. He allows students to be involved with lectures and he will make sure you understand the content. There are four papers available during the semester but you only have to do three. Quizzes are not difficult as long as you go to lectures. Highly recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took Justin last semester as well for 201 and left a not so great rating for that course. However, I found this semester that Justin becomes a much better teacher in a smaller class environment like this class. His lectures are super engaging. Only a 4 papers and you only have to do 3. 4 quizzes and the lowest grade is dropped. Love him.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Awesome professor who made a connection with almost every student in the big lecture. Really nice guy who will go back so everyone can understand it. Multiple exams but no midterm. Not difficult exams if you go to class and pay attention with notes.

Fantastic professor! I was worried about taking ECO 201 this semester, but I have had no problem with it at all. His lectures are amazing and the work isn't too difficult. Will absolutely be taking him for ECO 202 next semester. Can't recommend him enough!

Justin is an amazing professor he interacts with students during lectures and makes the lectures interesting. He will own up if he makes a mistake and overall just amazing. The homework and quizzes are not terrible at all. Overall this is an easy A class as long as you pay attention.
Great professor for Econ. Lectures were very interactive and it was easy to understand the material. No complaints at all about homework and quizzes.

I was a little worried about this class because I'm an education major and just needed to get the credit out of the way but was very pleasantly surprised. He made it easy and entertaining and I found the lectures easy to follow and understand. I loved his style of teaching and he showed he cared about his students despite it being a big lecture.

Dr. Heflin makes difficult concepts more understandable.  Criteria for assignments is clear and homework is challenging but doable. He makes lecture engaging by applying real life examples and is incredibly personable. I recommend taking any course and believe he is one of the best professors I have had at Kentucky.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: THE BEST TEACHER UK HAS!! He keeps the class engaged for every single lecture. He is super understanding on absences and some low grades. He is almost always available outside of class. He really puts effort in helping you understand the material and being prepared for the test. Taking him again for a different class next semester!!

I absolutely loved taking ECON with Justin Heflin. His lectures were engaging and he makes a point to use real life relatable examples with content. He also makes an effort to get to know you. The homework and quizzes for each chapter are semi easy and overall he is great. By far one of my favorite professors at UK.
funny and relateable
Took him at WVU in 2021 for ECON 200. Cool guy, maybe a little boring. Taught concisely and graded fair. Definitely would recommend him.

Justin is a nice professor, But let me tell you those lectures are so boring it makes everyday going to class a struggle. The lectures have mandatory attendance + the lectures only cover maybe 1/8 of exam content which is the majority of the grade. I learned more through the 4+ hour long online cengage modules for hw than in his class.
Justin Heflin made ECON 201 my favorite class. His lectures were amazing. Very friendly professor. 1000000% would take him again.

Professor Heflin has been my favorite professor so far! His lectures are engaging and he gives examples to hard concepts that are super relatable and easy to understand. He wants you to succeed so he will help you if you need it. His class is super fun and he is very understanding. If you take ECO 201, take it with Heflin! His grading isn't bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you have the chance to take a class with him, do it! By far the best professor, super nice always available outside of class and makes his lectures very engaging. He made learning economics fun and gave many extra credit opportunities.

Professor Heflin has by far been the best professor I've had at UK. His lectures were very easy to follow and extremely intriguing. He made economics easy to understand by using examples that pertain to the real world. The course load itself was very light, I'd spend an average of two hours a week to complete the homework and quiz.

Justin was pretty good. The class was very easy. You definitely have to go to class though. I think that his lectures were very comprehensible but they were SO slow and it made it difficult to not fall asleep. That being said, I think he had to go slowly because of how big the class size was. Easy class still so I would recommend.

Heflin is by far the best professor I've had so far at the University of Kentucky. He has very good lectures that are easy to follow, and he gives real world examples that pertain to the class for easy and entertaining lectures.  Going to the lectures and taking good notes will get you an A on every exam as long as you apply yourself.

Professor Heflin makes economics an approachable subject for everyone. During his lectures, he uses real-world examples of economics to really connect with students. Additionally, he even calls on students and uses their experiences as examples during his lectures. Assignments are fair and balanced, and he seems very approachable outside of class.

Great lectures and really connects with students. Easy homework that is identical to what was covered in lectures. Attendance was recommended but it was ok if you miss here and there. Uses creative real world examples to simplify the concepts. Cracks jokes and makes class fun to attend. O
Dr. Heflin is a very good lecturer. His slides are very clear with many real world examples. Relates to students well. Attendance is not mandatory but definitely helps to be in class,
If your taking ECON 201 or 202, do it online. Easy class, except when it came to tests. Responds to emails and tries to keep lectures interesting, but tedious.

Cares a lot about his students & gives very engaging lectures! If you do the online HW (2 assignments per chapter, 3 attempts on each), go to class, & use his study guides for the exams you should be able to get an A. Try to attend all his lectures since he really helps to simplify & explain concepts from the textbook. Just a great guy in general!
Very harsh and not at all makes you enjoy the class even if you enjoy the general subject.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class is extremely hard. The professor doesn't make it any better

Do not take. He gave me a 0 on a quiz for using potential energy instead of work-energy, when there is not much of a significant difference to the formatting. I also got 25 percent on the first exam, when it should have been higher. I would still have been alright had it been something like 40, 50, or 60 percent.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very harsh grader and will not negotiate even when taking points on a technicality. Will dock points for method (ie even if its right you have to do it his way), one pop quiz part way thru the semester, and hw every class. tests will have nearly irrelevant general questions and often tricks in them as well.

Be prepared for an extremely difficult and frustrating class. Tests average around 50% and make up most of the grade. Homework after nearly every class takes hours, and exam questions often feel designed to trick students. A large number of people drop the course. Easily the worst professor I've had at the University of Kentucky.
I dropped late and can tell you, over 50% of the class will drop out. Exams are impossible, tough quizzes, lots of homework. Good luck if you're stuck with him
Do not under any circumstances take his courses.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He is a bad lecturer, gives a hw assignment every class that will take a minimum of 2 hours. Maybe 1/3 of the starting class made it to the final without dropping. He is rude in office hours as well.  It is possible to pass his class, just get ready for a lot of work

One of the worst engineering professors I have seen by far. Makes me feel like he just teaches for a paycheck. He does not explain concepts well and somehow expects you to do well in very difficult exams that cover what we have not learned in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Just tough in general, really weeds our students. Be prepared for a 3 credit hour class to feel like a 6 credit hour class

one of the worst professors I have ever had will give you a zero on a problem with minor mistakes. I don't think most people pass it first try. had 30 something homeworks took me over 3 hours each. lectures will be the only way to learn since if you don't solve his way he will take points. overall extremely poor professor and he's proud of it.

Lectures are just not very helpful. Likes to show full solutions to problems with the insight of you should know this and no real solution strategy. Quizzes are hard and are harder due to his poor wording. Overall just a poor professor that should be avoided especially for a hard class like dynamics.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Hanson would better be served as the dictator of El Salvador than a professor. It's his true calling in life.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Okay lecture professor, homework takes 3-5 hours. Homework is assigned after every lecture and due at the beginning of the next lecture (thus a ton of hw). Homework is "easier" than quizzes and exams. Grading is harsh and can be shocking and absurd. Becomes prickly when asked to give thorough help or in-depth feedback (not worth his time). Avoid.

I went to office hours to figure out why I got a zero on a homework assignment I turned in. He had me close the door behind me on my way in (creepy, especially as a woman) and told me it was because I didn't staple my papers together. He didn't even grade the assignment that I spent 6 hours on. His tests “sort of” reflected the homework. Avoid.

Better put on your big boy pants because your in for one heck of a semester. The class is difficult that's no lie. It requires 6+ hours outside of class each week to gain a complete understanding. The homework is mentally taxing, but the exams are doable. If you want to learn the material and gain a complete understanding, this is a good class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: he doesnt teach at all. he puts his sloppy notes (copied from a pdf) on the board and it's a race to copy everything down. there is homework due at the beginning of each class that takes hours to finish. the exams are impossible and he doesnt give partial credit. he takes off points for misspelling? hes proud of his 60+% drop rate. i cried everyday
Absolutely no feedback. He will not let you know what you did wrong on any assignment. Does not need to be in the classroom.

Steer clear of this professor. His gradings are absolutely ruthless. Never curves his exams or grades. He will willingly let the entire class fail. He does not give good amount of partial credit. His HW solutions are lackluster with no explanations for how to do the problems. His lectures are not even helpful. This man should retire already.

Does not give any feedback on grades.  Do not know what was correct or what was wrong.  Definitely does not need to be in any classroom.  I think I will be transferring to University of Louisville to finish my last year to get away from Mark Hanson.   Stay away!!!

A truly horrendous professor. Very disrespectful to students by putting them on the spot, and being generally intimidating. Multiple times in class he mentioned that we shouldn't be engineers if we don't like the content. Tests are confusing. One positive note is always responds to emails, although he is often condescending and laughs at confusion.
Avoid at all cost. If you try, good luck.

Horrible teacher, barely teaches the material and the course is so out of order it is confusing, never helps and his grading is BS, counts off like half the homework if you forgot to write one little thing even if you got it 100% correct. Avoid at all costs

Should not be allowed to teach. Horrid lectures, awful quizzes, insanely difficult tests. Tests don't come with enough time to complete. His syllabus always says he'll curve but then he lets everyone fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Gives lots of handouts and examples and is very open in office hours. By far one of my favorite professors but his classes require a lot of hard work not a professor who will just let you slid by. Homework is often much harder than exams. EM 302 & EM 313

Horrid lecturing, terrible grading, not helpful in the slightest if you asked for help, horribly unprofessional towards the students. I would rather drop out of the College of Engineering than take this professor again.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This was definitely the hardest course I took during undergrad, and I was a premed/engineering degree. Dr. Hanson is tough. I STRONGLY suggest going to office hours if you dont immediately understand -DONT RELY ON CHEGG because the answers are usually wrong to his questions. Study the hw/quizzes and you will do well on tests.
Worst professor I've had. Homework every class, way overcomplicated math, poor explanations and poor lectures. Avoid at all costs.

Avoid this guy at all cost. Laziest lecturer I have ever had. Assigns loads of homework that has nothing to do what he covers in lecture. He uses old handwritten notes that he just mumbles over every class. He didn't have a syllabus for two weeks, and when he finally presented one, it looked like he had just written it out 10 min before.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Take a MWF section, he seems to like them better. That said, if you ask questions during lecture he will spend as time as you need (within reason) on a topic. He can be a little abrasive, but you're an adult. Homework is due EVERY class, but only a couple problems. He Will go over the solutions in class if you ask. Tests are tough, but doable.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Everyday he walked in and turned on the document camera and projected a hand written sheet on the board. He would then point at the sheet with a pen for 20-30 minutes as he droned through a proof. Flashcards are definitely a good idea, but there's a Facebook page and usually someone on it makes cards on quizlet. No quizzes, but random inclass assignments. GO TO HIS CLASS. Golding is by far the best professor I have this year. He really cares about making his lectures engaging and easy to follow. He tells you exactly what you need to know, and what you need to do to pass (do NOT skip class!). Follow him on instagram and he will, no joke, like all your photos.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Golding is hilarious. He genuinely cares about his students. He isn't impersonal like a lot of professors. He makes you feel important even in a class of 500. BUT YOU NEED TO COME TO CLASS. He has in-class activities, and he'll drop you letter grades if you miss too many. Overall, he's a great guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is one of the best professors I have ever had. he gives you direct study guides for tests that are so easy to fill out if you go to class and take notes. His lectures are always interesting and easy to follow. As long as you go to class and take good notes, there isn't any way that you can't get a good grade in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: My favorite professor ever! makes learning enjoyable and uses study guides.
i LOVED Dr. Golding.  he was really funny in class, always making us laugh. the class isn't hard as long as you take notes and study for exams. definitely recommend

Dr. Golding is very funny and makes you enjoy being in his class. He has random attendance questions and if you miss too many he drops your grade 2 letters so it's important to go. He never has quizzes and his exams are easy if you study.

dr golding is the best, do what you can to take his class.  he's an easy grader and wants everyone to get an A or B.  psy 100 was a pretty easy class, and his lectures go by fast.  just make sure you go because of in-class assignments.

He is a really good professor. Make sure you go to lectures or your grade will suffer although attendance isn't mandatory. I didn't use the required textbook once so if you don't wanna spend the money then don't.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Pretty cool guy. If you miss one day of class, you've missed a huge section of notes. I wouldn't waste my time on making flash cards because there is a facebook page for this class and someone will make a quizlet and post them there.
His lecture is him talking and you writing for the entire class. Tests are very in depth. He is willing to help you improve your grade if you reach out to him.

Dr. Golding is an outstanding professor! He really knows what he is talking about and his power points are strait forward. He always makes class entertaining by sometimes getting off topic, making a joke, or watching a video. His test are strait from the notes. Some multiple choice questions can get tricky. Overall great professor! Highly recommend

His lectures are amazing. Always keeps me guessing and I look forward to every class. He gets off track occasionally but it is always a welcomed break from material. Tests are fairly easy as long as you study a day or two before. FLASHCARDS FLASHCARD FLASHCARDS! Overall my favorite professor this year. Would definitely take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Golding is an amazing professor. I personally have issues with him as a person, but he makes lecture interesting. The way he says things makes them easy to remember. I've yet to study for an exam and gotten A's on all of them.

Dr. Golding is an awesome professor. He is a character and makes class enjoyable. You MUST take notes, but isn't that what you're supposed to do in college? He is entertaining and makes you want to go to class! Tests are typical tests, go to class and take notes, study the notes, and you'll pass! Would definitely recommend him as a professor!
Amazing person in the group setting but has issues with the one-on-one setting. Overall loved his lectures and was highly satisfied with my choice to take his class!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Golding is a phenomenal lecturer. His PowerPoints are straight forward and the test questions come directly from them so if you take good notes and study a little you will be fine. Hilarious guy with a good spirit. Would definitely take a class with him again.
absolutely amazing, must take him.
I LOVE Dr. Golding. He is sarcastic and witty and makes class interesting. Take one of his classes if possible.

Dr. Golding is an excellent professor. Being that I am a first year freshman I found his class to be one of my favorite. He is very clear in his expectations (GO TO CLASS). He uses examples given in class on the tests, there are review sheets for the test, and he highly suggests making flashcards from the notes. Do it! Great Class.
Golding is an A+ professor. He is super nice and he makes his lectures very exciting and makes you want to come to class.
His power points give all the necessary information that is on the exams. If you miss class, you miss a lot of information. He is a GREAT teacher.

Dr. Golding can come off a little intimidating at first, but he was one of my favorite professors this semester. He is very clear with his expectations for tests at the beginning of the semester, and his lectures directly coincide with the test content. I highly recommend Dr. Golding and would take another course taught by him in the future.

Ok so I took his Psy100 class because I thought it was gonna be easy. IT'S NOT. Yes he's an enjoyable teacher but his tests are HARD. I had to study harder for this class than Anatomy. Classes are mandatory and he has so many requirements. Most Psy teachers drop a test grade, he doesn't.
I would highly recommend him. He truly cares about his students even with his lectures having over 500 people. The lectures are very interesting as he is such a funny guy!
You will have to study, but Dr. Golding makes this class fun and interesting.

Love Dr. Golding. He is very funny and makes lecture interesting. If you show up for lecture and take notes, you are sure to pass. Put a few days in for studying and it's an easy A. FLASHCARDS! Maybe use the book once or twice.

Dr. Golding is a phenomenal psychology professor. There is a lot of note-taking, but it is not a boring process. He makes each class fun, different, and exciting. Depending on your TA the lab is very educational and fun as well. His tests come right from the notes and he grades very fairly. There are even opportunities for extra credit.
Absolute best professor I've had at UK. He's very clear on all work a the exams are what happens in class. Class is mandatory so do not skip. Love Dr. Golding.

I really enjoyed Golding's class. He made Psychology interesting and relevant. He was also hilarious. He would randomly talk to individual students through the microphone to keep everyone's attention. He explains the material clearly and prepares you for all tests and assignments. I would highly recommend Dr. Golding.

Excellent at keeping class interesting.  He gives in class assignments, but you should want to attend because he's very engaging.  Exams are fair, and studying is recommended, but simply showing up will help greatly because he explains things so well.  You might need the book to study the definitions for the first exam.

Attendance is not mandatory in such a large lecture, but has random in-class assignments to check attendance so show up.  Very good lecturer, super enjoyable to listen to and leaves slides open to write down word for word.  He is funny and cares a lot about his students, all around a good guy.  Study for exams by making notecards, really helpful

Have to study for the tests, but there were a few opportunities for extra credit. Going to him when you have a problem earns good points with him and he's likely to cut you some slack if you're nice about it. Don't buy the book! Never used it.
Dr. Golding makes class interesting. He gives you clear examples so that you can understand what is he talking about better. If you have any problems he is more than happy to help you.
He was awesome and interesting! Don't have to take the final if you don't want to.

He's a great guy. I definitely recommend him to freshman. If you go to class you'll pass. Don't buy the textbook. He puts up very specific study guides, so if you look at it you shouldn't be surprised by the tests. You have to go to class, he gives 10 random in class assignments that make up for your attendance.

He's a great guy. Funny, a little awkward, embarrassing dad type of guy. He has a lot of tests to help the students and I took this class with Archer and his tests were SOO long and pretty tough! Dr. Golding is really nice and engaging. He has 10+ in-class assignments and those are important. Study the labs for the tests!! I didn't buy the book

There are random in class assignments but no other form of attendance taking. However, many questions on the test are about in class examples, you won't get a great grade if you just read the book.  I think I've opened my book 3 times this semester and one of those times it was unnecessary.  The lectures aren't boring. Go to class and study easy A
Go to class and study a few days before the test and you will do fine

Great professor, ideal for freshman. If you're an upperclass you may find him a bit redundant & annoying. He LOVES flashcards and he spends at least a solid 5-10 minutes each class talking about studying. Go to class, you'll pass. He gives random in-class assignments as a form of attendance. You don't really need to buy the book.

Pretty easy class. He's hilarious and by far the best PSY 100 professor at UK. I came in without any prior psych class and have learned so much and personally love coming to class. There's videos galore to help you understand concepts and you don't really need the textbook. He's also one of the most whimsical professors. &english speaking TAs!

Makes class super interesting, we watched Big Bang TheoryHow I Met Your Mother clips like once a week and we watch a random music video every day before class. He also lets you out early every day. The tests are literally based exactly off the power points in class so if you take good notes, you'll have no problem at all.
He is a fantastic professor! Gives you a true understanding of the material and actually makes it interesting! Gives tons of extra credit opportunity.

Dr. Golding is a nice professor during class but not very nice when you approach him. I would recommend him though as he is very cool and makes class interesting. Exams are all multiple choice and he uses powerpoints. There's at least one in class activity per day, sometimes 3 or 4 so attendance is mandatory. Didnt make you take the last exam.

Fantastic professor. Took this class my last semester of undergrad and it was the BEST class I have taken since my time at UK. Golding is a phenomenal professor, and was recently recognized as a top professor at UK in the spring graduation ceremony. Highly recommend him as a teacher and definitely this class, great all the way around.

Simply a nasty person. I tried taking this course during a vacation overseas. I realized I would be in flight during an exam window, I requested to take it at a later time, he would not allow it. I had to drop the course and waste my money. Truly could have been avoided with a bit of understanding.

Awesome teacher, clear, and helps you out when you need. Really smart, attendance is basically mandatory with in class writing assignments and participation. no book he just gives you articles to read. take his classes if you can.
Really great teacher! highly recommend this class and Golding. tests are easy if you make the flashcards like he tells you to.
Dr. Golding was awesome! I always looked forward to coming to his class. I hope I can have him again for one of my future psych classes.

Dr. Golding is awesome! His class was fun and educational. He actually cares about teaching his students, and makes sure that everyone in class understands the material. I would love to take another class with him!!!
Material is very interesting, he's very fair, clear and concise.  The odd thing about him is has this 'class demeanor' and 'outside of class demeanor' its different and rather hard to get used to

It is an easy class as long as you take notes on everything that goes on in class. He puts all the emphasis of the class on application of what is taught in class. What I mean on the note taking is that there will be questions on the tests about what happened in class. It forces you to go to class. I bought the book for the class and never used it.

He is a nice guy and very funny but the class covers a lot of material and tests are difficult and require a lot of studying. He does not take attendance but he shows examples and videos that are on the test so not going would definitely be a disadvantage. However, you are required to go to every single  and will do poorly if you do not.
Class is interesting, but you must go for in class assignments. Do not miss a test, because he will interrogate you about an excuse. Pretty okay. Tests are tricky.

Dr. Golding is great. He makes everything super clear during lecture. In order to be successful in his class you need to actually go to class, take good notes, and study. It takes work, but not too much work. I thoroughly enjoyed his class and would love to take Golding's class again.

Dr. Golding great, however, he can rub people the wrong way sometimes.  Sometimes he seems a little overbearing and rude but I think he's a great professor.  I learned a lot from his class.  Lecture isn't mandatory but lab is and his tests cover a LOT of material.  But go to class and take good notes and study for tests and you'll be fine.

I love Dr. Golding! I recommend him to everyone! I always look forward to going to class. He is funny and explains the material really well. Tests are only from the notes, so you have to go to class the get all the notes. Take Dr. Golding!!! :)

Dr. Golding is one of the main reasons why I decided to minor in Psychology. He is a fantastic teacher who seems to love his field of work and teaching. Tests are pretty hard, especially the third one, but if you take his study suggestions to heart you should be fine. Take Dr. Golding if you have the chance, He rocks.

Golding is extremely full of himself which is obvious in both class and during his office hours. I met with him once and he was rude and came off as annoyed but the second time, he was extremely helpful and kind... As for his class, my favorite class I've ever taken. It's both entertaining and educational. Strongly encourage taking him.

Corny, full of himself. I took it as a senior though and it was a freshman class; just wasn't to psyched to hear nsync/Britney/beyonce blaring for the first five minutes of class. The lab is the most pointless thing ever. But it's cool that you don't have to go to it every single week. The research credits are a pain but I don't think that's him

Dr. Golding is a very good professor in my opinion, his lecture notes provide much clarity, as does the textbook. He makes lectures interesting with the way he makes jokes, however some of the comments he has made during the semester I had him were somewhat offense at times. During office hours when you have questions over exams he seems to be a bit disinterested, as he seems to think the reason you made a bad grade was always your fault, and not possibly bc his exam questions were unclear.

Golding is top notch. He's funny, a very great teacher, and makes some pretty boring stuff sound pretty interesting. He's a great guy, and I'd say that everyone should try to get him for your Intro to Psychology.

The best psych prof there is. So helpful and so invested in you doing well. The class is also set up so that it is pretty easy to get an A - just go to class, participate, and do the readings. Best capstone option there is for psych - an interesting subject and extremely knowledgeable professor. I wish I could take him for all my psych classes!
Dr Golding class was extremely interesting he taught very well and gave as much help as he could. He is one of my best professors
very good helpfull and has best interest of students

Dr. Golding is one of my favorite professors. All who have had him give great reviews and I am no different. Future students, you need to go to class. Many questions on the exam involve an example he used in class, which is not included in the notes. I recommend him highly for PSY100.

Dr. Golding is an amazing teacher. I've had my fair share of different types of teaching, but his style is quite unique and engaging. He finds a way to keep you entertained while still relaying all the information and keeping things professional. I hope to take PSY 223 with him in the fall.

In class Dr. Golding is energetic however one one he is the nastiest man.  Extremely rude, and degrading. Study your notes, and you'll be fine.  If you expect help from him on a personal level....you're out of luck.  TA's are helpful.
pretty laid back. has his moments but overall a good teacher

I've had Golding before for psy100 and he was amazing! I took him again for psy311 and again loved how he taught the class and how involved he is. He is amazing at explaining things and really does care about you and your grade. I recommend everyone to take at least one of his classes!!

Amazing professor. You really won't understand how interesting he is unless you attend his class. He makes class really fun; I always look forward to his class! Attendance is important, so go to class, but you'll enjoy every minute of it!
Great Class
Great professor
This teacher is amazing! Take this class!

Amazing teacher! He is quite the character. If you want to take this class you MUST get him! Makes class interesting and the tests reflect exactly what he teaches. The recitations are a little lengthy but the TA's are really fun and interesting. Rumor has it he isn't teaching spring 2012 so I heard Brown is the second best option!
Amazing teacher.  You have to experience his class.
My favorite psychology teacher by far! He made class fun and interesting. Tests are fairly easy and to the point but you must study. No extensive studying though, like a couple hours a week.

AMAZING! There are no other words. Just recently named Kentucky Professor of the Year, and it's clear why that is the case. In a class of 500, he cares about YOU. Biggest tip: go to class! It will help you tremendously on exams, and plus, he's just awesome and makes class so fun. Best 50 minutes of my day.

Great professor. Doesn't just read the slides, but uses explanations and lets you know what's on the exams. Never a time where I didn't want to come to class. Exams can be tricky, but studying about a week in advance is the trick for success in this class. Definitely would recommend.

By far one of the BEST professors at UK. He is hilarious and makes the class so personable. You never lose focus and he tells funny stories. He LOVES his daughter.. it's so cute. The tests are easy-just take the notes straight off the slides. Attendance is mandatory only because he gives in-class assignments that are literally take 30 secs.
Really funny, GO TO CLASS, study all examples he gives you, stickler for attendance, hard to get a hold of him b/c lectures are so big, always study in advance, you'll do fine

He is absolutely amazing. By far, my favorite class. He is hilarious and really knows how to hold a room. He makes a class of 300+ feel like a class of 20. Very attentive. As long as you listen to him, you'll make an A for sure! I highly recommend him.

LOVED HIM AND THIS CLASS. one of my favorite classes so far. information is interesting and he makes it fun, really nice guy. exams arent very hard if you study. you dont use your text book at all. all you need is to pay attention in class and you'll love it.

He is keeps a class of 500 freshman interested on a topic that can be very boring. His is not monotone at all and is aware of the diversity of his audience so generally does not offend anybody. I would definitely suggest him as a professor!

Golding is too traditional. I earned an A in his class from the tests, but received a B for attendance. His tests have questions that test if you've been in class. Its dumb. Attendance is a virtue for some, but for him, its the most important thing. Frankly, its ridiculous. He should teach and test and keep his opinions from affecting grades.

Dr. Golding was a fantastic professor! The class material is not inherently difficult, but you do need to pay attention and attend class; he doesn't have much pity for people who don't put for effort. Really though, it's easy to get an A in this class.

COME TO CLASS! He will call you out if he notices you leaving early or coming in late. He's super interesting and the material is enjoyable. He always starts class with youtube videos and tries to make lecture less boring by entertaining examples.  Make sure to attend lab and pay attention. Tests are moderately hard but all info comes from class.
