go to class...enough said

Absolutely loved this class. He made class very interesting. Respect him and he will fully respect you in return. Don't text, come late, or leave early, he will call you out. Overall great I class recommend Dr. Golding to everyone.
Great!
Sense of humor, kind of a jerk sometimes but interesting and jokes a lot during class. Don't be late to class or leave early.

Great Teacher. You do not need the book. All test materials comes straight from the book.  I used computer to take notes since there is a lot to study for each test and its easier to print out neat notes.  He was a funny teacher and really laid back.  Attendance is not required but he has in class assignments randomly so you can't miss too many of

Dr. Golding is hilarious! Although attendance isn't mandatory I never wanted to skip his class. Notes are very important too. And pay attention to every single example he gives because they are always on the test!

Don't use the book much, but you open it a few times, share with a friend. Pay close attention to examples for the test, these are a huge part! He's funny and easy to listen to. Really does well in a class of over 500! It's important to come every day for the in-class assignments. Always music and youtube videos! I'd recommend it to anyone!
I had Golding a year back or so and I thought his class was fun and I learned a lot!  I liked his personality a lot and class was very enjoyable!

Doesn't use text book at all, he thinks hes the man at everything. His class is too organized, so organized that he won't bump an 89.9% to an A. His youtube videos are cool but nothing else is, needs to work on his temper.

I really enjoyed going to his class. He starts off every lecture with music, and shows lots of videos to keep things interesting. Tests are extremely easy and straight off the notes. Has in class activities to take attendance.

He is an amazing psychology teacher! He made me want to go to class. His lectures were interesting to listen to and he always has a joke or story to tell that goes a long with the lecture. I would take any of his classes.
awesome professor! gives funny/good examples to help make material more clear.  Keeps class interesting. Gives random in-class assignments as a way to take attendance, so try to go to class.

Lectures are terrible.  He talkes about a lot of examples, but does not focus on the material that we are tested on.  Do not ever stay for his "test reviews".  They are extreamlly pointless because he just basically says the main topics that will be on the test and repeates himself.
best teacher you could have

This guy is a terrible proffessor. What teacher takes attendance in a 500 person lecture class? He purposly tries to give kids lower grades with that policy.  What ever you do not go to his office hours. He is the most rude person you will ever meet outside of lecture
Great teacher, keeps the class entertained and gets the material across very clearly.

Dr. Golding is an amazing professor! He is very easy to learn from and keeps class very interesting! Impossible to fall asleep in this class, and his exams are based on coming to class! If you pay attention, you will succeed!

If you can take his Eyewitness Testimony class. He only offers it in the Spring time and he is the only teacher. All you have to do is participate and write the slides down. If you are late he WILL call you out though. Made class VERRRY interesting!!! A MUST TAKE
Never wanted to go to a class as much as I wanted to go to this one. He is enthusiastic and made my 500 person class feel like a 30 person class.
He's the best. Hilarious, ready to help, he really wants you to pass. He surprised when he invited Calipari to come talk to our class. we were all speechless. the notes are the exams. great teacher.
Amazing teacher and subject matter.  Clear and concise.  He is very open and I would like to talk to him outside of lecture.  never bought the book just like he advised.

Go to class.  Don't get on his bad side!  He is relentless if you rub him the wrong way, and he will berate you all semester!  Other than that, this class is pretty easy.  He requires participation and attendance, so you have to come to class and speak up to get an A.
Great psychology professor! Just make sure you go to class...there are in class activities. Go to all the labs and do not buy the book, i used it once if that.
he's a great teacher

Golding does an excellent job with such a large class. Well structured class. Clearly explains what is expected. Go to class! Has attendance quizzes. Don't buy the text. Making flashcards really does make a difference.  Great class!

He's an awesome professor. All of his classes are so interesting, and he is hilarious! He keeps it fun! I would take this course again! the tests aren't bad , as long as you know what you're talking about.

It is absolutely necessary to go to class and begin studying for the test a WHOLE week before. If you fail to do so then you will not do well. Make sure you get all of the in class assignments and never miss lab. He is a good teacher and makes jokes a lot. Just don't get on his bad side. DON'T BUY THE TEXTBOOK!!

Dr Golding is a great professor. He wants his students to do well and understand the material. Everything on test if from lecture notes, so go to class (plus he makes class fun). Don't take anyone else for psy100 Golding is the way to go.
Great Teacher!!!

Very interesting, fun teacher. Had a lot of good examples. Tests could be tricky, but overall an easy class. Go to class/labs because everything on tests comes from there and there are quizes/inclass assignments. Labs can really help your grade! You don't really need the book, just share with someone, but you need the lac manual. Easy grade!
Excellent professor! He's so energetic and makes everything in class so clear.  However the test are a bit difficult in wording, as long as you study you'll do fine! Highly reccomend him for PSY 100!

DO NOT BUYY THE BOOK!!! He aids in the publishing of his textbook so he gets some of the profit. You use the book twice in the semeser. And you look up theories that will easily be found on the internet. He also changes the book every semester so you can't sell it bck. total rip off

Awesome teacher. I have had him in 2 classes and I wish I could take him a third time. He doesnt have you buy a text book in his upper level classes (311 and 427) so it is cheaper than my other classes. he is very clear and makes the subject fun and easy! his in class assignments are SO easy and he is my favorite prof at UK.
Phenomenal professor.  My favorite professor at UK.

This class was super easy! As long as you go to class, take good notes, and go to labs, you'll get an A. He lectures over exactly what's going to be on the tests, so don't miss class. I aced all of the tests with only studying an hour or two the night before. Golding is a great teacher, and he's fun, too! I highly recommend taking this class!

He's a fantastic professor, funny and extremely helpful. He uses a packet from Johnny Print for articles, about 8 or so, all pretty short. In-class assignments, so go to class. Tests are 85% from lecture, 15% from journal article/packet. READ BEFORE CLASS. Study enough, and you can get a pretty easy A/B.

He made class interesting, but you have to go to class in order to pass the tests.  He manages the large class well and really helps you understand what he's talking about.  Study the night before for a good amount of time, go to class and lab and you're pretty much guaranteed an A.

Attendence policy is ridiculous. He keeps attendence in a 500 person lecture class by having "in class activities". If you miss too many of these you're automatically dropped two letter grades...STUPID RULE. Besides that he is very rude and not understanding when you talk to him one on one. Very overrated prof.

The easiest psych professor there is. Tests are straight from the notes, you literally have to memorize them. If you go to class and spend a couple hours studying for each test, you can easily get an A.

psy100 was a very interesting class. I liked golding a lot until i went to his office hours. i went 2 times and he was very rude to me both times, and it was an unnecessary rudeness. He gives a lot of in-class examples and random assignments so you need to be in class. I got a B in the class, and it wasnt too bad. Lab helps to clarify the content.

Exams come straight from notes. Only few sections from book that he singles out, no need to buy the book. TA's are hit or miss, ask questions if you don't get anything. Guaranteed B if you just study your notes for a couple hours.

Great class, as he does in 100 there are lots of video examples and a good deal of the exam questions are dedicated to them. The book is a pocket from Johnny Print and there are a few readings, most less than 20 pages for each of the exams. He does in class assignments randomly, and they count into your grade heavily, so you'll want to be in class.

There were 500+ students in my class, but he caters to a crowd. It's simple: go to class, take notes, and ask questions during lab if you don't understand anything. Lectures are entertaining with a lot of video clips and personality. Tests are multiple choice and mainly from the notes. However, read the sections of the book he singles out.
Very good professor...you have to go to class and take the notes. The test come straight from the notes not the book!

He was great!! He is available in all office hours if you need him!  Tests are not bad at all, but you must study for them.  Overall pretty easy A, I recommend it!  Also, you must keep up with the experiment hours, do them they are really easy!!
Great guy, funny, fun class. Pop quizzes so you should go to class. Tests are a little hard but nothing too bad. A great class to take.
I love Dr. Golding. He is awesome, and if you don't do well in his class it's because you didn't try.  He's hilarious and very helpful, he will help you out if you did poorly on some assignment.
Golding is pretty cool and kind of cheesy. The class is not very hard at all. Just go to class and study for the exams and you should do fine.

Very easy.  I have no interest in psychology, but Dr. Golding was able to keep it fun and entertaining.  His tests are easy, they come straight from his notes.  I highly recommend taking him for this class.

He refuses to curve grades at the end. I was a tenth of a point away from an A and he refused to bump it. He is cocky and inconsiderate but if you don't mind having a complete jerk for a teacher, go ahead and take it.

Golding is a pretty good guy and an interesting teacher. He gives a few pop quizzes (very easy) to make people come to class, but it is enjoyable anyways. Class is easy to get through with a B, a little work and focus will get an A. Overall a GOOD class.
Golding is a pretty good guy i had some questions about the class and he was more that happy to help me. you hardly ever use the book ive opened mine twice and still hae an a.

Dr. Golding is a great professor and has the perfect personality for a giant lecture class.  He keeps class entertaining and always thoroughly explains the material.  His tests can be a little tricky, but as long as you study the material and think through the questions you'll do fine.  I definitely recommend him for PSY 100!
Great!
His class is always interesting and he's a generally funny guy.  But, better not come late.  Just go to class and Labs and this class is do-able.  No easy A from him though.

his exams are fairly difficult and there is a lot of work required for the class, however he explains everything very well. His TAs are also very good. You won't use the book much, but its a good idea to have it anyways. He gives in class assignments randomly, but usually just being there will give you credit. The class isnt hard to stay awake thru
I thought he did a great job, especially with such a large class.

It's a good class for freshman.  I was a junior taking it because I just need credit hours to remain a full time student before heading to pharmacy school.  I thought his tests were freshman level.  He uses a lot of notes-pretty boring.  He's a good lecturer for a class of 500.  He seems like a nice guy.  Overall, good class.
OUTSTANDING TEACHER!

Golding rocks!! His class was so much fun. He keeps you interested during the entire lecture period. His exams are based off of his lectures, so it's pointless to buy the book if you attend class. Just listen to his lectures and take semi-good notes. I got an A and didn't open my book once. His class is awesome.  Highly recommended.

Dr. Golding is really intersting. Attendance is not mandatory but he will give "in class assignments" which are really easy...like write your name on a piece of paper, for participation points. You don't have to read the book at all...but a lot of test questions are exactly things in class...his tests are tricky, but completely doable. Take it!
As others have said, there's no homework and you don't need the book. But Golding is extremely overrated as a lecturer. The class can bore you to tears, at times.
Great Professor!  Sometimes hard to follow because of the speed of the class but overall, it is fine!
Golding is a great professor.  He makes the subject interesting with his use of movie clips to serve as examples.  Fun class

I loved this class. Psychology somewhat interested me before this class but now I love it.  He is a good teacher because he knows what he is talking about but you need to go to class. He has random in class assignments that you definently need to do. Also be sure to go to lab, it's very helpful.

This is a great class for first semester freshman.  But be sure you take it with Golding.  He's easy, as long as you go to class and lab, you should get an A.  He makes a lecture with 900 people as fun as it possibly could be.  Very easy course and never any homework.
great teacher. really funny to listen to, but you have to go to lecture because he does in class assignments. don't need a book becuase the test is straight from the lecture

he is by far my favorite teacher.  you dont need the book because his lectures are interesting and fun so you will want to go to class.  uses a lot of class examples on the tests which are pretty simple if you study

Some people didn't enjoy Golding in a small class, but I really did.  He seemed to understand that we were freshmen and needed to learn to adjust to school.  There was a decent amount of reading involved, but I hardly ever did it and I still got an A.  I hear that he's great in PSY 100 from most people-- you either love or hate him.  :)
Very entertaining and easy to follow.  He likes to give pop quizes though.
very good professor! fun lecutres with lots of cool movie clips.  he's pretty easy going and likes to joke around with students.  a guy in a mokey suit once ran in our class and he just laughed!

Dr. Golding is a great teacher. The stories he has of his childhood at Camp Rockhill are priceless. Besides being a great psych teacher, he is a great friend to all his students. His stories of his friends Dave Ascuitto and Goldy are priceless. HOOT  Hoot

AWESOME PROFESSOR!!!  His lectures were interesting and he brings in outside sources (movie clips, etc.) to help students understand.  My TA was great as well!  Easy A (maybe B)0 if you study and actually go to class, which isn't hard to do because he's so fun!

GOLDING IS THE BEST TEACHER AT UK!! he actually conviced me to go into psychology. he is funny, interesting, his large lecture and his small are equally as fun. you will love every minute of it, and if you actually make use of his office hours he is very helpful. he also gets the best TA's.

BEST TEACHER AT UK! He makes class interesting and keeps your attention.  He's always really anxious but its really funny. He will know you by name by the second class so he knows if you aren't there.  Intimidating if you're quiet but not if you speak up and show an opinion. You'll get out what you put in to getting to know him and on his good side

I had him in a large lecture class. I found him to be very rude and not at all helpful. From talking with others who have psy 100 under different teachers, his class is definitely harder than average for the class, but not too difficult in and of itself.
Great teacher, one of the best on campus!!  Tests aren't too bad, but you have to study. Not a hard class to go to, he makes it very interesting.
He is the best teacher I have had in college.
Dr. Golding was willing to help me out of class to understand this difficult material. He was instrumental in my pursuing a doctorate degree in psychology. Very motivating, helpful, and hot.
HE IS DREAMY!
No Comments
Scatterbrianed, has no real set lesson plans.  Beware--he plays favorites and tends to undercut students that he is not particularly fond of!

This man is utterly ridiculous.  He professes to want "class participation" in discussions, but then refuses to allow certain students to speak.  He claims that it's because the ones who want to speak do so because their previous teachers let them--he insists on singling out quieter students and elevataing their opinions above the other students.
huge class in fall, 500+ students. interesting points to help you understand it all. tests are hard.
No Comments
Great Teacher, very interesting and gets to know his students.  It is a small class, but puts forth that extra effort.
No Comments

I'm sorry, I hated this guy.  If I can get the info from the book, then don't act like I need to be at your gigantic class every single day of the week.  He has lame test questions that refer to minutiae from class lectures, like the color of a hat that he pointed out from the audience on a particular day.  So self-absorbed.

make sure you go to class every day because a lot of his points are based on in class assignments and if you miss one than you are screwed. overall it was a great class and it is a lot of fun and very interesting

Passionate about his material. Pretty demanding class, attendence at class, labs & experiment hours are all necessary to get an A. Exams were somewhat difficult & required decent amount of studying. Definitely makes a 500+ lecture class interesting & definitely worth taking if you're willing to work

the class is fun and interesting, you absolutely have to attend class, do experiment hours, not miss lab& STUDY for the tests.  Hes big on in-class assignments& you can only miss a few before you fail. hes a great prof and keeps it interesting. plays music before class too & often you get out early
best prof at uk hands down
Awesome awesome awesome in lower level, big classes. But in higher level and smaller classes can be a jerk. Pretty intimidating even when he says he's not.

BEST PROFESSOR AT UK.  HE TOLD US AT THE BEGINNING OF THE SEMESTER THAT HE WANTED US TO REMEMBER HIM IN 20 YEARS WHEN WE THINK ABOUT OUR UK CLASSES, AND NO DOUBT I WILL.  GREAT GUY, HIP ACCENT, REALLY FUNNY.  TAKE PSY 100 ONLY WITH GOLDING!!!   GOLDING ROCK!!

by far, the best professor on campus!  makes a class of 500 feel like a class of 20! entertaining, clear, and gives good examples (movies, pics) to help you understand! Some prof's at UK need to take a few tips from Golding!
I love Golding!!!
Huge lecture hall but he works it great and never a dull moment.  Keeps class interesting. Plus he's cute for an older guy.
Classes are very entertaining and he manages to be one-on-one in a class of 500+.
very helpful

A 500+ lecture, but personable and engaging nonetheless. I never went to office so I can't vouch for that, but in class he was an absolute blast and this was one of VERY few classes I've ever really looked forward to at UK.
Classes were easy and mostly entertaining. He is good at interacting with large groups, not quite as good at interacting one-on-one. I'd take him again for his movie clips and easy tests
fun, easy class, but he is a jerk outside of class -- but is helpful if you need anything.
Easy, and tries his hardest to make things interesting.  He really wants his students to learn.  Make sure to read your PychOnline material!!!
total jerk outside of class
Someone who studies how people learn will obviously be a good instructor. Take his uptight attitude with a grain of salt. Class is fun.

Excellent at teaching, but imtimidating in person. Lively, fun atmosphere. Do not take if you do not like online reading. You read this, instead of a textbook. There are labs, so make sure you get a good TA. Highly reccommend this class.
This course was great.  He is an energetic teacher and the class is in memorial hall, so you can people watch all class and not get bored.  I highly recommend this course
Great teacher, he is fun and entertaining. He makes the information interesting and easy to learn.
Pretty cool guy, easy class

Granted this class had 600+ students, but this guy made psychology boring as all hell, was incredibly unhelpful during office hours, and let his TAs determine how lab assignments were graded, a total spaz.
Very good.
Very entertaining and his exams are easy. I don't remember really ever having studied, either.
No Comments
very funny and keeps students' attention (or more than regular profs.)
often rude to students who ask for help
great teacher

He's a really great guy and loves what he teaches. The grade is all 80% exams, but the exams are all memorization. If you start studying two days before, you'll do fine. The first exam is the hardest, but it's not as bas as everyone is making it seem.

Professor Schoop is a fantastic professor, The topics can be really boring but he still makes the lecture interesting and engaging. You will always be able to leave class learning at least one fun fact or unique bit of information. The First exam is the hardest by far if you do good on that the rest of the exams are lightwork just be sure to study.

Dr.Schoop is an amazing professor. He takes inherently boring material and turns it into a lecture where you aren't entirely bored out of your mind. The class becomes very easy after the first exam as long as you make flashcards and do the practice quizzes. I would've gotten an A if it wasn't for the for the first exam. Study at least 12 hrs for it

Schoop was hands down fantastic. He really is a professor who wants to his students to pass. He is aware of the difficulty of the course and does his best to make it as clear as possible and even drops hints of what will be on the exam. He offers extra credit opportunities and our final was online. He always teaches with a smile on his face!

ME 599/699 covers Dr. Schoop's expertise in surface engineering. Exploration of this topic is crucial for graduate students with an interest in engineered surfaces, fine machining, and residual stress. He lectures with vigor and joy despite the often terrible class timing a la UKY registrar. 10/10 based.

Professor Schoop does the best job that he can to present the content in an interesting way. However, I found the content to be very boring and ineffective. I gave him a high rating because he wants everyone to get a solid grade and provides many extra credit opportunities to achieve this. Be aware, exam one is the hardest. Study, study, study!
Amazing professor. If you watch the review exam videos he posts, you'll probably get close to a 100% on the exams.

Professor Kirn's class is super super easy. As long as you go to class and watch his videos on what to study, you should have no problem getting an A in the class. He does like to talk a lot during lectures, but we get out of class 15 mins early every single class. He prepares you well for exams.

PK is great, and I would definitely recommend to take him. That said, he doesn't speak in a linear fashion, and jumps from one topic to another in his in-person classes. If this will frustrate you, I would avoid him.
Genuinely one of my favorite professors! The class is relatively easy and logical, and there is a decent amount of homework, but it is nothing that isn't manageable.

He's a good professor who you can tell cares about his students. He has the best online lectures I've ever seen, and incorporates his personality into them. Online can get pretty busy some weeks with multiple long lecture videos.
Good guy and easy class. Makes the lectures engaging. Tests worth 75% percent of the grade, 3 of them with the final exam being optional.

He is such a happy guy with the most decked out lecture videos I just love his energy and passion. The material was mostly common sense, but I still struggled with certain questions on exams. He does lock assignments and releases them each week. There is a lot of HW, but it's easy and unlimited tries. He also drops the lowest exam out of 4.

loved kirn- sets up the course to feel like a real class, very reachable. exams were fairly easy, and he drops one so you don't have to take the final if you're doing well in the course. loved his class, and even liked his online lectures.

Professor John Kirn is one of the best. He's kind, funny, and creates a relaxed, engaging class. His real-world experience makes everything practical, and he's always helpful and fair. He truly wants students to succeed. I highly recommend him!!!

This class is on the easier side. However for more complicated topics, he does a really great job of breaking the content down. I will say there are a lot of assignments due each week, but they don't necessarily take too long to complete. Exams aren't too bad. Do the practice problems to study because the questions are similar to the exam.

PROTECT THIS MAN AT ALL COSTS!!! I've never met someone so gracious and considerate of his students. He drops your lowest exam, quiz and smartbook assignments and he makes lecture relate to real life. I would take this class in person not online because you gain so much from him. He is so knowledgeable, kind, and gracious to his students.
He is an amazing teacher! He is so helpful and really wants his students to succeed in his classes. If you use what he provides to study for exam and listen in class you'll do good.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: His class was good and organized. There are 3 exams and an optional final that are worth 75% of your grade. There are many little assignments, however, those don't weigh enough to change your grade. Depending on how you do on the first exam, will almost have you set for what you will get in the course. Unless you do much better on the rest of them.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Kirn is a solid dude, but he is just a professional yapper. He gets off topic every class to the point where you have no clue what he's talking about. Prepare to study all the material from scratch, because class doesn't teach you anything.

Really nice guy. Kind of boring concept if you aren't interested in MGT, but he makes it fun. Takes attendance one out of the two class days of the week, so sometimes you can guess when he will or won't. There is a textbook, but you can get bye without it.

The tests are harder than the homework and the quizzes but they are easy if you study for them. He is able to make boring content more engaging and enjoyable. He is really nice. He drops some assignments. Some of the assignments feel like busy work but overall it's an easy and engaging class. Definitely would recommend you to take Kirn!

Great guy, uses real life examples to spice up the class and makes sure you're paying attention. overall cool dude, and if you just use the study guide he gives you, you'll be just fine. he also curves all of his exams by like 3-6 points.

Professor Kirn is truly the best professor. He genuinely cares about his students and their success, often sharing practical, real-world advice.The class is engaging&thoughtfully designed to teach effective negotiation across a variety of scenarios.Encouraging you to step outside your comfort zone & offers valuable personal and professional growth.

I also took him for 301. PK is BY FAR the best professor I've ever had and 450 was probably my favorite ever class. I guarantee that every single student in the class would say the exact same thing. Hes attending graduation just to see some of us one last time. He is extremely engaging, personable, caring and knowledgeable. BIG Bengals fan

Theres random attendance. The class is overall easy. Lectures can be kinda boring but he tries to entertain the class. He's an incredible guy, a good person all around. He really wants you to succeed. Definitely one of the best professors at UK for sure.

He is super nice and gives good lectures. Four exams but the one with the lowest grade gets dropped so if you do good on the first 3 you don't have to take the last one. He also posts exam review videos telling you everything you need to know to take the exam. The homework is very easy and manageable.
Very helpful, a fun class with negotiations with peers in class, helps you learn in person and gives useful skills.

the class wasn't too hard in my opinion, you just need to put the time and effort for it, he does drop your lowest exam score and some of the home works, quizzes, and attendance. he engages a lot with his students and is super nice. the class is VERY EXAM HEAVY like 75%,so make sure to study. he does provides a lot of material to prep for the exam!

I loved this class and Professor Kirn's lectures. He is so funny and engaging and uses excellent examples for his lectures. His exams are a little difficult, but study hard. He is very involved in Gatton and willing to help you. Also, he is obsessed with all things Disney and the Bengals. I would definitely take more of his classes.

he always starts the lectures wtih a song, he's good at keeping the class interesting, and is able to apply topics to real life. all the notes can be found in the textbook, but he takes attendence one class a week usually. Really liked this prof, would definitely take again!
Very nice professor & gives great lectures. Has a lot of the tedious smart book assignments, but shouldn't take up too much time.

Lots and lost of info given during lecture so GO. He drops the lowest exam, meaning you can skip the final if you do good on the first three. theres always a smartbook assignment on new chapters and quizzes and these simulation quizzez to, not that hard and maybe takes like an hour for all of it.
Great guy and really cares about teaching his class. Loves management and his students. Test are actually kind of hard so you kinda have to study. LOTS of homework but it is super easy busy work.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I absolutely love PK! I ended up adding management as a double major after being in his class. I would take him for ever class I could in the future. The class are test heavy, but if you study the material you can easily get the scores you need to get an A.

nicest professor I have ever had. VERY test heavy (75%), but the tests are pretty easy so if you study you can get a good grade. The lowest test grade is also dropped, which helps a ton. he has a lot of funny stories as well

I absolutely adore PK with everything in me. He is my favorite professor at Gatton, and I can't say enough good things about him. He was born to manage, and it's very clear when you hear him speak. Absolutely inspirational and a great guy. Decently easy tests and homework if you commit yourself. Will absolutely take him again if I get the chance!
The best online proff I've had. Supper interesting lectures: make sure to study for those exams though!

I never thought I would care about management, but I've come to love it because of Professor Kirn. He is very approachable and makes the class as interesting as possible. He relates a lot of material to personal experiences, is very knowledgeable about the material he teaches. I would recommend him and this course for any major.

The guy loves to tell stories but can sometimes get a little off track. Don't fall behind because the material is presented quickly throughout the semester. If you do well on the first three exams the final is optional. Come to class because the best study guides are the notes you go over during class. You can tell he cares about his students.

I really like Professor Kirn. He has kind of a dorky personality but it makes him kind of endearing. Really good guy. His lecture videos for his online class are the best I have seen. They are extremely professional looking and well put together. VERY well designed course. I appreciate the effort he puts into it.

Professor Kirn is an incredible professor. His lectures are very clear and often connect to his years of real-world experience in management. There is no reason not to take Professor Kirn's class if you are a management major.
Professor Kirn is great. Very engaging and does a good job of keeping class entertaining while teaching the material.

Dr Kirn is awesome, easily one of the best teachers I've ever had at any level. Super engaging, great storyteller (you will hear many stories), nice guy, very knowledgable, decades of experience. If you take him in the fall he will talk about the Bengals ALL THE TIME (good thing). I am a management major and cant wait to take another class w/ him

PK is great. He takes a boring course and makes it a little more fun. He tells stories to make content relatable, and he engages a 400+ person lecture. IMO, a lot of the material is common sense and is pretty simple. He drops several quizzes, attendance grades, and one of the exams. Great course that is made better by PK, absolutely no complaints.
Great and personable person! Lectures are less boring than normal and there is a lot of homework that can help boost your grade if you do it all. No issues with this professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Kirn is one of the most influential professors I've had. His teaching truly applies to the real world. Whether it's buying an engagement ring, house, car, or a job offer, Kirn introduces negotiation skills to help give you the best advantage possible. Participation in class matters. He takes out some of your lowest grades. Exams are not bad at all

He is a good professor overall but the class material in itself is just boring. He takes attendance about half the time. The homework, quizzes, and readings are very simple and straightforward. The exams aren't bad and he drops your lowest score so you can skip the final if you do good on the first three.
All around great person and professor. Would definitely recommend taking him for any MGT courses.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Amazing human being and professor. Theres a couple assignments a week but they dont take too long or much thought process. Takes random attendance but need to be in class for notes and important info, if you go he will literally say "know this for the test" so as long as you sit down and study what he tells you to its really not bad.

One of my favorite at UK. He is such a stand up guy and tries to connect lectures to real life. I was going through a tough time and he allowed me to switch from his in person class to fully online with basically no questions asked. I am normally an A student and found his class very easy to get an A/B, everyone needs to experience professor Kirn.

Took his class online and he would assign as many as 7 assignments due in one day. He does drop the lowest exam though but he never specifies what is going to be on the test, so be prepared for hardcore memorization.  I would not take him online again. I wish he would post slides instead of making you watch long video lectures which take sm time!

PK is an amazing professor. He holds you accountable to learn, but does this in an engaging way by sharing personal experiences and being relatable. The course is very test heavy, but you get to drop one exam and he prepares you very well for each one. Do the assignments and pay attention to lecture and you are good. Highly recommend taking him!
Professor Kirn is an amazing professor and explains the chapters well. He also does an amazing job about explaining what material will be on the exam.

My favorite professor at UK so far! I was never bored when attending lectures. He takes attendance checks once a week and there's quite a bit of homework but it is not a burden at all. You can tell he cares about his students.

Took his online management class and it was really easy. As long as you keep up with all the lecture videos each week you will definitely learn the material and do fine on the tests. Guy seems super fun and I would have loved to take his class in person if I had the chance
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Kirn was born to be a manager/management professor. He is the best at what he does. Has lots of real world experience to relate to the theoretical concepts presented in class. Absolute pinnacle of what a professor should be. Take his class and do not think twice.

Professor Kirn was MEANT to teach this class. He is very engaging, entertaining, and genuinely wants to see his students succeed. If you take this class, take Kirn!! He teaches great life lessons and puts real world negotiations into perspective in the best way possible
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Kirn is the best instructor at UK. His lectures are very entertaining, he provides a lot of real world application. The smartbook assignments are perfect practice for the exams and he even tells students exam questions in advance. Also drops grades including the lowest exam score. Genuinely changed my perspective on the world!
so he does random attendance quiz on canvas. 4 test, only gotta take 3. easy homework. the exams are so easy, its just definition and memorizing. he makes this class so easy its impossible to fail.

Amazing guy and great lectures. He drops multiple assignments, quizzes, and one exam at the end of the semester. Loves Disney and the Bengals. Great sense of humor and plays music before class to boost your spirit and gets you energized before class.

Great Lectures, teaching and entertainment wise. good amount of hw (smart book, quizzes, mini assignments) but super easy. random attendance quizzes but not a lot, drops 1 exam. Overall a great teacher very nice, knows how to keep us engaged and teaches content well. Pretty understanding. Would totally take him again.

I learned so much from this class and I took it as an elective. He gives amazing lectures for real world situations. Best MGt teacher but you do need to pay attention in class. If you take notes and study them for the class you will get an A. He drops the lowest exam 2 quizzes 2 HW and a lot more.

Most of the classes are negotiations where your team goes outside the class to negotiate so it makes the class go by a lot quicker and is more interesting. The course is an easy A but you do have to show up considering the in-class negotiations.

Lots of video lectures to watch with graded quizzes at the end. Decent amount of homework. Drops lowest exam grade. As long as you watch the lectures, do the homeworks and quizzes, your grade should be pretty good when it is exam time. Proctored exams, closed note. Nice guy and good professor. Recommend taking him for your class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Kirn is one of the best professors in Gatton. He is a teacher who cares about his students and wants them to succeed. This professor and I still keep in touch from time to time and talk about football, school, and life. I plan to take another one of his classes that he offers in the future.
Very lecture heavy... good at relating stories to content material
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Kirn is a great guy who cares about his students and has very practical experience he applies to the classroom. The reason he gets a 4 is because his lectures reiterate what is in the reading, and sometimes can be boring. He sometimes can ramble on, however the class is easy and it is what you make of it, and has a lot of real world applications.

Dr. Kirn is a well-spoken and engaging lecturer for MGT 301. I took his online course, and it was really well organized on Canvas. He involves his family, Disney, and the Bengals in his lectures, so dont expect it to just be long boring lectures. He also drops your lowest homework, quiz, and exam grades. Just do the work and youll get an A.
A great teacher who really cares about students. Not a difficult class either. Biiiig Bengals guy.

I absolutely loved Professor Kirn! He really wants to see you succeed. In class, he tries to connect his real work experience to the content. You need to show up to class because he does surprise attendance points. He will also drop a few of your lowest grades to give you a boost. Before each exam, he provides tips on what you should study.

Kirn is a very great lecturer with lots of stories. You will know every career change of all his children (including his new ones), but also know the basics of management. I would not say you have to go to every class, but he did give random attendance quizzes. Would take him again.
Most of the content was common sense so it was pretty easy. He drops a lot of your lowest scores and even an exam, so it is easy to pass. He talks a lot but not all of it is important on the exams.

Kirn is overall a great professor and is so funny. Talks about his family a lot. Very very lenient and cates about his students. If you don't go to class but read the book, you'll easily pass. I feel like you would have to try to fail because its mostly common sense. Take Kirn!! Best professor I've had yet at UK
He was so nice and considerate!
Great professor. If you do your work you should have no trouble getting an A or B

Best remote learning professor I've had. The class format was easy to understand and the homework was pretty simple. The tests were a bit challenging and do require some studying but nothing too difficult if you put in a basic amount of work.

The class is very easy if you just do the assigned work and just look over some definitions before the exam. Very caring and making the lectures a little more interesting because of his personality. Highly recommend to anyone.

PK is very fun and loves his job. His class is the usual, regarding difficulty, but I am sure it is easier in person instead of online. He drops a lot of assignment grades at the end of the semester, including one of the exam grades. 4 exams, a chapter every week, and chapter quizzes every two chapters. You have to try to do bad in this class.

Professor Kirn is an awesome and inspirational professor. He is a really fun teacher and tries his best to make every one smile during class. If you pay attention in class and do the readings, exams won't be too bad.

Great professor, learned a LOT and it was pretty easy. He finds great ways to apply material to your everyday life and even teaches you how to use it in everyday life. He is very entertaining and great at explaining things. He loves the area of study and has tons of experience in it. He gives great career advice and is a great guy in general.

He's very clear about the topics and makes sure we understand. For COVID era, lectures are given through videos and some of them will have a question you have to answer for credit. Tests are super easy, basically watch the videos and remember vocabulary and you will do well.

Prof. Kirn is a very kind teacher and really wants to make sure you learn the content. He is very knowledgeable about how the various topics are actually applied in the real world which really makes concepts easier to understand. Exams are super easy and he gives you plenty of resources to prepare.

Professor Kirn is a nice guy and good teacher. His test were easy and the group project was actually enjoable compared to other projects in other classes. Sometimes he is a little unorganized about when things are due or what is expected on the project. Definitely recommend.

Professor Kirn was great to take for MGT because of his experience in the field. He doesn't just teach from the book, but uses real life examples. Lectures can be boring sometimes, but tests are pretty easy and he drops the lowest one.
LOVE HIM. Always engaged with his students and you can tell he cares so much about everyone. There is a lot of homework but the assignments are pretty easy

Prof Kirns is the best. He makes lectures personal, funny, and as interesting as he can. He's extremely caring and wants everyone to do well. Attendance is only taken 10 random times throughout the semester. Tests are easy if you do the homework and just follow along. Nothing too strenuous

Absolutely refuses to answer emails or questions unless cornered or asked in class. Trails off into rants during lectures and is very unclear about what is going to be on the exam because he changes his mind constantly and will wait till the very last second so no one can ask for clarification or help.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The guy is genuinely really nice, the problem with the class is that it is so pointless. There is a LOT of homework for a class that seems so so so so so common sense oriented.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: He is the laziest prof I've ever had. He makes his TA's do everything and doesn't know his own slides. He won't even take an email even though it's his job. He does random attendance quizzes and his tests are long. He does drop your lowest exam and quiz score.

Professor Kirn's lectures can be very boring, but this was definitely an easy class! He allows you to either not take the final or replace your lowest test grade with the final grade. He does take attendance towards the end of the semester, so I would advise going to class. Overall, it was a very easy class!

PK (as he's called) is one of the greatest profs in Gatton CoB. He's extremely intelligent but explains everything on the simplest level. Unless there's an attendance quiz you can skip & still pass. Homeworks were kind of frequent, but super easy & mostly graded for completion- textbook is online & part of tuition. I would take anything PK teaches!

Professor Kirn is one of the nicest professors I've ever had at UK. He genuinely cares about all of his students, even though he teaches big lectures. He keeps lectures interesting & attendance is only required at the end of the year. The homework helps a lot on exams & is pretty easy. But PK really makes the class as good as it is!

I like the way he gives the lectures as it makes the students understand easily. This subject does have 4 exams including finals but if you do well in the first 3 exams, you can choose to drop the final exam. This class is more to quizzes, connect assignments as well as the reading. There is no group assignments and individual assignments.
He is beyond kind. He truly cares about all his students and wants everyone to past. He also drops the lowest test grade so if your happy with your grade, you dont need to take the final.

Lots of homework for this class but it's all online and you can basically find all the answers on quizlets. PK is an awesome dude and truly wants best for everyone. Tests are pretty easy, you just have to come to class to get the notes.
Kirn is a super good guy. Tries to actually make lectures interesting. This class isn't tough at all by any means. I studied the day before every test and made an A in the class.

John Kirn is a great Professor. He cares about his students, he grades fair, and what you learn in his class if very beneficial. He gives great advice and has a lot of work experience to back it up. Show up to class and do the assignments and it should be an easy A

Professor Kirn was alright. I didn't care for MGT301 in general so that alone turned me off to his class. He rambles a lot and tells tons of stories that are not relevant to the class. Exams aren't too bad. If you study and show up (on the days he uses REEF), you should be able to get a A/B.

LOVE LOVE LOVE Professor Kirn. If I could take him every semester, I would be the happiest person alive. He's so amazing. Exams are easy and he will help you with anything you need help on things like class work or even resumes. REALLY chill professor.

Krin is a great professor but can get off track with his lectures sometimes. Class isn't the most interesting and it's easy to want to get on your computer or phone, but the material is directly related to the exam. He drops your lowest exam so if you try hard on the first few, you may be able to skip the final.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: super sweet, very easy, wants everyone to succeed! drops your lowest exam grade (aka if you like your grade going into the final you dont have to take it!)
He is such a great professor. Take his class if you can!

Professor Kirn is a kind guy and lectures arent bad, but its unclear what we will get tested on when exams come around because he tends to get off track when lecturing, so you never really know what youve actually learned. He really values real world experience though, so the interview project you do is pretty cool and you get to hear advice.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Kirn is hilarious and always making class entertaining, just show up and type the slides and the exams are no surprise he practically tells you everything on it the class before!!
Best professor I've had at UK.

This class is awesome and mostly because Mr. Kirn is awesome. Most of your grade is based off the cases you do in class, so don't skip. 2 tests total, altered grading scale (92-100 A). Real world applicability, if I was to suggest one class you're better off in life having taken, it's this one. Nothing else even comes close.

AMAZING professor. Exams are easy and the project is fun and he grades them very easily. He teaches a lot more than just powerpoint slides and has a lot of background experience to help you understand the material. He also brings in a lot of guest speakers that have experience on the topic we are studying.

I loved professor Kirn's class. Very interacting classroom setting, and he always bring real life example to class. The class project was the best project I have done in college and I learned more than any of my class by doing the project with my team.

No hw, 2 tests, 1 paper.  You don't have a lot of outside work.  You go to class, negotiate with another person (which isn't that bad) and leave. If you're scared on confrontation you can still take this class, it doesn't matter how bad you are. You'll get an A or B. Top half of the class gets A's.

The best professor I have had at UK. Not only does he teach useful material relevant to course, but he also provides students with great information on surviving in the business world. If you have a chance to take him TAKE HIM!

Tests are easy, but avoid if you're like me and don't like doing long, detailed, typical business school group presentations. This whole class is about coming up with a business (I'm so tired of this), developing a business plan and giving a 20 minute speech with Q&A.
Very easy going, likes to ramble on at times but genuinely cares about his students, tests aren't hard if you study. Uses the book way too much, too many definitions and too much writing.
Great guy. Can really ramble at times, but he genuinely cares about his students on a personal level. Any class you take with him is going to be really easy. Tests aren't hard.

One of the best teachers I have had at UK. He uses his previous experiences and movie clips to help get his point across. Tests cover a lot of material but he is very clear about the material that is going to be on the test. Does fun activities to get his point across. If more teachers put in the effort like Kirn students might pay attention more
Great professor! Use the book some, but might be able to do without. Easy A or B at lowest. If you ask questions, he will help a lot.

She is the best professors I've ever had! You can tell that she loves genetics and wants everyone to learn and understand the content. The class was a flipped lecture so you watch the lecture and then practice in the class. Her office hours are great! I loved genetics!

AMAZING teacher, she is one of my favorites. She loves what she teaches and cares about her students. It is a flipped classroom so stay up to date on the videos and come to class and you will do good. She does so much practice and goes over things multiple times. Labs are easy and if you go you will get 100%. Her lectures are good, rewatch them.

I loved her. Always high averages on exams (high C or B) and that's pretty good for genetics. She makes the class easy because she makes you practice so much. So kind and enthusiastic about the material.
easy class super fun would take again

One of the few great bio professors at UK. Flipped classroom style but lecture is still helpful because she goes over tons of practice problems. Can seem like a lot of work with all the videos/notes, but is still very manageable once you get a hang of it. Cheat sheet on exams too!

Dr. O is so fun and loves biology. Her lectures were always very fun, and her assignments were easy. The videos before class were boring, but she lets you submit work late so dont stress when you have a lot of assignments due. Just pay attention in class and you'll be fine. The exams were buns but you get to retake one at the end of the sem.

I LOVE Dr. O!! She is genuinely the best professor at UK. She has you watch the lectures and write notes the night before a lecture and then it's mainly review in lecture. Also, you get to retake one exam and you get a 1 page (front and back) cheat sheet for each exam. I 100% recommend Dr. O if you are debating which professor to take for BIO148.
Best professor I have had at UK and the way she teaches just makes you retain the material without having to study. If you have to take BIO 148, take Dr.O

TAKE DR. O!!!!!! She made the content in this class very easy to understand. She is very approachable and gives you plenty of out-of-class opportunities to get help. She is always in a great mood and this class was always a great start to my day. She makes the content in the class very interesting, and she is all-around a great professor!!!

Dr. O is an amazing professor. She explains difficult content in a very understanding way. She cares a lot about her students, and wants all of them to succeed. Very helpful with grades, and allows a retake on one exam.

Dr. O is an energetic and engaging professor who makes BIO148 fun and approachable. With helpful lectures, extra credit, and the option to retake exams, she creates opportunities for students to succeed. Unstuck AI proved to be a useful study tool alongside the class materials.

Dr. O may be the best professor UK has to offer! She clearly cares about her students and wants everyone to succeed. The class is very difficult, but she goes out of her way to be accessible for help outside of class. She also understands that most people in the class are pre-professional and doesn't try to burden you with busy work.
TAKE DR. OSTERHAGE for ANYTHING YOU POSSIBLY CAN! She is hilarious and truly cares about what she is teaching.  SHE LOVES BIOLOGY.

She is one of the best at Kentucky, up there with Steelman. She wrote me a lettter of rec and has always been a fair professor. Exams are reflective of lecture and homework is easy to complete and graded for participation. I have taken her for BIO 148 and BIO 315 and she made the experience enjoyable and interesting.

Dr. O is great, shes hilarious, her class is fun, theres really not much else to say. She uses Poll Everywhere to take attendance, which is like iClicker. She also livestreams every class so you can watch from home and get attendance if you cant go or overslept or something. Plus, the other BIO148 professor subbed for us a few times and she was bad

Dr. O has been the best professor I've had in all of undergrad. Her lectures are engaging and your grade in the course is a direct reflection of how much effort you're willing to put in. She lets you retake any of the exams to improve your score and homework assignments aren't considered "late" until the day of an exam. Take Dr. O if you can!

If you can take Dr. O, take her. She is the best ever. The content itself isn't super easy but there is lots of opportunities to make good grades. Her lectures are very engaging and you can tell she cares about her students. 110% recommend.

Dr.O was great! You get to retake an exam at the end. She is fun during lectures and makes things easier to understand. She really wants us to succeed. She had an echo so you didn't have to go to class but there was a pollev everyday which is like IClicker so you have to watch the echo. The class is pretty easy if you keep up. She accepts late work

Amazing professor. She is very energized and engaging, definitely the best BIO teacher available. Attendance is mandatory, and it's easy to skip, but GO TO CLASS!! She is very helpful and breaks it down in class. You also do certain assignments and notes in class. She wants everyone to succeed, you can even retake exams if you attend office hours!

If you take BIO 148 take Dr. O!!! She is one of the best professors at UK. She is so funny and engaging. She really goes out of her way to help students understand the content and do well in this course. She is very passionate about what she teaches which makes it difficult not to do well. Take Dr. O!!!
Class is pretty test heavy but if you go to class and attend office hours it helps. Dr. O is awesome. She wants everyone to succeed. Very funny and engages well with students

Made the class so funny and made me want to attend. Does attendance questions everyday but these can be done from home as they are online. Gives out plenty of homework but it is relatively easy. Dr. O is easily my favorite professor.
Absolutely amazing and funny. Wants students to learn and makes BIO 148 very introductory and easy to follow along. Many extra credit opportunities as well. Super nice and helpful!!
One of the best biology professors I have ever had. Take her
Overall an easy teacher for introductory biology and would totally recommend.
Honestly ones of the greatest professors in the Biology department

Dr. O is genuinely one of the best professors. She is extremely caring and understanding. Dr. O wants all her students to succeed and motivates her students various times throughout the semester. The course sets the student up for success. Her lectures are AMAZING - she explains complex topics extremely well. Take Dr. O!!
Super nice and lots of assignments that help you do well on the tests!
Amazing professor. She gives detailed notes that are presented via videos (flipped classroom) and takes test questions directly from them.

The best professor at UK. She is so sweet and caring. Go to her office hours and ask questions. She will help you in any way you need. There is no judgment from her at all. During class she tells you how to be successful in the class, follow those guidelines.

Most work is done online independently, but the lectures are very clear and enjoyable. She does a great job at explaining difficult concepts and making them interesting. You do have a cheat sheet for tests. Very nice and pretty funny. Kind of reminds me of a grade-school teacher, for better or worse.

Dr. O is one of the best professors at UK. She explains as clearly as she possibly can and makes any lecture/notes interesting and understandable. If you are going to take a BIO 148 course Dr. O will ensure you to pass. The tests are difficult and she genuinely cares that every student has all the material and understanding needed to succeed.

Dr.O is great. She is sweet and wants everyone to do well. This class is so easy it is almost annoying. She lets you turn in any assignment late and describes everything in the most basic way. The class is boring because it is so simple but I guess that is a positive. Definitely recommend taking her section if you need the credit.

Dr. O is an amazing professor and lecturer. She is engaging in her lectures and is so fun to listen to. She makes tons of videos covering topics; there is no shortage of study material. I highly recommend taking her if you can.
Dr.O is one of the kindest professors on campus. She really cares for your success!

Dr. O is amazing! She's very sweet and energetic! The class really isn't that hard you do kinda have a lot of homework but you have until the end of the semester to get it done (no late penalties) the hardest part of the class is definitely the tests, but you get a cheat sheet. 10/10 recommend

ALWAYS TAKE DR. O!! She is so kind, funny and smart! Her course is easy if you actually do the assignments and watch the videos. She responds fast to canvas messages/emails. Some of the material is hard so she simplifies everything and gives great examples. She's so charming during lecture that you never get bored! TONS of study materials for exams
She is awesome! Content is easy to access and she is honestly the best professor I've ever had.

Dr. O is the best professor Ive had this semester. She really cares about her students and makes sure they understand the content. Biology can be challenging, but she makes it fun. I really recommend her.

She genuinely cares about her students and their success. Don't be afraid to ask questions about concepts or advice for test-taking. She is by far the best professor I have had over the four semesters I have been at the university.
Awesome teaching.

If you can take Dr. O please do! I had her my first semester and she handled the online platform sooo well. You will be in great hands -- and, if you can make it to the online lectures, do so because she engages her students. I think it's the only reason I got a high grade (despite not having any biology since like freshman year of highschool).
Email her if you have a question, and she will help you! She is the best professor I have had so far.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: Hardest class I have ever had. Studied for a week in advance of exams & went to office your hours and still got a high D/low C on them all. Shes very nice and tries to be helpful, but material is just extremely hard.

Dr. O is one of the best professors at UK, 10/10 recommend. She genuinely cares about her students, is willing to help when you don't understand& is very approachable. Course is very well organized & the transition to online (bc of Covid) was very easy since she records herself teaching the content. tip: Understand the content, don't just memorize!

I would recommend Dr.O to anyone that has the opportunity to take any of her classes! She is organized, incredibly intelligent, and cares about her students! If you do as you are supposed to (listen in class, do your homework using your knowledge, and take the practice quizzes) you will do well!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Love this class! Professor is very caring and does a lot of extra work to make sure you understand the material before an exam!!

Absolutely fantastic professor! The best you can get for BIO148. Be prepared to pay attention in lecture and keep up with homework 2-3 times a week, but it's the perfect speed not to overwhelm you and to help you digest the material well.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is a great professor that cares about her students and the grade they receive. Very caring and passionate teacher.

Dr. O does a really great job of teaching a rather difficult class. She explains concepts very well and is super accessible outside of class and is always willing to work with students one on one. You really have to study hard to get A's on the exams but it is very possible! As long as you pay attention and practice a lot you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Overall great prof for the class - lots of homework assignments to make sure students learn. Do the homework, study hard for the tests by doing the given practice exams, they help a ton.

Osterhage is awesome. She's so organized and provides countless practice questions, review videos, and feedback. Her practice exams are very similar to the difficulty of the real exams. Attendance isn't technically required cause you can click in at home and watch the lecture online. No book needed she will provide all the notes,

THE BEST professor you will ever have. She is the sweetest and funniest professor i have ever had. She made freshman year fun. Please understand her tests are tricky BUT!! If you actually study hard it will be SO easy. I will say I got a C on my first exam but I talked to her and she gave me study tips and i did sooo good on the upcoming exams!!!!!

Osterhage always had the most entertaining lectures, and I always felt that lecture contributed to my learning of the course content. She is very nice and has a good sense of humor. She will try to explain concepts in many different ways if she sees that students are not getting it. I am so glad I had her for this class.

I don't like biology, but I got an A in this class. She teaches the info in ways that are accessible to everyone at every level. She's sincerely the kindest prof I've ever had. Up to 3% extra credit for each exam. Exams are TOUGH; not similar to the study guides. Just watch the lecture videos and review the homework questions. Understand CONCEPTS.

I took Dr. Osterhages summer bio 148 class and it has been my favorite class to take. She is a great instructor. There are several opportunities for extra credit on exams, bonus homework, and just participating in class and the TCE. You'll have stuff due every day but they are easy points to raise your grade. The final exam was the easiest exam.

She embodies what science educators are SUPPOSED to be. Often times they know their stuff, but can't teach well at all and come off as aloof/stern. This is not the case w/ her. She's kind, energetic, and her focus is you learning the material in the easiest, least stressful ways. She makes biology accessible. One of my favorites; highly recommend!

Dr. O keeps her lectures very interesting with her great sense of humor. She gives you the notes ahead of time so you just have to fill in the blanks in class, and her notes are much easier to understand than other BIO 148 teachers. The homework and clickers get curved to 100 if above 90, and the exams are manageable. Highly recommend Dr. O!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I love her. Great professor, honestly cares about students' success and having them genuinely learn the content. Great prof

Osterhage is a great professor. She gives very clear lectures with plenty of practice problems and examples. The exams are common hour, but are very straightforward. The course handbook is very helpful, and the homework assignments relate to exams.

Dr. O is the best teacher/professor I have ever had. She truly cares about every single one of her students and wants them to succeed. She creates lots of supplementary materials to help you study. Her lectures make difficult topics seem so simple and she is always available to help students outside of class. If you are taking BIO 148, TAKE DR. O!!

Dr. O is nice and easy to meet with outside of class but meeting with her didn't help me. She is very vague in class and the notes she has you take don't make sense to anyone but her. The Bio 148 exams in general are extremely hard and do not ask fair questions. You have to know of EVERYTHING for the exam.

Dr.O is the nicest human ever and cares about each and every one of her students!! I missed one homework assignment and she immediately messaged me to make sure I was okay and then gave me an alternate assignment to make up for the points. She loves bio and puts her heart and soul into making sure you do too.
LOVE. HER. She is very passionate about what she teaches and will answer any and all questions you may have. As long as you actually go to class and study, an A should be very attainable.

I liked DrO, but the amount of homework she gave us was crazy. It didn't help me learn. It was just a distraction and took time away from being able to study. Don't take the online class unless you have lots and lots and lots and lots of extra time to waste on her homework assignments.
Good teacher, but DO NOT take ONLINE OVER THE SUMMER. more stressful than a whole semester of five classes.
Best biology teacher! Very outgoing, easy to pay attention. Make sure to take her practice tests

Dr. O is an amazing professor, BIO148 is tough for an introductory biology class but she makes note taking simple and goes over important concepts multiple times. Before and after each exam there are small opportunities for extra credit. She makes great videos for studying outside of class and is very relatable and easy to understand.

I had Dr. O my first semester at UK, and she set the bar extremely high for other professors here. Her lecture notes are designed so that you can fill them in during class, and she takes the time to make sure the material is clear and understood. I 100% recommend taking any class she teaches.
One of the best teachers I have ever had. I loved biology with her! She made it very easy to understand and honestly cares about student success. I 10/10 recommend to anyone taking BIO 148

I thoroughly loved this class because of how easy she makes it! Definitely goes above and beyond to ensure her students have enough material to REALLY learn the content rather than memorize. If you don't pass its because you didn't put in the time for most because just going to class and doing the work helps a ton and she puts a lot of stuff online
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: AMAZING professor and person. She replies to all emails, answers all questions, and makes bio so easy to learn. Her course pack saved my life and she is my new favorite professor. Yes, if you actually go to class and do the homework you will easily get a B or A. Tons of extra credit, and you can earn extra credit points after every test
Great professor! Not a super easy course, but her teaching is great and her assignments and clicker questions help you a ton for the exam.
Best professor I've ever had at UK, she makes biology so easy. She has a course pack with all the notes that you just follow along with and tons of online resources. I now love bio because of her
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Osterhage is a very accommodating, caring, and professional lecturer. I had her for BIO425 - Epigenetics and the Environment (Spring 2017) and it was a great introductory seminar class. The first presentation (15 minutes) is based on a paper of her choosing, whilst the second presentation is based on your interests (in epigenetics).

By far the best professor I have had. Go to her office hours she will help you tremendously if you start struggling in her class. Participation/ Class Attendance is huge on your overall final grade. Exams are tough but if you but if you put in a lot of hours and practice they are manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Don't let her cheerful personality and chill classroom environment fool you. After doing countless practice problems and over 100 questions in practice exams you may feel prepared for the exams, but you NEVER will be because the exams are worded 1000X more difficult than what you've encountered in class or studying.

She is amazing! Probably the best college professor I've had. She is so enthusiastic and clearly explains the subjects so you understand. Her course pack will be your life. Go to class and pay attention. Study the learning objectives and you will do great on test.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: She is really amazing. I always like to attend her lecture even if the course materials are not really difficult!!! We all love the way she teach. Always teach that course with 100% passion. As long as you listen to her lecture, take notes and do the homework, you will get a good grade!

She really means it when she says "not to miss lectures." She is very interactive while she lectures which always make it fun to attend. The exams also go along a lot with what she lectures and because of that definitely recommend getting her course note packet.
Dr. O is a very good professor. Go to class and listen to lectures and you will have no problem doing well on tests.

Dr. O is the very best of the best. I've had so many professors that are dull and don't care but not Dr O. She is so good. Go to class get the free points. Go see her in office hours, she's great. Definitely recommend taking this class.
Genetics with her was so good and she even put up supplemental echos for things we didn't understand. Best biology teacher in my opinion!

Take Dr. Osterhage even if you're an Australian Literature Studies major. She's a great professor and explains intro bio very well. The material is very easy, and she will help you if you ask. She even gave me advice on my Biology and Chemistry double major. I can't emphasize it enough. Take her for 148!

Dr. Osterhage has been my favorite professor thus far. She brings positive energy to the classroom and a smile every day and is more than welcoming to students asking questions or even just chatting during office hours. As long as you pay attention, review notes, and ask questions you should get a good grade.
Really nice and good professor. I definitely recommend her. It's a hard class though and she does clicker questions for points
Overall an educational and useful course.

Dr. O was a great professor.  She was really helpful and genuinely cares for her students.  Make sure to buy the course packet from Johnny Print; all of the assignments, notes, are in there.  She even has reviews for exams outside of class, has study tips and recommendations and peaks your interest for the subject.  Had her at 9 am and I enjoyed it

She's a wonderful professor. She had packets to help you take notes and follow the lectures. She also posts the lectures online so you can rewatch it. Don't miss class or you'll lose easy points. It's a tough class but she made it as easy as she could.

She is definitely one of the best teachers I've had thus far! Extremely organized and accounts for many different teaching styles. The class will be hard no matter what. Even the other teachers use her website and material. Don't forget how much the MasteringBio is worth! Take advantage of it. I forgot and was borderline AB. I got an A in the end.

Dr. Osterhage is THE BEST BIO 148 teacher. She makes lectures interactive and interesting. I thoroughly enjoyed her class and the material. Make sure to buy the notes packet from Johnny Print across from the Business College. For exams, study your clicker and practice questions, as well as your notes packet. Textbook is helpful. This class is hard.

Dr. O has been one of the best professors I've had thus far. Some of the material she teaches can be rather difficult, but she seems to have making it easy to understand down to a science. You only needed an 84 average on the exams to have an A, which made the class very doable. I would most definitely recommend her to anyone taking BIO 148.
Great professor. Hilarious and fair; beware, you have to watch a ton of echo recordings if you classes are suspended (shout out to Winter Storm 2015)

Took her for Genetics. Lectures are extremely helpful; she goes over every exam question. Exams can be very difficult- you must do old exams to study for them. Overall, a tough class with a good professor.

Just took her for Genetics. Lectures are fun, lab is easy. VERY difficult and tricky exams! The hardest exams I've ever taken. She's a great professor and helps in any way that she can to help you pass. Spend most of your time working the practice questions and old exams! It's all problem solving! If you don't learn quickly, it can be overwhelming!
I had a terrible time understanding the material and was lost. I felt she was unapproachable. She took a girl's test once because the girl said "Happy Valentines Day" to another classmate.

Dr. O is probably the best professor I've ever had. The class requires a ton of work, but if you put in the effort and go to class you really can pull off an A. Missing class puts you really behind. Super enthusiastic about the material and made me love biology even more! One of the best 148 professors for sure. Take her if you can!

She is a wonderful and cheerful person. The pace of lecture is very slow due to multiple clicker questions in every lecture, and we end up covering less material and have to make up by watching echo recording. She records all here lectures but that should not be discouraging people from attending lecture, because you get to participate in lecture.

She's a rude teacher. She acts impatiently with most questions and students in class and has a tone of constant anxiety. She's decent, nothing special. Class is easy though, but it will be the same easiness whichever professor you take.

Prof. O is an amazing lecturer. She clearly defines what are important topics, has lots of in class activities to help with difficult topics, and if you email her with any questions she emails back ridiculously quickly. She always has a joke to liven up 9ams, and her course website is beyond helpful with study material and links to other resources.

Dr. Osterhage was an excellent lecturer. She presented the material clearly and effectively, often using interesting activities to enhance the learning process. Her homework assignments were easy and very relevant to the material. Grading was very fair.

You have to make sure to do the homework, key terms, actually read the assigned chapters, and go to class. If you do that, then you're guaranteed at least a B. She's a little quirky, but always willing to help. She's a great teacher, and explains everything very clearly. She gives you everything you need to get an A. It is a demanding class though.

Dr. O is an amazing addition to the Biology Department at UK. As a biology major, I have to say Dr. O is by far the best in the department. She's extremely helpful, and will do everything in her power to help you succeed. Homework and assignments inout class will keep you busy. Tests are complicated, you must STUDY for them. All in all, AWESOME.
