She is the best Biology professor that UK has in my opinion. By far the better Genetics professor. She is friendly and wants you to understand. The tests are very difficult and the subject is difficult but take her if possible.

Dr. O is one of the best teachers I've had so far. She is very easy to understand, and the tests aren't too difficult. Do well on the first two tests, and you're basically destined to get an A. She is very helpful if you decide to consult her during office hours. She also has a nerdy sense of humor, which I absolutely loved.

Lectures are posted on online recordings, along with the interactive presentation. Homework is online & can be easily googled. CLICKER Q'S COUNT ATTENDANCE! Clear Syllabus. Funny teacher who genuinely loves the subject. Tests are hard because they are written by the Department and not the professor. Holds review sessions. Posts practice material!

Osterhage is by far the best Bio teacher at UK. She makes the information clear, uses humor, and does hands on examples that gets the class involved. However, the test are tricky and memorization will get you nowhere, so your best bet to learn in depth is taking Dr. O

Awesome professor. Just study her power points and you're all set. The home works are very important for understanding. Attendance is also important for taking notes on her power points. Should be an easy A. I received a B because I wasted time studying the book on the first 2 exams instead of focusing on the power points. DO NOT buy the book.

She is a good teacher. The BEST bio teacher that UK has. However she was kinda mean in the beginning and I didnt want to approach her. That changed with time. Also she seems very busy, shes always "sick" when we have our Sunday review sessions. Either way the class is interesting and I learned alot. Dont buy the book. Lots of online homeworks.

Honestly one of the best teachers I have ever had. Lectures are interesting and detailed, and she provides all of her notes at the beginning of the semester. Tests are relatively easy if you attend class and review using the practice tests she provides.

Dr. Osterhage is an amazing professor.  I was worried because as an incoming freshman BIO 148 was going to be my hardest class; however, she is the best BIO 148 teacher there is.  Her lectures covered everything and involved many different ways of learning including hands on activities and note taking (with her) so you don't get behind.  LOVE DR. O

#1- it's a common hour class so I think she has little control of material #2 she uses Mastering, which is a great site  #3 of the Bio 148 teachers,  I think she's the better choice even though she is kinda demeaning,  and not what I would call friendly. She knows her stuff which is what matters

Not confident as a teacher, obviously new,  disrespectful to students who ask questions, vague and rude in office hours. If you have recent bio classes from high school  you should be fine,  otherwise I would try to take  the class from another professor

I had Dr. O for BIO 148 and thought she was the best professor in the world. After having her for BIO 304, I can say that I definitely do not feel the same. When questions are raised in class, she makes the student feel like it was a stupid question and refuses to explain further. Very unclear about what's included on exams.
She was amazing and a very good teacher! I loved it!

Dr. Osterhage is literally the best teacher in any subject I have ever had. Daily lecture notes are taken in a course packet she designed, which contains study strategies and practice questions for every unit. She is hilarious, super knowledgeable about her subject, and skilled at communicating ideas in coherent ways that emphasize important stuff.
Makes biology lecture easy to stay involved in and attentive to. Very funny, likes to use visuals A LOT!!! Interest in her specialty carries over to her class. Wish she could teach all of my classes

Dr. O is THE BEST general BIO professor at UK. She is super helpful, she cares that the students do well, and goes out of her way to explain things. Going to class is important because a lot of concepts are hard to understand, she loves to draw pictures but they totally help! Would definitely take her again.

She's a great BIO 148 professor, but for 304 was close to awful. Demeaning and seemingly always frustrated with students, she does a decent job explaining topics but often refuses to answer questions or go further in depth. I get that genetics is her area of specialty, but there is no call for her "holier than thou" attitude. Tests are horrible.
Great professor, explains things in a way that makes them fit into the big picture. Highly recommend!

Professor Osterhage is the best! I came into biology class thinking I was going to dread it, but I don't thanks to her. Professor Osterhage's enthusiasm makes learning biology fun! I have classes during her office hours, and she is always willing to meet with me at other times. Bio 148 is a hard class, but having Osterhage makes it much easier!

By far the best lecturer I have had, even though I'm a freshman. She keeps the class interested by sharing interesting facts and stories. The material goes fast and is detailed, so you will need to read and study to get an A. People who go to class get higher grades, which also proves her skills as a professor. Never fails to get me interested.

Very good lecturer and professor. She is very passionate about biology and it shows. Her tests are a little tricky but overall if you do put in the work you'll get an A. Also, very helpful if you go to office hours.

Dr. Osterhage is  hard to get into contact with if it's not by e-mail. She crumbles when students need an expansion on a topic in lecture and she goes too fast. If you can't grasp concepts on the 1st discussion, good luck. These tests don't match what's given in the study guides and there's never a curve. There are at least 5 assignments a week.

She seems like a nice person, but she goes far too fast in lectures and does not explain very well. Tests are impossible. They are now common hour and it's basically guaranteed that you will not pass. Curving does not exist. The majority of people got Ds on the first exam and the second most failed, then Cs, then Bs, then As

Dr O is a great teacher. I love her lectures. She likes to crack jokes and make the class fun. Her tests aren't the easiest, but look over the material and listen you'll do fine. Be prepared to get frustrated when doing the homework, however. Most of the homework problems are ridiculous and the animations are no help. Read the book or fail homework

Dr. Osterhage is a great professor. Makes the class interesting and easy for the most part. Go to lecture and be attentive because the exam is based on lecture materials and in-class activities. There is mostly 2 online hw every week which is pretty easy if you pay attention in class. Exam review sessions help,they are based on you asking question.

Great Teacher!! Attendance isn't MANDATORY highly encouraged. Exams come directly from in-class assignments, examples, online homework, and  practice questions. She gives you EVERYTHING you need to excel on her course website, but you need to use it.

She is a smart and interesting teacher! If you take this class make sure to do ALL of the assigned reading. The tests can be tricky so I would suggest paying attention to clicker questions and examples from lecture. She didn't curve a single test from my class. Homework is simple and there are sometimes in-class assignments. Best bio teacher at UK!
Great class! Much easier tests than the other 2 bio148 teachers at the time. However I felt that her content was less expansive and as a Bio major I wanted the most out of my introductory class.

Dr. Osterhage is very passionate about what she teaches, and it shows. She gets so excited when she is teaching, and it made me really interested in the material. She was difficult, but always available to help. Her tests include many of the homework questions, or ones like them, so it is important to be really familiar with the material.

Dr. O is a great prof, she's really funny and explains the material well. Her exams are difficult though. definitely study the clickers, mastering bio, in class work(!), and practice questions. I rarely read from the textbook b/c it goes way more in-depth than she does. Just buy the mastering code so you can read the online version.

She is an amazing teacher! I have learned soooo much HOWEVER, if you wish to get an A, use her course website. If you do the suggested readings and go to class you will excel. She is extremely helpful, use that to your advantage.

I LOVE DR. OSTERHAGE.  She is hilarious and makes class so fun, but she also teaches really well.  When she says only things we discuss in class will be on the exam, she means it. If you can, TAKE HER! She made a boring topic really interesting.  She's really nice too (and really pretty).

Osterhage co-taught my section with another professor, and she was BY FAR the better one.  Posts note shells online, takes her time teaching, and makes an effort to be entertaining in a boring subject.  I really like her.

This is meant to be a challenging course, and Dr. Osterhage makes it very interesting. I met with her several times in office hours and she was extremely helpful! You MUST study for the exams, but if you pay attention and make an effort, you'll be fine!

She goes to fast and does not explain things well. Her tests do not make sense and are not relevant to the material she teaches. She is the best biology teacher at UK, but still is not a great teacher. If you take her pay attention and read the book. Her questions on the test are out of the mastering biology, clicker questions, and study guide.
Best professor I've had in the biology department. You must go to class in order to do well!!

While she is pretty, the entire class is a bit of a snore. Biology is a dull subject and she tries her best to make it fun. The problem is, biology isn't fun. She's not too bad, but her homework policies aren't the best. If you're a bio student, she's the best for 148. If not, I suggest someone else.
Best teacher I've ever had at UK! She has a great personality and is overall a great person! I love this class :D!

You can tell she loves what she teaches! Read the book and go to lecture. She will help you if you go to office hours and she will find a student to help you if she can't. I wish more professors were as avid about their teachings as she is!
Really enjoyed this professor. Made the class interesting and the coure material easier to understand.
You cannot get an A in the class if you don't attend lecture.
She is an excellent new professor. She teaches well with a lot of enthusiasm and makes the content relative. Fun class

She is a good teacher. She explains things very well and is very willing to help. Attendance is not mandatory but she takes it into consideration using a clicker. At the end of the semester, if you within 1 % of the next letter grade, she'll round up depending on your attendance. Sometimes she gets off subject, but she'll adjust the exam for that
Great professor! Very energetic and keeps you engaged in class. Helps you during her office hours if you need it, she is very approachable. Also, she is very very cute.
Absolutely the best professor I've had at UK. If I would have done better on the second exam I could have easily passed the class with an A.

Ms. Osterhage is one of the best teachers at UK. She is more than willing to go out of her way to help you understand. She wants everyone to understand and everyone to pass. Her energy in the classroom makes classes very interesting and makes you want to learn!

I had Weisrock my first semester, I liked him, but I got a D in the class (He gave me a GENEROUS curve of about 15%).  Biology is my major and I was frustrated because I did so poorly.  Jennifer Osterhage changed that.  She is amazing.  She's very energetic and wants everyone to understand.  She has office hours and WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED. Get her!

Such an amazing professor, and she really wants students to succeed. The exams have extra credit. She gives you the option to go over your exams during office hours, so make sure you go. You will have homework and readings due every week. There is a lot of material, but it is manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Extremely tough, tests are very hard.

Second time having Dr. S. Wonderful professor, truly passionate about her career and really cares about her students. Lectures are amazing and are extremely helpful for exams. While attendance is not mandatory, I feel that attending lectures is very beneficial for doing well in this course.
Super sweet, content is difficult and its very lecture heavy but if you are interested in the class it will be a lot easier!

The professor is great at teaching. She makes anatomy fun and interesting. The class itself is very difficult, so you will be studying a bunch. However, the exams were mostly fair, if you study the professor's lecture notes well, you will get a good grade.

I really loved Dr. S, she made lectures interesting and is really helpful. Not going to lie the class is really difficult and requires lots of studying, but she makes it doable. She is definitely one of my favorite professors

She's very funny while lecturing but you will have to study for hours for the tests because it's hard material. The homework isn't bad its good review before a lecture. She did the oompa loompa dance once in class to explain a concept. She does silly fun things like that often.
Amazing at explaining things during lecture and makes jokes and relations to keep students entertained and focused. Very test heavy, will require studying but she would never set you up for failure.

Dr. S is an amazing professor, probably the best I've had. The course itself and the material are difficult and require copious studying. The exams are of moderate difficulty and there are many homework assignments created as a buffer for your grade. The lectures are always engaging and informative. Utilize SI leaders study sessions for extra help.
LOVE Dr. S. My fav professor by far. The class is hard and you have to study but she is a very good person and explains things well.

Excellent lectures. Lots of exams but gives plenty of homework throughout the course to help buffer your grade. Attendance is not mandatory but if you miss lectures it can be difficult to catch up/pay attention. I think her lectures are well worth attending. Lots of memorization for exams, but her lectures allow for easy understanding.

Dr Salmeron is genuinely one of the best educators I have ever had the pleasure of having. She is hilarious, and is constantly joking. The course is very heavy and you will have to study nearly everyday but her guided notes always help your understanding. However, she is very hard to reach personally outside of lecture.
Good teacher, likable. Lots of exams and homework. This class was honestly just hard to get into the flow of things but once you do it's easier.

Expect a great lecturer who is very funny and provides plenty of insight to her subject. Annotated slides and focus questions are provided for you, so you will know pretty much exactly what to study. With that being said, you will HAVE to study a good amount, this A is an earned one, not a given one. It's not an impossible class, but it is hard.

This class is pretty difficult as there is a lot of content for a short course. STUDY a lot. Exams are pretty much every other week. She is a great teacher and her lectures are great. There is a lot of homework but it brings your grade up a ton. The textbook is pretty helpful but it is included in the course and online. She offers extra credit too.
She is so sweet and respectable, you can tell she really cares about you

I honestly think that if you just study and put some effort into studying, you will do just fine. I have heard people find the pacing to be fast paced, but this was not my personal experience. I may be bias because anatomy is so intresting to me, but this class was really not that bad. Love the professor! Very passionate about teaching!

I honestly believe that if someone is struggling in this class, they're just not studying. It is very easy to make a good grade if you actually put some effort into the material (the tests are easy). As for the professor, she is very caring for her students, makes lectures fun, and does everything in her power to make sure you succeed. Don't Cheat!

Professor Sal is an amazing professor; I couldn't recommend enough. I found that the people who hated her class the most were people who didn't show up to the lecture or do the homework. As a pre-nursing major, she always includes clinically based scenarios for each unit that help make sense of the content. She also drops test questions in class!

Professor Sal was an amazing professor. As a pre-nursing student, she really makes sure her anatomy lectures include applied clinical scenarios. I find that the people who hate her class the most are the people who don't show up to lecture and get behind on work. She is so intelligent and explains the material so well. HIGHLY recommend her class!!!
hard lectures, tests, doesn't explain things great.
She is amazing and really cares about her students. The lectures are hard but she really wants you to succeed.
She is great

Easily one of the best professors I have had. She genuinely wants her students to succeed and she cares very much about each student. She is so funny and gives real world examples to try and help you understand the topic better. Highly recommend Dr. Sal.

She will make you laugh so hard even at an 8:00 class.  She always gives real word examples and breaks down content into simple concepts for us.  She genuinely wants you to ask questions and to reach out if you need help.  The way that she teaches is so memorable and has helped me to understand very complex concepts quite easily.

Absolutely amazing professor I would take her for every class if I could. She is so funny and keeps the class engaged. The class itself is a bit difficult but she and the other professors are VERY straightforward on what you need to know for the exam and they provide extra credit opportunities.

Dr. Sal is easily one of the best professors I have ever had. She teaches such a hard class but somehow makes it so understandable to her students. You can tell she actually cares about you passing from the first day of classes. She is also very funny and makes all of her lectures entertaining when the content may not be your favorite.

best professor for such a hard class!! this was the one class i was super stressed about but for as hard as it was she did the best. she could and gave extra credit opportunities. just do all the work outside of class and you will be fine
Dr. Sal is the best!! So sweet, energetic, personable, and knowledgeable. You have to put in a good amount of work outside of class but it is all worth it and you will learn so much!

Dr. Salmeron is an amazing professor! The class is lecture HEAVY, so showing up to class is very important. She gives extra credit opportunities and has assignments that goes along with the unit, so it helps boost your grade. There are also SI sessions that are super helpful, so if you have the chance to go, GO!!!

reviews.comment: Dr. Salmeron's class is lecture-heavy but engaging. The exams can be challenging, but the study guides and extra credit opportunities help boost your grade. unstuckstudy was a lifesaver for my test prep.

Dr. Sal is by far the BEST professor I have had thus far. She genuinely cares for her students, wanting the best for them. She makes class fun even during not so fun material! Class is hard if you don't put the work in, tons of memorization, but if you go to class, take notes, and study, obtaining an A is easy work.

Professor Salmeron is such an amazing professor! She cares about her students and especially if they're going through a tough time. She knows that Anatomy is hard but gives study guide after study guide along with plenty of SI sessions. I would absolutely take her class all over again!
Mrs. S was my favorite teacher of the year!
I will never take her again.
Terrible class

Dr. Salmeron is the best professor ever! She makes class super enjoyable and she is so funny. Tests can be hard depending on the content, but she does provide study guides which help a lot. There are a ton of extra credit opportunities to boost your grade. The class is very lecture heavy but they are recorded if you ever feel lost or get behind.

Extra Credit Opportunities available for every unit in ANA 109 and 110. It is a lecture heavy class and if you're behind in lecture then you WILL be lost. Lectures are recorded and posted so if you miss class you're able to rewatch. Study guides are made for every exam and are very very helpful, an answer key is also posted 2 days before the exam.

AWESOME AWESOME PROFESSOR!!! If you have a choice for an anatomy professor, TAKE DR. SAL! The class is difficult whether or not you have a great professor, but Dr. Sal will make the class so much easier. Her analogies made the class so much easier to understand. I cried during the last class knowing I wouldn't have her again. She is awesome!

Dr. Salmeron is absolutely my favorite college professor I've ever had!!!!! She is so caring for her student's and is always there for you if you need anything. The class is lecture heavy so make sure you go to class so you don't fall behind. She gives tons of opportunities to get your grade up with giving extra credit every unit.

i have had dr. sal for the entire year & she is easily one of the best in the game. she is super knowledgeable, wants all her students to succeed, gives extra credit, is quick to answer emails, etc. DO NOT GET THE WORKBOOK, though, that is my only pet peeve of the class, did not open it
AMAZING

She doesn't care about her 209 class like she does with her 109 classes. I took her for both and she didn't give extra credit for 209 nor let them retake the test. When her class average dropped in my class she got really mad and blamed us. The exams were like a foreign language and didn't make any sense. My classes average on exams were 30%.

Dr. Salmeron is an amazing professor. She truly cares about her students and wants to see everyone succeed. She is super funny and energetic, even at 8am. Her class is not easy, but if you put in the work you will do fine. Definitely would recommend her to anyone!
LOVE LOVE LOVE her :)))))

DR. SAL IS AWESOME!! she makes lecture interesting & truly cares about her students. you do not need to get the mcgraw hill workbook, lectures are videotaped, many opportunities for extra credit, etc. definitely make sure to study the study guides because they are just like the exams

Dr Salmeron is my queen and she makes an extremely hard class really fun. We did have 6 exams in total (including the final) which was kind of a lot. She also gives a decent amount of homework but it never takes long to complete. This class will kick your ass frequently but she does give a good amount of extra credit.
best teacher ever. I love her. made the 8am easy to go to
The class was just So So, and If there was a chance to take other professors in the options of an Anatomy or Chemistry, I would probably not select Kathleen Salmeron or Allison Soult.
Easy but terrible class

Less pressure than the chemistry 103 course and feeling easier than that class, some extra credit opportunities to maintain or boost up the grade. But this course isn't that easy to get an A. I tried both 109 and 110 class to get an A for both semester, but I got the same grade for both semester. Not bad but it was hard for me to get an A. Goodluck

Less amount of homework, many opportunities which is a tik-tok or non tik-tok extra credit in this course to boost up a grade little percentage and some great TA's. But this class is still not easy to get a A even though you get the extra credit becuase of the exam. Exam takes the large percentage of this class. Except exam, this course is the best

Dr. Sal is AMAZING! She is the best professor I have ever had and is so funny! She is super accommodating and really cares about her students! I would recommend her class to anyone! It is a lot of work but so is nursing! She explains things in way anyone can understand and is just 11/10!

Was actually better than CHE 103 because this course has some extra credit opportunities and it doesn't have tons of assignment in ANA 110, so the overall experience in this class was great but still it is hard to reach to get an A.
This professor is amazing. She gives great lectures and answers every question to the best of her ability. She really cares about her students and wants everyone to succeed.
Average.
Kathleen was amazing her lectures were super fun to sit through she is funny but gets the teaching done and effectively.

Just satisfied Just Okay with my last semester midterm and final Anatomy grade. Also, Dr. S is just fine. Just Okay not 100% perfect but you know, she is totally fine :) This class is actually better than the chemistry 103. Take this class with her. Highly recommended. Dr. Sal is an amazing teacher. She makes it a lot of fun to come to lectures every day and is relatable, understanding, and downright funny. There are usually one or two curves on each test and if you have her, you are in for a great semester.

I Personally think Dr.Salmeron is really better than any other professors that I've met in Univeristy of Kentucky. Dr.S is the best. She won't let students to be fail in this class. Even though the exam is sort of difficult, she gives lots of opportunities to maintain the grade which is amazing.

110 course is more difficult than ANA 109.

Well, Well, Well. You can actually TRY to get an A, but one thing you'll have to know is that it's NOT AN EASY COURSE!!!!!!

Really have to study and review every day after class is done and it's a lot important for both ANA 109 & ANA 110. But this class isn't that easy. College Anatomy is way much harder and challenging than the high school anatomy material you learn. This is just an entry course but both ANA 109 and ANA 110 they are so hard. Study almost over 10 hours every day. I'm literally so tired and sleepy. I want some 7 hours sleep. LOL

Dr.S is just an average professor. Not too bad but she is in the middle line.
Wow....wasn't easy. I'm not sure if only 1 professor teaches Anatomy at University of Kentucky.

Passed this course so it's lucky for me somehow but just not satisfied with the grade. I think many people are taking ANA 109, ANA 110 but 209 and 210 is very very harder. But the truth is not 109 & 110 are also difficult to achieve the grade.

I don't think Dr.Salmeron is the BEST professor teaching Anatomy in University of KY, Lectures are too fast every time, tests are a lot, too heavy and very tough. 209 is much more difficult than 109,110
This class is the first and also the last class.

If you are not reviewing and study, then you'll fail.
If you are not studying before you go to UK, then you'll probably be too late to get a satisfied grade in pre-nursing.

My recommendation is study Anatomy and Physiology and also biology and chemistry right NOW if you got accepted into UK College of Nursing. You'll first start pre-nursing bc it is not an direct program. Study earlier for anatomy, chemistry, biology before you go to start pre-nursing.
Having total 6 exams including final in 1 semester is likely to say tired. Almost stayed late until 4 am putting my ANA 109 everytime before exam comes at Willy T library.
I can't give full rate of 5 for ANA 210. 99% are great but tiny tiny little 1% isn't good enough. Lack of 1%. Covering 1% will be a full 5.0 quality in this class.

Yes....... I actually agree with the previous reviews. 4 credit is such a big amount of credit that can impact the GPA in transcript. Even if it is 1 credit or 3 credit like nursing 101, uk 101, art, biology 103 and CIS 110,111... it doesn't impact much but 4 credits like chemistry 103, anatomy 109 & 110 those subjects are very very stressful!

Not an easy class. Not all the students will be dropped this course or che 103 and also changing their major but the reason "WHY" many people changing their major is proabably because of the much more "difficulty" of the course including ANA 109, ANA 110 and plus CHE 103. I took this class cause she doesn't give exams, only 3 quizzes. The class itself is interesting and can help prepare you for the real world but I don't like how she ran the class. The projects were confusing, she expects you to read her mind and do it perfectly, a lot of confusion and inconsistent grading. I wont be taking another of her courses.

Dr. S is passionate about teaching and desires for her students to do well in her courses.  She is funny, approachable and knowledgeable.  The final project is a risk communication management plan - it  was challenging but very rewarding in the end.

He was extremely understanding. As long as you take notes and pay attention, the tests and weekly quizzes are really easy. He tries to help students in any way he can, so just email him. He literally gave us the option to choose our exams, whether they were short-response-heavy or multiple-choice-heavy. Overall, a great professor.
Peter is super nice and the class was pretty easy.

The only complaint I have about this class was that I was never quite sure what would be on the test. I don't think he was either to be honest. He's really understanding and down to earth, though and he welcomes different perspectives in discussion.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Mr. Lynch is my favorite professor he made everything easy to follow. He is very fair at grading and if the class average is not above an 80 he would give a curve to make the average 80. I recommend him fully you can tell he is passionate about what he does.

He's a chill professor in my opinion. You have quizzes every Friday and they are easy to do if you do the reading. He posts all his lecture notes and the class is very interactive. He didn't really assign assignments and the ones he did assign weren't difficult to do. He will help you if you have any questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mr. Lynch was one of my favorite professors at UK. Lectures are very organized and easy to follow. His test are a bit difficult but he usually gives a curve if necessary. As long as you communicate with him he doesn't mind giving extensions if needed. Great teacher 10/10

Super smart and knows his stuff, and his passion for the content does not go unnoticed! He is incredibly understanding and wanted to ensure everyone was digesting the content and was readily available if we needed any help!
Loved his course. SO helpful and flexible.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I really loved the organization of Dr. Lynch's class. He has great powerpoints, and the quizzes and papers and everything were very standard and helpful. That said, his exams had a lot of very specific questions (such as asking about a study that we covered for two minutes in one class) for being closed note. Otherwise, solid class, decent prof.

Professor Lynch has been one of my favorite professors Ive taken a class with at UK so far. His class difficulty was average, but if you take notes from his lectures you will do just fine on the exams. He is more than willing to help all of his students with exam reviews, papers, questions students have, etc.

Professor Lynch was great! Took the class over the winter semester and it was super easy, all the tests and quizzes were made up of the lecture materials he provided (and some from the book which he sent us a link for). He is super flexible and helpful with students.

Lynch was one of the best professors I've ever had. You could tell that he cared about the material, and he also cared that we learned it well too. Offered alternate ways to grade exams specifically to help people who get test anxiety. It was always very clear what material would be on the exam. Takes 1/2 of exam questions right from textbook.

Definitely take Peter if you have the chance. You will easily pass the class if you just write down all the bold points from the lectures. The tests are multiple-choice questions made up of notes, textbook questions (you can get them from a friend or online), and attendance quizzes that are easy. There is a core project that is easy as well.

If you go to class and take good notes it is a very easy class. I would suggest going to all of the exam reviews even though it is not required he gives you some questions and topics that will definitely show up on each exam. He provides and online textbook so you do not need to purchase anything for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Does not care about his students. It's not a hard class, but he is just not nice. Avoid taking his course, save yourself the headache.

He makes his rules really clear at the beginning of the semester and sticks to them, but otherwise he is a caring and kind professor who wants you to succeed. He rounded my final grade up without me having to ask because I attended class regularly and participated. If you respect him he will respect you.

Dude's been through a lot so I'll give him some slack, but he comes into class everyday in the worst possible mood and then reads off of slides for the entirety of the class. He doesn't give out any exam review material as well.

Not only is his class ONLY BASED ON LECTURING, but he also doesn't explain anything. He uses statkey for everything but doesn't explain it well and then when we do the homework (there's 4 a week) the answers are all wrong. Attendance and homework are about the only thing that'll save you in this class. He also laughs at people and is so rude.

My problem with Koebcke, isn't necessarily the class, it is his attitude and demeanor towards his students. He may be the rudest professor I have ever met. And I'm not saying that because he doesn't give extra credit or study guides, but, Nathan Koebcke is just all around a human with a LARGE attitude. DO NOT TAKE ANY CLASS OF HIS EVEN ONLINE.

Avoid at all costs. The worst professor I've had by far. He is so full of himself for no reason. The grades are weighted weird so hard to tell what grade I'd get by the end of the semester. The actual content isn't terribly difficult he just makes it so hard to want to learn because of his attitude.
Helpful, good grader, strict.

I really do not understand all the backlash towards Professor Koebcke. Yeah his lectures were boring and he just reads off slides, but never once was he disrespectful towards a student in my class. I thought he was very kind. The exams were difficult, but you wont fail the class if you do average on them. Really focus on the group project.

Holy cow, this class was stupid. The professor just reads off the slides, which isn't bad, but when you ask questions, he doesn't elaborate and keeps pointing back to the slides. He is also very opinionated and will make sure you know his opinions on everything. Also, he doesn't provide any study material for exams, so that sucks.

Don't take this class! He doesn't actually teach the content but instead ramble on about how much he hates the previous class. He grades group projects harshly and expects them to be absolutely perfect which is difficult when he isn't the best communicator. When he does lecture he spends most of the time making 67 jokes.

Professor is rude, won't answer questions, and seems to have no respect for the students. The last time I felt this way in am academic setting is when my art teacher yelled at me for spilling the paint in second grade. You completely have to teach yourself the material if you want to understand it, the TA's are nonexistent, and grading is awful.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: ABSOLUTELY DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! This material could be so easily understandable if it wasn't presented as common sense to the students. The professor makes you feel absolutely stupid when you ask a simple question and is little to no help in general. To learn the material you must fully do everything in your own time and teach it to yourself.

Professor Koebcke is pretty chill in class. You definitely need the textbook because you can't do the homework without it. There are no exams, and all quizzes were online. At the end of the semester, there's a group project, but it isn't difficult. He does grade attendance, so it's important to actually show up.

This is the single worst professor I have ever taken in my life. Do not ask him questions, he will talk to you like you are 5. I would honestly rather not graduate then have to take his class again. DO NOT TAKE THIS GUY!!!!!!
Gave us one day to complete a group project that was a reseach paper which ended up being 10 pages long

He says that you can fail an exam and still pass but don't trust that. You're gonna need any help you can get with your grade because come the group project, individual project or even submission of your workbook assignments, you'll be marked off for the things you would think don't matter. No section number…3 points off. don't take this class!!!

While I do appreciate a professor that has high standards, being disrespectful to students does not fall in that category. The way students are treated in this class is unacceptable. Don't even bother asking a question because he will turn it right around to make you feel belittled for asking for help. It is extremely hard to learn in this class.

I should have listened to the posts on here when I registered for STA210 with Prof Koebcke. He is genuinely one of the worst professors I've had at UK. He seems almost like he is on a power trip, assigns a bunch of assignments every week, and grades them harshly. My group had issues with our group project, and he was so backhanded in his feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He just talks abt that slides and doesn't explain anything, so everything will have to be retaught by yourself. Rude asf and calls students or groups out for no reason. GET WITH A GOOD TABLE GROUP. it will make you hate the class less and for the project. Attendence is a big part of the grade which is the only reason I go to this class.

I questioned my life every time I stepped into the STA296 classroom with this professor. This was the most unenjoyable hour and 15 minutes on Tuesday/thursday of all time. Do not take this professor unless you want no comprehension of anything he is talking about on the board.
He really really really really really really really really sucks

He is by far the worst teacher I've had. I literally sprained my arm and couldn't write and he told me he couldn't give me an extension ON A HANDWRITTEN ASSIGNMENT. He is the epitome of evil in human form. Don't even try to take his class unless you want to feel like a failure especially from his sassy emails.
Very tough grader, gives 15+ assignments a week, and will have no sympathy for you if you miss one deadline.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Gives out so many assignments, teaches none of it. Class isn't bad but is so time consuming. If you have a busy major or lots of other duties this class will not be for you. Koebcke is a good guy, but this course isn't great.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Boy were people right about this class. The slides you go over in "lecture" are him reading the slides  not explaining them. The workbook assignments have nothing to do with the exam.  He has no sympathy for anyone so don't test it. Exams are easy if you are good at teaching yourself material. He makes digs at you for your phone existing.
If I had had to say one nice thing about him, he is very good at making a simple class insanely hard. Stats shouldn't be organic chemistry hard.

This professor is the worst professor ever, his work load is a LOT and the way he organizes his canvas is so weird like SO weird, and also about extensions forget about that. He took 5 points off because i wrote a paper on word document instead of handwriting it ….. so absurd to be honest.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I took STA 210 with Nathan because I had no choice, and I'm drowning in work as summer ends. The workload isn't sustainable for a short session, don't take stats with him in summer/winter. He's odd and constantly nags about last minute work. If you want it earlier, set earlier deadlines. I have a life outside class.

This professor has a bad attitude always. I had him for my summer online course and he would be upset when we'd submit assignments either the day before it's due or the day it's due and takes off points for it. While the course material is easy, he is unhelpful and just straight up a jerk.

I'm graduating this year and had this professor 3 years ago, and I still come back to leave reviews to help future students. The class really isn't that difficult but Nathan is just a terrible human being who projects his miserableness onto his students by being flat out rude and making jokes about someone at my table who was in the hospital.

Do not take Koebcke. He is strict, he constantly belittles students and questions disabilities when he has no right to. Acts likes he's better than everyone, but can not teach for anything. You must attend lectures to pass, except he micromanages what you do during class. If you get a bad group at the start of the semester, you'll fail the class.

Actually the worst experience ever. The worst attitude and is seriously so RUDE. He looks at our computers to watch what we are doing. You will have to teach yourself everything so get ready! If i could give it a -10/10 i would. It came to the point where I couldn't force myself to go to class because it was so mentally draining.

Had one of the worst attitudes I have ever seen from a lecturer. I call him a lecturer because he doesn't deserve to be called a professor. Made rude jokes and called them "sarcastic." Absolutely, truly, 100% does not care about his students and will find ways to mark off points on the group project. If you can take any other professor, do it.

Has the worst attitude/demeanor of any professor I've had at UK. He is straight up mean, but plays it off like he's just "sarcastic". Would regularly make fun of people in my group if we had questions. Not a good learning environment at all, he WILL make you hate stats. Was so rude to his TA, I felt bad for her the whole semester. Just unbearable.

This professor is terrible! He says that he is sarcastic but it's just an excuse to be rude and belittle the students. He will say things like "clearly someone isn't paying attention" and call out students. You will have to go to the Ombud to get him to make up a quiz you have a dr note for (like I had to). The classwork is easy though...just a lot

This is the rudest professor I have ever met. He does not care about his students. He claims to be sarcastic but is just rude. If you want to be belittled and learn nothing for 75 minutes twice a week he's the professor for you!! The course work is easy but it's about the same in every 210 class. Skip the headache and pick another professor.

I really hated this class, the professor knows what he's doing but is terrible at teaching it and likes to talk more about himself than the actual material. He will go around and look at your computer to make sure you're on the right thing but majority of the time you can't figure out what you're supposed to be doing. Haven't learned a thing.

He is downright disrespectful to all of his students, does not answer questions with a clear response, he will complain about everything you do, and loves to micromanage you. Do not take any of his classes.
He is actually a good guy despite these reviews, if you have him for in person class he is nice and makes jokes. Attendance is required, and there are a good amount of assignments but they're easy.

He was the meanest professor I've ever had. A girl in my group had a friend pass away and needed to take a day off of class to go to the visitation and was obviously emotionally distressed. When she emailed him he told her “he didn't know why she needed to miss class since the class was a couple hours before the visitation”. So insensitive and rude

He is not as bad as everyone says he is. You'll have homework pretty much every day but it is easy. I will say the final group project is worth a lot of your grade, it dropped me 8%. He is not rude, just has dry humor, not everyone likes that but he does not have bad intentions. Aside from the group project this course was so easy.

First 2 exams are really hard, the short answers have to be almost perfect to get full credit. There is a huge group project at the end worth a ton of your grade, which sucks for people who don't know anyone in their class. Professor is also insanely sarcastic which just comes off as mean, hes not nice to say the least.

Koebke spends the majority of class belittling students under the guise of sarcasm. He seems more interested in trying to assert dominance (that he clearly lacks in his daily life) than teaching the class. Lets the authority get to his head, and seems like he got bullied as a kid. Definitely choose the class you're weighing this against.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Nathan is a good lecturer. Despite the reviews, he did well teaching the content. All you have to be successful in this class is to attend all classes and put some effort in the homeworks. You will be guaranteed to pass if you do this. He holds a lot of office hours, so if you are struggling, go see him. He is willing to help.
Professor Koebcke's class is tough, but unstuck study and the free textbook can help you get through it. Attendance is a must, and the grading is strict, but engaging with the material pays off.

He's very knowledgeable, but his attitude toward the class makes it unbearable. He never stops complaining about anything (phones, being late, leaving early, talking, not participating, etc.). He calls himself "sarcastic" but he's really just rude. Has a "figure it out yourself" attitude but complains about lack of participation.
bro be doing to much. complains all the time. do not take him. needs an attitude check.
He consistently belittles students for the entire 50 minutes of lecture MWF.

He has gross hands and struggles with breathing, he has a TA who hates her life, he also would go on rants about school work and fall break like get a grip. It is 2 weeks past fall break yet he still brought it up…

While Professor Koebcke was definitely not the worst professor I have ever had, with a combination of vague email responses to questions and a seeming lack of care for his students, he definitely falls short of anything positive.
Do not take this course

This professor is by far the worst I have ever had. He enjoys making students angry and genuinely laughs when people ask for accommodations. Every second people are around him their attitude and joy to learn drops to the floor. I wish nothing more than for this professor to be fired.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He was unhelpful and did not respond in a kind matter. He was rude and did not give helpful feedback and made me think i was smart enough.
He's an ok professor, he just ass a stick up his butt fr fr. Very strict and unwilling to do simple things, but other than that pretty easy and ok.
he was ok he was a tough grader and the exams are hard and lots of homework

If I could go back to registration I would pick another teacher, Nathan is standoffish and not easy to talk to. He uses the excuse that he is sarcastic to be snarky and unhelpful. He is a harsh grader and an awful teacher, often nobody knows what's going on. If you ask him a question he won't answer it and make you feel stupid for asking.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: You have to show up to class to have a chance in this course. The group project has very unclear grading criteria and takes a month to grade. He is very rude when responding to emails. If you have any issues, his syllabus is not exactly what he wants you to follow. Good luck.

DO NOT take Mr. Koebcke. My least favorite professor I have ever had. Extremely rude and seems to be on a power trip. He doesn't teach course content, just talks about random crap during class. If you are taking his class get chegg!! The only reason I passed, nothing could be learned from him. Go to class though, it kills your grade if you don't.

DO NOT take classes from this professor. If any of the classes are required try to find another professor. Very rude and snarky. Asks for way too much participation in class instead of actually teaching the content that is already difficult.

Super boring classes, but do not skip. A lot of what he says during lectures are more important than what are on his slides. Definitely would not recommend it, but I cannot stress this enough, go to class. He has super dry humor which comes off as rude.

I took this class over winter break and I would not recommend it to anyone. There were lots of work of just textbook problems and teaching yourself the material. We had a paper at the end that had little to no instruction the only thing we were given we were videos and a rubric. He also was rude when leaving comments and replying to my email.

Horrible grader as everyone in his course is bound to have a lower grade as even if you get a 100 on your group project your grade goes down by at least 3 percent. Also takes forever to grade assignment making it difficult for you to know what you need to get on exams and homework assignments in order to do well in the class.

He never gave review sheets because they're "short cuts," and for the final, he didn't even tell us what was on the exam. He constantly has an attitude to every student, for no reason. He is very unfriendly and seems to hate his job. His lectures make no sense, and his teaching is confusing.

Professor Koebcke is the worst professor or teacher that I have ever had or heard of. He is extremely rude, his class revolves around him going through the slides that do not relate to the homework or the tests remotely. He feels extremely entitled and clearly does not want to see you succeed and went as far to say he doesn't want us to.
Do not take his class. Take She fang shi, she can explain better than he can.

It is obvious that Professor Koebcke knows statistics, but he has no idea how to teach. A typical day in his class looks like him pulling up his 30-60 page slides and just flying through them. He doesn't answer questions well and he provides 0 support before exams.

He speaks clearly with no accent, but he doesn't know how to teach any material.
He gave no further explanations that he mentioned in his lectures. He had a very dry sense of humor, which often came off as rude. Offered no test prep tips or extra assignments.
Truthfully sucks. Definitely do not reccomend, does not want his students to succeed. Offers no resources for exams, extremely hard grader for no reason at all as well.

Him and the TA walk around the entire class peering over your shoulder to make sure you're only doing statistics things. Feels like high school all over again. He flies through the lecture slides and the homework is only halfway relevant to what you learn. Get Ready to get a tutor if you want to take him, or find someone else

If I could give him a 0/5 I would. I have never hated a class as much as I hate this one. He only talks about himself and flies through the slides so fast that I don't even have time to write down anything on them. This class is genuinely so boring and miserable with his teaching. He is condescending and rude, I would take this class w anyone else.
straight up rude, took off points for stupid things such as missing a capital, does not teach and have not learned anything in class.

He gets a bad rep but as a professor Nathan is actually pretty nice and funny. I think that online made him seem rude and he does come across as that but he is very sarcastic and monotone. The class wasn't too bad it was just annoying honestly and he did a bad job of answering outside of class. Do the homework and study because the tests matter.
Tough personality to understand. Class was hard and he flew through the lectures.

You will succeed in this class if you study the unit's lecture (power points)/homework material. The homework is very difficult because there's often more complex problems than what you cover during lecture, however, he is AMAZING at responding to emails in a timely manner so reach out if you need help. KEEP your old exams to study for the final.

Koebecke is intimidating to approach to, and I never went to office hours. I took stats in high school so the class was easy for me, but the professor is horrible at teaching and is very hard for students that have no previous experience with stats. Koebecke only reads off of the powerpoint notes word for word for word. I do not recommend him.

I think he means well, but with that being said he is the most sarcastic, rude, and all around arrogant "lecturer" that I've had. Don't skip class because attendance is 10 points everyday, but the exams really aren't bad. The group project is terrible though. I had a high A in the class and the group project paper tanked my grade.
good luck lmao

Attendance is mandatory however if you miss a few times your grade will barely be affected. He purposefully puts exams and important lectures on days most professors cancel a class. We had an exam the Monday after family weekend and Halloween and had important lectures the Friday before fall break and Monday before Thanksgiving.

This professor is not a good teacher. I've learned nothing in this class. Do not take this professor, take another, and if you can't do that, delay taking the class for a semester. It is not worth the stress of taking this class.

Very strict on attendance. Will only excuse you if you have a doctors note.

Decent professor but flies through lectures to the point where you cannot retain the information. If you go to class and do the homework you should get a good grade but if you can I'd take another professor.
rude

He grades hard for no reason. He's somewhat fair though. The most annoying part is you do not learn anything in class, but attendence is mandatory especially before breaks for no reason. Nothing is covered in those classes before break. I did pretty well though. A lot of busy work.
Dudes just plain rude and responds so rudely in person and to emails. Doesn't have common human people skills.
He's a loser fr

Imagine being told you are more than welcome to ask for help but then when you ask for help the TA has no idea what you're talking about and then when you ask the Koebcke for help he gives you a sarcastic open ended response that makes you even more confused even though you are asking for help and can't find any information online
terrible professor. Spends more time judging students than teaching. basically have to teach yourself throughout the entire course.

Belittles you with passive aggressive comments. Quite literally the worst professor that I have had. If you can take another section, DO IT! His class is boring and he will hate on you the whole time!

Belittling and disrespectful. Treats his class as a middle school classroom yet desperately attempts to receive respect that I have never seen reciprocated. Avoid unless you enjoy people being passive-aggressive towards you.

Genuinely the worst. I have had professors that I thought were bad from Midway, Morehead, and JCTC. This class makes me want to drop out of school and the content isn't even bad. Take STA296 but NOT with this guy. I have always been a good student and always have good relationships with teachers and professors, except for this one. Rude, petty.

Honestly the worst teacher I have ever had, and that says a lot, and I am sure there are many people who agree. He is incredibly rude to students and requires unnecessary documentation, and personal details(illegal) for excused absences. Very condescending and honestly just sucks at teaching this course. Group paper will screw you over.

This man is NOTTTT IT! He grades them final assignments like they're gonna be shown in a museum or sum. His daily work and chapter quizzes weren't too bad but he is no help. If you miss an assignment, OH WHALE. READ THE SYLLABUS!!!! He takes off points for the pettiest reasons. I wouldn't take this class again, no no no.

AVOID AVOID AVOID AVOID!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! I can't emphasize this enough AVOID THIS MAN AND HIS CLASS LIKE THE PLAGUE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! He is terrible, doesn't respect students, is VERY rude, and has a weird sense of entitlement. His class has a final project and with that comes checkpoints. He will give you bad grades on purpose.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: His attitude toward his students is WOW. He purposely gives you bad grades for your projects and nitpicks at your assignments!

Spends the majority of his lectures lecturing students about masks and doing their homework in class. He is very passive-aggressive and rude to students for no reason. He will grades very ambiguously on the group project and you most likely will not score above an 80. I had a high A all semester and the group project brought me down to nearly a C.

His lectures are very dry and he grades really hard. My grade dropped 8% because of a group project paper that he meticulously grades. He does this with anything you do. I didn't like asking him questions because many times I would ask him one and he would respond in a condescending way, responding as if asking him a question was a waste of time

Professor K really isn't too bad. As long as you go to class and do the homework there's really no reason not to pass the class. He does have a weird darker sense of humor but just take everything he says with a grain of salt. I don't think he intends to be rude sometimes but it does come off that way.

By far the worst statistics professor in the department. Provides very little help and/or clarification on grades received for both the individual and group project. Reads off of textbook powerpoint for an hour and then assigns homework that takes an hour and a half on average. I seriously recommend avoiding his class at all costs.
awful couldn't pay me to take again

Imagine you're talking to someone who has told you a blatant lie to make themselves look really good as a person. If you question the lie they add lies on top and make you feel like an idiot for not believing them even though you know every word out of their mouth has no real merit. Now add homework and sarcasm...

That's what taking Prof K is like
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: First day of class seems great. Next thing you know you're on your 5th week in a row of him reading powerpoints word for word and talking about vaguely relative stuff. Extremely condescending and rude... got mad at me for grabbing a free mask and announced to the class that I was unprepared... you teach an entry stats class get off your high horse
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: SO BAD

DO NOT TAKE HIM! He does not teach class at all, you are expected to teach yourself everything. Also, he lied about the first exam. Before the exam, he explained that it was all multiple choice, after opening the exam, it was all short answer.

This guy is awful. He acts like he is so much better than everybody and consistently calls people out in a 100 person lecture. Avoid him at all costs probably the worst teacher I have ever taken in my 19 years of living. Awful teacher

Aside from his expert knowledge in STA 296, I would avoid taking this professor entirely. He is rude, insensitive, and treats his students much like a highschool teacher, constantly calling out students for "not paying attention" in a 100 person lecture hall. I have never been so degraded by another adult, especially one barely older than myself.

Quite possibly the worst teacher I have ever had. I say teacher because he is not a professor and that part is very clear. He uses a dry sense of sarcasm that belittles students and makes them feel stupid for asking questions. He blames everything that goes wrong on the students. I have taken 2 stats classes before this and did well, AVOID KOEBCKE

Doesn’t really teach, expects you to teach yourself. Spends most of lecture time making us do group assignments that have to do with what we were supposed to learn on our own. If I could give him a 0 I definitely would. Also doesn’t give correct info about what’s on exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: If I could give him a 0, I would. He is THE WORST at explaining things and very cut and dry. He will also be rude if you ask anything and make you feel like its an inconvenience to respond to you. DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS, DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS... DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS.

If you have to take stats I recommend avoiding Koebcke at all costs. He can be very passive aggressive and rude at times. I don't think he's very good at explaining the material at all. Most of my group mates and other people I've talked to in the class also had no idea what was going on. If I could give a zero rating I would.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: He is the WORST. Most dry, boring lecturer ever. All he does is read off the slides and make snide comments to students. Oh, and attendance is mandatory. For the 2 projects, he grades so harshly and not based on the rubric. And if you try to bring it up to him, he gives no leeway or help or explanation. He doesn't want to see students succeed.

There is an individual and group project, which Koebcke grades overly difficult. makes material seem harder than it is ; more focused on everyone looking at him and wearing a mask than actually understanding. If you study the homeworks, you'll get an A on the exam, though. Don't listen to him -- stats isn't difficult, he's just condescending.

better if you have previous stats experience

He's a cool dude, but I'm not a fan of his teaching style.

Leaman is fantastic and he knows his stuff. The man is older than dirt but has been everywhere seen just about everything and loves to talk about it. He is very boring.  I like the subject but he puts me to sleep!  Bring a pillow!

important thing is to go to class...you can drift off, but you'll pick up some stuff that could help on the essay test..he wants you to form an argument and defend it, not that hard, right? be careful not to include any "rubbish"...good guy, great teacher, really funny
