There are 3 exams with 40 multiple choice questions each that are worth a total of 40% of your grade. Almost no homework but the TA grades them way too harshly.

She heavily pushes her liberal ideology in class and it can get quite excessive. There are only 5 assignments that are fairly easy but are graded harshly with no rubric to refer to. Three exams that make up the majority of your grade all of which include questions not included in the lecture, book, or study guide. I would not recommend taking her.

Dr. Lynn was the highlight of my day every time I had her class. I found the content relatively difficult but she wads always available and made time to talk to me, whether class related or just about life. She genuinely cares for all of her students.
I have taken every class Lynn offers and I can't recommend her enough. Great professor, an even better person and mentor.

This class was pretty easy. Attendance was not mandatory but she is very lecture heavy and if you show up you can pass the class. I would recommend going anyways. She is a great professor and her work isn't that difficult either. She recommends the book for class but it's not required by any means. Just a good class to take.

Dr. Phillips was very nice and funny but the class was pretty uninteresting. It was all lecture. The exams were kind of hard and it wasn't super clear what we were being tested on especially because they lectures were very information packed. It was a decent amount of reading but there was never much homework. Attendance wasn't necessary.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr.Phillips is such a sweet woman. I felt as if she cared for her students and made an effort to create relationships with us. However, her exams do not correlate with what she teaches in her lectures. I went to class, took notes, and studied yet still continued to fail the exams. Almost just guessing games.
Course material learned in class was not related to study guide or exams at all.

The class isn't mandatory, lot's of students don't go unless it's exam day. You don't miss much by not going to class as the exams have nothing to do with class notes but on the book. Make sure you get the book and make a study guide off of the book and not notes. She's not very understanding or willing to give help or talk to.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is extremely hard to study for. Assignments are very easy and don't take a lot of time. For exams you are told to study your notes, reading material, and even a study guide but none of this material is on the exam. The exams are ultimately guessing games.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very rude and snarky. Her lectures contain a lot of political statements even whenever not relative to the lecture. Ignores and never answers her emails even though she loves talking about her 36-hour response time as said on the syllabus. Does not care about her students at all or understand that life happens outside of academics.

Would not let me makeup an exam even though I had a University excuse for it.  The exams have nothing to do with the lecture or study guides she provides, its all from the textbook.  Theres barely any chance to earn points so you have to rely on the 3 exams and hope you do well.

Lynn is a terrible professor. She does not care about her students passing the class and she will do whatever it takes to punish her students instead of help them succeed. She is truly terrible. Think twice before choosing her.

Lynn is an amazing lecturer. While attendance is not mandatory showing up to class is very important to do well on the exams being that the class is very exam heavy. You can tell that she cares about all of her students and genuinely wants them to do well. She also makes her lectures very engaging. I wish all of my classes could be taught by Lynn.
Dr. Lynn is an amazing and caring person, but the Class is not easy.
The grading criteria is a joke and the class is so lecture/test heavy. Very little points are earned in assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Phillips is very sweet. She often talks about being a mom, and that is often apparent in the way she asks students questions about their lives and how they're doing. The textbook is helpful to have because many of the quiz/test questions pull from it. There isn't much for this class and you learn about several different environmental topics.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Phillips is a kind, she really does care about her students. The only issue with her class is how a lot of her lectures do not correlate with certain test questions, and her study guide isn't always entirely accurate. No attendance is taken, and you can survive without the textbook. Not a hard class, you just need to pay attention and go.

Dr. Phillips is a good professor. Unfortunately, her lectures are peppered with political opinions. She is very respectable and certainly knows her subject. Sit up front, pay attention, and don't miss class (this is very important to be a good student from her perspective). Do not expect an easy A.

Dr. Phillips is such a nice person and very caring! However, her course was very difficult and hard to understand. I struggled to get an A, and it was my only UK core class. If you meet with her after tests, she will more than likely give you a lot of points back. Overall, great lady, but not that great of a teacher.

Lynn can sweet but I hated her class. She project her liberal word vomit on students. She made a huge email at the end of the semester threatening to prosecute students for asking her to bump their final percentage. Honestly, not a class people should take if theyre looking for something easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Class is unorganized and class content is not typically on exams.  Class is very easy, but the grading system for homework is seemingly random.

Do Not Take This Teacher! Her lectures and power points do not match tests. Very unorganized. Instead of teaching, emphasizes classes on her political views. Average test score for all exams was 64%. Terrible!

Doesn't teach at all. Lectures do NOT relate to the exam. Average exam scores for all her tests 64%. You can see this on canvas but she will lie about the actual class average. Spreads her liberal views all semester long. Masks always required. DO NOT TAKE. First C I have ever gotten in my life and it was an elective. Worst teacher I've ever had.

All exams are based on things she says in lectures so if you come to class, you'll do well. She's a super understanding teacher & if you make an effort you'll easily pass. The textbook isn't necessary & theres only one assignment per week. She's a super sweet lady who wants to see kids put the effort in to succeed.

Lynn is a sweet person. Her classes are very lecture heavy and the tests weigh heavy on your grade. She is extremely liberal and projects her views on her students. She incorporates her political views in her lectures. Overall, her class was pretty easy but you have to study for her exams.

She says attendance is necessary, but if you do the readings you'll get by fine. not much homework at all besides one easy assignment every week. Maybe one or two quizzes in the semester, all online, exams are very easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lynn is an absolute queen. Get to know her well, and the class is so much better! She may be strict on policy, but she is someone I feel like I could be friends with on the low. Her lectures never fail to keep me engaged. Great course, great professor.

Personally not my favorite style of teaching or lecturing. There was a lot to cover in not a lot of time and seemed very rushed and many things were skipped. The tests aren't super hard but there always seemed to be things on it that I never remember covering in lectures. Lynn was a sweetheart as a person, but I did not like her teaching style.

DON'T TAKE HER CLASS. Lectures don't relate to the homework at all. She'll test you on things she MIGHT have mentioned once. No clarity on grading criteria either. THE LEAST UNACCOMMODATING TEACHER IVE EVER HAD. You can just tell she puts no effort into the class, and doesn't care about her students success.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Do. Not. Take. This. Class. She changed our 2nd exam from online to in-person two days before and changes it between aopen note and closed note exams. Her notes are extremely unorganized and her lectures do not make sense. She is such a caring person but should not be teaching this class. I am a 4.0 student and I got a B and struggled. Most dropped
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very nice and caring professor, but the lectures were literally pointless, most of the time she was off topic, discussing things that just were not on the tests. There we're 2 exams and a final all semester which wasn't terrible. I only went to a few lectures because every time I went she would not give enough time to write notes. Easy B though

She was one of the worst professors Ive had. Her lectures are completely off topic of her tests, and each test has a huge impact on the course. A benefit is theres only 1 hw assignment weekly but beyond that this class was awful for me
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is a very nice lady outside of class, but her class is very lecture heavy. The whole class is based off a powerpoint and she gives no time to write them down for notes. Each test is 20% of your final grade and she doesnt teach half the stuff thats on the tests. One upside is theres only 1 homework assignment a week.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Phillips is a very caring professor. However, her way of teaching is very poor. She will rush through her PowerPoint during lecture. Her notes have very little wordage and if there are notes to write down she won't even give you time to write them. The exams cover hardly anything discussed in class and you'll have to find everything in the book

She is so unorganized and very cluttered. Her powerpoints are never in order and uses maybe 1/4 of the 100 slides she puts online. She spends less than one minute on a slide so you can't get the information down and then covers 5 chapters expecting you to know literally everything she says in lecture plus stuff from the book on one exam horrible.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Phillips was amazing! You can tell she really just wants her students to know more about the world and what is happening outside of our own bubble. She made class interesting always, and the topics for weekly assignments were as well! However, the TA did not grade the weekly assignments fairly and rarely gave feedback.

Professor Phillips was great but my oh my was the TA unfair at grading. The first 6 weeks were fine but then she just started grading papers with no feedback and they were not the best grades. Honestly a little heated that I never even received feedback for some of these grades. If there is a new TA I would 100% take this class again.

Lynn is extremely caring but an awful teacher. She is very lecture heavy, that is the only way she teaches. Attendance is not taken but if you don't come to class you can't get the notes. In this course, there were three exams, each 20% of your grade. If you aren't good with tests, don't take this class. The only positive is there is minimal hw.

This class was not too difficult, I however was not interested in the topic but the professor made it better. She is very kind and understanding but does not let late assignment slide. Her exams are noticeably more difficult that the class work but if you are looking for an easy B, I recommend this class.

This profesor was very nice but a horrible teacher. Her lectures had nothing to do with our exams whatsoever and that was what our grade was based off. There was never study guides and we were never told what to exactly study for. On top of that, her notes were all over the place and they had nothing to do with the exams as well.

I really felt enjoyed this course. I highly recommend listening to her lectures, they are extremely informative. Her TA did grade pretty unfairly, however I never got a grade below a C. If you put in a standard amount of effort, you will finish with an A or B. Make sure to turn in assignments on time and you will be set!

Good teacher. Leans to the left when lecturing but still has interesting lectures nonetheless. Tests are open book and pretty easy if you attend the lectures. Homework was a breeze and took about 30 minutes to an hour each week. Easy A only problem is dealing with the TA who is very opinionated when grading.

worst teacher ive ever taken. extremely rude and does not care about a students mental health, and is not accommodating despite being in a pandemic. her class sucks and is un interesting. the exams arent bad because its open book, but the ta is quite rude too. worst 100 level class ive taken.

Lynn has been one of the best professors Ive had at UK. She had been very caring and understanding during this weird online semester. Lectures can be interesting when she talks about her experiences. Weekly papers but they arent super hard and dont take long. Standard 3 exams. Youll be fine on exams/quizzes if you listen in class

I really enjoyed taking this professor. Lectures are not mandatory but are highly recommended. Although her lectures could sometimes stray off topic she covers everything that is on the test. She is a really nice professor and cares about her students sucess.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class was 5 times harder than it had to be because of how harsh the grading of the weekly assignments is with no grading criteria. She doesn't do any of the grading and the TA is always behind and doesn't leave comments. The tests were easy, but she treats the class is much more important than just a core class, which its not.

she doesnt grade anything, the rude TA does, then doesnt give feedback. Also returns grades back super late. Weekly assignments, seems easy, but have to read 5 articles and watch a movie for 100 words. Worst 100 level class I've taken.

She is a good professor but I would not take her again unless I had to. We did not have many assignments, so you need to do well on everything. Her slideshows were annoying because you never know what is important and they are super long. She posts slides though so attendance is not necessary.

Lynn is the most caring and passionate teacher I have ever had. She cares so much about her students and cares that we can use this information to be better citizens. She wants us to learn and succeed both as students and people. I wanted to please her. She was so passionate about her subject and made all of her students excited too.
Really cool teacher who cares about the students she teaches. Not too much asked of you in the class but she made it enjoyable!

I took this class for a UK core and it has been the easiest class I've ever taken. Phillips is the nicest, most caring person, and she was very accommodating when I had mono. This class is an easy A if you read the textbook; it's all memorization.
Exams are very difficult but balanced with other work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Im rating this professor with all honesty. She IS AWESOME! Reading all the previous reviews, I was hecka nervous for myself because you guys scared me. What the heck, first day in class and shes awesome! Maybe the reviewers dont care to learn about the environment/policy. The class Im in hasnt been taught in a couple years.

Easily one of the worst professors I've had. She wastes class time with off-topic conversations and then expects you to teach yourself the complete history and geography of the world. Read the textbook closely because test questions are super random details from the book. Study for tests weeks in advance because its a lot of memorization.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: As a person, Lynn is fabulous. She sincerely cares about her students. However, this class is difficult. She goes too fast during lecture and often rambles. The exams have content on them that aren't covered on the study guide. I took this just for a uk core credit and it dropped my gpa significantly. Don't take this class unless you HAVE to.

Its hard to explain Lynn. I LOVE her. I usually hate class set up like hers but man shes such an amazing teacher. If you give her a chance to open up, shes fantastic. I suck at school and I got a B. It wasn't easy but Lynn made it worth it. I think shes a cool AF. Get the textbook and read it. You'll be fine. Shes chill if you're real with her.

Do not take this class unless you are good at geography. All the assignments are online and there are only 5 total . They are hard and graded even harder. 3 exams and if you dont read, you wont pass. If you dont show up to lectures you will not understand the material. Class attendance is not mandatory whatsoever, however it will help a great deal
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She was nice but the class was not well organized and you kind of get set up to not do well.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: As a person she is wonderful, but as a professor she is a NO GO. Her lectures are ridiculously long and completely irrelevant to anything on her tests. She gives "study guides" that are just random topics with no knowledge of what she wants you to know. She even sent us quizlets that answered her study guide questions but NONE of that was on test.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: She's a great person, but her lectures are irrelevant to what is tested on. Also the things that are tested on are generally concepts that aren't generally accepted/ not googleable, so i'm not really confident i've learned real geography rather than hearing opinions and stories/ seeing pictures from a world traveler. Tests are ridiculously hard

This professor is very kind in class, but is an extremely hard grader and her lectures and notes are totally unrelated to the tests. When she does give study guides they are also very unhelpful in studying for the exam. I would not recommend taking her at all.

My favorite professor of my first year hands down. interesting coursework and topics so you won't care about the work (there's a decent amount). Overall she's really kind, just show up to class and do work and its an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Best Professor I have ever had and this is my 3rd year in school. Lynn is always willing to help you and is very negotiable. The tests have a lot of material from the lecture and the book. Although attendance is not mandatory, coming to class will help on the exams. Do your work and come to class, stop by her office a few times and youre good.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Lynn is one of the best teachers I've had at UK thus far. She is incredibly nice, personable, compassionate, understanding, liberal, open-minded, and a true individual. I am not a fan necessarily of geography but she made the class possible for me to do well in. She is always willing to help if you ask. You really have to come to class/get book!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lynn is a great professor. Very active in the class and the community. I have taken two classes Geo406 and intro to urban planning. The field study class was a blast and very hands on and interactive. Urban planning is interesting but the night class makes it hard to stay awake at times. Her classes are not that hard if you read.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She is an awesome professor. Not sure why she has such a low rating. She gives you study guides for the exams and the exams are exactly what's on the study guides.

No attendance is taken at class, but she knows who comes and who doesn't. Very liberal and close-minded, if a student says something that counter-points what she says, she will belittle that person. A nice lady outside the classroom, but as a professor she is lazy and does nothing to make it easier on her students.

Lectures are long and pointless. She talks about things that aren't even on the test and her powerpoints are always random and confusing. You HAVE to read the book. Online homework and quizzes are easy but the tests are impossible. I'm a straight A person but I'll be content with a C in this class.

She uses powerpoint that have a lot of useless information. You never know what will be on the test. She is a really hard grader when it comes to essays. Come to class or else she'll call you out when you finally come. IF you're taking this as a core, take something else.
Tests are tough and you will have to work for it. Lectures are long and boring and usually don't even make sense. Definitely buy the book and use online resources. She will help you if you ask.

You definitely need to study and work hard for your grade. She's a VERY nice person and will work with you! Going to her office hours helps so much. She gives one big paper but it's pretty open and isn't too bad. Her tests are very tough though. Her expectations for the class are not very clear but every point counts.

Lynn is a really friendly teacher and an easy A, but she has the longest lectures and they are so boring. I watched Netflix with the sound off every class I went to of hers... Find something productive to do. She assigns a lot of projects for this class and hardly gives you time to do them. Also, she hates if you are late to her class.
tests and quizzes are impossible. she does nothing to help you prepare for them either.

Lynn is by far my favorite professor I've had at UK. Took her for GEO which was a requirement. Didn't think I would like the class but she made me LOVE it. I would definitely recommend her! Tests weren't too hard. Recitation was required but if you get a good TA, it'll be fun and interesting.
HARD TESTS , NICE TEACHER AND REALLY HELPFUL , TAKE THIS PROF IF YOU HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY , SHE IS GOING TO HELP YOU AND IF YOU WORK A LITTLE YOU ARE GOING TO HAVE A B OR AN A

Although she was helpful if you visited her office hours, she made the class way harder than it needed to be- especially since its a 100 level elective. The lectures were boring and the tests were very difficult- even after studying and reading the chapters. Wouldnt recommend this class to anyone.

She's an awesome person; very entertaining and nice, but her tests are way too hard. I always took notes and even read a lot of the chapters, but still couldn't get an A (and I usually get As). Take this class with a different professor for sure.

I loved her as a professor, very personable, but the class was way harder than it should be. Don't take it expecting it to be an easy elective. I went to every class, read every chapter, and met with my TA a couple of time and still ended up with a B. However, her lectures are normally pretty interesting.
This is a hard class for a 100 level. She is pretty annoying honestly. The online quizes are impossible and there is a ton of reading

She is so sweet! She ALWAYS walks into class with a smile on her face and sometimes gives out candy. I did not always go to lecture because they aren't mandatory, but the recitations are. The only reason I got an A in the class even though I didn't go all the time was because I read every chapter that we covered. Interesting class too!
Never went to class. Did not buy the book. Got an A. Although the class averages on her exams were not very high.

This professor is a total sweet heart. If your a student who tires real hard and goes to her office hours she'll help you out. Although I found her test to be extremely hard. But her class is very interesting even for people who really don't have an interest in geography. For the test you have to read the text book to get above a D on her test.

I liked this class, but the way that it was taught I thought that i could just study on my own and not go to class, But i found myself not studying at all. It is very interesting, i would recommend this class, but only if you plan on going to class.

One of the least enjoyable classes I have ever taken. The tests are easy if you skim the notes and read the book, but her lectures are almost unbearable. She is incredibly biased and tries to force her opinions on you--But her facts are often incorrect. Don't trust her!

Her lectures are poorly planned and she never gets through her notes-which aren't written well anyway. Her tests have nothing to do with her notes or even with her review sheets, which contain three times as many topics as are on the test and still leave out important points. I got an A b/c I knew the material going in, not b/c I learned from her.

I've been to every lecture and find it very hard to take notes. She teaches off of a word document and scrolls down the page feeding you a lot of statistics throughout class. She teaches until the very last minute and sometimes beyond because she tends to get off topic. The chapters are fairly long but reading them is a must. Overall not enjoyable

Dr. Phillips is very nice and can be VERY helpful if you seek her out during office hours. Tests are all from reading the textbook but you can learn a lot of what you're supposed to know by going to lecture and taking notes. Don't be a baby about maps, learn them. She notices when you don't show up to lecture. This course can be very interesting.

Mrs. Philips is a terrible teacher. She is not qualified to lecture about the topics presented in GEO 160 and constantly gets fundamental things wrong. As a major in my senior year who took this class as an elective, I can she should not be teaching. Take what she says with a grain of salt. Also, you have to learn what is on the test yourself.

I've taken Lynn for both 160 and 235, and it's obvious that those who recently reviewed her either didn't go to class, read the book, or both. This is college, you have to make the effort in order to do well. Her exams are really not bad at all if you study. Reading is a must, as most of the exams come from the book. Her classes truly aren't hard.

The class is incredibly boring and the material presented is far from acceptable. The test are extremely detail oriented and do not reflect what is taught in class. Found that the only real way to study for the test are to basically read/study the book. Lynn's study guides are a joke and will not help you on the test.

This was a class that I was told would be an easy A and a good way to get my cross cultural course out of the way. It turned out, her tests were extremely difficult and focused on little details rather than the major points focused on in class and on the study guide. I do not know why she has decided that a 100 level course should be this tedious.

I'm not sure who all rated this class as easy, or Lynn for that matter as a good professor. Lynn is awful, she doesn't teach half the material that's on the test. The test are hard as crap, they have nothing to do with her lectures! YOU HAVE TO READ THE BOOK! Nate Millington was an awesome T.A , but seriously... the professor has got to go!!!!

Her tests are near impossible. I went to every class prior to first test, read the text book, completed the entire study guide and took notes and read over the notes online yet still managed to only get a 72, all of my friends did the same thing and got low 70s. If you're going to expect us to listen to something you say Lynn, test us over it.

Class requires tremendous reading out of book and test are extremely hard.  The first one is easy but the second one and on has 50 questions plus a map of the country you are currently studying.  You will need to know the country, capital, and 2nd largest city.

Very nice person and helpful with things outside of class if you are truly interested in how local government works.  However, she is not a very easy teacher.  She grades writing very hard and has almost incomprehensible notes she gives you.  She also expects you to read more than grad students.

She is a very nice lady and really knows and is interested in what she is teaching, but makes her tests very difficult.  They are definitely not 100 level class tests.  You MUST read and understand all of the chapters and be prepared for very hard, confusing questions.

The class material can become boring at times but Lynn does the best to keep it interesting. She is fun and not too strict. Her exams can be a little bit difficult but she posts all the notes and information on blackboard. If you study a little bit, this class is an easy A

Middle of the road class. Ms. Phillips is a good and engaging teacher, it's just the material is boring as can be. Tests are not too hard, but not easy by any means. Studying is defiantly required. I would suggest Ms. Phillips as a teacher, but GEO 160 you should pass on if at all possible.

Lynn is a character, that's for sure. She's very friendly and funny. I love going to her class, however she has a really hard time staying on topic. Also, her knowledge on the environment wasn't very solid. All you really have to do is read the notes she posts online, skim the book, and do the online quizzes.
Hated this class. She never stays on topic, and rarely lectures what is going to be on the exam.

Not awful, not great. She told us that we didn't need to read the text for the first exam, then about 10% of the questions were from the text. The tests aren't killer, but they aren't cake either. The quizzes are at-home but they take a lot of time and are somewhat challenging. The class is pretty interesting and Lynn is very friendly. Class is ok.
I loved this class, she is a strict teacher but you get used to it. I learned so much in this class, and she makes it interesting!

i got an A in this class, but read my entire text book. If u are not willing to do this, do not take this class- or you will fail. If u are willing, read about 10 pages a day and take notes. The night before the test review the notes and u will do just fine!
fun and conversational, strays off topic but covers pretty much everything that will be on the tests, I found them easy without much study. Just go to class and pay attention and you will do fine.
Good class...gets off TOPIC!..a lot of test material is not covered in class so it makes it hard to study! Homework and Writing Assignments are really helpful for studying!

Teaches nothing about what the test is on, but in turn makes the tests easy.  She tells you what to study specifically, so putting an hour into it the night before  leaves you with an easy B.  We had cookies in class every day and just hung out.  Gave us all kinds of grade boosters so tests wouldn't screw us and boosted my B to an A.  Real cool.

This class was really frustrating because she never stayed on topic during lectures, but the exams were over what we were supposed to have learned.  It's really difficult to teach yourself things about the non-western world and she didn't do a very good job of teaching them in class.  Overall, this class was just frustrating.

i was really excited to take this class with her because i had always heard wonderful things about her... but i was disappointed. i hated this class ! she talked about random stuff in class and then when exam time came around you had to learn the real material.
She rocks....
teaches about 20% of the test, the rest is up to you from the book. in class activities are trivial.
She's a great teacher!  The information was not very interesting, but she teaches it so you can actually understand it.  If you can memorize maps easily, this class is for you!
Loved her
good class. solid teacher. lynn is who you want for geo 160
Amazing
She is extremely helpful in office hours. She definitely clears everything up if you visit her before a test.

Grading for writing prompts are completely random and unfair I received an 80 instead of a 100 becuase she said i was missing ONE date. hardly any of the material reviewed in class is on the test. She thinks she's soo cool but she's in reality she as well as her notes are very dated. Students correct her often. Avoid at all costs.
I didn't like Phillips due to her lack of respect for our president and CONSTANT ridicule of him. Also she CONSTANTLY pushes students to donate money to third world countries....

She tries to be cool rather than teach. The material was interesting but her biased views on some topics turned me away. The tests are hard. If you don't go to class make sure you know everything in the book.

what a cookie monster. loves Free Tibet. Lynn tries to be cool by blasting music and dancing around to it before class.  study the BOOK!  most of your exam questions will be on it.  hardly anything from class is on the test besides ?s from the movies. know your map.  that means all the countries and capitals.  which suchs learning all of Africa
i asked for help becuase i didnt understand and she responded with "its not rocket science"..arent you supposed to ask question if you are lost?
Phillps is tight, she keeps it interesting. Lots of notes so take a laptop but lecture is still fairly entertaining. Gives lots of grades to boost your exam scores. take this class!

I would say that she is a sweet and helpful person, but her classes are ridiculous in what they cover and actually only represent about 10% of what is actually on the exam.  I thought that I would have an easy A, and I am struggling to get a B because she makes her test so comprehensive when her classes are random and about starving kids in Africa.

The worst professor I've ever seen in my entire life and his native language is English. I genuinely can't comprehend how someone can understand a topic so much and be so god awful at teaching it. This class gave the person who made the comment below this one Type 1 diabetes. This is not a good class.

Hardest class at the university! Definitely don't take unless you want to devote 4 hours a night and still get a C. I am an A student in who values hard work but come on!

He was great! sometimes had quirky things to say, and he alwasy tried to get the class into it.
he is my favorite Geo teacher part of the reason I changed my major. Just come to class, do everything he says and you will be successful.  The material isn't hard and he makes it interesting!

good teacher

He's your average comp sci professor. He walks you through code which is helpful, but if you don't pay attention (which is really easy to do in his class) you probably won't be able to do much of the homework without using outside sources (they don't help at all). Just pay attention and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Moore does all assignments for you in class, including most of the final project. You have two actual homework assignments that you do on your own but if you go to open lab they will help you. Prof. Moore is really passionate about what he does and seems to actually enjoy teaching. 9/10 would recommend.

Prof. Moore does almost every assignment for you in class. You have about ~3 actual assignments you do on your own but open lab is always there and 2/3 were very easy. Homework is easy too. Prof is extremely passionate about what he does and seems to really like teaching. 9/10 would recommend.

Professor Moore does the entire assignment for you in class. There are weekly zybook assignments but they are very easy and repetitive. Exams can be tricky but as long as you do good on the 2 midterms you can skip the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: So nice and knowledgable. Definitely one of the better 102 profs. He demonstrates everything you need during lectures. Homework is like 3/4 the classwork so pay attention in class and everything will be easy. Weekly zybooks but they're easy.

One of the best 102 professors out of all of them. He explains and demonstrates all of the assignments in class and as long as you pay attention and follow along, you can get the homework done while there. He was always reachable outside of class for homework and textbook help. The worst part about the class was the online interactive textbook.

It might be the content of the class but his lectures seem to drag on about things that are very simple and common sense but then when it's time to demonstrate or show an example, class is almost over and he has to rush through the actual important interesting parts. Either way it's an easy A. If you don't get an A in this class - switch majors.

Dr. Moore was awesome.  He explained things in class super clearly, and a ton of the assignments in this class is the classwork.  If you pay attention in class, and follow along, nearly 2/3 of your "homework" can be completed in lecture.  The first half of the year uses online textbook, zyBooks, which admittedly is super ass, but it's part of 102.

From his lectures, you can tell Professor Moore is passionate and loves what he is teaching. He goes in depth about the topics and helps us out by guiding us through each assignment. The homework and exams don't really correlate to the lectures or assignments.
He do not help you if you need his help, be aware of that.

Dr. Moore is very knowledgeable and extremely helpful with the in-class projects. However, he's quite fast-paced so it's important to pay attention. It's also important that you understand the online textbook chapters if you haven't been exposed to coding in the past; open lab hours are also beneficial.
Literally just show up and pay attention. Easy dubs.

Dr. Moore is a good professor. Although he is not as engaging as some of the other faculty, he knows the content, and is friendly and helpful if you need him to be. Furthermore, he gives frequent examples/demonstrations, (most of which are similar to the exams/projects/quizzes) which means that the content is easy to learn.

He walks you through most of the homework assignments in class. So, by the end of each class, you're either completely done with the homework or close to it. If you have a question he will answer very nicely and help you with any misunderstandings. He is very easy to talk to. I absolutely loved this professor.
Very good at explaining things and made very good guide videos online. Went in knowing nothing about MATLAB or Arduinos but his lectures helped immensely in understanding them.
good professor , hard class. A lot of assignments
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I just dont like the usage of matlab and zybook. Matlab is as complicated as C language and it is useless. Zybook is like long exercises and its too expensive.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Moore was very clear in his instruction and made sure to tell us when there was something important that we needed to add to our code. He was very approachable and explained things as clearly as he could. Overall, much of the class is independent work; however, he has frequent help sessions available if needed, so don't be afraid to reach out.
I loved Moore. He is one of the most helpful professors I've had and is so thorough in teaching the content. He always is prepared to answer any and all questions.

Dr. Moore is the best professor Ive had. He makes class enjoyable, hes very articulate and so helpful. He replies to emails really well and is very accommodating. You can tell he loves what he does. He drops the lowest exam score (including the final!!) Take him!!

Dr. Moore is one of the most helpful and resourceful professors I've had in my life. I had him in my first semester of college in my EGR 102 class and even though it is a very hard class, he is very knowledgeable in his discipline. He is resoruceful, helpful, caring, and very reachable (even outside of class). Highly recommended!

Neil Moore is a great professor and is extremely helpful. EGR102 was the one class my first year in college that I was super excited to attend, and Niel Moore was a part of that. It is a bit challenging, but for the most part, as long as you do the work and pay attention, you will pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Moore is very educated in his field and will spend any amount of time giving his knowledge to a caring and ambitious student. Always willing to help out even during lecture. Excellent professor for transitioning freshmen.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The class wasn't always easy, but he always offered help in either office hours or by email. If you have a question he will most likely help you or guide you into the right direction. Just overall a good and helpful teacher :)
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Moore is probably the greatest professor I've encountered at UK. His lectures are incredibly detailed, he posts notes, he waits after class to answer questions, and is extremely considerate of students' time. He is always very helpful over email and won't hesitate to extend deadlines or curve grades if he feels people are struggling.

Dr. Moore truly cares about students. This is evident through his actions. He doesn't treat students like soldiers. If a student requests an extension because they have a lot going on, he'll give one to the whole class. This is because he actually cares about what students learn more than facilitating some backwards Darwinian battleground.

The material in systems was difficult but Dr. Moore made it somewhat easier to understand. He is very knowledgable about the subject and presents it well. Very responsive to emails and will always give a detailed and comprehensive response. He is super down to earth and will sometimes even curve exams. Not sure why his rating here is so low...
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Moore is a nice person who can respond to you with great advice and feedback. His EGR 102 class was easy and fun. He is super smart with computer science. Although, he does talk a lot and says some repetitive/useless stuff, making lectures somewhat boring.

He is really good at explaining complicated things in more simple terms which helped me a lot because most of the content was new for me. He was also super helpful if you had a question. One of the best and most helpful professors I have had. He can also be resonable on late grades and complicated assignments. I learned a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I really liked Dr. Moore. He is a really nice professor and is ready to help if you are struggling. Do not hesitate to ask him questions if you dont understand.

Dr. Moore is very well qualified for his job and willing to help. However, when lecture starts he begins talking and doesnt stop until he is done with the material he wants to cover. It is very easy to get behind if you dont stay on top of work in and out of class.

He knows whats going on in the engineering world. He is very good at what he does and is very willing to help. However, he likes to give busy work and will always have something for you to do no matter how irrelevant it is to the class. Its all pretty easy tho and he gives great explanations if you are lost on an assignment.

One of my favorite UK professors hands down. Lectures are actually interesting and is very knowledgeable and caring as a CS professor. Most homework is completed online and shown in class for credit, so most students leave early. Very willing to answer any questions/help you out. Moderately hard, but fun class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Moore's lectures are clear, but could be more concise. He will readily help students with their code and is available during office hours. His exam review was helpful. He is not the most engaging professor, but he is helpful and teaches the material pretty well.
Easy A

Loved Dr. Moore. He is a very understanding and caring professor. If you show the effort in his class, he will meet you halfway in terms of office hours, grading, and extensions. He is very reasonable and is also a great teacher and always ready to help outside of class. 10/10 recommend, he made the material very manageable for me

Prof. Moore is a great lecturer, but the lectures weren't key to passing this class. There was a lot of in-class group work that you could do without the lecture, but had to wait a long time if you needed help. There is also hw that has nothing to do with the rest of the class but is worth a lot. He gives good reviews for finals

This is part of the brand-new UKY engineering program, so the class wasn't totally up to him. His main flaw is that he fails to get most of the class's attention, everyone is on their phones while he talks. He does care, does know what he's talking about, and will help you if you ask. Easy. He's trying to get hired.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Starting this year (fall 2016) UKY started a brand new engineering program. Since this is the first year with this program there have been a few bumps, however professor Moore has always been very considerate and helpful. Very hands-on during 102 lectures. You will have groups that change every week in 102, so be sure to get along with class mates.

Don't know why his rating here is so low. Had him as a lab instructor in CS115 and he was fine. In CS485G, the material was hard but he presents it as best one can. Cool guy, curves heavily and is super helpful; email him with a problem in your code and you'll get a comprehensive response almost immediately. One of the better profs in the CS dept.
Solid professor. Explains things pretty clearly (for the most part) and answers questions pretty well. The lectures do run pretty long though

The lecture is really boring but that is largely due to the class size, not Dr. Moore himself. If a question is raised in class, Moore will be sure to answer it and if you ever email him a question about your code, he answers very quickly with a thorough response. Don't expect the class to be easy but you will do well if you try.

This class was and always will be a extremely boring class that I would never recommend to anyone. Especially with this professor. Dr. Moore was very unhelpful and made me take a nap just about everyday during class. Don't take CS115 unless you have to and if you do have to then get another professor.

Lectures are very long and boring. Does not know how to effectively convey the material in an interesting way during lecture. However, during the labs he is very helpful and answers all questions - you can tell he wants his students to do well and understand the information.

Pretty nice guy overall.. lectures are long and confusing. never lets class out early even if it means covering unneeded topics. Paired with Debby Keen makes CS115 miserable. you can basically get no real help. if you take this class better be ready to do alot of learning on your own.
Had him for 215; I personally thought he did a great job.  Just don't expect the teacher to tell you how to design your program.  Its your code!

Dr. Moore knows the material but simply can't teach it. He is a nice guy and tries to be funny but fails. His lectures are incredibly boring and don't help at all. Only went because attendance was mandatory. You basically have to teach yourself the material. Hire a tutor at the beginning of the semester because that will be the only way you learn.

Probably the most boring class I will ever have to take. Dr. Moore knows the material well, but how he presents it by reading off of the slides is not helpful for inexperienced programming students. I wish UK would hire multiple professors to teach the same class.

He's a really nice guy, but his lectures are awful...straight from the book lecture slides! I only went because he takes attendance. And his jokes are not funny in the least. If you can't teach yourself or if you don't have a decent TA, you'll likely struggle!

While Professor Neil read slide by slide and made the lecture incredibly boring, he is a newly graduated professor who just got his PhD this past year. If you went to him after class or to his office hours, he took his time to help you. In lecture, it is hard to stay awake and pay attention.

He doesn't do the one thing he is paid to do, teach. He simply reads word for word from a slide show created by the authors of the textbook and attempts to make the corniest and most nonhumurous jokes the entire time. I wouldn't even go to his lecture if he didn't require it for an attendance grade.
Doesn't make the class interesting or fun. He's incredibly boring and the content is incredibly difficult for anyone not computer savy. Hope you end up with a good TA.

I love Dr. Osborn! She's very sweet and helpful. She loves the work she does. She grades very leniently and her projects are good for real world things which I really appreciate. If you have the chance to take her, do it!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Love Dr. Osborn! She's a great professor who understands the material and how to teach it, and who cares for her students. There was a single group project in my class and I had problems with my teammate, but as long as you communicate with her well before the due date, she'll take care of it. She'll answer any question you have about a project.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Osborn is a very nice person who is accessible throughout the semester. She is very supportive of her students and gives us freedom to research whatever is interesting to us. There is a lot of writing associated with this class, but it is a word class so nothing upsetting. Sometimes class meeting can feel repetitive and not engaging.

You will never meet another teacher like her. You can tell she cares about each of her students and enjoys her job. My previous WRD304 professor, before I switched, was incredibly rude and was not accessible with my disability accommodations. Dr. O has been there for me every step of the way, personally and academically. This class is paper-heavy.

I think WRD204 was a boring class but Dr. Osborn doesn't really get to choose what's assigned so I don't think it's fair to rate poorly based on the class she teaches.  I will say is she is super sweet
and isn't a tough grader by any means. I think around 1/4 classes didn't meet in person because of the way she sets up the discussion assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: An annoying amount of busy work. Just show up to class, do the work, and you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Osborn is a good professor. She is kind and easy to approach. Her only downfall is she assigns a lot of work. The assignments are broken up during the semester, but they take time to complete. I wouldn't say she grades ridiculously hard, but she definitely doesn't grade easy. Despite the negative talk, I would recommend her!
Great teacher overall and was pretty flexible. decent amount of work but nothing crazy.

I have never had a teacher have problems with my writings. I got awful grades from her on writings. I got a D on the final essay after writing 5 pages, 15 paragraphs, and found new sources since she didn't like the first ones. You are given a lot of busy work and then at the end of the semester you are given 3 big assignments at the same time. 0/10

Her class can be boring, but it's writing, so, expected. There's a good amount of papers, but she gives you so much time in and out of class to do them. Not much HW, the final project is pretty time consuming but she's an easy grader! She's so nice and genuinely cares about her students. I've taken her twice. Love her. She also cancels a lot lol

Dr. Osborn was good. She occasionally lectured, but when she did, it was hard to stay awake. We had two huge projects at the same time at the end of the semester, which I thought was poorly planned, but it was manageable. I'd probably take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. O is a very nice person, but she gives way too much busy work. Even when you have TWO major final projects, she’s still throwing busy work at you. I wouldn’t say she’s a very tough grader, but she’s very picky. It seems like everything you write isn’t quite detailed enough for her. Class is boring and seems like it goes on forever.

She is a very nice person but her class is horrible. All semester you get a bunch of busy work and then close to midterm she starts your final project and then a few weeks later starts another project. 2 projects that are worth a lot of your grade are going on at the same time and she is still giving busy work at this time too.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this Professor thinking I would actually have an easier class. The class over all wasnt terrible but she makes class feel like hours, gives out a bunch of busy work, doesnt explain things well at all, and gave out two important projects (essay and a documentary) at the same time. I wouldnt take again. I would rather take a different pro.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. O is so kind and is very willing to help out since she teaches small classes. The class was very very easy, other than the 10 page paper with Remix due at the end of the semester. No tests, just writings. Some are in class and some are homework.

A great teacher who really cares about setting you up for success. Workload was average to light for a gen ed English credit. Definitely would take again as she prepares you for college without overweighing you with work.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Osborn is really easygoing and respectable. She is very understanding and forgiving if you miss an assignment, and she's always open to helping you out.

She's nice and seemed like she cared, but she gives way to much work with little explanation about most of the assignment. Also, a lot of the assignments were much longer than they probably needed to be. I can honestly say I did not get much out of this class besides just doing meaningless writing assignments.

She's a very nice and caring person and while her class is easy, it's an outrageous amount of work for a class that's so trivial. She knows we're all in scientific majors with other much more important classes yet she assigned assignments that were unnecessary long. In the end I don't feel I learned anything new or useful, besides writing memos.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Osborn is by far the best English teacher I've had at UK. The class is not very demanding at all. She breaks up the larger projects into more manageable pieces with earlier deadlines to prevent procrastination which I really liked. She's an easy grader and gives good feedback. Also gives a lot of time in class to work on assignments.

I thought I would just have to write a bunch of papers, but it wasn't that bad. You get to work on projects, such as a Field Report. There is writing associated with the projects but it is something you can do along the way, in little portions. She is really nice and approachable.

She has a great personality and cares more about how much you learn in the class vs. how much you write on the papers. She won't take off many points for grammatical errors, spelling mistakes, etc. The important thing is that you can communicate in-depth thoughts and support w/ evidence. Great prof, would take again.

Dr. Osborn is a caring and nice professor. This class isn't demanding work-wise, and Dr. Osborn is an easy grader. The only thing that annoyed me about her was that she asked us to buy two different textbooks for this class, and we use one of them for like one assignment and never even touched the other one, which luckily I never bought anyway.

Dr. O is great! She grades fairly and you know exactly what's expected of you. None of her assignments are meant to be confusing and she's great about answering questions. Her class is a lot more laid back than other WRD 112 classes. Your only big projects are a documentary, which is actually fun, and an essay. Take her if you have to take WRD!

Holly's incredible. So incredibly kind, she really wants to help you become a better writer. Instead of doing a lot of papers, you just have one and you get to make a DOCUMENTARY! In a group or alone, she's really flexible. It's super easy to get an A and you get that A by writing about and creating stuff that you care about. Definitely take her.
One of the easiest classes I've taken at UK. I had friends take the same class but with a different professor and their workload was out of this world. Very nice and respected prof.

She's so calm and sweet in class. The work is not hard as long as you pay attention and do your work. There is some reading, but she doesn't completely rely on the textbook for support. She is willing to help and I like blog days when we don't have to go to class and just submit the assignment online. It's a nice refresher for sure.

Dr. O was my first writing professor and she counted off for the TINIEST mistakes.  PROOF READING is the key to getting good grades on the papers she assigns. Also, not all of her rubrics/prompts were 100% clear. Overall she was super laid back and flexible. I'd take her again!
Very fun and easy class with the documentary idea, although I was disappointed to see that the textbooks were virtually useless; we only used one of them once.

I loved taking Dr. Osborn's class. She is very easy going and lets out of class early a lot. Takes attendance but it's an easy class to go to. You can tell that she loves what she does, and the books she chooses are for the most part interesting (she used Perks of Being a Wallflower which is one of my favorites!) Very nice, would take again.

Dr. Osborn was a cool professor, always let out of class early and sometimes it wasn't mandatory to be there. She makes the class applicable to everyday life and makes it interesting. A lot of novel reading though, but it's English so....

If you struggle with math, you NEED to take Mario's class! I have always struggled with math, but Mario's delivery makes it easy to follow. He is very accessible outside of class and is truly the nicest guy ever. He breaks down every problem step by step and gives you his annotated notes. He wants to help you learn and see you succeed.

I got a very high A in Mario's class. He was very good at communicating when quizzes were and his lectures were short and to the point. I would definitely take his class again if given the opportunity.

Great guy, short post lecture homework daily, longer at home homework weekly. Drops your worst grades in pretty much everything.

Class itself is pretty simple concepts.

chill dude, only thing that sucked was i had it at 8am and he grades attendance but it's fine, he lets u go on ur phone and stuff and normally class ends early, 100% study the practice quiz answer keys before quizzes, they r the exact same
I struggle a lot with math, Dr. Ordonez offered a lot of help in class and was very quick to respond to emails outside of class.

Dr. Ordonez is a great professor. His class was very easy to follow and not difficult. The exams were straightforward and clearly reflected the problems we covered in class. Homework was tiresome, but it's about what you could expect for calc 4, and still less than other classes.
I thought this course was very easy. He does not require attendance but every day there is lecture you have an exit ticket due that night. Simple course.
He was very accessible during office hours and explained things clearly, would take again!

Mario really cares and wants to see you succeed. His office hours are great for clearing up any confusion in the material. The class is graded on few things and there's only two midterms, but Mario gives notes with try it yourself questions with answers built in so you can practice on your own. His notes are amazing!!

Professor Mario is a very great lecturer and made learning calculus really simple. His lecture notes are very helpful, with example problems followed up with try on your own right after. The only things you're graded on are homework, quizzes, and exams so going to lecture is very beneficial. he also drops the lowest quiz and homework grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mario is a good professor and makes Calculus easy. You're not graded by very many things but if you stay on top of things and study you should have no problem getting an A in his class. Best calculus professor I've ever had.

Great professor! Cares a lot about the subject she teaches. The class was a little hard because we had A LOT of reading and no instruction (PowerPoints/lecture videos), understandable tho because it's part-of-term. Assignments were fun to do, I learned a lot. Really interesting class, but definitely not low effort. I recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: I have lived in Appalachia for years, but I never really knew about the region until I took this course. It definitely is a lot of reading because it's only 7 weeks for a full semester course. But there are no lectures, and she is an easy grader. If you just turn in the work its an easy A. London was also super nice!

I really enjoyed the material that she presented in class. I never thought I would be interested in learning about Appalachian history, but the movies and videos we watched were very compelling and piqued my interest. London Orzolek is also just a sweetheart.
This felt like a senior level class even though it's an intro course. LOTS of reading, 2-3 papers a week, but an easy grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Do NOT take SPA400, very hard class with lots of random vocabulary you'll have to memorize. I've gotten A's and B's in all my Spanish classes until now. She's a nice lady but gave way too much homework.

Dr. Paz is very kind & willing to help you with anything. But, her study guides aren't the best for exams, which could be a bit difficult. The averages were always pretty bad & she didn't curve much. By doing well on homework, essays, & participation, I was able to get an A. But, I do really like her as a person. Try your best & she will like you.

Prof. Paz is amazing. She's so caring and goes above & beyond to make sure all the students understand and no one is lost. There's light daily homework, three 300-word essays, and a few tests. Nothing crazy. The class can be a tiny bit challenging at times, but prof. Paz does everything she can to help you! I highly recommend her for SPA210!

Prof. Paz was great. Come to her office hours and get to know her and she will help you succeed. I felt that after I got to know her she was more lenient towards me with her grading. She is very vibrant and outgoing and knows her stuff. Great teacher :)
Great teacher, great personality. Loves to teach, and have fun while doing it. Explains everything well and how she wants it. Homework and classwork, not difficult.

Spanish grammar course, 400 is a special topics class. Extremely energetic, knowledgeable, helpful and demanding. Talk about Venezuela and get her off the class subject at hand. You *must* keep up with homework or risk never catching up.

I really, really like Dr. Bridges. I thought he was very difficult at first, but then I chose to go to him for office hours once weekly and it paid off. I was able to turn around my grade and recover. Must go to receive a better understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: good lectures, very interesting.The only way to get the material is through lecture attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really cares about his students and is willing to meet with you whenever needed. Weekly meetings were really helpful for me. Very difficult class with only 2 exams, a final exam, and 4 quizzes and he does not use canvas. As long as you put the time in and go to class, you will be ok.
Only 2 exams given during the course of the class along with 4 quizzes plus the final exam. You will fail the class if you do not attend his lectures or lab.

Dr. Bridges is a great professor for Reproductive Physiology. Some students think that his way of teaching is difficult because he really just goes off whats on his mind and not a certain set of notes, but his lectures are interesting and you definitely learn a lot as long as you pay attention and take quick notes during class.

You can tell Dr. Bridges really cares about his students. When I had him we had to move to online classes halfway through the semester but he still taught just like normal. He really only talks about the content and might draw diagrams on the board but there are no hard copies of notes that he gives out. Be prepared to come to every single class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This professor provides no outside of class material to review. If you don't get everything written down that he verbally says in class then GOOD LUCK. This professor is so unorganized and jumps around on so many topics that is hard to even figure out what you need to read in the textbook if you need other material to look at.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Bridges is a GEM. The class is no easy A, but it's very fair. 4 quizzes 3 exams, nothing tricky about any of them, just lots of content. He's quirky and funny and has an adorable australian(new zealand maybe?) accent. He makes coming to lecture worth it. There is no way to get the material without going to lecture! (But labs are optional)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Bridges is the best- I am in vet school now and the knowledge he taught me about repro in undergrad is still incredibly useful for my current classes. Wish I could have his class again!

This is by far my favorite class I've ever taken at UK. I already was interested in reproductive physiology, but now I want to take more classes after his. Most of the time in classes I didn't have to take notes because I could just listen to what he was saying and he presented it in such a clear-cut manner that it just made sense to me.
He is wonderful, but you need to go, pay attention on the classes and take as much notes as you can.  He always give fair grades. I loved the classes.
He is a very nice guy but I just had a difficult time in this class but as an ASC major I had to take it. I recommend the getting a book even though it isn't required.

Dr. Bridges is a very smart, sweet man. However, teaching is definitely not his strong suit. I struggled a lot with this class, especially in the beginning, just trying to understand what he is saying. He is very unorganized. Definitely buy the book.
He was really consistant and always was there for me, even in my darkest hours.

His lecturing style is slightly disorganized. Exams have similar questions to the multiple-choice question quizzes. Exams also have 2 more traditional show your work questions. Overall, not too hard of a class if you take good notes. Dr. Poonawala is one of the few professors who will actually value and seek out your feedback and try implement it.

He's alright, very fast paced so it's hard to keep up sometimes, but all the experimentation 1 content is relatively simple once you are able to grasp it mentally. Labs are a pain, but it is what it is.

He likes to take the most round a bout way to explain everything, super unclear on every topic. He essentially bailed out on the last topics in the class and expected us to just learn it on our own. He has very strict grading. Only 3 exams in the class, which your entire grade is based on. 2 midterms and a final. His grade replacement is good tho.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Systems is no walk in the park. The first half of the course will make you feel like you have never done math in your entire life. Homework is weekly and there are 3 exams. Be prepared to use 20+ sheets of paper for your homework and exams, the final exam was take home and took over a day to complete. NO partial credit on exams! Read his notes!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Owens lectures were easy to follow and I enjoyed that we did many in class examples of relevant content. This course is moderately difficult being that you have some chemistry background, though if you are not strong in the basics of chemistry this course can be difficult. The exams are very similar to the practices so utilize them.

Would often get frustrated with students for not understanding content, explains concepts in a way that is more confusing than watching Organic Chemistry Tutor on Youtube (recommend this). Difficult class and not enough help provided.
Professor Owen is a great professor, if you go to his office hours or email him he is very nice and will help you out! His class is very hard but he will help you!!

The professor was easy to understand. He speaks in a monotone, so the lecture might feel a little boring, but if you listen, he is an amazing teacher. The tests are hard, so be prepared to study. The professor always holds office hours regularly. Make sure to take advantage of the past exams since those are quite similar to the actual exam.
Was very difficult to understand the material even though I attended office hours twice a week. Was frustrated when I could not understand concepts.
He is okay. Dr. Owen explained chemistry in a way you could understand. However, he is very belittling and makes you feel slow if you do not understand a concept. Other than that, he is good.

Dr. Owen is a great professor! He is caring and makes sure that you have the resources needed to succeed. He does lecture the entire class time, but he explains topics clearly and slowly. He is also very accessible outside of class, and I suggest going to his office hours if you do not understand a topic because he is very helpful!

I loved Dr. Owen! His lectures were easy to understand and he explained concepts well, especially if you do the readings before class. He seems like a nice guy. Main downside is that majority of the class is based off exam grades that are fairly small (less room for mistakes). Enjoyed his class and teaching style :)
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Owen did not make chemistry feel more accessible to me at all. He does not explain things very well, and god forbid you ask a question. I would not take a course by him if you struggle with science concepts at all.

Honestly i like him as a professor and he's a good guy. Lectures are easy but tests are hard. Grades are test heavy but he does a lot at the end of the semester to help your grade (rounds attendance, drops lowest 3 hw grades, and final replaces lowest test grade). I'm a bad test taker but it's definitely a doable class.

Reads off the notes, talks too fast. I could do this sitting in my dorm by myself, but no because he counts attendance as a grade. Genuinely can't read or understand anything he says but acts like you're dumb when u ask a question.

This is was not that bad. You just actually have to put some effort into learning the material. Best thing for that is PRACTICE QUESTIONS! These will help apply the knowledge outside of class. Also, I loved Dr. Owen! He is so caring and goes very very slow through material, which was a nice change compared to high school.

If you are in pre-nursing, this class was slightly harder than ana109. If you just study and do PRACTICE PROBLEMS, you'll be just fine. On another note, I loved Dr. Owen! He dresses just like my dad (chacos and everything) and he is very helpful and throughout his lectures. This class goes very very slow (compared to chem 105), which was great!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I knew going into this class that it was going to be hard. This professor is probably the worst I have ever had. I will definitely not be taking this class again with him if i have to take it again. He talks about things like we are 30-40 year olds that know everything. His lectures are very long. Very homework heavy as well.

He will assign homework to be due but not even be done teaching the lesson so your there trying to teach yourself. we met to go over an exam, would put down his head and shake it when i got something wrong like I was supposed to know everything, did not help nor go through the problems just kept saying "This is on the study guide".

I retook this class after previously getting a C with another professor. Dr. Owen is great! He is very caring and provides lectures that are easy to follow and understand. He provides visualizations and analogies that help connect chemistry to real life which really helped me to understand the material. I couldn't recommend this class enough.

LOVED this class! Switched my major to Nursing (from pre-med) and decided to take 103 after GEN CHEM (105 &107) and it felt so fair grading and test wise and is VERY doable!! The teacher is really caring and clear in his lectures!

If you show up and actually pay attention, you should do well. Everything that is on the exams is taught in class and there are no trick questions. He has office hours multiple times a week, and provides you all the recourses to be successful.

He does not teach. He will go over an assignment in class the day after it is due, so basically you teach yourself 90% of the work. Test Heavy (3 exams about 55% of your grade, and a final worth 23%), only took because it was mandatory, otherwise would not have. Only professor that teaches this exam.

Dr. Owen was a professor who actually cared about his students passing the class. Yes, this class is difficult and he knows that so he offers lots of things to help you succeed. I would recommend this professor if you are ready to pay attention in lectures and study.

The class is overall tough and the lectures can feel pointless at times but the Dr. Owens genuinely wants you to succeed. He included a lot of advantages like replacing test scores, only needing 75% on participation, and dropping your 3 lowest homework grades. I did the homeworks over and over and studied the notes and ended with a low A.

He is a very misunderstood professor to say the least. He knows that course material is not easy but he has stayed after class to assist students. He is genuinely very caring and understanding. His exams are a little tricky but with enough studying, you'll get through the class. Use AKEKS! The homework is relevant and a good study material! 10/10!
I did not like his lectures, he made me feel more confused than anything. I resorted to watching YouTube videos to learn concepts in the class because I could not understand the way he teaches it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I think people are forgetting that this is a chem class and chem is not an easy subject. I've had many chem professors and Dr. Owen is by far the most down to earth. He definitely gives dad vibes and loves his dad jokes.

The professor is rude, passive aggressive, and if you ask him a question he sighs as if you are already supposed to know the material. His lectures and homework are not remotely related at ALL. The ALEKS are completely useless and the only helpful homework is the unit study guides. I DO NOT recommend this class to anyone unless it's required.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A lot of people did not like Dr. Owen bc they did not put the time into the class which was necessary. I had a great experience with Dr. Owen. I struggled in the beginning but started going to the study, office hours and went to tutoring. He stayed a whole hour after office hours and helped me before the final. I went from a low D to a B in the end
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: SO much homework is assigned through ALEKS which 90% of the time has no relation to what was taught in lecture and will be presented in a completely different way on exams. He is also very disorganized, we missed ONE class due to weather and it threw off his lesson plans for the rest of the semester. Only take this class if completely necessary.

Be prepared to be confused most of the semester homework and lectures have nothing to do with each other His lectures dont make sense and he always speeds up at the end of them to fit more stuff and then never explains it again Be prepared to take notes quick because he writes fast if you can avoid taking him do it save urself Worst prof ever

dr. owen is okay. he is not super accommodating & the aleks homework is a waste of time. the exams are nothing like the aleks homework either, but personally, i did not think the exams were that difficult. definitely focus on the key skills at the end of each page when studying

Overall, he was a very good professor and explained things well. He was always willing to help outside of class and gives "dad vibes" for lack of better verbiage. As long as you attend class and practice problems outside of class, you will be fine. I would reccomend him
