reviews.comment: Grades way too harsh and takes a 101 course way too seriously than any professor should. Also tends to be condescending

Good professor. Be prepared to read. There are 4 main papers in the course and 3 quizzes. If you go to class and pay attention you will pass. Tough grader though on the writings. Overall good class, very moving
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Voogt genuinely cares about his students' engagement with the material. Although the reading was often heavy, it was also diverse and included relevant topics that interested the students so as to promote discussion (which most of class was dedicated towards). As long as you make an respectable effort - you should be golden! He is a great guy!

Professor Voogt was a great teacher. The class is primarily discussion based, and it makes for very fascinating discourse. He takes a very interdisciplinary approach to studying the Holocaust, bringing in aspects of psychology and philosophy into the history department, so it's more than just date memorization. Favorite professor, highly recommend.

She is a nice lady, but she is the worst professor I have ever had. Her accent is EXTREMELY hard to understand and in lectures you have to listen and focus extremely hard to understand what she is saying and or explaining. Attendance is mandatory, assigned seats, and group work every class. Missing one class will drop your grade exponentially.

She's a fine professor. She just lectures, gives extra credit through “pop quizzes” (which are just practice problems you work on with your group). Exams are all multiple choice and you get a formula sheet you just need to know how to use it.

The professor is very knowledgeable, though lectures can be a bit dry. It's a manageable class. She offers extra credit for attendance and the review guides align closely with the exams. You will get the most value out of the homework assignments, so focus your efforts there to really learn the material.
She just reads off slides all class then gives you a couple questions to do, and says if you need help go to the study and ask a tutor.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: As other reviews have said, the language barrier makes it extremely difficult to understand. Test questions use improper English which can be very confusing. She is a nice person I suppose but learning from her is impossible, and this class can be annoying to teach yourself. I'd avoid this teacher like the plague as mean as it sounds.

I am sure that she knows what she is talking about but I would never know. There is a SEVERE language barrier that makes it impossible to learn in the lecture. What I have learned in this class is how to find materials to teach myself everything. She and her TA's hover around the room and pretty much just stare at people.

You can tell she actually cares & wants students to do well in her class. She gives reviews for each section, which are nearly identical to the actual exams. Although, sometimes it is hard to understand her. Overall, it really isn't difficult to do well in this class.

She is so hard to understand, and class is SOOOOO boring. She will start a new section with 5 minutes of class left. Attendance is mandatory, but she does extra credit with in-person assignments every so often. She is super hard to learn from. Wouldn't reccomend but if shes your only option I would take her just to get it over with.

This class is not as bad as everyone says. She is hard to understand at first, but you get used to it and it's really not that bad. The homework is consistent every week and she gives most of the answers in class. Homework and attendance make up a big part of the grade and prepare you for the exams. The class isn't bad just show up and do the work.
Doesn't speak English, all the tests use improper grammar.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class is not bad at all if you pay attention. She knows the material and how to teach it. Pay attention, take notes, do the homework, study and you'll do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: At first, I thought this class would be the worst. I promise you it is not. This class includes a lot of homework that has a clear due date. Start on it before it is due. There is one final project in addition to the final exam. Just stay after class or ask about if before if you have any questions. The exams are VERY similar to the homework.

Pay attention, she explains everything that will be on quizzes and exams but she can be hard to understand at times. I had to teach myself most of it using the videos that go with the course. The homework helped me a lot, and she provided a formula sheet on exams which made them easier. It wasn't the worst class but it took a lot of time studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved her and the course. If you just listen in lecture and take notes, you will be perfectly fine! I always did the homework associated with the lecture right after, and it helped so much. Just do what you are supposed to, and you will be just fine. She is such a sweet lady and is so willing to help.

Wouldn't recommend taking her class. She'll spend SO much time talking about Statkey when its not even useful on the test. literally all she talked about 80% of the course during lectures was Statkey. If she spent half the time teaching actual course material as she did Statkey, I probably wouldn't have a D.

She gave us a seating chart, lots of homework, and makes you buy a $40 workbook we used twice (though that might not be up to her idk). She's not the best but not the worst, just show up and pay attention and you should do fine. You will have to kinda teach yourself outside of class and if you miss something she probably isn't going back over it.
OMG PLEASE HELP!!!!! THIS CLASS IS SO CONFUSING, AND DON'T EVEN GET ME STARTED ON THE TA. SUPER HARD TO UNDERSTAND. GOOD LUCK
VERY difficult to understand. Made the class nearly impossible and had to teach myself everything. Do not take her class if you want a good grade.

fairly easy, but you have to attend class. attendance is taken every day, and she publishes the slides, but only makes sense if you go to class. TA is awful, and it goes 0-100 really quick. i did well, but i hated this class. did drop some small assignments at end of term.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Stats is hard regardless of professors. Def did a good job at explaining the content, the class itself is tough with a lot of homework, and attendance matters. Exams are straight forward since you do most problems in class already. Her accent is not difficult to understand but her lectures can be boring. Overall you just have to apply yourself.

Sometimes hard to understand but she is very kind and cares about the students. She'll answer any question as best she can and is responsive to emails. As long as you put in the effort and study you'll get the grade you want
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Yes, she may be difficult to understand, but as long as you pay attention in class and take notes, it's easy to follow. She gives 4+ homework assignments every week. 4 exams, 1 project, all very easy. The review homework is exactly like the exams.

Even though it can be hard to understand her at times, Professor Shi does a great job explaining and breaking down statistical problems and terminology. There is a lot of homework, but not much studying is needed if worked at properly. Attendance is counted for points, and sometimes she'll provide a pop quiz, but she usually gives you a heads up.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Was very difficult to understand, would avoid her if I could. The material itself is not difficult, but you are mainly teaching it to yourself. You are also given assign seats. She also walks around to room and reads over your shoulder and will correct you. Honestly, she made learning stats much harder than it actually needed to be.

This should be your last choice for a 296 professor. It is not her fault but she is very difficult to understand during the lectures and you will be teaching yourself 99% of the material. The class itself is not too difficult but it would be made much easier with a professor that is easier to understand and contact outside of class.

If you take her, be prepared to fully teach yourself everything. EXTREMELY difficult to understand during lectures, which is not her fault, but it is simply the truth. You will get SO lost SO fast. The material itself is not that difficult, but having her as your teacher WILL make it harder. Choose any other options before her to save yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She laughed at me when I got an answer wrong and by the end of the semester we had over 60+ homework assignments... avoid at all costs!

She's a kind teacher, but her lectures can be hard to follow. Tests are fair and multiple choice, but I mostly learn outside class to keep up. Attendance is key due to random assignments, pop quizzes, and frequent cold-calling. If you dislike being put on the spot, this class might not be the best fit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She's honestly not that bad of a teacher. Personally I had to self-study for the exams, but her exams are quite simple. There is a lot of homework each week, but it's good practice for questions on the exams. She responded to my emails quickly, her TA on the other hand, not so much. Make sure to go to class, it makes passing a whole lot easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Xiaofang Shi is very nice and can easily be understood so if you have to take her class you will be ok. BUT I will say that she doesn't do a very good job and it's quite difficult to learn stats from a review sheet. She will help you when you ask after class but after that long lecture I run away. It's a lot of work but dont fret it's doable.

She was amazing! It was a bit hard to understand her sometimes but she has been one of the most friendly professors. 2 Homework assignments as well as 2 canvas quizzes a week. Her review quizzes look exactly like the exams making it easier to get an A. TAKE HER! Her TA on the other had was a complete jerk. He was mean 90% of the time.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: English isn't her first language so there is a language barrier, but she talks slowly and eloquently so it is mostly easy to understand her. She is very sweet, but her class is a total snooze fest. She assigns two homework assignments every lecture. But her final project is so much easier compared to other STA296 professors.

Attendance is mandatory, but super understanding if you had to miss class for specific reasons. The homework can be tedious at times, but the exams are just like her weekly quizzes. If you pay attention in class and do well on the weekly quizzes the class is not that difficult.
The class lectures are all outlined in word documents so it is easy to follow along and the exams are almost identical to the practice questions that she gives you as homework/in class.

she is my favorite teacher. Her class is very straightforward and an easy A. The exams are simple and consist entirely of multiple-choice questions. I find her course much easier than AP Calculus. She is very enthusiastic, and while I know some reviews mention that there's a lot of homework, it's actually quite simple and doesn't take much time.

I thought I would never leave a review during college but i had to leave a review for this class. The lectures are the worst thing I have ever sat through and points are taken everyday. Its not her accent that makes the class a bore its just the fact shes a horrible teach and statistics is hard already but get prepared to teach yourself everything.
TA is just too bad. No matter how hard you try, you will still be bullied.
Can be a little hard to understand, but helpful if you reach out or ask. You will do bad if you don't go to class or pay attention in lectures.

This class is very easy if you put in effort. By effort, I mean attending class regularly and attempting to understand the material.(attendance is required) The quizzes/review questions are usually the same/ very similar to the actual exam questions. She walks around to answer any questions. I would take her class again.

Dr. Shi is pretty organized and clear on directions. You MUST go to lecture, as she goes over material for the notes/quiz reviews, and attendance is required. While there was a good amount of homework, she goes over everything you need to know. The exams are basically the quiz reviews. As long as you pay attention you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Unsure why there are so many bad reviews. She's great. Lectures hugely aided my understanding. She dropped a lot of smaller grades at the end of the semester, which was very generous. There is a bit of homework, but welcome to college! The class is not hard. I got a near 99% overall. Class was a bit boring, but she cares about your learning.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: There was lots of homework in this professors course, all of which are very manageable and not too difficult. With this being said, you do have to put in multiple hours per week to complete the work for her class. I would recommend finding a different professor, but if she is your only option, the class is still not incredibly difficult.

Her sections of STA 296 has a lot more assignments than other sections so if that bothers you I would pick a different professor. However I really liked  it. In math there's not really a way to study so all the additional assignments really hep. She grades attendance but lectures are recorded.

Very easy class.  If you follow along in lecture you might have to study 1-2 hours out of class for an exam max.  Not that difficult to understand, but I've had foreign professors before.  She is nice if you're confused, but can be irritated if she can tell you're not putting in effort (like most people in her class).  Overall an easy A.

The class is not very hard if you teach yourself. This professor is extremely hard to understand and SO SO rude. Does not care about her students in the least bit. I would strongly advise not to take her.

I created this account to leave a poor review on Xiaofang. She is very hard to understand and lectures are a snooze fest. Be ready to teach yourself some stats, if you follow along it's not that hard.
No, too much homework, making us study over Spring Break for an exam. Just no.

She's ok at best. She's hard to understand (Not her fault but just keep it in mind), you will have to teach yourself everything, and if you get something wrong or you try to ask a question it feels like she just makes up something and just laughs at you. I'm in the middle of the semester and I can confidently say, take a different stats professor.

This was a decent class. Throughout a lot of it, I wish it was online just because of how slow the class seemed. The notes and lecture explained everything in detail, which helped. Although, there was quite a bit of homework per week. None of it was ever hard, just time-consuming from time to time. I did feel prepared for the exams though.

If I can get an A's without Chegg, you sure can too!
- Do the section/review before going to class (you will get cold call) 
- Use StuDoc STA 296 (trust me, it help a lot)
- Go to tutoring
- Couple of Wiley homework answers is in the textbook (click on eTextbook and Media) 
- Do a lot of practice before exam (exam are similar to section/review)
Horrible teacher. Just failed the last exam and now will have a D when I was shooting for a C. Very upset. Do not take STA 296 with Professor Shi!!!

I took the only STA296 asynchronous-ish and it was a breeze. All the assignments had three attempts at least, and the exams were exactly like the assignments. I'd take this class again just to get the satisfaction of completing assignments in 15 minutes.

This professor is the least understanding or kind person at the university. I had a week of medical issues that led to me having surgery and I ended up getting one extension out of the 5 assignments that were due around the time of my surgery.

The worst professor at the University Of Kentucky. This woman is is practically impossible to understand and seems to have little to no teaching experience based on the understandability of the content presented in her lectures. She treats the class like its 8th grade and removes mandatory attendance points if a student is caught on their phone.

Very hard to understand, does not really teach the criteria of the class and would rather just read it off of a word document. Be ready to teach yourself. Also assigns work due over academic holidays which defeats the purpose of having one in the first place. 0/10. Do not take.

She was pretty good at explaining different concepts but with all due respect, she is hard to understand. The homework is repetitive but on the bright side she gave us practice exams to study for. The lecture was pretty boring but the content isn't very difficult. She is nice though and is willing to give you extra help if you need it

reviews.comment: Definitely the worst professor I've had at UK. Classes were sleep-inducing and she treated us like children. We had to keep our phones away and even had assigned seats. XiaoFang Shi is one of the worst professors I've had the displeasure of knowing and having as a professor. She doesn't teach the class so that's an issue. She doesn't teach StatKey which is detrimental to passing the stupid class, and she barely responds to emails concerning hw assignments. I REPEAT DO NOT TAKE THIS SNOOZE FEST OF A PROFESSOR!!!

reviews.comment: Professor Xiaofang is not a great teacher, but out of all the stats professors, she's the one you want. My advice is to go to tutoring services and teach yourself the content. With alittle elbow grease, you'll pass.
show up, pay attention, do the homework, you get an A. Crazy how that works.

Stats is hard so all profs are going to have low scores. I never listened to her in class because she repeats things a lot and I would get confused. To counter that she posts TONS of resources like video lectures that I would watch in class instead of listen to her. The practice quizzes that she posts (with key) are exactly like the test.

reviews.comment: Avoid at all costs! She is one of the worst professors I've had at UK. An insane amount of homework each week and she doesn't even teach. Do not take her for STA296.

This is by far one of the worst professors I've ever taken. The exams and homework are some of the most confusing and challenging things I've ever tried to comprehend. Get ready to either buy or use Chegg. She doesn't teach and worst of all is that she expects us to know all of the course material and tools without any help or guidance. STAY AWAY!!

I took her online during COVID. She didn't have any mandatory class time, and you do all your HW and lectures though a website. She didn't teach. She gives chapter quizzes, and these questions are identical to her exam questions. If you're a hardworking student, then you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Worst professor I've had by far. I am fully online and asynchronous this semester and she hasn't given us a single lecture to watch. She doesn't teach at all. The only thing we have gotten to "learn" from is short 1-3 minute videos from another school that make absolutely no sense. She hardly speaks english so it is hard to email her.

Worst professor I have ever had. Extremely rude. I am an A student, but received a B and I would like to normally say I'm good at math. We had lectures from another university so she was basically no help. We didn't learn how to use Statkey which was necessary for most of the questions. The homework took at least 5 hours each day. AVOID HER!!!!!!!

The only reason I got an A was because of AP Statistics in high school. This class had zero lectures all year long and barely had a professor. She assigned a lot of homework and quizzes to make up for lectures which don't help. She's rude when asking for help and didn't care one bit about any difficulties and stresses covid might give students.

She never had a single class, basically had to teach myself everything. A lot of homework, that I had to buy Chegg for. Test heavy class. She was inconsiderate to students during Covid. Awful teacher.

The online class format is the hardest class I have ever participated in. It is not the professor teaching the class, but some program designed by another college. This program focuses on forcing you to self teach the class. I pay for Chegg just for this class. Horrible class.

Prof Shi doesn't even teach, we watch lecture videos from another university and the homework assignments are extremely difficult. We have never been properly taught how to use STATKEY, but are expected to use it for every homework assignment and the exams. It's pretty annoying that we pay so much in tuition just for her not to teach us.

I only took this class bc it best fit my schedule but avoid her if you can. She doesn't even teach; we watch videos from Iowa State and have 100+ point homework assignments. I would be screwed if I didn't take college stats in high school. I got Chegg bc of this class. She assigned a TON of homework on academic holidays which prob isnt allowed sooo

Shi is really good at what she does. She is very understanding and helpful when you do not understand a topic. Go to office hours or send her an email. I took this class during Corona and the test got significantly harder. Lots of homework. Attendance to lecture is mandatory. Not type of extra credit at all so you have to do your absolute best.

reviews.comment: She takes attendance every day. She can be hard to hear at times, but if you follow along and try it should be pretty straight forward. Very fast paced summer class. The McGraw hill textbook quizzes are very hard and very long.

She is very lecture heavy but her lectures are very cleanly laid out, and all the test questions come directly from to notes.

She was an amazing professor! It is definitely lecture heavy, you HAVE to go to class AND take notes. All of the exam questions come from things she says in class, but it's just a 50 min lecture and she makes it very easy to follow and interesting! Plenty of extra credit opportunities. I would love to have her as a teacher again!
great as an online professor!

Attending class is the only way to receive the material as test questions come from the notes. The professor is amazing and extremely caring. The course is really simple as long as you take the time to do it with your other classes. Personally I've only emailed her once to ask about the paper you have to write and she was super nice and responded fast.
Dr. Stephenson was amazing. She is a very good professor and her class is straight forward. I would 100% take her again

This professor is really good to take for an online class, everything is laid out for you, and the only way you don't pass this class is if you don't do any work, and she is forgiving under the right circumstances.

There is a lot of reading and note taking but it is not bad just make time for it when you are doing the workbook assignment.

Dr. Stephenson is the nicest professor and very knowledgeable! If you come to class, pay attention, and take notes, you'll do very well. Her study guides are comprehensive and a great way to prepare for the exams. You can tell how much she cares for her students!
Class is very easy and it's hard not to get a A. She does everything in her power to make sure you get a A. She wants you to get a A more than you do.

Stephenson was so incredibly sweet, however, with exams she wasn't very considerate. The exams are very hard, and she's not very accommodating when you test with the DRC. BUT besides that, she's a very sweet lady and so intelligent. She knows her stuff for sure.
Dr. Stephenson was an amazing professor and her class was super helpful and easy

Wonderful professor, but the content she teaches is ridiculously difficult! Even with the difficulty level, Dr. Stephenson does everything she can to make it tolerable with extra credit, and flexible due dates.

Dr. Stephenson was by far one of my favorite professors I've had here at UK. She was very quick at responding to emails and always happy to answer questions. Her class was very content heavy but if you put the time into her class you should pass with an A. Loved the class.
I took her class for DHN101. The class was very easy as long as you kept up with your work. Professor Stephenson was great at reminding everyone of what assignments were due for the week.

You have around 4 assignments a week, for me it was irritating because I had a lot of other busy work, but it is easy if you read your textbook. I just don't like online classes I feel like I don't learn from them.

easy but a ton of busy work. i worked ahead at the beginning, though, which made it easier to control. there's three super short assignments and a smartbook every week, then discussions, four case studies, two short papers, and four exams.
Super easy class and very caring professor. Lots of weekly busy work, discussion boards, 4 case studies, 4 exams, no cumulative final, 2 papers or “projects.” An easy A if you just do the work.

Very easy class. Do your work and you will pass. No meetings and no attendance. Easiest A ever. Grades fast. She gives an extra credit assignment at the end but you'll have an A so you probably won't need it lol. Wish all my classes were like this.

Dr. Stephenson is probably the best teacher I have ever had. She is engaging, kind, relatable to both herself and the content, and passionate about her teachings. She gives so much extra credit! She can be very lenient about your grade + the final if you put in the work to show her that you are learning. Her study guides are key to studying!

Dr. Stephenson was an amazing professor. She was so understanding and accommodating to students and was so passionate about her lectures. She made the class interesting and gives extra credit some days. Dr. Stephenson replied to emails quickly and always tried to make everyone enjoy the class.
One of my favorite professors I've had. The expectations were clear, and as long as you put the work in, you'll get an A.

Such a good class! Its not hard to get an A but you have to put in the work. You cannot expect to not study and do the hw and assignments and pass with an A. Now people do fail the exams but its not hard if you take the time to study. What you put into it is what you get out. She is a lovely person and professor! She will work with you! 100%

All of the things you learn is a textbook that she wrote that is super interesting. As long as you get the work done  its a super easy course. Dr.Stephenson was a great professor. She was easily accessible even though the course was asynchronous and online. Dr. Stephenson is by far the best professor I've ever had! She delivers material in a very easy to understand way and truly cares about her students success. If you have any questions she is available to answer and does so quickly. She provides plenty of quizzes and study materials to help you succeed.

great professor, really easy class

she's the best professor I've ever had!! she genuinely cares for her students

Dr. Stephenson is an amazing teacher! She genuinely cares about her students and wants everyone to do well. As long as you go to class and do well on all homework, you will be golden.
Dr. Stephenson is one of my favorite professors at UK. Her lectures are amazing, and even though participation is not mandatory, taking notes is the key to a good grade in this class.

Dr. Stephenson lectures are very interesting she tries to relate the content to careers in the health-care field. Amazing. She is my favorite professor, by far.

Dr. Stephenson is FANTASTIC. Such a quality teacher who provides engaging lectures and effective teaching methods. Her exams are challenging, but very doable if you study. She is an asset to the nutrition department at UK and I would strongly encourage you to take this course!

Tammy is an excellent professor.  She is very nice and gives extra credit for students showing up on Fridays. GREAT teacher! Class is interesting and tests are easy if you study the notes from class. A few independent projects but they're not that time consuming. She is so caring and will do anything she can to help you out! Definitely a great class!
