Ms. Stephenson is a wonderful teacher!! I always looked forward to coming to her class! I am so excited that she will be teaching two classes that I will be taking next semester. If you need any nutrition courses, take it with her!

I absolutely loved Dr. Stephenson! She made this class my favorite that I've had so far! She makes the material super easy to understand and as long as you go to class and take notes, the exams are pretty easy.

Dr. Stephenson is a great professor! Very easy to understand, very friendly, and very helpful outside of class if you dont understand something. You do some in class participation group work, and exams are over what she lectures in class. Highly recommend her to anyone

Dr. Stephenson was a great teacher! She made this one of my favorite classes that I've taken at UK. As long as you attend class and take the notes on the powerpoints you will be fine. The book is not necessary except for maybe 1 project. She gives very clear study guides before each exam and reviews it in class with you before the exam.

This was a very informative class taught by a very passionate teacher. I struggled (made a low B) with the first exam, but did well on the others and ended opting out of the final and didn't have to go to class for the last three weeks of the semester. Highly recommend getting copies of exams from previous semesters.

My favorite teacher at UK so far. She teaches the material in a way that is easy to understand. All you have to do is attend class and take notes on the pp slides. I would recommend this class to anyone regardless if you need it or not because it is easy, interesting, and she's such a great teacher!

Tammy is wonderful!  She is very helpful, responds to emails quick, and her exams are very straight forward.  She wants her students to make good grades and will help anyway she can! I would take her for every class if I could!

Makes it pretty obvious what you need to know for the test. Keeps class pretty interesting. I barely used the book at all. If you have an A on the first 3 exams you test out of the final. Easy class, and she's pretty hot

Loved this class!  If you just come to class and take the notes off the PP slides, you'll be fine!  She posts a SG about a week before the exams with a question & answer session the class before to make sure you understand everything.  Also group class projects are automatic 15 points to your grade if you just show up.

I loved this class! She is such a nice teacher and presents all material in a clear manner. She actually made me want to be a human nutrition major. Her tests can be kind of tricky but if you studied you will still get an A.

She is extremely nice and will help you out if you need it.  She lets you opt out of the final if you have an A by the time it rolls around and you don't have to keep coming to class after the third exam if that's the case.  No attendance taken, but if you just show up and take notes off the PP, you're fine.  Book is supplemental at best.

Tammy is an excellent teacher. I have had her for NFS 212 and just this semester in NFS 315. For NFS 315 make sure that you do the questions assigned from the back of the book, they are used on the test.
This class is pretty much an easy A. She tries to keep lecture interesting, and the information you learn is actually neat to learn about.

This professor and class was the best class i took at UK. she is really easy and makings everything so interesting. if you take notes directly off the powerpoint and study that for the test you will make an A!

Really cheerful, pleasant professor. Class is very easy, just show up and take notes off the PowerPoint slides. Sometimes I even felt like it should be aimed at younger students. But the material is interesting, and she's good at answering e-mails and questions in class.

This is a tough class, but Dr. Wu makes it funny and bearable. He provides great feedback on homework. His lecture videos are helpful and I personally found them funny. He uses off-the-wall metaphors and jokes that I could see some people not enjoying, but I thought they made a boring class pretty fun. Definitely recommend.

Probably the best lecturer for Dynamics on campus, but the class was pretty rough still, especially the tests. He's funny and ALWAYS available to help with homework. My biggest complaint is that he caters the class content to his specific method of problem-solving, which does not align with the book or other professors. Can become confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I wish I had taken advantage of OFFICE HOURS from the beginning of the semester. Wu is amazing in his WILLINGNESS TO HELP and explain. He stayed up and assisted me with homework one night until almost 1am. Definitely can be hard to understand & uses too many metaphors that confused me. Watch all his help videos. Stay ahead of the concepts whenever
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Wu is hilarious and teaches very well. If you're a diligent student this class is no problem. If you do the homework and understand it, his exams are exactly like the homework. Go to his office, email him, and you will pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Dr. Wu's dynamics class gave me more problems than any other class in college. Would highly recommend against taking it unless you like homework and quizzes every day and insanely hard tests. Good professor, but the work load is unbearable, especially if you have a heavy overall semester load.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Wu gives you access to lectures online but attendance is mandatory. He is super funny and he tells lots of jokes that are obscure but he relates them to the topic so you will remember them forever. His homework is due every class and is difficult but it is exactly what is on the exams. He is my favorite professor and he is actually very nice.

Dr. Wu is hilarious and keeps all his lectures interesting. He is tough to understand sometimes and that makes the already difficult material harder. Homework is tough and time consuming, but it does help with the class. The tests are very difficult.

Very tough class, but do-able. He is a tough teacher and you have to know the material or you won't pass. Very helpful and will go out of his way to make sure you understand it, you just have to approach him. Homework due every class that will take a couple hours.

Wu is a good guy. HW is due every class and he picks problems that do not have available solution manual. He explains his math by relating them to girls, television, etc... and generally makes no real sense. I strongly recommend to aviod this professor... he is a good guy, just insanely hard (unless you are super nerd).
I had Dr Wu for dynamics and while he does give a lot of homework, he will always go out of his way to help you.  His methods to solve problems are hilarious.
Tough, but fair.  Taking Wu will make your learn the material.  VEry approachable and helpful.  He has some off the wall humor and memory aides!
No Comments
Notoriously, ridiculously hard.   Nerds love him.  He picks his test questions from the toughest examples in class, but makes them even harder.  HW every night, better do it.  Good luck!

Wu knows his stuff, but teaches by examples in his powerpoint, rather than by concept. His tests and quizzes were rediculously hard because they were much more complex and complicated than the hw. He is a FUNNY FUNNY man though, his jokes and humor are insane.

The class design is what I like, it gives plenty of practice and the exams are very similar. But the way he teaches the concepts is so hard to understand, he never simplifies things but instead makes up a story related to the concept to get us to laugh.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Wu is weird. He should disclosed he uses flipped classroom style which I hate. Further, he uses videos from 2010 which are long, rambling, and difficult to focus on. I think he wants students to succeed and cares, he just is "weird" and difficult to handle, understand, and predict. Frequently changed, canceled, and didn't show for office hours.

Best teacher I've ever had! Only teacher in the world that could make Engineering Dynamics my favorite class of undergrad because of how fun he made it. He took super hard, abstract concepts and found the most hilarious, memorable ways to demystify them so we could learn them and they'd stick. I'm sad that'll be my only class with him.

Never laughed this much before. Dr. Wu's jokes & analogies are great! EM313 is hard but just: 

Watch his videos
Go to lecture (optional but recommended)
Turn in HW early for VIP treatment
Study old Exams

Just put in some effort & you'll be fine. Otherwise, Dr. Wu might invite you to play to Call of Duty w/ him & Dot you (Inside jokes from class)

Dr. Wu is unlike any professor I've had. The class is rigorous, be prepared for a lot of working outside of class. However, he is super accessible, he holds office hours often and will respond to an email at midnight. Be prepared for the comments he leaves on homework. I do think he cares and wants you to learn, but it's lowkey cost my social life.

Love his teaching style; can be rude with incorrect homework. Laugh at critiques, don't take it to heart;
he does that to all. More practice than any other ME professor. No curves, high fail/drop rate. Generous partial credit on exams; don't aim for absolute completion. Solve symbolically; if "I" needed, write numbers without using calculator.

Wu is a pretentious jerk, instead of teaching he gives you videos from 2018 where he makes outdated references in order to connect with his students. His exams and homework are extremely difficult given that he doesn't teach. He then blames the students and asks you to drop if you have low scores because he doesn't want his record to be tainted.

Wu is hard on his students but is always willing to meet with you to make sure you understand the content. He always incorporates jokes to help you remember difficult concepts. If you take good notes, keep up with all of the work, and ask him questions about content/homeworks, you'll do fine. DO NOT PUT OFF GRADED HOMEWORKS, start them early!
Dr. Wu is a great teacher and delivers material in a very understandable way. However, I found his grading to be very inconsistent and his feedback was not always helpful.

Dr. Wu is the one you want for dynamics! His lectures are hilarious, so you get to learn dynamics while also contemplating what is going on in Dr. Wu's mind when he references some of the strangest things. He really wants you to succeed and will respond to emails within 10 minutes, regardless of the time! One of the best professors in the CoE.

This class is a fun experience! Its not common to have profs who are as hilarious as Wu. He makes lectures really enjoyable. Turn in hw early he will give feedback early so you can resubmit for a 100%. He gives plenty of practice exams and extra problems, so if you study, there will be no surprises on exams. Give a good effort and this class is ez!

Dr. Wu is by far the greatest professor I have ever had. The man is super dedicated. You could email him at 11 pm and ask him for help and he would get back with you within 30 minutes. Hes also super funny and his lectures are hardly ever dull. As long as you do the homeworks and understand them well, you can pass his tests.

I withdrew from this class because of a low grade. Dr. Wu cares about his students and is very available out of class. The lectures are all available on his website. He makes a lot of jokes and pop culture references, which can be either helpful or distracting. I found it somewhat inappropriate and unhelpful, and I did not do well that semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Though dynamics is a very difficult class, Dr. Wu is such an amazing professor. His lectures are unconventional but hilarious, and he truly cares about his students. If you dedicate the time to doing the homework, you can get an A or a B. I spent a lot of time in his office, which was super helpful. Just go along with his metaphors and jokes.

Even if you dont learn anything in lecture, it will still be worth your time to listen to the crazy stories he tells. If you do all the homework, you should easily pass with a B. And better than Hanson

You get lots and lots of homework but if you keep up with it and review and practice the assignments the tests will be cake. Dr. Wu was seriously such an awesome professor. He really takes the time to present material in a way that's easy to understand.
incredible
Greatest teacher of all time
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Legendary biochemistry lectures for USMLE prep by Dr. Turco !!! Can not really believe that somebody can teach biochem so well !
Very nice and amazing lectures..east to understand and quench my thirst for knowledge.
BEST BIOCHEM PROFESSOR EVER!! It just makes sense.... and if it doesn't make sense ... find out why !! (by attending his Kaplan course)
The best biochem professor ever.

You'll learn a lot even if you have zero background in biochemistry. His classes are perfect for students with a weak background in biochemistry, but also great for those with a solid background. He starts slow so all students can catch up, make sure you get the high yield concepts and make sure his students actually think instead of memorize.
THE BEST EVER
He actually made Biochem easier to comprehend. It makes sense!
Dr. Turco is the man. in all my years of med school i hated biochem. but 2 of Dr. Turcos lessons, all i can say is... IT MAKES SENSE
No words hes amazing thanks dr
Best lecturer

I was blessed to receive Dr Turco's Biochem lecture in Kaplan Pasadena for USMLE Step 1. If I could take it again, I would! Treasure this Prof because I think noone else in the world could make Biochem so simple and (I cringe whenever I think of this) FUN!  Remember, it will MAKE SENSE and it will make you respect the little things in life!

I took Dr. Turco's biochemistry & genetics lectures in his Kaplan USMLE course. I was a biochem major before medical school and I learned more in 11 lectures with him than in 4 years! His goal is understanding and integration rather than rote memorization. Here is where his approach excels over 95% professors I have ever had.
Loved the way he taught . Cleared all my doubts and now "IT MAKES SENSE"
I received his Biochemistry lectures in Kaplan reviws, he is awsome, is the best, he can make the biochemistry so easy and good, everything makes sense. I think is the best professor,
He is the best proffesor, there is o way that you don enjoy his classes,  When people know hoe to teach you can feel it . Thanks proffesor
It is one of the best proffesor I have had, he makes the biochemistry so easy and help a lot to understand really hard topics, He is the best.

I never actually met him before but i watch his kaplan videos, and i can truly say he is my biochem professor, the professor i have now is terrible, but this professor is amazing, would be great to meet him in person, really wish he was my professor!!
It was amazing, biochemistry made easy by Dr Sam Turco !!
good
Dr T is just great! Biochem makes sense in his class! The board has no chance!
Great. He is just great. Biochemistry has made sense.
u rock dr turco!
HUGE, HUGE, PROFESSOR, THE BEST IN THE WORLD TO EXPLAIN THE BIOCHEMISTRY... I ENJOYED HIS LECTURES ALTHOUGH I HAVE BIO BEFORE
Dr. Turco is the best, comin' in to play! C/O 2013 represent!

I was excited for the class content but I feel we barely touched on it. She would come in late at least half the time. She would constantly get sidetracked and in some classes we didn't even talk about course material. She didn't know how to properly assign things and all the instructions were unclear. It was an easy class but a waste of my time.

Kakie is knowledgable and caring. She gives good tips on finding internships and jobs. However, JAM 202: Portfolio and Profession wasn't very beneficial. Attending class was pointless. Kakie only taught about 10 minutes each class. She isn't the most organized and doesn't answer emails. I like Kakie as a person, but she wasn't the best professor.
Best JOU teacher! If you have the opportunity to take any of her courses, DO IT!
My favorite teacher at the University of Kentucky. Very well respected in the journalism and media industry. Is very well networked and cares for her students!
Shows humanity while pushing you to be the best you can be.

Kakie is one of the overall best professors you will have at UK. She is full of interesting stories about her experience in the field and is always more than willing to help her students with anything they need.

Cancelled class a lot. Gave assignments and never graded them. Gave an assignment during finals week that she never explained. She's very unorganized. Expected more from her, since I've heard good things about her.

Kakie is an amazing person. She genuinely cares about her students and will do whatever she can to help them succeed. However, she tends to be fairly disorganized and may never grade your assignments. If you can look past that, her class is an easy A and she's a great person to have in your corner. Show her you care!

I love Kakie! Amazing professor. Knowledgeable. Easy A with good feedback. She goes above and beyond to make sure the students are valued as people. Does not use the textbook, so that was a waste of money :( . She makes class fun and allows phones but says, "I try to be more entertaining than your phones." She is!
Everybody loves Kakie. Do what she asks and you'll get an A.

Dr. Urschel is so sweet, but LORD is she lecture heavy and open response heavy. She wants super detailed responses and for you to find your own resources but uses about 97 per slide herself, which makes it super hard to find sources that aren't integrated in the PP's. There's a lot of writing and reading to the point that you will get burnt out.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I was excited to take this class, but I'm overall disappointed. We have 1 discussion and a quiz weekly, but for the discussions, she's EXTREMELY picky. I appreciate that the discussion question is open-ended but she says we can't use any sources from course materials, but then gives us 31 sources, so what are we supposed to pick as our source??

Dr. Urschel is great! Her lectures are very informative and is taught in a way that really helps you understand. There is not too much homework in this class and her exams are really formulated around homework and the notes from class.

Amazing professor. Has pre-recorded lecture videos that are optional (though highly encouraged) to give a baseline understanding. Lectures are so helpful and she prepares you extremely well for exams. Exams are 5-7 short answer questions, and extra credit is built into exams. Open note, so no reason to not do well. Favorite class & professor!

Posts lecture videos each for the material being covered in class that week. Always goes over the 50 minute time period when lecturing. The exams are taken online, in person, and are open note. However, you have 55 minutes to complete 6 or 7 multiple part questions, all written.

Dr. Urschel is a great professor. She wastes no time during her lectures but still makes sure to go over each topic in depth. The optional zoom meeting hours to ask questions were helpful. The exams were long but they were open note. I'd recommend this course to anyone interested!

Dr. Urschel is very kind. I had her for Equine Sciences, and her teaching styles are identical to those in ASC 325. She focuses on the major points, making the classes seem very worthwhile before applying to veterinary school. She never tries to trick you. She cares a lot about respecting others' opinions and treating everyone fairly. A fun class!

Dr. Urschel is a great teacher. The material is slightly difficult to understand but that is just the nature of physiology. Dr. Urschel does her best to make sure all students have a chance to succeed. She kind and is a great teacher.

She is very nice and very excited about her subject, which is always helpful. Her tests are based completely off her notes (we had no textbook for the course) but they do cover ALL the material; she wants you to be able to explain things back to her. As a person she is extremely sweet.

Dr. Urschel is a very  nice person and genuinely cares about her students. She is very smart and does a really good job of teaching. Her material is kind of difficult through no fault of her own it is just the nature of the material but she tries very hard to help her students out as much as possible and usually gives curves on the tests. Take her!
Unpredictable behavior. Not easygoing.

I read these previous reviews and expected to walk into a class that would be an easy A. That did not happen. Exams were open response, activities were graded super strict. He did give out significant curves, which brought my final grade from a high C to an A. Super flexible with office hours and makeup exams
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Testa is a good lecturer who cares about the material and knows it well. The course is well structured, and even though there are few assignments, it's very possible to do well. I really enjoyed the activities and they helped me to learn the material. Dr. Testa is also very accessible outside of class and very flexible with deadlines.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Testa is such a nice guy! I love his personality and he clearly knows his stuff. I thought at first that the chapter assignments were just going to be something to do just to get a grade. However, I was wrong. They are actually pretty fun and allow you to express your creative side, while learning the course material.

50% mini projects (10) but he grades so easy! his 2 exams were the other 50% and were really easy. I got B's on both and waited the night before to study, I never paid attention in class but he asked basic concepts. Easy A if you if your willing to put in the work. Attendance is non mandatory. He's super understanding + willing to change due dates

Dr. Testa is really funny and approachable, but I can't remember the last time I took an easier class, the exams are multiple choice, and the homework is 'activities' which are hard to explain in 350 words, but they're so easy to get 100%. The stuff in lectures looked hard but the exams were easier than most of my freshman year exams. Very easy A.

I understand him so much better than my previous professor. H actually knows what he talks about and uses his own powerpoint instead of from the book. He's funny in class and is respectable. He's also very chill, and not rude unlike most professors these days, he shows mercy.
BEST PROFESSOR EVER! He is to the point and makes lectures enjoyable.  It's a shame he only offers gen chem.  I already miss him.
Testa is an awesome professor who understands that we have lives outside of chemistry class. He is a great professor and makes office hours short, but SUPER helpful.

I believe Dr. Tests is one of the better choices in the chemistry department. He is a great professor and is relatable to the students. He is perfect for people who haven't taken a chemistry course prior to college because he will take and explain the material to the best of his abilities.

Dr. Testa definitely knows and understands what he is talking about, he just has a really hard time portraying this to his students. He often gets confused and makes mistakes when doing examples, and this made it really hard for me to learn from him.

Wonderful professor, makes class more fun by accidentally cussing when he makes a mistake. He makes everyone laugh, but makes sure all content is thoroughly understood after every step for every problem. Great help.

I never really understood chemistry in high school and got a C. I really enjoyed his teaching style.  He genuinely tries to help you understand the concepts.  He does reef participation every lecture though so you have to attend.  Notes are online.  There's not a lot of homework and its easy to do.  Exams are taken in class online and kindof hard.

Dr. Testa is AMAZING and will help you immensely, if you ask for it. Clicker questions are graded, so it is helpful to show up to class to get those easy points. Make sure to stop by Dr. Testa's office hours if you do not understand something covered in class. He truly cares if his students are understanding the material.
Dr. Testa tried to make this class easier but some of the changes just made it more confusing. He did his best to give you the credit you deserved and graded seminars fairly.

Best professor I've ever had at UK.  Extremely helpful and understanding.  I hated chemistry before I took this class, and I sucked at it.  I ended up with an A in the class and I learned a lot from him. Definitely recommend him!

Dropped his class after first two lectures. Reads off powerpoints. Shows examples in class that are not relevant. Everybody falls asleep in his class. So boring and he makes lot of mistakes while teaching. Would not recommend taking his class.

Testa knows a lot about chemistry, but teaching is not his thing. He tries really hard but he constantly told us the wrong things. I think I'd have had an A if I hadn't missed the 12-15 questions that I did based on his teaching alone. Class was dull and too casual. He gives you the feeling like he is teaching you but you should already know it.

By far one of the better teachers at UK. He knows his stuff, is really laid back, and is always willing to help. Attendance grades are taken and chances for extra credit are offered. Even after completing this class, I still find myself going to his office hours to get help with higher level courses. Great guy and knows what he's doing!!

Testa does a pretty good job trying to help his students. He knows his stuff, but he sometimes doesn't think things through and will tell his students the wrong thing. Can be confusing. Overall, gives some extra credit and is a nice guy.

He's very easy to listen to and he does not just read the powerpoints.  He seems very willing to help, however, I never needed one-on-one help from him.  From what I hear, he does much better in a small class setting, so try to get one of the smaller sections.
Extremely helpful. All around nice guy and give bonus points for attending office hours. Would love to see him as a 107 teacher. Works lots of problems and explains things very well. Loved him

Testa is an extremely helpful teacher. Though the class is hard, all the Chemistry classes have the same homework and test, so the professor you have wont really have any affect on the how easy the class is.  But Testa tries to make everything as easy as possible to try to comprehend and he is always there if you need help! (and he's hot too ;])

I love Dr. Testa. He is by far the best teacher I have ever had at UK. He is SOOOOO helpful and he typically drops everything he is doing to help you. He only teaches this class every 3 years but I hope he starts teaching it more. Very willing to help; will meet you almost anytime day or night and he won't let you leave his office until he is confi
Awesome Prof, He is helful at all times. You can e-mail him at any time and he will get back to you almost imediately. The class is fairly easy if you put effort into it, If you care he cares.

I had never heard about him cuz he only teaches this class every 3 years, but hes really nice and approachable. i think the materail can be really hard but he tries to make it as easy as possible. take him if u cant get woodrum, our class averages are right up there with hers.
Dr. Testa is an amazing teacher. He is very good at explaining things and is always willing to help. If you can't get Woodrum's class then definitely try to get into Testa's class.
the class actually keeps your attention. he goes a little fast, but we have not fallen behind the schedule yet.

Well he tries to do his best.  Sometimes he is not good at explaining what he's trying to get across and you have to know he's saying is wrong or your think its right.  But he will correct himself even if he said it days before. He also is willing to meet you outside of class until you get it done.  He also is good at giing reviews before test.
useless.

He was one of the more personable teachers I've had at UK.  He managed to seem interested even though there were 300 ppl in the class.  Moved quickly but was always willing to help in office hours or via email.

Chemistry is far from an easy subject but, if you want to make it through this class with a good grade then I highly recommend Dr. Testa.  He does go faster than most profs but thats b/c he doesnt waste time going over useless examples and if you ever need help on ANYTHING he's always willing to help, he typically explains things well,too HE ROCKS!

The class is relatively easy if you are good at math. He goes through material pretty fast, so read the book before you go to class. If you don't understand it, you can't ask questions (the class is LARGE).Testa seems to have trouble explaining things sometimes. He seems to get things mixed up a lot and confuse terminology. Good professor.
Goes through things fast. . . seems to just read his slides.
I don't think he explains things very well and he moves at an accelerated pace.  If you do not understand the material the first time he teaches it, then you are very behind.

Testa moves extremely fast through the material.  He also has some trouble explaining things in a way that students can easily understand.  He does help if you need it, but this class is definitely not easy.

The class is going to be demanding, but Testa is the man. If u go to class, and start studying in advance of exams, Testa will make sure you are prepared. This guy truly makes Chemistry seem worth while.
Dr. Testa rocks my world!
No Comments

Professor Ubelhor is by far the worst professor that I have ever had while at the University of Kentucky. Were he one of my first professors instead of one of my last few that I will have, I would have been disheartened to continue. He does not provide clear feedback, is harsh in what commentary he provides, and is not compassionate with students.

Made the mistake of reading an old calendar and logging on to the class a week late. Not only would he not let me take the first quiz late, which is fair, he also derided me over not having the wherewithal that a graduate student should have. There were no lectures either, just long rambling powerpoints and endless textbook readings.

Mr. Ubelhor's class is very unique if you keep an open mind. Some topics are controversial but makes for an interesting class because students have an open floor for discussion. If you can act like an adult and go to his conferences about your essay you'll do fine.On my last essay I was able to make a C on it and still get an A in the class :)

Anthony Ubelhor is not a bad teacher.  However, he is a cold-hearted individual.  He does not accept excuses in any form (even those approved by the University, i.e. death in the family).  Getting an A is not hard, as long as you do exactly what he says.  Note: DO NOT express any degree of appreciation for Steve Jobs, he absolutely despises him.

Would I say that Ubelhor's class was easy? Hell no! It's the hardest i had ever worked in an english class, however he is a very interesting teacher. He focuses more on opening your mind and writing with meaning. His teaching style is pretty good, though. If you work hard and go to conference hours, you should be fine.

he comes off very mean, however he is not that bad. in the beginning of semester, you do a lot of pointless writings which relate nothing to your papers. but by the end its so easy and you hardly do anything. if you got to class and his paper conferences you will do fine in the class!

He is very intimadting at first, but his classes are alawys interesting, he is definately not a boring teacher If you go to his conferences, he is very helpful. He is a very nice guy once you get to know him, and grades very fairly. I Recommend having him as a teacher!

Getting a distinguished portfolio needed to graduate high school, I thought English would be easy.  This was not the case. I would go to his office hours, get help from him for my paper, but still get a low C on every paper. I would suggest staying away from his class, unless you enjoy learning and writing about things such as Dreams.

He seems very intimidating at first, but he's a nice guy, if you respect the rules and act like an adult. He has a no-nonsense attitude and tells it how it is out in the real world, which I appreciated. Most class assignments are helpful, and his grading is actually fairly lenient, so it isn't a hard class.

It's obvious that the majority of people who have written negative reviews for this professor aren't very good writers to begin with, which is probably why they had so much trouble with his class. Ubelhor's class is challenging, but you will learn a lot and it will open your mind. This class really helped in making my college experience worthwhile.

the one thing everyone in this class understood was their hatred for anthony ubelhor. His class was more psychology that writing and his grading was nearly impossible if you are an average writer. do not take this class your gpa will suffer.

I am very good in english, but he graded this class much harder than necessary.  As it turns out he is also one of the world's biggest jerks.  I would take him again, under no circumstances.  One thing good about him is that if you go to his office he will help you, but this is only because he does a poor job teaching in class.

He focused way too much on the topic of the research and not quite enough on writing...and here i thought this was a writing class! Boy was i ever wrong! And he was exceedingly rude and snippity to all of his students. I would highly suggest that you avoid him.

This class was by far the worst class I have ever taken in my life.  I hated every minute of it and dreaded waking up and having to be in the presence of this man.  I would say I walked out of the class knowing nothing new.

At the beginning of the semester, I absolutely hated him/the class. I got a D on my first paper, and have always done very well in English (I got a Distinguished on my Senior portfolio). By the end, he had come around, and I was very glad that I didn't drop. And, he brought us pizza on the last day!

Great prof! He challenges the class to open their minds. He always allows students to sign up for times to go over papers before turning them in (strongly recommended). I would recommend the class for everyone!
Our (a friend of mine and me) nickname for him was "Ubelf*cker". Hope that explains a lot! Have a nice day.

When i signed up for this class i thought this would be just another english class. I didn't know i was signing up for psych. 101! This professor has serious issues, and i have never experienced such nastiness from a professor in my entire college career. ( The whole two years it has been)

When I signed up for this class I thought it was an english class not a psyc class he is byfar the worse teacher I have ever had in my life he cares nothing about his students and will make you feel as if you do not matter.He is very strict on papers and according to him you have to show him something he hasnt seen to get an A do not take this clas

The class is hard,he is pretty much the hardest teacher i have ever had.He doesnt care about your opinion,and you wont recieve above a C.He is very contraversial and very annoying.If your looking for an easy class,this is NOT for you!Your blood will boil upon entering the room...i suggest you drop the class if you get him as a teacher, and run far!
Strict on papers, it was more of a pyschology class than an english class. Very anti-christian, is into wiccan and alternative religions.

This is the worst class I have had in college. He says that most everyone will get a C and you should be happy with that. It is a very hard class and his topics suck! I would do whatever it takes to avoid having him. He is anti Christian and can be offensive at times. He favors girls and is a ****. DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS!

He has very anti-Christian views because he rebelled against his parents' Christian background. If you are easily offended or fiery about religious issues, then do your best to avoid his class. If you are somewhat gothic or dark, a must have professor. Decent writing teacher, otherwise.
Peruse and speed read for key points!! readings no less than 50 pages. felt like an UNDERGRAD class w/strict syllabus (changed thru semester)/ grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Usher has been one of my favorite professors at UK so far. She holds her students to a very high standard, but she is extremely communicative and helpful. She is very clear and specific about what she's looking for, so if you pay attention to detail it's not hard to do well. She also highly values student feedback and is flexible with lessons.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Watch your back.

Dr. Usher is a phenomenal educator with a lot of experience in self-efficacy research. She is well respected in her field and its quite an honor to take her course. She limits her class size to 10-15 and only one section. Don't blink because her course will fill up fast. She is tough on writing and APA standards but extremely helpful.

Course content was good and she was knowledgeable and helpful, but be aware of nitpick grading. Follows a more stringent scale of grading than most professors (93+ is an A instead of 90 or even 92) and even small mistakes can wind up costing you a larger percentage of your grade than it should.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Never, EVER, miss class!  You will miss something crucial that can't be made up by getting another student's notes.  Class activities, pop quizzes, and participation all count toward the grade.  And do everything you can to get and stay on her good side!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Incredible. Good soul
Great teacher
Horrible....straight Horrible.... this man is crazy and cant teach. Avoid as ALL COSTS!!!

It genuinely feels like Udvardy spends the whole semester trying to dominate her students rather than connecting with them in any meaningful way. She hates the idea of cheating so much that she damages any kind of professor-student rapport and disallows any room for creativity to avoid it occurring. One of the most stressful classes I've taken @ UK

I feel bad for writing this review about her because she herself is a nice person, and I wish no ill will towards her in any way, shape or form, but I would not take this class. She is not lenient at all and does not give any second chances on big assignments. Her lectures are very long, and the reading is wayyyy too much. I wouldn't do it again.

Review for Dr. Monica Udvardy (ANT 220)

Dr. Udvardy is knowledgeable but her lectures are dense and hard to follow. Study guides cover little of what's on exams, making it difficult to prepare. There's more focus on preventing cheating than supporting students. I would not take this course again or recommend it.

I have no issue with Dr. Udvardy herself, but there's no reason I should have to sit through 60+ minute lectures and read 100+ pages per week when the classes dedicated to my major have less than half the amount of work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I truly enjoyed this class! The subject was very interesting. Dr. Udvardy does important work with tribal communities in Kenya and Tanzania. She assigned, Trevor Noah's Born a Crime. The book was a great choice because it was entertaining while giving us insight into the political climate during and just after Apartheid South Africa.
Unless you're perfect id suggest someone else

took course online, didn't pay too much attention to lectures and passed with an A. writing assignments were easy so long as you actually tried on them. she is great professor and really cares about her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. U is very sweet, but for an online course, the amount of work required is INSANE. Almost comparable to the amount of work I do for chemistry which is outrageous. I spent $100+ on books required for this class and didn't even get every required textbook, lectures are INSANELY long as well. Requirements for the term paper seem about impossible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very clear grading structure. I did not buy the book and did fine, would not recommend again. She is very caring and will help you wherever she can. Would take again
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Be ready to watch a 2hr and 30min film, take a quiz, and read 2 chapters out of a book in one day. The course load should not be this heavy for an intro level class. Lectures are long for no reason often, lots of films to watch, long readings from text book, and so on.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Exams and Quizzes are fairly easy, however, the workload to be successful in this course is enormous. For example in one day we are expected to watch a entire film, read two chapters from a text book, and work on a 1200 word term paper. Some of my higher level courses in math and chem have less work load,

Dr. Udvardy is a very kind professor. She genuinely cares about each of her students and does try her best to connect with them. I will say the class does require work, and there are a lot of readings. However, she is very transparent on her grading requirements and gives honest and good feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Don't take this class if you want an easy A. You have pay to watch multiple 2hr+ films if you expect to do well. I watched every lecture, read the required book, read the textbook & still did poorly. Very unclear criteria for papers and exams. I've taken classes way harder than this and gotten A's. Sucks because parts of the class were interesting.

The amount of work assigned was not what I expected when signing up for a 100-level course. She is a difficult grader, and her lectures are very long. I wouldn't recommend this class if you are looking for an easy A.

Dr. Udvardy is very knowledgable about Anthropology and has interesting stories about her field work. Quizzes and exams are fairly easy but if you do not watch the lectures you will not do well. There is usually one or two lectures every week and they are VERY long. This was more work that I expected for a 100 level course.

For a 100 level course, she grades our term paper ridiculously tough. The term paper instructions was also ridiculously long. I have not enjoyed this class at all. I wanted an easy course for my last UK core credit because I am graduating this semester. If you want an easy course, do not take this one.
She is awesome and she knows so much! She really incorporates modern things into her lectures so its not boring. The course content has movies, books, and short documentaries.

I had to take this class for university credit and I ended up loving it! Dr. Udvardy really enjoys what she teaches which helps you learn the material so much better! She is so sweet and cares about her students. She gives great feedback and it was really enjoyable!

Amazing instructor as well as an amazing person. I do not understand where some of these negative comments are coming from regarding her opinions to be non-negotiable. I took this seminar and she seemed very receptive to everyones ideas/views. I believe people just assume they can not differ in opinions. Therefore, they assume she is this way.
The class i took was part of term so everything was jam packed together, but overall easy class. Material is easy to understand, put in the effort and you will get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: she is very very very sweet . love her.

Dr. U can seem kinda intimidating at first, but she's very kind and passionate about her subject area. The workload/reading looks like a lot on the syllabus, but its honestly pretty manageable, and she's not a hard grader. Was an easy honors credit.
Dr. Udvardy knows whats shes talking about, which makes lectures a lot more interesting. She grades fairly, and consistently. The only bad thing about her is she doesnt post PowerPoint slides
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Udvardy is amazing! Not sure why there are so many comments against her. One of my favorite professors. I have had several classes with her. In my experience she is an easy grader, ready to help, very passionate about what she does. She's very sweet and funny if you actually take the time to talk with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Ignore the three comments, she's fine.  She's passionate about the subject, and she's really nice.  After having her for the whole semester, I think the reason the commenters left bad ratings is because she thinks evolution is correct, but it's a cultural anthropology class, so idk what you expected.  Take the class, I enjoyed it.

She's is the only person who is right I her mind. Don't ask her about other ideas or philosophies because there is no discussion. She lectures and then spends an unnecessary amount of time explaining why she is right and that's the only answer.

This is an honors course and alot is expected but we are honors students.  I learned ALOT and really enjoyed it.  The lectures were clear, and the fieldtrips awesome.  I also liked the group projects.
This professor won't give ppt for review and never  give a study guide for exam.

Dr. Udvardy's class was hard to get through. She has a combative nature and it is hard to make any points that do not fall directly in line with what she believes. Her lectures are clear, but a lot of people in my class can't stand how pretentious and self-righteous she is.

Dr. Udvardy is a brilliant, very helpful professor, but if you are not heavily interested in anthropology and willing to devote as much work to this class as you would to a class for your major, do not take it. I found the class to be much more demanding than I expected to the point that it took away from my major classes at times.

I really enjoyed Dr. Udvardy. She is a very interesting person and teacher. She loves her subject, and you can really tell when she is teaching. Tests cover a lot of content, she barely gives you a study guide, but they are not as hard as you expect. On papers, she expects multiple drafts and she helps improve your grade on them.
She's very helpful. Make sure you read the book!

I disagree with previous comments.  Took this class this past spring and thought she did a great job. Very clear, great powerpoints. wish she would let us have them but other than that, no complainst.

I read the last two comments before the class started and I though, "She can't be that bad." Oh, but she is. If you have any condition that requires, shall we say tact, or privacy than this is not the professor for you. Even my Disability advisor was appalled by her actions. Also her study guides are along the lines of, "Just remember everything."
Very poor teacher.  Really, not all that much better as a human being, either.

By *far* the worst teacher I've ever had.  Lost my papers, graded completely unfairly.  She frequently said one thing in class but graded differently on our assignments.  Rude, unkind, and disrespectful.  Overall, to be avoided at all costs, especially for INT 495.  If she's teaching it, it's worth waiting for someone else!!!

She really cares about her students and is very willing to help.  I enjoyed class and what she had to say, she has a lot of interesting stories to tell.  She grades fairly easy. I plan on taking her again for something else if I get the chance!
I enjoyed the class.  She was nice and seemed VERY interested in what her students had to say.

This is what college should be about! Dr. Udvardy is just FABULOUS! I absolutely loved her class, there was never a day that I was bored. She's a very inspirational woman who is doing very great things. I have a tremendous amount of respect for her.
Terrible teacher. Would sit and talk about herself for the entire class period. Struggled to stay awake every day.

Easy and straightforward class. Not such a great teacher, however. She seems to teach straight from the book with little variance from the text. Also, she doesn't make students feel stupid, but she also doesn't seem to have much interest in what they have to say.

It's a fairly easy class.  Her tests are straightforward and exactly what is on the study guides.  My only problem was that she talked about herself and the things she has done as if it was an important part of history and we were tested on it.

Horrible teacher pawns everything off on her TA's and never deals with students spends more time talking about how great she is than saying anything about the class.  Can't teach if classroom equipment doesn't work
Excellent teacher. Agree w/ what everyone has said so far! :)
Pretty easy class

One of the few teachers outside of my chosen field that actually peaked my interest.  This is a professor who not only talks theory, but a prof. who has also done the field work.  What a great professor!  UK is fortunate to have her in their ranks!

Actually made learning Anthropology intersting.. I loved this class, and had absolutely no problem getting an A -- even without the curve she ended up giving... A seriously awesome teacher who makes a seemingly boring subject great !
very nice body....makes time slip by
Easygoing -- you can speak your mind without being laughed at or feeling silly.

Vogel was an amazing professor. She has the answers to any of your questions, but sometimes she can be a little condescending when you ask certain questions. Other than that, I was offered much help from her and her TA's throughout this class.

103 is a lot of out of the class work, so in class doesn't really matter but attendance is required. This class as 1 big project and the instructions aren't really clear, and Vogel often didn't know the answers to questions asked about the project. She grades very easy
Valerie Vogel is a great professor who will tell you how it is, and in EGR 103 that is needed. She is willing to help and wants you to succeed. I would recommend her to future students.
A great professor that wants her students to succeed. Always making sure everyone has what they need and clearly explains all assignments.
EGR101 is a very boring course, but Professor Vogel is extremely caring and wants success for her students. She values creativity and effort even in mundane assignments.

Valerie is likely the nicest professor you'll have for FYE at UK. She's very clear with lectures regarding assignments when the class meets. Assignments are really easy (except for some of the Force/Truss weeks) and often have complimentary instruction slides. If you're creative, you'll enjoy this class a lot!

Not bad at all, loved her and always open to helping if needed. There will be assignments due every week in which you have to answer reflection questions and mathematical questions, but shouldn't take much from your time.

Professor Vogel was an okay professor. Now I know there's multiple people in the class so it's hard for her to make her way around to everyone, but sometimes I would sit there and wait for over 15 minutes with my hand up before she made it to me or I just gave up. She also went through the material really fast sometimes which made it hard to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is just amazing.

I loved professor Vogel so much, I completely changed my next semester's schedule so I can take her again for 103. She is incredibly helpful and patient, and always delivers content in a clear, concise way. An amazing professor I will always recommend.

Dr.Vogel is very kind and very understanding. EGR-101 isn't a hard class apart from the Conservation of Mass Assignment, I recommend starting that assignment the day it is given so you have time to get help from office hours. There was only one assignment a week and they are generally pretty easy to do. The class is an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Vogel cares about the subject she is teaching and helps you succeed. She knows many students are coming in with no coding experience and uses that information to actually teach. Overall very helpful just need to put forth the work.

Class is easy, attendance is mandatory unless you want 1-2 letter grades dropped. Lot of funky rules that could auto fail you, but they are easy to avoid. Online tests that are easy and amazing TAs, overall a easy chill class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was more difficult than any of my major-specific courses. I genuinely felt like I need an Anthropology degree to participate.
Relatively good teacher, but has a lot of random rules that could mean an automatic fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Tomato tomato tomato

He's very intense in the way he lectures, which some people like, but I personally found it to be intimidating opposed to engaging. The weekly responses that open on Friday and close on Sunday are very annoying, but graded easily cause the TAs are great.

His class was very easy (online exams), he gave us 500 word responses every week and it would open Friday and close Sunday which was annoying. TAs grade those and are very easy graders. Controversial topics but if you fade lecture you will be fine you just need to know someone in the class who can send u the attendance code.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Really nice person and his lectures are entertaining, but his labs and exams are long and arduous. Also gives little to no feedback or directions on labs, and is very difficult to access via email.

A wonderful professor who brings his class to life with clever analogies and personal anecdotes. Has a great mad scientist vibe. Made me passionate in a subject I had no interest in. Homework is very regular but interesting.

Explains lectures very thoroughly. The class work consists of personal research to supplement his lectures give in class for a weekly Journal Entry/Short Essay. As long as you do your work and participate in this class everything comes together very easily for his final exam/project. He is also pretty lenient on grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: I had him last spring and a lot of people were confused for the class. He told me I didn't do something on my paper that I clearly did. In addition, many students missed some of the exams because he didn't remind or send an email until late and barely mentioned it in class. Also, on exams he makes you do very long and unneccessary questions. Do not

Please do not take this class if you don't have too. Leslie seems very nice but the amount of work she gives is unbelievable. She makes you do video tutorials on how to use SPSS software which is already difficult as it is. I have never disliked a class so much in my life. Take any other professor if you can and if not, GOOD LUCK.

Pros: Major requirement

Cons: Busy work, stress overload, complete reconsideration of my major all together
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Online B+E201 is super easy as long as you stay on top of the work load. I took this as an elective and I would say it was not a super hard A but not the easiest A class I have taken.

I've had her 3 times now. She tends to be pretty slide heavy, but she is super understanding and caring. She is also the department chair so super busy but is still extremely cool and down to earth. A very safe bet for a Professor if you ask me. She is very likeable which makes up for the sometimes boring slide heavy lectures. Average difficulty.
Leslie cares about her students and always gives great lectures.

Dr. Vincent is a very kind and caring professor. Although the class can be boring, she always tries to keep us engaged. The exams are difficult, and there are several lengthy homework assignments and group projects. She provides in-class work days to help us. Be sure to attend class; she does check-in assignments.

One exam, which counts for 30% of grade.

Choose your group carefully because there is a significant amount of group work.  If you have a great group, no worries!  If you have a poor performing group, this course could be painful.

I thought this class had an appropriate workload. No excessive writing assignments/reading expectations. Prof is very friendly and it is clear that she cares about her students. Lots of groupwork, some of the content in the projects felt disconnected from class. The final exam is weighted more than I'd expect but it wasn't bad.

Absolutely awful professor. Asks for one thing on work, then marks off when you do it, saying she wanted more. Take home mid-term is long and arduous,16-20 hours of writing to finish for an A. If she doesn't like you, she will make you work twice as hard til you fail or quit her class, which happened to a cohort member. Rude during office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Literally amazing human. Total mom energy and really wants the best for her students. Wants every student to succeed and provides the resources to do so
She is awful. Stay away, will give you 50's for actually doing your work. Most of our class recieved terrible grades. Acts like her class is the most important thing ever.
The instructions for some assignments were very confusing. Extremely nit picky on exam grading.

Where to begin? Loves reading and writing 50 pgs-wk common. Bullet points are OK then tells you to explain. Write in narrative and you get a good grade. Sem. long project in 4 parts - ridiculously long and arduous 1 take home MT test w/a lot of writing and research to complete it. Many grp proj in class. All busy work not sure I learned anything
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Took her online summer class . Exams were decently hard but there is more grades than just the exams.

I'm convinced that whoever has previously rated her poorly were drunk when they rated her. Is her class challenging? Yeah somewhat but it's college. She's really fair, really fun, does what she can to make sure you succeed and is just a great person overall. I'd recommend her to anyone.
Terrible
Doesn't clearly outline in lecture what is expected on test then socks it too you. Grading is unreasonably tough for marketing. I would avoid her at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: The material is very easy but the exams are extremely hard. She asks a question that could have several answers but there is a "best fit" one that is the correct answer. Other than exams the assignments are easy and attendance is not required but it beneficial.

Class isn't mandatory but if u r there & show that u looked at the short reading then u will get points for participation. The readings were interesting & were most of the class. There r 2 tests and they r right from the PowerPoints. There r 2 papers that r pretty easy if you follow ur notes. There r 2 simulations that r kinda hard & time consuming

Does not engage in class – minimal interaction with students and limited participation in discussions.

Not responsive – questions from students, including critical ones about Debian, have gone unanswered.

Ineffective teaching approach – lack of guidance, delayed to no feedback, and insufficient support makes it hard to learn and stay motivated.

I enjoyed her lectures. I would describe her as energetic and easy to talk to. The class is very manageable. There are few assignments worth a lot of points. However, she gives these assignments out in a timely manner. Attendance does matter, make sure to show up! Overall, this class was an easy A and good to take for a core requirement.

Dr. Virtue cares & is nice, ICT200 was mediocre. Slow to respond to emails & cancels class randomly, but easy A, provided you try. Online (graded attendance) discussions that relate to reading (so do the reading). Nothing really learned in lectures; attendance taken every time, worth sitting through. Nice person, easy class, just not fulfilling.

Will cancel class via email, 5 minutes after class started. Lectures are very boring and repetitive. There are no exams mainly all projects but is a tough grader. You have to attend class and if you don't you grade will go down a whole letter grade. Cares about mental health but not students success. Calls on people in class!! Would not recommend.

No exams or anything and the workload is light, but projects are worth a lot of your grade. I emailed her 3 times over a project worth 20% of my grade, never responded. She cancels class frequently but when you have questions it makes it very frustrating. Also, missed class ONCE and my grade went from 99 to an 80- almost a C. How is she a teacher?
She is very understanding and willing to help. If you do your work you will do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Virtue is a great professor she really cares about each of her students and grades extremely fairly.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Avoid if possible. Her feedback style is very public students are often critiqued harshly in front of the entire class, creating a discouraging atmosphere. While the syllabus suggests a supportive environment, her interactions feel dismissive and make it difficult to engage with the material. The workload is heavy on busy work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Had Professor Vos for CPH 202, Public Health Through Popular Film. Class wasn't too difficult but the grading criteria was terrible, especially from the TA's. The mid-week assignments aren't bad, but for the essays and exams the grading is unclear and when you ask why you got such grade they wouldn't help you understand. Final project and exam + :/

Quizzes are once every couple days, either over a film or a reading for homework. Timed (1 min per question), cannot go back to a question, cannot see answers after submission. The class is a film class, yet we have many readings and outside projects on top of those movies. Work load is a lot, quizzes are extremely hard for what they need to be.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: 10000% the best instructor I have ever had. She MAKES it her job for you to have the tools to succeed in the real world/after graduation. Her lectures are incredibly engaging and it shows through how much she cares about each individual student and their specific needs! Best woman and human I have met in the walls of Gatton.

A literal angel. I had her during her first semester at UK (fall 2023), and am not someone who participates much in class but she still went out of her way to learn my name and face. She genuinely cares about her students and wants to see them succeed in all paths of life. Easy tests and projects, just show up and participate.

One of the absolute best teachers I have ever met on campus, and just in general. She truly is a teacher that is aspiring to help you and help turn your dreams into reality. She's easy to get a hold of outside of class and always open for discussion to clear anything up. Truly, cannot recommend her enough as a teacher.
Best teacher inside the walls of Gatton. Wonderful lady

Professor Whitaker was a great teacher. She will go out of her way to help you with things outside of the classroom. If you miss class repeatedly, your grade can drop a full letter grade but the course content is not difficult to understand if you are there everyday.

Not accommodating and acts more like a robot than a human… gave cold call for points towards books we were supposed to read. The review slides were nothing like the exams, which were super hard. It was the worst experience of college and I would rather do anything than take his class again. I'd consider transferring to remain far away.
Participation is big, if you miss a class you should be okay but you might lose participation points. Might have an activity to do every other day of class.

I have had Dr. Wedeking for both PS 360 and PS 463G. In taking these classes, it was clear to me that he is truly passionate about what he teaches and he encourages his students to think outside the box when it comes to analyzing academic texts and how the US court system operates.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Had Wedeking for 360. This class is a major step up. Lots of reading and larger political science research concepts being discussed. Super interesting but definitely a high level class. There is one big 15 page research paper be aware. No attendance but random participation days.

He is a good professor; he isn't as hard as people make him out to be. You need to have the readings up in class to keep up if you dont do them. His exams are hard at first, but all he is looking for is an understanding of the concepts he is teaching. He specifically looks for keywords and certain cases mentioned in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: A lot of readings and the lectures are fairly dry. But he clearly knows his stuff, and he gets all the information across clearly. He's also very good at engaging the class. He's a very good teacher but just don't expect his class to be the highlight of your day.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Had a great time learning in Dr.Wedeking class. Started the class with a D because I was overwhelmed with a lot but ended up passing the class with a B. His exams can be challenging bcz some questions on the exam is only taught in class and not on the slides or books; that is why I would recommend going to class as much as possible!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Wedeking is a great professor. Required course for PS major. Class attendance is mandatory, and you will read a few mandatory books with papers due, but they are interesting. His tests are a little hard, even if you study, so you'll need like a week or two to truly study. Super accessible outside of class.

One thing I will say is that attendance in this class is very key. Attendance grades are weighted heavily. If you show up you should be fine. Two books to read, both are super interesting and easy reads.

Dr. Wedeking's lectures can be pretty dense at times, but as long as you do the readings, he's easy to keep up with. His exams are intimidating at first sight, but you just need to have a general understanding of the concepts and you should be fine. He's not half as hard as people make him out to be.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

Go to class because participation is a grade. Decently hard class, but he did a good job of helping students.

Very good professor and willing to work with students. His exams can be tricky but I would recommend going to his office hours and asking lots of questions in class. He is a tough grader but willing to work with you if you try
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Lecture heavy, but if you go and take notes you'll be good. Attendance is mandatory, even if he says otherwise, go to class, it will impact your grade. Do the readings, textbooks and the other books. Tests are fairly difficult for a PS class, but doable.
Wedeking was a very understanding, and kind professor. His lectures were very good, and it is vital to take good notes and participate. I would take him again.

Wedeking is not a very engaging professor so lectures were very dry. With this being a constitutional law class, there was a lot of reading involved. The tests were mostly free response and he was a tough, but fair grader. We did a mock trial in this class. It was a bit stressful, but as long as you give it your best he will give you an A for that
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He is not a fair grader at all.

Wedeking was great. All of our exams were on canvas which made them pretty easy, although he was looking for quite a bit of detail in the free response section. The final was optional for us as this was the year of all the tornados in KY and he knew that it affected people in his class. Good guy, and I would definitely take again!

his class is tough because there are only 5 grades (3 tests, a paper, and a legal brief) so if you do poorly on one thing it is tough to come back from but he knows his stuff and is super helpful. i was sick for 3 weeks and missed a lot of class and he helped me with missed notes and offered to let me makeup a test later. 10/10 would take again

Wedeking was absolutely delightful. If you don't like the judiciary or aren't interested in it, just don't take the class! If you are, however, you will learn so much. reviews.comment: He's your typical powerpoint professor, but he knows his field and is a pretty solid instructor. Asking questions is the best way to succeed in his class.

reviews.comment: He is the best professor I have ever had. Letting me take a make up exam to be able to experience game 7 of the world series in Wrigleyville, Chicago. 10/10 great caring professor.

Class is somewhat uninteresting, but the professor is a nice guy. Keeps class involved with the discussion. Attendance is not mandatory, but some classes do have assignments that count toward a participation grade. Clear lectures and puts slides online. I would take another of his classes in the future.

Wedeking is awful. He takes the least interesting material out of a subject and puts them into his powerpoints. His classes go on forever, his lectures are useless, baseless and boring. No real passion for his own profession either which is both disrespectful to students and unprofessional. Hammers the same worthless concepts over and over again.
This was a good class. I learned and found the material interesting but it wasn't a super hard class either. You do need to do the reading before class though so you know what he's talking about.
Great prof
Pretty average class.. Only two tests and a lot of attendance quizzes. Tests are pretty difficult and he can be kind of unclear. I wouldn't recommend the class unless you had to take it.

There is a bunch of reading, which I wouldn't suggest doing till he tells you what will be covered on the exam. Pretty fair grader, notes are all on power point which he posts. Essentially if you do some work you will do well. The tests though are a bit tricky.
No Comments

This class is not an easy A. Professor Voss is an incredible teacher his lectures are engaging, and his depth of knowledge is clear. However, if you're not genuinely interested in history/politics, this isn't the right class for you. The tests are graded very strictly, attendance isn't technically required, BUT going to class is why I got an A.
Test are extremely hard with averages being D's and F's but puts a heavy curve. Everything is put on a curve because the class is structured on the 400 or 500 level.

Dr. Voss' class is not as bad as everyone says. His tests are very difficult and mainly reflect topics he spoke on in lectures, but if you take in depth notes and pay attention you will be completely fine. I would start to study two nights before a test and attend the study session hosted and do very well (with the curve) every time.

Dr. Voss' tests are not as hard as many people make them seem, but you do need to study and pay attention during lectures. There is a lot of reading that also requires comments and interaction with other students' comments, which are graded.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Difficult tests but fair grader, you will do well if you attend lectures. Accommodating if needed, Interesting lectures and definitely cares about what he is teaching about.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof. Voss is a great teacher with super engaging lectures, but if you don't show up, you're basically done for. Be ready to read and annotate 50+ pages weekly. I wouldn't recommend this as a 101 class because the tests are very difficult, even with the curve. The good news: he responds to emails fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Voss is very clearly an extremely intelligent professor. He's a very charismatic lecturer and I wish his exams could reflect his lectures better. They're very difficult to the point I got an exam score in the 60s and in the 30s and both were curved to a B. I'd recommend him, but be willing to always go to class and take excellent notes.

He is a very nice teacher, and his lectures are great. The TAs grade your tests, and some grade harder than others, but then the curve for that TA's section is steeper. Lectures are super important, and if you don't come, you won't do well. The SI instructor is very helpful.
Exams are extremely hard for no reason, so everyone fails and he has to do a very heavy curve so the class average isn't a 20%.

Amazing professor. He knows what he's talking about and is very passionate about his job. Exams are difficult but he does curve them. Very lecture heavy so if you miss one and you don't get the notes, your cooked. I love this class, 10/10 I absolutely recommend.

His grading system is awful. His 101 classes are so difficult that the average grade on his exams is an F. And that's not an exaggeration at all. So he is forced to curve everyone in the class upward in order to continue teaching 101 level classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: If you are a good test taker and you study you will be fine. This class was so interesting and his lectures are AMAZING. He is an incredible professor and very accessible! Definitely make sure he knows you as it is so helpful for the class! If you show up to lecture, you will be fine! Loved this class! The reason I switched to Poli Sci!

This is the worst professor I have ever had. His tests do not reflect anything from lecture and he makes them almost impossible to pass. I am an average A or B student and these are the worst grades I have ever received. Save yourself and do not take his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I read the reviews for him before I took his class and was terrified, but you shouldn't be at all. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

He was very passionate about the material which I liked, I didn't like how the exams were graded though. I feel like even if I studied all of the material, the tests were still hard and didn't relate. The curve was weird and I didn't like how I didn't know my grade. I did learn a lot, just didn't do well on the exams.

Voss, is one of the best professors I have ever had! He truly cares about the students & what he teaches. You can tell he enjoys teaching as well & this is a great quality to have!

Advice on success: 
-Do NOT skip class!
-Read EVERYTHING!
-Quiz yourself. Make sure you are able to verbalize terms & their importance.
-Get a study group!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Respected

reviews.comment: Dr. Voss is the best professor I have had, as he cares more about student comprehension then grades. His lectures are entertaining and you'll want to make sure you go to them. As long as you show up prepared to work, you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This Professor is the worst prof. I have ever had and ever will have in my life. reviews.comment: I had Voss last semester. you won't know your grade the whole semester and I feel like that puts an unreasonable amount of anxiety on the majority of people. reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Voss is as thorough as any PS professor I've had. This brought out the best in our class even when my classmates tried to slack off the course content. reviews.comment: He was such a bad grader and never clear about anything. A 28% was considered a B???

reviews.comment: Stephen Voss is by far the best professor I've had at UK. Honestly hes a fair teacher if you do the work you will do well. The grading scale he uses is confusing but if you do the math you get a good idea of what grade you have. reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: The best lecture I've ever had. You have to do the reading and notes because the best is timed and on the harder side. But overall a good Prof and a good class.

reviews.comment: Take this course if you want to have a hint to tell you that you are not build for college

Voss was a very hard professor. His class is graded on a curve because it is so hard so you don't know your grade all year which is frustrating. The tests were very hard and cover very specific things in the readings. My advise would be to dedicate time everyday to really understand the readings.

Dr. Voss is the best professor you will have here at UK. I mean the man is top of the line and not bias at all.
