Never have I been more entertained and engaged during lectures. This class rewards hard work and Dr. Voss is available outside of class. Please take ps101 with him if given the opportunity. Dont be intimidated hes fantastic. Really, this was a class Ill never forget.

I took him my freshman year and I couldnt have had a better experience. If youre looking for a class to half ass this isnt the class for you. I left his class more knowledgeable and a overall better student.

reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof. Voss is by far one of my favorite lecturers. He makes his lectures interesting and worth your time. Prof. Voss is the best lecturer I have ever taken. He is interesting, funny, and knows just about everything about political science. Voss is definitely a great professor, but he is not an easy one. He is a hard grader, covers a lot of material in his lectures, and makes you read a lot of material online in canvas. reviews.comment: Voss was easily one of the best professors that I've ever had. Lectures were extremely interesting, and made up a majority of what was going to be on the exams. Exams were tough, but if studied the lecture notes it wasn't too bad. This class is a lot of work, but I really enjoyed it overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is an awesome teacher and really likes the material.  He is super friendly and accessible.  There is a lot of reading but anyone that says it's excessively hard usually doesn't go to class.  Go to class and read and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Voss is the best Professor I have had at the University of Kentucky. I have taken multiple courses under his instruction and hope to take any more that he should teach. Dr. Voss is a teacher who is Harvard educated and it shows. He tries to develop points and connect all areas of learning which develop well one's critical thinking ability.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Yes, he does give huge curves but that doesn't mean the class is easy. Even with the enormous curves (one test gave like 50 points), I would still get B's on everything, and I spent a ridiculous amount of time studying beforehand. Taking his class was totally worth the B though. His lectures are incredible, so interesting. Great for PS majors.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Voss, a professor with his doctorate in government from Harvard, tries to make every student in the class feel like they have no clue what is going on; he does very well at it too. He tries to make it seem harder than is actually is, if you get past that and realize its a 100 level class simply with confusing readings , you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: One of the best teachers I have ever had! Great lectures, and needed to pass! Notorioua for being super hard, but its college get over it
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class involved a lot of studying, but was worth it. Dr. Voss is extremely intelligent and makes his class fun to attend. He curves all of the exams so that helps out a lot, I recommend taking him if you are a PS major/minor.

I absolutely loved Dr. Voss. One of the hardest classes my Freshman year but also one of the most rewarding. His tests are difficult but his curve makes up for it, as long as you read and go to lecture you will do fine. You can really tell his passion for PS and thats what made his lectures so enjoyable. Although attendance is not counted, GO.

Legislative Process; Dr. Voss is a skilled lecturer and always makes his presentations engaging and pertinent. His assignments definitely make you work. His tests are difficult and project/paper require lots of time, however, he is a professor that really wants his students to learn and is willing to go the extra mile to provide a strong education.

hard entry level class, if you get through it you will see the upper levels are not as hard. I did not like his style of teaching or grading. Youre grade is based on the class. If you get a 60 on each exam , you get an A.
The tests are extremely hard, but has a huge curve. As long as you go to class and study, you will do fine.

Dr. Voss was one of my favorite professors. He gets really into his lecture subjects and is easy to listen to during lectures. I really didn't go to class all that often and still managed to get a good grade. Tests are crazy tough, and there's a LOT of reading assignments. No textbook, only a WSJ subscription, which is only $15. Overall great class

not really the "intro to american government" I had expected. More of a history class until the last portion of the semester where he throws it all together. Wasn't impressed. Attendance is absolutely mandatory and don't be shaken when you find out the average on all of the exams are below 50%. If reading isn't for you, drop now.

He is a very good professor, but the average test score is 40%-50%, and if you don't go to class you won't do well.  He does post most powerpoints online, but if you don't know what he said in lecture then you won't get what you need from the powerpoint.  I would not take this class if you're looking for an easy class.
He's a  great professor. Yes, it's hard work, but he actually wants you to learn. Don't take his class if you're lazy. An A is absolutely possible, but isn't easy.

Dr. Voss is an expert in his field. He went to Harvard, so he's very intelligent. Expect to put in at least 10 hours a week. You should really only have him if you're a PS major IMO. His tests average in the 30s/100. Not worth the work for a 100 level. Wrote his own text book, he posts it on BB! $15 WRD Subscription is mandatory though.

My only problem with Dr. Voss is that he may be too smart for his own good. His directions and wording on tests, online and other class material is very comprehensive and seems unfit for a level 100 class. Otherwise, his lectures are entertaining, he is funny and overall a good guy. He curves the tests and if you study hard you will end up ok.

I don't recommend taking his course. PS 101 was a one hundred level class that he made entirely too difficult. His exams are horrible. The average for our 1st exam was a 46%. That should say a lot. He doesn't give study guides and just expects you to know everything. I am a 4.0 student, attended every lecture, studied, and still struggled.

The amount of reading in this class is ridiculous. The avg. grade on exams is a 45-50%. He does give a nice curve, but the class is all around stressful and way too much reading that you have to do for a 100 level course. I do not recommend taking this unless you enjoy reading a ton.
Terrible Professor made the class way harder than need be

He posts all his slides online but in order to succeed you have to go to class. He says so many specific things during class that are important for the tests. The tests are rough but definitely doable if you do the readings and go to class.
One of the best classes I've taken. Dr. Voss is a really good lecturer and tells awesome stories to illustrate his points. Overall, he is one of my favorite professors at UK.

Dr. Voss is one of the most knowledgeable professors I've had. But his exams are very hard. But he curves HEAVILY! If you're an A student you'll get an A in the course, if you're a B student you'll most likely get a B, same with C, D, and E. Highly recommend if you're very interested in U.S government but be aware of what is to come.

He is a smart person in his field, but is not a good 100 level teacher don't take him, exams are very hard, he is really boring, if you are not interested in the subject better US citizenship classes out there, he does curve well but really, + bonus i got 18100 and i studied well for the exam got 100 on all hw quizes but i got an e for midterm.

You must GO TO CLASS. If he sees that people are skipping, he will give you hints on what will be on the test, and trust me THAT MAKES A DIFFERENCE. The tests are really hard, but if you actually try hard, the curves will be on your favor! GO to office hours, he is very friendly.

Dr. Voss is a very intelligent and engaging professor. His lectures are always interesting and on topic. He is sure to give you all the information you will need on a subject, along with a good story as well. I would take him again.

Voss was a great professor. He loved talking about his field and he sticks with his material as far as what's on the test. No textbook, just a WSJ subscription. A lot of articles, but all fairly short. I missed a ton of lectures and still passed. He posts all of his notes and lectures, so it's easy to stay connected. Great class. Easy for me.

I loved taking PS101 with Dr. Voss. His lectures are very interesting, but you need to go to all of them if you want to do well in his class. There's no textbook, but a fair amount of articles that you'll need to read. If you have any questions, I've found that he's very helpful if you just ask. All in all, a great class and intelligent professor!

There is a lot to learn from Prof. Voss. His lectures are full of information which you will see on the tests. The tests are definitely tough with a mix of defining questions, multiple choice, and short answer. There is no text book, but a $15 subscription to the WSJ, therefore saving you money! MUST Work hard! Worth the time and effort for sure!

I absolutely loved my time in his classroom. He is not an easy teacher, not because the material is hard, but because he makes you critically think, which is a skill most college freshman don't have. It's definitely not a "memorize and make flash cards class"; it requires a deeper understanding. He is a great professor, and his class is worthwhile.
He is a tough teacher but if you go to class and actually pay attention you will be fine! When you are taking notes make sure to write what he is talking about rather than whats on the power point.

Great professor & intelligent in his field. His tests are difficult but you will learn so much from him. I usually hate historygovernment classes and I enjoyed this class because he made the content very interesting. Attendance isn't technically mandatory but he doesn't use a textbook so attending class is really the only way to learn the content.

Dr. Voss is one of UK's most intelligent professors. As everyone else says on this page, make sure you attend lecture. Dr. Voss works with a very intense curve. Basically the top 20% of grades get A's. Next 40% get B's, and so on. The three tests will most likely have you pulling your hair out but you will be thankful to have taken this course.

Dr. Voss was the best professor I've had at UK hands down. His class was very hard, but it was rewarding because I learned a lot, and even though the tests were tough, I ended up with a B in the class.  He presents material well and is extremely intelligent. I wouldn't advise skipping his class, and tests require a lot of studying.

Prof. Voss is one of the best lecturers at the University of Kentucky. He is extremely educated and far from boring. I always enjoyed going to his class. His tests are practically impossible but he uses such a high curve that your grade at the end reflects honestly how hard you tried. I would not take anyone else for PS101.

If you're looking for a cakewalk, do NOT take Dr. Voss. He is one of the most intelligent people I've ever taken, and it shows. Lectures are really interesting if you go into them with an open-mind. He does curve his exams tremendously, but don't let that be an excuse to do poorly. Take him if you've got the chance to
Lectures are hard to follow.

The best professor I've ever taken. I'm definitely a politico, but Dr. Voss is one of the most intelligent professors at UK; the guy is a Harvard-alum political educator at its finest. Not an easy A, but take the class-- you'll be happy you did.

My favorite professor Ive ever had. He is so smart and keeps things so interesting. If you listen to his lectures and write everything down then you will succeed. Just try to stay interested if you normally do not like American govt.
Dr. Voss is my favorite professor with the most interesting lectures. The class is challenging but the extra work is worth your while.

The best professor I have ever had.  Makes the class interesting and keeps content relative to current events.  He talks fast and expects people to figure out what is important.  But, he is very good at answering questions and clarifying and confusion.  His test are challenging and cover everything, but does not test on anything unfair

By far my favorite professor in the political science department. Many others are radically liberal and it shows, not so with Dr. Voss. This class was very challenging, but he revelead after Exam 1 that he usually curves so that 75% of the class gets an A or B. His lectures are really interesting as well.

Dr. Voss expects a lot from you for a 101 class. Be prepared to take notes without a powerpoint. Some questions on the test are so detailed you would have had to read the textbook closely. I felt like I knew what I was doing on the tests and got a 39% on the first one. However, I ended up with an A and received a nice email from him.

Dr. Voss is the most intelligent and interesting professor that I have had to date.  He is sometimes overwhelmingly informed and he expects incredible work from his students.  If you want a class that will be ultimately very difficult but, worth the effort Dr. Voss is the best choice.

this class is very overwhelimg. dr voss is an amazing teacher. the exams are extremely difficult but he curves. i got a 40% on the first test and it was considered a B. The text book helped me a lot so i would reccomend buying that. If youre looking for an easy A, dont take this class but its not impossible either.
It's definitely a demanding class, but totally worth it if you're interested in government. Dr. Voss is really smart and interesting. I would definitely recommend this class!

Dr. Voss is a very smart professor, he knows a lot and expects students to work hard. There is a lot of reading and the exams are very challenging, but he curves heavily. He understands that we are students and we pay a lot for our education, he tries to give his students the best education for their money. He will make you think and work hard.

Dr. Voss is one of the most amazing professors and individuals I have ever met! He is an amazing teacher! He does give very hard test but as long as you do the work and show up for class you should be just fine. He is the best professor I have ever had in my college experience! You should take his classes any chance you get!

Dr. Voss is unbelievably knowledgeable about about the subject manner, as a Harvard Poly Sci Grad. should. His tests are ridiculously hard and are over immense amounts of material (including many wall street journal articles, which are on tests). Do NOT take his class!!! ...unless you want to work really freakin hard for an A. [3 exams+paper=grade]

This class was my very first college lecture and it was great. At first you might feel he's intimidating but actually he's just a really passionate professor. The tests are extremely hard but he curves massivly so dont fret about that. I would definitly recommend this class to anyone even remotly interested in government/history/law.

He is a very smart man who knows what he is talking about. Three exams=three grades of the semester. Don't fret, he gives huge curves. An A is totally doable as long as you go to class and study a normal amount. Lectures entire class but is open to questions. Will call you out if you are talking. Good teacher. Exams are lengthy but fairly graded

Lengthy lectures everyday - your typical 101 class. Tests are extremely hard and he expects you to know A LOT of detail, despite him telling you otherwise. On top of it all, his TA's are extremely picky in their grading and seemingly take off points for no reason. Fortunately he curves HUGE at the end. Decent class, but not great.

If you want to learn from a true scholar, take a class - any class - from Dr. Voss.  He is a gentleman and one of the best lecturers around. Staggering knowledge of his material, and incredible ability to communicate historical and political events.  Don't let your cell phone ring, and DON'T talk to your neighbor during a lecture.

He's a great professor. I loved this class, it was hard but not one of my harder classes I took this semester, so it is definitely doable, and if you go to class and read everything you will most likely get an A.

Definitely not one of the easier 101 classes at UK... Dr. Voss is a tough professor.  He  knows his stuff, but expects too much out of his students and only takes 3 grades the whole semester.  The grades are tests which get curved but are the hardest tests I've ever taken.  Good luck, you'll need it!
This teacher is awful.  His tests are incredibly hard. He knows what he is talking about but expects way to much for exams.  Do not take him.
tests are NO joke, but all of his content is on blackboard!
Great Teacher.

overall, he's a great teacher. youll take A LOT of notes and he assigns articals from the "Wallstreet Journal" to read. they ARE on his tests. his tests are HARD but he makes up for it. he determines letter grades based off the class average. attendance isnt mando but its in your BEST interest to go! funfact:he also looks like danny off full house!
Best Professor at UK, hands down.

Excellent professor if not the best professor i have. Teaches the subject on a very neutral standpoint which is rare among political scientists. he is informative and extremely knowledgeable.(P.H.D. from Harvard University) DO NOT EXPECT TO BE LAZY AND SKIP CLASS. YOU WILL PAY FOR IT DEARLY!!!

The guys is a book nerd...never had a real job...a bunch of internships, part time work and a life time of books.  Without universities, this guy wouldn't be qualified to pick up your garbage.  I think he is also postin on his own site too!

Class: Congressional & Presidential Elections.  Dr. Voss is a great poly sci professor, knows what he is teaching, and expects his students to reciprocate his efforts.  You will definitely need to read, show up for class, and participate to succeed.

Been here 4 years & Best prof @ UK! He's so slick, he's so fantastic..don't worry bout "if you can get by without going to class." Go to class, be captivated, be entertained. He's like Bill Nye in the morning's for big kids with politics.
This guy is awful.  Creepy.  Stares at my chest during lecture.  YUCK!
voss is the best teacher at uk, period. if you read and attend class, the tests are do-able. However, be prepared for a low grade initially, he will curve them later!

A very energetic and astute professor, if not one of my favorites.  He loves challenging the class' beliefs.  The class requires a lot of work, but he really loves interacting with the students---like, a lot.
No Comments
great prof, hard class, very willing to help.
Very hard, curves like hell. Go to lecture!

Great professor! I would highly recommend this class. The lectures are very interesting and if you come to class, you will have no problem. Tests are lengthy, but if you are a good writer and able to express your ideas, it's not too hard to get a good grade--especially with his large curves.

If your not a poli sci person you might want to go for someone easier but he's amazing. you HAVE to go to class EVERYTIME and he curves. Make sure your TA is good. That's really helpful. All and all Steve's awesome
Voss is the boss.  He is the best prof in the poli sci dept.  He will seduce you with his engaging lectures.  Yeah you have to work hard but you learn alot.  Voss rocks my face off period.
what a freak!!
No Comments
Trust me, just avoid these classes.
awesome teacher. taught just as much about political science as how to perceive it

Voss is a generally nice guy, and his test curve is on average 30 points. He helped to write the primary text book used in the class, so it can often be read in place of taking notes in class. I passed this course with a C and attended class probably less than 25% of the time.

Best class ever because of Voss.I had him for 101 and then 461 and both were the best classes the PS department has. He is an amazing professor and is very passionate, which motivates you to do well. If PS major, do not leave UK with out having him once. A challenging course but interesting.
Great Prof, tells you how it is and makes class fun
Great Prof, tells you how it is and makes class fun

Voss is a great teacher, very smart and is good at teaching. His tests are hard but if you go to class everyday and read a little of the required text its not all that hard at all. The reason why most people struggle is b/c they dont attend class and don't read. Do yourself a favor and take him.
His lectures are interesting and clear. His tests are challenging, but they have a huge curve so don't worry too much! His class was one of the most enjoyable I've had.
Great teacher makes it very enjoyable yet all the while makes it applicable and interesting.
You'll really enjoy his lectures.  Thank God he curves the exams though...
He was challenging but interesting.  I learned more about US government and understand more about the political backround of this country.
Do not take.
I thought this guy was a good teacher?  Swing and a miss!  I got some bad advice.
No Comments
extremely smart man,you will read a tone if you take his class and you have to read to get a half way good grade
No Comments
Likes to curve, because he has to, if not everyone would fail.  Fabulous lectures.
A great professor, made my freshman year at UK really memorable and gave some of the most interesting lectures and worthwhile advise.
No Comments
No Comments
No Comments
My hero and mentor.  Not the easiest, but the best.
In lectures, he rants about how bad society is. Exams are much harder than any material he gives to practice. The practice exams are not his, and he crosses out half the stuff on them anyway.

Do not recommend, the lectures did not pertain to the exams. There were no curves or extra credit given for exams that never had an average above a 50. He shows you wrong ways to do mechanisms without also showing the correct way. Practice exams also were vastly different than the actual exam which set you up for failure. Look elsewhere

This was truly the worst professor I have ever had. His lectures are very unclear, lots of meaningless rants and hardly nothing learned in lecture is on exams. He states multiple times that lecture content will not be on exams and we are left to guess and scramble in the book to find the content we need. Also very unapproachable.

Does not lecture well, frequently says he should not need to explain things. do not ask questions, they are not answered politely. Homework does not reflect exam material. Must devote all of your free time to this class to get better than a C. Slow grader, does not give good keys - often wrong info on keys for old tests
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Watson is very unique, sometimes snarky but he wants students to do well. He outlines everything needed to succeed early on, and has an insane amount of office hours for students. Despite that he has the most confusing lectures that provide no help. He would rather rant than teach new content. Not the worst but the flaws outweigh the good.

The worst chemistry professor at UK, and that's saying A LOT. This man teaches like it's his first day on earth. He also makes snarky comments and has the biggest ego. Honestly studying for 2 weeks doesn't even help at this point so just pray. Even then you'll still get failing grades on exams because he sets them up for you TO fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Watson values deep understanding of organic chemistry compared to memorization for an easy grade. Compared to my CHE230 prof (Huckaba..), Watson actually seems passionate about teaching and helping his students. He is very clear on what you need to do to succeed, has a million office hours, and while his tests are harder; they are never unfair.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: he basically dose nothing and you need to read everything out of book, only good this is his office hours can be helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I'm a Dr. Watson defender. Yes his exams are tough, but he is also VERY clear about what you have to do to succeed in the class (textbook problems mainly). In office hours he's certainly helpful. He really does care about his students, and while he has his quirks (can get a bit snarky at times) I don't feel like those quirks justify his reputation.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Watson is VERY smart, but expects way more out of students compared to other orgo proffs. His exams are much harder than the other orgo classes. He does try to accommodate with a lot of office hours, and he has carrot assignments, but I would take another professor if I could. Not a lot of HW and he is fine if you watch the echo. Rough class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Don't be scared because people who failed attributed it to a professor that actually makes you work for a grade. If you are looking for easy (premed students) take Steeleman. If you know how to study/apply yourself, and put the work in, you will do well. He is a great guy, and cares about students actually learning things and working hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I wouldn't recommend this professor to anyone. He wrote reactions in lectures without explaining mechanisms, often saying, “you should know this by now.” (Y'know bc f** actually breaking things down for students who aren't chem geniuses) There was little homework, so grades depended mostly on exams. The textbook helped more than his lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you enjoy studying until your hair turns grey but still getting 30/40/50s on exams this is the course for you! Advise you take literally anybody/anything else in this universe besides him.

TAKE ASHLEY STEELEMAN NOT WATSON FOR YOUR OWN GOOD!! There was one question on exam 2 that 100% of the class got wrong and he said we should have known how to do it and he did not curve or take it off. He can get political during his ORGANIC lectures but ya know slay ig take at ur own risk. he does not convey his material well and skips chapters!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is one of the worst professors at UK! Here are some DIRECT QUOTES from this man: "Sending out a survey want ur feedback but I am not going to change anything", and "Avg. was a 49% but its ur fault". Famous for teaching the INCORRECT solutions first because "it helps you learn better". He doesnt care @ ALL about the success of his students. 0/10
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Watson is a VERY smart man. Too smart for his own good. I think that he forgets that he is teaching undergrad students because his lectures make NO sense. His exams are ridiculously hard too. He needs to be teaching grad school and above. He is a great guy and really cares about his students, and he wants to make sure we are actually learning.

honestly the worst chemistry professor here. He never responds to emails and when he does, they are very belittling. He gives false promises of what will be on tests. I have studied well over 30 hours for each exam on the content he said would be on the exam, and have gotten low C's on all of them. Absolutely awful, do not take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Watson is a nice guy but not a good professor. He teaches in a way that does not make sense to anyone learning the content for the first time. He is extremely slow to grade, and gives really challenging exams compared to other organic professors.

Dr. Watson is very intelligent and knows the material. However, his teaching style doesn't work for everyone and can be confusing. The exams are very difficult, but are textbook heavy. He does care about his students though, because he holds office hours on the weekends to be more accessible. This class has a grading curve which helps.

He is very smart, but is unable to teach what he knows. I stopped going to lectures and started to learn more by just studying the textbook everyday. Not very helpful in office hours, and is very disorganized. I would not recommend taking a class with him.

He is a good person, but does not know how to deliver information properly to students. The notes feel like your reading a paper with every sentence highlighted. Be ready to use the textbook and teach yourself.

Be ready to teach yourself! He is a cool guy and clearly knows what he is teaching but his lectures do not connect well with students. Read the textbook and you will be fine-ish or just take another prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Be ready to listen! Homework heavy. Overall, not too bad.

Prof. Watson is incredible smart in Chemistry however he is not able to teach what he knows, many lectures he went off track and had a hard time explaining concepts. I learned more from a tutor and youtube. His grades are scattered through 3 different websites . He doesn't respond to emails. Do yourself a favor take a different prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His teaching is not the best, gets off-topic very quickly. Overall, it is not a hard course, but I definitely would recommend during homework and taking time to understand it.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Watson is by far one of the worst professors. His lectures are so complicated because hes awful at teaching. Sometimes he doesn't even show up to his own study hours. Chemistry by itself is hard but he makes it even harder. Never will I ever, have Dr. Watson again. He's a great guy.. but not a great professor.

If you want a professor that bores you to sleep during his lectures, and only covers half the content that actually is in the exam. Then i highly recommend taking Watson. By for the worst professor i've had as a sophomore and all the things that i've learned was from outside of class from other resources. STAY AWAY FROM WATSON!

Mark Watson is not the professor for you if you do not do well teaching yourself. He does not lecture in class, so you are expected to teach yourself the material. When he tries to answer questions in class, his responses are very unorganized, and he side tracks often.

Dr. Watsons teaching style is an absolute joke. He never taught, never did example problems, and never once put in the effort required for a university-level professor. He came into class at the end of the semester and said, I dont know what im supposed to be for you guys in this class. How about a teacher? Made my life harder.

Dr. Watson is a gem in the chemistry department. I learned more from this research-based synthesis lab than any other class in my academic career. A very quality course and Dr. Watson is incredibly caring.

One of the most quality courses available at UK. Dr. Watson provides excellent instruction and makes sure that we are understanding the experiments we are conducting. This is the most refreshing course I have taken in my college career. The work we do isn't trivial, and it applies everything that we have learned leading up to this. Must take.

I love this class so much and Dr. Watson is such a good professor. The class is set up like a research lab and I feel like I am actually learning and applying what I know unlike other labs I have taken. Dr. Watson is always willing to help and is very passionate about the work being done in the lab which is very refreshing.

Dr. Watson's synthesis lab is a must-take. He is an amazing professor. We played music during lab and we created new stuff that doesn't exist. One of the best labs I have ever taken throughout my years as a chemistry major. Truly an amazing professor. Such a good guy. We almost got published but the pandemic hit. I can't express how much I love him
I never learned a thing from his lectures. Read the book and you'll pass just fine. The extra credit he gives is super nice, though.

Reading the book and solving all the problems in it is a must. Dr. Watson did a great job explaining mechanisms and patterns of reactions. He was always ready to help during office hours. But he wanted students to put effort to learn, so do not expect the material or grades to be handed to you on a golden plate. And hes a cool guy!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: If you could avoid this professor, do so at all costs. Does not care about his students and how or if they learn. Its crazy to think that the only form of communication through this PANDEMIC ONLINE CLASS was through email and he NEVER answered. Do not pay to learn from him, because you will have to pay for a tutor anyways. Do not recommend AT ALL.

He was the absolute WORST professor I've ever had. Doesn't care about you as a person and will just ignore any feedback you give. Took his class during the pandemic and he refused to adapt to the times. Obviously students are just a number to him, he does not care about our well being at all. I would rate him a zero if it was possible.

He is a super cool guy, but not a very good teacher. He tends to ramble a lot and his notes are confusing. Be prepared to rely on the textbook. He goes slow so you aren't tested on a lot of things. He has cool hats and thats about it
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Doesnt respond to emails. Doesnt care about you as a student. Rambles and gets himself confused in lecture. Read the textbook, hire a tutor, find a study group. Avoid him at all costs. Didnt have the syllabus done until the first exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Overall, he was a great professor. He would always make time to help his students. The class itself is a rough course. Time must be spent reading the book and doing practice problems. I would also rewatch his lectures so that I could pause and catch up if I did not understand something. He is a very understanding, great instructor
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Organic 2 isn't easy, I had to study a lot and work out every in chapter problem/integrated problems/challenge problems to actually understand and do well in this class. Dr. Watson was great at  explaining the theory behind the reactions and is always available to help you outside of lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Watson is a really nice guy, you can tell that right off the bat.  But wow, is he a horrible professor. This guy simply cannot teach a class. For an organic professor, his exams are really fair and so is his grading, but never have I had a more incoherent, rambling professor in my life. Skip class and read the book, you'll get an A.

Dr Watson wants you to learn, however he is a very unorganized teacher and long story short my grades went up when I read in my room during class time as opposed to coming and watch him scribble on a piece of paper. Unnecessary amount of theoretical questions. Good at explaining mechanisms not good at teaching
I like his hats

I took him for 230 and for 232 the second time. To me he's the best prof in this dept. he can ramble but if you do what he asks his class is doable. Got a B in ochem1 and a C in 2 the first time I took it, an A the second time. The book is a must! as well as the practice problems!
He is really tough an you'll have to work really hard to get an A in this class, but if you do all the working problems from the textbook you'll do fine.

Watson does a poor job  lecturing because he is very unorganized. If you are going to come to class, come to class prepared to devote your full attention to him. He doesn't have powerpoints and a lot of what he is teaching, he expects you to jot down from him speaking.
Quit going to class about half way through because he confused me. Started only reading the book and working old exams and it has been much more beneficial for me.

He is extremely confusing in class. Will go over examples and then he tells you two of them are wrong and won't tell you which so you can figure it out (just as an example among many other things) He says that he is supposed to complement the book but i have done better with only reading the book. He was the only one that was offered
Great professor. Expects you to read the chapters and do problems but if you do them the class is not that bad and he teaches extremely well.

Great teacher. Read ahead and take good notes BEFORE class with his provided outline. He wants students to learn and doesn't baby you through the class. If you come prepared lecture is a good review and chance to get any explanations you need.
His lectures were very confusing and not at all helpful. You're better off reading the book. I would choose another professor whose lectures are more clear and useful.

The man obviously knows what he's talking about, it's not likely you will unless you've read the chapter from beginning to end. He does put videos of the lectures on Blackboard so that's a plus. Not easy, but he's not an unlikable person. Sort of monotone.  I stopped going to class and just watched videos online and did book problems. Doing fine.
Wouldn't reccomend for CHE 230 horrible and boring teacher. Meier is a much better teacher from what I hear

Hopefully you're capable of teaching your Organic Chemistry. He's obviously very brilliant and he knows the material from top to bottom - just doesn't know how to teach it. Doesn't use powerpoint slides, is not consistent with his lecture, and it is just painful trying to follow him. Tests were fair. Got a B but I don't credit any of that to him.

I used to go to class, but realized that he wasn't helping. He even said that he doesn't teach just does examples. When I started going to class again, he did nothing but confuse me. He didn't do a good job preparing us for exams at all. The text book examples are super easy, then his examples are very hard. You never see that middle level problem.

Dr Watson really knows what he's doing and talking about.  He may seem to go off point but he does it for a good reason.  He is giving hints for what is to come.  If you do bad in his class it's because you don't put in any effort or read his extra material he provides through emails.  Plus he is super hot!!!

Took him for the accelerated version of organic 1. Personally, I thought it was really hard to follow him. He definitely knows what he's talking about, but we were learning it for the first time, so often needed more clarification. Go to office hours - don't wait until it's too late. Also, USE the book. Be prepared: organic chem is HARD!!!

Took him for the accelerated section of organic 1. It was great having him in a small class setting, it made the teaching more personable. He taught straight out of the book, adding in his own helpful examples. Very difficult, will challenge you, but put in the work and it will be worth it. Pay attention to examples used in class.

Do not take him for organic 1. He does not know how to teach organic 1. I had him for the accelerated course and it is a difficult class and much harder than regular organic. Plus he does not know how to teach the organic 1 material because he is an organic 2 teacher.

Basically learned most of Organic I during his Organic II. Do all the problems like he says.  Pay attn. to his examples though he tries to trick you on the tests. I liked the class but you can't skate on studying.  Its on you basically.  I was terrified of failing and got an A so an A is doable. Pretty sure the curve was huge.

Watson was a very hard professor for OChem 2. On the first day of class he told us that he couldn't teach us Organic Chemistry, we had to teach it to ourselves. If you didn't do absolutely every book problem, including the most ridiculous ones, it was pointless going to take the test. Not a good teacher, the highest test average was 55%

Had Watson for o chem II lecture, just an OK instructor not a Nobel laureate, sometimes rambled incoherently on unrelated tangents.  Real reason I'm posting was his peculiar statement during a lecture about what he would do if a "shooter started to shoot up his class!" No kidding, weird.  Kind of an ego for a professor who never left KY I think!

He is a great professor, but is very serious about what he does.  He tries to make the material as easy as possible and is willing to help you if you have a good question but he hates suck-ups. If you're not doing well in his class, it's your fault. He's not monotone.

I absolutely hated coming to this class. Lectures were unstructured, and he had the horrendously annoying habit of randomly shouting while speaking. It felt like he was angry at us for not knowing this material already. Ended up dropping the course and the pre-dental track altogether.

He enjoys teaching and is more than willing to help you understand the concepts in class, during office hours, and even a help session that is held once a week. He expects a lot. He wants you to understand the concepts very well. The tests are applied and have twists, but if you understand the concept you'll do fine. Old exam are given and helpful.
Straightforward class. He tests what he teaches.  Can sound intimidating but he's nice and he really tries to help if you ask any ?s

Mark is a pretty cool guy. He knows a lot about what he teaches and is super intelligent overall. He challenges you to think for yourself and look at things critically. I think he is a good person and means well. Plus his class is not bad at all if you study. Its O-chem, its not going to just be easy if you dont ever study the material.
Key for getting good grade in his class, is reading book and attend all his lectures.

Watson's tests were very straight forward. You didn't have to attend class but you had to read the textbook and you would do pretty well on his exams. His a whole lot easier than other people teaching CHE 232.

good teacher, knows what he is talking about, very helpful. he is the best organic chem teacher i've encountered and explains things on a level you can understand them. if you have a question, just ask. if he is wrong, he admits it. best chance at a good grade is by taking him.

He's unorganized.  I went back and looked through my notes to study for the tests, and he introduced one subject, moved onto another, and then came back to the previous (many times in one lecture)  He's easier than Meier, but Meier's a better teacher.  I made a B in the class, and would have had an A if he had not have made the 3rd test impossible.

Unorganized, sometimes late to class.  Doesn't seem to have much of an outline for his teaching--invents the lecture as he goes.  Still, material was relatively easy, and the textbook was one of the better ones I've encountered.  He's laid back and knowledgeable.  Just read the book and do the homework and it's very hard to get below a B.

This class is hard no matter who your professor is! But besides the material being hard Dr. Watson is really laid back and ALWAYS willing to help you when you don't understand. He really knows the material...plus he's totally hot!

He's an okay teacher. He is somewhat disorganized and his teaching skills vary per topic (i.e. go home and study carbonyl chemistry on your own, he didn't teach this well). Tests are, for the most part, fair as long as you do the suggested problems. There were a handful of A's, so his class is by no means impossible.
He is very unorganized and also very cocky!
He's very helpful, and a good teacher, but the syllabus was not unorganized and class was not structured.  It was difficult to prepare for the class.

give him a break...he's kinda new teaching.  his lectures could use a little organization, but he does know what he's talking about. seems to be more comfortable with smaller audiences. if something's unclear, ASK HIM. very nice and helpful during office hours. is there any other chem prof willing to admit he's wrong? (or this attractive?)
Dr. Watson rocks my socks!  He is always willing to help if you're confused, he made Organic Chemistry my favorite class...nevermind that he's incredibly cute!
This guy is incredibly horrible.  Talks into the board, scribbles incomprehensibly, gives ridiculously hard tests with no curve.

He posts the lecture notes but you're better off going to class as he adds a lot. You can tell he cares a lot about the students learning. Exams are pretty tough but doable. Attendance is 10% of the grade through quizzes he gives the code for in class. The 2 projects were interesting and actually pretty easy. Homework was extremely hard.

Dr Xiao is very knowledgeable and qualified to teach Introduction to Cryptology. He also very obviously cares about the success of his students. With that said, this class could have be so much better and easier to understand if there were concrete examples and demonstrations alongside the obnoxiously unintuitive lectures over proofs and theory.

Lectures were absolutely packed, but its understandable given the broad scope of the class. Xiao seems to be a traditional lecturer; class time is for giving you information and office hours are for questions. Strongly recommend office hours if you need help but you won't, just go to class and pay attention. Homework solved in class after due date

Lectures involve him reading each slide word for word with little discussion to aid our own understanding, but speaking as if we are also professors who have studied networking to his own degree. The textbook required is NOT provided by him and is also horrendous to read as terminology in assignments aren't in the textbook!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved this class and the professor. He was genuinely a great person as well. I would take this class again if I could!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: TAKE HIS CLASS SERIOUSLY DO IT! He cares about you as a student so much there is no homework except for 4 projects for the entire semester and only 2 quizzes. The easiest class you will ever take. He is just so sweet please attend class even though it's not mandatory cause no one ends up going its THAT easy. I had a 98% by the end! HE'S SO NICE!!!

Xun Zhu is an amazing professor! His class is so interesting and he takes the time to not only lecture but involve students with engaging activities. There are a couple quizzes, discussion posts, and a final website: all of which are fun and easy assignments. He learned my entire classes names and really loves what he does!!

I'm a bit late on my review, since I had this professor last semester. There's a lot of information to take in between the lectures and the articles, but the PowerPoint slides are extremely helpful. There's a variety of assignments and a final project where you make a website. The professor is friendly and super helpful. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: amazing professor, really cares about his students, highly recommend taking any of his courses

Great teacher!! He's worked in real-world crisis's around the world. He teaches u a lot about stuff that isn't rly talked about but important to PR. Teaches u how to make a website. Dont take class if u sit in the back & play ur on computer, he is super nice & cares so he deserves student's full attention. HW aren't hard or long, they r kinda fun.
Super nice guy, great professor.

You meet once a week for "class". You are assigned a partner for the entire semester and you work through the in class assignment. There is no instruction during class time. You are expected to watch the posted lecture videos on Canvas before coming to class. There is a single midterm exam then a final.

She just doesn't know the content the way the other circuits professor does. The lecture videos are taught by the other professor, but she is the only one present to answer questions. She is not the worst, but you will understand the content much better if you take this class from the other circuits professor at UK.

She's nice and caring. The courseload from the 2024 Fall semester was reduced to biweekly assignments, with final exam replaced by 2 short matlab projects. Most Students will get an easy A if they attend all classes. Compared to other professors in ECE department, she might not be a perfect English speaker, but alsolutely an excellent instructor.

I took this class this semester. The lecture was clear and useful. Just the projects was tough but ChatGPT helped a lot. Dr. Xie is a nice lady and she gave us 5% extra credits for taking quizzes. she also shared the lecture notes and it was helpful on reviewing.
Do not take this class. It is not taught properly by the lecturer. She could do better

Avoid. The class does not provide you with proper resources to understand the material. The material is taught in a confusing way in which can take hours to understand despite it should taking minutes. You do not have the resources to do the homework. Worst class I've taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: ONLY TAKE THIS CLASS IF YOU ARE STUDYING ROBOTICS. 50% of your grade is over 8 questions (that's 3 per test and 1 per quiz). These 8 questions are not taught to you by her or covered in the homework (worth 10%). There are 2 projects in Matlab worth 20% each and you will need prior experience to complete them. She's nice, but her class needs work.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Xie for Intro to Robotics. She has a very thick accent and hard to understand. Her lectures are the bare minimum they can be to reflect the material in homework, quizzes, and exams. Speaking of, these are almost impossible to complete on time or just at all. She is nice and kind but the material isn't. I do not recommend taking her.

he doesn't take attendance and reads directly off slides he posts so you don't miss much. exams are open note!! he's super nice and helpful in class. he's not good at replying to emails though. only bad thing is group project was SO HARD. he clearly didn't read it before assigning it and had to gradually give us more info to be able to do it

He's a super nice guy, but quite a bad professor. He reads straight off the lectures for the whole class every single time. Two homework assignments each week that are pretty easy. The tests are online and open note but can still be pretty difficult. Final group project is the worst thing I've ever done in my life.

Professor Xie is a cool, comical, and caring dude who genuinely wants to see all of his students succeed. He puts in a lot of effort for the students in terms of preparing them for his exams, and is quite resourceful if you need him.

Quizzes, tests, and homework is impossible. Went to do homework with him during after hours. He could not complete it. We spent 4 hours on 5 questions and he got them all wrong. He let me copy the answers that he gets as a teacher to get credit. Class is impossible. Not willing to give extra credit. Is a tough grader. Do not take this professor.

Hong is the worst Professor I've ever had. He can't even read numbers correctly off the board. He repeats the same phrases habitually and I'd rather watch paint dry than attend his lectures. He holds review sessions for his exams and says he will record and post them but doesn't post them until midnight the night before the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Extremely knowledgable when it comes to the subject.  For those questions he's not able to answer in class, he has followed up and answered after researching the answer.  These are odd questions for unique circumstances that I wouldn't expect him to be able to answer on the spot.  His course is difficult due to the subject, but graded fairly.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Xie is by far the worst professor I've had in all my years in school (First semester senior). His lectures are so dry that its almost impossible to follow, tests do not reflect the practice exams, and his take home quizzes aren't possible to do well on just by using his notes from lectures. I don't understand how UK lets him teach still

I would have given him a 0 out of 5 if i could. he is by far my least favorite professor at UK. His lectures are so dry and not helpful whatsoever. he gives take home quizzes that does not reflect anything he teaches in class. the quizzes are very difficult even with the help of notes. he does not know how to teach yet somehow UK allows him. UGH!

All of his quizzes are take home. The multiple choice questions on the exam are hard and very specific but the free response questions are the same as the quizzes. He is hard to pay attention to and very boring. Not a lot of people show up to class. You have to read the textbook and teach yourself

He will give you easy practice exams but will switch the exam up and make it hard. He also teaches everything from the book and nothing is different. Im pretty sure he copies his lecture notes from the books notes they give you. RUN FOREST RuN
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: professor Xie is why professors get a bad rep. he teaches one thing in class and then gives quizzes on something else entirely. you get a quiz per chapter and the quizzes are much harder than what was taught to us. He will be teaching chapters 4 weeks in advance even if it is something that the exam has no covered yet. he makes accounting horrible!

Professor Xie is really nice but the lectures were not super helpful and were very dry. He didn't pace himself very well so we were always behind and often spent too much time on the easier stuff at the expense of the more difficult material. He gives a pretty decent amount of extra credit, but be prepared to work hard for a good grade.

Hong Xie is a nice guy, but very difficult to understand and his lecture slides are so busy that even though they have all the information, I found them very difficult to follow. The quizzes were thankfully all take home. If you can find it, buy the professor version of the text book to help figure out the wileyplus.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: You will have to be able to teach yourself to get a good grade in this class. Great guy but he's not fit for this teaching job because he is hard to follow. My suggestion is to follow along with the topics you go over and then go review those topics that day. He does curve the tests to make the avg. a 75 which helps. 20 points EC is possible.

Very disorganized. Seemed to go very slow over easy material, but he would go through difficult material without providing much explanation. Additionally, the homework did not do a good job reflecting in-class lecture material and exam questions. This material is extremely difficult, and I had to teach myself most of the class.

"Ok Look, Guys" and "Folks!" come out of his mouth about every 5 seconds. Don't get me wrong, he's a nice guy, but his class is tough. The entire class is just him reading directly off his slides and it's hard to pay attention. His accent doesn't help his case either.... His exams are EXTREMELY difficult.. borderline unfair. Goody FOLKS!!!

He only gives you 5 tries on the homework, makes things harder than they really should (ie, indirect statement of cash flows). His tests are tough with the final being impossible. He's a nice professor though, I'll give him that. His slides make sense only half the time. If you have to take 302 don't take him except last resort

Very nice and friendly professor, The powerpoints he provides are very useful, the classes go through  very carefully and clearly, and he uses examples to help students understand easily. This is a very hard course, showing in the classes is important.

Overall I think he is a good teacher. I would take him again if I had the choice. He is a very friendly guy and gives good study guides before the tests. You only get 3 chances on the WileyPlus homework though, and the Final is practically impossible. He gives bonus points for attendance (up to 4 points added to final grade), and drops lowest quiz!
reads directly off his powerpoint slides so paying enough attention to absorb the information is nearly impossible. very hard class. if you can, dont take him.

One of the worst classes I have ever taken. It's a hard course to being with and having a bad professor doesn't help. WileyPlus homework only allows 3 chances. Tests are extremely hard, as are quizzes. Most of all the lectures are very boring, you have to go to get the notes but I usually ended up trying to teach myself everything after class.
Very difficult to understand in lecture. If you don't have a strong foundation in linear algebra and calculus it will be very hard to catch up.

Dr. Liang is an extremely caring professor. He is very accessible outside of class and even offered to help us study. Lectures often times can be hard to understand. There are not a lot of example problems in class, so a lot of learning will be in office hours, or on homework. He is a very fair grader, making a tough class a little easier to pass.

Not an extremely difficult class overall. Lots of opportunity for extra credit. The lectures are difficult to understand, There are three test they are challenging and messing up one question could automatically bring your test down significantly. However, the prof is very willing to give out partial credit so its hard to not do well in the class.
Prof Scholes Young is organized and keeps grades updated. She plans good classes, but she expects you to go to all of them. You have to write in a journal and my hand hurt.

Dr. Scholes Young is an excellent professor. There are only major assignments in Lit Editing & Publishing but she gives a lot of feedback along the way. We wrote a semester long book proposal after learning all about the industry parts: book synopsis, query letters, pitches, agents, marketing, publicity, comparative titles, ets. Mine was 40 pages.
She is so sweet and very passionate about writing. She wants you to succeed and will guide you every step of the way.

I took her for Literary Editing & Publishing. Kind of a wake up call to my dreams of becoming a writer. I just had no idea before this class how hard publishing is, but Prof Scholes Young was encouraging even with the big dose of reality. You learn the business side of writing and the assignments are useful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I didn't like this class. I loved this class. Best prof I've had at UK.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She's cool and she cares
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The class itself is pretty simple, even for those not interested in writing. The workload is reasonable and assignments are not heavily graded by skill level, rather evidence of process and progress. This course highly encourages creativity and exploration of different techniques. The professor is engaging and well versed in topics of discussion.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Caring

reviews.comment: She is so sweet and encourages creativity, she allows everyone to write what they want to write, which is perfect for a creative writing class. She is also very understanding about outside difficulties and she knows students have a life outside of her class. She was one of my favorite professors.
Super nice and caring. I'm not an English person at all and took for the credit but still enjoyed the class. Don't like the recitations though.
It's a core class and you have to attend. No late work. Only one extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I never thought of myself as a writer until this fiction workshop. Prof is amazing. Only sad is that I can't take the class with her again.
An easy core credit class, pretty interesting as well. Attendance grade kinda sucks, but should be an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Best class I've had at UK
I took this professor for a fiction workshop and absolutely loved it. Favorite class ever. Also, the professor gives a lot of detailed feedback and she'll explain it too.

She gives good lectures and her class is easy. She also talks a lot about creative writing so if you're actually interested in the topic, you'll like her class. If you aren't it's still pretty easy and she's a good professor.
Prof Scholes Young is a published author who teaches creative writing. I hated the 8 am but loved her teaching.

He is a very nice person, but not a good professor. The class is very test-heavy, and the content over the course of the class closely resembles what is on the short-answer questions, but the online questions and quizzes barely touch on the lecture content.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I would recommend if you still have time to drop this class. I had no clue what was going on because his lectures really didn't relate to the course work and the only grades you have in the class are quizzes and exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is not good communicating any of the material. He just doesn't present any of the information well. The course's canvas shell isn't organized well at all, and the structure of the lecture notes that are taken in class are all over the place. It's unfortunate as he seems like a nice guy just not a good teacher. Avoid taking him if possible.

If you're not in Int'l Bus, I would not recommend. Only graded material is 3 exams +15 quizzes. The quizzes don't actually cover material discussed in class, but random info from textbook (which is never referenced) and slideshows (that he randomly skips through). He does not present material clear + is not good communicator. Would not take again.

As an honors and straight A student I have never struggled in a class this much. The course is made entirely of Quizzes and Tests on material which you are barely even taught. I went into each lecturebut the lectures bounce all over and are a waste of time. Trying to learn from the book won't help either as test material is rarely relevant.
Easily the worst professor I have ever had at UK. No one in the class knows what is going on.
Horrible, do not take him, nothing about his lectures are on quizes/exams
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Stay away from Econometrics, probably the most miserable teaching experience I have had. 0 understanding. No one has any idea what is going on. There is no help with R. Do not under any circumstances take this class. You have been warned.

I have never had a professor so awful. I read the textbook and try to study but his quizzes are impossible to finish in the time limit and so are his tests. If you ask for extra time he says no. The class average grade right now is 66%. I need this class to graduate, and I'm not sure I'll pass because of him. He doesn't answer questions either.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class was a rollercoaster. I can honestly say I had no clue what my grade was all semester long, since he rarely gave back assignment grades and does not use canvas. I would often be in class and not have a clue what he was referring to all period. Fortunately, I was one of about 4 other students to show up regularly and it must have helped me

Attendance is normally mandatory but it switched to online so he just gave us those points. He is kinda hard to understand but the exams are unproctored and taken straight from the practice quizzes. He is very nice and will work with your schedule if you need an exam moved or anything.

This guy must be writing his own reviews becuase this man is the worst teacher in the world. There is no way anyone thinks he is a 4.0. He doesnt use canvas at all, and figuring out your grade is nearly imposible. Much of the class is arbitraiy curved, and the grade makes no sense. His tests are way to long, even with extra time i coudnt finish
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: WOW what a waste of time. This man doesnt know how to teach, and taking him will leave you behind. He doesnt answer quetions, he is very vauge in what he wants on his tests, and he lies about making attendance mandatory. At one point he bored the class so much taht only three people showed up reguarly. Definetly a luaghable exuese of a teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This man could possiblly be the worst Proffessor in the history of schooling. He is not specific about what he wants. The test that he gives is nearly impossible to finish in the right amount of time. It is very hard to hear him, and when you ask questions he is very hard to understand. do not take this man, you will be teaching yourself the class

If i can stop atleast one person from taking this mans class I will. He is possible the worst teacher that I have ever had in my acedmeic career. He is lost infront of his class, and his online files are impossible to navigate. Asking him questions is useless because he wont fully explain it. DO NOT TAKE ANY CLASS THIS MAN IS INVOVED WITH.

Dr. Kim seems nice at first, but that veneer covers academic sloppiness. He doesn't post grades on canvas and appears to curve assignments despite not telling students that he does so (based off the fact that I never got above a 90% on an assignment yet got an A). The tests are solely based off the quizzes and the quizzes are based off old ones.

He is extremely knowledgeable on the subject, but he is very soft spoken and the subject is dull. He operates best when people participate/ask thoughtful questions, but a silent class will just drag on awkwardly. I recommend following along with his lecture slides and sit close enough that you can hear him. His accent was not a problem.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very nice guy. He does have an accent but I didn't really find him hard to understand (I did sit in the front row). He assigns a lot of projects but he's very lenient in grading them. Grading scale is more than fair.  If you sit near the front he's pretty easy to follow, at least to me. I'm taking him again for Monetary International Economics.

Professor Kim is very intelligent and has a lot of knowledge to share with a respectful class that is willing to learn. He does have a heavy accent which might sometimes cause communication issues. However, if the class is respectful he is able to give very good lectures. He even offered our class two extra lectures on his own time.

Professor Yoonbai Kim is by far the worst professor I have ever had, or even heard of.   He is very hard to understand (heavy accent and he mumbles.   I can count the number of  legible graphs he's drawn all semester on one hand.  Textbook is almost useless.  He has no business in Education.  Do not take him if you can help it.
He's the hardest economics teacher at UK. He rambles and doesn't help students much

Worst teacher I've ever had out of my 4+ years here at UK. He is not clear at all with his material. You can't hear him, can barley read his writing and when he writes on the board he is the least bit organized. I couldn't believe that a teacher this bad was allowed to teach a course so deep in my major

Most boring Korean prof ever. His english is OK, but you will fall asleep during class, and don't expect to learn much from his lectures. He will also tell you attendance is not mandatory but if you miss more than a couple classes he will threaten to fail you. BTW going to his office hours is a waste of time. Don't take this guy unless you have to.
The most boring professor ever!!!!
Class was OK. Not helpful in office hours.

Macro certainly isn't the easiest subject, but this guy is easy on students... many test questions were from quizzes, which in turn were from the practice quizzes on text website, and his scale is very generous. Unless you are just too lazy to go to class (he takes off grade for 2+ absences), you will have no problem getting a good grade.
His lectures are horrible.  He's incredibly boring and he doesn't even really teach the material- he just kind of talks about it.

Other than his Korean accent, his English is great. Speaks slow so you can understand him, but mumbles sometimes. Most quiz questions are from the book's website. His four exams aren't incredibly hard like other profs. And unlike other UK econ profs, he won't make econ harder than it already is. Fair grading. Take him.
No Comments

his english is bad and his homeworks and test are hard, but find someone to help you out if you have to take this class, his grading scale is good, 60-78 is a C. And if you do bad on the test he will give a quiz and what ever you get on it he will add to your test score. His lectures, you will nap!!
The guy struggles with english. His lectures are so boring your heart may stop beating. Everything is so unclear.

Horikawa-sensei is the sweetest instructor I have had at college thus far. The way she explains things makes Japanese very easy to understand at a beginner level and I have little to no complaints with any assignment, test, or exam given in the class. My only complaint is that she only teaches 101 and 102 because I want more classes with her!

Horikawa Sensei is an amazing professor for JPN 101/102! She is incredibly kind, respectful, and funny, and is very easygoing on her beginning Japanese students. Her lectures are a bit fast paced, but she makes sure to explain things if you are confused. If I could, I would continue to have her as my professor for JPN 201 and beyond!
Very funny and understanding

This class was very hard for me. It was very fast paced and I'm a slow learner and overall this class was just not it for me. However, Horikawa Sensei is one of the best professors I've ever had. I would take this class again because she was that great. Very kind and caring towards her students and genuinely wants her students to succeed. 10/10!

I have never learned a language faster than with Horikawa Sensei. The way she presents material and structures learning is extremely beneficial to language acquisition. There is a lot of vocab to learn and there's homework daily, but it's to your benefit if you want to learn. I recommend learning hiragana before taking the class.

Horikawa sensei is amazing!! You can tell she is genuinely passionate about her students progress in learning Japanese. The class had a very close bond because of how Horikawa made the atmosphere so friendly and inviting. However, there's an insane amount of homework because language learning is a daily task. Expect homework every night.
