reviews.comment: JPN 102 is a great class if you are willing to put in the work and engage in group work during class. Attendance is mandatory, and there is homework just about every night, but the work is really easy, and you can redo the nightly assignments until you get a perfect score if you submit it before the due date. Hard workers will get an A!

Yoko is one of the sweetest professors. She makes all her classes fun and enjoyable. However, there is a TON of homework (every night except fri and sat) that takes a while to do. Overall, she is a great professor.

I love Horikawa. She is super sweet and understanding and makes sure you know the material before you continue on. She responds quickly to emails and even makes attempts to make you feel more at home in the classroom. You have to be actively trying to fail her class to fail it.

She is very intense and I definitely learned a lot, but she made it hard to get a good grade. I had some family issues and she wasn't very accommodating and sometimes hard to approach. She was nice and funny, and I took the class because I wanted to learn Japanese, but it wasn't worth the stress.

Horikawa Sensei is the nicest professor I have ever had, while the class is homework heavy as long as you care about this class youll do pretty good! She is so understanding for when you are sick or just not doing too great. Just wait til you hear the greeting song! 1000% would take again, more specifically JPN102 with her next year!

I had Horikawa sensei the spring semester of Covid-19. She was an amazing teacher before and after we went online. She's funny, caring, and understanding. One of the best professor's I have ever had. 10/10.
She's real great. She's a little fast paced for me.

Horikawa sensei is such a genuinely nice person. Shes always helpful and gives good feedback. There is a lot of homework, but as long as you pay attention in class and participate, you wont have any issues completing it. Basically, as long as you work on your Japanese and actually show that you care, you wont have a single problem in this class.

Horikawa-sensei is one of the sweetest teachers I've ever had. Her class was extremely easy as long as you participated and payed attention and she always made things interesting. You could always hear the laughter coming from her classroom whenever she had her students do an activity.

A MUST TAKE TEACHER FOR CHEMISTRY AT UK. Woodrum is by far the best professor for Gen Chem. Tests are difficult and worth a large portion of your grade. Her students consistently score multiple percentage points higher on every exam (10%) when compared to other professors for the same class. Teaches well and is very organized. Wants you to succeed!

Dr. Woodrum was great, there's some hard content, but her pre-lecture videos make it a lot easier to understand. The videos can take a while to get through sometimes, but it's definitely worth it to get the concepts down and work some practice problems.
A very good professor, but the content of the class is difficult. She is very caring of her students, and wants them to proceed. Highly recommend taking her classes!
A very good professor and cares about her students, the material in the class can be difficult.

Woodrum is the best chemistry professor I've had so far. She seems genuinely interested in her class's success, and although I have heard bad things about flipped classrooms, her approach worked well for my learning style. Tests are difficult, but she makes sure you're ready. Would definitely take her again!

I cannot speak highly enough about Professor Woodrum. She is one of the best professors I've ever had and makes daunting subjects easy to understand. She cares so much about making sure her students actually learn. Her office hours are incredibly helpful and the way she teaches emphasizes learning, not memorization. She made me love chemistry.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr.Woodrum is a good professor especially for chem. However, a majority of time I spent actually learning the material for this class was outside of lecture time. The video lectures and past exams are way more helpful than the in class attendance mandatory "lectures" where there is a few problems asked on iclicker that take way less time than given

Professor Kim Woodrum is a great professor. Lectures are just group practices of the videos we have to watch before class. Exams are easy with more than 5 old exams being given for practice from previous years.

Dr. Woodrum is an amazing lecturer and explains everything well. She really encourages you to try and take the time to understand concepts instead of memorizing them. If CHE105 is your first science class, this will really teach you how to study more effectively, don't cram everything the night before it won't work lol.

Dr. Woodrum was a fabulous professor, the class was lowkey a struggle however her lectures were very helpful and she would make time for you if you ever needed help. Make sure to stay on top of work and studying but as long as you do that you should be fine.
Dr. Woodrum is widely known as the best chem professor at UK. Chemistry at UK is HORRIBLE, but she does a great job at explaining everything.

Dr. Woodrum is such an amazing professor. Her lectures are extremely easy to follow and she presents the topics quite well. Be ready for a bit of busy work though, as some of the videos can be very long as well as the achieves.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you have to take any chemistry, definitely take Woodrum. She explains everything super well and cares about her students.
She teaches you how to study

Such a good professor. Class is hard but she makes it doable, obviously cares and wants you to do good if you put in the work and want to do good too. Easy to communicate with. 100000% recommend, I had a different professor for 105, and 107 was almost better than 105 just because of Dr. Woodrum and her teaching style.

Dr. Woodrum is by far the best professor to take for any gen chem course. As someone who thought 105 was difficult, she made 107 a breeze and taught me to love chemistry. Very approachable and makes coming to class enjoyable. Although exams are difficult, enough studying will allow you to be successful in this course as long as you apply yourself.
Best chemistry professor

Although gen chem ruined my mental health, Dr. Woodrum is the only reason I didn't immediately change my major. She is a caring and excellent instructor that understands that chemistry is difficult if you haven't studied for years. if you have to take this class, take woodrum!!
DO THE END OF CHAPTER PROBLEMS TO STUDY FOR EXAMS TRUSTTTT. shes awesome tho.

She was alwaays so prepared in class and took class participation very seriously. It was a flipped classroom, which is hard, but she made it fell easy. We went in there she talked and then we did group assignments which she then went over in class to better our understand. Overall amazing teacher and person.

Dr. Woodrum is the most dedicated and knowledgeable professor I've ever had. Very helpful and encourages students to attend office hours, review sessions, email, etc. This is a very hard class so if you must take it, try to get Woodrum.
Shes the goat
Love her, she was an amazing prof

Woodrum is the only chem professor that understands that chemistry is difficult, therefore she never degrades you for needing extra help. She greatly simplifies complicated subjects and will gladly explain something another way if you need. I noticed other chem professors make 107 way harder than it is, but woodrum makes it as easy as it can be.

Best professor I have had so far. I never liked chemistry in college and this lady made me want to change my major to chemistry. Use the learning outcomes as a study guide and you will get an A. exams really arent hard if you study

while chem 105 is a difficult class, woodrum truly tries her best to make it as easy as possible. she cares about her students and focuses a lot on group work in class. she was an amazing person and professor
Very, very kind and teaches the material well. The class is just a very difficult weed-out that most people don't finish.

amazing lady. truly cares about the wellbeing of her students. unfortunately, the class is just hard. put forth your best foot, ask for help, go to her office hours. i would have done better had i given it a better shot. she was not at fault. the flipped classroom model she has really make class worthwhile
Uses a 50 and 75 minute lecture to do coursework that takes you maybe 20 minutes and makes you watch 75+ minutes of *outdated* lectures on your own time for a grade.

She does video lectures that are assigned as homework which is either good or bad for you. I personally like them, just make sure that you can take good notes or use her student made notes which basically give you all the content to know.

When taking any general chemistry class, Dr. Woodrum is the way to go. She uses the reverse classroom mechanism through playposits. I absolutely dread doing them since they are so time consuming but they help so much. Dr. Woodrum truly wants her students to succeed. CHE107 is hard, but Dr. Woodrum is the best professor that teaches the class.

Professor Woodrum is the best! She made me enjoy coming to class and was a leading reason for me switching to Chemical Engineering. Great lecturer and keeps you engaged well. Her reverse learning model was super helpful and she provided amazing guided notes. You cannot go wrong with her.

Dr. Woodrum is one of the best professors I have ever had, if not the best. I've never in my entire academic career seen a professor explain concepts as well as she does. If you're reading this you NEED to take her for chemistry. She genuinely believes in her students and is passionate about chemistry like no one else. Amazing class.

Great professor just difficult material. The textbook is expensive and you have to buy it. Always willing to answer questions and uses a flipped classroom style. Has multiple interns walking around helping answer questions throughout class as well.

Dr. Woodrum is truly the best gen ed professor I've had. She knows this class is for people who don't like science, yet she still makes it fun. Group assignments daily, and homework pretty often, but she mixes it up. STUDY for her exams, but she is ALWAYS available to help outside of class. Taker her take her!

Dr. Woodrum is the best gen chem professor at UK. She uses the flipped classroom model, so class time is used to answer student questions and work in groups. However, her lecture videos are so helpful and she is always very quick to respond to emails and Piazza comments. She does everything she can to help her students succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: WHAT A WOMAN!!! She absolutely goes above-and-beyond. The chemistry department at UK is far from perfect, but Dr. Woodrum is like a bright light in a very dark cloudy night sky. She absolutely saved me from giving up on chemistry and my pre-professional track. Chem is NOT easy but is required for so many majors... take it with her... you'll need it
She is incredible at giving lectures and is very helpful if you go to office hours or call her over. Would 100% recommend her for taking chemistry.
Go to office hours!!!!! It was a life saver!! She is so nice and will explain over things you do not understand, will even give multiple examples. Also go over past tests upon studying for final!!
THE BEST ONE! Teaches everything you need to know from basics to advanced. Fair exams with good problems.

Dr. Woodrum is such a wonderful professor! Her video lectures are very thorough while her in class group assignments are very helpful in clearing up details and common mistakes. Of course tests are hard, it's not an easy class but she really wants you to succeed and all of my tests had a curve on them which really helped!

Dr. Woodrum is such a wonderful professor! Her video lectures are very thorough while her in class group assignments are very helpful in clearing up details and common mistakes. Of course tests are hard, it's not an easy class but she really wants you to succeed and all of my tests had a curve on them which really helped! I love Dr. Woodrum!

Professor Woodrum was nice and seemed to care about the students. Attendance in mandatory. This class is very test heavy, and with four main tests the make up a huge portion of your grade. The tests are quite difficult so make sure to do plenty of practice problems from the book. Please take notes and do practice problems and you will do well.

She is effective at teaching, but relies on lecture videos outside of lecture to teach. All equations must be memorized and by the final that is two pages of equations you must know how to use, manipulate, and understand conceptually.

reviews.comment: General Chemistry is overall a tough concept but Dr. Woodrum does her best to help out each of her students. Shes very caring and always willing to meet with students and talk about grades and help them out. Some of the concepts are very hard to understand and it moves quickly but she is a gem of the chem department. Pay attention and youll pass

Dr. Woodrum is one of the most caring professors on campus. She genuinely cares about her students and sets them up for success. I would say she is the best professor in the chemistry department. With that said, CHE 107 isn't easy, but she sets you up for success.

reviews.comment: Dr. Woo drum truly cares about her students and wants everyone to understand the material. She is even willing to go overtime in her office hour to help you. I would recommend asking questions in class and taking good notes. The playposits make it easy to get a good grade if you pay attention to them.

Ive taken Dr. Woodrums chem classes for 2 semesters online now and shes a solid professor for difficult classes. Shes done a great job of transitioning the course online, where zoom attendance is optional but very helpful!! The content is tough but the structure of her course makes it very doable if you utilize her class structure.

Teacher isn't bad, just a semi-difficult class. Make sure you attend lectures and study well. Allows leniencies such as replacing exam grade with highest score from corresponding section on the final and bumping lecture video credit to a 100% as long as it is above a 75%.

reviews.comment: Dr. Woodrum is incredible! I feel like she really does care about the students and i know that she loves being professor. She will help you as much as you want, just go to office hours and ask questions!

reviews.comment: Speaks too fast and she explains the easy questions but never the harder questions. Lots of typos in her answer sheet.

Dr. Woodrum does flipped classroom for 107, which I grew to love. Her playposit lectures are amazing, shes really great at delivering the content! Definitely the best 107 professor. In class, the activities help you collaborate and learn with others or get homework help! Truly loved this structure & Dr. Woodrums positive energy!

Dr. Woodrum has been one of my favorite teachers at UK. I took CHE 107 with her and her teaching style is quite unusual. She does a reverse classroom which means that she has us watch our lectures online and work on classwork during class. This allowed for us to ask questions about things we were confused on. Go to her office hours- very helpful!

Dr. Wooodrum teaches her 107 class very different as in you watch the lectures outside of class, and in class you do assignments to better your understanding. I like this method because I could listen to her lectures at my own pace and without distractions. This class is test heavy.

reviews.comment: Dr. Woodrum got me through CHE105 even though she wasn't even my teacher at the time. She posts all of her lectures online, so it's easy to go back and rewatch the material. The class is pretty difficult, so be prepared to spend about 3 hours a day studying/doing homework. Woodrum is incredibly caring and easy to talk to, I would 100% recommend.

Prepare to watch lots of videos/its a flipped classroom. You learn more and are better prepared for tests with her class, but its a lot of video watching time. Very caring woman who wants students to succeed. She's good at explaining things concept-wise so just really understand the math part and you'll be good for exams.

Kim is an amazing professor, she really cares about student success. Her playposits can be tedious but they offer good content and is easier to follow along with rather than in class lecture. She takes feedback seriously and is very easy to talk to.

LOVE Kim Woodrum!I may be doing horrid in the class, (just because Chemistry will always be a hard concept for me), but I had another professor here for 110 and I literally was helpless. Kim at least gives me hope and opportunities to learn and improve. She also is such a FUN teacher!!! 20/10 recommend her! Also she sang happy birthday to me (:

Her teaching style is great, you have to watch lecture videos outside of class and in class you do group work over the content which really helps you learn the content. The lecture videos are not bad. Woodrum is really friendly and lowkey a jokester. She is a great teacher and if you go to her office hours or ask questions in class you're gucci.

DO NOT take Dr. Woodrum. You are required to go to lecture (where she doesn't lecture) to only waste time doing iClicker questions. I'd recommend looking elsewhere for a chemistry professor.

reviews.comment: Kim is a great professor who really cares about the success of her students. The class is difficult but that's just chemistry in general. She makes amazing playposits that really help learn the material at your own pace.

reviews.comment: I have no bad things to say about Professor Woodrum. She was absolutely amazing. You can tell she genuinely cares about her students. go to her office hours, shes great!
Class is pointless. Lots of outside of class work

If it weren't for Iclicker points, going to class would be completely useless. All her lectures are given as homework, along with a ton of homework on the side. If you don't understand how to do the math, you won't pass the tests.

She doesn't lecture in class. All the lectures are playposits and you can find them all on youtube with the answers. They will bomb your grade if you don't get 10s. recitation is a joke. reviews.comment: Dr. Woodrum is amazing! Her style of teaching is different than most. She gives video lectures the night before and does group work in class. Go to her office hours!!! I will take her for as many classes as I can!!

Dr. Woodrum has really helped me get through a class that I didn't think I would get through. Some people do not like her teaching style since she makes you watch her lectures on your own time before class so that you can work on what you learned during class but it helped me a lot. She really cares about her students and their well being.
Makes class simple and easy to learn

Dr. Woodrum took me about a semester to warm up to. (Took CHE109/110). She a complete blessing for students fresh out of high school. GO TO HER OFFICE HOURS, it is where I learned the most and felt comfortable building a relationship with her as a prof. (YES, this is important). I wish she taught CHE 107, I'd change my major for this woman.

Dr. Woodrum is by far the best teacher I have ever had. Her style of teaching makes chemistry so easy to understand. She genuinely cares about your understanding of material and is always available for extra help. I HIGHLY recommend going to her office hours. She is a fantastic professor!! (I had her for che109 and che110)

This is for CHE109, it wasn't an option at the top. Kim is a great teacher. Literally all you have to do is show up, do the clicker questions, do the playposit videos AND TAKE NOTES (lots of the test questions come from those), & ask questions when needed. She's truly encouraging & cares about her students so don't be intimidated by her at all!

Dr. Woodrum is by far the best professor I have had in college so far. She is always available to meet and will help you in class on homework if there's time available. I went to her to go over an exam that I did not do well on at all and she was very helpful and was not judgmental. She was actually happy to see that I was reaching out for help.

reviews.comment: She is the best chemistry professor and is the nicest person in the world

reviews.comment: All lectures are videos for homework and group work and practice in class. YOU MUST COME TO CLASS. Easy to get an A if you take your notes and study learning outcomes.

reviews.comment: Kim does not lecture in class, so be ready to watch online lectures. We review and do group work in class, which can be pretty effective. There are many ways to raise your grade at the end of the semester. Kim is flexible and is pretty much always willing to help. Class attendance is important, but as long as you go 75% and study you'll be fine

It's common for Dr. Woodrum to walk around occasionally in class and ask students to get off their phones. Some students don't appreciate this, but I find it both helpful, constructive, and caring. The effort and attention Dr. Woodrum gives each student makes it hard for you NOT to learn. By far the the best teacher I've had in college.

Dr. Woodrum is by far the best professor I have had here at UK! Her lectures are all on youtube, so instead during class, you work in groups of four on example problem that helps reinforce the material. Student interns help with answering questions. If you aren't prepared for the exams, it's your own fault! Extremely available for office hours.

Dr. Woodrum is a great professor. She teaches Chem 109 and Chem 110 so I will be taking her again this semester. She does so much to try and help her students understand and learn chemistry even if you have a bad background in it. She is the most caring professor I have ever met. She has a wonderful personality. Homework heavy, but to help you.

I do not enjoy chemistry and find it hard to understand (unless you count Breaking Bad), but professor Woodrum made understanding a concept a much simpler task compared to my chemistry class in high school. If you email her your availability, she more than likely will find time to speak with you if you need extra help (and can't make office hours).
Online lectures only, which are very informational and include questions. Class time is used for group projects and participation points.

Dr. Woodrum is the greatest science teacher I have ever had. Her online lectures allow you to go back and get the help you need if you don't understand the first time. She is available multiple times per week during office hours and will answer your questions in depth. If you do the work, you will LEARN the material instead of memorizing it.
She is extremely condescending when you ask for help. If you go to office hours, she isnt helpful. Even after studying, the exams are still extremely hard. Avoid her if you can!

reviews.comment: It is a flipped classroom experience but honestly it makes it better. Most of the time you work on homework in class so you are actually doing problems and are able to ask questions which makes the content way easier to learn
Great professor. The online lectures really help because you can pause and take notes. If you do the work, you should get a good grade.

reviews.comment: Dr. Woodrum isn't terrible, but the class is very "teach yourself" type
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She is very good about giving information, explaining it thoroughly, and giving examples and completing them to reference. Very informative and a overall genuine person. I am currently in her class so I do not have a final grade, but getting at least a B, if not an A does not seem impossible at all if you put work into the semester.

You listen to the lectures the night before class and answer questions in them for points. She gives you a book with the ppt slides already on them so you are just filling in blanks. She explains things really well and during class will answer all of your questions and you can finish your homework for that week most of the time also with her help.

She is my favorite teacher I've ever had. Her teaching style is different but in a way it is very helpful. Lectures are online videos and then the class consists of group activities over the lectures. She goes deep into detail within her lectures so you can pck up a lot in them. The best way to study is to watch over videos and take notes. TAKE HER

Dr. Woodrum is extremely helpful and insightful in her lecture classes. You can really tell she wants her students to succeed. As long as you keep up with your assignments, I can assure you you'll pass the class. She readily prepares you for the exams as well. Great teacher!

Dr. Woodrum is one of those professors who just really cares about her students. Her class is not traditional, you work in a group all year and do a lot of activities in class instead of just lecture. Theres a lot of work, but if you pay even a little bit of attention and do the assigned work its and easy A. Lots of assignments, but all are easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Woodrum really wants students to succeed. With chem 109 you watch lectures (on playposit) for homework and do example problems and group work during class. The other homework is on Sapling. She uses reef polling during class for attendance and participation. The only bad part of the class is exams are taken on examsoft, its a chem dept thing.

Dr. Woodrum is very helpful and usually explains things more clearly than the other professors. 107 is a difficult course so having a good professor is never a bad idea. Her office hours are amazing so go see her every chance you get. She goes out of her way to help her students. Take her or Dr. Blue if you can.

Phenomenal teacher, for an insanely difficult class. She is one of very few options for you if you want a B or above in 107. The tests are insanely hard, but she'll prepare you for them better than any other professor for this class.

Super helpful, really funny, I was in the same class as one of her daughters and she has fun stories. The material is crazy hard but she helps as much as she can, she's really nice as long as you take some notes. She takes attendance using online questions and grades you on correctness, she will try to trick people who skip with the online polls.
This course is difficult. Woodrum makes sure to give lots of examples and work through things in class. She always makes time for you at office hours. She is a very helpful teacher.

Woodrum rules. I loved her and her class. As a chem major, she only solidified my appreciation and love for chemistry. She is helpful, available for help (in class, office hours, and on piazza) and is very clear about the work that you have to do and extra things to do if you need practice

She is a very nice lady. She gives good lectures. If she misses something in lecture she takes time out of her day to post the remainder of the info online. When you take this class do everything you can to take her, even if it's an 8am class. Chemistry is just extremely hard!
Dr. Woodrum is a great professor. She always goes into detail about everything we need to know for the exam. She is very funny, energetic, and always willing to help her students.
Great professor who puts in the occasional joke to keep the attention of the class. If you do all of the assignments and go to class you will pass and understand the material.

Dr. Woodrum is the best professor I have had at UK.  Lectures are very clear, organized, and helpful. If you get stuck, which you will, just simply ask her for help and it will be delivered.  Very knowledgeable about chemistry which makes her an excellent teacher for the course.

Dr. Woodrum is a great professor and really knows her chemistry.  She relates the class to things that are easier to understand and constantly reminds you of deadlines and ways to succeed in the class.  She is more than willing to help as long as you ask for it.

Absolutely the best prof at UK. Wish I could take her for every single class. Class starts off extremely basic then gets a tad bit more difficult but still easy class. Thank you so much Doc for inspiring me to get into Chemistry. Go to class though.

Just. The. Best. She is the best Professor you will ever have.  Imagine a helpful, nice, prof. who is passionate about Chemistry, who will help you until you -get- it without losing patience. She's awesome!!!

Required to take CHE 101 even though I had already taken other chemistry so I wasn't thrilled for the class and afraid I would be bored. Dr. Woodrum took the easy information and made it really easy. Fantastic Professor, she really wants to help her students,  Dr Woodrum is truly amazing.
She is an Amazing Professor. She truly teaches, and gives everybody the opportunity to learn and succeed. I wish college professors were more willing to be like Dr. Woodrum. Simply the best!

Literally the best professor in the chem department. Make your schedule fit around her class. Seriously. She is so helpful, and makes sure her lectures are understandable. If she asks the class a question, and there's a long silence, the next person that raises their hand may get extra credit. She clarifies problems in office hours until you understand. She is funny and performs cool experiments.
Dr. Woodrum is the best professor I have had yet had so far at UK. She is a very very good lecturer so you never get confused in the class.

Literally the best teacher I have ever had at the college level. She bases her teaching on understanding, not just throwing random material at you and hoping you catch it. If I had had her for 105, I would've gotten an A. She taught me more in my first class with her than I ever learned in 105. Take her class. #TeamWoodrum

Professor Woodrum is very easy to follow and quite possibly one of the best professors I've ever had. If I'd had her for 105, I probably would have pulled a better grade. She's incredibly helpful and clear and will do anything in her power to help you pass her class.

Doctor Woodrum is hands down one of the best college professors I have had! She is helpful in and out of class. She pushes students to do their best and provides them with the resources to do so! Although I received a B in 104, that was with minimal input on my end. Could have easily pulled an A with a bit more effort. She knows what she is talking about, I wish I could take her for 105 & 107.
Definitely one of the better chemistry professors at UK. She is very helpful if you go to her office hours.

Having her as my professor made Chemistry 107 my favorite class for that semester. She makes things easy to understand, and if you are still having trouble, she is more than willing to help you further. She literally sits down with you and works through problems. AN AMAZING PROFESSOR!

She is an AMAZING teacher! I had an awful teacher for Chem 105 and she literally changed my whole aspect of chemistry!! Makes it so relatable to the student! She truly cares that you understand. (not in honors section)

You want this teacher, simple as that.  Didn't mind her 8am lecture one bit...that is saying a lot!

Fantastic teacher. Revolve making your class schedule around getting this woman to teach you chemistry. Extremely helping during lecture and during her office hours. If you want to leave class feeling that you actually learned something, take her. #TeamWoodrum

She is an awesome teacher! Extremely helpful inside and outside of class. You want her as your professor! She has mandatory attendance but class goes by quick because she is funny and lively. She is theest chemistry teacher at UK!!

The best hire the University of Kentucky has ever made. Very Friendly and will bend over backwards to anyone who seeks out her help.  If you can't get in her class wait.

I had Dr. Zhou for both MA416 and MA427, and she's an excellent professor. Though both cover challenging material, she presents info in a clear, digestible way that makes complex concepts easier to handle. She has clear grading standards and is genuinely happy to help outside of class. Highly recommend taking a course with her!

You had direct assess to the instructor's Onenote, which are the class notes.
Grading was strict. Exams were tough, but it really helps if you're very familiar with the homework problems.
Had her again for another class, gotten worse and teaches straight from the textbook. If you have her, you better be familiar with the subject before-hand.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Difficult content, slightly strict grading. Enough in-class help/guidance on homework so that it isn't too bad. Quite a bit of in-lecture content that was not represented in the homework and exams. You will barely get finished if you struggle with timed exams. Certain high-level topics could be dumbed down and still be effectively taught.

Professor Zhou was not necessarily bad, but she had very unhelpful lectures. She knew her stuff reasonably well but had a huge emphasis on proofs and would routinely waste entire lectures going over a proof for a simple concept that could've been explained and done with in minutes, my recitation TA carried me.
She's great, she cares about her students and is always prepared for class. I took her for MA 113 and MA 213.
Great teacher that explained concepts really well. Calc 3 sucks but Zhou made it suck way less
Great professor, had her for Calculus 1 and 3.

Dr. Zhou is very funny, kind, and caring. She is always looking for ways to improve the program, lectures, and classroom environment. She has plenty of examples, uploads class notes that are very helpful and put in the hard work. Exams are based on old practice-exams and there is not much homework. Would take it again for Calc 3 especially!

Dr. Zhou was great! She posted handouts for each lecture as well as notes afterward. She was good at explaining things for the most part. She took attendance every Friday for the whole week. Textbook was not necessary at all; I did not use it once.
She has an excellent English vocabulary and handwriting, but a rather thick accent. It can sometimes be difficult to understand her verbal explanations for things.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class picks up in difficulty towards the end.  Professor Zhou cares about her students and provides lecture notes with examples that help understand the concepts, but her examples are easier than the ones that show up on homework, tests, and quizzes.  A lot of times I had to go to my TA to really understand the material and homework problems.

Professor Zhou taught this class well. Attendance was technically mandatory but was collected over participation every two weeks. She assigned roughly one homework a week and provided great lecture notes that helped with the homework. Exam 1 was very hard but for the last 3 she provided the exact outline for the exam so we knew what to expect.

Professor Zhou is very friendly and is easy to approach. However, I found that some content (couple of small things) were not covered in the lectures but appeared on the homework. Sometimes during lectures she goes a bit too fast, but she uploads the notes at the end of the lecture on her website. Overall very solid professor, would recommend.
I took Calc 1 in high school, so it was mostly review for me, for which the lectures are great for review.

She doesn't even communicate properly what you need to learn in order to do the homework or even the quizzes. My TA directly told us that he literally did not know what she was teaching us even though he was the one who made the quizzes. The information she is relaying to you through class is almost irrelevant because of how poorly it is taught.

While Zhou is as sweet and kind as she could be, she teaches in a very complicated, hard to understand way. If you don't already know how to do calc, don't plan on learning much in her course. Teaches as if she's reviewing instead of teaching actual new material.

Dr. Zhou is a very obviously great professor and intelligent mathematician. That being said, putting her as a lecturer for Calculus 1 is a travesty. She seems to be a 3-400 level teacher rather than a 100. While lecturing she will randomly go deep into theory and information we cant understand yet. That being said, very nice and very understanding

Professor Zhou is really knowledgeable but not great at teaching low level calculus. I get the impression Calc 1 is so easy for her she struggles to explain it in simple terms. She is hard to understand at times. Attendance isnt mandatory and you can tune in on Zoom, which is nice. I can tell she cares and really loves math.
free grade if any math smarts

Online MA213 was designed to have students watch a prerecorded lecture youtube video before class, Professor Zhou held three weekly (optional) zooms where she did additional practice problems and gave the students ample opportunity for questions. She was always very nice and wanted to make sure we understood everything. She was a great resource :)

An awesome professor, and one who genuinely cares about students. Be prepared to learn each class and likewise study outside of class. She is willing to go above and beyond in helping students; however, she expects the same level of participation from them. I would definitely recommend her and this class both!

Great professor, super respectful and caring. Her lecture notes and the course itself were both organized and well structured. She is also super helpful during office hours. CS/MA 415 itself was a bit tough and she could have been more clear about what to expect on quizzes and exams so be sure to ask her for details. Overall, 9/10 would take again.

Dr. Zhou is a very good instructor and cares deeply about her students. Her lecture material is clear and she does a good job explaining, and willing to help if you are confused about any topic. One of the best math professors I have had.
She cares for student, that is all you need to know
Awesome instructor, very fast at responding emails, have the patience to answer all questions you have. Lecture notes are super organized and helpful!!
Good instructor. She tells you what you need to know for the homework and tests and provides real world examples. Would definitely take again.
Dr. Zhou was very prepared for every lecture and she was more than willing to help students through email or office hours 9/10 would take again.

Teacher is very nice. Cares, but often seems to have difficulty explaining some questions. There are a lot of technical math theorems required. Tests are pretty damn tough and long. The entire lectures are spent writing notes, which she does post online. Some of the material on the exams is not covered in lecture, but is in the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: This professor is clearly very caring and kind, although it does seem she is still learning when it comes to teaching. The class itself was difficult and sometimes the professor made assumptions on what was taught prior to this class which were not actual prerequisites. It is very proof-heavy but she does post lecture notes online, which is helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Book is required for the course in order to do assignments. In class notes do not follow what is covered in the book. Exam does not cover fully what is covered in class, but "important abstract information is mentioned that will be on the exam. Only 5 grades for the entire class are entered. Exams have few problems; miss one and you fail. Bad exams

reviews.comment: Zeadally is a great teacher. Learned a lot!

One of the best professors I've had at UK, he spends so much time in preparing for every lecture. Extremely knowledgeable about his topics and is always reasonable about grading or asking for an extension. Beware it is a lot of information in lectures, so you need to listen and take notes from the start.

reviews.comment: Rambles incessantly every lecture, impossible to follow, 6 total graded assignments, doesn't offer makeups and still gives zeroes for questions not answered within the (absurd) 30 min time limit. Cares about nothing but the sound of his own voice.

He is very professional and genuinely passionate about his teachings. He has a lot of knowledge and experience in his field. It's one of the few ICT classes where you actually learn about IT and get hands-on experience. He tells you everything that will be on the quizzes and exams. Definitely write down everything he writes on the board.
He is deeply knowledgeable about his areas and is helpful if you need further understanding. He is straight forward and will tell you what type of information will be on his quizzes and tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Best professor I've had im college between IT and engineering schools. Go to class, ask him questions, he is legit and wants you to understand, but you have to show some effort. He tells you everything you need to know in class, you don't have to read if you go. If he writes it on the board, Write. It. Down.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Sherali is intelligent and truly has a gift in the way he teaches. But he was rude, intimidating when asked about the syllabus, and made it clear that you gotta figure things out on ur own. Made me feel dumb at times. And that's not how you wanna feel when taking a class you're interested in. Really disappointed in my experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Zeadally is one of the most knowledgeable professors I had at The University of Kentucky. He did an excellent job teaching difficult material in a way that made sense and where you could truly learn. He is open, honest, and gives 100%. His classes are difficult but if you listen and study you will succeed and the knowledge gained is worth it.

You can tell how passionate Sherali is about Cybersecurity. He seems very stern and strict at first but the next second he's smiling and laughing about whatever it is he's teaching. He is easily approachable and will take the time to help out any student in need. The course is hard, but he's the best professor I've ever had at this school.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor has a very hands on teaching style. He basically gives you quiz answers in class. But, he is rude, not approachable, and will make you feel dumb for asking him questions about the class. That way, you wont even want to ask questions and will probably have to figure it out on your own.

I wish I had never taken this class. He provides no help or instructions to his hands-on projects, so you're basically screwed if you are struggling. His class is very lecture and test heavy with him just content dumping, and his test averages are always around 40-50%. He enjoys calling out students and state comments that may be egoistic or rude.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Sherali's courses are the best I have taken at the University. He cares for his student's education based on his willingness to take questions, give and receive criticism, extend deadlines, and ensure his students understand the concepts he is teaching. Attending the lectures is the most critical element to success with Sherali.

I was scared initially, but Dr. Zeadally is so nice! Class has simple quizzes and fun projects. Expectations clearly laid out. He wants you to succeed, but if you don't put in effort, you'll do poorly. He will help you, but he won't spoon-feed you. He's a world-class cybersecurity expert and has lots to share. Attend class, listen, and take notes.

Usually assigns 10 or less assignments a semester with minimal outside work. Always has a hands on project that is fun and applicable. GO TO CLASS AND PAY ATTENTION as quizzes/Exams are short answer or fill in the blank. Endless experience to share and has respect for students. He explains topics in easy to learn ways, and cares about your success.

Prof. Zeadally is one of the best in his field, not just the university. If you show up and put forth an effort you will be fine. Privilege having him at the University of Kentucky. I would take him if given the chance his lectures are a valuable resource.

He cares about students and is very passionate about the way he teaches classes. He is very knowledgeable on the subject matter and is accessible outside of class. He does not rely on powerpoints or notes so attending the class is a must. he can come off as harsh and aggressive but does truly care about his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He is a really great professor who cares about the students. he can come off quite aggressive at times and his projects and exams can be hard if you don't participate and review before exams. He cares about the you as a student and wants the best for you.
I enjoyed his class. Very straightforward and clear. You know what to expect on his exams.

Not good. Lectures are boring and speaks monotone. He will not post the filled in slides. Exams are ok, he will NOT give them back. You can go to office hours to look at your exam but he won't let you keep them.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He will not post filled in notes so it is important to attend lectures. He fills in the notes during lectures and often shows video demonstrations for concepts. Tests are a combination of multiple choice, fill in the blank, and matching. He WILL NOT give graded exams back. You have to go to his office to look at it then he keeps it.
He doesn't teach well at all and just reads off lecture slides that probably aren't even his. He was nice and sent slides when I was out for a week due to medical reasons though.
He doesn't teach well at all and just reads off lecture slides that probably aren't even his. He was nice and yn when I was out for a week due to medical reasons though.
worst class ever

He can't actually teach, he just reads off slides he stole from another professor and shows How It's Made videos. His handwriting is terrible and at times illegible. Badly worded questions and typos in every exam, and in one a diagram was cut off that made it hard to answer the question. Not the worst professor I've ever had, but just overall bad.

Lectures are required, but the slides are a mess. His handwriting doesn't help the case at all. Only 3 exams that require lots of memorizing. Make sure to pay attention in class, missing even 30 seconds can cost you a point on a quiz. Seems to know what he's talking about most of the time, just a little confusing on what to put in my notes.
By far the worst professor I have ever had. Would not recommend.

I Had Zuidema the first semester he was hired and was under the impression I would have the previous professor who rated much higher until I walked in the door, typical UK admin activities. This class was not personally hard for me but I have previous knowledge / experience with materials science and makeup. First exam is worst, study all details.

Taught very monotone, just read off lecture slides, did not provide any material to help study for exams, even withheld past quizzes. The exams covered very minute details over things we hardly covered. Overall just not great.

No exam review lectures and no enthusiasm for this material whatsoever. His grading style is beyond questionable. He gave a quiz for each topic that hides the answers after its taken and when asked if he could open up the quiz for review for the first exam he said, "yeah I'm not gonna do that". His first time teaching so do with that what you will.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was impossible. He doesn't review content, makes it extremely difficult or impossible to access and review the quizzes (which are pretty much word for word on the exams), and has some of the most intelligible handwriting I've seen from a professor here. He also sounds like he has no passion for this subject and lectures are a drone.

This class was horrendous. This was his first semester teaching, so hopefully he improves in the future. Very memorization heavy, but gives you nothing to study with, and doesn't even review material before an exam. Lectures are incredibly boring, sometimes just him speaking with no eye contact and then playing episodes of How It's Made.

Personally, I feel that the other reviews are a little too hard on Dr. Zuidema. Yes, the class is long & boring. But, I believe that's the fault of the overall course. It's just poorly structured & everything is memorization. I'm unsure how many things were his decision or a "standard" for the course. Unsure if him adding extra content is true.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do your best to attend lectures and follow along with his notes because he won't give you any other materials to learn from in the class, including a filled out copy of the notes. He puts effort into taking resources away from students and makes learning the content unnecessarily difficult. Use the resources posted by former students to study!
This guy is buns
He just reads off the slides every class.

This guy does not care about what he is teaching and reads off the slides. Be prepared to hear a monotone voice for 75 minutes straight each class. He also has more content to cover than the other teachers who teach this course.

Not only does he just read off of the slides the whole time he "teaches", but he also goes over more content than the other ME 251 teachers did. It is hard to stay awake and take notes since he is always teaching in a monotoned voice. He locks quizzes and doesn't give you any extra content for preparing for exams,and has 0 review days before exams.
The class is straight up memorization and tests are harder than they need to be. Zuidema is cool I guess, he did his job or whatever, but the course is honestly stupid. Barely stayed awake.

Online class with only exams that are 8 questions. No real class material on exams “examples from lecture video” which are 45 mins each and assumptions. Videos aren't released until 2 days before the check in quiz. Hard to get an A unless you literally get 100 on more than half of the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He only does exams which aren't even questions about the material they're based on assumptions and examples from class which is once a week. One group presentation that is graded based on the whole group and is very harshly graded considering you only get a week to complete it with no set group meetings and no contact info for group is provided.

The class is based off of 4 exams and 1 8 person group project. The lectures were 2 1/2 hours and he used in class examples from those 2 1/2 lectures as most exam questions. The group project had instructions were unclear and having groups of 8 was weird and seemed like too many people for what he wanted. He didnt provide much feedback on anything.

This course was required for my major and the only section I could take with my schedule. Although the course is listed as asynchronous, exams are scheduled Wednesday nights (4–8 PM), and the professor offers zero exceptions for anyone. He was the least helpful professor I have ever had and made it incredibly discouraging to succeed in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Zach is great. The course consists of a project, lectures, and exams. You have few grades in the course, so be aware of that. The exams aren't hard iff you pay attention/ listen to him during lectures. He tells stories of real-world examples of things he discusses in class. Great guy, great lectures, and not bad/hard exams. Recommend!

Professor Edens is a very easy going guy and I'm sure is well aware his class is extremely easy. Each class period is 10 light slides and every couple classes there's an online exam, I just reread the slides an hour before the exam and got 100. There are several guest speakers. He is funny but in a corny kind of way, I liked it. Fun class material.
tough grader, consider going to class

Zach is awesome. The course consists of lectures, guest speakers, and exams. You have maybe 7-8 grades in the course, so be aware of that. The exams aren't hard if you enjoy sports and listen to him during lectures. He tells stories of real-world examples of things he discusses in class. Great guy, great lectures, and not bad/hard exams. Reccomend!

I'm sure he would be a great professor in person but do not take his online class. His online lectures are good and the exams are not overly hard but here's the downside. It is an asynchronous class - but all exams are due Wednesdays between 4-8pm. This was extremely difficult to complete because of other classes, work, and meetings. No flexibility

I LOVE him, the only downside is that there are no busy-work assignments so you literally have 5 grades in the book. I hate that I didn't have any room to pull my grade up to an A, but I can't even be mad because he is an amazing professor and I learned so much from his lectures. 10000% would take him again and recommend going to his lectures

Overall, Zack is a good professor with engaging lectures, considering his classes are 2.5 hours long. He's pretty accessible outside of class and is helpful. Only downside is that there's not homework, so grades are determined by the exams and group project. His exams can be a little difficult, so studying for them is a necessity.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Zack is great, i've taken 2 or 3 of his classes now. He is open to discussing all notes and exams with you. He only has 4 exams and a group project the entire semester, that's it. If you show up and pay attention, you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Allow yourself time before an exam to study. Content is not hard, it can be a lot. I studied like this; 6 days before exam...study ch 1 day 1 day 2 study ch 1 and 2, etc... it all builds on itself. Attendance is not mandatory, but go and pay attn!! The work you put into this class is the grade you will end with. You will learn a lot in this class.

If you love watching long prerecorded lectures with no sense direction in a class this is for you. Not to mention he grades incredibly hard for no reason. Would never take this class is if it wasn't a requirement and he's the only option. Does not give any feedback on your terribly graded exams either.

The entire class grade is made up of 5 exams which he grades incredibly tough for no reason and also provides zero feedback. His class uses lectures and slides from years ago, if your going to put in zero effort to teach the class at least give proper feedback on the exams so we can improve and know what we are doing wrong.

Took MGT309 online and I personally found the lectures tiring overtime. Having a 5pm class isn't the most fun but Zach tries hard to make the best of it. There is a lot of material which made it harder for me to pick up on things but you HAVE to go to class if you want an A and pay attention. I would rate the teacher a 10/10 but the material 5/10
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Must go to lecture because he references things/examples he gives in the test. Hard grader, especially on the final group project. No extra credit. Tests are the only grades plus the final group presentation. I studied for exams and still didn't do well. Would not take this class again if i didn't need it.

Really good professor. When the University cancelled in-person classes for the semester he offered to help students with any of their concerns that their advisors/other professors couldn't do. The exams are easy- you could just look over the slides the day-of and get a B on them. The group project at the end sucks.

Attendance isnt mandatory so some classes I did skip and then when I went to class I was called out by the professor for not being in class. Other than that I got an A in the class. Zack is nice but I wouldnt take him again bc every class he does the same end of the year presentation and it sucks. If you are good at presenting then take him
Not the most studious person but got an A in this class. Don't have to go to class but is meaningful. Can study by looking at slides he posts on canvas. If you are MGT for sure take this class.

Zack's class is easy if you show up. Attendance is non-mandatory, but videos and examples he uses in class (and are not on the slides) will be referenced on tests. Very easy course if you attend lecture. He's witty and quick and makes class interesting with examples. Not everybody's cup of tea but I loved him
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I've taken Zach 3 times and loved his class each time. He knows his stuff and demonstrates it well. He gives awesome lectures and once you learn his style, the exams aren't hard. I dont think I ever got lower than a 85 on any exam including finals. I can't recommend him enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Zach is overall a good professor. He is a nice guy and is willing to go out of his way to help you. He tries to be funny and a lot of the time he is, but sometimes he can be a bit rude without meaning to be. His tests aren't hard and all the material comes from lecture. The only bad thing about him is his group project at the end of class. It sucks
Loved this class! No book-- just class notes. He makes the material interesting. Very nice and fair professor

Zack is awesome. If you go to class and study like the day or so before exams you should be fine. Everything comes from the notes and he shows really interesting videos fairly often and is an awesome lecturer. I never got bored. For the final he gave me the exact grade I needed for an A. Pretty dope.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is a good professor and makes class interesting and attendance is not mandatory but I would highly suggest going to class. He will ask test questions like, when we learned this subject what example did I use? Overall if you go to class the exams are easy.

Zack is going to make you work hard for an A. Expect two-part essay exams & poor scheduling. He gave a take home & final exam w/n the same week. He claimed those who dislike him don't like to work hard and are lazy... Overall, he's a nice guy (one on one) but his ego is out of this world. I earned an A but wouldn't take his class again. Go to class

Going to class is pretty important. There is stuff on the tests that you only get from class. He does put all of the subject power point notes online so if you miss class you still get all of the big material. He is straight to the point and tells you everything you need to know for the test. There is a lot of material on the test.

Many people don't like him, but mostly because he is such a tough teacher. He's trying to prepare his students to do well in life, and he is an amazing professor - my favorite of all my four years of college. Just realize - you can't be a baby and expect an easy A. Deal with it, you're an adult - WORK for your grade.
He is very tough but he makes it all worth it. I feel like I actually learned something important in this class that I can relate straight to real life. I loved this class

makes the class way harder than it needs to be. If your looking for an easy A take holbine for MGT 301. zack is going to make you work your ass off for an A when it isn't neccesarry for a stupidass intro to management class. tells you a few random questions that will be on his test worth 2 pts, take the big lecture one unless mgt is ur major

GO TO CLASS!! If you do, the test are BEYOND easy if you stay half awake. no reason not to get an A. He tries hard and puts in a lot of effort, the presentations are graded more on if you practice than your content, and the material is easy. Also ask for the take home test option, he grades it easy.

Zack prides himself on changing his mind and grading his students accordingly. We found out before our SEMESTER LONG presentation that we would have papers due, although all semester Zack said we would be graded on our presentation alone. He is unfair in his grading and he frequently gives "life lessons" where he attempts to be an expert on life.

Zack is a challenging professor, but exams are exactly off of the notes. You will learn a lot from him, and there is an essay exam. Also group project that's not graded hard. Finally, no extra credit given, but overall a very rewarding class and he's very engaging and interesting with the material

I loved the class! As long as you show up and pay moderate attention, which isn't difficult, you can get an A. He tells you what you need to know for tests. Uses great real world examples to help students relate to what we are learning. You can contribute and participate as much or as little as you would like. Take this class with him!
He takes a simple class and subject and makes it more complicated than it needs to be.  Reads the power point notes. Take the larger class. He makes the smaller class do a group presentation.

Dr. Z is passionate about what she does, and the material is interesting, but it and the discussions are redundant. You NEED to participate, but even if you do, she might grade as if you're only minimally involved. It's an easy class, but unless you're really passionate, it's not too fun (but it is eye-opening); also, there is a group project.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Z is extremely passionate about teaching and all of the topics and material she presents to the class.  She truly loves her students, and she likes to keep classes fun, actually engaging, and very deep. I would say that the readings for class are usually very light, and the in-class writings are very short and simple.

The assignments where all weird and nothing we did ever really made sense. You have to participation LOTS in class. You can never skip. I had the flu AND a Dr. note, and she didn't excuse my absence. Also, lots of reading. The only good thing is there was no exams.

Dr Z is easily UK's best professor. She is incredibly knowledgeable about what she teaches and will take the time to get to know her students. There is a lot of mandatory readings and you have to participate but it is nothing very taxing, just a few minutes of your time. Her activities are fun and you really delve into the material.

Professor Z has made her class very engaging and fun! While you have to do the readings for her class and participate, it makes the class fun and you really get to dive deep into the honors experience! I would recommend again!

UK's best professor and it's not even close. Cares about her students more than anything. Assigns the most interesting readings, and is very great at facilitating intellectual dialogue. Her classes are all seminar based and they'll be the best seminars of your life. She's just genuinely a great person and inspirational presence.

Dr. Z is one of my favorite honors professors. For her Modern Material Culture course, we did a lot of interesting hands on projects. The class is largely discussion based, and students take turns leading class. The readings can be long, but not too bad. Dr. Z makes class so fun with her personality and interesting topics she has the class discuss.

Dr. Z is a lot of fun and is really passionate about her job. She is a super easy grader so just do the readings and you will get an A. I would definitely take a class of hers again, so just participate and you will be fine.

Dr. Z is a must take professor here at UK. She is not only an amazing teacher, but you can tell she truly cares about every single student in that classroom. Without a doubt, Dr. Z is the best professor UK has to offer. She somehow makes even the most mundane material into a valuable and interesting discussion.

Dr. Z is such an awesome teacher and she makes class periods so much fun. I will say there are discussion posts for almost every class period, but the in-class discussions are pretty fun. Overall, an amazing person and an amazing teacher! She actually cares about her students and her content.

ATTENDANCE MATTERS!! You literally can not miss a single class without it docking your grade, and if you want to get it excused, you have to write an essay, even with a doctors note. But the class is super easy, I missed class a lot and a few assignments and still got an A. She is a very good teacher but you have to participate and go to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Z is an amazing professor that genuinely cares about her students. She does expect your participation and will have some quizzes on readings but the topics are interesting. She does a lot of fun projects that will help you grow your resume.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The best professor at UK.

I can't say enough good things about her, so funny, so nice, super knowledgeable.  I would go to her office hours just to talk with her more.  I want to take every single one of her classes.  Lots of reading, but it is super interesting.  Genuinely cares about student well-being and grades leniently as long as she sees effort.

Dr. Z truly respects each and every one of her students. She is the GOAT at making class fun. She is super genuine and wants the best for all her students. She teaches the class in a way that she is also learning. The majority of the class was based around a seminary style of learning based on the reading assignments--which were difficult at times.
literally great that's all
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Z is genuinely the kindest, most caring, and funniest professor (and person) I have met. Readings can be long, but they usually are super interesting and worth the read. Class is mostly graded on participation with few assignments or grades, but Dr. Z is not a tough grader and typically gives students the benefit of the doubt.

Dr. Z is a great teacher who truly cares for her students. Dr. Z makes each class fun, and she always is open during office hours. Hon140 is an easy class as long as you read the material, show up, and talk once or twice. The reading is sometimes dense, but it's nothing to worry about.

She is by far the best professor I probably will ever have. I'm currently taking her HON 251 class and everything about her is the same like her teaching style, etc. Extremely inclusive, she genuinely cares about every single one of her students. If you have the option to take her, DO IT.

Dr Komara was amazing. She is the best honors professor I have ever had, I wish I could take more classes with her. Something about her makes class so enjoyable, and I would 100% recommend her to anyone. Just amazing!

Dr. Z rocks! She has so many students who love her and will take as many of her classes as possible. She assigned a coloring page midterm and a play performance final project, neither of which I had ever done before. She is one of the most accepting and badass people I have ever met. It's obvious that she's passionate about what she does.

If you can't tell by the reviews, everyone loves Dr. Z. She genuinely tries to make everyone feel welcomed and like they're a part of the class. I'm one of my only friends who actually enjoyed their HON140 class (and I'm also the only one who had Dr. Z). Would definitely recommend!

If you don't like an authentic and a straight up honest person then Dr. Z is not for you. A specific reading is required but you can get the audio instead of the book. Dr.Z is super understanding, caring, and down to earth. Literally just talk to her and it will feel like you're talking to a professional big sister that's your teacher! Luv u Dr.Z
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I cannot express enough how much I adore Dr. Z!! shes super accommodating and always does her best to support everyones wants/needs & employ teaching practices that value students as people first. even if you dont take her course, i highly recommend getting to know her
Dr Z is the best. That's it. That's the review.

Dr. Z is genuinely life changing. Her class isn't always easy (there's lots of readings that challenge your world view) but if you show up and put in some effort you'll get an A. She cares so much about her students, always gives us time to be candid and honest, and will be in your corner no matter what. She's just awesome.

Dr. Z is by far one of the best and most insightful professors I have taken at the University of Kentucky. The content she makes you read for class can be quite challenging, but taking the time to actually read it and understand it can be very rewarding. If she can tell you are trying your best, you will likely get a good grade.

Dr. Z is one of my favorite teachers/professors of all time, and I LOVED being in her class. She is a kind hearted person cares deeply about individual needs. I will note, however, that you do need to try to participate in class to the best of your ability. Also no textbook, but we did read The Book of Delights by Ross Gay.
Dr. Komara makes sure to educate her students in a clear and fun way. Shes amazing and flexible based on her students needs. The absolute best.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If I wanted to fully convey how great Dr. Z is, I would surpass the character limit. She is respectful and caring towards her students, and she is very knowledgeable and passionate about what she teaches. She expects effort and participation, which is easy in the accepting environment she creates. The readings she gives are interesting.

Dr. Z is my favorite teacher in the Honors College, and perhaps all of UK. Her classes challenge you to confront your own biases and think at a high level, while not being overwhelmed with the work outside of class. I also had her for HON 101 and would take any class of hers again. She remains an amazing professor both in person and online.
Her class is fun and she is amazing.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Hon 101 is an introductory course, but she is truly an awesome professor. Some of the readings are a little obscure and forced, but the discussion is always fun and interesting. The projects are manageable and she always is there if you need help. Very funny and up to date on current happenings as well.

Dr. Z strives to help students inside and outside of class. This honors course on pseudoscience was her best class I've taken yet! It was an open-ended discussion class based on readings that she assigned. We even had a section on Canvas for class memes about pseudoscience.

Class was discussion based and readings usually ran between 20-36 pages. No textbook. Conversation was very organic and informal. Had 4 short unit reflections (first 2 short essays & latter 2 student's choice). Photo essay was very doable and she'll help you a lot if you ask. Good feedback. Not enough people use her office hours. Overall very fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Since this is an honors class, she set the bar high, but everything is totally reachable. I tanked one of the first assignments, but then went to her office hours and she was so accommodating and so helpful (and let me rewrite!) Not only does Dr. Z love all of the topics in this class, she helped me learn to love it too. 10/10 recommend, take Dr.Z!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: This was easily my favorite class for my first semester of college. The professor chose topics that were important to the class and sparked discussion for a fun and interesting seminar. Nearly everyday was based on a different issue meaning that on some nights there was a bit of reading, but it was totally manageable. LOVE HER.

Dr. Z is an amazing professor who is willing to help all of her students not only within her class but with subjects outside of class. Her lectures cover interesting topics and she involves different mediums of teaching that allow for great discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Amazing professor! While her class was very article and participation heavy, she made sure to make her lectures as interesting as possible. Very funny and honest about everything. The topics that are covered in her class can be sensitive, but she makes sure to see everyone's viewpoints through and makes sure everyone feels respected and cared for.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Komara made this class easy for students who want to do well. The seminar style made her an accessible teacher. The beginning of the semester included heavy reading which got easier over time. We engaged in interesting topics throughout the semester and learned through a variety of methods and mediums. Her grading was easy, if you did the work.

Professor Komara was an amazing professor. She always went out of her way to encourage students and give them honest feedback on papers. She understood that this is a beginning honors course and really adjusted the syllabus to fit the needs of the class. Hon 101 deals with many interesting topics which is beneficial but participation is madated.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: She is very nice and loves what she teaches and expects the same from you. She requires you to be ready for every class with reading anywhere from a couple pages up to 30-40 per class. She changes from grading very easy to quite hard depending on how she feels on the assignments. Overall made an 100 level class more difficult than it should be.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very helpful and nice! Expects you to be prepared for recitation.

Monday is lectures, and Wednesday is a new group assignment that is based on a data scenario about a specific brand. The class is interesting and Zhang is always around to answer questions (make sure you ask them). No exams just a midterm and final project.

I will likely get an A but, I learned nothing. I would rather gotten a B and have learned something. I need this information for my major & future career. All we did was group work, so I was teaching myself basically. Slides were minimal & there was a language barrier. I typically don't mind but, most of class I could not comprehend her. Very nice!

She's nice and I felt bad but the class was so boring. 30-40 slide lectures that no one ever paid attention to. The content was difficult and no one ever knew what to do. The assignments were complicated for no reason, and the end of semester project is supposed to be 6-10 pages. I'm lucky I've had a good group, otherwise I would've failed.

She once expected us to write a group 25-page research paper from scratch during one 1h15m class period after she had already given a lecture. Of course, this is impossible, and she had to extend the deadline. Her expectations are extremely unrealistic and her assignment guidelines and feedback are unclear. She also does not post our class grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Language barrier is extremely difficult. An insane amount of class is dedicated to her PowerPoints that she reads word for word and every slide. Instructions unclear to everyone in the class (every single assignment). She is so kind but this class is not for the hard of hearing / those who have trouble hearing through thick accents.

Textbook never used. Attendance is measured by daily Canvas quizzes with a code that count as extra credit at end of semester. She will not measure it as such until the semester is over, so you'll never know your real grade. No one ever knew what was going on or what she wanted. Whole class is group work. Very short deadlines

Scratch that. Especially for MA162. Overcomplicates everything, even when asking her a question. I had to teach this whole course to myself during the end because it felt like the lectures were so pointless in terms of the overcomplicating simple steps and moving way too fast through. Maybe easy if you put all your attention into the course.
She is very kind but hard to understand sometimes. She moves pretty quickly as well.
do not take her class. take anyone but her.

The professor is super nice, it's just kind of hard to understand her sometimes. The exams are worth 70% of your grade, I studied a lot and barely passed. Hard to learn material in lecture, professor does not teach the work and just does it and wants you to follow. Doesn't answer questions asked in class, so even harder to know what's going on.
She is hard to understand and keeps going doesn't give a lot of time for feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is a kind professor but I feel like the way she explained some things in her class was much more difficult than it needed to be. Instead of breaking down certain problems in simple ways it feels like she added more steps than necessary. Attendance is mandatory and graded by iclicker, you will be graded by participating in the iclickers as well.
Great professor who truly cares and wants his students to preform well

If you're at all good at stats, this class is really easy. The first half is a repeat of STA 296. Anyway, Sam is fine. He's nice and not bad at lecturing, but the class was boring. Gives homework; gives quizzes that are exactly like the homework; gives exams that are exactly like the quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS
