reviews.comment: I would take him again just because how nice he is. He is willing to help you out if your grade isn't what you want it to be. Overall, he isn't the greatest teacher as his lectures are really confusing. The class is called "Business Statistics" but there were hardly any Business concepts used. It was just another stats class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Caring

reviews.comment: Sam is a great professor and one of the kindest professors at UK. He willing to go above and beyond to see you succeed, but you must show up to class. He's helpful in his office hours and will take the time to explain the material until you understand it. I highly recommend taking him.

He is very nice and funny. You have to show up to this class, but I wouldn't bother buying the book unless you really need a home reference. He gives quizzes and projects, but you get to work as a group for both. There was NO HOMEWORK in this class other than to study, which is crazy and awesome, but may change in the future.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Ahn is one of the most well-versed and knowledgable professors at UK. His curves on his tests and homeworks are pretty cool, since usually the curves are really large. He does not take attendance but gives you a participation grade depending on if he remembers your face or not.

As an econ major, Ahn is the worst of the econ professors I've taken. His grading scale in the two classes I've had with him is completely opaque. He assigns homework problems that are matters of opinion and takes off huge points if you do not say exactly what he wants. He "doesn't believe in giving As." Avoid at all costs.

Dr. Ahn is extremely intelligent and really knows what he is talking about in terms of statistics. That said his class is difficult but he gives you fair warning from the beginning. If he says that you should really pay attention and understand a subject then study it A LOT. His tests are difficult but all grades are curved.

he is very unclear with his grading scale. makes you feel very inadequate when asking questions. he takes attendance on the days that most people are absent. curves his entire grading scale at the very end of class. however, you have no idea where you stand the entire semester

Most intelligent professor I have had. Knows his stuff, is clear about expectations, always pushes back deadlines to give you more time. Also he makes class as interesting as possible by telling lousy, but still funny jokes.

Please save yourself from taking this class with this professor. He will not help you and says if you dont get it then drop the class. Also, he has hard problems sets and expects you to write a 15 page + research paper by the end of the semester with two other people. NOT WORTH YOUR TIME, even its it the only time slot left...
This was a great class with a great instructor. She explains things very well, and rewards effort. She is the nicest professor I have had here at UK.

I loved this class--it was a real eye opener to things going on in our world. She explains thing so well. She is also a very nice person: she would post the reading questions for quizzes and exams well in advance--so people complaining about the readings are probably a little lazy or something. I would definitely take her again as a professor.

Absolutely HATED this class. She let you use  notes on the quizzes and stuff but over 50% of what's on each quiz is from the readings and has nothing to do with the lectures.  She also counts off for the littlest things it's pretty ridiculous. I do not recommend this course at all.
Best theory professor ever! I hated theory before I took this class. She rocks!
great theory prof, explained a myriad of contemporary ideas. lots of reading with written responses, but you get to use em on tests so its really very helpful
Great teacher! Easy class, she gave a ton of notes which she let us use on quizes and test. She engourages a lot of class participation.
I have taken SOC 380 and it was a awesome class I suggest everybody to take it. She is also my mentor for INT 495 and she is just the most helpful and understanding person ever.

This was one of the easiest classes I have ever taken. She makes things very simple and you get to use your journal on the exam. Most of the exam questions come from the journal questions. She is super nice and laid back.

This class is interesting and you learn about a variety of topic regarding globalization. You have to do the readings and answer the study questions, the quizes are open note and come straight from the study questions. Tests are not too difficult. She is very nice.

She keeps theory simple which is definitely why you have to have her for theory because if you get someone like Scott you are pretty much doomed.  The tests aren't bad at all, especially since you get to use your theory journals for backup.  A lot of group stuff, though.  I guess it's a fair trade-off for her lax grading.
Very laid back. Made a hard social theory class really fun and suprisingly understandable.
One of the most amiable professors I have had at UK.  If she knows you're trying, she is willing to help you out.
Its a very interesting class. She is hard but explains the material well. She is a little OCD about attendance and being late but overall I enjoyed the class. Not my major.

In order to succeed in her class, you must constantly pay attention and on her tests write a book and include everything in the answer to get full credit.  Her tests are essay and short answer, and you have to do a presentation.  If she knows you're trying she'll bump your grade up if you've attended every class.

She's very passionate about the topics but never gets preachy.  Excellent professor and very easy to get along with & laid back.  The course may seem a bit tough, but really, you'll be surprised how easy her exams are.  Make sure to keep up with readings because she has pop quizzes (she sends possible questions she'll ask over email-- so no sweat).
Very nice---excellent professor.  Class based on lecture and readings.  She does a good job of explaining the material.
Great professor, did sometimes take minute to grade exams.

He is a great professor. I love his lectures anc how he links stuff we learn in class to the news. His assignments and exams are straightforward. He is also very confident and attractive and I can't wait to take his courses in the fall

I really enjoy Dr. Asiri's classes. I would take as many as possible with him if you can! His approach to political science content is very nonpartisan/analytical. I felt like I did the most "learning" in his classes for poli sci. Sometimes his assignments could have more detail, but if you go to class, engage, and review content you will be fine!

Content wise, it's straightforward. I got an A on every test having only spent less than an hour studying before each exam. Attendance and participation will make or break your grade, which is an insidious form of teaching given the relative ease of the graded content. Participation is graded arbitrarily, randos who never talked scored higher :(.

Class overall seemed to love him. He's very flexible with grading, the content he goes over in lecture, due dates, etc. Recognizes when class doesn't grasp certain things and so tried to teach or explain it differently. Encourages questions. Big on “group projects” (they're easy and done in class dw!) You won't regret taking PS 210 with him.
The class was ridiculously difficult for a 101 class. He tried to be helpful if you talk to him, but it didn't change how harsh it was, especially for an intro level course. Would not recommend.

Great person but not professor. Not enough assignments to guarantee a great grade. He can be a tough grader, and communication ain't always easy to adjust. I don't think he understands how much our GPA means to us students.
I love his classes. He is an amazing professor. Take any class he offers and you won't regret it

Took LJ201 with him. By far the best professor I had in college. His lectures are very interesting and knows how to get students engaged. Clear instructions and always responsive. I hope he comes back in the fall

(LJ201) Did not receive 5/8 of my grades until after the final, and did not have a rubric nor feedback for grades. Tried to reach out several times to inquire about grades, and never got a response. All of the grades are out of 15 or less, so good luck meeting his unknown standards enough to get an A. Overall disappointed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: (LJ201) there's barely any work assigned and graded in the course, so you may not be able to make up a bad grade. I literally got Bs on most of the assignments. The participation dragged my 83.75 down to a 78.5 (he didn't even add the participation and attendance grades to canvas til after classes ended) (mind you this is a lecture class)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a really good professor and cares about the material being taught. His class is mainly quizzes and exams but they are not worth many points. Overall, he is a pretty good professor and I would take him again.
LJ 201. Very lecture-heavy and is clearly very keen on starting debates. The class itself is fairly simple, though very boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: An amazing professor. I learned a lot from him and I'm not surprised to know that he has got four masters and a phd. Definitely recommend his classes

I've not had such a great professor and an interesting class as this one in a long time. At first, I thought this would be like any other class on wars and conflicts. However, the lectures and the activities turned out to be very interesting and thought provoking. He is a fair grader and I am already signed up for one of his other classes
There were two assignments the entire course that are horribly communicated, have no rubric, and are graded harshly. The exams are extremely difficult and near impossible to prepare for.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I love this class. At first the grading layout seems daunting but trust Asiri when he tells you that you will do well if you try. I got a 65% on the first exam and was very bummed, but I am finishing his course with a solid B because I trusted him! It is very evident that Asiri wants students to succeed and loves studying international conflict.

I love this class. He is really passionate about this course and cares about his students. He always mentions examples and have us to do fun group activities in class. This class helped me understand wars and conflicts. If you pay attention to lectures and use the study guide, you will do well in exams. I will definitely take any class with him.

I really like this professor. I'm in his class now and love it. His lectures are very interesting and asks thought-provoking questions. He values his student's opinions and participation in the lecture. You can tell he loves the material. I would take this class again and is a great professor.

He only gave us three assignments throughout the ENTIRE semester. This was very unfair. No matter how much you study, you won't do good on the exam. I studied for WEEKS and got a 50%. I am a straight A student and have been on the deans list the past two semesters, never have I done this poorly on an exam.

This professor gave us three total assignments for the whole course. I am typically a straight A student and had a 50 in this class because it was the only grade going into midterms. He doesn't care about his students success, and also continuously fails to communicate all information to students regarding course material.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He isn't a bad professor, he definitely cares alot about what he does, being a 4 credit course its definitely difficult sometimes. There are 2 exams which make up a total of 50% of your grade, so Study!
Lots of physical activity within this class, but good professor for it.
good overall
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Abel is very into the material he is teaching and no one questions his passion. The material is sometimes too complex, but he is willing to help with questions. A big portion of the class's 100 points are labs so being in class on those days is pretty crucial. He assigns two relatively large group projects due at the end of the semester.

Outstanding professor, he is really passionate about teaching. He really sparked my interest in strength and conditioning. He is really helpful and very knowledgeable. Read the book, attend class, and put the effort in and you will get a lot out of the course and a good grade. I would highly recommend Abel, one of the best professors I've ever had!

One of the best professors I've had. Thorough and available at the drop of a hat. His only downside is he grades grades on a 100 point scale for the whole semester so if you miss an assignment here and there you're grade will quickly suffer and he's a stickler on the final grade. All around nice guy, great professor and as smart as they come.

He doesn't know how to use Canvas very well. Its an easy class but attendance matters a lot. I didn't come to class often which is why I ended with a B. He is nice but I wouldn't take him if you actually want to learn just take him if you need a easy class.

Easy class. Quizzes are online and open notes. Attendance is for a grade but not a high percentage. However will never answer your emails after emailing multiple times and asking him to answer in class. Might of just been the TA but he also hasn't graded something from February and it is now May. Easy class but difficult professor to work with.
Love this guy so much he is very kind. Assignments were clear and easy. Quizzes and exams are online and open note. I reccomend getting your presentation out of the way early in the semester.
Easy professor and easy class. I wish we had more time for the exams and quizzes though. All the tests and quizzes are online.

He's a very wonderful, caring professor. He has an accent that can sort of make him hard to understand, but I personally had absolutely no issue. He'll joke about it more than anything. It's very lecture heavy, but the slides are uploaded and it's easy to take notes in class. You have your notes, you can easily pass every exam which was on canvas.

He just talks the entire class, super boring to listen to. Don't take him unless you want to hear sexist talk the entire time. He does give extra credit for answering questions, but his TA grades super hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a great professor

Mohammad Zannoun is the best professor for any topic. He is so sweet and understanding. He is also so funny and jokes often, and he is very easy to talk to. If you have any issues (exams, attendance), he is very easy to communicate with and understands any situation! I would 100% take him again.

He is a sweetheart. Reopens test and quizzes for you if you encounter any issues, offers extra credit, genuinely cares about his students success. Attendance is mandatory for your grade but he is very understanding if you cannot make it. Responds to emails very fast. I highly recommend Dr. Zannoun!

Dr. Zannoun is very entertaining and funny! His lectures were simple and interactive. All quizzes/exams were online. The final was too but a lot of information on it was very detailed when the topics were barely mentioned in class, which was how quizzes were. He takes attendance but will excuse if you email him. Overall he's good besides his exams.

Dr. Zannoun is a very good teacher. He was accessible outside of class. Main assignment, aside fr on tests, is a PPT about a reading you chose. My only issue is that he never opened the correct answers for the quizzes and tests and, although it was not a problem for myself, he does have a bit of an accent.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of the nicest professors I've had at UK, very easy class just show up, Mr. Zannoun loves his job and always has a smile on his face while teaching.
goat professor. Easy class. No homework other than weekly online quizzes and exams. Tons of extra credit offered. Participate in class and you will be set.

Dr. Zannoun is very nice and truly cares about his students! The content was interesting and not too difficult. We had quizzes and exams (open-note, online), some short papers, and a presentation. The exams can be hard, because there'd be questions on topics he barely mentioned. The class could maybe be structured better too. He's so nice though!

dr. zannoun is an awesome guy; all he does is lecture but he is so entertaining to listen to. attendance is mandatory, all quizzes & exams are online, not on lockdown browser, easy, multiple choice. he is not the best technology wise but is always willing to help people out
He was fine. Every day was the same: just another lecture. Tests and quizzes were online. Confusing sometimes, but really not that bad.

Overall nice guy, and although the class was lecture heavy, the content was interesting. However, his exams are surprisingly difficult; he words questions strangely and the questions seem to focus on very niche things from the class (tbh I felt like half the stuff on the final wasn't talked about in the class and/or I had nothing in my notes).

Super nice guy, just not my favorite professor. He just kind of talks all class and I'm not really sure what we are learning all the time, but it was not a hard class and if you read the textbook you will get by just fine. I liked him as a person and he was entertaining and caring, but just not the best at lecturing even though they were so much.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He was such a great professor! He made lectures very interesting and made it easy to learn material. He was very open to discussing if you had any questions or concerns. Overall, was a great course and professor!

He's the best professor at UK!. He accommodates to every students needs. I remember I forgot to do an exam and not only did he remind me,he also reopened it for me.If you are not good with timed exams, just let him know and he will extend it for you. Overall the class was exam and lecture heavy so as long you're prepared, its pretty easy.

Professor Zannoun was one of the best professors I have ever had. He genuinely loves teaching and it so chill when it comes to turning things in. Just make sure to study for tests and plan ahead of time for the presentations and it's an easy A. I would 100% recommend taking him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Amazing professor
very respectful person, his class is enjoyable. I would take again 10000000000 times

He's difficult to understand at first but it gets easier. Super nice guy and actually cares about what he is teaching. All the tests and quizzes were online so it's pretty easy to keep up an A. The TA does most of the grading, however, and can grade some things oddly. Overall, it's a fairly easy class & I would recommend
Good teacher

I had him last semester and his test are awful. He pulls for random parts of the lecture, books and supplemental materials its hard to gauge what gunna be on the test. Quizzes are a bit easier but not great. He takes attendance in a lecture. The only thing that saved em was the extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: My absolute favorite professor at UK. He taught 2 of my classes and was so reasonable and informative. He also is very open to criticism regarding ideas to better his course. By far the kindest professor I have ever met.

The only problem here is he is not great at answering emails and when he does he doesn't always answer the whole topic of the email. But I understand he is probably very busy. Other than that the lectures and slides are super easy and tests are directly off the material. Just sometimes the wording on the tests is odd or doesn't make sense.

Such a nice guy! genuinely cares about students. only grades are quizzes and exams- but all are short and online, so nothing to worry about there. lectures have clear material. he was hard to understand at first but you get used to his accent fast. Responds very fast and is flexible with due dates. love him!
The best professor I've had yet, incredibly understandable and so engaging. He makes every class feel so easy. Definitely the best professor at UK

Professor Zannoun gets a bad rep for not being great with technology and hit or miss grading but my experience was different. Hes very caring with students and opened up assignments all the time for students who didnt meet the deadlines, hes very understanding and quickly responds to emails. If you pay attention in lecture you will be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I absolutely love this man!

This guy is so nice and funny. Love the personality. Absolutely hate him as a teacher. Very little homework and assignments are easy. His tests are ridiculously hard. Even online theyre hard to get a decent grade. He gets a lot of answers wrong. Also, dont ever skip his class. Even with a note he will forget you were excused and mark your grade!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: There are not that may assignments from the course and little reading outside of class. Tests were all online and straight forward. However, he is a little all over the place and class is hard to follow sometimes. Lots of group discussions.

Dr. Zannoun is a great guy! He doesnt do a lot to be funny but hell make some jokes or funny anecdotes throughout the class. Only one presentation over an article, which isnt hard, and a summary paper of that same article. Tests are all online and fairly easy if you keep up with the textbook. Overall not a bad professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: The exam for this class was the hardest exam I've ever taken, but it just didn't matter because of all the extra credit he gave. Do well on the midterm and paper/projects, and you won't have any issues. He takes attendance, which allows for a ton of extra points. As long as you go to class, you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Worst professor I've ever had. Very disorganized, took forever to hand back assignments, exam questions that were repeated, and I often had trouble understanding what was happening.
Worst professor I have ever had. Completely lost in lectures, unorganized, didn't see a syllabus for two weeks, conflicting exam questions... even with an open book. STAY AWAY!

All exams are online and answers can be found in your notes and google. However, he added a secondary participation grade at the last second of the semester (that was exactly equivalent to our attendance grade) so we were graded twice for attendance, worsening my grade and missing an A.

Very nice professor, but only lectures. Grades consist of 4 exams, 1 presentation, 1 paper, and a couple of quizzes. The quizzes and exams are online so that makes it easier, but the final exam is in-class so it is hard to prepare for. Test questions are specific about students' presentations. You have to write a paper and present over an article.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Test were very, very hard. Notes don't help at all for the tests. Unorganized.

Most exams online but doesn't help when most things on exams aren't taught in class. Often gives no study guides. Almost entirely graded on tests. Had high A , grade dropped 8% after final. What seems to be organized lectures but most things you learn in class won't be on the final; it will be random other things. Very confusing, very poor quality.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I took Zannoun for a special "Global Citizenship" class. It was terrible. He lectured straight out of the textbook half the time and went on boring tangents the rest. Luckily the class was easy. He offered a few extra credit opportunities which were easy to do and worth lots of points.

He is so nice and really makes you think! He engages the class for answers and relates the topics to us in a way we can understand. He always explains things with good examples, and is very encouraging.

quizzes were inconsistent, and he's closed minded. he seemed unorganized. he wanted to help, but couldn't because he was not organized. all over the place. if you need to take a class but it's taught by him, wait for next semester.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Mr. Zannoun was a nice teacher, but he was very unorganized. Tests were very difficult, and most questions came from minute details in the book. He gives you notes, but they aren't helpful. For the exam, he did not tell us what to study, and he only told us that it would be 100 questions. The only reason I got an A was because of the extra credit.
Great guy and professor! He has a deep accent but he's still understandable, and he's very lenient with tests. Highly recommend!

This class is really easy. There is an attendance and a participation grade but if you show up to every class you will get a 100%. Professor Mohammed is really good about giving extra credit. All of the tests except for the final were on canvas and most of the answers (if not all) were on quizlet. I recommend this class for a GPA booster!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: This class was much more difficult than a 100 level class should be. The notes barely helped to study for the exams and half the time there are questions on the exams about things he never even mentioned in class. Mr. Zannoun also always changes the due dates of things which is so confusing. Would not recommend taking his class.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: I loved Professor Zannoun! Super funny! He grades fairly easily but the tests can be somewhat hard. However, if you take notes you're likely to do well but I suggest reading the textbook because a lot of the test questions come straight from the book. My best advice for his class is GO TO THE EXTRA CREDIT OPPORTUNITIES. They REALLY help! Easy A

He says the final exam isn't cumulative, but be prepared for it to contain the triple the amount of information that the other exams contained. He won't finish the final chapter, expecting you to learn them yourself for the final. You wont know what your grade is until after the class, seeing as he doesn't grade anything until last minute.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: The class is overall fairly easy. Show up, study for the exams, he curves a lot so that he looks like a teacher who gives lots of A's and B's. I'm not kidding.  But he is a very unprofessional grader, scattered brain when it comes to assignments.  Has an opinion and will share it.  Discussed the presidential election way too much last year.

Dr. Zannoun was not a great professor but he is a very smart guy and he really knows what he's talking about. He does have a bit of an accent but is easy to understand. Some of the exams and quizzes are online with lots of repeat questions. All very easy. Take good notes and you're golden.

I wish i could take every college course with this professor. His class is very lecture heavy but he makes them fun because he is so funny and a very interesting man. He knows what he is talking about and as long as you pay attention and obviously study a lil youll pass. Nicest man ive ever met look forward to going to this class 10/10  recommend

This was my least favorite class that I've taken at UK. He was extremely unorganized. For the final, we had to learn two chapters on our own because his lectures are so long, drawn out, and redundant. We literally spent 20 minutes on one question. The only reason I did well in this class because the PowerPoints and the book spell everything out.
He is very difficult to understand usually. He is not very clear about assignments and posts nothing online as far as a guide. His lectures are very lengthy and redundant. Grades easy.
I really enjoyed this class mainly because of the teacher. he sparked my interest because he was absolutely hilarious. I looked forward to coming to class.  I recommend to everyone!
A very nice and interesting professor, offers a great deal of extra credit opportunities. The class is not hard and he helps make everything interesting. Take good notes and you'll be fine

He doesn't help you with anything. His directions on the homework he hardly gives is very unclear. You constantly take notes and he skips the slides pretty quickly. He is a very funny teacher though. And he has a thicker Indian accent sometimes hard to understand. I don't suggest taking him.

Tough professor, but good with making you think. Nothing gets handed to you in this class, so get ready to work hard and have novel ideas. Also, a lot of reading, so get ready to read. Do not skip class because attendance is taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She is a really tough grader, and participation is very important. DO NOT SKIP CLASS. not a lot of work outside of class

The class is flipped, which is not stated on the course description. Very little is done in class, and there is a ton of reading outside class. The class is mostly a discussion of historical novels (like All Quiet on the Western Front), rather than history and society. Very disappointed with this course 1/10

The class was not efficiently adopted to be online, as it is super participation heavy, but it was not terrible. She gives decent feedback but is a tough grader and expects a lot. She will work with you on deadlines if you need it. I thought the class was super boring, but I don't like history at all. Pretty reading heavy.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is hilarious with a dark yet honest sense of humor! She is quite relatable and hits difficult topics without being too heavy. She makes sure anyone can talk, listens to everyone, is accessible, and teaches you the interesting sides of history! There is quite a bit of reading and projects/papers which are heavily weighted so beware.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Great professor and knows her stuff. A lot of tedious assignments that are time consuming, grades more difficult than the average WRD/CIS professor. She expects a lot of her students.

This is my first rate my professor review I have written and I am in the second half of my junior year. I am writing to warn whomever may be taking him, regardless of the class, to seriously reconsider your choices. If he is your only option, the next option is to pray. Unclear rubrics
graduate level expectations
Monotone
Does not teach
Do not take
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As an A student, I am surprised I got an A this time. This is supposed to be Intro to AI class where he is supposed to teach introductory AI things to students especially people who don't have a technical background. This guy would stuff like machine learning in this class and expect the class to get it. Even the exams were graded harshly.

Reads directly off of slides in lecture. Doesn't answer questions in class, instead just referring to what is on the screen. Makes things unnecessarily difficult, and for a topic that is otherwise interesting, the class was not engaging whatsoever. Avoid this guy if possible.

Don't take his class even if you know ML already. I got into research programs in AI/ML and had worked with ML but still got C. 
He didn't allow doctor's note for exam extension. Grading was harsh and rubric is unclear. The lectures and asking questions were never helpful in this class. Definitely the worst class I ever had, although I love AI/ML.

Absolutely horrendous Lectures. Cant even hear the guy. How is he even allowed to teach? Doesn't reply to emails like ever. Grades assignments extremely harshly even though we used the exact code in his slides. Expects too much from students and just says stuff like softmax and expects us to get it.. like what??? Dont ever take this class. Ever !!!

Actually terrible. Very VERY vague expectations. Lots of busy work and decided to grade a week before final grades were due. NEVER answers emails and you have no idea what your performance is until the end of the semester or midters. Also does not take general doctors excuses unless he considers it a "valid" doctors excuse.
Just don't take him, I warn you. Even if its a CS50 class, just don't!
I dropped out because of this professor. I thought this class was an introductory class, but he expected so much from everyone, even the freshmen.

I usually never rate professor, but this guy made me drop out of Computer Science. I am a first year and thought of taking this class as an introductory class, but he grades so harshly that I ended up dropping the class and switching to Business

To be honest I dont know where to start, I came into this class thinking it was not going to be easy but mann when I tell you this teacher speaks in one tone, you can never tell when anything is important, as he just goes through the powerpoint slides and talks the entire lecture he does not point anything that is important about the subject out at

You'll need matrix algebra and calc coming in. I think Dr. Imran cares about his class and it seems like he puts effort into making his own slides. He uses many mathematical equations. There's a bit of a disconnect between theory and implementation, so its good to implement the equations if you want to get the most out of the content.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Speaks quietly and reads from the slides verbatim. 
When asked questions, often overlooks students or repeat what was said on the slide. 
Expects students to know complex formulas before they were taught them and does not go over computations. 
Suggested readings from multiple high-price textbooks instead of following one credible textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Here is a list of the things that happened in this course.

Midterm exam average: 50

Final exam average: 47

Often ghosts emails

Over 50% of classes cancelled and moved online

Exams were worse than physics 2

No example problems covered in lectures

Class participation is not based on attendance?

~30% of students dropped

Abney's lectures don't really provide much as he rambles on about one simple idea. But the content of this course is really easy. The only things he graded strictly were the rhetorical analysis essay and the powerpoint presentation. There is a lot of assignments in this course which isn't his fault. He's easy to pay attention to and is easy grader

Abney is a super nice guy with good intentions, however he will lecture for over an hour, just talking about the same things. the class is pretty easy as long as you put in some effort, though he is a tough grader when it comes to papers. also, he doesn't answer emails, if you have a question, you're going to have to nag him in-person.

Not worth it to take CIS112. Volunteer work was mandatory (could end up far off campus). Many unrelated projects are assigned at the same time which can be frustrating. The lectures are useless. He rambles common sense under the pretense that it will be "deeper than what's taught in high school". He doesn't answer questions and ignores emails.
The feedback he gave on assignments didn't help at all and he ignores emails. The rubrics were never clear and people always asked questions that he never really answered. Also way too much homework.

His lectures drag on and on about things that are essentially common sense or can be summed up in a short paragraph. He grades based off of an imaginary rubric in his mind that he doesn't explain. To take this class you have to be proficient in mind reading. The feedback he leaves on projects is horribly rude and sometimes doesn't even make sense.

He doesn't accept late work. Well, he does extending the deadline but that case is for some special reason. Mostly, he does not extending deadline. But it's proper action because extending the assignment deadline isn't always the best idea for students. One thing I want to say Abney is that he is a tough grader. The rubric isn't always clear.

I believe I was in Abney's first college class (fall 2021), I think he came from a high school and it showed. He cared and was very understanding of late work and just had a general demeanor of a high school teacher, which is a good thing. If you don't like speaking in front of the class, take WRD instead (wrd=essays), but Abney is good for CIS.

I actually didn't like his class pretty much. He is passionate about his course as well, but he is not understand about late h work. He doesn't curve the grade. Some professors in CIS does curve the grade but he does NOT. And the grade is very tough. He is actually a tough grader. So if you really want to get an A, then this professor is not yours

Not all the professors do that same but this man gives a lot of hw and group projects to make deadline in the same day. Some professors makes homework or group project assignments deadline separately, but this professor is NOT. Some day there was 5,6 assignments deadline in one day which makes a lot stressed and pressure. Avoid this person.
I took this class because of the credit, but realized that this guy is very tough grader. He doesn't give full credit. But especially the grade rubric in the cavas page is very unclear.

Was really shocked when I saw my midterm grade in my UK. I thought I couldn't continue to get this grade through at the end of the final. My grade is changed and I also have to wait for the actual grade till final but I want to say mabe try to find out different CIS professors rather than abney I would recommend to look someone else for CIS 111.

I took with another professor for CIS 110 last semester and take with him this semester for CIS 111. He is very nice, friendly and kind. But I really wanted to say that he is very tough for grading. Actually my grade for CIS 110 last semester was very higher than CIS 111. I realized that grade depends on which professors that I meet. Choose others

Personally think compare to the last semester that I took CIS 110 with another professor, this semester feels like too difficult. Maybe because I'm not really good at english or my studying skills are bad but I just feel like maybe because professor changed but this professor is really tough grader for sure. It wasn't like that last semester.
He is a weirdly tough grader, but a nice guy. I got a 99% in my last CIS class and I've had a B for most of his class. His rubrics are clear, but he does not give grace.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr.Abney is nice guy for sure, but as an instructor, he is very tough person in CIS class. I'm not saying that he is bad but I want to say that he tries his best as his can in the class but for grading, he is a very tough grader. It's just my opinion but compare to last semster that I took CIS 110, this semseter is a way too difficult and too hard.

Pretty good choice overall. Class is usually very boring but you can tell he wants everyone to succeed and become better writers/speakers. Rubrics are provided, but will not tell you why you lost points within each part of the rubric. If you put in a bit of effort and submit the numerous assignments on time, you will get an A pretty easily.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Firey gives very boring lectures, granted the subject matter was quite boring. The weekly and monthly essays can be tricky, but she allows for the use of AI for the bulk of the paper. As long as you know how to use AI effectively, A's are super easy to get. The most difficult part was the weekly Purusal activities, but they are graded easily.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Was this the most organized class? No, but Dr. Firey is a very caring professor who is very passionate about the medieval ages and delved into the topics in full detail! I wasn't expecting this class to be all that interesting, but Dr. Firey made the class fun and engaging!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Firey is my favorite professor in the department. Her classes are very reading oriented, but if you do the readings you will be fine. She is extremely knowledgeable in her research area and cares deeply about the well being and success of her students, even if she doesn't always show it. Wish I could have her for every class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not sure how her other classes are, but 370 sucked. It was super unorganized and confusing. You had to read a ton from the books, and lectures were hard to take notes on. She assigned a lot of primary sources which ofc is hard w/ Middle Age English. While I got a good grade, it was very stressful and I don't recommend the class.

Dr. Firey is very knowledgable about her subject matter. However, this particular course was an absolute dumpster fire. No organizational skills at all, and the grading was very convoluted for no reason. I do think she genuinely cares about her students, but at the same time, for this course in particular she needs work.

I have made it a goal to tell everyone that I talk with to never take a class with her. I would put up signs. Up there with the worst professors I have ever had at UK. Disorganized, confusing, and condescending are just a few of the many negative words I would use to describe her. It truly felt like my grade was out of my hands and 100% in hers.

This professor is a caring person who seems to be very knowledgable on the middle ages but this class was just very unorganized. Grades took forever to be entered, mistakes on grades were frequent, no reliable syllabus and curriculum.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Firey is one of the nicest professors that I have ever taken at UK; she truly cares about her students. She is extremely knowledgeable on the middle ages, medieval history, etc. She delivers very informative lectures, but doesn't expect students to retain every detail. Her grading is very fair and she offers constructive feedback on assignments

Dr. Firey is amazing! I think she gives awesome feedback on papers and genuinely cares about students! I highly recommended taking HIS 301 with her! This class is very reading heavy and writing heavy, but it's worth it!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: My queen. Want her to be my grandma; she literally made me tea when I went to her office hours. You have to put in work to do well in the class, but she offers lots of genuine advice to improve. I feel like my writing has become better because of all the time she puts into corrections on my papers. Love this woman.

One of my favorite professors and classes. Every week we had group work. As someone who hates group work I was hesitant of this but once I figured out how it worked I ended up loving it. If you want to feel relaxed and respected in class I would highly recommend any of Professor Firey's classes.

Students are honestly to hard on Firey. She is very knowledgeable about Medieval history & Medieval Law. Her papers are tough, but very informative. She does not have exams in her class. Participation is a must & you will not pass unless you do all the readings. She is helpful, don't be shy, ask for help. Come to class, do the readings, participate

As a history major, I was very disappointed with this class. The quizzes are obscenely difficult and the lectures are monotone and impossible to take notes on. I don't think I learned a single thing in class the entire semester because of its structure and I wish I had never signed up for it. DO NOT TAKE 370.

Worst history class I have taken at UK. Not only is she boring and monotone, but her quizzes cover the most obscure portions of the text that is assigned for homework every night. I will never take another history class taught by her.

Firey is the best professor I have ever had. She is open minded and, as long as you have a slightly intelligent statement, you will get full participation in the discussion groups. Her pop quizzes are super EASY if you read the book and practice the geography on a blank map. I wish she taught more courses in history! She is the BEST!
EXCELLENT VERY KIND HELPFUL INTERESTING MEDIEVAL HISTORY
My favorite professor in the entire history department.

Dr. Firey is scary for the first few weeks but the woman is brilliant and this ended up being one of my favorite classes. The reading is dense and she is a tough grader but my writing greatly improved with her help and she is very understanding. I wish I could have her for another class!

I didn't like Dr. Firey at first because I thought that she was intimidating and arrogant. By the end of the class though, she was my favorite professor. She is not an easy grader, but she offered a lot of help to me on any questions that I had for her. Always have something to say when you come to class. The books are boring, but I learned a lot!

At first, Dr. Firey comes off as intimidating, but do not be alarmed.  Make sure that you talk in class; it doesn't have to be brillant but say something every day.  Her papers were not impossible so go meet with her and get a little help and some brownie points.  Have fun!

Dr. Firey is very intelligent, but came off to me as very condescending and a very tough grader on assignments. She was very critical of everyone in the class's writing and picked boring books. I really did not enjoy her class.
Too heavy on "participation."  The toughest prof I have ever had on writing assignments.  Favoritism may factor into your grading.
Dr. Firey is a brilliant professor. She is very helpful in making the transition into college writing. I would recommend her to absolutely anyone.

At the beginning of the semester, this class seemed really hard and overwhelming, but by the second test I was getting A's on everything. Participation is very important (online blogs) and you have to keep an open mind in this class. Once you get into this class, it is actually interesting and Affolter is great at teaching it!
Was very thorough but gave a lot of coursework. Loved having this class during the summer but it would be stressful during the semesters.

Reading is a MUST. Most of the grade comes from writing papers. He mostly teaches graduate level courses and expects undergrads to write on the same level as his grad students. Provides useless feedback on assignments.
You can tell he truly cares about his students and the work that is assigned. All coursework is reasonable. I would 100% recommend!!
Super easy professor. All you have to do is turn in work, and you're fine. Didn't learn a lot, but I turned in essays and got feedback, which was helpful.

Dr. Abboud gave relevant assignments while not being overwhelming and was consistently understanding and caring towards his students. Although sometimes I would see little reason to be in he classroom because there was nothing to do, the workload was incredibly manageable and I would very much recommend taking Dr. Abboud's course.
Great professor and gave lots of great feedback on papers
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Abboud is really great. I really appreciated his feedback because he always supports your original idea while also helping improve it and give a clear path to said improvement. If you have the opportunity to take a class of his you definitely should. I normally hate writing but he made me feel proud of my writing and that never happens!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Having a good professor is NECESSARY for WRD classes, and he is the best! Dr. Abboud's class was super easy, and I actually had fun doing the class project. He is a generous grader, easily accessible, and incredibly understanding about extenuating circumstances. He made me feel proud of my work, and he is seriously so nice. Take him if you can!!!

The class was very boring but very easy. It was very difficult to pay attention in class so I didn't attend all the lectures because they weren't necessary to succeed in this class. The group project was not a good choice for an online class because it was hard to access classmates. He also isn't the most clear on his expectations but still easy.

I'm a senior and I've taken courses from Dr. A for 4 semesters in a row. Truly one of the best at UK. Both class and the workload is super enjoyable. His main concern is his students creating work that they're proud of. He lets you have creative freedom and is super laid back. Take his classes as many times as ya can!
Great teacher and very understanding
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. A is a great man. Always understanding, flexible and there to help. Also just good at what he does I became a better writer by taking his class.

Super laid-back professor. Class was loosely structured and was discussion based. Projects were not hard and we had plenty of time to prep in advance. I would go out of my way to make sure I took this professor again!
Dr. Abboud is a great guy, a really understanding professor, and an easy grader.

Amazing guy. He is super nice and funny, and class is a really fun time. We would go to class when we didn't HAVE to be there just to see him. Willing to work with students if you fall behind or are unclear on an assignment. Just wants his students to create work they are passionate about.

Love Dr. Abboud, he is one of the nicest professors at UK. This class was one of the easiest classes I've taken at UK. It had to do with Black Mirror and you had to view and episode a week and write a 250 word paper after viewing them. There is only 2 big writing projects but one is in a group that he chooses. Overall awesome professor

Dr. A is one of my favorite professors at UK. He's always super helpful and loves to see his students learn. He is at times a bit fickle about readings, but it's nice that he didn't have a book to buy. His assignments can be worded funny, but he's always willing to explain further. Take him any time you can!

Awesome guy. So nice and willing to help with anything. Assignments are usually confusing but if you ask, he will explain it as much as possible. All assignments were actually pretty fun to do. He says to buy the textbook but you'll only use it for the first 1-2 weeks.

Dr. Abboud is a great professor! It's simple: do what you're supposed to, you won't have a problem. He makes class fun, but is also serious when it comes to teaching. Sometimes I was confused about the assignments online, but if you ask him he's more than happy to explain. Definitely my favorite so far here at the university.
The writing assignments are long and feel tedious throughout the semester but as a whole Dr A was a great professor. He really helped me further my writing abilities by the critiques he gave.

Very frustrated with this teacher. Nice guy, easy class, but the way he went about it was frustrating to no end. Clearly loved having the power to grade students as he saw fit (based on how he liked them). Was VERY unclear about what he wanted. Constantly going back and forth on lessons. Not well organized. Ended up with an A/worked my butt off.

Nice guy and all, but he couldn't teach. Class was pointless and boring, and it just feels like busy work. It doesn't help your writing at all. His grading is inconsistent, and it just feels like he's always unorganized. You never know what's going on. DONT BUY THE BOOKS.  He assigned reading but we never once discussed it.

Dr. Abboud is the best. He really enjoys what he does and he makes it known in the way that he teaches. Class is always interesting and he is always more than willing to answer questions if you have any issues. His grading is fair as long as you put effort into the projects and come to class. If you have the chance to take his class, do it!

An incredible teacher. Abboud is new to UK but is extremely helpful. He cares a lot about his students and their success and is very willing to meet outside of class. His work is challenging, but the projects are entertaining if you put work in them. Take him for anything you can!

Dr. Bagh is overall a good professor and explains things clearly, but get ready to deal with a lot of typos, bad handwriting, and general disorganization. It's manageable, but made the class a bit more challenging for me. However, the class was not too difficult, but the only grades are 5 homeworks and 2 exams, so make sure you do well on those
Dr. Bagh is caring. He explains every concept clearly. Very interesting class with nice real world applications.

Dr. Bagh is a great professor. Made game theory fun and engaging from a mathematical perspective. I would recommend getting a pdf of the textbook and work practice problems. Only 3 exams and 5 quizzes so if you bomb something it may be hard to recover. Smart guy and great lecturer.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Bagh explained concepts thoroughly. Little hw, but optional problems often showed up on exams! The textbook can be found free online. Attendance isn't required but necessary imo-very few canvas notes. Bagh is very helpful in office hours and is also happy to answer questions in class or through email. Warning: Exams80% of your grade

Very organized, explains concepts well, lots of examples, pointed out interesting conclusions. I especially appreciated that he assigned optional problems for extra practice. Everything a professor should be! Only complaints are sometimes he makes small typos and the homework was due at 5pm. You could get by without the textbook.
Not a good professor. Did not do a good job of conveying the class material and made the class extremely unbearable and boring. I would not recommend this prof.

Adib is a nice guy, you can tell he is very mathematically educated. However, in regards to ECO, he is not the professor you want. Lectures are confusing, examples are never fully completed (you should know how to do them yourself he says), and tests are miserable! He teaches class from a mathematical approach, heavy in calculus and computations.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Adib is by far one of my favorite professors. If you have any math background, this class will be straightforward. The most useful classes were differential equations, optimization, and analysis. While this was an econ class, it was taught like a math class and requires work. The exams are challenging, but if you know the material you will be fine.

Great class and professor. Clear, organized lectures and super helpful in office hours. Tests didn't have any big surprises, though the first test was more difficult than the second. While the only prerequisite for the class was MA213, MA322 or equiv. should be a prereq or coreq. Programming knowledge and basic knowledge of proofs also useful.

If you go to his office hours, he's great help. But his lectures are extremely confusing and made the material harder than it needed to be. He clearly knows the material but is not very good at lecturing it.
the homework was a big help. The test are okay but the 3rd one really hurts your grade. Also go to class and get the reef questions so you get some attendance points.

Not very good at lecturing. He knows what he's doing but he makes so many careless mistakes on examples that its impossible to follow what point he's making. Always does REEF at the end of class so it's not terrible if you're late. Seems nice and is helpful if you ask a question quickly following class but not the best at responding to emails.

He barely explained anything at all, it's like he knows the material so well he isn't able to teach  it, ya know? He isn't very good at explaining and his choice of vocabulary is a little hard to understand as well. I rarely understood anything and if it wasn't for some friends and engineering majors I wouldn't have survived.

Dr. Bagh is a bad lecturer. In my section, I found them to be very meandering and it was often times difficult to see what his main "point" was on a topic because he was jumping around so much in the examples he was working through. If the lectures were more organized, the class would be a lot better (and probably a lot easier).
Great professor; explains things extremely well. Teaches to the test, always open to questions, funny. If you have to take Calculus, he's the one to have.

Calculus 1 is regulated across all professors, however, Dr Bagh provides great 8 am lectures and the man loves his coffee. He's available after class and in his office. Calculus 1 is difficult, keep up with the homework assignments and don't be afraid to ask questions. Takes occasional attendance but double check the syllabus.

Very good teaching style with clear examples to explain topics. He teaches to the test, what he shows in class will be on the test. Sometimes goes off on "proof" tangents, but other than that, a good teacher.

Attendance not mandatory and homework posted online.  His homework and tests were very straightforward, with no surprises or anything that couldn't be learned from the book.  Very clear in class as well.  His macroeconomics course is recommended for math people, as it is computation dependent.
Take this his class and you will get a good grade as long as you attend the class. His lecture is very easy to follow and interesting enough.
Good calc professor, highly recommend.

We are halfway through the semester and the only grade he has put in is for attendance. Magendzo claims that participation is important and hands out "participation credits" for engaging with the material, but they don't seem to impact grades. He gives unannounced pop quizzes usually related to previous readings, but these also aren't graded.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class was easy to get an A in, but the professor was incredibly disorganized and hard to reach. He never responded to any of the emails I sent, and when I spoke to him before and after class, he frequently forgot our discussion. He didn't have a clear understanding of technology, and students had to frequently teach him how it worked.

He's a nice guy, but as a teacher he is very unorganized and doesn't really know what he's trying to teach. It's not that hard to get a good grade but just be prepared that he will always find a way to correct you even if you give the right answer and you have to participate in class for a good grade.

I was excited for EGR120 and the entrepreneurship concepts, but Professor Magendzo moved very slow and covered insignificant material. Felt like a waste of time. Not a ton of assignments and class participation is a large part of your grade. The group debates and presentations require a lot of prep and writing.

Professor Magendzo is an extremely kind and caring professor. I had him for EGR 120, and this was his first semester teaching the class. Although you need to participate in class to get a good grade, and sometimes work can be a bit heavy, he truly wants his students to succeed and will make exceptions for you if you need the help.

Was a super great person and really cared about his students. I had EGR 120 with him, and I enjoyed the debates he had us do on different technologies. If you put the work in, you will learn so many new things about newer technologies and ethical practices as well. He always questions our presentations to get the conversation started.

Took Adrian for HON 301 and HON 201. He means so well - truly cares about his students and wants us to succeed. No tests, a few quizzes over readings but honestly you don't even have to read it before class because its open note. Presentation heavy but he's such a chill grader. A+ in both classes. Take him!

Class isn't hard but very group-oriented. Magendzo knows his stuff and does ask a lot of questions to get you thinking. Overall, you'll get what you put into the class. If you are interested in international business, you can take away a lot from the lectures. If this is just another elective, you can go through the motions and still get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Adrian doesn't get how a UKY honors class is meant to be. He gives too much work/some quizzes & makes instructions so unclear for assignments, yet grades tough. He's also not tech-savvy in the slightest & is just unorganized in general. He'll grill you with questions during a presentation too. This class caused me so much stress. Do not take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The class was very messy, and at times seemed to have been thrown together at the last second. Adrian isn't the worst business professor, but the class was disorganized and uninformative. I can strongly say I didn't learn anything except that I don't want to take a class by him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you are genuinely thinking about starting your own business, take a class with Professor Magendzo. He really cares and has lots of valuable information. However, if you are taking this course just because you need an honors credit and you don't have an interest in business, don't bother. He makes you do a lot of work and gives pop quizzes.

Professor Magendzo is a great guy. He is one of the most experienced professors you will ever have. He really knows his stuff. His readings are sometimes very long, but the quizzes on them are pretty easy. He isn't the most tech-savvy, so expect some minor problems with that. Overall, he is great and teaches very well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: I won't recommend he take two exams instead of the presentation like other doesnt have clear grading and not very flexible with the grading. The exams were 25 marks each, which means 50, half of the whole grade he gives you only 55 min to finish
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor is not going to give you grades whther your attendence is good or not. He just do random grading. Never ever take any course from this professor.                                                                                                                                                          CNN.
Class engagement does not matter for him. Never ever suggesting to take his classes.
He was hard to understand and he just never made any sense!! Difficult for no reason
Difficult, but extremely friendly and helpful!

Adam is really helpful. He's aware that not everyone is into symbolic logic and works to make the class fun.  He spends quite a bit of time at the beginning of each class going over any homework questions that the class found particularly tricky.  His class is challenging, but he is always willing to work with students who are struggling.

This guy is great! He's super helpful, makes the class fun, and makes sure you know the material. His tests/quizzes aren't easy, but  you'll know the stuff well enough to get a good grade. Highly recommend!
Lots of reading, but he is nice and willing to work with you

He is such a kind and understanding Professor. The only thing I would say is there is 2-3 assignments a week but they are not hard or take long to due. Attendance is really on mandatory the day of quizzes but the quizzes mean A LOT. If you go to all the quizzes you don't have to take the final. I took it at 8 am on T/TH and it was not bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Super helpful and understanding! Attendance isn't taken, but there is a code for the homeworks that he gives in each lecture. All notes from lectures are posted in Canvas. Gives quizzes once a week, but they're usually pretty easy if you do the homework and review your notes. Drops two homework grades at end of the semester.
Overloads you with homework and goes over notes crazy fast
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: MA 201 not 113 (201 wasn't an option) He provides guided notes on canvas that he uses in lectures and will post his notes after class. Frequent exams but they're not crazy hard and he'll try his best to help you if you ask him questions. Homework isn't due until the end of the unit mostly so it's not a crazy work load.

The class is very test heavy. The teacher is hard to understand what he means when going to get help and doesn't help unless you completed the optional worksheet. The written assignments will get points taken off for stupid reasons. Tough grader

He focuses the exams on the small things he says in class rather than the information on the slides. He randomly skips things that then show up heavily on the exams. This class is exam heavy so if you don't test well you are out of luck. He is very lenient on attendance, but if you don't show up you will have no clue what is going on for exams.

Interesting material, but I'd rather stick my hand in a trashcan with a rabies-ridden racoon and get bit than listen to Dr. Adedokun lecture. He is the only professor that I had that uses a microphone while lecturing, and it does not go well.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Though most of his teaching was off of PowerPoint slides, he did teach and present material that was worth going to class for. If you attend class and study hard you will do well. He presents lots of information, but always highlights the most important things. I found him to be very personable and you could tell wanted the class to succeed!

Mainly reads off PowerPoint during lectures and is very difficult to understand. There is a lots of content in this course and the exams are based off of what is taught in the lecture. The exam questions are very specific, so knowing the lecture material well is key.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Know the lecture slides the tests are based off of them. He's a good person but can't teach that well. Take the time to get help from him and he will take note of your efforts. He loves participation. It's a hard class  but take time to study what he gives. Grades are based only on tests and a few pop quizzes so study daily.

While Dr. Adedokun is really passionate about animal nutrition, the way he teaches the class isn't beneficial for learning. He reads off the powerpoint slides the whole time. Your only grades for the class are exams and maybe an extra credit or two which I don't mind. His exams are fair if you study hard, but this class was harder than i thought.

Tough class but doable- the outlines of what you'll be graded on and what kind of questions asked are clear. Most exam questions are open ended, so make lots of flash cards to memorize, but there's also T/F and multiple choice. He WANTS you to do well so if you ask questions in class, in his office, or in an exam he will help. Some extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: In class he can mention something in the notes that would be on the exam.  Exams-directly off the pwpt slides, & about half open ended.  Gives some opportunities for extra credit, even had a review session where he told us half the exact questions on exam.  Final cumulative part was WORD FOR WORD from exams 1-4. If you show you try he will help you

You can pass his class without attending, just be ready to study a lot. He'll try to make it overly difficult. However, overall attending is a waste of time. He's hard to understand and his lectures are beyond boring. This is the second animal-based nutrition class I've taken and I love the subject. Not a fan of him.

Tayo is hard to understand if you aren't extremely focused in lecture. Lectures are very boring and not engaging. He completely changed the testing format that has been in place for several years and a large majority of the class failed his exam. Be prepared to focus on the specifics of each nutrient class.

Incredibly rigid and dismisses student progress. I worked hard to improve my grade from a 44 on the first exam to consistent 90s on the following ones(was all my effort, I studied really hard by myself) but he wont let me take the final to replace my lowest exam grade because I went to a different section of his class for final exam.

Attendance wasn't mandatory but he would randomly give extra credit if you went to class. The practice exams are mostly the same as the real exam just with different numbers. Probably studied the least for these exams out of all my classes and never had trouble getting an A. The worksheets he gives in class are really helpful.

As a student who has never had an issue getting good grades (A or B) in college courses, this course was particularly frustrating. Even after attending every lecture but 1, the amount of effort I put in did not show in his test results. I was able to score well on practice exams, but the real ones were much more difficult. Class avg. usually < 65%

Roeschley is my favorite accounting professor. His slides cover everything needed for exams, and he provides a practice test to help prepare. He makes the material easy to understand and is always willing to help. The class can be challenging, but if you attend and put in the effort, you will do well. He gives random extra credit in class, so go!

This class was one of the hardest classes I have ever took at UK, and Professor Roeschley made it worse. Exams are very difficult, and worth 75% of your grade. He is very nice, but the content is very hard and he does not explain it well. I taught myself the whole semester. You would be better off taking someone else. This class genuinely killed me

I would not recommend this professor at all. He talks way too fast during lectures, and the slides are so bare that its almost not worth it to go back later and take notes. His tests are weighted super heavily, but he does drop the lowest one. Overall, it was extremely hard to keep up with him. You'd be better off taking someone else for 201.

Personally, I don't think tests should be worth 75% of the grade. His grading felt like there was no reason to show up to class, but when you did, he would simply just read off slides the whole time, barely engaging with the class, making it feel pointless.

Overall, a great teacher for accounting. Really breaks down the material into simple terms during lecture, and gives an in-class worksheet that's almost the same as the homework. Attendance isn't mandatory but he does give random extra credit points for going, and learning the material is easier from attending his lectures.

He's a very boring lecturer, which would be okay if his lectures were slower. He goes incredibly fast and makes it pretty difficult to take notes. All in all, I'd take someone else for 201. Makes it harder than it should be.

Don't understand the hate around him. Gives great lectures, and always gives us a worksheet in class that he goes over at the end of as well. Also gives us past exams to study off of as well, which look very similar to the ones that we take. Understandably, he can be boring at times, but all in all I think he's great.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Honestly he is one of the best professors for ACC 201. He goes over the topic in class from the lecture, and he gives you practice exams that are amazing to help study for exams. The practice exams are almost word for word so use them to study, and the exams are all multiple choice. His voice is kinda monotone in lecture but overall not bad.

Professor Roeschley is an amazing professor. He is very knowledgeable. He cares about his students and wants to see them succeed. He is very organized and has clear grading criteria. This is one of those classes where if you actually try you will do well. He gives you all the resources needed to succeed! He conveys material clearly.Overall awesome!
He has the most monotone voice I have ever heard. His lectures are really, really bad. Prepare to teach yourself everything.

This professor cared about his students, but did not go into much detail with the topics. You need to read the textbook in order to do well. Several topics were not clearly explained in the lectures, and he ended up giving a lot of extra credit work to get people to pass by the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Roeschley was one of the worst professors I've had in all of college. He reads straight off the powerpoint and if you ask a question, there's a great chance he wont be able to answer it. I honestly dont think he would do well if he took his own exams because he seems very unknowledgeable about what hes teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Good teacher, but hard class. Gives pop quizzes to increase attendance. Lectures are boring. My main complaint is he makes so many errors in the slides/tests/quizzes/handouts, someone will ask a question and he will be like yea I see how that's confusing

Aaron has been one of my favorite accounting professors at UK. His lectures are very dry, but if you pay attention and reread the slides/practice all the problems, it's not hard to follow. You get 10 attempts on each hw problem. Lecture & ppt. is straight from the book. He has 4 quizzes; drops 1. Partial credit on exams which is AMAZING for acc.

Lot of people I know didn't like Aaron and said he's a lazy teacher... kinda fake news imo. Aaron is very intelligent/qualified. Grading criteria was slightly unclear but he provides all necessary info to prepare for exams. Attendance not mandatory but he gives pop quizzes usually for each chapter so its up to you if you wanna gamble

Dr. Grumbein was interesting. She cussed a lot in class, which I didn't respect. However, she cared a lot about what she was teaching. Her TAs graded all the projects (which I thought were pointless), and they graded very hard and to the point.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Adriane is a wonderful professor! She makes this class super engaging and I loved all of the material. She does not allow phones or typed notes, but it definitely helped me learn the material better that way. Exams are a little more difficult than they seem so SHOW UP to class and STUDY!!

Adriane is very knowledgeable in her field and is funny, but her class was a little difficult for me because of my learning style. She didn't allow us to type notes—we had to handwrite them, which felt tedious. There are four hands-on projects that are not too difficult but take a long time to complete and are graded harshly. Exams are fairly easy!

This class in entirely group work and you have presentations around every 2-3 weeks. The work is not necessarily hard but she is a very tough grader and does not give As and she will tell you that from the first day of school. She was nice teacher but she marked me off for attendance when my dog passed away even though I emailed her documentation.

You will not get an A in this class. You have to go above and beyond (I'm talking to GREAT lengths) to get even a low A on a campaign. She is kind but expects a lot from you. Sometimes her expectations were a bit unclear but she is willing to take the time to work with you. This class is entirely group project-based, and there are no lectures.

She is a great lecturer and is funny. I didn't enjoy the material, so it was harder to put effort into it, but she was still an amazing professor. No phones are allowed, and she is strict about it. If you miss one day of notes, make sure to get them from somebody else. The projects were like making crafts. It was an enjoyable class.

Dr. Dre was a great first major professor, especially being a 9:30 am class. She always found ways to bring jokes into her lectures, and I thought they were hilarious. Assignments were structured and had a clear rubric on how we were evaluated for our work. Adriane is very firm on her rules, but an excellent professor.

Attendance is mandatory, and you HAVE to read the textbooks. However, they're short and easy to comprehend, I read them before class when we would have chapter quizzes and it was cake. She's a bit of a hard ass but she's super cool and only does it to push you. There's also a few projects, listen when she says collect stuff throughout the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Grumnein is great! She is a little tough with grammar but is always willing to give feedback and help when someone is willing to reach out. She is super personable and easy to talk to, and her lectures, even the longer note-heavy ones, are always fun to sit through. Amazing professor and great class!

I loveddd Professor Grumbein she was amazing. She is funny and her lectures are actually entertaining. Attendance is required, no phones, and have to write out notes (on iPad/paper no computers). She is very strict on her rules but they're not that bad, if you don't show up to class/ take notes on EVERY lecture the assignments/exams can be hard.

she is a good professor & interesting to listen to but she is really tough. she has a strict policy for attendance (like if someone in your family died you would have to hand over an obituary type of teacher). the class was easy but definetely something to keep up with or else you will not do great
