She was very funny and a fine professor. TAKE NOTES EVERY CLSS OR YOU WONT PASS!!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Grumbein is amazing. She's hilarious and makes lectures interesting and engaging. She truly cares about her students and wants them to succeed. This class was a lot of fun, and there weren't many assignments. Four creative projects, two exams, and a few pop quizzes. This was one of my favorite classes this semester.
This class was my favorite this semester! The lectures go by so fast because she is SO funny. I definitely know after taking this class I want to go down the creative pathway!

This class was my easiest A. You only get 3 unexcused absences and then your absences are 5% of your final grade, but the lectures are easy and normally get out early. Exams are extremely easy if you go to class, small quizzes but they're easy points! Projects go along with content very well so they're not hard! She's amazing.

Adriane is by far the best professor I have ever had. She helped me inside and outside of class and truly cares about her students as individuals. You will need the textbooks but they are easy reads and the first textbook that was actually interesting to me. I will definitely take courses with her again, you can tell she is passionate.

Adriane is the BEST. She is so funny and a really engaging professor. You have to take notes by hand or on your ipad so keep that in mind. You have to go to class but have three unexcused absences. Mainly projects and like 10 pop quizzes throughout the semester, so make sure you read and pay attention during the lectures. Take her
LOVE Adriane!! So nice and gives great lectures. Attendance is taken but you get 3 unexcused absences. She actually wants you to learn and have fun, and I would definitely recommend!

Adriane is an awesome professor. She is really funny and wants you to do well in her class. You can tell she is super passionate about what she teaches which makes it easier to learn. The content is super interesting and there is very minimal work outside of the projects and exams. It's hard not to get a good grade in her class. 100% would retake.
LOVE HER. She made class fun and entertaining. You do take a lot of notes but its not bad. Attendance is taken every class but you get 3 skips before it starts to effect your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: I think she is so funny. She lectures almost the entirety of the class, but keeps it interesting by having us shout out answers and participate. Gives good examples. Takes attendance. Offers a lot of opportunity for bonus points. Required to read textbook bc there are short reading quizzes. Four projects total but they're all fun! Take notes!

Dre is super hard. Won't sugar coat it. her class is not easy but this is the class I learned the most from and got the most out of in my entire college experience. I think dre is worth taking because she is so helpful and you really see growth in yourself by the end. Even if you don't get a good grade .
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I don't know who has ever thought that Professor Yelowitz doesn't care for his students or is unhelpful, because he is the most caring professor I have ever had. It is the sweetest thing and is always willing to help you with anything. His lectures can be a little boring but he is always willing to explain things over if you don't understand.

Yelowitz has the longest and most boring lectures I have ever experienced. The lectures have absolutely nothing to do with what we are going to be graded on (quizzes and tests). His quizzes are often worded a little weird to trip you up.

I would never take a class with this professor again. He spends most of the time talking about himself or scenarios irrelevant to the class and we never got to cover topics that we were still tested on. He is little to no help when students come to him with questions and he has a condescending attitude when "helping out".

I had professor Yellowitz for ECO 383 and I found him to be a solid professor. Most of the class he spends going through theoretical situations that is almost always not on the exams so it gives you time to zone out if you need it. Everything that is tested or quizzed is similar to the homeworks he gives you over the semester. Easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Yelowitz was average at best. Classes are extremely boring. There are attendance polls to make sure you come to class. The material seems hard in class, but once you sit down to look at it it is very simple stuff. The test come exactly from the quizzes so if you study that you will get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This guy cares way more about inflating his ego then teaching properly. Do not take this course. He's grading is very arbitrary and aks tricky exam questions on purpose. He graded by 2 exams and 5 pop quizzes for the entire semester. No exam review, no study guide, just awful teaching filled with jargon and useless tangents.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Do NOT take this professor. Very high on his high horse and doesn't explain things well that he tests on. Does things like pop quizzes and intentionally confusing test questions just because he enjoys seeing students suffer. Not a nice person, just avoid him at all costs. Absolutely horrible.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He really is a great professor in the sense that he knows what he's talking about. If you participate in class and show up every time you should get an A on the class. However, if you skip class there is no shot you can get a good grade. The final is 50% of the grade and the midterm is 35%, but the tests are straight forward with no surprises.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very intelligent professor. My 410 was on Health Economics and I really feel like I learned something. He explains things well (sometimes a little too in-depth) and his tests aren't too bad.

His lectures are boring and he NEVER answers his emails. He's pretty high on himself, but he knows what he is talking about. Dropped his class because he is not involved with students at all (I understand professors have other things, but taking a couple minutes to talk to a student should be doable).

No book but lots of article reading. No need to read everytime, he covers everything you'll need to know in class. Some pop quizzes over them but usually pretty easy. As long as you go to class, tests are pretty simple. Lectures are a little dry however. One paper at the end of the semester. I suggest supporting his opinion in yours.
Good professor.  Lectures can be kinda dry, but if you pay attention, you will learn a lot because he really knows the material.
don't take him!!
No Comments
No Comments
No Comments
He is somewhat conceited, but still teaches well. As long as you show up for class and study the old quizes/exams it is an easy A.
No Comments
Good teacher. One of the better 400 level econ classes. Quizes are pretty straight forward.
No Comments

There are two group projects and most of the HW was discussion posts, content Q&A, and application activities. Class was pretty easy I just needed it for one of my geneds but the material was enjoyable, eye opening, and fun!
Awesome professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Took this course online. Bought the book online with it, only used it for quizzes and exams. Easy class, you should get an A.

Ok the tests weren't tough but don't expect much help from Quizlet. My motive was an easy A but the amount of homework proved to be quite the nuisance. Let me be your Obi-Wan Kenobi in saying "this is not the GPA booster you're looking for"  Nice guy, and good online class if this is actually your major.

If you're taking this class, be prepared to take quizzes every day. They are based on the reading he has assigned, but he does allow open notes, so it's not that bad. As long as you have a decent understanding, you should be able to get a 100% on all of the quizzes. The 3 papers make up 75% of your grade (each being worth 25%), plus quizzes (25%).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Coach for Ethics Bowl. He favors Blackboard too heavily, but that's my only complaint. He will really push you, and doesn't just let you scrape by. Also pretty awesome to hang out with.

Cool guy, super easy class, went 5 days total including test days and got an A. Essay exams but you can use a note card with your own notes on it. One thing I loved about this guy, he looks exactly like Seth Rogan! I would take him again for sure.

Nice guy, really enjoys class involvement in conversation. the course is kinda pointless b.c the conversation runs in circles to never get any answers, but it fills a USP and is EASY!! he gives study guides that are the tests! would def reccomend this course with him.

if you pay attention and take good notes the exams are easy! The exam is just 1 or 2 essay questions and he gives the essay questions before the exam...easy A.  he is really nice and funny,and answers questions asked to help the material make sense
Talk about a bad class. NOt a cool guy at all, and even worse a teacher.
37 black board posts (one for each class) and 2 papers. No tests. Very boring, attendance not necessarily required. I would not take him again.

awful class! i don't like this guy at all and the material is so stupid. this is the most useless class and i don't know why UK even offers it. if you think logic will be easy you are wrong-take calclus instead! teacher is arrogant and annoying!
SO BORING! i have to make myself go to class. the material is retarded and class doesn't help at all. all you have to do to learn the material is a CD-ROM. this class is terrible
i hate this class!! it is so stupid, i don't know why people have to learn this material bc it doesn't mean anything.

The material in this class is hard for some, but if it comes easy, you will have no problem whatsoever. German doesn't require attendence or regular homework completion, but if the material is hard for you, then just do it anyway and it will help a LOT.
Really likes the sound of his own voice.  Not exactly what I expected from a philosophy class...several million of my brain cells committed suicide.
No Comments
HARD! Great guy, but confusing teacher!

Garvey was really nice and helpful. Learn how to study for the tests, and you'll get an A. There's a semester long group project - it SUCKED. Each portion is a lot of work and Garvey's communication regarding deliverables was severely lacking (ex.15-18 page report due at the end of the semester, and we received the rubric a week before it was due.)

Not the NICEST teacher, but I didn't hate his class. It was hard, but he told us that nothing in the textbook would be on the exams, even though the textbook was required for some reason? The entire class is a group project and three exams. The exams are hard, got a D on the first one, I figured out how to pass the rest. Passed the class with an A!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Made this class way harder than it needed to be. He was very knowledgeable but tests were hard and the labs were rough. Dont take him for 340

Aaron Garvey knows his stuff but its very hard to get his attention in class when you have questions. There is a final project that isn't too hard but definitely takes some effort to get a good grade. He gives out lecture notes before every class, be sure to take notes as some of the questions on the exam come from whats said in class. Overall good
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Professor Garvey really knows his stuff and it translates well to students. Some professors dont know how to communicate their knowledge, but Garvey does a great job of it. Very applicable stuff for MKT majors. Semester long group project, but not bad. Exams kind of tough, but not terrible. Take him, he explains things well and answers questions.
He really bases this class on stats, exams are tough and the statistics labs are a pain. He's a nice guy but his section is harder than the other mkt340 classes

Aaron is great! Exams are exactly from his lectures and straight forward. There is a semester long group project, but he gives great feedback along the way. Don't come in late or let your phone go off. Does a great job of explaining the material and using relatable examples. Doesn't hurt that he's attractive.

Aaron is a great professor. Gives very clear lectures that directly correlate to the exams. There is one big semester long group project. Don't bother buying the textbook. Doesn't hurt that he's good looking.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Great class, great professor! There's no reason you couldn't get an A. Don't bother with the book though. Show up to class and get the notes to save yourself money on a textbook.

Aaron is young, straight-forward, and clear.  He doesn't like it if you're late and your cell phone better not go off.  But he's nice other than that and the class is really easy. Goes til the last minute every time, but he's really easy.

He's really good! Exams are exactly what he teaches in class. He's funny, helpful and nice.  DON'T freak if your grade is low:  He didn't tell us  until the last week, but he curved our class grade so that students who have the median score or above get an A. Students between the median and 2 standard deviations below get a B. (So 97.5% get A or B)

Lecture and handouts do not prepare you, or match up well with the tests. The tests are HARD. The way he words his questions is tricky and the possible answer choices usually leave 2 answers that could possibly be correct. You NEED to know the material INSIDE AND OUT in all possible applications. This is the hardest class i've ever taken at UK.
Amazing to come to for advice!
Great professor, with enthusiasm for PE, health careers, and education. He really cares for his students.

Definitely take this class. He is so understanding and you can tell he truly cares about his students. Show up and the assignments are easy. He is very flexible and just wants the very best for his students. I always left his class feeling motivated to do my best in everything. Plus, hes funny!
I LOVED Mr. Beighles class. His dad jokes are fire and he is super understanding. He is always flexible and the assignments are not bad whatsoever. I just wish I could have taken his class in-person!
Dr. Beighle is one of the best professors I have had here at UK. He truly cares about you becoming the best physical education teacher and wants to see you succeed. Take him for any class you can!

Aaron is very passionate not only about physical activity in the classroom, but education. He is very inspirational. I took a hybrid class where half was online. The class was easy, we wrote a few papers and did a project with a partner. I recommend you go to class.

The best professor I've ever had. I thought this class would be annoying(UK101) but he made it so enjoyable. Seriously cannot say enough good things. He even reached out to professionals in the field I'm pursuing to help me find internships and experience. He's so inspirational and real with you. If you get the chance take any of his classes.
He an amazing professor! If you do anytihing he asks for, you will get an A. He is very inspirational and motivates people to move forward.

Dr. Beighle is an amazing lecturer! I don't care much for those types of classes, but I loved his class. He is very inspirational and really makes you wanna be the best you can be. His tests are decently easy if you study and come to class. He grades easily, just follow directions, turn in everything on time and you'll get an A.

If you put forth any effort at all, you'll get an A. He's very easy to please and the majority of the class is him motivating us to be better teachers. He inspired me to get a minor in health promotion. DEFINITELY try to take this class with him. He's the best.
Beighle is always extremely helpful and it's pretty easy to get an A.
easy class. cool teacher
Awesome...really helpful and gets us active throughout class which really helped us learn.  Explains things clearly which is always helpful and is always available to answer any questions.

I liked her as a teacher and tests were straight forward. You use the book for daily homework and if you participate in class you will get an A. She is young and fun but she is a tough grader on written compositions and on graded speaking assignments. Overall good class and if you do your homework, go to class and study a little, you'll get an A

Obviously someone doesn't check their e-mail until right before class... Miss Clixby is very helpful, informative, and willing to go the extra mile if you genuinely need help.  I don't really like French, but I still like her class.
Attendance is mandatory and beneficial. She can be helpful, dont get on her bad side. Keep up with the material.. not an easy A but with hard work it can be. She can make class fun, participate!

My biggest problem with her class is her inability to arrive to class on time. Also, she often doesn't e-mail important information until late the night before. I will not take French 102 simply because of my experiences with her.
No Comments

I didn't do amazing on any exam but he gave enough extra credit and curves to bring me to an A. He is a fine professor his exams can be hit or miss. Content is not extremely hard and his lectures are fine for what they are though I skipped a good amount of them.
Wilhelm is a great guy, however I did do the best on the exam I skipped every class for. Take that as you will!

Dr. Wilhelm is your average physics professor. His lectures were pretty good for the most part, although he got off on tangents and often focused on derivations of formulas. His grading scale is more than fair, and he is a genuine person who wants everyone to do well. Overall, this is a tough class, but Dr. Wilhelm made it more than manageable.

Wilhelm is a good professor. My only real complaint is that he does a lot of derivations as examples but we aren't ever tested on them, and I don't feel like he does a lot of in-class examples on the stuff we are tested over. This class can be tough but he is pretty fair with exams imo and curves/gives extra credit.

Professor was fine. Lecture were often confusing. If you don't understand immediately it gets even more confusing. Be prepared to learn a good portion outside of class. Gives curves on exams, also one exam was dropped.

Dr. Wilhelm is your average professor. He reads off the slides he publishes on Canvas, does a demonstration here and there, etc. Participation was done via Canvas quizzes that can be done at home and hw is generally one assignment per week. He does NOT do examples, so the book is a good resource. Practice exams are also vaguely like actual exams.

He seems like a great dad. Loves physics and his kids. Not the best at calculus, but he tries. The exams are always too long for the time given. With other assignments and attendance grades its very possible to do well if you don't do the best on the exams. Less homework than the other physics profs.

This class is extremely unorganized and he will go off on random tangents. The observatory assignment was so unorganized. It was quite literally the biggest waste of time and resources I have ever seen. The tests and final paper were designed like it was a 400 level class. This is a 100 level core requirement class.. Do not take AST191 with Wilhelm

I am taking PHY 231 from Dr. Wilhelm. His teaching skills are good but he tends to go on tangents and explain things using a lot of math. In his small classes he tends to put you on the spot with questions. If none of that is a problem for you then you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I was in his TEAL section. He's a VERY laid-back professor which I liked. I was often confused by his lectures, but the group work helped. Physics is a hard subject, but he's an easy grader on the lab reports and gives lots of partial credit on exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Physics is really difficult, especially if youre like me and dislike the subject as heavily as I do. Physics II with Wilhelm is much easier than Physics I. There are clicker questions every single day, so participation matters. But there are bonus questions on every test and Wihelm is a really kind albeit strange professor!
Super nice guy and a great professor. Tests are fair and he will give up to an hour of extra time on exams. Very approachable and funny. Class is curved but tests are not.
Great teacher for the TEAL version. VERY easy grader on the in class work and gives a good amount of partial credit. Wish he taught 213
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you're interested in learning about distance stars, black holes, and other cool astronomy things, don't sign up for this class. It is basically a geology, physics, and chemistry course. He spends his lectures avoiding around the point for 45 minutes before he finally gets to his point in the last 5 minutes of class. DO NOT TAKE HIM AS A PROF

If you want to actually learn about space DO NOT TAKE THIS MAN'S CLASS! All he talks about is crater density and the physics behind everything. There is one week left of actual class and our final exam is Wednesday and we haven't even talked about over half of the solar system and what we have learned is irrelevant and boring!

Physics is by its nature difficult to learn, especially through lectures. You need to work the practice problems and ask for help at recitation. I went to his office hours once and it wasn't very helpful. He does lots of demonstrations and practice problems in class that really get you thinking about physics. Good professor.

no organization in class, his test are one thousand times harder than hw and practice. He is terrible at lectures, doesn't seem to have any order to class at all. He sets the class up well though, drops a test grade (because he knows he cant teach)

He was a good physics professor. Gave you all the equations, derived them for you, and then gave you some practice problems help show them in practice. On top of this, there were demonstrations on everything to help you nail down the concepts. Physics is hard. But he is not the reason. Physics is the reason.
Condescending at times but means well, tough course for a 100 level.

Well, Dr Wilhelm, he does not know how to organize his lectures properly, has no clue what he's teaching about, he turns it into like a 500 level geology class I can't even understand.  He didn't even seem helpful when I went to his office hours.   Good money was paid so I expect clear, understandable teaching.

I really enjoyed his class. I don't know why so many people don't like him on here, but he is a wonderful professor. I'm not big on science, but his class was one of my favorites. There is a reasonable amount of work, and it's relatively easy if you show up and pay attention. You learn a lot and I had a lot of fun in the class!

His class is a level 100 class that he makes into a level 400 class.  He makes everything much harder than need be and fails to actually teach.  If you like looking at rocks and guessing how old they are you might like this but honestly don't waste your time this class and this professor SUCK.
Don't take his class.  His lectures are long and boring.  Tests are 10 questions 10 points each.  Final project is a research paper that he makes more complicated than it needs to be.

Dr. Wilhelm is an antisocial lunatic who is hell bent on making this class as hard as possible. He begins by saying the class is not hard, but then he spends all semester filling your schedule with busy work and mindless tasks so his TA's, which do nothing, can have something to grade. Do yourself a favor and take BIO 103 for your Science req
Just an awful class. Lectures are long and boring and tests are brutal. It's basically a geology course...I learned nothing about the solar system. Don't do it.
DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS

Has an optional final exam. If you complete the homework and go to class, that helps a ton. Exams are only worth 15% each. Tests are not easy, definitely have to study. Be sure to make study guides for exams, review hw problems and in-class problems. Take good notes.
He is one of the worst teachers EVER. He really made astronomy harder then it had to be for an entry level class. DO NOT take astronomy with him. He is not helpful at all

Weekly homework is super easy, and he grades 20 out of 28 antecedence quizes, so if you miss 8 your still good. The guy below me that said fail test=fail class is wrong. I got a 60 on the first test and a 50 on the 2nd one and I got an A because I did the (easy) extra credit. No lab, so easy class if your doing it for core (vs. BIO/CHEM)

Solar system sounds fun-wrong you learn nothing about it, you learn bout earth and rocks. Hw and activities easy but beware test are as he says "only 30%".they are 10 questions worth 10 each.Essentially fail the test fail the class.Dont worry there is extra credit that he doesnt give. AKA stay away, not an Easy A, if anything a GPA killer.

Exam is 10 questions for 100 points but the grade is based mostly on HW and attendance so that is good. Its a Solar system class which means you do not learn about anything past Neptune (which really we only got as far as Galilean Moons.)A LOT of geology. Good class to take and good professor.

If you are looking for a read and memorize then take the test kind of class then this is most definitely not for you. This class is an application and practical course. the professor was fun and I enjoyed him but the class was no breeze. He has a very different teaching style than i have ever experienced. tests are really hard. DONT BUY THE BOOK
Wilhelm is a good professor. His tests can be tricky, and ten questions for 100 points can be quite frustrating, but he gives a HUGE amount of oppurtunity to gain points throughout the semester.

his tests were really easy ..much easier than the h/w problems.The written part of the test had questions that were done in class.He has the class set up with a built in curve.So h/w and attendance are more important than the exams .

He refuses to curve any of his tests. The class average has been a 60 for both tests and he thinks that's pretty good. The tests do not match anything we do in class, so its impossible to prepare for them. i highly recommend getting a different professor.

All powerpoints which can be stale at times, even with an interesting lecture topic. Big project at the end is a bear and requires a lot of little things to get right. Tests are basically like reading a novel, very difficult for that reason. Don't bother buying the book, never cracked it open once - total waste.

Almost everything is based on his powerpoints, not much use for the book. Has an intersting style of teaching: most of class is discussion of process and discovery and then he ends with one fact that we can obtain from said disovery. AST 191 class was not bad at all, much less content than the other 191 classes. Always available, nice guy.recommend

I felt like he made class pretty interesting, it wasn't too hard to pay attention. This is a hard class and the tests can be difficult but they aren't too bad. He didn't curve much, but he gave you a chance to earn test extra credit if the average was low. Was a pretty fair teacher. Homework was short and usually easy, quizzes were straightforward.

I took him his first time teaching phy 232.  The first test no one finished, the class average was 45.  During lecture he seemed to just flip through the slides provided by the book company.  He does lots of board work but it always takes him few tries to get the right solution.  Seems very unprepared when teaching. Grades slightly easy though.
I was taught if I learned Sufism from the likes of him and Hamza Yusuf I'd be able to fly and create things but nope! SCAM. I still have 0 superpowers.
They be hiring anyone
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: My class wasn't on here, I took AIS 430. Dr. Palmer is by far one of my favorite professors on this campus, he is so nice and is so passionate about teaching and making sure everyone understands the content. He is also an easy grader, he also doesn't count against late work, that doesn't mean abuse though. I love him.

One of the best professors Ive ever had. Great grading scale, very sweet, supper professional and cares about his students. Class material was heavy but he explained it well and gave good grades fairly. Enjoyed his teaching and would definitely recommend him for an easy and FAIR  A.
Terrible guy
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: AIS 440 -- Great guy and a fun course.

I have had the pleasure of taking Dr. Palmer multiple times. He's a standout professor-knowledgeable, provides great instruction, and is highly accessible outside of class. If there's ever an opportunity on campus that a student could benefit from, Dr. Palmer is sure to share it.
I love Ustaadh Palmer with all my heart. He deserves all the swag points.

Dr. Palmer really is an incredible professor. Arabic is not an easy language to learn, but his teaching was clear and easy to follow. There is a lot of homework (one assignment due before each class period), but each assignment only takes maybe 10 or 15 minutes. Dedicate enough time outside of class to learning the vocabulary and you will do fine.

Dr. Palmer was the best professor I've had at UK thus far. Arabic is not an easy language but he makes it fun to learn and makes sure that everyone is understanding. Dr. Palmer is passionate about the language and is very helpful if you are struggling or falling behind. Do the homework, show up, and you should get an A.

Palmer was a fantastic instructor who clearly and respectfully addressed the class. You can tell that he is passionate about the material, but also respects the differing views of his students. Textbooks were very helpful for homework and for essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: 100% the BEST professor that I have had at UK! Arabic is a difficult language and Dr. Palmer takes the time to ensure that everyone understands what is going on. Come to class, be respectful, and try to learn the language and you will for sure get an A or B. There is Homework every night but its not bad and its to help you, it isn't busy work!

Fabulous teacher. Arabic is a difficult language, but he explains things so clearly and is very helpful in and out of class. Attendance and homework matter, and can significantly bump up your grade. He has very clear grading criteria and is very clear about material covered
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Palmer is in my opinion the best professor at the University of Kentucky. I've been trying to learn Arabic for a while, this guy lays everything out clearly so that as an American we can understand how to properly speak, read, and write, and understand the culture. The guy is literally brilliant, learned so much in this class. Loved it
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: He is the best professor in the Arabic department.  He is easy to relate to because his first language was English and he became fluent himself so he understands the difficulty of learning Arabic. He grades fairly and puts grades in regularly. Anytime you go to office hours he will make you feel comfortable and treat you with respect.

Dr. Palmer is the best Arabic teacher I have had since I have been taking Arabic. He clearly has experience teaching the subject, and is very good at anticipating student's needs and the difficulties students will face in learning the subject. Also, he is incredibly flexible and is willing to work with the class to meet their needs.
Professor Maraj is positive and caring. She makes sure each student feels welcome to ask questions and reach out for help.

Professor Maraj invests to make the classes interesting and enjoyable. It is very evident that she wants all her students succeed. This makes it very easy to approach her for questions. Be prepared because she will make you work for the answers and will pay attention to even the smallest details.
She is energetic, involved, and knows a lot about the subject. Professor Maraj is hard on grading the quizzes but that is really helpful in the long run.

Such a nice person! She was very encouraging and it was obvious she really cared about her students and wanted us all to do well. Made sure students understood concepts well and were comfortable asking any questions! Difficult content but Aida really helped! Highly recommend, one of the best math profs I've had!
Very passionate and willing to help, but expected us to work which is a good thing. She even held individual post exam sessions to motivate and advise each of us.
Extremely helpful both in and out of class, constantly available for teaching and providing an excellent learning experience for her students. One of my favorite teachers of all time.

Professor Maraj is one of the best Math professors I've had at Michigan. She understands exactly where your misconceptions come from. I would ask her the dumbest questions but she would answer it respectfully and tell me what I'm misunderstanding. She gives amazing reviews for the exams and hints for the homework problem sets.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very ready to help the student. Clear explanations on the board and helpful review sessions.
Very clear on how willing she was to work with students and answer questions. Was definitely a factor in my deciding to go to her office hours so much.

She is a very understanding and helpful. You can tell she cares about how her students do in the class. She will sit down with anyone who needs help and gives everyone plenty of time to get things done and correct.

I have had very few teachers as committed to the course as Aida has been. She comes to class everyday with a positive attitude. She is extremely eager to teach and is dedicated to making sure that everyone in the class fully comprehends all of the material presented. Aida always manages to make the class smile.
Very Confusing and was hard to understand at times. Often would make several mistakes during lecture and not clear in material herself at times.
One of the worse prof Ive ever had. She does not understand the material that she has to teach and just walks around the room without a clue

Philosophy can be very hard to understand, and she makes it so easy.  She breaks down all the readings and has a witty sense of humor. She gives out readings for each class, and I never read a single reading and still passed. She goes over the readings as the notes for class. All you have to do is show up for discussion days and talk.
Participation is vital in her class. If you don't attend class you will not understand the material.

I took this Philosophy class to fulfill core requirements and did not expect much, but ended up really enjoying it! Not only does she make it interesting by presenting broken down material, she forms the final grade from one midterm exam as well as discussion papers that explain your opinion and reaction to the material. I recommend her class!
Breaks the material down, so that it is simple to understand.

Ajay is an interesting professor at UKy who taught me MGT611 (Managing Effective Organizations). What makes him stand out as interesting is that he has no practical management experience. It's surprising that UKy would let someone without real-world managerial experience teach MBA students who are learning to become managers.
He is not clear when it comes to tests. Confusing when lecturing, please stop teaching, you're awful at it
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a super chill and understanding guy. Software would crash at times or wouldn't cooperate and he'd give everyone credit anyways. Understands work-life balance and doesn't make anything a burden. Very passionate about what he does and knows how to teach it to beginners. Gives good feedback on projects and study guide for exams. Highly recommend

Dr. Mehra loves the material in the class but it is very abstract and struggled to translate it for people who haven't studied it for 20+ years, but he will work with you to make concepts clear. Social network analysis is super interesting and is worth learning about with Dr. Mehra, just be prepared to spend time outside of class learning yourself.
Dr. Mehra is very intelligent and expects a lot from his students. I don't mind because he puts a lot into each class. Grades easy though. Should make attendance compulsory.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Nice professor, likes to talk a lot. Sometimes argumentative and will push you to explain your position more, but that's not always a bad thing. Sometimes due dates and class content are difficult to follow, but review the slides pretty thoroughly and try to find old exams and you should be fine. Mainly just a LOT of content. Real life situations.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: One of the best management classes I have ever had. Most of the class is discussion based with real life situations. If you go to class and do what your supposed to do, easy to get an A. Great teacher and very fair grader.
Good teacher, good talker.  Topic can be confusing, but he always will take the time to answer questions. Class has real-life useful content.
smart guy. clearly works hard to provide value in class. made me see management and organizations in a new light. cute, especially with his shirt off-- see climbing pics on his website
smart guy. clearly works hard to provide value in class. made me see management and organizations in a new light. hot, especially with his shirt off-- see climbing pics on his website

recommend talking to him after first couple of classes to get on good side. likes to call out randomly in class to answer ?'s, be warned that whatever answer you give, he will argue in some way.  he does it with everyone.  doesn't care about grades really, just likes to talk.  got an A but no idea how

Dr. Akins is a caring professor and wants students to succeed. The lectures can be dry but give all test material. There are reading assignments each week but few graded assignments. The majority of grades in the class take place in the last month of school. Overall interesting content and would suggest.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Akins' tests were easy if you completed the study guide. Class is boring and she does not explain things in an effective manner. Go to class with the ppt pulled up on your computer and add some notes to it, occasionally ask a question, and study from the notes. She takes off a lot of points on the final essay for little things.

Dr. Akins taught this course in a clear and effective manner. If you actually attend class and study, getting an A or B should be easy. I attended every lecture and only studied a day or two before exams, and received an A. All of the information you need to know for the exam is on blackboard. All you have to do is be responsible and do your part.

Dr. Akins was very unorganized and confusing.  No textbook, information comes only from slides. Her tests are tricky and her assignments are hard to do because her slides do not match up with them.  Apparently she doesn't even make her own slides.  4 test, 8 assignments worth 5 points each.  Getting an A in this class is almost impossible.

Dr. Akins seems like a sweet lady. However, I had her for PSY 311 and we had a conditioning project that she's never done before. Very ambiguous prompt. Little discussion about the project. I did my project with my partner, presented it as outlined in the prompt and got back a score of 53%. I disputed it and she doesn't understand why I'm upset.

Akins is "okay". She's not the best teacher I've had, but definitely not the worst. Her lectures are DRY and she reads directly from the powerpoints. Her examples sometimes confused me more than the actual material. She gives a study guide but you are better off studying on your own.

Dr. Akins is awesome! I took her cap stone course "Biology of Aggression" and it was super interesting. 15 minute discussion on an article, 25 minutes discussion on a serial killer of your choice, and then a paper included with the serial killer. Super interesting class and not very hard as long as you can put in the work.

Dr. Akins is probably the best Psychology professor in the UK department. Shes super helpful and always available to talk after class. I definitely reccomend taking her if you get the chance. Class isn't easy but if you attend lectures and study, you'll do great.
Wonderful teacher. Lectures were at times a tad dry, but the class was very interesting nonetheless. She is very nice and willing to help students. Her exams are pretty easy too.

Good class and a great teacher.  Test questions are all from the notes, but can be tricky.  She gave extra credit, at least 4 times to my class.  Like all classes, all you have to do is study and show up to class and you should be able to get, at the very least, a B

Dr. Akins is a wonderful professor.  I highly recommend her.  She is very organized.  There is a lot of material to cover but she does an excellent job with it. The tests come from lecture and the lecture follows the book.

If you don't get an A in her class, you are lazy. She is very clear, provides study guides, and all the material on exams comes straight from her notes. She is very kind and very helpful. Provides extra credit opportunities.

Don't listen to this past reviews, Professor Takenada is one of the easiest professors I've ever taken. "Word choice" is not something she is picky about, just take your time on the papers and actually read. On one of the papers, I didn't read one of the books by accident and got a 95. She is a sweet and really cares about her students and course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I thought the class was fairly easy, the content is very digestible and Dr. Takenaka does a good job explaining the materiel. However, you will need to read a lot and there is a large amount of homework. Most of it is easy but will require you to read through some wordy and long texts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Super friendly and caring! Very approachable and relatively funny. Fair grader, not a lot of assignments. Large assignments make up for the infrequency. Decent amount of reading, but it's all interesting. Almost never finished all content of a lecture, but she was really engaging during lectures. Class was very informative and never boring or dull.

She is decently friendly, but not very approachable. Her lectures are mostly organized and structured. However, she does trial off from time to time. She grades rigorously for the unit paper assignments (there are 5), and is picky with word choice. The response papers do not include rubric, so it can be difficult to understand her grading scale.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I loved professor Takenaka! She was understanding, caring, and wants the best for her students. I loves her class and you will learn so much. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Takenaka was a phenomenal professor. The course topic was something she was very informed of. She did not care to take a look over the final essays before the class submitted them. Overall a top-tier history professor at the University of Kentucky!

An incredible history course. There is a lot of reading and a lot knowledge to take in from lectures, but it is worth it. Papers are over interesting topics and not too terribly long. She is super friendly and always willing to help students understand the material. Highly recommend

The subject matter is not everyone's cup of tea, but with such as clear course title, you know what you're getting into. Her lectures can seem disorganized at times, but she does a very good job of summing up at the end. Her tests are more than fair, giving ample out of class time to take them.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Nice lady, but a class definitely more suited for graduate students than undergrads. Ridiculously convoluted exams (essay questions -- more appropriate as term paper prompts than timed exams), difficult to follow lectures and quizzes. What does it tell you that in four and half years of college, I have never received less than an A, but a C here?
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: great professor, interesting lecture, maybe not an easy A if you aren't interested in the material, but definitely easy B. no tests, a few small papers and a 5-7 page final paper. recommend and would take her class again

Not really sure why Takenaka has so many terrible reviews on here. She is an excellent professor. Her lecture (class title: Japan at War) was really clear and informative even though I had little interest. No exams, just a couple papers, which are easy as cake. She is more than willing to help you find sources and gives excellent feedback.

This class was insanely difficult, as I previously took a similar class in the past. She hardly uses the textbook, so make sure to get lots of notes or even record her lectures. The tests are ridiculously hard. In short, I'd avoid any of her courses if at all possible.
She can't give a clear lecture at all. She goes back and forth so the lectures are next to useless and the tests are insanely hard.
Great professor.

As a special education major I've had Dr. Ainger for multiple classes in the past. The content for this class was nothing new to me but I thought it was clearly presented at an appropriate pace. This class did genuinely make me feel more comfortable working with others. If you are about to take this class please take it seriously!! It will help sm!

Shes not a bad professor. Very educated. However, doesnt have the best attitude which effected my learning. We only met once a week so attendance is very important. She is a very dry teacher and is monotone. All info is in PowerPoints. Assignments are straightforward. Didnt like her attitude though so would not take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: I never really got the chance to talk to Professor Ainger, but she was great given the circumstances of Covid. This class was asynchronous, which was really helpful because I was able to do the weekly assignments at my own pace. The quizzes are simple as long as you do the textbook readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I love professor Ainger, she is amazing and will try to her best ability for you to get a good grade in the class.
Professor Ainger is super sweet and caring! I absolutely loved her class and it was pretty easy as long as you showed up, and followed along to the PowerPoint!

I took Dr. Aingers hybrid 375 class. Overall, this class is pretty easy. The canvas quizzes arent bad and while attendance at the weekly in-person meeting is mandatory, it isnt hard to get the participation points (and it is actually a nice buffer for your grade). Side note: She was super understanding and helpful with the covid transition!
I absolutely love Dr. Ainger! I had her for both EDS 375 and EDS 547 and she is an amazing professor. Although I liked her in 375, I loved her in 547. You can definitely get an A in this course!

Dr. Ainger is very sweet. Attendance is not mandatory but she gives extra credit for showing up. Theres about 4 homework assignments (very easy) a paper, and four exams. Her grade scale is tough so if you don't do super great on them your grade will show it. She is passionate about what she is teaching, and gives very good study guides. DO THEM!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Don't let anyone tell you that she is a bad professor. Just SHOW UP TO CLASS and pay attention. She will literally tell you during lecture " this is going to be a test question and this is the answer" Also do her study guide, it is everything you will need for tests. She gave random extra credit for attending class. Textbook is not needed.

You can tell Dr. Ainger is really passionate and educated about special education and people with disabilities and it shows in her lectures,it's always nice to take a class with a prof who actually cares about the subject. However, you have to get a 92 and above to get an A and she doesn't give extra credit or round up, so be prepared to work hard.

She knows what she's talking about in her subject matter, but her monotone voice makes it hard to stay awake in a lecture heavy class. Her grading scale is 92< A, but even a 91.85 wont be rounded up - I know from experience. The slides are all online, but attendance is required. Shes also picky in grading. Make sure you use person-first language!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Class was very boring. She posts all of her powerpoints online and that's all you do in class so it always felt like there was no point in going even though she takes attendance. Don't bother buying the textbook, it's not required. Graded by 4 exams, a novel study, and 5 out-of-class assignments. Study for the exams or you won't get an A (92%)!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She was a really good professor. The grading scale sucks though because you have to get a 92% to receive an A in the course. The first exam is challenging and then the rest are super easy. She posts all slides online and she takes attendance every day but it doesn't count for points so you can skip whenever you want really.

I've taken Jan twice, the first time I failed because of attendance and tests. The second time her tests were so much easier (study the night before, you'll be fine) BUT she required attendance for her 100+ student 9am lecture, and required photo ID for exams. Try to take the spec ed class where you get hands on work, itll be more efficient for you
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Ainger was a decent professor who was obviously knowledgeable of special education. However, she was very boring to listen to and basically reads off her slides which can be found on canvas. I hardly ever went to class and received an A.

If you show up to class and take notes you'll be fine. Sometimes she goes super quick during lectures, but she always posts the powerpoints to Canvas. She knows a lot about what she's teaching, but doesn't necessarily make it fun.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: a 92% and up is an A and she doesn't round you up! I wouldn't take this class unless you absolutely need it, She sometimes gives extra credit when no one shows up

She goes over aspects of special education we should all know. She covers a lot of info so please be sure to take notes during her lectures. She also has some small group discussions in class. Over all she was an in depth professor who was great.

I enjoyed this class a lot because of her. The lectures always went by fast because they were full of slides/examples/activities. You can really tell she knows what she's talking about with Special Ed and she was always willing to answer questions!! But attending class is the only way to pass because so much information is given in lecture!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's a pretty good professor, and she's extremely knowledgable in the field of Special Education. She posts lectures online, so you can follow along in class. She does speak rather quickly, so you have to be very attentive to keep up. Overall, she's a really good resource to UK.

Jan is not super easy but she is so nice. I really do like her, her teaching is just a little off. Make sure you keep up with the work (it's not a lot at all) and go to class. Talk to her about assignments and do your best work. YOU WILL GET AN A if you do this! The people who skip class, do not do the work, etc. struggle...

She will never give you time to write any notes and she posts her presentations on canvas, but leaves words blank, so you can't ever get any notes in unless you are super speedy, but then, what do you learn?
very good english professor, super funny and had creative class assignments! if he can tell that you're trying, and you engage in discussions, you will definitely do well.

His is the worst organized professor I have ever had. He cancelled class at least 9 times during the semester and the details of assignments were not posted. It would always just say details forthcoming. When you would try to contact him he would never respond. His lectures were gibberish and incoherent.

They were extremely rude. They were so rude in fact, I stopped going to the class. They were a TA, and did not make me feel welcome, or able to express my opinions freely. Every time I spoke, they gave me a side eye or brushed off my comments completely. Do not take them. (I just wanted to put this out there. Had them Fall 2021 and never rated him)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Yusuf is such a fun character! They offer a ton of inspirational feedback for aspiring writers which is encouraging. They are a TA for ENG 107 and made the class super fun! Participation does matter in this class so you will have to get our of your comfort zone. There are some times where they get confused and hard to follow but you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: he will screw you over when he gets the chance. i had a 100% in the class all semester and then at the end we had an assignment worth 4 points, i got a 2/4 and it dropped my grade all the way down to a 83%. he explained that i didnt punctuate perfectly so that caused for an F on the assignment. wouldnt recommend this class unless youre perfect

Do not take this class if you're not okay with having assignments unlocked the day they're due :). Had a paper unlocked at midnight that was due at 11:59pm that night, and the midterm wasn't unlocked until a day and a half before it was due.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: The lectures are not interesting whatsoever, and he is impossible to understand, not necessarily because of his accent, but because sometimes sentences would be grammatically incorrect and I would have to decipher them. I'm pretty miffed bc I'm an anthro major and this class could have been interesting, but wasn't. Attendance not mandatory.

Class is an Easy A. If you go to class the first few weeks you never need to go again. I think there were three real assignments and the midterm and final were both take-home, online, and open note. Super easy class if you need a global dynamics credit.

Dr. Reda's class was somewhat of a drag this semester. Not a hard or difficult class just extremely boring. Can be difficult to understand because of his accent. I cant decide if i would take him again or not. For lower level classes he is manageable, but for anything more advanced it would be easy to get lost quick. Does not respond to emails.
Weekly papers, horrible boring lectures, had a feeling he didn't know what he was teaching. Course would be a lot better if taught by someone else.
He does not know how to answer emails and his lectures are sooooo boring. The class itself is very easy but I emailed him 5 times during the semester and he never responded.
Very boring class. Extremely unorganized. It was easy but each lecture made me want to fall asleep. Quizzes are open note.

I enjoyed the group discussion because it helped me learn the information better. He does not grade hard at all and is very understanding. He wants you to do well and enables you to achieve your desired grade. His lectures could get very boring fast, but it is worth going to class for the attendance because that is a lot of your grade.

This course was very easy with Professor Reda, but so incredibly boring. Attendance was mandatory and a large part of your overall grade, but class was often brutal to sit through. Professor Reda is extremely kind, but his class was so incredibly boring. You absolutely need the textbook (both in and outside of class)
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This was the first time INT200 was offered so it was new to us, as well as professor Reda. Attendance was majority of the grade along with some one page papers, map quizzes, and exams. He grades extremely easy so the only way to fail is to not do your work or not show up to class.

This is by far the easiest and most boring class I have taken. Attendance is for a grade, so suffering for 50 minutes of boredom every MWF is mandatory. The textbook is also extremely boring but is necessary to have because you have to provide quotes from it in reflection papers. Take a different professor if you can't handle boredom.

Professor Reda is adorable. The class is super difficult, but he makes it as easy as he can. He is extremely intelligent, thoughtful, and caring. His english is fantastic, and as long as you somewhat pay attention to lectures and review the PowerPoints on canvas, the tests and quizzes are an easy A. Do be ready to participate in discussions though!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mr. Reda is a caring and well-meaning professor. His grasp of English falters at times but is always understandable with a little reading between the lines. Course relies on a few assignments but if you do the readings, attend class, respond to questions, and give the assignments an honest shot, you'll get an A easily. I ended with a 107%.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I have taken several part-of-term classes and they are always intensive by nature. The organization, or lack thereof, in this class made it unbearable and impossible to keep up with. Inconsistent canvas and syllabus due dates were also an issue. I made multiple attempts to reach out to my professor with questions but found his responses useless.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: I had this class later afternoon and it felt like a stress reliever. The professor is always willing to help, and the work is very easy but for this class specifically be ready to discuss a lot because he genuinely is interested in everyone's opinions on the topics. Yes, there will be discussion boards and some reading to do just keep that in mind.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: i had him for phi100 and he was a chill prof. he would take attendance everyday, pretty big part of your grade. had to read after almost every lecture and would have assignments every week on the reading as well. kinda goes on long tangents but is funny so its chill
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Attendance is definitely mandatory and is the main way you earn points. You're given discussions and quizzes to take based on what the class was about, but the lectures were never really taught. Students talked more than him as it's a question/discussion based class. Would definitely NOT recommend taking this class again with him as a teacher.
Horrible teacher, only talks about his hatred for Trump every class and never talks about the assigned readings he gives you. Don't take him if you want to actually learn anything.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This has been the worst class I have taken.There is nothing to learn from this class because he just wants to listen to himself talk. He loves to talk about his opinions, which becomes extremely annoying. The only thing good about this class is the easy grading and interesting readings. Do yourself a favor and dont take a class with him.

I was excited for Philosophy of Law as I am interested in both. This class did not discuss either in class. Required readings were inspirational. In class, we would not talk about them at all which was disappointing. Andy pushed his political agenda. I could appreciate it for three classes, but after a semester, I found it incredibly aggravating.

By far the best professor Ive taken. Id recommend taking someone else if you r conservative/republican and dont wanna hear opposing views cause he's very open about what's going on in the government. Very down to earth. Literally cant fail cause he's open to any perspectives. No late grades for reading quizzes. Makes class interesting and engaging!
Honestly his class is super easy but he just talks the whole time which is boring. Be prepared for lots of political talk (liberal). Easy grader so if you're looking for an easy class take him.

This professor is extremely liberal and talks about his beliefs for every class period. But, he does grade extremely easy. He dogs the other political spectrum and makes wild remarks that should not be said within a teacher- professor relationship.

BEST PROF EVER!!! andy is amazing and probably my favorite i've had at uk. he's so easy to talk to and accessible. his classes so are interesting in how he relates them to the real world. such a fun class!!!
I LOVE ANDY!!!! I took PHI 305 and loved it. He was so nice, funny, understanding. He created such a safe and welcoming place for everyone. Take a class with him, you will not regret it!!!!!!!!!

He is such an understanding and easy to listen to teacher! If you can't make it to class he always uploaded the handouts to Canvas and we could just fill them out and send them to him. He makes class super fun and engaging and class discussions are easy to participate in because he makes you want to participate. He is easily one of the best: PHI335

Very easy class, but provides a lot of information as far as legal and law philosophy. Great and kind professor, and I definitely recommend this class to anyone who has the chance to take an extra credit.
Andy is just the best. Do yourself a favor and take a class with him. It will be one of your favorites.

Andy is by far one of the best Professors I have ever had at the University of Kentucky. If you like to laugh, this is the man for you. He also genuinely cares about what his students have to say. Andy's classroom is a free space for all his students to speak. I was always excited to come to Andy's class.

Loved this professor. He is honestly such a breath of fresh air, and he is not scared to be relatable which I love. He has a lot of shared views on life with his students, he was just delightful. If you see a class with him aw the instructor TAKE IT!

I cannot recommend taking a class with Andy enough. Andy is the best professor I've had at UK. His lectures are extremely entertaining and he is a very, very fair grader. He is also extremely understanding in regards of students. He is just over all an amazing guy. Do yourself a favor and take one of his classes.

Big fan of this guy. Lectures short and simple and the material is pretty straight forward. Do the homeworks and guideposts and you will get a great grade on the tests. Definitely going to take another one of his classes.

Amazing teacher and an amazing person, def take his class if you have a chance. He tries his best to make lectures fun and easy to understand. Exams are easy if you do the homework and do the practice exams.

Love this man. I've had him for 3 classes. He's one of the few professors who keeps his lectures short and simple. Very responsive. Biggest thing is that he keeps his class very structured and simple. You will not get any surprises. Do the work and its an easy A.
Love this guy as a professor, he realizes a lot of students are double to triple majors, so he will accommodate by having shorter lectures during hard times.
Very nice man! He cares and will help you if needed!

He is so amazing! He talks slow so you might be bored but overall if you pay a bit of attention, or do the smartbooks during the lectures, you're fine. His lectures teach you everything. HOWEVER keep all those guidepost questions on a running google doc. They all come back, an exam 1 question will totally be on exam 3

Great guy that cares about his students and the material he teaches. Be ready to attend class and do the homework's and you'll be fine. Exams aren't that bad he gives study resources that are really helpful. 

Overall the best professor in the marketing department at the school.
Awesome professor. Takes attendance each lecture but exams are super easy if you listen in class. Homework was pretty simple too. I'd highly recommend!
I loved Professor Andersen!!! He is one of my favorite professors at UK.

Anderson is one of my favorite professors. He is one of the few that care about his students and want them to succeed. Attend class because there is almost always an in class assignment. But, his lectures are quite short and he lets you work with groups. He's funny and caring and I really appreciate how accessible he is outside of class. Take him!

Very easy course but unfortunately every class has an in-class activity. On the bright side, you get out early almost every day. Online exams are short but every one is cumulative so they may get tricky if you don't remember material from the previous exams.

Mark Anderson is such a good guy. He learns almost everyone by name and genuinely cares about your success. Be prepared to attend class and do the in-class assignments but besides that, he is wonderful. His exams are all online but they can be a little tough. Overall great guy

Take him. An absolute gem of a professor, wants you to be successful and it shows. Lectures are always very quick and to the point, but don't really assist much when it comes to exams. Guidepost questions really help the content stick. Can't stress enough how kind and respectful he is, an absolutely amazing professor.

The class it self was easy, but I hated it. There was so much reading that I wasnt truly prepared. Id have 2-6 assignments per week related to readings that were boring. All exams are cumulative so it builds on the exam before which I didnt like. easy A but if I knew the amount of work I wouldve never signed up.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Super nice and understanding. Gives you many chances to get an A including extra credit. One of the best professors ive had

Super easy class, but you won't get an A if you don't show up to class and go the group work even though it is effortless. I only studied the Guidepost questions and found that the entire exam was mostly questions from those. Definitely recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Andersen is by the most genuine professor I have had. He learns all the names of the students, provides feedback, gives clear grading, and is extremely fair. He actually teaches you about valuable things that you will use in the real world and always has examples to back them up. Class is mandatory. Take him, my favorite prof at UK.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The BEST professor in Gatton! I am scheduled for my third class with him in the Spring. MKT 310/410 and in the Spring MKT430 and he never fails to be a great professor. Truly puts so much time into making sure his students are learning something. He almost always lets you out of class a little early and is very responsive! take him!!!!

Andersen is the sweetest, nicest professor there is. I've had him for 2 classes this semester. He takes the time to get to know every persons name. Very great guy!! Actually interesting classes too. Gives real life examples. Lots of extra credit!

Anderson is a great professor. We got out at least 15 minutes early every class because he doesn't waste your time. The tests are word for word from the study guide he gives you all you have to do is memorize it. Super nice guy and has good stories too. Give tons of extra credit if you choose to do it. Automatic A if you just show up.

I do not know why he has a perfect score. Andersen merely shows up late, rambles at the beginning of class about stories that have little to do with what we are learning, puts on a video, makes us do textbook work, then takes attendance before we leave. Therefore, the tests aren't too easy. Not the worst professor I have had, but not the best.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Mark is the best professor in Gatton. I cannot stress enough how easy his class is. Even though they are easy, you still learn a pretty good amount. He is really nice and he structures the class for you to succeed. Every class lasts about 20-30 minutes tops. The other reviews on here are spot on with how great he is. 5/5

I would take a bullet for Prof. Andersen. I've taken him for five marketing courses (310,320,340,410,430) and each class has nearly the same structure. He's easy, yes (test questions come directly from online assignments) but he's the most genuine professor at UK. He cares about your professional career and is always available. Always take him

This man should be rewarded best college professor in America. I have taken him 3 times and will be taking one more class with him my final semester. Easy A if you go to class. Test questions come directly from HW. Class last 15-30 mins. Truly the Greatest of All Time.
Mark is awesome, best professor I have taken at UK. He offers a lot of extra credit and gives a lot of real world advice.

I took his class for Management 430. He is super kind and laid back! Do the guidepost questions, they usually show up on the test! He gave us three opportunities to get extra credit during the semester, helped me make up for not studying well for the exams. Definitely not hard to get and A or B in this course!

Class never lasted more than 25 mins. He talks about the chapter in the book a bit then has you answer 3 Q's about the chapter in groups. Tests based off practice questions on Canvas. REALLY easy A if you do those practice Q's. Have taken him 3 times, received 3 A's. Really nice and caring guy, as well as very available. Fav professor at UK.

I loved Mark! He is so kind and often tells stories during class to make it interesting. The tests were fair and were graded and returned quickly. I would recommend this class to any management major wanting to take a class that will matter. If you do the extra credit and study for the exams, there is no way you won't get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Just take him you will love it if you don't get a 95% or higher you need to re-evaluate your life. Great professor to prepare you for life.

By far my favorite professor at UK. Attendance is not mandatory but he has class activities everyday that he gives credit for and if you show up you will get the credit. All the exam questions are directly from the practice questions. One big sales project but he gives a great outline and is very helpful.

Mark is the best! His lectures can be a little dry, but he always lets out early. Tells you exactly what will be on the exam. Just do the work and you will get an A. Even if you don't do the work, he gives a decent amount of extra credit assignments. I go out of my way to find classes he is teaching.

Awesome guy, provides everything you need to study and get an A in class, if you take the time to use the material, took the summer session so every day was group assignments but it was good because it broke up the material nicely, so whenever you finished you got to leave. He lets you out early 95% of the time. Easy A.

Great professor, took his night section and even though it was a two hour section he always made sure it ended early. Test are easy and you are provided with study guides and practice test that have the test questions on them. Gives several chances for extra credit. I finished his class with a 103 percent. Just do your work and you'll get an easy A

Dr. Mackey really isn't that bad. Her personality is pretty abrasive and loud but it's mostly sarcasm, don't take it personally. The class wasn't very difficult and as long as you read the questions on the tests thoroughly you'll be fine. Attendance is taken randomly but you'll benefit from showing up regardless. I was very pleasantly surprised.

This is the only rating you need to read. Would I be best friends with her? No. BUT she is the best lecturer on campus. If you show up to class, take notes, there is no way you won't get an A in the class. She gives MINIMAL homework, tests are not hard at all and all MC. Seriously all you need to do is go to class and you will get an A GUARANTEED.
Her exams have an incredible amount of trick questions that sometimes I think she tries to fail students. Attendance is kind of mandatory-she does sporadic attendance checks. Shes also not the nicest

I finished PSY310 with a 99% without reading the textbook. Exams are not that difficult as long as you attend lectures and pay attention (she will ask questions on exams that refer to certain lectures). She takes random attendance. She definitely talks down to students, but her lectures are entertaining and informative.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: PSY324* Angela speaks to her students like they're challenged or as if they're middle schoolers. She takes her time putting in grades despite there only being 10 assignments total so you don't know where you stand in the class and neither does she. She only does attendance when she notices certain students absent. Only started being nice around TCE

Dr. Mackey honestly isn't that bad. She's nice and understanding but can be very loud at times when teaching. You can tell she's genuine and passionate about the class, and she's very helpful during office hours. She doesn't take attendance every day, so it's still good to go to class.

If you aren't a good test taker I wouldn't recommend. If you don't get good grades on the tests you won't get a good grade in the class. Beware she does take a little while to respond to emails. She is very harsh and moves pretty fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures were easy to follow but didn't match the exams. Study guides weren't helpful. Communication was poor and emails often went unanswered. The instructor was passive-aggressive and made class uncomfortable at times. Constantly yelling in lecture. Would not take again. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!! Genuinely want the best for you and your GPA.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very test heavy, sometimes will relate to things talked about in the textbook however the textbook is not going to be a crucial part to your final grade (I didn't use it and passed with a 84). She will give out extra credit points for showing up to class time to time. Be ready to take notes and stay focused.

I had her first semester, and I thought she was great! The lectures were fun and interesting. Attendance is not mandatory, but she does take it on random days. Also, she gives out lots of extra credit to students that show up on days where most other students are skipping. The labs are pretty easy, and the test are not too bad.

Seeing these reviews prior I was terrified, but she really was not bad. A lot of comments said she doesn't respond to emails, but for me she responded quick to if it wasn't a weekend, and if she didn't respond, the TA would. There is some material on exams that aren't gone over in class but she posts plenty of study resources. She's very funny too.

Stated she hated people. Was rude to her students and didn't remember them. I would listen to others and avoid her at all costs. The tests are pointless with the study guide and are over complicated compared to how simple the lectures are to understand. Attendance will make a dent in your grade! Just making a C is difficult. TAKE SOMEONE ELSE!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr.Mackey is an amazing professor. She cares about students and wants to help as much as needed. However, attendance is random, so you have to be there every time to get credit. She mentions a lot of things that aren't on the lecture slides, so take notes constantly. Labs have a lot of busy work, but content is important. Overall, great professor!

Dr. Mackey is great. 70% of the grade is exams so keep that in mind if you aren't a good test taker. However, exams aren't difficult if you actually pay attention and study. She also gives out a ton of extra credit towards the exams and drops the lowest exam score. If you plan on skipping class regularly, you will likely not do very well.

Dr.Angela Mackey, is a great professor. I love how she connects a lot of the information learned to examples from her life or tries to connect it to the students lives to help us understand the info more. For every exam she provides a review session, and will often expand some due dates. For our first exam she also gave the whole class +2 points.
