I hope to never encounter this professor ever again. She is a very hard grader and at one point, most of the class was failing. I recommend taking MULTIPLE days to study for her exams. She also takes attendance randomly, and if you don't get those points, they will affect your grade terribly.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr Mackey is a pretty good professor.  This class is easy if you attend and pay attention during lectures. Take notes on not only the slides, but what she says. She gives out lots of extra credit for simply attending the class. Pretty easy class if you just pay attention.
She gives good lectures
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Unpopular opinion but Dr. Mackey is a great professor and if you attend lectures and pay attention you will be prepared for the exams. Very exam heavy class but the exams aren't super difficult. She makes lectures interesting and can be funny! I recommend taking her class but if you're not going to go to lectures then I would suggest other wise.

Attendance is mandatory, but is done at "random" times throughout the semester, which consist of days she expects a lot of people to miss. The test questions are wordy and vague, which makes them seem like they have subjective answers (they don't), and she takes forever to grade them. her excuse: "doesn't have the time to go to the grading center"

Disrespectful, raises her voice to sound intimidating, admits to trying to get you to fail. Doesn't answer emails. Attendance is mandatory, but doesn't take attendance every class. Doesn't learn our names so I would get deductions for being absent from classes I attended. She's confusing/fast paced, and will refuse to go back to any missed slides.

Overall, kinda rude, grades insanely tough, barely gives us any assignments, so your whole grade reflects off of your exam scores (which I typically fail because she tests you on what she says in class rather than what's on the slides). I really like the class and I find it very interesting, but it's a really hard class.

She didn't grade all my work, ignores emails, will yell and forget your name but attendance is mandatory. No attendance sheet, just mandatory, she won't accept any excused absent ( even school function) . One assignment she claimed we had 2 weeks on.. she didn't upload it til MID SPRING BREAK and it was due 9am first day back 4 days)

I had this professor for both 216 and 310. I truly regret not switching out of her classes. The pace of lecture is incredibly quick and she is open about the fact that she will not slow down for any reason. The way she speaks in lecture, email , and one on one show an extreme lack of respect. I am genuinely just trying to warn you.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had her 334 class but it's not listed : class is difficult depending, and I'd say a lot of the other ratings are very true, but she does genuinely care and tries hard. Come to class, she doesn't respond to emails often and canvas messes up a lot. Study guides aren't very reliable, but if you attend regularly you'll get the idea.

To find out she “took attendance” yet called me the wrong name AND gender is class multiple times, she never passed round a paper. there are multiple days I was there and she says not. Multiple projects made up but she never graded and still gave zeros for because she doesn't answer emails, gave final grade before half of things are graded.

Awful. This professor randomly takes attendance and often raises her voice with passive aggression before exams. Exams are tricky due to wording and studying helps only some. Not a lot of work in the course, but it doesn't have much of an impact on overall grade, so it's very test heavy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: i did not like her, i'm sorry. she did random attendance which impacts your grade hella. i did not find her very enjoyable to listen to either. tests were confusing. she's also very……… millennial core if you will. i wish i could've chose a different professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr.Mackey is horrible. She hates her students and hates being a professor. She was late every day, never had the lecture uploaded, but would continue to yell at us during class for not understanding. She admitted to rigging her tests to fail you, and had a secret study guide she gave to students who she believed was “showing up” these are her words

She was not the worst psych prof I have ever had but her exams are hard and on paper. drops your lowest exam and only takes attendance periodically. you almost HAVE to be there to do well on her exams. can come off rude & like she does not care if you fail or pass her class. The content is interesting, so the lectures aren't horrible to listen to.

the worst professor I have ever had. she is never understanding about anything, even emergencies. she has admitted to purposefully trying to trick you during the exams, and makes the worst study guides that don't get posted until 1-2 classes before the exam. good luck getting an email back too. if you can't test well, do not take any of her classes

Angela Mackey is one of the most disrespectful professors I've had at UK. She does not care about the well-being of the students, nor just she accommodate for anything. The exams are subjective, and extremely hard for no reason. She sets you up for failure. Do not take this class if you don't have to, unless you want to fail.

Dr. Mackey is a good professor. Lectures are entertaining and she cares about the subjects. Class is heavily test graded, so studying and learning in lecture are important. Class however, is not very hard, and she is a good professor that will present the needed information to pass and get good grades on exams.

I really liked Dr. Mackey. She was funny and her connections to real experiences were decent. While you don't have to attend class I would. She does random things that help your grade and prepare you for tests. Her tests are not easy, but I can't imagine if I had not been in class. Overall I will take her again.

Overall she was not a horrible professor from a teaching aspect however her lectures felt somewhat disconnected and she generally did not seem to have a good attitude coming into class. Her grading is poor though and after a month of having my final project turned in it still has not been graded, which I have informed her of so its a bit annoying.

Professor Mackey was so nice and she cares about her students. She chooses random days to take attendance, so make sure you show up to lecture. The lectures are also crucial to passing the exams. She gives "learning goal" for each exam so you know what to study, and you know what will be on the exam.

I enjoyed Dr. Mackey's class. She would explain beyond the slides and connect ideas to real life. She takes attendance on random days for a grade. Pretty much everything she talks about will be on the exams. She posts learning goals for each chapter which were super helpful. Study hard and do the assigned readings and the class will be easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Overall she's an alright professor, not amazing but not too bad. Attendance isn't mandatory but she does take it on random days. Exam are a huge part of your grade so you do need to study, one bad test can drop your grade significantly. One helpful thing she does it post learning targets before the exams, so I do recommend looking through those.

I loved Angela Dawn Mackey and her sassy and funny personality. PSY 100 def is content heavy so attendance in lectures is definitely helpful. Online labs are annoying and time consuming but they do help with your overall grade.

Blatantly rude and disrespectful towards students. I would highly discourage anyone from taking any course offered by her. She should not be allowed to teach at the collegiate level, she treats her students like kids and is honestly mean.

If you can take another professor, do it. She is rude to students, does not know how to respond to emails, and her exams are nearly impossible to pass. She is constantly making fun of students for not knowing the answer when she continually does the work wrong and is just like oops.

Do not ask any questions unless you want to be ridiculed in front of the whole class. She does not have many assignments that are worth a lot of points, so your grade just reflects your test scores. One bad test score dropped me a whole letter grade. She basically reads straight off of her slides. She takes attendance on random days.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Angela's lectures are crucial for performing well on tests.  If you do not attend you will most likely fail.  She's a tough professor, but I  believe it's because she wants you to really learn the material.  If you pay attention, take good notes, and complete the labs (which are pretty easy) you will be fine.

Angela knows what she is talking about during the lectures so take notes and write down her examples for topics. STUDY FOR THE EXAMS OR YOU WILL FAIL!!!!  She will take random attendance but if you have a friend that goes everyday most the time they can give ur attendance for you. Also don't skip the labs they're important for ur grade too

Dr. Armenta was an okay professor. His class was easy to pass if you put in the work. However, his lectures tended to go off topic to things in his personal life like clubbing. I would have preferred he stick to course topics.

Awesome professor! He is very funny and uses great examples in class. Attendance isn't mandatory and we have class on zoom often. He drops lowest exam score and attendance is extra credit. Perfect class if your looking for an easy A.
I don't actually think Dr. Armenta knows what he is talking about. Seems like he jus wanted to go on and on about random things.
Wish there was more focus on course content instead of tangents.

This class was disappointing. You'll likely get an A, but you won't learn much. Lectures constantly went off track with long personal stories unrelated to the material. I ended up teaching myself from the book. Dropped grades don't make up for the lack of instruction.

Angel is the funniest professor I have ever had, I think he does a great job at making the course connect with real-world scenarios that has a way of making the information stick better. He is one of the best psych professors I have had here by far.

Graded only on 3 exams, attendance, and 2 quizzes. The wording on exams and quizzes were not always clear. You can get extra credit if you don't miss more than 4 classes. He often got off topic during lecture with personal stories

This class was really disappointing. He seemed unprofessional and kept going off on long, random stories that had nothing to do with the lesson. Most days, it felt like we didn't learn much because the lectures were so off-track. I wouldn't recommend taking this class with this professor.

He spends most of class talking about himself, like bar fights or dates. It was funny at first but got old fast. I didn't learn much, and just read the book on my own. We never had class on Mondays and he drops a test grade, but that doesn't help if you're not learning. He even asked us to leave good reviews. Not cool.
Angel was absolutely amazing! His lectures are super super engaging and attendance isn't mandatory. Exams were also super easy. I feel like you would actively have to try to get lower than an A.

genuinely one of the most down to earth, funniest professors i've taken at UK. he makes it impossible to not pass. grades off of few things but everything is taken online with 24 hours to complete exams/quizzes. attendance is extra credit and he gives many extra credit chances. seeing his score on here shocked me cause i thought itd be much higher.
Good profesor, keeps it entertaining and not a lot of assignments.

Absolutely amazing professor. So funny and makes lectures enjoyable. The exams were online and reflected course material and the textbook. Offers a lot of opportunities for extra credit and drops the lowest exam score.

The class isn't hard and all the extra credit makes it very possible to get an A. He does focus more on making class enjoyable and telling funny stories, while not giving much memorable information during lecture. The exams are online and not proctored. He also holds rewiew sessions where he gives 5-10 questions and answers for the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy class. He goes on tangents about his life but I found them funny and enjoyable just as long as it can be related back to the material. He gives you so many ways to succeed in the class.
I loved Armenta. He is so funny to listen to and offers extra credit for coming to class. All of his tests are very easy and he does a review session before each exam. Definitely take his class

This class can be done in your sleep. There is no reason you shouldn't get an A - he gives extra credit for attending class, offers exam reviews, and drops your lowest test grade. However, his lectures are so off-topic - he spends more time telling stories about what he did at the club than he does teaching about social psychology.

This professor is the BEST!! If you attend class you get ec (if you only miss 4). Also there are 4 tests, but the lowest one is dropped and you take them at home! So, if you do good on the first 3, you dont have to do the last one or get the ec. He also does a review session before the test with some exam questions. TAKE this course!!!

He is an okay professor, but he really cares for his students, and it's pretty easy to get an A as long as you put in a slight amount of effort. He did read from the slides quite a bit with very little additional explanation, but I think that is just because he was new to teaching the course
Awesome professor

On the one hand, you WILL get an A in this class. On the other hand, you probably will not learn anything. He goes off topic to "relate" to the material but I guarantee nobody is making a connection. It is not teaching. He is also very self centered, it can be annoying at times.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly he's very understanding and a great person, but as a professor, I struggled with him. Lectures tended to get off topic very easily and most weren't necessary since he read straight from the slides which were posted on Canvas anyways. Half of the time I found it easier to work ahead and teach myself.

i honestly didn't understand his lectures so i never paid attention and learned on my own, which seems to be a common theme among my classmates in there. but he's super sweet and wants you to pass. 4 test, 3 unit test and a final, lowest score is dropped and the final is a cumulative off all previous test questions. talks abt personal life a lot...

I loved Dr. Armenta! He's very kind to his students and always ready to help! His lectures are a must simply because he breaks everything down in an understandable and comedic way. I wish I could have him as my professor again!

Pretty sure Angel is rating himself on rate my professor. He has been nothing but selfish. He spends the entire class talking about himself, leaving no time to lecture. I cannot stress enough that you will be teaching yourself, buy the book. He will beg you at the end of the semester to leave a positive review and make him look better than he is.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are very fun, although reading on your own time is definitely necessary (though not so much a negative thing to be honest).
super chill and nice. loved taking class with him!
Professor Armenta is really kind and very smart. I am glad I took this course with him.

He is a great professor. We only had class on Wednesday's and Friday's which a lot of us loved. Some times he would have to rush thought the lecture because he doesn't know how to stop talking about his life and past events. His exams are pretty easy if you study and he also offers a study guide. Overall, highly recommend.

He would spend the entire class talking about himself, bar fights, and failed dates he's been on. It is funny at first, then it gets repetitive and annoying. I would have rather sat at my house and read the textbook then attend his lectures. We never had class on Monday and he does drop your lowest exam grade. You will not learn anything important.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor always answered emails in a timely manner. Great person and very funny.
I took this class in spring 2023 and I was amazed by how personable and funny dr Armenta is. He had amazing lectures and made it extremely easy for me to grasp the material.

reviews.comment: The first two exams were online which is the only way I passed. He drops the lowest exam grade and gives lots of extra credit. His exams are straight from the book/quizlet.

reviews.comment: Dr. Armenta is super funny but it felt like sometimes he was so focused on being funny that his examples didn't really make sense. They were more to make you laugh. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is fine but lectures are NOT helpful. All of the test questions are taken directly from the textbook. Often spends the whole class talking about unrelated and personal topics about himself.

Professor Armenta gives real life examples that relate to the content and aid in learning. Overall, he is a fine teacher, different than any other psychology professor I have had, but its slightly frustrating because he lacks professionalism, is typically late to class, and wastes a lot of your time on unnecessary things/off topic conversations.

You'll like this class if you don't care about social psychology and just want the credit. He drops the lowest test grade and gives extra credit for just showing up to class. His lectures suck--I actually got more enjoyment out of reading the textbook. He cares more about being liked than teaching well, and stops being funny after the third class.

reviews.comment: 4 insanely hard tests & 2 hard quizzes; this is your total grade. The class is lecture heavy, however the lectures will not help at all when it comes to test time. reviews.comment: 4 exams, 2 quizzes, drops the lowest exam. Must get ALL of your information from the book, as the lectures do not help whatsoever. Exams are extremely hard; they average ~75%. reviews.comment: Instructor Norris provides a unique perspective since she actively works in the healthcare field herself. She offers great insight into healthcare professions and genuinely cares about her students. She's also a very lenient grader and an understanding person overall. Awesome instructor and person.

Took CHS 101, Mondays are when Miss Norris does her lecture, Wednesday is when all the sections group into a big lecture hall to listen to a different healthcare professional speak each week.

Her lecture focus is more mental-focused. Burnout, finding out your values, etc. Take her section

Very easy course overall and cares about her students. Gives 3 mental health days, but honestly you can take a couple more and be fine. There is a group project, which is arguably the worst part. If you stay somewhat active in the class discussion (like say something 2-3 a week) you're basically guaranteed an A.

The Prof. Was okay, the last minute was when the class went asynchronous. The material wasn't hard. I only read the textbook and I didn't watch the lectures, I did perfectly fine without them. The final was a group project, and you better hope you get a good group, mine wasn't good. But overall the class is okay.

DO NOT RUN AN ONLINE CLASS IF YOU REFUSE TO ANSWER EMAILS. How are we supposed to communicate anything to you when we don't see you in person, and completely disregard any emails sent. It was extremely frustrating.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Instructor Norris is incredible! She truly cares about her students and also what she's teaching. She is a speech-language pathologist so she knows what it's like to work in healthcare. I learned a lot in this class and never felt stressed about my grade.

One of my easiest classes as there are no exams and all the quizzes are taken online outside of class and open book. Very lenient on due dates and doesn't make you do unnecessary assignments that have nothing to do with the content you need for the quizzes. She truly cares about not making students' lives harder and definitely recommend her!

She was very understanding and cared about everyone's success. She gives opportunities for extra credit often, and understands that everyone learns at a different pace. Couldn't say enough nice things about her.
This professor was very nice and I definitely recommend taking her section of the course! Very respectful and caring.

Professor Norris cares a lot about her students, and she is very understanding when it comes to assignments. This class consists of a few quizzes which are all taken online, outside of class. I highly recommend taking her class for CHS150. You will need the textbook to succeed on the open note quizzes and in the class.
Love her!! I had her for CHS 150 and she was amazing. Super understanding and not much homework. Quizzes are done outside of class and she often gives notes and study guides. Take her classes!!
She is kind but lacked organization, so any due dates were pretty tentative. She's really flexible if you have stuff come up. I would take her again.
She is a super sweet professor who is completely honest with us all. She genuinly wants to grow as a teacher. She is super understanding and actually cares about her students. Love her.

Boy, do I have my thoughts on this class, and I wish the 350-character limit didn't exist. In short, the workload is insane and is a bad port of the in-person class. Online students do endless writing, while others just have discussions. Canvas is a mess of hyperlinks.  Grading is the worst because you will wait two months for feedback. AVOID.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: WRD 204 is a joke of a class especially if you're an engineer. But this profesddor takes it to a whole new level. There is an essay due ervery month and there are 2 large essays you have to write later on that are like 10 pages minimum. Do not take this guys class he makes the assignments way too hard for absolutley no reason

Mr. Heverin is very confusing during lectures and creating his assignments. They are very time-consuming, and you will find that you spend much more time than you anticipated on his lengthy assignments. It's unfortunate that class is mandatory because it is a waste of time.

Worst professor I've taken to date. Assigns so many things throughout the week and the prompts for the biweekly projects are 6 pages long. Horrible professor and expects you to know as much as him. Expects you to read so much before class and will give a quiz if he feels like some students don't read. Overall just horrible and do not take.

Heverin is smart, skilled, cunning, + more from a human level. The question I'll pose is why has he been shoehorned into teaching Eng students who don't even want to be in the class. It's not that he's a bad person or professor, rather, he's teaching the wrong crowd. Let him flourish with his kind, not STEM students. Hard grader, high expectations!

Don't take his classes. The canvas page makes absolutely no sense along with all the long assignments with different details that never describe what should actually be submitted. Also don't be suprised if you never hear from him through email (even the one he tells you to use). Avoid him at all costs.

This professor is extremely passionate—almost too much. He assigns multiple confusing assignments daily, and his Canvas page is chaotic. While he offers extensions with small penalties, it's likely because most students were struggling. Would not recommend unless you're okay with wasting your time. It truly was a disappointment to take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: The workload is completely ridiculous. I took this course my junior year second semester as a mechanical engineering major, and I had more homework in this 200 level course than my 300 level courses for my major. Also each rubric for the homework's is multiple pages long and unclear. The canvas page is a mess. Avoid this dork at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Heverin was extremely confusing. He assigns work every day with instructions that are long, vague, and unclear. No one in class knew what we were supposed to do, and the group assignments went nowhere. His Canvas page is messy and hard to navigate, and nothing seems to connect. Would not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr Ambrose in many ways can seem unfair in the beggining of you haven't been truly challenged academically. However, I believe this comes from the principles he holds surrounding education. And some of these can work to your advantage. For example Dr Ambrose expects true conceptual understanding. And if you if you demonstrate this. It is noticed.

He is not clear and only points at a PowerPoint for his lecture and doesn't clearly walk through his problems or notes. It is tough to understand him in lectures. Lastly, you have a cap on how many practice exams you can take, and there are 4 midterms and a final instead of 3.

Lectures were not good, and the recitation had nothing to do with what you're being tested on. The tests, as well, were very hard and seemed as if you didn't do any of that content. HOWEVER, use all the mock tests he gives out, as they are identical to the tests he gives out. I basically relied on independent study for this class.
There's 5 exams you have to take. The exams are 18 questions and extremely difficult. The class average on exams are around 50%. If you are not good with exams then you will fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Dr. Seo is 100% an underrated professor. It seems like he has changed his syllabus a lot from the past, so a lot of these past reviews on here are out of date.
I really recommend taking Ambrose if you didn't take AP Physics in high school. His lectures are very concept heavy, and his homework and mock exams are EXTREMELY helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Avoid this class at all cost! Especially if you commute. Attendance is MANDATORY, I am having to drop the class because I have received an automatic E due to the attendance policy. (4 unexcused absences you fail) The professor will only accept medical documentation as a valid excuse.

Professor Seo got a lot of hate last semester and has changed his ways. He is a good teacher and his mock exams are really helpful. If you do them multiple times you will do good on the test! Also he gives 1 homework assignment a week which is pretty good.

Unless you have a solid foundation of physics and can teach yourself steer clear of this professor.
no homework, in a course this difficult with no physics prior backfires on you. Inaccessible for most of the week except a 1 day of 1 hour for office hours. EXAM HEAVY, if you don't test well, you will fail. Reviews are nothing like the exams. AVOID
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Seo is caring and wants students to succeed, but PHY 231 was disorganized. Although succeeding in AP Physics previously, lectures were unhelpful, and I learned all new material outside class. There's no homework, so exams heavily determine your grade, but study guides mirror exams. Very iclicker heavy as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Seo is a good professor that wants his students to understand the topics. His lectures are good with plenty of demonstrations. No homework so you have to commit time outside of class to understand everything. This is not a course you can expect to cruise through. Exams are hard and there is no padding for your grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Certainly on the higher end of difficulty for PHY231. Doesn't give out homework so utilize the textbook as a practice tool. Biggest drawback would be the 4 midterm exams being 20 questions in only 50 minutes, as well as recitations not being helpful enough to prepare. Regardless, not the worst section, and perhaps one of the most rewarding ones.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Seo gets dragged too much on here. He holds students to a higher degree than other professors, but for good reason. The class is hard, but you will certainly walk out knowing more than other classes. Talk to him about results after every exam, you can usually get points back. He isn't the easy route, but you will be better for taking his class.

Absolutely horrible class do not take Dr. Seo for PHY231. I've taken high school level AP Physics A, so I have a decent amount of conceptual knowledge on physics. Dr. Seo was terrible at explaining lecture topics and applying them to practice problems, commonly getting them wrong himself. Also extremely test heavy, if you fail a test you're done
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: IVE NEVER WANTED MORE HOMEWORK BEFORE I TOOK THIS CLASS. All of your grade is his exams. You only get the study guide a WEEK before the exam. He doesn't curve either. His exam averages are horrible. I wish he'd give us homework. Get ready to lock in very last minute ALL THE TIME because there's no study material except for his study guides.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Seo doesn't provide any sort of supplemental content beyond minimal study guides, so it's extremely difficult to effectively review the content.

This section of PHY231 was deliberately more difficult than other sections, with study material not being consistent, and exams being too long for the time alotted. Dr. Seo does not make an attempt to ease difficulty, and instead wanted to push the class farther than it needed to go. Terrible experience, please dont take him.

Please don't take him. You won't learn anything, and you will fail his exams. All he gives are study guides, no hw, but study guides are helpful at all, you will be wasting your time doing them and have expectations for the exam, but it will turn out to be way harder, and less time and more free response. Really hard, don't make my mistake

Dr. Seo is a respectful professor. However, his lectures are often irrelevant for exam material. He leans towards the conceptual physics side, struggling on applying formulas and often incorrect during lecture. Exams were extremely difficult. Class averages were always D's, and he never curved. Try to find another professor if you take PHY231.

Commonly makes mistakes during lectures so if the professor is getting his own math wrong is gives you no hope for when you do. The average on most of the tests was below 50 and there was never a passing average.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Seo was consistently behind on lessons all semester long. We will not complete the content on time but will still be expected to answer questions about it on the final. He also did not present materials clearly in my opinion. Your only grades in class are from iClicker, recitation worksheets, and exams, so hope that you understand the content.

After having taken the grad mechanics course, I can say that Dr. Seo's 404 course does not prepare you for higher level mechanics. Many of the important topics like Lagrangians and moments of inertia are not very thoroughly discussed, and the textbook/lectures are lacking in quality. Dr. Seo also writes very poor letters of rec; avoid that.

Do yourself a favor and never...EVER take this guy for PHY 231. He can't explain concepts in a way that make sense to save his life. You never see exam-like questions worked out completely. And oh yeah, the exams are awful. Take someone else's 231 and if none are available go ahead and wait until the next semester.

His lectures are so unhelpful, and he tends to question himself with his own slides and asks the class if he is right. No homework which means no way to build up your skills and learn unless you do it yourself. Whenever he goes over exam problems, he sets it up halfway then says you do the rest i don't want to do math. Nice guy but can't teach.

He is not a bad person, but the setup of his class is really bad. The exams are hard to complete in 50 mins he doesn't even make all of them multiple choice. In 20 questions, half of them are free response, the other half is multiple choice. I couldn't get through all questions, plus the questions are hard and most are not even in the study guide.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor doesn't know how to teach he makes us come to lectures but theres no learning. Textbook readings do not help at all. It is all a waste of time. Study guides are so long and not helpful as the questions dont really match up plus they are just too long. destroys my sleep as I work on study guides all night long, but it isn't so useful

Worst professor you could ever take. Lectures are mandatory for iClicker but teach nothing useful for the exam. Textbook adds nothing, and his long timetaking study guides are often irrelevant since every student gets different exam questions only if student gets lucky the questions will match which is very rare. Do not take him at all!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He doesn't give homework like other lecturers; instead, it significantly impacts your grade, as attendance is tracked through iClicker, and it doesn't help at all. Has 20-question tests, while other lectures have 10, doesn't go over examples, and barely goes over content. Recitation worksheets don't go over stuff you learned in lecture that week.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: His class is much harder than the other lectures. We had 50 mins to do 20 questions while the other sections had 12 questions max. Also, the percent threshold for an A is 88% for him, but it was 85% for other. Be ready to memorize the study guides and iClicker questions. He is really nice though. Not worth it though, take a different lecture.

reviews.comment: His class compared to the other classes in the department is much harder. We had 50 minutes to do 20 questions while the other sections had only 12 max. The percent for an A is 88% for us, but it is 85% for the other lectures. Didn't explain concepts well. Be ready to memorize the study guides and iClicker. He is nice though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very difficult class, not much is ever gained from lecture. Exams are very difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Seo's 361 is relatively easy, but you must be present and prepared. Dr. Seo has a history of grading similar or identical answers inconsistently and not offering promised partial credit. If you know you will miss one of his exams with an academic letter of excuse, he refuses to offer exam makeups, so be prepared to do well in other areas.

Dr. Seo is a good prof. and amazing person, he really wants to see you succeed. Topics in 361 are difficult, and his exams are all free response with questions that are usually harder than the hw and account for 74% of your final grade. My best advice is go to class, use the textbook (it's the best I have ever read), and work with peers.

This is a hard class and the professor did not help. His practice exams were not similar to tests and he was not willing to meet up outside of class time with students. Told his class that he was too busy to make a practice test one time.

Practice tests he gave were nothing like the actual tests. He made this class harder than it needed to be. Didn't explain clearly and made concepts confusing. Very little review. I did not learn much. Funny guy with good demonstrations and kind heart but he made the class harder than it should have been. Don't recommend .

Physics isnt easy and Dr Seos class was a challenge for me. For his exams, both understanding the concepts and being able to do the math are important, which trips up a bunch of students. Problems from both lecture notes and homework sets were on exams, which sometimes felt difficult. I am not good at physics but with a lot of work I managed a B.

Very likable guy. You'll love his demonstrations. No excuse to not at least get a C if you pay attention and do the practice tests. My only gripe is there was maybe a little too much use of clicker questions but I will say they were the most challenging part of class.
Nice guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Class was extremely easy. Basically gives you the test before hand. Almost entirely math problems. A little critical thinking needed but not much. Didn't learn much material but learned how to solve specific math problems. Barely understood a word he said. However, great demonstrations and he was a nice guy.
He seems pretty confusing in class but the way the grading works out you can easily pull off a high grade. I think 90% of the class got B's and higher. Definitely recommend.

Friendly and funny guy, great teacher. The grading scale is better than most at reflecting how much work you put into the class. (I was overconfident and didn't study much at first, but it's surprisingly easy to recover). I heard Dr. Seo will no longer be teaching (231 at least) - he will certainly be missed.

Great teacher! He may not be the best at explaining things but he is one of the nicest, most generous professor I've had. The grading scale is very generous and he makes class extremely fun. He is very funny and can make light of any situation. He really cares about how we do in class and would do anything to help someone!

What i would consider an exceptionally easy A, he spends ample time covering the material and includes a detailed equation sheet for each test. I went to his office hours several times and he stayed and answered all of my questions until i was finished, often for several hours. There is also a generous curve built into the initial grading scale.
His slides are really useful,and he can explain it clearly to students as a second language spearker. Exam questions mostly come from his slides.

Ambrose is a very good teacher. He cares about how we do on our exams and really wants us to succeed. Each class he uses every second so that we can get as much information as possible. He speaks english clearly for it being his second language. If he were to teach again as an actual instructor or recitation instructor, I would take his class.

Dr. Edwards gives helpful feedback, responds to emails quickly, and is clear about how assignments will be graded. This class was organized fairly well as an online class. She provides PDFs for any readings from the textbooks.
The professor was easy to understand. The assignments are well-structured and easy to understand. If you actually take your time to do your assignment, this is an easy class to pass with an A.
did not like the attitude. very highschool like
Super nice and really easy. If you do the work in general you will pass this class

the readings do matter as you will have quizzes over them every so often, she's a very chill and understanding teacher, she gives great feedback and overall has helped improve my writing in different ways. Some of the assignments may be a bit more demanding but she will try to ensure that you will get the grade you want, overall awesome.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Easy class, she is extremely flexible with students and understanding. We often got out of class early. Easy grader
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Edwards is an exceptional professor, who demonstrates deep knowledge of communication studies and a genuine commitment to student success. She provides thorough, constructive feedback, communicates clearly, and fosters an engaging, supportive learning environment that encourages growth and critical understanding.

America truly cares about her students and genuinely wants you to succeed! Always willing to answer questions or help if you are having a tough time. I would strongly recommend taking her for a class. She is passionate about what she does and is a fun professor :)
Dr. Edwards went above and beyond to help me out if I was confused and offered opportunities for us to revise our assignments. I learned a lot and wish she taught 111
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I would recommend literally any other professor because this should be an easy 'A' class, but she runs it like the navy. If you simply breathe wrong, you will get accused of AI.
Gave me three rounds of feedback on a paper, I adjusted based on every single piece of feedback and still recieved a C on the assignment that had taken me two full weeks to do.
Best professor ever! She is so kind and helpful. Usually, I'm not excited about going to class, but she makes it exciting.
Maybe the best professor at this university. Absolute angel sent from Heaven

Honestly loved her. She is very understanding, will help you out and answer any questions, and responds quickly to emails. Attendance is mandatory, if you don't show up you will fall behind and do poorly on quizzes. If you do well on the quizzes and have a B or higher, you can skip the final.

Professor Green was the best teacher I have ever had. She was clear with her instructions and answered any question that anyone had at any time. The class was simple with quizzes every Wednesday so if you go to the quizzes and do all the homework which is online with unlimited attempts, you are almost guaranteed an A.
Loved her best teacher ever

Mrs. Green was one of the best math teachers I ever had, and I severely struggle in math. Her teaching style is very helpful, and she is happy to answer any confusion on homework questions over email. Very fair grading, and she will help you if you're struggling.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The best professor I've ever had

One of the best professors i've had at UK. She truly cares about her students and explains the material in several different ways to ensure that everyone with different learning styles understand. No tests, just a quiz every week. Attend class and do homework to help cushion grade if math isnt your strong suit. People that attended class did well.

Such an easy A!! I got a 101 in the class, because I got bonus points and things too. Go to class and pay attention, simple stuff she is such a good teacher. I didn't even take the final because she drops the lowest test and quiz grades.
Prof Green is great! She cares about her students and will do everything she can so that you can succeed . I took her for MA 109 but I would recommend her for any MA course!

Ms. Green is a wonderful professor, she really cares about the well being of the student's grade. If you struggle with math, I would certainly advice taking Ms. Green for MA 109, her lecture notes are well written and she takes the time to really explain if you do not understand. Very kind and Caring person.
The best teacher ever. So funny and makes you feel like youre 10. Math 111 so easy

She is so sweet! She really cares about your grades and will do anything to make sure you're learning the material. She gives partial credit on a lot of things, which is nice. She drops the lowest mini-exam (kind of like a pre-test) and lowest exam grade, and if you are happy with the first three exams, she doesn't make you attend the final.

Love her! Sweetest professor I have had so far! She really cares about her students and it shows. She is also very good with making the material understandable but giving detailed notes. As long as you take notes in her class and study for the mini exams and regular exams you will do great! She's awesome!!

I love love Amy Green! One of the best teachers for math (better than teachers in high school) I'm not that great at math and was worried to even take this class. Amy has been amazing at teaching and you still get what's going on even if you miss a day. I'm happy I took her class.

She was my favorite professor, her lectures are easy to follow and the homework  and tests correlate. She's funny, really cares about her students, very nice, and adapts the class to suit the students. Attendance is expected but extra credit is offered for participation and the tests aren't that hard. I would highly recommend! I loved her class!

This was a very easy class. The content is not what you would expect. Mrs. Green is very caring and a very easy grader. She gives you partial credit for a lot and a lot of time you can get points back for things you missed. There is a sign in sheet and you take a lot of notes so come to class. the class is very doable and she is always very helpful

Dr. Slone is a sweet lady, just a very, VERY harsh grader. I have received multiple grades, .5% or 1% off from a perfect score. I had her for CIS112; she is super easy to reach and gives very kind feedback, but her grading is really the only annoying thing.

She's a nice teacher, but my only complaint is that she grades very harshly. She doesn't seem to believe in giving perfect scores and often takes off points even when you follow everything outlined in the rubric.

Hardest grader I've had, but for a such a low stakes course. You could spend hours making sure an assignment is perfect and she will nitpick it and make sure you don't get 100. Also very boring lectures and holds you right to the end of class every single time. Attendance is also taken for a grade. Avoid if possible.

She seems like a nice person and enjoys what she teaches.  Her grading is extraordinarily harsh and seems to want to find any way to deduct points. It also seems like she relies on AI for at least a portion of her grading. This creates an environment that makes it feel like no matter how much time and work you put in it's still not enough.

Professor Slone is a great person outside of class. But here's the catch, she is one of the WORST graders on the planet. She is such a tough grader, even when the paper is perfect to the rubric. Her lectures are also boring and only one or two people actually care. The paper she assigns is worth 285 points and is worth 30% of the grade. Good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Slone is a good person, but she consistently gives B's out to many people in the class an 88 to be particular. I knew 5 people who would get 88s on everything in her class. weird.

Professor Slone was a nice lady, and you could tell she really enjoyed what she teaches. Though her lectures are a bit boring, you still learn good information from her. She is definitely the hardest grader i've ever had and it is surprising because it is such a low stakes course. Don't expect to get 100% on any assignment because you won't.

I liked her but she is a VERY hard grader. The assignments are not hard however she will NEVER give you a 100% on anything. The rubrics are not very clear what she is looking for either. Other than that I would take her again, the lectures aren't bad at all. I definitely had to work for my A in this class so take your time with assignments!
This class is an easy A but she makes it impossible with her grading scale. Take anyone but her.

Amanda Slone is the most critical grader I have had in college. She is one of those professors that likes to find problems with every assignment you turn in, even if its perfect. I also suspect she uses AI grading which makes it much harder to get a “perfect score”.If you are going to take CIS300 please take anyone but her!

This professor was a notoriously harsh grader, giving disproportionately low marks for even small mistakes, which felt out of line with the low-stakes nature of the class. Given the minimal weight of the assignments, it was frustrating to see such rigid grading standards, choose another professor if possible!!!!!
shows care for her students and works with them to get through issues or any difficulties. course work was very evenly assigned and not too overbearing.

I loved Ms. Slone she was great and always let my class out early especially on Fridays! We never had a test in class but had 4 quizzes that we could take online. I usually hate english, but this class wasnt bad at all!
Super easy class. Gives lots of extra points and is very flexible with exams and hw

Amanda is one of the best professors I've ever had, and she made the class so incredibly easy. I made a high a in every exam and each lecture helped me better understand the material. She gives a lot of practice assignments and tests and is always accessible outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: There are no cell phones and laptops in class, but if you finish early, a lot of times you just have to wait and be bored until she finally lets you go. She seems to genuinely care and want us to learn, but a lot of her methods of teaching seem very middle school. Exams are easy. Go to class. (even though it's boring)

Best STA210 professor.  Very clear, very helpful, fun, goofy, and easy.  You have to try to not get an A in this class.  Extra credit on exams is either something she said she would make extra credit or something goofy that gives you points on how much she laughed.
Amanda is the best! From what I've heard she's much better than the other professors. All of the material was easily understood (if you go to class).

Legit, best professor I have ever had!!!  She is super hilarious and will help you with anything you're not understanding or not for sure on.  She is there for you and I 100% say that you should take her for STA 210 or any other class she teaches.  SHES THE BEST!!!!!!!
Amanda was super awesome. She is very clear about everything and helpful when you need it. She responds to emails quickly and made my stats struggle a lot easier.

Amanda was awesome. She was very helpful and very nice. Her presentation of the material was clear and her exams were exactly what she said they would be. She gives lots of opportunities for extra credit. She makes the recitation portion very interesting and fun. Gives out candy sometimes. I highly recommend her if you're taking intro stats.
Dr. Martin doesn't seem as an expert in this field that I would look up to. Teaching is very mechanical. I would not recommend taking his course or seeking him as a mentor

I enrolled in Dr. Martin's class based on positive reviews but was disappointed by the inconsistent grading and slow turnaround times. Despite using the same study methods, I scored an A on one exam and a C on the next. Additionally, he took a long time to return grades, adding to the frustration. I recommend avoiding his class.

Never came to class. Half of the class was taught by TA's. His exams were graded moderately harshly, but because you have to teach yourself all the content expect to mess up on every single exam. Grading is ridiculously inconsistent. An 80 and an 100 essentially mean the same thing. No clear grading scale at all. Do practice problems and read book.

His grading is inconsistent on exams. Chooses to grade certain things harsher than other. Little mistakes will screw you on exams. Won't show up to class sometimes and have a TA teach and you will have no idea when/why he is gone. Handwriting is barely legible so make sure you're in the front of the class. Goes straight  from textbook so read it.

Clearly way too invested in his research to care about lower-level engineering courses. Took this due to the positive reviews, shouldn't have wasted my time. He is inaccessible out of class, weights exams as 90% of the grades, and is somewhat disrespectful to his students. Look elsewhere if you can.

I took this course with Martin after all of the positive reviews. Safe to say, time changed his instructing methods tremendously. His lectures and review sessions were not helpful, and I often found better education from his TAs and online resources. Exams are worth over 90% of the grade, and there's only three. WOULD NOT TAKE
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Love this guy, he managed to make a tough class not only tolerable but very interesting. If he's an option for a class you'd be hurting yourself by not taking him. It's a shame he does research for the most part and doesn't often teach classes.
Beware this is the first "true" hard class. 95% of grade is exams, but Dr. Martin is an AMAZING teacher. The lectures are amazing, and I learned so much in this class.

Absolutely loved Dr. Martin for both undergrad fluids (ME 330) and gas dynamics (ME 530). Funny and really wants to see his students succeed.  Also, he works on very cool research projects (re-entry spacecraft) and encourages his students to participate in learning outside of class through research and seminars.  TAKE DR MARTIN IF YOU CAN!!!!!!

Professor Martin is one of the best professors I've had in Mechanical Engineering. Tough class, but lectures are great, and if you do his homework and actually understand it, his exams should be very simple. He seemed like a nightmare to hav before I actually took his class, but really if you put in the work and aren't lazy, you'll love his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: One of the hardest classes in ME at UK. Because the material is so challenging, lectures can be hard to follow sometimes. Dr. Martin is always willing to help students outside of class and is a really friendly guy once you get to know him a little. Tests contain "built in" extra credit, ex: final had 800 points possible, but % was based on 700 pts

Great professor.  NOT easy, but you will learn your the material.  He forces you to learn how to do things symbolically, which forces understanding of the topic at hand.  He is also always willing to meet during office hours and will spend however much one-on-one time with you as necessary for you to understand what's going on.

Great explanations of concepts, but definitely challenges his students. Forces you to actually learn and understand the topics. Always ready to help if you approach him with problems, and will spend the one-on-one time with you to help you understand if you need it
He makes the exams way to long and actually tells you that you wont have enough time to finish them. Horrible lecturer. All the class work and exams are symbolic, as in no calculators or numbers.
Hard grader. Exam was hard and home work can also be challenging. Communicating with professors is challenging. The online section is not the easier option for this course.

The whole class is out of 100 points. Each of the three tests is worth 15 points, totaling 45% of your grade. Each test is 8 questions long. It's not fun when you do the math. Almost all the questions are those weird checkbox ones too. If you have the option to do the study abroad class instead, spend the 3 grand and enjoy your vacation.
AN 300 is not a fun class. Not even much of a reflection on Professor Post the material is just dense. You have to take it and this is the only section so just make the best of it.
I'll echo everyone simply and say, try to avoid it if possible. Bad class and teacher, simple as that.
Not a very useful class

Had an issue with the first exam, reached out for help, and she basically told me that my issue was my fault and that I never paid any attention to/cheated on any of the previous assignments- which is completely false. Any time I tried to speak in our Zoom call, she completely interrupted me and never let me finish. 0/10
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took her as an online class and her instructions for assignments were extremely vague and I was practically had to figure out the class by myself. She should not be an instructor or she should at least be more thoughtful towards her students.

Such a useless class. The assignments are extremely long and difficult and count for a large portion of your grade. The software is very hard to learn and takes hours for one assignment. Do not take this class if it is not required.

The worst part about her class is that it's based off a 100 point scale so if you don't do your work/actually know the info for the exams it's easy to quickly lose an A. Im assuming people rate her so poorly because the software she uses makes it impossible to cheat so their grade quickly drops on exams. Just keep up in the class and you'll be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Shouldn't have a job, should work at mcdonalds

Don't let people on here scare you Post is not that bad. JMP and Tableau assignments can be a little intimidating. The majority of my class got an A or B tho.She gives a lot of credit for homework, open book quiz's and extra credit. She is actually a very nice person and will help you if you need it. Just don't be lazy this isn't rocket science.

Omg. Save yourself and do not take this class. It is the BIGGEST waste of time and energy. Can't name a thing I learned in lecture. ALL assignments are based on how to use a software with tutorial videos that are extremely confusing. The grading is super tough. Even the practice exams are graded and there's only 2 attempts… just don't.

It was an awful experience. I would not have taken this class if it were not required. The whole class is out of 100 points, which means every assignment has a very heavy weight on your overall grade. It gives extra credit but does not affect your grade much.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst class I have had. The assignments are based upon tutorials that are given via videos. The professor uses outdated videos on past assignments to show how to do new assignments that involve data manipulation and code. I was in computer science before this class. This class is poorly structured. Avoid this class at all costs. It is very bad.

I HATE THIS CLASS!!! she has set up this class very poorly and it has to be the worst class I have taken in the 3 years that I have been here. I would have rather taken the 8 am course for this class then ever have her as my teacher.
Literally a waste of time class. JMP Pro is outdated, people use excel. Instructions are unclear. Wouldn't take if it wasn't required.

This professor is one of the worst I have ever had here at this university. Unfortunately, she is the only one who teaches this required course. The entire class is out of 100 points so everything is very heavily weighted. This course is designed for failure and is extremely challenging to succeed in.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Anita puts little effort into her course. She is hardly accessible and assigns a massive amount of work relative to the amount of instruction she provides. Her assignments all count for massive amounts of the grade. The grading structure provides little room for improvement. She conducts research, so it is clear that her priorities are elsewhere.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Exams are all that matters. If you are familiar with Data programs, it'll be a breeze it's just basic functions. The teacher helps all she can for it being online, just up to you whether you want to use the resources she provides.  She gives extra credit, but not much.

I wouldn't recommend this class unless it's required, as it was for me. The entire course is graded out of 100 points, so even small mistakes, like a 1.5/3 on homework, can significantly impact your grade. Notes don't align well with homework; even with open notes, test answers aren't guaranteed correct. Designed for failure.
Choose a different teacher if you need to take this course. Took online and the class was horrible and extremely hard.

This class is designed to fail. The entire class is out of 100 points, so missing anything has a direct affect on your grade. The exams are heavily weighted on definition based questions that are multiple select. No extra credit opportunities, it is like she wants students to struggle. Terrible professor, do not take this class if you can help it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The entire semester is graded off a total of 100 points. So when you have 2-3 assignments every week they all impact your grade. Also, if you don't round a decimal the way she wants for that week, she will not give you points for having the correct answer because "it's important to learn". She's a joke, try getting another professor if possible.
Bro it's the first day and I'm struggling on this syllabus quiz

Her AN 300 class was incredibly test heavy. If you did not do well on the exams, then it was difficult to pass the class with a decent grade. The homeworks take an hour and a half on average and there was three homework assignments a week (which I believed to be extensive for this course). The class was hard to follow as the lectures are not great.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is so horrible. I think this is the hardest class I have ever taken. I watch the lectures, try on the quizzes, and it is still impossible. I didn't even get a 100 on the SYLLABUS QUIZ. Not to mention that the class only adds up to 100 points so if you think that it's okay to just get that 4.8/5 DO NOT SETTLE. EVERY POINT COUNTS FRL FRL.
Hard course, but if you watch the lecture videos and take notes you'll be fine. Also take advantage of the cheat sheet allowed for the first half of the exam.

Get in the Group Me for this class. Only way you can survive it without having a mental breakdown. Super boring videos for lectures. The exams are in two parts. The first part is monitored on respondus and is definition based. The second isn't monitored, but you must use JMP Pro for the questions. It's just overall a horrible class.
So much work. Only way to get through this class was to have the videos playing at the same time as the quizzes and even then it was still extremely difficult.
This is the hardest class at the University of Kentucky you will take! It is only worth 100 points so if you miss 1 point you're already down to a 99. The biggest weight is exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She uses out-of-date software which most likely could be used instead like we do in the pre-req for this course. The class itself isn't bad the topics are somewhat interesting but she ruins it with the lectures being short and very undetailed. Tests matter way more than they should. Take her in person so that you can physically reach her.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Most lecture videos are no longer than 5 minutes. This course really requires a lot of time and effort to fully understand the concepts. All of the assignments add up to 100 points. There are 2-3 homework assignments due weekly, practice exams count toward/against your grade, and exams can be vague. There are of multiple selection answer questions!

I'd tell you not to take this class from Anita but she's the only AN prof at UK so we don't have a choice. 3 HWs a week worth like 1-2 pts. Practice exams are graded on accuracy and worth half the pts of real exam. Lectures are miserable to watch. Her syllabus quiz was harder than some exams I've taken. Alex from the BA lab should teach it instead.

Quiz and Exam questions are extremely vague and overly detailed. JMP was very tedious to use as some of the lectures are outdated and do not correlate with the current software.
Its not an easy class, but its also not rocket surgery. Its fun to learn about, just be ready to study and practice. Put in the effort and you'll be fine.

Was very difficult to understand during the lectures. Quiz and exam questions were very vague and did not contribute to learning the material. The software was very confusing and annoying, and the tutorial videos (while great to understand by Paul) were out of date, and we at one point were forced to download another version.

The only reason I think I will get a B in this class is because you get a cheat sheet for the exams. HW questions are vague and difficult. There are practice exams worth almost half what the actual exams are. I aced the first exam but the practice one tanked my grade. I no longer have any interest in analytics.

Class overall is beyond boring and just sucks. Prof uses a software that makes Excel look like Disney World. She tests on definitions that are so tedious that it makes learning boring. Exams are brutal, best prepare to study for a while. Uses pre recorded videos that are outdated and stale like a piece of cardboard. It makes you despise analytics

Buckle up. At this point having a B would be a MIRACLE. You get two chances to do the homework, and sometimes I still can't even get 100% on those, let alone the exams. You will have to teach yourself a lot, and the lectures don't seem to always cover what you need to know. Your grade is about 45% based on your exam score.

Horrible class structure and professor. Tons of homework. Exams and homeworks are difficult, tons of check all that apply questions and you get it partially wrong. Pre recorded lecture videos are outdated and do not translate well into your actual homework. Please stop grading and teaching the way you do. This is coming from a 4.0 GPA student......

Material isn't hard, but you have to actually work hard which I guess is hard for most business students. The class is a grind, but you can get an A if you try. She just doesn't seem to be happy, and she's the only option. Disappointing considering the efforts to build a strong analytics program, she probably is the reason many aren't pursuing it.

Kentucky really needs to find someone else to teach analytics. Post was very difficult to understand. This made learning online very difficult. The vocabulary portions of HW/tests were overly specific and way too hard. The JMP stuff was easy to learn because Paul Childers was the one giving the lectures on JMP. Terrible experience.

I took this class asynchronous and she gives you many short lecture videos to watch and then take quizzes on each section of videos. She is pretty hard to understand in speaking but if you just read the slides answering the quiz questions is fine. 3 exams and each has a mandatory practice that is graded on accuracy. Follow along and youll be fine.

It's almost as if she hates teaching this class and hates her students... From a teaching standpoint do not expect to learn anything from the professor. However the class is more than attainable to pass just stay on pace as there are 3 homework quizzes every week but other professors will show up on the video lectures and make it easy to understand

I have never in my life have had to stress over a class like I did for this class. The lectures were online and it really did not help you learn as much. Although I barely scraped by with an A, it was so much more difficult than I thought. The professor could've been more friendly with her students...
One of the worst professors/classes I've taken at UK. AN300 sucks and this professor has no regard for students or their success.

Worst class I've ever taken. It's fully online with no in-person classes, no zooms, no videos that actually help. The JMP program is impossible to understand without someone actually teaching you. It's obvious that this professor is too lazy to teach a class that people are failing. Sadly she is the only one that teaches analytics at UK.
This was just awful. I will never take her again for a business class, and I recommend anyone else to avoid taking this professor at all costs.

Literally Anita is the worst professor I have ever had. She changed our exam requirements on week 11 and made it to where it was almost impossible to get an A. I have taken three courses for excel and two based on tableau. I am very good with these softwares, JMP isn't a difficult software. But 60 min for 4 different analysis + 6 randoms is insane.
the lecture videos and the homework have a disconnect so you end up having to teach yourself about half of the course.

This class was basically just trying to remember to do the assignments on time and getting 100's on the homework. It was pretty simple, you use the notes for one hw assignment and then follow the videos with JMP Pro. you get a cheat sheet on the proctored portion of the test. JMP portion is hard & time consuming.

Impossible to learn from the vids provided (no live lectures or any prof help - it's all prerecorded), don't explain the WHY of anything just the buttons to push - use YouTube + Quizlet to scrape by. Outdated difficult software. 1pg cheat sheet on exams makes the proctored part easier, but the application part is confusing and nearly impossible :((
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class wasn't the worst thing in the world. It took a lot of studying and teaching myself as well as learning with friends to be successful. Don't let the reviews scare you, you can get an A in this class, just work hard for it! I would also go to the BA lab for help before going to Anita.

All the rumors are true but you can survive if you have a good TA

Probably one of the worst professors on the UK campus. As long as you are a STEM or Science major, you will sadly take one of her courses. She might not physically instruct but trust me she is definitely behind the screen since she is director after all, I believe. The TAs work for her, meaning she MAY grade your assignments. Be aware!
Don't try to see her in person, she is never available.

The largest problem, out of many, is how exams are done in this class. There are two exams worth a significant portion of your grade. Both of which do not have much to do with the goals of a laboratory class. Questions are very particular, often requiring memorization of specific topics. Labs are about note-taking and technical writing, not this.

reviews.comment: bad
Such an unnecessarily stressful class. Cannot believe it was only one credit hour. Just hope you get a good TA because you never interact with Dr. French.

Yes, this class is as bad as everyone says. Your experience is fully dependent on your TA, so pray that you get a good one. There is no consistency in lab reports grades, and this class has an excessive amount of homework. The labs themselves aren't bad, but everything else for this class is made intentionally difficult without help from Dr. French

I do not have the words to describe how awful taking a class led by Dr. French is. She is the reason the chem department at UK is one of the most disliked departments. Whatever you do, if you have to take a chem lab her TAs will be in charge of it. The University population here does not deserve to deal with this display of chemistry education.

Objectively speaking, Dr. French is one of the worst professors I have had. Your lab experience is largely dependent on your TA, which for me was not great. You are essentially thrown to the wolves on day one in this class. The criteria for lab reports can be vague and your TA can grade exceptionally hard or inconsistent. Good luck to all

I do not think I have been in a class where a professor cares about their students any less. An 'A' in this course is a 92.5% or above, but throughout the year, the grades on Canvas are locked from students. You can perform well the entire semester, but the final exam, that tests you on the most SPECIFIC questions can make or break your grade.

Mandatory attendance, she’s never actually present bc she’s just the director. You cant read her mind? Well good luck finding out the minute details she grades on. She’s a tenured professor but that doesn’t change the fact that’s she’s a senile old hag. I’m sorry for anyone that is required to take this class

reviews.comment: This class is entirely dependent on the TA you get. Fortunately I got a TA that was constructive and genuinely improved my academic writing abilities. reviews.comment: The amount of stories I have heard about Dr. French and still decided to take a class with her because there was no other option for gen chem labs was horrible. If you get Alex as your TA, you are all set because he is awesome.
Uncaring Professor. Very rude and does not try to see other people's points of view. You will fail if you do not go. Horrible for disabled people. Tries to make things harder than they have to be.

reviews.comment: Doesnt let you see your alive talk grade in canvas and everything is due by 5pm like who does that. Her whole class is taught by TAs with god complexes who dont help and grade harshly

April French is condescending and rude. She delegates everything to TA's so you can never actually talk to her if you have any problems. Absolutely never take her class if you can avoid it she is awful. I will NEVER take her class again, worst class I've ever taken.

reviews.comment: she never helps
