reviews.comment:
Do you like being belittled and talked down to??!! If yes, I strongly recommend taking Dr. A's class! 

Not a good teacher, doesn't answer emails, and if she does, she's extremely nasty. Pretty sure the only three positive reviews were from her two kids (which she spends more time talking about than class material) and her husband.

SHE DOES NOT CARE ABOUT HER STUDENTS. If you are planning on taking her for FINANCE 300 online, do not. She will belittle and talk down to you during office hours, if she even shows up. The lectures are not even her videos, and the homework is nothing like the exams! goodluck!!!!
THE WORST PROFESSOR EVER i dont know hows shes employed. Your only grade for online finance is exams and she does nothing to teach the class u only watch videos of Professor Trager.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor. Strict on due dates and assignments due each week. It helps at the end because if you do them, they bring your grade up. Some are easier, tedious, and tough ones. She teaches content well-breaks the content down. Gives extra credit. Make sure you study hard for exams-two of them. They aren't impossible but tough.  Final not to bad.

Maria is awesome. She was so nice and helpful and always took time to answer everybody's questions. She dropped the lowest 5 quizes/hws, and offered three EC assignments. Most test and quiz questions are out of the packet problems, and she even puts the power points online. Such a good prof. I don't see how you could fail her class.
One of the better teachers I have had in the econ department. Her lectures are clear and she is pretty willing to help if you need it. Not as stuck up as the professors.

She either explains things too much or not enough. Tests are hard and worded extremely tricky and will trip you up. The material is convoluted and hard to comprehend. Her examples are bad. But she is so nice though. She's like a mom to everyone. If they whole class does bad on something she won't count it. She grades easy on everything but test.
Dr. Hatcher was a great the medical school anatomy and embryology course.

Prof. Hatcher is really sweet and she really cares about her students. She is always there to answer your questions. If you skip class, make sure you listen to the Echo360 lectures or you won't pass the exams. Exams are easy if you study. STUDY STUDY STUDY!!!

This was the worst class I've ever taken at UK. The homework is worth next to nothing, the exams are next to impossible to pass because there is just way too much information on them, and the lectures move extremely quickly with hardly anytime for clarification. She never replies to emails, unwilling to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great professor for Anatomy, wish I could have her for another class. She is very nice and makes lectures interesting. Don't buy the text book unless you really want too because you are required to purchase the code for the online textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The tests are worth like 80% of your final grade, so if you  mess up one or two of those you're screwed. She also doesn't teach/explain well, she just goes through the powerpoints. It's nothing you couldn't do on your own. Not a good experience for me, this class was one of my biggest causes of stress.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I absolutely love this professor. She's so funny but at the same time she's all about business. She'll get the lectures done in a timely manner and has answered every single one of my questions inside and out of class. She's inspiring and I love her references. Anyways, if you take anatomy- take her. She's incredibly smart and knows how to actually Teach that to us!
Dr. Hatcher is a great teacher! Easy to get a good grade if you study.

I found Dr. Hatcher to be an excellant anatomy teacher! If you are going into pre-professional she is in charge of those classes as well and gives tips and hints for your future courses. I had prior anatomy knowledge so the class was easier for me. She will tell you what is on the test and give an outline of how many Q's per lecture on the test.

Dr. (Richardson) Hatcher  nice and I think she is easier than Dr. Deane, but the tests are still ridiculously hard and there is way too much material to learn for a single test. It's impossible to learn what they ask you to (especially if you are taking other hard classes). She is pretty good about giving hints about what may be on the test, though

Did not miss one lecture, but the lectures are pointless. Did not clarify things at all. Seems to be rather nervous when teaching. In highschool I was a 4.0 student and in this class i worked my butt off and still got a C.  If you are not a good test taker, forget it.....
Class is hard but she prepares you well.

Ignore people saying this is hard. It is not. Just read the notes once or twice a day a week prior to exam and you're good. I have an A+ with average effort. I didn't even bother to go to class on friday.

If you were an average student in high school be prepared to work your butt off. I study weeks in advance for her tests and I barely manage to pass. Her tests are really tricky and she is VERY smart so sometimes when she tries to explain something it just goes in one ear and out the other. She is nice though..but this class is TOUGH
Not very effective in lecture. Much better off if she just handed you the notes and set you free. needs to get rid of the fill in the blank

Let's be honest, anatomy kicked my butt. I got better grades in chemistry than this class. And I don't think Richardson did a thing to make me think otherwise. I thought she was a terrible lecturer, seeming extremely uncomfortable in front of a class of students. And these tests were HARD. Good luck on the test over muscles.

Richardson is not that great of a teacher, but she does care about her students. She will answer questions and help you outside of class. She is very nice and approachable. Anatomy is a hard class, and you have to be willing to work hard. She knows what she's talking about, but has trouble conveying the message to the class.

Dr. Richardson is fair. She is a lot better than Dr. Deane, but shakes a lot and seems really nervous. She is alright about giving hints about what to study for the exams, which is really the only positive point about her.
She tries to get the point across and wants to make sure you learned well. She is kind of dorky but she is really nice.  I love her!!
She is pretty good.  She wants to make sure you learn. She is alos good for telling you what will be or not be on test.

She is terrible at teaching!  She only goes over the notes.  I took her class and am having to retake it to get into Nursing school.  Do yourself a favor and take Stein, your acceptance into Nursing school depends on it!!!
She loves to teach.  Makes the class fun.  Lots of chuckles.  Very Hot.
Mrs. Kite is a great teacher!!
I love Mrs. Kite

Mrs. Kite is extremely sweet and very funny.  She is helpful when it comes to doing rote teachings.  She sometimes stops you in the middle if you're doing something wrong, which can be a bit unnerving, but it's only so that others won't make the same mistake.  I defintely recommend her.

He's a nice person but, If you aren't a math person, I don't recommend taking the class with him. Lectures were disorganized/confusing, and the textbook was heavily AI based. He didn't respond to email. Exams were weighted so heavily that despite passing all the homework with a 90-100, doing very poorly on exams (bad test taker) dropped my grade.
He does not answer emails and put things on the test that he didn't teach

as long as you go to class and pay attention to the lecture you will pass. attendance is not necessarily mandatory but again, class will go a LOT easier if you show up. exams were kinda difficult but could get extra credit if you turn in a cheat sheet (you get on one every exam)

I took him for PSY 315.

Your grade is mostly based off midterm and final, but the study guide is not what is on the exam. Have a good understanding of what is happening and come to class though it is not required. Good talks in class, but do the readings before. if i could, I would take this class again and pay more attention because i enjoyed it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The lectures aren't bad, and he does answer questions, but we barely get thru 1 chapter per class.The only homework is through Inquizitive, which is the online textbook homework. My main issue is when he posts the exam review documents to study, there is a ridiculous amount of material that we have barely covered or not covered in class at all.
Fantastic, well structured class. Super interesting group discussion. Go take on of professor Arthur's classes, you wont regret

He is super unorganized and nothing in lecture makes sense. I was a psych major…. now I'm not. 

overall so so so disorganized I couldn't stand it. 

go to lab, only reason I passed.
I would definitely recommend this class. As long as you go to class regularly and pay attention in lectures you will do good in this class.

Dr. Arthur is very nice and thoughtful, however, his lectures are surface level and boring. There are in class assignments rarely for participation points, but lab attendance is required. His exams are decently difficult, he provides topic lists but its hard to study because he doesn't post slides. If you can, take the course with Dr. Friedrich.

Super nice guy but class felt VERY unorganized to me.  Attendance is not mandatory. Lectures sometimes felt pointless and like i   could have learned more from reading the textbook at home. Exams were easy if you put in a little effort and inquizitives help boost your grade as well.  Overall not the worst class, but would not take again.

Everyone is so dramatic. He's genuinely so nice, and if you go to class, you'll be just fine. His study guides are useful. He does not post lectures which sucks but he's truly not as bad as it seems. Just read the textbook and take notes in class, and you'll be alright. He's a bit quirky, but honestly, a pretty entertaining teacher.

I seriously do not think I have ever had a professor so disorganized. Dr. Arthur was constantly switching between different slide shows and never knew what he wanted to talk about. Although this class was only quizzes they were all very difficult and were very specific questions related to something that was talked about for 30 seconds in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This was easily the worst class I've taken in college thus far. Multiple people (including me) went to office hours and the "advice" we got was basically "do better". TA was great and super sweet, but professor just didn't really know how to teach. Grading was pretty ridiculous and attendance is SUPER important. If you get the chance, switch profs.

Dr. Arthur teaches in an unorganized fashion, and his grading is pretty unclear. Most of his grades are based on quizzes and papers, and the quizzes include random information that he only mentions once. Additionally, he doesn't post the slides, so if you don't go to lecture or miss something while you're there, you are out of luck.
The class in general is very hard but he tries to help in the best ways he can. Ask questions and go to lab hours but most people struggle on the exams.

Pray you have a good TA for this class. Lectures have random tophat questions that are a large grade but lectures are hard to follow and slides are vague. Tophat is required for homework but pricey and messes up half the time. Hardest exams in the department that are made to mess you up. Just take someone else if possible

Attendance isn't mandatory, but there are things done in class for a participation grade & bring your grade down if you don't attend. Tophat was required & expensive. Gives study guides b4 tests, but you probably won't pass test unless your really good at math. Good news is that tests don't bring your grade down lots.

It is a very confusing class, and his lectures are very boring and hard to pay attention to. The slides are very unclear at times, so you have to read the textbook which is the online tophat app, but the app has issues all the time and is expensive, so it is annoying you have to get it for the class. The labs help a lot, and he will help if you ask
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Only take if it is required its so confusing. Nice guy but bad class. Exams are awful. Do not skip lab you will be so lost

I honestly loved Dr. Arthur. His wording can be difficult to understand but if you ask for clarification in class, he will always take the time. My biggest complaint was having to use Packback, which I felt did not supplement the course at all and was just more or less busy work.

Please listen to everybody on here saying to not take him! His class is the hardest class I have ever had to take. The tests are insane and usually have an average grade of an F for the entire class. He does not know how to explain things so that they make sense, and does not offer any extra credit. Please find another professor for this course.

He does not break anything down into understandable terms. I've always been a student who's struggled with math and things, and this was another level... I felt like i was drowning the entire course. He doesn't answer emails hardly at all. The tests were incredibly hard and the class mean score for each one was near a 60. TAKE WITH CAUTION
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I know all the other ratings say not to take him, but seriously... do not. He will explain the simplest things in the most scholarly way to where it just makes no sense. Inquizitives are the only thing that taught me.

I enjoyed this course! It focuses on studying conspiracy theories from a psychologists perspective. I loved Dr. Arthur as an instructor, he was very kind and he contributed greatly to my success in this course! We read many research articles and discussed them in class. Class discussions made the assignments relatively simple.

One of those professors where you just tune out the second he starts talking. 4 exams and weekly homework. Required about $150 for online textbook and packback, which didn't really help with course material. Take another prof if you can. Also you HAVE to go to lab or you will fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Arthur is one of the worst professors I have ever had. He never responds to emails, which is extremely important especially when the class is fully online. He uploaded pre recorded lectures from 2017 and 2018 so the material was horribly outdated and did not match up with his exams. I would not recommend him for any class.

I took PSY314 online this summer. The class itself has interesting material but avoid this professor if you care about GPA. I was on track to get an A in the class until Prof Arthur did not put grades in correctly, ignored my emails, and went ahead with final grades anyway (I was less than 1/4 a point away from an A). Not a caring professor.

This class was pretty easy. He tells you you need the textbook but I did not use it once. The homeworks are very helpful, I used those to study. Sometimes lectures were boring and since it was not mandatory to attend, skipping was too easy.

Participation quizzes, beware. The exams are impossible, and worded to trip you up. His lectures wont help. Use your textbook to understand material. He has 600 unread emails. Seriously, just take someone else!

Lectures are interesting but he reads off powerpoints. Attebd, even though it isnt mandatory because he gives participation quizzes all semester. They only loosely relate to the course & I assume are for his own curiosity. Dont even consider emailing him, he wont answer. He takes forever to grade and loses tests. Exams are all application.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I love him for PSY 311. I also had him for PSY 216 and he wasnt the best for stats, but he specializes in social psychology and it SHOWS. His class is super fun, you really get to understand the social aspect of psychology. His grading criteria is super clear. Attendance isnt required but there are participation quizzes. 10/10 would reccomend

He is the kind of guy you want on your bar trivia night, but not the kind of guy you want teaching you about experimental psychology. he is a really cool guy but his work isn't a priority to him and it is pretty obvious. the labs are confusing and there is not enough communication between him and the TAs. Not terrible but not great either

Not really a bad class. Dr. Arthur is a nice guy, easy to approach. I suck at math and I was able to still get a B in the class. Going to lab is the most important thing for this class. Make sure you go to lab and always ask for help if you dont understand something
I wish I would've read these reviews before signing up for the class
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I've heard that he's better for 215 but 100% do not take him for 216 its the hardest psych class you'll have to take and his exams are worded in a way designed to trip you up. do yourself a favor and take anyone but him for that class.

reviews.comment: hardest exams in the department. take someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class is lecture heavy, but he is amazing at explaining and really wants you to understand. Lab is important and helps with class material a lot. Would definitely take him again.
Very kind and knowledgeable about the content. Inquizitive assignments make it easy to keep your grade up if you aren't the best test taker.

I was nervous to take his class because of these reviews, but he really was totally fine--good even! If you're not good at math, the class will probably be a challenge, and I recommend going to office hours. Also: do go to class. A lot of people didn't go and struggled. The grade is based mostly on tests, homework, lab, and random tophat questions.
Hes a great guy! Just his exams are worded so weird and difficult to understand

When deciding who to take for this course, I looked on this site and was concerned about my options. I ended up taking Dr. Arthur, expecting his class to be a drag due to the reviews on here. I don't know which Dr. Arthur you all are taking , but for me his lectures were clear, he was so helpful and understanding when it came to answering ?s, etc
Really nice and funny, but if you miss a single class, you will be behind.

He's such a sweetheart and an amazing person, but sometimes his lectures seem disorganized or don't make sense, and he recycles everything from previous years so sometimes his tests/homeworks/labs don't reflect what we're actually learning in class. GO TO LAB, no way in hell I would have passed the class without it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: HE GIVES REALLY HARD TESTS TAKE SOMEONE ELSE
His lectures are awful and do not help. He does not teach, he just reads his slides which make his tests impossible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Not good at explaining things and has very difficult exams the short answer portion will destroy your grade no matter how well you do on the multiple choice. Also go to class because he will give you bonus points/ take off points on the participation questions based on if you actually go to class or not. Great guy just not a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Arthur is by far the worst professor I have ever had. He lost my tests, gives unclear grading criteria, and makes it almost impossible to get an A. I have never received a B in a course throughout college, and I have a C in his.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Okay so, attendance is not technically mandatory, but if you don't go, you'll miss participation quizzes and you'll probs fail. He's a very nice person, not the best teacher, even harder to get in touch with. It took me three attempts to actually get to him outside of class. He's very awkward. His tests are SO hard. Pick a different professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Dr. Arthur is a great person but multiple choice questions on exams are extremely difficult. Most questions are application based yet very, very hard. The exams are difficult even after studying well. Class participation matters greatly in this course.

The tests were very difficult. Half the exam is short answer and the other half is multiple choice. He doesn't grade in a timely manner which can be infuriating. Lectures are not helpful when it comes to exam time because the exam questions are all about application and the lectures are just general summations.

He is one of my favorite professors. If you pay attention and put forth effort you will do well. He gives study guides for all exams. His tests aren't word for word from the study guide, but there aren't any surprises. He tries to make his lectures interesting. He is very approachable and pretty funny.

He makes the lectures really interesting. Attendance isn't mandatory, but there are occasionally review quizzes worth a few points. You do have to study for the exams but he gives review sheets that list everything you need to know. He encourages class participation too. My only problem is he lets student ramble on too much. Loved the class!
Horrible teacher. Lectures make zero sense and do not help but you have to attend them. In the lab there were a lot of group papers that were graded very hard. Tests were nearly impossible

He is very personable and approachable if you do not understand a concept. His lectures are interesting. It gets a little homework heavy and the tests are challenging but he gives more than enough opportunities for extra credit. If you come to class and pay attention you will ultimately be fine.
Extremely hard grader, that although is very knowledgeable is a horrible teacher. Open response questions on test are impossible.
Very smart man but has no idea how to explain the subject matter in a way students can understand it.

Dr. Arthur is one of the worst professors on this campus.  He is very passionate about what he teaches, but he does not know how to teach the material to the whole class.  He confuses people during lectures, and tests are extremely difficult.  Made me not want to major in psych anymore after this class.  STAY AWAY
One of the worst teachers Ive ever had. He makes the lectures pretty hard to understand and his "topics you should know for the exam" make you even more confused about the notes he gave in class.

He was very confusing on presenting material in class.  He never followed his outlines that he made, so it was hard to take notes and follow along in class.  He didnt answer questions in class, and made it very dreadful to attend the class.  . He takes 3-4 weeks to grade multiple choice grades.  He also never finishes a set of notes before we move

Changed my major because of this class. I do not think the class would have been so hard if Dr. Arthur would have slowed down and been more clear in his teachings. Also, he grades the tests extremely hard.

I've heard he's a genius in PSY216, but 215 is a different story.  The class isn't difficult by any means, but if you only use his lectures as study material, you won't pass the exams.  He likes to give very long and drawn out examples which have only served to confuse most people that I have talked to.  Just read the book and you should pass.

I really liked him as a person and you can tell he knows what he's talking about. Expect to take notes. Pay attention to his powerpoints and take good notes and you should do decent on the tests. I made the mistake of not paying attention and it cost me. Overall nice man and good professor!

You don't even have to take notes in his class. I didn't take a single note all semester and studied from the book and taught it to myself and I got 85 and higher on all my exams. The information is easy, there is just a lot of it.

Gives you a huge study guide and then tests you on things that are no where on the study guide. When anyone answers a question he makes you feel quite dumb. Had to take him for 3 semesters, would no recommend him at all.
Tests were extremely hard, lectures were very unclear (very messy and unorganied), need your textbook to learn anything.

He's tough but i love him as a person. At first didn't like him in psych 215 (lectures weren't clear) but I got him figured out in psych 216 and im enthused now to have him in 314 now. Be willing to do a little work yourself and you'll be fine. Great guy

Ive had Dr. Arthur for two semesters and although he is tough, I really respect him. He is a very smart person. Classes are tough but stick with it! He is very very kind and go see him if you need help! Keep up on work and STUDY, and you will pass!

I thought that he was very nice, but the class was very difficult. I would advise to NOT skip any classes and to find someone in the class that you can work with outside of class in case you fall behind. The tests are tough and half the tests are short answer so be prepared to have to memorize a lot of formulas.

Dr Arthur is a great guy. Just come to class for every lecture, pay attention, and take notes and you'll do fine. We wrote some short papers to connect the material to our lives, as well as some online discussions and I believe 3 tests. His tests are generally about 24-30 questions, along with 4 short answers. You don't need the text book.

Dr Arthur has you watch lectures outside of class so that you come to class prepared and with knowledge of the material. In class you work in groups practicing the material you learned. It takes a bit to get used to, but being able to learn at home when you want is nice. Lab will clear up any questions you have.

So far the hardest class I have taken in college. He struggles with getting students attention and it is very hard to understand what he is talking about. I emailed him on several occassions with concern of my grade and never got a reply back. Once he finally replied, he missed the appointment we were supposed to have.
Meh, he's alright.

He goes pretty quickly in lecture and sometimes copying notes from the slides can be difficult. His tests are pretty hard but after the first one you kind of get the hang of his test set ups. Going to class is important even though its not required. Lab is very easy and you'll get an A if you do the assignments and follow all directions to them.

Kind of surprised by other comments on here. I've had Arthur and Archer (216 and 313) both at UK and would much prefer Arthur. He's more laid back and will curve. I got B's on all the exams, an A in lab and got an A in the class. Attending lectures isn't mandatory (like Archer) but he randomly does have participation points offered in class

One of the worst teachers I've ever had. Even when you ask questions in class he will never give you a direct answer. He is also confused on what he teaches. You will learn one thing in class and the opposite in lab. Your TA will be your best friend. Attend her office hours and ask questions in lab if you want to pass.

He's not that bad, but don't expect to pass by just attending lectures. The textbook will be your best friend. Some of the questions on the test are extremely ambiguous, but the class is manageable if you work for it.
He doesn't answer questions, doesn't teach and the tests are very hard

Tests have tricky q's, the short answers are impossible to get full credit on. Nice guy, helpful. Seems he is more research and statistics oriented in his teaching method. Got C's on all the tests but still got an A in the class because of how grades were weighted. Not a bad class, he gives extra credit. Lect's are vague, textbook is a must.

Nice guy, really bad professor. His tests do not represent the material covered in lecture. He ended up curving the grades after the final because everyone did poorly. The average on exams was a 64, if that tells you anything. Avoid him if you can, I would not recommend him to anyone, he's just not cut out to teach. He's very research focused.

Try to avoid him, i am an A/B average student and i studied my butt off for the past 3 exams and received all C's, the majority of your points come from the tests. his boring lect's only cover half of whats on the test so be prepared to study from your book A LOT! tricky test Q's. nice guy, bad teach. Cute in nerdy way. Hardest ive had in UK PSY.

We had to watch lectures that he had video taped over a year ago, yet he changed the tests around. The material was too much for each test, and I could never get ahold of him for help or explanations on anything.

I took this last semester.  I went to class most of the time and listened to his online lectures and didn't really need to study because he covered it well.  The class is very team and group based and he sometimes tried to be tricky on exams but overall I thought he was a good professor.

I can't believe some of the reviews here. I attended every class, every lab, barely watched lecture videos, yet still got an A at the end of the semester. He has a good personality, too, and 216 is required for psych majors. It seems as if some students need to look within themselves more, and not blame the professor for their own poor performance.

I would always avoid taking a class of his if possible. He is a nice guy, but can't communicate to save his life. He also makes up questions ON TESTS to throw you off so you WILL get it wrong. Never met a teacher that tries to fail people... But he enjoys it! Worst professor I've ever had, although I enjoy speaking with him! Do NOT take him.

Dr. Arthur's class is a bit challenging, but definitely doable. He uses a team-based learning approach, which has helped contribute more to knowledge as an individual. He is helpful with the questions that students ask, and tries to make the subject more understandable. Attend all labs, classes, try your best, and study well to earn a good grade.

I'm in his class right now, and although he seems like a great guy, he's not the best teacher for me. I struggle with the material, and he doesn't lecture in class at all. We solely do group work. I just wish he would go over material more in depth so the other students and I who struggle with Stats wouldn't be so clueless. He's a nice guy, though.

Dr. Arthur is a good professor but it seems like he is still getting adjusted to teaching. He is anew professor at UK and I took him for his first class here. It was a little difficult to understand sometimes and he is not always clear about things. But he is available a lot to help outside of class and very approachable. Exams aren't the easiest.

I've had Dr.Arthur twice now. Dropped the class the first time and tried at all cost to avoid taking him again and unfortunately was unable to. His lectures are hardly lectures..tries to do discussions and they don't work. All of his test questions are trick questions and don't reflect lecture material AT ALL. VERY monotone. AVOID HIM

I'm guessing the past commentators just didn't expect to do work in college. I have a 4.0 for this guy, after Stats, research methods, etc. If you're not lazy the classes are fine. Effort is the biggest factor. You must take the time to really learn it. These commentators are making external attributions, when they should be making internal ones.

This is the worst lecture I've ever attended. It is completely unhelpful and he is very unclear on the material. I benefit more from the lab than anything in the actual lecture. The tests are incredibly difficult. Avoid this professor.

Really smart guy, but a really horrible teacher. He was not clear at explaining anything even if you asked for specifics. Tests are ridiculously hard and it seemed like he loved using trick questions.

Knows the material but has no idea how to teach it. Horrible at explaining things and loves to put tricky questions on test. Doesnt seem to care about his students, he'll ask the class for an answer and no one know the answers and he just moves on. One of the worst professors I have had yet.

I went into this class really excited and wanting to do well. Needless to say now I will never take a class that is taught by him again. He tries to be a nice guy, but honestly has to think it's comical to make his exams close to impossible. He could care less about his students..you have to become best friends with your TA

This class was an unorganized mess. This is easily the worst class I have ever taken in college.His monotone presentation is so bereft of pedagogical talent it is almost disgraceful.  The tests are so hard as to almost be borderline trick questions.Get a grip man, we know you think you are incredibly important,but its a 200 level class!! AVOID!!
Tests are pretty hard. Good guy, tough prof.

The material in experimental psychology is not particularly hard. Arthur is very clear and his lectures are interesting, but his tests are near impossible. Lab is mandatory, but lecture is not. Thankfully 33 percent of your grade comes from lab, because it is fairly easy. Like I said though, his tests are IMPOSSIBLY HARD!

This class was supposed to be really easy and is required for psych majors, he made the tests really hard and the class average took a dive. he does curve the tests i think. speaks monotone. his class doable but not enjoyable at all. labs are essential to understand
He does not share the not lecture slides and moves very quickly. There are lots of quizzes, and the wording is weird wich makes it difficult to study. If possible, find another professor.
Very fun teacher and makes it easy to pay attention in his class because he is so energetic!

Dr. Archer was a great teacher and had a amazing class. It was super interesting and he made PSY100 such a fun class to be in. I would recommend him to anyone taking his class. Just do your work to your best ability and you'll do great! Don't really need the textbook
He is very knowledgeable on what he is teaching, and is a very good lecturer. I definitely recommend taking his class!
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I would not recommend this class with him; he doesn't give you any study guides for the exams, and they're set up and worded so difficult that if you study for hours on end, you still don't feel confident leaving the exam. I studied so hard for the exams, and I would fail every time. Overall, I would not recommend.

Dr. Archer is one of the best professors I've ever had. His lectures are so interesting and engaging that I don't even realize the time go by. His exams are fair and if you go to the lectures and pay attention you'll definitely do good. He hosts office hours every week which are really helpful to go to and review the subject.

Does not share notes, and sometimes moves at a fast pace during lecture. The tests are not the hardest, but they are not easy. I spent so much more time than anticipated studying during this course. Going to the SI sessions is what got me and A.
Would not take this class again
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Seems to think he is teaching the class well but exam scores prove otherwise. As a professor you should try to get your students to succeed but seems he wants the opposite. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! I've been to every class taken notes, studied on my own, went to review sessions and still his tests don't make sense.

DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS!!! his lectures genuinely made no sense and i struggled the entire semester. The study guides for tests are just long docs that say what you need to know and it takes FOREVER to create your own study guide using his format. Most things that were on the "what you need to know" weren't even on the exams?? His TA grade everything

His lecture involves a lot of note-taking and moves through the material quickly, so you need to pay attention. I would not take his class ever again. His TAs, though, are really nice. His exams are impossible, even if you study. I would study for days and long hours, and I failed the course. I would not suggest this class.
Highly recommend!

Dr. Archer is a great professor, despite the grade I received. His lectures are very informative and enjoyable. I took his course for PSY 314 and was met with the same experience. Yes his exams are hard, but in my opinion, they help you retain more information. I would rather this than forget most things after taking an exam.

Before taking this class I'd read negative reviews on here so I was hesitant, but he ended up being one of my favorite profs. Clearly passionate about what he teachers, engaging lectures, used stories, exams weren't too bad and are just memorization. Ignore the bad reviews, he was great.

I loved Dr. Archer and the way he taught. Yes his tests were very heavy and there was a lot of content, but he is very passionate about what he teaches and his lectures are really great and super informative! He is very kind and a good teacher! I learned a lot from him. 10/10

AVOID THIS CLASS AND DO NOT TAKE IT!!!! I failed his class and I did everything to pass by going to the TA to go over the exam study guides. The study guides weren't helpful at all for the exams. He blames the bad test grades on his students instead of thinking of his teaching style. This professor made me cry from his 100 level class.

Dr. Archer is a good professor. He does go a little fast when reading slides so make sure to write stuff down fast. Exams are not definition based so make sure to apply situations to the definitions that are given to you. I would recommend actually going to lab because it will help you on the exams.

Dr. Archer was a really engaging lecturer. The assignments are very interesting and he really cares about the students. The tests are hard though and I highly recommend doing the study sessions with the learning center. I would 100% take his class again.

Dr. Archer is definitely old-school and mandatory attendance for an 8am isn't ideal. However, he is a very engaging speaker and teaches well. A lot of studying is involved and there's high pressure to do well, but if you follow the test reviews he gives you, you'll be fine. He's not as terrible as he sounds and he's happy to help if you need it.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: people are honestly dramatic in these reviews. yes he is tough but he cares about us. he takes time to answer all questions and learns all our names. his tests are hard but the study guide is exactly like the test… it literally says what the short answer questions are. you WILL learn a lot from his class. i still retain everything.

Dr. Archer was an amazing lecturer. I didn't have many interactions with him, but he was very friendly and very helpful. He isn't as bad as others make it seem. There's a lot of work, and the exams are a bit hard. But as long as you pay attention and do the work, you shouldn't fail. The labs are time consuming but not difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: While I did find this class very interesting, I was not a fan of Dr. Archer. Specifically, he continually used the phrase "mentally retarded"
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Its not as bad as everyone makes it seem. Its a 300 level, its not supposed to be a cakewalk. Everything is very easy except for exams. Lectures don't do much, u gotta read entirety of each chapter to do well (not short). Exam short answer is mainly list memorization. No hw other than quiz/exam prep & 2 easy projects. Built in curve (89.5% is an A)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR FOR ANY REASON! Honestly took the biggest toll on my mental well-being. He recommended reading the textbook and it did not help when it came to test material at all. His lectures also didn't help with test material
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: PLEASE do anything you can to not take this course with him. the TA's are way too harsh of graders for a 100 level class. he randomly takes attendance, your grade is pretty much based on only exams and quizzes, the study guides are absolutely nothing like the exam, and he blames the whole class when he messes up. good luck if you have to have him

If you are wondering whether or not you should drop this class, DO IT. I cannot stress this enough. Dr. Ray-Archer prides himself on students failing. His instruction focuses on definitions, but the intensely long tests are all situation based. He goes so fast you can't even take notes adequately. I'm holding onto a B rn and crying.
Dr. Archer cared about what he was discussing. The class was just felt unnecessary because of everything we talked about was common sense.

He is very unclear in his instructions, even when they are written down. Was instructed to write "a brief summary" and had to resubmit because I failed because he wanted it to be over a page long. Will proceed to blame the class when multiple people messed up on that portion.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He such a difficult professor. You could study the study guide and the topics will not be on the exams. There are an open ended questions on exams that so difficult and worth so many points. The amount of time I spend study for the exams and still end up with a bad grade is crazy. All he does is blame it on the students and not his teaching style.

Course grade is heavily determined by tests and quizzes, which the study material is often not clear. Each exam covers 2-4 chapters of information, which isn't even the worst part since the textbook often doesn't help with studying. There are 10 online labs to be done and all of them include vague instructions. Random attendance checks too.

Do not suggest taking this class. Your grades are based on quizzes and tests. The test are 100 points each that equal to 300 out of a 600 point grading system. Very little other work besides the test and quizzes. On the test most of it is written answers and it's like 3 parts to each question.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor cares for only his exam and how you score on them. Even when the class average is extremely low proceeds to blame the students without taking into any consideration that it could possibly be his teaching style. There is also no opportunity to help your grade unless you do well on the exams which are extremely difficult.

reviews.comment: Way too much material to memorize for testing, at least 4 chapters of information. Exams are just way too complicated and asks for too much. Textbook reading is highly suggested by him even though I feel it doesn't make it easier.

reviews.comment: Unclear as to test material. Very specific and must know everything. On paper and in person.

reviews.comment: Dr. Blaine is the sweetest. She is easy to talk to and very understanding if you are willing to be open and communicate. Her assignments are helpful and she usually provides helpful feedback. She clearly has a focus on her students so if you are curious about something, just ask and she will probably find an answer!

Dr. Blaine is so sweet, and her care for her students is obvious. She does her best to help everyone succeed, whether that means making lectures/assignments relevant to our interests, being available outside of class, or just being there to chat with.

Great professor, very sweet and knows how to present, what would otherwise be boring material, in an interesting way. She understands that not all courses need to be weed-outs, and if she can see you putting in an honest effort your grade will reflect that. Super helpful and creates a comfortable environment! Can't recommend her enough
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: I loved this class and her lecture style. While not exactly rigid and followed perfectly to plan, the material was conveyed excellently. She is hilarious, super caring, and is clearly passionate about both students and pharmacy. Great professor!

Dr. Blaine is super sweet and caring and it is really easy to get an A in this class. However, lectures were disorganized and often went over the scheduled time. The class itself was insightful especially if you are on the fence about what path you want to take in pharmacy but it could have been taught much better.
This class was a lot of fun, easy, and very insightful. Dr. Blaine is always open to feedback since this is a new course, although, you are required to participate whenever there are guest speakers.

Dr. Halliday is one of those professors who just... they just get it. Gender and Popular Culture was a great time. Things got relatable, raw, and real. I recommend this course because it opens your eyes to the full spectrum of gender and how pop culture intersects with it.

Her TA is a very hard grader but can't seem to tell you what you do wrong on your papers and assignments. And the instructor does no grading, I would not recommend this class, this class was my only B and its only an elective it was harder than my major classes.

Took Dr. H for GWS 201 and UK Core and do not regret it one bit. I learned so much, they make coming to class fun and worth it. Only complaint would be the grading on the essays were a bit harsh, but in my class the TA did it, not Professor Halliday. If you come to class and speak your thoughts, you will get a lot out of the course.

I fw her heavy, Dr. Holliday is funny af and does a great job in lecturing. I took this for a gen ed credit and don't regret it. Show up, participate and you will likely get an A. Only complaint I have is the essay grading, but the TA did it not Dr. Holliday. Class was never boring and curriculum is straight forward.

One of the best professors I have ever had. Makes the course fun and manageable considering students have others to take. There are clear grading instructions and nothing difficult is asked of you as a student. Class discussions are always interesting and thought-provoking

Avoid this professor! The class has 5 3-page essays which wouldn't be terrible if she didn't grade so harshly. Seemed condescending in lecture and you have three books that you have to read throughout the semester and you have to reference them for the papers. I hated this class and would never take this professor again!

Very few assignments. Grades are not uploaded to canvas.

reviews.comment: Such a nice teacher and very understanding but the class is hard to keep up with because of finding the pdfs and him not using canvas

He is a kind man and he seems like he genuinely cares about what he is teaching. He isn't really helpful with anything, but a week before the exam, he releases a study guide that is basically the test.

Dr Farr is a really kind man, just a pretty bad professor. He doesn't use canvas, and your grade is based on 2 exams, an 8-10 page essay, and the final exam. You are expected to find a pdf of the book we are reading with hope that it translates correctly, and he does not help you find any. Not a single assignment the whole semester, just exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You're basically on your own when taking his class. He does not utilize canvas or provide links to the required readings—you have to search google for the adapted books and hope that at least one of the translations you find is accurate. Barely any notes to be taken during lecture. Graded on only 3 exams and a 8-10 page paper. Kind man though.

reviews.comment: Class lectures were often engaging, but never focused and too conversational. Lots of reading, and the assigned reading was good, but lectures felt unrelated and mostly guided by strong opinions. The Canvas shell only included the syllabus, grades were never given back besides the mandatory midterm, and the final exam had no rubric or instruction.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I never had any idea how I was doing in this class. Prof Farr assigns tons of reading every night, and then spends the class explaining it in his own ideas. Two papers and a final, no feedback ever given. If you can write good papers, you'll be fine, and I don't think he reads them. Just boring- I stopped going to class after midterm.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Farr for PHI305 (Healthcare Ethics) and I would never take him again. Made an asynchronous course synchronous where only 4/30 students could attend and didn't record the meetings. Used a different professor syllabus from 2019. No assignments for a month and then a test and several papers assigned during finals week. DO NOT TAKE EVER

I do not recommend taking. He is impossible to reach outside of class, the material is all over the place, and I was confused for all of the semester. Very lecture heavy, with no value given. He assigns exams two classes before the exam and overall does not respect his student's time. I still don't know my grade in the class. Avoid if you can.

I believe Dr. Farr is a really nice guy, however, this class was used as a platform to narrate his political views. The material covered did NOT reflect what was listed in the University catalog. We had 2 papers, with presentations, and 1 final. I never received a grade or ANY feedback during the semester, just a final grade. You have been warned..
Dr. Farr is super knowledgeable and articulate and lectures are always interesting and engaging. Highly recommend if you actually enjoy philosophy and are willing to read.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: If you want to take an easy upper level philosophy class, then this would be the one to take. As a philosophy major, however, I was disappointed with Dr Farr. The readings in the class were interesting, but we were assigned 75-100pp/nite. Class discussion was poor, and Dr Farr is lackadaisical most of the time. Class was overall way too unfocused.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: extremely intellectual individual. Will teach what you need to know. He is a great guy that offers extra opportunities to learn the information. He is tough though. Do not take the class if you are not prepared to do heavy, dense readings along with heavy critical thinking
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I enjoyed the critical thinking involved with this course. It definitely opened my eyes to new viewpoints. The coursework, however, was very difficult for a 100-level class. Dr. Farr even mentioned in the beginning that it is very hard to get an A. So be ready to work! Nevertheless, it was very beneficial.

Very interesting and makes you think. You must pay attention during lecture and take good notes and study. He usually tells u what to expect on the exam but doesn't give a study guide. It's possible to not read the text as long as you know the overall summary of the book and pay attention to the key parts he talks about. I still recommend reading tho. It's impossible to get an A in his class and the best u can do is a B. Take this class if u want to be entertained and/or challenged.

Probably the worst class that I could have taken. Exams were beyond difficult even though I went to every class and paid attention. Even on questions that were opinion, I still got them wrong! Dr. Farr is a cool guy but should not be teaching a 100 level course. This class was absolutely horrible and it brought my GPA down. I do not recommend!

Note how all of the bad reviews of Professor Farr are for 100 level PHI classes. Do not let this skew your perception. Professor Farr is very difficult and requires a lot of reading but he is a joy to have as a professor. He clears up my confusing with the reading with discussion in class. Loves to exchange ideas and hear students points of view.

He's a really cool guy, really smart, and very good at getting students to talk during class. He's a wonderful professor who encourages critical thinking. But, as others have said, this is a very difficult class. I didn't get a good grade, but I still learned quite a bit from him in this class, and enjoyed the in depth discussions.
Knows his information, relies on the student to put forth the effort to learn and know it.

Super cool guy, really knows his stuff, but you HAVE to stay caught up on the reading. Everyone that said he was super hard must have not payed attention in class. If you read, take GOOD notes, pay attention in class, and study your notes you will be fine. I slacked off after midterm and got a B. Hard class, learned a lot though.

This class wasn't bad as a whole. Had some good conversations. But the exams were pretty hard. You have to study everything you have went over in the lectures because he doesn't give you a study guide and doesn't tell you what's going to be on the exam. You have your notes and the books we read. That's it.
Dr. Farr is a really cool guy but his class is extremely time consuming and difficult. The test material is not equivalent to what is discussed in class. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!
Ridiculously hard exams.
No Comments

I can tell that Dr. Huckaba truly wants us to succeed in organic chemistry. He clearly makes an effort to make the class as easy as possible while still teaching the material. However, the most frustrating aspect of this class was how disorganized Dr. Huckaba is. He makes so many mistakes on assignments, answer keys, and even during lectures.

Very nice guy, but gets flustered and confused when explaining concepts. Can feel very disorganized, uploaded a practice exam key one time that was 60% wrong. The disorganization is my real hangup with him. I don't doubt he knows his stuff, but he struggles to convey that knowledge due to mistakes during lecture or in assignment instructions.
BEST PROFESSOR FOR ORGO CHEM!! Just go to office hours and you will ace this class

Good professor. You can tell he really wants his students to learn and do well. The class is pretty much graded on homework and exams, so there's not room to mess around. Exams are written, so there's partial credit given. I've heard that some students only read the textbook and not watch the lectures, and they do just fine. I would take again.

I wouldnt recommend Huckaba. Hes a really sweet person who knows organic chemistry but he cant teach its his second year and his lectures are hard to follow you cant read his drawings to the point you will have to read the book to pass the class which is lot of reading. 4 exams Exams worth 70% are problems pulled out the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Huckaba is a very kind professor. Unfortunately, his notes are absolutely horrific. He is not clear with what information needs to be known on exams since his notes are disorganized and unclear. If he made the expectations clear for what we needed to know , I would rate him a 5/5 because an A would be attainable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Organic Chemistry gets hard, but Dr. Huckaba makes learning it so much better. He is still a new professor, but he is absolutely fantastic and on track to be one of the best professors at the University of Kentucky with a few more years of experience. He is so accomodating and wonderful, and his personality is lovable. 100%, take this class.

Honestly I don't get this guy. seems chill and all but id rather he focuses on his research rather than teach a few sophomores IUPAC. Homework is worse like 70% of your grade so there isn't even point to try on the exams. also he doesn't know how to teach NMR like cmon you're an organic chemist.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I started out the semester not liking Dr. Huckaba's lectures because they were recordings from last semester. When he started recording new ones I really enjoyed them. Great professor and knows what he's talking about and how to teach it in a concise way. He's also so so nice. 10/10 recommend, even though OChem stinks.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Huchaba is a fantastic professor. He's clear with his expectations and helps make OChem a little more bearable. I recommend his class to everyone and anyone. Do lots of practice problems and take good notes and you will be fine in his class. He likes to pull test questions from the book so I recommend doing all the book practice questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I had Huckaba his first year teaching. He desperately wants to be a great prof, and for his first year, I think he did well! He was a bit flustered/disorganized, but he always helped during office hours. Grade is made up of 4 exams (88% of grade) and weekly homework (only 12% of total grade). 85 is the cutoff for an A though (70B, 55C, etc).

The best professor you will ever take. I wish he was teaching Ochem 2. He knew what he was talking about and made sure everyone understood. Organic Chemistry is hard, but Dr. Huckaba made it easier for students to understand the information. If you take a different professor other than Dr. Huckaba, I will feel sorry for you. He's a true legend.

Dr. Huckaba is a VERY NICE GUY! He's pretty funny, too! Go talk to him outside of class, you won't regret it. I took him for his very first class at UK. I think he did a good job! I found the material to be very interesting. I would love to take another class with him. Read the textbook and do lots of practice problems. Exams are 88% of your grade

I have Dr. Huckaba for my organic chemistry class and he is a very great professor! Make sure to read the text before you go to lecture or you may find things confusing. The class is test heavy so study well before the exams. He's good at answering questions and wants you to succeed!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She is the best professor I have had yet, she genuinly cares about your work load and understands that other classes come before WRD, so shes understanding about extentions. I havent even needed any bacause the work load is light and you have a reasonable amount of time to complete them. She gives extra credit and cancels class the perfect amount.

She's the sweetest professor I've had in my time here. As long as you show up and do the work, this class is a breeze. She gives lots of time in class to work on assignments, and homework is usually pretty light.

This professor is so extremely nice and caring. The course gave me no stress. You will develop a connection with the professor, which is rare to see. This is my favorite class and professor by far. You don't have to be amazing in writing essays, honestly. You'll be fine here.

Can be a little slow getting grades back. You can tell she's a newer professor but she's helpful and responsive when she needs to be. Sometimes she could do a better job at explaining assignments, but she takes time to meet with everyone individually to check in. I'm planning on taking another one of her classes next semester.
Always had really fun creative writing prompts, and was super helpful when giving feedback on poems.

Prof. Macquarie has been a fantastic teacher and had always been more than willing to help. She can be a bit hard to hear at times but class is always fun and she makes sure you understand what you need to do for assignments and how what you're learning applies to the real world. I'd love to see how she teaches her creative writing courses!

I enjoyed this class! You have to watch the movies before taking the quizzes. You will do well if you go to class and follow along with the guided notes.
