Great teacher, attendance is essential because the notes aren't online. The exams are exactly like the notes.
Tests are word by word from the book. Buy the book better than handwritten notes.

Great lectures but sometimes they feel like 1hr 15 min classes. He assigns two paper each of them are due a week after the exam. The class is an easy A as long as you use your time wisely when studying for his exams.

Dr. DeSantis' lectures were very interesting, but his presentation of the material is sometimes confusing. Don't bother emailing him with questions because he won't reply. His grading is very tough for an intro class, and additionally, he is insensitive to students personal situations.

One of the most entertaining classes I have ever taken. Desantis knows how to make his material exciting and interesting. His exams are difficult, but he grades papers easily. This class is a must take. I would highly recommend getting your hands on his workbook for class however, it'll make your life much easier.

DeSantis' lectures are amazing. When you study your notes for the exams, you can literally think back to when he said those notes and when you took them. He has a lasting impression on most kids that take the class.

This class is so interesting and easy to pay attention in. Desantis is so funny and engaging, I love his class! There are few assignments and the tests are tough but not impossible. Learn the concepts and you'll get an A on every exam! I would take this class again. He has been my favorite prof so far.

The class is extremely easy as long as you show up for class and study for the tests. DeSantis is straight to the point, and keeps lectures interesting. Do NOT expect to just go in there and play on your phone because you must fill in the notes.

Dr. D is amazing! The tests are tough but ONLY if you don't study (they are based solely on the study guides).  He may seem arrogant at times but it's to be expected from a professor of his status.  As long as you show up and pay attention, it's great. His lectures are long but fun.  Don't get on his bad side and the class will be an easy A.

Dr. Desantis is absolutely hilarious. COM101 is super relevant to everyday life and after taking his class you see the entire world differently.   As long as you stay on his good side, and study hard for the exams, this class is an easy A.

Definitely my favorite class so far. As long as you go to class and take the notes (definitely buy the textbook-it makes note taking much easier), you'll pass the class easily. The study guides are extensive and cover everything you will be tested over. Know the study guide and you'll easily ace the tests!
Fun class, but hard.
very funny, lectures fly by, material doesn't seem hard but the exams are difficult and you need to study a lot, and make sure you buy his textbook
I really enjoyed Dr. DeStanis's lectures, he moved around and made the class actually interesting to learn. He didn't have many tests but they required a lot of writing and cover everything.

DeSantis is not only the most rude professor I've ever had, he's also the worst. He has an ego the size of his big head, and is constantly saying something offensive. He stays unprofessional and offensive. In addition, he makes you pay $50 for a textbook that is comprised only of his powerpoint slides.

I was shocked to see Dr. DeSantis. He is my absolute favorite professor, such an amazing lecturer. I would look forward to his class, he's so funny and entertaining and makes the material so much easier to learn. The tests are hard and long, but studying is easy because the material is fun and interesting. Papers are easy. Love Dr. D

Absolute garbage. I took this because my advisor said it would be interesting and he knew what he was doing but it couldn't have been further from the truth. Papers assinged were vauge and centered on his own vocab he only mentions in specific lectures and he expects you to buy a "workbook" that is literally his PowerPoint slides printed out, $40
He's awesome. Funny yet teaches you a lot. almost everything he teaches pertains to everyday life. Take his class.

I always loved Dr. D's lectures; they were entertaining and I learned something every day. He is not one to respond to every student's emails, but he does have 600 students every semester. That's what the TAs are there for. The exams were much more difficult than other 100 level classes I've taken and attendance is mandatory.

Dr. D is a fantastic lecturer. I definitely got sick of his sarcastic comments by the end of the semester, but he sure does know what hes talking about. Information on the tests comes straight off of the slides. Memorize the study guide and you will get a 100% on the exams. Attendance is mandatory though.

DeSantis is an awesome lecturer, everything except for the tests are easy. I had to take this class for UKcore, the class was truly interesting but if you need anything talk to the TA not DeSantis because he will only tell you to email them.

DeSantis is a really good professor, he just expects a lot from his students in a 100 level class. Exams are entirely too hard for the level of coursework, but if you go to class and memorize the notes you'll do fine. He seems really arrogant and he rarely responds to emails. But overall a decent professor. Goodentertaining lectures.

Absolutely loved his class during lecture but he can be very rude every other time. If you contact him with questions of any kind he acts as if you've offended him and with much attitude tells you to go to a TA. So just go to your TA first.

The dude is cool, don't get me wrong, and he's an awesome speaker too. However, he comes off as arrogant because he won't answer emails. I mean at least pretend like you care about our success. Aside from that, the tests require memorization but just go to class and the concepts come easily. Anyone with a brain can get an A in this class.

I did great on all the assignments and most of the tests. However because of attendance and one zero on a small assignment I got a C. He calls kids out occasionally and is frustrated when people walk in late. Great material though, very relevant. His information is biased though for sure. The textbook he uses is just a book full of all his slides.

Dr. Desantis is a FANTASTIC teacher he teaches the whole class as if everyone has ADHD. IT's very interesting and he follows his book exactly. He cracks jokes constantly throughout class and the best part is most of them are funny. However, his test are awful, you will most likely run out of time and be prepared to write your hand off!!!

Dr. DeSantis is a good professor who presents the material in an interesting manner, even though at times it seems like pure common sense. He tries too hard to be "cool" and is a bit arrogant. Tests on concepts. So, memorization is necessary but not difficult to do if you just go to class.
Great professor! I definitely recommend this class. Make sure you study for exams two weeks in advance it is not multiple choice, all comprehension.

Interesting professor! Dr. D knew his stuff and really makes you think about things. you must go to class because if not you will miss a lot of information. His exams are non multiple choice, all short answer so you must know the material. Overall, I would take this class again.
He can be a real ass, but his class is super interesting and he does a really good job teaching it. Really good professor, but not so great of a person.
Dr. Desantis is amazing. The course is fum and very interesting.
He is a fantastic teacher!... made me want to go to class because of how fun it was and interesting
Loved his class... recommend !!!

Love Dr. D! I had his film class and absolutely loved it. If you are a junior or senior in Communications you must take it! Its a lot better than 101 because there are only a few students and you really get to know him. He is very passionate about film so its a blast.
He''s the man.

Wonderful teacher! Dr. D knew his stuff and was so excited about teaching. Great and interesting class. Study for exams and start studying like 2 weeks in advance. YOU WILL FAIL IF YOU DON'T STUDY! Tests are non multiple choice, it is all short answer. GO TO CLASS ON TIME! Will call you out if u walk in late. Would take this class again!!

Let me help everyone out: COM 101 is good but, whatever you do during your time here, DO NOT TAKE DESANTIS FOR UPPER LEVEL CLASS! He is not as good with smaller classes as he is with large lecture halls. You will hear horror stories about taking his 400 & 500 level classes. Stick through 101 and never deal with him again.

RIDICULOUSLY tough for an intro class. Yes you learn a lot, but you'll also be spending hours prioritizing studying this class over others, especially during exam weeks. Wouldn't recommend to somebody who's a full time student.
His lectures are interesting and he presents the information well. The tests are 100% memorization and the grading is strict. Study the notes!

He is rude to students and makes us feel like we don't know anything.  Arrogant!  Very egotistical.  He is mean, and demanding.  We had to work hard and he acted like we were losers.  It was disappointing taking this class and it was annoying listening to how much he LOVES himself.  Take other classes or you will regret it!

Class is interesting and he is a great lecturer. Material isn't hard but I never had enough time to finish the exams & they are graded harsh. Exam questions come from notes & are 100% memorization. He sends out a study guide before exams but there will usually be a section on the exams that he doesn't cover on the study guide.

I don't understand how he has so many good ratings.  He is so full of himself and is not a smart guy.  All the ideas he teaches are common sense which makes it irritating to have to memorize such specific lists and have to write your hand off during the exams just to finish.  Not particularly hard just pointless and irritating to listen to.

Really energetic and entertaining. One of the more entertaining classes I've taken. He can have somewhat of a big ego but, its not too bad. To prepare for his test i suggest making flashcards and studying them.
Very good! Learned a lot of new information about things. Definitely makes you think about the things you're exposed to in life.
Tests are all writing and you have to remember a lot of information so follow study guide and memorize info. 3 easy essays plus 3 tests

Absolutely loved dr. Desantis. After taking this class I changed my major to communications. He is very helpful during office hours and is turkey passionate about heat he does. Test come straight from the notes so pay attention.

Without a doubt the best class I've had at UK! He is so passionate about what he teaches and he puts so much energy into his lectures. Always makes you laugh. Tests are LENGTHY, not difficult. Just memorize the notes! I love Dr. DeSantis!
Fun class!
TESTS ARE RIDICULOUS! fun class though. attendance is mandatory or you will fail. TA's grade so hard its unreal, i escaped with a C

I took this class because everyone raved and ranted about it. I don't understand why. His tests are just absurd. I went to talk with a TA about my grade (since he doesn't grade them) and I got full points taken off questions for not explaining it their way, even though the TA said the answer was technically still right. Waste of my time.

He's one of the best professors I've ever had. However, I dropped his class because his tests were way too difficult. He makes class very interesting and he's really funny. But I wouldn't recommend this for a freshman.

The class is very interesting and I truly appreciated the passion he has for the topic. You can only miss two classes, which can be difficult. The test include a lot of information that is hard to finish with the 50 minutes you are provided. Wish there were more smaller quizzes than three large test...
Amazing class, easily the best class I've taken at UK. He's very interesting and put his heart into all of his lectures. Tests are harder than you would expect, just memorize everything.
He is a great teacher and all but all he does is read off his powerpoint. Like just send us the powerpoint online so we do not have to waste time waking up in the morning to get to class.

When I first saw a communications class on my (advisor-given) schedule, I was begrudging; isn't that just a subject area for people who don't want a marketable college degree? But Dr. DeSantis convinced me otherwise; his lectures are utterly fascinating and he delivers them in an expertly engaging manner. I wish I could take another class with him.
Absolutely wonderful! He is what got me interested in communications. Great class, easy to understand, and very interesting and funny. Def. take it!

DeSantis is a wonderful professor. Lectures are interesting. Go to class and take notes. 3 exams and 3 papers, all very easy. Tests come straight from the study guide and are simple memorization. Take the class!
Super awesome and interesting. Tests cover a large amount of information. But if you have good attendance it really doesn't matter. Most interesting teacher I've ever had.

DeSantis is a very strong lecturer, so if you're the kind of student that can go off of a lecture alone, he's your man.  Anything you don't understand about content can be better understood by visiting his office hours, but he will NOT help with the nuts and bolts (attendance, grading procedures) and will redirect you to his TAs.  Good professor.

He was so awesome! He was really really clear in his material! Although, I really liked the class it isn't just an easy A! But it is easy if you do what he requires! He is extremely funny and well worth the attendance. He makes every class fun!!

Easy class, papers are super easy, tests are cake if you take notes and memorize the study guides. Tests are straight from the study guide. Lots of memorization. Uses examples from his life and his "sweethart" A LOT but I guess it keeps his lectures relevant and interesting. If you don't get an A+ in this class you probably shouldn't be in college.

If any professor knows how to keep college kids entertained, he's the one that knows how to do it.  He is extremely fun, but also informative.  The material from the workbook he gives out is exact material that is on the exams, and if I ever take another class he teaches I would request him again in a heartbeat.
DeSantis is easily my favorite professor.  The tests are a lot of memorization, but the material is all interesting and you have plenty of time to prepare.  Definitely take COM 101 with DeSantis.

Fantastic professor.  DeSantis is by far my favorite professor and the class is great. The tests involve a lot of memorization, but you have plenty of time to prepare and there are no surprises.  I would definitely take his class again

By far the best teacher and the best class. The test do require quite a bit of studying, but the material is so interesting that you want to memorize it. He is hilarious and has true passion for his job. TAKE THIS CLASS.

You can tell he tries really hard to be funny/cool, but there's nothing wrong with that. The content is inherently interesting, and his anecdotes make it even better. He tells you EXACTLY what's gonna be on the three exams (non-cummulative), and the three papers are short. You want a cake Com class? Take 101 with DeSantis.
Awesome lectures with interesting topics

Lectures will keep you entertained. Attendance is mandatory 3 days a week and he rarely cancels. Seems like a cool guy at first, but you'll soon realize that he is very egotistical. I think he's obsessed with himself. Grading is hard. Small errors always receive deductions. Exams are extremely long and difficult to finish in 50 minutes.

He is seriously my favorite prof. at UK! Attendance is mandatory, but you WANT to go to his class. It's fun and in no way boring. Sure, the tests have lots of memorization, but if you take the UK 101 class, some of those teachers will actually give you study guides made by DeSantis. No homework, 3 papers, 3 tests, book = notes (printed powerpoints)

Great lecturer. TESTS ARE EXTREMELY HARD!!!!! They require a ton of memorization. The class is very, very interesting. TA's do ALL the work. Attendance is 100% mandatory. If you miss more than 2 classes you get an automatic 2.5% deduction of your FINAL GRADE every time.

Desantis is an amazing teacher. By far one of the best lecturers I've ever had. That being said, his tests are HARD! They require a TON of memorization, but if you are good at that, you will be fine. 3 Papers and 3 Tests. That's it!

Lots and lots of memorization, but very interesting lectures -- they were funny and relevant. He tells you exactly what is going to be on the tests; just memorize what he tells you and you will be A-okay!

He seems nice until you have to talk to him one on one.  Then he is a real ass. He is just a college guy who never grew up; he loves sorority girls and frat guys. EXREMELY CONCEITED.  But he is overall a decent lecturer and interesting class.  Just don?t try to talk to him.

The best class I have taken.  The lectures were incredibly interesting and I am that student who usually skips class or zones out easily.  Lots of memorization but if you pay attention to his examples it should come easily.  Loved his class!!
The class was very easy for the most part. Attendance is mandatory. The tests are insultingly long, but the material is elementary. Quite a bit of memorization required.

Although he may seem nice talking in front of 300 people, one on one he is not very nice. The TA's grade real hard because they are out to prove something for themselves. Great teacher though. He definitely has knowledge on the subject. Requires A LOT of memorization for his tests.

By far my favorite class to attend during the semester.  It is extremely fun to go to and doesn't require a lot of work except for 3 short papers.   Everyone complains about the difficulty of his tests but as long as you study and memorize the study guide, you can make 100s. I made high A's on all tests jut by study 5-6 hours total over 3 days

by far my favorite class of the semester. the lectures are very entertaining and interesting. the papers are easy I got A's on all of them and wrote them the night before. The tests are all writings and memorization so you have to study a lot but he tells you exactly what will be on them. The TAs grade everything and he can be narcacistic sometimes

This class was easily my favorite of the semester. It's enjoyable, entertaining, and interesting. While he does make his TA's do everything, the tests are straight memorization and easy. I studied only the night before exams and aced every single one.

Genuinely disappointed that this class is over. Very interesting subject and he is very good at keeping people engaged and entertained. The tests are hard/quick recall, but if you make friends with the TAs (like me!) they'll basically tell you what you need to study. Only 6 grades all semester, but the class was my fave this semester... loved it!

This guy has a million good reviews for a reason: his class is one of the best every. This class is about everything interesting you ever wanted to know about life ever. Tests are hard but the papers are easy. DeSantis is funny but not helpful if you have a personal problem. He'll immediately redirect you to a TA for everything. Great class though.

Many of his lectures are contradictory. Seems like he has some sort of score to settle with religion, as he's always bashing religion and promoting this search for knowledge and truth. He gives priority to females and will not talk to you one on one; he sends you to a TA. The class itself is enjoyable, but he assumes we're all middle class America.

His lectures are enjoyable and make you think, but that's the only thing good about this course. He makes his TA's do everything, so expect strict grading. Also, he has favoritism towards athletes and pretty girls. Lastly, he can be a real jerk if you use your phone or laptop in class. He'll single you out in the middle of class and embarrass you.

Sure it's an "easy" class, and there isn't much to it except taking notes and a few papers. But as everyone says, the TA's do all the work, and in my case they were terribly strict graders. Large parts of test or paper grades would be taken off just due to a small technicality, so any mistake you make is unforgivable. Fun, but wouldn't take again

Awesome teacher. He really knows how to keep a class of 300 entertained. The test are memorization, but the papers are easy (3 pages and you talk about yourself). Attendance is mandatory, but it's worth it. You don't have an actual textbook, but a book of all his slides that you fill in during class. He isn't afraid to curse and poke fun at people.

Class lectures are interesting and I always look forward to going. However,when it comes to his test it is all fill in the blank like such as list these 7 things & explain. It may seem easy but he grades really hard. Thought I did well on my 1st test & failed. Had to drop the class.
AWESOME!

Good at teaching and presenting to the class. He is interesting and keeps you listening. However, when you approach him for help with the exams he is rude and not helpful. He can be a real jerk when you talk to him one on one for help with anything.

Desantis is pretty cool. The only challenge about his class is that there is a lot of information to know. Gives great study guides, class is very entertaining. He can be a little rude to people who show up late, texters, or talkers. Yes he teaches 300 people classes but he will catch you. Ive seen it happen. Overall cool teacher best for com101.

He teaches incorrect info by twisting studies to fit his lectures and the point he wants to make. He favors girls who spread their legs, frat and sorority kids. He tries to live his life vicariously through his students. He yells at his TA's in front of 300 person lectures and even hit a water bottle out of a students hand during lecture

Really fun professor. Very engaging lecturer and is obviously enthusiastic about his subject. Some may not enjoy his humor. His tests are straight memorization and he tells you pretty much exactly what to expect. The only real challenge you'll face may be the three papers you'll write throughout the course.
If you don't like having fun, you probably wont like this class. great humor, he loves teaching this subject.
TA's do all the work. Wear a low-cut shirt and he'll like you a lot. Pretty "hands on" with his female TA's, if you know what I mean. Generally pretty easy.
He's really entertaining. It's one of the only classes I actually enjoy going to. Lectures are far from boring.

The information gained in this class is valuable, and as long as you take notes you will be fine. The tests are blank, so you fill in all the details which can be tricky without studying. His teaching style is kind of a pain because he's so arrogant, but it only lasts for a semester so it's forgivable.

I loved this class! yeah, he is a little bit arrogant...but he's still a great teacher and very entertaining. He makes the material interesting and easy to understand. His tests are very hard, but its possible to get an A as long as you know the material. I would absolutely recommend this class.

WORST CLASS EVER! This man just gets up there and teaches a bunch of BS.  None of his facts are right and he has a very clear liberal/atheistic agenda.  He treats frat kids, athletes, and females like gods.  This guy is a ****!

DeSantis is pretty great. His lecture style is very engaging. He injects a lot of humor into the lectures, and none of the assignments are especially difficult. All you really need to be concerned with is memorizing a lot for each exam, and you'll be fine.

As a class, it is very straightforward and easy.  The tests clearly reflect what was taught.  As a prof, he cares about how funny he is.  If you're humor isn't that of a second grade boy, you won't appreciate it.  Impossible to contact, sends you straight to the TA

Kind of a tool but it's an easy A. Only need to study a few nights prior but once you have it you are golden for the exams. Class is somewhat interesting b/c of his examples but he is kind of a frat guy loudmouth. Easy tho (that's whats important anyway)

He made class enjoyable.  The tests are purely memorization, but the information is retained should you go to class.  His lessons are full of examples that fit into all of our lives, which helps learn the material.  His essay/papers are really pointless since he makes it so easy to understand. I'd say he's one of the best.

If Greek life, drinking at Two Keys, and slapstick humor aren't for you, then neither is this class. The test is all memorization, and you retain absolutely nothing after you've regurgitated it for the exam. He cares ten times more about his reputation as a "cool" professor than he does his students, or his so-called intelligence for that matter.

Desantis is, in a nutshell, a glorified frat boy.  If you have a mind of your own, the class will make you want to take a power drill to your temple.  I wrote one of the papers in 15 minutes and got a 96, but if you don't memorize the test EXACTLY, then you wont do well.  He's a weasel.  And his jokes make me want to punch small children.  HATED it

Extremely funny.  Cusses a bit, but uses them responsibly and not too rough.  He makes the class extremely fun and entertaining.  You'll need to know essentially everything from the slides, and on the short answer, you'll need to be extremely precise if you want to get a good grade.  Loved him as a teacher!

You must memorize quite a bit for his tests. Once or twice, some of the things he said seemed TOO personal for a class of people he didn't know, it made me feel uncomfortable and seemed like unnecessary info, but I will admit that the class was probably more fun than it would have been with a different professor. I took his course in Spring 08.
awesome
Definitely recommended. This class is awesome.

Such an easy class if you're good at memorizing lots of info.  Desantis is incredibly rude in person, though he may come off as funny in class.  Probably one of the most useless teachers I've had, the TA's do all the work.  If you're in a frat or sorority, take it because you'll like Desantis.  If you're a minority, spare yourself the frustration.
Memorizing a movie script is equally studying for the exams but they are easy.

Very interesting teacher and fun class! Its for sure not an easy A but if you study you do good on the tests. The comments saying its a hard class and desantis is a jerk are the people who probably dont study and got a F!

I liked his class. He's a great teacher and it's evident he really loves what he does. He cracks jokes quite often and brings in personal life into lectures, which I really thought was cool. Not gonna lie, though, the tests are tough: straight memorization of his slideshows. I would recommend him and I wish I could take him again.
His TAs do all the work. He just lectures. Sometimes he is interesting, but most of the time he is just vulgar and immature. He is obsessed with himself.

test are strictly memorization! have to remember long list and must be able to explain list the way TA wants, papers the same way easy but all depends on TA, persuaded him to regrade my test and one grade higher in the class...have to go to class he takes attendance...sucker for sorority/fraternity people

He is a really nice guy and all but his tests are ridiculous! You have to memorize everything!! Make up exams are impossible if you are not a good studier! Loved him as a person but hard as a teacher.

Dr. DeSantis is an extremely intelligent professor who is very passionate about his career and the students.  I learned a great deal from his throughout my years at UK.  Sometimes he comes off a little cocky which makes it difficult to talk to him one on one but overall he's a really nice, fair guy.  I would definitely recommend his courses!

This professor teaches topics that touches most of daily life, from relationships to why groups are behaving the way they do. I feel as if I could use his theory and apply to my daily life, but when it comes to test, it is DIFFICULT. So, study hard, REALLY hard.

Dr. DeSantis is a nice professor, teaches well and thoroughly, and his lectures are interesting but his exams are really hard. Your expected to know everything he's ever said in class and respond to test questions in split second time or you probably wont finish the exam. I feel like his exams require more explaination than there is time to give.
AWESOME!!

uh this class is absolutely useless. It's really easy, but I get the feeling Desantis is trying to recapture something from his youth. Professor is annoying to the point you don't even want to go. Tests are all memorization and straightforward. One of my least favorite classes. Very deceiving class. Doesn't care about students so go to TAs for help
Dr. DeSantis is an excellent professor who teaches very effectively and keeps things fun and entertaining day to day.

I got a 100% in this class. He gives you the notes in a fill in the blank binder. Take notes in class, then make a study guide from what he tells you will be on the test. (Yes, he spells it out clearly a couple of days before.) Then straight up memorize your study guide. He's not going to help outside of class, but there is really no reason for it.

I saw him creeping on some younger girls at Two Keys.  Just thought that I should throw that in there.  Other than that, he's a pretty cool guy.  The class was kind of fun, but after a while you get this feeling that he's really immature.

Not helpful in the least bit, directs you to the TA's. pretends like his class is easy, its not. test are ALL fill-in. If you cram ALL the notes youll b fine. He's kind of rude/ slighty disrespectful. His class is hilarious but he does get on your nerves alot. Talks about ethnicities and genders ALOT. To the point where its uncomfortable/annoying.

Go to class, pay attention, memorize, get an A.   That truly is the formula.  You may stay up all night (not an exaggeration) to study for his tests, but as long as you know it, you CAN get an A in the class.  You'll probably get a high B on the paper (seems to be consistent).  I didn't need to see the TAs for anything. It is easy, just takes time.

Desantis is deceiving, you think he will be easy, you hear he will be easy, but you'll get a surprise if you take this for granted. Attendence is manditory or you get 2.5% off of the final grade for every class you miss. Go see your TA, they know how to narrow your study guide to main points. Go to their office hours often, or As are hard to get.

Seems to be a cool guy, but I didn't think he was all that approachable like he claims to be. The material is easy, but the written exams are difficult if you don't study the right things. TAs do everything, so make sure to get in good with them.
Interesting class... material is easy but his test are not.  If you spend plenty of time memorizing then you'll be fine... if you are better at explaining than memorizing = might be tough.
as a teacher he's okay, but i found his personality extremely grating which made it difficult to focus on the material rather than his antics. he drove me crazy.
Good class, energetic teacher.  These are large classes so the TA's are responsible for a lot.
his lectures are incredibly biased and he tries to force his left wing political views on his students.
This class is great, i love the material and the way that it is presented. The only down side is that he doesn't really care about his students, his TAs do EVERYTHING!

by far one of the most interesting and fun teachers i have ever had. you have to go to class, but you will want to anyway. tests are all memorizing the lists in his notes and being able to describe concepts (tests are entirely writing). grade is made up of 3 tests & 3 papers, each 3 pages long. poor attendance can lower your grade. definitely take!

When he teaches, he tries to make the material interesting for students, which is a lot more than most profs do.  I was entertained and learned a lot.  Tests were easy if you put in the work to memorize.  Some ppl think he's a tool, I strongly disagree.
I loved this class. Always interesting. It was a MWF class but I didn't care to go to class on Friday!
Keeps the class fun and gets your attention. DEFF recommend it for an easy A. Just go to class and memorize all the powerpoint and you have an A.

At first his class is fun but he gets old fast. He trys to act like he is young. He doesnt give a crap about his students. The ta's do everything i feel sorry for them. Overall it is a good class and is very easy!

He's an amazing teacher! During class he's hilarious and down to earth, making the material easy to understand. When it comes to his test, they are VERY straight foward. Memorize the notes you've taken in class (which are on powerpoints) and you're golden.
Excellent teaching ability. Uses examples that students can relate with or from his own personal life. Very funny. Wonderful professor.
he is pretty crazy but was able to hold my attention really well.  you just need to memorize like crazy for the tests... mostly lists!
easiest class ive had at uk...go to class, and exams are straight from the book...easy A, and pretty interesting stuff too
He is hilarious ! GREAT TEACHER !

Amazing professor! easy class came out with 98% for the semester. his grading isnt hard either? so i dont know why people wrote that. you dont need to pull all nighters if you write down the notes you know the material. papers are easy too. and the TA's dont grade bad. you just write what they ask for and you get an A. DeSantis makes the class fun!

Dr. D was cool teacher. I enjoyed his lectures and his class confirmed my interest in Com. His TA's are terrible though. You really have to fight hard for points on papers and tests. They aren't unreasonable, but a little high-strung. There is a reason he's always the favorite prof on campus... Take his course... at least for the USP credits.

Fun class. The tests are all memorization, mostly lists. TA's do all the grading, and usually a poor job. Most papers are skimmed over, make sure you meet up with them to reclaim points they take off for no reason.
It was a fun class, but he is kind of a tool.  Enjoyed it, and tests are memorization so it isn't too hard

You're right, he is a tool, but anyone who says his class "really is hard" should get out of college.  Easiest A ever.  You'll spend time on this class 3 times a year.  Pull an all nighter studying for the test and you're golden, it's all memorization.  Take him, it's an interesting class.

An academic poser with no discernable talent, DeSantis is  an unreconstructed frat boy who has adopted the mush-headed lingo of "post-modernism" to cover his own intellectual bankruptcy. Baller!

DeSantis is a great teacher and really made me interested in this field.  However I wasnt as into the class when he had a sub.  He's extremely funny and the tests are basically memorizing lists. Take this course!
He is a great professor, and makes it actually fun and interesting to go to class!  His tests are clearly laid out, and are based on memorization!

DeSantis is the MAN!!! You will actually want to go to this class... He is probably the best professor on the campus. He talks like a kid and supports the college lifestyle. Class is really easy if you apply yourself.. you have 3 exams and 3 3-page papers, not bad
He makes me want to come to class because he is very entertaining and enthusiastic about what he teaches. It takes time to memorize lists but overall a very good class.
Great professor with lots of energy and interesting material.  The tests require lots of memorization but are not too difficult.  Take this class!
Great professor. Very enthusiastic and energetic. Keeps you entertained. Has his lecture down to an art. Perfect powerpoint slides. Tests are all fill in the blank.
fab!
Great teacher and brother. His class woke me up to a few of his subjects. Exams take lots of time to memorize lists
The best teacher ever!!!
I loved this class! Amazing professor!!!

He is probably the best teacher I've had at UK.  Very entertaining and fun.  He gives his TA's too much responsibility. They grade everything and give zero feedback as to why they gave you the grade they did.

Desantis keeps your attention the entire class period. He's funny, engaging, but requires you to exercise your mind. I actually look forward to going to class; I know I'll learn something interesting in a fun environment.
Desantis is wonderful!  He's so energetic and it's a fun class to be in... and as long as you memorize every thing the tests are really easy!
Very easy class.  It's a lot of memorizing but still a very easy A

Dr.Desantis is a hoot.. his class is fun and He's italian... that's pretty much the most important thing.. the only drawlback is the fact that his tests are hard to study for.. there is alot of information and you don't know what to study.. it's a guessin' game.. he relies on his TA's tooo much!

very fun and exciting teacher.  makes you want to come to class.  the first test seems like a killer, but all you have to do is memorize lists...seriously, that's all,  and the 2 sections are at 10, and 11 AM, so on the friday morning classes you won't be that hungover compared to an 8 o'clock
its no wonder why he was rated best teacher like 3 years in a row!! he is gorgeous not to mention!! desantis is absolutely hilarious I loved going to class
Alan is extremely energetic, and he really kept my attention! The class is really interesting. Oh and one more important thing, he's really hot.

so much fun, i wish i could take it again, class is realy easy, and tests are always based on the lists from lecture and the open response is from the paper assignments, thank god there is a great teacher in the world

he is the most amazing teacher in the world.  everyone should take this class - if you don't, you're stupid.  anyone who thinks he's no cool is a moron.  plus, he's one of the sexiest men alive. =)

this is the greatest class BY FAR at Kentucky. I got a 99% on the first test and a 98% on the first paper. ALL you have to do is study the list and it's an easy A. Plus he has a greay sense of humor and it'c a class you'll look forward to going to!

Good teacher- energetic- but his class is a lot harder than everyone says it is- you WILL have to study for tests and actually write good papers. but still take it- for sure. it's like sesame street for college kids on crack.

One of my favorite professors yet. The class was kind've tough and  he has an annoying attendance policy fora class or 250 people, but a good time. He always picked on this Polish kid which was hilarious!

Desantis was on amphetamines half of the time which made class very interesting to attend. his enthusiasm is unrivaled in the school as is his devotion to the greek cult system. his class was easy and fun but at times he seemed to be trying a little hard to impress us

very engaging class, he's very enthusiastic

Loved the class! Had it a couple of years ago and am still talking about how much I enjoyed it.  His teaching style keeps your attention, and there are virtually no suprises on the tests.

This class wakes you up in the morning and flys by.  The tests are only hard if you don't study.  He is straight foward and teaches "the way he wishes he'd been taught"--Very Interesting and recommend taking
This class is very interesting.  Professor Desantis is hilarious and makes the time fly by. He also plays music and isn't bad to look at either!

The best class ever! Makes me want to come to class! His lectures keep you interested. He wants you to enjoy the class so he makes it fun! I would highly recommend taking it if you get the chance!

David Atwood is a great person with a lot of experience under his belt in chemistry, as for teaching - that is another story. He tends to go off on tangents about his personal life as well as other sections he is teaching. He doesn't get through the slides efficiently as I hoped he would, and his exam study templates are messy and hard to navigate.

I have taken 104 and 108 with this man, and he's singlehandedly reinforced my belief that there is no god. I got an A in 104 through studying to insanity frequently. This time though? It's over. I have an A right now and I can no longer bear to protect it. He is a nice guy, but there's a great evil within. He says so much yet so little in lectures.

Professor Atwood is so kind and you can tell that he really cares about his students. However, he is a not a good teacher. I have had him for 2 semesters and learned absolutely nothing. There are no practice problems during class and what he does write down is hard to understand and follow. The exams are hard because I'm having to teach myself.

Professor Atwood is a very kind man. In class, he mainly talks about what will be on the test, but he doesn't always teach the material clearly. You can tell he wants his students to succeed though and is very flexible with due dates.

I personally loved his class. Yes, lectures were boring but he was very clear what was on the exams. Overall a great guy and good teacher, would absolutely recommend for non science majors for his chem 101 section!

Terrible professor, one of the worst I have had. Does not teach and acts like everything is common sense. Never lectured correctly and when he did he babbled on about random topics and would go off on tangents. Slides were also never condensed, extremely long and made no sense

I loved Atwood honestly. I know some people do not like his lecture style, so if you are used to the backward classroom style that is NOT what he does. It is a standard lecture. So unfortunate, but reading the book before classes really did help. I think he is a good prof, the course itself just sucks. Go to office hours and read the book!

Everyone I knew in Prof. Atwoods class struggled with the hw. I read the book and watched his lectures and it was very difficult. He is a very very nice guy. I loved him as a person. Watch Professor Woodrum's online lectures and study the old released exams and you will succeed in this class.

He's almost too smart and because of that has no idea how to break down CHE107 concepts. If he's your professor, just watch woodrum's videos in class.
Terrible he talks about stuff that doesn't even matter, I've learned nothing.
Do not take this professor. He does not teach in class and just points at random stuff.

He just kind of quickly goes through the concepts and doesn't do much practice in class. He also does not understand how to use iClicker and if you have a problem, he'll tell you to email him but rarely responds. Don't take
Would not take again. Expects you to already know a lot of things and doesn't teach.

I didn't see a tag for CHE 107, but AVOID at all costs. He does not provide any lectures and just rambles during class (mostly about useless subjects). Students in his class are forced to watched another lecturer's lectures to get by, which is not enough. There is no supplemental learning, you are just thrown to the wolves. You will fail with him.

Dr. Atwood is a very sweet guy. That being said, he is not a good teacher. He is so smart that he cannot dumb it down for an introductory class. In addition, he often said that "we probably remember this from high school", which meant that he was not going to teach the basics. Get ready to teach yourself. The book helps. Tests are awful

The CHE 105 course at UKY is an absolute nightmare. The homework assigned is a complete waste of time, as it has absolutely no bearing on your final grade. Exams are worth a staggering 51% of the final grade, with the final exam being worth an additional 22%, is completely ridiculous. Professor always went on about pointless stories, wasting time.

Goes on tangents quite often. He is a genius, but can't translate basic ideas for us non-professionals to understand. Can be funny, but the monotone-ish voice makes sure his jokes aren't usually successful. Be sure to read the textbook and try to watch other classes' Playposits. It will take a lot of time outside of class.

Atwood is brilliant, but so brilliant he doesn't know how to dumb it down and teach a gen chem class. He is quite nice and funny, but can't teach. I learned more from his very frequent tangents about random things like dog sledding than i did chemistry. Your friends with other professors will save you. He was very out of the know. Read the book.
Terrible. Just no. Literally dont do this to yourself.

Dr. Atwood spends more time telling jokes that usually arent funny than teaching. When he is teaching, he rambles on about random chem stuff that could have no relation to what we are supposed to be learning. I want to clarify here that I have never had Dr. Atwood for a lecture. He was the professor in charge of my CHE 395 research lab. Loved him. Dr.Atwood made class optional, and it was supposed to be inorganic but a lot of the material was just a gen chem review. All the tests, hw, and final were online so google became your best friend. Such an easy class.

David is one of those teachers who can get a really good feel for the class and shape it to the strengths of that class.  He's incredibly busy all the time but still manages to come up with an excellent class. atwood is a sweet heart and very funny...he will be cool and help if you dont understand. always open and sooooo down to earth...only senior in this freshman class so its kinda sad

The lectures are boring and not interesting, there's a lot of homework and non-sense work, the class is easy but try to pick other instructor.

His teaching style was all over the place. He would try to make jokes but no one really laughed at them. There is a group project that counts towards your final grade and there are multiple essays with rough drafts too. He was super chill but didn't seem like he was organized.

his lectures are confusing and all over the place. He tries to be funny but he comes out as unprepared. He is nice enough but just overall very confusing grading and you never know what grade you are going to get.
He is very nice, but he doesn't teach or explain what he wants done in projects. Not very organized, lectures and discussions can be al over the place.

This class was incredibly helpful to what I do today as a music educator.

He is probably the worst band director I've ever had. He's very rude to most people in the band. If you're not 1. a music major 2. over 21 years old or 3 a trumpet player, he doesn't care about you. Expects students to show up, do their best, and be responsible. Does not tolerate hazing and will remove anything from the program that resembles hazing, even if it is a "tradition". If you want to be in a band that acts stupid and embarrasses the university go somewhere else. Atchison has made a respectable band that the university is proud of.

Where to start? Atchison has taken out alot of band traditions. He always seems nice at first but being around him you see he has a temper. I want to like him as a teacher so badly, but he is just unforgivably rude 98% of the time. Not very understanding, and really doesn't pay attention to you if he doesn't consider you worth his time. Band sucks.

Atchison is a good director. He has little patience for people who are lazy or who don't listen to instructions, but he is good. He is knowledgeable and helpful if you ask for it. He is demanding though. If you are lazy, you will not like his classes.

Atchison is a great band director. he's very strict, but not as bad as my high school director. he's strict because he cares. if he let us slack off we wouldn't be a good band at all. I love marching/pep band here.

Atchison is a great Band Director. I was very excited to join the Wildcat Marching Band when I came to UK.  He can be rude sometimes but just pay attention and you'll love his class. He is a great teacher.
point-blank, he made me hate marching band. it was something I loved before.
Atchison is a good teacher. He can seem a bit harsh sometimes, but the overall band experience here is a good one.

Atchinson is one of the worst people I have ever met in my life. He is just so rude and degrading to everyone, and will make you feel awful and stupid. I love music so much, and I wish I loved band here, but he makes it awful. I think he has good intentions but he teaches in such a rude, terrible way. Killed college band for me. Don't do band here.

Atchison is a wonderful band director and he loves what he does. The only way to get on his bad side would be by being intentionally late or not following instructions. Marching band is not a hard course and it is extremely fun!

This man was a terrible teacher. He simply yells at students all the time, is very degrading. He intimidates students and name drops every chance he can get. I would never recommend being in the Marching Band at UK. He never really teaches, just constantly degrades students in order to "play better". You will not enjoy being under his direction.
Athena was awesome! Learned a lot and a good grader. She's an awesome person!

Athena is great! She does a great job making the material interesting. Her readings and movies are interesting and relate to the content of the class. She is easy to reach out to and very understanding. I would totally take any class she taught.

Athena is probably the best professor I've ever had. She isn't a push over, but she relates to us. If we genuinely ask her for something and she knows we mean it, she will consider it and come around. Everyone really likes her, and no one has anything bad to say about her. She puts a lot of time and effort into the class everyday. Love her.
She is an awesome teacher!!She explains things very well and makes class fun!I highly recommend this class, but it is not an easy A you have to work at it. She is very lenient and understanding too!
Best professor I've ever had! And I'm a senior, so that's saying a lot. Extremely nice and helpful. Take her classes if you can!
She's fun, but can be pretty hard...

Attend class and you will definately get an A.  Doesn't have to work hard or anything but not going to class will affect the quiz and the attendence score
She gets better after JPN 101. You will have to work but getting an A is not as difficult, and the quizzes are easier.
Sajiki-sensei is amazing!  It's not an easy A, you have to work for it, but it's a very fun class!  I can't wait for 102!

Sajiki is an amazing teacher. If you are having problems she goes out of her way to explain things, and she is so cute! One of my favorite professors ever!
Charming with a good sense of humor. She'll make you work hard, but you shouldn't sign up for a Japanese class if you're looking for an easy A.

Sajiki is a little more difficult than any of the other professors in the Department thus far.  She speaks very quickly since she is a native speaker.  She is always good for a laugh though.  You have to work in her class to get an A - but then again you do in most Japanese Language classes anyway

reviews.comment: Great professor. He's funny. You need to do your work before the due date or you wont pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: very sarcastic and will not let you do the minimum to pass the class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. archer receives a lot of sh*t on this page but truly is great. YES, you need to go to lecture and study, but this is just like any other college class....??? He is very nice and understanding. He goes out of his way to help students that need it. He is very approachable. The class is very interesting and he is a GREAT PROFESSOR. u can get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is a very hard teacher. His tests are pretty difficult, not impossible but difficult. There are a lot of little quizzes and assignments that can be frustrating. He is a very good lecturer however and his classes are very engaging. I enjoy lecture but wish he had echo or at least put the slides online. Overall difficult but good teacher.

Contrary to the things everyone says about Dr. Archer, he is an AWESOME teacher! I took his PSY100 class my freshman year. He makes you work for your grade, but he also makes sure you know the material very well and feel fully prepared for his exams and the way they will be worded. If you do bad on the exams, you didn't make use of his material

If you are not a good test taker, do NOT take him. Almost all assignments are quiz's and Exams. There are a few projects and labs are very helpful. I love archer as a person and I think he is a really good lecturer, but the exams are very difficult, at least for bad test takers.

While Dr. Archer is a nice guy he expects WAY TOO MUCH out of an intro class. The tests are SUPER hard & you don't get them back to know what you missed. The homework assignments take forever and are only worth 10 points. There are also quizzes and lab (online and in-seat). The textbook cost me $150 including online code for lab. Don't do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Terrible professor. I actually enjoyed his lectures until I missed a class for a tragedy that left a family friend in critical condition. He wouldn't let me make up a heavily weighted assignment. He was extremely rude and showed no compassion towards me during this hard time. Do NOT take him!
Dr. Archer is a great professor. He really cares about his students. The class is a lot of work, but the work that you do isn't extremely difficult. If you put in the time, you will get a fair grade.

Dr. Archer is a really good professor. However, if you don't go to class, you miss a lot. He does not post the slideshow online so it is most beneficial if you go to class. His tests are harder, but if you work for the grade, you will get it. He's a really good teacher.

Dr. Archer is a great professor! He always keeps lecture interesting and gives great examples to go with the material.  But, he is definitely the toughest PSY 100 teacher! Tests can be difficult if you don't take good notes because all of the questions are very applied.  But as long as you pay attention and take notes, I would recommend him!

This is one of the hardest classes I've taken. He takes this class so serious and makes it way harder than it has to be. He does drop the lowest quiz grades, but the exams are so much harder than the quizzes. Avoid him if possible!!!

He has clear powerpoints that he goes over, but he will go in depth on them, so you must pay attention because sometimes he will put it on the test. His tests are pretty hard, but he gives out a study guide, so as long as you study you'll be good. I rented the textbook  for this and never cracked it open. Very nice professor had him for 2 semester

I didn't learn much from Dr. Archer. He wasn't my cup of tea. With over 400 students though, it is harder to get the class to engage. In my opinion, I would find someone else for this class if you find it hard to take notes from slides with no connection to understand the material.

Dr. Archer is a great teacher. He makes sure you get the grade that you work for. Come to class ready to take notes and listen to his cool stories! He challenges you, so if you can't take it, don't sign up for him.

awful awful awful, hes a nice person but he takes it way too seriously, my organic wasnt as challenging as this 100 level ELECTIVE! he makes the exams and quizes was too detailed and he covers way too much info and expects you to know ALL of it even things he didnt talk about but are in the book. AWFUL

I took AP Psych in high school and thought Archer's class would be an easy A. Wrong. He's a tough tester and quiz giver. My TA even thought they were hard for our level. There are study guides but they're long. They help a lot. Also attendance matters even in a lecture as big as 200 students. He's pretty funny at times and isn't awful to listen to.

I really enjoyed this class!  Dr. Archer lectures a lot, but his lectures are extremely interesting, especially for being in a large class in Memorial Hall.  The tests and quizzes are tough, but he gives good study guides before each exam.  Doing the study guides helps a lot.  Be sure to find a good study group for this class!

I took archer for Psych 100 and I was up to my elbows in work. My final exam study guide was 20 pages, if that says anything. The worst part is that he never returns your tests, so you can't see what you missed to learn from it. He takes attendance every class as well. There are easier professors to take, don't take him.

He can be funny at times, but his lectures are pretty long and boring. He has multiple tests and quizzes throughout the semester and they are VERY difficult. I studied for his tests, felt like I did well, and when I got my grades back I saw that I wasn't doing so well. He is nice but overall I WOULD NOT recommend taking him. Get someone else!

Professor Archer is a stickler for the rules. He is very touchy about APA style citations and will take immediate disciplinary action if you plagiarize ,even if it is by accident. If you put in a little effort his class is not very challenge. His test are slightly tough.

Attendance is absolutely mandatory. Tests are all about the notes you take and a bit from the book. He tries to tell funny stories to make the class more fun but it's still long. The tests are very hard, so study as hard as you can.

hardest class as a freshman. attendance is mandatory and WILL affect your grade. notes arent posted so you have to go unless you solely rely on the book for test. test/quizzes are hard and most of the questions test your ability to comprehend terms, not just kno the definition. projects also hard and take 1-2 hours when they're only worth 10 points
Went to office hours to go over my test and I was in there for 5 minutes total. All he said was for my to write the note and to come to class
He's really into what he does, but the class is kinda long and sometimes boring.  The tests and quizzes aren't too bad, but there are always a few questions that are pretty tough
Gives good lectures

For a 100 level class, this class was tough. He tells you at the beginning of the semester that you have to work for an A and he isn't lying. You HAVE to go to class, take notes, read the book, and study. On the projects you have to really put forth the effort and think about what you're writing. It has been way more work than I expected.
The class has a lot of material.  Go to class and take notes.  He gives study guides that really help for the tests. The book is very helpful.

Dr. Archer is funny and his classes are generally interesting for a lecture class. You have to go to lecture! He posts his PowerPoints online but they're just the highlights and don't give much info. Most of the info you need to understand and for the  tests come from him talking so take good notes. Tests are kinda hard. Look at the study guides!
The class material is difficult. I guess that's why people are hesitant with it, but if you ask, then Dr. Archer will definitely help you out.

Dr. Archer has been very reasonable. I had to miss aprox. 5 classes due to a serious illness. Class is super interesting, must study about 3 to 4 hours a wk., start studying for the exam immediately. Tests include about 70 multiple choice, short answer, 4-5 essays and one paper due. Attendance is critical. Offered extra credit.

Dr. Archer's Personality Psychology class is not for the faint of heart, it is a class where you will work for your grade. Dr. Archer is a kind man with great teaching ability, but one of the hardest  graders I have encountered at UK. Go to class, Study, and Expect to put in work!!

Dr. Archer's tests were a little hard, I must say. You must attend all of his lectures (you will receive an attendance grade at the end of the semester). He gives the students a sheet to pass around to sign every lecture. Great teacher. He gave me the challenge I wanted. Just come to his lectures and pay close attention and you'll be fine.

Dr. Archer was terrible. I had another psychology class with Freidrich and it was so much better. Archer's test are significantly harder and his study guides are significantly worse. Take Golding or Friedrich.

Dr. Archer is a great professor! He's very clear and detailed in his lectures. You are expected to actually know the material, and be able to apply it. Tests were usually 80 points mc (two points a question) and the rest was short answer. He's very helpful, more than willing to meet with you to discuss material, and makes the class fun!

I hated my life everyday that I had to attend his lecture.  seriously.  Yes, he knows his stuff, but he likes to make simple concepts hard.  His exams are extremely hard, although he does give you a 100+ item study guide that you have to fill out.  Exams are 50 MC and 10 Short answer.  Take anyone besides him!! You'll thank me later...

I've taken him a few times and earned an A for every class. He gives you a study guide over a week before the test and if you know that the test is cake. A lot of his answers are even word for word from the lecturebook. 216 (stats) is a hard class but he lets you have a note card as a cheat sheet and is very open to help.

Dr. Archer is a great professor and is very nice and helpful. Class was somewhat easy but does require some studying and reading. I thought he was awesome and I would take him again. I recommend him as I think he is one of the better psychology professors I've had. You can tell her genuinely cares about his students and their success in the course.

Archer was a very nice guy. Make sure you get a nice seat with the least amount of distractions- Considering, it almost impossible to pass his class without his examples to the definitions. His attendance is mandatory. Got more responses via e-mail from his than the TA.

Very good teacher but his attendence policy is passing around a piece of paper and expected 300 something people to sign it. Learned a lot but you in order to pass you have to know examples of the definitions. Test are hard but if you truely know what the term is and not memorization you will be fine.

Dr. archers lecture is very interesting and you will learn if you just pay attention.  Has some work you have to do in semester but keeps lecture very interesting and funny he knows the subject extremely well.

Yes this guy is tough, but he knows his stuff. An A would be hard to get in his class, however after taking him i felt much more confident in my knowledge of psychology in general. i barely ever used the book and got mostly B's on tests and quizzes, just took detailed notes in class. You must actually study!. attendence mandatory. enjoyed the class

I came into this class expecting an interesting class that wasn't an overload of work. Dr. Archer said on the first day of class, "You will almost certainly no get an A in this class, and you're going to have to work extremely hard for a B." I should have dropped there. Archer's test are very hard and his lecture was boring. Do not take this class!

Dr. Archer is a likable guy. His lectures are pretty easy to follow. If you go to class, take notes, and read the chapters an A is no problem. It is a lot of work though. I had to start studying at least a week before each exam. I have heard the other professors for this course were much easier.

He can be funny at times but talks about himself way too much. Lectures are boring most of the days except if the topic is interesting for the day. Tests can be hard with little studying but when you put the time in they are fairly easy. An A isn't handed to you but very doable. He's definitely willing to work with you and make sure you understand

Dr. Archer isn't a terrible professor, but I really didn't like going to his class. His lectures basically put me to sleep which was a problem because if you didn't pay attention in lecture and read the book extensively, you'd struggle hard on the exams. Exams are multiple choice and short answer/essay so you have to know the material very well.
His exams are very difficult and are over lecture plus more. He goes pretty fast. The final is cumulative and a lot to study. Avoid this class. I know I wish I did.
The class isn't terrible but Dr. Archer is boring and attendance is mandatory...I learned the hard way. The notes don't correspond to the book. The test are kind of hard.
Dr. Archer is a great teacher. Attendance is mandatory and graded and tests require a lot of studying but if you do the work it is easy to get an A.

Very hard to pay attention in class, boring lectures. Projects assigned are very easy. Tests are VERY hard. Make sure you know everything he talked about in lecture (+more) and know very in depth explanations for everything. Amount of content on study guide is almost unmanageable, so study for exams as early as two weeks before.
He is really hard , DO NOT CHOOSE THIS PROF. Enroll in the other class with the other prof.Dr Archer is not helpful, His Assistant teachers have no ideas about the assignments.

Dr Archer's class is very difficult, in a good way. He makes sure you learn the material and really understand it. He tries to add entertainment to his lectures but sometimes it is just not possible. He is very helpful when you seek help. Tests are hard but the study guides prep you well.

Dr.Archer is super hard, but he is an EXTREMELY good teacher. You will truly learn the subject material if you take any of his classes. He gives study guides for every test..his tests are very hard, but the study guides are very good. Do not take his class if you do not study or are lazy. For real.

You must attend class, Archer was at times hilarious and interesting to listen to. The test are somewhat hard, so you need to study quite a bit. If you had AP Psychology in high school, this class basically teaches the same content

he will warn you on the first day that it's hard to get an A in his class. he expects a lot from you. unlike other professors who just want you to know what something is, archer wants you to know how and why. he will help you as much as you need, but you HAVE to go talk to him. he can't read your mind. takes attendance, go to class.

Really hard teacher, especially in this class. Doesn't give out the homework on time so you don't have the whole time he should give. Went to him for help... still failed the exam.. A lot of work for this teacher.
Didn't really enjoy him as a person, but it was not bad.  Easily got an A after he warned the class that receiving an A would be very difficult.  Must go to class to get a good grade.
Archer is a great professor...can easily get an entire class of 300 people laughing. Attendance is a must for this class. None of the work is hard if you listen to lecture and take good notes.

I looooooved Archer. If you read the text book , pay attention in class , and complete the study guides you could very easily get an A or B. Archer is the type in which if you have a problem with anything with the class you must address him. He can't read your mind , no professor can , so don't be afraid to speak up!

Interesting class, good professor! He's very funny and gives good examples of concepts, but you need to write them down because they aren't on the powerpoints.  Gives study guides which are helpful for exams. Study and read the material and you'll be fine!

I found his class kind of boring. He's not a terrible professor, but I didn't like going to his class at all. Not sure why. That being said, it was pretty easy and as long as you go to class to take notes and study, you can get an A. There are multiple choice tests as well as a few papers. More work than your average big lecture class.

Terrible professor!! Lectures are extremely boring but easy to follow and attendance is mandatory for participation credit. Gives a study guide before exams but has nothing from the exam on it. Exams are hard and include lots of detail thats irrelevant to the chapters being tested. Avoid him if at all possible!!

Seems like a nice guy but next to impossible to follow. He gives out a study guide before each exam, which conveniently has nothing from the study guide on it. If you study extremely hard you'll be lucky to get a 70%. The quizzes and projects are easy if you pay attention, take notes, & study. The tests are what get you.

Interesting and funny. Looked forward to his class. Never once tempted to get on facebook during class. Would take him again in a heartbeat! Tests are moderately difficult but he gives a clear study guide so there is no excuse to get less than an A/B except laziness.
If you go to class and pay attention, you'll be fine.

He's such a great lecturer. He provides many examples during class that are easy to relate. So it makes understanding the material much easier. He's funny and makes class enjoyable. You basically have to write down everything he says because the PP slides just outline. Would take him again in a heartbeat.
His final is cummulative, so you have this massive review to look over.(~6 pages). Read the book. He's goes really quick in class. I'd avoid this professor if you can help it.

He sends around a sheet for people to sign in on for attendance, with your section number. And if you forget that section number he takes off points. You have 5 projects to do, which he only gives you 3 or 4 days to do. You also have research hours and lab. 4 quizzes, 4 exams. He drops the lowest quiz grade.

He was a good professor who made class funny.  His tests were a little difficult but not extremely difficult if you knew what you were talking about.  I got a 101 on one test so they aren't that hard.  The tests consist of multiple choice short answer and essays. He requires you to go to class. Overall I liked the course.

Definitely one of the easier 100 professors. As long as you go to class, take notes, and study, you will be fine. While it is annoying to have a paper due the day of a test, it's only worth 10 points and they aren't strict on grading it. The lab is also pretty easy.
He did a good job keeping my attention.  Quizzes and tests weren't to hard.  As long as you put in the study time you will get a good grade.  Wasn't very flexible if you missed class thou

He is a power hungry, controlling, professor who thinks his class is all that matters. He doesn't believe that we have any other classes to worry about and thinks his 100 level class should be our #1 priority. He assigns papers due on the same day of tests one week before the test. Don't take this class if you can avoid it.
She's a good professor! Attendance isn't mandatory, but she does have participation activities for each class. Her exams are online and open note. I definitely recommend taking her class.
Good professor

Dr.Samson is amazing. Very enjoyable class to go to, attendance is required, but is very understanding if you are sick, just provide a doctor's note. Exams are take-home and open-note. You will also have a very lovely TA every now and then-she is not human and fluffy!
Take Ashley Vowels, she is super sweet and a very kind grader. She is how every teacher should be.
Very easy A with minimal effort. She's super clear about what she expects in your answers, the assignments are easy, and she's very responsive. Great choice if you want a low-stress class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Vowels' HHS 262 is an easy A as long as you put in a little effort. Stay engaged, complete the assignments, and you'll do well!

HHS 262 doesn't meet in person for majority of semester. Must complete volunteer like shifts instead. Very few lectures were given and we were expected to complete a final project in small groups. Learn a lot about UKHealthcare. No tests/exams but we did have weekly assignments asking us to respond to questions.

Loka as a professor herself is quite knowledgeable and enjoyable to listen to. The issues arise with how reading-heavy the class is, with you reading her own textbook, and also the final project. If you want anything above a 70% on the project you will need to work on it nonstop for the approximate month you have it assigned.

Dr. Ashwood is knowledgeable, but her teaching style is challenging. She over-relied on her own textbook and canceled many lectures. She seemed annoyed at student confusion and provided unclear explanations. She was slow to respond to emails and took a long time to grade exams and discussion boards. Her feedback and rubrics were also confusing.

Dr. Ashwood never provides clear or helpful answers to questions, often speaking in circles. The textbook is difficult to read and is merely repeated during lectures without any meaningful instruction. The worst class in the sociology department.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Ashwood is one of the most compassionate and caring professors I have ever taken. She is genuinely interested in each student's experience and encourages everyone to participate in class. Her class requires effort but it is very rewarding!

The material was all very interesting. I feel that I actually learned a lot about how people, the environment, and just the world all work together. I will admit there was a lot of reading, but it was not too terrible. Short paper written most weeks, but very simple and easy work if you follow the criteria. I really enjoyed Prof Ashwood and SOC360!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Ashwood is an okay professor, nothing too special. Her class is very heavy on discussion and you have to read A LOT. She wrote the textbook and the readings are insanely long, which you have one reading each week plus a 300-600 word reflection on the reading. 3 "quizzes" but they are really exams. Also, her lectures are absurd and confusing.

She assigns a lot of work and constant large projects, so be ready to put in the work. However, she is a kind woman that cares about the success of her students. She is available for help and offers good feedback on assignments. I learned a lot in her class, so I recommend her if are looking to actually learn. Not just for easy credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: Extremely harsh grader who doesn't care about what your circumstances are. Assigns a long paper, but doesn't want to take your revisions into thought when grading. Group projects consume the second half of the semester and are very tedious. If you skip, good luck passing with a good grade.

Best part about this class is that, for most, it is the first and final writing based course in college. Some of the assignments assigned by Ashleigh were initially hard to understand, however she is always there to answer any and all questions her students have. She is available to meet in office hours daily and grades fairly.

She's super sweet, but her class is excessively hard. There's a new major assignment due pretty much every week, and extremely long papers are a regular. She's very willing to help you if you ask her for it, and she will definitely be more helpful if you show effort and interest in the class.

She is a nice woman, but her class is terrible.  She grades tough and she constantly has huge assignments due every week! Try to get a different teacher for your WRD requirement if you can.  She's nice, but her horrible class isn't worth it.

It's sad that others complain about Ms. Hardin being a hard grader. Her class isn't easy, but that's the point! There are no surprises with her. She's smart and expects a lot. Only people who don't try hard have something to complain about.

So, WRD is clearly a core credit for the University of Kentucky. But if you can help it, get a different professor for this course than Ashleigh. Don't get me wrong, she's a sweet woman. However, that does not make a good teacher. She focuses on the bad rather than good, her grading is inconsistent, she changes rubrics, etc. Avoid at all costs.

Her class was very interesting. She demands a good amount of work from her students. Her grading is pretty tough but fair. I could definitely see what I messed up on my papers with her feedback. I also feel like I learned a good amount about rhetoric in the class. If you put in a decent amount of work and don't BS, you should be fine in the class.

Avoid her as your WRD teacher. Even though the assignments in class aren't that long, she grades everything extremely critically. To her, your mistakes are more importanto that the good parts of your work. She takes everything to seriously and her rubric doesn't make sense. She's not formulaic in her class or grading which makes it hard to get an A

If you can, take another professor for WRD112. Even though this is a gen-ed class, it was lowest grade of the semester. We constantly had something due, and she's a very harsh grader. She does give good feedback on your grades and offers help IF you seek it out, but a good grade in this class requires a ridiculous amount of effort.

AVOID AT ALL COSTS.  Her class begins the semester as a fairly benign GPA booster, with very few assignments and could basically be cruised through.  Right after midterms (in fact, right after the deadline to drop the class), the class ramps up exponentially in terms of difficulty and courseload, to the point that it swamps your other obligations.

Doesn't give constructive feedback for improving grades on assignments. Unfair grader; clearly shows favoritism towards some students. Ridiculous amounts of work, and doesn't seem to actually read or watch anything produced for homework. Lots of peer review, but doesn't listen to feedback of other students to determine grades. Avoid at ALL COSTS.

I really liked this class a lot and thought it was fun to have options for the final paper. I thought she cared about how well I did and really wanted to succeed. Definitely my favorite English class and teacher in college. She knows a lot about movies!

I liked this class and thought it was a lot of fun. She is demanding but I don't think that makes her hard. She just wants you to try. She gave us choices on projects and opportunities to improve our grades. It's not a blowoff class so maybe her seriousness bothers other people. Not me, though. She knows a lot and is really helpful.

She expects a lot, maybe too much, out of her students. Class is manditory, and the workload is a lot. Her paper instructions are very vague and require a lot of abstract thinking. If you really want to learn a lot about movies, you can this, but otherwise, I would not recommend taking her class.
She takes this class too seriously. She grades ridiculous. There is a ridiculous amount of work. Would not recommend her.
Dr. Sorrell is an engaging  and passionate professor with interesting and informative lectures. She is also a pretty lenient grader, making the class an easy A. Highly recommend!
