Dr Sorrell was a really nice person, but HIS240 is extremely boring. Classes were a drag, and I used them as a study hall. Overall it was an easy A, but very boring content.

She is one of the most caring, wonderful professors I have ever had. She is extremely intelligent and passionate about Women's HIstory. There is a decent amount of reading but the books are pretty interesting and there is a lot of discussion about them in class. Highly, highly recommend!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Sorell is one of the best professors in the history department, you can tell she genuinely cares about her students and women's history! There was a final paper, group project, and 3 exams that were based off one of the books assigned. She had a discussion/review day before each exam, gives you a study guide, and offers extra credit. Take her!

Likes to rant and go on tangents a lot, usually about things at least partially related to the lecture, but still covers everything on time. You can get an A if you just study a lot and have poor attendance, but still go to the lectures because he gives good career and life advice. Has high expectations for his students, which is refreshing.

Dr.Ashley is a great dude who is very easy to talk to. I will see him around campus, and he is always fun to talk to. He covers the course material very well, and you can always ask him questions. In the lab, he is very understanding and is a great help when you are stuck. He is also very good at responding to emails promptly.
The absolute GOAT of a professor, if you attend lectures and study a bit outside of class you'll do fine. Probably my favorite professor I've had thus far.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class is not the easiest, but Dr. Ashley made it understandable. Attendance is required, but if you do great on the exams then you can still get an A with poor attendance. Homework is not worth anything but is a lot of work. It's good for review but it takes too much time tbh. Just study and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Refreshingly professory professor. Lectures weren't repetitive or hand-holdy, so it was always interesting to show up. One issue I had was that the exams were made out to be more difficult than they actually were. This class isn't a challenge if you study.

Anyone who says he's a narcissist is misappropriating justified self-confidence.

his lectures being held inside a chapel is a fun choice. felt schizophrenic a few times looking at the stained glass while he talked about his favorite alien show or rock climbing.

exams are graded heavily but if you do poorly it's genuinely just a skill issue. watch the videos or maybe look into compsci.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You either love him or hate him. I loved him, but there's room for improvement. He often predicts questions as they're asked and answers those predicted questions. He also relies on students reading the book, even though it's not really needed. Instead, his everyday rants could be more focused on subject material. Still, amazing professor overall!

Energetic, enthusiastic, knowledgeable in varied fields, give advice, caring, should give more space for asking question.
Lecture: you might like the stories he told than his lecture.
Updated near Spring break: No matter what happen. do not let yourself left behind after the 1st exam because the materials get harder, more non-intuitive.

The GOAT I would actually die for this man. He jumped in front a train for me when I was 19 years old and he told me to grow up and see the transistors beyond the man I am and see the circuit I could become. After taking the class I found my new purpose in life and that's DR. ASHLEY.

Dr. Ashley is…..something. He's very egotistical, eccentric, and he'll go on the most random tangents for half of class. But he's not rude and is nice and approachable. He goes over a lot of examples. Exams and quizzes were straightforward, no surprises. Read the textbook, watch the videos, study the practice exams, and you should be fine.

It seems most people are split on him, if you do good in the class you love him, if you do bad you hate him. He seems abrasive at first but seems to genuinely care about the students doing well. This course is well structured and seems to be more if you get it you get it. If you don't do well on the first exam just drop because it gets harder.

Dr. Ashley is very passionate about the material and knows it forwards and backwards. He is very laid back and approachable outside of class, but he can sometimes go down the rabbit hole, so you need to keep him on topic. His grading is fair and the tests are difficult. There's no "winging it" here, you either know the material or you don't.

Literally, all you have to do is watch the videos. If you study for 20 hours each exam you should be guaranteed an A. The only reason you have to not do good in this class is yourself. The tools are here; he will help you if needed and you have no one to blame but yourself.

Best professor ever. Ignore any bad reviews they were not cut out for engineering. Dude's class isn't even hard because of how engaging he is. They had to change the way the best professor award worked (voted on by students) because he won it like 11 years in a row.
best prof. learn from him about his watches

Dr. Ashley is easily is the worst professor I've had so far at UK. 80% of your grade comes from the exams (2 midterms and a final). His lectures are about 50% scribbling on a notebook paper (good luck if you aren't in the first few rows) and 50% talking about his life. In short, he makes class way harder than it has any right to be.

Colossal waste of my money and time.  Not uncommon for him to talk about his personal life for over 20 minutes in a 50 min lecture.  Goes through the motions and tells you to watch videos and provides no explanation whatsoever for what he's doing.  If you want to learn something do not take this class at UK.

The challenge of this course lies in its grading structure: 80% exams, 10% quizzes, 5% homework, and 5% attendance. Quizzes are not easy, with averages around 70%. Despite being just 1 credit, the lab demands about 5 hours weekly. Dr. Ashley makes you work hard, be prepared to practice. His lectures are good for getting the big picture.
Grades hard and not the best experience. Beware!!

Jeff was not a great professor at all. This class should not have been that difficult, he made it the worst possible class I have taken at UK. During lectures, he put up a piece of notebook paper and took notes that way and his handwriting was not legible. He was not tech savvy at all, and always went off topic in lectures to talk about himself

He knows his stuff EXTREMELY well, and will make sure you know it. Genuinely one of the most arrogant people I've ever met, yet somehow I liked him. His lectures are alright, but he usually forgets that we arent as smart as him and he just flies through difficult content without explaining and insisting that we understand. Loves rock climbing+funny
best prof at uky hands down
Good lectures, but god I hate the content. Class starts out extremely easy and then ramps up exponentially to be way harder.

Very engaging and helpful lectures, and just a very funny guy overall. My only real issue is that the course categories are weighted very strangely. 20% for 1st and 2nd exams, and 30% for the final exam! That's absurd! There's quite a bit of HW but it's weighted only 5%. Grading scheme seems unfair, but good class and learned a lot other than that.

He's a little quirky and makes lectures interesting. He provides a nice balance of good-to-know-but-not-required, actual material you need to know, and events from his life. Study what he tells you to study and you'll do fine. Would take him again. Not much partial credit is awarded so be warned, but the content is easy to understand if you study.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Just an all-around good guy tbh. His lectures tend to wander a bit and hes a little braggy but the info is there and he does a good job. I would recommend actually attending the lectures but attendance is via a passed around sheet so theoretically someone else could sign you in. Would absolutely recommend and I wouldnt pick another Professor.

Something of a folklore legend in the CS department there is one of two ways you will fall, You will either love Dr. Ashley or despise him. His lectures were incredibly easy to follow, his overall sense of knowledge about the topic fuels him to be so passionate during every single lecture. A true breath of fresh air, take him you wont regret it.

I think I learned more about Dr. Ashley than the course material. Dr. Ashley whizzed through the course material, and if you did not understand something it is extremely difficult to keep up with. He does give practice exams before each exam (except the final), which helps tremendously.

A very exciting character. Lectures are definitely entertaining but they also provide the basis for what you need to know for exams. Be prepared to read the book on your own. As long as you read on your own, and stay caught up on all the material, you will succeed in class. He tells you everything that you need to study for every quiz and exam.

Dr. Ashley is different. He is very blunt, but also very funny and charismatic. His lectures are very useful, but sometimes he goes off on tangents. I personally enjoyed his class, and he will round up a couple points if you work hard. He was the main professor that helped me decide computer engineering was for me.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Ashley is by far the worst professor Ive had at UK. His profound arrogance is really what ruined it for me. He tells students that they should drop the course if they do bad on one exam. Final was worth 30% of the grade and good luck getting any partial credit on exams if you make a small mistake.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Ashley is an excited and outgoing personality who cares a lot about computer engineering as a whole. As a lecturer, he can definitely bounce around and get off topic, but I figured if you learn how to take the right notes and get the general idea, you'll be fine. Also, practice exams are nearly identical to the actual exam so take those serious

His lectures can be off topic, but they helped my understanding of the content quite a bit. He definitely asks more from you, but as long as you stay on top of it (he stresses this), it's not bad. There are a lot of recent bad reviews, but some days there were only 5 people in class. He tells you exactly what to expect on exams just focus on time.

70% of the class grade was based on our midterm and final. If you're not a great test-taker, you'll probably struggle. Most people who were in the 280 sections instead of 282 struggled with the Verilog part of class. Video lectures were good, but in-person lectures were mostly random climbing stories and irrelevant anecdotes from the professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is unprofessional and has little respect to his student. He misgraded my exam. When I meet him asking for the correction, he scolds me and humiliated me. Saying that I do not deserve a good grade. I think he did not deserve to be a professor. It was a nightmare for me and I really regret that I did not report him at that time.

Dr. Ashley is a very nice person and highly intelligent in his field. However, he cannot transfer his knowledge very well if at all to his students. The class is a lot harder than it has to be because you have to teach yourself outside of his lectures.

Dr. Ashley is a character, but his crazy personality actually makes the class more interesting. He can give off the vibe that he doesn't care at first but if you actually talk to him outside of class or go to office hours he is very helpful and caring. Just stay on top of things and this class won't be that bad. Talks about rock climbing a lot.

People respect Ashley as a person. but as a lecturer, one of the worst I've had. He will talk about rock climbing at least once every lecture. He always talked about wanting to help make these times less stressful but he was about 90% of my stress, also told kids to drop the class after the first exam (including me, still passed it tho)
Crappy class made up by Dr. Ashley's great personality. One of my favorite EE professors to date

1. No partial credit period 2. Will alter students grades negatively if errors are found 3. Will grade more harshly if you ask for a re-grade 4. Will try to trip you up 5. Quizzes are very detached from exam performance as I performed average on quizzes but got 100s on exams. 6. Study a lot and you will ace the class. The material builds on itself
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Ashey is great at teaching this course--or at least he claims to be nearly every lecture. Students are expected to read the bo'ook; he brushes off questions with a cold 'google it' response. I really wanted to like him, but he ended up being an arrogant pain in the neck. Material is easier than he makes it out to be. Hope to never have him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Ashley is a grandiose lecturer who grades harshly and is often ill-prepared for class. He doesn't understand that most would rather learn than hear him tell all about his life. He is, of course, never wrong and all misconceptions are students' faults. Jeff, in short, only appeals to students who are amazed by circuses and edgy memes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Ashley is a horrible teacher. He zooms through information without explaining so be prepared to read the textbook and learn on your own. In addition to just being a bad teacher, he spends all of class bragging about accomplishments, how clever he is, how much money he has, etc. He also spends a lot of time being condescending to students.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: talks about himself more than class material. no partial credit on all open answer exams. 50% exam final grade. he made a mistake which made us receive a 100 on the first exam and on the second exam he shortened the test time and made it so hard that the average was a 60. this was all to save his bell curve. Then bragged how hard he made the exam.
Horrible professor! At times can be flat out ignorant to the point you would want to change majors. Makes the class harder than what it needs to be. If you can avoid Ashley... AVOID HIM.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Flat out, horrible teacher. One of the most horrible classes you'll have to take for EE or CPE. He makes the class harder than what it has to be. Always boast about his past accomplishments for no reason. Does not believe in partial credit for exams. If you can avoid him, please do so!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The man knows his stuff, he's helpful in office hours and he does care if his students do well. His lectures aren't the best, reads off of slides and demonstrates stuff on the boards, but he talks through it so fast that it's almost impossible to obtain all the information needed. He's not a horrible professor, but still not a great one either.

He spends half the class telling people they need to study and bragging about his own accomplishments. If he actually spent the entire time teaching, he'd probably be a fine teacher. He's friendly and helpful in office hours, so there is that.

Hands down was the best professor I have ever had. He is incredibly inspiring, and motivational. Dr. Ashley knows exactly how to convey what he is thinking. He is full of energy all the time and just an all around great person. He asks questions that get you thinking, and will tell you why you should know what you are learning. 100% would take

Dr. Ashley is really funny and super nice. I feel so bad hating him so mush as a professor when I love him as a person. He just doesn't explain things clearly and makes this class way harder than it should be. Homework is so hard and tests are even harder. Quizzes are every Friday which really sucks. Good luck - you're gonna need it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The class isn't terribly hard, but he likes to act like it is. His lectures amount to him bragging about his accomplishments, if you ask a question he doesn't deem reasonable he'll refuse to answer and tell you to read the book instead. Relates lots of things to the lab and to EE/CPE majors, but never to CS majors (who also don't take the lab).
I had this guy for one class and he seemed completely instane. If i met him on the street I would assume he is a homeless lunatic with a thesaurus.

He is a great guy, but as far as a teacher, he isn't the best.  The bigger issue is there isn't a better option for this specific class at UK, so I would take him still. He's a great guy that just can't seem to get to the point in any given class period, so if you don't read then you don't pass the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Ashely is my all time favorite! He expects you to read so you should. When it comes to exams just do his practice exams and think of all the different ways the questions could be asked and you'll be fine!

Great Person and Great Professor. He goes off on tangents sometimes but if you like the subject the class is really easy, if you do not you may not want to be there. He test are basically the same each year and are easy to study for.

Expects you to read the book but when you ask him easy questions because you are confused he gets mad. Gives off the 'go read the book I don't wanna explain to you' vibe. I mean I would get the answers from the book but asking him would save me much more time. Learned 90% of materials from TA because he goes through lecture very quickly.

All of your grade depends on the tests. It does not matter how hard you have worked on the homework/quizzes. Too bad if you don't test well. No set office hours and talks over you constantly when you come, also too bad if you want to ask questions. Gets really mad if you don't understand something. Does not encourage learning, only failure.

Great guy, not a great teacher.   Whenever I mention I'm taking this class, people love to mention how awesome Dr. Ashley is, which I'm always confused about. He loves what he does and is a total bro, but he goes off on tangents often and doesn't respond well to questions. He acts like his class is hard, but it's a breeze. Tests are just copies.

Amazing person and an awesome professor. You will have to stud,y, but if you buy in and find enjoyment in the subject, you'll sail out with an A. Also very fun to just talk with, stop by his office hours if you want to learn about the next big thing or get job-finding help. Awesome dude! Also math is more important than love.

Dr. Ashley is definitely a bro, but is extremely hard to learn from. He is definitely passionate for the material, but can't convey it in an understandable way. He spends half the class time going off topic about random things. The other half of the class he lectures (very loudly) and tries to draw on the board with terrible handwriting.

Outstanding professor. Sometimes he doesn't cover test material until the 11th hour and his lectures can often be confusing, but by the time you're tested, he's drilled what you need to know into your head. Extremely helpful and friendly, with an extreme passion for the material. Homework is really hard, but exams are exactly like practice ones.

Hands down the best and most supportive professor I've ever had. While his classes aren't a breeze, they are setup in such a way that you will certainly get an A if you put in the effort to understand the material, while cultivating a passion for content. His charisma is infectious, and he is primarily responsible for sparking my love of my career.

Great Teacher. Goes on rants sometimes. Funny guy. His test are cake and just like the previous exams. His quizzes are just like the practice quiz and some times are take home. His homework is harder than the questions on the test.

This class starts off a bit confusing, but after struggling for a couple weeks, it will all click. I skipped lecture often due to the fact that he would often talk too much about Dr. Who and other random nerd stuff (which was interesting but unhelpful) but I heard he takes attendance now. Find old exams and use google for hw. He's a great guy

EE 281 is pretty easy if you have a decent grasp of programming. The first few labs are cake, then you get into Verilog and you need to be doing lots of work before you get there. That said, my group averaged just over an hour in the lab, with the longest session being 2 hours. Tests are over 280 stuff, but easy enough if you understand the labs.

Sometimes the homework was due before we went over some of the material on it, so reading the textbook and watching online videos was sometimes a necessity.  He does give clear instructions and tells you exactly what will be on the exams.  Not a very hard class if you just put a little work towards it.

READ THE BOOK. His lectures are not directed towards people with no understanding of the material. I felt really lost in this class until I started reading the book BEFORE lectures. He is slightly intimidating but overall an incredibly nice teacher who wants you to succeed. A lot of the class gets A's. The tests are exactly like the practice exams.

Some people get scared of Dr. Ashley because he teaches tough love.  But in reality he's not bad and his lectures are informativefunny. If you go to class and read the book, it's an easy A.  Homework is long and tough, but it's a check mark and he posts the answer half the time. If you can do the practice tests, then you'll do fine on tests

Jeff is a great teacher, he inspired and motivated me to become a better engineer. He also like to influence "entrepreneurship" among his students which is a very good tactic, we are the next great minds of America, and he sees that. In the famous words of the great Jeff Ashley; "Read the booooooooooook"
So excited about everything, zest for life is contagious. If you pay attention in class and do the homework, you'll definitely get an a.
Best professor I have had. I learned an incredible amount in this class and the professor's side comments made the class entertaining and actually enjoyable.
An absolute pleasure to have as a professor. I'm a software person but thanks to him I'm not afraid of hardware anymore.
Jeff Ashley is the man. Makes the subject clear and interesting even if it's not. Super easy to talk to and he's very intelligent in his field.

Great teacher! Straight shooter. He tells you exactly what is on the exams. Not super easy, but he's constantly reminding you that that's the point. Read before class, it'll make lectures easy to follow. He's not trying to trick you, he's trying to teach you how to study. And if you listen to him you can do great. It's easy to get lost.

A VERY good teacher. His lectures are clear and do a great job of explaining the material. Most of the grade comes from quizzes and tests, so you will need to know the material to pass. However, with this teacher, that shouldn't be an issue.
Best teacher I've had so far. He explains everything clearly and is very approachable. Gives practice tests that are VERY similar to the test he will give.
Simply the best.  What can I say?  He is everything a teacher should be and he wants you to succeed.

GREAT TEACHER, easy class if you understand from the beginning. Some people have trouble if they don't understand the building blocks. IMPORTANT: Old tests are given online and are nearly identical to the actual test. Attend class because that's when he warns you about the (easy) quizzes that are every few week. Great class, great teacher.
Very awesome teacher! Knows his stuff and how to teach it. Attendance is needed if you want a good grade, but he's to entertaining not to go to class!

He is a VERY helpful and highly interesting professor!  As long as you come to class, pay attention and ask you questions you will do fine! He reviews the material A LOT because it builds on itself.  I would highly recommend taking this course.

Very nice professor. Tries very hard to keep the subject interesting and keep students' attention. Will do several examples if needed and will meet with you when ever you ask. Cares very much for his students and his subjects.

He was a good teacher. He was funny and turned a relatively boring subject into a fun class. If you want to do well in his class, you HAVE to go! The textbook isn't much help and he will do a million examples in class and brainwash you to know it if you just go to class! I wish I had him for the rest of my classes...

Incredible professor. He made what should have been hard fun. Relax in his class and laugh when he tells a joke, he's a funny guy. Use his office hours because he wants you to learn. Pay attention in class and you'll get a great grade.
He is really great at what he does, and if you sit in the front it will feel like he is talking to you the entire time. Great teacher!!!
The best professor I have had so far. Great guy. Super helpful. Hilarious. 'nuff said

Extremely Helpful! If you want to know about digital logic this guy will get you to the point of mastery!! Oh and probably one of the nicest guys in the engineering department! The course isn't easy but he is always available if you have questions
Great teacher, enough said.

Great teacher and a great guy.  That being said, don't plan on an easy A. He will help you to get the best grade you can but the material is what the material is. It's quite a lot to cover but he has his conventions and if you are interested in mastering the course he is definitely the guy you want helping you.
Does a great job. Tests are time intensive, make sure you go over old test and homework.

Really great teacher and a nice guy. Lots of energy. His tests can be difficult if you cannot work the problems quickly enough. (I had to time myself doing certain problems.) His office door is open almost all the time. He's extremely helpful with homework outside of class. He made 8am not as bad as it could have been.
Dr. Ashley is the best teacher I've ever had and he describes the material in a crystal clear way.  TAKE THIS GUY if you have the chance for any class!!!!!
Great Teacher and one of the best I ever had. Would like to take other classes under him. Make sure you listen during in class gives most teh answeres during class.
Dr.Ashley is a lot of fun and a very good teacher.
Dr. Ashley is a lot of fun and makes sure his students understand the material.
Great teacher and a lot of fun.
The greatest teacher I've ever had!!!

Ok professor, definitely improved her lectures over the semester. I find visual pictures very important for learning calc 3, but don't expect the best pictures from her. They apparently restructured the math department this semester so exams are quite a bit different than previous years, older exams are good but less effective now.

Dr. Almousa was a good professor. She is caring and wants all students to succeed. I struggled with attendance but she was very lenient. Exams pretty much dictate your grade, so prepare for them well. This is the case for most math classes here anyways. Dr. Almousa will prepare you well for exams with study guides though, so just use the resources.

Dr. Almousa was a great professor for my first math course at UK. She assigns very little homework through WebWork and one short written assignment each week. She prepared students for exams by walking through past MA213 tests with the class. She checks in on her students personally and truly cares. Basically, I never had to worry about the exams.
I wouldn't recommend this professor. She seems nice, but the way she assigns/grades work is not of par with the other professors I've had/currently have.

She's not helpful at all and doesn't care if you pass the class or not. I don't know why it's an online class but we have to have a group project. When I'm trying to communicate to the group via canvas and nobody wants to reply, I ask for her help. In response, I receive a snarky reply that let me know all I said above. I recommend Meredith King.
Ms. Cole is a harsh grader and edits your grade based on turning it in on the assignment.  Even having a 504 plan, she would not let you re-do any assignments.
The class seemed to be all over the place, and I just could not keep up. I went to class, although it seemed redundant, and had to get a tutor to even get a C.
He is a professor who cares about his students. His teaching does not 100% reflect test material. Study from the books. But other than that, it is not too difficult.
He was very unclear in class and I often felt very confused overall. Would not recommend taking with him if you don't learn well on your own.
Nope. His tests do NOT reflect lectures. You're going to be learning basically everything on your own. You better get right with the Lord, or you're screwed in this class. Good luck!

Dr. Awuah is smart and kind, he is not the best teacher. He doesn't present relevant material as well as other professors and isn't the best at managing class time. He has bad handwriting and makes mistakes sometimes, which can be misleading in organic chemistry. He usually only goes over concepts once. Read the textbook if you want an A.
This professor looks to make sure his students know what's happening, he encourages asking questions  about the material, and encourages going to office hours.

He is a very generous grader and aims for students to understand. I felt that I was teaching myself majority of the semester which is not ideal. He expects students to memorize little things he goes over in class because they will show up on the exam. It wasn't a terrible semester. The book is about to be your best friend. He is decent.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Awuah is incredibly intelligent and very knowledgeable. Ask questions, pay attention, and go to office hours. Organic chemistry is a notoriously hard course but he is a fair grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: If you take this class, you'll have to teach yourself the majority of the material. The exams were so difficult & covered A LOT of material, but his lectures didn't explain much at all. Can be rude & passive-aggressive to his students. Attendance was mandatory, but if you don't go to class, he WILL confront you about it during exams.

If you take orgo with him, you will have to teach yourself most of the material from the book. But, he does grade fairly and the exams cover the study guide material very well. You can tell he wants his class to succeed, but structure is lacking. Just read the book and start memorizing things early. Go to group work days before exams!

You will absolutely have to teach yourself if you take him. His lectures are confusing, and he consistently focuses on information that is barely (if at all) covered on the study guide or exams.

He is condescending to students and has even given me wrong answers for homework.

Positives: He is not a harsh grader and he learned everyone's name

Treats students as if they were professionals. He starts with hard concepts without starting with the basics first making over half the class stop showing up from the beginning because they are so confused. He does not follow the syllabus and goes over things not on the exam but ends up running out of time for the things actually on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You're going to have to teach yourself if you take him. He doesn't follow the learning objectives or even his own powerpoint slides, and rambles for the entire hour and 15 min. I got an easy A in orgo I with Steelman, but this is going to be much tougher to finish with an A. He's a very smart and nice guy, but he really does not know how to teach.

Spends too much time on things that are not on the test and skips over important things that are on the tests. Does not follow the syllabus well and runs out of time trying to go over the material. The material is not presented well. Lectures are extremely confusing and hard to follow.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: awful... if you get this professor run!! I did not go to class anymore because he did not teach, and I was wasting my time for an hour and 15min sitting there. His teaching style is to talk for the whole time and write something on the board that we do not understand. He went to MIT and treats us like we are Ph.D. students.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's cool. I don't dislike him but I wouldn't schedule another class with him because he has an accent that makes it a tad bit harder to understand, & he's not the best at explaining concepts. No homework. Grade depends on 5 quizzes, 3 exams, and one project. His grading scale makes it harder to fair so that's a plus, but still a boring class.
Dr. Awuah is one of the brightest professor I have had since being in college. He is a source of so much more knowledge that what you are doing in class. I would recommend him!
Dr. Awuah's lectures were not particularly helpful. I mainly used the internet and the textbook to learn the material. He is a nice guy though.

This is the worst clsss I've ever taken. I've never been so stressed. At the beginning of the semester, things seemed fairly easy for orgo but went downhill quickly. He didn't even give us a practice exam for the final like he did for every other exam. I think he had had enough of the class by the end of the semester.
He's the reason I changed my major. He made me hate chemistry.

Dr. A is nice outside of class. However, his course was a NIGHTMARE: few recorded lectures, he taught in an order different from the textbook, and had ridiculous exams. I'm talking 5 short-answer Qs (up to 35 subparts total) in 50 minutes ridiculous. I studied 40 hours for each exam and sobbed after each one. Heard of Grossman? Take him instead.

Doesn't give enough homework for students to learn, so you really have to make your own homework from the book. Practice tests sometimes cover different chapters than the actual test. He draws so incredibly sloppily you never know what is happening unless you've seen the molecule before. Dropped to take with another professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Doesn't ever put things into a "big picture" which often leaves the class confused on what he is trying to explain. He also does not receive questions or criticism well which causes tension in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Awuah is deficient when it comes to understanding the level we need to learn on. However, most of the issues came from the class assuming everything was too hard to do and complaining every time it got difficult, which is essentially all of organic two. Read the book if you wanna pass, but he does make it very clear what he wants on tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He's a nice guy, but Dr. Awuah is the worst professor I've ever had. He went to MIT, and literally teaches the class like we're MIT grad students. Very unclear with what will be on exams, doesn't allow makeup exams, draws sloppily and leaves things out during lecture which confuses us more, and answers any questions vaguely. Save yourselves and run
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He was the worst professor I have ever had. Organic Chemistry is already hard enough. However, Dr. Awuah made it impossible. Ended up dropping the class to prevent me GPA from suffering.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This class is a lot of work. Glad I took it because it's useful, but be prepared to work hard, especially in the middle of the semester. Very informative lectures but they can run a bit long and be a bit dry.
Lots of homework in this class but you get a lot of valuable feedback back on what you get wrong on an assignment.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: 304 with Dr. Lillywhite was intense but doable. He gives you a good road map for planning your longer projects. Lectures can be dry but helpful. He is very accessible and offers one no-questions-asked extension to everyone! Stay on top of your homework assignments and pick topics that you are actually interested in, and it will be okay!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment:
I had great time learning with Dr.Lillywhite. During this course (if you plan to take it for WRD 304) you'll have to read a lot of research and scholarly documents. You also have to come up with your own ideas and turn it In as a research paper, if an idea is not given already by him.

Overall, great class but just a lot of reading and writing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Mr. Lillywhite is very kind and clearly cares for his students. However, his class was incredibly boring and focused on topics that were sometimes hard to wrap my head around, even as a WRD major who has taken many classes such as this one. He's not a hard grader and focuses his class on meaningful discussion.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Austin was a great professor and was very knowledgeable about the course. My biggest complaint is that there was a lot of reading and a lot of work. If I had the option, I would take another section of this course because after talking with fellow students in other sections, they seemed to have a less work then my section had.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Very nice teacher! I thought the topics were very easy, and he made it very clear he cares about the topics, and students understanding it. The class overall was very easy. He gets rid of the worst two quizzes. He also does not take any kind of attendance.

Great guy. Easy to follow during class and applies real life content to class content. Tests are not very hard as long as you pay attention during class. Overall relatively easy math class and great professor.
Austin is the man.
Does a very good job explaining math. Weekly quizzes, no exams. Really wants his students to understand.
very easy class and will drop worst quiz grade
Great Teacher!!

Dr. Alderete was a very good lecturer, but he had the strangest ways of actually providing you with your information. He also says from the start the he is not responsive to emails, and that is very true!
Class was fairly simple but he has very complex ways of describing his material. Also, he is very seldomly accessible outside of class.

It is a hard class, but Dr. Alderete made the information accessible and worth the 8a lecture. Sometimes he focuses more on theory than worked examples but if you ask for more examples he will do them. If you start the class knowing it's hard and committing to learning the material from day one, you will be fine.

All of his lectures went through one ear and out the other. He's passionate about the material, but I was always confused because of his complex way of explaining everything. I mainly relied on ChatGPT, old exams, and Dr. Yip's notes, which helped a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: You can tell that he genuinely loves the content. Calc 3 is very difficult but he always made an effort to listen to the students. He consistently sent messages on Canvas, hosted review sessions, and would sometimes chat with us during class. Teaching difficult content clearly is incredibly hard but he definitely has that ability.

Dr. Alderete is very considerate and teaches material well. He is understanding and is willing to help with any questions you may have. Homework is easy, quizzes are easy, and Unit Capstones are group projects that are also easy. Would recommend to anyone.

His lectures can be fast paced, but he is always willing to explain content and answer questions.  There are quizzes every other week, but he is super flexible with makeups.  Made me enjoy math for once!

This class is super easy if you pay attention and take notes in class. He gives great notes and lectures. You'll be fine if you miss some classes, just make sure you understand the content. The homework can be difficult and he gives lots of extensions. He will also drop your lowest 2 test grades, and is super flexible with test makeups as well

He is one of the best professors I have had during my college experience! He makes complicated topics simple and knows that the class will have a good time. He cracks jokes every now and then truly loves what he does! No exams in this class!!!!! Might I repeat, NO EXAMS! Group projects are what he goes by and truly he made me appreciate math a lot!

I would recommend MA111 by Dr. Alderete as an absolute to get your math credits out of the way. He thoroughly explains everything and makes sure to write everything out. Just make sure you show up to class and take notes then you should be good for the most part. He is very willing to sit through a problem with you if you get stuck.

I loved Dr. Alderate! He allowed us to drop the last section of his course if we had the grade we wanted, so I was done with his class by the end of November. His lectures are very straightforward and correlate directly to tests, so I felt confident going into every class. He can be a little awkward, but he is so smart and willing to help.
Dr. Alderete had such amazing lectures. You can tell he truly loves what he does. He is clear and easy to understand. He is also always willing to help. I would recommend him to everyone!

Dr. Alderete is clearly passionate about what he lectures but still lectures his (fairly complex) topics in an accessible way. Friendly and helpful inside and outside of class. He grades very intuitively, giving extra credit to particularly unique proofs and reasoning upsides to imperfect proofs rather than strictly grading from an answer key.

My only complaint is that I'm not sure how to say his last name. Alderete is a relaxed individual with a friendly demeanor and caring attitude. Big lecturer that knows how to read a class in order to keep things moving. Generally by-the-books, but has a sense of humor. He clearly has a lot of knowledge and loves engaging with curious students!
I really enjoyed this professor. He answered questions when asked in class and was very eager to help students succeed. The exams were easy if you attended lecture, took notes, and asked questions.

Very laid back teacher, attendance is not mandatory and is easy with excuses. Goes pretty fast through lectures but is very clear in his teaching. Gives you time to do homework/participation in class and ask him questions about it if needed. Tests are exactly like the participation and he gives you lots of practice for the exams through homework
He is very clear speaking, easy to learn from and cares about actually teaching content. He was pretty nice, fairly laid back and helpful in class.

He moves EXTREMELY quickly but will answer any questions if you have them. He says attendance is mandatory but doesn't take it. He posts a quiz in which one of the questions has you type the number that's on the board to verify you are in class but only posts that once every 4-5 classes or so. If you do all your homework, you'll surely get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He does a fairly well good job of teaching, he just gives tests a bit too frequently. He doesn't take attendance, but you don't want to miss his class too much because of all the notes you need to take.

This class was pretty easy and consisted of your normal high school algebra and logarithms. Alderete was a little awkward, but he explained things thoroughly and always answered every question. People who didn't like him were those that didn't come to class and blamed him for their lack of knowledge. Overall, solid teacher, easy class and homework.

Super dope guy. Very chill and laidback. Attendance is not mandatory. Online HW is due each week and he gives practice exams to do leading up to the exam. Practice exams are very similar to the actual exam, giving you an idea of what to expect. He can teach pretty fast when lecturing, although he'll stop to answer any questions in great detail.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Literally the sweetest professor ever. The comments about her accent are not true, I could understand every single thing she said all semester. She has very few assignments and 3 exams throughout the semester, all of which are easy if you put in the effort and take notes during lecture. The lectures are engaging with lots of participation!

I took Dr. Occa for an online required class. I can say that for her online class she lined it up exactly how online classes should. Everything's already posted, complete things ahead of time if you wish, no zoom meetings. Very accessible and understanding too! 3 papers, 3 exams including final. Weekly discussion boards. Very manageable workload.

Dr. Occa is clealry very passionate about what she teaches and it really shows in her lectures. Her accent is noticable but is easy to understand. I can't think of a single time she was not understanding or easy to get ahold of! You are graded on few things but she is alwasy willing to look over/answer any questions you have about tests or papers!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Occa is an exceptional professor. There are 3 exams, an individual assignment, group paper, and a final presentation about the group paper. The tests aren't super hard if you study what she tells you to study and the projects aren't too difficult. The topics can be bland but she tries her best to make them interesting and easy to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: has a very thick accent, hard to understand during lectures. I have had her twice now, if possible I would take another professor. will call on you randomly in class, you HAVE to read the material. course is super dry & so is the class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof Occa gave good lectures but the massive group project had no guidelines whatsoever and she changes what she wants from assignments on the fly. The worst part of this class was the group project because she gives no criteria or guidelines and is a TOUGH grader. She's good but you gotta work for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Such a good teacher, enjoyed him so much. Made class awesome

One of the best professors at UK, he was always energetic and passionate about the material that we covered and made the lectures fun and engaging. If you have an opportunity to take him for any History course, please do so! you won't be dissapointed!

He explained everything in depth and his lectures were extremely entertaining. He made sure that we were all engaged (even at 8am). The excitement and passion he displayed when talking about history was shown through his lectures. The feedback was helpful, hilarious and respectful. If you have to take this course make sure he is your instructor!

Took his class during a winter intermission, so my experience is different than a full semester. Zinkle was an awesome professor and Im really glad I tuned in to the live discussions. If you take one of his classes, try to get to know him, hes a great guy and really passionate about history.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Mr. Zinkle is the best TA i've had. He is very intelligent, grades tough but reasonably, gives great advice and feedback on papers. He expects you to participate, but he makes class genuinely enjoyable. You can tell he really cares about his students. Take Zinkle if you can!!

If you are in any HIS courses, try to have Mr. Zinkle as your TA. He wants you to get the best grade possible, is realistic, but also wants you to achieve what the syllabus requires you to. He is sometimes a tough grader, but he has good reason. His recitations are laid-back and fun but effective. He is there to help.
Fun, but hard grader and doesn't explain material all that well. Also not the most approachable.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: There is a lot of reading but Austyn makes sure the articles are really interesting and deep. As long as you've skimmed the articles before class and make a comment or 2 you will do fine.

Austyn is smart, understanding, and kind. She graded very lightly & encouraged us to participate but did not force anyone to (which I appreciate because that makes me very nervous). She is easy-going & always helpful. She left the most thoughtful feedback on assignments & really acknowledged my work & progress. Great professor & wonderful person!

I LOVE Austyn! She's so chill and understands that life happens. She does assign a lot of readings, but they all have a purpose and really help you to think. She is so approachable and just creates such an open environment to share anything.
She made the class really interesting and tried to give everyone the chance to succeed. Coming to class is a big part in making an impression and getting a good grade.

Austyn is a fantastic person, and if you have any troubles, just go and talk with her, she will listen and make adjustments. For instance, about half our class admitted to not doing the reading, she said, " that's ok, id prefer it to not happen again, it may just be the text we our reading that's the problem."
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Austyn is so chill. She is really funny and extremely relatable. Loved her casual sarcasm. She provided a space where all opinions and questions were accepted. She cares about every single one of her students! The way she taught the content was very informative and interactive. I feel like I learned a lot from this class and Austyn!

Austyn is the chillest professor I've ever had. Talking to her feels more like talking to a friend than a professor, but at the same time the class had nothing but respect and appreciation for her and learned a lot. She cares about my well-being and wants everyone to do well in class. I hope to take more of her classes in the future!!!
Good lecturer, she is also an interesting person to get to know as well. Overall good professor

Austyn is a wonderful professor. I had her in non-fiction creative writing, and it was my favorite class. She encouraged conversation, she made sure everyone felt comfortable, and she helped you become a better writer. If you are interested in writing what so ever, take her class. You will not regret it. If I could take it again, I would.
I would not recommend Austyn she grades very tough and will take a large amount of points of for a simple mistake, If you are not really really good at writing you will not get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Austyn is AMAZING. The homework is a normal amount, you will have to listen to a podcast or read a few pages out of your textbook sometimes but it is not taken for points. She does free writes every class so whatever your homework was the night before you will write about the next day. She is so understanding & gives amazing feedback. Super caring.

Dr. Ault is a great professor. She may come off as intimidating, but she is very kind and is willing to help. If you put effort into the assignments and come to class, you should have no problem with this class.
One of the best professors I ever had. Best in the field.

Dr. Ault is a great professor! The class has clear expectations and due dates, you know from day when when every thing is due. The lectures are long but she tries to keep them interesting. She truly knows her stuff and wants you to learn.
GREAT professor!!! I loved Dr. Ault. She is very knowledgeable and super helpful. I love having class with Dr. Ault. I'll miss her next semester!

Dr. Ault is a great professor and really knows her stuff. Her classes are challenging, but definitely doable if you're passionate about special ed. She does come off as intimidating, but great at what she does!
Tests are hard, class is boring.

Maybe the least qualified math professor at UK. He tries to teach calculus, however cannot do simple algebra. Trying to understand what he is saying let alone what he is writing is harder than the material itself. If youre looking for a nice professor hes your guy but if trying to learn calculus go somewhere else. Would rather take a McGregor elbow
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Absolutely the worst professor I have ever had in my academic career. If you think his accent is hard to understand, try reading his notes. This man will derive one equation the entire class and still mess up on basic algebra. Very sweet man, but he should have retired 10 years ago. Would rather fall down a flight of white hall stairs than take him
Professor is a really nice guy, he just has no idea how to teach anything to anyone. His accent is also very thick.

Good luck understanding anything he says. He can barely speak English and he speaks very quietly. If you can decipher what he says, it is very regularly broken up from him making mistakes and laughing for no reason. 10/10 would never take him for any classes ever again.

Quizzes at the end of every class. Tests were pretty easy and they looked similar to practice exams. Very nice person. Hard to understand at times and made a lot of calculation errors on the board where he had to erase and start over. Lots and lots of homework but its not a huge percentage of the grade. Three tests worth 60% of grade. STUDY
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He's an awful lecturer. I think once he had 4 problems being solved on the board at once and he didn't solve a single one of them. He gives daily quizzes for attendance that he teaches you how to do at the beginning of class. But he doesn't change anything so if you can memorize the old exams he gives you then you are for sure a 95 on the exams.

Really nice guy. The dynamic of the class worked best when people asked questions. He doesn't mind to delay a quiz by a couple days if the class isn't ready by the deadline. If you email him he will respond the same day. You can tell he is passionate about what he teaches, and you'll get a lot out of the class if you try to match his energy.

Dr. Sathaye is a very nice professor, but he is a terrible one at the same time. He is very passionate about mathematics and knows his stuff, but he cannot convey that clearly in his lectures. This, coupled with his thick Indian accent, can make it very difficult to understand his lecture.

He's not great. Lectures are convoluted and his homework often doesn't reflect his examples. Only professor I've ever known to give unscheduled (sometimes on short notice) "supplemental exams" with things he couldn't fit on a main exam. He'll help if you need it, and allows a "cheat sheet" on exams, so he's not all bad, but avoid if you can.

This professor takes easy material (I had taken much of this material in high school) and makes it extremely convoluted with unnecessary theoretical information, some of which cannot be found anywhere online or in any books. On exams, he only gives credit if you use his preferred, very specific wording, regardless of it you get the concept correct.

Dr. Sathaye was not a very good professor, but there were only two people teaching the class when I took it. He will try to help you if you ask for help, but he isn't very good at explaining how to get to the final answer. The midterm tests were not that hard- they were pretty similar to the old exams, but the final was ridiculous.

Sathaye is a great professor!  However, he assumes that you do a good amount of studying and understand the material easily. If you're good at math, you'll love Sathaye, otherwise you'll despise him. He tries to show how everything he does is mathematically interesting. Talk to him if you're concerned about your grades, he's very helpful.

Sathaye is a good guy. But be warned, he is not a teacher. He understands the material, but he'll often do examples, then lose his train of thought. He teaches things that aren't even relevant to the class sometimes. Hope for a good TA, read the book, and above all find some of his old exams. He recycles. You wont learn much, but you can do well.
Nice guy, tough to understand, great personality. Reccommend him over anybody in the math department.

Sathaye def cares about learning,  but if you need addl help, he explains it as if you already get it (if that makes sense) which is less than helpful and doesn't realize he is doing it.  Lectures are decent  He is a light-hearted, goof guy, particularly in how he chuggles in delight at some of theorems.  Other funny stuff too (you'll have to see).

Dr. Sathaye may be the happiest and nicest professor I have had in college, but that's where the good news stops. He has no teaching ability. He uses train of thought to teach and does not explain a single thing he says or writes down. I would highly suggest finding a different teacher. Class would be worthless if there wasn't a quiz every day.
He spends too much time rambling on about the theory of a topic and then rushes through one example before class ends. However, his tests are very easy because he allows a cheat sheet.

Hands down, the worst professors at UK. It baffles me he got hired. He lectures are next to useless due to the fact that he does not know how to teach. Good luck trying to go to his office hours because he will yell at you. Lastly, who the heck assigns a 10 page paper, cumulative final and presentation during finals? Oh yea no one except Sathaye.

Nice guy, but his lectures are mostly useless. The material isn't all that difficult by itself, but he'll often mess up examples andor teach overcomplicated methods entirely different from the ones taught in recitation. Exams are fairly straightforward though, and he offers great resources for test prep -- just hope you have a good TA.
Great guy but an absolutely horrible teacher.

His lectures are utterly confusing and next to useless. On multiple occasions my TA would tell myself and others to disregard whatever Sataye had said on the topic.  That said the material is not overly difficult, and the tests (which are a large majority of the grade) are very similar to the practice tests. Passable by not ideal for learning

His lectures are confusing.  I learned most of the material from the recitation teacher and from studying with friends.  However, if you study the old tests that he gives you before the exams the tests are easy because he doesn't really change much.

His accent isn't the problem. He's extremely intelligent, but he's unable to explain things in a large group setting. His lectures are very confusing. He'll begin an example, change his mind and start a new one, then start a third example, and switch back to the first without finishing any problem. He often confuses himself and messes up probs.

This guys is the absolute worst. NEVER take him. He is rude and absolutely useless. I had to teach myself the entire course since he was unable to do anything for me after repeated visits during his office hours. The guy is not a teacher. Very obvious that he is at this university to do research and write his own textbooks.

Sathaye might be the nicest guy on the planet but it is clear he is not a natural teacher. Very difficult to understand and he employs alternative methods to everything that are often more complicated than standard ones. Exam prep. is lacking. Seek a new professor if you have this guy.

Knows what he is talking about but can't speak it without errors to save his life. Also he can't typically add so check his answers. If there is a g on the board and you think there should be a number chances are it's actually a 9. Not a bad teacher, willing to help, gives good idea of what will be on test before hand. Study hard and get a good TA.

If you have to take Calc 3 you need to take Sathaye.  He is by far the fairest math teacher I have had.  His expectations on your knowledge of the topics are always clear and he really wants his students to succeed.  Be sure to pay attention in class as there are after lecture quizzes that are short and easy points.  Amazing teacher :)

Class was extremely easy except for the final. Basically gives you the test before hand except for final. A little critical thinking needed but not much. Didn't learn much material but learned how to solve specific math problems. He was nice but  didnt make you actually learn the math. You basically just learned how to do a few specific problems

Class was extremely easy. Basically gives you the test before hand. Almost entirely math problems. A little critical thinking needed but not much. Didn't learn much material but learned how to solve specific math problems. Barely understood a word he said. However, great demonstrations and he was a nice guy.

He isn't that bad at all. His accent is as thick as others say. He also isn't that scattered. If you pay attention and take notes, it isn't that bad at all. In fact, he made a lot of the subject matter interesting, and I didn't have to use the textbook at all, he taught so well. Overall, he is a great professor and I recommend taking him.

Worst professor I've ever had. His accent is so thick even though he speaks fluent English. His notes are very confusing and are not in any order. He writes ALL over the board and it's hard to follow. He cares about your success but doesn't work well outside of class.

He is super nice and funny. He actually speaks perfect English but with an accent. You can understand everything he is saying. He gives you old exams and only changes numbers and maybe 1 question on the real test. I would rely on my TA outside of class but inclass he would easily work out any HW prob you wanted at the beginning of everyclass
Very confusing in lecture and takes attendance everyday. Exams were pretty easy. I'd recommend him over anyone else. Study the review sheets and old exams before the exam and you should be fine.

Although his lectures are sometimes unclear, he is helpful and really is interested in his students.  Attendance by quiz every class and gives practice problems before an exam.  Exams were fairly straightforward.  I would take him again if I had a good TA again.

Dr Sathaye is funny and cared about his students. Gives a formula sheet and practice problems for exam. Attendance is taken by a quiz at the end of each lecture. He is helpful if you ask for it, but confusing in lecture. Seek help from TA.

Dr. Sathaye is really awesome! I was worried coming in as a frosh to Calc III, but Dr. Sathaye made calc III really understandable, and was always willing to talk after class or during office hours. I definitely recommend him! His accent is a little hard to understand, but not too much. And he makes adorable jokes that you can't help but laugh at.

Very strong accent, he tries so hard and is so nice and I feel bad for the guy. I never went to lecture because I couldn't understand him and attended lab only. As long as you are descent at math you will do fine. He puts up the old exams and the new exams are exactly the same so that is how to study.

Strong accent, but you will get somewhat used to it. You just have to concentrate to hear, which makes it difficult when you are trying to see and understand what he is doing. 2 days lecture and 1 day of recitation, and I learn everything I have learned in recitation. Smart, just doesn't know how to teach. Calc test average:97%. This class: 68%

I guess you guys said it, he just go through these PowerPoint slides, and that's it, good luck! The way he teaches gives me a headache. But he's a pretty nice guy. He's trying his best, and he's a math genius, but does not know how to teach. Just expect to work on your own, and you'll get an "A", easily!

Though he is not very easy to understand, if you understand math well you will do fine in this class. His tests are very close to the practice exams and are not as difficult as the homework problems. If you're not good at math you will probably need extra help because he is not very clear when explaining.
This class was really easy, he's a little hard to understand.

It's true you learn basically nothing in class and the harder concepts he teaches are difficult to understand, but this class is pretty much cake. the exams are taken directly from previous exams and if you can do all of those problems, this is an easy A. If you are good at math and don't need fairly simple concepts explained to you, take this

TERRIBLE PROFESSOR!!! You cannot understand a word he says. He puts powerpoints up on the screen and clicks through them. DOESN'T TEACH ANYTHING!! you leave class with no knowledge of the material. If you ask questions, 7 times out of 10 he doesn't understand what your asking... and if he does, he cannot effectively answer your question. DO NOT TAK

Completely worthless class. He put powerpoints up with problems already worked and clicked through them all class. If you don't understand something he isn't going to be the one teaching it to you. Lots of learning on your own. Avoid Sathaye if at all possible. The only thing that kept my grade even decent was recitation because he was helpful.

I had to drop this class because I could not understand a word he said, nor could I read a single thing he wrote on the board. Totally and completly worthless professor. The guy knows mathamatics, no doubt - he wrote his own textbook for crying out loud - but he cannot, whatsoever, teach a class in understandable English. Avoid Sathaye at ALL COSTS

This class would be a nightmare if the material was moderately difficult, but it's not that bad if you're willing to put forth some effort (read the book).  The problem is if you have trouble understanding a concept in class.  He pretty much will not help you at all.  Recitation isn't much better.  Prepare to work a lot on your own in this class.
He just clicks powerpoint slides on class and doesn't actually workout any problems.  He is also hard to understand. Take someone else.

Before college i liked math this man has made me hate math and made my first semester miserable. He cant teach you wont understand a word he says. I pretty much failed this class DO NOT TAKE IT WITH HIM!!!
He's prolly a genius at math.. he just cant teach it.
HE IS IMPOSSIBLE TO UNDERSTAND. EVERYTHING I'VE LEARNED IS FROM RECITATION, I GO TO LECTURE PURELY FOR ATTENDANCNCE AND THATS IT.
No Comments

This year is the first time I ever had to READ a math book. This guy is super bad. I've learned more from my book then I have this guy. He does HW problems you did in recitation so he waste 30mins of class when you should be learnign new materical. He's super nice as can be, but NEVER EVER have this professor for MA113.

Embodiment of optimism and cheer. Gets to know all of her students and does an excellent job making you want to do well. Need to put the work in, but she'll reward you if she sees you trying. Great teacher.

This woman is full of energy. She is always ready to help and which is awesome as Russian rarely comes naturally to people. Nice but firm, demanding but helpful. I would recommend this class to anyone.

@Reviewer below me: i don't think she judges people based on gender, she likes people that work hard and try to impress her. Anyways. RUS 102 steps up the pace from 101 but as long as you put forth the actual effort required and enjoy the language and her teaching method, you can't go wrong with dedication.

Always smiling and is willing to help.  Likes girls more than guys.  Weird grading method, but not ness. bad.  never uses power point, which is cool.  must be awake and alert in her class, and ready to participate.

She isn't the easiest professor out there. If you take RUS 101 or RUS 102 be prepared to work, the intrinsic reward is worth the effort. She's also a lot of fun and is always willing to help a student.

She is not clear on what she wants from us. Her grading is confusing, as well as her feedback. The way in which she does attendance is also frustrating. She is very passionate about what she teaches, so I hate to leave a bad review, because I think she was very kind and open to questions. It's just that her grading and instructions are confusing.
Get ready for unclear feedback and grades to be put in next semester

Dr. Barfield is young and new-ish to teaching. I think that's just the biggest flaw. She makes the classroom an environment where you need to participate, and she is genuinely passionate about research. It's hard to be in a class like this when many students don't want to actively participate. You do get graded on ACTUAL ACTIVE participation.
Awful grading rubric standards. Can't grade right and relevantly.

Hands down, the worst professor I've had in my entire academic career. Unclear grading and meaningless assignments. Why give assignments if you don't grade them? She simply just did not grade half of the assignments, making her harsh grading burn more for the ones she actually bothered to grade. Might have gotten a B if she actually graded my work.
Professor Bailey is knowledgeable and the aerospace labs are quite engaging and informative. Lectures can be long due to the complexity of the material, but the course was very worthwhile.

I had Dr. Bailey for both the lab and lecture. Lecture was fine, kinda boring, but interesting topics. Lab was fun and he great to interact with. He loves to be sarcastic with students and is fun to be around. Overall great professor.
Took him for intro to aerospace. He's a pretty awkward teacher, seems new to this stuff but introduces topics pretty good. Was little to no help in the build lab though.

Bailey is one of the most stand up professors I've ever had. The material is not easy, but the class is set up so that points are easy to attain. We only had five homeworks throughout the semester and both exams were take home, so it was very laid back. I don't like his handwritten notes, but he also has supplementary text notes. Would recommend.
Too much homework also Lack of guidance
She doesn't care about the feeling and status of students at all. She only cares about her reputation.

This is a hard class regardless of if Dr. Bae is teaching it. She recommends reading the content before coming to class, I didn't but definitely agree because her teaching style relies on it. Quizzes are required and you should use them to try and abstract how to do problems. Grading is def harsh but I did ok on the tests studying minimally.

Not a great professor. HW takes too long and it does not help with the exams that much. Asking her for help does not work out either since she will re-iterate the question in different way. Lectures are too fast, not enough examples worked in class to help with homework and exams. Not flexible with grading.

This class was a nightmare.  Her homeworks took me an absurd amount of time and I didn't feel that it contributed to my ability or understanding much.  She flies through lecture content with not enough time to cover example problems which leaves you lost outside of class.  Quizzes every lecture usually over the content covered THAT day.

Dr. Bae is a great teacher. She has a great knowledge of the subject and speaks clearly compared to many other foreign professors. She grades fairly but you have to put in some work to understand the concepts. Heavy calculus, and elements of calculus IV but not required. Homework has been cut down alot compared to previous semesters.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The TA was a total lifesaver, always around to help out, it was awesome. But she'd throw in some tricky stuff that didn't really seem to help us think better, just made things confusing. She makes problems that necessarily doesn't improve critical thinking.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Assigns a lot of work but she's very available and helpful in office hours and the way she grades for EE421/422 is very fair. e.g: quizzes are graded more as attendance than by % right, getting 50% of the correct answer usually nets you a 9/10 or 10/10. Big time commitment but you'll get a good grade if you try. Understanding if you get behind.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This course should not be offered for undergrad. Even grad student suffers in this course. Provides many journal papers and materials and the instructor seems students would learn everything from that. The final project was so hard and you couldn't even progress if you don't have previous experience of ML and biomedical signal processing.

By so many papers, I mean you have to write the summary of 7 journal papers. This is in addition to the mid and final projects. Being new, she might be learning how to achieve balance between quantity and quality of content. She assigns lots of material to study and the student is forced to skip in-depth study for in-time submission of assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--So many papers

reviews.comment: this was a great class! I always looked forward to attend his lectures, as they were easy to follow along. his homework assignments were easy, and they definitely help you on his exams. if you're worried about taking macro, this is a great class to take.
Berdiev is one of the best professors at Bryant. He is hilarious during lectures. You will actually learn with him. His exams are hard, but if you want to learn macro, then I highly recommend him.

Berdiev is a great professor and you will learn a lot from him and have a good time in his class. However, during exams he goes from being friendly to an army sergeant and if gets a whiff of funny business will be on your a**. This is not unreasonable though. He is also nit picky in grading, but gives chances for points back.

Took Berdiev at Bryant University, if you're ready to be graded off of 4 things and want to hate your life, take this course. He is a tough grader and does not explain things clearly. Took this class for my minor. This class has ruined my life and I hate his exams. Do not take this course if you have any life left in your soul.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The best! It's that simple. Professor Berdiev is the best professor I have ever had. I have never met a professor so passionate in his students succeeding. He will take as much time as needed to ensure every student understands the concepts being taught. The world needs more professors like Berdiev. I'd give him 100 stars if I could.

One of the best professors I have had here. His love for econ shows and motivates students to dive further into the topic. If you get on his bad side, it may be rough, but if you participate, show effort, and actually care about the class, you will enjoy it a lot more because of him. Has great real-world examples and really cares for his students.

Best professor I have had at Bryant so far! He is very enthusiastic about the course material and enjoys being in the classroom and having class discussions. He never wants students to feel confused or uncomfortable. He also admits when he is wrong unlike many other staff at Bryant. He does not take any BS  but he always is willing to joke around.

I had to take ECO 314 as part of my minor. He is a good professor, knows how to teach. 2 exams and a final exam that make up most of the grade. Multiple choice is difficult but the long response is just like in class. Quizzes are easy and homework helps boost grade. Not many professors for 314 so go in with an open ears and you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took at Bryant Uni. Professor Berdiev is a great guy, and his class is solid. Grade is mostly determined by the exams. HW and quizzes are straightforward, but you NEED to know the content of the class to do well. You cannot skate by in this class, you will fail. He is available to help you and wants his students to do well.

I didn't do well at the start, hence a C+, but I learned to enjoy his class.  He cares a lot about how well his students do and wants you to learn.  His classes are lecture heavy and he does a good job, but doing work outside of the lectures is important for him.  You get tested on everything in the lectures, nothing is left out.

Loves Chipotle. I took him at Bryant university, beware of his tests. Anything open-ended is pretty easy but the multiple choice are absolutely brutal. Great dude, always available. You will feel amazing at macro until you look at your test grade. Confusing stuff.

Course is not difficult. But he has strange comment sometime such as Sumsang stolen a lot of technology from the U.S. He always talks about his opinions about the news for 20 mins. Confused about what he is doing in class.

I don't think he really care about the student. Some of my group members find that is difficult to find data, he said that he had provided the website and didn't want to help. He says he is willing to help but exactly only after class time. His office hour barely opens without any reasons.

I wanted to drop this class early on but I would have regretted doing so. He pushed me to greater lengths and I surprisingly enjoyed my second half of the semester in his class.
