The class felt like a mix between an econ course, m&b, and math. I recommend making quizlets on the presentation material for current students in his class

Do not take this professor! Makes the class so much harder than it needs to be. Claims he cares about his students deeply, though when I emailed him about missing a class due to a family death he didn't respond and proceeded to complain about the email next class. He's an extremely knowledgeable man, but it's really not worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: At Bryant now. Berdiev is a tough guy. However, he cares about his students and wants them to succeed in his class. He allows exam corrections/extra credit opportunities. His exams are tough and worded poorly/don't correlate with lectures. Gives a few easy homework assignments that will boost your grade. Definitely go to class and take notes!

One of the best profs at Bryant. Yeah he's a little rough around the edges but it is because he cares. If you do the very minimal assigned work and study for exams its an easy B at the least. He is the only professor that actually makes the PEC project fun and feel worth it. Super encouraging to all students. You will learn so much! Take for sure!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Caring

reviews.comment: Great Macroeconomics professor. Tests are difficult, but he gives clear explanations. Class are fun, but sometimes its easy to get lost. Very good, caring professor! Take his class!

Possibly the worst professor I have ever had in my life, rude, frequently berated me in class for not understanding the material, he caused me even more stress than I already had at the point so I had no choice to drop out. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: good

prof berdiev does a great job of explaining material. the two tests were on the difficult side but factors in homework in group work. put in the work youll do well. prof berdiev takes class seriously and is a discipline enthusiast, however he is an easy person to get along with and frequently makes jokes during class
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: Professor Berdiev is an alright professor but his exams don't correlate with his lectures and you will find yourself lost on the exams. He's really mean and will call on his students even when he knows that they don't know the answer just to make them look dumb. I give you the "Berdiev Guarantee" that you will not like this class.

He knows so much and is so pationate but his exams are worded very poorly. He can also be kinda mean sometimes, you know how those Eastern Europeans can be lol. Very straightforward and is a tough grader

At Bryant now. Professor Berbiev is a good and easy professor. He  makes things easy to understand but it VERY repetitive. You have to pay attention in class or he will call you out. He will call you on you randomly all time time too. He can be unintentionally a duck. His lectures are very long and most classes went 5-10 minutes over.

At Bryant now. He assigns assignments that aren't on the syllabus and don't really count for much. If you are having a tough time in the beginning he will say to talk to your adviser and drop the class - so not very inspirational. He loves macro and has some funny jokes, however towards the end we barely did anything and NEVER had a final review.

Berdiev is a professor that LOVES his job. He gets very excited over macro and takes his class very seriously. Prints out all the notes for you, clear about what he wants, read the textbook, and take the class seriously. He's a funny and respectable guy. He has a thick accent, but it is understandable, and you get used to it after the first class.

TEACHES AT BRYANT NOW. Really good professor, sometimes he can be a jerk but he likes to make jokes and keeps class interesting. If you have questions he'll answer them thoroughly but he does not like to waste time in class so make sure your questions are relevant. Would recommend! Loves Chipotle!!!
He is absolutely a great professor! Love his jokes!
He is a tough teacher, but honestly he is probably one of the best teachers I have ever had. Go to class and do the homework and you will do well. Spells out what he wants and doesn't deviate from it
Very Helpful teacher, comes off as a kind of mean. Very clear with what he wants. Participation is a must. He tells the greatest jokes.

Great Teacher! he explains a lot and he is able to explain very well. Tries to make class fun with jokes at times but never shifts too far off topic. Willing to work with you when your grades slip. Grading is tough but if you just turn in assignments, you do very well.

He is younger and tries to be helpful...but here is where the good review ends. He doesn't have a computer at home,so it takes a while for him to get back to you if you have a question.His exams are super hard and the reviews he gives are not very helpful. You need to attend class to have some sort of understanding of this subject.
cool guy, good class... go to class
I took a class by Dr. B as a sophomore and still have nightmares. If there are any other options I highly suggest avoiding this professor. Completely unorganized and she had a bad attitude.
shes ok if you go to class and do your work. if not avoid.

reviews.comment: I HATED THIS TEACHER!!! Her class was so hard to follow. She wouldn't accept my DRC accommodations unless I printed them and had a meeting with her, but when I told her I didn't have access to a printer nor time to meet with her over them she refused to accept them. At that point, I stopped showing up to her class because of this.

There is little to no work required outside of class. If you go to class and complete the few assignments she has, you will make an A. She is very particular on how she wants you to do things but if you are ever confused just ask her. Make sure you go to class every single time. I made over a 115% as a final grade in the course. It is super easy.
This class was extremely unorganized. Very hard to navigate through assignments and hard to tell what is do and when. Dreaded going to class due to how little people cared and how boring it was.

Dr. B is a a very nice person outside of the classroom, however, she believes students are solely responsible for themselves and does not give good feedback and help inside the classroom. As well professor is TERRIBLE at communication.

Her extra credit opportunities are the best though!!

reviews.comment: This professor is rude when you email her and will give you bad grades for the smallest reasons. I DO NOT RECOMMEND.

reviews.comment: Dr. B was amazing! I've taken two courses with her so far and she made learning really easy. She expects us to look things up for ourselves, but other than that her courses are pretty easy. She encourages us to participate and gives a bunch of extra credit. I would recommend anybody take her courses if they need a 2 credit course to help their GPA.

She has class set up where "the student is responsible," She believes that her syllabus (full of errors) holds the answers to all. Don't even bother sending an email that will mostly consist of a snotty remark. Attendance is mandatory. If you come to class you'll get a good grade-- this doesn't make her anymore tolerable.

This professor over complicates this course to the absolute maximum. I do not consider her as a legitimate professor whatsoever. She does not make deadlines clear over canvas at all, making it likely to miss a deadline by accident and for her to not give you any other chances. She makes assignment descriptions way too long and they don't make sense

Dr.B's class is a good class to take if you need some extra credits to get by. Her class is super easy- just 12 assignments and her syllabus can be a little confusing at the beginning, but just ask her and she will explain. she gives extra credit like crazy- just speak up in class. I had enough extra points to go up over a whole grade level.
As a person she is very polite, however if a mistake is made like an incorrect upload of an assignment she will give a 0. No matter what. Other than that extremely easy course.

I took this course because I needed to remain a full time student at 12 hours. This class isn't that difficult, however Dr. B is very specific with her assignments and the work is often tedious. She is hard to communicate with and if you have a question will almost always just tell you to read the syllabus for the answer. I would avoid this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She's great as a person, but not as a professor. I had to take this class to remain at 12 hours, and it is honestly not worth the hassle. She also is not willing to work with students, even if you attend class

reviews.comment: Dr. B is very helpful and gives a ton of extra credit. Most of her assignments are graded off effort versus content. Speak up in class she give extra credit this way. Look over PowerPoints on off days, they have extra credit in them. She is a wonderful professor!
do her extra credit, it helps
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Rita was the worst professor Ive ever had. I took this course for credit and regretted it. She doesnt have due dates in canvas, youre expected to just know when everything is due. She is rude with grading, harsh deadlines, and very very unclear. I was sick and provided proof and she did not give me an extension on a paper and I received a 0.

reviews.comment: I know the class is an easy A but some things are more Important, she has no Idea how to organize a class. she doesn't have a modules section and every assignments description is check the syllabus, which is 15 pages long. for the paper you have to write according to the template you can loose 25 points but the assignment is only worth 15 points.
She was honestly a great professor who helped us achieve what we needed out of the class.

reviews.comment: If you go to class, you can get so much extra credit. Professor B will answer any questions she can to help you. She truly cares about her students and wants to see you succeed.

Prof. Rita gets some bad reviews by the kids who don't show up to class. Those are the ones who don't pass this class. If you show up and participate and take advantage of all the extra credit she offers (once a week). You will leave this class with an A. Well worth the take if you need credits and to boost your GPA up. She's the goat.

Had a terrible experience. Forgot to sign in the day of our final project (which was a presentation to the class) and I received a 0 and failed the class. reviews.comment: She is crazy

reviews.comment: At first, I didn't really enjoy the class. That all changed the closer I got with my team & with Dr. B. reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I loved Basuray as a person, but I can't say that i've learned much of anything from her class. It's weird because she does an excellent job of engaging students and putting you in a learning mindset, but when it comes to actually learning and doing things she wasn't good. Quizzes were over absolutely random things, and overall confusing.
If you ever do bad on an assignment, you have several chances to make it up with extra credit. The class is based around teamwork. Interesting lectures.

Brilliant professor! Provides in depth information over all course work,and sets up the class to work with Team based learning giving you a chance to learn and work with your peers along the way in many different ways including different assignments,quizzes,and group projects. Everyone leaves her class having learned something as well as Bassuray!

She's an approachable professor. She teaches students, but she also learns from the students when they present their research to the class. The class environment is relaxed and participation is key to success. If you attend class more than 80% of her classes, you will have more opportunities to raise your grade.

Very short when it came to students asking for help. She would always respond, "look in the syllabus." Assigned a scientific research paper. Too much for a 100 level class. Strict on attendance. I asked to leave early for my next class, and she made me log it. Once I didn't turn it in on the date given on the syllabus, she knocked me down a grade.

Whenever I would ask for help she would tell me to ask my group or other students and whenever I asked a question she said things like "you know the answer to that" which was very rude and then she would wonder why the class was quiet and not asking questions. Doesn't pass back any assignments. too much work for a 100 level course.

Dr. Basuray is an extremely intelligent women, HOWEVER, I do believe that her talents would probably be of much more use in a laboratory rather than a classroom. She definitely knows what she is talking about but the way that she set up the class made it much more difficult than it needed to be. She also tended to be rude to particular students.
I really liked the class last year. It was an easy enjoyable time, and wasn't too tough. Teacher was super sweet.

I completely disagree with the student who posted that first response. This class was amazing, and the Professor Basuray did a fantastic job of presenting the material. The class was straightforward, interesting, and very useful for me as a premed student. Her knowledge and experience make this class invaluable. It is both interesting worth taking.

One of the least enjoyable classes i've ever taken. For what the class is, a low level elective, the work load was tremendous. She taught a class that had great potential of being interesting in a way that made it miserable.

She is an amazing professor! If you want to take an easy UK core, I highly recommend this class. The lectures are not bad at all, and if you attend class and pay attention, you will get a good grade. Assignments are mostly projects, but her grading is so reasonable. You don't have to know anything about theater or design to take this class.

She is an awesome professor. Super funny and makes lectures interesting. The class is mostly projects but she gives you so much time to do them and they are not hard at all. Attendance isn't mandatory but she will change your grade if she sees that you attend most of the lectures and pay attention.
I don't really like Design and I'm a communication/journalism major but if you do then you definitely would love to take her! She's super nice and laid back!

I took this to satisfy an art credit. It ended up being a class I found enjoyable and fun to attend. Attendance wasn't mandatory for the first 2.5 months, but she made it fun for those who showed up. Overall, an easy class with a fun professor. Would absolutely take again.
Take Tracy for your arts gen-ed. This class is low stress. She does cancel class a lot. The work is super easy and she a lenient grader.

Professor Barber is great! She's knowledgeable in a wide variety of theatre disciplines, and she's interactive during lectures. She's very passionate about what she does, so she may go off on (several) tangents, but take that how you will. As long as you interact with Barber and she knows you're a good student, you'll be fine.

Extremely easy class. Cancels very often, and she said herself on the first day, "You could never show up to a single lecture for this course and still pass." So.. take that as you will. If you're actually serious about design and production, maybe not the class for you. But if you need an easy art credit, definitely pick this class with Tracy.
He was not my favorite teacher but he wasnt bad, I felt like I had to teach myself most of the units

Very caring and understanding. I thought he was great at going over content and teaching; he would go over plenty of practice problems. Like any math class, the content can be hard, but he did a good job at trying to give grace where he could. He didn't want to see you do badly.

Professor Baker is a genuine guy, but he is easily the worst teacher I've ever had. Get ready to teach the entire class to yourself. If there is an 8 am with a different teacher, take that class, it's worth it.

If you have to take this class just get it over with tbh, you'll most likely get a C unless you put an ungodly amount time into it and get a tutor of some sorts OR took calc in high school, i really dont know how this guy still has a job in the math department here. this is a painful course, just get it over with.
Sucks so bad. Just does examples all lecture and does not explain them. Will give you an exam review packet before the exam but it is nothing like the exam at all. Misleading.

Not really sure why this guy still has a job, he is awful, he assumes you already know the topics, not really caring either. Please if you can take any other professor do it, I don't care if its 8 am its worth it. Also really test heavy. Baker if you are reading this review, please pursue another job and stop teaching you're not good at it.

reviews.comment: Had to teach myself the entire class. Lectures were terrible. Would not take for MA123. Class is already hard, he makes it harder.

This class would be easier if my previous math classes had been better quality. He is INCREDIBLY test heavy, if you get a bad grade first exam it's super hard to catch back up. His lectures were incredibly unhelpful, doesn't give thorough explanations and just writes things out on the board and expects you to know how to do it just by watching him.

Professor Baker is a very nice guy. However, it's very easy to get lost in the sauce, and he goes over things quickly, taking extra steps sometimes. In one class you end up going over 3 problems per class where you have no idea whats going on because he takes the assumption you know whats up. Self-study and recitation is necessary to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He can be hard to understand but is really just a whimsical dude. Attend lectures and review notes and you'll be set for the tests
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's a chill guy, but he talks so fast. You will have to make sure to review the notes after class because you will disassociate during class if you have a short attention span like me. ALSO, all of the exams are no calculator, so be ready. He also over-explains topics and makes things more confusing.

Hes real nice. Just review notes after class because its hard to understand how he explains sometimes but the maths simple if you pay attention to the patterns. Responds fast to emails and goes out of his way to help you out. Nice guy whos pretty goofy. Also 5% bonus to overall grade if you just show up and do your work in recitation.

Honestly he's really nice. He cares about his students & is just a whimsy guy. Most of the time, students who don't do well in his class skip & expect to do good on the exam. I'm a visual learner and he color coats his notes so it really helps. I will say that your recitation TA & practicing problems is what got me to truly understand the material

Professor Baker. Is easily the most poor performing professor. He doesn't teach the material whatsoever and assumes students already know it. He's unwilling to help students no matter the case. Do not take Michael Baker go to another MA 123 professor.
He is not a good teacher. Get ready to teach yourself the whole course because he will not. Good Luck

Mr. Baker is a genuine guy who wants students to do their best on tests. Unfortunately, I have to write this review as it is the worst class I have taken. He wears a mask and it is tough to understand him. The class averages 2 questions per lecture and then a rushed third question with no time to explain. WebWork is awful. Tests relate to lectures
It was a hard class for sure but his lectures were slow and he was easy to understand.

He's actually pretty nice, he worked with my DRC accommodations and was super understanding. But I almost think he does not know what he's teaching. He goes back and forth with the problems from the textbook, he one time said, “I don't really remember how to finish this problem, so we're just going to leave it like this.” If that says anything.

In one 50 minute lecture he will complete a maximum of three homework problems. He is difficult to understand and mumbles a lot. It is a very exam heavy class when it comes to grading but you do get effort credit so make sure you go to class and do your homework. It is worth a bad schedule to not have him as your professor.

MA123 was an easy class with Baker, but not thanks to him. I never went to lecture, and you're graded on weekly homework plus four exams. The tests aren't hard if you study for the week before. He gives a 5% grade increase for easy extra credit. I didn't think this class was too hard, but I definitely didn't love it.

Dr. Baker stumbles, mutters, and sounds unsure of himself the entire lecture. He takes an entire class period to do one problem. However, his lectures are thorough, and that paired with recitation cover EXACTLY what's on the exams. If you do the homework and attend lectures/recitation then MA123 is an extremely easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The tests are worth a lot of your grade, but he provides the tests from last year so you know exactly what to expect.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Michael Baker is by far the worst professor known to the University of Kentucky. You can't hear him during lectures, but he takes 50 minutes to go over 3 problems and half the time he doesnt even know what hes doing. He overcomplicates everything. The TA's are the only ones who teach anything helpful.

Overall it was not bad, he does talk through a mask and mumbles which makes him a bit hard to understand, but he works through all problems in the notes sheet in lectures, then publishes the completed notes, also publishes a review with solutions, as well as exams for every unit from the past 2 semesters, you have plenty of study material.
His lectures are thorough and he provides completed notes before each exam. Also provided practice problems and practice exams with answers. Prepared well for exams.

This is the first math class I have lost sleep and sobbed over. SEVERAL TIMES. I barely failed an exam and it brought my grade down 15 points, because the exams are a whopping 70 PERCENT of your grade & it's a tossup if his in-class reviews look like the exam. He mumbles through a mask in lectures, and harps on the wrong part of the problems.

This man has got to be the absolute worst professor I have had the unfortunate experience of having throughout my time at UK. He consistently spends the entire lecture on one problem, just to find out at the end that he did it wrong. If this were a one time thing, that would be different but it is every single day. How is this man still employed???

I've never struggled in math until I took this class. It's practically mandatory to get your own personal tutor if you want to pass. If you have to wait another semester to take it in order to get another professor do so! I know a lot of people who ended up dropping and having to retake it. The exams are 70% of your overall grade. Good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: For the difficulty of the class, Baker does a decent job of providing you with the materials necessary to complete the class. While lecture is a bit boring and tedious, he shows that he cares about his students when it comes to needing assistance. My class with him has also had several homework due dates pushed forward.

He takes the entire 50 minutes to go over a total of 3 problems and over complicates them. The TA's in recitation teach actual lectures than him just jumping right into it with no plan either. He thinks of the steps off the top of his head. People had to come in to survey the entire class about him and no one said one good thing about his teaching.

This professor is terrible, He does not teach anything. He works out problems on the board and expects you to know how to do them without even walking you through them. Can barely understand him when he is talking. Do not recommend to anyone, absolutely the worst professor/ teacher i've ever had.

Overall,I really enjoyed being in Dr. Bakers course. While there is quite a bit of different things to learn, he will spend time with you if you are not understanding what he is saying. He truly cares about people and how they are doing. Would definitely take again! Recitation attendance is mandatory but depending who your TA is you should be good!

I love Dr. Baker! He does add a lot of unnecessary steps when explaining the material and I think his efforts to help people better understand can come off by adding extra confusion. But besides this, he is a wonderful teacher that is very approachable and wants to see his students succeed. wonderful study guides as well!!
Do not take with this professor. He teaches the material wrong and is so hard to follow.
Wears a mask and too hard to understand, slow and boring
Class isn't hard, there is plenty of homework to make sure you know the material and he responds to emails fast. Attendance does not matter at all.

I took Baker for MA162 and it was the easiest math class I've taken in college. Baker takes very good/easy to follow notes and posts all of them to canvas. Attendance isn't mandatory, and to be honest, you could most likely pass the class without going to lecture because of his notes. His test reviews are also almost the exact same as the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Baker can be pretty unprepared for lecture and often obsesses about little details about how he writes out his handwriting, you don't really need to go to class but you need to stay caught up. His notes are decent and his exam review is excellent. Just make sure when you don't go to class you make sure you understand the content.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class
Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: terrible teacher doenst know what he is doing half the time and quite frankly shouldnt even be a teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Has a horrible method of teaching that only works well for you if you are good at taking notes. Has no options for retakes and questions on tests are not very similar to review
Intellectually weak and poorly sourced.

Disrespectful, unprofessional, and unfair. Had to get in contact with student services to help me overcome her biased grading. Warming: do not stand up for yourself if she disrespects via email, because she will purposefully lower your grade.
easy class with only a few assignments outside of class & attendance is mandatory. DO NOT BUY THE BOOK!!! the exams are not proctored but test questions are not even in the lectures
Dr. Banner is very sweet, she does get side tracked and will tell her own stories throughout the classes. However, the class itself is very easy and midterm/final are online with no proctoring.

I think I showed up to class twice and did homework for other classes both times. Lectures are posted, group projects are mandatory but can be done on group me, and teacher was super easy to understand. Final and midterm are taken online and not proctored.

Dr. Benner was great! The class was very easy, but she made the material interesting with lots of guest speakers. There are assigned readings but I never did them and got an A in the class. Tests are taken from home. There is an attendance question every day, but the class really is enjoyable so you should go!
Class is super easy but she asks opinion questions on tests with multiple choice questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I genuinely enjoyed being in her class and listening to her stories during lectures. Dr. Benner is incredibly engaging but this is at the downfall of actually understanding the material. She tends to go off on tangents during class leaving the course material to the wayside but this material isn't too difficult to begin with so it's not so bad.
Super nice and loves to tell stories from her experiences which make her lectures really interesting.

Her attendance is mandatory but there only 2 tests and they're both online. She also posts all her PowerPoints on canvas so it's easy to get an A. Otherwise her lectures are kinda boring but she tries.

Dr. Benner's class was SUPER easy. There are attendance questions, but if you know someone in the class then they can send you the answer. All assignments were short, didn't require much effort, and graded for basically following the given directions. Exams are also all online and to be taken at your convenience she will give hints during lecture.

Does not grade timely so you can't even estimate your grades. We are two days away from the due date for campus grades and our first assignment still has no grade. Communication is a big fail too. Also, does not open assignments timely. The final assignment was not made available until two days before it was due.

She ignores emails for weeks at a time. She does gran't assignments in a timely manner and then lies about it saying she has graded them. It is currently April 22 but she hasn't graded things from March 13th.  I have NO idea what I have in class because out of 11 assignments she has only graded two and the semester is over in one week.  Ridiculous

She is so nice and really passionate about social work, there are daily attendance quizzes, 2 exams that you take from home, and a few homework assignments. I recommend taking this class if you are looking for an easy UK core class

Class is mainly focused on lectures & you don’t actually need the textbook. She is very dedicated to covering all topics of social work, even if it’s aspects that no one is interested in or aspects that are barely related.

She was super nice and really showed her passion for teaching and social work through this class. The only downfall of the class was it was a little slow paced and sometimes the assignments could get confusing but overall it was a great class and she was extremely helpful in her teaching and explanations of everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Would not recommend this class if you are disabled. Trying to get a very simple accommodation met was a nightmare.

nice lady. material is easy and you can tell she really cares about what she does and the material. attendance is mandatory and there are attendance quizzes but they are nothing to sweat. lectures sometimes feel long but other times they are very captivating. assignments are easy. she isn't very understanding with late assignments though.

Kalea is really sweet and really makes you think about social work. her lectures are interesting, she takes attendance, but I think you could get away with skipping quite a few times before it matters. exams are online, answers were in the powerpoint. We had two short papers and she grades very easy so no stress there. Take this course for an easyA

Dr. Benner is very nice and will tend to understand if something is turned in late or if you are late for class. She does grade hard, but she does it to make sure that you know what you are doing so that you know how to do it properly in other classes.

Dr. Benner is the most amazing, caring professor I have had at UK. Tying her personal experience into her lectures makes them interesting and understandable. Such an easy A, midterm and final were easy and probably the most difficult part of the class if anything. Very reasonable and understanding, requires 15 service hours. Overall great professor

She means well. She mostly tells stories & uses random examples, which doesn't help when it comes time for the exam. I don't listen in class, I just use the textbook and the slides posted online and I do fine on exams. She does attendance quizzes everyday. But beware leaving early, theres occasionally random group projects at the end of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Benner is a good teacher who uses personal experiences so it is very interesting. Attendance is a big part and there are not many other things graded. Service hours are required, few papers and projects, and just midterm and final. Not many grades so have to do good on everything. Not an easy A, but if put in work than it can be.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Class was mostly PowerPoints (also posted online) interjected with relevant experiences of hers (which were very helpful) and several guest lecturers. Textbook required. Literally three tiny assignments and a final essay. Both midterm and final are online and pretty easy. Documented service hours required. Super sweet professor. Overall easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Super sweet lady at first but towards the end of the semester just turned very cold towards me about anything I asked about. The class was super easy but she doesnt give you much of anything to be graded in which sucks. Overall a good & easy class but she just also had a lot of guest lecturers.

She is SUPER sweet and understanding. Most of class consists of lectures, but she tells a lot of stories about her experiences to certain social work topics. She grades pretty easily. Final and Mid-term were online and at home. Overall easy class

The kindest & most memorable professor. She is so considerate of her students needs, her exams are online and not too difficult if you attend class, attendance isn't mandatory but is recorded & counts toward your grade. I NEVER used the book, or even opened it and still got an A. A must take class, made me love social work. also not much HW!

Professor Beckmann is really great and funny. He tries to break down very complex topics in the easiest way possible, but you can get a little lost when he is talking super fast. There's only 3 tests and 6 quizzes, which are split 50 50, and he dropped the lowest exam score and lowest quiz, so you can do well in this class.

The lectures are so hard to understand if you are not familiar with biology. But, the way the grading is set up you don't need to do amazing on the exams. He also drops the lowest score, which makes it pretty easy to do well. Buy the textbook if you are struggling; it helps!

Though Joshua is very nice, he is terrible at teaching. He literally just talks at you, spewing information about the most complex things going a mile a minute. It is difficult to understand everything he teaches so GET THE TEXTBOOK!! Use the study guide he gives you and fill it out using the textbook and you will pass this class easy.

I really liked this professor, he was very clear on grading assignments. Only assignments for the class are quizzes and tests. Both worth 50% of your grade. Finished the class right after thanksgiving break and he dropped our lowest test and quiz score. Would highly recommend.

Dr. Beckmann is an incredible professor. His class is a lot of work and challenging, but he is great at explaining difficult concepts. His rubrics and overall class expectations are super clear, and he is easy to reach out to for help. All assignments are also weighted very equally. He gives clear feedback and typically puts grades in quickly.

He was honestly a great professor. His exams (in my opinion) were not that difficult, but only if you give yourself plenty of time to study. Quizzes are 50% of your grade and so are tests. Make a groupme and share answers for the quizzes and itll be easy. Talk to him at office hours too if anything isnt clear. Overall, I enjoyed his course.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: He's a solid choice for this class. Good at breaking down some of the harder material. Grading is 50% quizzes, 50% exams. Quizzes are every Thursday, online, with 2 attempts and no time limit. Exams aren't bad if you read through his lectures (they're in class). His lectures are interesting, but not mandatory, so your choice if you want to show up.

He's engaged, energetic, and kind to students. I love his lectures. Even though they're not mandatory, for your grade & enjoyment, I recommend them. Grade: 50% quizzes, 50% exams. 11 quizzes/online/no time limit/2 attempts. Get 100% on all of them (easy) & you only need an 80% overall in exams. Exams are tough. 40 mult. choice + 3 extra credit Qs.

Great professor and great guy. Admittedly the course grading seemed weird and I did not like it at first, but it grew on me and rewards those who put in the effort starting day 1. There's no final, and every assignment is Pass/Fail with unlimited revisions, you just need to keep revising until you get enough passing grades in each category.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: One of the bess class setups ever. We got to do revisions on all work we didn't do right the first time and the class is set up to where if you do really well throughout the semester, you have essentially no work in the end. No final either. Not to mention he's funny and easy to talk to
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Braun explains every topic with patience. He paces himself according to his students' speed. I was in the honors section of this class with him and we had opportunities to revise homeworks and get grades for whatever we missed the first time. Highly recommend taking him for any math class!

I took the Honors section so the class was focused around inquiry activities in groups. Dr. Braun clearly cares about what he's teaching but is also very down to earth and helpful. Working with other people was helpful and a good challenge, but I didn't like having to write 2-3 page essays on how the class was going for me.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Braun was a really good professor, he spends a lot of time during the lectures focusing on why something is true instead of doing examples which can be good and bad at times. The class itself is pretty hard but that's calculus. He curved all of the exams by 4-7 points each which really helped by the end of the semester.

Calculus is inherently difficult, but Braun taught it in a way that helped me understand the motivation behind what we were doing and where all the equations came from. He didn't do a ton of examples in lecture, which would've been helpful, but the lectures were definitely critical to understanding the concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: This is the first math course I've taken that I really loved. Dr. Braun focuses on the reasoning behind calculus. The homework and past exams were very helpful in preparing for exams. His notes are straightforward and great for visual learners. I would highly recommend him if you want to deeply understand calculus!
He's the worst math teacher I've ever had. He rambles on and on and on about the process behind the math and never actually works examples. You get to the test and you're shooketh!!!

He has attendance sheets to sign at the beginning of most lectures, and if you happen to skip he posts all of his notes to Canvas. Although being in class is very helpful because he does a good job explaining things and is relatable and funny in class.

Professor Braun has been one of, if not the best, professors I've had since starting college. You can tell he truly loves math and teaches to understand, not just for test material. He is super accessible after class, and honestly wants to see his students succeed. He does a lot more than tenured of these tenured professors.

Lectures are "mandatory" with attendance grades, however the lecture barely helps when it comes to the tests. Lectures are random and he often goes off on tangents (pun not intended) about the history of the word algebra. Likes to think he is an inspirational speaker. Best advice on tests is to write "I can do this!" on front of exam. Real catch.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor Braun is a fantastic Calculus teacher. He and his TA's are more than accommodating with their office hours, and his homework actually helps prepare you for the test.

This guy is very kind and means well, but spends too much time explaining the HOW and not explaining how to apply the concepts. He wastes a lot of time asking you to discuss and taking live polls of the class. He loves explaining the theories which leave you often unable to do the 100x harder webwork. Tests are very fair though.

If you want an instructor who cares about the material who is teaching and who he is teaching, then take Prof. Braun. Get ready for a lot of WebWork, but if you buckle down it's worth it. I have learned SO much, he has made me genuinely love math.
Professor Braun was a great guy.  Taught very well in a way that we understood it, not just learned the formulas.  Would absolutely love to take him again.
Great guy.  Does problems in class just like the exams!!   Hope he does hte same for the final!
Quality guy.
Very good professor, keeps your attention during lectures, very helpful. Will sometimes take attendance, sometimes he doesn't.
Braun is just a great, funny teacher. He explains things very well; making sure we all know the how and not just the what.
Really great lectures! Teaches math by its concepts rather than just giving you formulas. He explains really well how each step of the process works.

I could literally not give Ben Braun enough credit. He is, hands down, the best college professor I have ever taken. He is incredibly knowledgeable,  hilarious, and just an incredible professor. A quick warning, this class is HARD. Expect to work, to mess up, but if you listen to the lectures, study, and do practice problems, you will be just fine.

One of the best math teachers I have ever had. He explains the material more clearly than most professors and tries to make lectures as interesting as possible (although that's pretty hard to do in a Calc 2 class)

Dr. Braun is the real MVP. He really enjoys his job. He is an interesting lecturer. He teaches why something works and then teaches you how it works. Calc 2 is by no means an easy class, but Dr. Braun has made it much more intuitive and enjoyable. I plan on taking him for another class in the future.

Ben Braun is honestly one of the best math professors I have ever come into contact with. He is completely inspirational. Just one week of going to his class is sure to put you in a better position in relation to math than you were before. He is a fantastic guy overall, as well.

He is honestly one of the two greatest professors I have ever had at UK, the other one being Dr. Lee. He is a great educator and you will learn a lot if you are actually willing to put in the time. Try not to focus on your grade, because he is a harsh grader. Rather, just focus on learning and understanding the material and you will be fine.

Walked away with an A without learning much or putting much effort into the course. He's way too into himself, and thinks this "new way of learning" works so well, but it didn't do much for me. I wouldn't take this course with him again.

Wonderful teacher and adviser. Take Calculus with him! He is very easy to talk to and will help you with any problems you have. He is very passionate about his work and tries to make class fun and exciting. Take Braun, he his the best!

Great guy, with an honest appreciation for what he does. He teaches why, not how. Sometimes people won't like that, but it is really the best way to be taught if you want to go on to Calc 2,3 and 4. I definitely suggest his class. He has been my favorite professor in the math department by far.

Hes an entertaining guy but does not do well when it actually comes to teaching. He doesnt teach you HOW to do what you have to but why it works. Braun has a crazy obsession with the unit circle and corny jokes. I definitely learn everything in my recitation rather than lecture. Id be better off not even going to lecture.
Talks about random stuff in class a lot but I've learned so much from him.  If you don't understand a topic, go to his office hours and he's super nice about explaining anything to you one on one.

Great guy. A little random at times, but he is excellent at showing every process step by step. You can tell he loves his subject, and he wants everyone else to like it too. This was easily my favorite class this semester,even if it was my hardest.

All in all, he's a pretty good teacher. He teaches Calculus so people can understand the concepts, rather than just being able to crunch numbers. He is more concerned with his students gaining a real understanding of math rather than receiving perfect grades. Very helpful, funny, and passionate, albeit sometimes too smart for my understanding.

He is super nice and actually kind of funny. He really loves math and wants you to love it too. He is also interested in helping you in anyway he can. He sent me an e-mail about being a math major because I was undeclared. He is super sweet. Love him.

Overall really great guy. The class itself wasn't bad at all, however the exams were very difficult when not made by Dr. Braun. He is a really nice, approachable, and helpful professor. He genuinely loves what he teaches and really tries to make it interesting and apply it to real world examples. Really nice and funny guy, made calc bearable.

excellent professor!  hope he gets tenure!  i learned a lot in his class and he made the lectures fun and interesting.  in fact, class was so much fun i've laughed until i cried several times.  i would certainly take another class of his any day :-)
She is difficult to understand, but the exams are all open notes. You make or break your grade on whether or not you show up. If you fail the class thats just on you.
She was extremely difficult to understand. I do not feel that I learned anything in this class. Attendance is a grade. It was not difficult, but the class felt pointless.
Attendance is mandatory but there is no point in trying to listen as you cannot understand a word she is saying, this is bad don't take her

After I rip the cart a couple times I can almost understand her. Its like shes speaking english but not really. She's a nice lady and obviously passionate about political science, but she lacks any public speaking skills. I would avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She was very hard to understand. Her accent was very heavy and I could barely understand her at all. Attendance is the majority of the grade so if you go to class every day, you'll get a good grade. But she didn't seem to understand the material, she would read directly from the slides which made the class extremely boring.

She was incredibly hard to understand. I would sit with airpods in the whole time because there was no point in trying to get anything from the class. She should not wear a mask as it makes her accent even harder to understand. Attendance policy was awful. She was easy to contact outside of class but that was the only redeeming quality

She mightily struggles to read or speak English, makes lectures long and insufferable. Not a difficult class necessarily, pretty much taught myself everything. Clearly an equity hire, offered nothing to the students. Overall I'd say she needs to look for a new line of work. Reading slides in broken English does not constitute teaching in my eyes.

Doesn't seem to know the material she is teaching at all. Can also be very hard to understand as she mumbles the whole class and because of the mask we can't even read her lips. Lacks any confidence when speaking.

This course is incredibly easy, and prof Commerford is a great instructor. The in class work completely prepares you for the exams, and he gives out a practice exam that is nearly identical. Always happy to answer questions, extra credit for coming to class. Gets a bad rep because he teaches a weed out course, an A is totally possible.
I would take him for sure, he is super nice and approachable. It is a difficult class but his in class worksheets are very similar to exams. Optional final, extra credit if you go to class.

Tests are 86% of the grade and doesn't teach the content well. A simple equation gets turned into a 9 step problem that is similar to rocket science. He also has never had any real life accounting experience.

I love accounting but this professor is miserable. He enjoys making life hard. He wants his students to worry. He reads the slides and doesn't teach. I can read. For me, accounting comes easy because my parents are accountants but others really struggled because he cannot teach. Take anyone else and you might consider accounting because it is fun.

Commerford was a great professor. Gave lots of extra credit opportunities if you attended class and also gave paper worksheets that helped with the homeworks. Easily ace exams if you did all the homeworks and practice exams. Very easy to get an A if the class if you actually try.

Explains everything very well. Gives in class worksheets that are very similar to HW & tests. Extra credit  in class. Nice guy overall. Practice tests very similar to real. Tests can be hard if you don't go to class/ do homework. Tests are very large part of your grade. Optional final to replace lowest grade.

Ben is genuinely one of the bets professors I have ever taken. He clearly explains every topic in depth and his tests reflect the in class exercises pretty much identically. If you want to succeed and fully understand financial accounting, take him. I have no idea why he is not 5/5 stars. If you pay attention and participate an A will come easy.

This class is hard with any professor, but Prof Commerford is a GREAT teacher. Just go to class. The in-class assignments help so much with understanding the material. Literally just attending lecture and doing the homework will help you get an A. All you need to do is take is seriously. He wants you to do well.

Does a good job explaining examples and showing how to do things. A lot better than my ACC 200 professor. He lets you know what will be on the test, and as I came to learn, as long as you make an effort outside of class, you should get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Commerford did an amazing job teaching a class that is so tough for so many students. He absolutely knows what he is talking about all the time and is extremely clear in lectures. Tests present few surprises. Get to know him! He's an awesome guy.

this class was pretty easy as long as you go to class and the final was optional.  When going to class he teaches it very well and allows students to ask questions throughout.  Also gives extra credit sometimes just for showing up.

He was good at teaching the material and would give worksheets that were helpful for homework assignments. Also, he would give extra credit at random times just for going to class (and would give out candy for answering questions!)

I hate accounting but Professor Commerford made it bearable. Make sure to attend lecture and to complete the hw as the material is difficult. HW is harder than the exams. Also he gives practice exams that are almost identical to the real thing. Would definitely recommend him
He is very nice and not that hard of a grader. The homework and quizzes are easy but the tests are pretty difficult even if you study. He does have extra credit opportunities too.
If you attend lecture, you will do fine in his class, its a hard class but lectures are good and hw's help you prepare.

He was gone for half of the semester. His TA taught the first half and when I finally got used to his teaching style it switched to Mr. Commerford. Im not saying he's a bad man for doing this but I would have appreciated more lenience or extra credit since he was gone for so long and KNEW that 80% of us were really struggling.

Compared to other accounting professors, he really wasn't bad and wants you to succeed. The in class problems are really beneficial and he helps when you need it. 201 is just difficult in general so no matter who you have you're going have to put in a decent amount of outside work. Homework each week takes 1-2 hours.

He is a terrible professor. All of your friends will get good grades in ACC 201, but if you take him you will not. His tests are awful and are 80% of your grade. I was a 4.0 student coming into this class and got a D.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is pretty difficult and definitely requires a good amount of work outside of class. That being said, Professor Commerford is really good about giving in class exercises that help you apply the content to real life situations. He is also very straightforward about the homework requirements and what he expects you to know for exams.
Test are nothing like the homework and your entire grade comes from the 3 test. I do NOT recommend him. Gives no study guide or practice test making the test nearly impossible.

Dr. Commerford is a great professor for accounting! Judging him solely based on his lectures is meaningless if you dont put effort in. You have to read the text to understand the class. Regardless, he is very good at explaining the concepts and will help you if you ask for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He wants students to pass and cares about students passing. He cares about teaching, its just boring and a hard class. The class is 80% exams. Must do homework and must go to class. He gave extra credit to the class when exam scores are low. I had him for 201.

Took for ACC 201 and let us get extra credit on exam 1 for low scores and have had several other extra credit chances, exams are hard but just go to class, online hw can sometimes not line up exactly with class but cool dude

Exams are harder than practice material. He doesnt really teach as well as other accounting professors, just points at a PowerPoint which is confusing and doesnt help me learn. If youre fine with teaching yourself a difficult subject take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The exams were just awful. Very different from what you practiced like the worksheets he gave in class and homework problems.

Difficult course no matter who you take it with. From personal experience and word of mouth, BC seems to be the best choice. He makes class optional but if you skip, you'll fail. Do all your HW, go to class, study the powerpoints until you can do everything without peaking at notes and you will be fine. BC is a great guy!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: There are many mixed reviews out there about BC -- here's my 2 cents. The class is rough -- you have to really work for an A. If you put in the effort, it's very very possible. With that said, this is NOT a class you can slack in. Be prepared to study 20+ hours for every exam (exams  80% of your grade). It's hard but he is FAIR!!!

ACC 301 is a pretty hard class mainly just because of the workload, the material itself isn't all that bad. Ben gives out a lot of handouts in class that reflect problems on the exams and they are super helpful. Make sure you do all the Orion and WileyPlus HW problems because exams are about 80% of the class. If you have the opportunity, take Ben.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I liked Dr. Commerford quite a bit; I am already missing him in my ACC 302 class. I studied 15-20 hours per test and got an A in the class. He does go by powerpoint lectures and then will go over examples in class. The homework is a bit (14 points with questions) and then he releases bonus questions you can go over. He's very no-nonsense, but kind.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Bhatt is okay, but not my favorite. His powerpoints are useless. He gives study guides for his tests but they are mostly essay questions and you have to say exactly what he wants you to say or you won't get credit. Group project is a huge aspect of this class so be prepared.

I really hate to say this, but I was very displeased with Dr. Bhatt. He doesn't use the book (pointless), the notes in class aren't helpful and minimal, he doesn't communicate well with students and the information prior to exams is ambiguous.

He was my 395 advisor and while I didn't spend much time with him, I recommend doing your 395 in his lab. The girls that lead his lab are awesome and what you have to do is fairly easy. You have weekly meetings with Dr. Bhatt and the other 395s to discuss articles that he chooses. Overall great experience. Highly recommend.

I came here just to see what other courses Bhatt teaches. He can be difficult to understand at times (English=second language) but that's the *only* downfall. He is extremely knowledgeable and challenges students without being overbearing or unfair. His course was centered around us learning from each other, and we studied useful journal articles.

I was able to come into Dr. Bhatt's class for the last 10 minutes of an hour and a half class, get all the notes for the day and be gone. So in other words, he covered about 10 minutes of material in a full class period. Very slow.

I had Dr. Bhatt for PSY 460 also. He knows a lot on the subjects he teaches. He makes you do a good amount of work but grades fairly. I would recommend him to anyone interested in developmental psychology.

avoid this class at all costs. i am taking it part term and it is extremely time consuming. i have 13 assignments due on sunday from this class alone. i absolutely dread it. i get it is a part term class but its too much. there are other better psych classes you can take.

This class is an easy A test-wise but lots and lots of homework. You teach yourself the content solely by reading textbook and answering questions. Interesting topics, and the course is set up so that if you do well, you don't even have to take all 4 exams to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor wise, she was great, but this class was just blah. Nothing was super hard to complete but it was very time consuming. Very easy to pass, but be ready to put a lot of time into this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: SO SO much homework for a 100 level class, honestly terrible time seeing all the assignments every week. Homework takes about 5 hours to complete just the smartbooks.

Excellent teacher and curriculum. This was a part of term course and I finished the whole course in about 2-3 weeks instead of 8. I loved being able to work ahead and do it at my own pace. Very easy to get an A

Dr. S is understanding of her students! She makes her best effort to communicate effectively. The assignments are straightforward, but do require a good deal of work. I would classify much of this course as busy work. However, if you are looking for an easy A and don't mind doing a bit of work...you've found the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The amount of homework is RIDICULOUS!!!!!!!  LIke 6-7 hours a chapter and there are 20 chapters.  And, you have to do it in order to get an A. I got an A but only because I looked up all the answers on quizlet.  Thank God for online learning. I learned nothing in this class and it was a useless waste of time.

reviews.comment: So many assignments. Takes like five hours minimum to do all the homework on a good day. Six to seven on any other day. Maybe I would feel better about it if school was my only commitment but this class is next to impossible if you have a job.

reviews.comment: it may be that Professor Sheehan is kind towards the student at an online course, but at the same time, she is not a very nice personality. I sent her an email about how much I am getting stressed over my procrastination for homework assignments and she responded to me back as if she is not willing to care and help out with my concerns.

reviews.comment: So much homework  Like too much

reviews.comment: So, I didn't have Dr. Sheehan as a professor, but she is currently my advisor. I'm really disappointed by her. She takes forever to respond to emails, and when she does, she is not helpful. Today, I asked her what color the tassel is for our department, despite graduation being postponed, and she basically blew me off, didn't know, no infromatio

Dr. Sheehan is very knowledgeable, but her class is one of the tougher ones Ive taken. The group project was the majority of our grade and it was hard and took the entire semester. She is very willing to help and nice about it. Make sure to go to class and read the textbook because if you dont then the pop quizzes will be really hard
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Elizabeth Sheehan is a very well informed professor, she obviously is smart and knows what she is talking about. As for her ability to explain her thoughts, however, is where she goes wrong. Her trains of thought are so incredibly complex and hard to follow/ understand that its almost impossible to follow what she is saying.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Sheehan is very knowledgable but the lab was rough. you design a research project that involves a lot of specifics that you do not have backround knowledge on. the grading is really tough like she expects us to know how to write a research paper before we even take the class. you also do not know your final grade until the end of the semester
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Sheehan is good! There are pop quiz's that make it necessary to attend every class. They are difficult too so be on top of the lecture information. The lab that goes with this course is very disorganized and frustrating. I also had trouble reaching her outside of class, it took at least a five days for her to respond to emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Sheehan was a great professor! Tests were pretty easy but the "pop quizzes" were a bit hard so you have to go to class although attendance isn't mandatory. The lab for this class was terrible, it was a lot of wasted time and the TA's didn't seem to know what was going on. Definitely the worst part about this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Sheehan isn't a bad teacher, but she's not a good one either. Her class consists of lectures where she reads right out of the textbook, a lab aspect which is very unorganized and unclear, and other strange behaviors like locking the gradebook for the whole semester. She's a good person, but she's not someone I want teaching my class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Sheehan is a decent individual but as a professor she lacks skill. She is very slow to respond to emails regarding any issues in the course. Dr. Sheehan is very slow to grade all assignments. Eventually during the semester she locked all of the grades for a month so there was no way to know what the current and accurate grade in the course was.

I have no idea why Dr. Sheehan's rating is so low. She's an amazing professor who is very knowledgable and willing to help you succeed. Plus, she always has a great attitude and wears the cutest outfits. If you go to class and read every once in a while, you will get an A.

Sheehan was a real sweet prof to have, made mornings more bearable. Lots of info came from the Lecture XPs, so make sure to study those, otherwise, it isn't difficult to get an A. Definitely pay more attention to what she says rather than what's on the powerpoint, those are the most helpful parts. Lots of group activities!!!

This class is a semester long group project. It is a lot of fun. Your grade is from the group project and chapter quizzes. Just try to contribute to your group as much as a possible so you can get a good grade in the class. Also, do well on the quizzes. Should be an easy A.

This class was seemingly simple but the grading is awful. Ive never had below a B until her class and I didnt miss or forget to turn in any assignments. Exams dont resemble class material. Labs are poorly structured. Rubrics for all assignments were very vague. No helpful study material is provided, overall very frustrating class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Had her for Research Marketing. Your entire grade is based off a semester long research group project and about six quizzes. You learn a ton of useful stuff in this class, and at the end she gives you an entire list of stuff you can add to your portfolio and explains how to use it in interviews. She was nice and helpful.

her organization and lectures are very poor. Her lecture slides are extremely useless, be prepared to teach everything to yourself. Her books are online for both classes and dont match class material. she uses strictly examples but its hard relating that back to the books and determining what will be on the exams which are VERY hard

Dr. Sheehan is a good professor. The class is pretty straightforward and not hard material if you study and pay attention. The thing that makes the class not so great is lab. A lot of the work is busy work, and it is often unclear what is expected. Communication between Sheehan and the TAs doesn't seem that good. Definitely not bad
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Absolutely terrible all around. Once you've had a pop quiz (lecture XP) over the material THEN she will "lecture" aka give boring examples. Her slides are useless. Theres no study material other than the text book. Test questions are worded terribly. TA's are never sure whats going on because she's extremely unclear with everything. Worst class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Everything is done through a math site and expects the site to teach you the math. There is online homework that you have to figure out on your own the night before class and she teaches you how to do it the next day. Quizzes aren't too bad, but the homework will kill your grade. Had her a few semesters ago, expect things are about the same.

She cares a lot about students and is one of the best professors at explaining concepts. She will help you and her tests are not that hard if you go through each learning objective as your study guide. Lots of points available in the class from easy homework and class participation, so don't skip that much. She's great though.

She was awesome! I had surgery during the semester and she was so accommodating. Best teacher i have had at UK by a long shot. She is so funny!! You will not regret taking her if you have the chance, shes so sweet!

I was not looking forward to taking this class, but she made it interesting and relevant. I really like her; she won't sugar coat things or hold your hand through the material, so you have to put in the effort! I hated the lab portion. It felt more like busywork.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: There are no exams just weekly quizzes online over the book's chapters. The whole class is a group research project. She is very helpful in her feedback and I would highly suggest taking her. If you put in the effort and ask questions she is very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Took her for PSY 215. She wasn't helpful at all when it came to understanding the material, and half the class didn't understand what was going on half the time. Went to her office hours, and she was very rude and unwelcoming. Would not recommend.

Everything is done in groups. She only says everything once and if you miss it or don't understand, too bad. She doesn't know how to make a powerpoint and none of the steps are on the slides, just the example info. Tests are really hard and you have to make up during finals week. Very condescending too.

She is a great person but this class is boring. The actual material is so dry and boring, but read your book and you'll be fine. She does extra credit so do the extra credit and it'll boost your grade by a solid 40 points. Random team and individual assignments though so don't miss class.

Reading the book is way more important than the lectures, since the lectures are more about reviewing what you learned in a chapter rather than teaching you material. I still liked her a lot,  the few things she went over she explained very well and she's also really funny. The book is your teacher, she just helps to explain things afterwards.

I took this professor for Psych 215... 100% would not recommend. If you miss an assignment, you have to make it up at the end of the semester during finals week. She hardly taught anything, and mainly used examples in class. However, she never explained any definitions to be able to apply them to examples, so really going to class was useless.
not much work but need book for test. Does not know how to make a powerpoint.
Was always super helpful when needed, would definitely take on online class with him again. Everything was online and lectures could be read/ studied at your own pace.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: LOTS of content but if you're good at studying, you should be okay! Just make sure to have a solid study method before you take this course.

Took 2 courses with him and had lots of issues; he did nothing to help try to fix things. Horrible teacher. The only thing thats slightly positive is that he is mildly flexible with our exam times if you cant take the exam during the scheduled time frame

He is an awful professor who does nothing to teach. He posts 600 powerpoint slides a week with no voiceover and expects you to memorize every slide. He posts the same assignments for lecture and lab, it is such a waste of time and energy. He is does not give any feedback to students, and is the worst professor I've had so far. I've learned nothing.

You get one homework assignment a week that discusses the structures for a certain body system. Only 2 exams, both open note and online. For the muscular, skeletal, and nervous systems, structures not on the assignments showed up on the exams. Definitely use the structure guide textbook. Unlimited attempts on weekly assignments, so easy A class.

I would recommend taking anatomy in person rather than online if given the chance. This class covers so much content, and you are pretty much left to learn it on your own. Powerpoint slides for each section are posted and mimic most of the questions on the exams; however, content not discussed may pop up. Use the textbook and study guides!!

Do not take this class. He does not lecture, only gives heaping amounts of powerpoint that you are expected to teach yourself. It is not beneficial and you will not learn anything. The study guide is so vague and the exam questions are so complicated that you will have no way of knowing what to study. Take the in person section, wait a semester!

Dr. Bing's anatomy lab course is taught entirely online and requires no participation. Filling out the lab guides can be helpful, though they don't have to be turned in. The weekly homework assignments are the only grades in this course and they're super easy. While the class does have a midterm and final, they are both open note.

Although there is a LOT of lectures and information in this class, it is completely manageable. A week before each exam, we get a study guide covering most of the information on the unit. Fill that out, study it, and learn it, and you will be just fine on the exams. The extra credit is so easy to receive and is so worth it for each exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I don't think this is a valuable course for pre-meds. There are no lectures, just a ton of powerpoint slides. There is extra credit. Your grade is dependent on your exam grades. You get a study guide a week before the exam, but it will only guarantee you a C, maybe a B, on the exams.

This is the most frustrated I have ever been with a class. There are no lectures and the exams are so specific that there is no chance of knowing what to study. I went into exams knowing that I studied significant amounts but would do horribly. Worst class I have ever been in and no knowledge obtained. Horrible preparation for pre-health majors.

Bing doesn't lecture, you download and follow the powerpoints, but it isn't bad. He releases study guides for each test that directly relates to the questions. So, read the book and complete the study guide and the tests won't be too bad. Quizzes are easy and unlimited attempts. Bonus is given from participating in discussion boards.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Does not teach, lecture, or even do the bare minimum. IDK what he even gets paid for. At the beginning of the semester we got 40 powerpoints and a pat on the back. The only redeeming quality about his class is that he can't even be bothered to write new questions, so the quizzes, APR, and tests are all on google. If you're expecting to learn, GL

DO NOT TAKE!!! so many people dropped out of this class and although it is not very extremely work intensive, the material is hard. He doesn't teach at all and expects you to teach yourself when he just posts his power point slides. Why am I paying 1,000s of $$ just to teach myself?? There is no TA and never emails back. Didn't learn anything.
Very disorganized. Had us download the entire Canvas modules, then proceeded to change/update them repeatedly. Supposed to be asynchronous, but deadlines for work.

60%  four exams; 40%  homework quizzes. Unlimited time and amount of attempts on quizzes. Exams in person. If you do the study guide and answer all questions on it, you will get an A on the exams. Honestly, I didn't even try to learn the material until the study guides were released. You can easily guess on the quizzes until you get it right.

Such a sweet professor who has insightful experience in his field and is happy to share his experiences. I always felt that his lectures were more realistic due to him giving real world examples from his own current work. Loved him as a professor and he is a wonderful person to talk with if you ever get the chance.
He and Michael Hatfield did a great job at teaching this course. Beneficial knowledge

If you have DRC accommodations, he will not grant them no questions asked. Mr. Birdwhistell was hardly ever present in class, it was mainly the TA's. He spends majority of the course talking about himself.

Only meet once a week. He has two TA's that are both really helpful. You only have a midterm that is online. The group project is the main grade for this class. Lots of guest speakers that allow you to network in class. Great teacher!

I think BP is a great guy, truly. However, his teaching could be improved. Lectures felt impromptu, often hard to follow. Important content not always taught clearly. He's very knowledgeable and willing to help so much, but you'll definitely have to take a lot of agency in your learning. PLEASE do the lengthy readings to fully understand content!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: While very knowledgeable on the material, he is awful at conveying that information to students. There have been many instances in which the class practically had to BEG him to give us more clarifying information on assignments. He backtracks a lot, leaving people unsure of what the point he was making was. Take someone else if you value happiness!
Great prof. Lectures are very interesting and make you want to learn about even the dull topics . Papers are challenging, but he is a fair grader. Would definitely recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: He's just an okay professor. There's no doubt that he is extremely knowledgable and passionate about philosophy but sometimes he does a poor job of explaining the concepts thoroughly. He also looks kind of uncomfortable all of the time. But he's a reasonable grader, caring, and easy to get in touch with.

He's a pretty tough professor, but he's very willing to help you if you ask for it.  This was my first philosophy class (looking back, I probably shouldn't have taken a 200-level), and while it was difficult, he did a very good job in making the class interesting.  Be warned of papers!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: He is very knowledgable on the material.
Good teacher, fair grader, and knows the subject matter.  Fun class and intersting topics.
Horrible teacher. So complicated. He gets mad quickly. I recommend to you to not take this teacher If you want a C or above.

Horrible professor; wrote the textbook and straight up reads from it. You practically have to teach yourself because he can't teach properly. The content is also fairly difficult, coming from someone who has always had math come naturally. You'll be fine if you learn from just reading the textbook, but if you rely on lectures, good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He wrote the textbook so the lectures are just him reading the textbook word for word. Easy class though.

The class is hard but if you pay attention and do your homework, you will be fine. He drops a few lowest quiz and assignment grades but the exams are killer. You have to study your butt off. Sometimes, he gives a curve.

Dr. Bieber was a great professor - he recently retired. The 672 course contained a lot of reading but the discussions were always useful and he really asks great questions whether they are preplanned or on the spot.
