He gave great constructive and targeted feedback on assignments and was always open to meeting to chat about the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is very specific of what he wants but doesn't tell you anything.  He grades with a letter/lower letter grade and decides your grade based on how he feels at the time. He has no legit way of grading.

In the main, I would say Dr. Bieber is quite demanding and depending the sensitivity of the topic can come across as a pedant.  infinitesimal vocabulary, wealth of experience, however definite declivity toward student affairs, depressing.  this course serves as a rite of passage to the EPE'rs, not for the faint of heart...the life of the mind!

Thought the course was okay, but somewhat boring.  We seemed to always discuss surface issues and not the real deep philosophical stuff.  Jeff is a good scholar - one of his articles was part of the syllabus, and it was a great article.  But, we really didn't get into the theory behind it - i.e. cultural reproduction.  Could have been better.

Started off not liking the class, ended up loving it and Dr. Bieber.  We had some real dumb***es in there and Dr. Bieber was really patient with them even though we were not.  Dr. Bieber seems like a hard core Republican, but he really is a bleeding heart liberal, which I like.  Great class and great instructor!!!
Great professor!
No Comments
Very knowledgeable and tough, but it pushed me to my full potential.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Biermann may seem harsh when you first meet her but she is great! If your class participates she will love you even more. She takes her papers seriously but she will grade your drafts and give feedback. Communication is key and she honestly is great.

Dr Biermann is by no means an easy professor, but she is fair. She sets out the expectations and expects you to follow those, no surprises come from her. She also is willing to work with you and is very understanding as long as you are honest and up front with her
Great professor, tough grader but a fair grader. Flexible if you actually reach out.
She is down to earth and values integrity, she can be flexible as long as it is within reason. Willing to help when needed

Dr. Biermann "Dr. B," is a professor that makes you think about the social work career from varying perspectives. She is a hard grader, but her grading is fair. She may seem difficult to understand but that is where you need to communicate with her on what's going on. She will do her best to have you pass her SW class!

I really enjoyed Dr. B, I had her online for SW-625. The DBs arent difficult, there are one or two due each week on Sundays. Quizzes are tougher than other classes, be sure to study for them. You have to read the material to do well on a quiz. I will say she is a tough grader, especially on papers. Be sure you know how to use APA format properly.

Although I did receive a good grade for Dr. Bs class, I wouldnt recommend a course that shes teaching. For her to be a SW professor, her attitude is horrible. Several of my classmates felt the same. Her grading is appalling. Dont ask questions or reach out for help unless you enjoy being made to feel stupid.

Between my Biology undergrad degree (4 yrs) & SW graduate degree (1 yr); this professor was the absolute worst. Grade posts took FOREVER, the material was outrageous, & if you reach out to get clarification/feedback on assignments, prepare to get a vague & condescending response. If given the option, RUN in the other direction.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Biermann was a good teacher but was pretty hard when grading things and wasn't very lenient with assignments.

I really liked Dr. B's class and enjoyed her way of bringing different modalities of learning into her course material. She is a tough grader but not unfairly so. Just make sure your work is detailed, very specific, and that you are very familiar with what she is asking for.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I love Dr. B. She can sometimes be a little tough, it may come off as rude, but she really just cares about your success. She expects that the textbook be read, and will give pop quizzes, so beware. Other than that, she leads amazing lectures that in turn produce incredible class discussions that leave a lasting thought for the duration of the day.

Dr. Biermann is one of my favorite instructors. She was very thorough when conveying the material. Follow her instructions and you'll pass. She is a tough grader and her exams are kind of hard but she's a solid professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. B. is hard for literally no real reason. Never take her for SW 445. it is completely unfair how hard her class is compared to the other 445 class. She will tell you that you can redo stuff without telling you there will be points taken off and when asked she will be rude about it.

MY FAVE PROFESSOR EVER! She was amazing and made me a better social worker & student. I would take her again in a heart beat! Can't express how awesome she was! You had to attend class, but I never wanted to miss anyway!

I love Dr. Biermann. She is very passionate about her work, so she puts a lot into her classes and lectures. Class is mandatory, but you do have 2 skips days. However, I wouldn't recommend skipping class because every session has heavy notes and she doesn't post her notes online so you NEED them. She's super nice, outgoing, and you won't get bored!
She is very hard on APA formatting. Really hard class but Dr. B is amazing and makes it a lot of fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. B is amazing, show up do the reading. Her mid-term is so hard it will make you want to cry. However, she is amazing, respectful, and understanding. Lots of writing, however, that is the nature of social work classes.
She is so fantastic. Hard class, but she explains well and you get a lot out of this class! She keeps ethics entertaining, which is a feat in itself, and lets you know she cares. 10/10

Does a good job of making information interesting.  There are a few large projects but the grading criteria is clear, it is hard to mess it up.  She really doesn't like when people use their phones though and will not hesitate to call somebody out for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She's tough but good. If you are looking for an easy A, go elsewhere. If you are looking to learn, she's the one. A lot of reading and a lot of writing but Dr. B ties it all together real well.

Dr. B is fantastic. She's a tough grader for sure, but she's always willing to help you out. Her attendance policy is super strict, so if you have to miss, make sure you have a note. The only thing that kind of irked me was the fact that she didn't put grades on blackboard, but if you're really concerned about your overall average, just ask her.

Dr. B is the best professor I've had in the COSW program at UK. People who haven't taken her think she is hard just because she doesn't sugar coat anything.. She treats you like a college student should be treated and I respect her for that. She teaches you well and does a very good job at relating the material to the real world.

Biermann is by far my favorite professor at UK. She works hard to make sure you understand the material and relates it to her real life experiences. She is VERY strict about APA citations but is willing to work with students to help them understand. Exams are very do-able. DO THE STUDY GUIDE. If you ever have the option, choose Biermann.

Dr. Biermann knows her stuff backwards and forwards. She is a very tough grader, and this causes people to be mad at her, but she's probably the only challenging prof in the COSW. Most spoon feed it to the students, and this makes her seem harsh, when in fact she just wants her students to be good. She expects a lot from us. Would take again.
Excellent.  She's very thorough and cares a lot about the material.  She is strict, but I think it makes you better as a result.  I received an 88% in her class.

She's a good teacher, understanding and nice. attendance is taken and she is very particular about what she wants from your work. make sure to double check on anything you are unsure of. study guides almost identical to tests! pretty easy! recommended course

Sarabeth is a great professor! She first comes off as strict and hard, but after you get to interact with her you realize that that's far from the truth. She really does care about each of her students and knows a lot about Social Work. She does a great job utilizing media and current events into her lectures. Do what she asks and you'll get an A.
One of my favorite professors at UK so far. Always helpful and friendly. Knows the material well and really wants you to learn. Just do what she asks of you and you'll do fine.
Weekly 10-20 minute video with a problem set. Have to use JMP software and sometimes Excel. Not too hard if you have some background in statistics. No exams
Rayens is a very understanding professor, and his lectures help a lot with the material. Exams are open note. Do the homework, buy the book, and you'll get an A.

Lectures are incredibly boring but that is expected with the subject matter. Since it is a required course you would probably be best to take it with Dr. Rayens as he is usually pretty lenient with grades and most of the course information can be found online.

I cannot express my disappointment in this professor. His hour and forty five minute class is filled with him justifying why he is a good teacher and telling irrelevant stories instead of actually teaching. Avoid this professor at all costs.

I did everything professor Rayens suggested to do when struggling in the class. I went to The Study, the Statistics tutoring center, and hired a private tutor. I also emailed him asking what more I could do because I was still struggling, and he never responded. In my opinion this shows how little Rayens cares about his students success.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Rayens spends more time explaining WHY we're doing a problem instead of actually HOW to do it. Beware of Exam 2...I got an A on the first exam and a D on the second. The class average was an F! The textbook costs $80 and he wrote it himself. Quizlet will be your best friend in this class for the quizzes and homework, trust me. Exams  50% of grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Rayens tries his absolute best to make the class as easy as possible. If you come to lecture and do the required work, the class shouldn't be hard at all. Lecture is drawn out, but attendance is taken every day.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took Rayens' class because it was a requirement for my major, but I left his class wanting to take more classes like STA210. He was extremely engaging and made the class about real world examples and often justified the importance of the things we were learning. I would definitely take a class like this again, esp if Rayens was teaching.

Rayens cares about his students and wants you to do well. Pick a good group to sit with the second week because you'll be with them for the rest of the semester and there's a lot of group assignments. He's very understanding and passionate about what he teaches.

Quizlet is your best friend for STA210. He was a nice guy but struggled with effectively teaching during lecture. I had to teach myself most of the material outside of class. He is more helpful if you come to him one on one with questions after class and is always willing to meet with students. I suggest never skipping class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He spends half the class justifying what he is teaching to us instead of actually going over the work. Also, he uses the book he created and uses different formulas than what you find online for statistics so you can't even find help online. Not to mention he is excessively petty and defensive about how he teaches so he will belittle us about it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Rayens can draw out a lecture and class can be quite boring at times but he wants to see students be successful and gives you everything you need to get a good grade. His tests are very straight forward and easy as long as you know the material from the homework. Very accessible outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Lectures are soooo long. He will talk about something really simple for an entire lecture, such as how to find an average.  Attendance is a huge chunk of grade, and sometimes there are random in class assignments that can bring your grade down if you miss. Spent way more time on this class than I would have liked.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: funny guy, talks a lot during lectures, but overall easy to understand and really nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Rayens was not a great professor. Spent entire lecture drawing out a very simple topic. Never gets to the point. Really simple material but he makes things super complicated. Any time you email him he seems like he is annoyed. And he always said stuff in class like he was getting tired of us emailing him.

Took the Honors section of this class. Fair amount of homework in the class but the quizzes are all in groups during class. Tests are online so relatively easy if you know the stuff. Dr. Rayens is not the most interesting lecturer and the content is not very interesting, but Dr. R is extremely helpful outside of class. Returns emails very quickly.

I was in the honors section of this course.  The lectures are long and somewhat boring, but the homework isn't bad.  There are daily quizzes in groups.  Tests are online.  The class isn't the most exciting, and it can get pretty confusing at times, but Dr. Rayens is very willing to help you and his enthusias for statistics is evident!

Bill is an awesome teacher that actually cares for his students. He sends emails regarding the smallest of matters just so everything is clear as possible for his students. Definitely recommend this teacher.

Rayens was awesome. Even though there was a lot I didn't understand I still got an A. He gives so much extra credit, all the quizzes are online so you can use his videos, and he basically gives you the exact questions on the test to study. Stats is really confusing but he makes it easy enough to get a good grade! Don't need to attend class

Take Dr. Rayens! Even if you don't understand the material (though it's pretty easy) he gives a TON of extra credit in class. Attendance isn't mandatory, but if you want the extra credit you should definitely attend. Do the work and you'll be fine. Dr. Rayens is also extremely helpful inside and outside the classroom.
Dr. Rayens really cares about stats and his students. The class may get boring/difficult at times but he gives so much extra credit just for attending class you will do really well.

He has a huge number of students, i emailed him today and got an email back in 5 minutes, the class gets a little dull at times, but the guy cares a ton about his job and his students, highly recommend

Dr. Rayens is one of the nicest people I've ever met and he is so passionate about his topic. However, the "inverted classroom" he employs is not my style of learning and he talks at a conversational level during lecture so always be listening! Those things aside, probably one of the best teachers for this class.
I took the honors section that was offered in sta210 and he taught it really well. I have no interest in statistics but he did make the statistical tools I might have to use, very easy to use

The homework is straight from the workbook and very easy. He goes over it all before you do it too. He kind of talks in circles and class sometimes runs over, but he knows his stuff. I wasn't really a fan of the "inverted classroom" we did, but the activities were all easy. Pretty good class.

Dr. Rayens is super nice, but I personally don't like the way he teaches his class. I learn better from lectures, and the whole inverted classroom idea is not really for me. He is also super quiet when he talks, so I suggest sitting up front! Otherwise, he isn't really a hard professor. He also offers lots of bonus point opportunities.

Dr. Rayens is very egotistical. He talked about how he made up this "Inverted Classroom" idea and it was THE most confusing thing ever. It was just a fancy way of saying "go teach go yourselves throgh the TAs, the workbook, and online videos!" Take this class with a different professor. I was constantly confused. I don't think many passed the final

Dr. Rayens is an incredible teacher. He truly goes above and beyond by making himself available for questions all hours of the day. You can tell he loves statistics and teaching and it is clear by the level of comprehension instilled upon those students who are still paying attention.

Absolute best professor here at the University of Kentucky! He is VERY passionate about his subject and deeply cares about his students. He legit goes out of his way every day to help out his students.Very approachable, friendly, and intelligent! Come to class and it's an easy A! Writes great letters of recommendation! Laid back guy! Always smiling

great teacher! i am awful in math but he makes stats fun and interesting. it's mandatory to go everyday, but he is a great professor. i would definitely take him again! if you have to take stats 210 i wouldn't suggest any other teacher!
He doesn't lecture much, but when he talks, he's usually pretty long winded. Explains concepts well. You MUST have the book.

This class is boring beyond belief, but easy to get the grade.  You have to go to lecture to turn in pages from your workbook at the end and recitation always lets out early.  The only thing is him grading written responses tough, but if you elaborate (A LOT) you'll be fine.

Dr. Rayens is an amazing teacher. Never, in all my years of school, have I met someone so passionate about what they do. He really enjoys statistics and does everything he can to make his students enjoy it as well. He's always very willing to help, and cares a great deal about the happiness of his students. SUCH a great guy. :)

An awesome teacher. If you have to take a Stats course, he is the best you could get. He gives out bonus points like crazy and really goes above and beyond what other professors do in terms of making the class fun and interesting, while always trying to make sure you understand what is going on. The TA's who assisted him were useless, though.

I took him for the A&S stats class for my usp. He clearly tells you what to do and gives easy assignments. I spent maybe 15 minutes outside of class a week (averaged) and got an A. You do have to go to class and he gives out bonus points like crazy. You really have to not want an A to not get one. Its so easy to do.
He is awesome. He cares about what he does. He gives you all the resources you need form class. He gives credit to those who show up. He is very passionate and enjoyable.

Dr. Rayens is AWESOME!  He is great about emailing the class and keeping you up to date and even if you don't understand, he will help you.  He REALLY wants you to understand the material and goes above and beyond.  By far the best professor I have had in terms of caring about students' performance.  I would recommend to anyone for stats!

Professor Rayens had a difficult job- trying to help students to understand stats! Although the material was difficult, he did a wonderful job of not only relaying course material but most importantly, he was ALWAYS willing to work with you if you were lost or confused. He helped me tremendously !

I really hated statistics before this class. Although it still isn't my favorite subject, I now have a much better appreciation of it. I really enjoyed this class and Dr.Rayens was a wonderful teacher.

Dr. Rayens is very passionate about teaching and hopes everyone gets excited about teaching.  He demands a higher level of thinking and wants everyone to reach their potential.  He is very personable and tells lots of interesting stories about his family.  Dr. Rayens was very accessible and eager to help outside the classroom.
good, nice, easy to understand
Easy A class if you go to it. Don't bother buying the textbook. Easy to get a hold of. Genuinely wanted to see his students do well.

Dr. Rayens was very attentive and eager to get feedback from the class.  He made a point to be clear to everyone before going forward with the lesson and was available for help whenever you needed it.
Dr. Rayens was genuinely interested in our learning of the subject, and was eager to answer any questions we had. I enjoyed his class, and very much recommend him as a professor!

Dr. Rayens made sure he explained concepts thoroughly so that everyone would understand the material and was more than willing to help outside of class. Overall, the class is easy if you read the textbook and go to class! :)
He was a really indepth teacher. He would keep the students up to date and was very understanding. I would recommend this teacher to all my friends.

He was totally awesome.most of the lecture in class went over my head,& some things never reached my ears-BUT email him or talk to him one on one and he's pretty dope about it all.  Plus if you can't make it to his office his emails are extra prompt-like within an dhour or two prompt.  I was dreading the class instead it was an A-ok experience.
Dr. Rayens explains everything extremely well, and he is very fair.
He really knew the stuff and was able to have fun with it. It made the class enjoyable for me.

Rayens is a great teacher who really does all he can to make sure you know your information. If you do your work, go to class and pay attention you'll be fine! Rayens is a nice teacher and you'll enjoy the course.
He was always so helpful when things got confusing.  You could tell he really cared about his students.  If you make an effort in this class, you'll do very well!

Dr. Rayens is one of the best professors I've ever had my three years at UK. He explains everything clearly during lecture, gives very simple and concise homeworks that are worth 30% of your grade, which you should get 100%. He explains every type of problem that will be on the test before the test. If you just do the simple things he asks its an A
Dr. Rayens was extremely helpful and nice!

Dr. Rayens is an amazing teacher. Statistics is not my thing, nor is math of any kind, but if you are dedicated to learning, he is dedicated to helping you succeed. Although his lectures may not have been crystal clear, he was positive, helpful, and dedicated to helping his students understand the material.  Ask and ye shall receive.

Statistics has many difficult concepts as a foundation and Rayens spends a lot of time focusing on those concepts.  He did an excellent job of teaching statistics to a group of students that didn't have much of a math back ground and that can't be an easy task.
Professor Rayens was a wonderful teacher. He was as helpful as he could be and did everything possible to help his students learn. I give him two thumbs up!
Extremely helpful and approachable. He does everything he can to help you succeed and responds to e-mails very quickly.

Not hard if you can teach yourself, and he is a pushover so you can make him do want you want, but EXTREMELY BORING.  He loves to hear himself talk and you can't get a straight answer to anything.  A very nice guy, but a terrible terrible teacher.
The most boring class I have ever had.  He explains everything to death then tells you why he is explaining it that way. Do not take him if you have a choice.

Hard Class, but Dr. Rayens does everyhting he can to help you. Very approchable outside of class. Go to class, take good notes and you'll be fine. Don't be afraid to go to him during his office hours.

Worst Professor around.  Clearly spends too much time complaining and making excuses for every little thing.  Extremely boring lectures but some of the best naps around.  Lecture notes are almost pointless and no where near helpful.
rayens is so boring, and he spends 20 mins complaining about uk tech dept.  don't take him if you want to learn something.  his class is good for naps and mild enterainment.
Very confusing professor. Test material comes mostly from homework and even if you really don't understand the material, you can get a B or C on the tests without a problem.

He explains how he's going teach you something rather than teach it. Tests are easy because he's too lazy to make up his own probs so he uses the HW. Labs are in a computer lab so you can do other things during them. Not fun, don't take Rayens!
Lectures make no sense at all- recitation sections are pointless and tests reflect information never presented before

hardest class i've ever had at UK. dont ask for help...he wont reply to e-mails or allot tome for you in office hours. he makes no sense in lecture. lecture is a waste of time, but he takes attendance in lecture (you must attend at least 75% of lectures to pass class).  overall, IT SUCKS!
No Comments
No Comments

He teaches like he is teaching the 5th grade, but I guess in a way it is helpful. The material was easy and he was slow in teaching but even though he slowed down a lot...things never got clearer, he just rambles on and on and on
VERY VAGUE class!

The sweetest man you will ever meet. He is so caring and down to earth. He is very passionate about this class and biology and general. He loves to tell stories which is nice because you aren't learning the whole lecture. The class itself is super easy. Go to class, take notes, and use practice questions. They are just like the exam.

He is a good professor, but you have to go to class because of his quizzes. He does not tell you when they are and if you miss them then you miss them. He is a great dude and an easy grader. Easy class to pass, honestly.
He is very clear when teaching and his exams reflect the material taught in class. He did 1pt. quizzes randomly to check attendance, but it helped check how well you understood the material.

One of the most time consuming classes I've ever done! He doesn't last an entire semester giving everyone a scare at the end of the semester by giving us 0/60 but he will eventually change it by the last day of the semester. Pointless class to take and barely any chance to redeem points if you've failed an exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Burke really doesn't last an entire semester. You'll love him at first, then you'll start to hate him after mid semester. He gives you a research paper that isn't presented clearly and if you do bad on it your grade with suffer. It's equal to the final exam and trust me it's a load of BS. If you have to I wouldn't waste your time!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I respected professor Burke until the last couple days of class. The research paper he assigns is completely bs. He would give you a 0/60 if you didn't get the first part of the paper right and didn't bother to read anything else. Lost all respect for him after this.

This was a very easy class for me, and it's relatively easy to get an A. Aside from the 4 exams, there are 3 foolproof projects and in class attendance quizzes. You can miss up to 5 of the quizzes, which are not graded on correctness, and still get credit. Just pay attention or watch echo! He is hilarious and explains concepts well.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He does lectures and at the end he does quizzes that you can only get credit for if you are in class. If you dont care about quizzes he records his class on echo so its always super east to go back and listen /watch the course. He is super easy and goes in depth about each topic so you understand what to do in actual life.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Burke is a great teacher! He is very clear in his lectures and is a very funny guy. There is only three multiple choice tests, a couple papers, and the final. He has study guides for the tests, gives out practice questions, and gives us the opportunity to earn back points on tests. If you show up and pay attention, you should do fine!
do not take this class. more time consuming than major classes.

Bill Burke is amazing!!! I loved this class so much. Make sure you show up, take notes, study the resources he gives you for the exams and DO THE RESEARCH PROJECT!!!! You will get an A if you do these things.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Mr. Bill is a very nice guy who cares about what he's teaching. His class was extremely easy with little effort required as long as you followed his specific directions and at least somewhat payed attention and studied for his exams.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: He definitely cares about biology and tries to make class not just listening to him lecture. It's a very easy A if you just follow directions, take notes, do the study guides, and look at the example questions for each exam. A lot are either exactly on the test or very similar.

Love Bill Burke's bio class. He is such a funny dude and really gets into his powerpoint slides. He gives good instructions and clear content. If you follow his guides and listen to his instructions you will pass the class
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great man, basically spoon feeds you all the information, gives study guides, super clear on grading, and always sends reminder emails when things are due. As long as you show up to class, the pop quizzes are for completion. Hilarious and actually keeps bio interesting
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: This class includes 3 exams plus the final (straight from class notes and he gives you study guides and past exams), a few really easy written assignments, a research project that you'll pass as long as you do it, and some pop quizzes that are graded on completion (not accuracy). As long as you do your work and study for the exams, you'll get an A!
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed him and his class at the start of the semester but as the semester came closer to the end he became rude and not helpful toward students. I approached him for help and he turned me away. His grading is ridiculous and only based on 3 exams, a project, and other tiny assignments. So, do poorly on one and you're screwed.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He never gives good explanations. He only grades you on your exams and your research project. There is no book to act as a guideline and his exams are tested only on the material he goes over during lecture. I feel like for as long as he's been teaching, he should develop new techniques for learning so his students are interested in his material.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Bill Burke is a legend! He is a great professor and this class is not hard. Just show up, take notes, do the simple written reports, study for tests, and DO the research project! You'll do fine and this is a very good and easy class.
He's an amazing professor. He's passionate about what he teaches and is a very fair grader. The exams are straightforward and come right from the notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Be prepared to go to class everyday. Although attendance isn't mandatory, you need to show up for quizzes and lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He makes lecture fun and interesting, however tests are a little difficult because he requires you to apply concepts
Great professor. Really nice. Offers extra credit. Getting an A is VERY doable.

Mr. Bill is an easy professor. The grading criteria is clearly explained and there are several different ways to earn back points throughout the semester. Would take for a core class if you want an easy A. Just go to class and know the material on the study guides- that is exactly what's on the test. Don't study anything more.

Burke was a great BIO103 professor! The written assignments/end of the semester project were decent- If you follow the instructions they were pretty easy assignments. He also did Echo360 for those who couldn't make it to lecture. The difference between lecture & Echo360 was in lecture he would give extra credit quizzes that you could turn in.
He makes material easy to understand and is lecture heavy. Go to class and study for a an hour and you are guaranteed an A. Just be sure to sit towards the front and don't fall asleep!

Go to class for the extra credit quizzes, and sometimes you can go to his office hours just to get points back from exams if you try and argue what you believe was correct. He so sweet and funny too!!

If you want an A in the class I suggest to go to class. I had a C at midterm and finished with an A because of all the grade-boosting assignments he offers at the end of the year. I would forsure take him again.
I loved this class! Def recommend for easy science core. No textbook and not a lot of hw.

Mr. Bill cares a lot about what he is teaching. He makes the attendance-optional lectures (although I recommend going for an easy A) very enjoyable and engaging. You learn what you need to know, what is relevant to your future as a non-biology major, and nothing else.
Personally I hate biology but Bill made the class very straight forward. He gives lots of extra credit which helped my grade a ton. Would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: To be completely honest, I took BIO 103 for my UK Core class. It was recommended by many of friends that said it was" easy." It is not with Burke. Burke is pretty hard considering it is all test heavy. If you try to get help or ask him questions, he never responds or is very snippy. Burke is the worst professor I've had in a while. Don't take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Mr. Bill was a nice professor.  Assignments and tests are not difficult. Attendance isn't mandatory since you can watch the Echo360 videos.  As long as you watch the videos and study a little you should be okay.  There were also 10 pop quizzes throughout the semester that counted as extra credit if you were in class. I made 101% in this class

Mr. Burke is a funny professor that tries to make biology interesting and fun to learn. There is no textbook and Echo360 records all lectures. Mr. Burke gives extra credit quizzes in class that can help your grade. He emails you back timely and gives you study guides for all exams.
super easy class. dont have to go unless you need a little extra credit. gives you study guides that tell exactly whats on the exam. take notes and youll pass easily

I absolutely loved this class.  Mr. Bill is very funny and tells tons of side jokes to make it interesting. If you take notes in class and study, you will get a good grade. I did terrible on my first exam and still got an A in the class. Attending class isn't mandatory but he sometimes gives extra credit to those who do come.

The most boring class of the semester. He is a nice person but my god is his class boring. His grading is so random and his exams are so random to study for. It's an honest crap shoot going into his exams. Pick a different Professor! I never had to work so hard for a menial 3 credit core class. not worth your sanity!

I loved Bill. He's the reason I ended up choosing Bio as my minor. He makes the class interesting and is very straight forward. Exams are fairly easy if you take good notes and pay attention.  The  written reports are straight forward and easy points. He also gives a good amount of extra credit class so go to class!

Mr. Burke is that man! Easy class, pay attention and take some notes and you will pass easy. Echo 360 (camera that films lecture) allows you to miss class if necessary, but you will miss quizzes. Overall he is super easy going and gives a great lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious

reviews.comment: The only grades he takes are tests and written reports. Lecture is not mandatory, and sometimes not necessary. Very laid back and likes to crack jokes. All test material is based on note taking. Gives a fair amount of extra credit. I'm not one to skip class, but if you skip lecture here and there, you won't miss much.

Bill Burke is definitely the best professor i've ever had. He makes you want to go to lecture with his random bits of humor. He isn't afraid to give his opinion which makes the class interesting. Pretty easy class as long as you take notes and do the few things of homework, its an easy A.

Very funny guy, sang "it's all about that base, bout that base, no sugar" when explaining concept. He's clear in his material, has a lot of experience, and does a great job of getting across the importance of scientific thinking in general not just his specific area. Would definitely recommend.

Bill is a great professor! Attendance isn't mandatory because he puts his lectures online, but gives quizzes for extra point sometimes! He lets you do test corrections and his notes are pretty good. he gives study guides and things to know for test. He makes getting a good grade easy!

Mr. Burke is an amazing professor. His assignments are very easy to do and if you study for the test they're easy as well. He likes to joke around a lot and is pretty funny for the most part, he responds back quickly, and is a very fair grader.

Mr. Bill is friendly and attendance is not mandatory but I do suggest watching his lectures online if you are unable to attend class. The final was extremely easy and so were most of his exams. Very easy class and the pop quizzes can totally boost you that 1% from a C to a B or to an A. Take advantage of those.

Mr. Bill tries to make biology fun by telling jokes but most of the time the students are laughing at him, not with him. It was a very easy A for me. As long as you listen to the lecture (online or in class) and take notes you will be fine. However he does do random pop quizzes that count as extra credit in class and those can help your grade.
There are only about three quizzes worth like .5 points. There are about three tests a semester. He's friendly. Usually large lectures.
HE IS AWESOME! His class is entertaining and easy as long as you go and take notes! Study for tests because they can be confusing.

The easiest class I had all semester. BIO103 was easier than my high school BIO. Burke's super entertaining and his lectures are good. He doesn't want to see you fail, if you receive anything less than an A in this class you aren't trying at all. He gives you extra credit opportunities and the ability to redo things. Exams are easy, use studyguide!

Burke is a super nice guy who doesn't want you to fail, he gives you every chance possible to succeed in his class. His lectures are funny and he is very entertaining. His tests are easy and he assigns extra credit quizzes so go to class!

Amazing Professor. You never need to come to class because the lectures are online but I went anyway because he is so funny and makes Biology so entertaining. Am passing the class with an easy A as of right now.

Mr. Bill is one of my favorite professors.  I got an A easily. There is no homework aside from occasional written assignments that are fairly easy.  His exams are easy but he includes material that he may have only briefly said during a lecture so it is best to attend even when  attendance isn't mandatory.  He's also comical.
Pretty funny guy, records all of his lectures so they're online if you miss a class. Nice teacher, tests are tough, unless you take notes and study!
Mr. Bill is one of the best profs ive had since being at UK. He is so lighthearted and easy going.

Class captures save lives! If you miss a lecture you can watch it from home, but he does give random half point quizzes that add up in the end. He is a great professor and really seems to relate to students in the fact that he doesn't make you buy an overly expensive , useless book
Wording is kinda weird, but he is really understanding and helpful if you seek him out. Really nice too.

He reminds me of Santa Clause because of his looks. He is an awesome professor that makes so many side comments that are hilarious. Study for the exams and pass. His tests questions are somewhat confusing because he words them weird.
He was awesome, easy A... you'll have to put forth the effort to study for exams and go to class for the extra credit. But its not terrible and he's hilarious, likes to make crude jokes sometimes.

Mr. Bill was an awesome professor. Class was somewhat interesting but super easy. He posts his lectures to blackboard but has in class pop quizzes (for extra credit) to check for attendance and they can help your grade so I do suggest going to class. But he doesn't check attendance everyday. He's like a cool papaw in my opinion. No textbook
He's hilarious, super nice, and everything is online. Go to class if you want to but if you don't not a big deal, just turn in your work on time.
Not a mandatory class, but i went because i enjoyed the class.
A good professor, enjoys his subject, and is helpful.
A great teacher!

Definitely take him! The class is super easy as long as you review his study guides and notes before tests. He's very straight forward. Classes can be boring but attendance is not mandatory and he can always provide a good laugh here and there. Great guy!

Bill's class is very easy. Attendance is not mandatory. He has this tool that records him during lecture so he puts the video of himself and the powerpoint he teaches from on Blackboard, so really you'd be fine with never coming to class as long as you watch the lecture online. Assignments are minimal & very easy to accomplish.

Really nice guy, pretty funny. The class is boring and attendance is not mandatory. He gives really only a few assignments which are not very difficult whatsoever, however his tests generally are. If you go to class and study you will do fine though. It will be an easy A if you attend.

Mr. Bill thinks he's funnier than he actually is, but class is definitely entertaining at times. I needed this for my UK core and it was easy enough. I did absolutely no studying or anything and got a C, so it's fairly easy. This class was a good way to fulfill the science core if you still need it.

Super sweet guy, but is kind of boring to listen to.  I hate science/bio so that probably didn't help.  But his tests are pretty clear, but theres always some questions that are really confusing.  I studied for exams and did all of the work and I got a high B.  Attendance isn't mandatory.

Mr. Bill was really nice and his tests were pretty straight forward. Take notes during lecture because his exams are straight from the powerpoints. If you do the study guide and know examples then you'll do fine!

Honestly, Bill Burke made me want to switch my major to BIO because his class was so interesting and fun. If I weren't already so far into Elementary Education, I would have switched. He's extremely helpful and knowledgable and you can tell that he has a passion for teaching college students. I suggest everyone has him as a professor!
Awesome guy and does his best to keep the class entertained. Posts study guides for exams and other helpful resources.

Mr. Bill goes out of his way to make sure that the course he is teaching is fully understood by all of his students.  He is more than willing to help outside of class times and emails timely and offers regular review sessions before tests. He does not worry about very specific information and wants his students to do their very best.

Awesome professor! Really cares about his students and truly wants you to come out of the class with a good understanding of the content. He does not test on specific numbers or things that do not matter because he wants you to come out with the general idea of what he's trying to teach you. Very understanding and fair! :)

This class was extremely easy as long as you go to class. I attended class almost every day but took awful notes and still ended up with an A in the class. As long as you pay even a little bit of attention and do all his assignments, the class should be no problem.

EASY class. I never opened the book. Tests are cake and Mr. Bill offers a ton of extra credit if you go to class. Very good about giving examples and addressing all questions, and very reasonable about deadlines. I attended about 75% of classes and got an easy A, and I have zero background in biology. The most open-minded bio prof. you will find.

Angry little red faced man. Calls himself Mr.Bill, which is just infuriating. Tries to be "tricky" on all tests, whether accurately measuring knowledge of the material or not. Also, taught ecology and drove a hummer, something's not right there. Completely useless and irrelevant writing assignments. Horrible prof.

Dr. Burke was a very very good teacher. He was very intelligent and knew what he was talking about. His lectures were interesting and not the type you would fall asleep to. however, his test are very very hard. I failed about everyone but did good on the homeworks (which are simple) and extra credits and came out with a B.
I absolutely did not like Burke, his test were very hard and he says he will help you out and I emailed him and he was very rude about everything.
At the beginning of the semester I really liked Dr. Burke then towards the end of the semester when I emailed him a few questions about a past exam he was extremely rude and condescending towards me.

Dr. Burke is GREAT!He's hilarious in class. The tests are all multiple choice & directly from the notes,so if you study a fair amount, you'll get a good grade. He also gives extra credit opportunities through the semester. You have to go to class though,because all his lectures come directly from the power points.Overall, he's an amazing professor!

Mr. Bill is my favorite professor at UK by far!  You must come to each and every class to do well.  He uses powerpoints.  There are four exams and several small written assignments.  He is exceptionally clear and easy to understand; he realized that we weren't Science majors and was helpful.  He was very willing to negotiate test answers.
Very easy course. Show up and take notes. Actually listen to what he says, don't just write down the powerpoints.

I had to drop his course.  He acts like he is better than everyone.  His tests were very hard to understand even though I attended every class and studied a lot!  And going to him for help won't do any good, he made me feel like an idiot.
I had to drop this class.. He made me feel about an inch tall when I went to him for help. The tests were extremely hard even after studying a lot and class was very boring..

The class is exetremely BORING! He's kind of funny in a wierd way. Hes grading point system is INTENSE. Every point truly matters. His test only have like 30 questions its easy to fail them. You need to come to class, study and get acquainted with himin order to get an A. Its not easy. but hes pretty cool.
Very good and easy to understand.
Great class and teacher. Easy as  long as you get the in class notes. Tests come from review sheet and extremely easy (all multiple choice.) Definitely take him for this class if you can.

I warn you to not take his class. I studied a lot for his tests, went to class everyday and managed to not do so well on the tests. They are awful and nothing like his lecture. He is also a jerk, if you ever try to approach him for help! SO DON'T TAKE HIM!!!
Terrible teacher and offers little no help when asked.  Class was boring, and he often had a hard time discribing topics in class.  If able, take another prof.!!

Great teacher...class material is meaningful if you care about the environment. Burke is passionate about the material. This class could not be any easier, all you have to do is SHOW UP! tests questions are directly from notes, sometimes word for word. Easy A for your natural science credit.

terribly boring teacher.  he's definitely a northerner who dosn't appreciate the south.  he is also obsessed with hawaii (where he lived a few years) and has a test dedicated to it. DONT TAKE IT.  you just learn about the environment and although it is important, an entire class is not necessiary.
Pretty easy tests if you go to class and take notes. He has review sessions that are also helpful. Good prof.
His notes are really easy to follow and the tests are pretty easy.

An ok, professor. Test mainly based on class notes. Sometimes he assigns readings in the text, that will be on the test. Tests are tricky. All tests are multiple choice. A cumulative final. (well part of it is.) And there are 3 short & EASY writing assignments that are due usually on test day.
Not a bad class....the tests are hard but if you do the study guide and go to the study group it shouldn't be too bad....GO TO CLASS EVERY DAY!! even though its not mandatory its worth going to !!
If you go to class and pay attention...you should have nothing to worry about

This is a really easy class as long as you go every time. Try not to take at 8am. I took 102 at 11am last semester and it was much easier. No book needed, test are all from notes and examples in class.

i thought this class was extremely easy as long as you go to class every single day.  my friend had krupa and i once sat in on his class and i hated it!  burke has all of the lecture laid out on slides that he posts online.  he was also extremely helpful with the papers and even let me email mine because i forgot to bring it to class.

I did not think that this class was so bad. I did pretty poorly on the first exam (failed it, I think) and still got a B with just a little extra effort. I am not a BIO major, and it didn't seem so hard.

i do NOT reccomend this guy. he is the most liberal dumb ass ive ever seen in my life. he actually called me out on a 200+ lecture class for blowing a bubble. he's not really that hard, although the test are tricky, but listening to him talk about his little miata and how hawaii is the greatest state in the world makes me sick.
DONT TAKE THIS CLASS! Take it from Krupa! This Guy Sucks! His tests are toooooooo hard!
not approachable. acts like he cares about students but doesn't one bit! tests are very tricky. I do NOT recommend this professor.
He is not helpfull at all he says that he will take time to help you but that is a not true! thinks that he invented Biology!!!!! TESTS SUCK
TEST ARE AWFUL!
his tests suck
Mr. Bill can sometimes be annoying.  His jokes are not funny, although he thinks they are.  The class is relatively easy, so I can't complain.
Great teacher, made class interesting.  Don't ever skip, your grade will show how much you did.  Enjoyed him greatly.  Would take his class again.

Mr. Bill's lectures were somewhat interesting, but beware of the tests. Most questions are very tricky in their wording. He makes fun of himself during lecture which is fine for the first day but then it got overrated. His style was ok, but had problems with the mic in our class. His instructions before EVERY test is aggravating. OK class, i guess.
Very boring class. His tests were extremely tricky except for the final which was super easy.

Class was pretty easy. The material is pretty cut and dry. The tests can be through you for a loop, he makes you think about the material which is really good. You don't need the book if you go to class and get the notes. He's even willing to set aside study sessions. Great Prof.
Boring... but overall an easy grade. Go to class and take good notes... the book wont help and is not needed. 8AM will not work. Lecture attendance is a necessity.

Good professor.  He gets angry at times over unnecessary things.  He does explain things well though.  There is no need to buy the text book.  I don't even know what it looks like and I've got an A in the class. Study 30 minutes the night before the exam and you should do fine.
He seemed very bitter towards the students, but the class was easy.  I didn't even buy a book.  He presented subject matter with great detail and did not attack creationist.
No Comments
He is very nice but his tests are very very very odd. If u want to meet a nice guy take his class but do not expect an A.

The cutest man you'll ever meet... Nice guy and willing to help however, lacks on fun lectures. But here's a hint... never take this class at 8am. You will never go and therefore, your grade will go way down. The class is hard enough as it is, take it later in the day.
Not bad, very fun and engaging. Easy A or B

He's a great teacher! Class is usually pretty interesting (he makes jokes to keep your attention), and tests aren't too difficult. However, he does have a tendency to go into great detail about things that we dont know to know...
I completely messed up my schedule one semester to take this professor -- and I'd do it again.  What a great teacher!!!
Great teacher.
This is a difficult teacher, but willing to help if you ask.
Nice guy but hard
Dr. Blasing is one of the best professors I have ever had! She is so attentive and sweet. She really cares about her students success!

Dr. Blasing is the most caring and approachable professor I've had. Her classes are very engaging, and she truly cares about her students and their success in learning Russian. The homework load can be a bit heavy at times, but she's usually very reasonable with that too. Would definitely recommend!

Professor Blasing is very kind, forgiving, and a good professor. The only (very) minor complaint is that class can be a little disorganized at times; she's often late and goes a couple minutes over time, and will sometimes not post the HW until nighttime. Other than that, I would definitely recommend!

I really loved taking her class! She's such a sweet person and the exams and homework were all really easy. Since I took her on T/TR attendance was very important. I took her for a core class and I don't regret it! I recommend taking a class by Dr. Blasing .

Prof. Blasing is the most helpful and caring professor I have been lucky enough to meet here at UK. She goes above and beyond to help all of her students and ultimately wants you to succeed in everything you do here. She is extrememely knowledgeable about everything Russian and the awful review below this one is wrong and is by an upset jerk.

I think she is one of the most biased prof I have ever seen. She needs to learn things other than russ literature. I only took the course because the topic itself is interesting, but the course taught by her made me never want to read another russian literature. She is unhelpful with papers and she takes everything way too personal.

Professor Blasing is very knowledgeable in her understanding of Russian culture & history. I had her for Russian Film, and she changed the way I have watched movies! You'll learn to analyze films better while learning about Russian culture. The group project at the end of the class was intense though, beware. Would take again! No english necessary!

She told one of my classmates she should "take a writing class" after a few small grammatical errors. She is an awful professor to start your nursing education with and definitely will make you feel small and inferior. Very biased and rude about criticism.

I think I speak for everyone when I say what a horrible experience it was to be a student in this class. This class was the worst possible way to begin my experience in nursing school and made me question if I wanted to transfer to a different nursing program. She has no respect in the slightest for her students and is such a bully.

Absolutely horrible. This was probably the worst experience I have ever had as a student in all of my life. Being a student in this class was a total nightmare and I am quite shocked that such a prestigious nursing program has her as an instructor. Do yourself a favor and avoid her at all costs.

I have taken both CIS 110 and 111 with Ms. Munoz, and I believe she is the reason I am now comfortable with college writing. She is genuinely there to help you improve your writing and boost your confidence. Additionally, she does offer many out-of-class work days when she believes you could do the coursework from home. She is the best professor.

Blanca is definitely one of the best profs I've had. She cares deeply about her students and their work and cultivates a positive and inspiring environment in her classroom. I would 100% take a class with her again, her work is easy and it actually helps you learn the concepts. P.S. she cancels class most fridays 🫡
She's one of most amazing instructors I've had (last semester) I have again this semester and she's just so chill!
Amazing professor, very friendly, gives extensions as long as you ask and allows creativity with most work. Occasionally advocates for certain views some won't agree with but not often.

She's absolutely awesome! Super light and manageable work. Will give extensions if you ask. Don't be scared to ask her for help; she does her best to make sure you're able to turn your work in and help in any way she can! Lots of out of class work days.
Great classroom environment. She made the class fun to be in. Also a great communicator, very understanding, and easy to talk to. I would defiantly recommend this class or this professor to anyone.

If you can take her class she is amazing. She really puts in effort to get to know her students and cares about our lives outside of class. Gives really good feedback and cancels class a lot on Fridays.
Such a caring and amazing professor. She cancels Fridays a lot. She can get a little political at time but she is amazing!
I loved Ms. Muñoz! Very caring and understanding about everything. Would highly recommend taking her to fill your credit.

Ms Munoz is amazing! She cares about her students and is very accommodating. She is so understanding with everything and a great teacher. Her class was very easy too and she is a nice grader. I loved her class!
Most caring professor out there. Very accomodating

One of the sweetest and most caring professors I have ever met. Blanca clearly shows that she cares about all of her students and the work you've put into class. Slightly slow to grade, but that truly is her only flaw and she allows for extra credit if you come and talk to her. If you communicate a problem with her she will do her best to resolve.
LOVEEEEE HERRR!!!!!! She gives a lot of Fridays off if you have her MWF! She is also very understanding about everything!
Ms. Munzo is great! She really cares about her students and is very understanding about mental health.
Maybe the sweetest professor here and I feel so lucky to have experienced her this semester. She understands the mind of a student so well and teaches in a way that makes it interesting and exciting.
Take her class, shes the GOAT.

I loved having Ms. Munoz in class. She promotes having a stress-free environment which means a lot to a first-year college student. She cares a lot about the well-being of her students and she is very flexible on due dates and make-up assignments as long as you communicate with her. HIGHLY recommend taking her for CIS 110 and/or CIS 111.

I LOVED Ms. Munoz! Her class is SUPER EASY so take her to fulfill this core requirement you won't regret it. She's lenient on due dates, cancels many assignments, cancels class often, grades mostly for completion, thoroughly supports students while writing papers, implements many workshop days, and radiates positivity and good energy during class.
Professor Munoz was amazing, she was always so helpful and funny!
She is simply the best human ever! I love her very much. She is so caring while also being professional and a great teacher. If you get a chance to take this course with her, you will be in luck!

Super caring and great teacher, totally understanding with any personal issues and is willing to work around it as long as you are to. Structure of the class is really good to understand and gives ton of real life examples to relate. Just a great person all around
The best pro at UK she is an amazing women I would 100% take her class again!
Literally the best professor to ever exist
Simply put, the best.

I took this class in the Summer and it was my first college course. Miss Munoz made every single student feel welcomed and had great social skills. There wasn't a day that I dreaded coming to this class.
I loveee Prof Munoz. She explains everything in-depth and is very understanding when it comes to late work or missed classes. If you have the option to take her class do it!

If you get a chance to take a class with Blanca, do not pass it up. Blanca is one of the most understanding, caring, and chill professors I've ever had. She will always extend due dates if you talk to her and she's very heavy on communication with her students. She truly cares and is also an easy grader. I loved her class!!

Blanca is the best professor or teacher that I have had EVER. She is so kind and understanding and actually respects you and your opinion. I would highly recommend taking her class, especially because she actually wants you to learn and not just complete assignments. You have one big paper, but it didn't even take me two hours. Take this class!!!!

She is the most caring professor I have ever met. She cares about your mental, emotional, and physical well being. If you need help with anything (even if it is not for the class) she will always be there for you.
Overall amazing experience. She is so nice and one of the best professors I have ever had. If you have the opportunity to take a class with her please do! She is the BEST
Amazing professor!! She keeps the class fun and entertaining while challenging students to become better public speakers and writers. One of my favorite professors by far!

Great professor and would highly suggest. If you go to class and try even a little you can easily get an A. She does a great job explaining assignments and is also very caring. She cancels class before holidays as she is also a student. Definitely would take again.

Dr. B is a pretty solid professor. EGR 101 is just a tedious class, but she's a good option. Lectures can be boring and there tends to be a great deal of busy-work, but she's super nice and accommodating to her students, and she does her best to make class interesting. Homework is relatively easy and there are no exams.

I do not think I have used a single thing from EGR101 (or any of the introductory engineering courses for that matter) in my next two years at UK. Regardless, Whitney Blackburn-Lynch is a very good and kind professor, and I would highly advise anyone having to take EGR101 to have her as a professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class is easy and an obvious GPA booster. The lectures are boring but she tries to make it more fun with games. The homework assignments are hard but she would work through examples in class that were the same. She also gave us extra credit for recommending a song to her, which was pretty cool of her. Overall a good professor.

Class itself was very boring and pointless. Homework assignments could have been done without going to class however, attendance makes up a good chunk of grade so it is heavily recommended that you should go to class. She was a good professor however, it is hard to make a class with the material taught entertaining so it is not her fault.

The most ridiculous professor in existence. She will forget to do things for the students. EGR103 is already a chore of busy work, but having a professor who forgets she would order something or forgets to let you know you can do something pushes it right over the top. If I had taken her my freshman year I would not have continued with engineering
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: EGR 101 isn't too difficult, but she doesn't communicate enough with students in and outside of class which makes the class way harder than it needs to be sometimes.

Assignments are easy, but there are a lot of them. Dr B is entertaining. Syllabus says the book is required, but as long as someone else in your group has one, you really don't. You can still do the MatLab assignments without the book (temp access does the trick without purchasing). Lots of group work - learn to love them.

EGR103 is a tough class, it's based upon a single project with many checkpoints. The class itself requires a lot of work, especially if you and your group gets behind. However, Dr.B grades fairly and helps make sure you are on the right track. The lectures are a bit boring but that's not her fault. EGR103 is a newer class and is working out kinks

Dr. B is an alright professor, her lectures are good but she can be stern at times. I hated the class not because of her, but because of the problem sets we were assigned. They were extremely difficult and the material we covered in class had nothing to do with the homework assignments. Luckily, she stills walks us through the projects.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I hated this class with a passion. It just seemed pointless, but its required. The class isnt hard, but there is a lot of tedious work with it. Dr. B herself isnt a bad professor.  She did the best she could with this class.
While the course can seem very pointless at times, Blackburn-Lynch is very down to the point. She cares about the our grades and tries to energize somewhat boring topics. Good teacher overall.

This was her first year teaching this class (EGR 101) and the first year for the class at the university, so most of the problems I had can be attributed to inexperience. These problems were excessive busywork and unclear grading criteria, but they were fixed as the course progressed. Prof Blackburn-Lynch put a personal touch on a boring class
Dr. B was a great teacher.  Not only did she teach effectively, but told some funny stories about her adventures as an engineer and let us critique some of her earlier work in class.

EGR 101 is UKY's new first year engineering program. So Dr B didn't have a lot of freedom in choosing how she handled things. That said, she has a lot of knowledge and background from a career in engineering. She will help you if you ask her. Lecture and homeworks were boring though. She sometimes instructs yoga, but I don't know where.

Dr. Jones is phenomenal. He cares about his students, provides lectures with real-world examples (and his actual face on video!), and is so knowledgeable in his field. I took his online class and recommend going to the optional "coffee-house" class sessions if you can. A great professor all around.
Yes, he can be a bit corny, but he's totally charming and easy to laugh with.  I was dreading taking this class, but he made it fun. I would absolutely recommend him to anyone.

To be honest, the class is very easy.  However,his lectures tend to be very repetitive. Would not recommend unless you want to be bored out of your mind. Other students find him kind of condescending...
Very easy and spoon feeds you exactly what will be on the test. He is a very sweet guy who genuinely wants you to do well.
he is very corny and lame.  likes to talk about feelings too much.  i would not recommend him.
Hon 140 is easy with her. The only thing you have to do outside of class is the journals and reflections. Again, very easy.
Good for a philosophy style class. Everything is a discussion and nothing is objective. My STEM mind didn't care for it, but more creative people usually like it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Forgiving when it comes to understanding your course load, and will always give extensions if you just ask. She is a kind professor who is passionate about her students and her coursework. There is a lot of reading and homework in the class but she gives more than ample time for everything.

I could not have asked for a better professor. She is so sweet and wants students to fully understand and learn the content. Anyone can tell how passionate she is about her writing and her class always is so fun! She has been the best thing that has happened to me for my college experience! Definitely recommend!

She is so passionate about what she teaches, I would 11/10 recommend her as a professor for any class. She cares deeply about all her students and is very understanding about pretty much everything as long as you communicate. The content is all very interesting as well, and we discuss a lot of fun ideas. Not a lot of homework, just some reading.

So caring. Such a nice professor. You do have to write weekly things, but they are super easy. It's a really easy and fun class. She also gives great feedback to help you be the best writer that you can be!

She is probably one of the sweetest people you will ever meet. It is obvious that she cares a lot about her students and is excited to form relationships. She is extremely accommodating with deadlines, but also creates great assignments that are usually very engaging and don't feel like busywork. Highly recommended her!!!

Super nice person and very good at what she does.  She is a published author herself and knows how to write a story and develop your voice.  I wish we had done even more writing.  Class is useful and engaging.  I feel like I learned a lot and wasn't overworked at all.  She really knows how to make you learn without overloading you with work.

I took Dr. Peterson's Creative Writing section of HON252, and I really enjoyed it. Participation is important, but if you put something into this class, you'll get a lot out of it. She's super sweet and will work with you if you need an extension, and she genuinely wants to have a relationship with students.

Dr. Boutwell-Peterson is an awesome professor! She is very understanding if you need an extension and makes the course material applicable to the real world. The class is very manageable and should not be overly challenging as long as you put in the effort. I would highly recommend her course if you need an art credit!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is super nice and understanding! There's good amount of reading/writing but everything is doable and helpful. She also is very chill and caring.
She was amazing! She challenges your knowledge!

I love her so much. 100% recommend this class. Light load of work but can easily understand it when discussed in class. The topics we learned were very relevant which made it easier to engage. But, I would say the most important thing about the class is participation.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Peterson is very helpful and understanding. As long as you put in effort and show up it is an easy A.

She's so nice and understanding. The workload is manageable and fairly easy to complete. There is a lot of class discussion, so make sure to include yourself and not get distracted by your other work.
Dr. Peterson is the best professor i have ever had. She is the nicest most caring professor. She will work with you on due dates if something doesn't work with you. VERY lenient.

This professor was a great teacher and provoked deep thoughts from students. Not only did she do her job well, she is also a great person in general. She is understanding, sweet, and very caring. 

She learns her students names and really enjoys teaching, which shows in the assignments she gives. 10/10 experience. Wish more teachers were like her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This was such a fun class where we got to exercise our writing skills. Sometimes the readings took a while, but they are only used for table discussions. There were journal reflections on readings, but they weren't bad. Overall this was a great, easygoing class.

I took this class for my arts and creativity credit. This class is not hard as long as you do the papers and readings. Dr. Peterson is very accommodating and wants every student to succeed. Class is discussion based so make sure you are up to date on the readings.
Easy class, understanding professor. Would be hard to fail.

Professor Boutwell-Peterson is a wonderful professor! She is very kind and gentle. She is also quite passionate about literature and writing. She structures the class in such a way that really helped to strengthen my understanding and execution of writing as a whole. There are required readings, but they're easy. I would take this class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: This creative writing class was a lot of fun. It explored lots of different types of literature and writing. Go to class. It's fun and you get to hear from a lot of different people and their stories. This is definitely an attendance-is-important class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Attendance is mandatory, however the class and grading of it is very easy.
Very sweet lady! Class consists of readings and 3 creative papers. It was a fun and rewarding class.
great professor! constructive and pushes students without them having to worry about their grade. fun class with great discussions!

This class is so fun and helpful. I always love attending and the professor is incredibly kind and understand but also very knowledgeable. Highly recommend if you want to dive into your creative side!

I took this class to satisfy an arts credit that I needed and the class was called Creative Writing. Unless you are really into this kind of stuff, I recommend finding a different class to satisfy your credit. This was an hour and fifteen minutes of her sweet calming voice rocking you to sleep as you read through chapters of books. Nice lady though
Very easy class, and she is super nice and easy-going

Dr. Peterson was a fine professor. I have come to find out that for HON140, she assigns a lot bit work than other sections. However, grading is extremely fair and if you show up, lowest you can possibly get is a 90%
Easy class overall, as long as you show up and do your speeches you will be fine. He's very helpful and understanding, although class isn't always mandatory his lectures are very useful.

Attendance wasnt mandatory which was nice, but i still showed up to class because I love him and his teaching. He is passionate about media and is very understanding. There is a research paper but other than that, the class is straight forward and easy.
He is the best most interesting lecturer and is so kind. Love Love Love his class and his teaching
Professor Booras is a legend. Take any class of his you can
He doesn't do test so the only assignments were speech's which he does grade kinda tough but he cares and wants you to succeed

If you see a class is offered by him, take it! I took his Communication and Sport (COM 327, doesn't show up on his offered courses) class this year and finished the class with a high A. We had seven assignments this semester, three exams and four papers, all of which are very doable! He is very understandable if you have to miss class.
very easy if you just do the reading. no more than 15 minutes of homework a week (weekly 3 question quiz) and professor is always very helpful! go to class for potential extra credit sometimes.

I loved Professor Booras! He was very sweet, easygoing, and very understanding. His class in my opinion was very easy the assignments weren't bad at all just quizzes every week, a few assignments, and 2 exams. Almost everything was online and attendance wasn't mandatory. I would easily take this class again.

I loved Mr. Booras! He was such a sweet professor. Definitely recommend taking one of his classes if you have the opportunity. The work was pretty easy along with the exams. Pretty much everything was online. You can tell he enjoys what he is teaching which makes his lectures enjoyable to attend. He also offers extra credit sometimes!
I loved Dr. Booras! You don't have to attend class as most everything is online. This was probably one of the easiest classes I've taken, and definitely recommend taking him if you have the chance!
[COM 287] Booras is great. 4 speeches for the semester. They will only class for as long as they would need it. Easy grader, Thoughtful feedback and clear grading criteria.

Booras's lectures are either like watching paint dry or exciting. Depends on the day. Tests are medium difficulty. You have to pay attention in class, everything is laid out for you. He posted the presentations for us, but that was during COVID-19. Definitely not the worst, but not the best. I would take him again if I had to.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Bosch is super nice and wants to make conversation during class but unfortunately, this class was not what I expected. Felt like I wasn't learning about the topic at all. It was easy but a little boring. Dr. Bosch was an easy grader and gave nice feedback! Showing up to class matters, big part of your grade. Assignments were simple!

This professor is SO boring. We are literally learning stuff I learned in 5th grade, and there's no point to it. She's nice, but I can't stand her lectures. If you need an easy course for linguistics, take this one and do your homework while you sit there and listen to her drone.

She's a nice person who missed the mark. She tried to keep class engaged, but few people were. Expect to purchase a different assigned book every few weeks. Major assignments are almost too simple.  Minor assignments were basic, but repetitive and pointless. It was weird, she's passionate about her field, but she didn't really teach anything.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things
