reviews.comment: Dr. Bosch definitely isn't a tough grader. Her lectures can be kind of boring as the content is usually pretty basic and doesn't spend a lot of time on any one thing. She is very accessible outside of class and willing to help if needed.

I had Bosch for LIN 221 (intro to linguistics); she is a kind person and an amazing prof! She doesn't understand Canvas very well, but that meant there was only about one assignment every week or two. She says attendance is mandatory but only checked it maybe 3 or 4 times. Go to class, read the textbook, do the homework, you'll get an A.

Dr. Bosch is a great professor who wants everyone to succeed. She is a fair grader, but she does expect you to know the material and be able to apply it to the exams. Exams were take home and open note, but def. still study before hand. There are random homework assignments to make sure you are paying attention and that you understand the material.
Awesome professor. She really cares about her students. If you get the opportunity, take her class!
she's pretty clear and the class is really organized, easy exams

Easy class, attendance for Friday recitation class was mandatory and where the group projects happened so show up on Fridays. Exams were open notes, open book and followed the study guide. She is approachable, cares about her students and what she is teaching. Overall easy class to take and nice professor.

I took this class for UK Core. Very easy. I didnt have to attend lectures Monday Wednesday but recitations were required Friday. I didnt use the book a lot. She was nice. James Keppeler taught recitation and he was nice too. I learned some interesting stuff but not a lot.

Lecture is very easy to skip and much of the content is elementary, but recitation attendance is necessary. The class overall is very boring but its easy to do well in if you just take decentish notes (midterms/finals are open note). Textbook is required, and there's only like 4 assignments the whole semester on top of exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Bonzani is an incredibly organized and clear professor. However, she enriches herself off her students by making a low-quality textbook that she wrote mandatory. Additionally, her grading system only awards 100 points/sem, so any missed points come directly off the final grade, with no consideration for exam weighting. Please find another prof

Very easy but boring class; overall well organized, but the TA and she weren't on the same page sometimes. There are very few assignments, so make sure you do them well. Lecture is easy to skip, but make sure you go to recitation. Easy class to get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super easy class. Make sure you go to recitations, but other than that you don't need to go to lectures. Also, no need to buy the textbook, I bought it and barely used it! You're graded on only a few things, so make sure you do well!
Class was super easy, barely went to the lectures, but make sure to go to the recitations! you're graded on a few assignments, so make sure you do well on them. Other than that, class was super easy!

This class was so beyond boring and honestly useless. I took it because it was required. She doesn't post the lectures or notes nor does she actually cover the material she gives on the guided notes questions. The ENTIRE semester was out out 100 points. It is October 2nd and we have 15 points in currently... It's pretty easy it just is so useless.

you dont have to actually go to the lecture only the recitations. theres attendance quizzes that are easy. the class itself was so easy i barely put any effort into it and got a 102.67 grade. she gives out extra credit but makes you do it so all this class does is boost your gpa and fill a core credit

Extremely boring and useless class, Unless you are extremely interested in Anthropology or need the core credit I do not recommend taking her class. Requires you to buy her own book (I recommend not buying it, all of the assignments related to it are in groups so you can take pictures or borrow a group members book for the assignment).
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: super EASY but very BORING. the class is made up of a few group projects, an annotated bib, midterm, and final. the recitation was pointless and, most of the time, did not have anything to do with lectures, but attendance is taken for that.

Dr. Bonzani is amazing!! Her lectures are great. You can tell she loves her job. Attendance is not mandatory. If you follow the rubrics for your assignments this class is an easy A. She responds to emails quick and is always happy to answer questions.

This is the easiest class I've ever taken. I forgot I was taking this class and I'm still finishing with an A+. If you have a pulse, then you can get an A in this class. Side note, you have to buy a textbook and the prof is the author so you're literally just giving her money indirectly and that's dumb but everything else is easy.
Professor loves her job and class is easy to understand and full of great information.

Class on Mondays and Wednesdays were lectures, and on Fridays, we would go over some main points in the lecture with the TA. Throughout the semester, we had only four assignments, a midterm exam, and a final exam, all open notes. I took the class for the social science UK core and overall the class was super easy, and Dr. Bonzani was so nice!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: really loved taking this class! Dr. Bonzani was an amazing professor, also very sweet, funny, kind. class itself is also very interesting, she designs each lecture to be one topic but not an overwhelming amount.  definitely take another class of hers again and cannot rate her highly enough. Take this class ifyou want to learn something, shesgreat!

Super nice and the class is insanely easy. You don't need a the textbook. Attendance isn't necessary either because all the tests are open note. At the end of the week you have to do a few easy questions on canvas, that counts as attendance. The test uses questions from those canvas assignments. 4 easy assignments the entire semester.

Very easy class. I only showed up to one class the entire semester and finished with an A+. Prof is very nice and caring. There is also an online option where lectures are live-streamed if you don't want to/can't come to class. Grade really depends on your TA
easiest class. there is group work, but you get to work on ur own if you want. sweet person. take her.
Dr. Bonzani's class was my least favorite this semester. Her lectures are boring and sometimes scattered. I learned some, but it was mostly from my TA during recitation. Easy Core credit but not fun.
Best class ever!! Take her! the material is easy to understand and the homework is simple. You learn a lot from her.
she really cares and is a great professor would take again!

I LOVED Dr. Bonzani! She records lectures, so you don't need to attend and can complete lecture outlines whenever it's convenient for you. There are hardly any assignments and graded easily. The exam questions come from the study guide and weekly attendance questions. If you ever have any questions she's always available and responds quickly :)
Super clear grading criteria, very simple projects and exams are easy if you use the study guides provided

This class is set up where if you do the lecture outlines you will do very well on the exams. The exams are open book and you can use the lecture outline that you do in class. The lecture themselves are slightly boring but I recommend this class to anyone, she does a good job of making this a stress-free class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Easy A, open-note exams, weekly lecture and recitation attendance quizzes. Overall, easy course to satisfy UK's Global Dynamics credit
This class was a bit boring but its not hard. You only need the textbook for the recitation when you do group work. Easy AF
Class is really easy. Lectures are a bit boring, but if you show up you will pass.

Only have to go to class when she takes attendance once a week and it's easy to figure out when she'll do that. Can pass this class without taking a single note all semester and without going to half of the classes. You should still go to recitation because they take attendance. The class is only out of 100 points so every attendance point matters.
Show up to class and do the assignments and you will get an A. She always seems slightly hungover in class and a lot of the assignments are pointless. You will be required to buy the textbook.
This class is so easy but so boring. I get bored in lecture because she just reads off the slides.

This class is an easy A. It is terribly boring but if you need a good grade you should get one by putting in little effort. I never read the books but got full points in recitation and rarely studied for tests but passed all of them. You never have homework either. Also, take Trudy as your TA, not the guy because he is rude.

This class is one of the easiest you can take. I missed probably 6 times and didn't study for an exam and I got a solid A. Dr. Bonzani gives very boring lectures but she gives note outlines for them and study guides for tests. If you need an easy A/GPA booster take this class!!

This class is cake. Easiest class you will take at UK. If you have any common sense, you could pass tests without studying (incase you don't, there are study guides for them too.) 'Attendance' is taken but its on canvas so just get a friend to send you the code. Only work I did was an annotated bibliography, but it was graded easy.

She can be pretty scatter-brained but it makes for funny tangents and makes class interesting. She is a pretty easy grader when it comes to presentations/papers, and it is easy to keep up with your grade because it's on a 100 point scale. She takes attendance 5 times randomly in the semester but usually tells when it will be ahead of time.
Really easy class, no one comes. She is a terrible lecturer so you won't really learn much.

Took her ANT101 class and it was so easy. You really shouldn't get anything below a B in her class. Attendance isn't mandatory, except in recitation after awhile they will dock you points. You can tell how much she loves Anthropology during her lectures. She's really sweet and very approachable. You almost never have homework and only two tests.

Dr. Bonzani is an amazing woman and an awesome professor. She is a bit scatter brained and her lectures are not bad. Tests are not bad, we had a presentation for this class and I know for a fact mine was terrible but I got an A. She's a very kind person and loves when you talk to her one on one.
Took 50 minutes to explain 10 minutes of information. Not a hard class though.

Sweet lady, but not the best lecturer. Luckily, her class was super easy, and as long as you glanced at the textbook and attended like half the lectures, there is no reason you would not get an A or B.
Great professor! her 102 class was so much fun! we only had one paper, which we got to write about a myth. the final was super easy too

Dr. Bonzani is a WONDERFUL professor!!! I enjoyed going to her class everyday. She is super excited to teach, which makes learning fun for me. I would strongly recommend her class. You will learn a lot and see her passion of Anthropology shine through!
she's really nice,  explains a lot, helps the students, she makes the class really easy and she's always their for help.
To be honest this class sucked so bad, but it was the easiest class ever. I would take it to get your UK Core done, but you're going to dread it everyday! She is really nice though.
Nice woman, but as the other comments say, shes pretty frazzled. Kind of air-headed. On the bright side, she's very kind and lenient and this class is very easy.

A very nice woman who is very approachable and down-to-earth. While her powerpoints were hard to follow and she always seemed pretty frazzled during lectures, I learned a lot in the class. Her test questions are pretty much from her powerpoints. Easy tests, one homework assignment the entire semester. Loved this class.
She is kind of all over the place during lecture, and her power points are really difficult to follow.  Overall the class isn't difficult or time consuming.

Her powerpoint slides were basically the textbook copied and pasted. You would do best to read the textbook (which is interesting) and just attend recitations. The midterm and final were really straightforward, but she was always all over the place.
Class was super easy. She always gave you more time on assignments if needed. She is always willing to work with students with help on the very little homework that is assigned.

She was always happy and positive. She makes herself laugh, which always put a smile on my face. Her class is extremely easy. Theres no homework and lectures aren't mandatory, however, I chose to go to every class to get the notes because she does not put them online. Theres only two exams and her study guides tell you exactly whats on it. Take her

Class was easy. Only 3 assignments & 2 tests. She really knows what she's talking about, but sometimes I think she adds too much info to slides for lectures. I enjoyed the class though. She's very nice & wants students to do well.

Well...Bonzani seems like a very nice lady, and she seems to really know her stuff, she just isn't the best at communicating it. Her lectures can be pretty boring. However if you're really into Anthropology you may really enjoy it, it just wasn't for me. Tests are easy. No HW. Her TA's are really great, they make recitation fun.

This class is super easy, but she is not a very good teacher. She doesn't explain things well, she puts way too much text on powerpoints, and she jumps around a lot while explaining things. However, there really isn't a lot of work in the class, and its an easy A.

Took class for an easy A, but the test was harder than it should have been. Had a bunch of really specific details. Attendence isnt mandatory for lecture, but was for the rec. Overall, not a terrible class, but not as easy as I would have liked.
Really nice and is an easy instructor. The class is easy but could be hard if you don't have a background in archaeology.
This is easier than a high school class.  You'll get an A as long as you go to lecture and take notes.

Easy class! Great Prof! Very sweet and helpful woman. Loved her class. Read the assigned books there are quizzes on them. Study for the map quizzes. Easy points! Attend recitation-attendance is taken. Very interesting topic! =) lots of videos and test questions come from them and the material she presents in class.

Easy A but boring class.  Usually only lasts 2 hours.  LOTS of notes if your writing them but most people use laptops and it isnt so bad.  Gives out a study guide before the exams and it is the EXACT same thing.  Only 2 tests.  Map quizzes are super easy. Take her for anthro
One of the worst professors I've ever had.  She's random, really confusing, and her voice sounds like nails going down a chalkboard.  Really hard to pay attention to what she's saying.
Really is an easy A.  The reading is useless so is going to class.  Sweet lady though, good class.

This class was an easy A. The study guide is the test exactly. The only thing i did poorly on was the reading quizzes, and that's because i never read the material. don't stress at all about the map quizzes, they are cake.
Crazy lady, crazy easy!
Lots of note-taking as she doesn't believe in handouts.  If you read the books, attend class, and participate it's an easy A.
This class was awful! It was somewhat easy but the notes were extremely long, the woman is a bit crazy, and the class is so boring. I wouldnt recommend it.
She was a bit nutty and she had super long over head notes, but the class was crazy easy! The TAs were easy too and you just need to do whatever assignments you have and it is an easy A.

One of the easiest classes I have ever taken.  I would suggest taking this class at night that only meets one time a day.  She lets you out early and goes through the slides (which have all of the test questions on them) pretty quickly.  If you miss class and email her she will send you the slides, EASIEST A EVER!!!

Probably one of the easiest classes I have ever taken.  I suggest taking this class with her at a time that only meets one day a week.  She never took the whole time to do lectures, so it was well worth it.  Map quizzes are easy, there are a lot of notes but most of them you won't even need. Easy A!

This class has a ton of notes, but I felt they were helpful for the exams. She is very willing to work with you about rescheduling exams and quizzes. Reading material is not necessary, map quizzes are easy. Should be an easy A.

She gave a ridiuculous amount of overhead notes, but they weren't really necessary. The map quizzes are much easier than you'll expect. The only down about the class is though it was easy, I didn't find she made it interesting.

She is very nice and gives a lot of notes but the class is so easy.  I thought it was a joke at our first map quiz becasue I studied every country in Europe and only like France, Germany and Italy were on it.  After getting an A on the first test I stopped coming to class and still did very well.  Very easy A!

This class is an absolute JOKE! As long as you go to class you will be fine and even if you don't just make sure to get the notes.  Bonzani has an out there personality almost like she's been living in the jungle for the past ten years, but she's very sweet and she wants everyone to do well.  Take if you can!
Wonderful hippie lady.  Map quizzes 1/4 of grade, easy.  Exams are short-answer(ish) with some variation, no cumulative final, all weighted equally.  fun class.

I know multiple people who had to fight with this man to get their practicum site approved, even though it was on the list... The hours we worked were barely worth any points toward our grade. Also, He is such a tough grader and takes this supposed to be easy class to an extreme, and he needs to chill out LOL. Bro takes it way too seriously.
This class is fine, not super difficult but the lectures are boring and very scientific

Very caring professor. Wants to create relationships with his students. He is also very intelligent and loves what he studies and teaches. His lectures sometimes can feel overwhelming because he gets lost in his own fascinations with the subjects. Show up and participate and you will be fine.
Makes the content interesting and gets really into his lectures.  Amazing professor, and he cares about his students.

Really poor communicator. He is non responsive to emails... like ever. Didn't post lab documents until 10 minutes before lab so no one had any idea what was going on. The canvas page is unorganized, too.

Dr. Bollinger is a competent, caring professor. If you're required to take KHP450 I highly recommend taking him. Ask him any questions during lecture or lab and he'll give you the help you need to succeed. I've seen him go out of his way to help his students (including me) multiple times this semester.
Boyd is a great professor and really cares about student success in the class. He is very helpful and gives great feedback. If you listen to his feedback you will get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I went to 2 lectures all year and got an A. But you do have to go to the recitations. The actual assignments/projects were kind of time consuming but easy. A lot of extra credit opportunities.(Took Fall 2024).
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is very nice. Lectures are very boring and not very helpful. Do not take this class if you aren't good with computers

His lectures were amazing and you could tell he prepared heavily for them, not just a read from the slide kind of guy. His assignments were easy if you read and followed instructions. If you struggle with the software used, him and his TAs are usually very good at helping outside of class. I was pleasantly surprised with how much I liked the class!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Boyd is a very understanding professor who puts a TON of effort into his classes. The lectures were informative, the homework was pretty easy (helps that he is a pretty lenient grader and very flexible with due dates). He puts effort into creating helpful materials and most lectures are just doing the homework in class. HIGHLY recommended.

I barely went to the lecture part of this class, but attended the recitation aspect and felt super comfortable with the assigned work. I needed his help for my final project, and he could not have been more helpful, walking me through each step on my screen. Definitely reach out if you need help; he's not intimidating.

I loved Boyd! My TA was amazing as well! An easy class, just need to pay attention. But if you don't make it to class he posts videos on how to work the software. The work is organized well and there are many opportunities for extra credit. I would definitely take another class with Boyd.

He is very passionate about what he teaches so it makes lectures very informative. He wants everyone to succeed and the class is very simple with little work. The only bad thing is that there is not much to be graded from so you need to get a good grade for each assignment.
Really has a solid structure to his class and knows what he is teaching.
Super cool guy. Really loves GIS and loves to see students succeed highly recommend. Class is complicated but once you get the hang of it you will be fine.

Easy class, instructor is very friendly. Two projects and two multiple choice exams. Exam questions come straight from extra credit quizzes throughout semester. Notes/slides posted on Blackboard. Material is pretty easy.

Great guy, lectures were very active and fun. Homework is fairly easy and content on quizes and exams are clearly defined. Extremely easy to get an A, he offers many extra credit opportunities and content is easy compared to previous Calculus classes.
Amazing. Lectures are actually helpful and he makes content easy to understand.

I've never been the srtongest at math, but he has been more than understanding and helped me figure out a plan to help me pass the class. I'm actually doing kind of fine in the class (after a not so great start grade wise), which isn't usual for me in a math class, but because of him, I'm starting to somewhat understand the subject.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you are not great at math, I'd say beware. I found that lectures went a bit fast, and no amount of studying personally helped me. He is not a bad professor, I just wish he was a tad bit more helpful. He does not believe that the first day of class should be a syllabus day and he immediately jumps into material, just too fast for me.

Dr. Elliot is the best algebra teacher I've ever had. When he explains things, topics I've never understood before instantly click. Every unit is connected. He loves answering questions. Usually there is homework twice a week, which takes 10 to 40 minutes. Recitation is biweekly. Very boring! Exams are 7:30-9:30pm.

Amazing professor! He is so nice and helpful! His lectures were easy to follow and stopped the lecture to answer any questions and would thoroughly explain. I would definitely recommend taking his class!

He is very good at explaining concepts, and it is easy to follow along with what is discussed in class. He frequently asks questions to make sure everyone understands the material and is always willing to answer questions. Very helpful professor, and I would definitely take Professor Elliot again.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Nicest professor, explaining everything clearly in lecture. Available outside of class for any question or confusion that you have. Would recommend anyone to take his class.

Dr. Elliot was one of the sweetest professors i've had. Though his explanations can be a little bit confusing at times, you can still ask him questions and he will clear it up immediately. I RECOMMEND TO HAVE HIM AS YOUR PROFESSOR!!
amazing teacher. would recommend taking this class before calc 1.
One of the best professors I've had, explains the topics well and his slides are very organized and easy to understand, I still go back and look at them to review.

There's a reason why Dr. Elliott is rated as high as he is. He's very knowledgeable about calculus and articulates the content in a way that is very easy to understand. I added math minor because of how much I loved his class and may even pursue a full math major if like my next few math classes. Take his section at all costs if you can.
Prob my favorite professor ever. Every exam had a curve and his lectures were amazing it made learning so much easier.
Absolute peak professor. He is very understanding and is all around an amazing person and teacher. Take him if you can and if you cant, find a way.
Genuinely my favorite professor I have had in my college career.
Amazing guy, super good at answering questions and taking extra time to make sure students understand content

I couldn't choose Calc 1 since he's only teaching it this semester, so pretend its a Calc 1 review, but my god he is the best professor I've ever had. I've had him two semesters in a row now so I can say for sure; he genuinely cares about student success. His biggest priority is us and not just making us do math aimlessly. He made math fun for me!

This is one of the best professors I've ever had. He goes through material at a steady pace, takes time for questions, explains things thoroughly, and you can tell he's good at what he does. 100% recommend. Really engaging lectures.

Dr. Elliot was an amazing professor to receive. I never really learned pre-calc all that well in high school so I took it with him during my first semester in college, and his teaching style made it infinitely easier to understand. I feel much more prepared for Calc 1 now and will gladly take it with Dr. Elliot next semester.

He was a good professor. He posts all his notes on canvas so you're never without notes. The homework's are easy 100 because you have unlimited tries. He's super helpful outside of class and you can see he enjoys teaching. Honestly a very laid back professor.

If I had to take another calculus class, I would 100% choose to take it again with with Dr. Elliot. The test's were pretty easy if you just pay attention in lecture and actually go through the practice exams. What I love about Dr. Elliot though is that he is always open with his office hours and cares about his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I would take math forever if I could have Bradley Fitzgerald Elliott for every class. he is an amazing teacher with an amazing personality. 10/10

Dr Elliott is a fantastic teacher. I have always been horrible at math but his lectures made it very easy to understand and handle new content. His homework isn't graded on correctness so it's easy to work through your mistakes without reaping consequences. He is a very understanding professor and I would willingly take another one of his classes.

I had a great time with Dr.Elloit. His exams were pretty straight-forward to what was taught in class, however, when it came to emails. I feel he hard a hard time responding to them, sometimes it would take weeks, to sometimes months just to get a response back. But overall, he's cool.

Professor Elliott is amazing! If you can take him for a math course I 100% would. Coursework is pretty easy and understandable and he explains it so well. There are no unit-covering quizzes just ones every other week that go over what we learned over the past 2 days so pretty simple!

Goated professor. Teaches very well and actually explains the math conceptually rather than just throwing problems and formulas at us which is something I think a lot of math teachers are guilty of. He makes the hws and exams straightforward and they're pretty simple. Overall calc 4 isn't difficult at all compared to the other calcs.

Seriously one of the best teachers I have had. He is a very funny and down to earth guy who genuinely cares about his students. He always makes sure to keep us engaged during his lectures and has clear expectations from the beginning. Attendance is graded by a one question quiz at the beginning of class and he uploads the PPT immediately after.

Dr. Elliot is hands down amazing. I'm taking him again for Calc 1 after taking his pre-calc class to refresh the concepts. I would take him for every math class if it's possible. He makes math way less intimidating for me and he's always kind and cares so much about students.

He made it really easy to understand the material. He would use his whole 50 minutes and make sure that everyone understood before he moved out. He creates a nice environment so I never felt scared to ask a question. The homework's are really easily, you get unlimited attempts. Recitation is something I found really useful as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Really great professor in my opinion. His lectures are straight forward and to the point. He does anything he can to try to help us understand the content. MA 110 is also painfully easy. Honestly, 3 lectures a week and 2 recitations a week is way too much for how genuinely easy MA 110 is.

Dr Elliott is by and far my favorite math professor I've had. His classes take some getting used to since each lecture has a worksheet done in groups that you struggle through before he explains the concepts, but overall this was a very good way to teach us the material. He was an absolute joy to have and I wish I could give him more than 5 stars

Dr. Elliott took over my class mid semester because my original professor was dealing with a health concern, and despite only teaching for half a year, I could tell he was the best for MA214.  You can really tell he cares about his students and their success within the class.  He is super approachable outside of class, and is understanding!

I can not recommend Dr. Elliott enough! He is an outstanding professor in the how he conveys material, answers questions, and provides study materials. The tests and quizzes are only a few questions and can be tricky. However, they are all fair to the material presented. Dr. Elliott is absolutely the right way to go when selecting classes!
Cannot recommend enough! Dr. Elliott was such an amazing professor and truly made this class so easy! Such a caring man who wants to see you succeed!

The best professor I have had in my 4 years of college. Dr. Elliott is caring, puts so much effort into making sure we understand the material and is hilarious. He makes a challenging course like calc 4 easy to understand. His exams are not necessarily easy, but they reflect the course material and he doesn't try to trick you.100% would recommend.

I LOVED Dr. Elliott he was the best professor I've ever had. He made the class so worth it you can tell he loves teaching and makes it fun. The work load was homework, and quizzes every week but not bad at all and is easy if you make an effort and he will definitely help. Just make an effort and it's a guaranteed A. Cant say enough good things!!

the BEST math professor ever. I hated math for so long and Professor Elliott made me enjoy class. So many assignment opportunities to get your grade up. A lot of quizzes but lowest grades are dropped.

Best professor out. Makes learning differential equations easy and is super caring and does everything he can to lay things out clearly and help his students succeed in his class. Couldn't recommend Dr. Elliott more

I hate math and Professor Elliott made this class fun! I enjoy his way of teaching and though we have a quiz every week, it usually consists of 5 questions that should be easily answerable as long as you attend class and understand the curriculum. I would push attending his office hours because he will slowly walk you through whatever you need!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: By far the best math class I've ever taken. Just show up, make an effort, and participate and Dr Elliot will respect you. Incredibly supportive and understanding, wants his students to SUCCEED, not just pass.
The GOAT, will literally help walk you through a problem on exams if you ask him.
goat

Professor Elliott does a wonderful job at teaching and getting the concepts across to his students. He actually wants you to do well in his class and will meet with you to help. In a world where school is no longer about learning, but about passing, professor Elliott is a break from this stereotype. By far the best teacher I have had so far at UK.
i dont normally like math but dr elliott made it so enjoyable. one of my favorite professors.
he is very nice, and makes his content very easy to understand. he tests are very easy and notes are easy to follow along.

Simply an amazing teacher. Im good at math when having a good professor teaching and he did an amazing job in making sure the lectures were easily understood and everyone understands. Quizzes often but they are pretty straight forward and he makes sure to teach everything before hand. At the end of the semester he drops you 2 lowest quiz scores

Professor Elliott is one of the best math teachers I have had in a while and that's saying a lot because I don't like math and most of the time I don't understand it but I do recommend you take math with him he teaches very well and yes you will have HW but if you attend class you can easily do it.

Professor Elliott was a great professor and really cared about his students. The class was easy and he drops the lowest scores for specific assignments. He was also super easy to reach through email and accessible for office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Elliott truly was the most enjoyable professor I had all semester. He truly cares about every student & their success and ensures you will get the grade you want. Show up to class, put in the effort, and do the homeworks and you will be perfectly fine!
LOVED THAT MAN
He is so accommodating and understanding. Teaches material so well!

Professor Elliott is an amazing teacher. I personally believe that he cares about each student and their success inside and outside of the classroom. If you do not understand a concept, he will take time out of his day and help you understanding the material.

Professor Elliott explains complicated math concepts in an easy way for students to understand. He always stops to let the class ask question and repeats the same point multiple times to really help students remember it. He is also available after class for additional help and has a very kind personality.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of the best instructors I've ever had. He lays out everything and makes it so easy to understand. Just actually try and you'll be fine. He's so nice, just awesome. I am not a math person whatsoever, but I actually enjoyed his class.

Dr. Elliot is both extremely nice and good at teaching. His lectures are easy to follow and promote deep understanding of the material. He is also generous about making exams only cover material that you have had time to cover properly in class, and he is also happy to help outside of class, both with course material and general math questions.

Bradley Elliot has been on of the best professors I've had at UK. His lecture are crystal clear and he is the most caring professor I have had. He wants his students to do well and is willing to work with them. I wish he could be the professor for all my classes. 12/10 would recommend!!!!!!!

A great professor! His lectures were very clear and he made sure all of his students could get the best grade possible. Incredibly understanding as well. He gives you extra credit if you use a cheat sheet on the tests and he drops your lowest exams. One of the nicest professors ever.
Bradley has a heart of gold. Best teacher I have ever had. He truly cares about each of his students and wants them to succeed. If I had the option to have him as a teacher for every class, I would.

Dr. Elliot is a king. He goes over and beyond to ensure his students success. If you want an A in his class, he will make sure that you get it. Allows a cheat sheet for tests, and has lots of points to make up for any mistakes. Highly recommend any of his classes!

Professor Elliott is super caring about student success. He goes very in-depth on lecture topics, and if you need help or extensions due to difficulty understanding the topic, he works with you. While attendance isn't mandatory, going to class makes everything a lot easier, but if you need to miss he works with you.
Professor Elliot was a great teacher. He really cared about his students. Theres a lot of note taking, so i prefer to attend class. All around Professor Elliot is a good teacher.

Incredible professor. Very clear teacher, easy exams if you understand the powerpoints and do the worksheets. Class isn't mandatory but should go if possible, but powerpoints and videos explaining class material are posted on canvas if you miss class. Very clear grading, drops lowest test and quiz at end of the semester. Great guy, would take again

he was a very nice prof, good first year teacher. he explains things great and will always help you with whatever you need. he really helped me pass math and was the best teacher i had for my first year.

Literally the sweetest man on Earth who truly cares about how his students are doing. I only went to the first week of class and then showed up for the tests after that and passed w/ an A. He gives cheat sheets on all section exams.

He is one of the best professors I have ever had. He teaches very good and is easy to understand. Attendance is not required but I would personally recommend. There is a lot of homework in the class but doesnt take long to complete
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Caring--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Elliott is an amazing professor and very nice person. He will work with you on everything and do whatever it takes to help you understand the material. He is absolutely the best math teacher I've ever had and if you can take a section with him, you will never regret it.

If given the choice, take from Brad!! He was an amazing professor. MA 111 was extremely easy and I never received a grade below an A. All assignments, but tests, can be done until you get 100%. Very easy class, easy A! :)

Dr. Elliott is a great professor. He is so sweet and approachable. His lectures are super straightforward and easy to follow. The math in this class will never require you to do anything outside of adding/subtracting and multiplying/dividing. This class is a great option for UK core!
he is the best!!! seriously such an easy class. if you can take a section from him, definitely try!
Best math professor at UK. Simple as that.

Dr Elliot made MA 11 insanely easy. I often wouldn't go to class on Monday since it was at 8am, but I never fell behind. Easy notes. Explains the material well. Take fro him if you have the option- it will be an easy pass and a good gpa booster.

Brad was SO AWESOME! My class was on zoom and he could not have run it smoother. Work-wise there are mini-quizzes every few weeks, homework every week, and 4 exams total. He drops the lowest grades and has easily accessible office hours. He is super nice, caring, and friendly. You should totally take his classes!

Professor Elliot has been the best math professor/teacher I have ever had. He was really understanding that there is topics that a student will not understand so he gives lots of extra credit to help your grade. His lectures were very easy to follow and would stop at any point to answer questions. I would 100% take him again in a future class

If you can get a section with Dr. Elliot, take it. You will not regret it. Never had a teacher who made learning so easy. I took it online, and he didn't require attendance in the Zoom lecture. So IDK how he is in person but he is probably the best math teacher I have ever had, gave plenty of time on tests and quizzes and was always helpful.
Professor Elliott is a great professor. He makes his lectures very understandable and will go back if you are confused. He is extremely nice and most of all he wants you to succeed. Take his class.
I love Dr. Elliott. He is hands down the best math teacher I have ever had. He is very sweet. He also explains his content really well, and doesn't move on until everyone is clear.

She's genuinely awesome. Took her class randomly because I needed credits and has easily been one of my favorite classes I've ever taken. Class is engaging and actually makes me want to show up. You spend a lot of time discussing cases, rather than just taking notes. Heavily recommend her class, she's also very willing to help and wants you to pass
Awesome teacher

Genuinely one of the most caring profs I have ever had the pleasure of meeting. Dr. B ran the class as a democracy, if you will, and made sure our voices and opinions were heard and taken into consideration. She knows her stuff and CARES ABOUT YOU AND YOUR SUCCESS EVEN OUTSIDE OF CLASS!!!

She let us as a class argue over attendance being mandatory or not which was great, and this is what she does for most of her lectures. She loves to include the class on all topics and will most of the time put anything permanent up for a vote. Will warn we used tophat a lot and readings could get a little off what she was teaching.

She great at her job, lets just start there. Lectures are super interesting, a lot of discussion, really makes you think your morals. Assignments and homework are super easy. She's so accessible and a fair grader. Only thing that I have to complain about is that she does make it fairly obvious about her views on things and can be disrespectful.

Overall, she does a very good job teaching. I would definitely take her again. She posts all the lecture slides online, and she gives 4 free unexcused. Make sure you read the textbook. Only one homework assignment a week, and she gives practice tests that are similar to the real tests. She also allows a 3x5 notecard for each test.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Amazing person and professor! Class is pretty easy going with daily homework assignments are simple if you attended lecture. Also, many papers but are pretty simple.

I was a bit worried about taking this online class but he is such an easy professor. Whenever I was confused I would email him and he would almost immediately get back to me. He provided good feedback aswell and gave good clear instructions in his lecture videos. Overall I would take this class again and him in any other class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: The nicest human ever. He likes to get to know his students and is very lenient with grades if you talk with him. One of my favorite professors ever.

Instructions are too long, lectures are not edited so they were way longer than it should. But Dr. Burns is a really good person. He is one of the best professors I have ever had at UK. I learned a lot from him.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: the nicest man ever. super helpful and very lenient with due dates and will work with you.

Professor Burns was a cool professor. The course was fully online, but the readings came from his own developed website which was cool. Learned a lot of good resources to use for research and the assignments for the class were straightforward. I'd take another one of his classes again.

This is an online class. At first I thought this might be difficult, but it was honestly one of the easiest classes I have ever taken. Don't be intimidated, and Dr. Burns is very thorough and helpful.
Very nice guy. Show up to your classes and participate and you will be in his good graces. Does not require intense HW and has a great pace to his classes. Nothing bad to say at all.

Dr. Burns was amazing. ICT-201 is an easy class and he makes it interesting and yet, somewhat challenging . Do the work to the best of your ability , and you WILL get an A.  He is super helpful to his students. Never met him in person, But he seems very kind.
Easiest accounting professor by far. USE THE PRACTICE EXAMS. They are literally just the test.

I'm not going to lie, I barely studied for this class. He does practices exams with the questions on the exam, however it is randomly generated for 300 questions. You are allowed a cheat sheet, so just put the answers on it. He is super nice and you can tell he cares about his students. I recommend taking him because he is the best ACC 200 teacher.

Absolute best accounting professor you can take. Possibly the best professor at the University of Kentucky. Professor Bugress has a true passion for accounting and it reflects in his teaching. As a finance major he made me want to pursue accounting. Great man, God bless him.

I have recommended Mr. Burgess to everyone for ACC200. He is extremely caring and laidback, but he can be a little hard to understand in lectures because he talks very quiet. I visited him in office hours twice and enjoyed it both times, I am also pretty sure this helped with my grade. ACC is hard but he makes it very approachable. Take him!!

Burgess was awesome, love him and definitely recommend. He is very caring and loves to help .His lectures are a little boring and talks quiet but he is older and cant do much about that I wouldn't put it against him! Does attendance quizzes but at the beginning and lets you leave after if you want I recommend staying they really help understand.

I honestly recommend people to take him for acc. He is understanding and I highly recommend attending his office hours because HE WILL HELP YOU. Exams are based on if you study especially on the practice exams!! exactly like the exam but different wording or things in the practice will be on the exam. You can only fail this class if you don't try!

Great professor who you can tell loves what he's doing and tries his best to get his students as excited as he is, only complaint is that he is a little quiet and can be hard to understand in a large lecture hall like Kincaid. Homework can sometimes take quite a long time. Extremely relaxed about attendance but it is worth it to go.

He is a very nice guy and seems to care about your learning. However, if you can I would just take this class online as he expects you to watch his lectures before class and then basically repeats everything from them when you go to class. He takes attendance by quizzes or team exercises everyday so you have to show up.
TAKE HIM. Nicest guy I have been taught by he gives extra credit that does so much for your grade and with a lot of work getting an A in this class is very doable. I would only take his hybrid class.

Professor Burgess is a nice guy and knows that accounting can be hard. He gives out 3 assignments a week but is nice when it's time for exams. Exams are online. He gives you a practice exam that has the questions for the actual exam. He also lets you have a sheet of paper with notes while you take your exam. If you watch the videos you'll be fine.

Mr. Burgess is a really sweet guy who try's to get the class excited and participating which is hard for accounting. You will have to watch the lectures and study the assignments and practice exams to get an A. He doesn't do review or practice problems in class but the TA does them outside of class and is willing to help you succeed

I've taken Professor Burgess for two courses now and have loved him for both. There is ample material provided for you to understand the material. There is a quiz every class, but he offers extra chances for points on every single one. The class has been enjoyable and not incredibly stressful. He's an excellent professor and I highly recommend him.

I actually enjoyed taking professor Burgess's class, however, his unfortunate issue is that by all means, he is quite old, while I personally loved him and found the class to be very interesting, he talks very slowly and most of the time very hard to hear unless sitting close by to him.

Literally the sweetest professor I have ever had. He is one of a kind. He truly loves and cares about his students. LOTS of homework but that is how you learn this material by practicing it. Take him if you have the opportunity.

Professor Burgess is seriously one of the nicest professors at UK. His lectures can be very boring, but the class itself is boring. Theres quiz at the beginning of every class but as long as you show up, you'll get full points. Homework are long, but not hard. He wants to get to know every student and see every student succeed. Definitely recommend

Note: ACC202 = ACC200, it was renamed. Professor Burgess is super nice and caring, he has decades of experience. The class is pretty hard and lectures are completely online, there is one class meeting day where he goes over homework, the format is new and wasnt his choice, it kind of sucks. But his online lectures are really good, but long.
super easy and nice professor.

Burgess is awesome. Extremely nice and very passionate about cost accounting. Lectures aren't the most engaging but it's a boring subject so there's only so much you can do. Exams are as easy as you can hope for. Do the practice exams and you'll be fine. Only knock is the homework; it is LONG. Some assignments took me 5+ hours.

I can't say enough good things about Professor Burgess. He is so nice and really wants his students to succeed. Gives plenty of opportunities for you to get work done and is just overall a really great guy. I wish more professors were like him and I hope I get to take more classes with him in the future. You definitely wont regret taking his class.
Cares very much about his students and makes that evident through his teaching. He is a fantastic teacher!

such an understanding teacher. I knew on the first day that he clearly just wants his students to pass.He allowed retakes. very easy to work with if you missed an exam and needed to make it up. f you're going to take Acc 202 take him. Online HW and quizzes, but allows multiple submissions. allowed exam cheat sheets. not my fav lecture at all though
He is so patient and understanding.

One of the sweetest and most caring professors I ever had. I didn't necessarily like the hybrid structure, but I never watched the lecture videos and still did well. He provided great examples worked out. The homework was difficult, but really helped me understand the content well. He allowed a cheat sheet on exams which was an amazing help.

Professor Burgess is very kind and helpful! The homework is time consuming, but isn't too difficult. The only thing I found hard was how the exams were set up. The questions are chosen from a database, so there may be questions that you haven't seen before. Just make sure you study the quizzes (plus he gives you a cheat sheet on exams).
The nicest professor ever. Loved having him for class. Open to students' concerns and is willing to help you. Would 100% take again.

I would never take ACC 202 with another professor (under any circumstance). Lecturer Burgess was absolutely fantastic. He is one of the nicest teachers that I have ever met. I had friends in other accounting sections that absolutely hated theirs, while Burgess made the class bearable for all of us. Take him if you have the chance.

He is seriously the most understanding, helpful professor here. If you just talk to him, he will let you retake a test. Go to his office hours. Yes, the lectures are videos, but if you watch them they aren't difficult to understand. He curved the entire course as whole, and offered extra credit. Don't listen to those that very obviously didn't try.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He doesn't teach! He just posts lecture videos and hopes his students understand it. Practice problems for exams are nothing like what is actually on the exam. Total joke of a professor.

Professor Burgess is a swell guy, but I didn't care much for his teaching. His lectures consist of him explaining his chicken scratch work for each problem. For those who are not ACC majors like me, as long as you get nearly 100% on all the assignments and at least a 75% on the exams, you'll pass with a B. Be prepared to work for it!

Professor Burgess is a very caring man and one of my favorite teachers Ive had at UK. He understands students have other work to do, and let me retake 2 of my 3 exams. Very funny and such a sweet man, you can tell he cares so much about his students. I wish i could have him as a professor again. If you're taking ACC 202, TAKE HIM!!!! love that man.

Professor Ray was extremely kind and always willing to help and talk with you. Homework on Connect was where you learned the majority of the content and exams were always similar to problems from homework and chapter quizzes. Lectures get a little bit boring but you learn what you need to know. Professor Ray genuinely cares about you.

Definitely choose him, he's caring and kind. the lecture videos can sometimes be boring. He speaks at a slower pace so I speed up the video. Homework is long but helps you understand the topic. He lets you study practice exams that are very close to the actual exam. Did not give extra credit this semester.

Homework is your main opportunity to learn and there is enough of it to cushion your grade should you score poorly on exams. Burgess is a sweet and understanding professor who is willing to work with you should you need extra time to complete assignments. He really cares about his students and genuinely wants them to succeed in his class.

Ray was the sweetest professor I have ever had. He was always reachable and grades very fairly. You can tell he cares about the well being of all his students. The only bad thing I can say is you have name tags and he calls on you randomly which isn't ideal when you don't know the answer and you have to say that in front of 60 students.
Super nice guy, terrible teacher. gets off topic and doesn't answer questions in a helpful way. only take if you are ready to teach yourself accounting.
Great guy

Professor Burgess is an amazing guy. Imagine a nice grandpa teaching you accounting, that's this class. His class wasn't particularly difficult, but you definitely know the material by the end of it. If you're lucky he'll fake having a heart attack when no one can answer the question hahahah.

Burgess is one of my favorite professors I've had at UK. His class is hard, but fair. If you study you will do just fine on the tests. He gives a quiz at the end of each chapter, so go to class. He cares about his students and he wants everyone to succeed in whatever field they go into. TAKE HIM FOR ACC202!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Ray is one of my favorite professors. He will do anything and everything he can to help you succeed in the class. he doesn't take attendance but if he learns your name he'll take time to make sure you understand for in class work. He really values student's opinions.

Offers a lot of extra credit! Pretty clear in what he expects from students. Quizzes at the end of every chapter, but you can work with friends. Willing to answer all your questions and wants to make sure that students understand the concepts. Only bad thing is he doesn't put grades into Canvas, so it is hard to tell where you stand in the class.

He's actually pretty hard. The averages of the exams were in the low 60s for nearly every one. Our final grade class average was a C. The HW is unlimited attempted, the quizzes are group quizzes and those help your grade. The exams are difficult though, need to study. His lectures can get pretty boring too. Also, he doesn't take attendance.

GREAT professor. You do have to pay attention and learn, but he will give you every chance to get a good grade. Really cares about how you do and will always answer questions and clarify if you need it. Tests and quizzes are super fair, he prepares you for them. Unlimited attempts on HW, quizzes are group a lot of the time. Would 1000% take again.

If you get the chance, CHOOSE HIM!!! He was so great at explaining accounting concepts/presentation slides,  and makes sure everyone understands by working accounting problems out thoroughly. Go to class and you'll pass and understand it. He cares about each student and  also leads Accounting Club.

Burgess is an amazing professor. He explains things well in class and actually makes accounting fun (for a non accounting major). He offers so much extra credit, you just have to actually do it. Also, unlimited attempts on homework so thats 100% right there. He's the nicest professor I've had and actually cares about you. Take Burgess if you can!!

Hands down the best teacher I've ever had at UK. Genuinely cares about you as a student, gives a ton of extra credit and tells some funny stories! If you take him as your teacher you will have a great semester, both in class and in the grades. A++

Really nice guy! Gives a lot of extra credit. No attendance, but you have to be there for the pop quizzes. The quizzes are done with groups and sometimes he lets you use notes or he goes over the answers. The exams can be kinda hard

Great professor! Very helpful!! Going to class is important though because there is a quiz almost every week. Missing a few if okay because he gives opportunities to make up lost points. Tests are straightforward but still a bit difficult. Lectures can be boring because he reads from slides, but he calls on students in class, so pay attention!

Professor Burgess is seriously the best. He helps you understand the topic better by giving you real life examples. You will hear about his whole life story, but it's a very interesting one. I go to class even though he doesn't take attendance. He gives you an exam overview that helps a lot and the exams are MULTIPLE CHOICE! :)

Made me love accounting. Solid professor who really cares about students learning the content. His exams are a privilege to  take. VERY STRAIGHT FORWARD with NO TRICKS/CURVE BALLS.  As expected with any ACC class, a good work ethic is required. He gives an absurd amount of extra credit. I only had to get a 49 on the final.

If you're taking cost take Burgess before Peffer at all costs (pun haha). But seriously, Burgesss' class is much easier. Peffer teaches material that is not included in GAAP, and I have no idea why that makes sense. I believe Burgess only teaches it in the fall, but I'd organize my schedule to get into this class. Trust me it's worth it.

Professor Burgess is the man. Class was fairly straight forward, he lets you know exactly what's going to be on the exams, which are pretty easy if you're willing to put in a little work. But really he's an all-around great guy and knows what he's talking about.  Also, offers a decent amount of extra credit, especially for those interested in ACC.

Totally unfair.  Only offers extra credit to accounting majors, which I'm pretty sure is against university policy.  All of his tests are 10% pop trivia and only 90% course content.  So unless you know everything about every US company's accounting methods, you get 10% off of every exam.  But he teaches the concept stuff well.  Not so good at math.

Treats you like his own kid.. so helpful and kind I would definitely recommend him as a teacher. His class was okay. Definitely need the book, the old version is fine to get. 12 homeworks in all and some quizzes in class assignments. You need to go to class. My only complaint is that he DOES NOT email people back.

Ray really wants you to do well. He has great knowledge and tries to make sure everyone understands. He really wants to know his students on a personal level, instead of just knowing a random face in the crowd. Exams can be kinda tough (expected in accounting), but he genuinely tries to make sure nobody gets lost

Seriously, try your very best to have Ray as a professor. He really cares about his students and does whatever he can to enhance their learning. He also has a really good insight on the subject after having worked in the field. HIGHLY recommend.
Ray uses slides provided by the book and reads straight from the slides. Really boring and not very helpful at all. Doesn't use blackboard either.

Professor Burgess was one of the best professors I've had since I've been at UK. He tries to explain the material as clearly as he can, and is always so happy. His exams aren't too bad if you just go to class and look over the book. Highly recommend him.
Great guy; really wants students to succeed. Very fair teacher who uses real world examples to supplement his lectures.

has a easy quiz on every chapter. make sure you do all the homework because that can raise your overall score. I barely studied and i did all the HW and quizzes and got a B. if you try it would be really easy to get an A. i would recommend him, he makes sure his students are doing well by offering extra credit

Good at engaging class and explaining things. Experienced and gives real-world examples. Easy if you pay attention and/or read the textbook(which you don't have to buy bc it comes with the access code)

Took the time to learn everybody's name, was able to effectively get the class participating.  Great teacher, easy class (for accounting), A if you do your work.  He enjoys clowning on his students and making jokes, keeping us alert.

I had Burgess for both 201 and 202 and absolutely loved him! Sweetest teacher ever and soo helpful. I hardly ever went to class and got As in both. T/F are tricky on some tests though. He's the best accounting teacher I ever had and wish I had him for every single ACC class! LOVE HIM!!!

Burgess is nice but isn't too clear when he lectures.  It's easier just to teach yourself through powerpoints.  You get unlimited tries on the homework, so getting 100 on them is inevitable.  His tests are the worst part! They are confusing and HARD! He seems like the best in comparison to the other teachers though.
Awesome teacher. Very helpful. and very experienced.Take him!!

Burgess is a great teacher although the way he teaches you are able to teach yourself just as easily with his powerpoints and textbook. So you don't have to go to class but he gives extra credit for going. He is super sweet though!
Lectures were draining and long, but class mostly depended on your TA. Burch didn't show up very often. Not difficult, just an annoying and demanding class.

AWESOME human being in general. Very understandable and responsive. Tends to lean toward her own views and talk about her experiences, and ignores other views. Honestly, the best HHS professor I've had. VERY lenient.

Dr Burch is a really kind professor. I wasn't majorly engaged in her lectures mainly because it was an early class but she was always super bubbly and informative with what she was teaching. The textbook isnt totally necessary but i suggest buying the online version. There are reading quizzes but you do them on your own time so its cake.

She's nice and you can tell that she cares about students but the lectures were so boring. Tuesdays were a waste of time as she reads off of slides and talks to the class like they are children. Thursdays were when you went to class with a TA and was genuinely useless.

Dr Burch is a very kind teacher. You are assigned a few assignments a week and there are very small penalties for it being turned in late. She can be a tough grader depending on the assignment. She remembers each individual student and their circumstances, which she is also very understanding about.I would highly recommend having her as a teacher.
The class is easy and she's a good lecturer, but she treats her students like kindergarteners. You won't have any problems with her or the class but it can just be annoying.
Took forever to respond to emails
If you want to be treated like you are in kindergarten by her and her teaching assistants take this class its a blast.

Dr. Burch is very caring about her students, and makes sure everyone feels welcome. She's always sure to greet you and make sure you are doing well. Assignments consist of weekly discussion boards and some small papers. There are no lengthy exams, but there are small quizzes. Overall, I found the class interesting and would recommend her to anyone.

Very poor. Expectations for projects were jack-knifed at the last minute, with feedback from drafts and final papers being radically different despite being relatively unchanged. Pacing was breakneck. Lots of emphasis placed on auxiliary materials, but barely any materials available for actual coursework. Specific due dates announced last minute.

I love Dr. Burch's teaching style as she is always prepared for class and had great lectures. Some of the material is boring, but she tries to find ways to make it fun and interesting. She is great at responding to emails and is always willing to lend a helping hand if needed. I highly recommend her!
Awesome class and professor. She really cares about her students and doesn't make the class overwhelming.

He wasn't "bad" at lecturing, just spoke very intelligently during class which was confusing at times. His handwriting was also hard to read. However, his grading was very lenient, i.e. your lowest exam score can be replaced by your final exam, and you get a 5 percent grade boost if you have over 90% attendance. I would take him again if I had to.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: There are quizzes every week, and he allows you to leave class early, but he will complain about it the next day. Talked EXTREMELY slow.

Professor Burdick ends class early everyday to give his students the opportunity to leave or stay back and ask for help. He posts well organized notes (unfilled and filled) and gives quizzes every Wednesday + returns them back by the following Monday with feedback. However, attendance is mandatory and heavily affects your grade if you miss class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: MA 109 itself is really easy, but he had all of his lectures as videos and did not teach in class which made it so hard to learn. In those videos he would do the EASIEST examples and then the HW and quizzes would look nothing like the lecture and he wouldn't really teach further than that. Basically had to teach myself everything.

Overall the course work is not diffiult nor are the quizzes, but Dr Burdick is super hard to engage with his hand writting is sloppy and he moves too slow very easy to zone out while listening to his monotoned lectures. If you can take this course with anyone else I reccomend doing so not a bad course just not a good proffessor.

honestly if you have the option don't take him. i've had the unfortunate opportunity of having to take his class twice and although he's very knowledgeable, he is all around not a good professor. he's very monotone and his notes are very sloppy. He also doesn't take initiative to review previous work and doesn't answer questions well.

I love having Dr. Burdick! He cares about the content and is incredibly knowledgeable. He always encourages discussion which can be hard to find w/ math profs. It's evident he cares more about us learning than grades/busy work/exams. He's clear with his course expectations, and all readings are provided for free. Would 100% take again
Just awful, don't take a class with him.
Very monotone guy which made it hard to stay focused in his class, I had him for MA111.

I would highly discourage anyone from taking his class, he is extremely dry and his notes are horribly scribbled and extremely confusing if you are not present. He hardly cancels classes even for horrible weather and is overall an unenthusiastic and boring professor. He answered questions poorly and more often than not made the work more confusing.

He explains things pretty clearly but can get boring if you know the material already. Class participation is crucial for part of your grade. The other part of your grade is entirely quiz based (easy if you review.) There is no midterm or final exam. The textbook is online and free. Super easy credit if you've already taken it in high school.

Korie is amazing!! AFE isn't the most entertaining class in terms of content but Korie makes it fun, and makes sure she tweaks the lectures to make them more engaging. She truly cares about her students and wants to see all of them succeed.
Korie Burgess is so nice and caring! I loved taking her AFE 100 class. She makes the material relatable and easy to understand!

Korie is an amazing teacher! She cares about her students in and outside of the class. She is always a friendly face to see around campus. She was my advisor and was so caring and awesome. I have no words to describe her
Great presenter who cares about her students. Gave good resume and interview advice that helped me get my first internship. Group project is a bit annoying but can't blame her that much.

Great professor who actually cares about her students and wants to get to know them individually. The class is super easy and she only gives about 1 assignment per week. Attendance is not mandatory but she sometimes does in-class assignments and if you miss class then you'll get a 0 for the assignment. Group project at the end that is fun and easy.

Dr. Buckley is great. She connected our speaking projects to how we might use the skills in our every day lives. Her class was more project based, but she broke them down into pieces and regularly reminded the students of due dates. She was always available for questions and seemed to really care about her students.
Lots of busy work, pretty easy grader as long as you put in effort. Take another professor or the online version of this class, it will be much easier.

Honestly one of my favorite classes. The class can be a lot, but Dr. Buckley does a great job with pacing the class and helping you through it. She was always super accessible in and out of the class, and I would recommend her to anyone.

Dr. Buckley is a tough grader, but she genuinely cares for her students and wants to see them succeed. It's easy to get overwhelmed with all of the speeches, papers, and projects, but you will be fine if you keep up with due dates. I recommend her for IHRC students as she ties in a lot of healthcare-oriented service opportunities and topics.

She is a caring person, really genuine. She DOES NOT accept any late work no matter what. Get ready for a bunch of baby assignments that creep up on you. Don't hesitate to ask questions---she is very good at emailing back. She grades kind of tough so just be prepared but as long as you stay on top of your stuff you will be just fine.

Extremely nice, but ridiculously tough on grading, and unnecessarily specific on the finest of details. Always been a strong writer, but he grading makes me feel otherwise. I feel like she looks for anything to be able to dock you points on. Do not like
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Alison Buckely is such a good professor. She really cares about her students. She does not grade terrible, but you won't usually get 100% on anything. Love her though!! Definitely recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Absolutely incredible professor, honestly one of the best I've ever had, he really has a passion for the topic. Highly recommend going to the lectures they are super informative and he tells you exactly what will be on the exams. Your grade is only determined by a few things but nothing is really hard if you just pay attention in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is an older professor that can get political at times. Overall a good professor and really cares about his students. He wants us to succeed. Lectures are good, can be confusing and boring. Tells you concepts that will be on exam(s), so pay attention! "Master the slides." If you know and understand the concepts from the slides, you'll be fine.
Good at keeping you engaged with the lecture and keeps it entertaining.

Hes a pastor at his church, super funny even if you are not religious. Not the nicest guy sometimes, he doesnt like when people come late or leave early, he told someone to not come back multiple times. super good lecturing, and the exams are really straight forward and easy. highly recommend.

This class was overall just not a great experience. It is very confusing to understand what you do and don't need to know. He rambles on about the most random things all through out his lectures. Also says some weird things like that he likes to look at women's feet and certain things that turn him on (I have the evidence.) Doesn't answer emails.
Bob is so personable, he definitely is attentive. Go to lecture I cannot stress it enough. AND HE TELLS YOU WHAT IS ON EXAMS!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a good professor but gets easily distracted and makes the lectures confusing. He doesn't put the assignments in so you can't calculate your grade. If you can deal with a lecture of constantly getting sidetracked and being confused then this class is for you

Bob is quite the character. He can get pretty sidetracked, and makes some comments that suggest he is slightly out of touch with reality. If you do the practice exams and listen during the lecture, you'll do fine on the exams. He can just be hard to follow.

Professor Gillette's ECO202 class can be a mixed bag. While his lectures can be entertaining, they can also be disorganized at times. Exams are tough, but the guided notes and past exams are super helpful. Definitely use Unstuck ai for extra test prep.
I loved bob

Very straightforward exams and homework. Homework is word for word in the packets you fill out. The exams are word for word in the packets. HE LITERALLY TELLS YOU WHAT QUESTIONS WILL BE ON THE EXAMS DURING LECTURES. Very similar to past exams as well. Lectures are also entertaining. Does not get much easier.

Gillette constantly gets side tracked during lectures. He is unorganized and messy. Offers no extra credit. Not very accessible outside of class. Tough exams. Your grade is only test and homework. Homework is easy though. Makes some interesting / offensive comments during lectures. Attendance is not mandatory, and he records his lectures online.

A nice man I'm sure, but often goes on tangents about things that are not quite relevant to the coursework. Often has to being his statements with "I don't mean this is a bad/offensive way". Attendance required to get credit for homework assignments. Doesn't do much if any in class review before exams so you're on your own for that.

His lectures are mostly confusing as he is hard to understand and his notes are messy. He also will get sidetracked a lot during lectures which doesn't help, but the lectures are recorded to watch later. The course is mainly graded on exams as the only other grades are from a total of 11 homework assignments, 8 points each.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I liked Bob, but thought the material was super boring. He trys to make lectures entertaining but it can be hard with this material. His notes are sometimes messy. He wants you to succeed and is willing to help outside of class.

I would not recommend taking Bob for ECO
202. His grading is the most absurd thing, the points that will count for your grade are only the exams. He's very difficult to understand and not funny. What he teaches in lecture does not help you on the exams, so I would suggest studying the homework and reading the textbook. He's also discriminatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment:
I would not recommend taking Bob for ECO
202. His grading is the most absurd thing, the points that will count for your grade are only the exams. He's very difficult to understand and not funny. What he teaches in lecture does not help you on the exams, so I would suggest studying the homework and reading the textbook. He's also discriminatory!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He is a character for sure. Attendance not required & lectures are recorded. I didn't read the book & did fine. He prints guided notes for the class, which is helpful. Exams would have been hard if I had skipped/not had the notes. So go to class, write down what's on the board, try to listen & you'll be fine. For exams, study notes and past exams.
He was a great professor. Gives practice exams for you to study. Give some effort and you can easy get a High B or evan a A if you read the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dont be afraid to go to him after class he is more than willing to help you if you did bad on an exam. It is super important to pay attention in class.

Bob is one of my favorite teachers/professors I've ever had. He truly cares about your success and pushes you to work hard. I really enjoyed his lectures and the way he presented the class material. If you have the opportunity to take him I highly recommend.

I absolutely loved Gillette. One of my favorite classes and professors yet. His energy gets me excited about learning and I added Econ as a major because of him. He prepares you to do well on tests with his notes and homework. He really wants his students to do well in the class. He is also hilarious
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Listen, I really wanted to love Bob, but I can't sit through another one of his classes. Hes a pretty good teacher, but the random political jokes are completely out of pocket. He really gives "Im a pastor" energy. Sorry bro

The class honestly isn't really that hard, but the true agony of having to hear Bob's pastor ramblings will make it almost unbearable. He seems like a nice guy, but he will say inappropriate things in class, and they will be uncalled for and everybody will awkwardly chuckle. Overall, this class feels more like a sermon sometimes than a class.
