He is ok. You basically need to teach yourself but he's fine for asking questions. He is really loud and likes to say some out of pocket things but mostly he's fine. You can't stay under the radar though.
Best professor for ECO 202. Go to his office hours for help and guidance in the class. Exam heavy but if you pay attention and take notes in class, you will succeed.

He is the most funniest guy you will ever meet! He is so nice and caring and you can tell he truly cares for his students. I will say (at least for me) macroeconomics are a lot harder for me so this class was tough. If you pay attention and put the time and effort into studying you will do fine!

Bob is a great professor, and always brings energy and humor to lectures, even when content can be complex and boring. He makes the homework and exams pretty easy. Doesnt require attendance, but I always went to class because I liked his lecture.

Professor Gillette has been my favorite professor yet. His class isn't the easiest, but he brings so much energy to his lectures. To get a B or even an A, you really have to work for it. He prides himself in making sure students have a solid foundation in economics, so they can have educated conversations.

Dr. Gillete is a professor that makes you want to learn. The energy that he brings to every class makes it clear that he truly loves educating. The class wasn't very hard as long as you showed up, participated, and studied his exam review.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: The lectures were quite long and could be dry at times, but I loved Dr. Gillette's personality. He's a funny guy who is passionate about education. His class can be repetitive though. PowerPoint-notes- homework ad nauseam until the test. Don't be shy to take his classes and participate.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Note- I was the only one I knew in his class for ECO202 that got an A, in fact some of my friends failed the class with him. Yet, I absolutely LOVE this man. He is SO funny and wants to help his students. He goes off topic in lectures like all the time and made me want to go to class just to listen to him go on about whatever he did. I love him sm

Bob was a good economics professor. His lectures were always interesting and he was passionate and knowledgeable about what he was teaching. Class is very test heavy so it's important to really study for all of them.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Now, I normally don't write reviews for this kind of stuff but I need to warn that this class is the hardest I've taken during my time at UK. The grading is wack, since 70 points was counted as homework and 300 was tests. Dr. Gillette himself is a nice guy, but the class was ridiculously hard for no reason.

Bob is very passionate and knowledgeable about macroeconomics. It could be tough to understand him at times. He prints out packets of notes for you to fill in. This makes studying for tests much easier. Very little homework, but tests are in-depth.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Changed the course of my life with guidance and inspiration. He is the reason I ended up working in financial markets for over 20 years. Great communicator. Brilliant instructor.

Bob is one of my favorite professors at UK. He is so caring and wants you to do well in his course as long as you're willing to put in the effort. He makes it known that economics is not for everyone, and he realizes this, so his tests are not super specific or detailed. if you study the power points you will be fine if you're not an econ major.

This class is HARD. If you are not good at economics then I don't recommend taking him. Every class he gives powerpoint note packets and is not very good at teaching the material. Be prepared to learn it on your own. He's a good guy but his tests are very difficult and basically account for your entire grade.

Bob has by far been my favorite professor at UK! He tells hilarious personal stories and cracks jokes to make difficult economics concepts relatively easy. Only 8ish HWs the entire semester. Definitely take Gillette if you can!!

Bob is one of my favorite professors that ive had at UK! Most lectures are boring but he always makes it interesting and uses real and current data that helps you learn the concept while also giving you what is going on in our economy. Definitely take him if you can!

Bob is by far my favorite professor, it is refreshing to have an instructor who isnt a liberal lunatic (which is hard to come by at UK).His lectures are based in real time data which is much more appealing to me as a student. Be warned if you arent from the south you will struggle with his accent, he has a very strong drawl! Take his class!

Love bobby great guy, material is easy to grasp if you go to class and take the notes. No attendance ,but it's in your best interest to go to class, I think he's pretty funny. He's from the south, but if you are too you'll understand him.

ECO 202 is much harder than 201. Bob's accent was hard for me to understand and took some getting used to. There are very few grades in the class so if you don't do well on the exams, you wont get a good grade. He picks on people and makes fun of them as examples
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Gillette is very nice and his class is very easy but his accent makes him impossible to understand. I stopped going to class because I couldn't understand a single word. His exams are also very difficult and there's only like 6 grades for the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: This class has just 7 homework assignments and 3 exams and is hard to get an A in if you don't ace the first two exams. Bob is incredibly funny and makes you want to come to class to get his notes and hear his stories. His lectures include only the information that will be on the exam so you're much better off studying the notes than the book.
Amazing, funny teacher. Only thing is, he makes concepts super easy in class, but the exams are terribly worded and don't reflect the level of difficulty of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Would take again

reviews.comment: Bob is hilarious, he loves talking about explosive diarrhea in class. Extremely passionate and knowledgeable. Like the super smart hilarious great uncle who flys in for the hollidays. Go to class for two reasons.. 1. You will love listening to his high jokes and learn much more. 2. He gives out step by step note packets that make tests cake.

He has an accent, so listen closely until you get used to it. He's funny. Packet every class to work on. attendance isn't mandatory. tells you what material will and will not be on the test in class as he lectures.

Gillette is my favorite professor at UK by far! He is so so knowledgeable on the stuff that he teaches, and he genuinely wants you to succeed. He is a fantastic lecturer, and he gives you print outs to follow along. His classes are fun but also extremely well taught. Even if you aren't an Econ major, take this man's class. You will love it!
lectures are far beyond entertaining

He's a really nice guy but I'd be lying if I said his class wasn't more difficult than the other eco391 classes. His test are all essay style and no multiple choice. There are very few points in this class so one bad exam can screw you. Also be ready to get roasted, he has a hilarious sense of humor and loves to joke on people.

If you are an Econ or Math Econ major like myself, this man is a must. As far as learning Econ goes. He gives you handout of the slides every day. Provides the slides online. He even gives you practice exams that have questions that will be exactly on the real exam. However, if you struggle in math & using graphs, this class will be challenging.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is a great professor , Lectures are fun and his slides summarize most of what you need to know.

Even if you are not an economics major he finds a way to make the class fun! He has a great personality and you can tell he truly cares if you do learn something from his class. Wonderful person, homework occasionally. He doesn't post full powerpoints online so it is recommended to go to class so you can have the blanks on the powerpoints filled in

Gillette is honestly amazing. I hate econ and he finds a way to make it interesting. If you read over his notes he gives you & do the homework, you'll get an A. He is a preacher so you can tell when he lectures but he makes class interesting & actually cares about you outside of class. Would take him again for sure.

Hands down the best professor I've had at UK so far. Do not take his class if you are offended easily because you will hate him. Very interactive in and outside of class. Absolutely hilarious. Would highly recommend 10/10

He's so annoying and rude in lecture. He is hard to understand because he talks way too fast and also has a weird accent. In lecture, it's very hard to follow along. I do not recommend taking him as a professor if you get annoyed easily. Hw is easy and exams are not too tough since he gives you practice exams before. He is just rude and annoying.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Bob G is the man. Hands down my favorite teacher so far. He's smart and a fantastic teacher- he can make a 400+ person lecture hall feel like a small classroom.

If you are willing to complete the homework and go to class, then you will get at least a B. If you study for the tests, you should get an A. He was the best economics professor I have had, and I will always try to take his classes.

The first few days of Bob's classes are fun because he's a very bright personality, but that doesn't take away from the fact that his classes are pointless. All he does is ramble about pointless things then blows through slides and valuable info to make up for time lost. He also tries to trick you as to what is on the final, so beware of that.

BOB G is amazing! Hes funny and tries to make class as fun as he can. He really loves econ and it shows! His tests are tough and you have to study quite a bit but it's doable and he is helpful if you seek the help. Attendance isn't mandatory, but definitely recommended. Never heard of anyone not loving this man and his class! Bob is a must take!
He's cool. Can be very rude. Exams were fair

Great lecturer. Entertaining and funny. 356 total in the class and 56 is homework, 300 are exams so you have to do well on exams to get a good grade. Exams are very similar to old exams but still are fairly tough, especially the final. First exam is cake. I didn't open the textbook and got an A. Just studied old exams.

Bob G. is the man! I absolutely loved his class and the group project.  He's so funny and a breath of fresh air.  Not for anyone liberal or thin-skinned. Pretty easy grader and straight-forward on exams.  Gives reviews.

Bob Gillette is a funny guy. Knows what he's teaching very well. Explains the material alright. Only negative really is that he will go off on tangents about random things, which only distracts from the material in lecture. You don't need to go to class. Homework sent out in groupme. Old exams are VERY similar to the exams you will see.
Favorite teacher I have ever had. Taught me so much about Econ and life in general. Always had the whole class laughing while still learning.
He  is an awesome teacher. Very fair. You can get an A in his class but you have to do a little work for it. I averaged a 97 on his exams
Gillette is easily one of the best professors at UK. I would recommend forming your schedule around his class because he is so good.

Probably the most I've gained from a class in college. Macro is just a life-changing course and Gillette just makes it great.  Honestly, consistently preparing before class and actively listening to him during may be all you need to get an A in the course. He is very engaging and that good.  His exams are difficult but he prepares you.

If you take ECO 202 definitely take Bob G. The class is demanding and requires you to go to class and pay attention, however, Bob makes it very interesting and engages the entire lecture class. He is a genuine guy and cares about his students. He is the absolute man.

Bobby G is a MUST take. Lectures are long but if you pay attention he will really help you UNDERSTAND the information and teach you a few life lessons as well. Study the notes and the tests will be fine. He is an awesome teacher, praying I get to take him again for another class.
Bob's the man, no doubt.
Fun, great older teacher. Cares about students, easy.

Bob is very animated and definetely not afraid to speak his mind. This being said, I enjoyed every single one of his lectures and actually feel as though I learned a great deal from his class. You'll have homework every night that must be turned in, meaning if you miss, you won't get credit. Exams come straight from lecture, but must go to class!!

I really enjoyed this class and I think taking it with any other professor would have been a mistake. He made everything extremely clear and used funny stories to help explain economics. I was never bored during lecture, which in my opinion is necessary for passing.

This class can really be confusing if you don't keep up. He provides you with fill in the blank print outs of the power points but he takes a while to get through them because he just loves to talk. His exams are fair and he tries to really help.

If Bob can't get you interested in Economics, no one can. He gets off on his tangents, of course, and he may occasionally tick you off if you have thin skin or you're not a conservative, but he really is worth having as a teacher. Learned a lot, highly recommend.

One of my favorite Classes I've taken!  he is passionate and loves to teach, and it comes through. Pay attention, you will need to work a little for an A, but if you pay attention in class, you'll be fine.
Great guy and willing to help you out. Tests are pretty difficult, a lot of the questions come from examples he gives in class. Reading the book will only give you background knowledge for his exams.

Gillette is the best professor I've had and it's not close. He knows the material well and is great at explaining it. He is also great at applying economics to teach students about real world issues while not going off topic. Also is a great guy and is very helpful if you talk to him.
Really, genuinely passionate about the class and his students. Sneaks in life lessons, but not in a "preachy" way. All around good professor and you'll really learn a lot

Bob is a fantastic professor and his 202 class is the reason I decided to major in Econ. He catches flak for expressing his viewpoint occasionally, but he always does so respectfully and in context. If you do the homework and go to class you'll know the exam. He makes material very relevant. He also gives great advice, an all around stand up guy.

Hardest class I've taken. It's hard to follow him in class because he goes off on a political/religious tangent every 15 mins. Any real learning is done outside of class from the homework he gives out daily. Exams are incredibly tough but fair. Would make fun of the Asian students in class but acted like he was joking, except he did it everyday...
He is really not that great. Funny at first but it got old. He doesn't make much sense at times and hard test. Take someone else

HIs grading policy is whichever is lower: average of exam grades or average of homework...that is your final grade. They don't average each other. His tests are insanely difficult but his homework forces you to read the text and he gives helpful examples in class. He forces class discussion which I personally hated

Please avoid!!  I agree with most of his views etc, but he is a complete jerk and he really thinks he isn't.  He can be funny, but very demanding and overbearing. Thinks we owe the university to speak up and voice our views, but if he disagrees, he will let you everyone know!!  If people don't want to talk, then he gets mad and freaks out.  WOW!

I really like Gillette. It's advised that you attend class, but not mandatory. I went to about 20% of the lectures, did all my homework, read the book and took notes and I got a B. Some topics are confusing, but Bob is good at clearing things up in class. He really wants to help you do well, but you have to help yourself first. Be sure to study.

Bob can be really intimidating. Some say the southern accent is hard to understand but I don't think so. We are going into the final and I still haven't figured out how to successfully study for his exams. He's a nice guy and is entertaining, he just doesn't explain himself very well in my opinion.

LOVE Bob! He's hilarious.. and I'm not one to usually laugh at teacher's jokes. He subtly sneaks life lessons into his lectures but isn't obnoxious about it. Relates the boring subject to real life events like sports and marriage. TAKE BOB! He's the bomb
Best real world event teacher at UK

In his upper-level classes, Bob can be a bit of a hard grader. He certainly doesn't cut you any slack on the exams. Be prepared for some of the hardest undergraduate examinations you will ever come across at the University of Kentucky when taking his class. However, as a person, other than his grading approaches, he is a wonderful person.
Hard class, but he lets you know exactly what to expect for the exam.  No exam surprises and grades very fair.  He'll answer any questions you have.
Great teacher.  Really loved attending his class.  Class attendance is important and he gives you everything you need to get an A.
I loved this class through Exam 1, and then it became "Graphs 101" and I lost all interest. Gillette is hilarious and the material isn't too difficult if you keep up. You get used to the accent
Couldn't understand the man over the microphone. Never went to class. His test are very reasonable and not too bad.

Gillette is a crazy man, but very passionate about economics. Examples are relevant and easy to follow. Definitely do the CPAs before class, though, to be able to understand what he is talking about. If you do the CPAs and attend class a decent amount, youll do fine. Pick up old exams if he has them at Johnny Print--super helpful!

GREAT PROFESSOR. He is awesome. I absolutely loved the class. He is fun and so intelligent. I learned so much about the real world that I never thought I would understand.  I recommend that everyone take his class, it's that beneficial, really.  It's a little tough but so worth it. I got an A pretty easily though.

Bob loves his students and will do everything short of interpretive dance to make his points clear. Yes he has a Virginia drawl, but he's perfectly understandable. You will LOL at his examples comparing econ to finding date on a Friday night. It's easy to skip class and get behind (those are the ones complaining about his accent/personality).
Absolutely love him! The class is so entertaining, but you are learning the whole time. A great professor! With class discussions and doing the CPAs studying for the tests isnt bad at all!
Dr. Gillette is so much fun! A very exciting and energetic teacher. He makes sure that everyone understands the material and prepares us well for the exams. I HIGHLY recommend this class!

Great professor, maybe the best I've had at UK, and thats going all the way back to when I was a full-time student. Gets you into the material, CPA's are helpful, online quizzes have built in extra credit and he doesn't test you over something if he hasn't covered it. Come to class, pay attention, do CPAs and you'll pass with an easy A.

The only thing I do not like about this professor is his actual speech. He is really hard to understand. He has a southern type accent and when he gets really excited he studders and yells. It sometimes makes learning what hes saying hard. Other than that, the CPAs and quizzes are not terrible if you work hard. Not a skim by class.

Most entertaining professor i've ever had.  Makes going to class enjoyable.  Best advice for the class: DO THE CPA'S AND GET BONUS POINTS ON THE ONLINE QUIZZES. If you do both of those, you can still get an A in the class with mid B's on the tests.  Favorite class thus far at UK.

Anyway who claims this class is "hard" is an idiot.  I easily got an A.  If you do well on the quizzes it's cake.   More importantly, he is more than likely the best Economics teacher at UK. He's a super nice guy who makes coming to class fun and relates to his students better than almost any teacher.  HIGHLY recommend.

I had him for a small section and I loved him. He is a very good teacher and knows a lot about Econ. He is hard to understand at first, but he is hilarious and you definitely won't be bored in class. He really cares a lot about his students.

multiple choice on his tests are extremely tricky, have to really work hard to even attempt to do well. Very nice and understanding guy if you go to his office hours but really hard to understand in class esp. Memorial Hall section. Great guy but not so great of a teacher in my opinion, a lot of the course is self taught, recommend takinga diff pro

easily the most entertaining professor you will ever have. However this is a hard class i'm an econ major and 4.0 student and i'm ok with my b. make sure you go to class and DO THE CPAS and know them front and back for the tests.

He is the best professor I have ever had! I went into the class having no desire to take an econ class and left his class deciding to add an econ minor. He made me love economics! Hes a bit hard to understand sometimes but extremely intelligent and very funny!

When I began this class, I hated Gillette. He's hard to understand and he acts weird in class (telling stories, etc.)... after a few weeks, I realized that he is one of the best professors on campus. He truly cares about his students and he wants you to do well. Just don't take him in Memorial Hall. It's utterly impossible to understand him there.
Just too hard too understand

great teacher! he knows his stuff and knows how to keep the class interesting. as long as you do the c.p.a.s before class it is easy to keep up with his lectures. classes are not mandatory but he goes over some stuff not in the book that are easy questions on the tests. yes, he has a accent but you get over it after the first week.

Great professor, one of my favorites at UK.  His classes are very interesting and engaging, and he is genuinely concerned about the progress of his students.  He knows the material extremely well and is able to communicate his knowledge to the class in a fun and interactive way.  Take if at all possible!

I didn't think his accent was too terrible, but I was in the smaller section. The CPAs are very beneficial even though they are a complete pain to do for every single class. Focus on the material he goes over in class and what is on the CPAs for tests.

Horrible professor, and I say this with no biases due to a grade, political views (yes, he is very political), etc. Accent is tough to comprehend, especially in memorial hall where you have an echo. Teaching was mostly off-topic. Tended to emphasize the algebra-based things more than concepts. Good guy, bad teacher. Teaching style is big-picture.

great guy. crazy accent. hardest open book labs ever. semi-decent exams. rec you taking a smaller section as opposed to mem.hall sec. more work but he's all over the place. you'll want that one on one.

If you take him, don't take the Memorial hall section, take the smaller class. You'll have more work with his worksheets, but it  will pay off. His southern accent is heavy, but he is energetic and keeps you engaged in class. not boring.

If you don't fall behind in the class and attend lectures it's easy.  If you decide to skip and slack off, it's hard to catch up.  He asks about 4-6 current events questions on each exam, if you're not in class, get the stats from a friend.  I thought the tests were worded tricky.  He's an interesting teacher.

Great teacher, loud and engaging.  His accent is pretty hard to catch on to at first but after a few classes becomes more clear.  Attendance is not mandatory but helps a lot because he gives you the answers to your daily worksheets and quiz/test questions.  Great professor for this class.

The best professor at UK, without a doubt in my mind. I took ECO 202 at Memorial Hall with him and loved it, but taking him in a small environment is even better. Makes everything interesting, and works with you on the projects in 391. This is a great class that I highly recommend.

Plain and simple, Gillette is a fantastic professor.  Im as lazy as they comes, but this guy brings the material to life and I didn't miss a single class all semester.  His class takes work but it is interesting and totally worth it!
YOUVE BEEN WARNED!!!  Horrible teacher, knows his stuff tho.  NO concern for students.  Strong accent hard 2 follow.  DO NOT TAKE!!!

This guy is hilarious and makes this subject shine.  He sometimes makes some controversial statements, but you can tell he has a good heart and means well.  However, he is fair and teaches the subject very well.
Rambled on a lot about nonsense and was very unhelpful, not understanding, and not easy to work with when I had to miss class due to a surgery.
One of the best classes I had at UK. He is difficult to understand at first, but if you go to class you will pick up on it. do the cpas and use the old tests.

He is impossible to understand. His accent is horrible which makes the class even harder. The exams are not easy at all, so you really do have to attend every class.  I debated dropping it because it was so impossible to understand him. He knows how to relate the information to the real world, but you don't know where he's headed half the time.

First of all, whoever said he had partisan political views is wrong- he shares the same views as every economist in the world. Dr. Gillette is a great teacher and a great guy. Attendance is not mandatory, but there are 3 tests and 2 inclass quizzes. You will learn the material if you try, and he is hilarious. I would recommend this class to anyone.

This has been the best class I have ever had because of his teaching. Never has econ been so real and alive to me. He is a spectacular teacher because he knows how to go at things from many different ways. I think most people avoid him because they're lazy and dont want to work.So if you're lazy then yes, avoid him but if not then prepare to learn.

Dr. Gillette is a fantastic professor! He makes the material come to life. Although at first, difficult to understand,and may seems pushy with his political/ spiritual views;he has been my favorite teacher at UK. You have to come to class and you have to study! If you don't do these you will do poorly.
Avoid at all costs. This guy is a jerk to the extreme. Much better professors in the econ dept.

I dropped this class after trying desperately to understand what he was saying, but to no avail. His accent is absolutely horrible, and the echoes in Memorial Hall don't help at all. I wasn't about to get a bad grade because the professor couldn't articulate his words.

Gillette teaches Economics, he likes to force his extremist political views down your throat. He is EXTREMELY narrow minded and prefers preaching/talking about girls over economics. Moreover, he is impossible to understand and uses stupid slang terms. Don't take his class unless you want to be called "gang" and hear "let's rock'n'roll" every day.

Great guy, great class, great material. Very funny prof that likes students that work hard. The material was tough so class is pretty much manditory. Mult choice tests, no need for book, just take tons of notes
very tough class, if you dont work hard and study hard you will do poorly in the class.
Outstanding professor. Probably my favorite thus far. Loved his class!

Dr. Gillete is the most entertaining teacher that I have ever had. It is impossible to get bored in class or not pay attention. His class is somewhat difficult, but if you work a little bit at it it's not so bad and you will learn a lot about economics. The only criticism I have of Dr. Gillete is his views on economics tend to be very partisan.

He's a very good teacher.  If you want a good grade on your in the class do the CPAs, read chapters and study for tests.  If you understand what you are doing his class wont be too bad.  Like I said he's a very good teacher, but he also let you know where he stand in the political world.  So if you're very strong minded about politics his views wil

Not a bad professor, fairly thick southern accent makes him sometimes difficult to understand. Tests are not extremely difficult if you take the time to do the CPA/reading and make sure you understand the concepts. Tests do require you thoroughly know the concepts, relatively complex questions compared to similar econ courses. Overall decent course

Dr. Gillette is amazing!  He is one of the best lecturers I have had.  He makes lectures fun and interesting.  Take his small class.  Don't expect to get an easy ride by just doing the CPAs and not studying.  The first exam is easy.  The second and third exams are impossible.
OMG! This guy is HILARIOUS!!! If you're taking 202, you MUST get him!!!
A good lecturer but test were hard....not a class to breeze through, be prepared to make an effort!!

Gillette is not only very narrow minded when it comes to politics and economics, but very politically incorrect. And he admits his extreme biases in his work. Don't take his section if you want anything except mainstream economic thinking. He raises the roof, too. Not funny.

Dr G is possibly the best lecturer I've had. He makes econ funny & is fair whn it comes to work. The ppl on here giving grief r ppl who probably don't do the CPA's & are just wanting an easy ride.If you know and learn the material you will do well. If u hav a work hard play hard attitude u wil love this class! Dr G rocks - Top bloke
Class was boring. It was hard to pay attention at times. Hard to understand him at times, but he still knew what he was teaching about.

I loved ECO 201, and really enjoy Economics but Gillette is annoying. His quizzes and tests don't match well (people usually do well on one or the other), he's a jerk, and a pompus ass. The only people I know who enjoy him were the teacher's pets-you'll understand once you're in the class.
Not clear at all, had no clue what he was saying half the time because of the way speaks, tests were hard in comparison to the way that he taught the class.

I HATE Econ, it's hard, but this class was better than 201 with Hoyt I thought! Exam 1 and 2 weren't bad at all just study. Look at his old exams that he posts online. The final would have been better if I had more study time. Nice and funny, class time goes by fast. He does lecture kind of preacherish but it's amusing. I probably got a B, maybe A.

He can't help it that ECO is boring, and makes a really good effort.  It still doesn't change the fact that the class is very difficult, his exams are very tough, and the material is painful. Sounds just like a southern preacher.
okay teacher...really smart, but the material is tough, unless you study 8 hours a day for one class already...study and do well, tests are killer, though....kinda goofy sometimes
Great professor, never a dull moment, but the class itself is difficult but he made economics fun, don't know too many that can do that.
The most passionate teacher I have ever had.  His lectures are very helpful so go to class.  Definitely take him unless your very lazy.

To sum it up he is makes a lot of politically incorrect statements, and he isn't very approachable. You can't understand him, and he doesn't try hard to help you. I loved econ before this class. Unfortunately most people ahve to take him, so do your CPAs and try to be one of his favorites (basically suck ass like Meg and the fly did this past fall)

DO NOT listen to any of the bad reviews for Mr. Gillette...he's the BEST most interesting teachers at UK. The class gets a bit difficult towards the end, just make sure you go every day it will definatly pay off!!!

Bob is the best teacher I have had at UK. The only people who hate him are those students who either never come to class or are just plain lazy. He is a great speaker and keeps you interested in the subject. His class is challanging but if you are mature and ready for it you will have fun!!!!!
Take his small class if you can.

Bob Gillete is one of the worst Economics teachers at UK.  His lectures are very unclear, he makes no sense when speaking, as he sounds like Foghorn Leghorn.  He is a hard line Christian Conservative, and is very biased, brings religion into Economics as well.  He thinks no one in the class with less than an A is smart.  Avoid Gillete.
Bob is great.funny man too.although i wish i had him in a smaller class.material is not to hard the way he teaches it gives lots of practice test and CPA's which are great.I recomend taking bob

Class was pretty straightforward, can't figure why people think its extremely hard. He does provide all the practice tests you would ever want to take.  As for having quizes at the start of class, if you know that's the way he administers it, get there early.  He is a bit animated, and his tests can be tricky, but if you take a couple practice tests and take good notes, a B is easily attainable.  He knows the stuff very well, very clear, a great teacher.  More challenging than the standard easy A class.
the most bias, narrow minded teacher i have ever had to endure...avoid at all costs

neo-conservative viewpoints constantly find their way into the instruction, he is subtly but very passionately a proponent for radical free trade and thinks money is the only way to help other nations, truly evil
Gillette's crazy wild, little hard to understand (verbally), and has a great class.
Same as previous, but in this class you do an interesting project, and he does a great job of handling it.    BTW: always take the guy in a small class if a large is offered in anything he teaches.
awsome, Hilarious, good teacher, great stories.  FAIR!!!  He expects some effort out of his students, but it's worth it for a great teacher.  One of my favorites.
Great teacher but you must put time into his class. Will not be easy on you.

Great teacher.  Complex subjects made simpler with his use of everyday analogies that are HILARIOUS!  Take him in a smaller class so he can get to know you.  Speak up, he likes that.  Nice guy.  Do the work and you'll definitely get at least a B.  Best teacher I've had at UK.
No Comments

I thought he was a great professor.  Very entertaining and helpful.  He is genually concerned with making sure everyone learns and understands the material.  Just an all around nice guy.  The exams are not impossible but the final is difficult.  I would definitely recommend him.

He is the worst teacher and always talks about baseball and other useless information. the tests are SOO hard and he acts like he is a preacher and is tryin to preach to everyone. its hilarious and everyone looks around asking what the crap hes sayin cause no one can understand. dont take it!!
Dr. Gillette was the best overall professor I've had here at UK.  He actually tries to teach and besides that his in class animations are hilarious.  Definitely take him.

Teaches the easy material in a confusing manner.  His tests seem set on trickery.  Do not recommend taking him (especially if you ride the bus and come to class a couple minutes late, you will miss his quizzes).
even though the material may be hard, he attempts to clarify it--offering help if needed; work load is quite heavy, however
good
His drawl is a of distracting fusion of Ted Kennedy and Foghorn Leghorn.
He's an ass.He expects everyone to know all. he is vague and gives usless information. Exams are a #(*%&!!! Do not recommend him, there are other better teaches in the ECO department.
awesome. one of the best econ teachers I have ever had.

Good teaching methods with instruction clearly reflected on the exams. Going to class, however, is like being in a fire and brimstone church, with lectures riddled with Christian metaphor and sounding like a sermon. Scary but informative.
I wish he had better reviews and explined things a bit more...I would have enjoyed it more if he didn't assume that everyone already knew...and if you didn't he would occasionaly make fun of you....
Awfull exam reviews....not quite concerned with students understanding material...
No Comments
He was very helpful. He genuinely likes Econ. Go by his office hours and he will help you out with what you don't understand. Probably better to take him in the smaller sections of the class.
Cares only about his ratings. Completely worthless when he isn't being rated.
Great Teacher has everything figured out.
Gileete is the ****!!!!
sometimes hard to understand the accent. overall a great professor

Decent Lecturer: however, thinks he's a Southern Baptist Preacher.  Church is all well and good, but I don't feel like a sermon in econ class every day, especially in Memorial Hall which seats 200 easily.:)
Great teaching approaches!  Loved the regressions!
very good teacher. funny, interesting, helpful
Very interesting and fun teacher

Dr. Burris brought humor into the classroom and made her class worth going to. She does not post the slides, and even if you get them with DRC accommodations or due to an absence, she goes over much more in class that is not on those slides. It is very important that you go to class if you want to pass! She takes attendance, but not every day.

Professor Burris was by far one of my favorite teachers. Albeit a tough grader, her teaching really helps you learn the content itself. She is hilarious and her exams reflect the material very well. The class itself is very interesting and the discussions are always really fun. Be sure to be at class because she doesn't post slides though!

i absolutely loved Dr. Burris. She is hilarious, genuinely made the whole lecture laugh basically every class. She is a "tough" grader but very fair- she literally gives you a third of the exam questions and answers. the class was just tests and papers. she doesnt post the notes so if you go to class and listen you will be fine.
Keeps you on your toes, can be entertaining as well. She is a great professor and the material she presents in class greatly reflect the exams.
Class was great! Very engaging lectures! Material taught well!! Attendance taken at random. Very funny and caring teacher!

Her lectures are really engaging and fun. She takes attendance when a lot of people don't show up. Always better to just go, thclass is fun and on days with reaaally low attendance she gives extra credit to who is there. Really fast responses to emails and is really nice about missing a class even if it's technically not excused, she won't dock you
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Burris is hilarious and very laid back. The material on the exams is divided equally into thirds: 1/3 from lectures, 1/3 from practice problems covered during lectures, and 1/3 from the textbook. There are also 4 short writing assignments. Overall, not too difficult as long as you show up and pay attention.

Mr. Loper, though at times difficult, genuinely cares about his students when it appears that many of the students in the class are unconcerned with the class and its material. Despite working towards his own education still, he makes himself as available as possible to his students. So long as you actually try and communicated, you will pass.
would not recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He went over things and didn't answer questions about them. The exams were really hard even if you attended every class and studied. There are lots of notes that are hard to understand and jump around a lot. I took this class as a fun elective and dropped it because it ended up being my hardest course.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mr. Loper is very flexible. Many examples of this exist. For example, students said the 1st exam was too hard, so he made the 2nd exam much easier, and gave extra credit opportunities totalling 16+ points. He can get unfocused sometimes, but he still gets the point across. He is a slow grader, unfortunately, but he is busy as a PhD student.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Class won't be hard if you attend most of all classes.This is a very exam dependent class and participation does help,Mr.Loper was working towards his PHD while I took his class and so after he has completed it I believe he will be a better teacher than the rating I had given him. No homework but there are readings that relate well to class content
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Will not excuse your absence even if a family member dies and you provide proof. Makes class extremely difficult for an introductory level class. Power trips over his students.

I took GER 102 through her. She is amazing! Very energetic, sweet, and understanding. Gives great feedback! The only thing I will say, she is very bad for holding us in class past when she should when she knows many students have to rush to their next class. I have been late to my next class pretty much every day.
not a freshmen course, thought I was on the spectrum at the end

Honestly when the class first started I really enjoyed this professor but as the semester went on she became VERY passive aggressive. Legit if you missed one class she'd basically call you out in front of the class. There was times when I even had to leave early (I have her a heads up) and she put notes on all the whiteboard about it. 4/10 ranking.

Dr. Byrd is incredibly understanding and offers short assignments on canvas to make up for attendance (attendance is not required, but is encouraged). The whole course centers around a research paper, but she helps you the whole way and it is addressed at the very beginning of the course. There is a textbook, but she posts it on canvas. Great prof!

super impressive woman, her passion for what she teaches is clear and admirable. 1 book is required and it's like $10; i would definitely recommend getting it. she has a lot of small assignments that are pretty tedious, but it's made up for by the fact that there's only 1 paper and no tests. if you struggle, she's extremely helpful at office hours!

The biggest disappointment in my entire university career was this class. You barely learn about Norse Mythology while the professor goes off on various topics that do not relate whatsoever. Everyone in the class knew it was a joke and those who didnt were the punchline. If you need a really, really easy A, take this class. For content? No.

Goes extremely off topic all the time. Barely learned anything. I thought this class would be fun but she lets Zoom chat distract her and goes off on tangents about things that don't relate to the class. If you've taken this class, you know what I mean. The whole controversy around the size of Thor's hammer...

Class was easy. Don't openly disagree with her if you have to take other classes with her or plan on grad school in those fields. And prepare to have everything you say picked apart, even during a casual conversation.

Dr. Byrd is really cool and flexible and understanding. Get ready for lots of class discussions. There are also quite a few reading and questions at the beginning of the semester that are eventually replaced by work for the 8-10 page research paper due at the end of the semester. Tests are online and take-home and you can ask her questions for them

She is amazing! Her lectures are very interesting and I loved listening. Sometimes they could get long though. She listens to her students and loves open discussion. Attendance is not mandatory, but I still went to every class because I loved it so much. I recommend for an easy humanities core class. Just be warned there is a 8 page paper due!

She is very funny and she never fails to entertain the students. She knows how to incorporate humor and lecture which is awesome. She thinks of neat ways to portray a concept which makes it applicable to your life. She's so sweet and very understanding about late work sometimes. She tailors the class towards what the class wants to learn too! TAKE

She has placed all the emphasis of this class on a 7-10 page research paper that you work on piece by piece but it is so unorganized and so boring. You choose a topic that most would not understand and have to research about it and not know what youre trying to argue at any point. I wish I had dropped the class but I had an A at the time and B now.

Dr. Byrd was an amazing professor. She made class entertaining and fun and the course work was easy and straight forward and she tied everything together in class. Would take a class with her again in a heartbeat.
She is an awesome teacher, and is extremely nice!  Doesn't hurt that she is really good looking too!

Dr. Byrd is so cool! She is extremely helpful with questions on her class and questions about German or anything she can help you with!! She is a bit stressed now that she has a baby, but she's still great!
"Germanic Mythology" - Dr. Byrd's class was super relaxed and interesting. Only downside is the final is a 10 page paper but she gives you over a month to do it and is very helpful.

Dr. Byrd is great!  She genuinely cares about her students and is always willing to offer advice on how to improve writing or speaking skills and offers a lot of ways to boost your grade if tests aren't your thing.  I would highly recommend this professor to anyone considering a German class.

Don't take this class! She never responds. The TA does all the work. Refused to accept DRC accommodations. Grades harshly. Canvas is disorganized and syllabus not updated since Covid. Must watch all videos and read entire textbook before the exam. Homework is not revevent to the topics covered.

Canvas is unorganised. Difficult to reach. TA grades harshly. Tests are pretty specific and rely on you having just about everything memorised. Assignments are a lot of busy work. The class as a whole seems more like a class to teach older adults about how to handle their finances, not one for college students. Take any other class but this one :)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: You can tell she just reuses the material that she made over covid. Material is not that hard but the tests you over small, irrelevant topics. Tests are given as canvas quizzes all MCQ. However, the grades are not released for a few weeks. Overall, I feel like that class was busy work and I would defiantly take a different class!

The canvas page was extremely unorganized and made finding things almost impossible. There are multiple assignments that don't make any sense and include information that was never taught. Exams are not extremely difficult but you definitely have to read the whole textbook to know what's on it.

She was horrible to reach. Her TA graded harshly on things that were meant for participation only. She didn't take the time to update her syllabus or actually follow it at times. Wouldn't answer emails.

Dr. Byrd centers his classes around a final project that you work on throughout the semester, very manageable and not overwhelming at all. He's super knowledgable and gives great feedback but can go through material a little too fast sometimes. Participation isn't really enforced but he covers a lot during lecture so if you skip, you'll miss a lot.

Dr Byrd is very likable and extremely knowledgeable in his field but not a great teacher. His lectures were very technical and had not been dumbed down at all, given that it was only a 200-level course. The assignments, however, were pretty easy and all compounded onto each other for the final project. He was very willing to help and clarify.
it's supposed to be an easy class but DO NOT TAKE IT PART TERM i spent at least 8-10 hours a week doing this class. He is an extremely hard grader.

You can tell that Dr. Byrd really knows what he's talking about when it comes to languages, which is partly what made this class difficult. As someone with no linguistic background it was hard to understand some of the concepts, but Byrd is really good at giving feedback and helping you. The entire course is built around creating your final project
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Dr. Byrd is a great guy and I really enjoyed my semester in LIN200. I have no linguistics background and he made it very easy for me to understand difficult linguistics concepts. We watched videos as lectures at home for "homework" and he helped us with our components in class. His class is extremely easy to get an A in and I enjoyed the class!

I was in the new LIN 305 class and it was his first semester teaching it, but despite that I thought it was a very fun, thought provoking class. He did a very good job at preparing us for the final mini-presentation. He's very knowledgeable and doesn't always explain the topic perfectly, but is very accessible outside of class. Also super fun!

I think he's a really nice guy, but I avoid his classes like the plague. I dropped out of this class before it was too late because it's his first time teaching it and he foregoes exams, but makes a huge semester-long individual research project worth 40% your grade WITH a 10-min presentation. I just can't; it's just a 200s level course.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: TIP: KNOW THE IPA CHART BEFOREHAND (i.e. MANNER AND ARTICULATION.) This course is difficult. He said it's the hardest Linguistics class you'll have. /Emphasis on analysis./ However, he was very nice, attentive, and willing to help outside of class. Doesn't require attendance, but will help you learn and is extra credit.

Although I could definitely see that this professor was passionate about the subject, students would much rather look at online sales than pay attention. Tests will reflect what has been covered on PowerPoint's, notes, and the book (which is NECESSARY to pass). As well, the material is a bit dry and hard to understand at some points.
Overall a good course, most lectures are pretty interesting, a few boring ones, but what class doesn't have them. If you need this class for a credit, take Byrd.

Expects everyone to have taken a linguistics class before his, so many terms that he uses are confusing to non-linguists like me. Take a linguistics class before you have Byrd it would've saved me a lot of time.

Very smart man, however, he needs to realize that not everyone is a linguistics major that has to take his lower division classes. His lectures have so much information, and for exams he refuses to give study guides and won't tell you anything that's going to be on the test. I took linguistics before and thought it was easy, his class was horrible.

Dr. Byrd is a normal teacher. He's helpful and his TAs are also helpful. His class is confusing to me because i don't care about the subject. He's really enthusiastic about it, and when you aren't it kind of frustrates him. TURN YOUR PHONE OFF before class or he will call you out. Nice guy though. class is good when its good and BAD when its bad
Attendance is necessary to get a good grade. Every lecture is a PowerPoint that is extremely boring.

My best classes in college to date were instructed by Dr. Byrd. If you are trying to be lazy & glide by in-class he will call you out; but that's exactly what a college course is supposed to be. His classes are the perfect combo of engaging and challenging. I recommend for hard-working, driven students.

Dr. Byrd is a good lecturer. He makes linguistics pretty interesting. Weekly online quizes that aren't challenging, a midterm, and a final. He lectures everyday. Posts all the power points online to an online interactive program that use use during class to answer questions. Tests aren't hard compared to material. I recommend taking this class.

This is not an easy subject and if you have no interest in linguistics look elsewhere. Dr Byrd makes a difficult subject fun and interesting, but do not expect him to hold your hand. You will have to study to pass this course.I found him to be personable and honest as an academic adviser. Very knowledgeable in his field. Good teacher overall.

I have been a straight A student throughout my college career.  Yet - somehow, I managed to get my first D in Byrd's class. He was not helpful and didn't seem enthusiastic to help me I asked. Avoid at all costs.

He is a terrible, terrible professor. Every class I was on information overload. He never told us when the final was when finals were coming up and he did not take the time in class to tell us. It wasn't on the syllabus, which was hidden on blackboard under a different name than what he told us. So I missed the final and failed the class.

Honestly, Dr. Byrd isn't that bad of a professor. If you go to class, his lecture's are pretty straight forward and help a lot with the homework and tests. The subject, on the other hand, is really, REALLY boring and if you don't go to class on a consistent basis (which I didn't), then you will quickly fall behind.

For all these people who say he is a caring, helpful professor- that is a lie.  He is not nice one on one. He rushes his lectures, very difficult to understand, and is not very helpful. His TA is very inconsistent and unfair with grading. Go to the study for help with homeworks and studying, that was my only chance.

Byrd takes what is undoubtedly one of the most boring subjects in English and makes it fascinating - Linguistics. Don't expect to be able to coast in his class, you'll have to work hard to get a good grade and study a lot, but he's a great, caring professor who definitely furthered my English.

Challenging class, but Mr. Byrd knows how to teach it so it seems very easy. You have to go to class to understand it but the lectures are very entertaining and hands on. Only negative is it is hard to write down the notes cause he goes through concepts very fast. Overall nice guy, really wants you to like and understand his class.

Glad I had him for my intro to linguistics. Makes things really easy to understand for those who are actually interested. He's great to talk to and will help you if you ask. Don't have to go, but I would, makes the tests easier. Only a few HW / sem. I'll be taking more classes with him for sure. He's awesome! Take him if you're a linguistics major!
Dr. Byrd is awesome!  My favorite professor at UK so far... Made me decide to minor in Linguistics.  He is extremely helpful, nice & makes class interesting.  Take him if you can!
Dr. Byrd is very passionate about linguistics and feels that you should be too. He is nice and the class is relatively easy, but the content is boring.

I think people usually overexaggerate how bad professor's accents are, but I really can't understand a thing this guy says. I stopped going entirely because the lectures are neither useful nor can I comprehend anything he's saying unless I sit 5 inches away from him. The labs are the worst part of the class, but grading is pretty lenient overall.

This lecture content wasn't too bad to understand but the lectures did not help. He goes over examples quickly, and he can be hard to understand. First day of class, every student looked around asking if they could understand him. Labs are very long and if you ask for help, he can be irritable and give indirect answers. Test reviews are like tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The labs take most of the three hour period. Dr. Lu is helpful in Lab, but can be snarky if it's obvious you don't know what you are doing. Homework online is much harder than exam problems, which are mostly from lectures and quiz. Quiz's are mostly able to be done online, but if attendance low he may give 20 point hardcopy quiz. KNOW COMPLEX MATH!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I felt Dr. Lu was fine as a professor. Second half of the class is easier than the first so don't give up! Tests have fairly straightforward questions (can have cheat sheet) but you can really only study using quizzes and examples that were done in class, as practice problems are often confusing or incorrect. Workload is mainly lab assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I'd give a 2.5 rating if possible. He lets you have full cheat sheets and grades very leniently on the midterm and final exams. Just write relevant formulas and make a real attempt and he'll give you half credit on test problems. Lots of homework, lecture/lab quizzes, and long lab notes/reports but nothing is ~too horrible. You will be fine, GL!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: Many instances where solutions for exam review are flat out incorrect. Labs are so bad that someone has been hired internally to revamp them. Grading philosophy is inconsistent, two students could turn in the exact same assignment and one could get a 100% while the other gets a 70% (no exaggeration). Course is disorganized, many other issues. Avoid
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: This is the worst class I have taken at UK. The professor is a decent human being but my god can he not teach this class. When I say he was the worst teacher I have ever had in all of my years of schooling I am not exaggerating. Despite this, there was only one section available and this is a key class so students have to suffer through it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This is by far the worst class and professor I've had at UK. The labs are far too long. The lab notes don't help with prelabs or lab reports. The lectures don't help with homework. There aren't sources of outside help for the material. The amount of work is crazy. The professor is also very rude. Use the textbook and Chegg. Otherwise, no chance.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Lu has a thick accent, so he may be difficult to understand. The labs were long but not challenging. The homework was similarly tedious. The tests are straightforward, so this class should be an easy A if you read the textbook.

If you can avoid taking him, do so. He bogs you down with work and it can be very hard to understand him, as his English is not the best. The week before an exam I had 5 assignments, a lab report, and a prelab due. He is basically a "weed out" professor that makes his class nearly intolerable to force you to reevaluate your major.

Dr. Lu is better than some think. His accent might be hard, but focusing on PowerPoint problems helps since exams mirror these. He allows cheat sheets for tests, which helps. He's lenient with grading. A bit of effort on homework and labs goes far. If asked, he may round up grades. He's very lenient when it comes to that. Good luck on the course!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Lu's class isn't as bad as its made out to be but there are definitely a lot of problems with the course. His lectures are almost entirely him reading off of slides and he goes through them way too quickly. The few times he works out an example in class, he doesn't post anywhere later on, so if you didn't write it down then you're out of luck.

Class materials are unorganized, difficult to understand b/c of his heavy accent. He's not very clear in his lecture and asking for clarification makes it worse. Lot's of HW and Quiz. Labs are unorganized with unlcear instructions. Only way to keep up is reading the textbook and do example problems. This class is a joke.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The worst professor at the University of Kentucky. Unfortunately, EE223 is required for EE majors, so don't take it in the Fall with Lu, take it in the Spring with Williams! Lu is extremely rude, monotone, and refuses to clarify himself. He is the only Chinese professor I cannot understand, yet he's been teaching for 30+ years. Lu doesn't care.

He does ok for a tough class. Lectures are required but it's hard to fully understand content in lecture alone. Quizzes are easy but randomly given out. HW is hard but on chegg and if you can do them you'll do good on tests. A project that is easy but requires effort in making a paper. Good availability outside of class. Hard class but not awful.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Don't recommend this professor for EE223. There are quizzes every class. After the midterm exam, averages were low, he gave test corrections that only raised 2 or 3 students exam grade by 1%.  Labs are very long, have to return to other lab sections to finish. Workload is insane for this class. You'll constantly be doing work for this class.

If you are taking the class with Dr. Lu I guess he's your only option :(  He is a good guy but a bad professor. Lots of homework, doesn't always gives clear explanation, lab materials are so heavy, for each lab expect a prelab, lab note, lab report, and lab quiz in addition to the lecture quiz and serval other HWs. I won't recommend him to anyone

Dr. Lu is absolutely the worst professor I've ever had. His lectures are long and boring and full of nothingness, shows examples and then skips over them. Between the homework and the lab, you never get a break from this class. Two quizzes, two parts of homework, a lab report, a prelab, and a lab all in one week. Super unorganized and doesn't care

This professor is very difficult to understand.  He does not provide grading rubrics for assignments which causes a disparity between grades depending on which TA received your assignment.  Labs are extremely long to the point that very few students complete lab assignments in class.  The workload outside of class is heavy.  quizzes every lecture.

After taking Dr. Smith and Dr. Lu, Dr. Smiths lectures are better he actually works through examples. Dr. Lu reads off his slides while explaining verbally how to solve the problem. Dr. Smiths grading scheme is very test heavy and Dr. Lus is less weighty towards exams but requires more assignments such as quizzes every class and lots of homework
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He just reads off of slides and expects you to comprehend everything he's saying. Which is really difficult considering his HEAVY accent. The labs are awful, I've spent more hours outside the labs then I have inside of them. The labs are so poorly worded you struggle more with figuring out what he wants out of you rather than the actual concepts.

Dr. Lu is very hard to understand, and I wish that were the only problem with his class. The labs are unreasonably long with regularly ambiguous terminology sprinkled through them. Very hard to prepare for exams given other than using the book and praying. Homeworks are average length, but on top of prelabs, lab notes, lab reports, and quizzes.....
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr Lu has a pretty heavy accent that's hard to understand at first, especially because of mask mandates. Go to the lecture and take notes and do the homework and you'll be fine. Engineering is hard, so the classes are hard too and if you aren't ready for that then you should switch your major to something easier. This is a weed-out class
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Lu is very hard to understand, gives an abundance of homework before an exam, does not review the exam, sometimes does not give a review sheet for the exam, does not tell his TA's what to grade in the labs, The labs arent what you talk about in class, require skipping for overtime, you have exams in the labs with no way to study. He is terrible.

His accent is so thick he's impossible to understand. He never replies to emails. The work for this class is ridiculously time-intensive. There are pre-labs, lab-notes, and lab reports due each week. The labs take 4 full hours, then there's at least 8hrs of homework a week and quizzes too. Don't take this class with Lu, take it with Dr. Smith.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Lu has pretty long lectures, so he tends to move extremely fast. Most of the material from the test is written from the notes, so you have to study a majority of the notes which sometimes range from 20-40 slides. Labs are also super long and rigorous. You have to have previous knowledge of ALL the lab equipment to finish the lab in time.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Lu is very heavy on his slides and if you don't pay attention for a second, you won't know what he is talking/writing about. He has a very thick accent which makes him hard to understand, but over email and in office hours he is pretty helpful. With covid and the tests being open book, most questions were from the notes and were done prior.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This professor has by far been the worst professor i've had at UK. He reads off of pdf slides and doesn't teach. He is hard to understand, and his labs are ridiculously long. he expects a lot from his students whom he fails to teach.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: He's a great professor and answers any questions. The class is pretty simple, read textbook and do the practice questions, come to class discuss questions, then take a test on exactly what we just learned. If you do the reading it's an easy A because he discusses the textbook in class so you get double the comprehension. Way better than math class!

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. This man is literally the worst professor i have ever had. He cold calls and will call you out in front of the entire class and stare at you if he even THINKS you are not paying attention. Literally avoid this professor at all costs.

Don't take this if you are expecting an easy A. Really nice professor, you can tell he really cares, but the class is boring and the work isn't hard, but you actually have to put in effort or you're not getting a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Loved him! My favorite professor to date .
Super caring and actually cares about students input.  Lenient with attendance and always willing to help. Would definitely take another class with him.

Sweetest man ever. Attendance is mandatory but he is very lenient if you email him about missing a class. Light workload. Fair grader. Participation in class is expected but not forced. Boring lectures. Would definitely recommend.

No joke, one of the kindest professors I've had here. He's full of knowledge to share! Class is simple while also being information-rich. Few assignments, but the essays require effort. Fair and accommodating, but you also need to put in work. The class is discussion-based and participation is self-graded, so it would benefit you to try.

He is a very nice person but as a professor, it is very hard to stay focused on the lectures. These slides are very dull and even though he is nice his personality is also very dull not making the class very engaging. I would not take this course again fully based on the toughness on being able to be engaged.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I thought the content of this class was boring, however, Thayne was a super great teacher. Participation is self-graded, so go to class and actually participate. There are three papers; one for each unit, and a final paper. He is super understanding, but it is just easiest if you attend class--especially on the discussion days.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Attendance is optional, but you have to grade yourself on your personal participation so just go. He lectures on one philosophy writing for a day, then the next day you discuss with the class. Super easy. You write 3 papers over 3 writings and you have a final project. He is very nice and I enjoy all of his lectures.

Difficult concepts but he is very patient and will do anything he can to explain them. Tests are daunting because so few but very doable if you prepare! Very nice and easy extra credit opportunities too! Overall enjoyable class and he is so nice and understanding and really cares about his students and their wellbeing

I skipped class a lot and was still able to get an A. Yes, there are a lot of papers, but he did not grade very harshly in my opinion. Extremely helpful and understanding, but still respected. Idk I enjoyed the class and he is nice.

Thayne makes this class so hard for no reason. I am a very good student, but this class is the first C Ive ever gotten because he grades so unfairly. He also doesnt have a grading rubric so he doesnt have a set guide as to why you got something wrong. Also his lectures are horrendous and the biggest waste of my time. NEVER TAKE THIS COURSE!!!

Thanye is a great guy but I just was not a fan of this course. It was quite boring and I don't feel as if he taught a lot. He relied a lot on class discussion which was ok but not my style of learning. There are a lot of readings which can be very time consuming, weekly DB's, and biweekly essays. No exams which was nice. Ok class but not my style.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Thayne is one of my favorite teachers I've had so far. His classes are almost entirely lecture, but they provide a lot of insight and are very specific and detailed. He is also very understanding and cares about your performance. He was also available almost every weekday for me and he ensured that I was able to understand every concept in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: His lectures are boring, he says he wants you to participate but really he just wants to dominate the conversation. For the two "reflection" essays, he is so unclear about what he wants, and he grades harshly. It seems as though nothing is good enough for him. He is such a picky grader and would the feedback was just as unclear as the expectations.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Thayne is a great teacher. You must attend class to pass. The concepts can be confusing, but he will do anything to explain them to you. If you dont pass, its because you didnt try
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Thayne's class consisted of lectures that teetered between dryness and hilarity. The homework assignments were graded based on whether or not you tried to complete them. The discussions in class were mostly answering questions about homework and preparing for exams, attendance is required. As far as exams, Thayne always made sure you were ready.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is a very nice guy, but he was not a good teacher in my opinion. Very knowledgeable, but did not translate well to the class. His exams are INSANELY hard for a 100 level class. He gives a lot of 300 level information and expects a lot from his students. Hes super understanding and caring, though, and is always available to speak one on one.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor! The concepts are kinda confusing but he gives you credit for the work if you just try. You only have to do about 7 assignments the whole semester. Really pay attention to every little word when he is doing the reviews because he will tell you exactly what is on the exams. Overall, great professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Thayne was an amazing teacher and the content we reviewed definitely changed my opinion and perspective on a few different issues. The only thing that was difficult for me to adjust to was the amount of reading we had to do in preparation for class. Overall, I loved this class & would highly recommend. He wants everyone to succeed which is nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Nice guy and good prof! Kind to his students and very open. Not a tough grader. A few online homework quizzes and a couple essays, but nothing too hard.

He was extremely nice and understanding. He was always open to discussion and pretty chill. Definitely would take him again. Prepare for daily, somewhat heavy readings. Some small quizes (easy) and a paper due instead of a final. Great class, I learned a lot
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: For a level 100 class, there is a lot of work that needs to be put into this course. the assignments aren't very hard its just a lot of busy work imo. The exams are difficult but just turn the study guide into flashcards and you'll be fine. You also have to participate in 6 credits worth of psych studies which was a little tedious.
Wouldn't respond to emails and went very heavy o lecture notes. The projects were graded pretty lightly but overall not the best.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I would rather never receive my degree than to ever take a class with this person ever again. If you have a death in the family, or an "excused" absence, she does not care in the slightest, and it is completely on you to figure it out no thanks to her. Avoid her courses at all costs, there are much better psych professors at this school.

An easy class, as long as you show up and at least somewhat understand the content. The tests and quizzes are straightforward, with only a handful of very specific questions. She is strict when it comes to student engagement, but is caring and wants everyone to do well. The only issue I encountered was her taking 2+ weeks to respond to emails.
Just show up to class and read some of the textbook
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Could have gotten an A but lectures were so dull I was crying tears of boredom. Quizzes and tests are super easy because you basically learn the same thing every unit. Being happy is good. Doing good things is good. Just know that on assessments you will be expected to remember details and percentages from every study she goes over.

This class was overall pretty easy. There are weekly quizzes every Thursday but there's no need to study for them as long as you semi-pay attention in class. Worick is strict about class ending though, she will get upset if you're packing up even like five minutes early. If you want to go on your phone, sit in the back or she'll call you out.

I had her for PSY120 and she was super nice with making up quizzes or in-class assignments. Very easy class, just show up and take notes and you'll be fine on all the quizzes, and she drops the lowest 2/5. She will get upset if you're on your phone or talking, but honestly valid.

I loved Dr. Worick's class! Test questions can be tricky, but if you use the materials she gives you should be fine. Occasional pop quizzes, but if you attend class and pay attention you will do well. I think her policies are a part of standard classroom etiquette despite what others have said. She simply does not want to waste her time or yours.

She is understanding of attendance. I told her I couldn't take the 1st exam because of a concert, we rescheduled and it was fine. I think her lectures are informational and entertaining, and reaching out for help is easy. She is sweet and professional and I really enjoy her and her class! It's difficult but Id take her as a professor again no doubt
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Genuinely awful when it comes to absences for literal medical emergencies or any absence for that matter takes forever to get back to you on email. Also pop quizzes and half the time what's on the quizzes and tests aren't even what are discussed during lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is extremely difficult for the level she claimed she would be teaching at. She is very disrespectful towards her students, even kicking out a student today for talking to her neighbor. She creates an extremely toxic classroom environment and makes it difficult to learn due to her inability to control her emotions.

Lecture-heavy course. Most grades are based on quizzes, mid-term exams, and final exams. Assigns readings weekly, with a lot of reading.  Gets pressed when people start to pack up 5 minutes early. Watched her kick a girl out of class for talking to her neighbor silently, and then kicked her out because she started coloring on her iPad. 200+ people
Good lectures, usually very engaged in what she is saying, easy assignments.

Homework was easy, and papers weren't too bad. She would post a few lectures for each chapter, which were usually very interesting. She explained things pretty well and would show videos to illustrate segments of development. There were no exams just 5 short (2 page) papers. We covered a chapter per week, so we didn't go too much into detail.

She cancelled class for an entire week because her and her family were sick, which I totally understand. But not reciprocating the same understanding to her students with a doctor's note is wild. The lectures can be boring most of the time. She gives random pop quizzes, so show up to every class if you can. The 5 writing assignments are LONG.

Canceled class for a week because of sickness, but doesn't excuse students for missing class even with a UK doctors note. Canceled class often too and is super hard on her students missing. Very rude and judgmental for no reason. Wouldn't take her if required! Tough grader! Not flexible and never answers emails till weeks later and blames students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers
