reviews.comment: No group projects!! Her class was fairly easy and very well organized compared to other classes I have taken. However, you can't turn in anything late ! Exams were proctored through the online class . You do need to study for exams . I would take her class again .
She doesn't care about excuses, even with deaths or sickness. Doesn't respond to emails until 2-5 business days.

She cancelled class a lot but was really hard on her students. When I got the stomach flu and missed ONCE the whole semester, sorry no extension! She also craps on students not showing up despite lecture not being mandatory and WILL call you out in front of the entire class if you have headphones on (it's giving public humiliation)
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: For a psychology professor, she does not understand the psychology of a college student in any way. Burnout in a week. Your grades in other classes will suffer due to the workload she requires you to keep up with. You cannot take other classes, have a job, have a social life, be a person. You can only be a PSY100 student. I would avoid this course.

I took 323 online an I really enjoyed it. You completed work on a weekly basis by reading the textbook and watching lecture videos. No tests or quizzes so there were writing assignments and discussion boards. She even extended a few deadlines because of students extracurriculars. I liked this prof and would recommend taking her online.

Dr. Worick assigns the most ridiculous amount of work each week, and gives no extensions even during the ends of the semester. She rarely responds to emails, however when she does she attempts to be helpful.

I never interacted with Worick because she has her TA's grade the writing assignments, but the format of this class is so easy. Weekly discussion board posts reflecting the lecture video material and 5 total writing assignments. She gets a bad rap, but I had 0 issues with her. If you don't do well in this course you only have yourself to blame tbh

This class in general is horrible, after talking to several other people's experiences I would say she is the best out of all UK psych profs. There is so much work outside of class, (about 3-4 hours weekly) Make sure to stay on top of labs, cause she'll usually throw an essay/paper midway through the week. Exams are hard but go to SI meetings
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I did not like this course at all, I should've dropped it. You HAVE to study a lot to do well on exams. Her quizzes give you a good idea of what is going to be on the exam. She's the kind of prof. to do surprise attendance assignments if she sees that the lecture hall isn't as full as it should be, or if she notices a lot of people leaving.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class has lots of homework but as long as you do it you should get a good grade. She does not seem to care too much when lecturing and hardly responds to emails. Make sure to put things in correct format or she will give zeroes. Overall she is not the not the worst but not the best.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She will give zeros on assignments if you don't submit them in the correct form. It doesn't seem like she's happy during any lectures. Goes way too fast during lectures, don't bother taking notes during, you'll just end up doing it later. She expects 8-12 hours of work a week for this class. Time-consuming and makes me have mental breakdowns!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I really did not enjoy taking this class. I had Dr. Worick online in which she didn't communicate well and expected us to watch and read upwards of 50 pages of the textbook and 90 minutes of lectures a week. It's definitely possible to get an A but it is incredibly tedious and taxing on any schedule. Buckle up if you're taking her class online.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I could tell she cares about her students and preaches for mental health but definitely not an easy online class. Not the greatest at communication and giving directions but if you read the weekly modules and watch the lectures you will be fine. This class would've been a lot better if it was in person...
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She isn't helpful at all. She doesn't care for you and offers you no help if needed. I ended up dropping because there was no way for me to get my grade up.

She is very impersonal. No points are given back if you receive a poor grade on a weekly quiz. You cover so much material in one week, that you have no idea what will be on the 12 question quiz. The labs are difficult to navigate, and I dont feel like I learned much from them. She expects you to spend at least 12 hours on her class per week.
This professor was online, instructions were always unclear. Test/quizzes extremely hard. Not very good at responding to emails. Not a very happy person.

I really enjoyed this class. Professor Worick always made the lectures really interesting which helped me understand the readings in a deeper way. The tests were a little hard but the quizzes helped me know what to expect on the tests.

The class just has a lot of required material no matter what prof you take. She was pretty nice though and wanted everyone to get a good grade. The exams were a little tough but not worth too much of the grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class is very interesting and packed with information. Attendance didn't count toward the grade, but not going regularly is a big reason I didn't get an A. The tests are information heavy and matter a lot. Overall, I really liked the professor, found the material engaging, and felt my grade was fair.

She was a good professor but, tests were NOT easy. This was my hardest class the whole semester. She is very nice and understanding if you miss class or an assignment she just lets you turn it in late. Make sure to get the textbook as it is needed for labs and to study.

Celise was a good professor; she tried to make the material easy to understand and her review sessions were really helpful. Attendance isn't mandatory but there's no way you can pass without going to class almost every day. Her lectures are long. Don't think this we'll be an easy credit. It was the hardest class I had this semester.

She is a very understanding professor, and will always make sure you succeed in her class. She is also very knowledgeable on ANT. Lectures are easy to understand and there are lab questions every week, but they are not too bad. The tests are just like the study guide and not too hard, usually just multiple choice, some short answers, and matching.

Hilarious and caring are not accurate enough words to describe RC. Her class was filled with dedication and enthusiasm, always being sure to make it clear for everyone. Through her passion, she connected every student together to form a working experience I will never forget. Thank you for a class I will never forget Ms. Ray Celeste Tanner.

Ray Celeste is not only amazing and skilled at what she teaches, but she truly cares about her students. She approaches teaching not as a job, but as something she loves doing. Ray Celeste manages to keep a positive classroom environment whilst also ensuring effective learning and productive work time. Ray Celeste is seriously the best.
She was very nice, extremely good lecturer, and overall a class that after I leave it i feel more fufilled than when I came in. Do a favor to yourself and take her class.

Ray Celeste made my time with her very memorable. She always offers a smile and a positive attitude and is just as excited to teach as I am to learn. She is always happy to answer questions and meet separately. She is not just my teacher, but a support system for me with a class I look forward to. Wish I could do it every year!
I liked this professor but there is a lot of work and you need to make sure you're on top of your stuff in order to keep an A. The work is easy but you have to put in the effort to get an A.

Overall, RC is a great lecturer. The class was very straight forward and the expectations were clear. None of the projects were hard and everything was graded fairly. The class was pretty easy and she taught it well.

Ray Celeste was a great professor, really passionate and professional about how she constructed this class. There was a lot of work, especially with a 10-12 page paper and group project, but the work was generally easy. The quizzes were also fairly easy and overall learned a lot from them and the lectures following.

Kind person but course load is a lot. If you are a student who slacks don't take their class. Overall though I learned alot of real life skills even though sometimes the class was confusing it was worth it.

While this class was easy when you showed up...it was not fun. Reminded me a lot of a high school level class with both the school work and the way you were treated. Was surprised to see my final grade after maintaining such a high grade all semester and following the outline provided. This class would have been better with someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I took music&war. Dr. Arnold is very knowledgeable on the subject, but class was always lecture, and I wasn't prepared for that. He was very helpful when you had questions, and pretty flexible with office hours.  He truly wants you to succeed. There's no midterm, but there is a 8-10 pg final and a final exam with three more short essays on it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Arnold is super cool, but honestly, I think he is too smart to teach the class; he knows so much about music and war so I think it's hard for him to teach.  The class is really repetitive but really try to stay focused and keep taking notes during lectures near the end of the semester because there is a final with three essays on it!

The class I took was Music & War and the requirements for the course was three papers, a presentation, and three short quizzes. He works with you to do better on your papers and really cares that you do well as long as he knows you are trying. If I had to guess, everyone in the class will end up with an A. Does give a final at the end though.

Mr. Arnold is awesome. His lectures are pretty interesting (for HON151 they mostly consisted of sitting and listening to a symphony then talking about it). He is really lax with grading the first few papers and really wants you to do well so he helps a lot. There is very little homework or tests, no midterm, and the papers are not hard. Great class

Interesting way to learn.  Teacher orients rather than teach.  Much of the result depends on what you do on your own.  If you want a good grade you have to do the work.  BTW try to avoid asking questions which answer you can answer in the course materials--he will ask you to read it again! tough but fair.

I had a good experience.  I thought it was going to be easier. Online classes are boring, specially if you expect the same personal attention that you get when when taking onsite classes. teacher was helpful.
Terrible teacher, had to teach myself everything. Didn't provide any materials needed to pass the class and he never replied to any of my emails asking questions.
LOTS OF READING MATERIAL. If you are not an avid reader, AVOID HIM!
Wow.  He really knows his topic. He also is passionate about it.  Never thought I would find this class interesting. Go figure
Very passionate teacher.  He is demanding BUT fair.   Attendance is mandatory so watch out if you like to miss class. He is fairly clear and always available and willing to help.

He was very passionate and interested in what he was teaching. However he was NOT helpful AT ALL in reguards to papers and grades. He is NOT clear when given directions, yet expects you to do things exactly how he wishes - even if he never told you!
class is boring and you only get to miss 3 classes or your attendance grade suffers.  Only hard thing about this class is the listening part on the test. easy "B"

Pretty easy- the homework assignemts and recital reports are easy. The hardest part is the listenings, you will hear random sections and have to identify the piece & key elements but If you study you will be fine! He is really nice,his accent is tricky sometimes but his english is fine! Really has a passion for it, made symphonic music intresting!

His accent can get a bit iffy at times. Quizzes come directly from the text (which is terrible reading material). Test are straight forward. You really need to know the music though. There are listening sections on the test, so if you don't study the music you're effed. Overall an uninteresting subject made somewhat interesting.
He is Great
Very interesting and artistic teacher.

Great teacher.. His tests are so straightforward and if you just take notes and read the chapters, I don't see how you can get anything other than an A in his class. He doesn't demand a lot and understands that everyone doesn't have an excellent knowledge of music.
No Comments
if the aliens were pointing the death beam at earth, give me marty chan

100% would recommend this to anyone trying to fulfill a core credit. I'm pretty sure almost everyone got an A because he clearly states how to and it's basically just pay some attention and do the exams which are super easy with the study guide he gives out.

I LOVED this class! I took it for a UK core and it was my favorite class! You do a lecture pretty much everyday, but he does an amazing job and knows how to keep you interested. You'll basically never have homework. His exams are clearly outlined, and while time consuming to study, if you use the guide he gives you, it is an easy A every time.
Great professor! He is really lenient and understanding, and has good lectures.

I can't express how much I love Mattan as a professor. He embodies what a professor should be! I'm currently taking two more of his classes this semester and I highly encourage anyone and everyone to have him as a professor at some point! He's also very engaging and caring towards his students which is a huge plus! Absolutely take a class with him!
I (and the rest of our class) know the person who gave Dr. Chan a 3/5 rating. That person is a hater who argued with the prof every class... take any class with Dr. Chan. It'll be worth it.

Dr. Chan (or just Mattan for Hebrew classes) is an excellent professor who is passionate about what he teaches. I had a lot of stuff going on during the semester and Dr. Chan worked with me regarding my attendance and deadlines. He's forgiving, kind, and utilizes student feedback to shape the course.
best professor I have had. makes class really easy to follow and really funny.
Ive had Dr. Chan for two classes now, he always makes class very entertaining. Very respectful and very knowledgeable
THE BEST PROFESSOR I HAD AT THE UNIVERSITY OF KENTUCKY! He is engaging, knowledge, and truly cares about the material and his students. I would recommend his class to anyone!
Fun classes, lots of discussion, it's pretty easy. But I felt like he wasn't the most knowledgeable about the field so I'm not sure I'd take him again.
Take him for your CIS class. Attendance isn't mandatory and the class isn't difficult. He's also a good guy and is understanding of things outside of class. Group project heavy but it isn't hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Took online. Assignments were quick and easy. Seemed to be an easy grader. One group project but it wasn't difficult. Reached out once for an extension and gladly gave me an extra day. Probably one of the best professors if you need to take this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class is so easy, but this man never grades. It has been over a month and he still hasnt graded my assignments - midterm grades are due today. What else could he be doing, it's an online class? Can't believe I have to spend money on this course.

Professor Hartman is amazing, I was nervous to take this course at first but he made it so enjoyable and he is an easy grader. I took this course online and he was so great about replying to emails and making sure the directions for the assignments were super clear. If you have to take this course I recommend taking it with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Chas is great. The assignments can be annoying, like Twitter interviews where you have to go find random people and take their pic and ask them a question and then you have to make five episodes of a podcast, but they were also pretty fun. He's not a tough grader at all and you can tell he really cares. I recommend taking him!

This professor is approachable and sets very attainable expectations for the class most of the homework he gives out you will have time to do in class with your team. Definitely take this professor for CIS300

Professor Hartman is awesome for CIS 300. His grading is very fair and he gives great feedback. He gives plenty of time to get assignments done, and allows for Zoom meetings during class time to get group projects done. Professor Hartman even met with me one on one via Zoom when I was out do to an injury--very cool guy and cares about his students
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: The stuff we learned in class had nothing to do with the assignments. He grades very harshly on the reporting assignments. Attendance taken every class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: He means well, but his class is painfully boring. For a 300 class, I was disappointed in how much he babied us. Going to class was a waste of time because he only went over things we should have learned in JOU101 and gave us extremely easy assignments that aren't going to prepare us for the real journalism world. But still very strict on attendance

Dr. Hartman has a passion for Journalism which allows him to be so insightful and care about his students and their future. He's also a very nice man who is very clear with his directions and is always willing to help.

Dr Hartman is a great instructor! He makes the assignments doable and is very nice and outgoing! His expectations are clear and he gives great feedback to his students!!! I recommend that you'd take him for CIS300 or any other class you may have!

Dr. Hartman is pretty cool. I was not looking forward to taking this class after taking CIS112, but it was way different. He is a very reasonable grader and gives a lot of good feedback on assignments. Class isn't particularly interesting, but I think he makes the class a lot less painful than it might be with other professors. Would recommend.
Great guy , respectful to students
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Hartman is a great guy who does care about his students. Read the syllabus and nothing will take you by surprise. If you are a freshman and need CIS110 I would really recommend him.

Professor Hartman is nice and really does care about his students. However, he is a fairly tough grader in terms of taking points off for the most minor APA errors. Expect a lot of reading for his class, but the information is interesting and he is a good teacher.

I had Chas for the spring semester of 2017. The first half of the semester you do current events quizzes (which they come from major news websites  and he includes campus news too) as well as practice in-class writings (which are worth no points). The second half of the semester is in-class writings. He's easygoing and he cares about your success.

Hartman is an interesting character. Super nice and easy going guy. If you take him for JOU204 beware that he grades harsh (in my opinion) and you must stay on top of your assignments and attend class, if not you will fail. I would take him again but I would be cautious on his grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Hartman's class while not the most interesting is fun because of the laid back class and he grades very easily. He genuinely wants you to do well!!
Very nice guy. Not a terribly interesting subject, but he tells you exactly what you need to know for the quiz and is a very easy grader for a journalist.

The class is not terribly easy, but it will improve your writing vastly. Dr. Hartman is very helpful with all things considered, but just make sure to attend class every day for the daily events quizzes. Syllabus has everything laid out in it for the semester, so make sure to hold on to it. Otherwise, just write your daily assignment & leave early.
I had an A in this class with no problem. Attendance is strict, but to be a journalism professor, he grades papers pretty easily.

this class is really boring and it is mandatory. the first half of the semester you have current event quizzes and then in class wrirtings worth 100 points so you CANNOT miss class. Its long but its only twice a week so you can get through it. just be prepared to be bored as hell.

This class was SO boring. Every day we did the same exact thing. You get a current events quiz every day and an in-class writing. He gives you a prompt for your writing and then you are free to leave when you are finished which would be nice if he didn't give the prompt in sections every 30 minutes so you spend most of your time waiting.
A great professor, who makes things really easy. He is very understanding too. Class isn't mandatory, but it is good to go because he gives quizzes and attendance points.

Attendance is not mandatory but there is a current events quiz at the start of every class. Also you do not stay for the whole time in class. You get an in class assignment and once you are finished you are free to leave. Nice, informative, educational class.

He doesn't answer email. He is not accessible. His power point notes are full of mistakes and he uses notes from six or seven years or even earlier. Even his exam questions have mistakes. He believes if the whole class gets A grade it is surreal and is determined to give hardest, mistake ridden tests and cut points.
You are better off asking the TA for help and having Chat GPT teach you 90% of his material.
Great professor, tests are super hard

This class is hard but honestly manageable, don't deny this class because people say its hard, this class will prepare you for future classes, just do not slack on the homework and be sure to attend class and go to ta office hours like a lot.

FIN-490 Sustainability Class was great. Dr. Farris co-taught this class. Chait is VERY knowledgable about finance while Farris brings insight from the UN about sustainability efforts. Researching companies and being able to vote how to invest the 2 million dollar endowment fund is very insightful
If Chait is your only option for FIN 300, you're better off not taking the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Chait is extremely difficult. His midterm is 25% of your grade, and his final is 50%. If you do end up with him, the TA will be your best friend. The one benefit of his class is that it prepares you to learn on your own and pushes you ahead compared to finance students who take an easier FIN300 professor.

If you are willing to actually put in the work, the exams are manageable. Just because the class is hard doesn't mean you should take another professor. Although my FIN 300 class was harder than some of my peers who took other professors, I am now ahead of them in other finance classes. Professor Chait prepares you for the real world.

Do not take Professor Chait, the first exams average was failing. The second was a C. He barely gave out any extra credit to correct this. His lectures are totally unrelated to his exams, prepare to study 24/7 and hope you get lucky with the questions.

Do not take Mr. Chait for FIN410. First exam class average was a 55% and while even curving the grade up, it didn't help much. Lectures are just him talking about stuff in the world then exams are over completely different things different from the practice exam. This class has been hard to keep a C. Take the other guy for 410.

Honestly I would not take this professor. He yaps for 75% of the class about content not relevant to what you're learning so you have to teach yourself that outside of class. All he cares about is his glory days at Chicago.

He is very condescending and rude which make you not want to reach out to him for help, he does provide midterm exam practice material but some of the answer on them are wrong. He shows his way of doing a problem than his wife which are very far apart and just leave you more confused. DON'T TAKE HIM IF YOU WANT TO PASS.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Test heavy

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE HIM FOR FIN 300!!! Especially if you are a finance major because you HAVE to get a B or better in FIN 300 as a finance major. He makes it so unnecessarily hard, his lectures are confusing and don't contribute to your understanding. He's rude and condescending. Take literally any other professor. His final is FIFTY PERCENT!!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Just save yourself and don't take him. His exams are impossible and the class is weighed by 75 percent exams. Take another professor and just save yourself the time and stress.

Professor Chait is a very knowledgeable guy but also expects the most out of his students. He will make you learn a lot of material that you won't necessarily need for this course but will make future classes much easier. Be prepared to do a lot of work, but he is very open to communication if you need it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: very condescending and rude, not beginner friendly as he assumes you already know the majority of things despite it being an intro class to finance. First day in class he told us that only 1/3rd of the class would get a passing grade. You're TA is going to be your only hope to pass and if you get put in a good group.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Rarely cold calls and is overall a knowledgeable and very nice guy, although somewhat disorganized. Not so much a complaint for Chait, but I dislike group projects and this class has a ton. There are 8 "quizzes" which are just tests and the questions are framed in the most difficult way. This class is hard, but an A isn't impossible if you keep up.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you want to have high blood pressure take Professor Chait. He was not the worst professor I've had but not the best. He will randomly call on people in the middle of lecture and asks you difficult questions expecting you to know it. When you get it wrong he will belittle you in front of the entire class. There are 8 mini quizzes that just exams.

Getting an A or B in this class is not too difficult. He isn't a tough grader. The coursework is helpful and applicable to finance. However, going to his lectures are brutal. I dreaded it. He always cold calls randomly throughout class asking obscure questions, that when you get wrong he visually gets frustrated with you in front of the class.

Such a caring professor! He shares useful job opportunities and resources for finance majors, as well as making the course work applicable to real life situations. He's very willing to explain things in different ways and in general wants to make sure you're prepared for life after college.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Chait takes a long time to reply to emails & has dry lectures, but also has lots of knowledge and senior level experience in the finance industry so he gives pretty good advice. You also have lots of group case studies and one you'll present to the class. Overall class isn't too bad but get ready for lots of group work, quizzes, and casework.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Terrible. Just stands and talks from the slides, mentions how smart he is, but never helps us understand material. Good Luck teaching yourself.

Chait has been the CEO/CFO of a few large companies so he has a lot of practical knowledge about corporate finance and the material he teaches in this class. With that being said, his lectures can be pretty dry and he randomly calls on people and asks them really strange questions. He's really good about offering career advice, which is helpful.

He gives you name tags like it's 3rd grade that you have to put in front of you every class. You better be paying attention because he will call on you. No exams but "quizzes" instead that are 9 question exams. Difficult class boring lectures.

Professor stands in front of the class and reads the power point notes. He does not explain how to work problems and when he does he usually messes up. His practice exams are nothing like the actual exams. His class is extremely difficult due to the lack of resources you have.

If you have the opportunity to take Chait for 410, you should definitely do it. He's both a seasoned CEO and an active investor, so he knows his stuff and is really practical. Very friendly guy and is always willing to help you out. Make sure you go to class and participate because he gives extra credit at the end of the semester for those who do.

Not gonna lie I got sleepy sometimes during lectures but for the most part this class taught me a lot and Prof. Chait taught me fundamental things that have changed my life regarding capital. Strongly recommend for those wishing to study capital and the forensics thereof. He's always there for office hours which I really appreciate in a Professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've ever had. He really knows how to teach. I learned so much! He's also really accessible outside class

She is such a nice and sweet person but she was not a great teacher. It took her months to grade things which was very worrisome considering your taking exams and so on that are worth so much and don't even know what your gonna get till months later..
Absolutely awful. she grades online assignments that should be an easy 10 points like a final exam. The exams are pretty hard but the final is 180 questions. Absolute bummer of an online class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: In the beginning you really feel like you're learning something but that slowly changes. She is a very nice person but cannot teach, her exams are 15 & 25 percent of your grade and the quizzes are awful. Everything is open note (physical copies only) but it doesn't matter how many notes you take you will not get 100% unless she adjusts grades.

I don't even know where to start with this woman. Personally she is very nice and very helpful. However, she should not be teaching a 400 level class, or class at all. Her quizzes have ranged from 20 questions to 80 questions, she fell so behind and we didn't finish everything, and she's not organized in any manner. Take something else!

She is not helpful when it comes to feedback or grading. The assignments do not have clear instructions and they take hours and hours. Graded very harshly and for things you aren't even aware you are being graded for. Takes over a month to grade the biggest assignments in the class. The exams are extremely hard and worth a big percent of your grade

The assignments are very difficult. For an online course I found myself doing triple the work then any of my in person lectures. Some of the assignments take multiple hours to complete, and oftentimes the answer key is wrong so you have to email her. I would find another class to take if you can

This is the worst class. You might only have 1 assignment a week but it will take you multiple hours and she knows it. She makes you purchase an online textbook for maybe 1 or 2 assignments but you literally cannot complete them without. She takes forever to grade which is annoying since she assigned us hours upon hours of work.

This class was dense. The amount of material that was covered was overwhelming. ~130 slides were dedicated to random processes. All notes were handwritten. Dr. Cheung uses AI heavily, and I suspect some homework/exam questions were AI generated. This class was disproportionately time-consuming compared to other graduate classes. Do not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: All homeworks are group assignments. Lots of good hands on practice. He's a pretty good teacher and easy to message on Slack. Sometimes the class wasn't well organized and the quiz questions were frequently vague or unexpected which was frustrating.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class is entirely project based with nothing to go off of for you to get better. The instructions are unclear and half the time the teacher is unavailable for help during office hours or even on the Slack discussion board he makes us use. The only kids who know what they're doing are people with prior cybersecurity experience. Take at own risk.
Very knowledgeable in his field and very helpful inside and outside of class. However he can sometimes overestimate what the students in his class may be able to reasonably accomplish.
Great guy, grades easily, gives good lectures. Books are either provided by him or on TPB.
He is the best
One of the best in the Engineering department.

This professor is a legend at UK. He is a miracle in the whole teaching group! He often give very detailed explanation and bring very vivid life-related examples to enhance our understanding. He inspired us a lot and get motivated in the direction of probability distribution!

Dr. Cheung is amazing! He spent a lot of extra time with me trying to help me succeed and it really meant a lot to me. Genuinely nice guy, and passionate about what he does. The final was surprisingly difficult, i don't think anyone even finished it, so try to prepare for that. But he is very approachable and simply one of the best at what he does.

Effective professor. Dynamic teaching style- he is willing to make adjustments based on feedback from his students. Recommended if you are interested in the subject matter. His topics are modern and industry-relevant.

Dr. Cheung is one of the few professors that displays his true passion for helping students succeed regardless of the situation. He is willing to put more than his share of time into the class and will make any accommodation for an individual to understand the material. This can be a pretty tough class but he makes it very comprehend-able.
Chris was a great facilitator of UK101. He encouraged participation and graded lightly.

Chris was probably my favorite professor I've had so far. He is very chill and caring made the class enjoyable. Overall great person. In the class, he would be very interested in the students and could tell he cares. Very easy grader as long as you did the work you will get an A.

Chris was a great UK 101 instructor. He sparked really interesting debate in class. I will admit that sometimes it felt like those debates were the main focus of the course and it was less so about academic orientation. However, he did cover the necessary topics. He grades very easily; if you do the work requirements you will get an A.

She is a bit much honestly. Thinks that typography is the greatest thing ever and puts the class above everything else. She also grades weirdly hard so put effort into each project and please participate in critiques a lot its like 10% of each project grade. She is super nice but like I said she can be a bit much sometimes.

An exceptional lecturer with a truly inspirational amount of enthusiasm for her subject matter. Going to second everyone here who's already noted that she's a rather tough grader, but she gives lots of genuinely useful + tactfully presented feedback, so I didn't really mind. I liked this class, and I'd recommend her.

Absolutely wonderful. I could not brag about Mia enough. I had her for A-S 340 her first semester at UK and it was by far the best studio class I've had so far at UK. She's friendly, extremely helpful, and fair. I've sent her long emails a few days before projects were due and she replied with paragraphs of helpful tips.
If she doesn't like you, she will fail you.

Cindy was SO helpful with whatever I needed.  Attendance was mandatory, but I skipped class at least 1 a week and she never said anything to me and it obviously didn't effect my grade.  She might seem weird but she actually a really nice, sweet lady that my entire class grew to love! TAKE HER!
all I can say is don't take her
No Comments

you have to read 3 novels, a text book, watch 5 movies on your own, write a 5 pg paper, do a 40min. group project, and a project by yourself along with a midterm and final. a lot of work...and she is weird!!

Dr Clasey is one of, if not the best professor I've ever had. She cares about her students and if you attend class, pay attention, and take notes on the lecture, you will be successful. She'll give hints on what will be on the exam. She wants you to do well, just wants you to work for it. It's possible to do well in her class if you try.

All she does during lectures is tell stories and I cannot personally learn through that and we barely get through a slideshow because she just rambles on. The only grades are really quizzes and exams so there's nothing that helps to buffer. Exams aren't impossible to do good on but don't expect it to be easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nice, but bad prof.She tells lots of stories during her lecture and you barely get through slide show. Previous exams, previous quizzes, practice questions, and study guides are not available. You can't even take your exam home. All you have to study are the slideshows. Exams have 40-50 multiple choice and 4-5 multi part short answers in 50 minutes

Dr. Clasey is extremely disrespectful to students. She is impatient and treats her students like five-year-olds. She has a habit of getting upset when the class does not do well on a quiz or exam when half of the questions make no sense. This class would have been much better if she treated her students with the respect that we treated her with.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very disrespectful to students. She has no patients, will spend the entire class on telling a story instead of lecturing. She will not give recommendations if you do not get a certain grade in her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Clasey tells a lot of stories during lecture which side tracks me personally. If you are one who doesn't like that, she is not for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Clasey really knows what she is talking about, but if you don't have background knowledge avoid her class. Even after studying and going to class and thinking I learned the material I still could not get above a 50 on the exam just because none of it actually made sense with what we learned in class.

Dr. Clasey is one of the best professors that I have taken at UK. She is very caring and really loves the material she teaches. Her tests are tough, but A's are possible with proper studying. She is always willing to meet with you outside of class to help you learn as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Clasey is passionate about physiology and really wants students to learn. She provides review sessions, will meet outside of class if you need help, and does all she can to make sure students really get it. She LOVES this stuff. Tests are HARD, but her lectures are easy to digest and she goes really in depth. Definitely take her class!

goes briefly into anatomy but goes deeper into the physiology as it relates to exercise. gives great examples and diagrams to help understand the material easily. this is a difficult class but she makes it so much easier to learn the material.

She's an expert in this subject, but she doesn't do a good job explaining to students. She never gives study guides & doesn't review for tests so tests are hard. Only 3 (including the final) tests which means tons of info on each. Doesn't go over the test after you get your grade. You don't get to keep your tests to study. Doesn't reply to emails.
Super nice professor and does a great job at explaining concepts.  Her tests are pretty hard though, so you have to spend a lot of time studying.

She is very passionate about what she teaches and really encourages her students to  understand exercise physiology, so it is easy to listen to her.  I enjoyed her lectures and stories very much so! The class is fun! Definitely worth the time you put into it!
Very interesting to listen to and knows and loves what she is teaching.
No Comments
Really amazing professor. Attending class and then study the material that is given is important, but overall extremely interesting and engaging.
One of the best professors I have ever had. The class I was in was for honor students, so it was a discussion-based class. Do your readings and papers and you will do just fine. She is amazing.

I took this class to fulfill a UK Core credit, and I'm so glad I took it. Dr. Batty is an incredible professor who gives great feedback on papers and she keeps her students engaged during class. There's a textbook but its like $10. Also, there are no exams!

She was a great professor, this is a great class to take to fulfill UK Core, especially if you are interested in philosophy. Lots of papers but they are based on the lectures she gives in class so they are not difficult.
I loved Professor Batty. Her assignments and exams directly reflect what is taught in class. If you need help, ask! She wants you to succeed and will work with you to get that A!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Awesome class! I signed up for this to fill a core requirement and initially dreaded it, but Dr. Batty has great lectures and leads equally great discussions based on interesting content. Easy A as long as you make an effort, too!

Dr. B is the best. She assigns readings before most classes that you do need to at least skim but they are all very interesting so I enjoyed reading most of them all the way through. Her classes are discussion based but as long as you look engaged she does not force anyone to talk. She provides awesome feedback on papers and is very understanding.

She is a teacher that definitely cares about her students and what she is teaching. She will proofread and give you feedback on early drafts of papers. You must put in the work to get an A, but she makes you want to actually try.

Clare gives out handouts for every lecture, but that doesn't mean you can't read the material.  She is available to answer any questions after class. Her lectures are clear; she likes class discussion so be prepared for that! She's a fair grader and very knowledgeable as this is her area.

Best professor I have taken in college. She is clear, fair, and knowledgeable. Do the reading and show up to class.  Lectures are instructive and entertaining. She gives detailed handouts. I had a very difficult semester outside of classes. She worked with me to allow me time to do the work. She is a professor that cares. I will take her again.

She was the best philosophy professor and most understanding I have taken at the university. She is hilarious and teaches very enthusiastically. I had my appendix taken out during finals and she pushed my paper due date back almost two weeks to help out.

Clare is one of the best professors I have ever had. She is organized, clear, and fun. She does not skirt away from the really tough concepts, but presents them in such a way that they can be understood pretty easily. Tests are tough, and require a good day or two of real studying.
Had her for Philosophy of Sports. Awesome class and a great teacher. Made every class intriguing and interesting. She always is available to help. Definitely recommend her.
One of the best professors I have had. I really enjoyed the class and really can't think of anything I disliked about Clare. One of the best, if not the best.
Had her for Metaphysics and Phil of mind. Very lively, effective, and fair. The content is very interesting and the class is the right balance of serious and casual. Highly recommend.
I took the online version of STA 296. Overall, pretty easy, and you only had to do the homework and the exams, nothing else outside of class.

im in his class now, and the reviews are right: i go to lecture but get ready to learn most of it outside of class- his wording on tests is very confusing and he adds trick questions so make sure u really know the content.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Annoying, stressful exams. Test grades are boosted by partial credit; write something sensible down and you'll get 3/10 at minimum. Test averages are around 65-75%, but a 75 is a B. I didn't attend lectures after the first week; he mumbles and gets distracted with his own stories. You'll have to teach yourself from his disorganized notes.

Lectures aren't amazing, and I think the only reason I'm doing well in this class is because I've already taken other statistics/probability courses in the past. Exams aren't too tough, but be sure to show all work on homework and exams or you will lose points.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Lectures are difficult to follow and oftentimes more advanced than what you're tested on.  You need to be able to learn the content on your own.  Gives an extra 5% on the homework and has a VERY lenient grading scale.  Exams aren't too difficult and the professor clearly wants his students to succeed.  Gives very few point deductions on homework

Confused as to how this man still has a job here. By far the worst educator I've ever had in my career. Lectures are him reading a PDF he needs help pulling up and very few examples. HW is fine, but tests try to trick you. He mumbles and has a heavy accent, plus he can't answer any questions. Wait to take this class with Nicholas Nguyen if you can

MA 320 is easy and hard in all the wrong ways. In class, Dr. Cid reads the book that he's writing word for word - no examples. It's probably intended for grads - homework is much easier, and often unrelated. Tests are 10 q., multiple choice, and laptops are permitted. I sweated through the entire class. However, one on one he's very approachable.

I learned nothing in this class. NOTHING. I taught myself everything using the internet. Cid couldn't answer my questions and never showed any work on the board. He provided notes, which made no sense. The format of his exams are harmful for those who have good morals and want to learn the material.

Absolutely terrible class. Lectures consist of him reading his (confusing) lecture notes word for word. He's super nice, but unhelpful in office hours. I went at least five times & often left more confused than I came. Tests are hard & consist of 10 multiple choice questions. I'm a math major & I switched tracks to avoid taking him ever again.

He makes things much more complicated than they need to be. Was confused the entire semester even though I did great in 296. He doesn't explain things and isn't much help outside of class. Doesn't put grades online. Only really good thing was that he rounded up my very low B all the way to an A - so he'll help you out there. Wouldn't advise taking.

Cid is the best mathematics professor at UK! He prints out lecture notes for you and gives three multiple choice exams, including the final, as well as easy weekly homework.  He even lets you pull up an online stats calculator to use on the final!

Very, very nice guy that really wants his students to connect with the material. Gives you the notes for every lecture and allows online calculators on exams (which are all multiple choice btw). The class itself is kind of a waste of time, though - if you've already taken STA210, it's essentially the same class.

Dr. Cid is the bomb. He prints out all your notes and assignments for you, allows online apps to be used on the exam, and thanks you for your time at the end of every lecture. Nicest guy EVER. I never had trouble understanding his accent. Just sit in the front half of the lecture. He doesn't believe in exams, so he makes them really easy and curves

Dr. Srini is an excellent professor. He is very passionate about his field, and always enjoys lecturing. I've never seen him come into class unmotivated or unprepared. I do recommend taking his class. You will learn a lot!
His lectures can be a bit dull, but he's very nice, explains the subject thoroughly, and grades quite leniently.
super nice!

Srinivasan made this class simultaneously one of the easiest and hardest classes I've ever taken. His lectures are impossible to understand (it's not because of his accent, it's because of the way he rambles and hops inexplicably from thought to thought), but you grade your own homework. Let me say that again. YOU GRADE YOUR OWN HOMEWORK.

Dr. Srinivasan is a nice guy, but he doesn't speak very clear English, and it's pretty hard to understand him. He gives packets out in class that are needed for the homework so missing class is not recommended. Lab doesn't make the class any easier because the TA's speak way worse English than the professor. Although he is hard, I think the other i

Very organized in both 671 and 672. His notes are helpful. Srini has lots of humor for at statistician. I learned a lot. He meets his students where they are. Class pass was slow. Most of us were not stats majors.

I had both STA 671/672 with him, and he was by far the best statistics professor I've had here at Kentucky. He daily provides lecture notes that are very helpful and organized and definitely knows what he's talking about.

i would reccomend this guy for sta 291. as long as you study the old HWs and do the suggested problems he gives you, you will do fine on the exams. personally i thought the firt two were pretty easy but the final was maybe the hardest final i have taken in my life, but i still got an A bc he curves a ton!

Ended up with an A because a 78% in the class was an A. He built in 10% into your grade in the syllabus, then gave made it where 88% was an A because we were all failing at the end of the semester. Didnt buy the book, online hw is impossible, you only get 3 chances to do it, must attend lab.Incomprehensible in lecture. GO TO HIS OFFICE HOURS!

This is a moderately easy subject matter. However you can't understand anything he is saying. He does give out the notes before each class so you can just go get them and leave because basically he just reads over them. Unfortunately the notes are not the best. Tests are tricky. I'm on academic scholarship and got a C in the class.

He is a very nice guy, and you just need to go to class to get the notes. His quizes are very easy, midterm and final are tricky but not too bad. This class comes with a lab, which you must go. Overall.. It was a pretty easy class!

Really nice guy, but poor exam writer. Felt like you could memorize the slides front and back and still would at least get AT LEAST a few questions wrong. Does curve. Uses PollEv, but easy to do at home as well. PollEv questions are also confusing and explained poorly. Lectures are so boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Van Cleve is quite understanding with his students and replies to his emails. One thing I do not like are the exam questions. It is not specific to his lectures and is broad. He does curve his exams which is a plus!! +6, +5, & +7 questions on our three exams. Getting an A is achievable for sure. The labs are time consuming but well organized.

He is so confusing, I don't think he understands his own content. His slides are informative and have good information, but he is really bad at explaining them, and that makes the exams really confusing because the questions don't make sense.

One of the best professors I've ever had at UK. He assigned a lot of great books and in class discussions were very engaging, even on some of the more dense, dull readings. Great classes, great books, and I have even started reading more by the authors of books read in this class. Do the reading. You'll get an A

Prof Clymer is a great lecturer, and although he doesn't grade attendance, you should go to classes because of how engaging he is. All of the content covered in class is what his exams cover, and class is graded off of a handful of exams and papers, in addition to reading responses. Definitely take one of his classes!

Dr. Clymer was really passionate about what he was teaching, making class engaging. He does a good job at allowing discussion in a class that is really just supposed to be lecture based. Attendance wasn't mandatory, but know if you skip you'll miss important exam info. He prepares you for what will be on the exam during lecture, and he's funny.

Assigns a buttload of reading which is made more imposing of a task considering how boring the material is. Big lecturer, but his lectures generally enrich your enjoyment and understanding of what are often thick and complicated texts. Incredibly nice and flexible person.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Clymer is certainly passionate about the books he assigns, even if they are extremely boring. Class lectures are interesting and if you pay attention to the discussions, examinations shouldn't be too difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Clymer is a passionate professor who knows what he's talking about. If you're looking for a class that you don't have to read and can get by in, it's not him. You'll learn a lot though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: great professor, passionate about what he teaches. don't bother if you're not going to read, bring your book, or participate because he notices those things. grade is based off of participation and written assignments (only 5 the whole semester so make them count). he gives you 5 free unexcused absences but after that your grade is affected
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Kept my interest during lectures.  Also nice to look at.
Really enjoyed his class. He is an awsome teacher and cares about his students

He's definitely one of the best professors I have ever had. He is more than willing to help out his students and is a very sweet person in general. His class was super interesting and his TA was really nice too. GO TO CLASS! I went to class and got an A. Tests are based off the lecture! Maybe take a tape recorder. He is So awesome! Clymer rocks!

The most amazing teacher at UK bar none. He clearly loves what he teaches, and truly wants his students to feel the same. Only 1 midterm, lots of reading, and you have to go to class. There is a huge project at the end with minimal help on his part, but this was the most interesting class I have ever taken at UK! I LOVE DR. CLYMER! & he's hot too!
Great teacher!
He is extremely picky about papers.  You must read ALL the material or you will fail the test.

I'm an ardent Christian (Holiness).  After telling Dr. Clymer this he kept showed much respect-keeping his relatively clean for the remainder of that semester and the next two times I had him.  An all around good teacher who knows what he's talking about.
Clymer is great.
Woah
Dr. Clymer's an awesome teacher!  He obviously really likes teaching and is super enthusiastic.  His lectures are funny but you learn a lot.  Snappy dresser!
He's a pretty laid back guy and really seems to love what he teaches.  I think he's pretty cool, and sometimes he makes really corny jokes that make me laugh a lot.  I'd recommend him to my friends.

I really enjoyed Dr. Clark as my MA322 prof. He did sometimes cancel class but not to the extremes that others are saying. Taught lessons clearly and with humor, which made the class much more enjoyable.

I feel the professor is a really kind person.He cares if his students pass the class.The problem is that he is very disorganized. I emailed him 3 times throughout the semester and didn't get a single reply.The assignments were graded very late.Going into the final I did not know where I was standing in the class because he had not graded my exam 2.
He never showed up to class a ton of lectures were canceled late and he wouldn't even show up. I had a 94 and he last minute dropped it to a 89.4

He came in 18 minutes late to the final. No assignments outside of mini exams and normal exams after February and cancelled multiple classes. Exam 2 is still not graded. Also, he deleted almost all his cancelled class canvas announcements. I fully get having bad family issues, but it's unfair to all of your students to do this. Easy class though.
Really chill, when he missed class he made up for it in the lecture, and made sure we all passed with flying colors. Half the exams are online or really easy. Don't pay attention to the hate.

First, he's very nice and when present tries to help you learn the material. Unfortunately, he went MIA the second half of the semester and gave no assignments, all exams/mini exams were given online, and missed/was late to classes. Also, he stopped communicating and as of the night before the final, hasn't announced it or given information on it.

Like others have mentioned, very easy, at the cost of not actually learning. Most of the classes this semester have been cancelled and or cut short due to Dr. Clark's tardiness. A very frustrating situation to those of us who actually plan to apply the material.

Honestly office hours was so helpful. I heard a lot of people complain about his class, but he answers literally any question no matter how silly, and he puts it in terms you understand. I will say, the syllabus calendar is a suggestion and one he doesn't really care about. He also helped me with grad school and as a first gen that's pretty cool.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This a good class if you want an easy A. That is the only reason you would want to take this professor. If you want to learn matrix you are in the wrong place. The course has no sense of organization and structure to it at all. We are now taking our second exam with a week left in the semester. No homework is ever posted he is constantly winging it
Great professor, very willing to answer questions and great at explaining, also pretty funny. Class is set up very well and you can tell he really wants all his students to pass.

He is a great teacher but stopped showing up towards the end of the semester but it was good because you can study for other classes. He doesn't respond to emails but other than that he is great and very kind, take him for this credit!!!

Dr. Clark is amazing! If you're someone who struggles in math TAKE HIM! I was awful at math in high school. He explains concepts so well, and he makes an effort to make sure you know the material. He is funny and uses real life examples to explain the math.

This class is very easy if you took some of this material in high school. He can be a bit of a cornball during the lectures but he is a pretty nice guy. If you look over the practice exams the exams will be easy. You get a weekly grade for showing up to the recitations.

Despite him getting easily sidetracked in lectures, he is very straightforward with his lessons. I could understand his teaching very well. He is also very self aware, for instance if he thought he said something questionable in a lecture he will clarify it next class, which is a great trait in a professor. Would recommend and take his class again!

Dr. Clark is a great professor. He cares about his students a lot, and he knows the material very well. Often in lectures, he can get a little side tracked, which causes a little confusion on those days. However, Dr. Clark is willing to change the course schedule, and exam materials to make up for any confusion in class. I would recommend Dr. Clark
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very nice guy. Always willing to answer questions during class, after, or in office hours. He explained the concepts well.

Clark is great. While I knew the material coming into class, he did a excellent job of explaining the material for it to make sense for everyone. He clearly explains what he wants you to know for exams and how to do it. Just show up if you don't get it, look over the several practice exams for each unit, and you'll pass. The TA for class is helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I quit going to the lecture (even though it was very informative when I did go) and just made sure to submit my attendance and go to all the recitations and understand the homework and practice tests and did very well.  This class was very easy

Dr. Clarks lectures are really fun and interesting, the content is actually really easy as long as you put the work in. I found the homework is different than what's on the actual exams. If you do the practice exams before you will get an A.
I had him for MA162. He gives old practice exams that are just like the exams. He's the best teacher I've had for a math class. I highly highly recommend taking him.

[MA162 not MA 109] Professor Clark is a very understanding teacher. He clearly describes everything and it's hard not to understand something. He post the notes so there's no need to go to lecture. There are 4 exams, exam 2 was the only one I would recommend going to class for. All in all, this class (MA162) may be easier than algebra.
i took Dr clark for MA110 he was really funny and the course work was extremely easy.  i would take him again.
He was very thorough during lectures and somehow found a way to make calculus enjoyable.
I love Jonathan he's really good at teaching in a way that I could understand, you can tell he just want's you to do your best. He also jokes a lot during class.

Dr. Clark was amazing! He was a super easy grader (although extremely slow). I did not receive my first quiz grade (taken within first 2 weeks) until about a month left in the semester. However, this didn't matter as all of the quizzes were super easy and he drops the lowest grade on a lot of assignments! Don't try and email him, he wont see it

Dr. Clark is an okay teacher, but he never grades anything! We've taken 10 quizzes so far (there are no exams, so quizzes are the biggest assignments), and he's only graded 4 of them. I have no idea how I'm doing in the class. Same with projects, he just never graded them, and he gets mad at us if we ask him to put in grades. Would not take again.

Professor Clark was so understanding and shows a genuine care for his students. He is a very personable teacher who makes a point to ensure his students understand and are comfortable with the content.

You will fall behind if you don't attend class. He always was willing to help us, especially outside of class hours. Before every exam make sure you study the practice exam because it is almost identical in layout to the real one. If you go to class, go to the Mathskellar, and take the practice exams you'll pass with at least a B easy
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Do as many practice tests as possible in order to do well on exams. Work through his exam reviews multiple times.

professor clark is a great the lectures is a lot but as long as you willing to work hard for the class you will get an A. He is very helpful if you don't understand something ask him for help. As for the exam do the practice exam and the old exam from the syllabus as many as possible if you want to a good score.

He is a good teacher if you show up to lectures and actually take the notes. He tries to make jokes sometimes which is funny. The practice review questions for the exam are basically almost the same as the actual exam just with different numbers. I like his class and he is very nice and will help you with any clarifications after class if needed.

Do not listen to the bad reviews. Students come into this class not prepared. Calculus is going to be a hard topic no matter the professor. Dr Clark does an excellent job preparing you for the exams. Your grade is reflected upon the amount of time you study outside of class. If you do not study you will get an F. Do not expect this to be easy.

He is a very nice person and I enjoyed his class. His grading is very clear and if you do the webwork home work and study for the exams, you'll be fine. He posts practice exams and even takes the time before the exam to review. He doesn't take attendance but there are online textbook material available if you miss class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

He isnt the best at explaining things and tends to fall behind on whats on the webwork(but the points from webwork are basically useless anyways). Its fine if you can teach yourself, but hard.

Lectures don't teach you what will be on test, not good at explaining concepts. Webwork counts as virtually nothing- exams determine your grades and most people don't pass those. I do all my work and still failed because of exams- don't recommend , take Nathans class if you can rather than this one!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

Math online isnt fun and with this class not having lectures at the beginning I struggled. However, if you go to his office hours he will help you with anything and everything. Hes really nice and funny. I ended up with an A so just go to office hours.

reviews.comment: He is a really nice guy and shows a lot of enthusiasm towards the subject. Doesn't really go over everything in the homework during class which made it more difficult for me. I would've gotten a better grade if he went over everything more clearly. Takes attendance (iclicker) so go to class or have someone go for you.

He is a fun guy but honestly the lectures are not useful at all. To do the homework, I would use chegg or mathway. But before the test, if you just go over the Webwork and study the practice test, you will make an A. Definitely go to class, if not at least get a friend to send you the reef answer if there is one.

I learned precalc in high school but took this class to refresh. I thought this course was easy but I heard of many people dropping other professors due to bad grades. If you do the homework you will be fine. Before tests, do the practice it's the exact test. Clark loves bowties and math but he's down to earth and loves to help with any questions.

Taking this online was great. You just need your phone, and if you meet the bare minimum requirements you'll be fine. She's an easy grader. However, I did find the amount of papers and written assignments we had to do tedious. I think there was one almost every week. The quizzes were easy and the actual photography assignments were easy to complete
Very easy assignments. She gives you lots of time to complete photoshoots/quizzes.
Great professor. We need professors like Clark who don't make a course they teach their whole personality & try too hard. Easy class yet fun.

This class was very fun! It involved a lot of small photography assignments and a few quizzes but it's organized very well on the canvas so as long as you vaguely have the ability to schedule your time out you won't have any problems with finishing the photography projects. Very lenient on the grade and fun projects!
The review scared me, but I think her requirements have changed. Her class is pretty fun. It is not meant to be hard at all plus she's always there to help you. Minimal effort and you get good grade.

Easiest class to ever exist. There are very few project. Dana was always ready to help and she wasn't a tough grader. She is so understanding and her replies to email were quick. Take this class, you won't regret.
I thought Professor Clark was great and her class was not that hard, however, I took it online. If you put in the effort you will be fine.

reviews.comment: Professor Clark is very knowledgeable and passionate about photography. Overall, the class is pretty easy but she can be a tough grader. Directions are clear, but points may be taken off without much explanation. As long as you read the directions and do what is asked, you should be fine. There are only 5 modules which makes the class do-able.

The reviews scared me, but she's not bad. Not the friendliest person ever, but she responds quickly. Don't wait until Monday to do your work. Honestly, not a lot of content for 3 credit hours and I would recommend it.

The quizzes are easy if you listen to the lectures and look at the rubric for projects. Projects may say at least 75 images but to get an A or full credit you need to take more. Overall very easy if some effort is put into it. Anytime I had an issue or for something to be cleared up she was helpful and quickly responded.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dana Clark is like most other fine art professors at UK. They give out grades and then never give good feedback. One of my projects was to take pictures in public. I took quite a few pictures of the downtown mall. She deducted points from my assignment because she " did not like going to the mall". Her grading is not helpful at all.
Alyssa Clements is amazing. She clearly explains and teaches I'm her lectures. She has always suggested to reach out for help if needed. I hope to take her again.

Took PSYC 3120, amazing class. Lectures were never boring because the material she teaches is actually interesting, and she relates it to college students. She said attendance was mandatory but never took attendance so you don't HAVE to go, but I would recommend it. Her exams are difficult but if you really study her power points you should be fine

She is really laid back and you can miss class a few times and it be ok. You work with your group a lot (Who sits at your table). All quizzes and exams are online. She is really nice. You also have to do a group presentation. Class can be boring but it is an easy A. Sometimes you even get to play Kahoot.

Super laid back and understanding. If something comes up and you have to miss class she understands. Rarely ever get homework in class, all tests are online an you have a week to take them. Really easy course
Rest in peace, she may not have been the greatest at responding to emails, but she was a kind person and extremely informative if you asked for help.

reviews.comment: Never responded to emails. No office hours. Had to track her down for weeks for fix my grade. Honestly I have no idea how she had a job, her mental acuity was definitely slipping. The course was taken over by the accounting department towards the end for unknown reasons. Avoid anything but online. Be prepared you will learn nothing.

Worst professor I have ever had. She does not even respond to your emails. The quizzes and exams open at 7PM ET every Friday. In middle of the course, we received an email that from now on the course is handled by another professor. Tbh we don't know what she did!
not sure why my exams open up at 7 pm on a friday night. She doesn't even answer emails. only take online
I remember taking a bath after her final and I stayed under the water just a little longer because I hated being in the same world as her
Just please avoid at all costs. I think Biden has more mental acuity, and that's saying something.

reviews.comment: She was not responsive to emails and was not helpful at all when she did. The exams and quizzes were at night, even with a summer course. They were not lockdown, but had short answer questions that took a long time to type out and show your work- some exams were hard to finish in time
She is not helpful!!! only take her class if ur gonna take it online do not take her in-person class.

It's frustrating how much money and in debt you're going for college just to end up with a professor like clark. truly makes me feel like she's only here for a check. not helpful, impolite, and puts 0 efforts into teaching. she truly does not care. plus she whispers during lectures.

Let's not even get started on her teaching skills, take her online class or take inperson with other professor, but here are some survival tips for her class: you will not learn anything, invest in chegg. don't waste time on studying, chatgpt is there for you. and set a reminder alarm because she only opens quiz/test from 7pm-12.

Worst teacher I've ever had in all my years of school. Cannot hear her speak in the classroom, and when you can hear her it is just her reading bullet points straight from one of the 5 packets she gives you during the class. Quizzes do not open up until 7 pm on Thursday nights. She has zero reason to be teaching, avoid her at all costs.

As a senior, she was my least favorite professor I've ever had. Quizzes and exams are locked until the evening or at night, which is ridiculous for people who have jobs and school. It's an online class, why is the quiz locked until 7 or 8pm and only until midnight that evening? This class made me despise accounting and it's my major. Beware tests.
Worst professor I've ever had and makes this class way less enjoyable. Avoid her at all costs unless you want to have the most miserable experience possible

I graduated from UK in 1985 with a BS in Accounting. If this is the SAME Myrtle Clark whose
class I took back in the early 80's, I've never forgotten it. Ultra bland, boring, with low monotone
voice. Had to drop class - could not adapt to her teaching style and it was
a difficult course to begin with. Took different instructor and moved on.

Try to avoid taking if possible. Highly reccomend in person acc class instead of her online. Very confusing and long, monotanous lectures. Exams are also very tough. Homework doesn't open until 7pm and does it on thursday and friday nights. Do not take if you can.

Her tests can be extremely difficult. She does give a lot of credit for homework/quizzes/assignments though which makes the class doable as long as you stay on top of all of that. This is just a really hard class regardless though.

Avoid her at all costs. For some reason, she doesn't open any of her tests/ quizzes till 7/8 PM. This makes no sense as I thought the whole point of an online class was flexibility. Lectures are old, and you can barely hear her. Very painful class so far.

As a finance major, I actually like accounting too. This is the first professor that I have actually had a major issue with. She keeps all quizzes/exams to not open until 7/8pm at night, with closing at midnight. The grading is ridiculous, I have gotten A's in all 3 accounting courses before this, but she makes you feel like you know nothing. Avoid
Maybe the worst professor I've every had. Online class but her quizzes and test were only open from 8PM to midnight on Thursdays. An actual

I like accounting (I know, crazy) and this is the first professor I've had an issue with. She's nice, but an incredibly bad professor. Only halfway done with this class and about to have to submit an assignment I've written gibberish on because she hasn't taught us how to do it, nor do the book/lectures have ANY info on it. Avoid if you can.

Not political but the best way to describe Myrtle is to look at Joe Biden or Mitch McConnell: WAY too old to be teaching and it shows. Her exams are terrible, her online lectures are horrendous. She has no idea how to use technology so all my exams were unproctored in a fully asynchronous class. They never reflected course material.

Do not take her, she messes up simple math on the board, excessive amount of typos on the exams and she is unwilling to elaborate on what she meant with the typos. She is rude and unwilling to help with homework. take anyone else but her.

More often than not she will get mad at you for even coming to her to ask questions to begin with.

You're not going to learn anything by going to class. She is too quiet to hear and the packets aren't very useful for studying. Despite this, I love Myrtle. She is such a sweet old lady and if you become her friend it makes the class a lot easier.

I feel as though Dr. Clark gets a bad reputation because how difficult the course is. Leaves you to teach yourself all content for her very difficult exams.

She is someone who knows EXACTLY what she is talking about. You can tell she has an extensive knowledge about accounting and the financial world. However, she has no tolerance towards people who do not show up often or come in last second and tends to be rude towards them in class. Go to office hours and you will understand everything she teaches.

reviews.comment: Professor Clark was difficult but fair. Great sense of humor. She is very passionate about the subject.

I have never met a professor like myrtle clark before, she is impossible to hear. she will laugh and make fun of you if you ask a question. a perfect illustration of myrtle is should told 65% of our class to drop (including me), the next class period after most of us dropped she offered a quiz for 15 extra credit points.

Myrtle Clark was one of the most ridiculous professor's I have ever had. Like everyone else is saying, she is rude to students when they ask questions. She reads off powerpoints that she didn't make. The quizzes helped but the I never grasped the material. I didn;t really learn the material until I was in 301.

Let me save you some time and summarize what everyone has (accurately) said about Myrtle Clark:  1. Can't hear her voice in class 2. She's condescending and rude  Regarding the material -- you'll get it if you read the book. The thing I can't understand is why she has to be so rude to students who are just trying to learn.
