Unacceptable.
Don't ever take this class with Clark it's the worst teacher I've ever had. So not understanding and so rude.

This is one of the first teachers I have had that doesn't want to help her students. She will give smarty responses to students that ask questions. Also, she doesn't review for tests so be ready to try to teach yourself because you will not be able to hear her.

The worst professor I have ever had as a student at UK. She does not let students ask questions, she does not give review classes before tests, no study guides, no practice exams, and the tests are completely different than the homework. She does not know how to turn on her mic either so you can't her hear during lecture. Do NOT take her class!!!!!
Awful. Mean. Very reluctant to help.
Worst professor Ive ever had!!! She goes through material super fast and you can't hear/understand a word she says. I dread going to class everyday.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She goes through the notes very fast, but she hands out study guides and works out some of the different problems for you. She gives a large amount of extra credit on her tests as well. She is always in her office and usually available outside office hours as well.

Haha she sucks.  I took her for 302 and it was extremely difficult.  She is completely and utterly incompetent. Her voice is about as loud as the breeze and she would screw you over just for the sake of doing it.  Unfortunately, I had no choice but to stick it out.  She really moustache rides her students with a test every other week.

She is by far the worst professor I have ever had. She is very unhelpful when students ask questions. She goes through powerpoints so fast that you do not have a chance to comprehend the material.  Her handouts are often time different than the material that is on the exam.
Myrtle doesn't care about any of her students and is super condescending. She doesn't go by any of the resources she gives you and is just bad. She's smoking hot though.

If you are planning to get a B or an A you should consider taking this class with a different professor. Myrtle doesn't care about her students and makes Accounting look like the hardest thing in the world, which it certainly isn't. I feel like I would have enjoyed the class much better if she would be nicer and friendlier to the students.

I got on rate my professor when I first signed up for her class. Everyone warned not to take Myrtle at all costs. I don't know why I didn't listen. Clearly thought she was above following the rules. Never once reviewed for an exam. Looked at you like you were insane if you asked a question. Couldn't complete addition and subtraction problems.

Took the summer session. Found in-class handouts pretty helpful. No curve but expect about 10 extra points on each test and theres a 20pt bonus quiz. Can be hard to hear/see what's on the board so I would recommend sitting up front. Also has the best jokes and transitions between powerpoints ever.
Gives homework over material she hasn't covered yet.  Is just generally ill tempered and not approachable. Talks so quiet you can't hear her. Makes it much more difficult than it has to be.
If you're in her section get out now. I read through other comments about her on this website and they are accurate. Even if her section is in a preferable time slot, do not take her.

You cant hear anything she says and faces the board when speaking. She does not teach anything, instead just does random examples on the board. She does not curve, and I will absolutely never take her again.

Went into this class thinking I might become an accounting major, this teacher is the sole reason I despise accounting now. She is the absolute worst. I spent more time writing a letter to the dean of the college saying how bad she is than actually learning anything from her. Do not take this class.

If you are looking up all your professors for your classes for the next semester and are kind of excited for a fresh start and a new class and are about to take ACC 201 with Myrtle just know that you are about to fail the class. You can't hear 95% of what she says. She expects you to get it and goes through material so fast..SWITCH PROFESSORS NOW!
she is the absolute worst teacher and i wish i had found these review before signing up. she does not explain anything and makes fun of you for not understanding the material.

the course material was way too much for a 1 month summer sesstion. She does not explain things, rather she would give class exercises, but she does not explain the numbers.  Avoid her if possible.  Class average is a C.
she is the worst teacher i have met. average is failed no curve.

Absolute worst professor I've ever had. Avoid her at all cost you'll want to kill yourself if you take her. I currently have a 3.8 Gpa and I'm pretty sure I failed her first test. Awful teacher I'd change my major in my senior year before I'd sign up for her again.

Amazing professor. She explains concepts well and is willing to further explain/answer questions. Consistently makes sure her students are following. Easy to reach outside of class and clearly cares for her students. Easy grader.

Dr. Curl is a great teacher who really cares about her students! Attendance is mandatory, but shes very accommodating if you email her. I would highly recommend this class, it's not necessarily easy but it's graded fairly

Dr. Curl is an amazing professor who cares deeply about student success. There are moments where the class is very boring, and you will zone out, but don't be worried, because her quizzes/exams are veryyyy easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This is my third time having Dr. Curl and she is still the best professor I have ever had at UK. She cares about her students and even brings in treats for class. This class has one major group project that takes up the majority of the semester but my group got really close and I made some new friends out of it. Overall super interesting class.
Genuinely one of the best professors at UK. She's very kind and clearly cares about her students. If you show up to class and stay engaged, you'll do great.
This is the second time I have had Dr. Curl and I cannot recommend her enough. She truly cares about her students and is extremely passionate about the coursework. Highly recommend.

Loved Professor Curl. Her lectures are pretty interesting, but at times can be boring. Very caring and willing to help you. Take notes and pay attention in lecture; you will do well on exams and quizzes.

Dr. Curl is an amazing professor. She is extremely sweet and understanding, especially if you are a policy major, but don't avoid taking her classes even if you're not. Her homework stance is a bit strict; no late work is accepted, but the workload is super light. Exams can be tricky, but she grades super easily.
Love her fr fr

Dr. Curl has been one of the best teachers I've ever had. She is incredibly kind and wants you to succeed in her class. Go to class, not only is it interesting, but the material is so important. Nearly everything she taught was used, which is why attendance is super important.

Dr. Curl was an amazing professor and the content was interesting. However, be prepared for random tangents that she does tend to go off on that have nothing to do with the content and that you will not be quizzed on. Focus on the slides and the specific content she lectures not the tangents.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Curl is one of the best professors UK has. She cares about her students, but most importantly, she cares about the subjects she teaches. Her course is very easy if you pay attention and put in any amount of effort. She creates a safe learning environment and wants her students to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Curl was amazing! She cares deeply about her students and wishes the best for us!

I love Dr. Cox. He is so great at what he does. He is passionate, funny, and brings in tons of cool specimens. Exams make up 75% of your grade, so it is important to do well on them. If conservation is what you are passionate about and you show up to class, then this course will be easy! It was definitely my favorite course I took this semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I absolutely LOVED Dr.Cox. He is very knowledgeable and straightforward. Everything that's on the exam is covered during lecture. He has a sense of humor and brings skulls, furs, and real animals into class. He even showed us a bear that he has in the freezer. If you pay attention and attend class you will do fine.

I think very highly of Dr. Cox.  I will take more of his classes.  The syllabus looks fun, the class sounds fun, it IS fun, but it is NOT easy.  Study even little details that you don't think will matter, because they will.  Keep in mind he is a true academic, he is all business, he will help you but he won't allow you to waste his time.

Dr. Cox is a very knowledgeable professor who is passionate about the subjects he teaches. His course wasn't a walk in the park; you must pay close attention to the lectures. Those who do poorly in the class often don't attend the lectures and miss out on important information. Attendance isn't mandatory, but if u miss classes, you won't do well.

He is an extremely tough grader. He will take off points for all sorts of things on the exams and there is no homework or attendance to help boost your grade. The whole grade is exams and quizzes + a project. The lectures are very packed and any random bullet point could be a question. However, hes extremely knowledgeable and overall I liked him
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Cox gave some interesting lectures and he seemed like a caring person that would work with his students. His exams have a lot of material, but if you study the lecture slides you will do fine on all the exams. There was not too much homework associated with the class, so you need to spend most of your time studying.
Honestly, one of my favorite classes I've ever taken. He's a great guy and his lectures are very interesting. The tests are also very straight forward if you study for them.

Excellent teacher, the best in the Environmental Sciences department. He has an amazing amount of knowledge in the subjects he teaches, and his lectures show it. Lectures are amazing and easy to stay engaged with, and though he can be a bit of a tough grader, if you show up every day to class and show that you are working hard, you will do well.

The man is definitely enthusiastic about natural resources and conservation, but the exams are written in a painfully non-specific way, where several questions on the exam sound like they're referring to one of the same answers. And the lack of homework/participation work makes it even harder to want to go to his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A detestable little man. I took this entry-level course for a science elective and hopes it would be a fun class. No. I have literally never taken a harder 100 level class. He was incredibly hard to reach over email and his syllabus was not accurate in terms of grading. Went the entire semester thinking I had one grade and ended with another.

I didn't enjoy this man or the class. It had the potential to be really interesting, but Dr. Cox came off as arrogant and wasn't great at effectively conveying material. He did little to make it interesting, other than drone on monotonously for an hour and fifteen minutes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hes a fantastic teacher that gives you all the tools to succeed. It is a super easy class if you show up and take notes. He does review sessions before exams that are extremely helpful. Some of the people that take the course aren't the brightest, so I would take people that say the course is difficult with a grain of salt.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: My favorite course! Loved coming to class because he was very inspirational and presented the material well. DO NOT underestimate his exams! The material seems easy, but the exams are a mix of fill in the blank, essay questions, and diagram drawing. But if you love wildlife, take this class. You won't regret it. Hope this helps!
You can study for weeks and the highest grade you will get is a 70. Not much help if you go to his office.
Wonderful class that pushes students to succeed and learn the material.
Great professor. Very knowledgable and passionate. His tests are difficult, if you don't study, but all the information is given to you on his slides.

Solid professor. Do your work, study, and you'll get an A, no problem. Many of the other students in his class were not the brightest, so beware what others might say about how hard he is. Study, pay attention, and you'll learn way more than in most other FOR classes.

Great guy. Expects a lot out of his students and won't let people glide through without effort. I learned a lot and appreciated being challenged on exams. KY's Forestry Dept. isn't known for its difficulty maybe Dr. Cox will improve its image.

He is a great guy, but his tests are kind of hard. You have to study every single thing on his presentations to get a good grade. When i took the class almost everybody failed the first test. Then about half the students dropped the class. But by the end of the semester the majority of the students that stuck with it got a B or higher.

Dr. Cox comes across as kind of pretentious and rude, but if you talk to him outside of class he's actually really nice.  His tests don't usually coincide with his lectures very well, but if you study hard you'll do fine.  His field trips always last way longer than he says they will though.

I absolutely adore her. She is quirky and entertaining. She is clear with her expectations and gives great feedback! She genuinely cares about her student and what she does. If you can would reccomend taking a course with her!
Lord have mercy. The class is ight but it's straight yap for 1hr 30min. Like I swear she doesn't take a breath. The workload is ight but the research papers are rough

Lectures were super interesting and she does talk very fast to get all the information in but is very easiy to understand. There is a 8 page research paper due at the end of the semester but it is split up into like 6 parts with outlines and drafts that you get feedback on so you don't have to worry about having a week to write a paper with no help

Dr. Cprek gives interesting lectures, but sometimes rushes at the end. The weekly workload isn't heavy and the textbook readings are not needed. There is a research paper broken up into sections throughout the semester, making it easy to do. She wants students to succeed, and I highly recommend going to office hours and talking to her after class!

This is my third time having Dr. Cprek as a professor and she is amazing every time. This course is by far my toughest PH course yet but she has made it very interesting. Expect a long paper but it is broken up into parts and there are 2 exams. She genuinely cares for her students and I would look for her first when deciding on a PH course.

Dr. Cprek is amazing! She truly cares about her students and wants them to learn. Attendance is mandatory with an attendance quiz, but class is only 1 day a week. Most of the online assignments were fairly easy, but the research paper was heavily weighted and was graded tough. Exams are online and open textbook!
Also, you DON'T need the textbook!

Dr. Cprek is amazing. She loves her job, and it shows. Her lectures are never boring. You will have one class a week, and the rest will be online. The research paper can be annoying and difficult, but it's doable. The final and midterm are open book.

Cprek was super helpful and gave very interesting lectures. The research paper was tough, but she was always available to help and wanted every student to succeed. Her lectures did feel a bit too long and rushed at times, but other than that I loved her. The class is hybrid, but the online portion is easy.
The online activities that take place of class 1 day out of the week were super easy. The research paper however is critiqued pretty heavily.

Great professor. Her lectures are so interesting, you do not want to leave. She genuinely wants each student to learn. You can see how passionate she is about her work through her lectures. Be prepared for a lengthy research paper that spans throughout the whole term.

All I can say is that Cprek is amazing. As long as you show up to class, once a week when your class is held, you WILL get an A. One of the easiest classes of my life. She also really cares for her students and is comical here and there so she lightens the mood a lot. Hope this helped!

Dr. Cprek is amazing, I absolutely loved her class. You have to attend once a week, and you will have to complete an online activity, but the tests are open note and open book. A ton of information is covered, and it's done very well. There are three papers what are combined into one big paper at the end, but other than that it is an easy class.
The assignments are pretty simple, youll cover a lot in class just pay attention.

This class was easy and Dr.Cprek was great. The class was done asynchronously and you only have in-person class once a week. Attendance isn't required but I liked going to class because the content is interesting. Grading is super easy and clear. The tests are open note and I didn't ever have to study.
Dr. Cprek is a very nice professor and is pretty easygoing. TA’s were tougher graders than Dr. Cprek. If you pay attention in lectures and try hard on assignments, you’ll do good.

If I wasnt already majoring in PH this class definitely wouldve made me switch into it. LOVE this professor! open book exams. felt like my TA graded pretty harsh compared to Cprek but still easy A. Genuinely seems to care about students and loves keeping up with news so dont hesitate to share whats going on in the world! Lots of extra credit

She is an amazing professor and clearly loves what she teaches! I only had her one day a week and the other is either a zoom or online activity. She gives extra credit for attendance on zoom and some lectures. Only 2 exams which both have study guides and open book! Theres a paper broken into segments which will be the hardest part of this class!
You can tell she loves what she is teaching.

She is a caring teacher and sets her class up for students to succeed. The class is mainly a lecture one day in the week and a online activity. The most difficult portion of class is with the research paper you have to write because the TA's grade harshly compared to the level of the rest of the course material.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Cprek is an amazing professor who I have learned a lot from. She is very knowledgeable and makes her lectures enjoyable. There are easy lecture quizzes along with some online activities, two exams (a midterm and final) and a paper that is broken up into segments.

LOVE this class! Professor Cprek makes public health so interesting. Taking it Fall 2020 we meet Tuesdays optionally for bonus points. Research paper is very easy and broken into groups. Workload of the class is not overwhelming at all. I have the textbook but have not used it yet.

Lectures are very interesting I had her for Tuesday/Thursday classes and we didnt have class on Thursday so one lecture a week. The test are easy if you come to class and listen to everything she says thats not on the slideshow. Theres a research paper but its done in sections so its not overwhelming. Great class for sure!

Professor Cprek is so amazing! I saw a few reviews that said she is condescending but she has never acted like that in my class. She is SO nice! The research paper isnt bad at all- its broken up into parts so its doable and as long as you follow the rubric the TAs will give you a good score. LOTS of extra credit opportunities. Glad to take again!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Cprek! The class is half online so the lectures can feel like they take forever but she tries to make them interesting. The research paper is the worst part of the class but only because the TA's grade them extremely hard. The final is cumulative but she gives extra credit for participating in a review session and gives study guides.

Cprek is amazing as a professor and a person! She really cares about her students and is always easy to get ahold of. I wish she taught every CPH class! While 440 is difficult, there are always ways to get extra points. Show up, do the readings, participate in class and try on the paper and you'll easily get an A!

Overall Cprek is an amazing professor and she is easily accessible outside of class. The class can be challenging if you do not engage in class discussion and read the required chapters on your own. There is a lengthy paper due by the end of the semester but it is broken off in parts. An A is achievable if students are willing to put in the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Cprek was a great professor. Lecture was only 1 day a week and the other day was a easy online activity. If you do the work and put some effort in you should get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Prof Cprek is good, the class is easy. The worst part was definitely the research paper, and that was mostly because the TAs just RIP it apart and it's a HUGE part of your grade.
Great teacher, the best

she is so nice, and the class is fairly easy. as long as you do all the little assignments and go to class you should be okay. exams are usually pretty easy- the hardest thing about this class is the research paper (mainly because the TA's grade it)

Shes a great professor and the lectures are not bad. There are plenty of easy assignments so as long as you do them I wouldn't worry about grades. Class on Tuesday and normally an easy online assignment on Thursday. Takes attendance for class. Multiple extra credit opportunities. Two online open note exams and two in class exams.
She is great at lecturing and providing the necessary material to pass the class. I loved her class and looked forward to having her again in the future.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Cprek is a great instructor as she makes her lectures enjoyable.

I really enjoyed this class. She does assign a lengthy paper that is graded rather vigorously, however, she provides an extremely detailed rubric for the assignment stating specifically what pieces of information you need. She was very helpful, encouraged class discussion and made herself available outside class. Would recommend!

Unfortunately the only professor who teaches 440. This is a really tough course & she doesn't really seem to care that students have other classes, much less jobs & other obligations. She gives a huge paper as a main portion of the overall grade which she grades viciously. On top of that, she assigns a group project & lengthy midterm & final.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I loved Professor Cprek! She really cares about the information she is teaching,  some times the lectures are a little watered down. The weekly work takes literally no more than 30 minutes, and you barely need to study for the exams. I would take more of her classes!

I would recommend Professor Cprek to anyone and everyone. Her lectures make it apparent that she is passionate and excited about teaching. Although she teaches a lot of information, she makes learning fun. She also offers extra credit and tests are online, minus midterm and final.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She provides a clear concise lecture for her class. The exams are based on what is covered unlike other professors who may add items never discussed. I would highly recommend her to anyone.

The class itself is incredibly easy but the professor is quite possibly the most annoying professor I have had at UK. She feels the need to make her opinion well known and present all other opinions as idiotic.

Wonderful lady who made me want to take many more classes in public health. This class is so easy because of online tests and the final is easy if you study for a couple hours and just take notes on the powerpoints. Would love to have her as a teacher again.

She is my all time favorite teacher so far here at UK. She is so easy to listen to and she makes each lecture so unique. I have learned so much while just being in one of her classes. I would definitely say choose Ms. Cprek for ANY class, she is simply amazing!

Professor Cprek is an amazing teacher. The lectures are very interesting and it is evident she is very passionate about public health. She probably makes the class a little easier than it should be, you have opportunities for extra credit, two online tests, a midterm, a research paper, and a final. I would love to take any other classes she offers!

She is good at responding to emails and is very nice. Overall a great experience. Would recommend her every time. Exams can be difficult but she gives you practice exams that are very helpful. Just put some effort in and you can get an A.

Very easy class. Would recommend. There is 'a lot' of homework, but it really is not that much and you are given a lot of time to complete it. The actual class is lecture heavy. Exams are easy to prepare for and you're given SO much extra credit!
ALL EXAM'S IN PERSON EVEN IF CLASS TAKEN ONLINE!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Cook is a great professor. I took the online class and she was very helpful and responded to emails quickly. There are a lot of out of class assignments that can be lengthy but are decently easy. Exams are especially easy, and there is plenty of extra credit. This class can take a decent chunk of time, but is an easy A.

This class was fine. Professor Cook tries to make the best of it but our textbook was absolutely horrendous. She's very accessible outside of class, though, and there's no reason you shouldn't do well in this class if you show up and do the work.

Dr. Cook does an amazing job at making all assignments clear. She is always willing to help out and walk you through any questions you may have. If you have to take a STA class for UK core, definitely take her class. Very very easy. Almost everything can be done inside of class with your table.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This professor went out of her way to help students.  I am not very good at math, so I was glad that she was willing to meet with me outside of class and she offered extra office hours before the final.  If you are willing to ask for help, she will help you.
I really like this class.  I had a great table and we were able to finish everything in class.  If you sit with a good table and attend regularly, this class should be an easy A.

She's alright. She just facilitates the lesson, but she doesn't really care about the student. Just make sure you do everything on time and good enough and you'll do well, but don't expect any slack. She's a helpful teacher, but it's clearly just her job. Student welfare is an afterthought.
I loved this professor.  She is so caring and goes out of her way to make sure we understand.  Highly recommend.
She is not a good explainer. She literally does not go over any problem and you are just left to you group to figure things out. I recommend not taking her, sweet lady but just not a great teacher.

I was in the online section for STA381. She is very friendly and easy to approach. I had some problems with the lab assignments and contacted her via email, and she responded with very good feedback. Expectations on exams were clear, and past exams were provided with an answer key for studying. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I had no background in stats and Dr. Cook made me like it a lot. Classes were interesting and tests were super hard!
Pretty easy if you study. She helps with the homework and basically you get the answers.
She's so sweet and truly is so nice but not a very good professor. Lectures are boring and she does take attendance mid class.

Very bad lecturer, she will teach something and then have an example problem that doesn't relate at all. We sit in groups though which is nice and helps learn. The class content is so boring though and the labs can be hard. She could be worse, I guess.

She is awesome!! You can get 100% on all the WileyPlus homework if you email her and ask for help on what you did wrong, so start early. She also gives a ton of bonus points throughout the semester. The practice exams have a similar structure to the actual exams and helped me a lot. Very understanding and was fun to be around. Not a hard class.

For someone who never had any statistics class/knowledge before taking her class, I was really nervous but she makes her class very manageable and she understands that you are taking other classes. The exams were very straight forwards along with the homework as well. Everything was super easy to prepare for. The labs were a little tedious buteasy.
Very helpful lab documents and lectures, but plenty of homework and I really disliked the supplemental reading. I also didn't like the homework website, WileyPLUS.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Cook was absolutely the best professor I've ever had, and I hate stats! She truly has a passion for statistics, and is so helpful in every way. She responds to emails almost instantly, and her lecture videos are extremely helpful to the assignments. The exams only count for 10, which is very helpful to your learning and overall grade.
She's so chill. Doesn't really USE a textbook more like your work will refer from problems so it is nice to have but could also use someone else's at your table. Super supportive of group work.

Ms. Cook goes above and beyond for her students.  The class isn't easy, but if you attend regularly, you'll do well.  Much of the work is done in class and she gives tons of review material for tests.  Highly recommend!!!

Every class you are doing work in groups and using a website called statkey which allows you to enter the data that you are given in a question and it solves it for you but then on homework and exams you are supposed to know how to do problems without statkey or the help of your piers that you do every lab & quiz with.

Professor Cook is hands down the best stats professor at UK. She really cares about her students and will go to great lengths to get them the help they need if they ask. Exams are only worth 15% each and there are only three of them. Absolutely take Cook if you can get into her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: It's a large lecture, so you probably won't get to know her too well. Her policies are fair and she will let you join her live stream instead of attending class in person. The content is pretty tough, and I got an A in STA 210. I would say she's a solid choice for STA 296, and most of my complaints would be out of her control.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Cook is incredible. The class wasnt too hard. There are a lot of assignments but she has homework help videos that basically walk you through the whole thing. Her tests were a little tough but if you study with the equation sheet and past exams you will be fine. Overall- great professor.

I wish all professors were like her. She provides step-by-step help for all homework and labs, and if you do have any questions, email her and she will reply in a heartbeat. The class is not a guaranteed A but if you use the resources she provides and ask her for help when you need it, you will do great.

Kara Cook is incredibly kind and a professor who clearly wants to see you succeed and gives you the resources to do so. She provides meaningful feedback and helps you find answers through labs and homeworks in very effective means. Her lectures are also recorded for later use.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Absolutely amazing professor. It is very clear that she cares about her students and wants them not only to pass, but to excel and to understand. She will walk you through a solution step by step if you ask for help. You can tell that she's an excellent human being aside from her teaching as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Material is very clearly presented with applicable examples but lectures can get a bit boring at times. As long as you show up and take decent notes, you will do well. She is very vocal about her political opinion so if this bothers you, probably wouldn't recommend. Overall nice professor and will help you along the way if you need it.

This prof is AMAZING! Take her for stats. She made difficult concepts so easy, her homework and lectures helped immensely as she made tests similar. She is so caring and does work herself that she could delegate to TAs. Goes above and beyond - nothing negative to say about her or the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Cook is super nice, and she is very accessible and helpful over email. I took this class online, so be aware that the video lectures are not actually given by her, but other stats profs. Even so, the class was structured well and she was always willing to look over a lab or help. She truly wants her students to succeed. Highly recommend!

This professor was very kind and easy going. I would recommend her to anyone. I felt the class was very well organized and homework and tests were always graded quickly. What I appreciated the most was her quick response time to any email I sent.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Super easy class, and I've never had stats before. Dr. Cook is very helpful and isn't problematic at all. Her lectures are kind of boring, and there's kind of a lot of easy assignments, but you can definitely learn everything through the homework help videos and can ask her if you have anyyyy questions (especially helpful with the labs)
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I had this class online and it was horrible. She didn't even teach the material or have class, just posted reading and old videos from other professors to watch on your own time. This class also had a ridiculous amount of work for 3 credits. She was always quick to respond to emails and help with homework, so she has that going for her I guess.

Math is not my strong subject, so I was very afraid of this class and put it off until my senior year. I am actually really enjoying the course and the professor. With COVID, we are able attend from home using Echo360 and she goes through all of the chapter quiz material in class. There are papers or projects most weeks, so be ready for that.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Prof Cook is a very lecture heavy professor, but is fairly unwilling to answer questions raised in class about material. She comes off in my class as standoffish and treats people who ask questions like children. The three exams are worth 60% of your grade, and attendance is mandatory and graded even though she just reads off the PowerPoint slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Lecture heavy--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Kara Cook is a sweetheart! Some people may find her lectures a bit boring since she has pretty dry humor, but she makes the material really easy to understand and always helps you in class if you're confused. 10/10 would recommend, she's great! Even through partial online class due to COVID-19, she was super easy to work with.

Dr. Cook keeps her lectures short and the rest of class is used for groupwork and if your table wants, homework. She's a funny person and tries to make stuff funny. She actually cares about her students. Exams are pretty hard and material can get hard, just have to stay on top of it. I recommend taking STA 210 before this STA 296

Prof. Cook is a very kind prof, but the class was lacking a lot of what a statistics class needs. Class is heavily based on daily group work. Exams were very difficult, with a review that always had content not covered in class. She wants you to do well but the class lectures and homework assignments didnt prepare you for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: I loved this class and this professor and actually looked forward to going to a class I thought I was going to dread. The material was hard, but Ms. Cook was accessible outside of class and usually answered emails within a few minutes. Attendance is mandatory, but I feel like the time in class was well used and worth the effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Such a nice person and actually cares about getting to know everyone in class. Does not grade harshly along as you try. We did about four projects throughout the semester, and after each we did critique. Attendance is mandatory, but Cooper is very lenient. If you need an art credit I wholeheartedly recommend you take this class.

I highly recommend this professor and "A-E 120" for anyone needing a UK Core fulfilled and who wants an extremely fun experience to go with it. There are four projects spread throughout the semester with mandatory critique days unless you have a good excuse. Overall, this professor makes you think outside the box and supports you the whole time.

Cooper is an awesome person and a passionate teacher. I took this for a gen ed credit and didn't come into class with an interest in creating art, but Cooper's teaching style was inspiring and made art feel fun rather than just an assignment. You WILL get an A if you show up to class and show effort. I truly believe I am better off after this class

I took this class to fulfill one of my UK core requirements and I'm so glad I did. This course was very easy and was a great introduction to art. Cooper is a great person and really cares about their students. Their grading was very relaxed and the class as a whole was very relaxed. I would recommend this class to anyone regardless of skill level!

Heavily recommend this professor if your planning on taking this course no matter your skill level. They understand if your brand new to art or if you've been an artist for awhile, great as a gen-ed or just an introduction to art classes at UK. They are a very understanding and a caring teacher. The class is easy as well, graded very loosley.

The class is so easy and has 4 projects with guidelines and a 500-word essay. The only upsetting thing was the fact that the last 3 classes of the semester are MANDATORY and if you don't show up to all 3 you get an automatic C in the class unless you have an excuse. Love the class I would take! The teacher is very lenient, understanding, and fun!

Go to class, problem sets based on lectures, exams based on problem sets. Intense prof, but will teach you A LOT. Does "cold-call" but not hard questions and stuff you prepare before class. Offers extra credit for attending class and answering questions. Has a bad rep, but go to class, try, and you'll be fine. Accessible TA help outside of class.

Most unorganized canvas, unorganized assignments, unorganized class. Absolutely no one can understand his teaching or even hand writing. I am shocked that UK allows professors like this to teach. He pumps out a lot of research though so it makes a lot of sense why they keep him! Biggest waste of money. Do NOT waste your time. Biggest joke.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Extremely difficult to follow. Lectures were often confusing and material was not explained clearly. He frequently called on students for attendance and answered questions in a way that assumed we already understood the topic. The course felt unnecessarily stressful and was not a good learning experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The teaching style felt disorganized and unclear, and important concepts were not explained in a structured way. At times, the professor's reactions in class created an uncomfortable atmosphere. Students did not always feel supported or encouraged to ask questions. I found that most of the learning had to be done independently outside of lectures.

Look he's a very nice guy but his lectures were very hard to follow. He shows examples but does not show how to do them and his answers are very vague. He teaches the class like you already have your degree. I bombed his class and with a different professor I got an A and the material was actually very easy to understand.

I'm conflicted about Creane, tbh. On one hand, he's very accessible and willing to answer questions and does seem to want to prepare you for the rest of the major. On the other hand, he answers questions like the Riddler and doesn't seem to really like teaching. Also, his participation grading sucks, but you kind of get used to it after a while.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I am not sure how to rate this professor. He gets you ready for your major and teaches content well but in a difficulty. You get called on multiple times a class which is very stressful but it makes you pay attention? He has high expectations of his students. The practice exams help a lot while studying. Learned alot, worth the stress? Unsure.

It took me a few days to understand how to class would be set up, as the way he takes participation is definitely unique. However, when you get into it it's not the worst--just make sure you actually do the participation work beforehand. The tests are always similar and he provides many practice exams to you. As a plus, all tests are curved.

You are guaranteed to be called on multiple times in the class as part of your grade. Makes it very hard to keep track with what is going on when you are constantly trying to be ready to answer some random question instead of taking notes. Overall, needlessly stressful environment. Would recommend taking anyone else for ECO 401.

I have never been so anxious about a class before. He's really smart and you can see he knows what he's talking about, but he also makes zero effort to make you comfortable or even motivated as a student. Doesn't post ANY grades, calls on people during class (worth points), and is just rude sometimes. Try not to drop your major because of him.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Creane is very knowledgeable in Econ, but not very good at teaching it. He has a know-it-all attitude and makes snide remarks at times. He teaches by throwing a bunch of stuff on the screen and lecturing in detail as if it instantly makes sense. Doesnt post lecture slides, just videos u have to thumb through. Dodges questions, too. Id avoid him.

Creane has notoriety among Econ Majors due to the intensity of his class. To preface, you will have homework every class and he will cold call for answers. However, these are mostly gimme questions that boost your grade if you have been paying attention. Creane is funny and has charisma. If you want to learn and can stand the dad jokes, take him.

This is the worst professor I have ever had. He is extremely condescending and won't put grades in until after the semester is over. There are no homework assignments, so tests are what make your grade. His tests are difficult and he offers no lecture slides. You have to rely off his sloppy handwriting for notes. Avoid this rude professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Creane is charismatic and engaging. He generally does a decent job at explaining everything and at making sure you know why things happen (rather than just memorizing things). The textbook he recommends is very unhelpful, and it is hard to check your work with no right answers provided. He can also get VERY impatient/annoyed at the class.

Professor Creane was amazing. This is a very difficult/math heavy class, but he does a really good job walking you through problems. His tests are all free response, but he is very generous with grading. Make sure to do the homework because he will cold call.

Lectures can be a little hard to follow sometimes but he's a nice guy. Be prepared to get called on to answer homework questions due every class. Doesn't give a lot of help over email but answers questions well in class. Not ton of outside work but you do have to show up to class and make an honest attempt. Similar exams every year & helpful TAs.

I feel some students overrate Creane because he's funny. Teaching-wise, he's a bit hard to follow and wastes a large amount of time simply trying to call on everyone. If you email him for homework help (you likely will, as he seldom gets through the material) he tends to dodge questions. He's a better teacher than some, but is overall mediocre.

He calls on every student at least once each class, so come prepared. The course is lecture heavy and often moves quickly so keeping up is sometimes a task. Still, you will learn a lot and he is very respectful and understanding. The course grade is based mostly on answering the questions in class and exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Tony Creane is the absolute man! I didn't know what to expect first coming to this class, but am I glad I stayed in. His lectures can be hard to follow, but as long as you study and do the homework the class is an easy A. Come prepared for lecture, and be ready to be called on. Helps you understand microeconomics.

Problem sets are assigned for each lecture. Need to be prepared to be called on to participate. He's very respectful in the way he addresses students in/out of class. Grade mostly consists of exams, but they're graded very fair.

Dr. Cooper is incredible. His lectures are very fun and interesting. He also gives a lot of extra credit. His quizzes and exams test on concepts more than just straight memorization, so it is crucial that you study and understand whats going on. I felt like I learned so much in this class and would 1000% take it again.

Dr. Cooper is an amazing professor who is very passionate and wants his students to learn. He gives lots of opportunities for extra credit for this reason. Tests are based on everything in lecture. Study using Echo360 and you will do fine. I would take Dr. Coopers class again. Lab is a bit scattered but not taught by Cooper.

Dr. Cooper is an excellent choice to take BIO 425 Seminar with! He is extremely approachable, understanding and loves to learn. You only have to meet once before your presentation so it can be reviewed. Always gave constructive criticism and was very encouraging!! Must take for BIO 425!!

Exams have a lot of open response, which can be harshly graded. You have to really know the material to do well on exams. 6-7 quizzes which are also often really hard, but Cooper curves a lot and is understanding. Nice guy, can ramble during lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Cooper is the best professor I have had. It was an honor to be taught by him. He genuinely cares for students and has a love for what he does. He cares if you know the information, rather than if you are able to sit and take a test over it and regurgitate the information.

He makes the class overly difficult. 
Some of the worst organization when it comes to lecture slides/content/schedule I have EVER seen.
His slides have zero order and on top of it he will ramble about things the slides remind him about and NEVER EVEN DISCUSS WHAT THE SLIDE HAD ON IT. He will also randomly exam you over things he rambled about.

Dr. Cooper is a super knowledgeable and passionate professor. I really enjoyed having him as a professor for BIO 446 and BIO 425. He was always available to answer my questions during class and through email. Also, he frequently gave reminders about when work was due and was clear on his expectations for work. One of my favorite professors!

Dr. Cooper was by far the best professor I have at UK. He created a positive environment to students and have a good sense of humor. Very helpful professor even outside the class, he will go out of his way to help you succeed on your academic goal. 100 out of 10!

I was very excited when I heard that Dr. Cooper was teaching a section of this seminar course. He really focuses on learning, growing, and focusing on communication to others (unlike some other BIO426 instructors). He brings a multidisciplinary background which really promoted some thought-provoking conversations. Wish this class did not end!

By far the best professor I've ever had! It was refreshing to have someone teach who is genuinely passionate and excited about the material. He really focuses on learning and understanding over grades, which I think really facilitates the most learning here. He created a very collaborative environment, which fostered a positive environment.
Dr. Cooper could not be a more amazing mentor in research.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Quite literally the best professor in the biology department at the University of Kentucky. He is the most knowledgable of all of my professors (even those teaching higher level courses than him) because he loves science and keeps up with research articles released every day. Other than that, he really wants you to learn. He is amazing.

Dr. Cooper is the most frustrating professor I have had while in college. He is unreasonable, will not meet for OH, and does not respond to emails. He gives a test bank, yet some of the answers are incorrect, leading students to miss these points on quizzes and exams. I strongly suggest you take this course in the fall with a different professor.
The whole class and Dr. Cooper himself are super disorganized. Nice guy, awful professor.

Cooper is probably one of the nicest professors, very approachable. His lectures are very scattered; however, and he often goes on tangents, which prevents him from getting through all of the material. Exams can be very difficult, but if you study the old exams that he posts it is much easier. Lots of quizzes, so make sure you go to class.
Cooper is a doll. Watch the lectures and know the material, dont worry about the book.

Big step up from Dr. Osborn. He takes the initiative to record his lectures. The subject material is very hard so expect to see an exam that may look easy, but graded hard. You need to write a lot for the free response questions to get a lot of credit, but the exams are mostly multiple choice, so no worries about huge essay questions.

Dr.cooper is one of the best professors at uk bio department. He actually does care about students' workloads and grades. He records all his lectures and post them online as a video so students dont have to suffer from the 8oclock class. The exams are fair. However the lab supervisor made the lab very demanding.. Lab reports every week

Dr.Cooper is extremely knowledgeble on his field. So he is sometimes easily carried away with his thoughts in the class instead of focusing on the material. Do prepare for a harsh reviewing process since his ppts are all pictures. However, he is very nice and will do everything he can to help you.

Coopers a pretty funny guy. Never went to a single lecture all semester and was usually out of lab in like 20 minutes. didnt study for tests until night before the first two tests 90% of the questions were straight from old test. Pretty easy A if you can get copies of old tests

Best professor in the whole Biology Dept. Works so hard to make the new wet labs in physiology to work. Also published the wet labs on JOVE for students to view before coming to lab. Lab write ups were demanding but now I know how to write a real lab report. Class avgs on exams were in the mid 70's so very fair for an upper level biology class.

Random is a good word to describe his lectures. Reading the material in the book is key here. Tests are not too bad, he is fair on grading. The recitation has been replanced with a lab for fall 2010 however, so have fun with crayfish.
Not helpful. Don't suggest. Loves crayfish but nothing he covers on them are ever on the test. Makes his exam impossible and gives NO curves.

Interesting teacher. rambles about crayfish but most the time its interesting. fairly helpful and is a good teacher when not talking about wetlabs and crayfish. misspells and mispronounces things alot. i would reccomend him.

Dr. Cooper just needs to play in the "wet labs" he loves so much and fiddle with "squid preparations" all day. If you get my drift, he needs to just research. He struggles pronouncing the most basic Biology related words like "caldesmon" and "dissociated." Last semester he recorded his lectures, and you hear him stumble on "caldesmon" twice.

His Animal Phys. class is a GPA killer. The man has a nasal toned voice and rambles about crayfish for 45 minutes. The TAs and old exams save your grade in the class. Try your best not to fall asleep in lecture!
Class was awful, exhaustingly boring, exams were based on lectures.  Class was the worst BIO class I have ever taken.

Cooper's neither great nor horrible. As far as helpfulness, every time I've tried to e-mail him, he's been pretty useless in his responses. I gave up part way through the semester, so I'm expecting a C in the class. If you're not interested in animal phys, take plant phys.

Attendance required. Super hard test try try to make up for the "easy" half with gleeson. Gleeson on the other hand thought cooper was easier than bonner and tried to make his test hard too to make up for the "easy" cooper half of the semester. DONT NOT TAKE THEM TOGETHER! Cooper has easier test when paired with Bonner though.
Horrible professor. Mispronounces words, gets off topic. Tells students to drop the class if they do poorly on the first exam. Should not be teaching.

Dr. Cooper might be the nicest teacher in the biology department but he isn't the best teacher. He has many tangents when teaching that are confusing and long-winded. Old TEST are so important! He will help you anything you ask him though.

He is easy going but requires you to think out of the box. He likes to make you think so you won't go around following superstitious beliefs, but use critical thinking of facts. Testable hypothesis is the way he teaches and that is science not hand waving.
he is the best prof I ever had in my whole Biology degree. He is open minded and tells you as it is . No fairly tales running around creating life here- just the real facts !

Very nice guy and always willing to help a student. This class comes with two awesome TA's who really know their stuff. The problem is that the lectures are simply figures from the book and he doesn't really click through them. He explains things so that they relate to you, but it is difficult to figure out what exactly to study. Old exams are key!
Dr. Cooper's tests were not that hard if you read the material and put time into studying it. He also curves the tests. If you can, take him with Gleeson.
I took Dr. Cooper for both BIO 152 and 351.  If you go to class and pay attention then you will be fine.  I studied very little in both classes and got A's.  He's very enthusiastic about his work.
Extremely boring...he put me to sleep every time. Tests were hard and his lecture didn't help at all. Smart man but he shouldn't be teaching 152...but, Gleeson rocks!

All the notes are online, but none of the test questions are related to the notes.  Going to class is a waste of time because again, the test material is not covered.  A very boring teacher--very nasal voice and doesn't know how to use a microphone.  Don't reccommend his class.

Dr. Cramer is such a kind and passionate woman. You can tell she loves her field of study and wants her students to genuinely find something interesting in every lecture/topic we discuss. If you have the chance to take her, absolutely do! My only words of advice are to email/contact her with plenty of time in advance if you need to reach out to her

She was very open to giving outside of class help. When i was struggling with an assignment she gave me an extension and was extremely helpful. Such a fun professor who definitely has the goal of helping her students succeed.

It's pretty easy to pass this class. You just have to get through some homework. You can't look up everything... she does activities that you have to complete with links, but they're pretty simple. I recommend this class, but you will have to put some time into it.

Ms.Cramer and her TA's are wonderful people, but this is by far the dumbest and most pointless class I have ever taken throughout my 4 years. The premise of the class is based on creating a language with made up words. Unless you have the imagination of a 4 year old, you will want to scream and throw your computer off the tallest building possible.

Great professor, passionate about what she teaches which makes lectures even more intriguing. Lots of relatable and fun fact content in the lectures, definitely interesting even if this is just a core class for students. Definitely recommend, easily good grades as long as your present and listen. (Didn't even take notes and I did good)

Professor Cramer is very engaging during lectures! She uses echo so you can just join live and do the slides from home. The assignments are all based on things you encounter in real life, so they are easy. Very easy to succeed in this course.
She was amazing her lectures went by so fast she is so excited to teach

Great class, great lectures. Don't buy the textbook, you don't need it for anything except adding to the lectures but ultimately I never used it. Only had exams and participation during class for grades, except for the end of the semester project. Very fun TA's and professor, encourages engagement through fun questions.
Very fair about class and quizzes every week. She's passionate which makes it actually enjoyable to go to class.

I had little interaction with her outside of lectures. Recitations taught by TA. She's passionate about the subject and wants you to do well. Very approachable. Easy class with minimal work - only two exams! Attendance counted - go to lectures! Straightforward work in recitation. Simple required class with caring professor.

LOVED Dr. Cramer. Class was very easygoing and she made the lectures really interesting. As long as you show up to lectures and recitation it's hard not to get an A. Just study for the 2 exams, otherwise there's very little homework. If you're looking for an easy credit take Cramer!!

overall a good class, not to difficulty especially if you're taking it as a replacement for a foreign language you do have to go to class but its not too bad and she assigns a textbook but i literally never opened it. i would take her again tho

Dr. Cramer was a sweetheart! Her lectures sometimes were hard to follow and didn't make sense. However, it is a pretty easy class. I recommend taking it if you need this course. There is a small required book, but I never used it and got a 100% in the class. You will be fine not purchasing it.

Dr. Cramer is awesome. I was in a semester where she did an experimental pseudo group project with Wikipedia and Linguistics. She is very passionate about her field and her class is enjoyable and I learned. She posts her lectures on Echo if you miss and is very helpful with questions.

Dr. Cramer is a great professor. I am a slow note-taker, and even though she goes through slides somewhat quickly, the lectures (w/ slides) are recorded through Echo360 and are available after class to watch whenever you may need them. She is accessible outside of class, kind, and gives study guides (reviewed in class, too) before exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Easiest class I've taken. 1st day she said attendance won't be taken. Ive only showed up to class twice and still have a 100 in the class. Super laid back and nice, kinda feel bad cause only like 5 people go to lecture and theres at least 100 of us. doesn't care what you do, literally brad calipari is in it and plays on his iPhone the whole time

You'll take 6 untimed, online quizzes and do 6 easy homework assignments. Lowest one of each is dropped. There are no exams, only midterm and final projects. Midterm is individual, final is with a group. Book is just a short non-fiction novel about Appalachians and their dialect. Cramer is nice, knowledgable, and enjoyable. Attendance is not taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: If you don't go to class (like me) the exams will be difficult but she puts all her lectures on canvas so find a friend who goes to class and takes notes and you will be fine! Literally got an F on the final and still got a B in the class. Also Fridays or "fondues" are not really fun they are terrible and mandatory. same 4 every LIN class tho.

She's nice, a little goofy but in an endearing way. Lectures are easy to follow and understand. My only problem with the course was the final group project, which was a documentary.  She kind of assumes you know how to do things like storyboards and video editing without teaching you how to do them. In general though, I'd recommend her classes.

I loved this class. Easy weekly quizzes and two exams, which are easy if you study from the guide Dr. Cramer gives. For my class there was no "final project," but instead we spent the semester working in different groups to produce a documentary. It was a very cool experience. Attendance was not mandatory and all of her lectures were posted online.

Dr. Cramer is fantastic. I also had her for LIN 211. She definitely knows her stuff and she is passionate about teaching it to students. Go to class - attendance is mandatory. The homework can be challenging, but use the textbook and talk to friends about it. She has office hours a lot and will stay to talk to you after class. Overall, great prof.

Ms. Cramer is great. I am a linguistics major and am so lucky I had her for 211. I am also taking her 212 class next semester and can't wait.  She is always willing to help you, but really wants people to participate and come to class.
She's an amazing teacher I'm taking another on of her classes. And minoring in Linguistics.

Awesome professor. Taking 3 more of her classes next semester and now minoring in linguistics. Got a 100 on the last exam, AND I had missed lectures. She cares, and she is great at explaining. My favorite professor thus far.

Cramer is a great professor and is willing to work with you until you understand a topic. By far the best linguistics professor at UK and actually made me want to declare a minor in linguistics. The class is an easy A if you do homework assignments and go to class!

LOVED Cramer! She was a great professor, I thought linguistics was going to be awful but I really enjoyed it. She keeps you interested and has a unique sense of humor. 10 homework assignments throughout the semester, they help on the exams and if you do well boost your grade. Overall good class and great professor

Dr. Cruz is completely reasonable in his assigned content—if you can't meet it, you're a philistine. The context he brings to lecture is always intriguing; take notes, learn from your peers, participate in the lecture (I've said many dull things, he'd always bring forth value from them). So incredibly worth your time. Also, he's a brilliant poet.

If you miss more than two classes there is no chance you will pass. You were expected to come to class with readings already done, and had assignments on the days where you did not have lecture. Assignments hardly had any instructions; were mainly a free for all, and then he would take off points that make no sense. Not a bad professor.

Dr. Sarmiento is a great instructor who carefully selects the readings and uses different strategies to help students refine their analytical skills when reading poetry. The course was well-structured by thematic areas, making the content clear and cohesive. Analyzing music videos was also engaging. I'd definitely take another course with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Do not take by any means. He is an insanely difficult grader. He makes up critiques when it was not even clear what was expected to begin with. It honestly felt like he'd make something up just to give out a bad grade. Then, he promised me I would have more opportunities to help my grade and I barely did. Terrible class.
such a difficult class for absolutely no reason. dude is just really passionate and it comes off bad. skip unless its mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Beware of this reviews of this professor. I was scared to take this professors because they claimed he was horrible and that this class was basically impossible. I took it anyways and realized that this class is not hard at all. Basic effort and reading you will do well. I never watched the lectures, I just read the note pdfs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: the class is completely online and super easy its basically common sense but you do learn stuff as well. super chill professor and class

Only took the course because I had to, but if you don't I wouldn't recommend it. This is simply the worst online course I have ever taken. The lectures are ridiculously long and the notes are so unclear. The IA's do majority of the grading, so you better hope for a good one. Three writing assignments at 100pts each and the final is 200pts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dropped the class last semester, and had to retake it this semester. This is the hardest class I've ever taken. Lectures are up to 1-2 hours and there is even amounts of work each week, regardless if you have an exam or essay due. Exams are opinion based and there is more than one correct answer choice. Overall terrible, don't take it.

The content in this class is very interesting and Crosby is very passionate about the subject. Prepare for long lectures. The guided notes and weekly quizes are doable. The papers are very specific, so read over the rubric to ensure you reach all criteria. Only a midterm and final exam that are both open note.
This class is awful and is so hard for no reason. I would not take this ever again. This class ruined my 4.0. The professor does not answer emails well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lots of papers and quizzes that are hard to get perfect scores on. I thought this class would be an easy elective but theres no way I am ending this class than higher than a B which PMO.

The quizzes are practically impossible to get a perfect score on, there are multiple 5-page papers, and the grading is pretty rough. I thought this would be a fun class and an easy A, but it is graded by so few things. I feel like too much effort goes into it for it to not be an upper-level class! It would be great if it was reworked a bit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Makes papers and quizzes due on fall break. You have to read the textbook to pass the quizzes.

The course content was interesting, but the class was not fun to take at all. The quiz questions were so confusing and there were times when I was marked off when I had found the answer in the textbook. When emailed about it he did not care. The TAs were great, but the lecture videos were long and boring. I would not recommend this professor.

Lectures were a bit boring and long but he is passionate about gerontology and this class genuinely changed my perspective on the aging population. That being said, his test questions are pretty difficult and confusing. Tests and exams are open note but questions don't always reflect course material. He is definitely a sweetheart though!

DO NOT take this course if you want an easy A. It is so hard and so much content. Half of the questions on the quizzes aren't discussed in lecture. Make sure to watch his lectures even though they're long and do well on the quizzes every week.

DO NOT take this class if you are thinking it is an easy A. This class was way harder than I expected it to be. Make sure you watch all the "lectures" Crosby records for the modules and get good grades on every module quiz those can matter more than the exams and written assignments.

Dr. Crosby's class was not my favorite. He tended to go on rants during recorded lectures, which was annoying. However, it is a pretty easy workload with weekly tests and occasional writing assignments.

Assessments in Richard's class make zero sense. All of the questions are very vague and leave much room for interpretation with only one answer being correct. Feels like he doesn't even bother reading the assignments that he posts and makes his TA's do all his work for him.

Easy A. Slightly boring lecture videos, but quizzes are (mostly) self-explanatory or in the notes. Some quizzes can be nerve wracking because the options are close or two of the four seem correct, and you only get one attempt on the quizzes.
I think that this class was unnecessarily hard and as online elective should not require so much time.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: They seem like a nice person, but the amount of papers I've written this semester is ridiculous. If you like to write, it's not too bad of a class. Pretty sure this is going to be the first class I fail in college.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Class seems to be a bit ambiguous at first, but the information is easy to learn through class (supplemented by the book). Easy to do well and get an A, but you have to know the theories well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: A little bit of a conspiracy theorist but he grew on me by the end of the semester. Only 4 grades but not a tough grader.

I was surprised to see Dr. Felima's low rating. I took her for ANT225, and while there was a lot of reading and note-taking, the workload and grading were fair. She really knows the material, uses real-life examples, and includes helpful videos. I learned a lot and would take her again.

Do not under any circumstances take this class. This is in no way a 200 level class, there are in class assignments each class that she opened 5 minutes before the class is over. Her lectures consist of solely reading off PowerPoint slides. She doesn't give any structure or study guides to the tests. DON'T TAKE THIS CLASS!!!

Never going to take a class with her again. She was knowledgeable on the subject but read off of lecture slides. Attendance was more than mandatory. Not sure if grading was so difficult due to the TA or her but this was in no way a 200 level class. The first test was impossible and questions on the tests seemed arbitrary. Avoid.

She cares if you reach out but be sure that you take notes so that you have a study guide of the important topics for the tests. The tests are difficult but the papers and in class assignments aren't bad. The material wasn't hard to grasp it was learning how she taught and how her tests were gonna be.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Classes are solely taught by reading verbatim off word heavy powerpoints. Talks a lot about her fieldwork, and not the content needed for assignments or tests. No study guide for the test. Discussion posts are NEVER going to earn a full score. Overall, it's not a hard class content-wise, but nearly impossible grade-wise.

If you arent an anthropology major and you want an easy gen ed class, dont take her class. She only reads off the powerpoint, tells us to Google it if we want more info, and takes forever to grade stuff (even though she only has 1 section *and* a TA). We dont even have a lot of assignments, but I couldnt tell you whats going on in class.

I'm not sure if this is the same professor for Sac State, But she goes through slides really fast and to make it even worst, she posts the lecture slides with blank spaces so that you have to come to class. It's a good hack but for me i dislike it because when i study, chances are that I miss some facts during the lecture and end up in confusion.

I disagree with the previous post.  We do in class activities and have assignments that actually help us understand the material more.  While things can be a little unorganized sometimes and some of the subject matter covered is really dry, it is overall an okay class.  Not the most fun but I think she actually cares about her students a lot.

She expects you to know literally everything. Each lecture is a powerpoint of 70 slides, which she goes over entirely too fast. She expects you to know things for the test that she doesn't even know herself. Always has to look up answers to questions students ask. She's power hungry, makes the class way harder than needed. DO NOT TAKE WITH HER!

She had a ton of personal experience in the field to bring to her lectures and genuinely loves her career in special education. She was very easy going, very patient, and was very kind. The class was extremely easy and had a lot of valuable lessons.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Custodero is a great professor, but her teaching was a little difficult for my style of learning. She lives in Nashville, so she is only in Lexington for two days a week. However, all of her tests are online and open-note, so it was an easy class.

This course was easy, especially if you have prior knowledge about disabilities. Attendance is mandatory, she gives one freebie and then after that, each absence is 5 points off your final grade. The class is just her reading directly off slides she posts in Canvas. She does cryptic wording questions that change the answer because of one word.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Literally the sweetest woman ever. Loves what she teaches and it shows.

Custodero's lectures are very boring. She will lecture the entire 50 minutes and leave little to no room for questions. She is not very good at using technology, she will eventually reply to your email but it will be almost a week later.  She also seems to forget what shes said in previous lectures. Overall a great professor but very boring.

She is very kind, but she does not give a lot of comments on your work. You sit and do slides once a week for 2 hours, and most of it is common sense. You do need to study for her exams, but they are straightforward.

She is a nice lady, but her lectures are the most boring things I've ever heard. She stands there and reads off the slides for almost two hours. You are graded on a few things so you have to do well on them. If this class wasn't required, I would never ever taken it. So so so boring.

Profressor Custodero is super kind and gives you opportunities to improve your grade if you ask. she is confusing at times but you'll get through it. I would musk rather take her than another professor.

Dr. Custodero is one of the kindest professors I've ever had. She truly cares about not only her students' academic success, but their personal well-being as well. The class is pretty easy, especially if you already have a background in education or psychology. Attendance is required though, so always go to class!!

Dr. Custodero is one of the most incredible professors and people I have ever met. She will do everything to ensure that you succeed in her courses. She cares about her students on a personal level and wants to create a relationship with you. There are no surprises within her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Custodero! I can tell she really cares about her students and wants them to be successful. She is very knowledgeable and is straight forward with information, she doesn't try to trick you on exams. She wants you to do well in her class and learn how to be a great teacher without stressing about getting a perfect grade.
She is the best professor. Not much homework other than reading, she has online tests and one project assignment. I 10/10 recommend her
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was a wonderful mix of being reasonably easy and very beneficial. Grade is based on 3 generously graded papers (4, 4, & 10 pages) and attendance. There's a fair amount of reading that people did to varying degrees, but it is useful to do the reading for class. Curwood is very kind and helpful. Definitely recommend Curwood!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Curwood is an excellent and articulate professor. I had her for my senior seminar, and I would definitely recommend her classes to anyone interested in the history of race or African American studies. We had a lot of reading and were assessed by a number of short papers. In addition, we wrote a twenty page paper at the end of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Super helpful in and out of class. Cookies on exam days were a great perk. Totally recommended for calc II!
Loved my class with Ryan!
