Ryan is very shy and soft spoken, however he is still very good at what he does. If you ask him for help, he will do whatever necessary to explain. Also, the cookies he brought in when handing back exams made the day a little better for everyone.
Ryan is awesome!

The vast majority of mathematics TAs are awkward. Get used to it. Ryan is no exception in that he is timid. However, he is very approachable and gives clear and simple answers to questions (within reason). Brought cookies to recitation when handing backs exams.
Ignored my questions and told me to see him outside of recitation for help when he was supposed to help us with our questions
DO NOT TAKE HER IF YOU CAN HELP IT. Everyone says MA 111 is supposed to be easy, but she makes it so difficult. I repeat: DO NOT TAKE HER.

All of these bad reviews are from general math classes where the students have likely never had another math professor.  In the math department, she's one of the best professors.  She makes class really interesting and explains things fairly well.  What she lacks in clarity she makes up for in tremendously lenient grading and chances for extra cred

Csima is a very intelligent professor, and she's helpful. More often than not, she over explains and makes things more complicated. She tries to make the discussions fun though. The material is really easy but can take a little time to fully grasp. She's there to help, and not too much homework. Great about letting you drop your worst tests.
DO NOT TAKE THIS TEACHER!!! If you can get out of taking her, DO IT! She rarely makes sense and is very soft spoken.

This teacher does not use blackboard, probably so she can't be held accountable for grading, She is a terrible lecturer and most of the material will need to be self- taught. Several times I found grading mistakes on my tests with the first est being graded 10 points lower than what I actually earned. Avoid the Csima!!!
Terrible, never taking again.
Just no.

She is really bad at explaining things but if you ask questions she will be open to answer them. The material overall is actually pretty easy to understand but if you skip class a lot then don't expect a good grade.
very bland, boring, tests are hard, hard grader

I'm personally surprised that people don't love her. She's by far my favorite math teacher, I can't say the class is a breeze but what college math class is? I enjoyed the class simply because I found the material and her off topic tangents interestingfun. She's a really nice professor.

People complain about Csima so much but her class really isn't that bad, especially considering its a college level math course. If you pay attention during class you'll be fine, but the tests are usually pretty tough and often are much harder than the material gone over during class so know the material!!
She is very monotone and gets off topic a lot. She is not good at explaining things and grades on tests tend to be low. Found myself at the math skellar and the study way too much.

Csima is not a very good professor. She flies through lectures and you cannot understand what she is saying because her voice is very monotoned. So I suggest you sit in the front of the class. She doesn't explain her work, and it gets confusing during lectures. I recommend finding a different professor for MA 111.

Truly, truly awful. I dropped the class last semester because of how bad of an instructor she is, only to have to take the class with her again this semester. When I saw her name I died a little inside. She is intelligent, no doubt, but intelligence doesn't always correlate with being a good instructor. AVOID at ALL COSTS.
She's not very clear in lecture and yo can never hear her

I barely passed this class and I believe that if I had a different professor I could have done quite well in the class. I often became more confused with the material after attending class and did better on tests when I taught myself.

This proff. gets sidetracked very often. She doesnt explain well and you have to find help else where. She is a cool person outside of class if you meet her during office hours or in the MathSkeller. If you can avoid taking her I would.

BY far thew worst teacher I have ever had. Tell me how I am taking this class with a friend and am always getting a higher grade than them and I still end up getting a lower grade. Grading is terrible, clarity is BAD, and she always makes mistakes. she ends up going too fast and always seems nervous. She's more of a researcher than a teacher.
Like, just don't.

Not a helpful professor. She is perfectly nice but her lectures are useless. You're better off skipping the class and reviewing the material yourself, which isn't hard in itself. She didn't curve despite classes bombing consistently.

Awful professor. Class was constantly correcting her in examples. Gets sidetracked & very nervous during lecture, causing mumbling. Does not know material. She often skips random slides & tells class to look at it later for reference but the slides have nothing of value in them without explanations. Class bombed first 3 exams- she did not curve.

She has know idea how to teach. Constantly messing up problems, getting the wrong answers and stumbling over her words. She always sounds unsure of her answers while teaching. Do not take her class, you are better off teaching it to yourself.

Good luck if you are stuck in this class. It is horrible. She knows what she's talking about but has no clue how to teach it to her students. She is very confusing. You never use a textbook. She uploads her lectures online, but they are useless. It doesn't have the answers to any of the solved problems. I wouldn't recommend this class to anyone.

At the beginning of the year she said we would use the textbook online. Not once did we use it. She tries to make class fun- doesn't work. She knows the material but not how to teach it. Her tests are not accurately reflected of the material she teaches in class. DONT WAISTE YOUR TIME WITH THIS CLASS.

Nice person, horrible teacher. I would not recommend her at all. She does not know what she is teaching. Very spacey and unclear in lecture. Most of the class skips because you can learn the topic better online or from the text book. DO. NOT. TAKE. HER. CLASS.

I think she is a fine teacher. Class test averages are low because over half of the class skips lecture normally. People asking her to slow down, are asking way to much for a COLLEGE math class. If you ask her for help she will give it, she is extremely nice. If you take this class even semi-seriously you should be able to manage an A.

Impossible to keep up with her speed in class, seems like she's trying to do it as fast as she can like a kid trying to impress her parents. the average on the first two exams were both below 50%.. she did not curve

She is an awful professor. She's nice but is literally the hardest person to pay attention to. She mumbles when she teaches, and only explains the easy questions. I learn much more going to the study.

I struggled a lot in this class. She moves really fast and doesn't thoroughly explain new topics. She seems unsure of what she's teaching, which makes students feel unsure. She needs to slow down a little and explain more in-depth.
Terrible teaching techniques. Class topics  are way ahead of homework topics and it's too confusing.

She doesn't explain things right and constantly says "I dont know exactly why this is this but it is." Does not take time to explain and is very annoying to listen to because she constantly doubts herself

This class is super easy, i haven't learned anything i didnt know before. but if you dont already know most of the material...the class might be hard because she is not the best teacher. DONT BUY THE BOOK. all hw is online. go to class, take notes. youll get an a

Terrible teacher! Constantly trips over her words and has to erase numbers while working out problems. She seems nervous, like a new teacher. The tests are hard because she doesn't teach the material well enough. Wouldn't recommend her!

Make sure that if you take her, you assume what details she wants in assignments, even if there is no rubric. And make sure to be prepared for her to remove 1/10th off your essay and assignment grade simply for not writing about a small moment spoken on in reading that doesn't affect the overall comprehension of the subject matter.

Doesn't give clear instructions for papers which can make it difficult to earn an A since you don't really know what she wants. She is generally unavailable outside of class and is hard to reach by email since she works during the day. She cares a lot about premed student success and will help you if you go to her. The class itself is interesting.

This 300-level course I have had to complete multiple exams for a single grade. For example in a graduate level class we could choose between two types of exams for mid-term and final, either short answer & multiple choice or essay, while some of the others you could just write a final paper and that was it. For this class all had to be done.

dr. leedham is a very sweet lady and genuinely cares about all of her students! you're assigned to a group at the beginning of the semester and stay with the same one, and the presentations weren't hard at all. the exams and quizzes are all open book/materials. the class is a little disorganized but it isn't too hard to get an A.

Each week you have a stack of readings you need to get through and have weekly group presentations reviewing the readings. Be prepared to be interrupted by Dr. Leedham and have her repeat everything you've just said after you're finished speaking. In your 2.5 hour class you will spend most of it doing group presentations every week.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: When asked opinionated questions, you must go with what she wants and not what you actually think. You have to purchase like 10 books and you do questions every week. You can't take notes in that class because she zips through the material. The exams and quizzes are always put off till last and you are RUSHED!

Interesting course and would be better if you take a different professor. She will not be clear on how she grades or what details she wants. Be ready for her to take off a lot of points if you fail to mention a specific detail you went over in class in essays. She is not very up to date with current sociology. You might have to work for an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She's an amazing lady. She really, really cares about her students and is extraordinarily nice. She's a very lenient grader as well. Take her class if you can, because she is legitimately one of the best people I have ever met in my life.

Great person, great professor. Very passionate about her work and willing to help those who help themselves. There is quite a bit of reading involved. She loves participation, be prepared to speak up in class! I would absolutely take her again.
There is a fair amount of reading in the class I had with her. She is a very interesting professor and wants you to learn. She talks a lot, but if you're interested in the class topic, it's great.

Professor Leedham is great! You do have to come to class and make sure you do all the readings and classwork to make a good grade on the tests. She is a pretty easy grader, and she is a little boring but so sweet and willing to do anything to make sure you get a good grade!
Dont buy the book Some of the book is on google books. Easy grader. Hideous old looking women but very sweet!Taking it pass fail and I never do anything. Still might get a B

I am a nontraditional student and she gave so much home work in this class I could barely keep up. She is very nice but I wouldn't take her again. She also required we summarize three papers we had written during the semester and combine them in the final exam. Not Fun.
She is very sweet and helpful.  The class tends to get a little boring but it is really easy. : )
very boring, but sweet. her accent kept me awake during class.
easy teacher, very sweet and caring about students, just a little boring
No Comments

Professor Ruder is awesome. She is stern, but fair, and cares and checks in on students. She very much wants you to learn Russian, and youll have lots of opportunities for using the language in class. Be sure to do ALL of your hw (even the stuff you dont turn in) bc it shows in class. RUS 101 w/ her was my favorite class of the semester by far.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Honestly the class was mostly boring and her droning on forever. This class was also packed with teachers pets. Ruder herself is fine but dont trust your Canvas grade. I somehow got a 95 on canvas but ended up with a B in the class. She failed to clarify until AFTER grades were finalized too. Shes also super nit picky with weekly assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Ruder is an amazing professor. She cares deeply for all of her students and wants them to succeed in her class. You will have homework everyday, but she gives amazing feedback. During COVID she went went out of her way to make sure students that were quarantined still learned the material and would host private zooms with us.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She is an amazing professor. She is friendly and has a way of explaining things that will make you understand. She also is very helpful and is happy to help you understand what is being taught. If you go to class and put in the effort, she will put in the effort. She also makes a point to know her students. She is a great person and great professor
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: If you are serious about learning the Russian language, do your written homework, do the work in the textbook, and do test corrections if needed. Do not skip the oral drills in the SAM. Participate in class. Ask questions if you're confused. Professor Ruder is a great teacher, and I recommend her to anyone.

Professor Ruder is wonderful. She takes a difficult language, and makes it super interesting and fun to learn. She is extremely helpful both in class and out. Visiting her office hours helps tremendously. She goes out of her way to send each student an email after midterm, and finals, telling them how they are progressing in class.  Recommend!!

Professor Ruder showed up the first day, and didn't speak a word of English for the first 40 minutes. She does everything she can to immerse you in the Russian language. When her class starts, it's like you're studying abroad. Great teacher that makes you work for it.

Professor Ruder is one of my favorite professor. She is so helpful and makes learning Russian so much fun. The class is a lot of work because there is homework every night, but it is worth it in the end.
She's different. But very nice and if you need help she will clear it up for you. Visiting her office hours are way more helpful than asking questions in class. Recommend this class to anyone 9/10.
Professor Ruder is a great professor who is serious about the material she teaches, as well as passionate. Fair, but very stern. Understanding as well.

Crime and Punishment Russia's Realms. I enjoyed this class. We had guest speaker and learned about crime in Russia and other parts of europe and asia. Dr. Ruder is awesome. I am definitely taking her for my foreign language requirements.

Professor is the best foreign language teacher I've ever had. She's energetic, tough, and knowledgeable. Everything a Russian teacher should be. She has very high expectations for her students, so if you're going to take Russian, you had BETTER be willing to work and study until your Russian skills are up to par.
She is one of the best teachers I have ever had!
Awesome teacher that is good at keeping the class moving and entertaining for about 2 hours. I recommend this teacher to all students, even if your major doesn't require languages.

Wonderful professor and class. Very passionate about Russian and very energetic. She has a funny and silly personality and makes the class enjoyable. The class is a lot of work, though, and she expects you work hard for your grade. I recommend her as well. I loved the class.
She's GREAT!  Energetic, passionate!  I'd definitely recommend her!  You'd better study, though - she expects you to work hard (but you learn a lot, so it's worth the time!)

Definitely go to class. She puts notes online but does a lot of examples and gives more info. She explains everything to make it pretty clear. The content itself is tough, but pay attention and do the work and it'll be a lot more manageable. She assigns optional homework and the exams are almost identical problems. She is generous with curves too.

Not the best structure. Tests were worth a whopping 75% of the total grade when more like 60% is acceptable.  Also with no extra credit and one exam with only 25 questions on it there wasn't a lot of breathing room.

Test are tricky actually need to be able to apply the information. Get a cheat sheet for exams that helps a lot. Energetic teacher, can tell she enjoys what she does  and she will always be able to help you if you ask.

Vines is a good teacher. This class is difficult, and she tries to make the topics as understandable as possible for her students. I enjoyed having her in class. She gives out good curves on the exams. Exams are all Multiple Choice with cheat sheet, as well.
Tax is not a great subject to begin with. She tells you at the beginning it's not an easy class which is true. Always go to class and ask questions. Do the homework at the end of the chapters.

I enjoyed Dr. Vines as a teacher. She allows you to have a cheat sheet on the exams and you get to work with your peers on quizzes. If you have a hard time understanding a concept she is willing to meet w/ you outside of set office hours. No complaints. Do the homework, it helps with exams! :)

Liked her as a person, but not as a teacher. Her lectures are useless, all her notes are written on the board and are often chicken scratch. She is very unclear about what is on the exams even though she allows a cheat sheet. Tax is extremely hard and she doesn't help any! And there's no graded homework to balance the awful test grades! :(

I found the lectures useless, she read straight from the slides and wasn't very clear. She could not answer many of the questions raised in class and I don't think that she even made out the exams...If you want to do well, you have to read every detail in the book-which I found difficult to read...Don't take Vines if at all possible.

Terrible. Lectures are useless, slides that don't teach you much. Attendance not mandatory. She doesn't really know what she is talking about. Weekly, open-book quizzes and tests (with a cheatsheet). I was 4 points out of 440 away from an A, she wouldn't give it to me (despite attending class and participating every day). tax sucks in general

Learned about 60% from book, 40% from lectures.  If you don't read carefully, you won't do well.  Tests are not very difficult if you keep up with reading and do homework.  Reading is not a breeze, so be ready to spend some time in this class.

THE WORST PROFESSOR IN ACCOUNTING!!! SHE MAKES EVERY TEST IMPOSSIBLE TO PASS AND YOU ARE REQUIRED TO STUDY 20 HRS A WEEK! NO JOKE! IF YOU WANT TO RUIN YOUR GPA, BUT YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED! STAY AWAY AT ALL COSTS!
I studied for days and got an F on the first test...dropped the class. Asks questions on exams from the freakin footnotes. Take Pope if you have any choice at all.

Not a good teacher at all! Not prepared to teach. Had numerous errors on her quizzes and exams and would get irritated if a student asked her a question. Also she did not understand many concepts in the textbook. Do not take her if at all possible!

Dr. Vines did not understand the textbook most of the time.  If she was asked a question about a point in the book she could not answer it.  She was not prepared for her lectures and would make a flippant remark if the class did not undestand her. Do not take her for tax if at all possible! She is a nice person but can't explain difficult concepts.
Worst teacher I have ever had at the University of Kentucky....tests are rediculous and she cares nothing about her students!!!
Great professor, very effective at explaining taxes and willing to help even more when asked.  Tests aren't too bad if you study some a make a great cheat sheet.
She was a really good teacher that made taxes easy to understand, She also lets you use a cheat sheet on exams whichs helps a ton. I'd highly recommend her.

You get 10 sometimes 20 points of participation for going to class and if you didn't you would lose those. Study guides tell you exactly what's on the exam. Gets from PowerPoints, book, and lecture. 1 group presentation and paper.

Cyndy may have been my favorite professor at UK. Very helpful if you do your end of the work, she can be a tough grader but if you go to her before she will help you succeed to the best of her abilities.  I took both COM 325 and COM 399 with her.  I wish she taught more classes!
Great prof. Will help you in any way possible as long as you are honest with her! Every com student should try and take her!

Great teacher and I really enjoyed her class.  As long as you are upfront and honest with her, she will bend over backwards for her students.  The group project can be difficult, just start early and talk to her about it!

By far one of the best professors at UK. Wish she would teach more classes. Very helpful, test are cake if you study the study guide. Very upfront and honest with you. Would take this class if you had the opportunity. Great class.
She made the class fun, even when it was boring material. I would take her again!

Cyndy is great! She can be a real ball buster at times but she just really wants you to understand this subject. Tests come straight off the study guide and she grades easy on the group presentations. Take her!

Great teacher who explains things well. Tests cover what she teaches in class and the text book. There is a group project... and make sure you are one of the first groups to present... she grades easier that way!
Easy class as long as you make and look over a study guide before exams.

Moves kind of fast but puts all the power points on line. I honestly had a HUGE crush on him which made coming to class easy but it is essential b/c of the quizzes which help cushion your grade if you're not doing well.
His class is very straightforward. He gives study guides which are extremley helpful and he also gives attendance quizes. If you show up, read and study it is easy to get an A.
If you don't plan on reading the book, no need to take the class. Pop quizzes, test are extremely hard. If you read the book, and study like crazy, you'll get at least a B.
awesome teacher, very engaging; tests are difficult, make sure you know details as well as broad topics. If you do the reading prior to class and actually go to class you should get at least a B

He teaches students. He tries to engage students in discussion and makes himself available outside of class. Very understanding, just be honest with him if you have a problem with the class. I would definitely recommend taking his class
Good teacher and easy class.. plus i agree with other person his smile is cute.
He's pretty boring. Just read the book and you'll do fine. Attend if you want that 10%.
Don't take this class! He walks into class and says... so what is this... what is this... what is that. He does not teach at all. This is a complete waste of time!
Pretty cool guy who really tries to engage the class instead of just lecturing.  He is a cutie with a great smile :)
He is like totally cool, but like also a little evil.  I like think he is Assyrian or something, which is quite interesting.
She was  not a really hard teacher but she could be really rude sometimes or come across mean. I personally would not recommend her

Cindy is great. She is funny and keeps the class interesting. She is very knowledgeable about what she teaches and does a good job presenting it. The paper is a bit difficult, but her quizzes and exams are cake.

This is an interesting class and is presented well with lots of video clips, discussions and movies.  Her tests are hard and you have to do the readings...but she is nice and seems like she really cares

I had her for her first year of teaching so I'm sure things will change. Her class was a challenge but she is very helpful and cares about you as an individual. She gives a lot of extra credit opportunities as well. The only bad thing was the group project at the end, but our group made it more of a comedy presentation so it was alot of fun for us.

She was a great teacher! She was hard because she always expected the best from you, but she was always open to help you outside of class. She made the effort to learn all the students' names and cares about each individual. She also gave a ton of extra credit.

She made us write 3 papers, have a miderm and a final, in class assignments, and a group project that was some what pointless all for a 100 level course. She clearly knows her information, she just doesn't really present it that well.
In response to all the other, more outdated, comments about Dr. Crofcheck: she's really not that great. She's mediocre at best.
She is awesome! I would take any class she offers!

She is really easy. Her exams are open book and her questions are good. I'm not saying i didn't learn anything, she just teaches in her own way. She also lets you turn in assignments late if it was had.She gives really good in class notes are really helpfull on exams. She's a lot of fun and is really nice! I would take her for any class she offers.

She makes class time very fun! Loves to help and cracks some jokes. She is more like a friend, and always smiles at you. You don't to feel tense in her class. She also makes sure class is not a playground, she makes you learn. Awesome woman, definitely take her. Her exams also have an open book section for each exam, at least for my class.

This class was very interesting but highly difficulty throughout the year. The news quizzes are the absolute worst because you can be tested on any news article in the WSJ world tab and it can be as niche as him asking about a single random quote from an article. Exams are very difficult and once you answer a question you cannot return to it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really good lectures and you can tell he's really passionate about the subject. He goes into everything in great detail and gives awesome examples

This professor is bad and makes the recitation quizzes based off of news from weeks ago  that isn't recent and still expects us to know every single detail. Even the Ta's won't do anything about it. I'd rather work at starbucks at willy t than ever come to this lecture again.

Attendance is not taken, yet if you miss one class you are kind of done for. He AI proofs his exams so don't cheat, he will be able to tell and will file academic charges against you. His AI proof exams are HARD, I went to all classes and still struggled on the exam so take good notes. But overall I learned so much from him and will be taking again

Absolute GOAT. Don't take if you want an easy class, but he is very intelligent and willing to work with you. An A is not easy but I like how hard you have to work in his class - saves a bit of this majors reputation of being “easy”. Show up to class and be engaged and I doubt you get lower than an 80 percent

Absolute nightmare. He brags about his class being a “hard A” which makes me think he takes joy in tanking his student's GPAs. I barely missed lecture and took notes, yet the exams were still difficult, with many short answer questions and barely any test time. I did well on everything else yet still ended with a D because of the exams. Good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: First off, I love his lectures and his dry sense of humor; they were the best part of the class. After the first exam, apparently there was heavy AI use, which I believe because the lecture hall has been half full since about week 3. Because of this, exam 2 and the final impossible to counter AI use, so be ready

First off- this professor  needs fired. He is a horrendous excuse for a teacher and the most pompous person I have ever had the experience of meeting in my whole existence. He will not communicate with you OR release grades properly. He failed me for suspected ai use and dropped my B to a D one day before grades became final and I NEVER USED AI.

Morey is very pompus and based large chunks of our tests on his own personal belifs. He accused our entire class of cheating and tanked our exam 2 and final grades with intentionally impossible questions. He is a fine lecturer but the tests have very little to do with what he says in the lectures and more on his belifs or random details.

It's an easy class if you actually attend it, attendance isn't required. He posts the lectures but they wont help you unless you go to class. They are more bullet points for him than they are explanations of what you're learning in class.

He fails to realize that others couldn't care less about what he's teaching and aren't experts/don't want to be experts, and grades like it. I hope he reads this and makes his teaching plan more like literally any other teacher for the better good of humanity.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Best professor I have ever taken. Also hardest political science class I have taken. Lots of reading, I would not dare skip class - it's very important. He's amazing. Extremely knowledgeable, keeps lectures interesting and made me want to learn. Would highly recommend taking him over any other PS professor. Took the class randomly, so glad I did.

Dan was by far one of my favorite professors at UK. He genuinely cared about his students and was extremely knowledgeable about the material he taught. I learned so much through this class; even though it was difficult at times, it was never anything unmanageable. I recommend Dan and PS434!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Morey answered my emails very quickly, and his class was my favorite class. His exams were open note, but difficult. If you ask questions and take good notes, you should do well. Study your notes.

Dan was a great lecturer and kept the class interesting even if the topic was not. Class was not mandatory Monday or Wednesday, but you will be lost if you do not go. Since there were very few grades in his class the policy brief and tests matter. This class was hard but if you study and attend lectures you should get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Morey is very knowledgable on his topic he teaches. Throughout my class we didn't have a TA which left him to grade and he even admits he is a tough grader. I felt he was rude to me at time but overall was willing to help!

Dan was such a nice professor and his lectures were very interesting. I will say, he is definitely lecture heavy and if you don't attend, you'll be lost. The tests are important in that class because one bad test grade and you will be spending the rest of the semester trying to catch up (from experience). Tests are open note.

Dan is the goat! While the class is very lecture heavy, he makes them very interesting; and has jokes and stories to go with them. The tests and quizzes are incredibly easy. The policy brief is quite challenging; but as long as you can write at a college level, it shouldn't hurt you to much. Go to class and learn to take good notes.

Dr. Morey is a fantastic professor, very experienced and it shows in lecture. Pay attention in class and be prepared to work and pay attention to current events. If you show up with the right mindset you will be fine, this is the kind of class I expect in higher education and I look forward to taking more of his classes.

Dr. Morey is one of the few professors who actually makes me want to become more involved in the course and topic. He inspired me to pick up a minor in his department. Be ready to write, as this professor heavily favors papers, however, the papers do not have minimum character counts, and you are encouraged to condense it as much as you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: At the beginning of the semester, Dr. Morey told us directly that many people would end with a B/C average and that an A is very hard to achieve in his class. He was not kidding. If you don't do well on the tests, doing good on the other assignments doesn't amount to anything. I'm normally a straight A student and ended with a 78.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I love dan, he's a great prof. Very lecture heavy but he makes them enjoyable. There are current events quizzes every week that help boost your grade if you pay attention to the news. aside from that there's a policy brief and about 3 tests. the class isn't too hard if you put in the work. 10/10 would take again.

Tests are built in a way to confuse students and trick them. There is no curve whatsoever even though the average test grades are in the 60's. The only assignments are two parts to a policy brief paper and three exams, so it is very hard to bring up your grade. Almost all of the class finished with a C. Difficulty depends on the TA.

He's a great professor but there's so much material that is covered throughout the semester. You definitely will need to keep up with your lectures and take good notes. We had quizzes over current news every Friday which were pretty difficult. The written and oral policy briefs were what I struggled with the most. Tests aren't bad if you study lots
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Morey was a great professor. His lectures were easy to follow and he is hilarious. There was a lot of material covered each time the class met, so if you miss a class you will most likely miss important content.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Morey is an outstanding professor that I recommend 100%. All exams have bonus on them and the final exam offered 10 bonus points just by knowing the professor and your TA's name. Easy class to get a B but have to put in extra work for an A. I didn't put full effort into any assignments and had a 77 after the final but he bumped me up to a B

Dr. Morey is a very interesting lecturer. His class is interesting and he explains concepts well. Attendance isn't mandatory, but his powerpoints are pretty vague so it's worth your time to go to class and take notes on what he says. He's also extremely nice if you go to his office hours.

Dan is an amazing lecturer. He is interesting and gives clear explanations for the more complicated concepts. The class itself consists mostly of tests (straightforward if you take notes in class) and a policy paper. He gives clear instructions and the TA's grade fairly.

At the beginning, he told us he was a very hard A and a very hard F. I have had no problem maintaining a solid A throughout the semester. The only downside to Dan is that he thinks he is hilarious because of his "dry humor". I just laugh along with him to get brownie points. As the class goes on, the material gets better. He is one of my favorites.
I was just taking this class for a gen ed, but Dan made it a super interesting class. Great professor.

Dan is the MAN. He is genuinely one of the most intelligent and personable professors I have ever taken. He knows what he's teaching and knows how to communicate that to students. The anecdotes he uses in lectures are entertaining and educational. I would highly recommend him to anyone, even if you aren't majoring in a social science.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Really good professor that is enjoyable to listen to. His classes are very interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I'm a double major in Political Science and thought this class would be a bit boring like mt previous classes/professors. I really like Morey's teaching style because he gives you multiple ways to learn it and it helps when he connects it to everyday life. You will have to show up to class because if you miss, you won't get enough info on things.

Professor Morey is one of the best Professors I've had at the University of Kentucky. He made International Relation fun and the lectures were very interesting. The tests we not difficult. The papers are a lot of work but as long as you put in the effort you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Best professor at UK. I had him for Contemporary Global Conflicts. The man is an absolute genius and his lectures are wonderful (he has the best narrating voice). Also his lectures, unlike certain other PS profs, are very informative and interesting. He gives a good amount of homework and tests, but they are easy if you listen and really care!

Dr. Morey made you like international politics as much as he did, which is saying something. No book, but you have to read 4-5 articles on Wall Street Journal each week. Interesting material, and good lecturer. Not the kind of class you can skip and hope to pass, and you need to take good notes.

Favorite professor I've had so far! Morey really knows the material, making class a lot more engaging. The subject matter is interesting & Morey is pretty funny. There were 2 exams, both easy if you went to class & took notes. Tests are essentially right out of the notes-- he even gives you study guides to fill out for exams. Loved the class.

Dr. Morey is a fun professor with material that is easy if you pay attention/take notes. Exams are made in a way to confuse students, all trap-door or "gotcha" questions. Seems like an attempt to make easy material seem harder or more relevant than it is. Regardless, enjoyable topic with smart professor. Who the TA is could really impact clarity.
Dan is a great lecturer. He is very clear and relatable. The exams are pretty much exactly what he talks about in lecture, so as long as you pay attention and study a bit they're pretty easy.
Very clear and makes the class interesting. Both TA's were very helpful as well.

The hardest part of this class was figuring out how to unfold and turn the pages of the Wall Street Journal without looking stupid. Morey talks more than he teaches because the content is so natural to him. The content was interesting and easy to handle. A general feeling of pleasure and warmth sticks with the memory of his class.

Really cool class that expands on a lot of the theories you learn in 235. If you enjoy the concepts of war, this is the class for you. I'm not a PS major, but have taken several for my area of focus within my major, and this was the best PS class I've taken. Really cool stuff. Dan is a great teacher too. Highly recommend this one.
Dr. Morey is a great guy! He is very helpful and is pretty available. He recquires a research paper thats extensive and his tests are a bit difficult. But a very interesting class!

Favorite class in college. Incredible teacher, uses great powerpoints, nothing is too difficult. However, he does require you to pay attention to current events outside of class. Will be honest in saying that my recitation was 9a.m. Friday morning, went hungover to this a few times, still escaped overall class with a mid 90's grade. Great class ;)

I really would struggle to find a critique of "Dan" as a teacher. Excellent teaching techniques, clearly, clearly knew the information he was teaching us, and he you could just tell it was what he was interested in. He's an experienced teacher as well. Hands down my favorite class so far in college.
He is an excellent prof and makes class worth while.

Dr. Morey's class was great. He did not require textbook reading at all, as everything you needed came from lecture. No bogus attendance policy, and he even ended up making our final optional if you were pleased with your grade!

Great teacher, makes going to class fun and always tends to bring a laugh and good conversation. Very friendly, helpful, accessible, and teaches from PPTs that share pretty interesting concepts for such a boring general subject area. Class attendance is recommended.

Dr. Morey is well-informed and definitely knows what he is talking about.  His lectures are well-structured and follow the material presented in the textbook.  Tests are difficult, but manageable if you study his notes and sit through the review prior to each test day.

International Relations class tought by young Ph. D professor who knows his stuff. The class is somewhat rough. No homework or reports, but your grade is only based on 2 midterms and a final. The stuff he lectures makes up roughtly 75% of the tests. I stress 100% attendence, otherwise you'll be lost, even from missing one class. Class fulfills USP.
so annoying and do not care about me
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I took his class online, and there aren't many assignments. His quizzes are relatively easy to get through, and there's one medium-sized paper. Either he or his TA is a harsh grader, but it doesn't affect your grade too much. I'd say it's an easy class to take if you need credits; just put effort into the assignments he gives.
Definitely a super fun class and keeps you engaged. Attendance isn't required at first but then he started giving extra credit for coming to class at the end of the semester.

CHE 105 is difficult in general but I personally was not a fan of his lecture style/pacing. I recommend studying with course objectives and the previous CHE 105 exams. If you don't understand a problem, take the time to work it out because they usually come up on the actual exam.

Nice guy who loves making jokes in lecture. He is super nice, and this class is quite easy. The lab is harder than the lecture but he doesn't really have much control over that. Just do the problems he suggests for homework (no graded/collected hw) and you will do well!
Dr. Derouchey is very funny and knows what he's talking about. He makes a difficult class interesting!

DeRouchey administers written only exams, however, he gives heavy partial credit and lets you drop your lowest exam. The only grades for the semester are exams and lab reports, there is no homework or extra assignments. The lab is very fun and the reports are very standard.

He was a great teacher! I hadn't taken chemistry since my sophomore year of high school but the way he explained things really made since. Make sure you do well on the pre-tests and if you want a good grade in the class be willing to put in 5-8 hours of studying for the tests. Practice problems are the way to go!

I took AP Chemistry in high school, so this class was fairly easy for me but the lectures seem to drag on for a very long time. It also gets a little annoying when he tells the class one thing and then seems to get confused and say the opposite.

Overall this class in general is very hard, especially if you don't know about chemistry. There is a lot of information covered in a very short amount of time. With a background in chem, I think Derouchey does a pretty good job of explaining the concepts in class. Make sure you pay attention and take notes. Studying for the tests is essential.
Dr. DeRouchey was a great professor for someone like me (a student with no clue about chemistry).  I would definitely recommend him to anyone

Enjoyed the class a lot.  Makes a tedious class entertaining with his humor.  As someone else said, all you need to get an AB in this class is do the work.  Read the book, do  the assignment and quizzes, study for the tests.
Hilarious and a genius; great combo. Do the online hw, make sure to preform well on quizes, and put in at least 5 hours of actual studing for each exam, and youre on your way to a AB

He presents all the material in a clear, logical way. He'll always do example problems and is happy to answer questions. He often times puts funny memes or pictures on slides. My only complaint is that he moves through the information a bit too quickly for me to keep up and take notes, but it's all in the book anyway.

Dr. DeRouchey is definitely one of the better professors for CHE105. His notes are helpful, and he's very willing to re-explain anything during his office hours. He moves at a very good pace compared to other professors - not too slow or fast. He reviews the material learned in the last class at the beginning of class which is a nice refresher.
He makes chemistry fun and significantly easier to understand. He's also hilarious &gives a lot of free points during lectures. If you pay attention and take good notes, you'll pass.
He was a great teacher and so funny. I had to drop the class just because of exams. Great teacher though.

Thought he was great and very funny.  I think people saying he only read off slides weren't listening - he added lots of things.   A minor complaint, I think he should skip a little more in the notes and do more practice problems in class to prep for exams.

Overall I had a bad experience in his class. They are very boring and he just reads off the power point with a few examples thrown in there. He seems very intelligent but he just cant convey the material in an understanding way. If you struggle with Chemistry I would avoid taking him.

He was excellent. While it was dissapinting that he went by the books so much, he really helped by explaining the material in a way that was understandable. He made the class fun and enjoyable by telling joks. He was very hazy with some of the math involved, but my TA i think her name was Jaimee, she was really excellent with teaching th math.
Pretty decent teacher when comes to chemistry. Always tries to relate to students and make jokes. Just come to class, study like you should, do your homework and know when to ask for help :)

Did well making the class amusing/worth going to. For example, he always started class with a funny cartoon. Also, he responds well if you email him questions - prompt/good information in return. Helped me not fall asleep for (most) of the classes.
Very personable and keeps attention.  He did great.
I took 105 last year.  Dr. DeRouchey made this class as enjoyable as a horrible subject like General Chemistry can be.  He was funny and did a great job making this class tolerable.
Taught the material well.  Has a good sense of humor.  It was a good class overall.
Great teacher, fun to be in class, will help through problems.  He rushes and makes some mistakes but was good about fixing it.  Makes the lecture worth going to

I really enjoyed his style of teaching.  Treated us like adults, showed us there was more than one way to solve problems, and did a lot of problems with us in class.  Not the most exciting material but Dr. DeRouchey did a good job getting us through it.

This class is very fair. Sometimes his methods are confusing, but the majority of this class is GenChem so use the techniques you already know if he confuses you. The lab is part of the class, but it's straightforward and fairly simple. His tests pulls questions directly from class examples and the recommended practice problems from the textbook.
These people complaining he is a bad teacher have no idea.  I had a truly bad Gen. Chem. teacher last year at UK and failed badly.  This semester was much better and I passed.

Nice Guy. Terrible teacher. He merely reads the powerpoint. The one time I attended his office hours to ask him a question on homework he forced me to use my last attempt on an answer that was obviously wrong... Learned my lesson... the hard way...

Good teacher but new to teaching 105. Real problem is General Chemistry in general is kind of boring but he explains things well. Worked several old exam questions which really helped me for taking the exams.  Was also really helpful outside of class as well.  I would recommend him

I don't care that he says this is his first time teaching this course. He is horrible. So boring. Just reads the ppt slides that are premade from the textbook company. He only does the examples that are already in the book, no additional. He can't explain anything clearly. He's making it difficult to understand. Doesn't care for the basics.

Nice guy, but all he did was read from the powerpoint slides that were premade by the textbook company. But you have to go to class to answer the clicker questions... I Think he said it's his first time teaching the class and he's a higher level teacher, so he doesn't care for the basics.

While not the easiest class I've ever taken, DeRouchey's class was straight forward and not overly difficult. The lab has been reworked since I took his class, but it wasn't too bad. He's very friendly and helpful if you get to know him! And his tests aren't so bad if you do the suggested homework.

Easy class if you don't follow his over-complications.  Just do stoich the way you feel comfortable doing it, and you should do fine in this class.  Once I started using his stoich methods with converting stuff to mg and mM and just weird and unnecessary conversions, I did horrible.  Luckily, he drops the lowest test grade.

Dr. DeRouchey is easily one of my favorite professors thus far in my collegiate career. He is a very friendly guy who is also a good teacher. He definitely puts effort into his lectures and questions.

His lectures were very tedious and his examples were overly complicated. He wrote in tiny handwriting on the board with a large class. He did not explain things clearly and relied heavily on the book. The book was published in 2000 and explains little about the actual topics. Instead, it teaches how to use Excel 2000, which he assigns as homework.

I loved taking this class! Professor Dewitt is the absolute best! The class is once a week and she gives you notes to fill in during lecture. Your grade is based solely on in class attendance and quizzes after class. She very clearly lays everything out and it's on you to study for the exam at the end. All in all she is great and so is the class!

This is a very fast-paced class, so it was loaded with homework. All the quizzes she does and the case studies are all really helpful in passing successfully the certification. Her lectures are precise and helpful, go hand in hand with the book but be ready to read because not everything can be covered in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Ms. DeWitt is AWESOME. Her lectures are actually enjoyable because she tries to engage the class, rather than standing at the front of the room and boringly lecturing AT the class. I would definitely take another one of her classes again.
She is a caring professor and is helpful outside of class.

Truly my most favorite professor so far, she genuinely cares about the grades her students get and she wants you to do well. She tries her darn best to make the more boring lectures interesting, and she is truly a kind soul. She cares about your future, she just wants the best for everyone.

Professor DeWitt is an amazing, kind woman. Her lectures are very interesting if you are an Agriculture student- otherwise; they can be pretty boring. This is not her fault however! She always encourages us to reach out with questions, and always has her best intentions for us. I very highly recommend Professor DeWitt.

I took MUS140 this semester for my natural sciences credit. This class was easy. I like that she gives 3 tries on quizzes so that you can try again if you get a bad score. She doesn't assign much work, usually only 2 assignments a week occasionally there might be a third one. I would 100% take another class with her.

One of the easiest classes I've ever taken. Easy to navigate through and you can easily work ahead and finish the class early. She gives great feedback on assignments and is a VERY lenient grader. The class is pretty fun in general and I highly recommend taking it!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: This class was online so I did not have the pleasure of meeting Professor Deen but she was great during the class and laid everything out for us the first week and then set us free to work. If you needed help you could just email her and she would get back quickly plus none of the assignments are that hard. Great professor and class overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Course is well-organized, but modules are locked until you've completed the ones before, so I'd recommend asking for rubrics for bigger assignments ahead of time so you know what to expect sooner than later. If you aren't a bio or chem person, take this class for a science credit. Probably the easiest course you'll take even if you aren't musical.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She lets you know right away what she expects from each assignment, the weekly quizzes and discussions arent hard and you get multiple chances as well. The final seemed worrisome at first but it wasnt hard and she gives helpful guides.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Deen is a gem. Her class is ridiculously easy and fun! She is an easy grader, but there are a lot of assignments (discussion posts and chapter quizzes) but they are easy to complete. She really enjoys teaching and you can tell by the way she treats her students. She understands that we have other classes and is very understanding.

Professor Deen is an extremely organized individual. I always knew what to expect from my assignments. I was able to complete most of the points for the class within the first few weeks of school. She also gives very helpful feedback. Great professor, would take again! Definitely need the book if you want to pass the quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: I took this class to fulfill a UK Core requirement, and it was one of the best courses I've ever taken. Dr. Deen has the entire course available, so you can work ahead if you want. Super easy and manageable. Plus, she grades fairly easy on assignments. No exams, and only one paper, but it's easy.
Super easy, manageable online class. Solid choice. 30 minutes to 1 hour a week at most spent working on the assignments.

This is the PERFECT class if you need a science requirement filled and you hate science. Dr. Deen makes everything crystal clear as to what is expected and gives you plenty of opportunity to score higher if you bomb on a quiz. There are no tests either which is AWESOME. One pretty big paper but again, you cannot fail if you just follow instructions
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Took this class to fulfill a UK Core requirement, definitely recommend. The class setup is simple, weekly discussion boards and quizzes and occasional sprinklings of other assignments. Dr. Deen gives good feedback and is really flexible with due dates. Overall very easy and interesting class
Take her. This woman is a gift from God. Take the class just for fun, to learn some interesting stuff, an easy A.

Very nice teacher, encourages questions during class, and is fair on grading. Attendance isn't mandatory but the subject is nearly impossible to learn on your own. No cumulative final. Your test grades will reflect your in class notes so make sure you put maximum effort into them and stay organized.
Hard to understand at first.  2 homework assignments each week and 4 exams throughout the semester.  If your good at math and can teach yourself you'll do fine with him.

Avoid at all cost! I had AP Calculus my senior year of high school, then arriving at UK I figured college algebra would be a breeze, but this man makes it seem like Latin. I have no idea how, but he's horrible! I had to show him how to use a function on the calculator. Says "Uhmm..." way too much. Doesn't seem like he knows how to teach.

If you arent very good at math, dont take this teacher.  He doesnt explain things very well.  Takes attendance every day.  Notes are easy though and hes a cool teacher.  I'm pretty good at math and i got an A.  Tests are exactly like the review ones that we look over the day before exams.

Dr. Ding is very kind, caring & lenient either his students, though it is hard to understand everything in class & he expects prior knowledge in this very math heavy course. Half of the topics may go over your head but he makes it up by generously awarding points. There were 12 hws worth 45%, and 3 exams worth 5%, the last one was a take home exam.
MA 321 - For Numerical Methods, Professor Lu was fantastic. He was really passionate about the topics covered, explained them exceedingly well, and was also very kind. Easy course if you do math.

Until the last moment, he keeps teaching without offering test guidance. He said the final exam would have 6 questions, but there were 9. The curriculum is packed and relies on prior knowledge, yet he offers no background information. When asked for clarification, he says, "You should know it." Midterm consisted of 7 HW, while final covered all 12.

Had him for Calc 4. He was okay at teaching, although his lectures were a bit dry. In my opinion, kind of average. In the last unit, kind of assumed that everyone had taken linear algebra (it is not a prerequisite for this class), but other than that nothing too objectionable. Tests aren't too difficult, and he allows a page of notes on each test.

Professor's teaching lacked clarity, rushing through new topics with little explanation. Answers were final, lacking essential reasoning. HW was often due, especially over weekends, leaving no preparation time. Exams and HW did not receive feedback. HW 11 and 12 were due on the last day of the semester 'Reading day', contrary to university policy.

He tries to make it fun, but it can be hard with staying focused with his monotone voice. Lectures can be hard to understand because of little background of information you get. He does daily attendance with Iclicker and that will affect your grade, it is based on how well you do on the questions and most are open response.

Personality wise, he's a super nice guy and he means well. With regards to the course, this was a HARD class! Probably the hardest one that I have taken so far at UK. I did not like the material and I could not focus very often. I tried my best and I ended up just barely passing the class. I don't blame it entirely on Dr. Lu, though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This is without a doubt the worst class I've ever taken. This class is less a diffs class and more like a proof/trig class. The tests and quizzes are so long you can't complete them. Test qs just as difficult as hw qs. Hw takes hrs and you never see full solutions. Outside sources don't help, clarification doesn't help, do yourself a favor- AVOID.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I have this teacher for calc 4. He is a first year professor and it shows. It seems as if he is used to being a professional student and not a professional teacher. He very rarely uses specific examples in lecture and does not explain questions clearly. For my class, exams and quizzes take up 90% of the grade collectively. Bad grading scale.

Ding Lu is another great example of the university of Kentuckys ability to hire someone who is probably great at research and horrible at teaching. Seems to be the only thing they care about in the math department. I will be learning calc 4 on my own, as I have with every other calculus taken here. He copys the book directly to the chalk board.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: 8 quizzes and 6 tests. His tests are clearly not written by him and pull questions that don't relate to what we learned. Find another professor if you can, the class shouldn't be hard. He makes it hard.
Would not recommend.

He was a very kind teacher, but not a very good teacher. It was hard to study for tests because there would be things we did not directly talk about on them. The class is graded on tests, quizzes, and in class assignments. All of the quizzes are online but everything else is usually in person. I would not take him again.

As very academic student, this professor does not teach anything that goes on his tests. He only tests your knowledge through multiple quizzes and exams monthly. The lectures are very base level and the exams are advanced material we have never covered. Wouldn't recommend, have to teach yourself.

Tough grader and doesn't grade against any objective grading material, but rather her own opinion. I'm almost done with the program and she's the only professor who I've had any kind of grading issues with. Not sure how she's made it this far as a social work professional when she lack basic social work competencies herself.
Really interesting course content, but grading is extremely opinion based. Had to reach out and ask questions ab feedback because it just did not make sense Ever
Not helpful and not compassionate. Do not recommend. Was graded poorly for her own opinion rather than facts.

As a social work professional, she does not treat her students as if they are social workers in training but rather treats them as less than individuals that are not allowed to make mistakes. Very hard grader. do not recommend. the course content was interesting but lacked assignments that followed that engaged me as a student.
She is an incredibly tough grader and does not give leeway for students. She is a social worker, but does not show any social worker tendencies with her students.

Dr Dicken was a decent professor and I learned a lot in her course, but I feel like she was unwilling to work with students. I had some tough circumstances and she turned me away. I have had great experiences with all other professors at UK besides her.
"Hands off" is an understatement.  Most classes are taught by guests or videos.  It was disappointing to feel like my professor wasn't interested in actually teaching.

This was an elective about Informal Learning in info orgs. The content was interesting and the course was primarily just discussion boards. There were a couple of papers but it was super easy to get an A. Her teaching method is hands off because she wants us to interact and share our knowledge with our peers.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: She was one of the best professors I've had. I took this class for UK Core, and it was actually interesting, because the topics are relevant relate to things we endure today. She is very understanding. No test or quizzes.

She seems smart, but all the lectures are from guests so I never felt like she was teaching me. Once, her guest lecturer fell through so we just didn't have a video lecture at all that week. It wasn't a bad class, but I felt taught by guests and the textbook.

This rating is for EE 685. Dr Deitz is an extremely smart man and is an expert in computer architecture. The course is pretty rigorous, exams are hard if you study one week before finals so study regularly. He does grade pretty liberal though. Grading is 40% assignments, 20% midterm and 40% finals. DO NOT SKIP ANY LECTURES OR YOU WILL BE LOST.

The course was very organized and I felt that Dr. Dietz was good at explaining technical concepts in simple language. But be ready for trick questions on exams, especially about Verilog syntax elements that weren't covered in class.

Occasionally willing to accommodate you if you've had trouble keeping up. Nice and cracks jokes but stern, doesn't mince words. HIGHLY recommended you take EE282 before you take 380, you might be lost otherwise. Doesn't always explain things very well but lots of resources. Exams are select all that apply and short answer, lots of partial credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Dietz really gets a bad rap. His classes are hard, but you will learn a ton in them. His lectures can drag on, but they are very informative and I've never needed a book for one of his classes. For project based classes, he only counts half off for documented bugs (even to the level where you can get a 50% just by saying it doesnt work at all)
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: His exams and homeworks stay roughly the same year to year so you can find old ones online everywhere. You don't really need the book and half the class never shows up.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dietz's EE380 is a strange beast; he talks way over everyone's heads, and most of what he says isn't even on HW or exams, but the class itself is pretty easy. The few HW assignments are short and easy (with the answers all over the internet) and his exams barely change from semester to semester. Study old exams and a good grade is likely.

His lectures were sometimes a drag, which is why half the class never shows up.  I did, however, think Prof. Dietz did a good job telling us about what we needed to know for homework and tests.  He also seemed to want everyone to do well.  Really as long as you find old tests you should be able to do fine in this class.

Easily the worst professor I've ever had. No helpful feedback. Lectures drown on for what feels like an eternity. He uses his own server so it crashes just about every lecture and he ends up talking about nothing related to the class. Pray you can find old tests. He should NOT be teaching.

Dietz gets a bad rep, but it's mostly because he teaches the first difficult class you'll take as a CSCEEE major. The material is tough, but he knows his stuff. No real curveballs on the exams, but the sheer amount of material makes them difficult. Minimal homework (4 assignments all semester). Helpful if you can track him down.

I tried to tag Dietz, but there was no tag for "biggest chode you've ever met in your life". He uses his own server for slides and homework that crashes about 11 times a week and cracks jokes that maybe one person has laughed at all semester. Sometimes it's like I want to rip my own arm off just so that I have something to beat him with.

This class is honestly the biggest joke of the entire EE curriculum. I go to class every day and attempt at taking notes even though everything he says is over everyone's head anyways. The man loves to brag to the class about his accomplishments and prove how "smart" he is. And no Dr. Dietz I have no clue what is going on in your class.

the class is tough. and you don't know what to study. he don't use the book and the slides don't have any explanation. it is hard to find him. although if he is there he will help you. the worse thing is the class is so big. i believe this course need to be small classes

Worst professor I've had so far. He will not return exams or post assignment grades unless you ask. Half the content covered in lecture is not on exams. It's hard to study for exams because of this very reason. The best thing is to find old exams and learn them.

Dr. Dietz is one of the most intelligent professors I have ever had.  I've learned a lot from this class but there is so much material it is hard to stay with him.  If you want to be successful in this class look at the outlines he posts online then read about the topics in the book.  Solutions to HW are online, exams are like HW, find old exams.

Ask "is everyone getting this?" like 5 times every class. Teaches us about his life more than the material. Also has you use his simulator that has little to no documentation and throws random C syntax errors that you can't troubleshoot because it is his CGI server.

Dr. Dietz knows his stuff inside, outside, forwards, and backwards. He posts many class-related resources to his website, and is generally available after class for questions. Be warned: homework assignments are difficult and lengthy. Tests aren't terrible, but make sure to understand the MIPS architecture and assembly code, not just memorize it.

Dr. Dietz is the worst professor I have ever had. His lectures consist of him talking about himself and nothing related to the material. You have to find his old tests to do well and even then you might be lucky to get a good grade. He doesn't need to be teaching.

He is a terrible professor. He's too involved in his own little super computer bubble world. Sadly there's no other professors to teach this class. He is a smart guy but a terrible professor. The class needs to be completely restructured and assigned a new professor.

Boring class and he's too smart to be a  teacher, but this stuff is difficult so I can't blame him. I'm just squeaking past, not sure what I'm even doing. That being said, he is a really cool guy if you talk to him. Not the worst class you'll take.
Don't buy the book. Going to class will leave you confused. Learn the assembly code for sure. Study for the tests by looking at CollegeTestVault and old homeworks.

Impossible to pay attention in class. He just rambles on about how much he knows, will reference super computers at least 5 times per class and talk about the amazing things he did once upon a time before he was washed up. Terrible class, too bad you have no other options. You will leave everyday and not know what the you should have just learned

He likes to brag about his contributions to modern society a lot. This is a relatively difficult class that Dietz makes even harder with his poor teaching style. Difficult from and EE or CS perspective.

Find old tests; pay complete attention in class; start the homework as soon as assigned as it usually takes longer than you expected; get help from the grader. More interesting subject than I expected, but professor likes to demonstrate how much he knows.
No Comments

Hard to follow.  BORING!  He'll ask you four or five times during class if "everyone is getting this" and noone will answer because noone knows what he is talking about.  He's a great teacher if you already know all about this subject.  Unfortunately, he's the only teacher for this class at UK.

Content is not terribly difficult, but she makes it more confusing. She is lecture heavy and doesn't post the slides, so you need to jot down everything. Barely any assignments so it's hard to come back from bad grades. Tests are hard and difficult to study for. She constantly reminds you she has a PHD and the TAs are hard to understand most times.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I really liked her and her lectures, and the content of this course was actually easy to understand. We had a a relatively short textbook we used at the first half of the semester and a novel for the second half. If you read what you're supposed to, it's an easy A. The TAs were also SO nice and personable.
She's super nice. Attendance matters tho. Class is easy if you show up
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Had an entire 30 minutes of a 50 minute lecture dedicated to a random presentation from one of her TA's wasting class time. 0/5 would not recommend

attendance is 100% mandatory with zero grace for even one absence. any absence will affect your grade. only grades out of 100pts  (all papers, quizzes, or exams) if you bomb one thing you will never be able to recover. reads directly off slides and lecture is completely pointless. acts like ant160 is the end all be all of the world.

If an advisor recommends this course for you change it & them. She assigns a project of you going to interview "someone who doesn't look like you" and do the project based on her rubric and present it with 4 reflection papers and you have to state what she said during a lecture and she rambles all the time and the person grading it isn't even there

Dr. King is a very unnecessarily difficult professor. There are no grace absences and participation is mandatory. She grades very hard on papers and fails most people on the final project. Even if you go to extra help, you are most likely not getting a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Went into this class thinking DK would be boring and unreasonable due to these reviews, but that wasn't the case at all. The lectures can get boring, but DK herself is an interesting person with good talking points and clever analogies. The curriculum is straight forward and there aren't too many assignments. Helpful, kind, and passionate professor
I would advise not to take this class. Save yourself the stress
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Diane King's class is unstructured and honestly uninteresting. Graded by too few papers and graded too harshly. Final project being worth 60% of your grade makes it tough to care about the smaller assignments anyways.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You have to read 3 book and have reflection papers over them. I took this class for my GenEd credit and it was to much work and too time consuming. She is very passionate about Anthropology and I am not at all even more so after taking her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is horrible at emails (you often have to contact her multiple times and hope that she chooses to respond to you). Also, her class is 100% just the various books that we read and quizzes/discussions about them. She barely teaches as she assigns students to teach the class about the books each class. She also does not prove helpful on our project
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Be prepared not to have any elaboration about what is on exams, the most I received was "chapters ___, lecture notes, and films." Lectures are very fast-paced and slides are often skipped over because "everything is in the book." Also be prepared to read loads of chapters before each exam, since she requires 3 books for the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor King treats this class as if it's the end all be all of college courses. Don't think that because it is a 100 level course that this is an easy class. The exams were based more on opinions than actual facts and the TAs were the only reason many people knew anything to study.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: You have to read 3 books and write 6 two page reflection papers. Attendance is mandatory and she doesn't post the lecture notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Greetings. Can you hear me in the back?
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I dread going to this class every day. We either watch a video in a different language or listen to a rambling lecture. Attendance is mandatory and it is taken every day. The papers are graded ridiculously hard for no reason. The tests are pretty easy if you pay attention in class. Other than the papers and readings, there is no "homework".

This is my second review because this class has made me so angry. Literally, do not take this class with her you will regret it I promise. No matter how good of a writer you are you will get points marked off for something on top of the fact papers are only worth 5 points so you will struggle. I hope no one signs up for her 160 class ever again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--SO MANY PAPERS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Grades r mostly determined by papers that are worth 5 points, the TAs & prof grade them like they're psychotic. We were told that everyone would do poorly on the first paper, everyone got around a 2/5, 2nd one was not much higher & anyone w/ a brain knows that is a very low %. Dr. King needs to get off her high horse this is an elective.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She is okay, depends on the TA though.

Her lectures were easy to follow but very boring. The first and third exams were super hard, but the second was fairly easy. The only problem is she should change her grading systems because she does it out of 100 points just. Lastly, TAs grade papers way too hard in this class and very unfairly. Choose another core class if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: The class grade was determined out of 100 points, 55 of which come from the three exams. 30 come from six two-page reflections over the assigned reading. The textbooks are far more interesting than any lecture will be, but you have to gobecause she takes attendance (10 points of the final grade). If you can handle monotony, take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. King's lectures tend to be extremely boring, but you really just need to sit and write down what she puts in her slides. ANT 160 is a fairly easy course- there are just six (small and easy) papers and three exams. The first exam was much more difficult than the second. You must read in order to complete the six papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I had her for her first semester teaching Intro to International Studies, she often just spoke about herself and didn't have any good quality lectures. We had reading assignments for every class, and TA did most grading. Papers were small but there was a lot of them. Tests were sometimes completely irrelevant to lecture and class material.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Very smart woman, but doesn't care whatsoever about teaching her students. She doesn't want to meet you outside of class and doesn't care if you pass or fail. Readings of over 100 pages per week of dense material. Treats class like grad school. Her instructions are very unclear, yet she does not welcome questions in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS
