ONLY take if you are an accounting major. Homework heavy and takes hours, be prepared to put a minimum of 15 hours a week into this class. Exams, good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Terrible mistake taking this professor, thought I could handle it after reading the reviews of her, but honestly I was just straight up wrong. There were 5 people I knew who dropped the class, plus me. The exams were pretty difficult considering it's a basic accounting course. She doesn't give the exams back to you or go over any of the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: She is extremely unreasonable and grades very hard. Acts as if you have no other classes, homework assignments take hours upon hours. She'll scream at you if you take pictures of her lecture power points or if you bring a mechanical pencil to a test. DO NOT TAKE AT ALL COSTS
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Let me put it this way, I've never gotten a grade lower than a B in my whole life. I spent 12 hours a week on this class. I did all the homework (which is awful) and didn't miss a single class. I got a 59 and I have never gave so much effort to one class. Avoid at all costs
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Most difficult professor I've had my whole college career. Test are about 15 pages long and every question is at least 5 parts. Quizzes bring grade down and homework is difficult and takes hours to do, but only worth few points in the end. If you can take another professor I strongly encourage it.

If you are an accounting major this class is very helpful. However, if you are not. DROP THE CLASS. The homework is impossible. Her in class quizzes are really hard and bring down your grade. As well as the exams are impossible and super hard. I would not recommend you taking this class if you can find a better teacher.

Toughest professor I have had to date, shes not terrible at teaching the material but if you dont read and prepare ahead of time you will not be able to understand anything in class, she expects an unreasonable amount out of her students, if you bring a mechanical pencil to an exam you will get yelled at, be prepared to teach yourself from the book

Professor Miller is not easy. BUT, if your an accounting major like me you should take her. She makes you learn a lot about Financial accounting and I am actually grateful that I took her. Yes her exams are hard. Yes her homework can be hard. But read the book and GO VISIT HER IN HER OFFICE!! If you go see her she will help you out!!
Worst professor I have ever taken. 4.0 student that had to drop the class due to the unnecessary work she included. Taking her course hurt my grades in my other courses.

Professor Miller is a very intelligent person and is a great accounting teacher. If you're an accounting or finance major, you want to take Miller because she will prepare you for your major. This class is so important and Miller is the professor to take. If you're not an accounting or finance major, you may have a harder time in the class.

If you have a good handle on accounting, take her! She will help you and you'll learn a lot. If you don't and still decide to take her, may God have mercy on your soul. This is not an easy course, she is not an easy grader, and if you aren't buckled down you will not succeed.   Goodluck.

Be prepared to go to class and pay attention. Make sure you know every single detail about everything.  Read notes and book.  really nice in office hours and definitely learned a lot. takes a lot of time, be prepared

MUST go to class for (hard) clicker questions. TEXTBOOK is your best friend. Helps make the homework easy. For tests, I pretty much just read and took notes on the textbook. DON'T just know how to do things vaguely, know exactly why and how and effects of changes. The tests expect you to know info VERY well. Overall a GREAT class to learn ACC201.

She is by far the worst professor/teacher I have ever experienced in all of my 19 years of life. She doesn't give tests back, so you don't know what you're doing wrong to fix it and that, to me, is the reason why I'm not progressing in the class. Therefore, I dropped it. She is VERY strict about rules and attendance and grades and even for exams.
I cannot write a nasty enough comment. Hands down worst teacher EVER to have been experienced. Seriously the worst mistake you will ever make.
Don't do it

Attendance, completing the homework, and paying attention is necessary to pass. She gives no sympathy to those who skip class then ask questions. She is a nice lady and cares about her students, just as long as you show you care about her class. Must read the book and look over notes if you expect to do well on the exam

At all costs do not take her as your accounting professor. Not helpful. Horrible teacher. Lectures to fast and gives too much homework without explaining it at all. Worst class I have ever been a part of.

DO NOT SKIP CLASS. She tends to not help students who do not take the time to attend lectures. The less you attend the less she is willing to help and the less lenient she will be on your exams. Lectures are difficult to follow unless you print off every-single-chapter outline. I would avoid her and smigla unless you are an accounting major.

She has some of the most unorganized presentations for notes that I've ever seen. Uses animations and (tries) to color code EVERYTHING which its extremely distracting and confusing. Did not answer my emails in a reasonable time..  skip one class, and she won't help you. BEWARE. I would never recommend this Professor to anyone.

One of the most rigorous, demanding courses I've ever taken. However, she will always be willing to help you and answer questions that you have. With that said, do not expect her to baby you and spoonfeed you. If you want a solid understanding of accounting and don't mind devoting lots of time to it, take her.

She gets an awful reputation around campus but is easily the most helpful teacher I've ever had. If you go thru her notes, listen to her, and don't cheat on the hw you will get an A. She may be harder than most teachers but because of her I didn't even have to attend my ACC 202 class because it was so much easier.  Actually teaches the stuff to you

Ms. Miller was one of the toughest professors I've had but I also learned more about accounting from her than most of my peers did taking the same class under a different professor. While she is tough, if you are planning on going into the accounting field, she is the professor for you. She is also easy to talk to in her office hours & very helpful

She is tough but if you go to every class and pay attention you can get an A.  I found the class to be interesting and I am not an accounting major.  Read her syllabus and  you will be fine.  I did all the homework the day it was due and then studied for a couple hours.  Go review your tests.  Anytime I had a question she addressed it the same day.

Professor Miller teaches 201 Accounting at a 301 level. If you enjoying Accounting, or plan on being an Accountant, take her, she's the one for you. If you're not an Accounting Major you will not pass her class. And if you do, your other grades will suffer, and you will still get a C in her class; after focusing 3 hours a day on her material alone.

Miller is a very nice lady. But that is probably the only good thing she has going for her. DO NOT TAKE HER! Her exams are impossible...  I studied for each exam for over 40 hours the week prior to taking them but the material in the book and on the homework did not help on the exams and her lectures are pretty useless too. Avoid Miller at all cost

She really believes that if she says something enough that it will stick. The problem is that she uses abbreviations like this before explaining what they stand for. She had some of the worst organization I have ever seen in any presentation (yes including those 3rd grade book reports). Would definitely not have anyone I know take her class.

Really pretty bad. Readings, homework and lectures do not have anything to do with each other and will not help you on the exams. Homework takes at least 3 hours to complete. Exams are next to impossible. This class is what made me decide to switch majors. DO NOT TAKE!!!

Powerpoint slides would never help on the exam. Even you have excuse absence, you are not gonna have make up quiz. Anything she teaches in the class might help 10% of the exams. NEVER recommend her at all.

Cynthia Miller is a great professor who really knows what she is doing but her teaching style and class material  and exams are very tough, she really wants her students to exceed. Spent 4-8 hrs doing each homework assignment. You must go to her office hours is u plan to do well and really understand the materials.

At first, I was worried about this class because of what I have heard about Ms. Miller. However, she has ended up being one of the better teachers I have had at UK. If you are willing to put in the time, this class is not impossible. Miller really cares about her students and I can not stress enough how important it is to go to her office hours!!
PowerPoint slides were unorganized, homework takes over 5 hours. Test are way to hard & don't relate to the powerpoints. I won't recommend this teacher at all.

This one is pretty simple. If you're an accounting major and really love the subject, take her. She is the most thorough and will prepare you well. If not, stay far away. Miller is tough, dry, and to the point. Very sweet person though if you need anything or have a question, just gets a little rattled sometimes. Loved the class.

Currently Enrolled in this class. As a dietetics major I find it pretty challenging. Its quite a bit of work but Cynthia does a great job explaining and reinforcing the material. She's extremely helpful and really cares about her students. If you are willing to put the work in an A is very attainable.

If your major is non-accounting, do NOT take her. Very strict about attendance, very time consuming. Particularly if you are a Nutrition/Dietetic student and have an already demanding schedule. She is nice, but its not worth it. Don't get me started on the exams.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. This was a terrible teacher. I live with 2 accountants and they couldn't even make sense of the homework. I am an A/B student and was in tears more than once over this class (Other were too. Her homework was miserable and the tests were near impossible. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS.

One of the best teachers I've had at UK. Definitely reccommend if you are an accounting major, she really makes sure that you understand the material. It is a lot of work - but if you do it all, you will definitely get an A in the class. Very helpful & willing to work with students outside of class. Extremely nice.

I loved this class and loved her! If you aren't willing to put in work do not take this class though. Do not buy the textbook because it comes with the access code for homework. If you are an accounting major for sure take her

This was quite a demanding course. She expected a substantial amount of effort from her students, but if you did everything she told you an A is definitely feasible. Do not take this class unless you are committed to devoting a significant amount of time each day to the material.
Loved this class.  I'm really prepared now in accounting.  Teacher really knows the material.  Nice.
Best class.  Recommend this teacher.  Learned alot.  Fair exams and homework.
Definitely not for non accounting majors. Very boring lecture, her only method of teaching is reading power points off slides
This class is really boring, it ruin my interest in Accounting. I'm sitting in her class right now, typing this review of her and her class to give you guys a heads up before enrolling in her class.

Spent 5 hours per assignment, and had 2-3 assignments before every exam (5 exams). EXTREMELY boring and monotonous lecturer. Exams are 5-6 pages long, and extremely difficult. AVOID. She will most likely ruin your semester.
Excellent instructor and course.
This class was rough, the teacher isn't very forgiving

She helped form a strong foundation for what I am now confident I want to major in.  Tough exams but not impossible.  If you go to class and actually pay attention, and do the homework then you should have no problem getting an A/B.
Best instructor I've had yet.  Great class. Worth taking.
One of the best I've taken. Great class.
She is a great teacher.  Challenging exams but very fair.  Go to class & office hours! Extremely helpful, easy to talk to
Not helpful. Made little effort to help students understand material that should not have been too difficult. Tests were painfully hard.
Do not take Miller!!! this class is obnoxious! homework takes 10 hours a week and her notes are useless. She's a really nice lady, but this class is just not for the non-accounting major!
She will ruin your semester. Do not take her. She is a nice lady, however she thinks everyone in her class will be a CPA one day and I don't know if some CPAs could pass some of her test
Best instructor I've had. Learned way more than thought I could.
DO NOT TAKE!!! Class requires hours and hours of studying and homework every week. Test are ridiculously hard. Take someone else because Miller will ruin your semester.
Teacher is ok, but the class itself is HORRIBLE! not for non-accounting majors at all! this class will make you want to pull your hair out!
She is an amazing teacher, not easy, but if Accounting is your major she is definitely the teacher to have.
Great professor!  The class is a lot of work, but you remember the material. She's a stickler for the rules, but I loved her class. You must go to class to pass!

Helped me build a solid foundation in accounting 202 where i'm now consistently getting A's on every exam while putting minimal effort into the class.  DEFINITELY take her if you're an accounting major; as the foundation you build in her class will pay off in the upper division accounting courses.  She's helpful, and a great teacher.

ONLY take her if you're an Accounting major!! Very difficult class if you are not fully committed. HW & Online quizes take hours to finish. In-Class quizes are very tough. Exams are very tough too. She is a great professor & is super nice. You get what you put into it, and if you aren't going to put a minimum of 3-4 hours a week, then Good Luck.

She is very helpful and encouraging. I learned a lot from her class. I would encourage you to take her class if you are a accounting major, because her class will definately help to build a solid foundation for your future study.

Motivated and caring teacher, will go out of her way to help you.  Miller is really nice, although she seems scary at first, with a desire to help students succeed.  Material is hard and she expects a lot from students.  You get what you put in.  You will know the material when you leave.  Ask questions and seek help when needed.

This was the hardest class I have ever taken. Her online homework takes hours upon hours. The quizzes are downright impossible. The tests are slightly better than the quizzes but still difficult. Expect to study a ton and be confused often.
Helped me learn alot.
Great teacher.  Got me interested in ACC as my major.  Lots work,but TAKE if you really want to learn.

Her tests are hard, and she doesn't give them back to you. MAL homework and quiz every week. She shows up late to class almost every day or cancels it. She doesn't always cover all the material or rushes through it, expecting you to get it on your own. DON'T TAKE HER!!!

EXTREMELY HARD CLASS, be prepared to have your i.d. verified whenever you take her tests to make sure its you, that kind of class. Covers too much in her notes and doesn't provide  any time to go over examples. Be prepared to spend a lot of time in her office for help in the course

Three words.  DO.  NOT. TAKE.  Incredibly hard class. This class is a living hell for non accounting majors. She abbreviates everything in her power points and nothing ever makes sense. There is no study guide or way to know what's on the exams until your're stuck in the middle of another "D"

Hard Class. But you will learn a lot. She gives you enough resources to be successful, but shes not going to hold your hand. Class doesn't slow down for you to catch up. Expect to have to put effort in.

Great teacher. Very helpful. Willing to help any student if they ask. Very precise in responding to emails for help and other concerns. Hard class, but great for accounting majors. Worth your time if you put effort into everything.
One of the best instructors I've had.  Alot of work, but can definitely be done, and learned a ton.

If your passion is Accounting and you already have a solid foundation in the area then you will probably survive the class. Otherwise RUN!!! Seriously, worst teacher ever. Prepare to hate your life if you take her class.

If you want to have one of the most stressful, frustrating and difficult times of your life, then take this class. This is the hardest class I've ever taken. Tons of homework, weekly quizzes, and the tests are killers. ONLY take the class if you absolutely HAVE to. Miller is a great teacher though. She's very clear and explains everything well.
Loved this class.  She explains things very well.  Tough, but fair.  The work is worth it.

This is a hard class and from what I hear the hardest of all ACC 202 classes. There is a lot of homework and online quizzes, but its worth doing. Her test and quizzes are fairly difficult, but going to class and doing the homework will earn you a decent if you really make the effort to understand it. I would only reccomend this class for ACC majors

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! Her lectures are completely POINTLESS and the homework takes at least 7 hours in order to finish. The tests are unbelievably IMPOSSIBLE! Taking this class was the worst decision I have made so far, she makes it way more complicated than it really is. DO NOT TAKE HER AS A TEACHER! Consider this your warning.
Great teacher.  Enjoyed this class.  Alot of work, but really learned.

If you are genuinely interested in learning about accounting then Miller is recommended. She is a tough teacher, but by golly you will leave her class with a solid understanding of the in's and out's of accounting. I admire her help during office hours and is a great professor with terrific people skills. TAKE HER!

Just a horrible teacher. Her tests are impossible and her lectures are useless. The amount of work that you have to put into this class is not worth it. There is no time for any other class. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS

Hard Class, Prof. Miller is a great Teacher, however her Test,Homework and Quizzes are too difficult for a 200 level class, be prepared to spend 40+ hrs studying for exams and another 6 hrs on online homework, Unless you have this kind of time to donate to Accounting DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS

She is great at explaining the material so being an accounting major I enjoyed learning from her but when it comes to tests, quizzes, and hw be prepared to make her class your life because it's all extremely time consuming and difficult. Disliked her class A LOT

While this class is very difficult, you will also learn a lot about the subject. Be prepared to work hard and spend a lot of time on this class. I am an accounting major so I appretiated that it was hard so I learned the material well, but if you're not an accounting major you may want to look for another teacher since it is a time consuming class.
Learned alot.
Great instructor.  You'll really learn.
Does things like, gives you 15 mins to take quiz, then at minute 15 calls people out loud to put their pencils down. Real mature.

I wasn't an accounting major, however I was still required to take this class for my HES major. Plan to spend up to 12-15 hours a week studying and doing homework. Exams and quizzes are extremely difficult and thorough and no study guides are given even for the cumulative final.
Very Difficult. Cynthia knows the material well and will take the time to teach it to you. Know that you are getting into very tough course and should be limited to ACC majors.
This class should be limited to Accounting majors only. Words cannot describe how difficult this course is. I ended up dropping it and am glad that I did! Homework, quizzes, and exams are brutal!

DON'T TAKE HER. Her syllabus is 15 pages long and you will spend at least 6 hours on homework every week, not including the quizzes which are available on Saturdays and due Sundays every week and are 1 hour long. Tests are feasible but you have to study A LOT. If you're not an accounting major, don't waste your time like she did mine.

Hardest class i have taken at UK. You have to work very very hard to get an A and you have a mandatory atleast 5 hours of homework a week or you will fail the class. Attendance is not mandatory but then you must read the book. A test or quiz every week (on friday)and you must study very hard. You will learn a lot if you pay attention.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH THIS TEACHER. Yes, she knows her stuff but it is WAY WAY harder then any other section. The homework, quizzes, and tests are ridiculous and she is a super tough with grading. Save yourself about 10 hours a week of homework and quizzes and just take another teacher.
Worst teacher at UK!! This class is by far the most difficult class I have ever taken!! She wouldnt even help me when i asked to meet her outside of class! DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS!!

If you are an Accounting major I would take this class. It is very hard and time consuming, but it is worth it. You will understand the material and be ready for upper level accounting classes. She is also extremely helpful and willing to spend time with all of her students.

She is by far the best teacher that I have had at UK. This class was extremely difficult, but she knows the material and is more than willing to sit down with you and explain it. ATTEND OFFICE HOURS AND ALL CLASSES. Also, don't wait to the last second for homework or quizzes. You have to study for ever quiz like it's a test because they are hard.

You will have to work VERY hard to get a good grade, but you will understand the content better than anyone else in ACC 201.  If you're willing to put in the work, it will pay off.  It can be frustrating at times when your friends dont have any hwork and you have a LOT, but it'll be worth it.  ATTEND OFFICE HOURS!
Do not take this class! She is by far the hardest accounting teacher at UK. Extreme ammounts of Homework and quizzes most classes. Tests are very hard as well.

She is absolutely awful. She knows the information but can not teach it. I have spend my entire semester working 20 hours a week and barely have a C. Half of my class dropped before the halfway point of semester. DO NOT TAKE HER! Her test and homework are way harder then other ACC 201 professors.

she is a cat lady.  she gives you 5 hand outs a day and doesnt even use them, she uses them the next class so if you dont go to them all then youre screwed.  And even if you do go it's impossible to follow bc she goes so fast.  the tests are 70+ questions in 50 mins so dont even hope to get better than a C.

knows material, and wants to help. homework is beast! prereq's, for prereqs, then you can start homework after you have received 100% on them. then comes hw, and the timed quiz. extremely demanding class! if you have no life...take this class
Nice but REALLY HARD. gives handouts every class that are impossible to follow. Class is mandatory (gives quizzes). She never reviews for tests or tells what the format will be or what will be on it.
Really knows how to teach. Prepared & organized. Recommend taking.
Great hand-outs & worksheets provided.  First exam based alot on those.  recommend taking

I had her fall 2009 so she might have tweaked her grading and teaching styles. I have a full ride to UK and got my first C in this class. not for lack of effort. You must go to class as she gives quizzes daily. count on spending 20+ hours studying for any test. Advised not to take this teacher.

Professor is very willing to help if you put fourth the effort. This class by far covered the most material in one semester than any other class however not all the material was that difficult. If you fall behind very difficult to get caught back up. Only negative is the professor has to much going on at once in the power points.
Learned a lot. Final exam questions mostly from exams during semester, so I wasn't real surprised. Drops lowest midterm exam score too.

Final was cumulative but when I was taking, I recognized most of the questions on previous stuff right off her earlier exams.  A lot of material to study and not easy but is do-able, plus new material final exam questions looked mostly to me like those covered in class.  Relief.

Drops lowest Exam.  Drops 2 lowest homeworks.  I think I'll get a B, maybe A depending on final exam score.  I feel o.k. about the final.  Instructor Always willing to help ..... even stayed past end of office hours a couple times I needed.  Even tho material is really challenging.

Took the final exam ..... I am SOOOOOOOO glad I went to her office hours to review my prior exams!!! Big time help preparing. Majority of final was WAY better than last Fall when I took her B4.  Would recommend taking this instructor.  Very helpful in person.
The material is very challenging and you have to put in a lot of work if you want to do well in the class. But she is always willing to help outside of class time if you are proactive enough to go.

This teacher is terrible.  She expects so much out of the students at a subject that is foreign to most of us.  We covered a chapter in just 2 50 minute class periods.  It's like a new chapter per week or less and she goes through each chapter ridiculously fast and spends little time on each slide, just enough to expect you to understand everything
very helpful and nice too.  Take if want to learn material & be ready for later financial acc courses

do not take her if you want to get a good grade in this class. the final was rediculous and even if you go to her office hours, it rarely even helps.  her tests are nothing like her notes. do not take.
Last exam was tied to homework & lecture - - good. Learn a lot in this course. Thorough. Feel more prepared for intermediate acct course.
great instructor.  very helpful.

This is hands down one of the worst teachers to take at UK. Her tests do not relate to the class or homework. She purposefully makes the tests hard by changing the formats on each. I would never take this person again  if my life depended on it. Read these Cynthia and learn.
Good instructor. Not entertaining, but know what talking about and clear. Need to understand meanings of stuff. Recommend taking.
terribly boring class, her mono tone voice makes it even worse. exams do not reflect what was learned through the homework.. i wouldn't recommend her.

She is a horrible professor.  I spent hours studying her lectures and homework.  My dad is an Accounting professor and CFO and says that is doing a horrible job at teaching students.  Her homework does not pertain to her exams even though she claims they do.  She knows what she is talking about but can not make it relate to you what so ever.
Class well organized and structured.  Extremely helpful in office hours.  Keeps you informed of standing
Very well organized class structure.  Teaches for learning.
As several people have said what she "lectures" in class does not correspond to what the homework is. Also she is very mono toned!
clear on expectations.  useful class.  great prof, Interested in helping you learn
learned alot.  Teaches extremely well.  Not super easy, but makes adjustments on exam & Quiz scores, and answers questions.  Got a "B" ... but Coulda got better if I spent more time
Very nice lady, but not a good teacher at all!!! DO NOT take her. She was very unorganized and her final was impossible. She does not curve.
learned alot.  very fair prof
She is clear about what u need to know for exams.  Covers it.  Good
Great instructor.  Knows her stuff.  U will learn.
This is an excellent instructor.  If you go into get help, she'll do it. She stays beyond regular ofice hrs if you need.  And, she DOES CURVE.  All Acc 201 course sections have comprehensiv finals.

This class is impossible!!! She starts the semester out good and acts like she is going to be a good teacher but she is NOT!! Do NOT take her! U have four regular tests that are over 2 chapters each and then the final is over 4 NEW chapters and all the old stuff -- its impossible! She is by far one of the worst teachers@

DO NOT TAKE HER. Not only is this class more boring than watching paint dry, her tests are impossible and her teaching style is unorganized and extremely hard to follow. She does not curve AT ALL, has daily graded quizzes, does not hand ANYTHING back, and has a cumulative final. Don't think her kindness is proof of being a good professor..it's not!

Cynthia Miller is extremely helpful. I didn't really understand the material during class time or on my own, but she is very approachable and her office hours helped me a lot. Quizzes everyday so attendance is mandatory.

You'll want to attend every class.  You have a 3 point quiz every class period and she drops your 6 lowest scores.  There are 4 normal tests and then a cumulative final.  Cynthia teaches the material really well and you will have to put forth some effort to get an A because tests are not just gimme's.  You have to know your stuff.
Good instructor.
Excellent prof.  Clear.  Uses class time, worthwhile going.  Super nice.  Helpful in office hours.  Take her if you want to learn somthing.

She could be a decent Professor but she talks so monotone and only does problems on the board by herself without asking the class for participation or engaging the students in the learning.She then asks if you have any questions but I was so confused and lost that I didn't know where to start for questions or comments.Take someone else if possible!
Awesome teacher.  Answers students questions well.  Covers lots of material.  Worth attending class - clear lectures.
Super instructor.  Take her if you can.  She really cares about student learning.  Shows how things fit together.  Clear.  Very approachable.  Helpful.

She is an awesome instructor.  Extremely organized and clear.  I've had other instructors that are scattered, she's clear.  Her quizzes are helpful in advance of exams.  She pays attention to whether students are getting the material and answers questions really well.
Best instructor I've had.  Accounting is hard but she provides all kindes of opportunities to do well.  Very clear instruction.  Highly recommend this teacher if you want to understand material.
Cares about her studentes. Willing to spend time outsid class to help
No Comments
Hard, not very useful.  Hard tests, must go to class.

She is a very nice lady, her class is kind of boring but I have it at night so what can you expect. Class is pretty difficult, but she does an OK job explaining it. She presents all of the material, but does not do it in a way conducive to her student's learning. Take someone else if possible, but she is not bad.
Great class. Loved the material. All work (homework and exams) reflected course material.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This was an online class so I cant say much but I liked the class it was very straight forward and easy. He was a tough grader on the weekly short answers we had to do and gave minimal/vague feedback you usually have to go out and email him to get specific answers on what you're looking for. But overall he was great couldn't ask for anything else.
This was a super easy online class but he is a tough grader when it comes to the short answer assignments.

I really enjoyed taking DLowe's class this semester. Really understanding and willing to work with you. If you participate he will grow to like you even more, which benefits you. Highly suggest taking his class.

I have had him for two classes so far and I would take him again in a heartbeat! He is a very respectable professor that is understanding if you are a good student willing to try your best. Very funny and tried to relate to the students which made learning more fun.

He doesn't do a lot of teaching, mostly was taught by my peers when they presented in class. Overall Lowe is a solid choice. You have like 3 major assignments and can kinda chill the rest of the semester. Exams were hard if you didn't do the reading because like I said, he doesn't really lecture!
I took this class for winter intercession. His lectures are really fascinating so its easy to follow along and get a good grade.

Took this online in the summer. You will get an A but this class is super unorganized. There are tons of broken links on Canvas and he won't relink them. However, he's so lax that this won't affect your grade. Quizzes (only five questions) and tests are a joke. Use Quizlet to study for those.

Best professor at UK. Class was almost painfully easy. The lowest grade I received the entire semester was a 96, with no effort. He's easy-going and tells you exactly what he wants. My final project took like 45 minutes, and he gave us all semester to do it.

Class is easy. Just show up. He has a lot of in-class participation discussions and they're pretty laid back. Not a lot of assignments. One big one at the end. Posts all lecture slides on canvas. Very laid back and when I had him in class I was never stressed or overwhelmed. He reminds you about assignments and gives clear directions.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Lowe is one of the best professors at UK. He knows when to have fun and when to be serious. He gives long-ish lectures but makes them interesting. A great guy. And a great course. 10/10.

D-Lowe is super relaxed. Class is only on Tuesdays, Online Thursdays (changes every semester). I never used his textbook. Just follow the notes and do the online assignments that are due during class time Thursdays. He likes to joke around, very sarcastic. Attendance is mandatory. Online assignments are impt. No ex credit & 1 paper and bibliography
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He was funny during lectures. The study guide for the midterm did not reflect what was on the exam very well. There's a lot of notes and they're detail heavy.

Best class I've ever taken! Lowe is by far my favorite professor I've had at my three years at UK. He's very real and straight to the point and delivers lectures in a hilarious way. Pretty much everyone gets A's on tests and quizzes
hes super easy, just boring and it feels like class is moving in slow motion, gives a ton of extra credit, study for the quizzes and youll easily get an A

DLowe is the man. This is an easy A class no doubt. At times his lectures can be a little boring but the test are so easy that it makes up for it. Only downfall is that he is very liberal and kinda pushes it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lowe is a good guy. He is lecture heavy and boring at times but he mixes in some humor which helps the time go by a bit faster. There are lots of quizzes but the class is only graded on those one or two assignments and then midterm/final so each quiz is important. Study in this class and you'll be just fine.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: COM 249 is a class you are required to take for a Comm major and Don Lowe is the only teacher for it. Expect for half of the class to be conducted through video lectures on Canvas and half as an actual lecture. His tests are extremely hard and don't follow the study guides very well, so study everything. An A is possible in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Lowe is a hilarious professor that truly wants to make your education fun. I highly recommend that you take his course as you will definitely have a laugh or two per week. It turned out the class only had to meet ONCE a week after the first month of the semester!! It was amazing to have such an open schedule. Of course this means some online work.
DLowe is the man. He is funny in a sarcastic way and it's hilarious. He doesn't like to be disrespected but if you show up and just listen to him he will be cool with you.

meh. he's okay. can have fun. some day he's super interesting and others he's just as bored with the material as everyone else. very liberal and kinda pushes it on you. so watch out for that. it was a good class.
he is so funny and nice. is super laid back and helpful if you ask him questions. basically everything for this class is online and a lot of it is common sense.

Don is a great professor and guy. This class is based off of mass media so its interesting since it has a lot to do with social media and technology; something we can almost all say we use every day. He cracks modern jokes and has a dry humor so its easy to laugh along during lectures. He's reasonable and can tell if you truly care about his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: He's wonderful instructor you will have 4 speeches and all quizzes will be online and easy to handle When it comes to  exams there are 3 but all from quizzes and again online so it should be piece of cake to get a full mark without any problem  he's not that tough grader do what he say and show some effort and you will get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Lowe was great. The  class had two tests which you really have to study for and 6 quizzes that you have to study for some as well. There is a paper but it isn't too bad. Somewhat interesting. Dr. Lowe is funny and that often made lectures a bit easier. Easy if you study a bit and do what he says. Take this class.

This class wasn't even taught in the actual classroom. We have watch voiced over powerpoints and it was terrible trying to teacch myself. In class all we did was group work like high school students. I definitely do not recommended.

DLowe is awesome. I reccomend taking him. The lectures can get a little lengthy, but his humor always breaks up the boredom. He is a fair grader and is certainly there for his students. Overall great teacher.

Amazing COM teacher. We had one test throughout the entire semester and it was online! You give a speech about every 2-3 weeks, but they aren't very difficult. He gives you guidelines to follow for each one. The class was definitely not as hard as I was expecting. As long as you put forth effort you can ace the class!

Guys, take DLowe. He lets you call him DLowe, if that doesn't show you that he is super chill and laid back, I don't know what does. In 249 he let us try to get extra credit on our exams by having us answer three pop-culture trivia questions. Basically he's chill and fun and that really helps during "lecture's"(his are super conversational).3 him!
Very interesting class and he definitely knows his stuff. His lectures were sometimes pretty dull, but he's really funny and laid back. Would recommend.
Teaches the material straight up. He does not speak like he is talking from a textbook. Everything else was fair. He is a nice teacher so sit through.
Dr. Lowe is an entertaining lecturer. But he doesn't lecture often. Most of the time you are working with classmates or giving speeches which makes for a close-knit class.

you don't always do everything on the syllabus if he decides you don't have enough time to get to it. he's an easy grader, just do all the work he assigns and you'll do fine, and don't miss any speeches. he's pretty funny so that keeps the class interesting. i recommend him, easy, fun class. community service required (10 hrs)

Super disorganized. Literally just give a few speeches and take a midterm. Forced community service sucks but its only 10 hours so knock it out quick and you will be good. I'm bad at speeches and I got an A. Do what he says and pay attention and act like you care and you will get a good grade.

Cool guy but unorganized. grading all depends on the TA he has that semester. Mandatory attendance but overall fairly easy course. I got a high B. only used the book twice but you will need it for his study guides
Really knew his stuff. Tests straightforward from the notes and book. Provides extra credit throughout the semester. Overall-great!

Really easy going. He knows the content of COM 249 very well and he does a good job at keeping it interesting. Tests are pretty straightforward and allows for some extra credit opportunities throughout the class. Overall-great teacher!
He's pretty laid back compared to the other public speaking teachers. The one test you have is easy just study the definitions.
The best professor ever. Do your work, listen to what he says, and it is almost impossible not to get A!

Don Lowe is the man. Coolest professor I've had at UK, and I took Tom Troland. Hilarious, yet fairly easy. Study for the test and you're golden. He made class actually something to look forward to. You. Must. Take. Don. Lowe's. Clas.

Interesting class, terrible teacher who was sarcastic and rude. His "quizzes" are more like impossible tests that don't represent any of the book material assigned for reading. A study guide was given for the midterm that didn't even cover half of the test material. The grading scale was completely unfair and not even calculated correctly.
Class was always exciting... Fair read the textbook.

Don Lowe is awesome!  He is very entertaining during class and he grades speeches easy.  One test that is super easy as long as you look over the definitions in the chapters assigned. Speeches are easy too.  Take him for public speaking!!

Great class but I wish the tests weren't so bad.  They killed my grade and I even went to class almost every single time and read the book! I couldve enjoyed it a little more if I wasnt so stressed about the exams. Take him though.

Hilarious. He kept me awake on friday mornings- the class is rarely boring. Understands its a basic/intro public speaking class and grades speeches accordingly. Tests cover book material which is usually NOT covered in class- the syllabus explains which chapters will be covered in each test so be sure to read the book. Definitely recommend

I had him for mass com. and he did a good job of keeping things interesting. Used youtube a lot and a lot of class discussion. Just like all his other classes, quizes are from the notes and are generally pretty easy, but the test are over the textbook chapters, which you dont not cover in class. test are hard. read the book! take d lowe!

Dlowe is very entertaining and fun.  You won't dread going to class.  He isn't too uptight about attendance, I think he allows 3 unexcused.  Quizes are easy, tests are kind of hard. Be sure to read the book!

Don is a very down-to-earth, laid back person, and will drop the f-bomb every now & then. He makes sure everyone in the class interacts to get the most out of it. The quizzes are easy because they're over the notes, but the exams are straight from the book. Go to class, read the chapters, and you won't dread it. I highly recommend Don!
laid back... easy on grading work... look over book chapters for test.. and talk to dlowe

Really interesting class, funny guy.  Very nice, laid back.  Tests are difficult, but I don't think he writes them, might be the same tests in all COM252 classes(?).  I really enjoyed being in his class, my favorite teacher this semester!

He is an awesome teacher. Vary laid back.  The tests are kinda hard but all of the questions on the quizzes are on the tests.  I got C's on all of the tests and still got an A.  He is funny too, likes to drop the f-bomb at least once a class period. haha
Very Laid back and fun! Keeps things interesting and will work with you to find a good topic!
easiet class offered at uk. as long as you go to class you will get points and theres no way not to get an a if you give some effort.
Easy, just go to class everyday and you should get an A or B.  tests are harder than they seem but they only amount to a small portion of your grade.
Even though he was really easy, I didn't really care for him.  Tests are a lot harder than the subjects covered in class.

Fun guy.  Keeps it interesting.  Tests are hard, but are only a small percentage of your grade in the class.  Make sure you go everyday and do the little stupid assignments and you will get an easy A.
He's cool. His tests are kinda tough.  I got C's on all his tests and still pulled out an A.

Easy class but the tests are suprisingly hard. Tests are not consistant with the difficulty of the class assingments. Although, if you do study from the book in addition to the notes, it is very easy. But def. read the book.
Cool guy.  Easy B.  Exams are surprisingly tough.  Do everything else and you should get an A, though.
Good ol' D-Lowe...Great class
Easiest class I have ever had.  He is awesome too!  He is very laid back and loves cracking jokes in class.
No Comments
Easiest class ever

Don is a great teacher! I would recomend that anyone needing/wanting to take COM252 to get out of COM181, defintely take his class! Its extremely easy, fun to be in and enjoyable. I missed 1 class the whole semester(very odd for me)! You have to do one group speech, but its no big deal. Promise!
Good class...easy A...hes a really good teacher
Great teacher, very very laid back.  Defianly recommend him!!
Typical Com class,
good teacher, class is fairly easy, as long as you go and do the speaches you will pass. Much easier compared to all of my friends com 181 teachers
He's a very laid back type teacher.  The class is always fun and you can always get a good laugh from his stories.  This is definately a teacher you should try to get!
awsome guy, very funyy and understanding!
I liked Doug and his class. He definitely has favorites though and it's great if you're one of them. You present and do group work a decent amount but he is an easy grader with great feedback.

Nice guy, but the lectures are SO boring. We watch YouTube videos in most classes. No one pays attention, and the videos are so long and come off as if he doesn't want to teach. Very repetitive and boring. Not an engaging class, and team assignment-heavy.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I liked him, but a lot of people thought he was boring but just has a very monotone voice. We had in-team class assignments once a week, and both the midterm and final were team presentation assignments. I'm not sure how much I truly learned from this class, but he is a very gentle grader with presentations, and it increased my confidence

Dr.Powell is compassionate, approachable, and personable. His class was working heavily in group projects but nothing impossible, I thoroughly enjoyed his class and learned a lot. He has a lot of experience in advertising that he brings to the classroom which is beneficial. Def recommend!

Klein is a very nice person, and someone you can tell really cares for the students. He try's to get to know you and will be there to help you. Of course he still expects everyone to do well but with him as help and you staying on top of it you can't not get an A.
He is amazing!!

Klein is a great person who genuinely cares about all of his students. He attempts to learn everyone's names before the first class even starts and will with you throughout the projects. He is a great mentor and resource to have throughout college. 10/10 would recommend.

Professor Klein is awesome. I had him for EGR 103 in Spring 2025, couldn't have asked for a better mentor. His feedback is tough at times but is constructive and is always willing to help. Be prepared to keep up with the 103 project, but as long as you do, you'll be just fine. Would definitely recommend for first year engineering students.
One of the best professors on campus. Klein is extremely easy to talk to and wants to help each group succeed. Class is almost entirely focused on group projects.

As his several teaching awards suggest, Professor Klein is one of the best professors at UK. Doug's goal is to make EGR103 approachable regardless of your experience. It is difficult to get anything below an A in his class, because he cares about you. Talking with him, he said he learned and rehearsed each student's name before the first day :)
Doug is a class act. He memorizes your names on the first day and takes the time to learn about his students. He is extremely helpful and exceptionally knowledgeable. 10/10 would recommend

I don't know what happened to Doug this semester, but all the stories I've heard of him being an amazing professor could not be further from my experience. We had a teammate who wasn't showing up to meetings or doing their part and Doug just said, "Oh that's a bummer," and did nothing about it while he said his job was to handle those situations.

Dr Klein was amazing for 103, but the class is extremely teamed based.Basically, the entire semester comes down to a large group project that ultimately makes or breaks your grade, but there's a ton of assignments to keep you on pace.He's strict on team attendance, and will protect you and your teammates' grade if someone isn't carrying their load.
Mr. Klein is an exceptional person and truly cares about his students. Would give him a six out of five if I could. I highly recommend him for this class.
Amazing teacher! Really cares about your learning and is great at explaining things and problem solving. Genuinely cares about his students and brought back my love for engineering.
Super laid back and genuinely wants to see you succeed. He provides amazing feedback and is extremely reasonable. His class was great!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Enjoyable
The class sucked but the professor was really lenient and understanding.
Very passionate about the class and engineering in general. VERY group project heavy class but Klein is forgiving if someone isn't pulling their weight.

Klein is a very approachable guy and is always accessible. I remember my group was working at 11 pm the Sunday before our project was due, and Klein responded to our plea for help almost immediately. His oratory skills in class are superb and always keep you interested. He provides good feedback and makes an effort to learn everyone's name, too.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I cannot reiterate how good of a prof Doug is. He genuinely cares so much about his students and has such good energy in class. I've been slacking and the class is still flexible enough that I can easily pull through with an A. Amazing teacher and person, would take him again if I were in CPE. EGR 103 itself isn't the best, but he makes it great!
Klein is a cool guy. He's the type of person you would want to spend an evening getting to know. He has a lot of experience and genuinely wants to help you become a better engineer.
Klein is a very caring teacher who makes a point to get to know every student. He does a great job of using interesting, real-life examples to get students engaged and excited.

Egr103 is without a doubt the most useless class you will ever take in your entire life. Klein's alright, but if you enjoy stupid busywork that has nothing to do with anything useful in life, you will probably really enjoy this class.
EGR 103 is the dumbest class Ive ever taken in my life, but having Klein as my professor made it much less painful. A great guy who actually cares about his students.
Dr. Klein is very helpful and a very nice guy. His class isnt very difficult, but if you are struggling hes more than happy to help as long as you dont ask him last minute.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Klein is just an awesome guy. He is very funny and will crack jokes throughout class, but he also has a lot of knowledge and real world experience. He is very honest with each team about staying on track with group projects and is realistic about the challenges of group projects. The first exam is a group challenge that should be an easy A.
A real fun guy. Explains the material well. Lets you do the projects outside of class and just show up to get them checked off then leave.
He actually tries to educate his students. He radiates intelligence and he wants to pass that on to students that take his class

Klein was a great professor that really understood and was enthusiastic about the material. He teaches EGR101 and EGR103 but I only took the first class with him. The class has one lecture a week and a lot of homework, but thats a requirement and doesnt grade too hard despite the loads of busy work. He is always available outside of class too.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: One of the nicest professors out there. While I came in knowing most of the material already, he added a new way to look at coding. Do well on his first two exams, and you will not have to take the final. Keep up with the Zybook chapters and ALWAYS do the challenges. They help with understanding tremendously. Easy content but lots of work involved.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I had Mr Klein for EGR101. The class had a very heavy workload, but it was not difficult. Klein was very funny and entertaining, but his lectures weren't very effective. He is not thorough and jumps around a lot when teaching.

As an engineering major taking this class, I was genuinely shocked by how well it was taught. He is a great Professor who cares about his students and is a great person to talk to. 100% of the exams were covered in class on the slides. If you take good notes and pay attention in class, you won't have to study much. 10/10 would recommend for credit!
Love this guy. He's super funny and down to earth. The course and homework wasn't hard it was mainly common sense. He gives lots of opportunities for extra credit.

I took this class for a business credit I needed my freshman year. The professor is condensing and has a big ego when it comes to his profession. He lectures the whole time and rarely lets out early. I stopped participating in-person halfway through the semester and completed my work online. TA doesn't come to class and grades harshly. Don't Take.
He is a great teacher who answers questions during class and who is very straightforward with how he teaches. If he offers any classes in the future, I Would pick his class again and again.

Honestly such a chill guy, he is enjoyable to listen to and makes relatable or funny comments throughout all of his lectures. Attendance isn't required, but is definitely encouraged due to the amount of content that is covered each class. However, the teacher assistant grades our assignments and he grades kind of weird sometimes
Young guy who's chill, very lecture heavy and can be boring. Weekly homework and reading quizzes but super easy to do. 3 tests with lockdown browser which are lowkey hard to study for.
Very chill guy and is relatable in his lectures. Attendance isn't required but he still encourages you to go

Dr. Ross is an amazing professor who makes lectures not boring with his sense of humor and attitude. I was able to reach him outside of class very easily and he's a professor who really cares about students. In a lecture of 200, he came up after class and followed up on a question I had asked weeks before. 100% recommend and WILL take again.

Dr. Ross is an excellent professor. If you're considering the Family Financial Counseling major, do it! I'm almost done with the program, but I would have to say this course was the hardest. Be prepared to remember lots of material for the exam and spend lots of time with the financial projects. Overall, it's a very informative course.
It's overall a great class to take. Took it as an elective, and got a C because I didn't take it serious, however a high B/A is very easily attainable. Great professor
I liked professor ross. You can tell he's teaching a course in which he really cares about the content. If there's an in-class assignment, go to lecture.
Really great and approachable professor, is very helpful in and out of the classroom. Fantastic teacher; it is extremely easy to do well in his class.
He's a really nice guy but I found him boring.

he's amazing! i love him, he's so funny. he's very easy to work with as well. go to his office hours, he'll be lenient if you make an effort to show you care. he's really sweet too, he brought cookies and snacks for everyone on the last day. i wish i could take his class again, he's so awesome.
good class

Mr T is super considerate and understanding. His lectures are relatable and engaging. He genuinely cares about his students and their progress. He is super easy to reach through email and very cooperative.

Mr. T is a great professor. He is accessible outside of class, his lectures are interesting, he makes you think about the readings. Most importantly though he is super understanding and wants all of his students to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof Thibs is fine. He's a very nice and easy going guy. His class obsesses over superheroes so if you're really into that, you'll have an amazing semester. I'm not into all that however, and at the beginning of the year, was worried it would affect how well I did in the class. It ended up being perfectly fine and prof thibs was a very easy grader.

This was a very easy class. You will get an A if you show up, do the homework, and follow the directions that Mr. Thibs gives you. He is very accessible outside of class or in office hours and is very understanding about personal issues. If you have to take WRD 110/111, this is the professor to go with.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very understanding and not a tough grader
he's so chill, he had interesting lectures and would always get us out earlier than scheduled. he offered extra credit before every exam by playing optional jeopardy. overall, super chill and easy.
amazing professor, very engaging and helpful. would love to have him again.

Marko was pretty average as far as professors go. Lectured the entire time and always put me to sleep. He responds quickly to emails. He will dock off points for attendance so show up. Never had any homework. 3 tests and a group project but over all, pretty easy.

Dragojevic is the best professor I have had at UK. He is extremely engaging in class, and he is very clear about exactly how he is going to grade you on exams, papers, and projects. I found the material super interesting too. Absolutely take his class if you have the opportunity!!!

Great professor all-round. Really enjoyed the online lectures and the lecture notes he provides. Discussion posts were really easy to complete and not very time consuming. There was only one paper for the entire class. Tests were difficult though. 50 questions/50 minutes. I'd recommend taking detailed lecture notes to prepare for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Honestly Marko is so sexy, his looks and brain are super intriguing to me lol. Nice guy and the lectures are interesting, must go to class but i highly recommend him.

Dr. Dragojevic has been one of the most memorable teachers of my time at UK. Great teaching style and makes the content very easy to understand. Lecture notes are provided which really helps for exams. Very quick to respond to student concerns and grades all assignments in a timely manner. 10/10 would recommend any class he teaches.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Dragojevic has been by far one of my favorite professors here at the University of Kentucky. A persuasions class sounds really boring but the way he teaches and gets his students involved really made the class worth your time. Definitely have to study for his exams but he provides lecture notes. A class worth taking!
IDK everyone said he is great so

Terry was an amazing professor for a freshman engineering student to have to warm up to UK and eng. Lectures are so good and often fun you'll want to go, you need to tho bc of Iclicker questions daily. Demos are frequent and very goated. I didn't find class difficult but some peers did. tip: reach out to upperclassmen who have taken the class. YW

Dr. Draper is very passionate about what he teaches, and he actually has really good lecture slides that you can download directly from the canvas page to take notes on. For this class if you just focus, do the work, and make sure you understand it, this class shouldn't be too hard.

Draper is a below-average professor, he spends far too long explaining basic concepts and then skips all of the calculations, which are the only things on tests. Overall not bad, definitely the best physics professor at UK but that doesn't mean much.

Lectures can be a bit boring but he acts out real life examples and those are very interesting and help me remember things. Easily the best physics teacher at UK. Tests are easy as long as you study and are just like the practice exams.
Good guy in bed

He is nice, engaging, and respected by many. He has 5 tests including the final. All are taken online with ExpertTA. Attendance matters to listen and learn about the content, it can be difficult to catch up by missing class.

he spent a lot of time in lecture on things that were super obvious, and then seemed to speed through the things that were actually difficult. Also - do the homework. It has a larger impact on your grade than you think.

Overall Mr. Draper is a really nice and funny guy. He knows the material, however I will say it can be hard to pay attention some times. I'll admit the online exams were fairly difficult for me because there is no partial credit for responses on some questions which, if missed, can hit you grade fairly hard.
Dr. Draper is an all-around funny guy. His lectures can be boring, but he usually does what he can to spruce them up by using demos. If you get the chance, I'd recommend Draper for this course!
Draper is the best of the best in terms of Physics lecturers. He is insanely smart and loves including jokes in the lectures. Take his section if you have the chance.
Nice guy who does care about his students, but the lectures can be long and boring.

Daily attendance is based on small quizzes; if you answer incorrectly, you receive a 70% participation grade, which can be frustrating. Homework and exams are taken on a website; decent feedback is given on homework, but it's difficult to gain partial credit on exams, which are 50% of the final grade. Also, the textbook isn't needed.

Professor Draper is an amazing professor. He is clearly passionate about Physics and goes out of his way to show demonstrations and involve the students in them. He uses iClicker to ask the class questions during his lecture and this is used as an attendance grade. He talks about a textbook and assigns readings but I never used it.

Draper did a phenomenal job keeping me engaged. He always had a demo or video in class that helped me see the real world applications of what we were learning. He uses big physics words- it took some time to get used to but I loved it because it made the exams less intimidating. Overall amazing professor.
He cares a lot. Physics just sucks. A lot. Boo physics. Yay terry. Lots of demos. Buy his stickers.

Very kind and accessible (office hours, quick email responses, etc). Not too much homework, but it is all online, which kind of sucks. Find a study group to do it with. Put the work in and it isn't difficult at all- skimming textbook before lecture helps sm. Lowest test is dropped at the end of the semester. If you can, take calc 1 before PHY 231!!

Dr. Draper is clearly very passionate about physics and wants his students to be as well. He clearly wants all his students to succeed, but is not willing to spoon feed his students good grades. He graded everything to correctness though, so things can get pretty gnarly when you dont understand a concept.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If youve never taken physics before, this class is really hard. Draper is a really nice dude, and really gets into his lectures. He does a lot of demonstrations. Go to his office hours!! There are a lot of exams, but the lowest gets dropped. Theres a textbook but nobody reads it. The homework and exams are on ExpertTA which is the worst.

Prof. Draper makes some funny jokes but also really helped me understand my first physics course, even in online class. Sometimes he goes through problems a little too quick but his lectures and notes are always posted online for us to look back on. Prepares us well for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The professor is obviously well versed in geography and passionate about the topic but lectures seem to drone on forever. There are few assignments in the course so doing well on the exams is crucial, though insightful feedback is given on all written assignments. There are readings every week and exams pull from lecture, readings, and notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: bro. absolutely not. he basically constantly asks you what a city is and it's the end of the semester and i still have no clue.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Wood is a great professor. He really loves the subject of geography and is willing to help you if you need it. Expect to have to read a lot. There are articles nearly every week that you will need to read. The material from the exam comes from readings, lectures, and other work done outside of class so do the readings and other work as well.
Super nice guy. When he says to read, you better read. Most of the tests are on the in class notes and lectures, but a lot of the test questions are on the readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a really good professor and super nice! The TAs grade everything, so be nice to them. He makes a study guide for each exam, and as long as you make a Quizlet, you should be fine!.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had Manson as my 110 professor. Class was mostly lectures, reading, a few exams and some art. Manson does lecture-style teaching better than most professors. My favorite thing about Manson is that he clearly cares about what he teaches. He's very knowledgeable, and is straightforward with what he expects. Great guy + great teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Best professor in COD. Incredibly intelligent and great teacher. I looked forward to every class.
Found the tests fairly easy, he almost always curves them.

Easily one of the best professors I had this semester. Professor Manson's class is very interesting and each lecture is always filled with new things. Assignments are sparse in with about a total of 4 homework assignments given and only 3 exams to complete. You get a study guide before each exam so its hard to not get an A!

The exams do require a fair amount of study to pass and going to class is not both mandatory but necessary to get the large amount of info to pass the exams. Textbook reading is also necessary to some degree. However the class is very passable and if you put effort in youll be fine. Manson is a very knowledgeable teacher and great lecturer as wel
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Manson shows obvious passion and excitement for his subject, which translated to interesting lectures and clear connection to the subject application to an architecture degree as a whole. Tests were challenging but not unfair, as was the entire class. Dr. Manson is an engaging and caring professor despite the big class size.

Manson is an incredibly smart and well spoken lecturer. The lectures may be boring sometimes but he does his best to make it interesting. You really don't need to read the textbook as long as you show up for class and take lots of notes. His exams are definitely on the harder side but that's mostly because of the amount of material. Nice guy.

He teaches architectural history well and really knows what he's talking about. As long as you take good notes and thoroughly study for the exams, you'll get an A. He schedules homework and exams so they don't overlap with other big projects in other architecture classes. He's nice and loves to answer any questions.
This is my second year having Dawson has my professor and he is great! He obviously cares a lot about his students and gives you many chances to re-do an assignments. He is very flexible.

A class that should have been beneficial to me but unfortunately was not. Dawson has good intentions I think, but poor execution. He gets upset for not fixing mistakes but then wont help us. Lectures always feel like we talk about the same thing. Schedule changes a lot and makes it hard to keep up with assignments.
He is great professor. He doesn't stress out students and is approachable. Do you work and you will pass!
I found the classes with Professor Dawson very good. He was always very attentive to students and very helpful with doubts. He's the kind of person who inspires you to be a better human being.

Although he may not have a lot of hair, he does have a lot of heart. He really cares about the success of his students and those around him. He is vastly underpaid (looking at you, College of CI). He is a man with a lot of experience in the business. I'm truly grateful for my time spent in his classes. Take his class or good luck getting a job.
He's great.

I have to say I strongly disagree with a lot of the reviews on here. Andrew Dawson is more than qualified to teach JOU courses and is an excellent professor. During lectures, he repeats himself and re explains things until every student understands the information being discussed - this is hard to come by when it comes to college professors. 10/10

Andrew Dawson is not a great professor. No format to lectures, and you are in class for about 30 minutes at max. That may seem great to some, but you are not going to learn anything about the radio. There are two big busy work projects that are going to be long and difficult.

I really enjoyed this class! It is a lot of hands-on work, but you learn something every time. He is not easy with his grading, but gives great feedback and will take the time to make sure you understand what went wrong. He has experience in the field, so if you are a journalism major/thinking of a career in journalism, he can share knowledge.

I loved Dawson. He really cares with students and connects with them on a personal level. There is a lot of work but as a Journalism major the work is important to having success in the field. Dawson always leaves great feedback and is always willing to help. He has great experience working in Journalism on top of all of that. He's been a top prof.

Not sure why all of the previous rating about him are so horrible. JOU204 with Mr. Dawson was a solid class and he's funny, he isn't bad at teaching and goes over exactly how he wants his assignments completed. He doesn't really stick to the syllabus in regards to the larger assignments though, so that can be kinda confusing. Overall good class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Most under qualified teacher I've ever had. Rude to students, raises his voice, and has no idea what he's talking about.

Andrew did a great job. It's his first time teaching, and he's filling Mel's shoes - not easy. He really cares about his students and wants everyone to do well. His real-world experience makes for good examples.  Hope he gets to teach more!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: UK hiring this person to teach 404 is like an ER asking a hospital sanitation worker to help perform open heart surgery. He neither has the credentials or confidence to teach this class. So glad to have graduated from this school.
Just awful!

Professor Grimes is a great professor! Class was pretty easy, had informational slides and online lectures, and he was easy to access outside of class. You do the assignments, you'll pass the class with an easy A. Hardest part of the class is the exams but he provides review guides for them.

The class is super easy. He gives 100s on all the assignments. The exams were pretty easy and there were only two exams in the class. But he was so rude when I emailed him. Took forever to answer and gave two-word responses. The lectures were also very boring. But the class is an easy A.

I have had Grimes for 3 classes and he is great, probably my favorite professor at UK. The only thing I don't like is his exams are kinda hard because they are fairly ambiguous and it can take a toll on your grade. But all other assignments are easy.

Grimes is the coolest professor ever! He has his own marketing firm in Lexington, bringing awesome real-world knowledge into the capstone. He also has us do simulations and projects that may seem frustrating initially, but I think it sets us up very well for the real world. I 100% recommend him for any class.

Grimes is mega chill and down to Earth. There isn't any BS with him. He gets straight to the point in lectures while respecting students' feedback and what not. He doesn't take attendance but I wouldn't make it a habit of skipping. Most of his assignments are two exams and group projects. You can do the work outside of class most of the time

The class was online but wasn't bad at all. He just had two exams on lockdown browser. The only assignment is a simple Google Analytics tutorial which takes like 15 mins max every week. The tests were pretty straightforward too. I had no issues, you can get an easy A if you just do the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Good class with very few assignments so each one matters a lot. Aside from the tests, just doing the assignments will get you the points so the tests are what will decide your grade. There is no required lectures or videos so you have to go through it on your own and use that info for the tests.
