reviews.comment: Probably really good for in person classes. Being online though, he really lacked communicating with us on what were supposed to be doing. You work on a research project throughout the semester which is kind of annoying but manageable. Nice guy, means well, just didnt adapt like a lot of other professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: The whole course is a group project and two fairly easy exams if you study a bit. He is super understanding and sympathetic and will work with you in your favor if a problem arises.

Professor Grimes is super cool. He is laid-back and is an easy grader. Tests are easy if you review his Study guide materials. He is a good communicator and emails back quickly. Still gives points if you turn homework in late.

Grimes is easily one of the best professors at UK. There's no tricks to his class, he just teaches you the material and makes it interesting! He's so laid back and very chill. Attendance isn't mandatory, but he basically uses your attendance grade to determine if he wants to round you up or not.

By far my favorite professor so far. The class was actually fun and Grimes is a very relaxed and enjoyable professor. He lets you take the lead on the final project and go where you want with it based on what interests your group. He would let class out early if things got done, or if he felt like we could work on something from home which was nice
I've take Professor Grimes for two different marketing classes and he is by far my favorite teacher I've had. He is super laid back and is knows a lot about marketing. His test are also pretty easy.

Definitely one of the best professors ive had at UK. His class is interesting and easy. I thought the exams were kinda tricky but not bad at all! Attendance isnt mandatory but if you go alot he will probably round you up. Attendance is kinda how he bases if your gonna get rounded up if your close to an A or a B at the end of the semester

Coolest professor at UK. Take him any chance you get. The exams are easy, he is super laid back and is actually knowledgeable about marketing. Funny guy and great class plus attendance isn't mandatory.
Grimes is one of the best professors I've ever had. 10/10 recommend taking him.

Definitely one of my favorite professors I have ever had in college. He is super laid back and chill. His test are pretty easy if you study the review slideshow he provides. Will take him again if given the opportunity.

Prof. Grimes is one of the coolest teachers in Gatton. Class is always enjoyable and we only met every other Friday (MWF structure). He never tries to trick you and is very straightforward with expectations and grading. I would definitely take another class with him.

Digital Marketing with Professor Grimes was probably the most helpful class I took while at UK. He explained the topics really well and provided real-world examples which were helpful. You could tell he liked the topics he was teaching and was flexible to provide students what they wanted to learn and what was most relevant to their careers.

Mr. Grimes is an excellent Marketing professor. He has had a successful marketing career that he can draw from while being young and able to connect well with students. He teaches in a way that makes sense for the course and only includes material you will actually need! This was easily one of the best classes and Professors I have had at UK.

Andrew Grimes was easily in my top 3 professors that I had at UK. He is a boss in real life, is married to the secretary of state, and is still young enough to connect with college students. The insights that he gives as far as how to be successful in the professional world are invaluable.  Definitely take him if you can.

Passionate guy, interesting class, but assignments were an absolute nightmare. Takes off incredibly arbitrary points, super picky but will never give you one clear rubric. The assignments sound fun, but don't be fooled. Unless you get lucky to be one of the few students he actually likes, don't expect to get a good grade.

reviews.comment:
Funny and personal teacher, but his grading can be alot harsher than expected, and GOOD participation is crucial. Overall, class is fairly easy I never had to put in too much effort. 

NOTE: Every teacher is wildly different for this course. Some will have you doing zero homework all semester, others will treat it like a college english class.

reviews.comment: He isn't horrible, just very mediocre. The class is seminar based that had a different topic every time. I spoke like 7-8 times throughout the whole semester and still got an A on participation.

reviews.comment: Dr. Faulstick is a fantastic professor who is clearly passionate about what he teaches. This course requires a significant amount of reading but he was very open about this during syllabus week. The readings were interesting and impactful. He is a bit of a tough grader, but if you put in the effort and follow the rubric you will be fine!

reviews.comment: He is so disrespectful and accuses half the class of cheating-when no one even did. Completely degraded students.
If you want to be accused of using AI and failed out of the course even if you didnt use AI then take this class!

reviews.comment: Faulstick comes to life with an interesting perspective. The class had LOTS of reading, 45ish minutes for every class period. There were essays due about every 3 weeks, which were not difficult, but he graded ridiculously hard. I felt like he often took petty points off. If you miss more than a couple of classes, be prepared to get, at most, a C.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you enjoy reading and a discussion-based format, then you will love this class and Dr. Faulstick is very kind and engaging. However, there are many projects throughout the semester where directions were unclear and ideal formatting for the project was withheld or given at the last minute. However, I still did well in the class and enjoyed it!

Dr. Faulstick is INCREDIBLE. I am not a literature person, but he gave me a new appreciation for reading. There are readings for every class, four papers, and two group projects He gives amazing feedback, facilitates engaging class discussions, and helps students become better readers and writers.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He is a good professor. There is always an assigned reading, typically between 10-20 pages. He holds class till the very last second everyday. If you email that you are going to be absent he will ask you for your thoughts on the reading. Overall, he is a funny and entertaining professor and a good class. .

reviews.comment: Dr. Faulstick is a great professor, I was not a fan of the class. There are LOTS of readings for class that you'll have to discuss. There are a total of four creative projects and two group projects. One downside, he does not offer one free absence, so in order to get participation you have to email him summaries of the readings, even when sick.

He's a really good professor for HON 140. He engages with his students really well and easily approachable. As a student, I feel like he is the professor that you hope to have with a class like this. If you do take his class be prepared to read and discuss a lot of material for the class.

reviews.comment: Really good HON140 professor. Would recommend it!

reviews.comment: Dr. Faulstick is quirky and a bit eccentric, but clearly passionate about what he teaches. The readings are interesting and lead to engaging class discussions. Only four individual projects and two group projects. Dr. Faulstick was a decently lenient grader if you put in effort. The class was fun and challenged me creatively.

reviews.comment: He is such a nice person and an awesome professor. He made our class so fun and enjoyable. Definitely take his class if you have the chance!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dustin is a really nice guy and encourages students to "co-create" the classroom experience. Participation definitely matters, and it is important you do the readings before each class. There are a lot of readings and papers, but none of his assignments were extremely difficult. He cares about and respects all of his students.

Dr. Faulstick is my favorite professor I have had at UK. He is incredibly caring for his students and takes every measure to ensure their success. There will be readings for every class, but never anything over 45 minutes in my experience. Overall an awesome professor, and I would highly recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: This was the worst class I have ever taken at UK. Dr Faulstick is the most awkward person I have ever met and he was passive aggressive in class multiple times. DO NOT think this is class you can use as a study hall, he will be mad. He was extremely awkward when I approach him with a question. Very lengthy readings everyday. Do not recommend!!!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Faulstick is one of the best professors UK Honors has to offer. Witty and insightful, he makes sure students learn something in every class. Creative projects were fun and engaging, as well as class discussions. I recommend him a million times over.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Faulstick is a pretty good professor for a class that is interesting and easy to do well in. If you have an overloaded schedule and need to squeeze in an honors course, this is the one for you. The class is graded by a few big projects, but they are easy and fun to complete and he grades leniently. You will definitely like some of the readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dustin is a great professor with an awkward sense of humor that makes him lovable. Dont take his HON 252 class if you hate to read. Theres homework everyday and your grade is based off of participation and about 6 big projects, including creative projects and group projects. Would take again!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dustin is one of my favorite profs I have ever taken. He is super funny and truly cares about his students. He chose interesting readings and was super engaging. He also ended up being my advisor for research and was so helpful. 10/10 would recommend

Honestly, I don't really like literature, but Dustin made this class fun and interesting. There's a reading for each class and a guided discussion in class, so try to participate about once a day. We had four creative projects and two group led discussions that weren't bad at all and he grades pretty easy as well as give great feedback.

Dr. Faulstick is a great professor. He is funny (in an awkward kind of way) and makes class discussions engaging. There are several papers but they are certainly manageable, and Faulstick gives really great feedback. If you do some of the reading and show up to class you'll certainly get an A. Take him if you have the chance!

I don't love arts and creativity, but Dustin made this class really enjoyable! Super reading and participation heavy, only four creative projects, three short analyses, and a group presentation. Cares a lot about his students, made discussion really engaging most of the time, provided really good feedback, not a super hard grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Faulstick has been the best professor I have had at UK. I've taken two classes with him, and they both were very engaging and intellectually fulfilling. In this class, the readings are well thought out and truly integral to the class. Discussions too were also nice, and I never felt like they were too basic or surface-level.

Dr. Faulstick is an amazing professor and person. I had him for HON 101 and decided to take his short form literature class. This is the first time I have ever wrote creatively and felt a genuine like for my work, even if he doesn't fully understand it. Has an excellent ability to pull greatness from your papers when grading. Highly recommend!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: If you show up and participate in his class, you'll get an A. Very relaxed and awkward (but in a relatable way) and understanding if you need to leave early. Enjoyed his class; however, I do wish he had been harder. Many did not complete the readings, and it showed, and he relatively remained quiet on the issue. We are in honors after all!

I'm glad I took this class with Dr. Faulstick because even if he isn't the funnest honors professor he gets your work graded quickly and actually discusses the readings. His addition to HON 101 was a few short and relatively easy essays which you might prefer to having to do a reading journal entry for every single reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Hes a curious guy who legitimately wants to hear your thoughts on things. Make your essays original and youll get good scores. Actually treats students like humans, lets everyone call him Dustin, and wants students to know each other and be involved. A lot of people say hes a hard grader, but if you put in effort and ask questions youll be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed his HON 252 class about poetry. He is a hilarious professor and strives to initiate interesting discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Often very unhelpful. You watch lecture videos outside of class and are expected to know all the answers whenever you come into class. No amount of studying helped me. Exams have pretty much whatever the gen chem department wants on it, practice exams are unhelpful.

She isn't the worst, but she has a flipped classroom. She has lecture videos to watch before class, due at 10 am every day. These videos can range from 15 to 50 minutes. When you are in class, she quickly goes over the equations, and then for the remainder of class, you work on a worksheet. She makes it seem more confusing than it needs to be.

General Chemistry classes are difficult regardless. She wasn't the worst, but her teaching style didn't benefit me personally. She has a flipped classroom style. Lectures felt pointless to attend, you'd work on a worksheet and receive a grade for it with little guidance or teaching, and then have iClicker questions.

Easily one of my least favorite UK professors. He's nice, but nearly impossible to hear. Sometimes the TA goes over examples, which is pretty helpful, but other lectures are just a waste of time. Tests are only one question, but they're also open book. Not much homework, and not everything gets quizzed, so some of the material seems unnecessary.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Can't hear anything he says. Lectures are useless. Open note tests/quizzes so easy A, I guess.

Lectures were a little difficult to hear/understand because he does not talk very loud. Your entire grade basically depends on the midterm and final. He cares about you learning the material rather than plugging things in to equations. He was very nice and the course work was pretty manageable. Overall, I would take a class with him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Such a sweet old man! He was so helpful when you have a question and would give feedback during quizzes and exams if you wanted. Was super approachable and wanted you to understand so he wasn't shoving information down your throat but instead went at the classes pace. Love him!!!

This guy is super nice as a person, but because of his age the lectures are too difficult to understand or follow. He typically mumbles and it's best asking his TA for information on anything. The quizzes are super difficult, but the tests are pretty easy. VERY FEW ASSIGNMENTS, MAKE EVERY POINT COUNT

SUCH A FUN CLASS. If you have the opportunity to take this class do it, professor Duncan is such a good professor. He is very fair with grading, if you put effort in then you will be perfectly fine. All the movies you watch are Disney Princess films and then you have a discussion question each week with two essays and note checks, its so easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: easy easy A. TA sucked, but grading is easy. duncan obviously cares about his students, but the class was so boring. still, easiest A of my life. like 5 assignments all semester, super chill, very caring.
Without a doubt one of my favorite teachers ever. Please take him if you're considering it!!!

Took this course for ENG 130 and I would say that he is a great professor. They are a lot of discussions during the course lectures about the assigned books, which I am not a big fan of. But the class is pretty easy, with 4-5 assignments spaced out throughout the semester. 


Completing your assignments and showing to class will guarantee an A!
He's a really nice professor and not a super tough grader. The class is mainly large assignments spaced out over the semester but they aren't bad at all!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Duncan is extremely nice & funny, and I really enjoyed his class! There were only 3 major writing assignments and we had to write a short piece about a reading weekly, no exams. There are regular readings but I thought they were interesting. I also enjoyed the workshops a lot! We also didn't need the textbook. I'd highly recommend taking him!

He is super nice. We only had 3 major assignments. Don't buy the textbook we never used it. The class is very boring we just talked about the assigned readings the entire time all the time which can be very boring but the class is super easy and the professor is great.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was an insanely easy professor. A really chill guy. He didn't do much grading for my section, our TA's did, but they were all instructed to grade lightly. I think everyone in the class received an A unless they didn't submit anything. I also barely showed up to class but stayed on top of the assignments which was literally 3 assignments.

Dr. Duncan is a great, caring professor. He grades very easily and wants his students to take risks and write about things they enjoy. Do not bother buying the textbook - you will never use it (I'm glad I never bought it). There are lots of readings, probably too many for a 107 class, but most of them are interesting.
Amazing professor! For my first writing class I loved this course!! 100% would take again
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Duncan is interesting to listen to, funny, and easy to talk to outside of class! There was a textbook but you DON'T USE IT. Save yourself the money. You really just read the texts which he provides. He's understanding that a lot of people take this class since it's required but don't take advantage of that. Very sweet professor 10/10

I took ENG 107 with this professor and he is amazing. I would 1000% recommend this professor. His lectures are about readings that he will include links to. You do not absolutely need the textbook, but some readings are in there I would say about 3. No finals and no midterms. Understanding about other classes and their work. Great teacher!

Dr. Duncan was really good at understanding his students and their needs. He did assign a lot of reading and a paper every 2 books (4 papers in total), which I mean it is an English class so it makes sense. His discussions about the readings were very in depth and he helped clarify any areas of the books we did not understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: The letter count for this review tops at 350 letters, but there are not enough words in all of linguistic history to make it clear how wonderful of a professor and man he truly is. Plus, he's goofy. In terms of the class, it's difficult only if you don't lock into your study habits early on and/or you end up procrastinating on your collection!

The letter count for this review is only 350 letters, but there are not enough words in all of linguistic history to make it clear how wonderful of a professor and man he truly is. The course itself is somewhat difficult, but once you've locked into what works for you in terms of studying, you'll be fine. Also, collecting is fun!!! Get out there!!

julian is an amazing man and i am so lucky to have been taught by him. hes so kind and passionate about his work and it shows. if your taking taxonomy (offered every other fall) be prepared for a LOT of studying and working on your collection outside of class time. stay in class after the lecture for open lab!! that helps a TON

This professor speaks terrible english. You cannot understand him. He goes through a worksheet each lecture, and his handwriting is most of the time unreadable, especially if you cant understand what he's saying. If you have the option to take a different professor, i would highly encourage you to do so.

Assignments and exams weren't too difficult and he was helpful when I asked him to explain anything again. The notes he gave during lectures were also very similar to the questions on assignments and exams.

THIS CLASS SUCKED. The content itself wasn't necessarily that bad but Dr. Duc was horrendous. Had a really thick accent and was nearly impossible to understand, had abysmal pacing, and was awful at helping students actually understand. Never finished examples. 0/10. Class was way stressful

This is my second class with Dr. Dvorak and I am taking another one with her in the fall. She has high expectations for students and expects them to work for an A. Average or mediocre work will not get an A. She is an expert in her field! Taking a class wiht her is very different from the other CLD professors that give easy A's.

Dr. Dvorak has very high expectations for her students. She is extremely knowledgeable about the subjects she teaches and has a lot of field experience. CLD classes are usually too easy and she actually makes you work for your grade. She cares about her students and wants them to do well, but she isn't going to give out an easy A.

CLD classes are usually fun, engaging, and stimulate our students' passion for leadership. Dr. Dvorak makes it her job to make a class that should be fun and interesting, difficult and nearly impossible to get an A. WOULD NOT recommend, either for CLD majors or not.
BORING...I was not a fan of this class because it teaches you things that you basically already know. Billings is very smart but he isn't good with coherence and clarity, nor with technology.

I thought this class would be easy, especially for his overall ratings. They take this stuff way to seriously, and they all (professor and TA's) think way out of the box. May interest some people, but if your looking to take this for a UK Core and don't have any desire or interest its not worth it.

Billings really loves the region of "Appalachia" and teaching about it. He makes you think about things in a different way. The class was very interesting and the Ta's were also great. He's a really nice guy and you'll even see him at the extra credit lectures if you decide to go to them.

I took this class in the spring of 2012 before the class had been fine tuned.  Professor Billings was amazing and knows a lot about Appalachia. Coming from California I thought I would be bored out of my mind in this class but he really connected the problems of Appalachia to those of the US as a whole.

Dr. Billings has been one of my favorite professors at UK thus far. Genuinely cares more about representing the people of Appalachia in a good light then following all the stereotypes you would expect. Fairly easy grader and an interesting class. Take him if given the opportunity. A++

A lot of reading involved with the class but he makes it interesting.  He knows so much about the subject he sometimes doesn't explain things clearly.  The tests are essay based basically and theres a lot of potential material.  I failed the first exam but got a B on the second so just be sure to do everything he asks.

Prof. Billings is incredibly approachable and VERY knowledgeable.  He is an expert, but he never made students feel stupid (always got something intelligent/valuable/relevant for the class from what a student said in class).  This made it very easy to speak up in class and to enjoy learning.  He also has a good sense of humor!
BEST TEACHER!!!! so nice and sweet very understanding...and will work with students! literally got  a b and didnt even go to class

I loved this class.  He was always more concerned with actually teaching about Appalachia than grading students.  The major portions of the grade were a take-home midterm and final plus a weekly journal.  Lots of reading, but it was all interesting.
Really really easy class and a very nice professor.
his classes are fun and he is very knowledgable.  there is a lot of reading, so chose a topic you are interested in
Great teacher! Knows tons about the subject. Fairly easy class, lots of reading, lots of writing. Some boring documentaries.
awesome!!
He looks at the papers you write very carefully, so make sure you can write clearly.  Also, there is a LOT of reading involved with this class.
Dr. Dziubla taught this course very well. He does challenge you to know the material very well but is ultimately fair in his grading.

Avoid if possible. he does not teach. There are no slides and no real guidance, so you are 100% responsible for teaching yourself the entire curriculum. This class is extremely time consuming because you'll spend hours outside of class trying to understand and learn material. Quizzes and exams are weighted highly so score as high as possible.

You need the book for homework. You don't need the book for anything else. His tests will not match example questions in the book. Go in knowing all the material as an A student should learn and prepare, for him to outsmart you. I felt like all his tests were to impress the class with his knowledge of the material. Not necessarily testing ours

worst professor I have ever had. made absolutely NO sense 100% of the time. Homeworks did not line up with what he was "teaching" in class. I use that word teaching loosely cause I did not learn a single thing this entire class. Unless ur a child prodigy and do engineering as your hobby, ur not going to know what is going on.
He makes you think critically about all aspects of reality and question it. He'll then question that. He taught me the importance, but also limitations of being curious.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Dziubla expects students to understand the material given in class, not just regurgitate it on the exams. That being said, when I took the class, he allowed a note sheet for the exams and gave solid hints as to what would be covered on the exam. Grading is pretty black and white as this class focuses on using computer programs which run or fail
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: His tests are just incredibly hard. First exam average was a 61. Gets worse as semester goes. Super spazy dude, but wants to help. Tests are stupid hard though.
Intro class for CME at Uky. Easy if you do the work he gives. Large portion of grade is a group project, but not bad if you actually do the work.
Last semester I took his class, CME 220. I don't know where he is from, but he has never taught clearly. Exams were extremely hard. Also, he graded unfairly. I would not take his class anymore.

Nick tries his best to work with the information he gets from the professor. He is a lenient grader and wants us to succeed. He has been very helpful with things outside of class as well, like talking one on one about a career in psychology. He is a cool guy, I would recommend trying to take something with him before he leaves next semester.

He was the TA for the course, but often explained things far more clearly than the actual professor. He clearly knows what he is talking about, and takes care to ensure that the students understand as well. During the lab, he made certain that each student/pair/group understood the task and the content. Easy to get along with, easy to learn from.
He was the TA for this class. Ultimately, he was better than the actual professor. He is super caring and wants students to do well.
Ive never been more disrespected by a teacher in my life. Doesn't care about her students well being. Simply docent teach just reads of the slides. Worst class ever but is mandatory.

Impossible to avoid in this major and the worst professor ever. So rude and not personable at all, lectures by reading directly off slides in the most monotone voice you've ever heard in your life, only uses canvas to insert grades, buy a folder because she has a 'hand-out' for everything, complains about students using the bathroom, overall, 0/10
tough teacher but overall if you pay attention you will be more likely to succeed

I wish more than anything that she was not the only professor teaching this class- mandatory to my major. Lectures are god awful boring, making it difficult to pay attention. Exams are upwards of 80-100 questions each, some including material never covered in class. Easter is rude to students. Its a wonder she still has a job.

Easter is a very dry professor and if you are a MAT major you cannot avoid her. Her classes are very test-heavy. She has a couple of quizzes and exams. Her exams are very long and will not let you engage with the materials or lessons in class. Avoid her if you can!!!

The class is really not that bad. Try to go through each slide and write down anything even slightly noteworthy onto a Quizlet set to study for exams. However, the professor is unforgiving and at times condescending but she is very knowledgeable. No matter what NEVER forget your textile kit for labs/quizzes or there is no mercy. You will do great!
Old lady needs to croak already

You can do well in this course if you come to class everyday (3 days a week, and I don't think she's ever cancelled class), study for quizzes and tests (but she tells you exactly what to study for), and NEVER forget your textile kit if you need it. Overall, just follow her rules, study what she says, and you'll be fine. Plus, tests are curved!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easter's class should have been interesting but due to her lackluster teaching style, it was hard to focus. Easter isn't very personable and is not very kind to students. While the class is  pretty cool, she is often short with students and seems as if she doesn't want to be bothered. I would not take this professor by choice.

Just dont do it. Its an elective class and she does the most. And she has an attitude from time to time. Especially if you have extra-curricular activities or youre an athlete, do your mental health a favor and just dont.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The tests are unnecessarily hard because they have 100 questions and sometimes there are even things we haven't learned. The thing that helped me the most was studying other people's quizlets. She was just very monotone and not very personable. The only good thing is that she gives lots of extra credit options and curves the tests. DONT TAKE
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Easter knows a lot. She is a little intimidating to ask questions to but she will teach you a lot if you pay attention. The tests are fairly hard but she curves them which is nice. She also offers extra credit!

This class requires a ton of studying and memorization to pass quizzes and tests. Professor Easter basically just reads off of the slides and doesn't explain things in detail to help students fully grasp the concept of different textiles. She also gives out a ton of unnecessary packets and papers that are difficult to keep track of.

She expects you to know every little detail about textiles. Luckily with attendance and some extra credit you can receive a C on most exams and still pass with an A or B. If you fail more than two exams you will most likely end with a low c or B. I dreaded this class. I had to study so much just to receive C's on her exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Easter is by far the rudest professor I have ever encountered and her class is ridiculously hard. MAT515 is an ELECTIVE and not even required for MAT majors. Do NOT take her or this class. You have to spend your own money on the shirts, binding the projects, and she keeps them! There are also 100 Q exams and a presentation. So much stress.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Worst professor I have ever had. Never take a class with her. The amount of work she expects from students is ridiculous. She is rude to students and will not help you if you are confused. She expects you to go above and beyond just to get an average grade in the class. She is not helpful and the workload she gives makes it hard to pass.

Dr. Easter is incredibly knowledgeable and she is known for having a challenging class. This is not a class that you will easily skate through. If you want to succeed on the exams you need to study EVERYTHING and I mean everything on this chapter. You need to know your content for these exams inside and out and they can be very brutal if unprepared

Dr. Easter can be intimidating at first, but after you get to know her, she is really caring and sweet. She is someone who will for sure make certain that you will learn everything. She is highly connected outside UK, so getting on her good side is very important in terms of networking. She is an excellent teacher and you will for sure learn a lot.
Dr. Easter is incredibly hard, but so worth it. Dr. Easter taught me the most out of all my teachers at UK.  If you participate and show dedication, Dr. Easter will reciprocate.

Heaven forbid you actually have to work hard at a 100 level class!  Dr. Easter's class is what I wish more classes were like.  It is challenging, no-nonsense, and by the time the semester is over you have actually learned  something.  As a student paying my own way though college, I really feel like I got my money's worth with her.

Ms. Easter is extremely unpleasant, and she DOES NOT let you use your swatch kit for the test! Memorize every fabric. She is not a nice teacher and doesn't help you learn at all. She also tries to tell jokes that are NOT funny. When she ask the class a question, answer. She won't go on until you do.

Dr. Easter is an amazing teacher and very knowledgeable of the subject matter. She challenges you to do your best and you learn so much in her classes. People don't like her because they are wanting an easy class and are unwilling to put forth the effort.

Easter is the most miserable professor I have ever encountered.I missed a few classes due to surgery & she humiliated me in front of the entire class and tried to force me out of her class. Her tests are unfair and ridiculous and when she reads the grade breakdown she laughs and blames the students for a lack of studying.  I wish she was avoidable.

This class would not have been so bad if she had not been the teacher. She is uninteresting and mean. But you need to go to class or you will miss quite a lot on the tests, plus you get 50 extra bonus points.
she sucks and she is mean
Not very helpffull at all and very uninteresting.

there is a lot of material for each of the tests that she has which there are six test and a cumulative final don't wait to study till the last second to study and make sure you go to class it helps a lot
She has no desire to hear about your excuses and will not be nice about make up work.  Just attended class and study and you should do well
Easter's class is ridiculous. Imagine the hardest exam ever, then beat your head against a rock.

You really have to work hard in this class to get the grade that you want. I studied more for this class than any other that I have taken. Do well on all of the tests and you wont have to study that much for the final. Also, if you go to every class you get 50 extra credit points!!! Not a very personable teacher, and you really have to work

Dr. Easter is the most unhelpful teacher I've had in my 5 years at UK. She makes students feel like idiots when asking questions, and laughs when we're confused about something she's unclear about. If I didn't have to have her to graduate, I would avoid it at all costs.

This teacher has the most bitter personality and does not ever crack a smile. Her material is easy and the book is easy to follow. She teaches in an effective manner but this class is not for slackers.
I cannot believe how horrible of a teacher this woman is. Although I know most of us who want to take this class HAVE to, I am sorry. :(
No Comments
The worst teacher I've had at UK. Unclear, not helpful, poor attitude in general. Listening to lectures was like watching grass grow.

Lee is awesome! I've taken several classes with him, from the 100 to 300 level. He grades tough, but gives great feedback and is usually willing to make recommendations on a submission before you turn it in. He's hilarious and a great teacher!
Lee is hilarious. The semester long project gets a little tedious at times, and he is a tough grader, but the lectures are interesting and it is a great class
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is a great teacher, super fun and funny. He expects us to work hard and is a good teacher. Has high expectations from us but an awesome teacher. I can't wait to have him as my teacher again!

Lee is a great professor, but he grades hard. Sometimes expectations can be a little unclear, but if you ask him to look at something, he'll give good feedback. The biggest plus for me is that he never takes points for late work, and will let you redo bad assignments for a better score. Great teacher, harder course than it looks though.

Do NOT take this class if you are not an Arts Admin major. Lee is a nice person, but this class was the bane of my existence this semester. The work feels mindless and the class is uninteresting. SO many expectations and so much work for a 100-level class. I'm even a studio major and I am extremely passionate about art, but this was AWFUL.

I wouldn't recommend taking the class unless you're actually an Arts Admin major. There are way too many expectations for a 100 level class-- the grading is so tough. There's a semester long group project so if you hate group work, definitely avoid this one.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Lee is a tough grader but gives so much feedback so that you can improve over the semester. If you want an A you have you put in the work, but I wouldn't necessarily call it hard- just takes focus and determination. He is funny too- always had the class laughing at his overuse of slang. I enjoyed him as a teacher and can't wait for 320 with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Lee was one of my best professors this semester. He was definitely a tougher grader than expected, but it just pushed me to work harder. Friendly, funny, and genuinely interested in educating. Highly recommend taking any of his classes!

Prof. Lee is incredible! Although he's a tough grader, he gives an incredible amount of feedback to let you know what you're doing correctly or what you need to improve upon. He is probably the funniest professor I've ever had, and is extremely caring about his students.
He yelled at me everyday and had the worst style. he thinks hes a therapist when he just rubs his hand on his head 100x and doesn't stop saying uhm.

A lot of people don't like Dustin but he was great for the most part. Yeah he's strict-DON'T USE YOUR PHONE OR COMPUTER-but he's a good guy. Tests are hard and don't reflect the workbook at all. Lectures can be boring and pointless but you have to go. Overall for a mandatory class it wasn't horrible and it's my worst subject, but I managed an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: He is really funny and engaging. You HAVE to go to class for a good grade.
Dustin is a great prof and cares about his students learning. The material is difficult but if you can get in a good table group at the beginning of the year you'll be fine & should pass the class.

his classes are boring but that's because it's math. you spend the entire class going over homework in your table group. he is hilarious and tries to make stats fun. all the work was for participation. pick a good table at the beginning and you'll be set.

I took Prof. Lueker for STA210 online. Its a demanding course simply because its an entire semesters worth of work smashed into 10 days. Even so, as long as you complete the workbook pages by his suggested due date, its easy to stay on track. I spent 4-5 hours a day doing work for this class and its a pretty easy A or B. Would recommend.

Dustin Lueker is a horrible professor. He doesn't teach anything. The professor will treat you horribly if you have your phone out. I had to use my phone due to a family crisis. I told him that but he didn't care. He's an ass---e. He doesn't realize that this is very tough material and not used outside of the classroom.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: I took STA210 online and I had many technology problems which he refused to help me. I had to drop the class

VERY mean teacher, does not help you learn stuff what so ever, DO NOT TAKE HIM, if you can get another teacher PLEASE do or take it online because he is AWFUL at what he does. My group was asking a question and he JUST WALKED AWAY. He is the WORST teacher I have ever had at UK.

He gives very good feedback and always makes sure you understand the material before moving on. He does get off topic a lot, but it isn't that much of a problem. He's very tough on late work, 0 tolerance policy.   Overall a very good teacher. I was worried about how focused I'd be with the subject material, but he kept it entertaining.

If you want to learn statistics either teach yourself or don't take this class. Professor doesn't usually teach the material and is very patronizing when it comes to attendance, technology use in class, etc. Would not recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Terrible teacher. You hardly learn anything in the class. He's also rudely sarcastic, threatens to kick you out of class for using any technology, and cusses for no reason. Would not reccomend taking whatsoever.

His class was bitter sweet. If you just want to pass the core, then go with him. If you want to actually learn something... well you might want to pick another teacher lol. Every sentence is interrupted with an UM and a cuss word, and the classes are literally just going over homework. Easy tests, easy homework, and an easy group project(s).

He is by far the worst professer  I have ever taken here at UK. He reads straight off the powerpoint and sucks at teaching. His exams are incredibky hard considering you learn nothing. I am a deans list student and got my first C ever in his class. Would not reccomened. He will not help you if you ask for help and he is mean.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: long-sleeve-button down with cargo shorts. Everyday
He's a cool dude but the class is confusing and more challenging than it should be. Maybe I just hate math, but it's a subject that could be easier. Barely got an A. He gives EC at end of semester.

I took this class due to the positive ratings that I am now very confused on. I am not terrible at math, some would even say I am good; but in stats 210. This class is set up where you do homework BEFORE you are taught the material. You have multiple assignments, quiz and test making the work load ridiculous. He is snarky and just doesn't care.

There is homework due every class, but the homework doesn't account for many points. Very funny and sometimes has the whole class rolling, but if you are talking or on your phone he will angrily call you out. Gets off topic really easy and doesn't explain things very well, so get ready to teach yourself. Not terrible, but try to get someone else.

Dustin Lueker is one of the meanest people I have ever encountered. He is constantly yelling and cursing to the class. He has a zero technology policy, so if he catches you with your phone you might as well drop the class because as he said "I will make your lives a living hell and feel no remorse about it."
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Very good teacher, gets to the point and tests are easy. However one of the meanest people I have ever met, very sarcastic and gets off topic during class to insult his students. Very rude and mean and extremely disrespectful to his students

Lueker has been one of my favorite professors. He is very approachable and helps out when he can. I had to be out of town for a period of time and he was willing to help me make up material, homework, and quizzes. He does get off topic often, but it's usually a nice and funny break from stats material. Bottom line, he's great and tests are easy!

Dr. Lueker is a "straight to the point" kind of guy.  He will teach you what you need to know for the exams without trying to trick you.  Attendance is technically optional but I wouldn't recommend.  Exams are moderately tough, but manageable with the resources he provides.  I would definitely take any class taught by him.

One of the worst professors I've had at UK. this is supposed to be an intro stats class, but really difficult. He seems like a really nice person, but not a very good professor. He doesnt explain anything in class, and for someone who has never taken a stats class before, the content is very confusing. DONT TAKE HIM.

Dustin is really laid back and approachable. He makes a required class bearable. It's still difficult, with many homework assignments and mandatory attendance, but not impossible.  The workbook is often confusing, but that's not his fault. He tries to be as clear as possible. If you have to take the class, he's a good, straightforward professor.

dustin is a great teacher. you have to apply yourself outside of class, even though there is no textbook. you have to take your own notes and study the material, and if you do okay on the tests, and participate in class it is fairly easy to get an A. lots of points because you get 10 points for attendance each day and lots of small homework points

If you have to take this class I would recommend taking it with Lueker. Statistics does not come easy to me, but as long as you come to all classes and labs, turn in homework, and raise your hand for bonus points it is still possible to get a good grade without doing the best on the tests. There are a lot of homework and projects.

He is really funny in lectures and respects his students while still being able to make fun of them in a joking way. The class is tough and things aren't always super clear but it's for a core credit so just do your best.
He was really funny and I learned a lot in his class
Dustin was funny and knowledgeable. He was fun in class and was very accessible if you needed help. I would definitely recommend people to take him for STA 210

He says he is strict about due dates and means it.  Tests are hard.  Make sure to ask questions during the reviews and he will steer you towards questions on the test.  Answer questions in class for easy bonus points.  His humor and off topic stories make lecture easier to sit through.

Looked forward to this class even though it was only for a Core credit. Absolutely hilarious, very clear cut and understanding. Tests are nearly exact questions as in lab & class. He literally works through everything with you. Online videos are given for extra help if you need it, he will walk you through everything. Wish there were more like him

His grading was really tough and he is not understanding of complications or conflicts. He does not grade any of the work. He makes his TA's grade homework, quizzes, and tests, and he REQUIRES you to grade your peers papers through an online application. If you turn in your work, but forget to grade someone else's, you will fail the assignment.
Great guy! Very funny as well and gives out extra credit.

Super funny and nice guy. Very helpful when you have questions and always responds to emails quickly. He usually always takes up the work you do in class for participation so its an easy grade if you go to class every time.

This class is pretty easy. Go to class, participate often to get extra points, and turn things in on time. The tests match homework and in-class work. Dustin is very funny but can get off-topic sometimes. Overall a great class
Very easy! Test questions come straight from the homework.

Don't be fooled. This class is not a super easy A if you are not good at statistics. Dustin is great though. He's funny and explains himself pretty well. Be sure to attend on a rainy/cold/generally gross day because he always collects stuff on those days. 8am wasn't too bad with him.

Loves sports and talks about them a lot. (Wrestling, UK Basketball, Football) Explains concepts pretty well and open to questions. STA 210 is really easy. Tests can be a little tricky in the short-response section, otherwise very clear. Good Professor.    Textbook used as workbook.
Very hilarious and helpful!
Had a really good time in the class. He cracks a lot of jokes and is in a very good mood for an 8am class. Really glad I had him as a teacher.

He's an enthusiastic and funny professor. I'd recommend going to class as much as possible because he often collects and grades (for completion usually) the worksheets you do in class. Also, the examples he covers in class often turn out to be exact exam questions. Very helpful professor!

He's really funny, and tends to get off topic but the class isn't that hard. Be at lecture for in class assignments and at section, but he doesn't take attendance. Class is easy, but be careful, if you're half asleep that day make sure you go over whats happening on your own. One more thing, watch the time on tests, open answers are long!
Very good teacher.  Usually he get off topic which is nice and the homework is pretty easy.  During lecture you mainly do easy group work and tests are not bad at all.
Hilarious! Always has something interesting to say, doesn't spend the whole time lecturing, but you do more (easy) group work. An easy class to fill a requirement.
This dude is insane. Hands down the most A.D.D. prof ever to teach. Class is always entertaining, and yet he still manages to teach the course. Laid back and helpful when needed.

He is pretty cool, very laid back. He tends to have ADD and ramble about sports or Morehead (where he went) but overall he's a good teacher. Lectures are pointless but Labs are really helpful. Online homework is kinda hard and the final is incredibly hard but overall enjoyed the class.
Great, hilarious guy. Class is incredibly easy, and he is funny. Highly recommend for STA 291.
Very enjoyable class, very helpful teacher, always has something funny to talk about
I was doubting architecture until I had professor Eade. His studio made me see how meaningful design can be.
I hear a lot of Prof Eade before I took the class,. after his studio I felt like a learned more in one semester than I did since I was a freshman 2 years ago. Def . recommend .

Professor Eade's studio's are famous for producing incredible projects which address real world problems. Take his class and you will end up with an amazing portfolio project. He always comes to class with inspiration for students to feed off off. I wish more of my professors had his level of enthusiasm. My favorite studio so far!

He constantly changes what he expects from you and your project. He wastes a lot of studio time by talking over his students and hearing himself talk. He can be extremely pretentious and ovezealous, which wastes a lot of studio time. Despite your design ability, he will try to micromanage your project. Don't recommend.
The worst mathematics prof at UK. Avoid this guy like the plague.

He makes no sense in class. He just rambles on for the whole hour. Quizzes everyday for participation points, you will need to study for every single one of them). Starts class 3 minutes early and ends 2 minutes late every day. Just don't take his class, save yourself.

He goes on a lot of rants. This class could be called snooze-a-lot class. If you haven't had precalculus in high school, get a tutor fast. The TAs will try to help but sometimes will only confuse you more.

I took his MA 110 class during fall semester. he's confusing. Exams are easy if you study. There's a quiz every class (that's how he takes attendance) but he posts the possibles problems for the upcoming quizzes.

I Still have good memories of this course,although I finished it in Fall of 2009. I viewed for myself, the actual historical occurrences, not a revamped modern twist of journalistic opinion. I also got the opportunity to write in nearly every genre, which was a great experience. I found Carol Eades to be thoughtful, insigtful and a Godly woman.
Very good professor, willing to help whenever she is needed.
Very good professor.

Not the best ENG 203 instructor...  Try to STAY away...  She grades really hard and marks up papers something awful...  I really disliked this woman and she made this class suck...  I had recieved all A's in every other English class but I somehow got a C in here... Go figure...

The class is easy i guess, but she is such a pain.  She's a tree huggin, read to you aloud, monotone speaking pain. And she has no idea what an academic source is.  Not worth the trouble, pass this one up
No Comments

She is a good teacher and you have plenty of small assignments that can help your grade.  We had to write three 5-7 pg papers and one 10 pg (final).  If you talk in class and work hard at first then the rest of the semester will be a breeze.  Recommended.
awesome teacher
No Comments
easy English 101 grade, only 4 papers to write but there is a lot of reading for each paper, also the teacher conferences with you on each paper & helps out if you have any questions

I managed to pull an A in this class, but she had several assignments that just went ungraded. It would suck if you were so close to a letter grade you wanted, but she did not put the grade in. She is also a tough grader.
I think there is actually something going on with this woman's head that is beyond simply being an unkind person and a bad professor. If you catch my drift.
One of the most unorganized professors I have ever had. AVOID at all costs.
absolutely NOT.

Despite the difficulty, I enjoyed the class, her high standards pushed students to produce quality work. Dr. Eckman is a tough grader with very clear expectations and a strong focus on group work. She'll mark you down for anything she can justify, but she also offers chances to revise assignments and gives helpful feedback.

Quite possibly the worst “professor” I have ever had in college. Not only does she lack any sort of respect towards her students, but she is also an awful educator. She does not teach course material and her feedback for projects is both unhelpful and unnecessarily lengthy. She makes Satan seem pleasant to be around. I would avoid her at all costs!
Y'all I graduated three years ago and I just woke up from a nightmare I was in her class again. Can't believe she's still teaching
Worst professor I have ever had
I will never forget this woman as long as I live. In a bad way.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There are no words.

I took ISC 311 online with her. She was always unprepared and would just forget to post assignments or tests or just message us. She does not answer emails so don't even bother. Avoid her at all costs, she is the worst professor I've had, maybe even worst teacher I've ever had.

Avoid at all costs. When literally every single group gets an "F" grade on the first three major assignments and has to revise, you know your professor is the problem. She is so unclear and expects so much. She says she treats this like the comp team. If I wanted to join the comp team, I would have joined the comp team.

Do not take any course with her if you do not have to. She is such a tough grader and expects above and beyond when she does not teach accordingly. She rants the first half of the class about things that are very rarely relevant to course work. Overall, not an amazing professor..
gives study guides for exams
So mean and scary! Doesn't teach you anything in class, such a hard grader. Worst person I have ever met!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I did a study abroad class with her and she talked about how she purposely made the class hard because she's hard to impress. If you write a good paper, but it's only good, then you will get a C or maybe a B if you're lucky. She wasn't very clear about her grading criteria or instructions as well, so I definitely didn't enjoy the class.

She is so difficult to work with! I tried so hard to communicate any problems and issues I was having, and she was very condescending and purposely makes her content hard for students to succeed. Seriously don't take her class if you can choose someone else

Dr. Eckman is well educated and knows her stuff, however she is extremely condescending towards students and even her TAs. She'll give large assignments w/ little instruction, but make sure to follow her few instructions EXACTLY as they're given. She'll also count you absent for being tardy but she'll more than likely be 5 minutes late to lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Easily the most annoying teacher I ever had. Its not that shes hard, its that she almost wants everyone in her class to do bad to prove a point or something. If you have the chance to take it with someone else DO IT. I hated every min of that class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: The second she starts talking, you should be writing. EVERYTHING is important, even if it doesn't seem like it. The first half of the semester is hard, but it's to weed people out. It gets better after the midterm. Don't let her scare you!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She is an awful teacher and doesn't teach you anything in lecture.

One of the most difficult classes I've ever taken. She is also rude and tries to come off as intimidating to her students. She knows she's a tough professor so just get ready. You can pass but you need to try harder in this class than you may be used to.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I barely learn anything form her lectures. If it wasn't for her TA, Molly, I do't think I would have passed this class. She is very unclear and expects the world out of you with no information.

Tough grader and leads a tough class. Students find her intimidating, but I didn't. Condescending if anything. She mirrors the real world in her classroom which really prepares you for what lies ahead. So many students didn't want to put in the work and just whined through the whole class. But her class was the best & most helpful I've taken at UK.
She loves to see her students suffer.   Make sure you follow the directions. She doesn't give leniency for quizzes, tests or assignments. Be prepared...

Absolutely loved Dr. E. Yes, she is tough and she is very strict, but she's an amazing professor. She gives you all the tools to succeed and gives you the choice to do well or slack off. I sat in the second row and only asked a question once and she recognized me out of class. She rewards hard work with recognition. Work hard and you'll be fine.

This was by far the hardest class I've taken at UK in the last 3 years. I put more effort into this class than any of my others combined and never got higher than a B on an assignment BUT Dr. E is one of the best professors I've had. You learn a huge amount from this class and although she's an extremely hard grader, she provides you w/ resources

Dr. E is a great professor! The class, however, is EXTREMELY difficult. Take notes on EVERYTHING and study like crazy before exams. I worked my ass off and got an A but the majority of students struggled to even pass the class ;/

Major hard ass! If you don't follow the directions to a T then you are not going to get higher than a C. You need to literally not even miss a period or comma if you want to pass the class. However, she is very open and nice once you get to know her it is just her way or the highway. Good luck incoming ISC majors
Very hard class.  She is a great professor but doesn't provide any lenience on any test, quiz or work.

Eckman is a badass. I loved her class, she's hilarious and she really knows her stuff, very knowledgable. I always looked forward to going to her class, it was a lot of fun. Her exams can be kind of difficult, but just make sure you study the things she tells you to study and you'll be fine. I definitely recommend taking her class.

Dr.Eckman is the best. She is absolutely hilarious and makes class very interesting! I would suggest sitting in the front row of her class. She is incredibly helpful. There is a variety of material in the class so your grade will really depend on if youre good at all the different types of direct marketing, ect. I would take any of her classes.
No question that she knows what she's doing. Has a lot of experience in the field. Really funny and cool if you get to know her. Willing to help students all the time.
Knows her stuff but doesn't explain assignments very well.

Took an online class with Seth he gives clear instructions and provides all materials needed to succeed in his class. He cares about his students and provides great feedback and easy to get in touch with. If you have a chance take his class you will not be disappointed. Fun, informational and well-organized.

Seth is an awesome professor. Class was mandatory, but he makes learning his lectures so enjoyable that you wont miss a class. He is easy to contact when emailing. And he truly cares about his students and sets them up to succeed. Having a teacher like Seth makes you want to work hard to show how awesome he is.
I love him!!! He is so awesome and so easy!! I think everyone gets an A regardless of what you do... TAKE HIM!
Seth is a wonderful teacher! Definetly take his class! He has a great personality and he makes his class super fun!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Seth makes class fun,intersting and is always making me laugh.  If you have any questions he is always there to help.  TAKE HIS CLASS!

Dr. Eakin needs to retire. His lectures are pointless, but that the same time you need to go. He gives quizzes every single day, and usually there are typos on them. He gets distracted and loses train of thought in class quite often which in return makes the lecture even worse.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class was supposed to be a pre calc like class, but instead we ended up doing things that calc 3 students were doing. A lot of his work is theory based and topics are random and all over the place. He's a sweet old man, but the class is confusing. I got a tutor and she had no idea how to do some of the work.

Really nice dude, and I believe HE knows his stuff, but he can no longer teach it. Very confusing and makes a lot of mistakes in lectures and notes. Covers random topics, my tutor was a math and physics professor and he didn't even know what Eakin was talking about when I went to him. Also, DO NOT SKIP CLASS. He gives quizzes each class worth a lot
Not easy to understand sometimes. Loves to go over theory based work.

Eakin is the worst matrix algebra professor I could possibly imagine. His lectures make no sense and are impossible to follow.  Textbook doesn't help since his lectures don't follow the chapters and his notes are  unreadable. There are no uk tutors for MA 322 so I'm kinda screwed. Don't take him for MA 322 if you want to learn
Very hard homework.

Professor Eakin means well. He is a nice guy but my high school Calc teacher was much better.  If I didn't have high school notes, I would be screwed.  Tests are pretty difficult but a nice test bank is provided on the website.  He's not the greatest teacher but if he's the only one that fits your schedule, it's not the end of the world.

Calculus II is as difficult as you make it. In order to do well in the class, you have to study and work out the suggested problems. Paul was great at giving help to anyone that came to his office hours. The lectures weren't bad, but you couldn't really grasp the material until you worked the problems. Paul was great and kind to me.

Dr. Eakin is a great Mathematician.  Lectures focus on the theory and why you use certain formulas.  Outside of class (office hours, Mathskeller) he is very personable.  He knew my name without me even talking to him one-on-one before.  He demands participation in class and often will not continue until he gets it.  Overall a great math professor.
People who don't like him don't understand math. Great teacher. Great person. I love paul.
horrible teacher,we had a 30 point curve on our first exam. the test are too hard and his notes are terrible.

He is awesome. You have to go to his office hours to really understand the topics. He wants to help his students and cares. Don't leave early from class because he hates it. He is super nice and will meet with you at almost anytime for help.
I took Calculus in High School and if it were not for that I would have received an F. He has so many errors in his notes that I gave up copying.
Terrible teacher. Never wanted to go to class. Confused himself and the entire class daily. Learned nothing. If it wasn't for recesitaion I would have failed this class.
Kinda didn't learn a thing

Great teacher for Calc 2. Sometimes a little unclear or flustered and he will make mistakes, but he will always help you understand what is going on and is very available. Really nice guy all he asks is that you attend class and don't leave in the middle. Made it so I didn't dread Calc 2.

Calc II isn't cake no matter which professor you take it with, but Dr. Eakin is overall an excellent choice. In a math department filled with...less than savory professors, Dr. Eakin stands out by putting a priority on the success of his students, if you're willing to work for it. Four tests, online homework, class attendance required, I recommend.

Dr. Eakin is very helpful, sometimes he does get stuck and some days he can be slightly confusing but if you ask him to clarify, he'll clarify right there in the lecture and he's always willing to help you. Once, he spent about 20 to 30 minutes helping me after class even though it wasn't his time to be in Mathskeller or office hours. Great teacher

He manages to take simple topics and completely overcomplicated them. He constantly fumbles over himself making mistakes in class. The worst part, however, is that he makes the mandatory online homework insanely hard which makes you lose serious motivation. I could rarely do the hw, but got an av. of 97 on the exams, only because I read the book.

A great teacher, more then willing to work one on one outside of class. I have taken him now for 3 of my classes and even though his classes aren't easy if you are willing to work he will make sure you understand the materail which in turn equals a good grade. I recommend him to anyone who is serious about math.

Eakin is a very nice professor if you go to class everyday and actually pay attention. He is wiling to work with you and explian things further. For this class you need to go to class to  understand since there is no text book. If you pay attention and do all the homework and understand it there is no reason why you won't pass.

He believes that it is his job to teach the theory and then examples will be shown in recitation. However, if you go to MathSkeller he is WONDERFUL! He will teach you anything and make sure you understand it. Sometimes he gets confused in class, but for the most part it is easy to follow.

Pretty straight forward class. Prepares people for thinking outside of the box. Tries to help students understand and learn the material. All the MA 109 kids typing stuff on here should feel ashamed for sucking at MA 109 (algebra for crack babies).

Though he is slightly distracted he was always willing to answer questions inside and outside of class.Very fair...if you struggle on one test and do well on the others he will guarantee you will have a decent grade. Lectures slightly boring but overall I learend a lot from his class.

GET OUT GET OUT!!!! You will want to blow your brains out in this class. NO MATTER WHAT you will NOT pass, don't listen he's lying. My class had to retake 2 exams because we all failed so bad, then we had a "permanent substitute" for 3 weeks and we all did wonderfully on that material on the exam. The university NEEDS to do something about him!
I failed awfully, im going to take this class at a smaller school and transfer the credit... i wouldnt recommend this class at all
Don't take your MA 109 class at UK.  Not only do the professors not teach, but the whole programs is horrible.

I now like calculus.  Dropped this course years ago when he taught it.  For me, he was a poor instructor.  Used a HANDWRITTEN 'book'; taught from one chapter and assigned homework from another.  I went on to do well in another course, but even when I tried to talk to him about my needs and abilities on many occasions, he was not receptive at all.
I hate this class
this guy will make you hate your life.  you will never want to go to class and you will fail.. get out while you still can!!!

OMG I HATE THIS GUY! He totally screwed me over. At the beginning he promisses every1 a C but I did all the homework, passed the tests (barely) and I got a D. He's such a loser. He can't teach a thing and rambles. Mathskellar didn't even know what he was doing. #*#*#*#*#STAY AWAY!#*#*#*#*#*

***WARNING*** if you are in this class, GET OUT while you still have a chance!! he is crazy, he is supposed to teach math 109: algebra and you will definatley be failing because he teaches calculus instead.you will hate the class, hate your life if you take this class!! stay away!!!

This man teaches what is supposed to be MATH !)(: college algebra, yet you end up learning calculus, and he does not teach problems - he teaches theory.  Unless you enjoy sleeping through classes, failing tests, and hating life, this class is NOT for you!

WOW this guy made me want to shove a pencil through my eye. That would have been more enjoyable. Very unclear, rambles, and does not show "How to DO a problem" but where its components came from. No effort to know anyone in class.
LOVE LOVE LOVE MR CHAD. LOVE YOUR CHADDY!

He was easy to talk to and I never felt scared to ask him questions. He was always willing to help. Gave good feedback on critique days, but I was always unsure how he graded projects. Some of the things he suggested felt kind of contradictory depending on the person presenting.

I got a good grade in his class, but I feel like I didn't really learn anything. Lots of group projects and easy grading because he gives so much feedback. He takes attendance religiously. Has a cool vibe and is nice and willing to explain things multiple times
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Amazing teacher! Very intimidating, but she pushes you to do your best. I wouldn't call her understanding just because she definitely leans towards tough love. I only wish she taught us more technical stuff rather than pushing our concept.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Ebony is a difficult professor, and her class is very expensive. But if you work hard in her class, you learn a lot. She pushes you, but it's worth it!

She is extremely insightful but has a tendency to push some students too far without any consideration. I'm not sure if she's trying to prove herself but whatever she's doing, she needs to calm down. Honestly, she's a great person who is extremely hard to deal with occasionally. Sometimes it doesn't matter how you feel or if you're learning.

I feel that the time I spent under the instruction of Ebony was ill used.  Her system of tearing down students in order to rebuild them is out dated and puts the passive natured students at an unfair disadvantage.  If your are extraverted and highly out spoken you will do well.  I found her to be too aggressive which stifled my development.

Ebony will push you to the limits and get you out of your box, shes takes no bs, but when your on her good side she is an amazing teacher and has been a wonderful source of inspiration and motivation.  She is a fantastic artist and very knowledgeable.  One of the best professors I have had in the Fine Arts program.

Ebony is intense: she works hard and she expects students to work hard, also. At the same time, she's very invested in her students' work and success, and will go out of her way to help you do what you're wanting to do. Her courses are definitely worth the workload, so stick with it!
She has a great attitude about making you work. She expects you to work hard and takes time with you during class. For majors, a must!

Dr. Morris was a great professor. The class is primarily lecture, but he ensures his students are engaged with the content. Although the exams are pretty difficult, he makes sure to prepare you well for the exams. He is very intelligent and it shows through his teaching! He also cares for every one of his students.

He is a very nice guy and really intelligent and it shows throughout all of his lectures. Although you have weekly quizzes, the readings for that week are not too much. He kept me interested in the subject and I will try to take another course that he teaches.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I really liked him and his class! He's cool and the content was interesting but I was surprised by how difficult the class was. I took his 305 theory class as an elective and it kicked my butt. I managed a B with no prior SOC classes so its not impossible, just a heads up!

AWESOME PROFESSOR. Loved every minute of his class. Extremely helpful and straight forward. Exams are all essay format, but they're not hard as long as you read the required books. He' the best! Take him

Great professor, great class. Notes are straight forward and easy to keep up with. Does a great job of involving the class and making the topic more interesting. If you learn everything on the study guide, exams are pretty easy. I highly reccomend taking the class, especially this prof.
Great teacher. Notes are easy to take and gives study guide before test. Test are not bad if you study. Sometimes extra credit is given. Really found the class interesting and enjoyed it.
No Comments

Ted is always more than happy to assist students with comprehending and synthesizing German, especially those not seeking a German degree and thus not as proficient or devoted as the German majors and minors in the class.

Ted is the best german ta I've had since I've been here. He's incredibly helpful, knows the material, and works with students to make sure they understand the material. Take him if you have the chance!

Very good teacher.  Speaks ~90% of class time in German but it is VERY easy to understand what he means and it really helps when you're trying to learn grammar along with the vocab. Really easy grader and understands that the students aren't going to be speaking perfect German at the end of the year. Highly Recommend!

Very clear with his teaching style and makes things extremely easy to learn.  If you show up, you'll do well.  The class isn't very hard and he makes learning so easy and interactive in class, you'll hardly ever have to study.

Group project class with no exams. The difficulty depends heavily on your team, since most of the grade is group work. Grading is very confusing and inconsistent, assignment rubrics are very vague and short, but he often docks points for something very specific that's not listed on the rubric. Nice person and accessible outside of the class though.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I liked this professor a lot. Assigns a fair bit of homework, but it doesn't feel like a burden because the homework is very helpful and can even be enjoyable. Sometimes rambles a bit during lectures, but the lectures themselves aren't very intense. One of my easier classes this semester (although I have used some coding before).
Great prof who cares about his students' learning. Some of his TAs are tough graders but overall you will learn a lot from him
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Buddy is lost as last years easter egg.

Lectures can be boring at times, but overall this class isn't bad. He also posts the lecture slides which is very helpful to refer back to. Gives good help when you ask questions especially in the labs. As long as you follow what the assignments say (it's all laid out very clearly), you will be fine in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The class moves fast but as long as you stay on top of your work(due every friday) youll be fine. The only complaint I have with this class is the exams. Throughout the semester, you have 2 exams and 2 labtests. The labtests show off your coding ability, while the exams do nothing but show you can memorize definitions. Besides that its a fun class.
