I personally love Professor Eby. He is an accommodating professor and cares about your learning. Lecture days are not mandatory but labs are group-based and attendance is taken. I would NOT recommend taking this class if you have no interest in doing CS or as an elective credit. There are extra credit opportunities for lab tests.

Dr. Eby was a quite average professor. You will learn the material if you put in the work and attend the lectures and do the homework - which there can be a lot of. Lectures are quite boring but he posts the slides for your reference and is very helpful with questions. I would recommend Dr. Eby for CS115.

Average lecturer overall, lectures often become long winded with no clear purpose behind them. He is very smart and fairly helpful in lab but can come off as somewhat condescending if you are lost but that does not happen often. Most learning is zybooks and practicing coding, so professor is not as important as some other courses.

I would recommend him to start your CS program. He is very passionate (maybe even to a fault, yes-or-no questions can become 10 minute lectures) and you will learn a lot in his class. He is one of those "I'm gonna send you a curve ball to prepare you for the real world" type professors but he is also very flexible with grades (my 89.1 became an A)

The main issue I have with this course is the exams. The exams have no basis on your actual coding ability. I get you have to have some basis on how to judge students that is not influenced by Chegg, but the lab tests do that fine. I took this course to boost my GPA, not tank it. Please Professor Eby if you are reading this, just do the lab tests.

I really enjoyed taking this class with professor Eby. As others mentioned, the lectures can be a bit bland, but the workload is manageable as long as you don't try and do your whole project in one weekend (note: seriously don't do this). He cares about students and the class is set up in a way that it's an easy A with just a bit of effort.
Its just reeeaaaalllllyyy bland. Class material should take two weeks to be covered instead it takes a whole semester. No complaints about the prof though

This class is definitely missing the "Intro" part. I came in with no programming experience and struggled a bit. One of the things that helped with the course was the Zybook, it presented information in a way that was easy to understand so I suggest doing all the Zybooks. If you need help in the course, go to office hours, it helps!

Take my words, if you dont want to drag your GPA down, dont take his class. This is class in DEF not for someone who has no experience in programing. This is the course may take longer time than your major course. its not worth it

I truly appreciate Professor Eby as a professor, super nice guy who is flexible and will work with you, more than you can say for most professors. However, the course is extremely homework heavy. Homework is due on Fridays, and I've had to block off at least 6-7 hours every single time for it. Calling CS115 an 'intro' course is laughable and a lie

Kevin Eby just started lecturing, so his lectures are not great. Some of the information from his lectures is not communicated well, so you may miss some stuff on the test if you don't pay close attention. He is a great guy and super helpful during labs and office hours though. Points are spread out, so the final and midterm are less weighted.

He's a nice guy and he helped me understand computer science from a people and process focused perspective instead of just a technical perspective. The focus of the semester was a group project. Your team can choose what it is and I learned a lot from it. But his lectures were very disorganized, lacking in content or explaining the content poorly.

Professor Eby is a great instructor for the introduction to computer science class. His lectures are easy to follow and he is always helpful if you ask. Any of these poor ratings are more than likely from students who didn't try in the course and can't think for themselves.

Eby is a new professor so he doesn't have his own lecture material yet and his lectures are pretty bland. Your level of achievement is largely dependent on how much work you put in. You have to manage your time and your team to be successful. Eby will provide tips and some assistance, but has a relatively inactive role in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Worst. Teacher. Ever. Grading is super harsh, lots of work with very little feedback, lecture quizzes but gives terrible lectures that he basically stole from a different professor. Traumatizing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He really doesnt ask that much of students. The labs and homework are very doable. The ZyBook homework we use is much more helpful than the lectures though. Nice professor, will always help you out if you ask.

Most of the material for this class seems to have been lifted from other sources. This class has the pacing and difficulty of a high-school course, and points are often lost on missing miniscule details of the class's poor instructions. I would not recommend taking this class or this professor unless absolutely major-necessary.

He's not the best lecturer, but is way more helpful in office hours so i'll give him that. That being said, for an intro level class, it moves so fast and if you have a bad TA, good luck. I spend more than 15 hrs a week on this class alone, do with that as you will...

So here's the deal. In lectures, he uses slides made by someone else and pretty much just reads that but if you go to his office hours, he's super nice and good at explaining things. Lots of work, though.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Edward is one of the coolest, most chill dudes I have ever met. He's an interesting person and he's funny too. He definitely wants all his students to pass and will do everything in his power to make that happen. He always wants to hear from everyone in lecture, so don't be afraid to speak up. Just make sure you turn stuff in, and it's an easy pass

Hilarious. I absolutely LOVE him, I took WRD110 this semester with him and I dont have any negative things to say about him or this class. He is one of the most chill people Ive met in my life. If you need help, just ask him and he will help, A LOT. I highly recommend him, you wont regret it. One of the few classes I actually enjoy going to.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Such a great professor who really cares about his students. He wants everyone to succeed so bad and if you do just a little bit of work, he will appreciate it and do everything in his power to help you. Lots of class discussions and DO NOT be afraid to talk. Not a scary dude and really wants to hear from everyone. Had no problem getting an A.
Best professor I have this semester. He actually cares about us learning the material and is funny and nice.
Take this guy if you get the chance. Hes awesome.
Easy to get a B but hard to get an A. Makes you turn in draft after draft to get an A. But a funny guy who makes class fun.

If I had to describe Edward in a single word it would be beard. His beard is distinguished. It makes one think of a Viking of old. He nods to his students when they answer a question correctly. This gives one a warm feeling of accomplishment. He also is an avid fan of pop culture and makes class fun and interesting. I like history now. Thanks.

Great lectures, super funny, and wants his students to pass. Lots of reading but he is able to make it interesting . Gave good feedback, accessible out of class and was easy to talk to. Total of 2 papers, 1 exam and 1 group project. Would definitely take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Would take again

reviews.comment: Funny and makes class less boring
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Super funny guy and easy to get along with but wants you to work really hard. If you're willing to put in extra work and turn in drafts he'll help you get a good grade really easily

If you're looking for an easy A, Dr. Enochs is a great choice. If you're looking to learn the material, pick a different prof.  Dr. Enochs is hard of hearing, and asks a lot of questions during his lectures. Be ready to speak up and speak loudly, or he'll  spend 10-15 minutes explaining something obvious because he thinks the class doesn't get it.

Professor Enochs is wonderful and renowned algebraist. I found the course to be pretty easy, but he gives lots of extra credit problems that can be challenging. I have learned so much this semester and strongly encourage this class to everyone.
I had to take this class, it was the only section.  I had the hardest time understanding him and what he was talking about.  Wish I could've avoided this class/professor.
A very nice man. His class really got me interested in knowledge of math instead of being bored in most of other math classes i ever took. I have never had a professor as smart and nice as him!
Very kind man. He is somewhat generous with his grading, he could've given me a much worse grade than he did. He's a little hard to understand and moves through the material quite quickly.
Very knowledgable about math in general. Very personable and willing to help his students with any mathematics topics. Very smart, definitely take him!
This man is a great teacher and is relatively easy.  I would recommend taking him for sure.  Tests are straight forward and comes mostly from homework.

he grades homework and tests really easily.  He could have given me a much worse grade sometimes if he wanted to.  But because his class is so easy, you aren't forced to learn as much as you would in the class taught by someone else, i think

rediculously helpful and nice. If you have him as an option and aren't sure whether to take him or someone youve never heard of, take him without a doubt. Go to his office hours and he will basically tell you how to do the test questions. Very easy A, great guy, great class.

Dr. Enochs was a great professor.  He heavily encourages class participation, and is very interested in making sure that students understand the course material.  His homework can be somewhat difficult, but he is absolutely willing to help you if you are having trouble.  Tests cover what was taught in class, and he reviews in detail beforehand.

This man is very willing to help you if you have any trouble whatsoever. he is very approachable. the entire class was straight forward. pretty generous on tests with partial credit.sometimes his handwriting was hard to read but its not too bad.
Very friendly and helpful, explains concepts clearly.  Recommended.

IMO, he is a great teacher!  He makes you turn in homework every lecture, but it ends up helping you learn and boosts your grade.  He doesnt trick you on tests or test you on material he hasnt explained.  GET HIM IF YOU CAN!  Also extremely nice and very helpful in office hours, thats what helped me.

Mr Enochs is very hard to understand in class but I will agree he is a funny old guy if you talk to him and he will help you out a lot as far as being leniant. If you show effort you will get a very good grade out of here.
Very hard to grasp the concepts he trys to teach, hes not very hard though and is lenient with turning in homework. Hes pretty funny if you actually talk to him.
Great philosophy professor! Engaging conversations/topics with minimal quizzing and manageable papers.

By far my favorite professor of the semester. He is extremely kind, caring, and understanding if you communicate with him. His class is primarily writing with very few reading quizzes. Make sure to read before class for the next days lecture and discussion, but the readings are short. He is very well spoken, and cares deeply about his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: There aren't many reviews so I know yall will take my review with a grain of salt, but this professor is so caring for your grade and knowledge and passionate about the topic. This is coming from a student who had chem1C, chem lab, GE, and this writing class. This class was doable/ fun and what you put in is your grade. Weekly quiz, but not bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very beautiful teacher and I'm talking about his face and personality. You have to read and participate in discussion for a good grade, but he is amazing with feedback and very direct with what he is looking for you to get out of the class, as well as what he wants for assignments. The only problem I had was I'd find myself distracted by his looks.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: First, he goes by Ted, and doesn't like being called by his title. Second, he is absolutely amazing. He is extremely well spoken and friendly, and he explains things so well. It's a difficult class, and I personally don't care for anything math related, but I genuinely enjoy going to his class. He's easily one of my favorite professors I've had.
Great professor. He was very accommodating and the class consisted off reading, listening to lectures, and writing three papers. Overall a great class.

Very intelligent individual with a knack for teaching. He is willing to work with you if you have circumstances that prevent you from coming to class or a difficulty understanding the material; I had both. Great person. Great sense of humor. I highly recommend him. The University will be losing an amazing asset should he ever decide to leave!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I had Ted for two semesters in a row, and I would say he's one of the best professors at UK. He does such a great job explaining things that it's easy to forget he's still a grad studentand not a full professor. He's always willing to helpwhether during office hours or by appointment. If you need a PHI class, take Ted.

Ted (as he asked us to call him) is an awesome professor. This class is not hard. At most, we had fifteen pages to read between classes. He would sometimes give reading quizzes, but nothing more than a surface knowledge is required to do well on these. He gives amazing feedback on papers, and he's very encouraging. If you want to learn, take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: There's a lot of reading, and you really have to keep up with it. But he does a great job explaining everything in lecture! He is a picky grader, but he also gives a lot of good feedback and the chance to redo your papers. As long as you go to class and take notes, you should get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: He's too smart for students, but is very kind and genuinely wants to help.

There is no homework ever, but your grade is only based on a few things. 2 scenarios, the midterm/final, participation, and a final presentation. If you show up and participate, you will have no issues with this class or Dove. Sometimes he was very hectic, but he taught us well seeing as he is an attorney first.

Mr. Dove is an interesting guy. He is super knowledgeable about laws in education. His teaching style isn't my favorite, but I learned a lot from him. His tests are take-home and you get graded by very little. You would have to do absolutely nothing to get a bad grade in the class.

Dove is a special sort of character that one has to grow to enjoy. He's hilarious, blunt and informed. He has a good court record and he knows his stuff. Be certain you take notes though, his tests are directly off of the notes! He only appreciates your efforts as much as you appreciate his. He will always answer questions!

The class itself is very interesting, but Mr. Dove is super hard. He's not very clear during lectures and jumps all over the place. The tests have questions that aren't found in lecture notes, and grading is super hard. I would not take this professor again, but I would take the course.
Prof. Dove is AWESOME!!! You will be fine in this class. He's funny and very laid back and easy going. I absolutely LOVE his class. It's an easy A class for sure.
Ed's the man!

Prof Lee was a great teacher for RUS371. He claims that you can't miss more than two classes without a grade decrease, but I missed three and received no penalty. He assigns two essays throughout the term, plus take home midterm and essays. You don't need to do the homework as long as you go to class and answer his opinion questions. Great guy!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Lee. He's so well-rounded and passionate about his subject. Plus he rocks on the piano. Class discussions can be great or dull depending on the people in your class, but make sure to at least skim the readings before and keep track of the few assignments.

he is a good teacher overall, but he is totally inaccessible outside of class. he won't respond to emails and the syllabus is useless. the class is interesting but his voice puts you to sleep. Has no clear grading criteria. he basically sits in the front of the class and talks, if you miss there is no way to catch up as there is no online content
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: classes can drag on and he has a voice that puts you to sleep. material is interesting, but the assignments are tough and often involve topics we haven't covered in class. participation is 100% mandatory, no excuses. he's completely inaccessible outside of the classroom. not a horrible class, but you definitely have to put in the work!

Dr. Lee is my favorite prof this semester! The subject of the class is so interest and his lectures only add to it! He is so funny and well spoken-just a great person overall. You will do well in his class if you read the novels and participate in discussion in class- its not hard as long as your interested and pay attention.

Dr. Lee was awesome. Two easy papers, the midterm and final are long but he gives them to you a week in advance. There are a few reading quizzes but just read summaries. Boring lecture but I got an A without ever speaking to him or speaking in class. Highly recommended, Lee is very very passionate about Russian culture. He is a killer piano player.

Professor Lee is a good professor. His lectures are pretty boring though and can put you to sleep. There are two easy papers and he gives you the exams beforehand so you can prepare. Overall pretty easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Took his class for a Global Dynamics credit. Amazing guy, passionate about what he teaches.

If you're looking for an easy A to cover your Global Dynamics or Humanities credit, you should definitely take this class. The material is boring, but you only have two papers. Plus, he gives you the exams and you simply memorize what you're going to write down. Dr. Lee is SO passionate about Russian culture. Take this class if you can.

Dr. Lee is a really nice guy but the class sucked. I took this class for a humanities core credit. You had 2 papers and it took him about a month to grade each. There wasn't a blackboard or canvas page so you didn't know what your grade was and if you asked him, he wouldn't have a clue either. Not a bad class, but I would try something else first.

Dr. Lee taught me RUS270 (now RUS371), and though I took the class for common core credit, Dr. Lee was my favorite professor of the semester. He's a really smart, understanding guy, and I'd definitely recommend his class.

I really loved this class. Professor Lee is probably the most intelligent person I've ever met. I could sit and listen to him all day though he is pretty quiet so I would recommend sitting in the front. If you go to class, do the short readings he assigns and the papers it's an easy A.

It's kind of cute the way he lectures. The lectures are VERY interesting and informing. He is a great professor. He really knows a lot about Russian history and themes in Russian culture. The class is easy if you read the assigned material (there are quizzes over several novels). Do the papers, come to class, pay attention and you will do very well

This man is amazing and a pure genius. He is so understanding, genuinely kind and an overall great person. How many professors will play famous piano pieces from the Russian masters, from memory. He is just great. I encourage you to take his class.

Prof. Lee was fantastic!  I had his class after a year abroad, and frankly I had a terrible attitude, because the material was too easy.  So Prof. Lee took time out of his own schedule to tutor me one-on-one once a week, even creating more curriculum.  I've never had anyone work so hard just to invest in a student's growth.  I owe him a lot!

Dr Lee is a wonderful man. Very smart, and you can tell by the way he thinks about everything he says. Has some great stories. Takes a while to get used to him but worth it. If you go to class, he will literally walk you through the 2 papers, as well as the midterm and final. Oh, and he gives you both exams a week before you take them to study.
Excellent professor. I've had him twice now. I would definitely take his class again!

such a nice guy!! class was easy- easier if you go because he explains what you read and what you should do for the papers. you do sign in to class when you go and attendance isn't mandatory but he does notice who signs in (likely to give you some help with your grade if you always go).  recommend for a cross cultural class if needed!
Great professor. Really nice. Makes you think about life if that's what you're into. Dry sense of humor occasionally makes you laugh uncontrollably if you understand the point he's trying to make

He is deep as you want to be or wish you could be. THe man plays the classical piano for you, Rachmaninoff, live jeez not some recording,.... LIVE finger decxterity. THe man is a genius. Explore and you will be fulfilled and wowed!!!

Dr Lee is awesome!! Really liberal grader and mostly interested solely in discussion. This class focused on Guns, Germs and Steel when I was in it and I learned a lot about the history of human development. He is very fun although classes are very repetitive; read a chapter, write something on it, discuss.

I love Dr. Lee. He was a pretty awesome guy. Class was kind of boring though. It was the same thing every day and it just got old. Read, write, discuss, and repeat. It's an easy A, you just have to kind of bear through the class. I think it was worth it though. I learned a lot in the end.

He is an extremely nice guy, but overall the class was pretty terrible. it is an easy A, but sometimes I thought it wasn't worth it. Lost my first exam, late giving things back, graded without any helpful comments. There are easier A's to be had.

LOVE Lee.  Not only was this class the easiest I had during the semester, but it was also the most enjoyable.  Dr. Lee has a passion for Russian culture and only wants you to appreciate what he is teaching...and BAM: you have your A.  Nice guy-always willing to help.

Dr. Lee is one of the best teachers at UK in any department.  Lectures can sometimes be a little slow, but more often they're a fascinating exploration of Russian culture prior to the 20th century.  Music, film and literature are used to great effect.  Dr. Lee speaks with thought and quiet passion.  He encourages discussion, but never forces it.

Be ready for lots of 1-page responses, which are cake. Only a couple of larger papers; class completely discussion based, although he does preach a little. Things can get quite slow at times, plenty of awkward silences.

A funny, kind, and passionate professor who truly enjoys teaching.  This class was really easy, you can say the dumbest things in class and write the worst papers and he'll give you an A because he's more interested to hear your own thoughts than what you think you want him to hear.  The only class I never ever skipped.  Total Fox, BTW!

I had Dr. Lee for my Honors class and he was great.  It was like having a kind grandfather teaching class.  Although, he will push you to work in class but it is not so much that you feel over-whelmed.  If you ever get the chance to take a class with him I suggest that you take it.

Professor Lee is a very kind, gentle man. The reading material is highly stressed in in-class discussions although students are never forced to share their thoughts. Do the reading assignment questions and read the books and you'll get an A.

Dr. Lee is one of the best teachers I have had. I had him for honors. His class is set up to be a discussion of the books we read, and he is genuinely interested in each student's opinion. Make sure to have read the assignment for each class and you will do great.

Super easy class. Show up, do the work, you write like 2 papers in the class and you have two tests. Easy A. He likes the class to talk and get involved. He likes hearing what his studnets have to say. Very helpful outside of class too.

Prof. Lee was the man. He'll assign a lot of reading and some questions to go with it. You can skim through your books and just answer the questions. But the content is boring but he does his best to make it as interesting as possible. He also took the whole class to eat once. Def. take him if you get the chance.

we read 3000 pages of literature over the semester including anna karenina and the brothers karamazov, so the homework for the class was intense, but the class discussions were wonderful and his comments always clarified and elucidated the text.  if you show up, discuss, and read, you'll have an A
He's a really good teacher, and the class isn't too hard as long as you do your work.  A really nice guy that doesn't mind if you share your opinions.

Dr. Effinger is an amazing math teacher! She puts everything in simple terms and reviews before each quiz. MA 109 has a very laid back set up, and she does an excellent job teaching the material. You need to go to class for participation, but she lets you out early almost every day.

I loved Effinger's class. I have never been amazing at math, but she explains it in SUPER simple terms. She basically gives you answers during review for the quizzes. The only people I know who fail this class are actually just lazy and don't do any of their work.

Show up to class, take notes. There are 6 "exams" for each unit, you only need to pass two of those to pass the unit. I think there are 7 units, one of which is participation based and you only need to pass 6 of those to pass the class. She basically tells you the answers right before each exam through review, so pay attention.

This professor is very nice, yet so difficult to understand. From what I learned in this class I learned more on my own than anything. The quizzes are the only thing that matters you can take no notes the entire year and only go over the practice quizzes and succeed in this class which makes no sense to me.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Look shes a nice lady but she was very hard to understand in class because she was so quiet and if you catch her in a bad mood she can be really sassy. I'm not saying she doesn't care about her students but shes definitely was only there for the paycheck yk.

Effinger is a really sweet lady, she seems to care for her students and offers retakes on exams. Sometimes she is soft spoken so it is hard to hear and she handwrites everything and uses the projector to teach. Overall, good professor but if you have questions I would go to the mathskeller.
There is a lot of work, but it is doable. Shes an old school teacher, homework is online but daily attendance quizzes are on paper. Shes nice

She is very knowledgable about what she teaches and she teaches it very well! If you have difficulty with algebra, she is a great option to help you understand it better! She is understanding about issues and is always willing to let you make things up if you have a valid excuse.

I would not recommend this professor she never responded to my emails, the home work assigned did not reflect what we did in class. She was also horrible at explaining math, if you didn't comprehend something she wouldn't explain it another way. Avoid this professor.

She is very boring and dry. But teaches math well. I took this class for an easy A and I needed the credit for it, and got through it easily. Make sure you are on top of the webworks. You don't need to buy the book, she never uses it. She also has in class assignments so you need to show up for points.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Kathy was overall awesome, but sometimes I would question her teaching skills. This is just because of how she would barely explain some things and be reluctant to explain if she thought it was an easy topic. She also would never speak up if the class was chatty. However, she is very understanding about issues in life and would give extensions.

I began the semester with a different teacher and Kathy filled in, but im honestly so glad she did! She is super caring and willing to help you, and her notes are very clear. The practice exams are sooo similar to the real exams. Im terrible at math and did very well on them. If you put the work in, you'll get at least a B in the class.
I was neutral on this professor. She was very nice and would always answer any questions but did not speak up and went at a vey fast pace whether students were keeping up or not.
Only 3 exams all were identical to the practice tests. She was good at explaining concepts and would go over all the homework and review questions for us in class. Good class, I would recommend.

The lectures were really helpful, and a lot of times she would work out some of the more difficult homework problems before they were due. Before exams she would also work out problems from previous exams, which was nice because a lot of the times the tests were very similar as well. You do need to go to class, but she was a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Hard to understand, took her because of the good rating on here and was very surprised..  Not clear about anything really. Doesn't reply to any emails in a timely manner. most of mine got completely ignored. never answers really fully . Changes her mind, and will go back on her word about makeup tests , etc. wouldn't recommend.
Very clear when giving class instructions and going over course material. Homework is out of the book about twice a week. Tests and weekly quizes are graded very very generously. Take her if you can!
If you ever need help, she will go out of her way to clearify, especially during her office hours

Kathy is absolutely amazing! This woman knows calculus very well. If you have her for recitation, you will get an A. She will answer any question which you may have and she gets to know her students. Don't be afraid to ask her for help.

Great teacher! Explains everything very clearly, and gives great review guides for tests. She tells you exactly what will be on the test. GO TO CLASS. She gives little easy quizzes often and takes attendance FOR POINTS every class. Very fair grader.
Great!!!!! She is very helpful, and is good at explaining. Sometimes lectures get boring and she does easy examples, but she goes over the homework and is always willing to help!

When she began the first class, I was like, this woman is a JOKE! But, she turned out to be really great.  At times she moved a little fast (trying to get through all of the material) and she would go over as many of the common version hw problems as possible which was VERY helpful. TAKE HER!
Ms. E is nice.  She gives random quizzes in class to help boost your grade so go to class. She goes over homework before it's due.  I hated math before I took her but she makes it easy. Take her!

Very easy class for people with prior knowledge of algebra. The professor is a nice lady and goes over any questions you might have about the homework. She is very helpful if you're having any problems. Gives quizzes a few times a week, but they're always super simple and even if you miss every question, she still gives you an 80. Overall good.
not helpful
go to class and write down everything she puts on the board
Very nice person who is a good teacher.  She cared about everyone in the class, when most people didn't give effort.  Works with students to help them succeed.
easy.
Easy class, quiz once a week, only showed up for the quizzes...easy A...

Professor Ehrkamp was a caring professor. She could be a tough grader at times and there are only a few grades overall. However, she was always willing to help, and would treat you with respect as long as you treated her with respect. In my opinion she was a solid choice.

The class topic is diverse and broad, so memorization won't work. Focusing on trends and analyzing text. Readings are done in recitation for further analytical practice, accompanied by short-response essays. Lecture gives you information you definitely need, take notes. The book is difficult to use and understand. She'll be very willing to help.

Dr. Ehrkamp is very passionate about what she teaches, but she's very rude to her students. Her lectures drone on, and she believes her class is the most important. Honestly, I would avoid her classes unless you are a geography student, in which case I hope her classes are easier.
She was rude

I have no idea where shes from , she does have an accent, but she is a really nice teacher and her class is definitely interesting.The tests are of medium difficulty, not impossibly but also not an easy A.Attendence is definitely manditory becuase you take notes almost every lecture and the tests are based off of the notes. Great Teacher,witty too.
Dr. Ehrkamp is all business. If you do what she expects, you're good. If you don't, you'll wish you had.
i had her for geo300 and 499. she is wonderful. if you have any trouble she is very willing to help you. she is my favorite teacher.
i really like this teacher. she is so nice and really cares about her students. she is one of the best teachers in the geography department @ UK! she is great!
i love this woman!! we had four people in our class and she was really interested in helping each of us. she is super intelligent and very nice!! it is an honor to have her as a professor.
It is a cross-cultural USP course....VERY EASY. Just mindlessly do the assignments and the tests are cake.

Personally I don't like this teacher. The way she presents to the class is very useless; it's a powerpoint with a couple words on it but she doesn't define what she's talking about at all.  Her tests are actually pretty easy, it's just difficult to study for them because I have no clue how to study for it or what I'm suppose to write in class!

she is so confusing! i don't even know what we are talking about in that class. she takes attendance and it is so hard to even go listen to her. i hate the class and i have a 10 page paper due in a few days and we have barely talked about it in class

She is an ok teacher, knows ALOT about what she is teaching sometimes tooo much...like she expects us to know what she is talking about when she uses strange terms....Test arent tooo bad!!! Just do the study guide

Dr. Ehrkamp's first year at UK, she is a very experienced professor, OH University, German origin.  She has extensive knowledge of her material but sometimes I found her to be talking too fluently, not emphasizing words and articulating with enthusiasm enough to keep my attention all the time, but always speaking the truth.  Good Teacher.

She's amazing. She's pretty tough on critiques, but not harsh - just makes you work for it and think outside the box. Can be political (which is fine with me, but if that's not your jam). She also doesn't treat her classroom as a safe space, anything goes.
She is a little tough on critiques, but it will only make your future projects better.
Amazing. Very technical at first but once you learn the basics you have a lot of wiggle room. IF YOU DON'T LOVE STACEY THEN YOU ARE AN IDIOT.
Totally the prof you want in the photography department. The class is harder than i thought it woulf be, but i learned so much about seeing the world through photography.
She is a ton of fun and very dedicated to the art. Def one of the best instructors in the department. Very enjoyable class
Awesome.
No Comments

She is very passionate about what she does. She is very fun and makes every class interesting. She extends deadlines and is wiling to help if you need it. She is a more fair grader than the other Photo professors and she is very easy to approach. Made the subject which is time consuming appear unstressful.
Super great professor! Really relaxed classroom setting, and always ready to answer questions if you need help. He makes the class really fun!
This was a great class!
GREAT TEACHER! I REALLY ENJOYED GOING TO CLASS.
John was a fantastic teacher!  It's so rare to have a teacher that is truly passionate and gifted in their field.  I wish I could take his class again!
BEST TEACHER EVER!!!
Great teacher!  I enjoy the class a lot!!
Fabulous professor

I had Dr. Eike as a professor in the 80s at Illinois State University - she is a GEM! Smart, wry, and knows how to teach. It's been 35-ish years and I remember her fondly. Dr. Eike is someone YOU show up prepared for. She cares to teach, not hold the hand of the lazy and whiny. I gave her tickets to a Shakespeare play, summer of '83 or '84.

The book used, "Survey of Econ," is difficult to read. Also, many typos make learning Econ a total chore. Eike's exams are all application, whereas the textbook is mostly definitions. The tests Eike uses would be more fitting for an upper level course, especially with the complex wording that she uses. Take another course

Unless you can teach yourself Economics, don't take this class with her. She breezes through lectures and doesn't explain anything well. She writes really small on the board. Tests are all application, which she doesn't go over during lecture very well. Find another professor.

On the first day of class she told us that she is counting down the days to retirement, and that is why she only uses scantrons exams. Lecture is difficult to follow, her small handwriting on the whiteboard is difficult to decipher and struggles to effectively explain topics to the class. the textbook is full of errors. Find another teacher........
Does a very poor job of preparing you for tests. No study guide is given. All of the tests have a lot of trick questions. Test-like questions are never discussed in class.
Professor doesn't care about her students. All exams are scantron (so grading doesn't take too much of her time) showing how little dedication she has for this class. I wouldn't recommend this class.

Terrible class. She is terrible at explaining economics and doesn't seem to care about her students. She says that since she is close to retirement, she is just trying to breeze through these 2 years. Nice person, but terrible prof.

Eccentric and effective. Very flexible grading policy: attendance points missed will simply increase the weight of the final. That said, class is  rarely boring, so if you pay attention and do the online homework you should have no issues doing well on exams. She gives you everything you need to get an A

Daily quizzes, attendance mandatory. I went into every test feeling confident after studying for days, then barely pull off C's. Very very confusing tests, as the class averages (in the D range) show. Even if you think you're good at economics, I advise you take a different professor. She has a nice personality though - whatever that's worth.

Awesome prof. Took econ in high school so I didn't really learn anything, but people have made it much harder than it really is. the online aplia assignments are cake and go with the text. you could get a lot worse then her. Final exam was just the other exams copy pasted and she goes over those in class. With a little work an easy A

Maybe I just caught her at a good time (I took this as a small-enrollment one month summer course) but I thought this class was super easy and well presented. Eike is a bit eccentric, but she really is friendly, knows her stuff, and is willing to help you if you ask for it. If you aren't great at precalculus I can see how this might be a struggle.
Really good teacher. She is goofy and outgoing when he gives her lectures.

she is funny, but seriously one of the most confusing professors ive ever had. Also, doesn't give any study guides(first out of all my teachers who hasn't), gives quizes daily(go to class), atleast one online quiz a week also. Too many assignments,dont take this if you want an easy A, because with her its not.
Worst class ever.  She curves the entire class before the semester even starts so even a 70 will give you a B.  class average was a 63 for my class...worst class. avoid if at all possible

People have been giving Eike way too hard of a wrap on here. She is a great teacher who is very knowledgeable of the subject, although I could definitely see how some people could get confused by what she says. She's funny and lively. Go to class, do the homework, and the tests arent bad. 87.5 is an A, drops lowest test, Eike all the way. Easy.

Eileen clearly knows her stuff, but teaches as though she's teaching herself. Doing well on homework and other out of class assignments is absolutely no indicator of how you'll do on exams. While class and notes and homework is based on graphs and concrete examples, the exam questions are based in esoteric, hypothetical situations.

Some of these comments blow my mind, clearly these people took this class with the intention of putting up no effort and getting an A. Dr. Eike is a great professor. Take the class, take it seriously and you will do fine. If you have any questions she is more than happy to go over them with you. Also she is hilarious.

Dr. Eike is an extremely intelligent woman. Her jokes are hilarious if you get her humor. She grades on an 85-100 is an A and so on. Very realistic to do well in the class. The book will be your key to success, by reading the chapters you should do just fine. She really knows what she's doing.

Tries to keep the class less boring with jokes that aren't too irritating. Knows what she's doing, but hard to understand. Doesn't convey the information enough for you to understand. Does give extra credit, which helps a lot, since her tests are pretty hard and are not like the hw.

She gets a bad rap on this cite. She has a rather strange sense of humor, but its not god-awful, she does make a funny joke or two. This is a semi-difficult class because its a difficult subject. GO TO CLASS! If you don't you will find yourself quite far behind. I didn't study much and I got an A, but I paid attention and took good notes.

Ugh, impossible class. No matter how hard you study you will not do good in this class. Wording is not clear and she does not know how to teach economics to people who know nothing about it. Very intelligent, just not meant to be a teacher. If you have to take this class, take a different professor or take it as a summer class.

Hands down, hardest class I have ever taken. She knows a lot but cannot convey the material to her students. Aplia homework sucks and is very difficult and you will have it twice or more times a week. Attendance is basically mandatory, and tests are extremely hard. Information very hard to understand and she flies through the information.

If it's not for your major, don't do it. I got a C in her class...and it was just for USP. Her attendance quizzes are annoying and she is mad boring. If you like lame jokes at 8am...this class is for you.

Terrible. Do not let her fool you on the first day! Everything she taught was so hard to understand. Her jokes are lame and the class is boring. Time goes torturously slow. Get another teacher if you can.

This was by far the WORST class I have ever had in my entire college career.  This woman is the worst grader known to man.  She gives quizzes every day before class and if yo do not answer word for word the way she wants it, then you automatically get a zero.  I am a 3.75-4.0 student and had a D in this class..I dropped it and am re-taking it @BCTC

She is by far the worst teacher. She has no clue what she is talking about and just reads from slides that people make for her. She always gets off topic about pointless things and always tries to be funny with stupid accents. DO NOT TAKE HER

I found her to be a very interesting teacher. She was often very fun in class and tried to get students involved. Her tests are extremely hard and I didn't do very well just looking at notes, I HAD to read the book. Do NOT miss doing the homework on Aplia it can really help your grade. In the end she gave a little extra credit and I got an A.
She made this course very difficult. On top of this, she requires her students to purchase a $70 membership to an online homework website.

She is one of the smartest professors on campus. Really fun personality. Unfortunately this is an entry level course and she doenst explain things very well. She would be perfect for a 300 or 400 level class, but you need someone who can teach brand new material to students who may not understand what is going on. I wouldnt recommend he for 201

I took Eike for 101 and it was horrible. She is very knowledgeable about the subject but doesn't break things down well or explain things well. She is funny but kind of all over the place with her notes. I'm taking 201 now with Hoyt and it's so much easier. Hoyt is a great professor, I would suggest taking her rather than Eike.

If your going to take this class make sure you read the book and know someone who actually goes to class and type the notes.  The online hw is really hard and experiments and papers are graded really hard.  If you can take hoyt

She is a funny lady, most of the time, but this class is terrible. She goes around and around on explanations, the powerpoints aren't helpful whatsoever, and the textbook is even worse. I would recommend if possible, to take this class with a different professor.
Fair teacher; extremely knowledgeable on subject matter.

Anyone who thinks Dr. Eike is a bad professor has never experienced a truly bad professor before. Her jokes/accents are a little strange, but I think that's one of the things I liked about her. She's nice, and knows what she's talking about. Also, the online homework system is helpful enough that you don't really have to read the book.

I hate Economics and am an awful math person, but she was able to present it in a matter I could comprehend. I missed a couple classes, but as long as you are able to read the text and understand, you should be alright for the tests. Whoever said the tests are random obviously did not read the textbook...

advice to make this class easy: Find the powerpoints that a different class uses. She uses a totally different set that sucks. Once i received powerpoints from different professor's class i was able to score well above the class average
She really makes sure that you understand the concepts!

A lot of people seemed to dislike her, but I thought she was really nice.  Her bad jokes and weird comparisons are annoying, but she is always there to help.  Everything is straight from the book, and there are quizzes every week on each chapter to make sure you keep up.  grading is easy.

This class was not enjoyable. Lectures where boring and was made worse by Eike's jokes and random accents. Most of the test is made of material from the textbook, which i never read. The good thing is her grading is very forgiving. Since you dont fail unless you get below a 50%.
I didn't think she was that bad...
I hated this class and I just couldnt follow it
she sucked.
She was horrible.

She's changed her whole class format, so everything's online now and the online activities are actually really helpful. She's not as bad as she used to be (based on my roommate's opinion- she took her last semester before the change.) Better than the "staff" at least- i changed out of one with a TA who barely spoke english.

I'll give Eike some credit, it's hard to make Economics interesting.  She has the same speech patterns as a church preacher so she's able to lull you to sleep quite easily.  Her explanations aren't too helpful, but I think her grading is great.  She really gives the students mercy.  Read the textbook!!  And try to will yourself to pay attention.

Econ 201 with Ann Eike was the worst and is the worst class i have taken in my entire educational career. I have never failed a class in my life until she became my professor.  She does not apply the information in a easily understandible matter. The tests are completely tramatic on your final grade. May i recommend Gil Kim!
Don't take the 8 A.M. class...pure torture!

if youre only in this class b/c your major requires it is utterly awful. teacher rambles a lot. i agree about mind numbingly boring presentations w/the bad jokes and off the wall comparisons. a mind numbingly boring class, unless your major is economics. if not, dont take an 8 am class is my advice.

This class was a complete bore, but when I managed to stay awake the material was fairly easy to follow if only she could present it in a more interesting way than lame jokes and strange comparisons.  The tests were pretty straight forward if you studied.

i disagree with whoever wrote that last entry.  the class is not very difficult, you just have to study the material.  she is very willing to help.  the exams are comprised of material from the textbook.  the exams aren't hard if you study
I hate this class, it is the hardest class I have ever had in my life. She doesnt help you prepare and specify for the exams which are nearly impossible to pass. Be smart and dont take it!

The online class is absolutely ridiculous for a gen ed. Multiple assignments twice a week, lots of Db posts, & responses. She doesn't accept late work for any reason. It's a ton of busy work, takes quite a bit of time. Avoid if you can, it might just be better to take in person instead of online. Can get an A but you have to stay on top of things.

She does not grade objectively. If she doesn't agree with your standpoint expect a lot of points deducted. This class is also a huge waste of time. It's a shame we have to spend money for such a useless class.

Took this class my freshman year. She could have been more helpful with how to write the paper that she expected. Very tough grader. Rude, which made it hard to want to ask her for help. The topic of the class was interesting, however. I actually read all the books because they were so different..
She was super nice! She was also very helpful. All you had to do was email her your paper ahead of time and she would tell you exactly what you needed to do to get an A.
She was super helpful on papers! You could easily get As just by emailing her your paper ahead of time and getting her feedback. She was really great!
She's hot...white hot!
She tried to help studetns and seemed to care about them but she is kinda rude to some students and hard on grading.

I took this class my freshman year. She tries to act like she's your friend, but sometimes it's just strange. Also, several times that semester, she'd been just plain rude to her students. Her grading of speeches is a bit harsh, too. Other than that, she's always clear on what she expects of you and will try to help to the best of her abilities.
interesting for a USP teacher, willing to help, grades reasonably
This man is a genius! He is EXCELLENT with helping you outside of class and he gives extra credit on every quiz/test!  *****TAKE THIS GUY FOR ANY CLASS YOU POSSIBLY CAN!!!!!*****
While it was difficult to understand his English sometimes, his lectures were always interesting.  He is very helpful and he really cares how you do on his tests.
Dr. Eiderman struggled with his English, but he was an excellent Calculus professor.  His tests were very fair and always offered extra credit.
The class was pretty evil, but it wasn't his fault. His tests were pretty fair, if you study.
No Comments
This guy cracks me up! He can't speak English well, but that doesn't stop him from being a very animated professor!

I was in Mr Egan's Corbin, Ky class; this will always be my favorite teacher and class. 
Charlene Evans in Barbourville, KY student

Dr. Egan is by far my favorite professor of all time. Ive learned more from him than I have in all my combined courses. He is passionate about what hes teaching and is the most intellectual person Ive met. Most people dont like his class because he will not coddle you, and treats you like an adult. Failing is up to you in this course.
He's a good professor. Sometimes he is odd but he's really kind and tries to be as helpful as possible.

I think Mr. Egan's passion for sociology comes through during his lectures. If you are a disrespectful, narrow-minded individual, don't expect to like him. If you are mature, and willing to have an open mind, he will enlighten you. If you feel as though you have always been disenfranchised by society you will adore him.

Mr Egan is a wonderful man. He drove all the way from Louisville two to three times a week just to teach in Corbin, Ky. He is a dedicated Sociologist and has a passion for helping Native Americans. He and his wife actually go and stay on the reservations during vacation times and help the people there. Don't hate because you couldn't keep up.
NOT an easy A. This is the only C I've gotten in college.  The class was terrible and the tests were sometimes over his opinions. Take another teacher.

This year and took this class both semesters, i got a D the first semester and right now i have a B the second semester. WORST TEACHER EVER!! first semester i read the books and tried to keep up but still got a D. Second semester i havent gone to class for lecture and have a B. and for his third test, it is an exact copy of the notes he gives out.

When the student is ready, the teacher will appear. I learned so much from this guy! He teaches text and life. If you want to learn, you can be enlightened by Dr. Eagan. If you are a self-righteous little twit who is only looking for a few credit hours...you can stay mentally numb and eek by. You will decide what it is that you get from Dr Eagan.

You really don't have to show up to lecture, and you really never have to read (with the exception of the Lame Deer Book).  There's a wealth of extra credit offered, and as long as you read over the study guide the night before there's no reason to not get an A. Is he terrible?  Yes.  But if you're looking for an easy A this is the class for you.

He was a nice man, but a terrible professor.  I never could follow his lectures and eventually quit going to class. Attendance wasn't mandatory, so that was good.  His notes are ridiculously long along with his ramblings.  Good luck!

Sitting through a class is like pulling teeth, but he does not take attendacne, so if you're willing to read over the notes he gives and the book, tests are easy and your only grades. Extra credit on each one adds up a lot at the end. Use common sense and think about what he would want you to say to answer.

The only times I ever went to the class were on test days and the week later to get my results.  This class was super easy, I got 100's on every test.  He usually gives you the notes, so just study those and you should be fine.  Boring going to class though!

By far the worst teacher. I went to every class and tried to stay up with the ridiculous amounts of reading and still left with a C, might be a B, hopefully. He is off topic a lot and his tests are just impossible, avoid him at all costs.

I read these ratings prior to taking his class as a freshman.  I thought all the bad ratings were the people just getting bad grades.  Well, thats not true.  I have an A in the class, but it is by far the worst class to take.  If you have no interest in SOC and its a requirement, wait for a different teacher. It's worth the wait.

He is the worst professor I have ever had.  I haven't learned anything.  His tests are entirely the notes.  Some of the notes he gives to study for the test are stupid and have nothing to do with sociology or anything but his opinion. I've technically have learned nothing from him everything I have learned has been from what I have done on my own

Dr. Egan is very nice, but his lectures put me to sleep within the first 5 minutes. His tests are almost incomprehensible, but if you have done the reading, watched the Google films, and most importantly, studied the red notes from Blackboard, you will do fine. So far, I have gotten over 100 percent on each test. However, I haven't learned a thing.

he is not a very good teacher. there is a ton of reading, out of class videos, in class videos, and his tests are difficult to understand. his questions are extremely wordy. ive been told that he is the worst sociology professor to have

I think he is actually one of the best teachers I have ever had. If you are not learning or listening in class, it's your own fault. He is engaging and opens one's minds to alternative perspectives. Does tend to ramble, but about very interesting subjects. Make sure you read all your notes several times before the test. He is brilliant and nice.
Worse teacher, but very easy I've went to class about 5 times maybe and have an 89 right now.  You dont have to go
This guy is the worst god-awful professor I've had in college.  He rambles, goes off topic, and half the things he talk about in class aren't even on the exam!  Do NOT take any of his classes!

awful, AWFUL class. i didn't go to many classes before the first test and got an A on the test... good enough, right? Go to every class for the second test and FAIL! I did well enough on the third after not going to the class again. The only good part about this class is the final is early. Don't take this class. Awful teacher. AWFUL.

Although this class is pointless and Egan is a terrible professor, the tests are not hard. HE TAKES HIS TEST QUESTIONS STRAIGHT FROM THE STUDY GUIDE. the red sentences are lifted from the study guide and placed on the test. i did not go to class nor open the book and got an 81% on the first test by just reading the study guide.

This guy is impossible to learn from. His notes are completely unorganized and have zero flow what so ever, he doesn't even use periods at the end of his sentences. His test questions all look like this "According to chapter 6/in class..." and then give a list of 5 totally irrelevant things that might or might not have been in the book. Retire now.

This is by far the worst teacher. He RAMBLES and DOES NOT TEACH. STUTTERS. His notes are note easy to follow AT ALL. Although if you read the textbook you are more likely to get a passing grade. I HATE THIS CLASS. and I am being paid to take notes for his class and that is the ONLY thing that is keeping me in here. I suggest NEVER TAKE THIS CLASS.
One of the WORST professors I've ever had.  Random, gets off topic, and just reads to you out of the book.  Attendance isn't mandatory, in fact, its better if you don't go!!!
Most of the tests are multiple choice and easy as long as you read the bold words in the text book.  However, he is a conspiracy theorist and will keep bringing it up.
He sucks. I don't understand how this man is considered a teacher. Horrible experience being in this class. Luckily I retook it with Thompson. I actually understand what Sociology is about.

I'm not goning to knock his kindness he is very kind and willing to work with you to try to explain things but even after he explains it you'll be confused. His tests are really hard and you seriously have to know your material to do well so read all the books (3) and study his notes. He's not a good lecturer so you don't need to go to class.
In order to get an A in his class you just need to study the study guide--literally don't define anything it is a sentence from his study guide on the exam and maybe missing one word. SO easy
worst professor ever! Doesn't make any sense what-so-ever!  Drop as soon as you find out you have him!

Do not take this man. You can read and go to class and study your hind in off and it does no good. I dont know why he works here. He teaches what he believes, repeats himself over and over, and rambles on the whole class about nothing.
Definitely try and get a different teacher for this class. Class is so boring and he just rambles on about random things. He is a hard teacher and  doesnt present the material clearly.
One of the WORST professors I've ever had.  Attendance isn't mandatory, but even if you go, you're still lost.  Don't ever take a class from this guy if you want to have any sanity left.
Terrible
To get an A all you need to do is to read over the study guide he posts.  All the questions are from there-- don't try to define concepts; just memorize the study guide!
Don't have to go to class but he takes questions from lecture material. He uses sarcasm to challange your beliefs. Shows a movie without words in order for to be more aware of your surroundings.

This professor was completely useless. He sits at the front of class and simply rambles. at one point we watched a video, for 2 hours, of pictures, no words. pointless. I am a senior, he is the worst professor I have ever had. U will always be late 4 ur next class, bc he dismisses 5 min late everyday. The tests r nuts!AVOID HIM if at all possible.

I was a bit put off by his demeanor at first & felt offended.  However, after having spent 3/4 of a semester in his classes I've realized that he is merely challenging the class to speak their minds! I spoke with him one-on-one about a topic and he was very cordial and interested in my opinions.
Test are not reasonable.  Lectures are boring and he rambles off topic making it nearly impossible to take accurate notes.

So easy! I must say HE IS CRAZY!He talked about weird stuff that wasnt related to what we were supposed to be discussing. I quit going to class and just started printing off the study guide for the test an hour before. The questions were STRAIGHT FROM THE STUDY GUIDE. I would have easily made an A if I would have studied more than an hour.

I hear that this man is extremely nice in person and if so I feel a little bad about this but... THIS CLASS IS AWFUL!!! I have no idea how this man is still employed at a university. He rambles, repeats himself, and keeps the class until past when he is supposed to. You can feel the class turning mutinous as the minutes drag on. Avoid at all cost.

Went to class every day before first test and failed it. After that I went maybe five times BUT I read the books and I passed the rest of them. It is a hard class but all you really have to do is read the material.

The man clearly knows his stuff, but communicating it to the class is another matter.  I found that most of the questions were book related, so it's essential that you read each chapter and study efficiently before each exam.  Lame Deer was easily my favorite part of the course, and if you attend his class with an open mind, you will be rewarded.
Nice guy, but his notes are somewhat scattered...really study your notes extra hard because he often chooses random questions for the test

This class is extremely easy if you know how to study for it. I garentee you won't even have to come to class to get a perfect 100 in the class. Yes, the stuff he says in class is not important at all. On his website he has "Additional Notes." study those VERY WELL. The tests follow those notes EXACTLY! Egan is also one of the nicest prof on campus

Well, I see that I am going to be unpopular here, but I loved this class. Yes, the teacher is a bit nutty. Yes, the subject matter is quite odd (What does Protestantism have to do with Organization?) but I feel like I learned A LOT from his class. Also, I got a B pretty easily. Give it a try, it's not so bad.

The questions on the test, are not questions. "According to chapter 7 and/or class:" then theres 5 statements and you have to pick which one is most true. It was awful.I never understood a single thing he talked about in lecture.His notes are also not notes.I read the book and scored decently(B-, C) on the tests.
the person below me has no idea what he/she is talking about. that man was horrible.

He is by far one of the easiest professors I have had in my collegiate career. All you have to do is show up for lectures and go through with a highlighter and highlight everything he says. Then do the review questions at the end of each chapter. If you are comfortable with the questions at the end of each chapter, you'll get As on his exams.

this is absolutely worst professor i have ever had! not only are his lectures completely pointless, his questions (which aren't even questions) on the exam have little to do with actual concepts from the reading. i had to withdraw from the class and i'm going to the ombud. if anyone wants to go with me, post a message on here and i can contact you.

by far one of the worst classes i've had in the 2 and a half years i've been at uk.  his lectures literally consist of him going page by page and reading parts of the books outloud.  the way he words his tests make them so difficult to follow.  most likely going to have to withdraw from the class.

this teacher is aweful. he lecture continuosly with no powerpoint adn no guarentee he'll get through every chapter before the test! you must read the text and anything in the selected text is fair game on the test. ITS TOO HARD FOR A 100 LEVEL CLASS!

Definetly go to lectures because some examples are on the test. Relies heavily on key words in the textbook. I loved the supplemental book; I thought it was interesting to have a Native American's POV

Santa Claus is a horrible teacher! I skipped just to save my sanity.  Regardless of how much I studied I still did miserably on his tests simply because the questions have nothing to do with the material or the lecture!
Lectures were about nothing.  Exams were about nothing.  I learned ABSOLUTELY nothing and it lowered my GPA.  Don't take any of his classes.

Not the worst professor I've had by any means but not the best either.  His test are tricky, not necessarily hard.  I have to say though I did just as well when on the test when I didn't go to class as I did on the test where I did.  If you take this class be prepared to have to read, especially the supplemental book he'll assign.

Please, do not take this class!!  I did and didn't get out in time.  I may have to retake Intro to Sociology...who does that?  His test are impossible unless you have a photographic memory and can remember everything you read word for word!!  His voice during lecture is very annoying as well!!!  STAY AWAY

I ignored all the warnings on this site last semester and thought I would try Egan. What a mistake. Avioid him at all cost. This is hands down the worst teacher UKY has to offer. You will be robbed of an education if you take this class. Consider yourself warned.

Really easy.  Do the reading and you should be good.  Just take the notes and leave.  The notes suck, but sometimes he pulls really random stuff from the notes for the tests.  There are like 4 or 5 extra questions built into every test.
DONT TAKE HIS CLASS!! I had to drop it because his tests are impossible. Now I am taking an awesome SOC teacher that is so much better than him!!!
probably the nicest professor I have ever met, but the worst class I have ever taken. Tests are very tricky.....do not bother going to class except to take the tests.

probably the worst professor i have ever had.  lectures are boring and extremely hard to follow--he just rambles and i rarely had any idea of what he was talking about or what the point was.  avoid if you can!
easy if you read the book but there is no reason to go to class i pased with an A and only went for the exams his class is a waste of your time

How this man is employed by any University is beyond me. His lectures would put an insomniac to sleep, and his tests are ridiculous. He doesn't test on concepts but on worthless facts from the book. Switch professors or prepare for death.
nice guy, boring as can be though. i couldnt even force myself out of bed for the class so i decided id rather have a w than go.
Painfully boring and repetitive lectures. no chance for discussion, just him rambling for an hour and fifteen minutes.  nice guy, but i would def. recommend taking another professor.
Well, lets see he is deff the worst teacher i have ever had.  His tests are hard even if you do study because the study guide will do nothing for you...get out while you can!
stared at his gobling beard during lectures, because that was the most interesting thing in the room.  4 exams 25 MC all based on common sense and book stuff.

Nice guy personally, but rough teacher. Fell asleep every day due to the painfully boring lectures.  Skip class...and just read the book. One of my least favorite classes of all time. I'd suggest switching teachers if you have the chance.
He's a nice guy but his lectures are terrible and completely irrelevant.  His tests are hard because with only 25 questions you don’t know what he’s going to ask.  Don’t take him!

He gives four multiple choice exams consisting of 25 questions. Don't attend lecture and read the text. There is nothing to his class beyond reading and basically teaching yourself the material. Professor Egan looks like a Santa Claus on LSD.
Class is an easy A if you read text. MCQ is to test if you read text. No hard twist in questions. Don't really need to attend class. But I stress reading Text is a must!

My class grade is dervied from 4 25-question multiple choice exams. The book cost me $86 and it is a photocopied paperback. It is the most worthless piece of writing I have ever read, suitable for community college type people. Lectures unhelpful.
No Comments
He's a very nice guy, but no one goes to the class because the lecture is nearly impossible to follow. You'll have to teach yourself most of the material
he talks in jibberish every class, his notes on the board are irrelevent, everything i learned in this class i taught myself, but he is a nice person
he talks about jibberish during the whole class!!

Mrs. Holidays a good teacher but she grades really hard. You can't miss class and you need to participate to get full credit. She takes off 3.5 points off of your grade for every class you miss without an excuse. She grades very hard and will take points of for little things. Class seemed easy at first, but its a global dynamics class, its to much
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: EDC315 is a great option to fulfill the UK Core: Global Dynamics. It is open to all majors, not just education. There are no exams, only projects, but a chunk of the grade is participation. I found the content interesting but felt the lectures were boring, however, there is a lot of group work to breakup the lecture.

If you ever get the chance to take a class with Dr. Holliday do it! She is one of the best professors i've had and she cares so much for her students. She is very understanding and wants all of her students to do well and gives everyone the materials they need to well in the class. Lots of group discussions and activites but I didn't mind that all.

Such a sweet teacher, and very understanding if you have any issues or need help. Readings are very short but important for grades, also showing up is a big part of the grade. Easy yet through provoking, you get what you put into it.

My favorite professor at UK by far. She is so sweet and wants the best for her students. Lots of group activities and discussions. There are no exams only a big research paper and a lesson plan. Take Professor Holiday if you ever get the chance.
She is great! Many fun activities and has informative lectures. She is a super understanding grader. Highly recommend.
SO KIND. Wonderful TA's. The way she has the class take notes keeps everyone engaged and the lectures are always interesting and well planned.

Great professor, however if you are taking this for credit, I don't recommend this class. For a UK core class, it is very assignment heavy. There are not many assignments, but the assignments themselves require a lot of work. One of them required going off campus, another was a long 6 page assignment. Great professor, way too much work.
I was very surprised to find out that I think design is interesting and it is all because Liz's lectures are really great and she is so passionate.
Very caring for her students and design100 is very easy, literaly a free A

She's awesome and her class was my only fun one. She's super enthusiastic and you can tell this is definitely her passion so it's entertaining to listen to. COME TO CLASS or you will have a hard time earning a good grade.
Super nice and caring, and wants everyone to succeed, but the lectures can sometimes be very boring. Only 5 big assignments the whole year that are not too difficult.

A good mix of lectures, hands-on activities and field trips around campus. Most assignments involve drawing, which was fun.  Attendance is a big deal....don't miss classes because she takes off points for unexcused absences.

Liz was extremely passionate about all things design but understood that not every student was. She made her lectures clear and entertaining and kept things simple for students who were not the most artistic. We had weekly sketches to do and had a lot of group projects but we were given a ton of creative freedom with it. I would highly recommend!

Professor Swanson is a very intelligent and caring person. She is very knowledgeable about her work. There are a lot of group projects and they can take quite a bit of time to complete. However, there are no tests or quizzes so as long as you put effort into the projects you will be fine.

If you have a passion for design or drawing take this class. Mrs Swanson is a great teacher and passionate about what she does but the workload she gives is insane for a level 100 class. Be ready to do a lot of work for this class like drawing, notes, group projects and more. She grades your notes, amount of drawings and the organization of notes.

I loved this class.  Monday and Wednesday are lectures and tutorials, Fridays were in smaller groups with a TA. My TA was also really great, so that made the course even better.  I don't love group work, but the assignments are written so they know who did what, which helps.

This course was really overwhelming at first because the projects are open-ended and there is alot of group work that is involves research, which I was not expecting.   But you will learn about design at all scales, how designers work, and see the world differently as a result. I also enjoyed practicing drawing.

Liz is a total free spirit and that reflects in her teaching methods. It was quite the transition going from high school teachers to Liz but it was well worth it. I learned so much about architecture and the process and I wouldn't trade my first semester experience for the world. You really have to work for it but Liz notice the little things.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Liz will prepare you for upper year classes. That being said, she does that by making your semester hell. Totally worth it for how much you learn but you have to really work your butt off.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Be sure to ask the most specific of questions because otherwise you won't get a clear response. Do everything and more, she expects you to go beyond what you can do. Her instructions make sense in her head but do not always make sense for everyone else.

Get ready for an abstract architecture adventure. Liz's first-year studio is fairly laid back and is mostly drawing, which is my strong suit. The best way to earn her favor is a strong work ethic, and she is very helpful. Has a strong knowledge of architecture.

She is one of my favs! I mean,yes she talks a lot, by a lot I mean probably majority of the class.but she is very helpful if you ever needed helf.she is more artsy and abstract comparing to some of the upper level professors. Just be creative and put in efforts and you will get an A!
Joyfully rambles about every topic of life. Stories bring interaction of life and architecture into reality.

If you pay attention and look at what she tells you as a whole instead of pieces, she's awesome. She tends to ramble a bit, but actually take in what she's saying and you'll get a lot more out of her class.

Amazing professor! Absolutely love her, all you have to do is listen to her and you will do great! Although she does ramble on a little bit and loves to give tutorials a lot! By the way if you take her class and accidentally cut your finger, don't tell her! She will talk about the proper way to cut EVERY class!
Liz is awesome

Liz is one of those professors whose lessons might take you a while to grasp.  She talks about the A-HA moments in life---some you get now, some you get later.   I'm still thinking about things she talked about when I was a freshman and that's not true for all of my other teachers.
She's quite cracked out when it comes to a first year studio professor, but actually having her on a jury in upper years she can actually give some good critiques.
No Comments

I don't even know where to start, but do not take this course with this professor if you do not have to. The course is honestly amazing, but the professor is horrendous. She gives no assignments, no information, and expects you to know everything without teaching. She also expects you to be at every class even though she cancels once a week. DO NOT
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. wasoften rude.Little to no grading all semester,so you never knew where you stood.We were given a study guide,but the daybefore the final we were told toread a new negotiation during the exam.When logging in,the instructions said we were expectedto have already read it.There was too much detailed information toretain and apply duringthe exam.

Professor link knows absolutely nothing about technology, so if any class is missed, her "lectures" are literally her just talking to you and writes maybe 4 things on the board, so there is no way to make up for missing a class. She is also just mean to her students if they don't follow exactly her rules -- it literally felt like high school.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things
