reviews.comment: easy course material but exams are nearly impossible, final grade is based off of 4 exams that contain very little of the provided study guide. although professor engstrom is a great teacher and very knowledgeable the way she grades and makes exams make it hard to enjoy being in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you go to class and pay attention to the lectures, the class is very easy. About 40% of your grade is based off reading quizzes from the textbooks/novels that you are required to read. The other big portions are midterms/finals, both open note. As long as you attend lecture and recitation you should have no problem passing this class with an A.
Took this class in Fall 2020 so it was completely online and honestly didnt get to know her too well but shes super understanding and always checks her email if you need to ask questions!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. B is an incredible professor. She knows what she is talking about and always has great input on whatever the topic is. I took the online class and it wasn't too hard. There is a lot of reading though, and weekly quizzes on the reading assigned in the syllabus for that week. Overall, she gives a good class and is accessible outside class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Beaulieu is really enthusiastic in lecture, and you can tell she knows what she is talking about. She's very clear about what will be on exams and how the class will be organized. Recitation attendance is mandatory. We only had two or three tests, a weekly article to read and summarize, and a take-home essay final. Easy A
Took for honors seminar. She really does care and wants us to do well. Not the most interesting class.
Wonderful teacher, she goes above and beyond. Very well rehearsed. Assignments are intriguing and challenging.
Ridiculously Easy Tons of Extra Credit Tests are Cake Class is Pretty Enjoyable and Thought Provoking  Also, get her talking about gender equality. She will go on and on forever about it.

Super easy professor. If you don't get an 'A', then you aren't trying. She comes off as really stuck up at times though. T.A.'s apparently write the tests for her and take the questions directly off the reading quizzes. Lab is mandatory (like 25% of grade) but you aren't tested over the material, because that makes total sense. Extra credit galore!

I loved her class even though I'm not a Political Science major. Even though her lectures were not mandatory I still went to almost everyone because they were fun and I learned a lot. Recitation can be terrible when you have a bad TA like i did but what can you do? Two tests all multiple choice and reading quizes online over every chapter.

great teacher, in class participation is very important and keeping up with the reading is key! the tests are essays and she isn't too strict about grading, but you need know the material well enough to have a good overall concept. cheat sheets allowed on tests. clarifies material in class discussion well

As a Poly Sci major, I naturally love the subject. However, on the first day of class she started by talking about her (nearly radical) political views. TOO opinionated. In addition, the format of the class is odd. Lectures and Recitation classes are completely irrelevant of each other. Often found myself incredibly frustrated with teacher.

The 2 tests are hard but not worth a lot, read the case studies (most important on tests). You don't have to go to class but she's great at teaching and really helps you understand the content. Go to your section- it will help your grade if your participation is good, and then if you do bad on the tests you're still okay. Take her, she's good!

She is very knowledgable about her subject and interesting. She is helpful and fun to talk to about the subject. I loved the class she lectures the entire time, but it's intersting. Tests are kinda hard. As long as you study lecture notes and case studies out of the book you'll be fine. The final paper isn't that bad either.
Read the book! And go to lecture because it is interesting and you learn it then and don't have to study so much for the tests. Shes a good teacher tho. And I liked that you turn everything in on BB.
I love her lectures because she is so hilarious. Be sure to read the book, a lot more of it is on the test than you might expect.

She is a great professor, very knowledgeable and entertaining to listen to.  She relates to her students well, too.  She expects participation but allows you to post on blackboard if you don't like to talk in class.  I really enjoyed the class and got an A easily by attending and listening to lectures.

A passionate and knowledgeable lecturer with an unfortunate rude streak and downright haughty in person. Rarely mentions the book in lecture, but surprise - it's all on the test. Get started on your country comparison paper early because it's worth 45% of your grade. Tests are very similar to "cheat sheet" type study guides that are provided.

Great teacher who knows what shes talking about and seems to genuinely enjoy teaching the subject. She is always able to get the class to listen in an interesting fashion. All in all, a great teacher for political science.
Great teacher!
Very easy class as long as you attend lecture and take good notes! that's where her lest material comes from. Reading isn't required
The material that she teaches is actually true in real life in regards to elections in developing states. I recommend taking this class.

I recommend taking this class to fulfill your cross-cultural requirement.  It's an easy A and the material is very comprehensible.  Her antics can be VERY distracting, but other than that, she is a great professor, very clear, and definitely understands the material.
She is kinda sarcastic, but overall a great teacher. she knows her stuff and the films are interesting. you watch a ton of films, read 3 books, and take quizzes and tests. love the class.

Take this class (fills x-cult req)! It's cake as long as you read the novels. There are 3&all pretty easy to read except for one, but it still wasn't too bad. The whole class consists of watching films(which are interesting) and writing reviews on them. The lectures that she does give clarify the material in the films and novels and are also on BB.

Her lectures are clear and to the point.  They don't last long, but it's obvious that she knows what she's talking about.  Her focus is on reading the novels and watching the movies in class.  She's extremely fair.  She tells you what she wants; do it and you get an A.  I would take her again.
she is a good teacher but does expect you to do the work and lots of reading.
very good teacher. sweet

She is an awesome lecturer.  If you go to class and take notes you might not have to read much to pull a B or even an A.  I highly recommend her class even if you don't think you are interested in the subject because you will be at the end.
She is a great professor. Go to lecture even though its not mandatory, thats where the tests come from. I made an a in the class. shes really helpful and easy to get a hold of if you have questions.

One of the best profs I ever had. Really stimulated my interest in the subject, and was available outside of class to help. Lectures and readings and imp for tests, and grade is spread out evenly through assignments. As long as you do the reading and participate you will do fine in her class!
Very good professor. Extremely helpful and good at making students interested in the subject matter. I enjoyed her class very much.

She is an alright teacher, you need to attend class and take notes though because that is where the test comes from. halfway through the semester she threw in a curveball test in order to offset the amount of 'A's that were being awardedyour asking. Her TA last year sucked and barely spoke any english which made papers suck.
she is the nicest teacher i have ever had! she always has a smile on her face and she is really easy to listen to. she is also very helpful and pretty.

Silvia is one of the best teachers I have ever had. She is so kind and caring and truly loves her students! If you put in the work in this class, it will show. Just show up, do your homework, and be prepared. She is amazing!

She's chill. Homework every day of class takes about 20-30 minutes, calls on students to participate, no class the days of exams. Attendance is mandatory which sucks. Although she's not my favorite professor she's my favorite Spanish instructor that I've ever had.

she is really nice. there is a decent amount of homework but a lot of the answers are given in lecture so most assignments are easy. there are some written assignments but you can turn it in twice and get your score averaged which is really helpful to boost your grade.
She is the best professor I have had! She is such a nice person who truly cares about her students. I wish that she taught more levels of Spanish so I could have her again.
Super sweet and super helpful! Willing to work with you as long as you put in the effort. Very encouraging and made sure students knew what they were doing before she moved on

She's my favorite Spanish prof, after I had her for 210 I made sure to get her again for 323. SPA 210 wasn't too bad with homework, but there was a lot in 323. Still I would definitely suggest Silvia because I think it's more the nature of the class than in her teaching. She outlines all the homework for the semester in her syllabus, so print it!

She talks pretty fast at times and gives a decent amount of homework. No tests in this class, but you have many presentations including one where you're supposed to talk in Spanish for 10-15 min. without having notes.
I absolutely loved having Silvia! She is an awesome professor and makes class enjoyable. As long as you do your homework and keep up with the readings, you'll be right on track!

My favorite teacher ever in the Spanish department. She is so caring about her students and makes class fun. The class is mandatory, but you're allowed 3 free skips. There is homework from the textbook every night but never takes more than 2o minutes. 3 compositions throughout the whole semester. Take her for any course11/10 recommend taking her!!!

Yorki really loves teaching. In SPA 310 he helped us analyze and understand Spanish texts from literary, historical, feminist and political perspectives. He is funny, smart, well-prepared and very open to new ideas. He also likes student participation and will encourage you to talk more and support your answers. Take a class with him, he's a gem!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Yorki is a great instructor, very professional and extremely organized. Participation is a must, so make sure you answer his questions. He can be funny and he also loves sharing interesting facts about his country when possible. Exams are easy; and don't cheat on the compositions because he will find out, trust me --- He's also easy on the eyes.

Not helpful and not clear. You play a guessing game when you're asking questions because he does not help at all to lead you in the right direction. He is a very strict grader for written assignments without offering any outline so that you know what he is asking.

Me encanta Yorki! He uses Spanish as much as possible, which was great for me. Participation and attendance are very important!! Read the syllabus!! He  also expects you to know concepts covered in 201, which is fair if you are in a 202 class. If you participate, come to class prepared and study, there is no reason why you cannot get at least a B.
Professor Sandoval is a really nice guy and grades really easily, especially if he recognizes that you come to class most of the time. This class was a breeze.

Professor Sandoval is great!! I loved this class.  He is very fun and explains everything very well! I would definitely take this class again.  You have a few performance tests (which are easy), a few written tests, and in class- concerts.  Overall great class! 10/10 would definitely  recommend.
HE IS A STUD
Best person in the entire world. Truly wants students to be successful!

extremely personable, I had him he was also my academic advisor, so i was able to build a stronger relationship for advising, participation matters so come to class, assignments are not overwhelming at all and he shapes them to fit your interests and busy schedules
GREAT PROFESSOR, I LOVE HIM!!!!
Patient

Marcus is awesome. I know so may people that didn't like their UK 101 classes, but I had a great experience because of Marcus. It is a super easy class that has actual applications to your life (which is nice). I would definitely recommend Marcus to anyone!!

Normally students hate this class, but if you have Marcus, it is amazing. I felt so comfortable going into class each day and made so many friends through it, all because of him. Definitely take his class, you won't regret it at all!

By far one of the best professors I have had. He is very understanding and would drop everything to help you with anything. If you can get into his UK101 take it! By far the best class I took freshman year.

Online class. It's clear she just re-uses stuff from previous semesters and doesn't bother to update. Said "Incorporate notes from our meeting into your next assignment" but I NEVER MET HER. Assignments are unclear.

The class is ICT 310. Professor is unfair and doesn't treat all students equally. She's scattered in her class presentation and class details change on the fly. Tests cover materials that haven't been gone over yet. I hope I NEVER have to take one of her classes again. Hated it so much I'd consider delaying my graduation date to avoid her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Good personality, very nice but grading scale is horrible. Must have a a 95% or above for and A. A 94% will be counted as a B.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Very nice and understanding. No exams, just quizzes you can do with other people. She's a very light grader and gives lots of extra credit. Uses a lot of AI tho bleh. She makes the class easy and wants to see everyone succeed. Attendance can be done online via submitting an assignment. Minimal effort is needed for this class.
She was very caring and understanding. Great lectures and fun. A couple group projects but nothing bad.
Super easy class and she wants you to get a good grade! There are many extra credit opportunities and she is always open to feedback.

If you're looking for an easy A, this is the class to take. If you're looking to actually learn microbiology, this class might frustrate you. Erin Richard is very kind and super accommodating; but I feel like her class could be condensed to a footnote. I think I would still get 100% without ever attending a class.

I loved Erin Richard's class! As a nursing student, she made microbio very easy to learn and gave simples lectures. She drops the lowest quiz scores so you're pretty much guaranteed an A, especially how you get a cheat sheet for the quizzes. She has some things for attendance but usually I did it after the class and got credit. Would take again!

Dr. Richard is super nice and very flexible in her course. There's no exams, only biweekly quizzes. You also get a cheat sheet on the quizzes and work with others. Attendance is technically required with poll everywhere and gradescope, but you get 7 free absences. The class is super easy and Dr. Richard is really understanding, so I'd recommend!
Super kind and great professor. Easy class to pass.
I LOVEEEEEEEEE HER!! BEST PROFESSOR EVER!! SHE IS SO SO SO AWESOME

Dr. Richard is so knowledgeable and caring. However, and y'all will hate me for saying this, I think she's a bit of a pushover, and the class is too easy. She asks for feedback often and will entertain the most ridiculous asks. Being one of the only science classes that nursing majors take, I think they should have to face a challenge science-wise.
I LOVE DR. RICHARD!! the attendance policy is really the kicker in this class, but you are able to watch the echo to submit your attendance question. exams are all open note & taken from home

I love Dr. Richard. She really cares for her students. Attendance is mandatory, but many students use Echo360 instead of going in person. Her lectures are clear, her homework is easy, and her exams are online and open note. She also gives extra credit after exams for answering the most missed questions. She gives many opportunities to succeed.
Good professor overall.

I hated this class. I felt like I understood everything going on in lecture and as soon as I was given a worksheet, quiz, or test she would give us questions about things we never even went over. I could not do good in this class. In fact, I would rather be hit by a car than have to take another one of her tests.

Beware on where you sit for the first day of lab because that is where you are going to sit for the rest of the semester. Lots of busy work and too much work for this class, granted it is 2 credits. But this lab is not hard but it is harder than the class and more work. Overall this lab is annoying but you do see some cool stuff.

LOVE her! All of the exams are take home and they are open note. 35 questions 50 minutes. For our class attendance was mandatory and there was an attendance quiz you had to take and all it says was if you were here or not. But you can miss like 8 lecture days and still get 100% for attendance points.
this course was pretty easy. every test was open note, and all of it was from lectures and homework. very easy to maintain an A

One of the easiest classes I have ever taken. All assignments are graded for completion not correctness and quizzes/exams are all open note. There are always review sessions before each exam and they are super helpful!
She's a nice person, can be confusing during lecture, WILL NOT ROUND UP CLOSE GRADES BEWARE, offers some extra credit, class isnt too hard but she can make the content more confusing than it is

This class is great. Echo lectures make watching lecture more flexible. Each week there's a worksheet (for completion) and a quiz (with 2 attempts). 4 open-note exams through the semester. Her lectures are helpful and notes are great for the quizzes/exams. I recommend watching lecture and taking notes to help with the open note exams.

I took her summer microbiology class and it was fairly easy. She has some great lectures posted and she seems passionate about the topic which always makes the class more enjoyable. She is also really nice.

Dr. Richard is a super caring and knowledgeable professor that always showed concern and care for us as students. The content wasn't super difficult, but you definitely need to put in some work and studying to properly understand the learning objectives. There was a variety of different assignments that were very straightforward and interactive

This class seems to be fully run by TAs, as the lecture (208) seems to not be in sync whatsoever with what is learned. Too many group projects and papers for a fully online lab. 2/3 TAs are supposedly very hard graders, and not many people seemed to gain anything other than busywork out of this class. Too bad it is a prerequisite.

Dr. Richard for 208 wasn't bad at all, but it wasn't fantastic. It seemed a little unorganized at times, but that can be attributed to a fully online class in general. I wish she wouldn't ask us to occasionally write questions and put student-written ones on the test. It seems nice to do, but it leads to some oddly worded questions.
She's a great teacher and a very caring person who wants all her students to succeed.

Dr. Richard is a caring professor who wants her students to succeed in the course. Bio. 208 isn't an easy course but she tries to break down difficult concepts in order for students to better understand. There are worksheets graded for completion, lecture quizzes, and mini-exams. Workload is doable and don't be afraid to reach out to her.

Dr. Richard is so sweet and does everything she can to help her students succeed. BIO208 is definitely a hard course, but she makes everything digestible so its not so overwhelming. You definitely have to spend time studying for this class, but the homework & worksheets never take long at all and help your grade so much as long as you do them.

I passed her class just by going to lecture and paying attention and looking over notes before exams. She made this class way easier than it should be and really wants students to succeed. She does reef but not for correctness. This course is very slow paced and easy to get an A in if you keep up with lectures.

She is such a sweetheart who cares about the material and her students. Her lectures are important, but they are recorded on an Echo. You are allowed a certain about of skips from the clickers, but the clickers is how you get the points. Its almost like extra credit. Her exams are not difficult and everyone gets points for the hw and worksheets.

Dr. Richard is hands down my favorite professor I have had at UK. Her lectures are super easy to follow because she gives access to her notes before class and the lectures flow very smoothly. She is very nice so be sure to go to office hours. The tests aren't bad if you go to class and study a week or so in advance. Awesome professor!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Not an easy class. However, Dr. Richard explained the material clearly and was really helpful outside of class.

This was a good class. This class is lecture heavy but it is not taught in a boring way. There are 4 quizzes but they're group quizzes. Exams can have a few tricky questions where two could be the correct answer. Professor Richard always answers her emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's is such a nice professor, always responds to your emails and is super understanding. There are 4 quizzes in her class but they are group quizzes so don't worry. Her exams are about average but even if you don't do great on the exams you can still get a good grade in the class and the homework is unlimited tries to get a 10/10.

She is super sweet! As long as you pay attention during the lectures and complete/study the chapter themes she makes you'll be fine. She's super willing to meet with you in and out of office hours and makes all the content as easy for you to understand as possible. She's also really reliable in regards to emailing back, no matter the time or day :)
Dr. Richard was very good at lecturing. Her tests are pretty easy. She is also very understanding if you need to miss class, make up an exam, etc.

For sure, the best professor I've had! She knows what she is talking about and makes everything very easy to understand. This course is easy as long as you put time into it. There is a lot of content, but none of it is too hard. i would recommend taking this course and her as the professor.

Hands down one of the best professors Ive had. She makes the criteria she lectures so easy to understand. Its still a lot of content but its completely doable. Be sure to visit office hours, look over study guides and online lectures.

She's a great lecturer, and the class isn't too difficult as long as you pay attention in lecture, do the homework, and do a quick review of the slides before exams. I wouldn't recommend buying the textbook for the lecture, but you definitely need the lab manual for lab.
She's super nice! Knows what she's talking about.

Dr. Richard is an amazing professor who really loves what she teaches. She is really sweet and is always available to answer any questions you have. She makes microbiology (an intimidating subject) easy and understandable. Her tests aren't overly hard and if you take good notes and do the study guide she gives you you should have no problems at all
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's great. Highly recommend!
Great teacher! Everything she explains is in simple and understandable terms and her tests are not unnecessarily hard. I'd recommend her to anyone.
Awesome professor! If you listen in lecture you should do fine. She explains things in really simple terms so its not easy to get confused.

She's very nice and understanding. The rules and requirements are set at the beginning of the year and she sticks with it. As long as you pay attention the quizzes aren't hard but you are graded on if you get your iclicker questions rights.

This is an easy class, if you show up to all lectures you will get an A. There are no exams, but there are quizzes every week and sometimes group work. The lectures are very straightforward and fast so you can't get distracted. However, she does a great job at answering questions.

She is a really great professor overall! Beware that you will have a participation assignment every day after class covering what you worked on in class. They are fairly easy and you have unlimited attempts on them. On top of that you will have other assignments weekly as well as weekly quizzes but there are no exams.
She was super great and drops two quizzes and one group project at the end of the semester! Attendance is taken through completion of classwork.

Professor Woods is super clear about how everything in the class works, which made it really easy to keep up. The work wasn't hard at all and the quizzes were pretty simple if you paid attention. Honestly one of the easiest math classes I have ever taken and she also explains things really well. Definitely recommend having her as a professor.
Professor Wood is an amazing professor. She is very understanding and helps me understand math unlike my previous professors.

Erin is a very nice professor but she does move very quick. I have never been good at math so this class was not always a cake walk for me especially when she teaches fast. There are quizzes every week and you get a chance to retake them, they take off points sometimes for the tiniest mistakes- or wont explain why they took off any points at all.

Class is a repeat of high school math in my experience, but overall really easy if you pay attention. You will have to use iClicker for attendance and in-class participation which counts towards your engagement standard. I never had any problems with her and she taught the class well in my opinion.

Easy class if you payed attention in 10th grade math.. She gets mad if you do the desmos classwork ahead of time and will do everything she can to prevent you from doing it before anyone else but it's usually easy to bypass.

Always willing to help if you're having trouble. Strict with attendance.

10/10 recommend taking Dr. Hester's classes. She is really relaxed, and she makes herself available before/after classes. 311 was very discussion-based and opinion-based, and Dr. Hester made it a point not to show any biases toward one side or the other, so that students could express their own opinion.

The TA's are tough graders, but Professor Hester's lectures are super chill, and she's very understanding about missing class for valid reasons. She does give out extra credit, and the points definitely help if you don't do well on her projects.

Everything about this class was a great experience. She clearly cares about her students. It's very clear what she expects of you. Her slides are clear and she gives you access to them. She's funny and makes the concepts easy to understand. Textbook was awesome and we only had 3 assignments all semester. Exams aren't bad either! I highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I loved Erin! She took over for my TA so all of my labs were with her and it was super beneficial. However, she is a tough grader. There's always something you can be doing better. Multiple opportunities for extra credit.
I loved the professor but I didn't really like my TA in the class. Make sure to take notes! All projects, no exams in this class!

Professor Hester seems like a a kind woman but you won't be interacting with her at all. You will be talking with yours TAs, they will be grading all of your assignments, and they will guide your labs. Assignments are graded really picky and large assignments are given suddenly without much knowledge on how to do them or what they should look like.

Dr. Hester was awesome! It was a large lecture so participation was tough, but the labs were smaller and easier to participate in. She noticed when lecture and lab weren't working and brought someone in to try and fix the issues and I think it really helped the class flow better- She saw an issue and actually fixed it. Loved taking her!!
Waste of money. She took an entire lecture to talk about fonts. Haven't learned anything from this course.

Erin is one of the best professors I had at UK! I looked forward to coming to her class. I highly recommend going to her office hours- it will pay off dividends!! She sometimes offers additional help/bonus points just for making the effort to come see her.

ISC 261 is a hard class. It requires a lot of work, and a lot is expected from you. You should know that going in. That being said, Professor Hester is amazing. She is a great lecturer, and I actually really enjoyed class. I will say you will probably see much more of your TA, but Erin is great!

Professor Hester is hands-down my favorite professor I have ever had. I will make an effort to take as many ISC classes with her as I possibly can. I even nominated her for an award. She is kind and a good person, but also knowledgable and passionate about ISC.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hester is a solid choice. She clearly knows her stuff and tries to make the content current. She's also really understanding and kind outside of class. I hated the group projects and wish I could have picked my own brand, but otherwise no complaints. She won't waste your time and gets straight to the point. I would take her again.

I took 311 online and Erin was amazing. She does everything to get her class engaged and the way that she set up group work worked really well even online. The only reason people wouldn't like her is bc she didn't get the class feedback she deserves. I wish I had her in person please take her. Class is cake if you show effort for her

Erin is easily the best professor I have had at UK. She really cares about her students and wants them to learn. You have to put effort in but this class is actually really interesting and she likes to keep class fun and interesting. Get ready for a lot of classroom discussions! The more you participate the better grade you will receive.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Peters is a great professor for CHE107. She explains concepts clearly and gives plenty of practice questions. Exams are heavily weighted and there are Iclicker questions used for attendance every class but I believe that is the same for every General Chemistry course.
Very good at explaining things, always ready to answer questions. Really clear on what's expected; this is one of those courses that def rewards genuine earnest work
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Peters is knowledgeable about chemistry, yet she is not a good professor. She focuses more on memes and jokes rather than actual content and frequently cuts the lecture short because she spends so much time on them. If you want a serious professor, this one is not for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Peters is best option for Chem @ UK atm. Especially if you, like me, despise flipped classroom bs. She cares + wants you to succeed. Do well early as it gets exponentially harder later. Homework is plentiful / time consuming. Exams are standardized across chem dept so doesn't matter who u have exam difficulty wise, but more for lecture + support.

CHE 226 is difficult if you didn't perform well in CHE 107 in my opinion. It basically covers similar content, but elevated. She does her best to explain the content, but I feel like she doesn't have enough time to teach it within 50 minutes; her lectures felt very rushed. The lab experiments are fun, but difficult and worth a lot of your grade.

CHE 105 is typically a difficult course for students, especially if you don't have any background knowledge. However, she teaches this course better than any of the other gen chem professors at UK. She cares about her students and is good at answering questions. You should be more than fine on exams if you can do the homework questions on your own.

I thought she was good. Her lectures were cohesive and she explained them well. She sometimes did experiments in lecture, which helped keep us engaged. She does use iclicker to make sure people show up. Overall, good lectures, and good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Super helpful and passionate teachers. Always wants you to make sure you understand the content and is very accessible for help outside of class.

solid professor, 105 is just a really hard class to take as a freshman in your first semester. she always worked out math problems in class and tried to keep most of her lectures light-hearted. if you take 105 don't mess up the first exam because you'll be in way over your head trying to recover
Very knowledgable and passionate instructor. Can sometimes be condescending when you ask questions, but other than that is willing to explain and work out problems with you.

Dr. Peters is a great professor! The Gen Chem department sets the course structure, but she keeps lectures light with humor and a positive attitude. She's very friendly and encouraging. Go to office hours—they're super helpful!
Peters isn't an amazing professor nor is she a bad professor. I find her lectures to be boring but she doesn't do the flipped classroom which is nice. She explains things well but fast.
Peters is rude. Lectures are boring and she rambles on and on. The exams are fine but the past exams don't help

Dr. Peters gives solid lectures, though they can be a bit dry. She keeps things light with corny memes, which add a fun touch—unless you're a snob. iClicker is required for participation points and can't be done outside class. If you're deciding between professors, she's a strong choice and makes the material manageable!

I really liked her lecture, and her jokes are funny. The iClicker questions shouldn't be that hard as they are usually after she explains the specific topic. Exams aren't so bad, but I do recommend studying after class and attending the review sessions held before the exams.

Peters is a knowledgeable professor, though lectures can move quickly. Staying engaged and using resources like unstuck study alongside the free textbook can really help. Overall a challenging but rewarding class.

Dr. Peters is great at explaining topics and goes over a lot of math practice problems in class. As long as you pay attention in class you will understand the content pretty well. CHE 105 is just a hard class so you have to study a lot on top of lecture to do well on the exams though. You also get one exam replacement on the final.

Honestly Peter's was a pretty good professor, but sometimes she would just read off of the slides. She got a little snippy with people talking during lecture so dont make that mistake. Her handwriting is awful and hard to read so just make sure youre listening to what she's writing. CHE 105 is just overall a tough class so make sure you study!

I loved Dr. Peters as every class was fun and engaging with a few demos, funny chemistry jokes, and some laughable iClicker questions. She made chemistry truly fun for those taking it for the first time or for those who took a dual credit/ AP course in High School. If you ever need help with the work, I highly suggest her office hours or the GCLC.
The in class Iclicker is very important for your grade. She is hard ot focus on in class and moves really fast but provides good online resources.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I adored Dr. Peters. I am genuinely considering changing my Bio major to a Chem major because of her (despite me undergoing the wrath of April French's Chem lab concurrently). Dr. Peters really cares about her students, and truly wants you to succeed. she does NOT use a flipped classroom style which worked very well for me. Highly recommend!!

Dr. Peters is a decent professor. She goes over content fairly quickly. Sometimes when someone asks questions though she can come off as condescending. She includes LOTS of funny dad jokes. You need to study a lot outside of lectures to do well in this course. I recommend Dr. Woodrum.

overall call was decent, if you get an A on the 3 exams you do not take the final exam, its is an average of all 3. Lecture hardly covered any math on the exams, all written exams. Lab is fun, just make sure to write procedure or you loose points. Davis could lighten up on grading, he is specific. Exams are from lecture, quiz, and book. STUDY!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I wouldn't recommend Dr. Peters if you are taking chem 105. Says she's going to going to be teaching chemistry like you've never heard of it before but that's not true. All she really does is read from the slides and quickly work out problems. It's hard to really grasp the concepts and know what you need to learn for the exam with how she teaches.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Decent professor. She does explain the concepts pretty well. She sometimes starts brand new topics in the last 2 minutes of class. Also, don't be having a full on conversation if you sit close to the front of the hall, cause you will be called out! Finally, make sure you attend every lecture, not just for the iclicker, but also to prepare for exams

Dr. Peters cares a lot about her students. She crams in the last few concepts the week of the exam, but that is because she takes her time to explain concepts learned in class prior (the last concepts are not heavily on the exams anyway). No one asks questions, but she is open to them during lecture. She also makes many puns and is very kind.

She explains things incredibly fast and is sometimes against answering questions. If you make too loud of a noise or ask a stupid question she is not afraid to call you out on it, but everyone she does this too deserves it. I had to start reading the lecture slides beforehand to be able to keep up. Overall she explains things fairly well.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: if you would like to be made feel stupid take this class. this class is very lecture heavy but will cram in information that is very important for exam. don't ask cough, laugh or do anything if the sort you will be called out for doing so. do not recommend this class in the slightest. Extremely hard because of the way she teaches.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor
Does not engage with material and just reads from slides and moves on. Very tough class to grasp if you have no chemistry background. Miss class won't pass. Clicker questions are graded.
I do not recommend taking Peters. The resources that were provided were fine but she would drop so much material on us the day before an exam and just expected us to know it!

There is a lot of content and lectures could feel very long, she does a good job of keeping people engaged. I appreciate that she recorded lectures to go back and watch. I suggest sitting in the front row and annotating the slides as she goes over them. Also for students taking gen chem for the first time, take advantage of the practice exams.

Dr. Peters is super sweet and a great professor if you learn best with lecture-based classes! If flipped classrooms work better for your learning (watching lectures at home and doing problems in class), a different professor might be a better option. That being said, she is so understanding and helpful if you ever have questions!

Dr. Peters is a great lecturer. She does move fast, but that is the nature of Chem 105. She works through problems in class and is available to answer questions in office hours. Make sure you can stand some corny chemistry jokes before you take her.

Dr. Peters is a great professor and the lectures are well taught Attendance is mandatory, but if you stay above a 75% attendance score on iClicker, she will round up your grade to a 100 for attendance.  She uses three screens at once to display different content, which is super helpful. There's a lot to know tho, but just pay attention in class.

Peters is a cool person and deeply understands chemistry. That being said she has the tendency to be fast during lectures which can lead you to fall behind but all the lectures are online. I would take again over some of the other professors I've heard about.

Dr. Peters was a great professor and explained everything clearly, if a bit fast. Sometimes would cram content in right before exams, but was always available if you needed help. Overall if you pay attention in lecture and take notes, you'll do fine

Dr. Peters thoroughly explains everything covered during lectures. Everything on the exams were covered in class. She provides students with copies of her PowerPoints so students can write on them with iPads. The class can be demanding at times through homework assignments and memorizing different topics, but that is the same with other professors.

Attend the lectures as participation questions and practice problems done in class mimic the exam questions. Not required, but I'd recommend reading the textbook before content is covered in class to reinforce topics. Dr. Peters holds plenty of office hours and exam review sessions to help students excel. Put in the effort, and you'll be fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: the class wasn't easy, but it was fair. lectures would be boring to anyone outside of chem, so don't take if it's not your major. show up, take notes, you'll be fine

Dr. Peters was really an okay professor... Exams are hard but do practice problems and you'll be okay. Only complaint is the lab and more so the TA's. They had as much an idea what was going on as we did. Kevin was cool but Megan... lighten up, m'kay?

While CHE 105 is a very challenging class, I think Dr. Peters is a great professor. She has good lectures but sometimes rushed content right be for an exam. She is a very nice lady who really does care for her students. I think she is one of the most caring faculty in the chemistry department. I would take her again for chemistry if it's an option.
Dr. Peters is the only professor who still lectures. All the others use online videos for the lectures. Her lectures are great, and because of the Playposits, she is the only one worth taking.

I loved Dr. Peters. She actually taught in class and did not send hour long videos for you to watch outside of class hours and she would answer tough questions you had. I think sitting up front in this class is very beneficial and she takes a positive relationship with those up front imo. She did not like talking and would stop lecturing for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Peters is a nice lady and overall good professor. Exams can be very difficult and often required days to study. Additionally, Dr. Peters doesn't record her lectures. My only real complaint about the course is the lab. When grading lab reports, one TA graded way too harshly and the other like he wanted everyone to get an A. No consistency.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Peters only provides lectures with no videos. Other professors provide videos which I found more helpful. She rushed difficult topics a lot. She would be behind in content before an exam. She would be rude when answering students in class and would stop the lecture for talking. She is helpful outside of class, but I would take someone else.

Ms. Peters is a good teacher as far as the chemistry department goes.  Nothing will prepare you for the exams you will take for chemistry but she does care about her students, her lectures aren't amazing but they will give you a decent overview of what the science is behind the numerous math problems you will see.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: BEST CHEMISTRY PROFFESOR IN UK

Dr. Peters is harsh in class and has the tendency to answer sarcastically to questions. I have personally been made to feel stupid several times in her class, which does not reflect who she is. She is very caring and kind if you talk with her personally, but her lectures are a whirlwind: fast-paced and confusing.

Dr. Peters is one of best general chemistry professors, if not the best. Dr. Peters teaches during lectures. She does NOT use pre-lecture videos like the flipped-classroom format. This was so much more beneficial to me rather than watching boring videos. She does go pretty fast sometimes, that is the only downfall. Be prepared to study for success!

I liked Dr. Peter's for the most part... she did speed through a lot of tough concepts and could be condescending when answering questions. But she taught everything that needed to be taught and there wasn't a ton of homework.

Dr. Peters is knowledgable about chemistry, but does not know how to teach it. She wastes time with memes. Then, she rushes over important topics. When a student has a question, she either answers in a way that isn't helpful or makes you feel bad for not knowing the answer. She would stop the 300-person lecture just to call out people talking.

Dr.Peters was phenomenal. She uses an in person lecture style, as opposed to the flipped classroom style that other chem107 professors use. Dr.Peters was very knowledgeable about the subject and was able to simplify the content and explain it in simple terms. chem107 is a very difficult class, and there is a lot of math so be prepared tho

This class is honestly just difficult. Dr. Peters does her best with the time she's given to teach us all the content. She is a very intelligent woman, which sometimes causes her to speed through confusing concepts. All in all, she really just wants her students to succeed, pass, and learn. She is very helpful when it comes to asking questions!

Shes an amazing professor and genuinely wants you to learn and succeed. She gives you motivational quotes before exams and tells you not to worry and just show what you know. The class itself is absolutely awful but as a professor, she is amazing.

If you do the homework, reviews and seek help when you are struggling an A is achievable. This class is by no means easy, especially if you're not familiar with CHE, but honestly if you put forth the effort you will be fine and Peters will help you when you're struggling, as she wants to see you succeed. No playposits means more time to study.

I was lucky to get Peters for both 105&107. B/c of her I enjoyed CHE. If you are struggling, go to office hours; she's happy to help anyway she can. Yes, her lectures can be fast paced but she has 50 min to relay information & her lectures are recorded for later use. She doesn't use PlayPosits and she only teaches exam content, unlike other profs.

I really enjoyed Dr. peters class. She made the class interesting and would go over plenty of examples in class. Che 107 is just a difficult class, but as long as you put in effort then she will help you a ton. She would also email back answers to questions really quickly. Dr. Peters is an incredibly caring professor and one of my favorites.

Dr Peters is an amazing professor. The content can be difficult but she takes the time to do lots of examples and does a great job of making the topics clear and understandable. She keeps lectures entertaining with cheesy memes and real-life examples. She is a caring professor that will really help you in this class as long as you put in effort.

Dr. Peters is the best professor I have had at UK. Overall the chemistry dept is bad but she is the exception. I have had her for 105 and 107 and done very well in the class because her lectures have been helpful. She is also an amazing person.

Dr. Peters gives very boring lectures that are also very hard to follow. She goes through material very fast with little examples that are hard to understand. When the class does not understand something she is very rude about helping and acts like the student is dumb for not understanding her very confusing speaking. Def take another professor.

Peters is smart but has no idea how to teach the chemistry content to her students. She taps through slides and skims over math problems to show her memes that she deems funny as quickly as possible. She wastes time with students and is then mad when we fall behind all the other classes. Asking questions seems to make her angry in class.
She is the worst chem professor at UK. She doesn't explain things well and she goes through the lecture like she has somewhere to be. Literally take anyone else other than her.

Very knowledgeable and caring professor! She truly wants her students to do well no matter their background in chemistry. You have to go to every lecture and pay close attention to the content being presented, however, she is an amazing lecturer and gives many in-note examples. She also dressed up for Halloween which I loved!
She knows very well the content, but don't know how to pass it to the students.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Peters was an awesome professor! Her lectures were all really good and left me with a very good understanding of the material. She is also really good at answering student questions and super sweet! The exams can be difficult, but she makes sure you know what is on it so you can study well. I loved Dr. Peters and would definitely recommend her!

Dr. Peters is probably your best option for CHE 105. The homework assignments are very helpful to learn content with, and she doesn't assign more than necessary. Her slides are also extremely easy to follow. She goes over some of the topics way too quickly, but looking over her slides or rewatching the lectures make studying a lot easier.

I loved Dr. Peters. I like the lecture style, and I think that she explains things very clearly. She is funny and very nice. My only complaint is that I felt like there were simple sections that she spent an excessive amount of time on, while there were complicated ones that she breezed over. Overall, my experience was positive.

I really enjoyed analytical and Dr. Peters was a good professor to have for it. The exams can be difficult, but if you review the slides and the suggested book problems you can do well. She was easy to access outside class and wanted us to do well. I also liked how she linked lectures to real-world applications. Overall, I would recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: WOULD NOT RECOMMEND. She treats you differently if you are not naturally good at chemistry!! Your grade is dependent on the tests even though you do SO much work outside of class. CHE 105 is too crammed and makes it impossible to actually understand the concepts with how fast and how much content they skip. Recommend 109&110. I am a all A's student

The chemistry department as a whole is very unforgiving and as much as they claim otherwise, they do not care about the students. Dr. Peters is an ok professor, but is not helpful when asking questions in class. To get an A in this course go to Gen Chem learning center, make a study group, watch youtube videos, or go to The Study (hit or miss).

I liked Dr. Peters when I had her for CHE105: she was strict, taught rly well, had a lot of passion, and motivated me to attend with iClicker. However, my CHE107 class was unbearably behind compared to the other sections and got screwed on the common hour exams bc of it (ntm she talked with students for the first 5 of class). CHE105 yes, CHE107 no.
CHE105 is a difficult class for most people but Dr. Peters does a great job at helping her students understand the content as long as they make an attempt to ask questions.

Dr. Peters is a very intelligent individual, but her teaching is awful. She rushes through her slides, which are not very clear to begin with. She dismisses most questions or makes you seem like an idiot for having asked them. The exam grades are most of your grade and they are nearly impossible with the material given to you by Peters.

Good lecturer, better than other CHE 105 from what I have heard. She makes lots of meme jokes, but she makes content easy to understand sometimes, but others she will rush though content. Hit or miss really.

Dr. Peters class is fully taught during lectures using very well organized PowerPoints that are given to take notes on. She is very good at teacher, however she does go a little fast sometimes. I would say she is the best teacher for chem 105. You will have to work hard and study a lot but if you do that it will be well worth it.
love Dr. Peters! Your best option for CHE105

Ok so I went a whole semester hating her because I didnt realize she doesnt make the exams. The exams for CHEM105 are busted perversions of what you learn in class and on homework. Besides that shes a pretty good teacher. I didnt like her iClickers because I was always tired of lectures but I still got an A+

I had Dr. Peters for 105 and 107. Her lectures are structured really well and her notes help with the homework and exams a lot. She genuinely wants to make chemistry enjoyable for her students by including memes in her slides and doing in-class experiments. If you like traditional lectures instead of Playposit lectures, I highly recommend.

If you can choose which professor to take general chemistry from Peters is your best option. She is the only professor who does not utilize the flipped classroom model and genuinely cares about her students understanding the content instead of weeding them out or requiring extra assignments. Her lectures are engaging and reflect the exam content.

I love Dr. Peters! She is an incredible person and this is my second time taking the course and I am looking to pass under her class. The class structure is just like any other class- she does give more extra resources though. Her lectures are the most important though and she does a great job at explaining! definitely recommend.

Mrs. Peters started the semester by stating that it would not be memorization-heavy. This was extremely untrue as most of the content on the exams is all based on what you can remember. The exams are 73% of your final grade, and there's very little you can do to boost your grade. She makes the class too difficult especially for a gen ed class.

If it's possible, take CHE107 with Dr. Woodrum. Dr. Peters is not terrible, but she quickly goes over the most difficult concepts. She is a genius; she is sometimes too smart to read the room. She is usually never helpful if you email her personally for help or for accommodations
Amazing professor! Chemistry is a difficult subject but she does a great job of clarifying it.

Dr. Peters does a great job with her lectures. I love her powerpoints, and she is one the best to teach 105. If you have the option, take her! Her reviews before exams always helped a lot too. I never had to read the book because of her powerpoints.
Erin Peters is a great professor. She lectures well and includes some jokes to try and lighten the mood. She answers questions thoroughly and I would def recommend her as your first choice.

The professor really makes or breaks CHE105, and Dr. Peters is stellar. She always made sure to add corny "dad jokes" throughout our slides to renew interest in the subject. The subject matter is tough, but she makes it bearable. Her words are clear and easy to understand, but don't sit in the back, or else you won't hear her in the big room.

Dr. Peters is a great professor! She is so caring and kind and her lectures are hilarious. The analytical chem lab is not easy. Get ready to be precise in the lab as accuracy and precision are a large portion of the grade. This class is very math-heavy but if you attend the lecture and read the book and slides you'll be good to go on exams!

Out of all the options she seems to have her stuff together the most. Each unit (4 total) has about 3-4 100+ PowerPoints of all the notes and she goes over them in class. Other teachers give video notes and do example problems in class, so its up to you, but she's super good about controlling the class and getting through the material pretty fast

Dr. Peters is really good for CHE 105 because most of the professors, I heard, were awful. She lectures really well and explains things really well. Overall, this class is REALLY hard like you will hate chemistry by the end of the semester no matter how much you like it. You will threaten to jump off POT many times because of this class but oh well
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Although this class is very difficult, it is possible to get an A. She is the best professor for gen chem and she truly wants us to do well. Everything you need is given to you you just have to work hard. She is very sweet and makes jokes in her lectures to try and keep us engaged. Overall, show up prepared to take in a lot of info and try ur best

She's such a passionate and great teacher, and she makes really cheesy jokes. Overall, I love her class (CHE105), but make sure you study, show up to class for iClicker questions, and memorize equations.

While I've only had her as a CHE105 professor, from what I've heard, she's easily the best. Her lectures are engaging, she makes learning chemistry fun, and I've learned a lot in just this one semester. If you have the opportunity to take her class, ABSOLUTELY do it.

If you are taking this class freshman year, it is a great introduction to college. It is going to be very challenging, and you are going to have to do a lot of work on your own, however, Erin Peters does a great job at helping with that. She is very kind and is a very good lecturer.

Actually cares about trying to help her students understand the content. Even though the content is indeed difficult to comprehend, Phillips tries her best to help you understand. If the time is put in you can easily achieve an A, but as far as professors go she is the best to have for CHE105.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Peters was very nice, and you can really tell she cares about what she's doing. She goes out of her way to try and make it fun to learn. I think the online format was a little bit tough for her since you can tell she's a people person, but I still enjoyed watching her videos and attending her lectures, she was very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Peters. She taught chem class at UK and I loved her so much I wanted to get her again for the next chem class but she was not teaching it ugh. As long as you took solid notes from her lectures and paid attention this class should be an easy A. The tests are hard but it is chemistry so just study and look over notes.

I love her sense of humor and her lectures! I would do anything to have her for CHE107! Her sense of humor is quite punny and she takes the time to really explain everything! She responds very quickly on Piazza (within a few hours, usually less than 30 mins) and she is very humble. She is also super easy to understand! Take her if you can!

Dr. Peters class is very organized, the lectures are consise and easy to follow. She is very helpful and is eager to answer questions. She also tries to make the lectures interesting and easy to grasp with diagrams and pictures. The homework can be hard sometimes, but rewatching the lectures helps.
Dr. Peters is almost always willing to help in anyway she can. The class itself will become difficult the minute you stop paying attention though.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Peters for 105 and 107. She's great at presenting the material! She tries her best to make lectures interesting with bad jokes. Even the gen chem is notoriously difficult, I had no issues making an A with Dr. Peters. The only downside is that she is not the most socially aware person in the world.

She was fine, very nice person. Dont be stressed, probably the best entry level chem teacher. If you genuinely go to class and pay attention, do your homework, no reason you shouldnt get at least a B. An A is achievable for most people.
She is so nice and makes chem interesting and fun. Love her and taking her for 107. Make sure to do well on all sapling HW and youll be fine

Dr. Peters is a good professor who cares about her students and wants them to succeed. Lecture is of course boring, but she adds lots of jokes and puns to try and bring it up. CHE 105 isn't that difficult if you pay attention and don't skip. Overall, I liked Peters and would recommend

Peters is a really great CHE105 lecturer. She is so passionate and explains things well. Her examples are extremely fast. You have to pay attention in class or youll miss a whole concept. Overall, shes great.
Dr. Peters is a good professor; however, she flies through the content. Make sure to attend lecture and learn on your own outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: For a chem professor, Peters is pretty good. She is goofy which gets annoying but for the most part is always willing to help. She does her best to keep things interesting. UKs chemistry department sucks in general but Dr. Peters manages it pretty well. The content and tests are difficult but she cant be blames for that.

Dr. Peters is a really good Professor who cares about her students. She really tries to make her class fun and engaging by making really corny jokes. She also tries to explain concepts different ways to try and help everyone understand. Would definitely recommend her.
She is an amazing professor. She teaches everything very clearly.

She's a very nice and empathetic professor. Her slides are organized and easy to follow, and she does practice problems in class. Her REEF questions are a piece of cake too. Don't feel nervous about going to her office hours either because she's really friendly in person. The exams aren't hard if you have enough practice, but homeworks are tough.
She really tried to get people excited about the topics and chemistry in general. Tried to include lots of examples to relate to real life. Absolutely loved her! Made the class bearable.

Ms. Peters is very good at presenting the material needed for tests. The course is pretty straight forward, so as long as you just attend class and pay attention, you'll be fine. Ms. Peters tries her best to make gen. Chem. as interesting and enjoyable as possible, and she achieves this goal in my opinion.

Dr. Peters was amazing!  Though the class is known for being difficult, she taught well, and her lectures were never boring (they included so-bad-they-were-funny chemistry puns and memes).  If you show up, participate respectfully, and go to office hours with questions you should be fine. Take her class if you can!
Get ready to teach yourself lol.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Nice attitude and very chill but does not teach to where it will help you on the test. Barely any extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Peters was a terrific professor. Her lectures were clear and super helpful. She does a great job of explaining everything and takes time to answer questions  in class, after, and during office hours. She's so sweet and tries her best to make the material as enjoyable and understandable as possible. For sure would recommend her!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's a really good professor. She teaches the material well and explains it in many different ways if the class doesn't get it. She puts funny chemistry memes into her powerpoints and does cool demonstrations that go with the topic. Also, she posts her notes on canvas so you can print them and follow along in class. I would definitely recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Peters was a great chemistry teacher.  The course itself is very hard and requires a lot of work, but she makes it much easier to understand! She is also super helpful during office hours!

Dr. Peters was an absolute joy as a professor. She paced the class very well while still taking time to answer questions within a strict timeline. She seemed to really care about making sure we understood the material and explained concepts in a way that finally allowed me to understand chemistry! Which was exciting:)
She is an amazing person and a commited professor.  She is kind and helpful. Although I disapprove mandatory attendance, listening to her lectures is amusing and useful.

So CHE 105 is a really hard class. You have to study more than just the homework. But Dr. Peters is so amazing. She is super sweet and so willing to help. She really wants her class to do well. Always willing to take lots of time out of her own schedule to make time for you!
Good teacher. Great lecture notes

Dr.Walker makes her class really fun. The workload is light and the professor is super accessible when you need her. If you love listening to music, you'll love this class. Im a business major but had to take this class for a UK requirement. If you have the chance to take this class, I would. Be sure to give an effort, she appreciates that.

Dr. Walker knows her stuff! This class was overall easy. Attendance matters and counts towards your grade, BUT there is only class once a week. During class you play instruments and dance. She posts weekly videos to go over actual content. Exams can be a little difficult but all are open book/open note. I would recommend to fill a core.

Such a fun class!! I had her this past spring for class, so I was surprised that she had some bad reviews. It was super easy, so cathartic to play entry level music compared to my major which is super time consuming. I feel like I learned a lot. There were a lot of bored greek life students in the class. thats the source of the bad reviews.
Her class is actually fun but those exams are hard as crap. You have to do a lot in a short time. Just go to class and use your resources on exams.

Although she's a nice person, Walker is very disorganized and has you memorize an insane amount of artists for tests and some of the content on the tests weren't even things we learned on the slideshows! While the class was interesting I would not recommend Walker.

Overall, great class! very fun you play cool music and sometimes dance. Easy A, exams may be hard to some people if you don't pay attention. Attendance mandatory you get one skip but you only have class once a week which is so easy. Deff recommend to fill a core!

She is nice, but in class time is spent playing music, you have to teach yourself the test material. She doesn't go over notes at all, making tests difficult. You also have to identify names, artists, and styles of songs just from a 30 second clip. It wasnt hard for me , but I did spend 2 hours studying before each test, which isnt great.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Most boring lecture class I've taken. I thought this would be an interesting topic to learn about and get rid of a gen ed credit, but I hated getting to this class every time. Lecture for 2/3rd, and the end of class you dance/play instruments/etc. Introverts and easily bored students beware.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Walker is awful. This class could be so easy and fun but instead she makes it extremely difficult and boring. For exams you have to memorize tons of artists and be able to know what style of music she plays for only a couple seconds which means there's no real way to study for it. She's very unorganized.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This professor is pretty unorganized, and includes terms or names of artists in her tests she has never previously discussed. She also expects you to know over 15 songs/titles/artist per exam and they all sound the same. She also takes points off for pretty much whatever she wants, and imo is unfair.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I thought this class wouldn't be too difficult and it would be enjoyable, but I was wrong. She lectures most of the class on most days but the slideshows are very vague. Then, she expects you to know like 20 songs and their artists, and lemme tell u they all sound the same. Also some terms on test are never mentioned, would NOT recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Honestly, I love Dr. Walker. She's one of the best professors I've had at UK and very knowledgeable about her subject without being arrogant. The quizzes and exams are extremely easy if you pay attention in lectures. Don't buy the textbook, you won't need it. Only downside to the class is strict attendance policy.
