Okay... Everyone literally hates him BUT if you go to class, sit in the front row, and pay attention/take notes you will do fine. The people that do bad are the ones that don't pay attention and then fail the tests. Yes the tests are hard but study for them and you will get at least a B. Labs are easy, just go. Never miss class. Try hard!!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He's not the best professor I've ever had but definitely not as bad as people make him out to be. He makes class pretty easy - Gives out homework you can get an A on, drops 1 exam grade, gives some extra credit, and posts all lectures online. To do good in his class, you HAVE to really listen and take notes but that's all. You don't need the book!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Kinda seems like he just doesn't care. He'll spendwaste the first 20-30min of a class talking about we should change our study habits, as opposed to actually teaching the material. I had to spend a lot of his lectures, looking up terms and topics on the internet due to his lack of clarity and inability to answer anyones' questions.

Frank is without a doubt, the worst teacher I have ever had at University of Kentucky.  If you have to take a class of his because your major requires it, I strongly suggest changing majors or transferring. His clarity is awful and he intentionally puts questions on his tests on topics that were never discussed (Trust me, I asked him directly).

One of the worst professors I've ever had. You could tell he really didn't care about what we thought of him or the class, and therefore sparked no one's interest. If he didn't have a helpful TA or lab assistants, I would've dropped the class. Avoid this professor at all costs.

His lectures are useless, as are his PowerPoints. They're all pictures with no explanations. He needs to stick to research and give up his teaching position. Do whatever you can to get a different professor.

Not an effective teacher. He spends half of every lecture either redundantly reviewing, telling  not to live somewhere cause it is unsafe geologically, or telling us on how we are bad students who don't know how to study. More than slightly insulting considering when he does teach, it is boring, confusing, and unclear.

Professor Ettensohn's lectures are very confusing. Hard to understand and grasp what he wants you to know for the tests. The tests are multiple choice and only thirty questions - the class average on the first test was a low D. If you don't go to class - you won't know anything come test time. Not a bad guy, just not a great professor.
He is really nice and a cool professor just a harsh grader.
One rule: If he likes you, you will get a good grade.  He didn't like me.  Do the work, and agree with him a lot and you'll do fine.  Pretend to LOVE the earth too.
Best course ever!!!!!!
This guy rocks!  The bahamas field course was the greatest.
Coolest teacher ever! I wish I was his daughter!
Could be a great professor.  He likes graduate students much better.

This professor is bad it is currently 4/17/2026 with only a small bit left of the Spring semester and she hasn't graded ANYTHING since 2/14/2026. She often moves deadlines the day it's originally moved, she puts her own personal things above her class, she attempts to give a workload in a 260 class that's similar to a 400 level
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: If you need structure dont take her. She'd change assignments after they were made and asked us to create assignments for the class. She said not to worry about deadlines, then complained abt ppl turning things in late. Her lectures are boring and her assignments make no sense. she is not engaging. doesn't create good lessons.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Very disorganized in terms of dates/grading criteria. She lectured directly by reading paragraphs off the slide extremely quickly. I enjoyed the movie content and she seemed passionate but the course itself was messy and confusing. Many mistakes she made she would not notice and sometimes did not even fix when brought up.

Extremely disorganized; confusing instructions for every single assignment and project, even discussion boards. Group discussions and presentations almost every single class. Reading was interesting but the entire set-up of the class was really difficult to follow. Never had such a confusing and disorganized class

Seems very disorganized/scattered and Canvas reflects this, passive-aggressive attitude and “threatened” us with quizzes, class often confused about what she wanted from assignments, interesting material but not taught well at all, regular struggle with technology (for her and for class accessing movies and book)

Class was disorganized and very lecture heavy and group presentations happened almost every class. Grading/points were done in a weird way and the final project was unclear for most of the semester. I was confused on the content of my project until presentations began. Lots of presenting in front of the class.

One of the worst professors I've had. The long boring videos, the confusing questions and typos, it was the worst semester I've had in a while trying to keep up with her confusing, time consuming assignments. I feel like she tries to make the class seem important by giving heavy work load, but it is just a 300 level elective.

There is so much to love about Dr. Ewing. I took her class my first semester and seeing that she has no ratings makes me have to brag on her as a professor. She is very ambitious and you MUST work for your grade but her lectures had great information including watching movies from different countries in Africa. I learned so much history! Loved IT!
Horrible. Projects his political views and uses them to criticize students language. Terrible at workshopping genre fiction and will discourage you from writing it.

I adore professor Ewell. Most people will tell you he is way too harsh, but in reality he is just telling the truth. Any issue I had with my writing he gave me honest feedback and a greater worldview. I truly believe that I grew as a writer and for that I am very thankful. He is brilliant and students should really try and see his humor.

Super great class. I want to be a writer, so the honesty and frankness with which Andrew approached grading was extremely helpful to me personally. Everyone will tell you hes an ass, and thats totally true. However, everything he says is completely valid, even if its not always presented nicely. Only take if you really want to be a good writer.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Ewell (or Andrew, as he prefers you call him) is a good professor. He sometimes  runs on a little long- like he'll ask the class a question and then keep talking for a few minutes- but he really seems to know his subjects. I've had two classes with him now and he was great in both. Will grade hard- have someone proofread your papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This was a great class but if you don't speak up during discussion it will hurt your grade. Make sure your short story makes sense and has clear intentions or he and the rest of the class might actually laugh at you. You will read a passage of his choosing to the class and are then expected to stay quiet while the rest of the class discusses it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Ewell is a good professor. Imaginative Writing was a very easy class. His assignments aren't very hard, and he grades them for completion. If you attend class, it's an easy A, if not 100%. Not to mention, he teaches well along the way.

Easiest A I've ever gotten. So long as you go to class and do the two 300 word homework assignments you won't get less than a 100% in the course. Homework isn't graded on correctness or anything like that-- hit the word limit and you're good. No midterm or final test.

Needed this to meet my core Arts credit, and it was an easy A. You have 2 assignments every week, but they're easy, just around 300 word responses to a prompt or what you read. You never read more than 10 pages. Only 3 papers due for the whole class. Lecture was super boring, but you get attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Was not easy. He is a really tough grader. Is super nice to look at though.

He's a really nice guy, knew what he was talking about but was still open to other interpretations. In our class, we studied one book all semester, but it had a good pace, was well thought-out. He wants you to do well, always available by email and for office hours. Grades tough, but tells you how to improve. Supposedly tougher in creative writing.

I took a fiction writing course with Dr. Ewell and thoroughly enjoyed his approach to the class. While his opinion came through strongly, he was always very clear on generalities in fiction writing and worked as much as the student wanted on their specific pieces. He also left a lot of learning up to the discussion from class. I really enjoyed it.
I really recommend this professor. He has pop quizzes for each chapter, so go to class. Exams are relatively easy if you study the quizzes and do the homework.

I did not find Professor Ewing to be very helpful in my understanding of cost accounting. In class (and yes you have to go to class), he does nothing but blow through slides, he gives pop quizzes in multiple forms, and even worse, hw is on Connect because he's too lazy to grade it himself. He does tell you what's on each exam though.

I highly recommend him, especially if you didnt do so hot in ACC 201. He really does care, he's genuine person, and his lectures keep your attention. Go to class, do the review/quick checks with him. He brings candy after Easter and Halloween for you example of his thoughtfulness. Always open to questions, and he study hours are always welcoming

He cares about every student and learns everyone's name. He gives clear study guides and practice problems so you know what to expect. Before the exam he will tell you how many of each type of problems there are from each chapter including the topic. He is no nice!
Very nice teacher, very helpful!
Really nice professor

Mr.Ewing was really nice and did everything he could to make the material easy to understand.Just go to class, go over the power point and do the reviews he gives in class, and you'll do fine on exams.Highly recommend this teacher!

The slides don't even match up with what is on the exams. She WILL NOT help you with any questions you might have when it comes to assignments. She walks in 5 minutes late to class but expects everyone else to be on time. She is a harsh grader that knows her class is hard but does not care. Do not recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The lectures/slides are no help. She will give you in class work days for group work, but if you ask questions she will say she cannot "pregrade" and does not answer any questions.. Her exams are hard to pass- even if you study the slides from class. Few assignments to boost grade. Do not recommend!!!!

I have never had such a bad experience with a professor that i wanted to rate them on here... until now. She is never clear in her lectures and has sassy responses for valid questions asked. Attendance is optional but a big part of grade. Every assignment that isn't an exam is group work, it was a nightmare. Save yourself and your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very helpful and nice. Knows French really well. Pretty to look at.

test were not based what was taught in class. the majority of the course was independent study. Was not helpful to talk to about content. Knows french but does not convey knowledge well. Dreaded going to this class everyday.

What was for homework and taught in class did not reflect the content on the test. Knows subject matter but does not know how to teach. few extra credit opportunity. Dont waste time going to office hours, he too busy working on his masters to even bother actually helping you. hot and helpless. this class made me want to switch languages.

Has refused to answer questions and go over homework multiple times. He doesn't like to teach and rarely uses English, even for things he knows the class won't understand. I feel completely unprepared for the next level after this semester.

Very laid back, sometimes class gets a little slow but only because no one will respond. He is very willing to help you and explain things more thoroughly as long as you express to him that you need help or don't understand.
Really nice guy, really passionate about this class because its his subfield but a lot of reading and discussion so it depends on your classmates too how much you get out of it.

He wasn't bad, but I chose to not attend his lectures because the few times I did go, he went over 7 of the 27 slides and told us to review the rest at home on our own. I chose to just do that every time. The class is relatively easy, just a quiz every week about reading assignments and lectures, but I had a grad professor and he sucked.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: pretty good professor. three long papers to write. a few extra credit opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Really nice guy. Maybe one homework assignment a week, either a paragraph or open note quiz. Few longer papers. Free online textbook readings here and there, decently easy class if you pay attention. Recommend greatly.
Very respectful and very well prepared. She knows the subject, and she is very competent. She listened to you very carefully and gave the correct answer. I would recommend Prof. Bogdani.

It does not get better than with Prof. Bogdani. She truly made the class an enriching learning environment. She is so intelligent and happy when you do your homework and makes everything easy to understand. I give Prof. Bogdani an A+.

This is by far the best professor I had at the University of Kentucky. She knows the subject, and she is very clear and concise, respectful, and polite. I am happy I took this and would take any course with prof. Bogdani.
Definitely one of my favorite professors at UK! Made a 4 week summer class enjoyable and I learned a lot from it. I would definitely take her again if I could.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very professional, very hands on and willing to help anyone. An amazing professor.

I am really impressed by Prof. Bogdani and very happy to have taken a class with her. She is very well prepared and explains in a way that everything looks so easy. She takes care of you, and she looks like a happy person when you complete your projects.

It couldn't get better with this professor. I love her manners and dedication. Not a tough person at all. She makes things very easy, and you still need to work, which still looks doable. I still can't believe I know accounting much better now than what I expected when I first decided to take this class.

Professor Bogdani was truly a wonderful professor. She is so intelligent and educated in her field and she explains things so simply. She is always willing to help you outside of class and overall a great person, she is especially understanding and caring. Truly, one of the only professors I have had that truly wants everyone to pass her class!

The best thing about Prof. Bogdani is that she cares about you! I had many difficulties at home, and catching up wouldn't have been possible without her help. Thank you for your time and help. I will never forget it. Thank YOU!!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She really cares about your grades and you, not just assigning work hoping youll pass she wants to help anyway she can :)

Professor Bogdani is very helpful and very well prepared. She made the class very interesting and somehow challenging. Now I love accounting and am very happy to pursue an accounting degree. She was ready to help all the time and would take any class with her should she have another one. I strongly recommend her!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Good class, really helpful professor. Would definitely recommend.
Prof. Bogdani really helped me establish a solid foundation in Accounting. I had fun in this class and learned a lot!

Process Bogdani was very informative on the language of Accounting. I learned a lot in her class about calculating Assets and Revenue, T-Accounts, and how to put my weekly spendings into a Balance Sheet, Income Statement, and more. Would recommend taking this class to anyone and would take any Accounting class with Professor Bogdani if it comes up!
Liked everything about her. Made things very easy. I feel much better now in Accounting, and I love it. Prof. Bogdani is straightforward to understand, and inspirational person.
The subject was difficult at the beginning but easy at the end. Thanks to Prof. Bogdani I was able to learn and love the subject and have an A grade. Would take another course with her.

When I first thought about accounting, I thought about math math math. The fact is I love it now, and that's one of the most interesting classes, thanks to Professor Bogdani. Thanks again for your hard work and help.

Professor Bogdani has delivered an excellent class. She was accommodating and very easy to understand. She has given me useful tips about this profession, and I feel fortunate to have had her as the accounting professor. I thought Accounting is difficult, but she made it way too easy for us. I recommend Prof. Bogdani.

Prof. Bogdani made my life a lot easier. She was responsible, helpful and very clear. She paid particular attention to details and made the class very interesting. She is simply amazing. The best think I like about her is that she adapted to our needs in a very natural manner. I recommend Prof. Bogdani

BIO447 is a neuroscience class. Animal phys didn't prepare me for this course; I felt like I was set up for failure. Dr. Schneider assumed we knew a lot of information and had us learn from neuroscience research papers. The material was unrealistic. I think Dr. Schneider has potential to be a good teacher in the future, many improvements needed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Schneider is very nice person but overall very unorganized.There are a lot of readings for every class and you are expected to attend in person every class even when she's late to class everyday. The exams are much harder than the homework given and this class is very neuroscience based with difficult journal articles.

Dr. Schneider is fantastic. Her lectures are some of the most interesting I've attended. Tests (midterm and final) were difficult, but she gives great feedback and a chance to correct mistakes. She is also very easy going and willing to help students. If you are on the fence about one of her classes: TAKE IT!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Everson is a good teacher. I can tell she may be too smart to be teaching a prereq at the university but she really tried hard to help students new to biology understand the topics. She was funny and quirky which made the zoom classes not as horrible. Not a fan of having to meet on zoom for all classes but we did go over a lot of good material.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Everson is my favorite professor I have had. She is so nice, funny and genuinely cares about your grade and success in the class. She is very good at explaining material and is helpful when students ask questions. She answers emails very quickly and is helpful outside of the classroom as well. I would 100% recommend taking her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Everson is so helpful with her students and explains things in a way that relate directly to the test. If you go to class and take your notes, you will get an A. She's definitely the best professor I have had and made BIO148 my favorite class I have taken in college.
Dr. Everson is one of the best professors that I have had. She taught and explained concepts really well. If you have any questions, make sure to utilize offixce hours and the study.

Dr. Everson was the first professor at the University of Kentucky that I really enjoyed class with. She broke down dense material in a way that made it easier to learn. The amount of resources provided with the class was great. You do have study and pay attention, but it helps to have a great professor.

Professor Everson was such a great professor! She was very caring and flexible if you needed anything from her. While attendance doesn't count for credit, the lectures are EXTREMELY helpful, and she does a great job making things easier to remember/comprehend, so I'd recommend showing up every day. She was my favorite professor this semester by FAR
She was a very energetic and fun teacher. The material was easy and she was very kind and responded quickly to email.

Honestly one of the only teachers I have had at UK that genuinely cares for her students and wants to see them succeed. Allows students to retake one exam before the final and even congratulated me for my score going up just 10 points. One of the kindest teachers on campus. Would highly, highly recommend taking her if you have the chance.
Dr. Katie is the best. She is genuinely understanding and works with students. I would happily have her as a professor again.
Very friendly and welcoming. Content heavy but Dr Katie breaks it down and makes it manageable.
This class was difficult for me because I'm not a dancer but EveMarie is very sweet and caring. She is mostly an easy grader (definitely a tougher grader on papers than dances).
LOVED HER! She is passionate about her work and students. Show up to class and you will pass if you put forth the effort. She's super caring and wants you to succeed! Easy A.

Grade is very reliant on attending class and being willing to participate in dance. Likes to put you in very random groups that sometimes work and don't. Otherwise, really kind and encouraging. Can take course without having had any dance experience and still get an A.

Kyle is a great professor. He's very respectful to his students and creates a great environment to learn in. He's very passionate about film and is interesting to listen to. Watch the films and complete the easy assignments, and you'll be fine.

Professor Eveleth's Intro to Film class was by far my favorite of the semester. The criteria/assignments of the semester were clearly understood and easy to do. Participate in discussion and show up and you will enjoy yourself. His movie selection and discussion of the films were enjoyable and insightful. I wish he were teaching other classes!

he's a nice guy for sure, BUT SO BORING. readings were also super long and super boring. easy A because attendance counts toward your grade, i went to every class and ended up with a 106%. some people never showed up and got kicked out of the class.

Mr. Eveleth is one of, if not the BEST professor here at UK. He understands his students all aren't on the same playing field and will easily move with you as you proceed through different styles or writing. He is also very fair with grading and absences. If you are taking WRD 111 you MUST take his class. On a side note he is hilarious.
Mr. Eveleth was a great teacher and I actually walked away knowing a lot of new information. He makes the class interesting as well!

Mr. Eveleth is by far the best professor I've had at UK. He treats his students like actual people and seems to genuinely care about what they have to say. Although his humor takes a while to get use to, he really strives to make his class as enjoyable as possible. His ENG280 taught me so much about film and sparked my interest to learn more.

He wasn't very clear with his expectations on papers. During lectures he flaunts his education. Tries to relate to students and frequently crosses the line making students slightly uncomfortable. He's funny and really tried to engage students in readings. It's pretty clear he hasn't been teaching very long.
He's super sarcastic and awesome. Loves when students interact and talk a lot! He grades somewhat easy but you read A LOT of books. You can get by on Spark Notes though...

Dr. Eyderman is a visiting professor from Russia, and is extremely fun in class. If you write down what he says will be on the test, then you'll most definitely get an A. He offers a huge amount of extra credit on the exams (12-20pts). The only thing I didn't like about this class was the weekly quizzes in recitation, but that is not his call.

His english is really good, and he's pretty funny, too. He tends to run out of time in class, so might need to teach yourself a little bit from the book each day, but if you keep up with it and do the homework, you'll learn it. He always offers to do homework problems in class. He tells you exactly what will be on the test, and offers lots of EC.
He is a very easy and nice teacher.  He has very easy tests and is extremely helpful if you see him at office hours.  He is a little hard to understand but it is not to bad.

He is a hilarious professor from Russia with a cute sense of humor. His teaching style is very easy to go with and exams test knowledge of Calc 3/4 an not calc 1/2 so integrals are not difficult (clean answers). Also open for office hours. I recommend him for both Calc 3 and 4. Very considerate with grades. Every quiz and exam has extra credit.

ok, 1st thing- he's russian, ok? hard to understand at first but you get used to it fast- once you do, it's great because his trouble with english leads to a lot of funny situations in class. this man is a GREAT math teacher- his tests are about as reasonable as you're going to find in the math department- and he is incredibly friendly.

Absolutely loved her, best professor I've had. She's SO understanding and you can tell she really loves and cares about her work and students. Loved the way she taught, literally nothing bad to say about her!
This women is great. She is super understanding will offer you extensions if you need. Her office hours are awesome. Quiz's are super easy too. If you need a math classes take hers.
I love her.

I haven't received my grade yet, but Faith has made this course super easy and is an all around amazing lecturer. She really knows how to break down tough subjects and make them easy to understand. Take her if you can!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I had Faith as a TA and she did a far better job than the professor ever could have. I think if we had more people teaching us like Faith does then we would be far better off. I would recommend her and if you get the chance to take her do it!

Faith was my TA for MA 123 this semester and led my recitation hour. She was so kind and actually got visibly excited to help with math problems. She was very understanding as well. She explains problems thoroughly and grades fairly for recitation problems. Faith also responds to email in a timely manner.

The other review who said "get ready to be outsmarted" is absolutely right. This dude has lived a thousand lives. Anything we talk about, somehow he was there. "Lin-Manuel Miranda? I wrote a play with him during my skydiving meet-and-greet with Obama." It's lowkey hella funny though. He's a great resource and really cares about theatre.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr Farrell is an inspiration. He really believed in me and my progress, even after I left his class and continued to update him about my work. He's respected in the theatre world & has lots of fantastic insider advice. Encouraging, kind, funny, and thoughtful. He's the perfect mentor, and I'm really going to miss taking classes with him.

Herman really, really cares about his students and this writing course singlehandedly improved my dialogue from idealistic garbage to realistic and loaded with subtext. There was a lot of reading, but no real quizzes. Mostly it was in-class discussion, but he was hilarious, kind, encouraging, and so ready to help outside of class. He's my fave prof
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: If you are a theatre major, then this class is for you. If you aren't, prepare to be lost and confused all semester. Herman's tests are difficult. There are four of them, 5-10 books to read and discuss and a 7 page minimum research paper. His voice puts you to sleep, so drink coffee before you go into his class. Also, be ready to be outsmarted.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This was my hardest class.  The class consisted of 2 tests and a paper and a lot of reading.  I didn't read most of the plays, but I studied really hard for the tests and I still received an A.  Herman is a good teacher though!

His exams are really tough, but he knows what he's talking about and is very kind. He is also passionate about the subject, which makes for interesting discussions. You have to read a lot of plays, but most of them are interesting as well.

Eugene O'Neill Seminar. It was a really interesting class and Herman REALLY knows his stuff. His lectures can get boring, but so can every other teacher's. Graded the quizzes kinda hard, but there were no tests which was sweet.
No Comments

Dr. Falco is an incredible professor. She is personal, approachable, and helpful. She answers questions promptly and listens to students' concerns and works alongside them to find ways to solve any issues.

They aren't listed but I had Dr. Falco for both EGR 101 and 102. She is incredibly personable, approachable, and genuinely cares about student success. She responds to emails quickly and gives helpful responses. In 102 I had issues with my Arduino board for the first few weeks but she was understanding and gave extensions. Great lectures too.
Amazing professor! I love Dr. Falco

I feel like I didn't do as well in this class as other STEM classes I have taken, but thats mostly because I didn't come to class sometimes, since attendance wasn't mandatory. There is an online quiz used for attendance throughout the class, but if you can't make it to class, you can do it remotely and still get credit. Dr. Falco was super nice.

Physics is a harder class, but Dr. Falco makes it less stressful. If I were to take physics again she would easily be my first choice. Probably my favorite professor I have had at UK. Lectures are entertaining and make it easy to retain the information with real life examples. I highly recommend Dr. Falco
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Although the grade scale was 90-100 for an A and she didn't curve the exams, her lectures are clear enough for you to be successful in the class. You have clicker questions each class so it's important to not miss too many lectures. If you go through the practice questions and review the clicker questions, you should be perfectly fine on the exams.

Dr.Falco is the best physics teacher I have ever had. She brings in so many visual representations of what we are learning and real world examples. If you are a visual learner, she is the professor for you!

Dr. Falco expects a lot of her students. While other sections of physics had an altered grade scale (80-100 for an A) her sections were 90-100. She makes up for this though by being an excellent lecturer and availability outside of class. If you want to actually learn physics, take Dr. Falco. You won't regret it.

Dr. Falco was solid as the only PHY 228 Professor. The glass is decently hard as what you are learning is not intuitive whatsoever. Homework, Recitation, and Exam question sometimes came out of left field when compared to what was covered in Lecture. Gave a little bit of bonus at the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Falco is very nice. However, her teaching style and exams were not the best. The first exam I took, we got evacuated and only had 30 mins to do the exam vs. the usual 1hr and 15 min. I got a 36 with no curve or partial credit. I dropped before the second exam because I was absolutely miserable trying to learn the material. Good luck!!

Dr Falco is definitely tough when it comes to physics. You can tell she is very in to physics as she knows her stuff extremely well. Her lectures are easy to follow along with as long as you keep up and pay attention. Her tests are pretty hard but as long as you study the practice exams and read the book you should be good to go.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Physics II was the hardest class that I have ever taken. Falco is a decent professor, however the content is awful. Read the textbook and study the practice exams. Falco is very caring so if you ever need help feel free to approach her.

Falco is a great teacher! It is obvious that she is very passionate about what she is teaching in class, and she has a lot of demonstrations (and iclickers) that keep you engaged. Tests are very hard, but representative of what she teaches. She consistently had the "easiest" tests among PHY profs. iClickers are the only form of attendance
Good professor, fair tests, and homework isn't too bad either. Its still physics 2 so hard concepts but as long as you study youll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Her class is super hard compared to the other students in Physics with Professor Draper. Her homework and her lectures arent hard to get a 100 on but her exams are very very difficult. Shes very nice and approachable. Her exams are nothing like the practice exams given. If you take her be ready.

reviews.comment: Dr. Falco is a good professor and explains (and demonstrates!) concepts in an understandable way. The exams can be tricky, but the class is curved enough so that it's not too difficult to get an A. You definitely have to study, but Dr. Falco will support you if you need help!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Really a great teacher and super nice. Exams were kinda difficult but the grading system helps.

reviews.comment: Very difficult exams, but she is super nice.

reviews.comment: The homework and tests are a lot harder than what you learn in lecture. She is a nice person but its like the lecture has nothing to do with the exam. It is difficult to prepare for the exam and be successful.
Well I was not an excellent student but I'd say Dr. Falco is a very good professor but the coursework is not in whole clearly lined out.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: She was ok. Not the worst professor Ive had, but Ive definitely had better. The homework and tests is a lot harder than what you learn in lecture. The physics department makes the tests and gives you a practice test right before the test but it isnt super helpful.
She may be the worst professor I have had. Literally teaches everything backwards. DO NOT TAKE HER!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Doctor Falco is probably my favorite professor at Kentucky! She is always willing to help. She even stayed late after class every single day to help students who needed extra help. I went to her office hours numerous times and she was always helpful. However, she will not baby you, if you work hard in her class I promise you will get an A.

worst professor i have ever had. so unreasonable. does not do nearly enough practice problems. does not adequately prepare students for exams. Basically self taught class but have to go to class because she takes clickers- only receive full credit if the answer is correct.

Her tests arent bad if you study and understand the material. She does clicker points everyday and you have to go to class to be able to do them. Homeworks are pretty easy but you cant make them up if you forget to do one.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Best physics professor I've ever had, she explains things clearly so that it's easier to understand. As long as you put forth effort in the class you will be fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: My favorite UK teacher ever. Super encouraging, fun and accessible.  He obviously CARES about his students and wants us each to succeed. Explains things well. Very highly recommend.

Amazing professor. Participation matters and is very beneficial; often made us pair up into groups to speak to each other. He really cares about his student's success, and provides great practice for using Spanish

I had Juan for an independent study for SPA 302, so the class just consisted of me. He is easy-going and really nice. He doesn't make you feel bad for messing up and tries his best to help you learn and succeed. He is complimentary of your strengths and does not grade harshly. He always replies to emails and is very helpful. I recommend him!

Professor Fernandez is very caring and is passionate about what he teaches, he cracks jokes all the time and participation does matter, he calls randomly but as long as you follow along his lectures, you will do fine in class. There is homework every night and is due the day it is assigned. He is a good teacher and I recommend him!

I would recommend Juan to every single student taking a spanish course at UK. He cares more about his students than any professor I have ever met. He is very understanding and forgiving. His classes are fun and engaging and you can tell he loves teaching. Simply an amazing, caring, compassionate man.

Absolutely loved Juan! I hated Spanish for years and he helped me start to love his class since he is such a great person. If you participate in class and do the work, this class is an easy A. He's a funny dude who is very down to Earth. He also literally gives you what the test is going to be like so you can practice for the exams using that.

Professor cantero was not a bad teacher, but his class was difficult. He does have a strong accent which sometimes makes it hard to stay focused and learn in the class. The class also has lots of homework which play very little role in the grading it seems. He calls on you a lot during class so be prepared to talk during class as well
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Juan is one of the most caring professors that I have had at UK. He cares much more about his students advancing in Spanish, rather than what grade is received. He is very generous on grading as a whole. You will learn Spanish in a non-stressful environment because of the way he leads lecture. I would absolutely recommend Juan.

he was really sweet but had a really strong accent so i could hardly understand him, which is no fault of his. just be aware that if you have a hard time with accents you may struggle a bit. very lenient grader though. he does call at random though so have at least three questions prepared so you can volunteer before he calls on you.
He was a great professor who genuinely wanted you to get better at Spanish. He was very personable and clearly presented the material.

Juan is a very caring professor. He really wants you to learn Spanish a cares about your progress. Grading is very fair and he understands the learning is slow for a new language. Juan was a fantastic beginner Spanish professor in SPA 103

SUPER nice guy and very forgiving on some things. However, SPA 210 is still a very difficult class and he grades tests with no curve, lenience, or extra credit as is probably mandated by the department. He lectures pretty much exclusively in Spanish. Very hard class, but he's willing to work with you as much as the department allows.

super nice and understanding, easy to talk to, definitely not a harsh grader. textbook is super important because you can't do the homework unless you have it. homework is easy and a majority of things are unlimited attempts. the homework may have a due date but late work is accepted until the next sunday.

Professor Cantero is a nice guy who puts a lot of effort into his lectures. The homework is pretty easy and it is relatively easy to get a good grade in his class. The only down side is that sometimes the assignments are not always clear and the exams can be difficult.

really nice professor, doesn't expect you to know everything the day after learning it, has good exam reviews that tells you exactly what will be on the test, picks people to call on so be prepared. homework is assigned before every class but it's usually not too much.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Juan is a great professor who really cares for his students. He is understanding and a really nice guy. But honestly avoid this class, SPA323. I wish I hadn't taken it. Whole class is confusing as well as assignment directions. Everyone I've talked to in my class also hates it and I dread going to each class. Take something else if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: He is very sweet and takes his job seriously

Juan was an amazing professor. He made learning a new language, which is often a scary event, an amazing experience. He really cared about his students as if we were his own. He spent time getting to learn us each individually, which does not happen often at such a large college. He emailed back usually within 3 hours, trying his hardest to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Gud
I promise you, you will not regret if you take this professor. YOU NEED TO TAKE HIM!

Out of all of the Spanish professors that I have had while at the University of Kentucky, he was the BEST. He teaches Spanish soooo well and is always happy to help his students. One of the kindest instructors I have ever had and am saddened that I didnt have him as a Spanish instructor sooner. 10/10 would recommend!! :)
Juan is very friendly and approachable. He is an extremely easy grader. I definitely recommend him if you want a good grade in Spanish.

reviews.comment: Very easy and wants all of his students to be successful! Makes class easy offering redo's and extra credit for those who attend.

reviews.comment: If you need to take AN 105 with a professor, I will highly recommend this one. Just do the assignments on time, tell the professor if you have any issues with the software or absences, and get the easy A.
Literally just do the assignments and get an A, not much to say
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He was honestly great, get your work done and you will have an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: If anybody needed to take AN 105 I would take this class, incredibly easy and can work at your own pace. Could realistically complete class in 1-2 weeks if you wanted to.
Really liked his class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very good instructor, informative and understanding.  Gives you detailed info for assignments and goes by the rubric exactly.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Won't take his class again.
Lee has been an amazing help to me in the program.  Be sure to let him know if you have research interests - he even offers PAID research opportunities to his students.

I took Lee's online SW 580 Class - It was so interesting, and the material was extremely relevant.  I never felt like I was doing "busy work."  He is a very fair grader, and crystal clear about expectations.  I wasn't even a social work major, and he made it very useful to me.
Lee doesn't require attendance, but he has no pity on you if you get behind because you suck at life.  I shouldve attended more classes.

Lee's a good and fair teacher, but his exams are tough.  They really expect you to apply the information you've learned.  He tried to warn us of this, and of course I thought he would have an easier exam.  I actually felt like I learned from the exam, because it required me to apply the material.  He doesn't quiz your reading, but you better read!
He is a great professor, and always is there to help outside of class.
This is my second class with Lee, and he continues to be an incredible instructor.  He's the most supportive instructor in the entire College of Social Work.
He is thorough, passionate about social work, and really wants students to succeed.
Great guy and super helpful in and out of class!

Love this guy. He is great. There is a lot of reading for the class, but he goes over everything in class. Very clear about what he is teaching and very nice. He wants you to learn but he doesn't make class so you can't pass. He really cares. I would recommend him to anybody. He gives a very clear syllabus and study guides.

Finally an instructor who TRULY CARES about the students.  It's really refreshing to see a younger instructor in the Social Work program who understands what we are going through.  I felt like the class was not very challenging, but only because he was very thorough in his method of teaching.  I never left class with unanswered questions!

Super easy class if you show up or join online. A big part of his grading is participation through questions in class, but you can join the online lecture and answer them there. He cares a lot about astronomy. As long as you pay attention and have notes for the 3 exams and answer the participation questions every class, you will have an easy A.

I genuinely don't understand why he is teaching a 100 level course. He is so accomplished and knows so much. I really enjoyed his lectures and found everything he talked about interesting.I appreciate how accommodating he is, breaking things down in a simple, clear way so that everyone regardless of their background can understand. He's so precious
Ferland cares about the class and about astronomy. It is unusual to see such a senior and respected scientist teaching a large lecture 100 level course. It really makes a difference.

I love astronomy but I didn't enjoy this class too much. The lectures were a bit all over the place and unorganized. Some test questions were super hypothetical and didn't make sense. Gary is super sweet and so was the TA. It was great being able to decide if I wanted to go in person or join class online. Extra credit opportunities were helpful.

Gary is a sweet guy but his class is not easy even if you participate and answer all the questions. You can take notes and study for the quiz but there's no guarantee he actually asks questions that he taught material on He words his questions to the point where idk what the question is. You're grade is basically up to 5 quizzes and 1 project

Very sweet older man who just loves the solar system. You get participation points from online questions during class time and you do not have to be present to receive this credit. Very fair grading policy and gives plenty time to study for upcoming quizzes.

Dr. Ferland is a just an nugget. He is funny in a really quirky, nerdy grandpa way. Class is easy, no textbook, he let's you miss up to 9 days, and tests are straight out of class lectures (anybody who says they aren't wouldn't know, because they didn't go to class). Repeats stuff, but the stuff he repeats is on the exam. Great teacher.

Mr. Ferland is great! He covers everything on the exams. The exams do take a little time to study for though. He's very friendly and funny and answers any questions you may have. Don;t buy the textbook, you won't need it. Lots of extra credit, overall great class.

Ferland is a great professor. He is genuinely funny and accurately answers any questions. Can be very repetitive but at least you learn! Don't buy the book, he even tells you that. I would definitely recommend him.

I thought that this class was easy.  At the beginning of every lecture, he asks questions about what we have learned and those are the questions that show up on the exam.  Total points for the course was 392 points and he offered 35 points of extra credit.  He also allowed us to miss 9 days unexcused of class without taking points off of attendance

I took astronomy thinking that it would be very interesting. Unfortunately, Dr. Ferland was unable to engage many students during lecture. His exams were also confusing and worded as trick questions. Avoid this class or wait until you can take it with Dr. Troland.
Easy class. Attendance isn't required, but he has random writing quizzes (you get to use your notes). Good way to fill a USP.

Enjoyed the class overall but I really hated his lectures. I found it hard to pay attention because it seemed like he repeated himself a lot. The tests are extremely difficult and sometimes tricky. He gives 12 writing assignments randomly which is basically like a pop quiz for attendance. And you have to make two visits to the observatory.

His multiple choice tests are harder than you'd expect from a USP, but at least the course material is interesting. Ferland has a really quirky sense of humor, but what else would you expect from an astrophysicist?
Dr. Ferland is a good teacher and he knows his stuff. If you go to class and do the extra credit, you will get an A.
Good teacher, offers lots of extra credit. Easy class as long as you try. Subject can get a little boring sometime, just make sure you get the notes because they're the best thing to study from.
Fun professor! i hardly went to class, but all the tests were based off the notes.  Extra credit is given for asking questions! Very easy and fun class!

I loved going to this class. He has a really dry sense of humor, but I found him to be hilarious. I didn't buy the book and barely studied for the tests and got A's on all of them. By far the the easiest and most interesting class I have had in college. Plus he incorporates facebook pictures into his powerpoint slides, classic.
I stuggled in this class. Hard!
it was great becuase you didnt have to go to class, but the test can be tricky.  offers a lot of extra credit
Easy class. All the notes are posted online and the tests are strictly off the notes!
Great teacher, sometimes he repeats himself a lot but other than that I recommend this class.  Tests are very easy

This guy is great. Best teacher on campus without a doubt. Test are easy and he gives you tons of extra credit. He is also hilarious and I highly recommend this class. Classes are entertaining and I actually look foward too coming to his class.

This guy was great. Tons of extra credit. the class was so easy. A+ all the way. Great way to knock out that USP Natural Science. He puts all his old exams on his website and 95% of the questions are from those exams.
No Comments
good guy makes  class interesting, easy A or B

This was a great class. He is a very good teacher who will make you want to come to class, although it is not mandatory. The test are somewhat difficult, but you have a lot of extra credit opportunites.Very interesting class. I recommend it to everyone.
study old tests! dry sense of humor, not a great teacher. all test questions are recirculated from the bank that made his old tests. it's how i passed.
No Comments
No Comments
Ferland is an excellent teacher and I found the class extremely interesting.  All of his notes are online so you can miss, just review the notes before the next lecture.
The class was okay and there were notes online.
Ok teacher.  Pretty boring.  Thinks he's hilarious but he's really not.

Dry sense of humor, but the class is interesting. Just gotta make sure you attend it if you want to do good on the exams. Do the old exams he puts up online! He takes questions for your exams directly from them.

You would be stupid not to take him. Ast191 is one of, if not the easiest, science courses available. Great sense of humor and an all around nice guy. Very easy to get massive amounts of extra credit, which you will need because the last test and final are challenging.
he's very funny.  his tests are a bit challenging-just study.

Dr. Ferland cracks me up. He has such a dry sense of humor -- he can make a hilarious comment and won't even smile. Class can get pretty repetitive -- but it's nice that the notes are online. Don't even bother to go to class on Fridays, no one shows up anyhow. Study the old tests on his website.

Totally. Completely. Insane. The dude started off class talking about how the physics department can read your mind, which would be funny, if he wasn't so crazy that you start to think he was serious. VERY easy, but it's a mind bender if you're looking for a remotely serious class.

Dr. Ferland is hilarious!  He's a typical science geek, and that's part of what makes class fun.  Pay attention, don't skip and you'll be fine.  Warning, tests get gradually harder, the first one is super easy.

He's great, he is clear and to the point about every thing. He makes it interesting to learn about space and such. Print the notes off the webpage and take them to class. Listen to him talk as he goes over the notes. When you go to review its alot easier!

Great professor!  Dr. Ferland is funny and keeps you interested in the subject matter.  Sometimes the class is boring but if you don't go to class then you won't do good on the tests.  Take this course with Dr. Ferland!

Orientation class, not super important. But she definitely has your back and wants you to succeed. If you needed help or were going through anything, she'd for sure help you out. She's very entertaining and kind. I really enjoyed her lectures, even though this class was only 1 credit and met once a week.

Shelley is an absolutely amazing professor. She is so knowledgeable and has so many connections. She's hilarious and makes a boring class really engaging. Anyone who has the chance to have her for UK101 is lucky.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I loved Shelley! She is so caring and adapts the class to what the students are interested in. She seemed genuinely interested in how we were doing. As long as you do your assignments and follow the rubric, you will do fine.

UK101 is obviously a very easy class; just complete all your work on time and you'll be fine. She grades super easy, but doesn't accept any late work at all. She was very kind and seemed to care about her students but I felt sort of disconnected from her and she doesn't get back to you quickly. Easy, but you have to go to class even with COVID.

Had him for Calc 4. He's the goat. 3 exams no final. He had practice exams that were very similar to actual exams. Had webwork for HW and were originally gonna have 3 quizzes but he took them out and gave us full credit for it anyways.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Shao is very good at making his class as light as possible while still teaching you everything you need to know from the course. Even gives you information on some exam questions you could have gotten yourself, but isn't what the question is trying to test. Uses a textbook you can opt out of, and I never needed to use it.
Just show up. Bro is chill fr fr

Professor Shao is extremely smart. Just make sure you go to the lecture and pay attention. Very good lecturer, but sometimes would go into unnecessary detail. Not a bad class, and will give you a great grasp of Calc 1 as you continue on!
He chill af frl.

Dr. Shao is very smart and a decent teacher. He explains things clearly, albeit a bit slow at times. His Calc. 1 class was easy and a good introduction. Lectures were comfortable and not rushed, and he gave a lot of good examples. There was also useful review of exactly what was on exams. If you put in a little work and show up, you'll get an A.

Prof Shao was overall a good lecturer, though I found talking to him outside of class (flexible office hours) was extremely beneficial. Grading was very generous. My main problem with the class was that he often covered topics rather last minute relative to when they're necessary for HW or on quizzes (both weekly)

I had Shao for Matrix Algebra. He explains everything thoroughly and at a good pace--he'll introduce a topic at one point and later will go more in depth, so it's like you're learning it twice which is great for understanding new material. He's a fair grader, and if you show interest in his class, he'll reciprocate.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Shao is a very nice professor, he's not hard to understand and his notes are very organized and concise. He makes awkwardly funny jokes which are THE BEST. Super nice guy, would recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Would take again

reviews.comment: Shao is my favorite calculus professor I have had at uk! He is hilarious, which makes his lectures a lot more enjoyable. The class was very challenging, but he is a good professor and explains everything very well. He frequently asks for feedback and if we understand what he is teaching, showing that he does care about his students. recommended
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment:
- Very passive aggressive and easily excitable
- Tons of homework that requires excessive revision
- Doesn't leave very clear feedback and is sometimes rude in doing so
left a comment on my assignment basically saying, "you're supposed to be smart, I'm not sure why you're struggling with this assignment." This was after I already revised it twice.

Had a very good relationship with Dr. Fernheimer initially. She was very helpful in making edits for a paper I was writing, making clear suggestions. However, it is very easy to get on her bad side. After a simple misunderstanding, she quickly became very cold and rude. She wrote me a long email to criticize me heavily for this misunderstanding :(
Really hard class, but the professor was very forgiving to late assignments and understanding of circumstances

This class was extremely time consuming and Dr. Jan did not make up for it. She was super understanding of students, however, not when it came to missing work. She often called students out for not doing work/participating in class discussion which was not helpful! It was paper after paper with little learning and lots of confusion.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: I just want to know what kind of professor requires you to write an argumentative essay, then asks you to write a reflective essay... with an argument. She is also very nitpicky with her grading, and her feedback isn't that helpful. She asks more questions than she offers feedback. Your peers will do a much better job in guiding you.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Easily the hardest class I've taken in college and it was supposed to be about comics. Still working on it now. Requires 200 pages of reading in a day with a truckload of assignments. On top of that, the teaching isn't great either. Haven't learned much from the course overall due to her turning the class from a writing course to a history course.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: You MUST attend class every time, or face consequences. If you dont do the readings, youd better be a great liar. God forbid you be a straight, white male in this class because its full to the brim with very liberal political bias (invalidated a students POV on an opinion topic based on privilege). Lots of papers, lots of work. Good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Just overall not good. Passive aggressive and a hard grader, not to mention she makes you do a reflective essay of another essay.

Dr. Jan is an extremely tough grader, grades first drafts as if they should be written on "doctorate level." Comes across nice, unorganized & unhelpful. Is willing to meet with you unless you have a grievance, then she will refuse to email or zoom. You will only learn/talk/write about social issues and not improve your craft writing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The workload was a heavier than expected but overall a very nice and understanding professor, the class was not too difficult but you definitley had to put the work in.

Extremely difficult for a WRD class. She based the entire semester on "joy" yet it was a quite un-enjoyable class. Makes you feel dumb for asking for clarification or questions. Very tough grader, grading criteria is vague. Comes across as a sweetheart at first, but you will learn that she is passive aggressive and condescending. Do not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Jan is condescending, makes you feel stupid, & claims the amount of work is "the least amount compared to other WRD classes," when in fact this class has the most work for me. She doesn't know how to use Canvas in any way, so be prepared to not have access to modules or have duplicate assignments. (Also always has spelling errors in feedback��)

Seems very nice but can be condescending at times. Had to schedule a 2-hour interview with a peer, read an entire book, do self-help for 10 days, write a summary of the book and our self-help, then a reflection on everything that I just said, and THEN we had to make a video speech about our interview. That was only one of three projects. Good luck.
Very tough grader

Dr. Fernheimer is not someone to take if you want an easy class or to not work hard for an A. She is very caring and understanding, but is a little disorganized. She is flexible with deadlines, and just wants you to take real interest in what she is teaching.

I went to one day of Professor Fernheimer's class and dropped immediately after leaving. She was unorganized and had made a mistake with setting canvas up but then put all of the blame on the students. I was only in her class for one meeting and she made me feel dumb several times. I could also tell the work load she gives would be pretty bad.

Fernheimer is such a bad teacher. She can come off nice at first but is very condescending and makes you feel so stupid. We had so many books to purchase that she suggests you split them with someone else because they will be hundreds of dollars. Then you barely read any of the books. She also is a terrible grade and so much work. DO NOT TAKEEEEEEE
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Being type A in a type B world is nothing new to me, but this was too much. A very caring prof who always understood personal matters, but this class was just not worth it. I never understood what was due or why I got the grades I did after HOURS of working. I highly discourage taking this unless maybe you're an English major.

Prof Fernheimer definitely should not be a college professor. You will either hate her or can tolerate her, but you learn nothing. She is an inconsistent grader, does not tell you what she wants but grades hard and when you ask her for specifics on what she wants she is vague. She is unorganized, can be rude, and unprofessional. Would not take.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: THE WORST! Tons of reading, tons of writing, very hard grader. I have never hated a class more. She approaches class as if everyone loves the topic and already has extensive knowledge in the area. Just save yourself multiple mental breakdowns and long ranting sessions with classmates and FIND ANOTHER TEACHER!

Not focused, has no clear grasp of the subject matter or what real rhetoric is. She can't stick to her own schedule, but expects you to stick to hers. Best way to describe this prof: not professional. She needs to teach community college

I wouldn't recommend her to any one. she is nice but very disorganized. we NEVER used the books and I paid a lot of money for them. A LOT of busy work and very hard projects. She is also a tough grader and always returns papers late. Never knew what she wanted exactly.

Dr. Fernheimer is really unorganized and had way too many things on her plate this semester. I found the course extremely time consuming - all with busy work. I really did not enjoy the course, and while she is a really nice person, I just didn't enjoy her class.

Fernheimer is a tremendous person and loves her students. Unfortunately, those qualities do not make a great teacher. She emphasizes subtopics while never actually teaching you how to be a better writer. Her projects have vague guidelines and she may be the most difficult grader I've ever had. Avoid this class if you are wanting a writing course.

Super cool, super smart, but super bad teacher. She emphasized way too much on the subtopic of the class, Jewish and Arab Lexington History; than on actual writing. Piled on a ton of course work to be due at the same time, while we wouldn't do anything else the rest of the semester. Very unorganized. Bought 3 books.. didn't use..

Everything was online and there weren't any zoom lectures, just video recordings. The exams are insanely easy as well as the homework assignments. If you need the UK core for global dynamics this is your move.

ENT 220 Online was a great class to take to fulfill the UK Global Dynamics Core. The course load is very reasonable and I am honestly shocked seeing the bad reviews on here as I highly recommend this class. There is 1-2 weekly quizzes due on Sunday, 4 "Experimental Activities" which are not hard, 3 Exams and a Final project.

This class is very easy and counts as a Global Dynamics UK Core credit. There are about two (5 question) quizzes every week based on lectures and videos posted for that chapter. Questions are often repeated on tests, and as long as you do the homework and pass the tests, you can end the class with a good grade!

I did not have contact with the professor. I never needed help with anything so I never reached out. This class is SUPER easy online. Do the work and you will pass no problem. If you need an easy class for credit take this one

She is a very nice professor! The class its self was very easy. If you do the work you pass, attendance is only required because she takes off 15 points if you dont show up. There was a good amount of work but it was easy work. Lectures were boring but she let us out 20-45 minutes early everyday because she went over the material and was done.

Do not take this class. This professor clearly does not want to teach. She is lazy in regards to sending out information with when things are due or when class is. The majority of grading comes from little quizzes that she purposely changes words to screw you over and doesn't care. The lecture material has nothing to do with what we are doing. Bad.

Dr. Fischer is amazing. such a great professor who truly wants you to succeed. 261 is a tough class in general but she is ready to help you out in any way and offers bonus. you have to work for the grade in this class but its only to prepare you for the real world and higher division classes

Prof F is the absolute best. She's super understanding and fun, but also organized and productive in class. She'll hold class online occasionally to give us a break. The workload is pretty heavy in terms of assignments due each Sunday, but it's definitely manageable.

reviews.comment: Good professor.
Professor Luke is a great teacher. Although there is a lot of lecture notes he explains everything perfectly. There is not a whole lot of busy work and assignments. I give Professor Luke a 10/10.
He was the best teacher I've ever had
He was a super cool professor. If you showed up to class and turned in the work on time you won't have a hard time in this class. He's a very likable person and his lectures weren't boring.

Super fun class! heard that it was boring coming in, but this was not the case. Mr. Fetzer is an amazing teacher and made the course a ton of fun! He would always open the class with hilarious rants about the latest news in UK sports. His lectures are interesting and engaging and I enjoyed talking sports with him sometimes after class. I highly recommend you take his class.

Professor Luke is such a funny guy. His discussions are fascinating and engaging, and he relates the class to things happening recently in the real world. Mr. Fetzer makes his lectures very enjoyable and engaging. He knows exactly how to relate all of the concepts to students' lives in a way that is easy to comprehend. He makes the lectures interesting to listen to! His work on top of that feels easy to complete for full points. All you need to do is show up, takes good notes, and do the work. Luke is a super chill and fun professor. He made class interesting and I enjoyed his emphasis on class discussion. It is clear that he cares about his students and wants them to succeed. Would definitely recommend him!

Enjoyed having Luke as a professor. He made what would have been a boring class otherwise fun to attend. Knows what's he's talking about (or he may just do a good job of BSs his way through it). Recommend him.

I recommend taking this class. He's a very laidback professor who knows what he's teaching. The lectures were interesting and very organized. The projects and essays were fairly easy and he's a good grader.

Overall, Professor Fetzer did a very well-done job this semester.

I really enjoyed this class. He always started class in a light-hearted manner. As long as you show up to class and participate you should be fine. He is easy going and really knows how to make lecture interesting. I'm taking another class of his next semester so I highly recommend.
He is awesome! He gives great lectures, and as long as you do the work (and in a timely manner), you will do great in his class. Good grader, and very respectful

Luke is a very chill professor. He is very understanding of his students and has been in their shoes before so he can easily relate to them and see their perspectives. Professor Fetzer was a great instructor who actively tried to engage the class. His lectures and slides were well-organized, making the material easy to follow and understand. Overall, the class was relatable and straightforward.

Honestly a very good class with lots of good content. Keeps lectures for entertaining and engaging as well as relevant.

Luke, 
You were a super engaging and fun professor! The class was straightforward enough and was easy to manage.

Mr. Fetzer is a very personable and genuine teacher who cares about all of his students. He takes the time to listen and answer questions, clearing up any confusion. Super engaging professor, fun and in-depth lectures. Loves to talk with students and ask about their weeks. Highly recommend this professor for communication classes.

Fetzer was a great professor. He taught each lecture and ensured each student knew each lesson's concept. Exams in the class were very straightforward and exactly what he taught. He cares for all his students and their success.
Super great teacher who seems to really know and enjoy what he is teaching!
Most chill professor you will ever have. If you have to take this class make sure to get this professor.
If you're looking to take this class you have to sign up for professor Fetzer's class. I promise you will not regret it. Not strict with attendance but there are participation grades every class.

Not joking when I say this, even though I'm only a sophomore he's the best professor I've had in college so far. Professor Fetzer my boy FOR LIFE!
Thoroughly enjoyed having him as a professor. His ability to relate the topics of interpersonal communication to real life experiences we have was great.

Luke was an amazing professor! He makes class very interesting. There was never a dull moment. I enjoyed coming to class everyday. Class work Is very simple but also doesn't feel like busy work. Excellent teacher.

not only is he a professor but he is a dang good teacher too.  he always clearly stated what he wanted.

one of the better ones in the dept.

She was inspiring and supportive. We do need to read a lot but the content was always interesting so I didn't mind it plus it's college so duhh if you don't challenge yourself to read and learn now then when will you?
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Terrible class. Very rude teacher

Never actually shows up to class and openly admits to having a dislike for white straight males. Her instructions aren't clear and she says some really mean stuff that is unprompted. I would strongly discourage choosing her as your teacher.

AFE100 - Class is not difficult, just busy work. ~3-5 assignments per week. Attendance is mandatory - if you don't attend, it can massively hurt your grade. SO MANY PROJECTS, and you almost never get a 100%, she will find the smallest thing to take points off of. Really nice professor, but the lectures are incredibly boring.
Professor just recycles old assignments from the past without updating the information. Seems scattered at best and doesn't really feel engaged in the class at all.
ICT 200 consists of lots of outside readings, lots of group work in class, and lots of papers; however, read, attend class, and follow the rubrics and the class is an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Mrs. Foxworth is a good professor however she is not very relatable. She is not easy to confront however once you get to know her she is very kind and caring. If you put in the work, you will receive a good grade. She assigns a lot of readings that are crucial to performing well on tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Easy A. You have to come to class and maybe talk every now and then. There are a few projects, but just follow the rubric and you'll be fine. Take for an easy core class.

ICT 200 is a very easy class as long as you show up for lecture and participate! There are several projects throughout the semester, all of which have clear rubrics included so all you have to do is follow them! Ms. Foxworth is very personable and very willing to work with you to help you get the grade you deserve!

His grading always felt very subjective and uncertain. Then the feedback you would get back was never clear. You could appear to have done well in class, but your grade reflect something completely different.

Had students agree that "even great work rarely receives full-credit and that points taken off don't necessarily mean I did anything wrong; rather, it simply means that my work didn't fully meet the subjective standard of 'exceptional achievement'." in the beginning of the semester. Called one of the students ugly in our portrait unit. 
Avoid. Pls.

Professor Kelley remains one of the most devoted members of the Studio Art department. Forest takes time out of their day to help develop student projects and help push creative vision both inside and outside of class. The class itself is challenging but Forest's critiques have lead to improvement from countless students including myself.

He is young and awesome. Where he is a younger teacher he is very relatable and helps you learn stuff about your camera that you didn't know your camera could do. He grades easily if you show that you put in the effort and didn't half-ass the night before. Def recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He isn't clear on how you're graded. He says he grades things based on their "creativity" and "effort" but it's rather subjective and changes from each assignment. Doesn't have a rubric for the smaller assignments/essays he makes us write, and we don't really get much constructive feedback

I absolutely love her and her class so much. You can tell she cared for the students individual well being and she was very lenient and understanding about absences. I think I am actually going to miss her and won't find as good of a professor. She would try to connect with you and her class was the easiest thing I have ever done.

she really is a very caring person and i feel like she notices everyone in the class. she grades pretty easily and is also quick to email you back. i would def take her class again if she had one. also attendance is 5 points but she's understanding if you miss class a few times.

Ms. Ford is so sweet, and she really wants to see you succeed inside and outside of the class. As long as you turn in your assignments with some effort you'll get an A. Wish she taught other courses as well.

Literally the best lecturer I've ever had. I took him for CE 341 and it was a hard class but he made it as straight-foward and workable as possible. If you show up to the classes you will learn most of the content. The tests and some of the homeworks are still difficult but the material is presented as clearly as it could be.

Very Passionate for fluid mechanics. Hard class but Dr. Fox sets you up for success. He's a strange one, but strange in a funny refreshing kind of way. He makes it a Priority to learn your name and be personable with you.

One of the best profs I've had. He truly has the gift of teaching - he is awesome at explaining fluids and doesn't teach over your head! This class is hard, but it gave me a very solid background for fluids classes in the future. Dr. Fox is super nice and really cares about his students. He's quirky but in the best way possible. Highly recommend!

A lot of people say he's a great professor, but I think that he was average at presenting material. He is very nice and passionate, and I think that masks his flaws. His tests are very hard and almost impossible to complete on time. On top of that, he's the harshest grader I've ever had. You will automatically lose 1/3 of the points for ANY error
