reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Fox is great! There is a lot of homework, but all of it is helpful and it doesn't feel you're just doing something for the sake of a grade. Learned a lot. Tests are very fair. He is incredibly adept at helping students really understand the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've ever had. Quirky dude. But he loves fluids as much as he loves seeing his students succeed. But seriously don't skip class. His in class examples become homework, and they show up again on exams along with the recommended problems he gives you. He also gives you solutions to everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Definitely take is class: he's passionate about the topic, down to earth, and knows how to explain concepts is a way easy to understand. Great guy, great professor!
Best professor on campus. Best class taken thus far.

He is a little strange at first but once you get used to him you will love him.  Material is hard but fair because he explains things very well.  So if you don't do well it is on you.  Don't skip the class!  A lot is covered in one day!  It's a long class but you get a 10 minute break in the middle every day.

One of the best professors I have ever had! You have to attend class and do homework. Don't look at the solutions for the example problems until you have tried it yourself and you will get 90+ on his exams. He is extremely entertaining and I would never miss his class even though it is 2 hours.
Amazing teacher. Cheat sheet for every exam but you dont need it as he explains everything very very well. If you fail it's your own fault.

This class was amazing and such a breeze. This is truly how a 100 level course should be. She was always posting announcements making us aware that she was always around if we ever needed help with anything. I would recommend this class/professor to absolutely everyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was wonderful. The lectures were not too long and gave you all the info you'd need to ace the quizzes. There was a miscommunication on the syllabus about due dates, and professor Founds was quick to accommodate students that may have been going by the incorrect dates. Overall, great course and great professor!

Katie is AMAZING. Hands down the most caring professor I have had the entire time I have been at UK. She is genuinely compassionate and she cares about what she teaches. Class allows for open discussion which really opens your mind. I can not say enough good things about her. If you have the chance, take her class. Will be the best choice you make!

Katie is an overall amazing person. She is really passionate about her subject. There are weekly articles, but they are also great reads. Class is mostly discussion based, but you learn a lot. It is eye opening! Even if you do not need the credit, you will not regret taking a class taught by her.

Do not take any chem class with this professor. I've genuinely never done this bad in a class ever in my life. Literally run. He only reads off the slide and doesn't add anything going to class isn't worth it

This professor is genuenly one of the worst ones I've ever had. He doesn't teach and only reads off the very confusing slides he created. He never uses the textbook and expects us to already know the material during lecture. The study guide he gave us for the exams never actually matched what problems were on the exam.

Dr. Ladipo seems like a nice person, but his lectures are not helpful. I had an A and a B in CHE 109 and CHE 110 respectively, and now have to retake CHE 107 even after getting an online tutor for this course. The lectures are surface level and don't prepare you for the difficulty level of the exams.

When I went to lecture there were way to many slides that we went over in one day to the point where going to lecture was no longer helping. He would only read them and then move on, instead of explaining them. I recommend using ChadsPrep on YouTube to learn/study. I also would go over the practice exams.

As expected from a weed-out class, except worse. Unhelpful during lectures, provides very minimal study guides, and doesn't work through problems presented in lecture slides. Not many other options for CHE107. However, like any section for this class, make sure to never fall behind. Attend office hours.

Do not take this professor at all costs. I have never gotten below a B in my life, and received a D as my final grade. His averages were failing every time, and he simply does not care. The smartest people I know are receiving Cs and Ds. If you aren't a genius, be prepared to study all day every day just to pass (If you're lucky)

I really wish he would work through problems in lecture instead of just putting up a screenshot of typewritten work he did before class. He also tends to say "This is an easy concept, you should be able to understand this." during every single lecture when 0 of it is actually easy. I recommend Woodrum HIGHLY over Ladipo!

This guy chose the wrong profession. He thinks everything is common sense. Doesn't interact with the class very much, and just goes over the example questions too fast with no real explanations. You better hope you don't get the iClicker wrong because he's gonna make fun of you. Work and exam isn't very hard but he is not very good at teaching.
Brutal. The final was nothing like past exams

This teacher is the hardest chemistry teacher I have ever had at the University of Kentucky. I had Duley and Nunez last year for Chem 109 and 110. Coming into this year, I thought it couldn't get worse, and somehow it got so so so so so much worse. He reads directly from the slides; he has no new content added to the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Ladipo reads directly off the slides for the entire 75 minutes. Expect to learn the material on your own because he doesn't explain beyond what's written. There's a lot of math, but he never walks through the steps—he just shows the solved problem for a couple seconds and says it's not that hard. Good luck!

Only B I've ever gotten. Lectures are useless and exams are impossible. Any practice problems he will just click and all the work will show up at once. Got confused by his own slides multiple times and if everyone is clearly confused, he doesn't even review, just comments and moves on. No way anyone should try this hard in a class and not get an A

Terrible lecturer. All of the exam he created were extremely difficult and even had been corrected two months after exams were taken. He would never go through any problems with the class and if you ask a question about a topic he would just say that its easy & not help. Doesnt seem like he enjoys teaching or the students trying to learn chemistry.

doesn't care about students or his job. Doesn't show up to reviews he hosts and we just  leave. Works out NO problems, just puts up pictures of them and expects us to understand the content. States everything is easy and we should know it. No explaining to help students comprehend thecontent. Prob a chill guy in real life but not a good teacher.

He acts like he hates his job, and students are an imposition. If u ask a question, he will say the topic is common sense and to convince yourself that the answer is right. Bad at explaining things, and the tests make up 81% of your grade, so if you are a bad test taker, BEWARE.

Dr. Ladipo is obviously very knowledgable in chemistry topics, however, he doesn't get the information across effectively. Halfway through the semester, I had a friend mention Crambetter, an online tutor for Chem 107 and other classes, made specifically for UK curriculum. They provided me with explanations and problems, and I ended with an A!

Geniunely, this dude is god awful. He's not teaching CHE 107 next semester, but he was the only option for this Fall semester. He reads directly from the slides, doesn't add any extra information, or work out additional problems. Expects you to know everything off the first time he mumbled through the slide. Too many dumb achieves all due at once.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This guy is awful. I have been left speechless. He fails to accurately teach us anything and only reads off of his slides that he gives us full access to. There isn't even a need to show up to class, but he uses iClicker questions for participation. Once, he showed up 10 minutes late, didn't apologize to the class, and then jumped straight in.

Despite the reviews, Ladipo isn't as terrible as people say. He can be a bit condescending, but he does a decent job at explaining concepts. However, he doesn't solve math problems in class, just shows them already worked out. As long as you put in the effort outside of class, you will be fine.

Don't take this professor if possible!! The entirety of CHE 107 students were cornered into taking the class from him!! Lecture vocab consists of "you should already know this". The smartest people I know are barely passing the class- that should be a sign! Its a hard class, but Ladipo makes it 10x harder

Please do NOT take this professor unless you have great friends to study with or you are prepared to teach yourself the content. He only reads off the slides and even mentions he posts the lectures so you can look up the answers to the I clicker questions before class, so he doesn't have to spend much time on them.

The worst professor in the chemistry department. He acts like he's "too good" to explain material and expects students to already know it. Reads off the slides and does not explain ANYTHING. He does not explain how to do any math problems or what formulas to use, just shows the solution. Get ready to teach yourself the material, which is A LOT.

DO NOT TAKE HIM I had an A in chem last semester He's a terrible lecturer, tells students it's easy calculations and that we should know how to do this, reads straight off slides but he doesn't even know what's on each slide before hand. He doesn't solve math in class so you have to figure it on your own. He's impossible to reach outside of class.
DO NOT THINK ABOUT TAKING HIM. RUN. Actually awful at explaining things. I read the reviews before thinking it could not be that bad. It can. Self teaching at its finest.

Dr.Ladipo is probably the worst professor I've had so far. Chemistry is already a very hard course and he makes it even harder. His lectures are extremely boring and he doesn't work out any practice problems, claims everything is “self-explanatory”. If you have the option to take this class with another professor do it.

Definitely one of the less ideal options for CHE professors. Dr. Ladipo is very smart, but shows a lack of interest in lectures. He would often skip over examples, claiming "we already knew them". The class was not that hard, but just use Woodrum's lectures online.

Not about the prf.
I personally lost since after exam 3. About vsepr theory, molecular geometry, polarity and hybridization.Those are tough.

Literally learned nothing in 107 with him. He doesn't teach. He mumbles his slides & never works through anything in class & runs through iClicker questions w/o explaining or working anything out because it's “simple” and “self explanatory”. That's not how chem is supposed to be taught. Take Woodrum or Nuñez! They're both excellent for 107.

Folami ONLY reads off of the slides during lecture, and he clearly does not want to be teaching this class. I had to teach myself all of the material. Look at the learning outcomes on Canvas, Dr. Woodrum's yt videos, and make quizlets to have a shot in this class. Do whatever you can to be in another section than his.

No effort was taken by Dr. Lapido to ensure his students were learning the content. The bulk of the lecture is him simply reading off of the slides with little substantiation, continuing on by saying "this is basic stuff", and scoffing at students who got the iClicker questions wrong. Do everything in your power to get another professor.

Take literally any other professor for 107. Everyone I know that took a different professor did fine in 107. Everyone I know that had ladipo was struggling terribly. He does not teach. He reads off slides and mumbles and then gets mad if we don't immediately understand it. Then he wonders why we don't want to go to office hours. Avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The teacher just reads through the slides and doesn't explain any of the material. He does not elaborate on difficult topics, and does not work through any of the problems. He just shows it, says it's simple math, and moves on. You will need to teach yourself the material.
Lowkey always makes fun of people who get clicker questions wrong. You can tell he doesn't want to be teaching the class, which is sad. Just self study a lot and you will be okay.

Get ready to teach yourself everything
Confident that this professor will remain the worst professor I'll have had throughout undergrad. Extreme lack of consideration, doesn't care if you understand the content. As he lectures, scoffs at students who get iClicker questions wrong, claiming the subject is “pretty easy, pretty straight forward stuff”.

Be careful in chapter 3 when you get confused with similar terms (ie. molar, formular, molecular, atomic mass).
Many times, you don't want to use the slides to take note because the text is not selected and organized that work for students. Use McMillian textbook instead.
Lecture are useless

This is genuinely the worst Chem Prof At the University of Kentucky. He does not teach the class, he only reads off the slides, He shows papers of the work on the screen of the problem and does not talk through it or explain it, He Expects everybody to know what he is doing at all times IF you have him good luck and lock in. Dont Cheat wont help.
It felt like all material was crammed together. He doesn't really follow through with how you solve equations, just uses the formulas and expects everyone to understand why.
Unless you are good at teaching yourself hard content, get a different professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Ladipo is hard to understand and learn from. He mostly reads off slides, doesn't work out examples problems with us, and speaks quietly. Chem 2 doesn't have to be that bad, just try to take a different prof than Ladipo.

Ladipo is obviously extremely intelligent and a very nice guy, but his teaching style is unproductive. He is extremely unclear, gets off track, mumbles, and will not work problems. He expects you to kind of just read and understand. I don't want him to get fired, I just think he needs to change his teaching style.

PLEASE take Dr. Woodrum for 107. He would just talk through slides and would never solve any of the questions claiming it was "simple math." If you take anyone but Woodrum I would recommend watching her playposit videos on her youtube channel "KimChem." He was a nice guy, just not good at teaching intro chem.

While not the worst chem professor, he spends a large majority of class time explaining one concept and then rushes through the rest of the material He also refuses to go through worked examples in the slides claiming its simple math. He also messed up iclicker so many times that while I only missed 3 classes my iclicker barely made it to a 75.
Dr. Ladipo is a Great Prof. I had him for Quant. Org Analysis & that was the best Class of my entire academic Career.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Extremely quiet and boring and very bad at explaining things. Take any other professor if possible.
The lectures did not focus on the content.

We read quite a few Shakespeare plays, about one a week or so. His weekly assignments are graded kind of strict, but he drops your lowest grade in the first and second half of the semester. He really helped me learn a lot about Shakespeare. His oral/written test option wasnt too bad. Would definitely recommend taking a class with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Fun and easy class, you just watch 1 movie per week and answer 5-6 questions about it. There's a midterm and final paper, but it's a story you create then expand on. Classes take attendance, but you can multitask with other courses while you listen to it. He's really nice, and I would take more of his classes if this was my major! 10/10!

If you need an Honors Arts and Creativity take this class!! It is not difficult at all; he wants you to succeed! We watched a bunch of movies and discussed the readings. There were only 2 papers to write and no tests. He was so kind and genuinely cared about the material.
Foreman is the most precious old man ever. His Shakespeare class is ridiculously easy. 10/10 love it
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: This class is super easy but it is very boring. He spends every minute of the class going over the material even on the first day of class when handing out the syllabus. It is like dude we get it just give us the syllabus. On Tuesdays you will be tested on the movie and on thursday he goes over it. We just took the test. Let us leave
This class is extremely easy, but incredibly boring. If you do the assignments, you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor Foreman is awesome. He is so nice and friendly, and he is really passionate about Shakespeare. I was scared to take this class, but he has made it as painless as possible. His class can be a little boring, but if you don't mind that, then it's great!

Foreman is a sweetheart. He is very knowledgeable when it comes to Shakespearean literature and theatre. For someone like me with a background in theatre, I found the class extremely interesting. He is very quick to respond to emails and is very accessible outside of class.

Shakespeare Aloud was a fun, easy class for a Honors credit. Two major papers, a few small assignments, a few presentations, and reading aloud in class. Foreman is a caring professor, funny without even meaning to be. Workload was definitely manageable as long as you make time for your out of class reading. Overall, a great class!

I've never been super comfortable with Shakespeare, but Prof. Foreman made it fun. We did a lot of reading aloud and class discussion, but it always felt casual, never intimidating. He's also one of the kindest people at UK(/in the world), funny, and such a joy to chat with. He's very understanding, and responds to emails quickly. One of the best!

I really enjoyed "Walt's" class and how interactive it was. I took honors Shakespeare aloud; there was a lot of reading aloud and a little acting, but as a non-theatre person, I never felt overwhelmed. Walt rekindled my love for Shakespeare and I hope to take another class with him in the future! Although a tough grader, he will bump your grade up.

I wasn't super interested in the course, but it was pretty easy. I honestly did not read the books, just caught up on SparkNotes, and I was able to keep up. Discussion is not content-based, but rather mainly just reading aloud. Two major papers - one on your own, another with a group. Not bad, just a bit boring if you aren't into Shakespeare.

Professor Foreman is amazing! His class was truly challenging (as in up until I got my grades I was convinced I had gotten a C). I left his class confident in my knowledge of Shakespeare. He is the epitome of what you'd expect visually of a college professor and was very personable.

Dr. Foreman is a good professor but this is a survey class with a TON of reading. Many instances of 100+ pages of reading each night plus a quiz over it the next class. The quizzes are WAY too specific for that amount of reading and many people in the class had difficulties with it. Not easy grading either. Exams consists of ID passages and essays.

Prof. Foreman is awesome! I took this as a summer class, so the class was small. We really got to know each other in the class, and Professor Foreman did a wonderful job at keeping things interesting. As long as you went to class and paid attention, you're guaranteed an A.

Dr. Foreman is a great professor!  He managed to link the class to just about all of our lives and made the subject matter very interesting.  Not very hard homework, and he is very helpful when grading papers.  If you try, you'll get an A, but he's not a pushover.

THE BEST! Don't worry about grades in here if you do the work you'll get an A.  He was really interested in topic.  If you talk during discussions it makes it a better experience. Texts were pretty interesting. He leaves really helpful comments on papers that you have to do. We watched a few random funny videos during the semester, which was great.

I think he's great and really knows his stuff.  DON'T BUY THE BOOK, there are tons of sources online.  Lots of time spent watching the movies.  He's a good teacher, it takes awhile to get use to his style, but good other than that.
It's about 3/4 through the semester and I have an A in the class.It's not fun, or easy. There's a lot of outside work, and he's not very nice one on one.

Prof Foreman seems really sweet, but isn't very helpful or understanding when it comes down to it. Your grade consists of 2 Essay exams, 1 paper and 7 quizzes. The TA does all the grading. The class isn't hard if you pay attention, but I definitely went from loving Shakespeare before class started to hating Shakespeare. It sucks the fun out of it.
Singlehandedly renewed my interest in both the Honors Program and classical literature.
The class discussions were often tedious and boring.  One girl ususally fell asleep during every discussion.  Dr. Foreman is a nice man, but he doesn't make his class fun.
Good teacher...can be difficult though.
Dr Foreman is the nicest teacher.  His class was fun and pretty easy.  I had a loudmouth student in this class dominating the class discussions; Dr Foreman was too polite and didn't shut him up ;)
WALTER FOREMAN IS THE SWEETEST MAN ALIVE
Great Shakespeare In Film class--Foreman is a teachsmith.  Maybe not a sharp dresser, but when he takes shots at people...God, gimme more!  Aced his class, too, so I liked him.
Great Teacher; Great Class.  Loved everything about it.

I took Walter Foreman's Shakespeare survey over three years ago and still remember it fondly. He's a great teacher--kind, enthusiastic about the material--who makes some difficult texts a real pleasure to slog through. Also liked the comparisons between texts and film adaptations.
No Comments
the class isn't hard but it is a lot of work
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Henderson was an amazing professor. She was nice and helpful even with an online class. There is quite a bit of reading, but her class is interesting. There are discussion boards and a few papers and one pop icon presentation. Midterm and final was doable. The only downside is that she takes forever to grade assignments and exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Henderson is a kind person, but her class is not my favorite. There was a lot of work that often felt unnecessary and her exams were very difficult. However, she is understanding that things happen outside of class and can be flexible to help.

Dr. Henderson is one of my favorite teachers! I love that she is caring (she checked in on everyone after the election) and is passionate about what she teaches! This class feels less like a class and more like a group involvement. Even though its 50 mins it often feels shorter. If you need easy credit and want a good teacher take this course!

I love Dr. H! She is truly inspirational to other black students here at UK. You can tell that she is passionate about what she teaches. She gives amazing feedback. Participation and attendance is key to passing this class. I highly recommend her as a professor!!

I personally think Dr. Henderson is an amazing professor. She is kind, cares about her students, does not assign anything absolutely crazy, and is a very fair grader. You have to put in a little bit of work to get the grade, but her classes are one that I actually get excited to take and go to each day.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I was pretty excited to take this class when I signed up for it, but overall it was pretty disappointing. Dr. Henderson doesn't respond to a lot of emails unless you're snippy, and the work can be incredibly boring. There are 2 tests, and you can do all the studying in the few hours before you take it and get an A still.

Class was a bit disorganized, but not the worse. If you are nice to her, she will return the favor. I had to ask for an extension on a bigger assignment, & I told her that I would do my best to complete it on time, & she ended up giving me an extra day. Don't expect her to do favors for you if you are going to be rude and condescending.

This class was way harder than I expected. Professor Henderson is fine, but she can seem cold sometimes. Her lectures were intense; lots of info and sometimes not enough time to type. The exams were tough and required a lot of studying. I was looking forward to this class but I definitely wish I hadn't taken it.

Dr. Henderson is great and very chill. Theres a lot of assignments in this class including projects, quizzes, and discussion boards. Its not my favorite class because of the number of assignments. She also cancelled class a lot which was nice but online classes are more expensive and it seems like time was wasted with how much was cancelled.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Actually took ENG407 but it wasn't an option. I loved this class and I genuinely learned so much about writing poetry. I would take it again if I could.

Super easy class. A couple pop quizzes but he makes adjustments based on the classes overall preparedness and reactions (i never did the readings and got 100% on them.) Pretty much the only grade is a poetry collection at the end of the semester worth 60% of your grade. It's only graded on if you did it or not so just write ten poems.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was very easy, and Professor Walker is very engaging when it comes to lecures just show up, and you'll pass this class; it's an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class wasn't awful but it was too easy, if you have any basic knowledge of writing you aren't gonna learn crap. Grading is pretty fair as long as you read. Completely centered on black authors, to the point where it is 100% on purpose. I didn't sign up for a black appalachia history class, sorry not sorry.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: i actually really liked him and his class. there were pop quizzes, but he ended up allowing them to be open note—he stated he doesn't want anyone to fail. he does also offer extra credit every once in a while. attendance matters, but it's really easy to pass. you aren't graded on how good your poem is, just on if you did it and in proper format.

Ignore the previous comments!! Professor X's class was one of the easiest classes I had last semester and I really enjoyed hearing him speak. Participation is required but your writing is not graded on how good it is.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: If you don't already like creative writing, you probably won't like this class. It's fun and Prof Walker is a really interesting guy but it's a lot of work for a 100 level class. However! Most of your writing is graded entirely on completion, not how good it is, so as long as you do the daily exercises you'll be set for your portfolio.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I was terrified after the reviews on professor X, but this class was so easy, and thats coming from someone who doesn't like to do a lot of work. Just show up to class and listen. The two mandatory (outside of class) literary events are not bad and takes 30 minutes at MOSt. all you have to do is a write up on it. Be in class and you'' get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Lectures made zero sense, he was simply rude to students (i.e., he would talk quietly, and then refuse to repeat himself when people couldn't hear him). There's two things you MUST go to outside of normal class times, which is extremely odd in a course this simple. I would probably call this class "history of poetry" instead of "creative writing".
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Over the semester I've learned that professor Walker is strict because he loves what he does. You HAVE to do the work and show up. My TA Deidra White was the absolute best. She's so understanding and wants and loves to get to know you.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A complete joke. Doesn't post about homework so one knows what's going on. It's Halloween and we have 3 grades in. Majority of the work he asks us to do goes ungraded. Lectures can be off topic and are usually useless. Will call you out for sleeping/being on your phone. It's pathetically easy. If you're looking to go back to preschool, go for it!
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Rude and will not work with you. Just a complete d*ck

I've had Walker for three classes, and he's a wonderful teacher. He challenges his students but doesn't go overboards.He knows creative writing, especially poetry. He had us read published collections by other poets as well as workshopping our own poetry. He's a caring and kind individual.

It feels like his lectures are made up on the spot. He's changed what's on the syllabus multiple times. He is rude when you go to him for help. really inconsistent and unpredictable with what we're doing in class. Never gives his TAs any information. Gives tests and assignments last minute. Very pretentious and does not care about his students.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Walker is very intimidating. Never is easy to talk to, and I have once. Not approachable, and very strict on tests and papers. Grades harshly, but most of the TA’s do the grading. My TA is okay. Overall, thought this class would be fun since I love to write, and had to be taken for UK core credit. I was wrong.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You are lucky if you get to take a class from Professor X.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The best way to learn about creative writing is from an amazing writer. If you have the chance to hear him speak, much less get professor and course feedback. The best any future writer could ask for.

I would not recommend taking any course taught by Prof. Walker. His lectures are all over the place and are more history than writing. Anything he says, even if he just mentions it once, is fair game to be on the test. He's rude, and did not help my writing improve at all
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you want to be a writer or learn about great writers this is an amazing class. professor X, needs no review, his merits as a teacher go way beyond the classroom. Any student would be blessed to sit in his presence

Do not take Frank Walker. I didn't have a problem with him for grades, it was just that he's a terrible prof. Doesn't teach, sometimes doesn't show up to class, doesn't read your work. Teaches useless information for a creative writing class. It wasn't hard, but it's pointless to learn about history and geography in a 100 level English course.
Boring, easy class but some work is required. Lots of extra credit opportunities. He wants you to pass. Much of the class is taught by the TAs.

Professor X is an amazing teacher that makes you think beyond the surface, gives tons of extra credit to make sure you pass, and provides help when you ask. He respects more you if you actually do the work. AND his name is on the mural on the side of the new student center!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: It is an easy class. Like everyone else said, it was a waste of time with him. All we did was read his books and talk about them. Although it is a creative writing class, you never get to write unless you are given the prompt and you must only use those.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The worst professor Ive had at UK. 0/10 recommend. Lectures do not really make sense. All quizzes and tests are short answer so if you don't read then you're screwed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: i took his creative writing class and i was super excited to get to write and explore that part of my brain because the rest is math etc. but needless to say, there is nothing "creative writing" about that class. we sat and read the books that he wrote.  not cool. there is a huge portfolio at the end of the semester and he doesnt even grade them.
Please don't take class with him. Be ready for regular pop quizzes and an unorganized class if you do.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I don't recommend taking Frank X Walker. He uses his own books  that he has written and expects you to understand all the ins and outs of it and all the tiny nuances in them. He also relies heavily on his TAs and is not afraid to call you out in class if you are not paying attention or on your phone. More than once I felt like a child being scolded
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Basically what everyone has said is accurate. The class is unorganized, and Walker hardly ever teaches. I had another class with him and it was the same way. He is a great poet and when he actually tries to teach, he's very good. But he rarely ever does. Most lectures are done by the TAs, and I never knew what my grade was. Would not recommend.

The class was extremely unorganized and frustrating. We were all one big section but split into groups and on Blackboard it got confusing. I didn't get a single grade for the assignments I turned in all semester so I never got any feedback on anything. At least attendance isn't mandatory.

I'm a junior and this is the WORST class I have taken at UK. Incredibly unorganized, confusing, assignments are never graded and overall its pointless. You get divided into groups and I was unlucky enough to be in Professor Walker's group. When I had questions he was rude, arrogant, and just completely unhelpful. DO NOT TAKE.

One of the most unorganized classes I've ever taken. Apparently ALL of the work you submit in this class is for simple completion. It doesn't get looked at or graded by rubric. Extremely easy exams. Overall, it's an easy class but extremely unorganized and BORING.

This is my senior year, and this is the least organized class I have taken so far at UK.  The TA assigned to my group is very rude.  There is no communication and no one knows what is going on until class time, if then.  Haven't received a single assignment back and it's now mid November.  Seriously considering filing a formal complaint.

Super easy class if you just work on your writing. Alternates between meeting in person and online assignments. He is a very cool guy and has a great sense of humor, but I don't feel like I could ever go up to him and ask a question. On the plus side he has 5 TAs so everything works out. Recommend for sure.
I loved having her. She is such an icon. Lecture exams are worth most of your grade in this class. If you pay attention you will be fine.

This level 100 course was hard for no reason. She wouldn't let you retake quizzes, again for a level 100 course, makes finding the information for the quizzes extremely difficult. Overall a nightmare for a course I just needed to fulfill an elective for my senior year. Grading is rough too. Not an easy A. ridiculous
Professor was great and everything but the class was a little hard. This is a class you definitely need to watch the lectures and take notes on everything.

I thought this class would be easy, but it wasn't. The prof. was good, there was just lots of hard topics. If you take this class, make sure to take notes and pay attention. Good thing there was a BIG curve!

This class is ok, like you can end with an A but it is SO much work. I would say it's easier than a Bio or Chem class, but everyone I know in this class HATES it. you have four assignments a week, which doesn't sound awful until you do them. they take forever and the exercises are almost impossible to get a 40/40 on do with that what you wil.
Worst communicator ever.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took it online, so many of the assignments required you to know such tiny, obscure things, everyone I know who has taken it regrets it. Reached out to ask how I could do better in the class and for help on certain things, told me I should email the TA when I told her I already did, she basically just said tough luck. Do not take, find another class
Worst communicator of any teacher I've ever had in my life. Not sympathetic to technology troubles or illness so if you or your technology breaks down good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I really liked the lectures and thought they were very engaging. Her assignments and exams are weighted pretty heavily. Be careful who you work with because the end of lecture quizzes can hurt your grade if you do not do well. You are allowed notes on the exam and open google. I took in depth notes to help me out on the exam and included pictures.

Dr. F is awesome, there is no denying that. Not sure how she is in-person, but she is a great instructor and person. This course is not an "easy A", you have to work for it. There's lots of assignments, but everything is weighed similarly. Open exams and quizzes, but it's helpful to watch lectures. Weirdly difficult class for a 100 level.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This was by far one of the most difficult classes I've ever taken, especially for a 100 level course. Lectures are long and there is SOOO much work. As someone who has had a 4.0 my whole life, I struggled to end with an A. In each grading category, your lowest grade is dropped. Very boring class as well

Dr. Freeman was very nice when I talked to her in person, her class was just difficult. I do not consider myself to be very science forward though, so take what I say with a grain of salt. The lectures were a little tedious, but I suppose that is the trade-off when the course is asynchronous. She is still very nice and caring to her students!

Dr. Freeman is super sweet. The class is easy and interesting but I wish her lectures were more engaging than simply reading off the slides. That coupled with the fact that attendance is not mandatory often leads to a dead lecture hall, which is unfortunate. The labs are great and she is super easy to contact with any questions.

Professor Freeman very obviously cares about what she teaches and her students learning, but there is so much class work for a 150 level, it is actually ridiculous. This class that 90% of students are taking just for a credit is more work than every 350+ class I've ever taken. Absolutely no hate to who she is as a teacher, but there's so much work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Freeman is a good professor, you can tell she cares about what she is teaching and her students. The class is just unnecessarily SO HARD. The lecture videos take forever to get through and there is TONS of content. This class was way more science heavy than I expected it to be, I thought I'd be learning more surface level things than I am

Don't recommend if you're taking for UK core. Harder than my actual classes and was my lowest grade, I would not recommend in the slightest. If you want 120+ slides, 4 quizzes, and 2 assignments a week, this class is for you. Sadly, I think that is too much for class that has nothing to do with my major nor any in Kentucky considering no oceans!

I thoroughly enjoyed EES170! I didn't watch any lectures and reviewed the slides every week, took notes, and completed the reflection quiz (reflection quizzes due Tue. and Thur.) and would be good. There's the occasional exercise but every quiz and exam is open-note, no lockdown browser or camera. She gave good feedback and had good communication.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class was very intersting and I definitely recommened! She drops the two lowest quiz and exercise grades and drops the lowest exam grade. The material can be confusing, you have to write down everything she says in the videos in order to pass, since there is no textbook required. There's two quizs per week and usually one exercise.
Only like 5 homeworks. STUDY for the exams. Lectures are long but she cares.

This class was overly hard. There is an exercise every week, and they weigh as much your exams. The two lowest exercises get dropped and your lowest exam gets dropped; however, the exams and exercises were extremely difficult. An 85 is an A, but it is even hard to maintain an A on that scale. Her TAs are helpful, but the professor herself is not.

Took this class online after being recommended Professor Freeman by several friends who took her classes in person. DO NOT TAKE HER CLASSES ONLINE. I've heard her in person classes are great but the online classes are impossible to pay attention too, especially with her 1-2 hour long online lectures.
very easy class.. 2 quizzes and an exercise every week and only 3 exams. drops lowest exam grade. 85% is a B. took minimal effort to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: This class was okay, it's all open notes. I personally can't stand to watch the videos, so I go through the slides she provides, I think if you can watch the videos, you'll do fine in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: The class itself was kinda boring but Freedman did a good job at explaining things and clearly was passionate about what she taught. I did not find the class to be too difficult, just go to class/take notes. The exams were hard but she drops the lowest exam grade. I recommend taking this class if you are willing to pay attention in class!
She's a very nice woman, but the tests, quizzes are definitely difficult. However, if you take the time to take notes on the ~30 min lectures, you'll do just fine.

Dr. F was a great professor, this was just a tough class to take online. She was readily available when you needed her, but it was difficult to get immediate feedback as it was an online course. She tried her best to help though and she was super accommodating when you need something.

The class is mostly online, except the lectures. A lot of difficult information that youll never understand. but as long as you do the reflections and exercises, youll be fine. Shes a sweet teacher, but the information is super hard

Took the online version. Pre-recorded lectures, very fast paced, have to pause to take notes. Quiz and exams have backtracking disabled, so you have to answer the question to move on, which I dislike. Some tricky worded question on quizzes can hurt your score. Good note, she drops 2 lowest grades for quiz and assignment. Drops lowest exam.

Probably the worst class I have taken in my life, I don't understand how in a semester she changed but the reviews are wrong about her for EES 170. Lecture videos are a waste of time, the quizzes and exercises don't even use notes. Anytime I emailed her it was also the next day so I did not get any help on my assignments.
Dr. Freeman was an overall great professor. The course was the easiest class I have ever taken at the university level.

I took this class fully online and was in a really helpful GroupMe. From someone who hates science, this is an easy and interesting core class and it seems that she enjoys the material, she is extremely nice, and wants students to do well. I can't speak on what it would be like in person, but online it was really easy and wasn't too much work.

This online class is super easy- and an 85% is an A. you have videos to watch every T/TH but you don't really need to watch them, just look through the slides and take notes. you have unlimited attempts on practice quizzes, so its an easy A. exams are open note, and questions are from practice quizzes. she drops the lowest exam. def take this class

This semester has a lot of quizzes and the material I would not say makes sense in a 100 level course. Way too much information. The tests are online and open book but NOT easy. She luckily drops 1 exam out of 3. I feel out of my 18 credit hrs this semester this class is taking over my 300 level courses.

class was asynchronous online with pre recorded video lectures. she allows all work or tests to be open note and you're able to use the internet or other resources, but tests are timed. there's a decent amount of work but its not hard. she considers 85-100 an A. very easy class to pass if you do the work.

EES 150, taught by Professor Freeman, is by far the easiest course I have ever took. Freeman's lectures are very easy to follow. She doesn't give much homework and her tests are open note. She also drops the test with the lowest grade. Also, class isn't mandatory and can be easily passed without going.
Very sweet lady. Grading scale is nice and she will help if you need it!

Professor Freeman made learning very easy with how organized she is. She posted all the lectures a week in advanced so you could go at your own pace. You have about 3 assignments per week that didnt take much time. Also, exams were simple and you can use your notes. Overall, you dont have to put much work in to get the grade you want.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Boring class but good teacher. I had online so the lectures were posted, but there is a good amount of work every week. Tests can be difficult and there is a lot of information.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She has no interest in teaching the material. Her class isnt that hard to pass and do well in, but teaching the material is not her primary goal. A lot of answers are subjective and she just wants to trip you up on wording and formatting rather than not knowing the material. If you learn her game the class is easy, but its frustrating.
She did an amazing job with classes moving fully online. She makes herself accessible to students and wants everyone to succeed.

Her lectures are easy to understand, and the content is not hard at all. She lets you drop your least graded exam and some quizzes, which is nice. That being said, we had quizzes each week, and that was time-consuming because you most likely won't understand what to do for the exercises if you don't go to class and take it with your classmates.

I took this class as a gen ed and loved Dr. Freeman. She is very sweet, passionate, & helpful. There were a lot of assignments (99% in class), but they're easy if you pay attention. She drops the lowest out of 3 exams so I didn't even have to take the final. This class is easy if you show up & try. The material can be hard, but not bad at all!

Loved DR. Freeman, she drops one of the 3 exams and drops up to 4 of the exercises. If you pay attention you will do great. She is also very understanding, I really enjoyed learning about earthquakes and volcanos. Also the last exam (exam 3) counts technically as your final but it is not accumulatative. :)
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is a sweet woman, she just. moves fast in lecture. It is hard to keep up during class and could take me up to 7 pages in my notebook to write the notes for class each day. She does not provide study guides for exams and it is impossible to study all of the information we learn in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Freeman was a pretty casual professor, as long as you come to class you'll be good. She doesn't take attendance normally, instead at the end of every lecture you have a reflection and even a mini quiz only 1-2 questions and that counts as your attendance points. Because she doesn't assign much homework & tests, attendance is pretty necessary

EES 170 was my favorite class and Dr. Freeman is a gem! Beware of the online homework it seems easy but, it will get you in the end if you aren't paying attention. Also, she is a little quiet so sit in the front and you'll be fine. She posts her slides online so no need to take notes, just pay attention! Her A is 85-100%!

Dr. Freeman is by far one of the kindest people you will ever meet. All of her lectures are very interesting (the topic itself is great but she only adds to the glory) and fun. She ACTUALLY cares about all of her students and will go above and beyond to make sure you succeed. She's done more for me than any other teacher. Will always recommend!!

This class is NOT an "easy A". You need to take notes during lecture, do all of the homework and study for hours in order to get a decent grade in the class. The exams are impossible with about half of the class getting a C or below after studying for 6+ hours. The content is boring and the lectures are painful to sit through.

She is a kind person and cares about her students. Her material is very detailed, but as long as you take notes, pay attention in class, and do all of the hand-outs, you should be fine. She makes her lecture presentations interesting with cool but relevant images, maps, and videos. I would recommend taking her if this subject really interests you.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Freeman was nice, but she lectures the entire class everyday, and everything she talks about won't be on the worksheet you do relating to the lesson. The tests are near impossible even with immense studying and it's nearly impossible to get above a C on anything. 0/10 would not recommend this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Rebecca was an ok professor. The issue is that her lectures are all note taking and it gets boring very fast. She's very sweet though. Her exams are kinda difficult and require studying but she drops an exam which helps.

She is a very kind professor who genuinely cares about her students. While the material is difficult to understand, she will drop a number of your lower grades to help you pass the class. I'm pretty sure I failed about a fifth of the work assigned and still managed to get a B in the class. If you can, take her course.

I had Dr. Freeman as a join professor for Geoscience Orientation but she has had the biggest impact on me outside the classroom. She truly cares about her students and will go out of her way to help you/be a psychologist. She is a great advisor for geology and helps make sure I;m on track to graduate. HIGHLY recommend taking her, given the chance!!

This class, although intro-level, requires some work. Copy down the powerpoints (which she puts online at the beginning of the semester,) listen to what she says, and use the study guide she posts for tests. Easy A if you do that --helped by the fact that she grades on a 15 point scale instead of 10 -- but easy to fall into a C if you don't keep up

Makes a class that should be so easy surprisingly difficult. Can never understand a word she says. May be too smart to teach entry level seismology. Attendance: Not mandatory, but a 40 pt in class assignment each day. Will give you makeups on tests thought if you are sick or traveling. I would not take this prof if you're looking for an easy A.

She is a great teacher. I would highly recommend her for natural science requirement. If you study the notes in her PP, an A or B is guaranteed. Also, I did not have to take the third exam because I already got a good score in the first two.

Dr. Freeman really cares for her students. She loves the classes she teaches, it's obvious in the content. Look... show up, take notes, study a little, easy A. The material while VAST, its not that bad. Attendance is necessary for points. The tests are not bad BUT multiple correct answer options can get tricky when taking the test. Great Class tho

I took her oceanography class this past spring and it was interesting. Most of the class seemed to be about plate tectonics and currents and the earth, not marine life you would expect (was the last couple weeks). I thought I did a lot better on the tests than I got graded for so I don't know what happened with those. Homeworks take time.

Dr. Freeman is not only super knowledgeable about the subject matter in her classes, but she is a super nice person. If you have any questions her email responses are prompt and she's great if you stop by her office hours. Tons of points in her classes, low grading scale making for easy success. Her tests are difficult though, so be prepared.

Love this woman. Her class really isn't that hard if you attend lectures (which are basically mandatory, since in-class exercises are 40% of your grade) and she doesn't make it harder than it needs to be. DON'T BUY THE TEXTBOOK. I would definitely recommend her for any course.

Dr. Freeman does not waste your time. She doesn't go off topic or ramble about things that aren't going to be on the test. She definitely knows what she's talking about and is also very friendly. I definitely recommend taking a class of hers if you're serious about learning environmental issues. Beware: Study a lot for the tests! They can be tough.

Dr. Freeman was very nice and she made the lectures as interesting as possible. The tests are a little hard because all of the answers seem right most of the time, but she lets you drop your lowest test which is really nice. No homework usually. Just show up and pay attention for a good grade.
She does this think pair share this in class where she asks a question and then asks us to talk about it with our neighbor. This sucks. Homework assignment were decently easy.

The online homework for me at least seemed always easy when taking them, but I always managed to do poorly on them. She met up with me and explained what I didn't understand and even offered the class an extra credit assignment. Every lecture is put up online in power point, BUT STILL GO TO CLASS, she has participation points, but she's great!!!

Dr. Freeman is an excellent professor (she does have a lisp though) who is truly in love with geology and it shows through her lectures. She'll basically hand you the answers if you ask for in class assignments and she's always availible for office hours where she will GIVE you the answers! Her grading is awesome and she drops a LOT of grades.

As long as you pay attention in class, it is an easy class. Her lectures are packed with information but are very straightforward and interesting. There are a lot of in-class assignments that make up most of your grade. But if you pay attention they are pretty easy and if you are confused she is happy to help. I learned so much in this class!

She loves teaching and will always help you if you need it. She has a small lisp making some things unclear. She also usually doesn't explain the assignments well before she hands them out making all of the students confused.
Grading scale is very generous. Go to class, study a little, do the homework, get an A. Only do 2 of those 3 things, get a B.
She is very nice, & her class has a very nice grading scale. Pretty difficult to get an A, but she drops ALOT of assignments. Don't expect to pass the Google Earth hw's.

This class was hard for me. The tests were the type of test that 2 answers could be correct. I got an average of a C on both tests. The project and in class activities is what really boosted my grade. I got an A on the project and activities. She said that if you have an 84.1% she will round your grade to an A, which is how I got an A.

Dr. Freeman tends to use vocabulary and move at a pace that only science majors will really understand.  However, all lectures are posted online, so you can easily follow on there.  Grading scale is really giving.  Take for natural science as an interesting A.
Great teacher, and super easy class. Take her if you want an A!

Friendly, she drops lowest test grade and drops two lowest homework's. Lecture can be boring but she allows you to surf the web and text so time flies. Easy class, she takes grade on attendance that can really boost or hurt grade
Friendly

The course does not relate HW and Exams. Very difficult to understand his teaching. Often teaches little on class and requires you to do more. His teaching does not help you understand concepts and textbooks. Not a good teacher or instructor.

Does not test on material covered in course. Difficult to understand. Does not relate course to HW or Exams. Mandated course and everyone complained of test difficulty and not teaching I had straight A's in a competitive engineering field :( Very poor instructor

Yang frequently teaches materials courses but isnt my favorite teacher. His lectures can be hard to sit through since he has a tendency to fly through information and then homeworks and exams wont match what was went over in class. He doesnt intentionally make things hard but getting an A is difficult unless you know the material already.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Ito was great for this class. She knows so much about drawing and is willing to help with almost anything. She is very understanding when it comes to mental health and being busy if you forget to do or bring something for class. She definitely helped me improve at drawing and I highly recommend taking her if you can!

She is amazing!! TAKE HER CLASS. She's so kind and attentive with her students and really taught me how to see art and create what I see. She's very understanding of the level of experience people come in with, and their artistic ability as a whole. You do have to show up for class and do outside work to complete the projects though.

This is the best professor I've ever had and probably the best I ever will have. Fuko is one of the kindest people I have ever met (she offered to make our entire class thanksgiving dinner) and she cares so deeply for each and every one of her students. She really helps you improve your drawing skills without being condescending. TAKE HER CLASS!!

Fuko is very sweet, she cares that you get your work done, but as long as you are on track and staying up to task she is always up to mess around in class or let us draw whatever we want. There are some reading assignments, but they are interesting and relate to the course.

From what I've read, online Ms. Fulton is different from in-person Ms. Fulton. Many people told me that her sections of MUS 100 were some of the hardest classes they had ever taken. That might have been so in-person. This was not the case online. Tests were open-book. There were 4, 3-page papers weekly discussion boards. This was not a hard class!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Would take again

reviews.comment: There is no way you can really study for the exams. The exams are over information she says in class, but she does not write anything down that ends up on the exam. The exam questions are the most random questions that you could think of and most the time are not in the text book or clearly covered in class.

She is very helpful and gives clear instruction and grading, but the class was strictly lecture, usually went the full time, and was not the most interesting.  The papers were short but could be difficult.  I had a strong background in music going in so it wasn't awful.

Miss Fulton's class is kind of a "you're on your own" type class. All notes you have to take by yourself from the textbook, because her notes are very vague and virtually useless. If you have a general understanding of music you'll be fine, I didn't take notes once and pulled out an A. Textbook is MANDATORY for passing.

She was not a great teacher. Class was a lot harder than expected for 100 level class. She assigned a few papers throughout semester, but each had same guidelines, just different eras. Was unclear with what would be on tests, so had to study on your own for those. Lectures were a little weird; wrote random words on board and tried to explain them.

Ms. Fulton is a pretty decent teacher. Her expectations were unclear at first, but, her tests and paper rubrics all follow the same format so you know what to look for. I will say though, that the class itself could be difficult for people with no musical background. A huge reason I have an A is that I have nearly 15 years of violin under my belt.

Her notes are very scattered and unclear. She writes one word on the board and expects you to understand its context. She reviews for the test but it's basically the same as her confusing notes, not helpful. Doesn't matter how hard you study you will still be thrown a curve on the test. Lots of papers, but those actually help boost your grade.

Terrible Professor, one of the worst I've had. Averages of 40's on most of his tests and doesn't feel the need to curve. Lectures are useless because of his heavy accent plus a lisp. His handwriting is also atrocious, which isn't good in equations. Gets very stressful at times, but his grade weights are generous. (hw was 25%)

At first, I thought he was awful - heavy accent and his handwriting is atrocious. You get used to it though and find he's not all that bad - his lectures are mostly examples and his exams are shorter and usually easier than the other sections (but they're still very hard). Still not a very "good" professor, but he's new - you could do worse.

We call him the Guz, The absolute worst professor I have ever had at UK!!! He talks like he has peanut butter in his mouth and needs a glass of milk. All his lecture are is him rewriting the examples in the book. You can not distinguish his pi from an r or an s. He writes in cursive on the board. His tests are impossible. Beware the GUZ!!!

Fran does the exact examples from the textbook all year long. The only difference is you can actually read what's written in the textbook. He's hard to understand and his explanations are rarely helpful. I'm sure the guy knows his stuff since he's got a doctorate for physics, but this guy cannot teach.
Very heavy Spanish accent combined with an extremely fast pace makes his lectures nearly impossible to understand. Don't expect to learn much from him
Guzman knows what he's talking about when it comes to material, however his lectures are very unorganized and he is kind of soft spoken. Tests are really hard, but there are curves.

I learned a lot in this class and Ms. Fulmer did a good job with spreading the material out so that the 3 hours didn't feel so long.  My only complaint is that sometimes when you approached her with questions or disagreed with her, she could get defensive and snappy.  All in all though, I thought she did a fine job teaching this class.

Professor Fulmer is an excellent professor!  She really cares about us as students and has a lot of social work experience.  I learned a lot in her class and was never bored. I hope to have her again!
Professor Fulmer is very interesting and uses relevant examples from the field to keep our attention.  I will be able to use the information I learned in this class throughout my social work career.

PROFESSOR Fulmer is an EXCELLENT professor! She is the most relatable, relevant, and interesting one I have had thus far. Her lectures are extremely interesting even though her class is almost 3 hours. Her past experience in the field makes her an ideal candidate for this class. She has such passion for the field of social work! Extremely helpful!
She is in her own world, loves art, and clearly does not like students who aren't art-oriented, like myself. But the class is super easy and kind of fun. You use photostop and final cut pro. Take it.

She is a very nice woman, and you can tell she loves seeing what her students have created in class. She can be vague and confusing at times with instructions, but its not that bad. I loved critique days because she always gave really nice, helpful input. The class is easy and fun, she gives you total creative freedom. Great prof. Take her class.
Can be very broad and unclear with what she wants but makes up for it by being understanding. Recommended.
Don't do it. Just don't do it.
Great class , great teacher. She is q wonderful professor.
Furlough is an awesome teacher. She is extremely nice to her students but also a good teacher. She is understanding and is always willing to help her students.
Wonderful! I loved her and am taking her class next semester
Fantastic pofessor, one of the best UK has to offer.  Extremely helpful, extremely kind.  Highly recommended.

I don't understand the negative ratings for this intelligent professor.  Her readings can be lengthy but if you have trouble getting them completed before class she is forgiving.  Also, she invites feedback about her test format and general teaching style and is always willing to answer questions (no matter how stupid).  I found her tests easy.

Dr. Furlough is a demanding professor, but very willing to help outside of class.  Spent a lot of time with me and helped me improve my work.  Heavy reading load (300-500 pages/wk).  I often did not care for the works she assigned, emphasis on post-modernism and theroy, a lot of gender and cultural.

Ellen is a novice in everything she teaches.  Frankly, I don't understand how she became a professor.  I suppose teaching ability has nothing to do with getting your PhD, as she is living proof of that.
A bad choice.  A very awkward and irritable person.  Do not take 606 with her unless you enjoy 20th century feminist propaganda.

Denise is a WONDERFUL teacher. She really does give you a crazy range of insight and different views and will talk to you about your takes on literature and will point out the holes in your argument to help it be stronger. She is VERY quick at gettting back grades. One of the best teachers I've had at UK, and she was ONLINE!

I absolutely loved English 264 online with Denise Fulbrook. All of the assignments were clearly outlined at the beginning of the semester and you set your own pace.  The online lectures were interesting and the feedback on graded assignments were prompt and fair.  If you work hard and keep up with assignments then this class is a  breeze! Take it!

Because of Mrs. Fulbrook this class was much more engaging. She made the online lessons fun and easy to follow. Her methods and insight made it much easier to understand the readings. The assignments were well thought out with ample amount of time to complete each. Definitely one of my favorite classes at UK...and I'm not even an English major! =)
This is a very good online class to take. It is flexible, and she is a really good teacher

The material itself is most definitely not the easiest, but Dr. Fulbrook is a most wonderful professor and strives to do anything and everything she can to make sure we all achieve our best. I had a better relationship with this distance-learning professor that I have with professors I see daily. She's simply amazing!

Denise is a wonderful teacher. Although the material is very dense and at times difficult, she truly shows a passion for teaching and engages students with the material as best she can.  Her feedback is incredibly helpful and she goes the extra mile to make things easier on students with due dates and expectations. Highly recommend her!!

Dense, sometimes difficult  material but Mrs. Fulbrook takes the time and energy to make the lectures engaging and you can tell she's very passionate about teaching and helping students genuinely enjoy the course.  Incredibly helpful and always willing to go the extra mile to clarify assignments/expectations. HIGHLY recommend her course!

Denise is the best professor I have ever had, the video lectures are engaging and make you want to learn more, normally bland material comes alive as she teaches. Ive had a closer relationship with this distance professor than any professor on campus-she is involved and enthusiastic.Denise makes you love what you're learning and is the best by far

Denise is excellent!  Even though she is not physically on campus and this is an online class, she is still the most attentive and helpful professor I have ever had.  She takes the time to structure the class in an efficient way and leaves detailed, helpful comments on all assignments.  I would love to take a class with her again!

My experience with this class was one of the best I have had during my time at UK. I enjoyed her ENG 262 class so much that I decided to take ENG 261 as well. I have taken numerous online classes and these two have by far been the best. She leaves the most helpful comments on papers that I have ever received. Great class!!

She teaches online, the syllabus is NOT well laid out, nor is it clear AT ALL. I have taken many other classes online, but this is by far the most difficult to keep up with. She is not that helpful, and doesn't live here so for those of you who like/need physical office hours it is not possible!

Took this online.  She is a great teacher.  For someone who is teaching via online, her comments on papers were great, and not to mention she really wants you to learn about these books. You write a decent amount, but easy enough.  Don't buy the books, get them online for free.  Well worth it, she's a great teacher.

I took this class online to fulfill graduation requirements. I thought it would be easy, but it took more time than my physical classes. I put so much effort into reading and writing for this class and still was not making the grade. So confusing! I withdrew because it was distracting from my other classes and was simply just a waste of my time.

I dreaded this class in the beginning because of the classic literature we were required to read.  I just wanted to get it over with, but Denise taught me a different way to read, a much closer look at the text.  She inspired me to dig deeper into the text.  It took time away from my other classes to give it my best, but I learned more because of t
I had this class online, so there wasn't too much interaction, but through email she was helpful.  You do have to read a few books, which isn't too fun, but she grades pretty easy.

Awesome teacher, even if I sometimes hated the material...very interesting theories/interpretations of the world, particularly her anal reproduction theory.  (NOT kidding - you must take the class to find out!!)
Outstanding!!!  You will learn so much more than the topic listed and enjoy every minute. I wish every professor came to class with equal enthusiasm, preparation, creativity and ability to motivate.
Best teacher ever.
He is defiantly the best physics 231 professor. he is super chill and his lecture are actually helpful. The class is test heavy, but if you do the practice exams you should do great.

Be prepared, as this class is very hard. However, he did his best to make it a worthwhile experience. He's very good about providing all necessary resources, lecture slides, practice tests, and homework assignments. He is definitely the professor you want to get. Be warned, he is a very sassy man and not the most approachable.

Having Dr. Gannon for PHY 231 was one of the best experiences I have had in the physics department overall. He always takes the time to explain concepts and is always willing to clarify any question. One-on-one, as he wants everyone who takes his class to pass and not fail, as he understands the struggles of having to take a course like Physics I.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: Compared to my high school AP Physics 1 class, this was so so so much easier. If you took physics in high school, especially AP, you won't really need to try in this course. Most of your grade is homework, and the exams are quite easy. You can even drop your lowest midterm. Even if you struggle with physics, Gannon makes getting an A attainable.

I had Gannon for PHY 231. If you've never taken physics before, this course will inevitably be challenging. However, an A is doable, and he explains difficult physics concepts very clearly. The homework is lengthy, but necessary, as the exams are exactly like the homework questions and often the exact same problems. The iClickers were very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Gannon is a solid pick, I wouldn't have taken anyone else for PHY231! Midterms are only 25% of our grade while homework is 35%, and then a final worth 15%, and theres always questions just like the practice tests on the actual tests, makes it harder to fail than to pass! Gannon definitely understands how many struggle in physics and accommodates.

Dr. Gannon taught advanced mechanics really, really well. His grading on the homework was generous and his exams were pretty much just examples from in class. Allows an 8.5x11, front-back cheat sheet, so it's kind of hard not to do well. His lectures follow the textbook (Taylor), so it's easy to catch up if you miss class.

Best PHY231 Professor! Physics is hard regardless of professor but the way Gannon grades is the best. Homework takes a long time and is kinda hard so do in advance but go to theStudy. Exams can be tough so do the practice exam and the unsolved lecture questions. Lectures can be boring but informative. I never bough the textbook and did fine!
he taught physics 1 pretty well! i understood everything but be prepared to take notes outside of class. he goes somewhat fast during lectures, so just beware of that.

Slideshows during lectures do have a lot of material, but he does post them on canvas before class. He also doesn't take off on homework for incorrect attempts! Going to class is highly recommended but if you miss a day of class you won't fall too far behind as long as you look at the slides and answer the iclicker question.

He teaches well for the most part, however a lot of the lectures heavily go over conceptual things, or take a long time to get to the final equation you need. As well as lectures bleeding into the next lecture because he runs out of time.

Dr. Gannon is a solid physics teacher. He's very to the point and does not enjoy unnecessary interjections, but is happy to answer legit questions. He teaches from content-heavy slides, but not all info is needed, you are better off listening to what he says. Group work done daily, and moderately heavy homework given weekly. Attend office hours!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: As long as you pay attention in class and study for the exams, you will be successful. Gannon is really approachable and works hard to answer any questions you may have.

Lectures are decent, however I wish he would do more examples instead of explaining how the formulas work. But thats most physics professors honestly. But hes pretty chill and seems to care about his students.

Gannon is not the worst physics professor at UK; however, he is not the go-to in my opinion. He is very boring and reads directly off the slides (his slides are pretty useful though). The worst part is his tests. His tests are significantly harder than both the practice tests and the other professor's tests. Make sure you take advantage of EC.
Not available, doesn't show examples. Is verbatim to PowerPoint slides with no extra explanation of more difficult content.
Not too boring of a lecturer and his notes are really all you have to study with extra hw problems.
She was a very nice teacher and clearly cared a lot about her students. She had very good advice
Dr friedrich is an overall amazing proffesor as well as an amazing person. She genuinely cares about her students and wants everyone to succeed. I love her.

Dr. Friedrich is amazing! She is so sweet and very understanding. PSY195 is just a career planning and info class so the level of difficulty was very easy. But, she cares deeply about teaching and her students. Very good to take as a psych major and can answer any questions about material or anything in general. One of my favorites.

Honestly, this has been my easiest class. She was a great professor. Knew how to explain thing in a way that was easy to digest. You do have to show up to class, as she will not post any notes on Canvas, but the lectures are fun and interesting. We did not have a textbook. Everything you needed for homework was embedded within the work itself.

I took her 310 and 195 at the same time. Its not that I wouldn't take her class again, it's not like I wouldn't take her class again, its more like if I had a choice. Exam 1 will get u bc some of the definitions are same (i failed), 2nd is much easier! She doesn't give out the PPs which sucks. EXs in class are key to understanding the content more!
One of the nicest professors ever.  I didn't love all of the in class activities, but honestly she made up for it and her tests were fair!
Andrea's PSY100 class is a great choice. Her engaging lectures and kind personality make up for the challenging exams. I found Unstuck ai and ChatGPT helpful for study prep.

Super interesting lectures and she is obviously excited about the material. She doesn't take attendance but there are a few in class assignments that can only be done if you're in class. You should really study for tests, but if you spend a decent amount of time reviewing notes and going through the homework assignments you'll be fine.
