I really liked her bubbly personality, and you could tell she cared for her students. I will say that you should definitely study and take notes for the test. Also, you need to make sure you don't miss any homework assignments, because she doesn't take late work, and there are only 500 points in the whole course (each homework is worth 10 points)

It's obvious she cares about her students and she's very understanding! Lectures were interesting and you should show up since they aren't posted. The tests were a lot harder than the study guides so make sure to really study the material and have examples in mind for everything.

she was a sweet person but i hated her lectures. definitely passionate about cognition but rambles and drags things out. you MUST take the notes in class, because she doesn't believe in uploading the power points. will do in-class assignments randomly. grades on a 500-point scales (i.e: 450-500 is an A).

I love Andrea's lectures. She is so sweet and engaging. Her tests, however are very hard and very application based. Take good notes on everything she says, not just whats on the slides. She doesn't post the slides either. That said, her engaging lecture and kind personality make up for it
She was an amazing professor I would love to have her again if I could.

This class is easy except for when it comes to exams. lecture is not required but you should attend if you want to receive a good grade on the exams. Labs and sona participation is super easy to complete. The professor tends to wander off topic and does not post her slideshows or send them to you if you are absent which makes exams a struggle.

Andrea is the best PSY 100 professor and truly cares about her students. Labs are fully online, and your grade depends on labs and exams alone. The exams were not cumulative and she offered multiple extra credit opportunities in the last 2 weeks of the semester. There is a lot of material but much of it is self-explanatory.

If I had to take psych again, I would take it online.  All you do in class is write notes. The only work outside of class is the lab, research participation, and a few discussion posts. Her test and kinda hard. She does offer the textbook free online.  Attendance is not mandatory and if you can get the notes from someone, you don't need to go.

She is a really good teacher. If you are taking PSY 100, you need to take her. She is so nice and caring and gives such easy notes. Her tests are a little hard so just pay attention in class. Such an easy teacher, take her.

Her class is easy if you go to lectures. A lot of students can get a decent grade by just lectures but I found it to be easier if I also took notes from the textbook. She provides the textbook for free online. Her tests always have at least one question that you cannot get wrong but otherwise you'll most likely need to do some studying.

Very good, actually learned in this class! 
Go to lectures!
I love her. Her teaching style is easy to follow. I'd take a class of hers every semester if I could.
Her attitude

The best I mean take her for psychology you will not regret it. Her lectures are great and the examples she provides are on point. Your best friend is definitely the study guide she provides for each exam! She is a 6/5 hands down

She was very nice and also easy to get ahold of. She doesn't take attendance but I would recommend attending class for the lectures because everything in the lectures will be on the exams. If you do the labs and study for the exams, you'll be fine. She says you are supposed to be reading the "textbook" outside of class but I didn't and had a B.
Professor Friedrich did a very good job at teaching the material. The grades are from weekly labs and four tests. Not a hard class at all, just go to lectures and take notes and you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: just don't

Do not take Professor Friedrich!! She is horrible at responding to emails, and her lectures have a ton of videos rather than her teaching the content herself. The tests were in a horrible format where every time you answer a question you cannot go back, with answers not getting released later so students could review what they got wrong.

Professor Friedrich made notes very interesting. I really enjoyed the way she taught the class. The exam content was based on application and so it was not easy to answer 60 questions in 60 minutes but the exams, content wise, was fair.

This class was just lots of online video lectures (due to COVID). She was understanding, but the lectures seemed like they were filmed for middle school children. The lab component was extremely boring and tedious. Exams were average, just like most of the class. She seems like a very nice teacher, but definitely felt like a 100-level class.
Hard test but easy labs every week.

Dr. Friedrich is very knowledgeable about her field, and she's also very friendly and approachable! Attendance is mandatory, and she also doesn't post her lecture slides, so definitely go to class. The textbook is "required" but I never bought it and never needed to. Overall good class!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: I absolutely love professor Friedrich. She is super sweet and the lectures are easy to follow. She does have a heavy accent but you will get used to it very quickly. The tests are pretty basic just study a bit before and youll be fine!

Andrea is a great professor! She can be a little hard to understand at times, but overall does not make the class too difficult. The tests are more example based than definition based, but there are helpful reviews prior to the exams. There is also a quizlet made before each exam I used to study under the user: tntharp1
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Don't even bother reaching out to this professor for help, she won't answer. You can blow up her email and she still won't answer. If she does, she's very short and not helpful. Took this class during COVID so we couldn't meet in person but still wouldn't set up zoom with me. Cares so little about helping her students and does the bare minimum.

Dr. Friedrich is a great psych professor. Attendance isn't mandatory, but she doesn't post the lecture powerpoints so it might as well be. I hardly ever studied for any of the exams and got an A on every single one. All you have to do is show up and take notes. Easy A, and the final isn't cumulative.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is a pretty good psychology professor but she is kind of hard to understand at points. She is very passionate about psych and talks very quick. She does always have a review session before the tests, & if you study you should do well on the exams. There is also Sona research which is worth many points and should be completed as soon as you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Classes are her reading from powerpoints and us taking notes, doesn't post them online so try not to miss a class. Tests usually have some questions that are specific and not really talked about, have yet to get an A on an exam. Outside online labs and SONA research can be done between periods.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is super sweet and makes sure that you understand the concepts when she talks about them. Take really good notes though, so that means that going to class is very important. The tests are a little tough since they are centered around examples instead of definitions, but the class is pretty doable. Don't take if you're lazy and don't go to class
Very sweet and cares about her class. Exams are a little hard so pay attention to lectures and labs

She's nice but hard to understand, her exams are hard! 4 exams 75 pts (2) and 100 pts (2). I did well on first 2 and bad on the 3rd so couldn't get an A. for a 100 level class the exams are harder than you would think.

she is not from the U.S. very hard to understand. i made the mistake of not paying attention at all this semester and my grade reflects that. she actually is very hard that is no joke. do not take this for an easy A

Absolutely loved Dr. Fierdrich. Very sweet and cares about your success! Also, super approachable and will help explain anything you don't understand. Listen to her examples because they will be on the test. Just listen to her lectures and youll get an A. DEFINITELY recommend taking her.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is very consistent. Once you learn her system you always know what is coming next.
Wonderful professor! She relates all of her content to everyday scenarios and it's super easy to understand.
Professor Friedrich cares about her material and her students success. Go to class and take good and thorough notes and you will do fine. Tests are somewhat difficult, spend time studying the notes.

Dr. Freiedrich is a great professor and definitely knows what she is talking about when teaching. Often give hilarious personal stories relating to the topic shes teaching. Would take her classes again in the future.
She obviously cares a lot about her subject and is excited to teach her students.
The textbook is online and free. Her lectures are good and contain a lot of information and she does not post them. She has study reviews before the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Friedrich is very good at teaching the information presented in lecture but makes the content more difficult than it should be. Homework is usually a way for people to boost their grades overall if they do poorly on tests. The homework is graded way too harshly and you don't even get feedback on it many times. The essays on tests on the same way.

She was a very nice professor and her lectures are somewhat interesting. She makes handouts of the notes which are helpful. However, her homeworks are unnecessarily time consuming and some are graded very tough. Her tests are much harder than they need to be. She assigns a group video project that is extremely pointless.
She is very nice and the class can be considered easy so long as you attend. However even with attendebce the tests are difficult. You will not be tested on terms but on applying them

Andrea is an amazing professor! She is a super nice lady who makes lectures enjoyable. The labs were online and super easy. Attendance is not mandatory but her tests come directly from her lecture notes so I definitely don't recommend skipping! Super easy class.

Definitely my favorite professor of the semester. Lectures are very easy to follow because she uses powerpoint and gives you time to take notes. Everything on the exams will be covered in class. Very easy to get a hold of outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I showed up for lecture and took all of my notes in the form of quizlet with the study guide for each test open. Studied the notecards the night before, and got an A on every test. Andrea is so sweet and honestly such an easy teacher. Definitely recommend!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: If you pay attention in lecture and take notes you hardly have to study for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: She was a wonderful professor who genuinely loved all of her students and what she was talking about. As long as you take notes, do the online labs, and study for exams you should pass with a high grade. I would definitely take her again, only thing I would do differently is start signing up for SONA research as soon as it begins.

TAKE HER. Class is extremely easy, no need to read the online texts. The only outside of class work are the online labs once a week that are SUPER easy and quick. Exam material is literally straight from her powerpoints, so just type down everything on the powerpoints, read over it all a couple times before the exam and you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: I love this teacher! She is the reason I am going to pursue a minor in psych simply because I want to learn more. Definitely take her if you have the opportunity. She reminds me a lot of my own mom!!!

Andrea Friedrich is very sweet, and her love for psychology seems to make the class much more interesting than it already is. Shes very helpful, and gives many reminders for due dates and deadlines. I definitely recommend taking a course with her. You wont regret it!
Cares about her students. Tests are not very hard if you pay attention and take notes!
Nicest professor I had at UK. Go out of your way to take her! Her tests are super easy if you go to lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Friedrich is entertaining and a really nice lady. She explains the content very well but often rambles. Lectures are informative but boring. This class was laughably easy, and she's a great professor. Labs were super easy. Just know the concepts. If she doesn't get to material, she takes it off the exams. Definitely take her!

Dr. Friedrich is an incredible person and I absolutely adored her class. Her accent is thick but easy to get used to, she provides so many examples for everything and makes difficult material so much easier to follow. There was a project and weekly homework along with exams, but it was never overwhelming.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Friedrich!! She uses a lot of examples to help us understand the content. Explains everything very well.  Labs are easy! As long as you come to class, take notes, and study you will pass easily! Very interesting class!
Andrea is the sweetest professor I've ever had. I loved her class and she was a genuinely nice person.

Dr. Friedrich is really awesome. Her test questions require application rather than memorization. She moves pretty slowly in lecture, so the class is not overwhelming. The lectures and readings are not always connected, so reading the textbook is not enough to do well. Otherwise, she's pretty easyand actually delightful.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I never showed up for class, and still managed a B in the class--i underestimated the difficulty of material. It's truly not THAT hard to understand, but i would advise to go to class because she gives really great examples that help on the exam (ok, i went a couple times and i had her for PSY100).
Dr. Friedrich is such a great professor! She is so sweet and the class is very manageable. Definitely take her if you get the chance.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Friedrich is a very caring and compassionate professor. She makes sure everyone understands the material and goes at a reasonable pace. She also tells GREAT examples that make complex concepts easier to comprehend.

Andrea is a great professor. She always takes her time explaining things during lecture, making material easier to understand. The tests can be difficult, because it is about applying the information not just knowing it. Once you get a good grip on note taking and study methods, this class is a breeze! There is no homework, only 1 paper, and 4 test
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Friedrich is engaging, enthusiastic and intelligent. Good lectures, would definitely recommend going but not absolutely necessary to pass. Despite a few others saying her tests are very hard, they are not above a 100 level course difficulty. I would recommend Dr. Friedrich to anyone.
Good professor
Super nice but class lectures are hard to follow along. Lots of material on each exam so make sure you go to her class to keep up!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Andrea is an amazing professor. Full of energy, very sweet, and incredibly caring for a 300-student lecture. One major paper in the class- make sure you turn it in on time. Makes lectures interesting. Doesn't put notes online, but skipping a few classes won't kill your grade.

reviews.comment: I loved Professor Freidrich! She was by far the best professor I've had

Dr. Friedrich was a super nice lady! She was always so friendly and her lectures were  good! She is Brazilian, but her accent never got in the way of understanding her lectures. Class is not mandatory, buy her tests are all based on lecture, so I would recommend going!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Friedrich is great! She wants you to understand the overall concepts not the exact definition for exams. She uses a lot of examples, one of them being how she classically conditioned her daughter. Try to sit in the front row b/c the slides are hard to read sometimes, her mic doesn't always work, and she remembers you (which is a good thing)!
Very energetic and always ready to help

She is a very good professor, but her test are extremely hard and if you don't attend lecture you have no chance of passing. Studying is a must or you won't pass because her test are extremely difficult.

Glad I had Dr. Friedrich as my prof for my first PSY class. I highly recommend her! She is funny and understanding to her students. This is a very large lecture class so you will not really get one on one time with her, but there are tons of resources to help you out. Always go to class because your grade is basically tests and your few lab grades.
This is the second time I have had Dr. Friedrich and just like before, she is fantastic. If you have the ability to have her as your professor, jump on it!

Andrea was such a great professor! Lectures were amazing and SO easy to follow along with. She presents the material in a very memorable way which makes studying for the tests a little less daunting. Tests are all multiple choice and if you go to class and take the notes you will pass! I didn't have the textbook and I did just fine.

I loved the class. Andrea's a great professor! If you are worried about her accent, don't be; she is very aware of it and will repeat anything if you don't understand what she is saying. Also, attend class and study all examples she gives. All exam material comes from lecture and if she doesn't cover a topic it will NOT be on the exam.
She is literally the sweetest woman you will ever meet. Attend class, as exam material comes straight from the lectures.  Awesome professor.

THIS CLASS HAS NO HOMEWORK!!! MOST PSYCH CLASSES DO! To pass: Go to class/lab, take notes, and actually understand the topics. Don't just memorize definitions and stuff. Actually relate them to real life examples so that you understand them more. Do that and you'll be fine!
She is awesome. So sweet and helpful. The exams come straight from notes so don't buy the book! Lectures are always interesting.

SHES AMAZING AND SO NICE AND SO CUTE AND FUNNY. LOVE HER AND WISH I HAD HER FOR ALL MY CLASSES. SOMETIMES THE TA'S ARE ANNOYING AND NOBODY LIKES LAB BUT THE LECTURES ARE GREAT. SHES REALLY FRIENDLY AND SWEET.
All the tests are straight out of the notes, make notecards for her lectures and you'll easily get an A. There's not a lot of homework at all. Don't buy the book

She's very willing to help you if you ask for it.  Don't be afraid to ask her to clarify something, because she does have a thick accent.  DON'T SKIP LECTURE!  Pay attention to all of the examples that she gives - including the ones about her family.  They will more than likely be reiterated on the test.

She's brazilian and has a very thick accent, but her powerpoint are very clear. If you don't come to lectures there is almost no way you will pass because she says things on the text that are specifically on the exam. She's very nice and willing to help.
She is great. Recommend her for PSY 100. She understand students. LOL
The class was mainly her assigning group presentations and then interjecting feedback and advice, so it was a really chill class.

She's truly passionate about what she does and inspires me to be passionate about what I want to do with my psychology degree. There is only one assignment in this class, it's a group project and it's super easy. You pick your topic, sign up for it, do the project and that's it. I enjoy going to class, it's great!

She's such a wonderful professor. She's truly passionate about what she does and inspires me to be passionate about what I want to do with my psychology degree. There is only one assignment in this class, it's a group project and it's super easy. You pick your topic, sign up for it, do the project and that's it. I enjoy going to class, it's great!

She's the best. I have had her twice my freshman year and I'm looking to be in any of her other classes offered as much as possible throughout my college career. She inspired me to look into a career that I never knew existed. I absolutely LOVE her. EVERYBODY should take her. She's super sweet too.

She is a great teacher. Book not necessary because all info on exams are given in lecture that attendance isn't, required unless you want to pass. Hardest part is the discretion of the grades in Lab depending on TA. Easy A. I only got a B because I did not attend class when school first started, and I failed test. GO TO CLASS AND TAKE NOTES & STUDY

Really enjoyed this class. Dr. Friedrich's a very happy person knows Psych inside out. She's from Brazil & has an accent, but isn't an issue. If anything she'll laugh with the class when she can't pronounce a word correctly.  Tests seem easy but are fairly hard. BUT she lets students vote on how many Qs there are, & if they'll be MC or TF.

Dr. Friedrich is a great professor! Her lecture notes are very clear and she gives a lot of examples. The exams are pretty easy if you go to class - basically everything she covers in lecture is on the exam. She also provides study guides. I would recommend taking her!

First off, I never bought the book for this class.  That being said, I went to almost every lecture and got an A.  Her tests are directly from lecture, and if you pay attention and take good notes, it is an easy A .  She is a good lecturer and understands she has a thick accent so she makes sure to speak clearly.  Great class.

Dr. Friedrich was very reasonable. She always presents material with a smile on her face and it seems like she loves doing it. Her class is very straight-forward, simple, and organized. She is very approachable and is a fair grader with average tests. Would definitely recommend.
She covers everything on the test in each lecture and they are interesting as well. Tests are easy and as long as you go to class, it is an easy A.

Great teacher, her test are her exact notes and she takes topics off the test if she did not cover it. I would go to class if you are taking her lecture because she says a few things that aren't in the notes
Dr. Friedrich is such a good teacher. As long as you go to lecture/lab you should do well. Tests are easy and come directly from lectures. Overall it's a good course for the core requirement!
Fantastic teacher - just FANTASTIC

All of her classes are taught the same. She provides outlined notes. I recommend going to class, as she expands on what's in the outline and you will be lost if you don't. She gives study guides for the test and it's taken directly from what's taught in class.

Very friendly professor. She posted outlines of her notes online to follow along in class/take extra notes on. Her tests were easy if you study.  I would recommend going to class most of the time and definitely study prior to tests.

If you go to class, take notes, and look over the study guide it's an easy A. Professor Friedrich lays out information in a very simple and easy way. There's no tricks, and exams are only over information she's covered in lecture! Take her if possible.
Wonderful professor! I've had her for PSY 100 and PSY 215. Her lectures are very clear and easy to follow. She only tests you over what she covers in class; you don't even need the textbook.

Dr. Friedrich's class was my favorite at UK! Her lectures were great, everything was clear and if you had any problems understanding she could come up with an example that helped clarify. Take this class!

Dr. Friedrich is an amazing teacher! Her lectures are always interesting and easy to follow. I try to take her for as many psych classes as i can after having her for intro to psych. Her tests are easy to study for and she doesn't require you to buy a textbook. I would recommend taking her for whatever classes you can.
super easy  just go to class and pay attention you wont even have to really study for the exams.

Super easy class.  All the notes from the lectures are on the test; she doesn't put any other material on the exams.  Attendance isn't mandatory but you must get the lecture notes to pass the class.  Labs were also super easy.

Dr. Friedrich is a great professor. If you go to lecture, you will barely have to study. I never opened my textbook and still wound up with an A. She gives good examples and makes the material interesting. I highly recommend her.
Dr.Friedrich is awesome. Everything on her tests are from her powerpoints-every single question-and she organizes her powerpoints extremely well and simply. Definitely take her for 215.
By far the best professor I have had at UK! Knows so much about psychology and cares for her students grades and understanding. Tests are not too bad and she explains everything in a lot of detail.
She had a wealth of knowledge about the subject matter as it was her area of research. The material was presented in a straight forward manner and exams were straight from the notes.
absolutely awesome teacher. one of the best. super friendly, always willing to help, and overall a really great experience. love her!

BEST PROFESSOR EVER!!!!She is absolutely wonderful to say the least. She always keeps class really interesting by providing examples from her own life, I really liked that because I feel like you get to know her better. She does have an accent but after the first week you get used to it and then it just adds to her bubbly personality. Great class!
GREAT class. She has powerpoint slides that go along with notes. The notes are exactly what's on the test and she gives you a study guide. She has a lot of charisma and keeps the class interesting.

LOVE LOVE LOVE this class and this teacher. She is one of my favorite teachers so far! I really loved her lectures but hated recitation because there was really no point to it. Dr. Fredrich is so helpful if you don't understand something and is so sweet! Definitely take her if you have the opportunity.

She has a bit of an accent because she's from Brazil, but that will only take a couple days to get over it. She is very helpful always making sure we understand material and goes at a good pace right along with whats in the book. She also gives a study guide for tests. Easy A

Nicest, happiest, most passionate and helpful professor ever! Easy A, simply go to class. PowerPoints are not posted so always take your own notes. Make class fun & very interesting. Talks about her children a lot and uses many many examples to explain the topics discussed. Easy to understand and makes the time go by very quickly!

Has to be the best psych professor at UK! I LOVE THIS PROFESSOR. She has an accent, but it isn't bad and she's aware of it and tries her very best to make sure students understand her. Super easy class, never touched the book. Attendance isn't required but she doesn't put the ppt slides online so it is helpful to go to class. Never gives homework!

Best psychology professor at UK without a doubt. She stayed after class so I could get the notes when I had to miss a class. She's very considerate and a wonderful person, which makes her a great professor.

Attend class & take good notes. Textbook not mandatory for an A. Study notes well before exam & get an A. She covers material very in depth and slow. If she can't cover material before exam, she doesn't test on it. Asks class what info we want on exam & what format (# of questions, etc.). Great professor.
Super professor, really interested in her subject and conveys that passion to her students. Very helpful, available to students outside of class. Highly recommend!

Best teacher I have EVER had. She is such a wonderful instructor. She is passionate, easy to understand, and friendly. Don't bother buying the book unless you skip class. Attendance is not mandatory, but she doesn't post slides online, so do whatever work. Her tests are easy, I've gotten a 100% on one. (She doesn't curve) I highly recommend her.

One of the best professors I've ever had. Extremely clear, friendly, approachable; if you attend class, you won't need the book, but if you skip class, you can just read the book and catch up! A wonderful teacher.

Tests are composed directly from the notes. Uses a variety of slide lectures and short videos. Tries to give clear examples. Has a slight accent that was distracting for a few days. Very nice and willing to work with you.
YAY
Really knows her stuff and I already have a psych minor and this class made me want to become a major!
Love, love, loved this class so much that I even acquired psych as a minor! Dr. Friedrich presents the material in an easy-to-understand manor and makes the subject fun with lots of great examples.

Andrea is by far the best teacher I've had at UK! She is always friendly and helpful and understanding! Her tests are easy as long as you read over your notes; the textbook is DEFINITELY NOT REQUIRED!! Such an easy class, and very interesting too. :)

Her class is very easy & she explains the material really well.  As long as you go to class and pay attention, you will be fine on exams. Don't buy book unless you plan on missing a lot of class -I missed a few and the book was helpful.  Exams are only over what she covers in class and very easy. Look over notes 2x before & you can get an A easily
Such a sweet lady! Loved her class. Didn't buy the text book and missed a couple classes and got an A. Take her!!

Took her for PSY 100, 215, 216, and 311. She explains everything in lots of detail and gives plenty of examples. At times, this is a negative, because it makes the class move along sluggishly, but it makes for an easy A if you go to class and pay attention. She is also super understanding and helpful. One, if not, my favorite teachers at UK

Fav prof at UK! She gives very clear and specific examples in class to help you understand concepts better. I got an A in the class just by studying her notes. She'll tell you not to buy the book b/c you ONLY need to study HER notes. You need to go to class everyday to copy her ppt slides. The TA's grade REALLY hard in every section!

She is a wonderful professor- definitely take her if you can.  The PSY 215 material is a little boring, but she admits this in the beginning, and gives great examples to try and make class a little more fun.  I've signed up for her PSY 311 class in the fall as well.

I loved going to class everyday just to see this beautiful Brazilian goddess teach. She is one of the nicest people I know, and is very helpful and the class is very easy to do well in. Highly recommend
I love this professor. You can tell she has a passion for psychology and she always gives great examples. I will be taking her for 215 in the fall!

I love andrea! If you go to all the classes or at least get the notes from all of the classes you will get an A. She is very accommodating. I took her for psych 100 and 215 and I am taking her for 311.

This class is great! I didn't go to class once and I got a B plus. She is the easiest of all the psych 100 teachers and she is super nice. Also, she was pregnant when I had her! Still nice! I would recommend her for sure!
She is one of the easiest psych teachers at UK and the tests come from lectures not the book!

She is an AMAZING professor.  This is the easiest class I have ever taken.  Do not buy the book...everything on the tests are straight from lecture notes.  You should go to class, and make sure to get the study guide before tests.  She is SOO Nice and extremely helpful.  I am taking her next fall for 215 because I liked her so much!

Very easy class, study a couple of days before the exam and you should be fine. Go to class, get the notes, the test are over those only. Book is not a necessity. Great teacher, in fact i'm signed up for her PSY 216 and PSY 311 class.

I have also had her for PSY 311, 215 and 216. She is my favorite teacher at UK. She is very easy as well as interesting. You do not need to purchase the book and if you go to class and take notes you will get an A. I never studied more than reading over my notes one time. Take her for every class that you can
She is an excellent professor.  Unlike some other professors, she doesn't write her own reviews.  The textbook supplements her lectures well.  Ya.

Tests were pretty hard. A lot of it came from the book, MAKE SURE YOU GET THE STUDY GUIDE!!! The class itself was pretty boring, but that's expected with this material (she even tells you it will be boring at the beginning)
Understandable, but class is still a drag.  Awesome accent!
Great professor. Uses really good examples in lecture to help you understand material. Exams aren't hard, just read over your notes several times. Going to lab definitely helps your grade too.
Very wonderful professor. Really helps content stick in such a dry boring class. Tests are strictly based on the notes she gives in class, so attendance is recommended, however, not mandatory.

I've taken Andrea for two courses (215 & 311) & I've really enjoyed her teaching. She's always cheerful & doing her best to make sure you understand her during lecture. You don't need the textbook if you attend lecture regularly -- she is straight forward & provides study guides for each exam. She will clear up misunderstandings with her accent.

Super easy class, tests come straight from lecture.  I bought book and didn't use it.  I skipped all the lectures for one test, bought KY Class notes and got an 88.  She is entertaining and easy to solve conflicts with.  Make sure you do all your research hours because she doesn't make exceptions for those.

I had Andrea for 100 and 215 and I'm taking her for 311. She is very friendly and really cares about her students. She's Brazilian, but isn't that difficult to understand and her tests are straight from her lectures - no need in buying the books!

She is awesome! I hate lecture classes but I truly enjoyed her class. She tells such interesting stories to go along with the material its much easier to pay attention in her class than in my other lecture classes. Her tests are relatively easy if you are there to take notes in class. She gives great study guides as well. Definately take her class!

Pretty interesting class. VERY passionate about psych- she will tell you her experiments about putting mice in sensory deprived boxes to test if they get addicted to drugs or not... creepy but whatever.
Easy class, good professor, and for an entry level psych class she keeps it fairly interesting and relevant.
She is a great teacher!!!!!You should definitely take her.
She is a great lecturer(sp) and her exams reflect the class notes about 96%. A higher course receives paper notes. 215 & 311 she gives a study guide. Solid B, work hard to get an A

She is probably the nicest and most helpful professor I have had in college. The class was somewhat boring but that was because of the material being taught. Attendence is not required but is very beneficial because she explains all the of the subject matter in great detail. If you go to class and study an A or B is very possible.
Good teacher. Sometimes hard to understand. Easy. No book required.
great teacher.  very helpful and motivated for the sucess of each student.

Meh, I found her lectures rather boring and dull -- occasionally an interesting ancedote was thrown it, but her overuse of examples was quite a bit of a turn off. Take the class for an easy A, but not if you want to get excited about psychology.

My favorite professor of my entire college career! Had her for PSY 100 and PSY 215 as well. Her PSY 311 class isn't as easy as 100 and 215, but as long as you go to class and take notes it's not too difficult. She is very helpful and so incredibly nice!

Andrea is the best teacher I've ever had at UK. Her lectures are fun and enjoyable. She loves teaching and really knows her stuff. Her exams are straight from her powerpoints and she will never include anything on the exams that hasnt been covered in class. I loved her! Class was so fun!!

She is such an amazing teacher! I love Andrea, she wants you to call her that. Notes are straight from powerpoints, all test questions come from her notes or what she said in class. Tests are easy and that lab is not hard either. Take this class with her! We never use the book, don't even bother buying it.

She is such an amazing teacher! I love Andrea, she wants you to call her that. Notes are straight from powerpoints, all test questions come from her notes or what she said in class. Tests are easy and that lab is not hard either. Take this class with her! We never use the book, don't even bother buying it.
She was an amazing teacher! Her tests are really easy. She loves teaching and the students respond well to her. Great class

Most adorable teacher ever. She makes sure you understand all the concepts really well. If you go to class, there's no need for the book, her tests are all from what she goes over in class. Tests were all pretty easy (especially the 1st one). Psych. majors take 215 with her if you have the chance.

Probably the friendliest and most helpful professor of my whole freshman year. She is funny too, especially when she mispronounces words. Her tests are simple, all you have to do is go to class and look over the review sheet. If you take this course, make sure you take her, even if you have to wait until the next semester, because it is worth it.
I really liked Andrea.  She only tests on the material she covers in class so if you go to class theres not much studying you have to do for her.

She's a great teacher. She has a powerpoint that explains everything very well. She gives a review outline before every test.  As long as you know what's on the outline, you'll ace it. The book is helpful for extra examples on things you're not clear about, but not necessary. She's a great teacher. I have an A, and don'really do much.

She's soo nice and has a really easy class. I have her this semester and I'm taking her class next semester. The TA you get will really make or break your lab. Tests are easy, lectures have a power point to go along with them. If you make at least 2 friends in that class you don't have to even worry about going all the time.

For this class all you have to is show up, take notes, and go to lab. She gives you a review sheet for each exam, which is basically every thing in your notes. Her test, she ask you straight forward questions, look over the notes about three times, out some effort in to it and you'll ace it. TAKE THIS CLASS WITH THE PROFESSOR.

great professor....over explains majority of things, but i guess thats a good thing. no need for the book test a directly from the notes, but the book will help you wil extra praticed. overall good class. watch what TA you get (Bolin dont do it). TA can make the class diffcult
Easy class, easy material. Didn't use the textbook at all. Gives handouts for notes, but its helpful to go & write in comments. Tests are all easy, straight forward multiple choice.

She is so cute and you won't fall asleep.  She gives you handouts b/c she talks really fast.  Don't buy the book!!  She gives great examples and does a review for every test.  Attend for the most part and study minimally and you will get an A!

Go to class, take notes, study, and class is easy. I think what got most people was lab. Although it's easy (two papers -- long, but quick once you get the intro done), a lot of people failed to make sure they had it correctly done before turning in the specific sections each week. Just double check with the examples in the text. Easy class!!! :)
she is very friendly and helpful. does a review before all the tests. tests are all multiple choice and easy. i strongly recommend this professor.
easy A if you get the notes and study
I love this class! She is mostly defintely the nicest professor I have had in college!

Andrea is the nicest teacher I've ever had. She really cares about her students and her teaching. I really enjoy her classes and her english is superb. Her accent makes her more interesting to listen to rather than difficult to understand like some teachers. I've had one of her classes twice now and plan on taking her again.
She is so cute and happy.  She will even modify test formats according to what the class wants.
She's so happy all the time that class is never boring even if you pay no attention.

She is a very helpful and nice teacher but the class is boring no matter what. The test are mulitiple choice but have tricky questions. the lab sucks but could be alot worse. If you have to take 215 take her.
She makes class fun by always being up beat and happy.  She explains things in a way thats easy to understand what she talking about.
She is Awesome! The best teacher ever.  I love her accent, and she makes it all very interesting!
very nice
Her accent is hard to understand sometimes, but she is always smiling and ready to teach.
Very helpful for a class that has difficult material.  Stats is never fun, but she did a good job explaining.  Definitely recommend.
Andrea is very helpful.  she will help to understand an unclear entities and she is extremely nice.  Her tests are so easy as long as you study She's only a TA so she's not hung up on a power trip.
She is a great teacher! Let's you chose what you want on your own test. Gives you alot of answers to the test on review sessions. shes also funny, too. If you are taking psych.. YOU WANT HER!

Great teacher and gets her material across at the level you can comprehend.Uses many examples which helps you remember almost everything for an exam.She is very easy, Exam2 class avg was 90% /w 200+ students.She asks the class how they prefer the exam to be made (mult choice, fill-in blnk, etc) and goes over questions almost the same as the exam's.
great teacher, extremely helpful, willing to curve & add bonus on tests.
BEST TA EVER!  If you can't get her for 215, DON'T TAKE IT!  Worked with her in the lab as well, and is just the most helpful grad student I worked with!  Amazingly sweet!
Awesome and extremely helpful. She is starting to teach some bigger classes now (Psy 311), so she might not be as available for help. Has somewhat of an accent, but is very sweet.

she is the ONLY TA to get for psy 215.....this class is soooo hard.  but she keeps labs easy and short. and she will revise your papers for you as many times as you want. plus, if you have a question about part of it she practically re-writes it for you!  she is sooooo nice! HIGHLY reccomended!!!!

If you are picking an online section for CIS 300 pick Professor Gaur. There were very few assignments, mostly discussion board posts once a week, there are 5-8 big assignment worth 50+ points BUT he is a super easy grader. You will have to do a group project towards the end which is annoying to get done but again he's a really easy grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If anyone is wondering who to take in their ICT or their communication classes then this guy is it. His lectures are top notch, he understands student schedules and needs. He's flexible, easy going, and after so many classes I have taken with him I can confirm that anything he teaches he'll teach for real world application. Learn more & enjoy it!

Raj is one of the best professors at UK. He was so knowledgeable about machine learning and really cared if we understood the material. There were only 4 assignments in the whole class, but he met with me before each to make sure I understood how to do them. Take him if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Raj is the man.
Dr Gaur is a great Professor, and I totally recommend taking his class for CIS!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Raj is frikin hilarious. If you have the chance to take him, do it. This was the first time ICT 390 was ever offered and it was pretty good for a first time class. Raj can sometimes go off on tangents, but usually they end up being funny so no big deal. He is always willing to help and cares greatly about his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: RAJ is the man!!! he's so sweet and actually really funny..a few papers but that's required for the course, but he's a gem!
Raj is a great professor, so good that I have taken two of his classes offered. He is very understanding and personable. Not to mention hilarious! For sure take Raj!
I love Raj.

Raj is one of the best professors ever! He truly cares about everyone. He loves to make jokes and relate to the students. It's amazing to have a teacher that is so understandable and always has a smile of his face. He does a great job of making everyone comfortable and really listening to what students have to say. Had him for CIS 110 and CIS 111.
raj is the best. he goes out of his way to help you and is so understanding. I would take his class a million times.

raj is a great professor not to mention he makes his class really entertaining. he's always making jokes and just over all making class much more enjoyable. don't buy the books for cis110 they will say you need them but you really don't. we don't do much work in here and when we do its pretty easy. definitely recommend!

I love Raj. He's a great guy and really funny. He doesn't grade hard and as long as you show up and participate you will get an A. 10/10 would recommend and I'm definitely taking his class next semester!

I LOVE RAJ! he so cool and absolutely hilarious! he makes the funniest references to things in class and actually finds a way to make things sound more interesting. he grades pretty easy and his class is pretty entertaining. ill most definitely be taking a class with him again. 10/10 would recommend
Raj is a great professor. Doesn't grade super hard on papers, and always explains assignments super well. As long as you show up and do the work that you're required, this class will be an easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Raj is definitely one of the best. He is super funny and really nice. I plan to take a class with him again next semester. You definitely should go to class and put effort into your papers and speeches but hes not a very hard grader and he will help you with anything you dont understand. Definitely take him if youre taking CIS
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: raj is literally the best. easy, but you'll have to work for it. raj basically outlined my whole paper for me. love u raj u the man.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Raj is so awesome. He is hilarious. He genuinely cares and is willing to work with you no matter what as long as you talk to him.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Take him if you can! He is a great guy and really funny. Show up to class event though the lectures don't really matter. You will be let out early most days. Grades really easy. Wants you to do well. Definitely the easiest class to get an A in if you just follow the rubrics.

Literally the nicest most attentive professor I've had, if you can get him to like you it's almost impossible to not get an A. Some of the papers and speeches may be a little more difficult however I never found him to be a very tough grader. The absolute best CIS 112 professor.

Raj is literally the nicest person. His class is super easy and he is a fair grader; he also is accessible outside of class and is willing to help you with papers that are for other classes. He also responds to emails faster than any other prof I have and takes a genuine interest in the wellbeing of his students. Take him he's the best!!

Raj is literally one of the best professors I've ever had. He's always willing to help you with any work (even if it's not from his class). He's an easy grader and really cares about his students. TAKE HIM!!!! I promise you won't regret it!!
Great, enthusiastic and intellectual person but still a reasonable grader! Raj is always there to help you with any assignment, even ones not form his class.

Raj is dope. Very nice and funny. Lectures stray off topic every now and ten, but they are always entertaining. You can tell he makes an effort to relate to the students and actually cares about them. Super easy grader as well.

Raj is so nice and is eager and willling to give you as much help as you need outside of class. He presents the material clearly and his enthusiasm for the topics we discuss is evident in his lectures. I can only reiterate what the first person said: take raj!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He provides a syllabus with a detailed daily schedule and does not stray from it. Class is often cancelled and most work can be completed from the comfort of your dorm. Not an intense class or a tough grader, easy work. Take raj!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Here after taking him a second time. I passed, barely attended class, and completed two 10 page papers, one midterm and a final. Very easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures consist of him just talking about the topic, no powerpoints it's all verbal (which doesn't work well for me, I'm a visual learner), but I still passed with flying colors. Two exams, three papers, which are all graded high despite me not reading much. His grading is very lenient, and I'd recommend him. I am taking him again next semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: No attendance, 4 assignments total. Two exams (Written essays) and two 8-10 page papers, so thats a lot of pressure. He just sits in the front and talks at the class, no powerpoint or guided notes. He is quiet so sit in the front of class, I could never pay attention to lectures. But he's totally a sweet guy and passionate about his job.

He's an ok professor he clearly knows what he is teaching it's just very hard to keep up with him. He also speaks quietly so try to listen as hard. If not reset are all written but he expects you to know which terms form the textbooks he would put on the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: boring lecture's but very easy to cheat on midterm and finals as he sits in the front of class and read the whole time.

Dr. Gargola is a nice guy and means well, but I felt like I had no idea on what I was learning out in lectures because they felt like tangents more than lectures. Absolutely get the textbooks because they will give you an idea on what you need for this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Gargola is a wonderful professor. He's engaging during lectures and knows the subject. However, if you are someone who doesn't like not having power points for class and writing papers don't take this class. Not only are there multiple short papers you write throughout the semester, but his exams are only an essay and short answer questions.

Professor Gargola really enjoys teaching history, I mean the man giggles and gushes about certain parts of history he likes. The only grades in there you have are essays and tests (just midterm and final), so complete the essays! The essays require a lot of critical thinking so dont think you can get by with procrastinating they are time consuming

Only take this guy if youre really REALLY interested in the subject matter. He provides no power point or outline for lectures and just talks for 50 minutes straight while fielding little to no questions. To be Frank, hes just very old school and a bit outdated for modern students. I got an A and this is still my opinion.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Gargola really cares about his students in a way that most professors don't at a large university like this. Of course, Roman Law isn't a topic that peaks most peoples' interest, but the class was enjoyable because of him. Definitely would recommend!

He is a good guy. His lectures will murder your brain. 50 minutes of constant lecture twice a week. No slides, no handouts, just talking. He is very quite, so if you wanna hear him... enjoy becoming a front row student.

Dr. Gargola is very knowledgeable about what he teaches. In fact, it seems that his brain is a steel trap because he can give multiple examples from a broad time frame. This class consisted of two exams and two eight page papers. Dr. Gargola has a very dry sense of humor and his lectures will seize your attention. Highly recommend!

Dr. Gargola doesn't seem to care one bit about whether or not you get anything out of lecture. He lectures a random word vomit off the top of his head for fifty minutes straight. No visual aid, no outline, no nothing. If you can follow him, it would be a miracle. Reading quizzes are worth 30% of your grade (6% each), so that doesn't help either.

Great professor. His lectures are really interesting and give you insight you can't get from the textbook. You are pretty much told verbatim what you are going to be tested over, so getting an A doesn't really require much effort. If you have the chance to take a class with him, I definitely recommend that you do so.
No visual aids.  He lectures for 50 minutes straight without looking at a book or anything.  You must sit near the front or else you wont hear a word.

Gargola is a wonderful professor. He really is passionate about the ancient Roman culture and Roman Law. He knows a lot about Roman Law. I am taking him in the spring for another course. The class is easy. He lectures and assigns a couple of papers. Come to the lectures, do the readers, and the papers and you will pass. He is very nice!

Roman Law isn't necessarily something that peaks a lot of student interest, but Gargola knows more than anybody about this material. He is an easy grader, but you still learn a lot while in the class. Not mandatory attendance whatsoever. Very little interaction in class, he mainly tells stories for the whole 50 mins. Good class, great professor.

Dr. Gargola knows more about Roman History than is likely healthy. Entire class, which is once a week for 2.5 hours, is lecture based. Long, drawn out stories. Yet, Gargola has a good, dry sense of humor and he always lets class out about an hour early. Incredibly easy grader, especially if you meet with him for office hours regarding questions.

He is a very smart man, who doesn't require attendance. I did the required two papers, (presumedly) got an A on the final, and that was it. I was there just enough to get the prompts and figure out what was on the final, and it was smooth failing from there. Take him, he's an awesome teacher.

Dr. Gargola as a professor was friendly, lectures were boring and was difficult to understand and follow. All depends on your TA! The quizzes during recitation were a killer and really dropped the grade. However, Dr. Gargola pretty much tells you what is going to be on the midterm and final so that is the easy part

Very clear professor. Hard to say he's "easy" since that has a lot to do with which TA is grading your papers & exams. Professor himself is very clear and his lectures are very interesting and in-depth. Sit close to front, he talks quiet and will not call out chatty students in the back.
All of the courses that I have ever had with Gargola have involved learning tons of information without having to do very much work. How do you top that?

I've had Gargola for both 229 and 503 and both classes worked essentially the same way. You can either go to class or you can read the book, but you probably don't have to do both. Pretty easy grader and his lectures are really clear. Overall an easy class compared to others in the History dept.

Dr. Gargola is wonderful. His lectures are amazing and i would recommend going to class b/c you can not read the book and pass with an A if you listen and show up. Wonderful professor.One of the best at UK

He is probably one of the laziest teachers I have ever had, but he's really nice and interesting. He takes quite a while to return assignments, and there's only usually two exams and one paper, so it's easy to fall behind if you mess up on one. But his lectures are very interesting and the class is pretty easy overall.
Professor Gargola is great and has brilliant lectures. The class is pretty easy if you come to class and do the papers. He is also extremely helpful and is usually available if you need help.
He's somewhat boring, but really easy..you don't have to read much and he tells you what's on the test! Very nice!
His lectures are incredibly interesting. Even though it is not madatory to attend class I do recommend it because you will enjoy listening!
Actually listen to his lectures.  They are absolutely brilliant.  One of my favorite history teachers at the university.
Great prof. If you go to class and take some notes you will learn a lot. layed back and a very nice guy.
Great professor. Very funny and has good stories.
awsome. i love him!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Good teaching style. answers questions fully. overall nice guy.
Very laid back teaching style.
Great professor, tough but fair.
No Comments
No Comments

One of the best classes I've taken at the university.  He brings in a patient to talk to you every year and was one of the most memorable lectures I've had.  Class is test heavy, just use Anki and you'll do fine.  They also adjust test scores by omitting certain questions or accepting other answers.

Dr. G is an amazing person. The lecture is specialists and they speak for the lecture. There are 3 tests which require you to know a lot of details, as they are written by the guest lecturers. 80% of your grade is test, 10% required attendance, and 10% course evaluations so make sure you study. Overall, not hard but the most interesting class taken

Lots of specialists come in and lecture on their specialty. It was incredibly interesting and probably my favorite course I have taken out of 2 majors and 2 minors! Three exams, which are easy if you pay good attention to lectures and the main points in them. 5% of the grade is given to you as 100% as long as you do 4 course evaluations.
Dr. Geegan was amazing! So easy to talk to and made sure everyone understood the content before moving on.
Such an angel!!! ISC dept. give her a raise asap
SO KIND. Sometimes gives out extra credit just for attending class. The exams are easy as long as you read the textbook.

Professor Geegan is very kind and gives great lectures. There are only a few projects and exams that make up your grade for the semester so study thoroughly for the exams or else you will not do well in this class. The assignments are easy, I recommend filling out the study guide using lecture slides then making a Quizlet to study for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Sarah is SO kind and caring for her students, as well as an awesome professor. She has a lot of experience in the field which makes her a great person to learn from. There are four assignments and four exams, each of which are fairly easy. She offers lots of extra credit and there's no reason to not do well in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I echo this : "Her lectures are very informational. She does her best to keep your interest and it works. She's extremely caring and is always open to talking after class. She brings in guest lecturers who have legitimate jobs in the ISC profession, which is super helpful. Explains things very clearly; has a review day before each exam.

She had a personal vendetta against our group the entire year. Found a way to make my group the class low for every project even though it was obvious other groups did plenty worse. She grades based off how much she likes you, not how well you did. Avoid her classes.
Such a sweetheart.

I honestly enjoyed her at the beginning of the semester. Towards the end she made it miserable for me. She was rude when I met with her and her exams are very hard. We had a god amount of projects to in this class so be prepared for that.
She was rude when talking to her. Tests were hard and had a lot of projects. Would not recommend taking her.

This was my 2nd class with Sarah (I also had ISC 161 with her the year before). She is a great professor! She provides interesting and informative lectures. Her class was fun and she was very helpful with any issues her students had. In her class, you get out hat you put in. I would definitely recommend taking a class with her.

Sara Geegan is one of my favorite professors Ive had in college. She is very caring when it comes to her students. She is always ready to meet outside of class to even discuss things like studying abroad/ any other questions you have about ISC. Also gives incredible lectures, and is absolutely a babe. 100% take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Hard grader, and few assignments/ opportunities to raise your grade. Bad test taker? Good luck because that's basically your grade. Extra Credit? Maybe if you're lucky, but don't worry you won't get the full credit for doing extra credit.  Not a good lecture, overall boring, and sometimes useless material, not on exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Her lectures are very informational and often enticing. She does her best to keep your interest and it works. She's extremely caring and is always open to talking after class. She brings in guest lecturers that have legitimate jobs in the ISC profession, which is super helpful. Explains things very clearly; has a review day before each exam. 10/10.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Sarah was amazing. She was so sweet and her lectures were super interesting. She has slides with the topics of discussion on them, but YOU have to take the notes so focus and you'll do great! This isn't an easy A class, but if you study, show up and apply yourself, it'll be great!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved her and her class. DEFINITELY take her! You will not regret it.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Loved having her for 161. She's relatable, really understanding and keeps lectures interesting. Having an 8am is hard but she does her best to keep you engaged and interactive. She's always offering to answer any and all questions or happy to meet with you after class. I wish she taught every ISC course.

Sarah was great, and one of my favorite professors so far. She is young, relatable, and there for students - whether it be class or career related. ISC in general is tough so be ready to study, but her class was enjoyable and her lecture style was easy to follow. Make sure to write what she says, rather than just studying the power points.

Sarah is literally the nicest person in the whole world. She lets you send your projects a week before they are due to her and she will give you feedback. She also sticks to her study guide, so if you fill that in, you will do great. She gives extra credit too. I ended the class with a 103% if that puts things into perspective.

Sarah made this class super easy, and although the lectures were long, most days we ended 10 minutes early.  She's super willing to help with any assignment, and the study and assignment instructions are super straight forward! Would love to have another class with her!
Loved her. Great class. Lectures are long but the material is interesting. Does her best to keep you interested.

Professor Geegan is an awesome laid back professor, and easily the most attractive professor I've ever seen. Her lectures are very long, but she tries her best to keep you interested. Would definitely take again
She's actually the best. Get excited if you have a class with her - if you go to office hours, she'll be super willing to help out!

She's the best! The first half of the class is exams and they are exactly what is on the study guide. The second half of the class is a group project and she is pretty lenient. Ask questions if you have them, she is super nice and will help you. She grades easy too. As long as you show up and try you should be good!
her tests are so confusing and literally impossible

Her tests are challenging, and I recommend studying heavily (but there are only 2). Her lectures are laid back and canceled often. Hard grader for projects, I recommend picking a good group! She really does care about her students, but you have to show you care, too. If you email her questions, she will reply quickly and give good feedback.
Tests were impossible almost the whole class failed and she did not care - would never take again
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her tests are incredibly hard and most of the class failed and she did not seem to care- she does not give extra credit or let you retake tests if you do poorly. Does not seem to care about the well-being of her students at all I would avoid at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is actually the nicest professor I have ever had while at UK, wish she taught more classes because I would take all of them. In this class you have interconnected group projects that build off of each other and what you learned in class. She has clear expectations on each assignment. Overall an easy to understand class if you put the work in.
