reviews.comment: Really good instructor lecture wise, lots of assignments but not a hard grader at all. As long as you put effort into your assignments in his classes you will succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: LOVED HIM! He's my favorite professor by far, he's super helpful when it comes to absences and make up work he's the best
Beat teacher Ive ever had

Currently taking WRD110 with Mr. G. He is easily the best lecturer or professor that I have had so far at Kentucky. Attendence is mandatory but he makes lectures easy to listen and follow along to. He also implements lots of small group discussions into his class which help days when the lectures do get heavy. One of the nicest people I've met too
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Literally the best teacher I had my first semester of college. he is so understanding and genuinely cares about his students. attendance is mandatory but it is so easy to get a good grade in his class because there are so many point opportunities. take his course!!!!!!!
Hes my favorite teacher ever. His teaching style is a lot of work but he's an amazing teacher to where you can do it and he'll push you to your limits but in a good way. Very good teacher

Mr. G is an outstanding professor! He is so kind and you can tell he is passionate about what he is teaching. I would definitely recommend taking WRD courses with him! There is a lot of writing, but it is a writing class so that is inevitable, however he is very flexible with due dates and grading!

Literally the best professor to start freshman year of college with. Super understanding and flexible with assignments and projects. Easy grader and very clear about his expectations for the course. Would 100% definitely recommend taking WRD110 with him.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing teacher. He really has pushed me to be a better writer. There is a lot of papers, but that's expected with WRD. He's an easy grader. personable, and very fair. He's also really funny too. Do your work and you'll pass, and he also gives extensions.
he's the goat.  pretty easy class as long as you do the work and communicate with him.  definitely take wrd 110 with him.

He is a very understanding professor! If you need anything, he doesn't mind finding ways to help you out! He doesn't mind sitting down and helping you out, he'll always make sure the class understands what's happening, and he isn't too harsh on grading but always lets you know what you need to fix!

Considering I missed nearly every due date I still ended with an A. I can tell he just wants his students to pass and learn something. He goes light on the grading. He's a bit monotoned with his voice but he's a pretty average instructor.
I really enjoyed this class but the matieral was hard for me at some times. Had nothing to do with him, but mostly just me struggling.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Super chill and friendly prof. Whole class is spent going over the homework and doing activities. I hardly had to do hw outside of class (besides essays). Attendance is mandatory but participation not required. A bit of writing but if you just try you will get an A. Didn't learn a whole lot but if you're wanting an easy A take him.

Mr. Medina is a pretty chill and laid-back professor. The class is sort of difficult if you do not spend time on it. The tests are difficult but they are only 20% of the course and there isn't even a final. Overall I would recommend him.
Dr Medina is an excellent professor, obviously loves teaching, teaches the material well and is always available to help with anything you don't understand. Great class!

I am someone who was not up to the skill level this class required. I attended every class and put in the effort, and with Professor Medina's help, I got the A I wanted. He is super helpful and funny, and his classes always keep me interested. 10/10 would recommend this course.

Fun class + professor! Plenty of readings and practices are assigned in the required textbook, but I got along just fine without doing any of the practices. Easy to get an A as long as you show up to class and do the assignments (most of which are in class or at home for participation).

The singular perk of this class is that you can get so much work done for other classes while sitting there. The entire 75 minutes is doing VHL exercises, but no one actually does them because they know that he doesn't really check. As for the writing, just know you'll get a 95 for doing the bare minimum. Just slap something into the text box.

he is very sweet, very fluent in spanish, but i didnt learn anything, he doesnt teach it to the point you can understand it. all of the homework is on the website and all the answers are on quizlet. the writings are easy i used google translate. he does take attendance but he is easy and you can still do bad on exams but make a solid A.

Easy, didn't learn much, funny.  He didn't give feedback on writing, and I got a 95 on every single blog (I don't think he read them).  Very knowledgeable about Spanish grammar.  Would count me absent from class many times when I was there.  I never knew if he would take attendance right when class started or at the very end.  Waste of time.

Hard to review him, so I'll state the facts. He knows a lot of Spanish and is fluent, but the class really doesn't use it. Bulk activities without real application or use in conversation or even writing. Said the n-word twice in class kind of to prove a point? Really easy class, barely any homework or real class work, I did work for other classes.

I enjoyed being in his class because he is a funny guy and can brighten any room your in, but it doesn't cover the fact that I felt like I taught myself the class. He is great at giving you the answers, but if you are looking to really learn the language, I would suggest a different professor or be motivated to learn a lot on your own.

Georgie is a great guy- super funny, nice, and understanding. However, I didn't learn one single thing in this class. While some may find this good (easy A for most), I really feel like it was a waste of time, since I am majoring in Spanish and would like to feel like I'm coming out of the class knowing more.

I didn't love this class. Most of the class meetings consist of grammar practice or text analyzing, but I never felt like the class activities were helpful. You write blog posts, in-class essays, and a few papers, and he gives feedback on the papers but not on the other assignments. I always got the same grade and didn't know how to improve.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class is writing-based, so be prepared to read an essay, discuss it in class, and write a report, along with a few other compositions. As long as you do the work, you'll get an A. Professor Medina does not pressure you to speak Spanish every second of the class, either. He is hilarious and shamelessly shares his honest opinion about everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Be prepared for homework every night, 3 essays, and 4 exams. Despite that, Professor Medina made Spanish enjoyable and I loved going to every class. He tries to have fun with us and joke around, while still teaching Spanish. He is a bit of a tough grader, but you get used to it and understand what he wants/expects as the semester goes on.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I had Georgie as a professor for my SPA310 class. He has a good sense of humour and is very friendly. However, he's a tough grader when it comes to assignments, but he also offers Extra Credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I took this class as my requirement for my Global Dynamics and he is an amazing professor. He knows a lot, is willing to help you and makes you work for your grade. By far the best professor I've ever had.

This class was not incredibly difficult. Doing the reading helps you participate, and he can definitely tell who does the reading. Dr. Medina was, without a doubt, the best professor I've had in the SPA department. Go to class, do the work, and I promise you will learn. He knows a lot.

Dr. Medina is a great professor! He is super funny and tries to keep the class interesting.  I took this as my Global dynamics core credit and I would definitely recommend taking this class! Attendance is mandatory (4 skips) Only a presentation, 2 tests, and 2 papers! If you pay attention in class he goes over everything you will need. Great class!
I never found Dr. Medina to be particularly funny or amazing, but he cares a lot and the class is easy. Pretty much just show up and put maybe an hour into the writing assignments and you're golden.
He's an awesome professor. very funny! takes attendance though. pretty easy class. just read and participate in class

This was my second time taking Georgie/Jorge (same person). I LOVE him. He's hilarious, honest, and very helpful. He will not move ahead until everyone's questions have been answered. This class involves a lot of writing, which is not my strong suit, but I can definitely say that my Spanish has improved this semester because of it.

Funny guy, good teacher, always in your corner. If you miss an assignment or even a test, he'll often let you turn it in late without any penalty. The material you have to learn on your own and class is more of a review, but he will stop and clarify anything and everything that you ask about. Gets a little distracted sometimes.

Georgie was my favorite professor this semester by far! He really cares about his students and is always willing to help. He's a very fair grader and as long as you participate in class, you'll be fine. He's also hilarious.

Dr. Medina is a likable and funny professor. He sets his students up for an A at the beginning of the semester, as long as they follow his directions exactly. Didn't love his teaching style. The course material was very scattered and didn't follow a clear pattern and most classes were merely discussion based.
My favorite prof so far!

Dr. Medina is a great professor.  He always ollowsthe syllabus and is willing to help you when you have questions. He is fair and is always encouraging participation in his classes. His test can be a little hard but he's an incredible professor with a great amountof knowledge. He is one of the best professors I've ever had in my life. He is great.

Medina is awesome! Expect homework every night and the test can be a little bit difficult but if you pay attention in class and do the homework you will be fine! He is always more than willing to help if you have any questions.
Gerg is a nice guy and an easy grader. But he talks soooo much his class is kind of a snooze fest

Absolutely loved taking a course taught by Alex! He made the class so inviting for everyone and made it enjoyable. Very fun and easy-to-understand assignments. Very understanding both in person and through email; treats the students like friends. Overall, would 100% recommend it to anyone thinking about taking a course taught by Alex!

Alex was great. I liked his film class, and I do not consider myself to be a "film person". It is entertaining, though, my class was 2 and a half hours long which is difficult to sit through (but that is on UK, not him). Overall, would recommend!
Professor Gergely is that guy.

Never in my life have I remotely enjoyed an English literature class until Alex. I LOVE this class. Interesting discussions make you really want to do the readings. He picked some great stuff for us to read. There aren't many papers and assignments are straightforward. There are some in-class assignments and quizzes, but nothing to stress over.

Alex is amazing. If you want an entertaining, easy class, just register for one of his. He gives a lot of leeway on assignment deadlines, especially as it pertains to mental health reasons (which saved me once this semester). Great guy all around.
He's HEEM. Class is easy never have test or homework besides occasion paper or discussion board. Super easy going guy and is more like one of the boys than a professor.

Alex Gergely is the GOAT, he felt more like a friend than a teacher. Super down to earth and friendly, and one of my favorite teachers like ever lol. Considering most english teachers make you want to fall asleep instantly, having this guy to bring his fun energy to the class really helps. If you literally just try to do good youll get an A.

This professor really puts effort and time into what he teaches. He makes sure that each student he has in class will succeed by the need of the semester. As for feedback, he gives positive feedback and tells students how to improve their work for the next big writing piece.
Very inclusive with whole class. You read a good amount outside of class for some discussion in class. Easy grader. Participate and you'll pretty much ace this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: I took the online class and there are few Zoom classes. There are many assignments but they can be done easily. He gives incredible feedback and is always willing to work something out if you have a problem. If you keep up, which is really not that hard, I think it's an easy A.

She has been one of my favorite professors and knows what she's talking about. Wants her students to do well and offers lots of extra credit and curves on exams. Lectures can be kinda boring but she tries to make them fun. If you study and do practice exams you will do good in the class. Leap lab is also helpful for the class
She's passionate about what she teaches but the content is a bit difficult, as long as you study the practice exams and go to class for the daily quizzes you should be fine.

She has very fun lectures and makes the boring topics fun. Would recommend as she makes an A very attainable as long as you put in the work. Homework is annoying but not worth much. Tests are fairly difficult, but she gives you a lot to help prepare.

She is super kind and her class is easy to follow. HW can be annoying sometimes and almost cheat you out of points. But this class should be an easy B/A If you don't pay attention and don't know what to do GO TO LEAP LAB. She will talk about it a bunch but that's how i got my A. Also practice exams are basically the tests.

Professor Hoyt was one of the best professors i have ever had at UKY. She is passionate about the topic and her exams are very consistent with her lectures. If you put the work in you will absolutely do well in this course. I cannot recommend her enough!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: i would highly suggest taking Gail. she actually cares about the students and her lectures are so entertaining. attendanced is not mandatory but you get extra points going everyday. she is easily my favorite professor. also she gives so many practice exams that help exactly what is on the exams

I loved having Dr. Hoyt as my economics professor. Each class was engaging and interesting and she always found a way to make the lectures relatable and fun. She does a lot of interactive activities in lecture. Daily quizzes (she gives the answers) and homework (lengthly and lowkey hard) are a huge cushion if you don't do well on the exams.

Personally, I find her very mediocre, while she is not by any means a bad teacher, she teaches a boring class and does very little to keep her students engaged outside of the quiz questions she gives.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Hoyt makes this class engaging and fun. The material can be challenging, but she offers great resources like practice exams. Definitely worth taking - Unstuckstudy was a big help for study prep too!

Words cannot describe how much I love Dr. Hoyt and her class. The lecture material is pretty difficult, but Dr. Hoyt made the lessons engaging and fun to the point where it was easy to understand. If you need to take this class for a core credit, PLEASE take Dr. Hoyt!!!
Very engaging and her lectures are fun. Would highly recommend taking a class with her.
Words can't express how much I love Professor Hoyt. If you have the opportunity to take her do it!!! She makes me look forward to going to class.

Brilliant, kind, hilarious, helpful, understanding, & approachable. My advice for her class is to study the practice exams & go to class. She offers many resources if you are struggling with the material. She makes class fun & interacts with us more than I expected, considering there were 500 students in the class. I wish I got to know her better.

My grade is an A right now before the final. Hoyt is a wonderful person. She really tries to make the class as entertaining as possible. The only problem I have with this class is that its a 500 person lecture so it makes it extremely difficult to stay focused the entire time, but that is not a professor Hoyt problem. You get six unexcused absences

Dr. Hoyt is honestly the best professor/teacher I have ever had. Her lectures were extremely lively and easily understandable. She provided a lot of real-world examples to further her students' knowledge. She truly cared about her students' success. Her teaching really made me consider changing majors to Economics.

One of the best professors. So engaging and interesting to listen to, very good at explaining things also. She cares about all of her students and wants to get to know all of them. You will have daily quizzes and a lot of homework, but it helps balance your grade. Would 100% recommend her she is awesome!
Great overall teacher, awesome lectures. Caring and good personality, keeps you engaged during lectures.

The best class I have taken at UK. Keeps lectures so entertaining and fun, while still being very informative. Very accessible outside of class, and always willing to help. Somehow made a massive lecture feel small. Best professor. Quizzes and tests are manageable if you go to class, must go to class for quizzes.

LOVE prof Hoyt. If you take the time to study for exams using the practice exams provided you will succeed in her class. Go to lecture so you can receive your attendance credit and can understand the material. She gives lots of extra credit throughout the semester. If you attend the class right before lecture she gives SO MANY exam hints.

Dr. Hoyt is an amazing professor and person. She makes an effort to involve students in lecture for examples to ensure you understand material. Also just for fun. Resources are plentiful and the notes, hw, and practice tests are very relevant to exams. Final exam is heavier on material from end of course, so don't fall off before the semester ends.
Very caring professor and loves to teach. Would 100% take her again.

I absolutely loved Dr.Hoyt! Economics isn't necessarily the most exciting topic, but she makes learning it so enjoyable and I am always looking forward to going to her class. She is so funny and deserves the whole world. Make sure you do go to every class because she does do in class quizzes, which she goes over the answers in each class.

Dr. Hoyt is hands down my favorite professor at the university. She makes you want to attend her lectures. They can be extremely fun and engaging regardless of the class size. I highly recommend her for ECO201.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Highly recommend this professor.

Not enough words to describe how amazing this woman is. I guarantee I would not have an A in this course if it wasn't for how entertaining her lectures are. She really wants to see her students succeed and is very understanding. In a lecture hall of 450 people she wants to get to know you which is rare for many. Take her, best professor I have had.

I loved Gail and her class so much. She wants students to learn the material and put in their best effort, then she helps you get the grade you need. She cares about all of her students and makes class so fun. Would take her every semester if I could.
Wonderful professor! She is great at canvas and posting lecture videos and supplemental content to better understand concepts. I did not have great attendance but if you just study, you will do well.
Showing up to class in person makes the difference, she explains it so well and stops to answer questions and makes time for you to understand the unit. I really enjoyed her class

Professor Hoyt is one of the best professors at UK. The 410 class had us going and working directly with non-profits in the community and conducting economic analysis reports for them. Class time was used as group work to write the paper and get help from Hoyt. The midterm was very hard, but that is the only test/quiz. Hoyt wants to give out As!
Very energetic and wants to interact with the students. She is an interesting person but loves talking to you recommend taking htis class and getting to know her.
Dr. Hoyt is awesome, even though the lectures are long and theres a lot of material, she makes it engaging. ECO201 is not particularly difficult as long as you go to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Gail Hoyt is awesome. Shes very funny and entertaining while still being thorough in lecture. Homework load is pretty light and she gives resources to study for exams. She is SUPER helpful in office hours if you need further explanation. Hard to imagine a better Econ professor.

My favorite professor ever. She was very engaging and actually made class fun I really recommend taking her. The homework was a little challenging sometimes, but you get multiple attempts. She curves and has bonus points on exams.

Attendance isn't mandatory but there are daily quizzes and lecture is where majority of the material comes from. Dr. Hoyt is super funny and tries hard to be relatable and make connections to college students. She is super funny! Would take her class again!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hoyt is awesome. She is very engaging and her lectures go along with a workbook that she has copies for everyone for!!! Super easy to follow along. If you miss class, her presentations are usually posted on canvas

Dr. Hoyt is great! If you read the textbook (which is a really easy read), watch her videos (which are really chill), and skim the practice exams, you're going to do great in this class. This class is very organized and consistent, and Dr. Hoyt is super helpful and caring. Also there are a few easy extra credit opportunities. Miss her already!

LOVED Dr. Hoyt. Yes, the class is difficult and requires a lot of time, but that is just the nature of the course. Dr. Hoyt is a gem and tries her best to make lectures fun and interesting. She gives a lot of examples and old exams to practice with. There's a lot of content, but she is very accessible and if you put in the work, you'll be fine.

Although I tend to struggle in math related classes, Professor Hoyt was extremely helpful through her lectures. She provided many examples and made sure she was easily accessible if you were still struggling. This class is very lecture heavy and has many quizzes, but if you put the work in outside of class you will definitely get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: do not listen to these reviews! Gail Hoyt is THE HARDEST PROFESSOR EVER The work load in this class is insane for this just to be a 201 class. I had to put so much effort and time into her class that I could barley focus on my other classes that actually involved my major. Get read for weekly quizzes AND weekly hw assignments EVERY WEEK hard exams
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I really like her. She focuses on the content and explains it in a way that others can understand. It's a lot of homework but if you pay attention it's bearable. You really need to study/understand the content or you won't do good in this class. She's easily accessible and cares about her students. She also shows her dog in uploaded lectures, cool.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had never taken an econ course before so I was nervous, but Dr. Hoyt makes content super digestible for students -- I do think reading the textbook is a good idea bc it helped me review the material. Also, study for the tests!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Lectures were pre-recorded, and note-taking handouts were offered to follow along with them. My section had the option to meet twice a week to review the material covered in the lectures and the daily quiz due before class. I read the corresponding chapters after class, took the quick-quizzes, and chapter quizzes in the book. Do the practice exams!

TAKE GAIL HOYT!!!!! You will not regret it. She makes class fun and I actually enjoyed the 1 hour and 15 minute lectures. She is so funny and entertaining. She makes the material easy enough to understand while still testing your knowledge. One of my favorite professors I've ever had.

Dr. Hoyt is the best professor I've had at UK. She makes a lecture hall of 400+ students still feel personal. Notetaking packet you have to buy though a little bit expensive is the key to doing well in the class. Allows you to follow along with lecture and makes studying for exams super easy. Amazing class and prof.
Hoyt is my favorite professor I've had at UK. She's entertaining and keeps lectures interesting, as well as having a super organized class. Definitely recommend for ECO201!!

She made each lecture go along with the work book which makes studying and not taking much easier to follow! She answers any questions very clearly and gives multiple examples. She truly cares about her students and wants all of them to succeed in her class, so she is willing to work with you to help you and your grade! Great professor overall!

Gail Hoyt was an amazing professor to have for ECO201, especially during the COVID-19 situation. She was always willing to lend a helping hand even though she has many students. Attendance is taken in her classes but honestly if you plan on skipping class a ton then it is likely that you will not pass anyways. Her lectures are very entertaining!!

Gail is so sweet and funny and has made my entire lecture hall burst out laughing numerous times. The online homework is very manageable but her tests definitely require a few days of legit studying if you want an A.

She gives really good lectures and is really accessible outside of class. This is a pretty average class in terms of difficulty, there's homework almost every week, attendance is mandatory, and exams are 70% of your grade. If you go through past exams repeatedly and do well on the homework you'll get an A.

Class is kinda all over the place and hard to pay attention to. Not the best at being understanding and tests are pretty difficult, easy points from participation on reef, homework due on canvas and mind tap once to twice a week
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I cannot stress how amazing of a teacher and person Mrs. Hoyt is. Her lectures are very entertaining and well planned to keep the attention of the students. Go to her office hours. She will be delighted to help you out in any way possible and reward you for showing you care about your grade. You'll learn economics with her as your teacher

Definitely take Dr. Hoyt if you have the opportunity. She a lot of fun. Attendance isn't mandatory, but highly advisable. Tests are easy if you study; she gives study guides that are spot-on and lots of extra credit opportunities. She's a real gem- super friendly, and very funny. Best professor at UK.

While she is entertaining she is a horrible explainer. Econ is new to me and she jumps all over the place and does not do a good job of explaining. I have to figure things out by youtube videos constantly.

Gail is one of my all-time favorite teachers, she is funny, explains topics so they aren't as confusing, and is very straightforward in her expectations. Go to class, pay attention, and you will have no problem passing this course.
She explains things very well but exams are still pretty hard even with lots of studying. Lectures are interesting and Hoyt makes sure everyone is following along.

I have only been in her class for 2 weeks now, and she already has become my favorite professor at UK so far! Her lectures are so fun and engaging, but also very helpful. Everything she gives you on homework is stuff she covers in class, so pay attention and you'll do great! I would recommend her to any student.
She is a great professor and very easy to follow. Very clear about exam criteria. But, she takes FOREVER to give back tests and can be very petty when trying to go talk in office hours to her.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I LOVE professor Hoyt! She is hilarious and always makes her lectures fun. One day she decided she was going to teach from the balcony of Kincaid. She explains everything really well. You do have to study for the tests but they aren't overly difficult. I would take professor Hoyt anytime possible. She is accessible outside of class.
She is by far the sweetest professor at UK and a great teacher, especially for material that can be very confusing at times. Everyone should have the opportunity to take a class with her.
Makes complicated topics understandable and gives you ample opportunity to succeed. Loved having Professor Hoyt.

Gail is honestly the best. She made learning econ so easy and fun. Although the class was huge, she always made sure everyone was with her and always had ways for the entire class to engage. Go to class and you'll get an A easily.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is very funny and has the students engaged in the material. She gives many resources for exams and really helped me feel prepared for the content. She does clicker reef every class for attendance. She is one of the best teachers I have had and I would take her class again.

Gail explains everything so well and makes ECO fun. she is an AMAZING professor and I recommend her class. Exams are similar to the practice exams she gives out so make sure to study those. homework due once a week and reading but other than that its just three exams. The material can be difficult at times but Gail is always ready to help.
By far my favorite prof at UK so far. I didn't know anything about economics before her class but got an A. Know the notes and you should be good for the exams. Offers some extra credit

I LOVED Gail. She made an easy subject fun to learn and there was never a class where she didn't make you laugh. She gives it her all and wants you to succeed. The tests can be difficult, but I wouldn't hesitate to take her again.
She is so fun as a teacher and her class seems super easy during lectures, but the test are difficult. You have to study in advance for this class but homework is pretty easy.

Dr. Hoyt was great - funny and interesting lectures. The material is sometimes difficult, but she explains it well and is available in office hours. You need to study and put in the work, but if you do that, you'll do well in the class. Offers extra credit opportunities. Cannot put into words how much I would recommend this class.

Hoyt is one of the most incredible professors, if not these best, I have ever had. She makes the material relatable to your daily life and actually cares about her students, which can be hard to do in a 400+ person lecture. I would 1000% recommend her class to anyone, regardless of if they love econ.
Gail is so sweet! The concepts aren't that hard, but the exams were really tough to me. The wording is just really confusing. Gail is a must have though! She makes the class enjoyable

Dr. Hoyt is one of my favorite professors. She is really funny and makes lectures fun and entertaining. She is also a really good econ teacher and uses understandable examples to explain. She really likes engaging the audience and will learn lots of people's names. She is really accessible in office hours.

Professor Hoyt is one of the best professors I've ever had, everyone should get the chance to have a prof this good. Her lectures made the class so much less boring, and she is really passionate about teaching and helping students by doing anything she can. 10/10 recommend.
Hoyt is one of the nicest ladies ever. truly does her best to make her class enjoyable and relatable. she truly wants you to succeed

Hoyt is so sweet and funny, she makes econ a really enjoyable class. She cares about what she teaches but she doesn't take everything too seriously to the point where you're just cramming vocab. It's all applicable to life and conveyed in a way that is easy to comprehend.

It's a big lecture class but she tries to make it as much fun as possible by having class interactions every once in awhile. You should buy the guided notebook because it makes the lectures easier to follow, and you are given practice problems within the notebook as well. There are two homework assignments every week which suck.
Her lectures are amazing and she keeps you completely engaged. Her exams, on the other hand, are extremely difficult and her questions are worded weird. Her final is also cumulative and so hard.

Big lecture class, visited her in her office hours once and she was great help and also full of advice. She tries to be funny and keep your attention in class, you can tell she cares about her students!
Great professor. Really tries to help you understand the material instead of just talking at you. Gives quizzes every class day, but drops the lowest six. Exams are easy if you go to class.
She is one of my favorite professors Ive had at UK. She makes lecture entertaining and incredibly clear. If you attend every class and pay attention the exams are a piece of cake.
Gail is amazing. Really funny, encourages participation but not in an annoying way or in a boring way. She is really personable and easy to talk to. I highly recommend taking her if you can!!

Hoyt is one of my favorite professors I've ever had. Economics isn't the most exciting topic, however she uses really fun examples to help us understand topics. She encourages class participation, even in a 600-person lecture. Clicker quizzes every day but drops your 6 lowest scores. Really knows what she's talking about, super funny and helpful.

Amazing teacher! She is really straight forward when teaching and tries to make economics as fun as possible. She is always there if you need help/have questions. Class participation is pretty important. There are clicker quizzes each class for attendance and grades. Reading the textbook isn't needed as long as you go to class and pay attention.

Such an amazing teacher! She's hilarious and probably my favorite professor thus far in college. Her class isn't the easiest but it's really not bad at all. I would definitely choose to take her for Econ!

She is an amazing woman, very kind. Her lectures/powerpoints are all posted online and goes along with the notebook you are asked to get (which i highly recommend). Her class is very long, it isnt mandatory to go to but she asks clicker questions so going will only help your grade. I recommend this class, the exams are ok if you go to class!

Class is not mandatory but she does give clicker questions although she drops your lowest 6. Lecture is always good to better help understand concepts and go to class the day before an exam and she gives you a full study guide basically word for word. Lectures are also entertaining. Must read the book and look at notes because of online hw quizzes.
Loves her job. Minimal homework. Quizzes in class over what is covered that day

Gail was one hell of a professor. All of her notes are in the packet from Johnny print and are essential to pass. She gives extra credit throughout the semester which I highly recommend doing to pad your grade if you do poorly on a test. Definitely attend class and study in groups for the tests. Very down to earth professor and willing to help!
She is the best ever. First teacher in college to actually teach me and make me feel involved in class. She is the reason I became an Econ major!!!!!!

Although she is very knowledgable in her field, I'm not sure she should teach such big classes. You can't really ask questions and you need to snce this stuff is hard to learn. She tries to make class enjoyable but fails.

Dr. Hoyt is a great professor. She does her best to make sure you understand the material. She offers a lot of extra credit and drops your 8 lowest quiz scores. The exams are tough, but her supplementary packet helps.

Dr. Hoyt is definitely my favorite professor at UK so far. She gives a lot of clicker quizzes throughout the semester but she drops all but like 20 of them. Her lectures are long and there are about 400 people in the class but she makes it interesting and easy to learn. Her exams are very fair and you should do well as long as you come to class.

She clearly goes over the expectations for the class at the start of the semester and lays everything out. Lectures are well-organized, and she's always willing to go back or talk with you one-on-one if you don't get something. Mandatory attendance due to clicker quizzes, but you need to go to class to pass anyway, and you can miss quite a few

Professor Hoyt is fantastic! I'd highly recommend sitting in front of the class to absorb her material better, mainly because ECO 201 has 400+ students. She's very helpful and responsive and is pretty funny. Go to class as she gives clicker quizzes, most of which are easy. She drops some and provides extra credit. Get her book from Johnny Prints.

Overall Dr. Hoyt is a good professor. If you don't take the time to study, you won't do good on her exams. If you moderately study, you'll be fine. She is VERY helpful. She also gives quizzes everyday so going to class is recommended.
Nice lady

Awesome professor! She makes a 500 person lecture in Memorial Hall feel small! She gives examples, explains things thoroughly, and enjoys student participation. Definitely made econ make sense to me. Lots of clicker and in-class quizzes, but she drops half of them and has extra credit opportunities. Not too hard as long as you put in the effort.
Dr. Hoyt is incredibly personable and easy to like. Her lectures make sense and her exams never surprise you as long as you go to class and pay attention. One of my favorite professors at UK so far.
Dr. Hoyt is one of the best professors I have had so far. She makes the material extremely easy to understand and makes lecture interesting.

This was a very enjoyable class. I took it for a USP/Gen Ed requirement. For those not majoring in economics, Dr. Hoyt simplifies concepts so that they are universally understandable! She is very funny, so I was actually sad when I had to miss class one day. She gives clicker quizzes, so show up! Exams, quizzes, and assignments are very fair!
Quite possibly one of the best teachers I've ever had. She has a genuine concern for students' learning and conveys information effectively. Also, very helpful in office hours! Highly recommend.
Hoyt is simply the best.
Fabulous teacher!!! Do not buy the textbook though was not helpful. If you attend class you should do great has clicker quizzes but drops a lot of them

She is the best! Clicker quizzes almost every lecture, but almost half of them are dropped. No homework. Exams are straight from lecture notes and old exams. She explains everything well and makes the class fun and relate-able. I definitely recommend her!.

Great teacher.  I wouldn't buy the textbook unless you like to read them, but do but the workbook from Johnny print. It has everything you will ever need for the class, other than a turning point clicker.  Wish she taught 202.

Shes a great professor except all she really does is give examples and doesnt explain anything. Ive taken Econ before and passed with flying colors and now Im barely squeaking by and I normally love Econ.

Dr. Hoyt is great! I'm a merchandising major so I was scared to take this class. I didn't buy the text book and you really don't need it. Just buy the workbook and go to class everyday! I got B's on all the exams (with studying!) and got all my quiz/bonus points that I ended up with an A. She is a great teacher for this course!

Dr. Hoyt makes class so enjoyable! Some of the material can be hard if you've never had an econ class before, but as long as you're willing to ask for help, she will explain anything! I didn't use the textbook for her class but make sure that you have the workbook because it'll save you a lot of time when taking notes and when preparing for exams.
Great professor! Made economics fun and interesting for a pre-pharmacy student. My only complaint is that her multiple choice questions on tests are tricky. She does curve, though!
Absolutely fantastic professor.
Dr. Hoyt is the best! Lots of easy quizzes to boost your grade and she's always available to help.

She is a really good teacher. Explains everything very clearly so it's easy to understand. Attendance is not mandatory but she gives quizzes on some days which make up 80 points. She's funny too at times. I got an 89.25 in the class and she rounded up to an A!! She rocks. Didn't use the book at all, just the workbook for $20 from Johnny Print.
Amazing professor. Always helpful and straightforward.

She is a nice lady and interesting, but it is impossible to pay attention in her large class. She's a good teacher but not good enough to teach a class of 400. The way she takes notes makes everything 10x's harder to understand than it is.
so sweet!! loved her! and class was easy if you pay attention and try to go as much as you can!

The main textbook I didn't touch once and still got an A. The book you buy from Johnny Print you will use and I suggest you look at the reviews at the ends of the chapters it will make the tests MUCH EASIER. She teaches really well in class and really engages the class and seems like she has a lot of fun with it. The quizzes WILL help your grade.
She is a very helpful teacher that seems to really enjoy what she teaches. The tests are difficult but she makes up for it with several easy quizzes in class.

Economics is pretty intuitive if you think about it the right way.  If you study and do the quizzes, then there's no reason for you to not get an A or a B.  My only complaints about that class is that I was in Memorial Hall (with 450 others) and that Dr. Hoyt would hand out papers like crazy.  It was impossible for me to stay organized in there.
She is a fantastic teacher, and the class is not difficult because of this

Wonderful professor, but hard material. Test are difficult but she gives super easy quizzes. If you study hard you can easily make an A or B. Dr. Hoyt is very intelligent and has much passion for teaching.
She is one of my best teachers yet, but you still have to work in the class.  She really tries to do whatever she can for her students and you can tell she loves what she does.  Take her course!

She gives a lot of extra quizes that you get to drop that helps boost your grade. I got a 100 on everything including the first exam and did badly on the second exam that left me with an 89 in the class.
shes fab!

Dr. Hoyt is a remarkable professor who takes ECO 201 to a whole new (and fun) level.  It was by her passionate and delightful teaching style that I was convinced to be an Economics major.  I also had friends who said that she made it interesting for them even though they didn't like econ. Clicker quizzes in class to measure attendance, no textbook.

She is absolutely awesome!  I was so scared going into the class because i've only heard bad things but she makes it super clear and interesting!  You definitely have to devote time to studying if you want to do well but i would say this is the only teach you want for eco201.  Go to class everyday for the in class quizzes but she only counts a few.
Great professor! Makes class interesting and material easy to understand. Tests aren't that difficult if you have followed along in the course packet. If only she taught more classes!
Great teacher! Easy class.
They should make her teach every econ class.

By far the best teacher I have had at U.k. She is hilarious and really cares about her students. Class is not mandatory, but the test is mostly based on her lectures. Her lectures are so interesting that want to go to class every day. The material is pretty difficult at first, but the way she teaches make it easier to comprehend.

Dr. Hoyt makes Economics as interesting as possible. She tries to make it fun, and she has made a book of notes that make it so much easier. The text book is not necessary. There is a quiz most days so attendance is recommended. It is really easy to get all the quiz points.
Terrible!... Good Luck

I was worried about this class in the beginning because I have absolutely no background in economics, but Gail Hoyt makes the subject crystal clear. Don't buy the book; the course packet is all you need. I went to class, studied the course packet 2 days before the exam, and I got a 99 in the class. She's the only way to go for economics!

Gail Hoyt makes the material in this class very easy to understand. She gives in class quizzes throughout the semester which really helps boost your grade. It's not necessary to buy the textbook for this class but she has a course packet for around $30 which is very helpful. There are old exams in the back of the packet to help you study.

The material was really difficult, but she was an alright teacher. Quiz grades really help with your overall grade, but you have to attend class to get the points. I recommend going to class every day even though its not mandatory.
Good teacher

very easy! take this teacher. me and my buddies sat in the upper level of memorial hall and joked around most of the class and we all got A's. but you do have to go to class to do the quizzes which are really easy and you have them almost everyday

Pretty difficult subject, but she makes it easy to understand. I got As on all my tests. Go to every class & get the workbook she makes for notes..makes things much easier.  She puts the notes online but i def recommend going to class. easy in class quizzes.

Dr. Hoyt is a great teacher. You need to attend class to get a good grade. She gives (easy) in class quizzes, and she gives you everything you need to know for the exam in class. Textbook only contributes to what she talks about but not necessary. Her course packet is great...aids in taking notes and studying! Gives old exams in back!
Good Teacher. I just didnt like the subject

Really great teacher. Don't need the text book, but you do need the manual written by her. There are old tests in the back and the new tests are basically the same. Pretty important to go to class. She gives in class quizzes.

My FAVORITE teacher so far at UK, she's an absolute sweetheart. Covers everything completely thoroughly, very clear. Tests aren't too bad as long as you study the course packet and do the practice tests... GREAT TEACHER!

She's nice, teaches well, and gives you everything you need to get an A. Go to class and pay attention, read what she tells you to in the book, and before an exam, study the course packet and take the practice tests in it, and you'll do well.

She is a great teacher. take her. she makes the class interesting and fun. do the practice tests in the back of the course packet and you'll do fine on the exams.          you have to study to get a good grade though
Awesome teacher. Makes a dull subject semi-enjoyable. Go to class and study the packet and old exam questions.  Wouldn't call it an easy A b/c her tests can be tricky, but it is a very doable "A".
hoyt is awesome. thats all I have to say!!

She is a great teacher.  She explain everything clearly and her test are not hard as long as you attend class and study.  She make a good study guide before every test that really helps.  She puts her nots online, but it helps if you attend the lecture 1st.  You can easily get a A in the class if you pay attention and study for the test

Did a great job with UK101.  Very funny and really helped us freshmen to get involved and aquainted with our new university.  Im very glad I had for my UK101 class, because others have said their UK101 teachers and class sucked.  Thanks Doc Hoyt!
she is a great teacher. she is really clear and she explains everything with terms that students can understand.

Hoyt was awesome, her tests were exactly what she went over in class and she gave you old tests to study then pulled 10% of the test questions from those exams.  So far she has been my favorite teacher.
Great teacher! Made the class as interesting as it possibly can be. Very helpful and good at explaining. Make sure you go to class and actually study. If so, you should do fine.

Dr. Hoyt is nothing short of AMAZING.  Her class was very intersting and the exams are not bad.  Be sure to study her old exams, as 10% of questions are pulled off there, use the LEAP lab, and go to her office.  I thought it was very interesting and hope I can take her again.  One of UK's best instructors!!
Not super easy, but I got an A. Just use her practice exams a lot and use the economics lab for extra help if you don't understand the material. She is a nice teacher!

Dr. Hoyt only teaches this class every couple of years, but still knows the subject very well.  Tests were fair, HW was fair, and she was very helpful with the projects at the end.  I had a lot of fun in this class.  Definitely take her if you can.
She's easily the best teacher at UK. There's nothing wrong with her class, her tests are fair, her homework assignments are actually helpful. She's great.
Great teacher.  Very understanding.  Keeps class entertaining.  Cares about her students.  Definately recommend her class.

She is a wonderful teacher. I know a lot of people have trouble in the class, so maybe I just got it, but she isn't out to screw you over so that is a plus for any teacher! Take advantage of the quiz points, study the old exams, and go to her to talk if you fail the first exam so you can figure out where you went wrong-she'll help. Good luck!
Gail is a great teacher.She gives a lot of helpful practice exams and the study guide is a good investment.GO TO CLASS!!!!!! It really helps in her class

This class required a lot of attention and a lot of reading. Gail is the type of teacher that wants to know the students she teaches and relate to them on a personable level. I was impressed that she went around the class everyday and tried to learn everyone's name. The handbook is the best investment for the class. I love Gail and the class!

Easy at first, gets a bit harder. She gives TONS of practice exams - USE THEM!! Short answer, multiple choice, and questions from articles on first two tests, all MC on final. Read the articles, not reading them is why I got a B because I was clueless for the second exam. Study exams several days in advance, it's tough material. Hoyt is nice/funny!
Really great teacher that furthered my interest in Economics.
She gives out a lot of extra material to help you study.  It's fairly easy to make a good grade in her class.  She's very helpful.
excellent, highly recommended......really smart, easy if you attend class
No Comments
No Comments
No Comments
Go to class for an easy A or B.

What a GREAT teacher! Dr. Hoyt SOMEhow made a tough subject palatable enough to learn well enough for an A. It's important to go to class EVERY day and do the reading/assignments as you go. The tests are same given to all ECON 201 students -- Dr. Hoyt, from what I can tell preps her students better than the other teachers. Worthwhile class.
If you're going to take Econ, take Dr. Hoyt. She is super nice and will help you with whatever you need. Her classes are interesting and she gets students involved in her examples to help them learn.

Dr. Hoyt is very helpful and quite humorous. She strives to develop a comfortable atmosphere and wants to learn everyone's which is pretty remarkable. You have to study for the tests, but she gives plenty of practice material that helps a lot. Go to class because she gives quizzes that count for a test grade and its easy to get the full credit.

great class...if you study and do the practice tests you should be prepared for the tests...great instructor, made the class of 400 much easier than expected...recommended.....she's funny and nice, you'll enjoy it in there
Hard class, but she really care about students.  Plus she's pretty hot for an old lady so it makes class more interesting.

Very good teacher.  However, her tests are pretty hard (especially the final) but she curved our first test, and our final grades.  She gives very easy quizes that really help your grade.  But the tests count for a lot of your grade - there is a lot of preperation needed to get an A in this class.
She's easy.  As long as you go to most classes you'll be fine.  If you don't, it's kind of hard to figure out what's going on.
She is a great teacher and a very nice person!!!

Mrs. Hoyt is a great teacher and tries to make hard subject matter a little easier.  She gives you several practice tests for each section which are almost exactly like her real tests.  She has gotten me to understand a lot of concepts that i never though i would, and i really recommend her!

Dr. Hoyt is a very good professor.  However, the subject matter is somewhat difficult.  There are only 2 tests and the final so you have some pressure to do well.  However, she gives 21 VERY easy quizzes (that she usually tells you about in advance) ad only counts 16 of them. Helps your grade a lo
Awesome!

Awesome professor!  Class is very interesting and she does a great job of explaining difficult topics.  Quizzes daily that are very easy and help boost your grade.  Tests are not too bad either.  If you are taking econ 201, definitely get into her class!

She was AWESOME.  I wasn't interested in Econ at all--just a general for my program--but I ended up getting a high A.  The class was fun, she made it easy, and she was so approachable.  I wish all my professors were more like her.
Great class-The hour and 15min always went by really quickly. Understanding and ENERGETIC
Made freshman year fun.
She's an awesome teacher. Good tests. I got a B but I never study so I was happy. I like her alot, and her stories were funny.
teacher "simplifies" information so that it is easy enough for students to understand, is willing to help with whatever problems there may be, great teacher
she was a cool teacher related everything to drugs made a class of 300 people not incredibly boring
Everyone loves Dr. Gail. She's the reason why I became and Econ major and is just as sweet and fun as she can be. Her class is a must take, whether or not you're an Econ major.
I hate Econ and stats but loved this class. HIGHLY recommend if you can get in.
Gail is an amazing professor.  She cares about all her students and will do anything to help you learn the material.  Lectures are presented with useful handouts that prepare you for the exams.
This woman made me love economics!! She is the reason that I chose ECON as a major. She should be the head of the department!! Gail Hoyt rocks the casbaw!!!
No Comments
One of my favorite professors.

Scorching hot!
Classes are fun, and she's a hottie
No Comments

Dr. Hoyt is THE best teacher at UK. Learning-oriented class, fabulous lectures.
Reading and quizzes everyday
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Tough grader but I loved him as a professor and a person. He offers extra credit on quizzes occasionally. You HAVE to read the books to have any success but most of them were enjoyable, especially with class discussions. He facilitates class well and also offers great feedback on essays. Participation matters but he makes it easy to talk in class!

I've had Dr. Genovese twice. He's funny and gives off girl dad energy. Participate in class- you'll want to be a favorite. He grades tough but lets you redo everything to give you a higher grade. You HAVE to read. If you don't, you'll fail the course in the first week.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Hilarious and incredibly talkative. Assigns horrible books and is clearly fixated on a certain reading of them (economic lens), but he is fun to listen to. Grades harsh and assigns a lot of papers but he is fair on offering you changes to recover your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took class as an elective and ended having to drop after I got my midterm back and realized I was never going to get a grade above a C. Worked really hard to prepare for the midterm (multiple hours a day for weeks in advance) and still got a bad grade. He is very rigid on interpretations, you HAVE to read every single day or you will fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Genovese is a really great professor. The texts are interesting and Genovese's passion for the readings shine during lectures and makes class enjoyable. He is also always willing to meet and help brainstorm paper ideas and develop your thesis. Though a tough grader, his paper feedback is always helpful too! Overall I recommend.
Great course. Great professor. My only issue: he dislikes falafel. And also the novels were long. Otherwise, ten out of ten.

Ignore the bad reviews, Genovese is awesome! Had him for three classes and loved each one. Tough grader but gives constructive notes. Will bump your grade up a letter if you participate a lot/talk to him. He's just like a dad and super friendly, even if in class he seems strict. Hard work great payoff! 242 had lots extra credit, other courses none.

This course is a ton of work and very intense for what I was expecting. You must participate and be a good writer if you want an A. He gives good feedback on papers, and your writing will improve. I'd suggest watching the recorded lectures before submitting a paper to make sure you have your interpretations the way he wants them.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Genovese is very educated and passionate about his subject. However, he expects class discussions, but leaves no time for others to join in. His feedback on papers is not good and just hurtful. You think you're a good writer? He will humble you without helping. You can't really succeed. Hardest class I've taken thus far bc of professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: In this class you have to read around 8 books in a semester, I would not recommend if you are taking this just for a gen ed. It it very time consuming, also he keeps the grades locked the whole semester so you never know what your grade is. Be prepared to write a lot of papers, and do group work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He clearly cares about the course and the material. As arent given to everyone, he makes you work for it. Will give random quizzes to ensure everyone actually read the books. On the topic of books, get ready for a whole library of reading this semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Overall, the class was interesting, just pretty paper heavy which was expected for the most part. I did all the reading and participated in discussions. It seems like he has a pretty specific idea on the interpretations you should have from the readings, and he will let you know if the interpretation you have is wrong. This class was my first B.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Incredibly passionate about subject matter. He doesn't sugar coat your work, but never before have I received feedback that I have believed to be so concise and constructive. Be ready to read and write!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This class is definitely my favorite from this semester in many ways. Dr. Genovese clearly knows what he is talking about and loves to talk about it. He makes himself very available to students. His grading is difficult, and it is hard to get an A, but he gives specific feedback, so rewrite papers if he gives you the opportunity.

You can tell he is passionate about what he does, and it is infectious. I never thought I would enjoy studying British literature, and even the really boring books were intellectually stimulating due to his radical critiques. He made me a better writer and student. He also makes himself available beyond the semester for any questions you might have

He was a good professor! I had a bunch of health and injury issues this semester, but he helped me get through it with a B. He is really funny and nice, but also, make sure you read the books. He will give you little grades based off of reading quizzes. Overall its an easy class. Don't take it for granted!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Tough grader, but he gives good feedback. Very respected in his field. He began the semester by quoting Stephen Duck: "Alas! the Bottle and the Beer's too small."
This class was pretty intense, but he made coming to lecture enjoyable and interesting. It was a graduate level course, so there were lots of papers, but he is a fair and clear grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: His lectures are all interesting, and make you think outside the box.  Though it seems simple at first, he shows you different ways of picking apart literature that shed a new light on both the material and the author's take on society.    He is very inclusive, and makes you want to participate even if you're shy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Terrible.

Like others have said, his grading is far from consistent, his expectations are extremely high, and, in my opinion, unrealistic. Your grade will definitely be hard-earned and probably lower than deserved. However, he does know how to keep class discussions interesting, even when the material was a bit dry, which was nice.

This strange fellow is the definition of a terrible professor; Far too much coursework, overly-rigid grading of said coursework, inane rambling while in class, complete lack of course materials both in class and the website. I've been at this awhile and never have I worked so hard and received so little. Avoid!

This professor seems to enjoy giving out mediocre grades and stressing his students out. Every time a student had a question about the course he would instruct them to check their syllabus, which had no helpful information in it. His grading seems to be random and all over the place. If you don't want a frustrating semester, then avoid him.

While he made class very interesting, his grading/expectations for written assignments are nearly impossible. When meeting outside of class he claims he enjoys your work, only to later receive a graded paper remarking otherwise. I have heard reports that he has claimed to only give out one A a semester. Definitely avoid for the sake of your GPA.

Horrible professor,the absolute worst I have ever encountered.Absolutely no teaching skills.She is always late for class, clueless about the material she is teaching so the students pretty much teach the class since every problem she attempts comes out wrong.Extremely unorganized.Rude when you ask questions and says things to make you look stupid.
hard to understand has really hard accent. easy class though. lets you turn in things late as long as you communicate. she does change her rules a lot.

Class was super super easy, but the teaching was terrible. It seemed like the syllabus was changed everyday and she gave us 2 exams one week apart from each other without any warning. The class was easy, but the professor was VERY unorganized.

Take this class. She is difficult to understand in class but the tests are exactly the study guides she hands out. She told us what days in-class assignments were on, so show up for those days because she posts all notes on blackboard. Not much homework but an extremely boring teacher.

Terrible teacher. You cant understand a word she says, we never did what was on the syllabus. Only go to class when she sends an email saying there is a quiz or assignment. She gives you all the notes and sends out study guides and only gives one version of the test so it is easy to cheat. you wont learn anything but easy to get a good grade.
so far the worst professor i've had during my time here. changed the syllabus almost weekly, and our first two of three tests came within a week of each other, i do not recommend her to anyone.

Hands down the worst professor I've had at UK. Nearly went the entire semester with half of my assignments remaining ungraded. Politically biased and inserts it everywhere she can.  Absolutely do not take unless you're a heritage student.
Professor Zannoun is very skilled at teaching Arabic. It is considered one of the toughest languages in the world for people to learn and she made it very simple for me to understand and thrive in.

She is nice and energetic, but the textbook is really bad and the h.w she assigns is way to much and can be very confusing. You have to do things her way or no way. She grades to harshly, and it has ruined the Arabic language for me. Takes forever to grade h.w. I have taken many language classs and this is by far the worst one.

I love Ustaaze Ghadir! She's super nice, funny, energetic, and cares about her students! I always looked forward to her class! There is homework assigned every day from the textbook/website. Arabic is tough, even for someone like me who knows some Arabic, but she's always willing to help out. Looking forward to having her next semester in AIS 102!
the best of the best

Picks apart all your papers down to what word is the noun in the sentence and if its correct. Instructions arent clear and she changes them often and if you bring up how they change she gets kind of condescending.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Prof. Ghadir is a great teacher. You don't learn the language only with her but different aspects of Arab culture. She told us clearly to always check the online syllabus as it was the most updated. I didn't have a problem with this at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Her syllabus changes constantly and right before class. She'll assign time-consuming homework 48hrs before it's due. I've never missed a homework assignment before in any class and I missed two in her class because all the changes were so confusing. She is really nice and a good teacher in class, but so disorganized with homework.
Really nice person and encouraging teacher! Arabic is really hard but Professor Zannoun made it a lot easier for me. As long as you're willing to try you'll be fine.
i had her, and she was way too difficult, her syllabus is constantly changing. She tires hard to keep students engaged but she assignments way too much hw. i would not recommend

Ghadir is an amazing woman and professor, but if you hate reading do not take this course because it revolves around novels and there is quite a bit of homework. Despite that, I loved this course and Ghadir really knows the material and you will learn a lot about the Middle East if you don't already. As long as you do the homework you'll get an A.

Dr. Zannoun is one of the best and smartest profffessors I had at UKY. She is very interested in her topic, helpfull and she makes the environment of the class very interesting through discussion, presentations, and   talking about the Muslim women's issues. i love this course and her and I disagree with some reviews.

I really love this class as well the teacher. She knows a lot about her topics. She does her best in delivering her material. If you attend, participate and be prepared I am sure you will enjoy this class as much as I did. I definitely going to take another class with her. I disagree with the other review.
Excellent professor. She knows what she is doing, very smart, knows a lot about her material. I can't wait to take more courses with her. Also, she is extremely helpful and nice.

Very interesting class. Sometimes the teacher is challenging to the point I am using her strategies in other classes. I am planning to take the next class with her. she is helpful and loves teaching the language.

she is a great teacher. I have learned a lot from her. She does her best to deliver her lessons. she is extremely helpful. Very dedicated, passionate teacher.. you will learn a lot and you will love her.

Ghadir is one of the most passionate, dedicated professors at UK. She's always willing to help you outside of class and you can always count on her to be helpful. You will have your rough days with her; she's definitely challenging. You won't regret taking her, however.

Ghadir is amazing, sweet, intelligent, and VERY thorough. I feel that I have learned SO much from this class, and even though she's tough when it comes to attention to detail and participation, this has been an incredibly rewarding class. Do the reading, invest yourself in the stories, and do your best to contribute. You'll love her.

I love Ghadir! She is so nice and kind of funny, and is genuinely invested in your success. She let's you redo homework and quizzes, there's only a midterm and final. You do use your textbook and workbook every day, and attendance is mandatory, but it's the highlight of my day, so why not show up? She starts simply and will attempt immersion.
Great Instructor and very informative. Three Easy Exams. Class attendance is mandatory. If you study and attend class your guaranteed an A.

Ghadir is difficult at first for students who have no experience with arabic, but the way she teaches allows you to learn in the best way possible: emersion. She speaks arabic from day one, but as long as you attend class things get easier. Just ask questions!! She is very helpful and wants you to succeed, even allowing students to redo exams.

I am a straight A student all my life and this is the first D I have ever had. Only give you 7 homework assignments and 3 big tests which are worth at least 70% of your grade! Offers no retakes or any extra credit either!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Gillete! Like most people say, his exams are very fair as long as you read and know all the powerpoints, and study the practice exams. His class was not stressful at all and I enjoyed lectures because he always kept them interesting! Do good on your exams because they are like 77% of your grade if I am not mistaken.

I don't agree with any of the opinions he presents in lectures, but Bob is a nice guy. He rambles a lot during lectures so it's best to stick to his powerpoints, which do help while studying. The only grades are the exams and homework, and the exams are difficult. Not the greatest professor I've ever had, but definitely not the worst.

He has a passion for teaching and would recommend him. Sometimes he goes a little too fast or off track trying to make the class engaging, but he really knows his stuff. The class itself is hard to begin with, so make sure you study and memorize his notes. Attendance isn't mandatory, but I would show up as much as possible!
Very important to score well on exams, there are very few points in this class.
James, aka Bob, is very fun and makes learning macroeconomics very interesting and engaging. Almost all of the information on the slides are included on the exams with some application questions.

He is a great person and is very passionate about ECON. However, he gets off topic often, and will go on tangents about material that will not be on the exam. There is no extra credit, and the exams are the only points that are worth anything. His lectures can be difficult to follow.

BEST TEACHER EVER. Very engaging with students. His lectures are great, and if you pay attention you wont have to study much for the exams. His practice exams are helpful, but make sure you know the concept behind the question, not just the question itself. He's lenient within reason and really cares about his students.

Bob is one of the most passionate professors I've ever had. He does a great job at bringing energy and analogies into the classroom to better elaborate on material. The homework assignments are not difficult and do not take long; there are only around 11 for this class. Tests are not too difficult if you pay attention and focus on the material!

By far the best teacher I've had in college thus far. His lectures are very entertaining and engaging and he does an excellent job presenting the subject matter. You have homework assignments once a week which are pretty easy to complete and really help on the exams. The exams are thorough but very fair if you put in just a little effort

Bob is one of the best teachers at UK. He is incredibly entertaining and an excellent teacher. You have to attend lectures or you will fail but you will probably end up wanting to go. Homework is manageable and helpful but his exams are tough (but fair) so they require a bit of studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Does not take attendance but you have to go to class to get the notes. Bob is hilarious and will make the lectures fun. Had no problem getting up to go to his lectures.

Gillete is a nice enough guy, but his lectures are very difficult to follow. He gets really excited about topics and will speak very quickly on tangents that he will later say are not on exams. There are very few homework assignments or practice problems available, and he makes a point of making the exams nothing like practice exams.
strict grader, weekly quizzes, entertaining and engaging lectures, 2 spoken recitations where you're graded on pronunciation, willing to help students
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Giancarlo is very passionate and knowledgeable about what he teaches, and he can make lectures interesting, but it is so. Much. Content. There aren't that many assignments, and the smaller writing assignments shouldn't be too difficult if you meet with your TA to workshop them beforehand. The exams are hard but he does curve them.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: you have to read so much. 2/3 of the norton early brit lit anthologies. giancarlo is very intelligent though, and does make what he is teaching clear and concise. also, attendance is important. it will ruin your grade at the end of the semester if you miss class.

Noteworthy:
Professor Giancarlo had really great and informative lectures.
There weren't a lot of papers that we had to write

The Unforgiving:
Had to read a lot (in a short time) so much so that Giancarlo kept revising the syllabus
The test were very content heavy, and he required us to know the dates of events
Mean on the midterm was 44 c'mon
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: His British lit class is definitely the best at UK. Prepare to read A LOT, reading are long but it's worth it. He is funny and nice to students. Extra credit is available!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Giancarlo is very passionate about his work, however his class is one of the reasons my GPA is low. He only grades a few things, and grades them very harshly. I've taken a variation of this course and passed with flying colors, but here I was considered "barely grasping" the material - books I've already read! Good enough guy, but tough grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You read 6 books throughout the semester, take reading check quizzes, write two large papers, and 4 shorter writing assignments. He grades hard on your grammar but really helps you improve your writing. Each class you discuss the books and it is rather enjoyable. He is a great guy, if you like to read take this class with Dr. G. He is awesome!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. G is very passionate about this class and you can tell in his lectures. He really knows what he's talking about. Most of the material is pretty interesting, and you will learn a lot if you pay attention. Take notes or you won't do well on the quizzes. recommend taking the quizzes with a friend!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. G is intimidating to say the least. But if you are a good student, you will be fine. The most annoying thing he does is keeping you there until like 11:52, not just wrapping up class, but still trying to lecture. My hand feels like it is going to fall off everyday. I've almost used a whole notebook for notes. But it's fine.

I took his course on British literature & its obvious this guy knows his stuff. His lectures are honestly easy to follow along and pretty interesting. Be prepared to read ALOT. Quizzes due every week, 4 essays, and 2 hard tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. G is awesome. His class was one of the most difficult I've ever taken because he's such a tough grader, but he offers a significant amount extra credit. He loves what he does and it shows. I would recommend taking him despite how hard the class might be.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He's smart and knows his subject very well, but asks a lot of questions that require students to read his mind to know the answers. He also not only usually holds the class late but often starts early as well. He takes attendance every day, and you MUST show up. He also said that he holds different students to different standards, so...
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.
