reviews.comment: I took two classes with Giancarlo and he was truly brilliant. The first was a survey class of Early British Literature. His 330 class was much more focused on one body of work- The Canterbury Tales. It was a lot of work, and a lot of reading, but he was always available to help with the readings, papers, and exams! Definitely will take more of his

Dr. G is brilliant and is really passionate about his work, but he's not very clear. I took his British literature class and I loved some of the reading. However, he rushed through literature that is know to be difficult. You can't rush through that. Also our class was 50 min when it should've been at least a hour for all he was trying to cover.

I really loved Professor Giancarlo. He is very knowledgeable and I always felt like I learned something in his class. It's not incredibly easy if you don't keep on top of the work but it's very rewarding.

Dr. G is an incredible professor.  He is so smart, so passionate, and he will make you understand what he is teaching.  He doesn't pass students just for being in class; you must do all of the readings and participate in class. Beware: there is A LOT of reading, and if you fall behind, you probably won't catch him.

This Brit Lit survey was my second class with Dr. G. He keeps lectures interesting and relevant, and I always left class feeling like I learned something. This is not an easy A, but as long as you attempt the reading and go to class it isn't overwhelming. There are weekly quizzes online, four writing responses, and two (difficult) exams.

I took Dr. Giancarlo's Survey of British Literature I class. He is a very knowledgeable professor who cares about the topic and his students. He makes the material clear and interesting, though he sometimes bombards you with a lot of information. The class was very interesting and I learned a lot, but it wasn't easy. Few papers, but hard tests.

Dr. Giancarlo required all students to meet with in his office several times during the semester, which isn't too terrible. He was very knowledgeable on the subject and kept class discussion interesting. I wouldn't mind taking him again.

This class rocked my world. Though I agree with the other comments on the intelligence of Giancarlo, he can sometimes come across as arrogant. He likes trick questions and even if you have done the reading, it does not ensure a good grade. I felt like I did learn a lot, but a lot of his questions were about mundane things instead of major points.

First thing you need to know-- the guy is smart.  He knows his stuff, especially old english, and he teaches it extremely well.  I thought the class would be boring but he made it interesting most days.  Test and quizzes aren't easy but if you keep up with the reading you'll do well.

Professor Giancarlo is undoubtedly a master at Old English literature, and is extremely intelligent. He can take a complicated text and explain it very clearly. But beware! I thought his tests and quizzes were very hard. Make sure you interrogate him on what material will be on the exams or else you will get many surprises. Awesome dude though!

I absolutely love Professor G. He is incredibly intelligent and has a passion for Old English literature. I had him for 230 and 331, and have enjoyed both classes. He does weekly quizzes, so keep up on the reading. His exams are not difficult if you pay attention. He is more than willing to help you succeed. Looking forward to taking 481G with him.

Clear, concise, and reads Old English. This course has difficult, weekly quizzes, but once you get used to the style, they are not hard. There are NO PAPERS, a plus, but moderately difficult tests. Do the reading. Participate in class. He is a friendly, but sometimes seemingly aloof. He wants his students to do well, but he doesn't like excuses.

He is extremely passionate about what he does, but that also means he strives for perfection from everyone. He can be very harsh when people don't meet his standards and even had to instate a "no crying" policy. I had stress dreams and lost sleep over this class. Almost completely destroyed my self confidence. You may thrive if you can handle it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Jeremy is a very fun professor! He's very tough but has a great sense of humor! He can seem a bit harsh at times, but it comes from his complete honesty. He really tries to help his students succeed, and that's why he's a bit harsh!

Jeremy points out all the nitty gritty critiques that you're not thinking about when performing. He gives very matter-of-fact responses, so he may stress you out. His points are valid, but you can get frustrated.
He's tough, but it's all the critique you need to hear.

He is a decent professor, but is very hard and very intense. He did make a few students cry after his comments regrading acting scenes. If you can take this class with any other professor I do recommend it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hannah is one of the best professors I have ever had. She explains things clearly and is excited about what she teaches. She grades fairly, is very understanding of outside circumstances, is generous with deadlines, and is very engaging. By far the best WRD professor!
Great professor really cares about what she is teaching. Very nice and caring while also being thorough in lessons. Would take again!

Professor was extremely understanding and kind, offering extensions to deadlines whenever possible if you spoke to her about it. Even without a "reason", speaking with her and explaining you're struggling will help. Assignments were interesting and graded easily. She was clear in her teaching of the materials used for the projects.
Best Professor ever!
Best teacher I have had at UK. Super flexible teaching style. Fun and enjoyable class.

Ms. Gibson did not answer emails or texts. Her assignments were somewhat difficult, but it's fine because she didn't even view my final project and still gave me an a. It is super easy to get an A in her class. I think she was a very nice person and was very patient and understanding.
Super nice person and she is understanding. Her assignments were somewhat hard but she graded them nicely. Would definitely take.

I love her! She is very caring and understanding, if you have an issue outside of class she will ask what you need and drop the assignment for you. She has little assignments, and grades easily. Attendance is not mandatory, but she is very nice and cares about teaching so she appreciates if you show up. Overall, amazing professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The nicest teacher you will ever meet. She grades easy and if you try she will give you an A. She makes English fun while also learning a lot. Attendance is not required, but it helps if you go to class. SHE IS AMAZING!!
Very fun and interesting class to take. If you show up and do the work the class is easy.

Ms. G is nice, but she is way too strict with rules like no laptops and mandatory attendance coupled with her regular refusal to excuse absences. Communication always felt condescending. Projects were absolutely ridiculous and a complete waste of my time. Exams were supposedly "easy" but the class averaged an 80%. I constantly dreaded this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Ms.G is as good as a professor can be for this class. She covers all the content in class and in the readings. Pretty much all you need to do to get an A in this class is pay attention, do the readings (very short), and follow the directions of projects.

DO NOT TAKE THI COURSE IF YOU ARE NOT INTERESTED IN ART! I, a business student, was reccomended this course for my art credit/UKCore. This class is not an "easy A". but can get one if you work for it. Ms. G is a bit crass and is quite strict in class. 4 Projects and 2 exams decide your grade! Get this with Adriane instead of Mrs. G. Don't reccomend
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Literally like a campus mother. She's so wonderful and amazing at what she does. She is so caring and compassionate, and as someone with special needs, she accommodates you in whatever way she can. Literally the best professor I've had at UK and I would recommend EVERYONE to take at least one of the classes she teaches at UK. She is a QUEEN!

She is a decent professor. The class is easy if you are a decent writer and have a decent confidence level with public speaking. She is a pretty strict grader. She is compassionate and willing to help if you reach out.

He is a very good teacher and knows his stuff. He makes his lectures very interesting. The class itself is not that hard just make sure to show up and pay attention to his lectures. Exams are pretty straightforward and similar to study guides.

The guy is very funny with the way he gives lectures but very educated and sometimes gives his own personal opinion. Part of the grade is going up and discussing in front of the class where the professor will ask you questions in front of the class, but it actually was not bad when going up there, usually would just be one easy question.
Funny, good professor who records his lectures online. Class is easy enough even without reading the textbook at all, just pay attention to lectures. Very weird but not in a bad way

One of the best professors at UK. Lectures were clear and the professor did a great job connecting the material to the border social, political and geopolitical context of the time. He might be outspoken in terms of normative economics but teaches fair positive economics and his lectures are free and open discussions for all opinions.

Very nice guy, bit of a southern accent but you get you to it. Class is very straight forward each class you are assigned a reading and during lecture you have an open discussion as a class. Exams are just like the readings. As long as you go to class and pay attention this class is an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He's very out spoken in the lecture.The PowerPoints are all over the place . He talks a lot about politics and the Bible . The practice exams are always opposite of what's on the real exams

Bob was great. He does slightly make his political beliefs conspicuous, but he is overall an amazing professor. Each class is an open discussion over the reading assignment due that day. They are pretty straight forward assignments. Tests are weighted very heavy. 2 out of 3 exams were all multiple choices, they were not too hard if you study.
dont take this professor
I mean I just feel like his style of teaching really confused me. He's very out spoken in the lecture.
He kept econ very entertaining and set all students up for success. Sometimes he can be hard to understand, but he lays out whats going to be on the test and study materials.

Dropped this course, he enjoys what he does. That being said he's ok at best, his PowerPoints are very scattered, he's hard to understand with his thick southern accent, he's SUPER LOUD to the point you have to wear earbuds to not get hearing loss, and 80% of your grade is exams. 70% of the practice exams reflect the exams which was nice.

It's very hard to understand him because of his accent but you will get used to it over time. You need to be prepared a lot for the exam. He would make us speak on a microphone in a lecture. Not very recommended for international students.

Really liked him as a teacher - however wasn't a fan of him injecting his politics into the curriculum whenever he could, often times it just led to an uncomfortable room atmosphere. However, a really cool and caring guy - just happens to shoot off about politics when he doesnt need to.

One of my favorite professors I've had at UK. His class was so enjoyable that I never wanted to skip! Not only were listening to him speak engaging and informative, but they were so darn entertaining! He made me interested in the class content because he was so easy to listen to and good at teaching. 100% take him for 202!

You will easily pass this class if you just do what he says. he sets his student up for success. his exams aren't even that hard if u study. there are only 3 exams so have to aim high for test scores.

Bob is an amazing professor and an even more amazing person. He is passionate about what he does and makes his lectures entertaining. He also shows a genuine interest in his students, and always makes you feel included. I always look forward to attending his lectures! I would absolutely recommend taking his class and I hope I get to have him again!

His teaching style is not for everyone but that being said he is hilarious. You definitely will not fall asleep in his class. He keeps it engaging and his tests are fair. He makes up the homework himself so the homework is also fair. You can pass easily if you pay attention in class.
Amazing professor! He is passionate about what he teaches and helps you try and understand these hard topics by relating it with things we know about. His tests are fair.

Gillette is super funny and makes lectures interesting, but the class itself is very difficult. Most of your grade depends on your exam scores. The exams are really hard so you need to study a lot. He does offer some extra credit during the semester which helps.
He is very animated and teaches the material well. Exams are tough though. He is passionate about the subject and his students so that makes the class enjoyable. He is a very good professor.

Bob is one of the best professors at UK and my favorite since I came to college. He is very knowledgeable about the material and has actual experience from his background in consulting. Bob loves what he does and stands out through how much he cares for students.

Awesome professor. He really loves his job and you can tell. Lectures can be long but he makes sure you really understands topics and he jokes around too. He's really animated so that makes class easier to pay attention in. Exams are tough and that's basically the only grade so you really have to understand.
He loves his job and it is awesome. Now I understand so much new concept like unemployement, inflation and economic cycles. If you go to class and take notes this class is not hard. Very interesting!

Awesome prof; one of the best at UK. He is clear about the message he is conveying and teaches you information relevant to modern issues in the US. Now I understand the financial crisis, GDP, the treasury, Federal Reserve, etc  because Bob G is so good at teaching macro. Highly recommend. Not hard if you go to class and pay attention

Great guy, that really cares about his students. Great personality and keeps you on your toes. I got an A in this class, but its pretty difficult. Have to do a CPA before almost every class, and tests are essay style and pretty difficult. Group project is a life saver.

Gillette will challenge you to keep up with the material.  The exams are a little difficult but fair.  All of the course material is gone over thoroughly in class.  You will struggle if you do not keep up with the "Class Preparation Assignments" on your own. If you really want to learn economics, this is the instructor you should take.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER!!! Professor Harden"s human trafficking course is the best course I have taken and will probably ever take. Although this class was very hard and I was spending 90% of my studying/work on this course alone, I learned so much and got a good grade for putting in hard work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Harden was the best professor I had at UK. There was a lot of reading and note taking. You do have to do work in the class, but all of the work is worth because you are learning so much. Nobody that took this class will say that they didn't learn anything. I appreciate the attention and care that Professor Harden put into this class.

Harden is very opinionated, but does not let it interfere with his lectures. He wants to see you succeed and will help you in any way he can to do this. Great resource if you need help in any other political or world relations classes. Tests were hard but he goes over them and you can still get an A even with lesser exam scores.

Mr. Harden was the hardest professor I ever had. Luckily, he offered a lot of extra credit and if something happened and you needed an extra day on your homework, he would grant it to you. He truly cared about his students but his tests were extremely hard and there was loads of homework. He also assigned a ton of readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Prof Harden is really caring about students as people. I went into this class not knowing a lot about politics and now I do feel a lot more informed. Anything assigned he's willing to help you with. There's tons of extra credit opportunities. The course has a ton of material to cover. Reading the text isn't necessary he covers everything in lecture
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The class is almost all lectures. If you take notes and study the powerpoints you'll do fine on the exams (especially with the curve). There is one group project that's a bit tedious but other than that the occasional homework assignment is quite easy. Lectures are sometimes dry but mostly interesting.

Really nice and funny guy. Very smart. Assumes you know a lot more than you do, which makes his class hard. Tests are hard, very lecture heavy. Not a great lecturer. Helpful when doing makeup exams but getting a C on an exam is really good.

As long as you do the reading and take the papers serious, you'll do fine! Pretty lenient grader on papers, just make sure you know what you're talking about. The final is long but nothing the average student can't handle. Everything in between isn't bad at all either, but he does weigh attendance heavily.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Very reading heavy, he assigns anywhere from 30-50 pages per class. If you do the readings you'll be fine. Essays are graded pretty leniently. I got a 99 and a 98 and definitely didn't deserve them. Very discussion based. No notes and no lecture. Overall, a very caring teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: With taking many Political Science classes, Professor Harden was not my favorite considering he was such a harsh grader and textbook heavy. If you don't read for the class, you are done with having a good grade + he gets mad. In his lectures, its so hard to write notes because it's so opinioned base and if you don't agree, he gives you 4/5's
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Glixon is a very interesting and engaging professor. For this class, you'll have to come almost everyday in order to get full participation points. He also gives you a lot of freedom in your essays, but he is a tough grader. Luckily, he gives you the chance to improve and resubmit your essays to get a better grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He stresses participation and in-class discussion over documents that are already hard to understand. He also says that interpretation is up to you but then when he grades your papers he'll tell you the way he thinks is more correct. This class stressed me out so much, and I didn't want to go most days. If you are outgoing this is the class for you
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Glixon is an excellent professor. You can tell he is excited about what he teaches and that motivates students. He gives good feedback on essays, pinpointing exactly what you need to change to get an A (you can rewrite them as many times as you want). Participation matters.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: 3 readings per week, 8-10 pages long. 3 essays - he allows rewrites for regrades. Glixon means the best, but he is almost too passionate about some of the topics. He also likes to ask questions that could have multiple answers, and he only has one in mind. Overall, hes a great guy and tries to keep it interesting. Best advice: PARTICIPATE!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a scholar, not a teacher. There is a wide disconnect between his level of intelligence and his students that he is entirely unaware of.

Professor Glixon is very nice. There are readings every night. In-class discussions are a huge part of your grade. There were three five page papers that he grades strictly, but you can rewrite them if you aren't happy with your grade and he clearly tells you what to fix. Overall, a kind of boring class but I would consider it an easy A.

Dr. Glixon is a nice guy but not my type of professor. He knows what he's talking about, but sometimes he forgets that you're not an expert in medieval communications. Grading will always be less than you expect for this reason. Rounds up significantly at the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Participation is vital in this class as the class is composed of student led discussions, Glixon only guides discussion when it goes off topic. Also, if you cannot get into religion, do not take this class, you will hate it.

You have to pay pretty close attention to him, because he gets sidetracked easily and you'll lose track of where his thoughts are going. Discussion is a huge part of the class so be prepared for that. Easy grader.

Glixon is the man. 3 papers, you can re-write each as many times as you want and one final research paper which you can re-submit once. Class discussions are like 30% of your grade, just show up and contribute a little bit after you skim the reading. He really cares about you and started some great discussions.Best prof I've had

He's just an amazing professor. Incredibly helpful and genuinely interested in the subject and your progress.It's not just about showing up to work for him, he actually cares about you. Definitely take him!

He was very interested in the subject. Attendance wasn't mandatory, but participation was a large portion of the grade. Reading was assigned every night, but one could easily get away with not reading. I would recommend him for Honors.

He's not great. Real tough grader, class discussions are tough to get an A in because you have to participate tons to get an A. You MUST MUST MUST do every bit of the reading or you'll risk a C or below. Definitely prefer my other honors teachers so far.

Professor Glixon was a pretty good professor. The class was 3 papers plus a final paper, not too hard. The discussions were pretty interesting. He didn't overpower the discussions and looked for student opinions. I would recommend him.

He is a wonderful honors teacher. He does not overpower the dicussions in class. he allows for the students to talk and debate about the concepts in the book. There have been some really thought provoking conversions in class and he relates to the students. He is really helpful and will take the time to explains confusing concepts to you. I would t

Dr. Glixon is by far the best music history teacher I've had at UK. Even though this period of music history isn't appreciated by everyone, he does a stellar job selling it. I never read the textbook, except to study for the exams (which you get a detailed  guide for), I just took good notes in class and got an A.
Jon is a good teacher. The class isn't too hard, 3 papers + 1 research paper.

Take warning she doesnt post her grades online and wont email your grade either. If you need to know your grade you have to go to her office hours. Not the best class for someone who has anxiety about grades. So make sure if you cant get to her office hours you try the set up an appointment to meet with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Shes very rude. Makes you feel like youre dumb for not being fluent in Italian. Never ask her questions or she gets annoyed. Just dont take her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof Allaire usually assumes you're being rude when asking questions. Grades aren't posted online, but you can ask her about it. She's a tough grader on individual assignments, but overall lenient on your final grade if you're working hard. You can miss a few classes, but I wouldn't recommend it. Online assignments can boost your final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Literally the worst professor I have ever met in my whole entire life. She is so incredibly rude and has no manners. Very odd manerisms and boring class.

Professor Allaire is the best language teacher I have ever had. Previously I had taken 4 years of Spanish & hadn't retained anything, but one year into Italian, I know more Italian than Spanish. She is very funny in class to make learning fun. But, she is about business. Don't be talking while she's talking & pay attention. She teaches in English.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I struggled with Italian up until her class. She was easily the best foreign language teacher I've ever had. She makes sure to explain things if you do not understand. She's also very understanding; if you put an actual effort towards what you are doing you will get a good grade. I would definitely recommend taking her over any other professor!

For anyone taking ITA 101, I would recommend you take Allaire.  If you show up to class and genuinely try, it will be the easiest A you will ever get.  She works through the material slow enough to understand, and while the in class activities seem stupid at times, they really help you remember and practice the material.  Best Italian professor.

I took the courses in the UK and she was not a good instructor at all.  She is not a native Italian and her accent is odd.  She was late to class and distracted and missed several of her office hour appointments.  She was not interested in teaching my class and I learned nothing.

I never write reviews on teachers. She has easily been my favorite professor I have ever taken at UK. She organizes the material in which, we as students, can comprehend. Take my advice, don't go with any other Italian professor but her.
Dr. Allaire is very knowledgeable and is really great at breaking it down and making it easier for students to learn a new foreign language.  You HAVE to go to class though if you plan to do well.

Dr. Allaire is an awesome professor. She knows so much about Italy and not just Italian. She teaches you culture and perspective along with of course the language. She is funny and does interesting class activities. Shes very hands on and wants you to understand. GO TO CLASS and you will get an A.

Excellent Prof. Understands learning a new language takes time. She tells stories as part of class to help teach the material and goes so far as to give Latin root meanings. Teaches grammar as well. She can be grumpy if the class isn't paying attention and sarcastic, too. Which I find funny as hell. Never mean, always helpful.

She is a very good teacher but she constantly complains about grading and how students don't care about the language. She expects a lot from students and gets  frustrated if you ask questions. Pay special attention to vocab and make sure you go to class and be prepared to do a lot of partner work. Uses book every day. I'd recommend her class.

You'll hear her complain about how she spends 14 hours a day grading, how students don't try, how the textbook is set up poorly, etc. That aside, she's a great educator. She has funny anecdotes about everything. If you haven't studied a language before, you'll have to work hard. Don't be afraid to ask questions.
One of the best professors I've ever had. She is CRAZY but she knows everything about Italian and better, she knows how to teach it.

Sometimes she gets off on tangents about how her students nowadays are mentally retarded and how Italy is amazing. When you ask for help she makes it seem like you should already know the stuff. Quizzes and tests are easy if you do the workbook and devote a night to study.

Very good teacher, you have to go class though. She's a little batty and seemingly bitter about the world, but shes really funny. This is definatly a class worth taking. Just be prepared to invest in some books...

First off, attendance is mandatory for this class. You will fail if you miss. Class is straight forward. Show up, brief, negotiation simulation, debrief, go home. Wont keep you longer than necessary, most classes last an hour and a half. Final paper makes or breaks your grade. Difficult, but he offers lots of feedback. Friendly and funny.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great teacher who clearly relates to his students. His lectures are fascinating and show a different way to analyze the world around us. He is clear and fair in grading and generally does not take off too many points even with lower-than-normal work. People seem to try hard in the class simply because he and the subject are fascinating. Worth it.
Best class ive taken at UK. He is funny, smart, and not a hard class as long as you show up. I actually enjoyed this class and he wont keep you longer than he has to
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Overall great Professor. Seldom makes the class stay just to stay. Gives a lot of feedback and participation is key. Going, paying attention, and putting in a moderate amount of effort will secure an A.

You can tell Prof. Gladstone know's what he's doing and is well respected among his peers. As a teacher, however, he's not the best. Lecture has minimal relation to the weekend assignments. He can be rude to students and is not afraid to call you out/embarrass you in front of the class. I will say, this class prepares you for the real world though.
Solid course
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This professor was great.  I would recommend him.  Gives small amount of homework and out of class reading.  Lectures are funny and informative.  He is engaging and helpful.  Overall great teacher.
He's soooooo great! very straight forward with his class. paper is 5 pages which is easy for a UK history class. take him because he's the man.

I took this class online, hoping for an easy pass/fail class. You have to summarize about 20 pages from the text each week and compare ancient documents.  The teacher provides feedback and answers questions. If you are looking for an easy online class, this isn't it. There is also a paper and 2 tests. Expect to spend lots of time.

took him for history 104 and 105. It's a lot of note taking, but not a lot of outside work. the tests are not too hard and only one five page paper which is awesome for a history class. He's really nice and if you take him for the 2.5 hour class he WILL keep you the whole time every time but give you a break halfway through.
Class is pretty boring, but most history classes are so its nothing out of the ordinary. Hes really nice.  He gives lots of options on tests so theyre not too hard.  Not a bad class to take.

I didn't really go to class because it wasn't really necessary. Weekly online tests that were really easy. There was a project we did that was a little random but not the worst thing in the world. The class was mainly busy work, but it was an easy 3 credits for core class.

Very easygoing Professor, and he makes his lectures actually entertaining. Attendance isn't mandatory, and there's not much homework, other than the few weekly assignments you're given. It's an easy class, as long as you actually do the work on time and put in some effort.

This man is the purest human ever. He cares about every student he has and is very helpful. This class is very independent work and you can watch his online lectures and receive an A. He is always trying to make class entertaining and ALWAYS makes time for his students if they need extra help. Definitely recommend if you need an easy Science credit
This class is very easy. If you do the two tests due every monday which are so easy and the packbacks your grade will be fine. Attendance is not mandatory at all.

Professor Gleeson is one of the best professors I have ever had! He makes class super fun with his jokes and occasionally breaks out into song with his ukulele. This class is pretty easy in terms of homework and quizzes. There aren't any exams which is super nice. If you need to take a science class for the science core this is the one to take!

The professor was fun, although I don't actually know what his face looks like. I took his class totally online. It was asynchronous which was nice, but I never really got to know the man. Class consisted of these rambling narrated PowerPoints where the voiceover was either too soft or far too loud. I wouldn't take his class again.

Easy class and chill guy. Never met him in person because of covid and the class was asynchronous but he was very clear on his standards and the assignments were easy. I actually really enjoyed the final project for this class. Would take him again (I hate science but he made the class bearable for someone who knows nothing about it)

The best professor at UK. Hands down. I took him for BIO 102 and was the easiest class I ever took. He makes lectures fun and genuinely cares about his students. He also counted attendance as extra credit if you needed it!
Take attendee on TurningPoint dont have to be in the class plus if It hurts your grade hw will drop It .
this class was literally easier than my high school bio classes. I 100% recommend Professor Gleeson. He make lectures fun and enjoyable. Exams are copy and paste questions from the online homework.

Very good professor, tries very hard to keep you entertained in class, makes bio interesting. Participation grades online, exams are copy and paste versions of his online tests, most answers are on quizlet! Very helpful and willing to work with you!
great guy. 10/10 would recommend
Easiest class at UK. Exams are word for word the study guide. Just turn in the HW on time and show up for exams and you get an A. all HW is word for god on Quizlet too.

A funny dude, super flexible with grading, class is super easy if you show up for exams, attendance is bonus points. He tries to make it really easy to get an A. Plays instuments during class, good easy A. Would take his class again

I forgot to do a peer review for the project (which was 35% of the project grade) and instead of making me do an extra assignment or just saying "tough luck", he gave me full credit. He's very understanding and his passion for his job is clearly seen in the way he teaches. Great guy, would recommend.
Such fun lectures. He is very entertaining and passionate about his job. He really makes the class interesting
i think i forgot to turn in my final project, failed every exam and still got a B in the class.
Hes the best Professor you will ever have, attendance is not mandatory and he is hilarious.
Tests are take-home, exams are word for word multiple choice off the tests, easy A, plays the ukulele every week

Scott is so funny, he will just break out in song in the middle of lectures. Attendance is not required and is a very easy A. One big project to keep up with and take home test. The exams are questions from past test which are on Quizlet so it's easy to cram the night before. If you suck at science THIS IS THE CLASS FOR YOU.

Great professor, cares about students and the class was easy enough to relax and focus on actually learning the material instead of just gaming the system for points. i would take his class again in a heartbeat

Scott is the man! They weekly quizzes can be found on quizlet. The exams are the quizzes word for word. There is one easy project that takes the 2nd half of the semester. Scott is very laid back and plays the Ukulele and sings at least once a week.I got a 58 on the final and still got a 97% in the class so don't worry much.

Professor Gleeson is hilarious and interested in helping students learn the material. The class was really easy, but attendance is mandatory (taken with clicker response ware). I always looked forward to going to this class and it balanced out my more difficult ones. He's down-to-earth and fun. Definitely take this for core if you have the chance.

I took this "science" class with Gleeson to fulfill my natural science core credit. It is sooooo easy, you don't even have to show up to class (download attendance software on your phone and you can click in from your room!) Exams are word for word from quizlet. Gleeson is so nice, he's willing to help if you have questions about the project

The weekly quizzes are easy and you use turning point, a response system, to track your attendance. By far the easiest science class to take for your core. Scott sings to the class too which is a plus

Scott Gleeson is the man. If you need a science credit take this class for sure. It is the easiest science class you will find and he plays songs on the ukelele like once a week which is an added bonus. The exams are the exact same as the quizzes. Easy and good class overall.
Most boring class ever. don't waste your $ on a clicker. just download response ware on your cell phone. easy A though

Really nice and helpful teacher! He said in the beginning he is not one to beg you to pay attention in his class, he knows we pay to go to class so if we don't want to pay attention it's on us. He is very out going, assignments can be found on quizlet, exams are word for word. LOVE THIS CLASS

This class is super easy. He does clickers, but you only need to click in once, and the answer does not even have to be right, and you get full particiaption for the day. So you can click in when he puts the question up at the beginning of class and leave. His tests are all based off the homework, so just study those answers and you will get an A.
He is super easy just study.

Dr. Gleeson is funny! He is very fond of his ukulele. However, this is a quack class. Show up and answer clicker questions. People do their homework or they are on their phones. The exams are verbatim from the weekly unit tests. The lectures themselves are boring I didn't really learn anything. If you need an easy credit, then take this class!

His lectures are pointless. Exam questions come directly off of the assignments online, so just memorize those and you're sure to get an A. His lectures are usually so far off topic that I don't even know what we're talking about. Seems like a great guy but not my favorite professor by any means.

Scotty G is a unique professor. He likes to yell THE GREEN SLIIIIME a lot and will play his ukelele in class. Participation is in the form of answering clicker questions. Exams are word for word from weekly "tests". FOLLOW THE GUIDELINE for the online lab. It literally tells you what you will be graded on - don't try to get creative with it.

He is not a strict teacher at all. The daily routine is come in, sign in if your "clicker doesn't work"(that he uses for participation grade) & then a lot of kids leave which he was starting to notice, he goes through his powerpoint, &plays his banjo. His tests are word for word from online chapter&lecture quizzes. I hate science&got an A still.

This course is so easy. There is no reason to get less than a B. Gleeson is a funny guy and doesn't take himself too seriously. Clickers are used for attendance, but he also has a sign-in sheet. The work is not hard and the answers are practically served to you on a platter. If you need some type of science credit, here's your class!

This class was super easy. There is no need to attend the lectures, so get someone to sign you in or click for you. The only assignments are online tests, a simple online project, and the in class exams. Gleeson always sings with his ukulele which makes for a fun lecture.
Great Teacher! Very easy to work with, made the material interesting
funny guy, keeps you interested, easy A!

CPR!!!!! The guidelines for the simple assignments were a little vague so it is really up to how people decide to grade your stuff. I had someone either run out of time for grading, or didn't understand the assignment give me a 60, and I missed a self assessment, those two alone took me from a borderline A to high C. Tests are simple, CPR sucks!

I can't see why people don't get an A in this class. If you show up and do the work (it isn't that hard), then you should get an A. Yeah, he rambles a lot and plays his ukelele, but he seems to enjoy teaching and he really loves his subject. He's really laid back and easy-going.  One of the easiest classes I've ever taken.
This guy is terrible, the project is peer review graded, so if you have a 95 in the class and fail the project you can get a C in the class, and people love to rate poorly on those types of projects.
This is perhaps one of the easiest courses that the University offers.

Stupid class. Your knowledge isn't important, but trust me, attendance is. You can get 100% on every exam and still fail if you find your time worth more than a silly Ukelele song every other day and then an hour of him blathering on about some inane "news," from ten years ago. Avoid his nonsense grading scheme like the plague, for real. AVOID.

Take him!! That is all I have to say. He sings to you in class and says funny things. Course is easy, just do the work and you'll do great. He's a super understanding guy too. Definitely would recommend

the tests are word for word what the online homework is.Attendance is by clicker so just have someone click you in or you can email him and tell him you were there&he will fix your attendance grade.If you need this class for your major don't take it with him. If it is just to fill the university requirement then I would recommend taking it with him

Really great guy... knowledgable. Very easy. Never paid attention in class and ending the semester with an A. Weekly homework quizzes, but very easy (and answers are always passed around). Tests taken directly from weekly quizzes. He's unintentionally funny, and sings! Great class to get those requirements filled in!

This class is very easy. Attendance is taken by easy clicker questions. (or you can just give your clicker to someone else) He plays the ukelele and sings. He is funny, too. There are questions every week that you have to do, but they are easy. The exams are the EXACT same questions that you get during the week.
very easy class

Gleeson is very knowledgeable about environmental science. He's a bit interesting. He sings to you and plays his guitar. Attendance is mandatory by use of the clicker. Tests are easy. Take him if you want an easy a and a study hall to complete other homework.
He is soooo easy! If you don't get an A then it's completely your fault. There are 3 assignments due per week and the tests are literally word per word from those assignments.

Cool guy, really dont have to show up if he has the sign in sheet option or you can have someone click for you .. he does 100% count for attendance so either show up or figure it out. Tests are cake. they are word for word from your hw and all you have to do is memorize basically. quizes once a week count as hw. will need book for those.

If you get anything less than an A in this class, it;s your fault. It is so easy, test's come WORD for WORD from homework. My section did have class on Friday, but you are allowed to miss 3 classes. Attendance is 25%, so if you don't like to show up, don't take this class.

I would take ANY class i could of his. He does lectures online. They dont take long to watch & you have 2 assingments due each week. You have a full week to do them and they are EASY. His exams come DIRECTLY from the homework. WORD FOR WORD. In class, he rambles but he is funny & extremely helpful. There's NO reason to get anything lower than an A.

He is so nice, and very helpful! Test questions are identical to weekly quiz questions. Judging from past comments, he has clearly changed the class structure from past years. I highly recommend taking his class!  If I was a BIO major, I'd take every class taught by Dr. Gleeson!!

Class is basically an online class. He puts the lecture online and class discussions are on a totally different tangent than the lecture. Exams are entirely based on memorization. The question are word for word from the lecture and book activities. Easy 50/50 if you are good at memorizing

Nice man but talks in circles. Gets off on tangents and spends a good portion of class on them. Kind of hard to hear because he likes to teach looking at the slide with his back to the class. Really has a passion for plants and has a good knowledge of them. Funny at times but then again gets boring. Monotone voice but it's not so bad.

Can sometimes embarrass himself, but at least he is entertaining. The exams come straight from the lecture slides and he is very clear as to what information you must know. Old exams are helpful, but certainly not necessary to excel.

He loves what he teaches and could talk endlessly about biology in the current news. The book is ONLY used on the weekly online tests and the attendance is NOT mandatory. However, he gives many extra credit point(6) for signing your name and ID number. If you know EVERYTHING that is on his Exam Help worksheet you will okay!

We do quizzes over the book but we never talk about the book in class. We go over 100+ notes and slides but he dosent tell us which will be on the test. My advice: do good on the quizzes and try not to stress too bad about the test, theres nothing you can do to prepare. He even said he dosent put questions of the exam he knows everyone will know!

He is so random and sometimes will just yell for no apparent reason, but that's probably the only way I stayed awake in the class. He is very enthusiastic about plants and it shows through his lectures. The exams are pretty easy. Just study the slides he gives you and you'll be all set!

Going to class is not particularly helpful because the test comes straight from the slides. If you want an A, just memorize them and your good. Other than that, he shows enthusiasm about what he teaches and tries to make class interesting which is more than what I can say for Bonner. He should also probably be checked into a psych ward.
He says to study the slides for tests, but you practically need to memorize them. There are also many of them.

Gleeson is enthusiastic but incredibly boring at the same time.  If you pay enough attention to take relatively good notes, you should do fine on the tests.  He curves quite a bit, and there are extra credit chances along with online tests to cushion your grade.  Also sings and plays his ukulele in class, which makes it a little more interesting.

I don't know about this guy. His lectures are incredibly boring and his personality is a little weird. He's like a really embarassing father. However, he gives curves and omits a few online exams. So, if you can understand Bio, you should get a A/B

He is an okay teacher for this class if you get him with the right other professor. I would recremend taking him with bonner. He tries to make these test ALOT eaier since they have a herder animal teacher. Whereas if you get him with who he sees as an esier teacher, he tries to balence it out by being the harder teacher. I took with bonner...A!
Study NOTES!! First test I used textbook and did terrible. Second I only read notes/lecture slides and got an A! NOTES NOTES NOTES!!!

He is my favorite teacher this semester. He really loves what he does and is very knowledgeable.  His tests are kind of hard but he gives HUGE curves.  There are also weekly online open book tests that only help your grade.  He's very easy to work with and is very nice and understanding

This class has been the worst class i have taken so far at UK. The test are worded so hard that no one can understand them. I would not take this class if i was trying to fulfill a USP, it has just pulled my grade down.

He is soo boring. I fall asleep all the time. I went to talk about my exam and he didn't help at all. Very confusing and boring. Yet, he does do weird things like dance in class etc. Take someone else!!

Well he has ALOT of knowlegde about the topic but has the hardest time in lecture staying on topic. The first 25-30 are just him talking about random subjects and most students fall asleep. After the 1st test less then half of the class attended lecture. Test are really confusing, but the homework helps alot...HE GIVES HUGH CURVES ALWAYS!

He is very knowledgable about the class. However, he has a hard time relaying that information to students. He rambles a lot and drifts to tangets during his lecture material, so it makes it very hard to stay attentive during his class. The tests are pretty challenging. Online tests aren't hard, but they're redudant and annoying.

I did not like this class. There were 300 people enrolled but only about 20 of us would go to lecture b/c it was so hard to pay attention to him. Internet homework boosted grades. Tests kind of hard. Never answered any of my questions over email. He loves his material but can't really get anyone else to care about his lectures.
online access to study guides and slides of power points, tests are too difficult, so he curves largely, weekly online tests are open book
Gleeson is very entertaining and tries VERY hard.  His tests, however, are worse than biting off your right arm with your own teeth.  Weekly homework.  He is, however, a very nice professor.

Definitely a relief after Cooper's first half of semester. Gleeson is a nut and his "Plant Dance" is hilarious! GET AHOLD OF HIS OLD EXAMS IF YOU WANT A GOOD GRADE!!! He never changes the questions from his old tests, he uses the same exact ones, doesn't even change the order of multiple choices! Prolly your best choice if you have to take 152.
nice one.

Wow today was my first day in class and I laughed my ass off. This guy comes to class in a red Hawaiian shirt with a fishing hat and a eukalaelee or however you spell it. He is hilarious and sounds like he'll be an easy teacher! Take him! :)

Eeek.  I wouldn't take this class again.  He couldn't keep the attention of very many students.  He's excited about the material, but doesn't know how to present it in an engaging manner.  Simply hearing his voice will put you to sleep.  Tests are pretty difficult.
easy class, funny guy

i loved this class: so easy, all lecture notes are online, no pop quizzes or in-class assignments, attendance isn't mandatory. i went to class most of the time anyway because i loved his sense of humor and teaching style. it's a shame so many of the people in my class had no reading comprehension or study skills, they almost ruined my experience.

I only went to class on the days of the test and got an A. This is the easiest class I've taken here at UK! Everything is online the study guides, assignments, slides,  so there is no reason to go to class. Just study the study guide and you'll do fine. Also he gives huge curves on the test.
pretty funny, but really confused teacher...i recommend the class, but study the slides he puts online for the tests...and above all else...do not buy the book, you will not use it
Let me tell you a little somethin about Scott Gleeson.  He's just about the coolest Led Zeppelin lovin tree huggin hippie around, but...... he is so confusing and unclear.

he's teaching 100 lev human ecology and hes a botnist. it's so hard! he can't teach the materials, the text is a waste of money b/c he never uses it, everyone fails the tests b/c they are on such a high level than his teaching. he's a good guy in 152 but a sucky 102 teacher.
I heart gleeson.
He is crazy and fun, definately a relief after bonner was through teaching his section.
Pretty cool guy! Good lectures

Dr. G seems very transparent and approachable. On the first day, he explains the 5% lecture attendance bonus offered at the end of the semester. Lecture isn't required, but the bonus can really help students. Although calculators aren't allowed, the exams are designed fairly and focus more on conceptual understanding than difficult math.

Mr. G was a great teacher. His notes were clear and very organized, and they were a big part of succeeding in the class. Make sure you don't just copy the notes—take time to actually understand them. The practice exams are very similar to the real tests, so use those to study. Also, going to class and recitation can earn you a 5% bonus.
TAKE HIM!!!! he's so good like actually
His lectures were very clear, and he explained the content very well. The exams were just like the practice exams and review. He also would often tell us what is actually going to be on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He cares about his students more than most professors at this university, he definitely is passionate about his career/subject and it shows. I do not think you could find a professor able to simplify/clarify calculus to the level Dr. G does. He is seriously the BEST!

Hes a very nice and helpful professor. This class content is difficult but if you pay attention, its not that hard, and if you go to the supplemental Instructions and the big exam reviews, it makes the class a lot easier. Tests are realy similiar to the practice exams.

If you take this don't make the same mistake I did and not pay attention all year. THE FINAL IS CUMULATIVE you will be in the trenches. The professor drops your worst exam grade and adds 5 percent which got me to be able to pass so that was good.
The professor gave 5% bonus if you attended class and did your homework. He responds to emails quickly. The TA I got did not teach at all; we did not know what we were doing during recitation.

Dr. G is an awesome professor. His style of note-taking in lectures makes the material very clear. Additionally, he makes the class easier for students by providing review material, and even telling you what questions to study for the final. The exams are very easy if you study for a couple hours. The class is so much easier than AP Calculus.

Dr. G is the best. Dr. G formats MA 123 in such a digestible way that it is nearly impossible to fail if you actually put effort into the class. People hate calculus because it is hard, but Dr. G cares so much that he makes it easy and enjoyable.

Professor is great...content is challenging/difficult.  It would be nice if there were a smaller number of students in lecture portion but recitation helps.  He structures the grading in a way that really helps people who try to learn and actually go to class. There is a bonus that really boosts you at the end.

The work itself can be challenging, but he makes the class much easier with his grading. Your final exam grade replaces your lowest exam grade, and he gives a 5% boost if your participation is high in the class. Aslong as you study a decent amount for the exams and go to class, this class should be an easy pass.

As someone who is historically terrible at calc, this is the easiest it's getting. Phenomenal lectures, which are all recorded and accessible at any time. He tells you EXACTLY what to study for the final, which also replaces your lowest test grade. To top it all off, you get a 5% grade boost too. DO NOT TAKE CALC WITH ANYONE ELSE!!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Literally love him, he is the actual best! This class was hard just bc I have other difficult classes and didn't really have enough time to be fully committed but regardless awesome. There are 4 exams, and he replaces your lowest grade with the final grade if it's better. Attendance is mandatory (iClicker) but you get extra credit for going 85%+.

Dr. G is awesome! As someone who sucks bad at math and struggled hard in this class he genuinely cared and tried his hardest to explain it as clear as possible to me. He is THE GUY to take ma123 with so try your hardest to get him.

Dr. G is the goat. If you take MA123, try your hardest to get him as your professor, even if it means having a lecture at a bad time. Just come to class, go to recitation, do your homework, and you get a 5% boost at the end of semester. The given practice tests are the exact same as the exams, and he tells you whats strictly on exam and whats not.

Definitely is the best professor for this course. However, the curriculum is more confusing than Calc 1 in my opinion. He uses iclicker so attendance is a big part of your grade. As long as you turn in all homework and have decent attendance you get a 5 percent grade boost at the end of the semester.

Attendance isn't mandatory for the lectures but it is for recitation. If you get Brian as your TA, you're set. Both him and Kyle are super caring towards each and every student, they are both super accessible and communicative towards students and overall can be an easy class if you study and actually understand the lectures. 10/10 would take again

He explained the topics very well in lecture and made sure to answer any questions that were asked. Recitation was nice to learn new topics before lectures the next week. No calculator on exams but this makes the numbers on questions much easier. Also %5 bonus to your grade for attendance and participation at the end of the class.

He was a great professor, class was difficult but I did really well in his class. Recitations were annoying because we would learn new material. Attendance is also mandatory and help a lot with highering your grade so I would suggest that if you are not the best at waking up early to change the time of the class.
He moves VERY fast, I had to teach myself a lot of the class. The recitation doesn't really help either. Exams are 70% of the grade. (Took Spring 2025).

Great at teaching material in a simple way; I even sat in class with AirPods most of the time, if I went. If you can do homework questions without help you can perform well on exams. Practice exams are same as actual exams just different numbers. Homework has infinite attempts without point deductions and if you need help just go to The Study.

From all my calc professors he has been the best. His notes get you prepared for the homework. The exam is very similar to the practice you get from doing the notes and the homework. When working through a problem he does not skip any steps. He never excepts you to know any thing in advanced. You will feel very comfortable asking him for help.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Gives really good notes and is one of my favorite Professors I have had at UK. Makes math very easy.

Overall, Professor. G was all right. I found myself learning the material on my own because the lectures are very fast paced and he's a fast talker. Attendance is mandatory so show up to class. If you are sick at all you're out of luck because you need a doctor's note. Both The professor and my TA treated the syllabus as if it were the Bible.

Dr. G was an amazing professor. This is a very difficult course, but he does a great job explaining course material as well as getting you prepared for the exams. Additionally, you receive a 5% grade boost as the end of the semester for just going to class, recitation, and completing your homework.

Loved Dr. G! Very detailed and organized. Made my first time taking calc manageable. Doing well on the 4 exams is a must due to them being worth 80% of your total grade at 20% a piece. Simply going to class, recitation, and doing your homework will earn you a 5% boost at the end of the semester, this was able to push me to an A. He loves to help!

Dr. G is truly the best! His lectures are perfectly paced and you can tell that he cares about his students' success in his class. If you complete homework and go to lecture/recitation you can earn a 5% grade boost. Couldn't have asked for a better professor for calc!
Dr. G made this class so easy to understand and he is willing to help with anything you need. Best math teacher I've ever had.

Easy class. The way he structures his class and the way he teaches is great. I appreciated that he was always available to assist his students in any way he could. Attendance is tracked, but it does not affect your grade as it is only for bonus points.

I loved taking this course at UK with Dr. G because he was always available to answer questions and wanted everyone to succeed. He started with teaching the basics of limits and worked us up to the power rule and even antiderivatives. I would 100% take another mathematics course taught by him.
He was one of the best math professors I have ever had. I understood everything great, he prepared us well for each exam. Such a nice guy!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He is incredibly nice and helpful. The homework has unlimited tries so you can always get full points for them. The tests are only 20 questions and not very hard. He is nice and sometimes will let you out early. If you go to him with a problem he will always help.

Really good math professor, cared about everyone being able to understand the material and lectures are slow enough to understand. The reviews are helpful in prepping for tests and always wants students to do well.

Loved having him as a professor for this class! Although the material was overwhelming, he did a good job at explaining how to solve and I really liked his teaching style! You just have to go to lecture to keep up!!
This professor is great! The material is pretty difficult but he explains the content very well. He goes slow and also is very open to answering questions during the lectures.
Even thought the math is hard he does a great job at explaining. Very caring and he's hot lol
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Inspirational--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. G was overall mid. I attended every lecture of his and still found myself struggling to learn the material outside of class. Your grade is very dependent on exams and recitation. Attendance for lecture is taken during class, but you don't receive any points for it at the end of the semester. The recitation TA's are also not very helpful.

Be ware this class is extremely difficult. This class will take a lot of time out of your week to get a good grade, but out of all the teachers this is the guy. What matters most is your TA. If you get a bad one do your best to switch as they determine your grade. Always do your homework on time to get full credit, and you should pass the class.
He is very good at explaining difficult concepts. Love Mr. G

Dr. G is a great professor, during lectures he goes and explains in detail what to do and not to do. He goes over the material at a good pace and makes sure that everyone is on the right track. Overall, he is a chill professor, and the material is easy if you attend lectures often.

Overall Professor Golenbiewski is an incredible Professor who cares deeply for his students, unfortunately, he teaches an incredibly difficult class that involves lots of homework and lots of studying.

Dr. G was a good professor but the content was hard. He goes really fast during lectures but is alway excepting questions if anyone has them. If you go to class and take the notes it will be so helpful when doing the homework and studying for exams. I would 100% take him as my professor for any other math class.

Let me preface this by saying that 123 is a hard class for most students especially if you're in your first semester of college like I was. If you don't show up to the lectures you won't do good on the exams. He is a very good professor and really tries to help students learn, but if you don't show up, there isn't much he can do. Show up & listen.

Dr. G is a good professor, but not anything special. While class isn't mandatory, lectures help you understand the homework. I liked the organization of this class, but he went through the materials quickly and doesn't always explain the answers to questions clearly- he expected us to understand the material previously. He will help you though.

Dr. G was a pretty chill professor, but the course itself was extremely hard. There is homework every week and four exams, and the final goes over the 15 chapters we went over, which was a lot of work and tears. But if you have to take this course, he would be the best professor to pick! He was always open to questions and offered office hours.
Goes through content way to fast, and describes it in a way that just made me more confused. His lectures are kind helpful but going to recitation helped me a lot more than him.

Dr. G was great, I just sometimes found his way of explaining things to be more difficult than they actually were. Lectures were often harder than recitation, and the exam grades are the majority of your grade.

I like his way of teaching. A little slow at times, but not bad. Not too enthusiastic either but I've seen way worse. He is always eager to help you during lectures if you have a question or if you need help with the homework after. Recommend.

He is a nice guy and offers lots of resources, but is not great during lectures. He spends such a long time going over one problem and his voice is so monotone. Attendance is not required, which makes going to class not incentivizing, especially since he posts filled notes online. Wouldn't recommend him.

I took his class again when I had the chance at another math professor. I personally really understand his way of teaching. He posts all of his notes online in case if you miss class. He only uses an attendance tracker for 162 so he knows if you show up. he doesn't grade you based off of it.

Class was super helpful and I LOVED his way of teaching. The only reason I got a B is because I only needed a 60% on the final to get an A so I didn't study. HIS FINALS ARE NO JOKE. Study for them hard. If you know all of the material you're fine. I just forgot everything and blanked.

Good teacher, made for matrix algebra. Tests are more theory-heavy than the homework. If you do the homework you'll ace the quizzes. He lets you look at your homework while you take the quiz, so take thorough notes on your homework. His study guides and notes are excellent.
Probably one of the best professors I've had a UK. He is a really good teacher and goes through the content at a good pace so everyone can understand it.

Professor Golenbiewski lays out a lot of resources for students to succeed in this course. The class is formatted in a very simple way to lay out a math class. For the exams, doing the practice exams and going over the review slides is the key to a good grade.

Great Professor, nice, teaches well, easy to follow along. HW is webwork, most of them aren't too long and its 80% reduced after due. Exams are not awful, practice exams help ALOT. Recitation is bad drops a few of your lower grades for some stuff. There is Iclicker everyday so class is kinda mandatory but you can def miss a few. optional textbook

Dr. Kyle is a great professor. He delivers the content simply to where you can understand it easily. He also is very accessible outside of class hours If you need assistance with a missing grade or if you miss class.
The class is very lecture heavy, but he assures every student is on the same page before proceeding to the next lecture topic.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. G. was a G. The way he taught the class was easy to understand. He was easy to get in contact with. That being said, the lectures were boring but that was to be expected. He makes sure there is a general understanding before moving on to different concepts. The tests were easy because the math problems were similar to the ones from the notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor. He did a good job of teaching the covered material. Lectures were boring but that is to be expected with math. Homework was usually only 5-10 problems and test were very close to the practice tests.

Kyle was definitely the best option for a math professor. He goes very in depth during his lecture to make sure this students understand. The material is difficult but he teaches it well. You have 2 homework assignment each week so not terrible. But I would not have wanted another professor for the class except Kyle. Definitely recommend!

I've never thought as highly of a teacher as I have about Dr. G. He's incredibly prepared for each class. Explains everything very thoroughly, never skipping a detail. He genuinely cares about his students, even in large classes and will explain until everyone understands. Absolutely take him if you have the opportunity. I can not say enough good

While he is always willing to help, his teaching is, for lack of a better word, stupid. He spends 25 minutes on one or two problems, taking the most difficult route possible to solve the problem. The entire class is problems and not easy to understand instructions. Not that this is his fault, but classes are very big and it is easy to fall behind.

I am not good at math and why the course material itself was not easy Dr. G was great! His notes are easy to follow and read. He's also very nice and was suer helpful whenever I visited him during office Hours.
Great professor, always open to others' opinions and concerns. Very knowledgeable.

Mr. G is really good at explaining things. Hes very patient and takes time to answer everyones questions almost too much time lol. Its also kinda easy to pay attention in his class because his voice sounds like John Mulaney :)

I had him for MA 123 and 162 and I think he's the perfect math professor. He doesn't take attendance and he's really nice. You get unlimited attempts on the homework and the exams aren't too hard. He provides so many resources for studying that if you have a brain it should be impossible to do bad. He also posts the completed notes after each class

I loved Dr.G's class. His lectures were straight forward and if you pay attention and do your homework it is very easy to do well on the exam. He is very helpful and available outside of class time. Make sure to use the resources like the Mathskellar and attend the recitations.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I failed this class but Kyle did everything he could to help me. He’s a good guy and I really liked his teaching style. The class wasn’t that hard I just had other stuff going on in my life

Dr. G is the best math professor I could have asked for! He is very helpful and willing to go over anything you need. All of the notes he goes over in class will help you complete the homework and practice for tests. Want to pass? Take the practice exams until the problems feel like old hat.

Dr. G was an incredible professor. He has plenty of opportunities to get help outside of class if needed. He helps prepare student for each exam and gets more specific if needed. 80% of your grade are exams so come prepared for each one. If you have the chance to take him, do so. Whether you are good or bad at math, he is a top tier professor

Coming in as a freshman, literally my favorite professor since his lectures are so easy to follow. Definitely go to his office hours for any clarifications. Crap load of quizzes, Webworks and lecture assesments to keep up with, so use those easy grades to fluff up your overall grade and you'll be fine.

textbook/ notes are free if you download them to your ipad, Pr. G is a great teacher he offers plenty of help and is willing to take class time to go over a topic again. Tests are hard but it's expected. Homework due twice a week usually just 10 problems. 4 tests totally. other points come from rec class which is somewhat helpful.

Dr G was about the best calculus prof I couldve asked for. Clear, to the point, and thorough in his lectures. There is a lot of hw and the exams are most of the grade, but there are ample resources provided both online and in person to help. If you show up to lecture, do your hw, and take advantage of help offered, youll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Kyle is a great person outside of class and was always there to help students. All he does in class is a worksheet which does nothing for students. His tests are extremely hard. My friends and I all had to drop this course. Expect 40s on most tests and if you don't show up to class, you literally will not pass. I wish I would've taken this at BCTC.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Such a good professor! Super sweet and very well organized which make the lectures very easy to follow and makes learning the subjects much easier. He makes it very easy to receive help which is not always the case with a lot of professors. One of my fav professors yet! Highly recommend.

Professor G is a great teacher! I really enjoyed his lectures because he took us through each problem and made sure that everyone understood. If I didnt he was always open to help and had many places to get help. I would definitely go to class unless you know the math because he give assessments based off the in-class work but it isnt hard!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had Dr Goldey for HHS 353. She is the best HHS teacher by far. You actually learn in her class and she is very prepared. Also it is a very relaxed environment where it feels more like a conversation that lecturing. She also lets you get a cheat sheet for each test which is very nice. She is the best. Take her if you can

Dr. Goldey is one of the best professors I have had in my 4 years at UK. I have had her for 3  HHS classes and she is so easy to understand, is very well prepared, and genuinely cares about her students. She will adjust things mid way through the semester if students are struggling and will adapt to your needs. Truly the best!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Goldey is an amazing teacher and clearly passionate about her job, we had two exams that were pretty big, but you get a "cheat sheet" so its actually not bad. I loved this class and this teacher, she made everything super interesting and fun.

Dr. Goldey is a great professor that cares about her students. She makes class interactive by having group discussions and the content is very interesting. There isn't a lot of homework, but there are projects and exams. The exams are in class and she gives study guides that are super helpful for the exams. I really recommend her!

Dr. Goldey kept this course very interesting. I enjoyed the class discussions thoroughly and learned a lot. I did not feel like this course or the assignments were a waste of time. Very applicable to daily life and our futures. Dr. Goldey is very open, easy to work with, and understanding.

I had a really good experience with Rae! She gave thoughtful feedback and seemed to really care about whether or not her students understood the content. She does give tough quizzes but I felt like that was helpful especially with the wood project.

She would always criticize artists consistently and came off as disrespectful. I know this is a required class, but I would recommend waiting until a better professor is available. She isn't as inclusive with teaching, barely teaches, gives extremely early deadlines w/o helping out, and doesn't provide enough instruction.

Shows very clear favoritism, and if she doesn't like you or your choices on projects, she grades them accordingly. Was rude and had A LOT of double standards. I literally ended up with an 89% and still got a B. NEVER TAKE HER EVEN IF YOU HAVE TO DON'T YOU'VE BEEN WARNED.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Absolutely horrific experience when she took over our 3D class. Nightmare to work with. Took away our work time to make us clean the three 3D classrooms despite it not being our mess, but her other classes. Doesn't value or respect your time and money. I would say avoid at all costs. You will not feel joy in this class.

I showed up to class late by 5 minutes because the bus was running behind. she marked me absent for the entire day and would not let me make it up. the very next class period she told all of us that her student teacher would be teaching today, because she was leaving for a meeting, and then the day after was late by 20 minutes. dont take rae EVER.

most disrespectful professor ever. She always was late or left class early, but then had the audacity to tell us to do the majority of project work outside of class. extremely passive aggressive and genuinely made me have panic attacks on multiple occasions, DO NOT take Rae no matter what, she makes you hate art
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She is the worst professor I have ever met. If you were late for 5 minutes, sorry, she would put you on the absence right away.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Rae Goodwin was a fine professor. She wasn't a great teacher but she was nice. Although it seemed like she spent the majority of class trying to make students like her. No one in the class was very fond of her, but the class wasn't hard at all so no one minded her teaching skills too much. Not sure if I'd take her for anything other than UK101.

Rae's nice, but she's not really accessible outside of class. Doesn't answer her emails either. She also gives a lot of lectures that are on the boring and obvious side that are made up of information that everyone already knows. I get that it's UK 101, but she doesn't cater to the class's boredom very much.
Shes a very nice person but I cant say I learned much in her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: IF YOU ARE NOT AN ART MAJOR, DO NOT TAKE CLASS WITH RAE. However, I'm an art major and I have learned so much this semester from her. She makes you work very hard so if you're taking this class as a core class, find a different one.
