One of the best professors I've had so far. Very knowledgeable in her field and wonderful to be around. Class was always pleasant and I never dreaded going. If you do the assignments, you'll pass.

Rae is a great teacher and mentor, se can be rather intimidating at times and will not spoon feed you. She tries pushing your limits - don't confuse her for ignoring you, or being rude; she just tries to get the best out of you as an artist. Getting an A in her class will require hard work on your end, but it is very achievable.

At first her personality was  bright and funny so I was excited to have her. The more we got into project the more I began to dislike her. If you come up with an idea for a project be ready to change it because she will make suggestions she expects you to follow. She's also gone a lot for her own art which I found rude.
worst teacher at UK. She is also so into herself the class may as well be her on personal performance art and or stage. She's also rude and her strong personality makes it difficult to talk to her.

I had Rae for 2D, my first college art class. Her strong personality can be intimidating. She won't spoonfeed you, she expects you to keep follow the syllabus, invest time and effort, and really learn the material. These are GOOD THINGS. As the dept head, she sets the bar high for the other profs. You'll earn your grade in her class!

Rae is one of the worst professors at UK. She was personally nice to some students, but knows little about art that's useful. She requires that you show up to class and do your work on time, even when she incorrectly states due dates she expects them to be turned in "when she meant," even if she didn't say that date. She's useless and awful. AVOID

Rae is one of the best professors at UK. She was there for me through a very difficult semester and she is a wonderful friend, and knowledgeable in her field. She requires that you show up to class and do your work on time. You have to really read and take notes on the text, but it's worth it. If you want an A in the class, you have to work hard.

She excuses her own inability to teach as "Showing you what it's like to have a bad Professor," but it's quite obvious she's only making a feeble attempt to cover her own lack of knowledge and desire to teach. She's no good at what she does, and will make your semester hell. Stay far far away from her, at all times. No, really, stay away.

She cannot teach. She assigns reading every week, but on the first week said nothing about turning in notes. I didn't, and got a permanent zero. She never reminds you of assignments, and assigns really horrible things. She makes you go to a gallery opening, and an Art Event in town, away from campus. 90% of art events in Lex happen on campus. AVOID

Incapable of teaching. The class is meant to introduce you to college life and rules, instead, she teaches it like a normal class and expects you to know the rules already. She's not helpful, and rude. She neglected to fix two of my grades that were zeros due to her error. Grades went in today, and I got a grade lower than I earned. She's useless.

I have found that she seems really nice and outside of class she more then likely is, but in class she is rude and she told us that it was her job to teach us what a bad professor was so that we could learn from it. Also if she failed to mention something to you, she will blame you for not hearing it and penalize you for it.She is not a professiona

If at all possible, avoid not only this professor but also the class. The class is nothing but silly chores, like visiting galleries and "art events" around town. Apparently our studies don't take up enough time, so we must do this. Despite this class being an intro to Art School, she explains nothing clearly, not even her own assignments. Rude too

I am going to go out of my way to make sure I never get thiswoman as a teacher ever again. She plays extreme favorites, and if you don't kiss up, don't expect to get an A, and expect to be treated rudely. And if you only do what she says, you get a C, you have to go way above and beyond to get anything better than a C. Good Luck. :/
really nice, but so hard to understand. her directions just are not clear enough to actually do the work correctly. i heavily relied on her power points as well as group members just to get through.

I'm an engineering major taking this class just to fill couple core requirements. But by the end of this class, I was more worried about it than most of the classes relating to my major. Grading is extremely subjective and Daria helicopters around you, taking away a lot of the creative freedom from a class that's supposed to help grow creativity.

Dr. Goncharova is an extremely sweet and caring teacher. Her classes are laid out in a very simple and easy-to-follow way, and the work load isnt too bad for an English class. The only downside with the class I took is that she made it very political. However, her understanding and forgiveness with students mostly makes up for it.

Professor Goncharova is super sweet & really cares about her students & their success! There are a lot of assignments, but thats typical for an English class, & especially since 112 is 110&111 combined . A lot of the grade comes from three big assignments, which all the little assignments build to. Not my favorite class but not a bad one at all!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: You will have multiple assignments throughout the week that are not worth any points, they are just considered participation. This is on top of other major assignments which she grades pretty hard. You feel like youre in elementary school with all of the little assignments that are meant to keep you on track.

You have tons of assignments in this class. I mean tons. Every two days you will have to do up to three outside of class readings and then write a written response to each one. It feels like a lot of busy work. In addition to this, the professor is somewhat of a hard grader. Makes you feel like you're an English major, even if you're not.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Be respectful, show up to class, do your homework on time and let her know if you are not showing up. You are guaranteed an easy A for this class. But don't expect anything other than getting a good grade because its not going to happen. The "discussions" every so often become political or about Amazon.
Class is very easy. Reading and writing-heavy, but not much in the way of actual work.

While the class is very easy, it is discussion based, but she is unfair in most discussions in how she responds to responses. A student answered her question and she said it was wrong, another student paraphrased and she praised them. Not only that, she also tends to bring up politics a lot which is not appropriate for a COMPUTER ethics class.

The class itself is easy but she is just the worst. She treats her students like they're middle schoolers and not 20+ year olds. She often yells and makes accusations. Not sure what her deal is but everyday I go to ethics I know it's gonna be an unpleasant experience. I've never left a review before but I felt compelled to after this experience.

Dr. Goldsmith is a fantastic professor and if you show that you are putting in your best effort (even if you struggle) you will easily get an A. It was refreshing to have a class that strengthened my reading and communication skills after so much time doing nothing but math!

The class isn't hard. You work in groups and do reading assignments. She expects group work based on readings every single weekend. Goldsmith isn't the best to be around—she has a nasty attitude and was very political for an ethics class. Get on her good side (if that's even possible). I definitely wouldn't take her again, but the credit was worth.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: I took her CS Ethics class and the class itself was very easy. However, she would constantly call students out in the middle of class very aggressively (tardiness or computer being opened), she brought up her political opinions at least once a class, and she claimed ALL students used AI on ALL assignments (no proof needed).
Dr. Goldsmith is awesome. Just a heads up though the way they teach is discussion based, so be ready to talk and ask questions!

I had her for CS Ethics. I really liked the class and learned a lot. There was a lot of participation. You have to write a short essay every week. She gives great feedback on essays and the final project proposals. She really cares about the people in her class and the topic!

A few of the programing assignments can be difficult but nothing crazy. Cutoff for an A was 83 and 1 of the programming assignment grades was dropped, so just turn stuff in on time and don't forget to do the short writings/discussion posts. Her lectures weren't always super helpful but attendance isn't required.

Judy Goldsmith is a great professor. Your grade is mostly the projects and the stuff for the final paper thru out the semester. She also drops the lowest project grade and made an 83 an A so it was super easy to get an A. Lecture attendance isn't mandatory but is recommended to do well on projects
Judy Goldsmith sucks. She literally sucks. Don't know how she became a professor instead of a housewife. Worst professor ever and ever

This course has a lot of projects, but they're not unreasonable. Dr. Goldsmith is a super reasonable grader, she never says no when the class asks for an extension, and she is encouraging of collaboration. Most importantly, she cares a lot about her students and understands how stressed we are. Her grading is super generous.

She's a caring professor and cares about the students. However, the course had 4-5 projects and a final project. She ended up making an A a 80% which was nice but the course had way too much work for a 3 credit hour class. Be prepared to have to ask a lot of questions about project criteria.

I had 15 hours of credit. Even during Covid she mercilessly made the course load so high that it was more work than my entire undergraduate courseload combined for one course. This is unacceptable. Other people have backed this up on ratemyprofessor. It is certainly accurate. I am a straight A student. This was horrible and you will cry.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Goldsmith has unreasonable expectations. She allows group work for some projects then gets frustrated when you do group work. For assignments, she sets rules, breaks them, and creates new ones on the spot. I took this class, hoping to learn AI. Instead, all I did was write papers on topics she found interesting and correct. STAY AWAY
reviews.rating_tags: SO MANY PAPERS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Fun lecturer, not a fun professor. Really passionate about her subject. Asks questions and gets students involved. The assignments and expectations are not well defined. Jumpy in terms of topics in class and doesn't actually end up teaching you what you need for the assignments. Work load is way more than the credit hours merit.

Dr Goldsmith is one of the best lecturers I've ever had. When students ask questions in class (and she is good at getting us to ask questions) she understands them and actually answers them. She makes us see exactly what about the problems make them interesting. Standard CS course format, with lectures in class and a homework every other week.
Best teacher I ever had.

Exceptionally unclear instructions for assignments and profoundly unorganized, even for a tenured professor. Has undisclosed expectations for group projects. Does not have students best interests at heart .
Very much interested in getting her students engaged, she won't do with a lecture what could be done with a discussion and she won't give an exam when she could assign a project.

Dr. Goldsmith is one of the finest teachers in the CS Dept. She makes the class really interesting and assumes students are mature. If the students expect everything from her side, well you shouldn't be in the grad school then.
Very helpful in office hours.  Lectures are enjoyable.  Gives good examples.  Very interested in listening.  Don't be late!  Late homework, even 1 minute late, is not accepted!

Lectures are terrible.  You are given no pointers as to what is important.  We spent two classes going over a simple game, and then 5 minutes talking about the algorithm she wanted to explain with it.  Assignments are not defined very well, so you can't be sure if you're really finished or not.
This mop-lady is mean, uninteresting, and dull overall. It seems like she compensates for her lack of a real life with small esotericisms.
No Comments
No Comments

Very helpful and a great teacher.  She speaks with great clarity and tries to involve everyone in the class, going as far as making people speak up.  She certainly has a passion for the subjects she teaches.
she is really kind, just actually gives so much homework. the exams are challenging, but the topic is interesting. massive lecture hall. will not get much 1 on 1.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is so sweet and genuinely cares about your grade. There's usually a lot of information in lectures and you do have to read some outside of class.

Cool class but lots of work. Surprise paper at the end of the semester on top of the final exam - total of 3 exams. Homework quiz with long reading every week takes a long time if you read the whole thing but you do get two attempts on the quiz. Attendance is graded on accuracy to the echo questions instead of actual attendance so good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I am not a fan of History and this class was required but Dr. Goan truly made the class the best she could. She gives amazing and fun lectures, she's very understanding and easy to get a long with, she treated all students with respect and as if we were her own kids. She also tells you what to expect on exams and there are no surprises.

I am not a fan of history but Dr. Goan made her class very enjoyable. She gives great lectures that are easy to take notes on and is available to help anyone if needed. Her TAs are also a big help. As long as you study, tests should be an easy A. There are 3 papers due however she only keeps the 2 best scores. Interesting class and 100% recommend.
Dr. Goan was a very helpful professor who was open to student involvement in the class. She is flexible when it comes to due dates and is open to extra credit.
Honestly depends who you TA is, but as long as you go to lecture and take notes you will be fine. She is very passionate about her material. Makes it interesting

In opposition to most of my fellow classmates on here, I really enjoyed Dr. Goan as a professor and person. Her lectures are a storytelling-nature, which is very fitting for most history courses. All assignments had clear expectations, the midterm was a great format for a history class, and basic reading quizzes every week. Not difficult at all.

Honestly my least favorite class and professor since I have been here at UK. Hard homework assignments and extremely difficult midterm. She goes through notes fast and hard to take detailed note for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: very hard

the class is okay if you go everyday, and take extreme notes. but if you miss one you are not going to do well. there are too many research papers and they grade them very hard. the midterm is extremely hard and long for only a 50 minute time frame.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Made everything ten times harder then it needed to be her TA's saved her too many times

If you love history, I have a feeling Dr. Goan would be an excellent professor. Her lectures were quite interesting, however I did not like the American Yawp textbook that went with the course. It was very hard to follow along with. The course wasn't too hard, history is my weakest subject, if you like history, you'll be fine.

There are a lot of tests with questions about topics we barely discussed. Take very detailed notes during lectures. I would rate her as a poor professor, but she was very fair and professional. She was simply a harsh grader and required high levels of participation.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Honest review here for Professor Goan her lectures can be long and boring but make sure to take decent notes and study the Quizlets to pass her exams. If you dont show up dont expect to receive a good grade simple. If you study and put in enough effort you will receive a good grade. Do not be lazy on your papers either.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: you are required to read two books which i didn't read and i still made an okay grade on the papers. but you need to study for this class because i didn't study for the first two exams and failed both. i studied for the final and made an 85. she says that there is no way to get a 100 on papers or exams. the ta's dont really help you either.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Would definitely recommend taking a class with her. She really cares about her students and helps where she can. This class is not easy, you need to make sure you listen to her lectures (her class is lecture heavy) and take good notes, but if you attend classes and do the homework quizzes, it is really easy to get an A in her class.

Goan's lectures are boring and she goes through material pretty fast so it's kinda hard to take good notes. In class echos are small points but if you miss a lot, they add up and can drop your grade. Your overall grade basically depends on how hard of a grader your TA is, which is annoying and not really fair. Exams are a lot of writing & studying
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Annoying when it comes to the work, all of the echos make a big deal on your grade. The exams you have to write so much in a small amount of time. She has even said I dont know how you guys can write that much in that time. Which feels like she is setting you up to fail, if she even says its hard. We go over information but it does not count.
She will blaze through lesses and will get off topic frequently.

Dr. Goan is a really kind lady. Her lectures do get quite boring and are rushed through really quick though which was hard for me. Homework and quizzes have to be done by the book. You do have multiple papers and books to read, but you can get by without reading them. Exams are easy as long as you study. Recitation teachers grade harder.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Goan, she is a true gem.

Class was pretty okay. Lectures are large so you don't need to pay attention, but exams are pretty difficult and completely essay based. Not a single multiple choice. Also made exams harder during corona? Class also included papers, reading homework every week, and a group project. Melanie makes it more hard than the class is worth.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Goan has been one of my favorite professors. She is incredibly knowledgable about history and it shows in her lectures. You need to complete the readings, if you sparknote the books youll be fine. Dont rely on the prezis, you need to pay attention to the lecture too. Her exams are not too tough, I can make an A by studying the night before.

I'm a business major with a minor in history and this class was so much harder than it needed to be. The TA I got was the worst you could possibly get so this is a review for him. Fletcher is by far the worst TA I've ever seen. Not only can you not understand him but he grades your exams and papers as a 300 level class. Fletcher wasn't nice at all!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: I would not recommend this class. There is 3 tests and you have to memorize so much information for only a quarter to be on there. They consist of identifications and an essay. The TA's do the grading. You have to read 3 books and right a long paper on them. It is pointless to go to class because her lectures consist of prezis with no information.

Professor Goan is an amazing teacher, but I would not recommend this class if you're not from Kentucky as it will be more difficult. Class has easy weekly readings, 2 essays, and 2 exams. Participation and coming to class matters.

I almost lost my 4.0 because of this class but an A is possible with lots of effort. She is a super picky grader when it comes to papers and exams but she is open to helping you during office hours. She puts a lot of emphasis on participation and will give you a low score if you do not speak in class. Weekly reading quizzes, two essays, two exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The class is straightforward, but there are three books you have to read that are pretty pointless. The exams are all short answer/ essay so you really have to study for them. Overall, good class and nice professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you want an easy A, Melanie Goan's HIS109 class is not one by any means. I would suggest not taking this class if you have the chance. The exams are all written responses, and there are several difficult papers. Attendance is not mandatory at all because the material on the study guides are just on quizlets that you can find online.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Good class and good lectures. Everything is clear and though out. Just make sure to prepare for exams.

Fantastic professor! Her class is very straight forward if you come to class everyday. If you do assignments according to the rubrics you will get an A. Tests are very straightforward with no surprises.

I wouldn't consider this class to be an "easy A" by any means. There are a few papers along with three tests. She tells you exactly what will be on the exams, it's just a matter of memorizing all the material. Tests are all short answer and essay.

Professor Goan was one of the best I have ever had in college. Her enthusiasm and passion for teaching this course is something that I really enjoyed. If you are not from Kentucky, you will learn a vast amount of important/awesome history of Kentucky. Likewise, if you are from Kentucky there are things that I learned that I did not know prior.

Dr. Goan is super passionate about this class which will rub off on you! Definitely need to go to class and participation matters. She understands that not everyone wants to speak so she gives you other opportunities to get your points. Amazing professor!

Dr. Goan is amazing! She definitely makes you work for your grade, but showing up to class and participating is key to getting the grade you deserve. She is very personable - I highly recommend to take her class if you want a professor who actually cares. Dr. Goan is by far one of my favorite professors on campus.

Attending class is definitely not necessary. For our tests my notes were useless and you can complete the echo without having to be in class and you'll get the participation points for "being there". She's a good teacher but I just lost interest because it was honestly pointless in attending class. Didn't enjoy having to read 2 books as well

Dr. Goan gives really good, in depth, easy to understand lectures. You have homework assignments every week but you can find them word for word in the free online textbook. Everything you do outside of lecture falls under your TA and mine was super helpful which made it easier.

If you like history its great. There's lots of reading and listening to her talk about history. She uses Prezi... Also, food. Like our books are about food. And our paper is about food. It's not awful, but I won't take again. If you study for your tests, you will pass. All open ended and identification of words.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Amazing professor! She gives really clear and in-depth lectures that are interesting to listen to. Expect two homework assignments for the reading weekly. There is an essay on two long books you have to read throughout the semester, but you can honestly maybe get away without reading them if you can write well enough. Tests require you to study!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She was soo sweet! I loved listening to her lectures too! Definitely would recommend taking! Beware of your recitation teacher though, because they do most of your grading!

Makes you read tons of books throughout the semester and sometimes overlaps them making you read multiple at a time. Gets kind of confusing. Class is ALL discussion based. She's nice but a tough grader. If you take a class with her be prepared to read, write multiple papers, and take essay and term structured exams, no multiple choice!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I'm not a history major (or even overly interested in history for that matter) but I enjoyed Prof Goan's class. She's extremely knowledgeable and passionate. Attendance and participation mandatory. Weekly online quizzes are 10 questions and in order from the reading, takes 20 mins. I took HIS109 with her and would take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Goan is a really good professor at UK. HIS 109 is a pretty basic history class and you can get an A if you actually put in some effort. Dr. Goan lectures the whole class but is very enthusiastic and tries to keep it interesting. You read two books throughout the semester and write a big paper near the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Would take again

reviews.comment: So good realy sweet and nice
She is very passionate about history. Very sweet and funny. I enjoyed going to her class. Be prepared to write a lot of papers. Test are essay form but pretty easy if you know the material
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Dr. Goan is a great teacher and definitely knows what she is talking about. Lectures get boring after awhile but are definitely beneficial for the exams. Attendance is mandatory. If you want a class that isn't to stressful than take His 109 with her.       Mr .Zinkle her TA is really cool too.
Prof Goan is a great professor and if you have to take history take her, she is passionate and sweet.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Goan is super sweet, however, her method of teaching is not very good. She's puts on powerpoint that are outlines, so if you don't go to class, you will struggle in the class. She's a tough grader. And you have to read ALOT. sometimes 150 pages a night.

She has enthusiasm for what she's teaching so her lectures aren't too boring.  The toughness of the grading depends on your TA. Mr. Baker was mine and was very reasonable with most assignments and exams. All around, if you try on most tests and assignments you can get at least a B no problem.

Dr. Goan has been one of my favorite professors at UK. Although the class requires a decent amount of work, she is there to help her students. Take advantage of her office hours. She is a great lecturer and make sure students are prepared for the tests.

She was very laid back and personable! However,  I didn't realize I was registering for a careers in history class. I would like to take an actual lecture class with her because she was a good professor but this class was more about job preparedness. Overall, I would take her again forsure and the class is good if youre about to graduate.
Great professor! Works hard and truly wants her students to do well. Always available. Easy to have a conversation with.

She is my favorite professor I have had so far in college. Go to class and listen to the way she lectures and she makes you want to learn. She is passionate and it really helps you be engaged. As long as you listen and attend class you can get A's on all the test. Homework once a week. Recitation once a week. Really inexpensive/ interesting class.
Good teacher

I have no complaints about the woman. She is fair in her grading and expectations. Lectures are fast paced. She uses Prezi to guide her lectures, but they are only outlines. Be prepared to have cramps in your hand as you scribble down every word she says (that's the most important). Show up and care, with that in mind the class is an easy A.

She is a good lecturer and held my attention most of the class. Information was easy to understand, there was just so much squeezed into the semester. She flew through almost 200 years of Kentucky history in 4months. Tests can be tough because you never really know what she wants. Always do the homework and go to class. Ask your TA's for help.

I really enjoyed having Dr. Goan. She is extremely knowledge and makes sure that we know why everything she tells us is relevant and ties into the bigger picture. Getting an A is definitely achievable but you will have to put in a decent amount of effort on a weekly basis. It is a lot of time to go over in just one time period.

Dr. Goan is super friendly and easy to listen to. She posts all of the slides online after class. There's online quizzes over the books, but there's no time limit and she gives you 2 attempts. Participation is required in discussion. It's not an easy A, but you'll get an A if you put in effort- even if you're bad at history.

The class itself if over an interesting time period in American History, but Dr. Goan jam packs each lecture and teaches at an unreasonably fast pace. It is hard to keep your notes up with what she is saying. In recitation you hardly go over what's being taught in lectures. Exams are all essay exams, and they are graded harshly.
Professor Goan and her TA Mr. Chilcote went above and beyond helping me finish this class.  Awesome!
Great and fun teacher. Loved her lectures
she is a good teacher but she only does the lectures, so it is important to have a good ta
She knows her stuff, and class can be interesting. However, grading is very tough, sometimes too tough.
She knows her stuff, but the grading and tests are a little harder than expected.
I loved Dr. Goan and this class! She is an excellent lecturer and very easy to listen to. I would definitely recommend this class to anyone looking for an interesting, enjoyable gen edu!

Overall, she is friendly. She makes an attempt to converse with the students. However, she makes the class much harder than needed. She is an extremely difficult grader! I was expecting this class to be relatively easy, but it is not.

This class was overall pretty easy. I opened the book less than 5 times and got an A. For the exams she gives you about 40 key terms and 8 essay prompts on a study guide and you explain 5 terms of 8 that she chooses and one of two essays chosen on the exam. If you pay attention in class and do the study guide you'll be fine!

She really cares about students. It doesn't appear so at first and she is very intimidating. She grades hard but let's you redo your papers however many times until its perfect. She just wants to see hard work and effort. Brought panera on the last day of class. Taught me the most and best advice on writing, really pushed me to do well. THANKFUL!

Mrs. Goan is a good teacher who knows the subject material extremely well. She is excellent at making the material worthwhile and in terms of usefulness, she makes sure this class will impact you. However, she is far too harsh a grader which makes sure this class comes with a challenge.

Dr. Goan is a good lecturer, but is horrible with grading. She has very specific expectations on tests and papers, and will not hesitate to give you a bad grade, no matter if you meet the requirements of the assignment or not. Overall, this class isn't cake and is harder than it should be.

Prof. Goan is not what I expected. If you're used to a history teacher as an old man who sits and tells you stories, this is NOT the class for you. Lectures are boring. She stands in front of 300 people with a monotone voice reading from a script. Attendance is NOT mandatory for lectures but for rec it is. Don't really need to read textbooks.
Great professor overall

Melanie is awesome!! She's changed how she teaches the class some, and she really takes student input to heart. She doesn't take role every class, but she is aware of who misses. However, she is VERY understanding about absences if you email her ahead of time. She loves this class and is so intelligent. I highly recommend her!

She requires that you know what you're talking about on the essay/tests.  She gives you names of poeple/events and you need to talk about them on the test.  A big essay requires that you connect events in history together.  I would pick another prof.  She's tougher than I'd like for KY history.

She's very nice, but like others have said, her tests are kinda hard.  Also, don't think that just because she doesn't call roll you can miss- she really does know how many times you miss.  She is very helpful if you go to her office hours.

She's very nice in class, but is also very demanding in terms of the assignments. As long as you attempt to do the work diligently, she's a good teacher to have. She is very willing to help you succeed and seems to genuinely want everyone in her class to do well.
Good at relaying the info, but come test time watch out. She is a stickler when grading and never really tells you exactly what she wants.  Everyone thought it would be cake, took some work however.

Would not ever take again. Cannot explain concepts clearly, rambling about confidence intervals for 40 minutes explaining nothing meaningful. Goes on tangents and complains in class about unnecessary things. Learned everything from textbook outside of class, never learned anything in lecture. Handwritten notes and exams that are illegible.

Dr. Griffith was a fine professor. He teaches the content exclusively on whiteboard. During lectures, he often rambles on about stuff for minutes on end. This can make lectures extremely boring. Exams made up 75% of grade. However, all 3 of the exams were very easy with him providing formula sheets for 2 of them. Very good with responding to email!

Mr. Griffith is a nice dude, and he intentionally makes the class pretty easy. He knows that. So even though he pretty much spends the class discussing stuff that isn't all that interesting, the class is fine. If you put in a little effort, you'll get an A. The tests require a bit of knowledge on units you've covered, but are often common sense.
Show up and Pass

Griffith is good teacher to take if you're just filling a core requirement. He rambles...a lot. He usually spends the first 10-15 minutes of class rambling. However, if you just show up and turn in whatever homework was due, or whatever worksheet you worked on as a class, you'll pass easily.

He is an easy grader but he does not explain much in class. This class is a lot of teaching yourself. Participation in class helps your grade a lot. Overall it is an easy class just boring. He goes off on rants that have nothing to do with what you are learning, which just makes everything more confusing.

Dr. Griffith is very boring, but he does not make the class harder than it should be. He lectures in class, then you do a worksheet that you turn in at the end. He pretty much will give you the answers. He offers extra credit a lot, so answer questions in class. Tests are straightforward. If you know how to do the worksheets, you'll be fine.

By far the easiest class I've taken in my life.I did not attempt extra credit and received a 102%. He's also the most boring professor I've ever suffered. He rambles and often says incorrect things or says opinionated statements as acts.  He is, however, very clear in his teaching.  So clear it is boring. Take him for an easy A, not a good class.

rambles on and on and on...even though the lectures are beyond boring, it's an easy class and you are able to teach yourself. However, you need to go to lecture because he decides at random when to collect work for points.

He rambles alot during class but will help out students with a grading scale. One time he gave a pop quiz but it does not count against you. Tests are only 30 questions multiple choice and has 1-3 tricky ones. He is not very interesting but the material is not hard for you to teach yourself. Overall, a good class and easy A or B.

This man rambles about God knows what for 50 minutes. He is virtually impossible to follow. If you are going to take this class, I hope you're good with teaching yourself the material. He uses 200 words to make a point when it can easily be said in a sentence or two. This class is definitely not recommended!!

Going to lecture is absolutely pointless, however, he threatens attendance quizzes (though this has never happened).  He reads off his notes, but doesn't allow ample time to copy them down. I've taught myself this material and have been lucky to understand it.  Unless notes go back up online, I'd say stay away. Recitation isn't helpful, either.
He is extremely caring and helpful. He is also easy and will fix the grading scale in the end to help students. Very clear and lecture notes online.

Really nice guy but tends to ramble.  I don't recommend takikng it @ 8, he is not lively enough to keep you awake.  Tests are multiple choice with a few tricky questions but all in all they're fairly easy.

Don't go to class. He puts his lectures online and then reads it word for word in class. Tests are easy but have tricky questions. Be careful and read the question a few times on the test. otherwise, piece of cake!
EASY....easiest class so far
Very critical and expects too much from everyone. Tough grader.
She is very difficult to communicate with. She acts super nice and understand but doesn't back it up. Her instructions are hard to follow and her emails are non sense.
Too strict on grading.

This class is mentally and emotionally exhausting. Nothing anyone writes or says is good enough for her. I felt like I was being criticized (others too) just for the heck of it. This class made my depression way worse, unfortunately it's required. Oh and don't bother with the textbook, it is useless.
Lectures were mainly going over written assignments which were meant to be completed before class. Attendance is mandatory. She is a very nice professor and does not grade super hard.

She is a very smart professor and nice lady, no doubt!! But I definitely think she's on a power trip. Her lectures overcomplicate things and make a menial task seem much harder than it needs to be. I agree it comes off very insecure and like she needs to prove her intelligence to us instead of just teach us. Makes asking questions hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: These reviewers surprised me. Dr. Tekeli is very positive, helpful and honest. I would definitely recommend her.

This class requires you to participate during lectures and has its fair share of homework. She was always available and happy to help if I had questions. She genuinely cares about your success in the class. I certainly wouldn't hesitate to take future classes with her.

I dont know how she has a bad rating. I had her for a mandatory class, and she is so sweet and funny. Unless you expect to never go to class or do the work I do not see how you would not get an A. She has everything perfectly set up on canvas and explains exactly what she wants. Her expectations are very clear on the first day

She was nice and gave good feedback. There are lots of assignments in this class, and you will need to put in a good amount of effort, but it is doable. I hated the amount of group assignments, but liked doing the presentation and final report at the end of the class. She does grade really slow, but if you put in the work you will do fine.
She is a nice lady who will help you if you need it. There are a lot of assignments in this class, and she does take a long time to grade. Attendance is taken at every lecture

Content of the course was not the problem. The content was actually quite easy, it was the fashion that she organized the course. She gives a lot of busy work and spends a lot of time on other things rather than the assignments we have been given. She is big on group discussion, which I am normally fond of but in this class it was a time waster.

Utterly horrible if I am being honest. This lower level class that most are required to take turned into my own personal hell. While my friends with other professors were raving over their WRD 111 professors, I was stuck with this one. Seemed like she was worried about how smart we thought she was and demanded respect but it was not reciprocated.

Showed absolutely no respect to her students but demanded it herself. It seemed at times she was trying to prove her intelligence rather than educating the classroom. The environment felt very much like a secondary school type environment rather than a University. I would not recommend.

Genuinely the worst- took forever to grade assignments, horrible communication, lots of busy work, very passive aggressive. The kid that participated most in class was picked on the most and she treated him horribly. I hated this class, not kind or caring by any means. I would steer clear, there are so many other standup profs in the WRD department

Had a hefty group project assigned & the last few classes before the due date she had us playing "shark tank" instead of working on the task. Treated the class very much as a high school course, if students were late or not paying attention she would call them out in front of the class and pull them into the hallway like we were 5.
expects you to participate

Nice person, passive aggressive sometimes. Calls on you and lots of group projects. You speak in class a lot (for people who are shy I WOULD HIGHLY NOT RECOMMEND TAKING THIS CLASS). Things were hard to follow and she would put in grades very late so you would never know what grade you have in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I would highly suggest avoiding this professor. She was very unfair and disrespectful to students but demanded that we show her respect. She put more effort into looking intelligent than she did being a decent professor. She also took forever to grade things so I never actually knew what my grade was.
Excellent

Every assignment has unclear instructions that are way too long... making it seem like the professor cares more about looking smart herself than for students to understand what they're doing. Takes forever to grade, yet assigns so much busy work that builds off each assignment. No way to gauge how well you are doing in her course because of this.

I could not figure out how to turn in an assignment at the very beginning of the semester and she said she would change my grade if I showed her proof of a time stamp. This was the very first assignment of the semester and I reminded her multiple times in class and on email and she never fixed it. This caused my grade to go from an A to a B.

Professor Tekeli was extremely helpful and clear with what she was expecting from us. Even though there was a lot of busy work, I think that the engagement/participation really helped with my grade overall. As long as you're communicating with her she is extremely understanding and kind.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: A lot of busy work that is not necessary

One of my favorite professors I have had at UK. She is super kind and her lectures are usually pretty interesting. Her grading is very fair and she's super sweet if you go to class, participate, and put away your damn phone. It is kind of a lot of work but if you do it all then you will get an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She assigns to much busy work. The peer review worksheets are ridiculously long. She takes forever to enter grades so you don't even know how you're doing in the class. I would not take again
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is very personable and seems to care about her students. She is very reasonable as well, as long as you communicate with her. LOTS of busywork, so get ready for random freewriting activities on what we're discussing in class. I really didn't mind her class though, I had a good section that got along really well and she got along with us.

The course requires two books, but you never use them. Don't buy them. I didn't and I was fine. She is a bit of a hard grader with the second paper, but otherwise, for all the busy work, if you follow the instructions, you're good. I would prefer her online for this requirement versus anyone. 1 recorded video speech versus in person all the time.

If you HATE presentations, take this WRD class online with her! Other online professors make you come in/do (live) presentations. She only requires 1 pre-recorded presentation. A lot of busy work, but a pretty easy grader if you follow the rubrics & instructions. Will do 2 papers, a recorded presentation, a podcast, and a blog. Don't buy the books.

I took the online section and the class was much easier than the other sections. There were a total of 2 essays, 1 speech, 1 podcast & a blog projects. Even though we weren't supposed to meet in person, we still had lots of Discussion Board posts that mostly required a 300 words essay. It was a really easy class. Just be on time & you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: No tests, but there are three (short) papers. Very nice person but you can't miss an assignment or it'll tank your grade. Book review project at the end of the year instead of a final. Overall, there's a lot of reading but she doesn't force you to participate in class discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Gives good lectures, lets the class decide whether or not attendance is graded. Unit 3 is rough.

Dr. Groleau is very passionate about his work and his field, which bleeds through in his lectures. Sometimes, because of this, he will go off on tangents that may not be engaging for students not interested in analytics. The class itself was really easy though, and exams are structured in a way that if you prepare you should get an easy A!
His such an Amazing Professor. I loved his class. Assignments were so easy, and so were the exams.

An honest review on the AN 300 class itself and not just how interesting of a person Professor Groleau is. His lectures can be interesting, but they don't have anything to do with what you're actually learning. There are no TA's in the class which is unfortunate because this class is difficult. This class will not give you a true education.

Great class, great professor. Groleau is a freakish athlete, almost as good as he is a professor. I know everyone talks about his crazy impressive backflips, but once I was working out at the alumni gym and timed his mile on the treadmill under 6 minutes. You do need to go to class in order to perform well on exams. Def recommend!

Theres no way to make an analytics class enjoyable. He came about as close as you can get. Theres lots of homework but there are attached video tutorials explaining how to do it all so youre never just lost. The lecture was at 8am and wasnt very useful so I eventually stopped going. I learned everything during the homeworks anyways. Hes a nice guy

Given it is an analytics class, you can expect a lot of online work and studying, but for his class you really are all alone. Honestly might as well turn it back to asynchronous. Little explanation over exam material and when he does he flys through the calculations and formulas without providing an explanation of what he is doing.

Great teacher! Super knowledgeable, cracks open more dad jokes than a midlife crisis. Only downside? I was devastated to learn he can't do a backflip after literally breaking his back last year. 10/10 would recommend, but don't expect any gymnastic stunts in this 300-level class!

An300 overall just isn't the greatest class to take. I will give the professor credit on the fact that the material is disinteresting and has complex applications; however, Dr.Groleau doesn't make it much easier to understand. During his lectures he will steer away from what students will actually have to apply on homework and exams, goes off topic
He is so nice and such an amazing professor. he has so much knowledge. Take him!!

This section of AN 300 was exclusively for Honors students and in-person and sounded far easier than the online-only section taught by other professors. This class was my easiest class of the semester as Dr. Groleau made lectures enjoyable and applicable. The new textbook shows you how to do labs. Final Project required for an A in the class.

Professor Groleau is an awesome professor, class is enjoyable with intriguing questions and he is always willing to help. The only Extra-Credit opportunity is to juggle in front of the class for 1 minute. Finally, he has a thing for an imaginary cat who sings but don't hold that against him because he also has a lovely northern singing voice. :)

I currently have Professor G in AN/MKT 306. He does a really great job bringing together real-world examples to illustrate the often complicated and boring data concepts. In other words, he makes a difficult and boring topic entertaining and understandable. He gives you everything you need to do well. Thought-provoking and funny. Super chill guy.

Very engaging lectures, and teaches you a lot as long as you are willing to listen. Most importantly though, one class every year, he will do a backflip. It's crazy. He turns in the air like a trained acrobat. He doesn't warn you either. I was eating a granola bar playing sudoku... I look up and brofessor is making upside down eye contact with me.

AN306 - Dude is pretty chill. Plays jazz music before class sometimes and buys the class shaq-a-roni pizza after every assignment. Has insane range of vocabulary too btw, get ready to google some words sometimes. Would take again in the future.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class is entirely formatted through Cengage, so he does not do any actual teaching or even grading. That being said, he is very accessible outside of class and an understanding (& eccentric!) man. Make sure you only send messages through the special email though, or else he will not respond. There were lots of extra credit opportunities, too.

We miss you, Gurney. This past month I went to an event, surrounded by people who adore you to pieces just as much as I do. I think you'd be proud of all of us. We keep kicking. The world isn't the same without you. I can't wait until my little one is old enough to tell her about you, and how many people's lives you changed for the better. x

GURNEY NORMAN IS A PURE GEM. Dr. Norman is precious, passionate about writing, and really emphasizes ENG207 as a space for creative writers, not a class mandated by the university. He's super chill, and while class can be boring at times, his sweet disposition makes up for it. I can't emphasize enough how inspiring and pure this guy is!

Gurney is seriously the best instructor I've had at UK. He really cares about your learning experience within your own writing rather than having tests or memorizing things. He gives you great positive feedback and is a super amazing guy all around.

Gurney is my favorite English professor. He's very positive and helpful with his comments on your work. I recommend taking him as many times as you can.  It's an easy A, as long as you show up most of the time and do your 3 writing assignments.
Sweetest guy ever. Takes your "future writing career" very seriously. One of my favorite professors I've had.

She is currently works part-time and often shows up late to class or multiple calls. The lectures are long and consists of tangents and hypotheticals that mislead you from the information of the book. By the way, the exam is made by the book company's website so it gets quite confusing when you combine the two. The average 1st exam score was 62.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Terrible professor, always late to class, doesn't respond to emails
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Her lectures are 2.5 hours which gets super boring without any visual presentation. I could not even take notes because I had no idea what to write. I tried to email her 3 times about an excused absence and she finally responded with a rude comment. I have not 1 clue what to study for the final.

She is a very condescending and rude woman. She is always late to class, provides no notes, no PowerPoints, not a single thing. Her lectures are a mess, she rambles for 2.5 hours about the same singular topic. She straight up does not teach and is completely unresponsive to email. It took me 3 emails to get a one sentence reply from her.
Worst class at UKY. do not take unless you have to. the class has zero structure as she just rambles for 2 1/2 hrs giving you no note structure or study guides for quizes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is so cool in class, has zero censor, and will say what she wants to who she wants. She's a retired attorney so she has amazing knowledge on the course but final exam is very difficult. I would 100% recommend taking a class with her though. She has been one of my favorite professors. Also very understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She does no slides or powerpoints in class. Post nothing on canvas. While she is teaching you can't tell if what she is saying is her opinion or something you need to be writing down. The only thing you have is the book. Very unfair teacher I recommend to never take her. Worst teacher I have ever had.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Choose any other Professor
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Don't take her! She made this class more difficult than it had to be especially during a world wide pandemic. She did not post any resources on canvas to study from. Also, it took 3 emails and a canvas message just to get a response back about a grading question that I had. She provides next to no info about anything in the class.

Probably top three worst teacher I had at UK. Screwed the class over in spite of her own mistakes. Didn't understand teaching interfaces. Took all study materials and files down before final (in spite of students calling her out for mistakes).
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is really funny and she knows a lot about the subject. The class was 2.5 hours long, but she made it seem shorter just because she has a lot of interesting things to say. The class is more difficult than it needs to be and the final is worth 40% of the grade. Make sure you keep up with the chapter outlines and you'll be fine
She knows what she is talking about for sure but it is a hard class. You can get a B without that much effort but it is hard to get an A. Partly because the way the class is set up.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Nope. Just no This teacher is terrible take another MGT 340 teacher promise itll be easier and you'll probably actually learn something

Denotra is a lawyer so she knows everything about what she is teaching. She makes class extremely interesting. Enjoys when students participate and ask questions to spark class discussions. Exams come directly from the book, you HAVE to read the chapters. Can get an A or B in the class if you study the material well. She interested me in the subj!

She is a lawyer and covers material as if you are too.  The first part of the semester was easy because it was mostly all discusion.  However, we then had 3 test including final every other week.  Must keep up with a lot of material.  I'm sure there is an easier MGT 340, but nonetheless it was an ok class.

Good teacher, but demands more than most do in this course.   It was a very time consuming course, but well worth the effort, as it allowed me to learn alot, as well as retain it.   Stupid questions need not be asked in this class, as you will quickly wish you had not asked them.  Gunther does have a bit of an attitude, but she is very accomplished, and knows what she is presenting.   Keep in mind, that the final was culmulative (and I presume still is), and there is ALOT of material covered.
Sassy and outspoken, DeNotra is an excellent as well as entertaining teacher. Thorough and first-hand knowledge of the subject matter. Not exactly sweet, but very nice.

Avoid this guy for MA123 if you can, he's the worst. Try and get 100's on the quiz. He overcomplicated subjects and his teaching style isn't effective. We had a sub teach the class for a day and that's when I realized how bad of a prof Bert was. Do NOT take this class another 4 credit class, you need to put all your focus on this class.

Dr. G is a wonderful professor, he is always very thorough in his explanations in calculus. Although it is a very hard subject to understand, more so to teach, he does a fantastic job. He is consistent and is always willing to answer questions with no backlash. Go to his or your TA's office hours, it helps a ton.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Bert was not very good at explaining any topic in this class, not to mention lectures were super boring. Does a lot of iClicker questions. I had never taken any calc before so this class was very difficult for me. Learned every concept outside of class. Recitation TAs are terrible. Only good thing was posted old exams are similar to actual exams.

This class was pretty easy. Guillou kind of teaches in a funky way, so going to recitation is really important so you completely understand. You get 5 skips, but he uses iClicker a lot so going to class is pretty important. I thought the exams were easy, but some of my classmates have a hard time with the exams. You do need a clicker for this class

He's the kind of professor that might be too smart to teach this content. Elementary calc comes easy to me so I haven't struggled. The HW is often way harder than anything you'll be tested on so be prepared to go to the study. Nice guy and tries hard to make everyone understand but try to take Druvinga if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Guillou is . wonderful teacher and lecturer IF, and only if, you actually attend his class. His notes are posted online, but the explanations that take place during lecture are VERY important to the course. He is easy to access outside of class, and he always tries to find ways to relate the subject to the students that they will remember.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Lectures are extremely boring and does not explain the topics well at all. When you ask questions, he does not provide a good explanation as to how to get the answer at all. Recitation class is terrible. Old exams are posted online and are very similar to exams he gives.

Does not explain things very well, just does an example on the board. Not very good at answering questions. I had never taken any calculus class in high school so I struggled in this course. There was homework every week that ranged from 10-20 problems. However, he was very nice and willing to meet for office hours. Recitation TA was clueless.

Guillou doesn't explain the examples in class, he just works them out. When you ask a question he very vaguely explains. They will recommend the MathSkeller but go to the study. The TA was not good and never seemed prepared.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Guillou is not bad, or incredible, but right in the middle. The class is structured so that your grade is heavily reliant on tests which consist of very little questions, which I don't like because then each one is worth so much. There's frequent homework but if you engage in recitation you'll be fine because the TAs are amazing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Would take again

reviews.comment: While I wouldn't take the class again, he's a great professor. His lectures can be boring at times but the assignments aren't bad and its very relaxed
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, would definitely take his course again. There is a group project at the end, it is important to be interactive and put a lot of work into it to receive a good grade. Participation is a decent part of the final grade as well.

Even though this was an online course, he still was very helpful. The workload was pretty light each weak and the podcast and reading was actually interesting. He responds very quickly on emails and is understanding about any issues that may need extensions.

Such a nice guy and an amazing teacher, somehow managed to make what I thought would be a boring class into a very fun and engaging one. He is extremally lenient and understanding of the fact that his class isn't the only one you are taking and will give you an extension pretty much no matter what.
Dr. Griffith is an absolutely amazing and caring professor! Although this is an honors course, it is very easy to do well. Lots of group work!

Dr. Griffith is an amazing professor, definitely one of the best WRD teachers. He is extremely lax on attendance (5 free unexcused absences and very forgiving of any excuses for absence). His projects are very well laid out (expect group work) and he is a very kind grader. Would definitely take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Griffith is a fun and intelligent professor who is extremely lenient with "excused absences" and provides clear grading criteria. He often bases your grade on the self-feedback you submit, making the process straightforward. With only seven total graded assignments, this class is an easy A—as long as you put in a little effort!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This was a super fun and easy class. There are not a lot of assignments throughout the semester. He does a really good job explaining the requirements.
10/10 would recommend! He's rly funny! You can tell he actually cares about his students and does what he can to help them.
Dr. Griffith was my favorite professor this semester, he was really nice and flexible with deadlines. Not a lot of writing assignments and it was mostly group work.

I enjoyed having Dr. Griffith as a professor. His lectures were always very entertaining and engaging. He gave in-depth feedback on all assignments and was a relatively easy grader. He also responded to emails in a timely manner. I highly recommend having him for WRD 112 if you get the chance!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super great professor and he gives amazing feedback. Really enjoyed this class.

Zach is amazing. Hands down one of the best professors I have had at UK. Cares deeply about his students and wants us to enjoy the material. He is flexible and understanding with assignments and classes. Engaging and fun, this is a class and professor you don't want to miss.

Professor Griffith was my favorite professor this semester! He is so kind and gives excellent feedback on assignments. He really wants his students to participate and engage in class and ask questions. There is one paper and a group project which is actually very fun. I highly recommend taking his class! I wish I could take a class with him again!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: He's a really good teacher, and he makes the class interesting and fun. Most classes are discussion based and he does a good job of facilitating class involvement. He isn't too hard of a grader and is accessible outside of class if you need additional feedback or help. Overall great teacher. You should take his class.

Zach is a great professor. He takes pride in his class and cares about his students. You must show up to receive small amounts of in class points but missing a class here and there isn't a huge deal. He grades clearly and fairly and is rooting for his students to do well! Good guy.

Zach is a pretty chill dude. He can be a bit unclear about how he will grade, but overall, the grading was fair. However, I think at the end of the semester he was trying to scare us. He gave most of us the lowest grade we could get and still have the grade we wanted. It ended up working out for me though. Overall, I'd recommend.

I really liked Zach. His grading is harsher than other WRD professors and he takes a while to grade assignments, but he gives really fantastic feedback on every assignment. He really cares about his students, and even though he's a student himself, he is willing to make time for you outside of class through office hours or through email.

Zach is easily one of the most laidback, funny, and real professors I've ever had. He tries to make the class interesting and it is for the most part. You only have to write 1 paper, do a few speeches, and 1 group project. I don't have anything bad to say about him. Definitely take this if you want an easy WRD class.

Zach was such an amazing prof! While I wasn't too keen on the topic we would be covering for the semester (advertising), he made the class really enjoyable. He obviously did enjoy talking to us in class and he made a lot of jokes. Your grade is based mainly on a few projects, but they're not super hard if you pay attention in class and can write.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: I can't stand Zachary. He wastes class time showing stupid videos that don't relate to anything half the time. He doesn't offer any way to improve your grade and gives bad grades often. I wish he would realize that WRD is a class no one wants to take and that people who show up and work hard should not be getting B's.

Almost everyone In my class got B's. He grades harshly and doesn't make it clear what he is actually looking for. He also judges people more so on their abilities than effort. WRD is an intro to writing course, not everyone is a fantastic writer and he is only going to give A's to people with natural talent. I don't recommend this teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Zach is a really good guy however he is a really tough grader. He lets you turn things in for feedback before they are due but doesn't tell you if you are on the wrong track. His class consists of very few assignments (3 of them are worth 20% each) and he grades them extremely hard and with unclear rubrics and grading scales.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Professor Zach's class, he kept the class interesting throughout the semester and you could tell he genuinely cared about every student in his class. Although he took some time to grade our assignments, he made it a point to provide detailed and personalized feedback on every submission. Highly recommended!
Really cool guy who gives great feedback for any assignments you do. Very easy going.
Cool professor. Barely use the required textbooks for WRD112.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I would recommend taking Zach. Throughout the semester you will listen to a lot of podcasts, do blog posts and a group project at the end. There will be a few in class writings and a paper you will do on your own. He is willing to meet with you outside of class and give you feedback on your writings. There is not a final as there is a presentation.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Zach is a really great professor and he cares a lot about his students. He wants everyone to be successful and takes the time to give thoughtful feedback if you ask for it. The course is definitely an easy A as long as you show up for class and complete assignments on time.

Zach is a great dude. I had an 8am WRD 110 class with him and it made having an 8am easier. We could miss up to 8 classes before we lost credit for attendance. The homework consisted of maybe 3 reading from the textbook and listening to podcasts. Everything else was for the major assignments in the overall course. I would recommend to take Zach.
The class was pretty straight forward. Nothing to crazy and it was pretty easy as long as you did the work. I walked away with an A and there was never a big workload.

Zach was funny and made the class interesting & insightful. I enjoyed going to his class and learning. But WRD is supposed to be an easy A, and his grading makes that hard. He is a very tough grader & didn't put 3/4 of our assignments into Canvas until the day before grades were due, leaving 0 time for extra credit or a conversation about grading.
He was the best professor I have had so far! He is so funny and caring and grades honestly and respectful! I highly suggest you take him for WRD 111!
Fantastic teacher! He made an 8AM worth going to, the work was reasonable and definitely better then any english class I've taken!

Zach was an awesome teacher. He made having an 8 am not the worst. The class was useful and didn't ever feel like a waste of time. Zach told good stories. He was super personable and truly seemed to care about his students. He responds in a timely manner. I would recommend him to everyone! I would love to take another class taught by him!
Zachary is my favorite professor from this semester. Class was easy and fun, while you were still learning things. He made an 8am easy to go to.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She never helps students when they are stuck or having problems with the assignment. Instead she becomes very irritated and accuses the students of wasting class time. Good luck getting the correct formulas to use.

She is extremely unhelpful and blows off questions. She cannot keep up with the grade book so you will probably retain a bad grade until you go to someone to fix it. She acts like everyone should already know what she is saying and gets mad when you dont. I would never recommend to take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Is very rude when approached and makes you feel dumb for messing something up however, if you do ask a question, she is still rude about the response and does not give very helpful tips either. Tells you to follow directions of lab, but the labs directions are not very helpful and they are vague.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Hartman only cares about you if you are absolutely obsessed with Video games. Half the time, he is talking about politics and random stuff during the required Discord meetings. You could do everything right on the assignment, but he will still only give you a B.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a great professor, at times he can go on rambles on how people don't show up to class that's online, or he will talk about politics more than his own lectures. He used Discord for classes and information instead of Canvas, which I don't like, seeing that Discord is more personal for me, so this might affect some students.
Michael is awesome and fun to listen to

Professor Hartman is caring and has a lot of passion for the subject! As long as you communicate and put effort this class will be a fun learning opportunity and for any designers and developers out there- helps alot to understand the material!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Love the projects/works we did through the course and able to apply many of these amazing knowledge/experience in my career field.
Professor Hartman has never been anything but fair with me and is always willing to accommodate to his students needs as long as they do their best to stay on top of material.

AMAZING!! Overall he's just a professor you wish every one was.
Work wise, there was an average amount, and he's not a tough grader as long as you follow the minimum requirements.
The only thing people probably won't like is that he uses Google Drive & Discord over Canvas and Outlook which can be a learning curve for some.

Dr. Guiton was by far one of the best professors for many of her students in the Chemistry department at UK. But there is an exception to this. If you want to pass this course, you should be prepared to do a lot of homework based from lecture notes and the text. The exams are difficult, unless you actually understand her lecture material.

Unless you like the flipped classroom model and prefer to learn that way, I do not recommend this professor.  She does care about her students which is helpful however, the way she structures her class creates 3x the workload that would be required of a regular section. She is not helpful in lecture so you either understand or are left behind.

Dr. Guiton is such a wonderful lady. Her office hours are the most helpful things ever. She will remember your name and help you keep up with your progress in your class. CHE105 is a difficult course, especially as a freshman but Dr. Guiton will set you up for success with the daily class worksheets and availability during office hours.

Dr. Guiton is a good person overall and does care for her students. The way UK chem department organizes things is just absurd. No matter how many complains you make towards the dept. they won't care at all.

Shes a good professor but the class layout is bad. I wish she would just lecture instead of making us do playposits. Also if you dont get it the first time on the playposit you get a bad grade. The tests are also pretty much your whole grade.

This professor is not horrible, but the layout of CHE105 doesn't work well with her teaching style. The lecture is not a lecture, just a time to work on optional worksheets and homework. The actual lecture is through an online video with questions that you don't even get credit for unless you get the answers right. Chem 105 is hard.

Good teacher, and definitely cares about her students, but her class just was not for me. She teaches through Play Pos Its, and only lectures for 10 minutes at the end of class each day. Attendance is taken through iClicker, so if you have friends in the class you really don't need to go. Overall good teacher, but her class just wasnt for me.

Professor Guiton is truly great professor. Chem 105 is a very hard course with hard material, but she breaks up the content into videos. You have to watch the videos before class and answer questions throughout, or else you'll fall behind, as she doesn't teach during lectures. She also does helpful review sessions before every test during class!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She's so nice!! The coursework was hard but that's less her fault and more a fault of the chemistry department.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The lecture is mandatory in order to receive an attendance grade but actually attending lectures is unhelpful because only a non-mandatory worksheet is done. Beth does online lectures that are helpful to look back on but are not specific enough to do well on tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Guiton is a solid choice for a chem professor! She is very helpful, but it is a TOUGH class. Go to office hours. HOWEVER: all of her lectures must be watched prior to class, and in class you will work on worksheets which you can ask questions about. You will need to set aside about 1 hour the day before each class to watch the lecture videos.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Guiton does not care about her students personal life although a very respected teacher. Her class is taught through online videos even though attendance is mandatory. Hard to learn if one learns best through in-person lectures. The tests are worth 51% of your grade and the homework assignments do not reflect the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This course would be much more beneficial if Dr. Guiton lectured during in-person lecture and gave us the videos to do outside of class. The achieve assignments are SO difficult and do not accurately portray the difficulty of the problems seen on exams. Exams also hold a ton of weight so make sure you study!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Guiton has been one of the best professors that I have ever met on the UK campus, even though the course itself is tough. She is really considerate about your overall grade and loves to help with assigned homework assignments if you ask during office hours. I find her lectures to be helpful, even though the homework was tough.

This is by far the absolute worst professor I have ever had. She literally makes you watch all of your lectures online and then come to mandatory class where she does not even teach and you basically just sit there after completing practice problems on your own.
