Unhelpful in office hours and does not care about her students at all. Lazy teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Guiton was amazing! Her lectures are given outside of class which allows you to go at your own pace. Class consists of review worksheets and practice problems so you can figure out what you don't know. The course itself covers difficult topics, but if you go to class and ask questions you will do great! She wants all students to succeed!
Guiton is amazing as far as chem professors go. Lectures are given out of class, and class time is actually just review sheets and practice. Sweet and approachable.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She uses these things called playposits that are basically recorded lectures that you watch out of class, so if your ADHD like me and need a physical in-person lecture, this is not the professor for you. The play-posits are mind-numbing at best.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Beth is the best, if she ever decides to teach other chemistry besides 105 I will be lining up to take it with her. She's very funny, but her lectures are online and we do review worksheets in class which is great because she's very available to help or explain, even in a lecture hall of a couple hundred students!

She's phenomenally smart, but often overexplains things to a point where I no longer understand any of it. She's very nice but is extremely to the point. 73% of the final grade is derived from tests. (IDK if that's up to her or not) She makes herself available to help during lecture and outside of class, though. Just be ready to study HARD!!

I love this woman! The whole class is based on watching play posits outside of class and doing review worksheets in class. There are clicker questions every class that count as "attendance" but as long as you get 75% of the points, it gets rounded up to full credit at the end of the semester. The class is a challenge but if you work hard its great!

Pretty much all of the 105 professors are the same. Guiton makes you watch the lecture outside of class then in class gives a worksheet while she sits at the front of the room. But our attendance in lecture is mandatory?? It doesnt make any sense because you can do the worksheet from home. The whole chem department is wack but she isnt terrible.

Dr. Guiton is a great choice for this course! Her lectures are easy to follow, and even though this is an online, asynchronous class, it is easy to reach out to her if you need any questions answered. Also, her life is super interesting, but you can figure that out if you take her class!

Online lectures were decent and explained well however, there were questions within the videos that we were graded heavily upon and we did not have the option to retake the videos whereas other people I knew who had the same class with different professors were able to rewatch the videos and get better grades on them.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Guiton is amazing! Her lectures are prerecorded so you can do class when it fits your schedule. Her lectures are easy to understand and she does her best to not make them too long. Take notes on all lectures because the exams are open note. The material is hard so you do have to study but I would definitely pick her as my professor.
Awesome Lady, God save the Queen !
Really good lecturer and clearly explains chemistry concepts for you. Very quick to respond to questions/concerns too! Very accessible in office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I found that Beth often over explained things to a point where it would make me confused. I new the majority of the material because of taking AP Chem in highschool; however listening to Beth explain made me more confused and I had to basically stop listening and reteach myself the material

Dr. Guiton is amazing! Shes really good at relaying the information in a way that makes a lot of sense. Shes very organized and works at a good pace. I never used the textbook but its easily accessible if you want it. CHE105 is naturally a hard class, but study hard, go to lectures, get help, and youll be okay!
A good lecturer, but be ready to do lots of work on your own to make sure you understand course material.
Does not go into depth about how to do equations, only lectures off of her slideshow. Will definitely need to seek help outside of class to pass.

Shes a wonderful person and is very knowledgable. BUT she reads directly off of the powerpoint making it very difficult to take notes and she assigns around 20-25 problems of hw every other night, the hw is on sapling and the questions are nothing like the ones done in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She flies through the slides... hope you're a fast note taker
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is a good choice for Chemistry because she goes over a lot of examples and really tries to put the information in a way that is accessible. She understands that the material is difficult, so tries to be mindful of that.

You definitely need to put in the work if you want a good grade, but its not impossible. Everything is well explained, but its done at a fast pace so you need to keep up. However, if you miss something she posts all her lectures online and has plenty of other resources. This professor wants you to get a good grade in her class.

Dr. Guiton seemed like she knew what she was talking about, but sometimes struggled to explain it to the class. Also, she had a tendency to work a problem out and then realize she had done it wrong, causing some confusion. For the most part, che105 is easy enough that if you pay attention in class and try to do the sapling questions, you'll be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I had Ms Guiton for CHE105. She was good at explaining the material, but her classes felt like they lasted forever. She's a nice lady, but her classes are very boring.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Guiton really knows what she's talking about. She went to Harvard and has an amazing chemistry background. She has even inspired me to consider switching my major to chemistry, a class I always hated as a high schooler. Make sure you spend the time outside of class studying the materials and examples! I wish she was teaching CHE 107.

She was very enjoyable for 105! The class itself is not easy and requires a lot of work on your own time. The only complaint I have for her is that she would occasionally breeze though some topics that the class was struggling with when she should've slowed down and tried to explain better. She seems very sweet and you can tell she loves chemistry.

Ahhh Beth, she is awful. I liked her at first at the start of the semester and then she started to suck. She doesn't know the material, she will literally do a whole problem wrong and then say "oh wait thats not right, forget that" and her lecture slides do not help. READ THE BOOK. The lecture notes don't include any work or answers just problems
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She gives great lectures and answers all questions
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Guiton is wonderful! She is brilliant and seems to really enjoy what she does. She will get you to love Chemistry. Her British accent is very fun to listen to. If you are wanting to get to know her, go up to the front of the room after class and start talking to her. She inspired me to one day conduct research.
Seems like a genuinely nice person. Easy to zone out though, makes chemistry understandable. Tries her best to answer questions
She has a British accent and has a great sense of humor. Loves to teach

Extremely difficult to understand the material, she zooms through her lecture notes expecting you to understand everything when she's just reading them off, which I can do on my own time. Does not give any time for REEF questions which are your participation points. Expects you to be a genius when you're in a general chemistry class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is a really good professor and genuinely wants her students to do well in class! I strongly recommend going to her office hours. One thing she could improve on is that before every exam she teaches the easier stuff really slow, then rushes through the tough information. One time she covered almost an entire chapter in one lesson.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I've taken Dr.Guiton for physical chemistry and then again for her 580 course because I thought she was a great teacher. She gives an extra 5% of the grades bonus for attendance so go! and all the tests are based on the homework so you know exactly what to study and what to expect. She does write a lot during class. But office hours help a lot

Dr. Guiton is a great professor. She cares about her students and wants them to do well. She makes every effort to clarify and simplify an overall dry subject. She gives extra credit for attendance, and she posts her lecture notes online (a life saver). Doing the homework is essential (that's what the tests are on). Plus, she has a British accent.

Dr. Guiton is really helpful. She understands that the material is hard and makes it relatively easy for the exams. The book is confusing but you need it for the homework. Make sure you get the solutions manual!

Obscure material, but Dr. Guiton seemed to understand it and teach it as best she could. Doing the homework helps a lot (which you have to), and talking to her and her grad students is super helpful. Lots of math. Great woman.
Takes a tough Subject and makes it realtively understandable!

The professor is okay, she's not so bad. The TAs are what makes the class so annoying to have, they all grade very differently and just expect way too much. The assignments are basically pointless and the only thing that matters is what you get on your exams.

Johanna is kind and soft spoken, but she is extremely knowledgeable. Her lectures are very interesting but sometimes she does get flustered and goes off topic. She is picky on the writing portion of the exams so make sure you know what you are talking about. Overall, if you have good study habitats, you will be fine.

If you can, avoid this professor at all costs. Attendance is mandatory, except the lectures aren't very helpful. You get a very limited amount of time on tests, but are required to produce so much information. This class is incredibly dysfunctional. Good Luck!

She cares very much about the material, this makes her lectures very interesting. I've had her for two classes and never had any issue with the grading like some other people writing reviews. If you study and try in class, and actually learn the material you will get a great grade.

Had for both 212 and 315. Earned an A in both. If you have good study habits you will do fine. Can be a little picky about essay questions on tests; usually is looking for things she deliberately mentions in class. Overall, very nice will help you outside of class.

Johanna is more softspoken than the typical lecture professor, but still is very knowledgeable. I feel like she has so much material that she doesn't know what to do with it and gets overwhelmed in lectures and puts too much to do on the tests considering the time limit, but if you pay any attention in lecture and prepare for tests you will be fine

Johanna is soft spoken but she is an extremely knowledgeable and caring professor who always makes time to help students. She lets you know ahead of time what will be on an exam so just pay attention in lectures and study. Those who say she is picky about writing arent using her office hours and TAs as a tool to improve their writing skills.

She is extremely picky on how you write your essays for the take-home tests. If you even use a term slightly wrong, she'll deduct several points for it. I had to do extra credit in order to get an A, and I spent as much time on this class as I did on studio. She expects you to have a lot of knowledge in history this early in college.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: One of my friends spent many hours tutoring people through this class, they work very hard. They ended up getting a worse grade on an exam than someone they tutored who really didn't try as hard in the class. The grading honestly makes no sense and this class is harder than it should be for 200 level, choose a different professor if you can.

Good professor, had him for the CAD lab. The CAD lecture examples are often difficult to follow as he tends to quickly move through them. Not always an issue but if you've had very little CAD experience it will be more difficult. Best advice for him is to not be afraid to ask questions when lost. Easy Grader

Henninger is better than other professors for senior design. The grading is insane. Make sure you have a good group - I did not and it has completely crushed my love of engineering. This course turned into a full time job.
His lectures are good and he understands that most of them are unnecessary.

This was a tough class if you don't have any prior CAD experience. Dr. Henninger is a great professor and wants his students to succeed. He lectures for a good chunk of the class, but then gives you more than enough time to get your work done. He is very helpful and will answer any questions you have.

He grades extremely harshly. I forgot to turn in part files with drawing files for a homework assignment and he gave me a zero for the assignment and didn't allow me to resubmit with the correct files attached. Even for a reduced grade. He will call you out for not paying attention and he lectures quite fast.

very straightforward and knowledgable but has no tolerance for absences/late work/ mistakes. you are forced to pay attention in class as he will call you out. all that being said it is simply because he wants everyone to suceed and as long as you show to class you will likely do very good. he also is great at helping with assignments.

Thinking you'll enjoy senior capstone at UK? Think again. This class is nothing but nonstop assignments with the most arbitrary grading you can imagine. Turn your engineering notebooks in with extra pages? -10%. Meet all prototype requirements? ehh.. -30% Turn in the final report? -20%. No feedback AT ALL. You will likely not get an A or enjoy it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Your ME205 grade will be defined by your homework and your final project. There are a couple of exams, but the two together are worth 3 homeworks. My class was forced to be a hybrid class, so things were a little weird, but when I was in class I had no problem getting help from him when I had something trip me up.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Henninger will give you your space to work during class, but will answer any questions you have. The assignments are all weighted pretty evenly, so you can afford to make mistakes and you can always bring your grade up from a rough start (what I did). If you submit assignments early, he will give you feedback so you can improve your grade.

Second to Taghaddosi, Henninger's the most cruel professor I've ever had. He likes to look down on students and is extremely stringent. He shows no mercy with grading, so getting a grade even just above average is a challenge. ME 411 with him is the second worst experience I've had at UK.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: -Taught way too fast for me to understand -Concepts you have to figure out on your own -Gets annoyed by questions -Homework is weighted more than the tests -If you miss a class he takes 3 points off homework assignment (out of 10pts.)-He posts instructional videos for inclass assignments -All assignments can be done in class and you can leave early
good teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He answered any question I had for him, with a direct answer. he is strict during lecturing times of the class that is so people will pay attend and not have to ask as many simple questions
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Must do the homework. One homework assignment is close to the same amount of points as an exam. The computers you use suck and crash all the time so save your work during exams. Extra credit available on final project.

Im not going to lie, I got a C in this class. It was not all my lack of attending and nothing assignments, for this didn't start until I was unable to get help from the teacher. I have had no CAD experience, thus leading me to asking more questions. Tom soon got annoyed by my asking, after this and his refusal to meet with me, I began to not care.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He's less than the ideal teacher. He will help you if you ask, but he also talks to you like you're dumb if you do ask a question. His attendance policy isn't super strict (as in he doesn't drop your grade a letter every time you miss like the syllabus says) but it does hurt. Uses Creo which is not very user friendly. Prior CAD experience helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very knowledgeable and explains things clearly.  Willing to help if you have questions.
He makes you work hard and is not the nicest of characters
Great teacher.  If I could take Dr. Henninger for every ME class I would.  I enjoy his teaching style and his willingness to help.

Solid teacher, he knows what he is talking about and is pretty helpful if you have questions. He is really funny in a sarcastic way, which makes the class less boring. I recommend him as an ME 205 professor.

This is one of the most fun professors you can ever have. He started the first class by saying, "What if you didn't have to worry about the grade you get in this class," and proceeded to let everyone use open notes on exams. He has a lot of fun with the class, and if you like HR or Management a little, you will love this class.

Hector is amazing, literally as long as you go to class you will get an easy A. His exams online are open note and open AI and most of the important grades are in class based off of simulations which are easy and fun and require no brain power lol. He's a really good guy and there is essentially no work outside of class. Literally show up to class!
Best teacher at this University, take any class of his that you can.
Best professor at UK. the class is hands on and you can expect him to turn small assignments into fun competitions and what not with real prizes. Totally recommend taking him.
Hector is the man; class is structured around group participation. If you show up, you'll get an A. Take any class of his you can

Hector is probably my favorite professor I've had this whole time I've been here. He's a professor who actually cares about your grade and how you're doing in the class. He is not the teacher that goes over the textbook word for word instead you have to apply the readings to what we talk about in class. Worked in a group every day. 10/10

He doesn't care about grades, but about actual experiences and learning. His Exams were open note and the only other grades were in class participation. Sometimes I did think his class was pointless, but I think it's just the course itself. He is a stand up guy and wants all his students to get an A... if you don't get an A you're the problem.

Such a sweet guy, takes the time to know his students by name and prioritizes learning real things over lecturing with textbooks. exams are easy, class is enjoyable. Showing up and participating/engaging with the material makes this class an easy and impactful A.

This couldve been a useful course but he made it completely useless. There IS a textbook and actual course material but he doesnt teach ANY of it, yet the tests still cover it all so prepare to teach yourself everything. Instead he goes over case studies and dumb group activities in class. Hes a fun caring guy but his teaching  style was worthless.
Hector is my all time favorite professor. He wants you to succeed and as long as you show up to class you will get an A. He's so nice and always happy to help with anything.
Hector wants all of his students to succeed. If you show up to class and participate you will get an A in the class.
She seems caring and gives positive feedback to students during presentations. She also sends out weekly schedule updates with project due dates and lecture topics.

She is really kind and takes time to make sure you understand the concept. Emails back really quickly. She lets us have a lot of group discussions and practice in groups. Almost no homework (unless you didn't finish in class).

She is very kind and not a tough grader at all. The only problem is that most of the content explained in lecture is straight from the textbook so attendance is not very important besides participation points. The class is very boring at times but it isn't bad by any means.

Very easy course. Lectures are kind of boring but have important information for exams. Exams are open note and open textbook. The textbook is pretty important but it is free and online. There are a few projects and papers but she is not a strict grader. There is a lot of busy work but it is pretty easy and brings your grade up.

She's very sweet and understanding about things & will give extensions if you ask. She gives A LOT of busy work and it seems really pointless. Lecture is pretty boring but it's easy to crank out other work during class.

Hilary is nice but she is a YAPPER so be prepared. Her class can get extremely boring to the point you don't go for two weeks, but the work is really easy. All the exams are online and she's a very sweet person. notes aren't that important, and even though you don't want to answer her questions just do or the whole class will be silent and awkward

Hilary is very nice and relates to her students very well. She sends out lecture outlines online so lectures are easy to follow. The only thing is that she sometimes has a hard time explaining vocab terms, but she'll give you plenty of examples if you ask. Not much homework, she's an easy grader for papers, and test are open notes. Easy professor.
Actually so bad I switched majors to not need a language credit.

I took her for GER 361 but that was not an option on here.

I had a good time in this class, but I would say this is more a history class than a film class. I learned a lot but she is very disorganized and I did not know what film to watch until I was taking a quiz for the film the next class. I also felt very disengaged in lecture as most were.

Dr. Herzog is an amazing professor! She makes the class extremely easy, which is something you should take advantage of. There are no tests/quizzes, but the material and homework help you understand the language. She is very caring and will help you in any way that she can. Only thing that isnt top notch is organization. She is a bit unorganized.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is a very nice lady, but one thing that really bothers me is that she doesn't correct students when they say something wrong, which is pretty important to do in a spoken communication class. She is very disorganized, kinda all over the place, doesn't post grades anywhere or even really give back graded assignments.

Awesome professor. Class seemed very daunting once I got the book, but she works with the level you are at so you can get the most out of the class. Is not particularly strict about the fine details of grammar or fluency, makes sure understanding comes first. Highly Recommended
She is a wonderful professor. She is extremely caring. She is however a bit disorganized, but not to the point that her being so will affect your grade.

She is one of the best and most caring profs at UK.  Always provides feedback for her students and helps them to see things in a different light.  Extremely intelligent and very sweet. Highly recommend.

NICE Teacher. She really cares about her students and tries to make German as fun as possible. German 206 was only a two hour credit, so her expectations were fairly low, however, I learned a lot. Basically come to class because attendance is a major part of your grade.

Another nice professor. This was her first semester teaching a German Culture class. Classes tend to be lectures. Only 2 2-page essays, few quizzes to see if you've done your reading, mid-term and final. Also very helpful in answering questions.

He is an awesome lecturer and made everything make sense. All the exams were very straightforward of what was taught in class. The homework can be a little tricky but if you give your best effort, it will be represented fairly.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class lowkey cake, y'all clowns if you get lower than a 100. Free A fr fr fr gng

Hilts' class was challenging, but in the best ways. I have always had great retention from his lectures. There is a lot of content and homework, but it's all doable. Exams are tough at times, but old practice exams often reflect the new exams, so do those and you'll be fine.

Dr. Hilt's class was hard but he taught in a way that made the material stick. His lectures often consisted of example problems that foreshadowed similar problems on future exams/quizzes. The previous years exams/quizzes he posts are the most helpful tool for studying.

Dr. Hilt was a decent professor. It was pretty clear what you should expect on the exams since they were very similar to past exams. My only criticism is his lectures were difficult to follow and he very rarely awarded partial credit on exams. If you make an error on a problem he isnt awarding partial credit on then you get 0 points.

Dr. Hilt is a good option for a difficult course. The homework is difficult and there is a lot of it, but if you can push through you'll do just fine. The tests are easier than the homework and you know what to expect.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: For anyone who has to take CME 200, take Dr. Hilt. He's a great guy, who is always willing to meet with and discuss any issues you have.

This class was hard, but don't give up! Make sure to read the textbook and do practice problems. If he spends an entire day on a problem, then it will most likely be on the exam. He lowers the grading scale slightly depending on the avg. Hilt was very helpful in office hours. The difficulty of this course prepares you for future CME classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Lectures are not helpful at all. Shows little interest in teaching. Grades tests very strictly. I would avoid taking him if I could.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Ive had Hilt for Process Principles and Heat/Mass Transfer and hes easily my favorite CME professor. His lectures are super helpful, his homework is indicative of test/quiz material, and he is also a really nice guy. Hes got a very dry sense of humor which I love but may make him come off rude to some. Tough grader but tests are very fair
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I've had him for 3 classes now, and he is my favorite CME professor. He honestly wants everyone to do well and tries to make the class somewhat enjoyable with his dry but hilarious sense of humor.  CME classes are going to be difficult, but Dr. Hilt definitely is one of the better professors to have for CME 200, 425, and MSE 201.

While his tests are not the easiest and partial credit isn't given very often. He did meet with me and helped me improve my grade. He does give a generous curve for the whole class. Problem is you don't know the curve till after finishing the class. His tests get easier as you go if the whole class is struggling.

CME 200 is really hard, regardless of your teacher.  Hilt's lectures are basically just reiterations of the book and working examples.  For this class, it is imperative that you read the book yourself and do the HW problems.  The HW was very long(20 hours/week)but quizzes and test were similar, but easier.  Class isn't so bad if you devote time.
I enjoyed the material, and I think that he did a good job of going over what would be covered on the exams.  He also based his exams and quizzes off of assignments, so they were predictable.

He's boring to listen to and doesnt seem interested in teaching. U need to learn this stuff on your own he didnt really help in class. However, his quizzes and tests can be pretty predictable once u figure out how he makes them.

MSE 201 was challenging, yet do-able.  The class was curved, so I can't really see too many peoples' grades suffering heavily from the class (even though it will seem like you're all failing at first). Be sure  to understand how to do the homework.  Homework problems and graphs tend to frequent on the quizzes and tests, so watch out.
Very Hard

[Review is for ABT 101] I took this class as an AMBT freshman and really loved it! It was a smaller class size so it allowed for deeper connections and even though Dr. Hirsch wasn't present for each class session whenever he was there, we had a great time. We did a semester long lab and multiple different events in between which were all engaging.
Lectures are amazing and often exciting to attend. However, the use of TA's and improper rubrics, make it difficult to fully succeed.

Great professor with engaging lectures and labs. You only get one unexcused absence. You have to take notes, but it's important to know the material for writing lab reports, as that's a huge part of the class. Point recovery assignments are available every now and then.  Hirsch himself is a funny and great at explaining things.
Show up for class no matter what. The class is overall easy and engaging just make sure you show up and are respectful.

The course tag wasn't there for the course I am in with him, but I love Dr. Hirsch! He is one of the best instructors I have had, and his class is my favorite one I have taken in college so far. He is really funny, caring, and understanding. The community he creates in his classroom is one of the best.

Dr. Hirsch is by far the best professor that I have ever had. He is such a funny and kind person and he actually cares about the material he teaches. I was definitely never bored in his class and the lab was my favorite lab that I have ever had at UK. I cannot recommend taking his class enough. I literally love this man and his classes are so fun.
Awesome

I can confidently say that Dr. Hirsch has set the bar high for what it means to be an exceptional educator. From the very beginning, it was evident that he is not just passionate about his classes but also deeply invested in the success and well-being of each student. I would gladly take his class again.

Dr. Hirsch is my favorite professor. Super tough grader, but you get clear grading criteria. You WILL improve through the semester. Make a meeting with him or the TA for every. single. paper. Once you get past the grading part, the class is amazing and enjoyable. Dr. Hirsch has a wonderful sense of humor and gives amazing advice. Lab is AWESOME!

Dr. Hirsch is a fantastic guy, his lab period is extremely fun and he makes sure he forms a connection with each student. The class is tough and there is a decent amount of work. The writing assignments are graded very hard but he gives an outline of what he expects. He is always willing to help if you are willing to look for help. Go to class!

I really like Dr. Hirsch as a human being, but his class is a little frustrating. I took ABT 120 and you have 2x weekly quick assignments and a weekly writing assignment on Sundays. The quick writing assignments are basically worth nothing which is annoying. The writing assignments are VERY heavily grammar based but he gives you guidelines to go by

I had Dr. Hirsch this semester for GEN300. Even though it is a 300 level course, all you need to prepare for is maybe 10 homework questions due the day your section meets. I'm not even sure he reads them and you get the full grade, he just uses the questions for discussion the next day. Super easy class and cool guy, extremely smart.

Recommend NOT taking Dr. Hirsch as a professor unless you know you will have plenty of time for course work or you're a grad student. He teaches his classes GEN300 and PPA400G like graduate level courses with lots of weekly course work and readings, as well as many presentations and papers. He is a thorough and very detail oriented grader...
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: One report a week. Tough grader but he tells you EXACTLY what he wants and how to do it. Very caring and intelligent. Always willing to help you. Be perpared for class and you'll get an A.

The exams are rough, multiple FRQs and if you mess up the first part, rest will be impossible to do. "Helps giving extra points". First time, calculus 214 had a curve because the exam average was a 60, physics 2 had a 10% higher average to compare with that exam. Very harsh grader, learn everything on your own. Switch Out immediately.

Lectures are meandering, prone to at least one (or more) math errors each lecture, and generally not of great value. Notes provided on Canvas are not timely, not very well organized. "Directionless" best describes overall feel. The class was not worth paying $2,000+ tuition and fees. Taking the class next semester with a different professor.
He clearly teaches every topic, you just have to make sure you don't doze off and you'll be completely fine. He makes everything seem easy, especially the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I took Hislop because his reviews were strong, but his lectures have consistently been incohesive, unorganized, and at times simply do not pertain to the quiz or exam material. I've had to use a friends' notes from another calc section to truly learn the material. His exams are easier, but make sure you know how to teach yourself new content.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's about as genuine as it gets for a prof. Hislop comes in everyday with a smile on his face and clearly loves teaching. He is old so sometimes he makes little mistakes but overall he presents the material in an easy to understand way. He will literally tell you what is going to be on the quizzes the day before.

I loved taking his class. He does a good job reviewing what we did the previous class at the beginning if each lecture and assigns less homework than other calc classes. Honestly loved taking his class and wish I could have him im the future.

Professor Hislop is one of the best math professors I've had. He makes learning very enjoyable especially when the content is very tough, and is very easy to get a hold of outside of class. He is also very understanding with work and is very kind to you as an indicidual.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took calc BC in highschool and a lot of the content in this class was taught in a different and more difficult way. Do your best to sit close in lecture because all notes are handwritten, most times you will have to watch videos on it later. Your TA will be your best bet in terms of learning the content so make sure to pay attention in recitation

Overall Dr. Hislop is a decent professor. He knows what he is talking about, but some of the time he uses a lot of notation that makes the actual process less clear. He is interested in what he teaches and will try to make the class more interesting with a joke or two. I had to rely on my recitation TA and UK's tutoring to clear some concepts up

Not a bad professor, just really expects most of the things being taught to be a review. If you have not taken calculus before, this class will be a challenge but that is not something that is professor specific. There is often homework due online and he sometimes gets behind in class so you are on your own. He sometimes makes things complicated.

Sometimes in class instead of explaining something easily with a formula he makes it very confusing to the point I think we are doing something completely different. Some days he spends way to much time on a subject and then we get behind so the homework is not on the material we covered in class. He is a good teacher though and is there for you.

He often makes random puns and jokes in class. Attendance doesn't really matter, you can skip half the lectures, but you will need to know the material that is covered in class. Majority of your grade is from the tests. (four tests total)
Classes make zero sense. Made tests harder this year than what it has been in the previous year. Highly suggest to take someone else.

If you have not taken calc before you are absolutely screwed. Does not teach it in a way you can understand if you have not taken calc before. Expect a lot of outside help if you don't already know the material
Seems to know the material very well, but doesn't necessarily explain it that well.  He's pretty adorable though.  And he occasionally makes class interesting.
Pretty cool dude.  I really liked the class.  It was challenging at times but you definitely learn the material.

I thought his written assignments were harder than needed, but when I would go to his office, he was always willing to help.  He didn't just give the answer, but he really made me think about the assignment, which I liked. Others had problems with him because he would make fun of some people every class, but It was entertaining for the rest of us.
hard

Be prepared to not understand what is going on at all. You better pray you have an amazing TA because you will learn nothing in lecture. The written assignments are unreasonably hard that are meant for graduate students. Good luck.

He teaches as though everyone in class has all prior knowledge needed to understand his lectures. I enjoyed his class and am thankful I got a teacher I could understand, although it is easy to get lost while he teaches. Go to your recitation and understand the worksheets and you'll be fine.
He was confusing and often got his own questions wrong. I passed the AP Calculus Exam in high school, but I didn't understand this guy.

Dr. Hislop's calculus class was very confusing. I didn't have the chance to take calculus during my senior year of high school so I was lost for much of his lectures. The tests required a much different type of math knowledge than I expected and thus, I didn't get the grade that I wanted. Study hard and actually use the book, and you should be fine

"I'm sure glad I just had calc in high school or I would be so lost" - Every freshman that takes calc at UK. So good luck if you're like me and you've been out of math for 2 years. Also, be careful about what TA's you get... it took me half a semester to figure out my TA was saying "variable" when she would say "da-ribel".

Hislop is a very confusing teacher. He knows what he is talking about but gets example problems wrong while explaining them to class which doesn't help you out at all. The TA's are much easier to understand and I learned more in recitation than I did actual class

Dr. Hislop is a solid teacher to have for calculus, if not the best. He's a cool guy, and is very laid back in class. He does however make some concepts more complicated then they have to be. Honestly though, the professor doesn't matter too much in Calc I. The TA is more important. Get a good TA, one who helps you with homework.
Professor Hislop is a great professor! He is clear when he teaches and wants you to learn. He is also entertaining in class and makes subtle jokes that are hilarious. By far the cutest old guy ever!
Simply put, Dr. Hislop is THE best math professor I have ever had. You learning the material is his #1 goal.

Great teacher. Wants his students to learn. Willing to bump up your grade if you're close. Problem session each week where he basically told you what was going to be on the quiz (helpful). 4 grades in the class though, 2 midterm exams, a final, and quizzes. Still very realistic to get an A.

Take him for calc4.  Generous grader, HW is not graded, pay attention in class and study for tests (3) and quizzes (1 per week) and you will get an A. He had a study session outside of class once per week- it helps.  I highly recommend.  TAKE HIM.
Great professor and exams are very similar to material covered in lecture!  Best Calc prof I have had and throws in a few jokes now and again
Hislop is a great teacher with a  different sense of humor. He wants to make sure his students understand everything, and recitation is extremely helpful.  Great teacher, take him if you can!!!

Very clear and easy to learn from... often overlaps what he talks about in lecture so its easy to skip a few... tests and quizzes are pretty straigtforward and he's a fairly generous grader... dry humor and absentminded but usually keeps it professional... I enjoyed having him as a professor and would definitly recommend him over others
You must take his class.
Smart guy, but tough to learn from.
Best math teacher I have ever had.  If you have the chance you should take him.
No Comments

He now teaches at Wichita State University. He's a great lecturer, very knowledgeable, and is generally flexible with assignments, but some of it felt like busy work. Average or even below average at writing test-questions.

The reading is terrible, and you're supposed to read to pass your weekly quiz, but you can find quizlets to help you. He does Echo360, so you can watch it online. Besides the quiz (on Canvas), no additional homework. Tests are straightforward (study the quizzes!) and he gives you a study guide. Recitation is an activity, and you can leave when done
Professor Hippisley is a real gem. He is passionate about linguistics and I think he is a very entertaining lecturer.

He's very straight to the point. Very fair grader, wants to get to know you, good lectures/labs. He is incredibly helpful. You won't just get by with the class though, you have to put some effort into it. It's worth it though. I'd definitely recommend taking a class with him. I've really enjoyed it.

Dr. Hippisley is a no nonsense professor who moves pretty quickly through the material. Very smart and a very clear guy. Even though he expects a lot, he's a fair grader and understands the stuff he's teaching is pretty tough.

This was his first time teaching Computational Linguistics, so of course there were a few snafus here and there, but Hippisley knows his stuff. He is a very interesting "bloke" and he's an absolutely fantastic lecturer. I would definitely take him, if you grab the chance. He helped me enjoy being a linguistics major and he really, really cares.

Fantastic! Took his 211, Syntax, and Computational Ling classes. Readings not necessary but make an A very easy. On tests-- answer what you know & do not stop writing or you will run out of time. Generous grader. Understand principles and be able to write about them and you will do great. If class is full, email him and you'll get in.
This class was very easy to manage. He is very flexible and wants you to succeed in his class.
Honestly one of my favorite professors I had ever had. He was very understanding and made the course fun to leant. Definitely my favorite class I have taken!

This is the easiest teacher I have ever had. I have a 100 in the class. You literally have no exams or quizzes you just show up to class and do group projects that take a couple of min tops. Offers extra credit every month multiple times a month and I hardly show up to class and I still have a 100 from so much extra credit.
LOVED her. Had very clear and informative lectures and was very supportive of students. Highly reccommend!
she is really a great professor. pay attention and come to class you will do great. she wants you to pass. her content is real life centered and makes sense.

Such such such a good professor. Love her teaching styles as she is very organized and clear with her content. She respects all of her students and also shows that she cares. I really enjoyed everything she taught as it was actually really interesting to learn. If you need to take a communication class, I would highly recommend this class.

She takes multiple weeks to grade anything and I mean anything. Won't input grades even for midterms and way past finals. So you essentially never know your grade in the class because she will only input attendance most of the time because it is on an app. I used her class to do other work and aced every assignment it's extremely easy. Hard person.

Overall great lectures and content, really learned a lot. However, so many essays and projects to write on top of 3 exams throughout the semester. They were all relatively easy just needed to be spread out a little more, felt like I was writing 2-3 essays at a time or one right after another. The exams were easy if you took great notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Cares about her students and engages in lectures. Allows a 3 day grace period if you need extra time for an assignment. Exams are easy if you take good notes.

As long as you take notes during class the exams are easy and open book. Papers are mostly on guest speakers and she allows a grace period of 3 days if you need it. She is super sweet and keeps class interesting.

Dr. Hodgson is my favorite professor I've had at UK. She is the sweetest, most caring person I have ever met. You do have to go to class as there is daily participation, but she makes it far worth your time. Definitely take her classes!

The professor is great and you can tell she is passionate about the content. Lots of papers but she allows for a one-time 3 day grace period if you have too much going on. She was very caring and respected all students. Get ready to read lots of articles, and attend class for every class meeting.
She is such a great teacher! She is very caring and will do anything to help you if you give her your time. A great professor to have and if you have the chance to take a class with her I would!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very kind and very easy to access outside of class. Makes her content very easy to learn, and the exams are online. Very few assignments, but overall pretty easy to get and keep a good grade in the class. Her lectures are fun, and overall a great teacher to have.

Great professor! She is very kind and caring towards her students. Presentations can be tricky if you are bad with speaking in front of people but there are a lot of other grades so you definitely can still pass with bad presentation grades.

I took COM101 with Dr. Hodgson and she made the course enjoyable and as simple yet involved as possible. She is a very passionate lecturer, and her presentations are very organized and easy to understand. She gave numerous opportunities for extra credit, participation make-up, etc. She made even the most basic concepts interesting!!

Dr. Hodgson was an amazing prof and so sweet. There were a couple of easy papers, a 2 min speech, open note exams/quizzes, and a group project which was the final. Dr. Hodgson made her lectures fun and easy to understand. In general, she made the class a lot easier when it could have been way more difficult. She's great. Highly recommend.

Love her!! COM311 is the best course I have taken in my 4 years at UK. She makes this class come alive and engaging. I looked forward to this class every single week. If you are pre-health you need this class, I think everyone in medicine should have it. She is the most precious human and professor!! If you're at UK, try to get her as a professor!!

Absolutely loved this professor. She was very kind and understanding and an amazing lecturer. I was really intimidated by this class, but its pretty easy. The class itself is very interesting. Take her you wont regret. Also, shes very organized and well prepped which I appreciate.
I loved her! She made presentations far less intimidating and I really enjoyed her lectures. Interesting class and I would recommend.

Professor Hodgson is absolutely amazing! She is super sweet and definitely cares about her students. Reading is "required" for the weekly quizzes, but you could definitely get away without doing it. The papers are easy and she makes presenting less intimidating. There are only 2 presentations which is also nice. Exams are super easy as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Great professor. Always willing to help with anything. Highly recommend.

This professor is very kind and understanding. While delivering speeches can be very nerve-racking, Hodgson makes it a great environment and is a very considerate grader. This class is a lot of work and can be dreadful but she makes it survivable
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Mrs. Hodgson was such an amazing professor! Shes so sweet and makes this class so easy! Its all about group projects and you keep the same group all semester. The projects are super easy and youll actually become good friends with your group. Shes the nicest prof Ive met, and she truly does care about you and your grade. Loved this class!

She is super nice and understanding but a lot of group projects/peer review which is kinda annoying for an online. You have to volunteer outside of class 8 hours. Otherwise, pretty easy and would take online.
She is really nice and doesn't grade too harshly. Just join a good service group, and you should be good for the rest of the semester.

Dr. Hoffman is a great professor, a bit picky on some grading things. She gives great feedback and revision and is willing to help out when asked. There are a lot of "outlines" or "drafts" that are due at seemingly odd dates compared to their final date, but they're always due on the same day of the week. I liked the volunteering part of the class.
If you don't get an A bro you ain't trying, her class is so simple.

This class isn't hard at all. The essays and assignments are really easy, and the service learning can actually be interesting and not a burden. The in class lectures can be somewhat boring but she lets us out early sometimes and gives us every other Friday off. She's a great person and cares about our development as people. (Took Spring 2025).
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Hoffman is the nicest professor I've had and also the easiest. I recommend taking her for CIS 112 because she makes the loaded curriculum very doable. The main grades you have for this class are reflections and a podcast you make about volunteering. VERY EASY and 100% recommend.

One of the best professors and people I've met so far. Her grading criteria is clear and not overly difficult. Additionally, she's very flexible and understanding. If you can take her for any class, do it.

Dr. Hoffman is an awesome professor! She is very understanding and is a helpful guide to the course. Some of the assignments and speeches can be slightly confusing, but she is always available to help clarify and answer questions. She always helps making the speeches less intimidating and more achievable. I would highly recommend!

Dr. Hoffman cares about the student and knows how stressful public speaking can be. She understands that students have varying background experiences regarding papers and speeches, and uses lecture time to help improve the student. 

If you're eligible to take CIS 112, do it! don't let the "accelerated" title intimidate you.

She is a great teacher! Super easy and fun class because you get to make a podcast. She is also very understanding if you need to turn something in late. She is very chill and interested in her students. There are a lot of speeches and oral assignments, so just be ready for that. Plus, you have to volunteer outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class can make one nervous, lots of talking in front of the class. Dr. Hoffman makes the class stress-free and so enjoyable. She's very understanding and patient. If you have concerns of any type, email her. She is so genuine. The class itself is also easy. Lots of volunteering, research for volunteering.. ect.

Dr. Hoffman was a great professor. For this class we spent most of our time with our service learning groups so a lot of group work was done. There are speeches scattered throughout and one big paper. I felt like she was easily reachable outside of class as well as a fair grader. Her class wasn't very difficult. I'd recommend taking Dr. Hoffman!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I liked Dr. Hoffman's class, but it was also just one of those classes you have to take freshman year. Sometimes the work seems a little pointless/childish, but Dr. Hoffman makes it enjoyable. You do have to give a few presentations in front of the class, some of them impromptu. Weirdly picky grader on some things but otherwise easy A.

Dr. Hoffman is a very sweet and kind professor. She knows what parts of the core curriculum are BS and will say. Hey I do have to lecture about this but I know you all know this stuff so lets get it done quickly so we all can have some extra time today.

Dr. Hoffman is a really easy grader for all the assignments. While there are a lot of assignments throughout the semester, she always reminds you what is coming up and is always willing to help if you are having trouble with something. You can talk to her about anything. There are two textbooks but you don't need to get them.
Very nice guy and attractive

There was a lot of homework but that's with every SPA101 class. His classes were really fun and engaging. There was a lot of group work in class. He made Spanish very easy to understand and overall the class wasn't bad at all.

He is a great professor, is genuinely willing to help, and will work with you as long as you genuinely try! I had a lot of fun in his class and he did his best to make speaking spanish as relaxed as possible while also making sure you knew the material
Homework online every day that class meets. Due at midnight, not at the time that class meets. Straight forward. Easily approachable. Helpful explanations. Fun in-class activities.

Mr. Holman is awesome I had him for SPA 102 and he is super funny and gets the whole class involved.  He cares about his students and makes everyone feel comfortable.  He's lenient with grading and very approachable.
Literally couldn't focus he was too attractive. Not his fault tho. Really chill guy, definitely understanding and grades things fairly.
Great guy, super nice and understanding. Always willing to work with his students and do what he can to make their lives just a little but easier. Very fair grader
He is really patient with students. There is homework every day that there is class but it isn't very hard. He grades exams easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Holman is the professor that you wish you could take every class with. He cares about his students personally and their success in the classroom. All around just a good guy.

Hayden Holman is a great professor who takes his job seriously, but also makes the class fun to attend.
-very fair with grading assignments and exams.
-funny and connects with his students
-If you do all of the HW and attend classes you will pass the class.
-Will speak Spanish most of the class, but will make sure you understand what is going on.

Shes very chill, tries to engage with class and mix it up from lectures and shi. I didn't study for tests and averaged a 70 on each of them so very chill for me. Also two group projects but very easy. Only like 4 attendance checks per semester and they are worth 15 points so go to class.

MGT 410 is very boring but Hong tries to engage the class and she cares. Attendance is graded but will not kill if do not attend. Had 2 group projects in there that were very manageable. Class is just boring but overall decent professor.

I think shes new, I wouldve guessed she was a TA if I didnt know better. The course itself is very useless and boring, lots of people skip, but its not her fault, she does about as good as you could with it. Its a topic shes really interested in. Theres a big group project, and lots of group work days and activities along with the usual lectures.

I love Dr. Hong and this course. She is engaging and asks lots of questions during her lectures. There isn't a lot of difficult content in the class other than the group project kinda, but it isn't hard. She is very caring and extremely knowledgeable about the course and Business. Kind and respectful instructor who does a great job in this class!

This is a very easy A if you can memorize simple information. There were no surprises on the exams, even though the study guide was WAY too long for them.  You do not need to go to lecture to do well, the exams are made word for word from the power points that are online.

I hated this class. Lectures drone and get to a point where we aren't learning what we need to in class. Exams cover a lot that was not spoken about in class or things that are only mentioned briefly in the book. and 6 REQUIRED BOOKS. That is overkill when you don't really need them. The title of the class "religion in everyday life" was misleading
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Got an A and only went to lecture the very first week of classes. All you have to do is do his study guides and read maximum 5 pages of the reading each week and write two paragraphs a week on them. He is hard to understand so I never went but his study guides are similar to the tests. Not a hard class if you have common sense!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: He was very hard to understand. The material he went over in class was literally him reading off the slides word for word. The exams were ridiculously hard for a core class. Also, while working on the study guide for the exam, half of it was not even covered on the lecture slides. Do not take him. I got a 70% on the first exam AFTER THE CURVE.

Honestly, this class was somewhat easy if you actually care about anthropology. If not, he isn't for you. Skim the readings and make flashcards for the test and you will be fine. I got low C's on the first 2 tests but never got my final exam grade. Finished with a B so I'm happy!
Dr. Iliahiane was an excellent professor, albeit a little bit of an accent, lecture was extremely interesting. Although we had a reading each week the material was interesting.
He's fine.  He's top of the line.

This guy is all over the place in his lectures, you can barely understand what he is saying.You have to write a paper every single week over a large amount of reading material.He gives you a study guide before exams but only a couple of questions on the exam are from the study guide.Pretty much everyone does badly on the tests.I like my TA better.
There is A LOT of reading..Be Prepared!
One of the best professors on campus. Full of energy and tries to keep interest of the class. This class was easy if you spent time on it and paid attention in class.

This class was horrible! There are about 200 pages of reading assigned each week - they expect too much for a 100 level class. The tests are things about a certain sentence somewhere in the reading! The TAs are of no help! The class avg for tests were 55% - he wouldn't add the curve till the end so you don't know where u stand grade wise. Awful!

This class was horrible! There are like 200 pages assigned to read each week. His tests are ridiculous-nothing normally covered in class - usually one sentence from the reading. The TAs are of NO help! U must be prepared for attendacne questions every class! The assignments are the only thing that helps your grade! Avg test % 4 200 people was 55%
He was hard to understand and paced up and down the isles when he taught. He didnt make the material clear enough. Dropped the class.
Its hard to understand what he is saying and his test cover material he feels is important but did not cover or was only mentioned in one sentence in the entire reading.

He is a great professor and will walk you through things that you don't understand. If you get stuck on an exam just raise your hand and he will help. Uses python code to grade all assignments so he won't miss anything. Showing up to class helps because he walks you thru everything but doesn't take attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is a great class. Its appropriately difficult and you will learn a lot. It's so useful. I know way more about excel than I did before this class. Professor Liu is a great professor too. He's very chill and will walk you through the problems and make sure you get them right.
Notes are clear. Problem sets are helpful for exams. Hope he can be more accessible after class.
Well structured class! I wish other professors followed the idea of putting up all the notes and material in a course pack. Liked the cases, thought that was a fun part of class.
Dr. Lui is probably one of the most organized professors I've ever had. He gives detailed notes and homework for each lecture. Once you go over those, getting an A is easy.
He knows about the material but obviously has no interest in teaching. Be prepared to teach yourself using the slides and book. With the cheat sheet doing well on exams is pretty easy.

dumb class. don't go.. i went to a total of ~4 classes and got 101 on the first test, 97.5 on the 2nd, ??? on the third because i didn't even care because i had an A locked up... do the homeworks using the book and its a freaking breeze..

The first test is by far the easiest, but as you go on the test get harder since there is more calculations involved. If you go to class and pay attention to the powerpoints, you really don't need the book and can pass easily with a B
The class is easy enough, but he does not seem too concerned with the class at all.  Classes always end early and he is indifferent.

Great professor! Very helpful in office hours. Everything taught in lecture & on the HW is on the exam so that is helpful. The exams r very similar to the practice exams. If you go to this office hours he will give u points back on the exam. You have to pay for the HW tho.

Chunli is one of the best and most respected professors (between my peers and me). He is so goated. He will support you and help you through all of your work, he understands that not everyone is a physics genius, and he doesn't put you down for bad attempts. If you can take him, take him.

Huang really cares about his students. He makes most of the lectures really fun to be part of and he tries to crack jokes most of the time. I personally am not a fan of physics but he made it a lot easier than the horror stories I heard about the other physics prof...
Easy to understand and explains things well. Does reviews for test during class. Tests are semi-difficult, but strongly tied to the reviews and homework assignments.
He went above and beyond to help his students to succeed in his course. If you put forth the effort he will match you.

Great professor! I highly reccomend Chunli Huang. He explained things well, was funny and personable in class, answering questions and talking with students. I struggled with this course, but he was incredibly gracious and kind in office hours, and will always make time for his students.

He is a hilarious and genuinely caring professor. He sometimes discusses topics at a very high level when trying to inspire us, which can be a bit hard to follow in the moment, but his office hours are very helpful. He also speaks frankly about how to use AI which is good. He really cares about the success of all his students.

Lectures can get very overwhelming as he goes over theory only essentially. I often found after lectures I would get more out of a 15 minute YouTube video. He does fine explaining concepts but he does have a tendency to explain them in a very high level manner. Exams are 2-3 conceptual multiple choice and the rest are open ended problems. HW cost $
He is a thoughtful and caring teacher. Highly recommended!

Prof. Huang is a great physics teacher; his lectures are always super clear, and tons of demos help as well. Review days before exams are super important. Main gripes are the software he uses to count participation and homework are paid for. Lowest exam grade dropped and clear grading policy with 85+ being an "A".

He moves pretty fast in lectures but office hours help. Tests happen pretty frequently at like 2.5 weeks. The grade scale is forgiving as 60 is a C, 75 is a B, and 85+ is an A. He puts up midterm practices alongside the homework and I'd recommend studying those.
Lectures aren't the most clear, but he covers all the content. His grading and exams for this course is significantly easier than the other professors, and you should pass easily.

Chunli really cares about his students' success even in big lecture classes. While his lectures can be confusing, the homework and exams are much more reasonable than any of the other physics professors. He is also extremely helpful in office hours! I definitely recommend Chunli for phy 231!!

Not a fan of her guided notes, so I would write my own. She doesn't really engage with students, which can make lectures seem uninteresting. I would kind of have to guess what to study for exams. I wasn't sure what would be covered on exams and what wouldn't. She didn't have review sessions (the TA did) and they were vague and not the most helpful.

This class is not that bad but your grade is almost entirely dependent on the exams. The exams don't even really cover the content you learn in the class lectures or homework. A lot rides on them and you kinda just have to hope you do good. Otherwise she's good.

This class is way harder than it should be because of the way it is structured. Exams make or break your grade, and she gives little and unuseful review material. The notes are not really related to the exams at all.

Professor Hapke was really nice; however, I did not enjoy her class as much as I had hoped. The exams were harder than expected, and I am not a fan of the hybrid method. A lot of the exam material is not what's in the lecture. Not my favorite class and way harder than inticapted.

The hybrid model just doesn't work. The lectures are very fast paced and the material covered is completely different from what is on the exam. If you bomb the exams you're good, they count for 40%. What person below me said about reviewing her, RMP won't let me say it.

didn't like this class, the hybrid setup just didnt work for me. felt like hapke didnt create the exams based on the course material. she tried to cover too much in each unit. told students not to review her if it wasnt perfect scores. tests aren't weighted heavily, though, so easy class.

Professor Hapke is nice; however, the exams usually don't align with the lectures/ guided notes. It's hard to do exceedingly well in this class because of that. Not the worst class, but know it's almost impossible to study for everything on the exams.

Treats us like we are children in the lessons, then the exams treat us like we are students with our PHDs. The lessons being taught is so drastic different than the exams. Then, if you do bad on an exam she sends you a nice message saying you did bad on the exam and tells you to study harder or get a tutor. Maybe the problem is you honey.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took this class online, and I should've just taken it in person. Gives guided notes for lectures which I like. Gives NO exam review. Literally tells you to rewatch the lecture videos. Like who is going to rewatch like 8 hours of lectures to review for a test. Do the readings!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Hapke really likes to include her students and is very understanding of everyone. She is so caring! She doesn't weigh exams heavily at all. She made Marketing a fun class! Would definitely take her if you can!

Hapke as a professor was good shes sweet and funny. For the class its hybrid which was good for me because if I couldn't make it I can just join online. Pay attention and take notes the homework is really easy. The exams on the other hand don't always align with what she said would be on also there are no review materials besides a ta review video.

She is really nice and kind, I would say her exams are difficult and sometimes don't align with review that she gives out. I would say read the packet that she gives and the under set and everything on the review videos, but don't only rely on it.

She was a wonderful professor, She knows about rate my professor and try to learn based on that. She did fix some of her grading where her Exams don't affect your grade too much. I've failed all her exams 60 or lower but I still have a B in the course. The Exams are a pain though, don't really line up to what she gives us.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Not a big fan. The hybrid setup is not a good way to teach this class. Exams are only relatively similar to the notes she provides. On top of that, she doesn't really give any study tools, and only provides a huge overview of what COULD be on the exam (it's essentially just the notes but very slightly condensed)
Tries to lay the class out to be accessible but makes it even harder and then doesn't give 100s and won't give any feeback. Maybe one of the worst classes I have ever taken.

Professor Hapke has very entertaining lectures and there are only a few assignments due a week. The exams are hard and worth a good portion of your grade so I suggest taking notes on the lectures and making a Quizlet, give yourself at least 4 days in advance to study!! Aside from the exams everything else is pretty much common sense.

She is so lovely and made lectures so fun and dynamic. I learned a lot not only from what she taught in the lectures but also from the *book*. The book is online, and it contains all the material we learn throughout the semester. Everything she teaches comes from the book, and even the photos in the book are useful. Homework is from the book
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Super nice professor. Exams can be a little confusing at times, but because homework and attendance is graded so heavy, its very manageable. Would totally recommend, she seems like an overall great person.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The professor makes the class engaging and accessible, whether you attend in person or watch the livestream. unstuck ai and the textbook are helpful for acing the exams.

This was the hybrid class but the professor's personality made me show up to the in-persons 90% of the time. She really cares about her students and is lenient if you communicate with her. Highly recommend
One of the easiest classes I've ever had. The flexibility was amazing. Was able to either attend in-person or do the lectures asynchronous. Exams were also the same way (online or in-person)
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is the hybrid class she offers so you either have to go in person or watch the lectures online for credit every day. The tests don't hold a lot of weight towards your grade so you don't have to score amazing on them to get an A. The lectures aren't very engaging and she tends to ramble on quite a bit. The weekly assignments are fairly easy.
Professor Hapke teaches a relatively easy class if you pay attention, and with a positive attitude and works very well with her students, overall incredibly solid teacher.

Hapke is an excellent lecturer. She engages a large classroom (whether you're in person or not) and makes this course VERY easy. There is not a lot of homework, it boils down to a few exams, showing up/livestreaming the lecture, and a few connect assignments. Amazing instructor and an excellent human. She is a "must take" professor,highly reccomend

Her online MKT 300 class is exceptional. With the price of college being astronomically high these days it is important for professors to make it worth your investment. Holly does this. Well designed course. Her lectures are high quality and I can tell she is really into this stuff.  Her lecture feels like a Ted Talk.
Easy class overall, I took it online during the summer. Exams are fine. A lot of smartbook and homework assignments for the units.

I loved taking her class so much and wished I could take her again. She makes her classes easily accessible where you can attend in-person, watch it live, or watch it on-demand later in the day. She also gives interesting power points where she doesn't just read off the slide like other professors. She engages with her students and cares for them.

Dr Hapke is good, the class is not always super interesting but its not the worst. The way the class works is theres 1100 students in the class and half show up on Tuesday and the other half shows up on Thursday, the other day you watch the livestream. It's "hybrid". The tests were hard and didnt always match the homework which killed my A

This course was relatively easy and enjoyable. I took the hybrid section but did it all online, easy to earn attendance points. I did struggle a bit with the exams. Overall, she cares about her students and wants the course to be pleasant/constructive. 

Grade breakdown was 40% exams, 32% online assignments, 24% lectures, 3% REP.

Amazing professor, she is very personable and I took her hybrid class so I didnt have to go into class(could take it from my couch). she took the time to learn as many peoples names as possible. if you pay attention in her class and take the notes the class is supper easy. test were a little harder tho.

She is a good professor who cares about what she is teaching and her students. I took a hybrid course where I could do attendance online or in person. I didn't pay much attention so I got mostly Bs on exams, yet I was able to pull off an A in the course because of other grades. I would definitely recommend her over other professors.

I kind of slacked off in this class and the tests kicked my butt and I still got a B so it is definitely possible to get an A if you pay more attention than I did (which is none). She is a fun teacher that liked to engage the class with fun activities and everything online is laid out nicely too so if you are at home it is easy to follow along.

Overall she was a good professor however the class consists of a lot of memorization of the lecture/textbook material. The lectures were structured well however they didn't directly relate to the exams which were the majority of the grading scale.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Professor Hapke was a pretty good professor, but the notes that she gives were nothing like the exams so it was hard to study. She also just recently put Lockdown Browser on the exams.

HARD. This class was altered to become SO difficult so don't pay attention to old reviews. The exams are application based and often include more details than what we were taught about a particular concept in lecture, making it hard to decide the correct answer. There are too many answer choices that are similar to one another. STUDY EVERYTHING.

She wasn't too bad, nice but didn't enjoy her lectures, she wasn't really teaching just reading. 1/2 online which was annoying with how she does her lectures&participation didn't like it learning wise but easy. HW is easy. Exams are online& proctored,put extra time into reading book or lecture if you wanna do well on exam. Way harder than should be
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors I have ever had. Exams are long, paragraph-form questions without enough time to read them. Reads straight off of slides, is the one of the only hybrid courses in Gatton. One of my lowest grades of the year and shouldn't have been. Finals are supposed to have 2 hours, yet hers was timed an hour and a half.

All exams were lockdown browser with webcam, which has been changed from years past. I'm not following why you wouldn't want students to enjoy and excel in marketing so that they may want to pursue it in the future. Hapke seems okay, but material is dry and this class was way more difficult than it ever needed to be.

Professor Hapke is an absolute queen! She's so kind and helpful. The homeworks are not difficult. For lectures, attendance is required, but it's online one day and in-person on another. Exams aren't too bad either. They're online but they have more application type questions. So, make sure to prepare for that.

Professor Hapke seemed nice enough, but she changed MKT 300 and made it way harder than it needed to be. People that took it before me had open note exams and they enjoyed it even online. I keep up with the lectures and notes, made about 40 flashcards to study and still can't do great on the exams- they're way too hard for a principles class.

A TON of notes. I mean 10 page notes twice a week. Hard to study 6 weeks of those notes for the exam, which is proctored and CLOSED note, ignore other ratings saying open note. Exams have some tricky worded questions. Do your homework and attend every live session to get the most points possible. Exam averages are around 75% FYI. Nice professor.
