reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Acts as if their class is the only class you are taking. Took her class because I needed another class and it became the class I had to do the most work in. Non stop homework that can take up hours to complete. Extremely hard grader when it comes to papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Tough grader and giver of homework but overall she's a wonderful teacher. I really enjoyed her class even though it wasn't one of her areas of expertise. She was excellent at facilitating class discussion.

You only spend about three weeks covering actual folktales (at the end). Russian Folklore could almost be called "Russian History." She is an extremely picky grader. I am a senior and she is the first professor to give me a D on a paper. She counts off for pet peeves.

Hard grading, but really interesting class.  She makes it fun and while she does grade pretty hard, I still ended up with an A because of a final project where you do folklore research on a ritual specific to your family/region.  Since she's so interested in that, I think she graded leniently.  Says attendance is requ., but I skipped 10+ times.

I've never left a lecture feeling like the content wasn't made crystal clear. She is incredibly understanding, flexible and friendly: she even made our final paper optional. She holds student work to a reasonable standard that is not too hard to meet, even for a procrastinator like myself.

She teaches her classes like college classes, not like modified high school classes. You have to think for yourself, but you learn a lot. Papers are a breeze because she has no set number of pages, you write whatever length you need to complete the assignment. She's also really helpful and easy to talk to.

She was one of about 3 professors I had at UK who actually taught at a collegiate level. Those complaining about her strictness regarding grammar should be complaining about their high school English teacher instead, who obviously failed to prepare them for college. She's hard but fair, and would do much after hours to help a student if necessary.

Very passionate about teaching Russian. I enjoyed the class a lot. She's not an easy grader, but you get the opportunity to redo any homework assignment and you get to correct your tests to get more points back. She's fair, and mostly just wants you to learn the language.

She wasn't too bad but didn't really give you enough information on some things to be able to write the way you should have.   She pays CLOSE attention to grammar and spelling so DONT get points taken off for that. Homework is pretty easy as long as you answer each question - just give your opinion and your set. You do have to work though.
Grades extremely difficult on papers. You never know your grades until the end of the semester.  Class is much more difficult and analyzed than it should be.

Quite the “flamboyant character.” Spelling and grammar are huge to her. Get ready to read your eyes out and write a trillion papers about nothing. She doesn't “require lengths” on the papers she assigns, but you had better write a lot. Crazy hair-cut that she always pushes back with her hand and it always falls back exactly the way it was before.
She has to be the worst professor of all time.
Absolutley Hell!!
Fluffy subject matter and cloying respect for individual learning styles meets the comma police - this was my last class in the linguistics department.

she is compassionate about teaching, yet she is not understanding of her students needs.  she is ultra stubborne and has the most distracting hair cut ever.  she grades menacingly hard and wishes she was russian very badly

An unduly tough grader.  She lets you know exactly what she wants (although she never tells you that she considers contractions a spelling error until the first time you put one in a paper), but her expectaions are a bit ludicrous.

I loved having Jen! I thought her lectures were very funny and she is a very nice. She clearly cares a lot about journalism and cares about her students. It is important to show up for class because she makes questions every class that are graded for participation. The only time there is homework are on days we do not have class.
She was genuinely the best. I hate journalism and writing and she made it fun, she loves what she does. It's an easy class and she wants her students to get an A.
The assignments stink to do, but not too hard besides that. Just show up to class, even if you aren't going to pay attention.
She's one of the coolest instructors I've had so far, if you get on her good side then your good to be honest!
Layout of the class is not great. Professor Smith is a decent lecturer, but not very fun to cooperate with and not very understanding at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved having Jen as a professor !! Despite not being a journalism major and taking this for core requirements, I had such a great time in this class. She has so much respect and care for the students, and somehow is able to make her lectures interesting. If you have the chance, please take her

Super super friendly and awesome. The lectures are huge so her TAs are the one giving feedback, which does suck even if they give you a good grade. It would be better if she was the one giving it. Other than that, she is a great lecturer and very intelligent in journalism

Jen was a great professor! Make sure you introduce yourself to her and let her know you through her assignment, Six Feet Meet, the earlier you do it the better. Reading the textbook is helpful if you don't attend class but if you attend class and take good notes you'll pass the class.
Super awesome and caring. Teaches a huge lecture class but makes sure every student feels included. She also makes sure to take the time to get to know every student. No negatives to say about her.
lowkey bro she was chill ash
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Smith did a terrific job at teaching Intro to Journalism (JOU 101.) She is very caring and always gives clear and constructive feedback. Would 100% take her again, she made coming to class worth it. If I could give her a 6/5, I would.

I absolutely loved having her. I took her for jou 208 and you can tell she loves teaching. There is group work a lot for little things at the end of class. You will have about 1 assignment a week and an essay towards the end of the course. She is very easygoing and understanding if you miss class or things come up.
She is very kind and compassionate. I took this class as a core class, as I am not a journalism major. The class was pretty easy and enjoyable as a sports fan.
Very kind and understanding, and overall a good professor to have.

Mrs. Smith is great, her class might be mandatory, but she grades fairly. You even have the chance to receive extra credit in her class, if you participate in fairly, either in speeches, group projects, etc.

Had her for Jou 101 and ofc, I received an A in it, so I would 90% take her again, but not for the mandatory attendance.

Loved having Jen! Extra credit is offered, but the class itself is easy if you stay on top of your work. Super easy to contact outside of class and incredibly understanding! Her passion for journalism has left a great impact on me, and encouraged me to put my all into every assignment I did.

Jen Smith is literally iconic! Her sports journalism class is really interesting, learned about race, women, LGBTQ, NIL etc. in sports. Her class is an easy A, we have class every other Friday and on the Fridays we don't have class we have to submit a journal based on a doc. we watched, super easy. The final and midterm is really easy.

Jen is an amazing teacher; she truly cares about her students. You are required to purchase a textbook and it can be a helpful source but honestly, I never used it. There's not a ton of homework but the big assignments take a while, so you have to work ahead of time on those papers and analysis projects. Super accessible, go to class and take notes

I loved Jen and her class! Lots of lectures but she makes them interesting. She made me even more interested in journalism than I was before. She's super easy to talk to. You should stay on top of your smaller assignments as they can sneak up on you if you don't. The bigger assignments take a good amount of time but are easy if you pay attention.

I have taken Jen 4 times and have loved her every single time. She is not only a great teacher, but also an amazing mentor. Her lectures are basically just her reading the powerpoints word for word, but she grades really easy, while also giving amazing feedback to learn for next time. She's truly made me the writer I am today. TAKE HER CLASSES!!!
The best prof at UK, lucky to have been in her class three times. TAKE HER CLASSES!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I wouldnt suggest this class to people who arent left. While Dr. Smith is a great professor her class become far more about politics than journalism as the year went on.

I love Prof. Jen. She is hilarious and makes the content fun. Not a hard class work-wise, but there are a lot of small assignments you need to stay on top of. Go to class, participate in Spotlight Speaker days, and do the reviews for the exams and you will pass easily.
I love Jen! Take her for everything you can! She is so knowledgable and dedicated to making you a better journalist!

I wish I had Jen for all my journalism classes. She's caring, knowledgable about all things journalism, and understanding. JAM 201 is a fast-paced course, but everything comes from your notes. Buy the AP Stylebook, take good notes, and you'll be good to go!

JOU 208 was the best class I have ever taken. The course is so interesting if you enjoy sports and Jen makes this class 1000x better. She lectures everyday so be sure to take notes because her exams are open note but are super easy if you write all the info down.

Jen is wonderful. If you are interested in journalism, writing, or even if you just need an elective, I would highly recommend her. Attendance is mandatory, but some time missed wont hurt you. You will, obviously, be writing a few papers, and I would recommend you get those out of the way asap. Tests are very easy if you pay attention.

I love Jen. She is extremely caring and considerate. Most classes were lectures, but Jen made them interesting and engaging. There are only a few papers and quizzes, and a lot of points come from attendance. For the midterm and final, Jen created a Kahoot that was very helpful. This class was a lot of fun!

Hands down my fav professor. I've taken 2 classes with her, and am signed up for another in Spring. Don't think you don't have to put in some effort, but as long as you have an interest in writing/journalism, you'll like her class. She wants everyone to do well, and she is well accredited/respected in the industry. Overall a really cool person.

Jen is genuinely the best prof Ive ever had, she makes the lectures very interesting and you learn so much. take her classes if possible, she actually cares about her students and she's very experienced. wonderful teacher
Great teacher. Very understanding. You learn a lot without trying. Easy and fun course. Im not even a journalism major.
don't hesitate, if you have 1% to take any classes with her, go for it and you will like it.
This course is very rushed, but Jen does a great job of teaching it!

jen is amazing. she cares about her students and she is passionate about what she does. lots of quizzes and in-class assignments so make sure you go to class. it annoyed me in jou101, but i respect the attendance policy after seeing the impact on my grades by just going to class. highly recommend her

LOVED jou 208 and LOVED Professor Smith. The class was very interesting if you're someone who likes sports. Text book is required but you can find a free pdf version online. There is a little bit of reading for quizzes but they're pretty easy. Def take any class Jen teaches!!
Such a sweet teacher and you can tell she genuinely cares about her students. Her lectures are an interesting and engaging and small group projects are so fun!
She is the absolute best, please take any class you can with her!
Professor Smith is so caring toward all of her students. It's a super easy class if you attend all lectures. She is super understanding about mental health issues. Love her lots!

First class I took at UK and she was welcoming and made things easy to understand. Lots of real life examples to help understand topics covered in class. She was a Journalist not long ago so all of her personal experiences and stories are unique to any other professor. Turn in deadlines are pretty set in stone but that's just part of Journalism.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Love this professor!
Jen was an awesome professor! This class just requires a lot of reading and random quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Jen was such an amazing professor. She is always understanding if you can't make it to class just let her know. Obviously don't over do it and take advantage of her. Tests and quizzes were from textbooks and pretty much straight from the book and a lot of it was just common sense. Class was super fun, she really wants everyone to do good.

This was my favorite class of the semester. Jen was awesome! If you have any interest in sports, you'll like this class. Despite being a journalism course, it's not overloaded with writing assignments, so don't let that deter you. Open note/ book exams. Quizzes cover reading assignments, so make sure you look those over beforehand.

Very fun and interesting teacher. If you love sports this is a great class. Have readings periodically out of your textbook that will be on quizzes. Quizzes and test are all open notes. Recommend this class pretty easy and fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Jennifer is the most interesting professor I have ever had. She has amazing lectures and great stories from her days being a journalist. She doesn't give a lot of homework. She is a very easy grader on papers. Her exams are a little harder, but she gives you a bunch of hints and tips beforehand. Should be easy A if you pay attention in class.

Professor Smith is a great introductory Journalism Professor. She is very caring and respects all of her students. She also cares about everyone in her class, for example, she has an activity called 6-feet meet (because of COVID). Here, she sits down will all her students and gets to know their stories rather than just a name. I highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I noticed Jen (she prefers that you call her Jen) didn't have a RMP page, so I made her one. She is phenomenal, and I adored her course. Jen knows it all (and has the journalistic experience to back it up), but you will not feel intimidated in this course. Lectures are hilarious and informative, and coursework was NEVER a burden. You'll love her!
He was a very nice teacher with a dad joke sense of humor. There is a pop quiz every week but if you try you basically get full credit (more of attendance then quiz). Exams are all online.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This professor is good, but attendance is mandatory. There is a pop quiz at least once a week, so you need to be there. This class was pretty easy; you have a small homework assignment after every class, and online exams and quizzes. If you go to class and do the homework, you should end with a high grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The class is very easy. All exams are open book/open note. The only cons are that there are random in class pop quizzes and you must buy an $80 textbook.

Pretty boring, class work was easy / all online so you can re-do if needed. Pop quizzes weekly, online exams, i would say this is an easy STA class but its very boring so you don't learn a whole lot. pretty nice guy just reads off slides for 50 minutes.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Very boring and monotone when talking. Says attendance isn't mandatory, but does pop quizzes so it might as well be. Him and his TA write down people's names if they're on their phone and watch over us. It's like high school/jail. The quizzes, exams, and homework are all online so you might as well just save yourself and take the class online.

A super nice teacher, just very boring at times. Be aware of pop quizzes, as you will have one at least every week. Quizzes are not bad, but exams were a little difficult. Be sure to take notes, and try to not skip class.
He was great! He was a little boring but very nice. There was a pop quiz once every week, but even if you got the question wrong, you got 90% for showing up. All tests are online and not proctored.

Both his lectures and his subject matter are incredibly boring. Fine and relatively easy class to get a core requirement done, but you will very quickly begin dreading it. The exams are online so as long as you cheat on those and keep up with homework you'll be fine. Attendance isn't tracked but random pop quizzes happen, so don't skip often.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Boring and will put you to sleep in his lecture
did not learn much in this course, take someone else if you can! very hard grader, pop attendance quizzes every week (sometimes twice a week!) avoid taking his class if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: It was so hard to stay awake in his class. There was so little content and I feel like I barely learned. He talks so slow and monotone. I do not think he really cares about his students or subject all that much. Class itself was pretty easy to pass, but if you want an A or B you do have to go to class. Pop quiz EVERY week.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: AVOID AT ALL COST!!!! very difficult to deal with and unfriendly if you have any issues.worst professor I've had at UK.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Modenbach was ok. Attendance "technically" isn't mandatory, but he gives short pop quizzes about every other class and they're worth a big chunk of your grade. Takes pretty good notes but his lectures are extremely boring and often found myself not being able to pay attention. Has online (non proctored) exams which is nice, but still difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: the class was easy and i only spent 1-2 hours a week doing assignments. Modenbach is really chill and the lectures are easy to fall along with.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I'm surprised by the low rating for Professor Mode. I would recommend anyone take Mr. Mode. If I hadn't taken this course with him, I'm not sure that I would see the same success. Material is understandable and in powerpoints. Attendance isn't mandatory but it is encouraged as he will give random "pop quizzes" for attendance. Very manageable.

Professor Modenbach was amazing! I took the online summer STA296 course for transfer credit and thought he was very easy to reach and friendly. The course is structured very well! This was my very first introduction to statistics, and I found it very manageable and easy to follow.
When it comes to absences being excused he is not understanding but rather unhelpful and stubborn. Also, he doesn't really teach in a way that engages students but instead reads off his PowerPoint.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I didn't mind him. Although lectures were boring, he always responded to email and if you show up you get points on pop quizzes even if you miss the question!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Honestly, the only good thing about this course is the online exams. Modenbach just reads off the lecture slides and does not actually teach. The only reason I passed this course is because chegg was my tutor. I do not recommend this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Online, open-note exams are the only good thing about this course. The lectures are very long and do not help you understand the material or do the homework. While attendance isn't mandatory every day, there are pop quizzes taken for attendance and they cannot be made up or excused even if you are sick. Long and boring lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very boring classes with long lectures. Modenbach was an easy grader but very boring in general. Pop quizzes every week.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He made the class way harder than it should have been and was not helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Modenbach seems like a very sweet person but his lectures are incredibly boring. He just goes thru a PP and talks too long about certain subjects b/c he doesn't have enough material for the whole class time. Attendance is not mandatory but he has a random pop quiz once every week to try and get everyone to come to class everyday.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Hardest class I am taking as a freshman. He is boring, his exams are hard, and class is mandatory, Each time you miss class, you lose 10 points. I hate everything about this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had Jill for ARC 152, and she was great. She is so patient and caring. You will have a lot of projects to do, but you will learn so much, and her final project is always good.  She LOVES iterations, you will do millions, but otherwise, a great first-year professor!

Jill is amazing but does not like late work so try your best to get your stuff done! she also sometimes does not give clear instructions but if you ask her to tell you again she explains it better! this class is super easy just participate!

Jill was an amazing first experience for architecture. Beware, she does have you create and iterate a ton, but keep in mind that the more you engage, the more you learn and gain in the end. So glad I got to learn technical skills from Jill. She's very honest and encouraging as well, so her feedback is always helpful and beneficial.

I had Jill for my second semester of studio. Jill is extremely understanding, thoughtful, and gives feedback that helps students develop their work and technical skills. She grounds the first-year workload with real-life sites and projects and makes sure one has a clear understanding of how this connects to their progression as future architects.

Jill Leckner was my first arch. prof. and she led me in a direction that I am still going in today with design. She gave helpful critiques and was kind. Her style of teaching allowed me to explore my personal interests. This was by far my favorite studio experience.

Leckner was my first studio professor. Her 151 studio focuses a lot on renderings and form studies and creating real life structures like pavilions and visitors centers. Shes super flexible and gives good feedback without coming across as being super picky. She gives a lot of great general design help that can really help you elevate your work.

A treasure to academia. In all four years at UK, Nels is probably the best professor out there. Not only are his lectures EXTREMELY interesting, he's an exemplary educator and individual. TAKE HIS CLASS! Even if you pass, TAKE IT AGAIN! Exaggerations aside, if you can, take any and all of his classes in triplicate.

Nabokov said: "There is nothing in the world that I loathe more than group activity, that communal bath where the hairy and slippery mix in a multiplication of mediocrity." Ignoring the instances in which I crashed out at frat boys, Dr. Rogers' class was transcendental. I once quoted Nietzsche incorrectly to him. He is a tour de force of film.

I love Professor Rogers. He is so passionate about what he teaches and so interesting. The class is not hard at all. Textbook can be found easily online and the concepts he discusses are very easy to understand. You just have to actually watch and pay attention to the films.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I took GER 305, not bad. lot of work but easy. We did at least two assignments every week a reeding response and a film response (you have to watch the films in your own time). Theres like 10 films and responses and 11 reading responses. 2 exams overall, pretty easy just do the assignments. He's very passionate about third topic.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Rogers was an amazing professor for this class. He was very engaging and knowledgeable. Film responses were easy as long as you actually watch the movie. For the reading responses, just don't put it off until the last day. Half way through he stopped lecturing every class and did mostly group work, which was annoying but it wasn't bad.
The movies we watched in his class were fun. The german cinema class was a lot more about german history than it was movies. So dont take this if you dont want to learn about germany.

Global Horror is easily the best class I've ever taken at UK. Professor Rogers is an extraordinarily engaging lecturer and is very knowledgeable. This is the only class I've been EXCITED to get up at 9 am for.

I took MCL343 with Prof. Rogers my freshman year and it was probably my favorite course that Ive taken in my time at UK. I am a passive fan of horror films, by no means super passionate about it. He makes class fun and interesting, plus you genuinely do learn a lot in class - it doesnt feel like a complete waste of time. I highly recommend MCL343

I am currently taking this class and hate it. He changed the course like halfway through the semester and now we have group work every week instead of just usual lectures twice a week. The exams are a lot of work and you'll probably have 3 papers to write for each exam plus a multiple choice section. The content is interesting but I wouldn't take..

His grading is confusing and not good several of our big assignments barely affected my grade, the small 10 point assignments affect your grade wayyy more, his classes are hard to stay focused in I almost fall asleep during all of his lectures, his assignments never make sense and when you ask for help he doesnt help you. Do not take his class!!!

This class was very enjoyable, but get ready to learn how to decode basically the entire horror genre and all of the films by the end of the semester. Its a hard class if you arent a humanities major, but its doable if you put in the work. The tests are all online and he is easy to reach outside of class, but be prepared for 2 movies a week.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: One of the coolest professors at UK. His MCL343 class is always in very high demand because it is such an enjoyable class. If you can get a spot in it, and need it for your core requirements, take it!!

Rogers was SUCH a great prof to have! He was so nice and laid back. I was honestly excited to attend his lectures because they're always interesting and fun. The books weren't hard to understand, just have to skim a bit, and papers weren't bad. Definitely watch the movies though, just sparknoting it isn't good enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Rogers is a cool guy, and that is not an understatement. I took him for a Global Horror class and the class was a true joy. However, there are lots of homework such as film reviews and reading responses, and his tests are just papers, no final. He is laidback and approachable. You get to watch horror movies for credit. Take this class
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: I've taken three of his courses and will be in a fourth this upcoming semester. My favorite teach on UK's campus. Easy to talk to outside of class, super knowledgeable, and never condescending even when talking about something he is insanely passionate about, which is the film course. Great guy would recommend.

Professor Rogers is amazing! He will look over any paper you have to turn into him before it is due and give you feedback. As long as you keep up on homework and show up, you will easily pass the class.

Very interesting class! Don't take it unless you're willing to watch a lot of films (once a week, totaling 12 films) He's kinda a hard grader, especially with sequence analysis. ADVISE: go to his office hours and ask for him (or his TA) to review your work before you turn it in. Whenever I've done this, I've gotten an A on every assignment.
Wonderful guy, great teacher, and easy to work with. I recommend him when at all possible.
Such a fun class!  Very passionate about subject!  The class is pretty easy if you watch the movies and show up for discussions.

Great professor!! Really interesting and knowledgeable about anything film or German. As long as you go to class and so the work it's and easy A-B. He's helpful and if you talk to him he can help with the work and your grade.

If you are interested in international film, he is the professor to take. He displays both key factors to understanding the subject: the cultural context in which the films were made and the technical filmic language needed to interpret them. He is engaging and knowledgeable of the content without being pretentious and pejorative towards students.

I've taken two classes with Rogers (352 and 361) and I think he is an amazing professor. He lets you know what you should take from the class & he's clear about what he wants from assigned work. He keeps it interesting and has a respectable sense of humor. He can also change the way you view films for the rest of your life.

I was interested in the class at first, and fell in love after. This was my favorite class, I wish I could take another. Easy class, books are pretty interesting, and easy to read, the films are fun, and he gets into the symbolism of everything, makes you think differently about it. Highly reccommended.
Good Prof. Nice, mumbles when he speaks. Easy class
Class was very interesting. I had a lot of fun in this class. Several readings throughout the semester but nothing too serious. Dr. Rogers is very enthusiastic and relays information clearly.

AMAZING! I honestly could have cared less about german until this class. He was a fantastic teacher & I loved the class. The class (& the prof) is very very interesting & entertaining. plus he's hot lol

This guy is an amazing prof. I went into this class dreading it and now I'm looking for more germaan classes to take. He is interesting and enthusiastic. He is one of my best profs yet. Take his classes... I plan to take another one. :)
He is an awesome prof! Really sparked my interest in German Studies!
Extremely intelligent and enthusiastic.
No Comments
No Comments

This class was a lot more work than I expected, but if you go to class and actually do all the readings and watch the films this class is pretty easy. If you can do you work and attend class regularly, an A or B in this class is certainly attainable.

Good guy overall, very clear and to the point.  However if you plan on taking 104, be prepared to read a lot and make sure you go to the films and you'll be ok.  He made the class a lot more enjoyable than my other classes as well, he's a pretty cool guy.

Incredibly intelligent and insightful.  He knows more about the subjects than you could ever fit into a semester-long class.  Yes, his Powerpoints have some spelling and grammar errors but this is in no way a reflection of his pedagogical ablilty.  As far as factual errors go, I've never seen one.
Awesome teacher, increased my interest in German and German film. One of the true Gems of UK's Faculty.
He's awesome!!! Helpful, understanding, interesting, field trips, lots of group activities and variation in instruction. I'd take him again and again.
Love this professor she is great.  Highly recommend taking her classes. Lots of reading, and lectures can be a bit dull but it her classes are low stress. She is so knowledgeable as well.

This is a political science class, so more often than not personal political views will come out. She did not even tried to hide the fact that she is so left leaning. In my opinion, professors in this field should try and be as unbiased as possible when teaching. Her teaching is boring and it seems that she uses complex terminology to be confusing
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I took two of her classes at once and as a person, I really like her. She's nice and every time I had an issue that made it so I couldn't attend class, she was happy to help me catch up. As a teacher not so much. Her zooms were extremely work-heavy and because of rushing to finish, we didn't learn much.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Haglund is an extremely knowledgeable professor! I learned so much in this course without it being excessively boring. She assigns a lot of reading every week, but you can get away with just skimming. Her exams are kind of hard, but if you completely fill out her study guide, there's no reason you shouldn't get an A! She's also super nice :)
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I cant say enough good things. Really interesting class and Dr. Haglund has done a lot of cool research and is so kind hearted. She just wants to talk about world peace.

She does read straight off the slides, but she knows so much about the material! I found her class enjoyable, and It was not very difficult. Attendance is not mandatory (besides recitation), but I would recommend going to class to get the notes. She makes study guides and there will be extra credit opportunities!

You are graded on 5 things. Three exams and two papers. The exams are really hard and sometimes not even relatable to course content. The papers are a piece of cake, so you better hope you do well on the exams. Lecture class is not mandatory but if you skip recitation, your grade will suffer.

Easy class, just like all GWS classes. Some pop quizzes here and there, but if you pay attention you will ace those. Super lenient grader. Attendance is worth a lot though. Go to class and do your work and it'll all be good.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: she's literally the sweetest teacher ever. i love her so much. her class was not hard, but participation matters a lot, and i am a very anxious person. however, i did fine! do the work and you'll get a good grade effortlessly. she does have trouble with her english sometimes, but i didn't find her hard to understand. she's trying her best :)

I like her a-lot but sometimes assignments can get confusing, class gets cancelled a-lot so thats good if ur lazy but it gets kinda confusing as time goes on, she doesn't really respond to emails, you have to see her in person to ask her. attendance is mandatory and grade will drop if you miss class. overall i think shes a pretty good professor!

She is absolutely amazing! Very understanding and acommodating, even when people don't deserve it. She is passionate and friendly, and the class is super easy. I would 100% take another class she taught.

She was an outstanding and invited new ideas and perspectives into class discussions. There was a lot more focus on genuinely learning and discussing instead of testing how well you memorize something. She was also extremely sweet and made the entire class feel genuinely cared about. She created a comfortable welcoming space.

Amazing professor. She is extremely kind and down to earth. I suffered a terrible family event during my semester with them and she was very understanding and accomodating to me. This class can be a little hard, but she is always willing to help you out if you need it. I would definitely take another course with them.

Professor Zhang was so sweet and gave amazing feedback on assignments! The class content was a little intimidating at times but she was always clear with what she expected on assignments and explained things well. Lots of reading and the midterm/final were super tedious but still loved her and the class. Highly recommend her!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Zhang is super sweet and understanding. We had weekly pop quizzes over the material that were super easy as long as you paid attention. The midterm and final were a little tedious and a lot of writing that took quite a long time, but the questions were posted beforehand to prep. Really great professor, highly recommend.

Great professor, very understanding! Lots of extra credit is offered. You definitely should do the readings, not just because they're required, but also because they're super interesting! A very enlightening class with a great professor!! :^)
The professor uses she/they pronouns. They give a lot of extra credit and the midterm and finals are take-home exams. Take notes over movies so you can use the notes on these at-home tests.

70 points of extra credit, so very hard to fail. I didn't read very many of the assigned readings and will still most likely get an A. Quizzes every week, but they're not too hard. Writing assignments every other week, but they are very simple. I would take this class for an easy core class.
Essentially was a TA, was very helpful.

This class was somewhat difficult. The first portion is pretty simple, then it speeds up a bit and gets more challenging. She is a good instructor who knows the material, but sometimes it can be hard. Participation gets you bonus points, attendance is points, and there's a decent amount of HW. The class is overall "OK" and doing the HW is 80% of it

NEVER AGAIN. I took STA296 with her and it was horrible. Lectures are so boring I want to rip my hair out, you learn nothing and quizzes/exams are terrifying because you don't know the content. I learned nothing and I'm a striaght A student.I really tried to understand in this class but between her accent and lack of teaching skills, its impossible

Dr. Winter is very nice and a generous grader. The only reason I didn't get 100% is because I forgot participation was graded for like 2 weeks. As long as you turn in something that generally reflects the rubric you will get an A. The class is not a lot of work at all, and her personality makes going to class (which is mandatory) enjoyable. 10/10.
An entertaining professor, but if you're already a good writer, you're going to be extremely bored.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Winter is genuinely one of the most caring professors that I've had. She seems to genuinely care about students and is very understanding. Attendance and participation is graded but she does give you a few free days. Definitely take her for your WRD classes if you can.
She is a very engaging teacher which I appreciate. Also just a kind person in general and will work with you if there is a problem. I would take her as my professor over and over again.
Incredible professor, very easy class, really good environment. No complaints, would take this class every semester if I could.

Dr. Winter is the absolute best WRD 110 professor I could ever ask for. I feel like a lot of WRD 110 teachers are mediocre at best but Dr. Winter is quite the opposite, she truly cares about her students and if you ever have concerns let her know and she'll work with you.

I LOVED THIS CLASS!!! Dr. Winter was soooo much fun and maked it easy to come to class evey time. Wish she was teaching WRD 111 because I wanted to take her again. Not your avreage WRD teacher! She is funny, always happy to be there, gives great feedback, and her class is soo much fun. She brought out a love of writing I didn't know i even had.
Dr. Winter was my favorite professor of the semester! I highly recommend taking her class as an incoming freshman!

Take Dr. Winter!! She is a great professor and so understanding. The work is not hard and she gives extensions for pretty much every assignment. She is willing to work with her students and grades very fairly. You have to take her!

Genuinely the GOAT. She's very eccentric, which leads to much more exciting classes that don't bore you to death like many others. She's also incredibly understanding about any issues you may face in your semester, and extremely resourceful in seeking out assistance in her class or even classes outside of hers. So thoughtful.
I wish all my classes were taught by her.

Best professor ever! She has lots of extra credit and you get 3 excused mental health days. If you email her ahead of the assignment due date, she will provide feedback before you turn it in for a grade. I was nervous because participation is a requirement. However, she is very inviting and energetic. It became very easy to participate in class.

Probably the nicest and most positive person ever. She is a very easy grader and wants every student to get the best grade possible. The classes are very pointless but that's not a professor flaw it's a class-wide problem. She does a ton of "pair shares" which I found very annoying because I'm not very social. Best WRD 110 teacher nonetheless.

She is one of the most accommodating teachers I have ever met. She actually polled the class to see which day we would prefer for a workday. Additionally, we were explicitly given 1) three unexcused absences and 2) two opportunities to request a deadline extension for major projects. Not my favorite class but Mz. Winter made it bearable.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Definitely one of my favorite teachers by far since coming to UK. if you have the chance to take her for anything, DO IT! She is so personable and relatable, and genuinely made going to class fun and worthwhile. She gave us plenty of time to get our work done so it never felt overwhelming. No matter what she was always in a good mood!

Mz. Winter is one of my absolute favorite professors I've had so far. She makes class fun and light and doesn't give tests which I liked. It is very discussion based but the discussions are very chill and nothing to stress over. The paper's are all pretty simple and she grades very fairly.

Mz. Winter was accessible, gregarious, and helpful. She established clear grading guidelines throughout the semester. She always answered emails quickly and was willing to help you with your work. Her class was always enjoyable and I left feeling like the class had been worth my time.

Ms. Winter is very personable and funny. She assigns a lot of papers so if you don't like to write I'd choose a different prof. Her feedback is very helpful and she will edit your papers if you send them in early. She made me a better writer. No quizzes/exams. Very very easy class.

Ms. Winter for WRD 111 is by far the best teacher I've had a UK. She is super chill, cancels class, and is hilarious. Also an easy grader! I can get pretty lazy and I ended with an A in her class. Winter cares about her students and wants everything to be a smooth as possible. The work I did in her class was nothing compared to other WRD classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Ms. Winter is absolutely hilarious and such a great teacher. Definitely my favorite since I've gone to school here at UK! She grades mostly on homework, and a few group projects. NO TESTS!!!! She gives you the grade you deserve based on effort and improvements from the rough draft. As own as you put in the effort, you will get an A. I Recommend!
Ms. Winter is awesome with students and as long as you do the work you will do great in her class! She is very helpful and thorough in her explanations. The assignments aren't very hard either!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Ms. Winter is the best! She cares so much about all of her students and loves to laugh. Her class isn't hard at all since she keeps everything super interesting and enjoyable. Participation is key! Definitely try your hardest to have her as your WRD 110 teacher!
this class made me want to cry
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is so passionate about her work. However, do not take this class if you are uninterested in early literature. You are graded on very few things. She doesn't use canvas which can be confusing. I didn't know my grade until midterms. However, when I was sick during the midterm and couldn't take it in person she was very accommodating and helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: MacDonald doesn't do any grading until last minute. She also doesn't provide clear study guides for exams. Be prepared to have no idea what's going on while she stands at the front of the room and talks about her grandkids.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you want an easy A, take any of Dr. MacDonald's classes. I have been in a few now, and she is incredibly knowledgeable about what she teaches. Her classes are guided by discussion, and there's rarely any work outside of reading. She is very considerate, and always asks for our input on things like exams. Definitely a quality > quantity professor
She is definitely passionate about Shakespeare. The class is just talking about what we were assigned to read so I didn't really pay attention. I didn't mind the class but it was kind of boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is very king and understanding. There are few grades, but the class is overall pretty easy so it is not hard to keep a high grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Pure lecture, with no opportunity to give your own input. Few chances to earn a grade. Very nice person.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Macdonald is the worst professor I have ever had. At the beginning of the semester, over half of the class missed a discussion post because it was added onto Canvas with no notification on a completely different date than posted on the syllabus. She is never unavailable because she lives in Louisville, and makes it clear that she will not help.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really feel as though every assignment was graded extremely unfairly, even though I increasingly put more effort with every assignment. I will never understand why I got a C in this class. I have never done even nearly this bad in an English class. So ridiculous. Do not take by ANY means.

This was the most boring class I've ever taken. It's a monologue the entire time which makes it super easy to get bored and distracted. She answers her own questions that she asks the class and it's not much of a discussion, just her talking at the class. I appreciate her grading but it's over the top difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: clueless and overly particular grader, lazy communication, cancelled multiple classes very last minute (was already in class room) with little explanation, every class is a long monologue filled with arguably unimportant information that is hard to take notes on and likely will never show up again--in this class and in future english classes. bad.

Very nice but every class is a monologue. Discussion is not encouraged and material can get boring fast unless you are extremely interested in the subject like she is. Not nearly enough graded assignments, so grade was determined by one paper and a midterm exam that we were not prepared well for. I do not feel like my writing skills improved at all
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. MacDonald, for her lackadaisical attitude, has exceedingly high expectations. She does not put in as much effort in this class as she expects students to do. She is constantly late, and she forgot when our final was 3 times. She also lost one of my papers. She's impossible to please, and she does not give students the advice needed to do so.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Amazing lectures--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor MacDonald was super nice and enthusiastic about what she talked about. The tests and quizzes were easy. Thats how I got my A. The two papers brought me down because she is a tough grader on papers. If you read the plays, go to class, and do good on the tests you will do good.

Dr. MacDonald loves what she teaches. She lectures a lot, but she seems excited about teaching you. Her papers are nearly impossible to do well on, even when you ask her for revisions more than once before turning it in. Her rubrics are vague and she doesn't follow the syllabus very well. She also doesn't put grades on Canvas.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This is the worst class I have ever taken. Do not take it even if you like Shakespeare, never got above a C on a paper

She was a super nice teacher and person, but when it came to grading papers, she was very tough. I never got higher than a B on any paper, and most times, comments were vague. She is knowledgeable in her subjects and accessible outside of class, but do not take her unless you are good at writing and passionate about Shakespeare.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Super nice lady, but a very tough grader. You need to go to her office hours before you turn in anything to make sure she likes it. Doesn't "trust" canvas so you have no idea what your grade in the class is. Very knowledgable when it comes to shakespeare, but if you're not obsessed with shakespeare or plays don't take this class.

I love Dr. MacDonald. I had her for Renaissance Era. She's really enthusiastic during her lectures. She practically puts on a play every class and reads in character. Her lectures are just insightful discussion about the plays. She's super down to earth. Her tests are easy, but prepare to write really quickly.

I took her for my graduating semester and she was very very into the texts that we read in class. She is one of few English teachers who is very knowledgeable about the subject she instructs. Her class was not boring, I found entertainment in her lectures. I could listen to her talk about Renaissance Drama and never get tired of it.

Didn't give clear expectations, and grading was ambiguous. (I got As throughout semester, but final grade: B). She lost assignments/delayed in returning them. She doesn't encourage your participation; even when she asks a question, she answers it before you have a chance to chime in, which makes it too easy to zone out. She's nice. Class is boring.

She's not very specific about any papers you have to write, but is really strict on grading.  Her handwriting on returned papers is almost illegible, and the comments aren't very helpful.  She also won't post grades on blackboard, and only gives letter grades, no number grades, so you won't know where you stand until final grades are posted.
Her students may not be as smart as they think they are, but they're definitely smarter than she thinks they are.
She's used to working with grad students, so she had a higher standard. Very hard grader and full of self-importance
did a great job of explaining difficult material

I wouldn't take her class unless you have no choice.  She lost my final paper, didn't give me feedback until the night the paper was due, told us she didn't know when she would get to our papers because of a cocktail party and derby and then brought us food on the last day of class to make up for her irresponsibility.  Also painfully boring.

She is the worst English teacher I have had in college. She is horrible at getting stuff back to students on time. She gave me my rough draft back for our final paper less than 24 hours before the final was due and I basically has to rewrite the paper and I had given her the draft a week ago. Also her lectures are AWFUL but the TA grades everything
Snotty attitude, hard, ambiguous grader.  Don't take unless you have to.

Runs an entertaining class.  Doesn't give note-based lectures.  Running over some SparkNotes (if you've read the play) and listening in class will get you a sure fire A or B.  Never got below a B on papers, but rarely got higher- she's pretty cruel when it comes to essays.  Easy 300+ level teacher.

very enthusiastic teacher and not too bad to have in class (especially since you don't have to attend. doesnt encourage a lot of participation. also, extremely hard grader, especially on papers, and very intimidating outside of class.
Unclear and hard to communicate with, she is actually snobbish.

The quizzes can be hard to study for because she's likely to ask questions that have nothing to do with the reading, but the sticking point to me was her grading on the essay (25% of the total grade), which was unusually specific and harsh regarding elements she did not contest in the draft I submitted to her beforehand.  I wouldn't recommend her.

Amazing teacher, but EXTREMELY hard grader. Makes her TA grade most, but if she gets your paper it will be very hard to get an A. Funny at times, and also gives interesting stories. Definately knows what shes talking about when it comes to Brit Lit!!

Very ambigious in the grading and criteria expected in the papers. Very hard to get an A in the class, let alone the papers. She drives from Louisville every tuesday and thursday, so that makes things pretty difficult.
Lectures are mandatory and boring, but exams and participation are the only things graded. Overall, not bad.

Jokinsky is a very nice guy. If you pay attention during class you should do very well. You have to do well on the exams to get an A because there are no papers. The only other grade is participation.

The class was pretty easy. Tests and final were online and had a few hard questions, but not bad. Class is lecture-heavy, and there are participation points you need to earn on most days of class. Dr. J is very young and chill, but his lectures are somewhat boring. Overall, his class was good and he was great.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He gave random participation grades, took forever to grade tests and papers, and was a harsh grader most of the time. Lectures were mostly in Spanish, and he called on people randomly. Tests, papers, presentations, and interviews were standard for the Spanish department. There are better 201 professors, but he's not the worst.

dedelow was just disrespectful at times and made students feel uncomfortable. grades participation too harshly. he is an okay lecturer, but expects you to answer questions in class about content you have barely just learned.

If you cannot handle randomly being called on often, don't take his class. I will say I've done well on everything and haven't struggled much. I got by without having to participate TOO much, but make sure to at least try to. You can tell he wants you to learn. He is a nice guy, but being in his class was just stressful for me at times.

Class is very hard for someone who is not very good at Spanish(even in his 201 class - which seemed unfair)& if you have a lot of other classes to focus on as well. You will get called out to answer questions and HAVE to participate to have anywhere near a good participation grade. Even when I participated my participation grade was not very good.

Extreme when it comes to participation and attendance grades. If you don't have a sick note you only get 3 days of unexcused absences before it starts to effect your grade heavy. Mental health, family emergencies, doesn't matter you HAVE to have a doctors note.

If you want a professor that is not very helpful and is sometimes pretty condescending, then you should go with him. I really would not recommend! Very picky grader and not very understanding if you are in a tough spot and need some flexibility. Avoid!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: His class is very standard to UKY's Spanish department. We solely used VHL for tests and homework, very straightforward. What made me like Darryl's class is that he's young and enjoys talking to his students. He's always doing activities that include pop culture, campus, etc. He's very understanding of skipping for mental health days.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Hes the average Spanish professor at UK. Were kind of expected to learn on our own and then we practice in class. Personally, I think it would have been better to teach us the content in class. Overall, hes not a bad professor and he can be accommodating if necessary. Participation and attendance matter a lot!

I have never had a professor more condescending in my life. Class is all activities. He doesn't teach anything, and his explanations are awful. He grades participation extremely hard even when you do actively participate.

He doesn't teach anything but rather just expects us to do activities in pairs almost the whole class time. I hate that I have to teach myself at home and then come to class and just hold conversations when I should be getting taught. He grades participation too hard and doesn't explain things well. He has an attitude sometimes and is not helpful.
He's a jerk to his students, very moody. But, the material isn't hard, the homework doesn't take long, and he's an easy grader. If you can put up with his attitude, it's an easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: At first, I hated coming to his class. But as time progressed, I started to enjoy it. If you participate in class, he makes in a lot easier on you. The exams aren't bad whatsoever, but be sure to do the hw and go to class. Those two factors play a vital role in your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Darryl is a nice guy, but man, his class could be difficult to attend sometimes. His powerpoints are incredibly helpful, and he's usually decent at explaining concepts, but definitely pay attention to his examples, especially when test time comes around. Participation and the extra credits are a must if you're "okay" at Spanish.

You must be in class AND participate in order to do well in his class. Most of the stuff is out of the book and online homework. He tries to answer questions but is not always extremely clear. Tests are pretty hard and he is a rather tough grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Not very caring to students. When asking questions does not give clear answered and does not encourage students for right answers. Friendly personality and let's students know about homework.
Ted is really nice and always willing to help out a student.

Prof. Higgs was amazing. He was very easy to approach and encouraged students to pursue research in a variety of interesting directions. He was helpful and I got the impression that he cares about his students.

i literally know nothing about greek mythology. but he definitely thought everyone in the whole class knew about greek mythology just because we had 2 or 3 people who knew everything about it. you only get one unexcused absence, and one after every miss class means a 3% decrease in your grade. so annoying! he is also hard to approach too and talkto

He's very knowledgeable, however boring and all that happens in class is him paraphrasing the assigned reading, essentially making class redundant and unnecessary. Except for, however, the require attendance, and the significant grade lowering by absences.

He is very experiences and definitley knows his material, but is very boring to listen to. He switched textbooks this semester students couldn't use the online summaries like in the past. He lectures straight from the book, so as long as you read you don't have to go to class. It's a lot of memorization, but nothing extrememly difficult.

He is boring in class and hard to hear. Everything on the tests basically come from the online website. I never read the book and did not got to class, but memorized the online chapter summaries and online quizzes and got A's on each test. It is a lot of memorization though, but definitely will get you an A!!

Professor Higgs is great. hes very helpful and makes everything very clear. Is always prepared and expects you to be also. He doesnt use powerpoint but that never bothered me. He is great and will curve tests if people do badly.

Very boring, but very easy if you can memorize stories, names, and various facts.  Don't bother buying the books.  The smaller one is rarely used, and the main text is found online on his website (but he didn't tell us about it until halfway through the semester).  I got an A by just reading the summaries and taking the online practice quizzes.

If you have this professor on your schedule, drop it immediately. I have never had so many issues with a professor before. his grading is very strict, and he is never happy with what you turn in. his feedbacks are rude, overly critical, and not helpful at all. the way he explains how to do an assignment is confusing.

He's genuinely such not correctly assigned professor for a freshman level class. He's incredibly political during lecture and passive aggressive if you don't follow his rubric that he doesn't even adhere too correctly. I've compared with other people I know WRD110 class and it is like night and day. He won't treat the 100 level like it's supposed
Would never take him again. Petty in his grading. Political. And references inappropriate things in lectures often.

Probably one of the worst teachers I've ever had. He's odd, in love with his base guitar, hates the whole world (except his mom and brothers wife), very political, grades like his life depends on it, acts like you're grad students, and you won't learn anything in class. The only reason he's a teacher is because he likes to hear himself talk.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Attendance is mandatory for some reason even though the lectures are absolutely pointless. He is a VERYYYY harsh grader, taking this class is gonna ruin your GPA. He never puts any positive feedback on the work, only really rough criticism. The class made me miserable, I would NOT recommend.

Class is so boring. All he does is talk about politics. Ive tried copying but writing in my own words on an assingment HE GIVES HIS OWN EXAMPLE. I still got a 75. He is the toughest grader Ive ever experienced. Same yourself while you can
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: why is he requiring all students to have usb drives in the big 2025 when he is claiming to upload our work onto his? Not sure. I cant stand being in his class. he only talks about politics and rock bands and bashes everything he doesn't agree with. his monotone voice makes it even harder to listen and take him seriously as a college professor.

I would not look both ways crossing the road on my walk to his class hoping I get hit by a car, not a good teacher and the lectures are always about everything but the actual assignments, also he mentions politics a lot which have zero connection to anything in the class.

He is terrible. If u value ur mental health or urself as a person AT ALL then u wont take his class. Do not. Hes so weird and only talks abt politics and then leaves personal hate comments on ur essays.hes picky and aggressive and always angry at someone. If u get unlucky and have to take his class then be prepared to wanna drop out
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Mandatory lectures and he docks participation points if you're on your phone or not answering questions. He is kinda funny but he gets off topic quite often. Also a very harsh grader.
Do not take this professor! TAKE ANYONE ELSE!!! Horrible grader, have to go to class and participate. Cannot be on phone during class.

grades really hard but if you just listen to what he says about the assignments and do exactly what he says you'll be fine. The rubrics are very vague and he talks a lot about irrelevant rock bands rather than english.

When I tell you this was the worst class I've ever taken (and I've had April French). He grades like he's personally offended by your existence. Attendance is mandatory and his lectures are so painfully dull and irrelevant that I would count down the minutes until I was free from his voice. Longest hour of my life.

He is just an awful professor. He gives papers with descriptions and rubrics but doesn't follow them when he grades. His lectures are so boring and he just rambles and yaps about random things. You will not learn anything in his class ever. Takes participation points off for no reason and grades like his life is on the line. Do not take him.

He was a very harsh and mean grader. The comments he puts under your assignments are very mean and hostile. His lectures are very monotone and boring. He never stays on topic and never explains anything but expects you to just understand and do everything he wants. Please find a different profesor.

If I could rate him a 0 I would. He genuinely does not want you to succeed. He is an overly tough grader,  Save yourself from wasted time. He does not explain the work he gives. You will walk out of that of that room knowing more about random rock artist and politics then anything English related.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr JJ Roberts is a very very hard grader. I feel like the work you submit will never be up to his standards even though the work is still good. YOU MUST GO TO CLASS or else you will be stuck getting 0/5 for participations. Even if you go to class pay attention cause he will still dock points off of your participation by 3 if you don't say a word.
This dude is pretty weird and most of the class just rambles about a lecture and gets off topic very easily. Very boring while in class. Save yourself some time and look for a different professor.

Do not take unless you are an Accounting major. He makes 202 very difficult. On my final for 201 I got a 97% but I'll be lucky if I can pass the final in this class. Who said ACC202 was easier than ACC201 again?

He really scared me at first but he is a really nice professor. I got a B & Icould have gotten an A if I had more time to put into the class. He is a really good teacher & will explain everything in detail that you need to know for the exams. I plan on taking him for ACC 202 next semester since I am used to him & I hear that 202 is easier
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Probably the best teacher I ever had. If you go to class and keep up with the homework it is a tough class but not an impossible one like some say.  He always answered my questions and showed me how to think. I am taking him for 202 next semester because I like his teaching style where he lectures first before he assigns you homework. No complaint

He's exam are very very hard. He's style of teaching is mainly from the book, meaning you need to read the chapters throughly before coming to class because thats what he expects. He goes over homework by individually calling out everyone on the roster, and will quiz you on the spot about how well you not only know the problem, but the subject.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I am not an accounting major, and this class has been the bane of my existence. Smigla loves the subject, and knows his content, but he does not sugar coat anything. He is very thorough, which I think is what made it so difficult. Great professor if you are an accounting/finance major, but I'd advise to not take him if you aren't.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: BEST ADVICE FOR SMIGLA: If you are not an accounting major do NOT take his class! 6+ hours of homework each week and exams are VERY thorough. He clearly states this is a continuous study course and that is 100% true. This is an intensely detailed course geared toward ACC majors. Save yourself from the stress and do not take from him nonACC majors!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I took this professor for 201 during summer 1 and 202 during summer 2 and WOW am I glad.  I aced the assessment exam in 301 and intermediate accounting is actually easy because of him!  While others are struggling in 301 I know it.  He explains things really well and shows you how to think so you end up remembering it all.  Just work hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Smigla is going to humble you on the first day with a graded quiz. You're going to do homework for every class and you're not going to know how to do it even though you go to every lecture so you'll have to look up the answers online. Everyone will drop out and you'll be feeling like The Few. The Proud. The Marines. All he serves is L's on exams
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I also had prof Smigs for 201 and 202 is much easier.  He teaches the class the same but the material is just a whole lot easier. I had a low B with him in 201 and have a high A grade in 202.  His lectures are excellent and he covers the homework in detail and will answer questions. I highly recommend him for either course and especially 202.

I'm an Accounting major currently in 302 and i took Smigla over a year ago for 201. Here's my 2cents: If you're an ACC major, Taking Smigla for foundational classes like 201 will help you SO MUCH down the road. Trust me when i say Accounting builds on top of each other. Smigla is Hard. But who ever said Accounting was easy?!

I got a B in the class and if I would have spent more time I know I could have an A grade.  I'm not an accounting major but he did make the course interesting. He seems intimidating  since he is a very serious teacher and wants you to learn but he is a really nice guy.  He will answer all your questions and help you during office hours. Recommend.

I took him for ACC 201 and I did not find his course to be that difficult.  Just keep with the homework and study his lecture notes and you will do well.  I would take him again and he was very helpful when I had questions.

Prof Smigla is one of those professors that students absolutely love or hate. I am one of the latter. He is TOUGH, but fair. If you read, do your homework, and take time to actually study, you will do well. Talk to him in his office hours. Learn from your mistakes, the material builds on itself. You may not get an A, but you'll LEARN all you need.

Smigla is a very very mean man. If you have the chance to take someone else, DO IT.  He is very rude to his students and constantly belittles them.  I took this class in Fall 2015 and after the first exam, half the class dropped, and eventually, before I left, there were a max of 10 students in his class.  Do not take him.

By no means an easy class. Its not impossible to get an A, but expect to work really hard for it.  Must do the hw assigned for every class. Can come across as mean because he's intimidating, especially in lecture, but is super nice during office hours. Best professor for accounting majors, as you'll learn the most, not so much for non-majors.

Do the homework and take notes in class and you will be fine. Logic is key to passing the exams and class, don't memorize, just understand why things happen the way they do. you will have homework after every class, get to it asap and it makes it much easier.
ACC 302 is a breeze since I had him for ACC 301.  Definitely recommend and he is an awesome teacher.
Smigs is a really good professor and I learned  a lot during his 4 week summer class.  Just dont get behind, I was not an accounting major and liked his class.
Not helpful during office hours. Goes over homework with you. Has homework due every class and calls on you for answers. Pretty straightforward and knowledgeable

I did not find Smigla to be as difficult as some students say.  Don't miss class since you will really fall behind and keep up with the homework.  Listen to him when preparing for exams and do your homework.  I did learn more in his class than any other class at UK so far.  Excellent Prof!

I have never had trouble with terrible professors until I had this professor. He will not go out of his way to help anyone, he teaches directly by the book and homework's. Terrible at answering questions regarding the homework. I stuck through the class until the end and I can say over 60% of the class did not pass and he doesn't care.

I took intermediate over with him and I wish I would have had him the first time.  Just do as he tells you and he does explain everything well and is very thorough covering the homework.  I know I am better prepared for 302 even though I earned just a B grade.
I learned more than any other class and he is an excellent professor.  Be prepared to work for your grade in this class!

Explains very well, and is very helpful with questions.  Assigns homework every day, but it's short and it really helps you understand the material.  Doesn't give any points back.  I was 0.1% from an A, and he would not round me up, so I got a B.  But he will make sure you know the material and remember it for a long time.

Smigla is a great professor. He may come across as intimidating but he really wants his students to succeed.   Not an Easy class by any means. It's the hardest class i've taken in college and i was shy 6 points from an A but the knowledge gained was well worth it. If you're an Accounting Major, you can't go wrong with Smigla. be ready to work hard

I just finished this class and can say I really enjoyed it. If you are an accounting major take it with Smigla. It is a hard class but if you do the work and ask him questions in and outside of class he is always willing to help. He will teach you a lot of stuff and prepare you for future courses. Also, he is a great advisor for accounting majors.

DO NOT TAKE SMIGA IF YOU ARE NOT AN ACCOUNTING MAJOR. I spent at least 2 hours every night on the homework and barely passed his class. The work you will have to do is not worth the grade you will get. He also has a 4 hour, 100 question comprehensive final, in which a majority of the questions are workout problems. DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS, TRUST ME.

Excellent class! The material is tricky and he is tough, but if you put in the work, you will do well and have a solid foundation in accounting. As an accounting major, I am very happy I had him and feel as though I am well prepared for my future accounting courses.
Great class and I found it to be be very interesting compared to most other  courses.  I definitely recommend him especially if you are an accounting major.

I had him in the evening MBA program I think he is the best professor I ever had. Some say he is really difficult and I did not think the financial section he taught was that difficult.  He is not easy but as long as you do the homework you will do fine.
Smigla is tough but really knows his stuff.  He actually teaches you an explains the reasoning behind all the rules and requirements.  If you are serious take him, if not then find someone easier.

His teaching style was awful. Will not tell you why you got a hw problem wrong. Only reason to attend class was bc attendance is required. More than 70% of my class got less than a C in the 1st exam. He made me reconsider my major. If you have a choice take Jane wells or Cynthia miller for 301. Avoid him at all cost or you will regret it!!!

I have never been more disappointed in a class in my entire life. How this professor can teach this class like it is a masters level class and then when you take his first exam and out of 44 students 1 gets an A, 6 a B, 8 a C, 14 a D and 15 a 59 or below. His response to this is this the worst class he has ever taught. I would never EVER recommend!
Smigla is awesome. Really knows his stuff. Exams are somewhat difficult but he tells you what to study. Definitely recommend!
I worked my butt off and only earned a B gade. Excellent teacher but exams are difficult.

Words cannot begin to describe how much I hated this class. The material was interesting, but the exams were insane. Over half of my class failed and he refused to curve the grade. The exams together are worth almost 4/5 of your grade. I would avoid him at all costs.

I don't know what to think about Smigla actually.  I had started taking 201 with Miller and that was horrible and I took a W. Then I tried it online but couldn't teach myself.  Now I may have to retake it again.  He is knowledge and very demanding.  You have to go to class!!! I learned more from him than in previous accounting experiences.

I had intermediate 1 with Prof Smigla almost 2 years ago and he was tough but  excellent. The best I had at UK! I selected him as my adviser and he was great.  He advised me with preparing for the GMAT, getting an internship and getting into the MSACC program. Nice guy and he will really help you out.

I really hated this class. He seems like a nice guy, but his tests are really difficult and for no reason. This should be an Intro to ACC class but he makes it very hard. I studied for days and still barely passed. I would not take him ever again.
