Although Smigla is a nice guy and very informative, he is too demanding and test are difficult. I am a non accounting major and it was hell. The final exam was worth double the normal exams . I barely passed with a C. However, if you talk to him during office hours and come to class, it helps. But I don't recommend him for non-accounting majors

He is very hard and you must keep up with the work and go to class.  I realized halfway through the semester that I had not put enough work in during the beginning so I am retaking the course but he is a good teacher is you try and work hard...very hard, the workload is terrible though

I worked my butt off and only earned a B in Smigla's class. This prof is not easy so be prepared to do a lot of homework if you decide to take him. He is an excellent teacher and does explain things well, however, he is very demanding. In my other classes I earned A grades and spent less than half the time.
I took Prof Smigla for intermediate accounting 1 and I wish I would have had him for my earlier accounting classes.  He is excellent and I highly recommend him
Awesome teacher. He was very nice and would take the time to help you with any questions. I wish more profs were like him and I highly recommend Smigla.

Prof Smigla was my professor almost 10 years ago.  His class was very challenging, but very fair.  I learned alot in his class, and as a result am using the skills i learned in his class as a launching pad for a successful career in accounting.  I highly recommend, for those serious about accounting, signing up for his course.
I wish I would have taken Professor Smigla for intermedate 1 the first time.  He is a great teacher and I strongly recommend him over the other guy.
He is a superb professor and make sure you keep up with the homework. Work extra hard for him because he decides if you get into the MSACC program.

I took Smigla for Financial Accounting and he has made the course interesting enough that I now plan to major in accounting.  He is not easy but just do your homework and go to class, and you will do well.

Smigla is an excellent professor.  I am a non traditional student and came back last year after 8 years off to take ACC 202.  Now have him for ACC 301 this semester.  He is very fair and helpful.  Just show up, do your homework, listen to Smigla and you will do fine if you have half a brain.
Great teacher. Extremely helpful and knowledgeable. Be prepared to work hard and do homework. If you come to class and participate you will learn the material and make a good grade.

I am not an accounting major and asked around before I took Professor Smigla.  A few said he was terrible but good students like him and said he was excellent. He is an excellent teacher but be prepared to work more in his course than most other courses.

I took another professor last semester for managerial accounting  and withdrew because he was terrible.  Accounting is not my major but Smigla makes it understandable and interesting.  He actually teaches you!!!  He is not easy but you will learn and just keep up with the homework and be prepared to work hard.

I have Professor Smigla now for Managerial Accounting and I had him last semester for Financial Accounting. I also plan on taking him for  Intermediate Accounting in the fall.  If you are an accounting major, definitely take him since you will learn a lot.  He is the best teacher I ever had and he gives you great notes and covers all the homework t
great prof overall and good class if you go

This the toughest professor I ever had but also the best. If you do not want to learn then do not take him but if you want to, definitely take him.  Now I know why he was voted MBA teacher of the year in 2009.

He is HORRIBLE! If you want to have a teacher that is extremely arrogant and can not teach at all then by all means take him! He acts like everything he teaches is common sense that you should know it already. Our class went from 150 people in the begining to about 30 in the end!(most of the 30 failed!) NEVER TAKE HIM!Worst teacher I have ever had!

One of the worst profs I've every had! John is in charge of the graduate accounting program and is not going anywhere anytime soon. Dodge his class at all costs! He is not only a very difficult prof, but believes accounting is all common sense and doesn't explain concepts.

Dr. McDonald is a very sweet person, but her lectures aren't very engaging and the class feels unorganized. There's hardly any grades besides exams, which are online, but makes it hard to come back from if you don't do well on one. She definitely knows anthropology very well, I just don't find much interest in it personally, which isn't her fault

I've taken 4 classes with Dr. McDonald and she is truly amazing. She is the reason I switched my major to Anthropology. Her experience is so valuable and is always willing to help you out. From reviewing research, presentations or networking, she is so reliable. 525 was one of the best classes I've taken at UK in undergrad.

Overall very easy class, weekly assignments laid out very well in Canvas and easy to navigate. Weekly in-person discussion section (if you select that) attendance mandatory but I found them to be helpful.
Both professor McDonald and my TA Stephen Fox, are as good as it gets. It's a straightforward class. Do the work & you'll do great.

This class was fully online and we just zoomed for recitation once a week. There's just weekly reading questions that aren't due until the day of the next exam and a few big assignments that are easy and I got 100's on everything. She's really nice from the few interactions I had with her and it's an easy core class and you learn valuable things.

The class wasn’t awful but it’s not set up very well. You’re expected to read the syllabus and be responsible for any due dates, even if they aren’t mentioned. It’s a fine class to fill a requirement but I wouldn’t take it for fun.

this class was an absolute mess but my classes in middle school were probably harder than this class. Super easy, was even easier due to the coronavirus causing our tests to be open book online. Also, if you search the book title on google with "pdf" on the end, there's a free pdf. Only issue is the organization of this class, but you'll get an A

This class was really easy. Make sure you go to class because thats where the most of your grade comes from. You're only required to attend half of the classes though. definitely take this to fill your uk core. McDonald is very caring and understands the struggles of being in college. She is willing to work with you on some things.

This class was a very easy A . Very minimal work outside of class and you only go about once a month . Attend your discussion sections once a week but that's about it . The class is disorganized and in the beginning of the year, I thought I was missing something. I wasn't . If you study a little for the tests and do the RQs you'll pass for sure .

Dr. Mcdonalds study guides are absolutely useless. They make barely any sense at all it is just a bunch of words piled together. The class is unorganized when you meet in person and the recitation/discussion is pointless as well. also, tests are 600 points between THREE of them. Absolutely ridiculous
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class is definitely an easy A as long as you study for the exams. The exams are very easy but you need to study for them because they are the majority of the grade. It is mostly common sense but if you review for it you will get an A. Professor McDonald is hilarious and very easy to work with.

Dr. McDonald was very unorganized. She frequently worked outside the syllabus, and her expectations for the course shifted throughout the semester. While her class was not difficult, it became a major annoyance as the semester went on. I would recommend seeking out another instructor if possible.

If you're looking for an easy A, then this class is for you. If you go to lecture and pay some sort of attention, you'll pass. In the recitation for this class, the TA would basically give the answers to the homework, and we got out early every time. Generally an easy class, I would recommend to anyone.

She was very unorganized and took forever to post grades on canvas. She let in too many kids off the wait list because they could not keep the promises she made a lot of the time. With that being said, she loves her subject. I am a fiance major and I took away things from her lecture. Also she lets class out early by at least 20min each lecture.
The class is easy if you read and show up, lectures are interestng and information from Dr. McDonald's experience that she ties in really helps add to the topics.

Dr. McDonald is a very nice professor and will help you out if you go to her.  The exams aren't too hard but I probably learned more in recitation than I did in lecture.  You really have to pay attention in lecture because she won't post any Echo360 recordings or lecture slides online.  She has pop quizzes in the lecture for participation points.

Her lectures can be a little boring, but as long as you read the assigned books and take notes during class, it's a very easy class to pass. Attendance to lecture isn't mandatory, but you'll want to go to avoid last minute cramming before exams.

Dr. McDonald is a great teacher. She tries her hardest to be friendly with her students during lecture. Her power points are to the point and have the material you will need once she gives out the study guide. Going to discussion sections is a must! Participation is everything, most likely if you do the assignments, you will get full credit.

Dr. McDonald is a great teacher! She is a pretty easy grader as long as you show up for class and try your best, but she does expect you to read the text and you won't be able to pass if you don't. She really loves what she does and it shows in her lectures.

You do have to read 2 books and some other articles. They're not that bad though. Go to class and take notes (they don't have to be in depth, just the general idea). Gives a study guide and it's very clear cut with everything you need to know, you just have to put in some information about it from the notes. Pretty easy class.

She loves what she does! I had a terrible TA who would never email me back but Dr. McDonald handled it so fast. She really does care about her student. It's a core class so its pretty easy. Just do the work and you'll get an A.

This is a Professor who understands students and sides with them. I struggled through my last semester of school due to a lot of different circumstances. She went the extra 15 miles to make sure I understood the topic instead of just learning it to pass a class, and actually created an interest that will shape my life. She is an AMAZING PROFESSOR

The Lumbee from Robeson County North Carolina. If the class was entirely based off that first sentence, then she would teach it much better. You have to do a whole lot of reading for this course, and the text book is very expensive. ($80-$90) This class was interesting, but I would have enjoyed something a little less difficult for a UK Core class.

She is a passionate prof. who strives 2 do her very best & is approachable+really understanding.Class grading is mostly determined on the TA's & Rec. is mandatory.A 10pg paper,class Exc's and 2 mult. choice exams was the work+ExtraC.Lecture slides r organized & simple 2 write.Study guides provided ahead of time made material easy.Will lrn smthng :)

I did not like this class. The material wasn't bad, but I got tired of the prof's sarcasm, ranting, and treating us like we're dumb. If you want us to act like adults, don't treat us like children. I would not take another class of hers. On a positive note, the exams were really easy and I liked the TA.

This course depended on a lot of things. First of all, it depends on if you like the subject. Secondly, it depends on if you're willing to go to lecture AND recitation. If you miss either, this course isn't easy. If you go to both, it's a cakewalk.

She is an awesome professor! I had no idea what anthropology was prior to this class. She makes lectures interesting! You WILL get a bad grade in this class if you do not attend. Tests are easy, with two obviously wrong answers. I am now majoring in anthropology because of this class, Dr. McDonald, and my awesome TA Matt Krebs!

Watch food inc., a marshal film about dobe and look up the ant wiki page. Boom you've finished ant 160. Minus all the poppycock nonsense. If you believe things like Bob Marley's a prophet, we have no idea what causes aging  and taking over the world is as easy as shutting down kroger, then this class is perfect for you and you for it.

This class is a joke. Exams, you can eliminate 2 of the 4 choices because they're sarcastic answers. Always spouts something about it being a "points" system, where you still have to get 90% of the points and know what percent of your grade each thing is. Also loves to talk about how much she used to drink. I'd summarize my experience as: Whatever.
Very organized course. Points based system rather than percentage. She's a good instructor but doesn't give our idea of a multiple choice test. You WILL have to work hard for an A
If you aren't into anthropology, don't take this. I have a 3.65 GPA through 2 years and got a B in this class. Was just horrible. Avoid if you can. Not an "Easy A"

Overall material is easy. She likes to relate everything back to herself which can be kind of annoying. You have to go to lecture to get notes and discussion is mandatory for hw/quizzes. There is a research paper and she gives study guides for tests so it's easier to study. I didn't dread going though & I would recommend the class

Wonderful Teacher. Engaging Class. You really have to pay attention and go to lecture but if you do then the tests are a breeze. She is without a doubt passionate and interested in her field and is super helpful if you go talk to her. Really cares about her students.

DO NOT take this class if you have McDonald. Do not put yourself through the trouble. She rambles in class and it is impossible to listen to her talk because she is so boring. She talks about things that are completely irrelevant to what is on the exams. TA's grade way too hard. Would not recommend this class to anyone.

Dr Mcdonald was very nice and willing to help. However, she was never prepared and changed things all the time. Also, her lecture topics were random and her tests were hard to study for bc her lectures were so all over the place. Overall, easy but was annoying when it came to deciding what to study for. The TAs were the most helpful.
Excellent instructor! If you follow the readings and review notes, exams are very easy and straight forward. The research paper is an easy A if you take the time to do each step they give you!
Treats the class as upper level. material is easy, but the way its formatted, makes it difficult.

The professor was awesome. Her lectures werent always the most interesting but it was easy to listen to. The recitations/TA's I wasnt to thrilled about. Thats  when the work became pointless and hard, and attendance was neccessary.

I took this class online over the summer. Easy as pie. Finished with an A. She's really nice and approachable. 4 exams. 20 quizzes. 5 mini essays. The class itself was pretty interesting. Take her if you can!
The class was pretty boring to me. I could hardly stay awake in there. The prof does tend to digress from the topic at times. It was not really my favorite subject.

By far my favorite professor at UK so far. She really enjoys what she does and wants you to succeed but you have to put forth some effort. Read what is assigned, come to lecture and discussion, and do the class exercises and you'll make an easy A. Oh yeah, and get started on your research paper well ahead of time like she says to!

She is a little weird, and rambles all of the time (blurts out the most random comments). However, She loves what she does and is very helpful. If you go to lecture, take notes, go to recitation, read the books, and complete all of the assignments then an A is likely. I liked the class overrall and suggest it.

Dr. McDonald was awesome! She really does care about her students, especially the ones who show that they care about the class. The lectures can be hard to follow sometimes, though the tests are pretty easy. Reading the books, going to class & recitation is important. There's also a 10 pg paper, turned in in steps, but it was surprisingly tame

Lectures were a little boring but you can tell that she has a passion for helping students to succeed. She's very approachable and willing to help you with anything. your grade literally effects how much you did the work. if you take notes, go to recitation, and read the books you'll pass.

Couldn't stand this class. Her lecture is just her standing up and rambling. She makes no sense, and her tests are worded very weird. Wouldn't recommend this class to anyone. The only thing I learned in this class, I learned from my TA. This class is the only B I received this semester.

She is really nice but he class is not an easy A.  If you don't want to actually learn about other cultures DO NOT take this course.  There is a 10pg paper and exams along with quizzes and homework once a week.  The books are a must read, that is what half of the tests are over.

Definitely recommend this professor. She keeps the material short and to the point. She is geniunely interested in seeing all of her students succeed. She seems like the type of teacher that would do anything for her students. Class is fairly easy, even with a 10 page paper. Do the work and an A is definitely attainable.

Highly reccomend this teacher! Lectures quick, not mand, and are let out early often. The hardest part of this class is a long paper but she guides you through it so it was not bad at all. Tests were exactly what was on the study guide. Students who took her class before said that her tests were worded weird but I definitely think she changed them

Really nice professor. Wants to help in any way to make students do well. She likes what she does, unike other professors who seem miserable with their work. She is very busy but still very committed to her job and to her students. Overall great class thanks to her attitude! Everyone should take at least one ANT class in college! I recommend her.

One of the best grades I've had in college. Partly matters which TA you get, as they grade your paper, quizzes, and hw. 10 pg paper isn't fun, but other than that the class isn't bad. Do most of the reading, stay awake in class and its an easy A. And, McD was interesting, enjoyed the subject matter pretty well.

My favorite teacher on campus! This is the second class I have taken with her. It was a class about religion so at times people disagreed but she always encourged open discussion. She is very approachable outside of class, if you ever have any troubel she is more than willing to help you out. She is awesome!

Joke of a class, she cancels class the week Keeneland is in session. Grading is completely done by TAs so you can get lucky and have an incredibly easy grader, or have someone who takes being an Anthropology TA way too seriously.

An absolute waste of my time. Although the class was easy, the grading was done by all TAs, which ended in me receiving a B and all my friends getting As. Class made me want to shoot myself in the foot, anthropology is not a real field of study, please get over yourself
She truly was an awesome teacher, she gets you inspired to make a change in the world. Very helpful, took her online class over the summer and provided very interesting lecture PowerPoints.
She truly was an awesome teacher, she gets you inspired to make a change in the world. Very helpful, took her online class over the summer and provided very interesting lecture PowerPoints.

Great teacher! she got me more interested in Africa than i ever thought I could be. You can tell she really loves what she does, and it shows through her teaching. read all of the books prescribed they ARE  on the tests.

She is wonderful! The class was very interesting. Everything that is in place is to assure the students understand what is being taught. There was a 10-page research paper, but it wasn't very difficult and graded easily. Tests are not difficult at all. She is always willing to help with anything, even if it doesn't involve her class.

10 page paper is 100% useless, helps you learn nothing about the class. Tests could be easy but worded so oddly that it is difficult to understand what is being asked. Requires more work than you would think, definitely not an easy class.

An alright class. Not too much in terms of workload, except for the major 10 page paper. I learned a lot from this class in terms of global problems. McDonald seems very nice, but tends to treat her class like children, which has its ups and downs. I had a great TA, and a lot of my assignments were graded generously. Not a bad class.

McDonald herself is a wonderful woman. However, I got stuck with the TA from heck. She has no part in the grading, so if you do get a crappy TA- sucks for you because there's no chance for extra credit in this class. The books in this class are mildly interesting. The ten page paper in this class is stupid. I will leave the class learning nothing.

She is SO nice! Her teaching style is different and her notes are vague but they are on the test so you need them. Her tests are multiple choice and EASY if you study your notes and reading questions briefly.  You learn more from the TA honestly though and you have to attend every lab. Her papers are weird and annoying to write.

The 10 page paper assigned for this class is absurd and does nothing for helping you understand the material in the class. The TA for this class have an obvious dislike for her teaching style and what she expects of them. Honestly I learned more about the Bali and San people from my TA.

This was the worst class I have taken so far at the university of Kentucky. One she gave us a test on the Monday we came back from spring break.  The class is extremely boring and the books that we have to read for the class are dull. The test weren't too hard but the way she writes questions makes it hard to understand what she is actually asking.

Great teacher. The class was interesting. She is very to the point with grading. If you come to class, read, and do the HW you can get an A or a B in the class. Tests are not that difficult expect for about 5 questions that are the difference between an A and a B. She will tell you that. Some questions are even funny.

She is very nice. She really cares about her students...but the class was incredibly boring. She is kind of a crappy lecturer. She uses power points that are ridiculously hard to follow. For an entire topic she'll use 1 word in her powerpoint for it, then going back to study later, your notes have a bunch of random words. It sucks. Tests are HARD!!
Anthropology was really boring to me. She made it sound as if the class was super easy if you read and take notes, but that is not completely true. Her tests are hard.
This is my third class with her, and I like her more each class I take.  Very knowledgable about subject matter.  One of the best professors I've had, and definitely my favorite!
Excellent
Not the best lecturer in the world.  I was regularly, painfully bored every time I attended class.

Great teacher, pretty interesting classes although I missed quite a few. The tests can be tough so make sure you read the books and do the study questions. The recitation is a total joke but they take attendance so you have to go
Really good Professor. She is interesting, and really loves her subject. Her tests, however, can be difficult.
Attendance isn't mandatory, but she wants you to come.  Class is pretty interesting, and Dr. McDonald is awesome!

great professor you will learn so much she wants all her students to succeed and will go the extra mile with you to see that you reach the goal you have set, the university desperately needs professors like her, she promotes learning and you will learn
Enjoyable classes.

Make sure you have a good recitation teacher. Not a hard class don't have to attend all the lectures if you can get the notes from a friend. Make sure you read the books and stay for the videos and you will get an easy A

Dr. McDonald is one of the best professors you could ever have.  She really knows what she's talking about and makes learning fun, even if the topic is something you wouldn't normally be interested in.

I really thought this class was interesting! She is a good teacher and her tests are very fair. Make sure you read the books required for recitation, though. They aren't too bad to read and you'll need the info in them for quizzes and tests. Good choice for a proffessor!
I learned a lot from Dr. McDonald. If you go to class and have trouble, she's easily approachable.
Okay teacher. She is very into the subject and knows a lot. The class tends to be a little boring, but she helps you out a bit.

I have no idea why I had some difficulty with this class, I guess I was over-thinking.  The wording of her exam questions are kind of vague and it always seems like with the options for answers two could be right or none at all.  Drove me nuts.  She really is a nice professor and loves what she teaches, I would recommend her.
Easy A if you attend lectures and labs.  Extremely boring. Learned more from TA Allison. READ all novels. Busy work every class. I failed one test and still got a B.
This class is an easy A if you just go the the lectures and the discussion sections. Sometimes McDonald is a little boring and there is a lot of busy work, but overall the class is not bad.
Great attitude and understanding when it comes to students. Easy to work with and genuinely kind.

Really nice and approchable. It's an easy class,kind of boring. You read 3 books that are all pretty easy. I learned some interesting things in there, and never had to worry about my grade so that was nice.
Very entusiastic and has first hand knowledge of much of the material. Easy A if you go to class and recitation.
Nice teacher, reads right from the powerpoint, class is pretty easy.
She is a great teacher, VERY easy A if you dont mind going to class and reading.  I really liked her attitude, take her!
horrible horrible professor but super easy.  she just rambles about morocco andd keeneland a lot... you will want to blow your brains, but it is an easy A, so..

Very easy course if you keep up with material. Textbooks are semi-interesting and class consists of powerpoints and videos.  Okay as a prof- can be a bit crazy, but overall okay and helpful.  Easy A if you keep up!

Horrendously easy.  Too easy.  This should not be worth college credit, but I guess it's an alright intro-level class for freshmen.  Lectures are an awful combination of student apathy, babying on her part, and ridiculously low expectations.  Tests are multiple choice--an elementary schooler could get A's on them.

Took this as elective. McDonald sometimes makes me sleepy but knows her stuff, has done research, helps you if you need it and enjoys discussion in class. Lecture not slide-based, gives list of terms for each chapter, some short-answer on test, 8-10page research paper or project at end of semester.  Few assignments if any otherwise. Nice teacher.
awful...boring..outdated
awful.  do not take.
this LECTURER cannot teach.  material is not boring but is presented in a boring manner

BORING class with outdated materials.  Opinionated lecuturer.   EASY class.  Makes unsupported arguments.  Friend got grade changed through discussion.  Unfortunatley boring as I'll get out. Does not challenge students.  Avoids sensitive topics.

First class I ever fell asleep in. Some of the videos are boring, as well as the lectures. However, I did enjoy the reading. Discussion was incredibly boring but you have to go. Tests can be tricky... study pretty good. I probably got an A. DO THE READING!!!!

Easy class, but boring material.  She is a nice woman and she lays the material out for you nicely.  Just follow her study guides and you will be alright.  She is fair and the lab grade will boost your final grade.  I recommend it for an easy A or B.
Intro to ANT...good class.  Tests are mult choice and follow outline.  A few movies and some interesting lectures about her travels. Definitely recomend!

Dont take the class with the TA sesion on friday at 8 in the morning, I took this class cuz people on here said it was easy, but I got a C. Yes the tests and material are easy, but class is boring as hell, crowded, and thus hard to attend. Also if your friday class is at 8 in the morning, and you cant get up eraly, dont bother taking this class.
Very easy, tests were mainly multiple choice and usually was very close to the study guide.
She's a decent teacher.  The only bad thing is her test questions are worded different and confuse you.  But overall an easy B if you read the books and go to class.

Dr. McDonald is a very easy going person. This class is very easy!! The required text is pretty interesting except the 3rd book. The discussion group is necessary to attend and if you need a GPA booster this class is for you. EASY A!!!!
likes to talk TOO much and will go on and on (even during the tests)...it's an easy class though!

If you take this class, ANT 160, Youl read 3 short books about different african tribes, write 2 papers. There are 3 tests which she tells you everything that you need to know on a study guide. Tests are easy as long as you read the books wich i found enjoyable actually. Easy A Interesting material.

My favorite college class.  Information gained has been useful throughout school as well as life.  Would take class again in an instant.  Very nice woman, very clear, and very happy to teach her subject.

Dr. Sena's class is very discussion based so you have to do the readings before class. He's very kind and encourages everyone to talk. His participation rules are strict, and if you miss more than 2 classes, you get half a grade taken off, however he offers opportunities to make it up and is lenient about what is considered an excused absence.

Dr. Sena is very caring and loves his students. The only issue I had with the class is that if you miss more than 2 times, he takes off half a letter grade penalty for each class missed. I would take another class with him as my professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Sena is super easy to talk to and is very kind. The conversations can be a little repetitive but it won't affect you to much to not talk extremely often. As long as you pay attention you will receive good grades.
Super nice teacher and understanding. Honestly not a hard class at all if you do the work- which is just simple readings before class. He also offers extra credit and is an easy grader.

Dr. Sena is truly kind and cares about his students. His classroom discussion is always invigorating and you can tell he truly cares. I would love to have Dr.Sena again in the future. He is the sweetest!

Dr. Sena is a wonderful professor. He cares about his students and pushes them to learn and grow. You get out of his class what you get into it, and he is always open to discussions and creative approaches. I am so glad I had him for Hon 140!

I liked Dr. Sena a lot! Our class discussions were always super fun. He is a super caring professor who cares about your mental state and is very lenient on due dates AS LONG AS you contact him with your reasons for late work. I regret not attending more of his classes. He is very interesting and accepting of all beliefs. Take Dr. Sena!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: This man is the only reason I survived 4 years of the Honors College. Big ups
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I think if you're in a position where you just need a natural science credit, I would not take this class. There is a required field trip where you have to drive out to Eastern KY with your own vehicle and gas. Dr Sena is a very nice prof and if you're interested in ecology take it, if not dont. alot for a 100 level that is unrelated to my major
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Sena!!! His workload is very light... a 15-minute reading every night, 2-3 sentences about it, and then a monthly project (which is an easy 100%). If you do the work, you will get a 100%, he grades very generously!!! All around a great professor. Incredible at guiding discussions and asking questions that'll make you think.

I took the Appalachia class, and it's really not worth it unless you're ecstatic for the topic. There are 15-30 page readings every night with a 1-2 paragraph reading response attached. These are worth only 4 points, but if you get a 3 it's a 75% and can drop your grade fast. There is also a 6-7 page research paper due at the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Sena is a nice person but I don't recommend taking him as your professor for HON 140. The work load for the class is ridiculous considering it is a seminar based class. You can't miss a class without it affecting your grade. The workload compared to other honors professors is so much more. You would have a better time with another professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The reviews on here are misleading. I regret taking Sena. There are annoying assignments due before every single class. He expects so much compared to the other professors you could take for this course. He fails to mention major assignments in fair amounts of time before they are due. He expects you to be discussion-ready every single class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Really down to earth, nice professor who knows how to start a good and interesting discussion with the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Sena is super down to earth and really nice. We had to read and do a reading response almost every class but as long as you do it, you get credit. There were a few papers and projects but Dr. Sena is a pretty easy grader as long as you show effort. He provided opportunities to bond as a class which I really enjoyed and brought his kids!

I took this class even though I only had 10 mins to make an 18 min walk to the honors building from my last class- because he was so highly recommended! worth it! I have thoroughly enjoyed Sena and the class in general. Heavily discussion based, which creates great conversation. He is understanding and very funny. A really kind, invested professor.

Sena is literally a gem. He's super fun to learn from and likes to get to know his students really well, so I felt more comfortable in his class. This course requires reading scholarly articles almost every day, so be prepared for that. As someone who wasn't interested in ecology before, this course taught me so much about it which I'm happy about!

We had readings for each class however they were generally very easy and are a good cushion grade. Classes are discussion based and if you're trying you're going to do good. . This class has a service and research field trip, both which are very fun and educational. Sena is so funny and so caring. He is without a doubt the best prof in honors
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Sena is the best professor I have ever had. I took his Restoration Ecology in the Commonwealth class, and it was life changing. I came into this course with very little knowledge on restoration ecology and Science in general, and I am leaving with a deep understanding and passion for both. Sena is so caring, brilliant and happy to help!
Very genuine, down to earth, cares about his classes. Also very intelligent!
Sena is a total bro. Assignments arent too hard and if you do the work he gives you good grades. He talks a lot but his lectures are worth it. I really really enjoyed having him as a professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Sena was a great professor who truly cared about each one of his students. He made in-class discussions very interesting.

Dr. Sena is honestly the most amazing professor I have had so far during my college experience. He is incredibly helpful and encouraging. I feel like I could ask him for advice or help on anything and he would be more than willing to jump right in. He is the kind of professor that wants you to succeed and will help you do it.
Dr. Sena is a great guy. He is very intelligent and cares about your success. If you do your work and ask for help when you need it, you will get an A. He sets you up for success.

Dr. Sena in genuinely interested in engaging students in academic conversations. There was lot of reading involved in the class but it was mostly discussion based with a few assignments thrown in. The assignments were easy to complete and he was very flexible with scheduling. The last two big assignments of the semester are graded harder.

Dr. Sena is a great professor and an amazing person. HON 101 is a very pointless and unnecessary course, however, Dr. Sena makes it a bit more bearable with his interesting discussions and sense of humor. He truly cares about every single one of his students, though he does grade papers a little stricter than the other professors.
She was amazing!

Dr. Wright is such a passionate professor and genuinely wants to see her students succeed. She is smart and she will make sure that you have everything you need to be the best version of yourself while at UK. I often utilized her office hours to have someone to talk to. She remembered things about me and made personal connections.

She is a great professor AFE 100 is just a dumb class. She's very understanding and will always give you an extension if you really need it. Your grade in this class is solely based on if you show up to class.

The course is not difficult if you show up to every class and know how to write a paper. The course is mostly discussion based so prepare to share your opinions on the topics. Dr. Wright is incredibly smart, understanding, and accommodating.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Wright is very nice and her class is easy to pass if you attend and participate. There are a lot of essays, but they are not hard and she gives very good feedback. Definitely one of my favorite professors I have had thus far.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I wouldn't blame her for how much I struggled. This class is obviously structured strangely and she herself is having trouble trying to make it all consumable for students. I can tell she genuinely cares for her students as people. She did a lot for me when I was struggling with personal issues.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Wright is the sweetest human being, very approachable and understanding. I would say it's impossible to not succeed in her class unless you explicitly don't do the work at all. A lot of reflections/essays/writing but not challenging, usually relating content to your personal life which is pretty easy to do. This class is an easy A.

I got an A in his class. It's extremely easy if you show up every day and complete assignments on time. Lectures were sometimes long/annoying so I did homework during. If you do the projects to the best of your ability, show up to class, and carry your weight in group projects, you will have at least a 85%.

Professor tends to gloss over important subjects which are stated to be tested later, to focus on irrelevant and non graded activities within class. Professor goes over time frequently within class and provides little to no help or care for struggling students. Lots of graded projects with little to no guidance or example  on how to complete it.

I had a great experience with Prof. Kearns. The lectures got tiresome, but that's my only complaint. Plenty of time for all projects, and he isn't a harsh grader. While attendance is strict, if you email him, he is extremely understanding and will excuse your absence!

I found his lectures very helpful and i did learn a lot. The class itself is very project based, but I feel that he sets the foundation for each project well. As long as you are willing to be creative and put in effort to the assignments, you will learn and do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This course isnt particularly difficult, and features 4 projects (2 group, 2 individual). The group projects can be difficult to coordinate. The lectures can drag, but he has passion for theatre. In the weeks a project was given (~every 3 weeks)I spent ~2 hours on the project total, and in the other weeks there wasnt homework. Lenient w/ extensions

Assigns an extensive amount of projects that are incredibly difficult to understand. It does not provide any examples of what the projects are supposed to look like in the end, so you just have to guess what he wants it to look like, even with the help of the rubric. If you don't know how to draw well I would not recommend this class.

I got an A in this class but it was extremely hard to do so. I am a stem major in this class for credit and this class ended up being harder than a few of my majors classes, which is extremely shocking. I also despised group projects where no one cared what grade they got and overall the projects made you pick up on others slack.

Jeremiah seemed cool and laidback during class, however he often wasn't clear on exactly what he wanted for our large projects, which caused issues for me. The course was fine and bearable, but I would not actively choose to take Jeremiah over other professors again.

The professor was caring and approachable. However, the attendance policy significantly affected my grade. Homework grades were reduced by 50% or more when class was missed, even when circumstances made attendance difficult. Given that the homework was lengthy and opinion-based, this policy felt disproportionate and impacted overall performance.

Dr. Sarge is one of the nicest professors ever. Very passionate, loves to engage his students, and is easy to talk to. There is a lot of homework in this class, especially for an honors class, but as long as you submit the assignments and contribute to discussions, this class is an easy A. A bit time consuming, but super interesting and fun!

Dr. Sarge cares a lot about his students and it is important to him that people participate and come to class. If you don't go to class he will email and check on you, which is super kind. The homework can take a while, but overall, the class is pretty easy. Take the time to get to know Sarge and Park-Sarge, they're great people!

Dr. Sarge and Dr. Park-Sarge are amazing. They want you to do well and will give you all the feedback you need in homework assignments so you get the points next time. No tests, and super informational and accessible class as someone who isn't in STEM. Would take this class 100x over. The HW assignments are lengthy but a fair trade for no tests!

Dr. Sarge is very knowledgable and caring. He's a pretty lenient grader. The class was discussion heavy, and participation points are half of our grade. I'm not a STEM major, but I found this class interesting and insightful. We have discussion leaders for every class, and discussions became a bit tedious towards the end, but the class was fun.
Difficult class for no reason exams are impossible to do well in and the lectures are very boring and not engaging enough to pay attention to

Calvin University: He's clearly smart and passionate about geology, but his lectures are painfully boring and hard to learn from. The topics are broad while the exams are extremely specific, making the class frustrating. Honestly, the skewed grading scale is the only reason I'm passing. Don't recommend!!

Kent is all around a great guy. He is a genuine guy that is very educated and passionate about what he teaches. However , as someone who takes this class just to satisfy credit, I highly recommend you do not take this. This class is taught like a 300/400 level class. The tests are practically impossible with highly specific questions.

This professor is very passionate about his profession. He is very strict with grading and does nothing to give students any chance of improving their grades. On the other hand, as college students and adults, it is up to you to put in the effort. Show up, take thorough notes, and study. Do your best, and push through if you take this course.

Dr. R's class was difficult, but also one of my favorites this semester. Stick to the syllabus schedule, show up, take good notes, and stay proactive and you'll be fine. If you are a big procrastinator it will probably feel like a lot but it is manageable.

I was initially excited to take this course, but that was short lived. The lectures are long, boring and mandatory. Speaking of exams, there are a lot of them, all of which require lockdown browser. The minutiae of details you have to memorize for an entry level class is insane. DONT TAKE THIS CLASS!

I took this class thinking it would be an easy credit and its online, but was I wrong. I assume the professor is a great guy, but he makes this class a living hell. It fully online and he makes super long lecture videos and the tests are extremely hard. DO NOT TAKE IT BECAUSE YOU THINK IT WILL BE AN EASY CORE CREDIT

class was unnecessarily difficult, outside of the scope of an 100 level class. He told us exams would be based on "general understanding" but all things had to be memorized including dates etc. Overall, this class was frustrating and asked way more than the capabilities of a non geology major.

Just a slides reader, extremely boring lectures in my opinion. Hard to retain anything from the majority of his lectures, I only remembered about 3 of the lectures he gave us from the whole semester. Class is very hard, and has 6 exams.

Thought it would be a normal, easy gen ed class, I was so wrong. Takes this course so seriously, basically making it a 300/400 level course. So many details you need to know and so many homework's and quizzes. Worst teacher I have ever had throughout my schooling career.

Kent is overall, or at least seems to be, a solid dude. However his exams are incredibly tough. The exams are based on things that he says in lecture. Anything that he says can be on the exams. The powerpoints are very image heavy. Makes you wonder whether he wants you to grasp concepts or just wants to know people listen to him when he talks.

Dr. R is an insanely tough grader. His archaic style of grading severely wrecks your grade. No matter how often you go to class and participate, how well you do on homework or a quiz, if you fail an exam you fail the class. His exams are so difficult that I had to get help from my other geology professor and she knew the exams were hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mr. Ratajeski seems like a professor that is passionate and willing to help. However, between the lectures and the required videos, it is not unreasonable for a student to spend 1.5 hours watching the videos on some weeks. This doesn't include the weekly homework and studying for closed-note tests. I've taken other EES classes that were easier.
this course ruined my life.

This was by far the most difficult class ever taken. He uses computer/eye detecting software to monitor online exams. Lectures are extremely long and you have to remember countless concepts and terms for exams. Homework every week and is difficult. Kent himself seems like a good person and he is very passionate about geology but difficult class.

Thought this would be an easy class, I was wrong. Do not take this class if you don't have to, for exams he uses lockdown browser and the camera stays on during the exam. He does seem like a cool guy though.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He seems like he'd be a nice guy but he's not a good professor. He randomly takes attendance and targets students who aren't there by taking attendance on those days. This is a 100 level course and he treats it as so much more. I have taken 400 level courses that were not as difficult as this course. I've also taken other EES classes with no prob.

I really see this as a pointless class, that will take up large amounts of your time. The tests are completely memorization and there is a TON of material to memorize. Unless you're very passionate about rocks and minerals and considering this as an elective, AVOID THIS CLASS. If you're an engineer, you'll study for this the same as calc classes.

If you study very hard for at least for 5 hours everyday, you will still not be able to get a C grade. Seriously though, this class is probably the most difficult one in UKY. IDK about the Prof, since it was online class. If you get an a in his class, call me I will pay for your tuition.

Kent is one of the worst professors I have ever had. He, himself, not that bad probably a good person, and tries to be funny. But this class. SUCKS. Worst entry-level class ever, treats it like a graduate class. I wish there was any other possible professor but sadly there was not. Just try to do your best, you may not end with the grade you want.

He is a great person and can tell he truly loves geology and what he does, although this is an introduction class and I have studied more for this class than I have for all other engineering classes combined! His lectures are boring and very long, and you are required to memorize every detail about geological events, and minerals. Wouldnt recommnen
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very fun professor with difficult yet fair tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very challenging class. He doesn't care if you end up with a bad grade. For some weird reason, he expects you to memorize every single small detail related to class. I would say avoid him at all cost but there is no one else to take...
Man, this guys class was harder then STA 210! His lectures are so boring and he makes you remember so much for the exams. I am an A/B student but his class brought my GPA down.

His class isn't about how much you learn in his class its about your ability to memorize random facts about random geological occurrences throughout the world. Don't get me wrong he's super nice but I don't think he knows how to write a test that will accurately test knowledge rather then just memorizing everything he ever said.

There is a lot of information- but my best advice is start very strong. What you learn early will appear again in different ways and help. Many complain his tests are hard but they really are not- they TEST you. He is a very thoughtful nice guy and really cares about his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Ratajeski is nice, helpful, and is VERY passionate about Geology. But as a teacher I cant recommend him. His lectures are extremely long and frequent, and his quizzes/exams require that you watch them all the way through. To echo what others have said, he teaches intro Geo like youre planning on becoming a Geophysicist. Good guy, meh prof.

Don't take this class unless you absolutely have to. Tests are impossible and the lectures are so boring. He's a nice guy, I just don't think he understands that this is a 100 level introductory gen ed course and not an honors course for geology.

This is the most time consuming course for a class thats Gen Ed. The lectures stretch on from anywhere to 40-60 minutes. Some lecture are combined with 2 parts such as the Yellowstone NP lecture being a combined 96 minutes. The exams require lockdown browser, are filmed with audio, and all questions are small details from lectures. Very boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dont take this class. I needed it for UK core and thought itd be a pretty reasonable class since its ONLY A GEN ED but he makes the class as if its only for geology majors and an honors class. Tests are impossible and the lectures are YouTube videos that are around an hour long. Quizzes are over multiple lectures. I dont recommend !!!

Dr. R made an unfamiliar subject a blast and pleasure to learn. Geology is not always easy to understand; however, Dr. R is a strong lecturer and I would not have the appreciation I do for geology if it were not for him. Go to every class and take good notes. There's a lot of content in the class so don't get caught behind.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: "Online class about National Parks? Oh cool!" That's what I said at the beginning of this class. It is the hardest 100 level class I have ever seen. I cannot believe this guy makes you memorize so many tedious details. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!

"Okay, it's online, it won't be too difficult." I was VERY wrong. He REQUIRES the use of the Lockdown Browser and the Webcam. Genuinely the only way you can get an A in the class is if you cheat on the exam. Lectures are also very long and detailed. Basically expects you to memorize everything within 6 weeks (compressed). Impossible to get an A.

reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He started off very nice and understanding, but this changed fast. Easily one of the worst professors at UK! Its an elective class big guy, you aren't teaching anything important. If you want to study rocks I would recommend picking one up outside, you'll learn more from it than you ever will from this horrible teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class was the biggest waste of my time. Mr. Ratajeski is an awful professor who is not at all flexible when students need him to be. The online course EES 180 is an insane amount of work and honestly not worth it. I was also advised to purchase the textbook and I have not had the need for it once through the entire course. Waste of money.

I took this class to fill a gen-ed requirement and it is the worst class Ive ever taken with the worst professor Ive ever had. He does not care about students receiving good grades, he is condescending, lectures are dry, rubrics are nothing like how an assignment is actually graded. I only began passing exams when I found quickest online. AVOID.
Hardest thing is this class is just memorization everything else isnt too bad.

Kent is a really nice guy who is clearly passionate about what he teaches. It's a 100 level class but one of the hardest classes I've ever taken. You basically shave to memorize every detail from every lecture for the exams. If you don't do well your grade can't be fixed. He's nice but I wouldn't take him unless you're a literal geology major.

I don't think he's an awful professor at all. He's a good lecturer, but his tests are difficult. He rarely takes attendance, but everything he says in class is fair game for exams or quizzes and you should take that seriously. You do have to pay attention and work in this class to get a good grade, and people don't always like that
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I had Kent for an online 100-level earth science class and I am a non science major. He would post very dated and dry lectures that students would be expected to essentially memorize for the exams. The exams were unnecessarily difficult and specific. Do not take Kent because you're looking to knock out a requirement, there are better options.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Kent gives a lot of lectures and is very passionate about what he teaches. However, the test are very difficult and you have little error to mess up or your grade will suffer. You can obtain an A if you study hard for test, attend class (he does random attendance checks), and do well on most assignments. This class is not an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Because this was an online class, I didn't interact very much with Dr. Ratajeski. His online lectures were well structured and informational. He was excited to teach. His course was well organized, and he tries to communicate with you frequently. Tests and quizzes are very detail specific but not impossible. The field trip was enjoyable.

Tests are 15% of your grade and the final exam is 30% of your grade. The homework and quizzes are online but aren't that difficult. However, the exams are very hard to prepare for. Grading scale is 85-100 for an A. All classes are lectures and attendance is randomly taken on specific days that he decides to. Drops your lowest grade in each category

Kent was a very unfair professor. His grading scale was an 85-100 gets an A, and so forth, yet no one could get an A. This is an entry level geology course and he makes it impossible for his students to succeed. It is used as a weeding out course for engineering students, yet environmental science students are still required to take it?????????????
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is good at presenting the material, and it helps if you are already interested in geology, but his grading is incredibly harsh. in my experience, exams will be ugly even if you know the stuff. Also, he's less concerned about the students and more concerned about being in charge/control, so contesting a grade or late work is pointless!

Personally I think this class is better than the other courses he teaches. I have taking 4 classes with him. This class requires a lot of work, time, and effort. I suffered from some exams but I learned a lot from this class. If you like minerals then you would like this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I have had Kent for multiple courses and do not like the way he lectures or how he treats students. Avoid him at all costs but if you do have to take him(geology majors) make sure to visit his office hours and make yourself known. If you show that you are trying to do well in the class he is a little more helpful. Do not expect an A. Most get B/C
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: It is rare that I see a full class (about 25 students) unanimously dislike a professor to this extent. The class material itself isn't bad, but he presents it in a very ineffective way. His stubbornness and condescending attitude makes the class much more difficult than necessary, which is surprising since EES 180 is a new class. Avoid this guy.

I'm not understanding these bad reviews; Kent is a good professor. He tries to make the class laugh and teaches the content of the class very well. His exams are difficult, but it's nothing that a lot of studying can't handle. He even offers to go over your exam with you after the fact to see what you missed in his office hours. Hilarious prof.

"This class, is more difficult than my 300 & 400 level geology classes" -The people in my class who are actual geology majors.  Kent made this class unnecessarily difficult. You aIso will need to pay about $80, just to take your exam. I also agree about him being rude to students (previous review). He talks to you in a noticeably condescending way.

Kent has a really funny dry sense of humor, that not everyone gets.  If you are considering being a geology major, PLEASE keep going. Your first few classes are with Kent and if you don't put everything into studying for each exam it can be discouraging. Kent is a nit picky grader, even other geo profs have acknowledged that, and his busy work.

Hardest professor in the Geology Dept. Very rude over email but very nice in person. He makes you memorize extremely specific information and you have to pay to take exams. Interesting class, but very difficult.

Dr. Ratajeski is one of the best professors I've had. His sense of humor makes the class enjoyable. The content is heavy but logical If you're that kind of person. He makes the material easy to understand but you will work hard to do well on the exams. He uses great examples and models for teacher as well. Including watching stuff explode.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He's a very good guy
Hes cool
find another major if you want to stay at UK

never think about taking that class with him, you will hate geology because of him. You need at least six hours to finish HW, sometimes more than 10 hours. tuff grading, no help,,,, simply, everything works against you...

Dr. R is a much better professor than people make him out to be. He is very corny and attempts to make the class laugh. It's somewhat difficult to fall asleep in his lectures because he plays music and tries to keep you engaged.  You can tell he loves the subject he teaches. He doesn't give much work and you hardly have to go to class. Hard tests!

never think about taking that class with him, you will hate geology because of him. I am (f worked+ed) to get that B  homework need at least six hours to get done, sometimes more than 10 hours.  tuff grading, no help,,,,  simply, everything works against you...

He knows his stuff but tests are super hard even if you do know what you are talking about but if you fail a test it wont kill you as the labs are where a lot of the points are at so do well in lab its the easy part
KNOW EVERYTHING!!!!

It may be different on campus, but this online course was much more difficult than any 100-level I've taken. Lectures were longer than necessary and there were often additional videos. HW was busywork and exams cover a lot of information. Grade consisted of HW, quizzes, two exams, and one finalcumulative exam. Take if interested in material.
He's really approachable and super smart; take him if you need an easy A. But don't buy the textbook! I got an A in the class and never once opened it.
Tests are hard as heck.  Good teacher though!

I find it arrogantrude to tell a class "I'm not going to ask you this question, because you won't get itbe able to answer it." Note are downloadable, but not the complete set used in class. Sections of graphscharts are missing.  To me, the instructor seems defensive and will talk over you before you finish what you are saying.
He is the rudest professor I have ever had. He made you feel like an idiot.

Class was difficult. This was my first semester at a larger University though so that may have had an effect (Fall, 2011). Very large class and all material is presented on powerpoints. Kent knows his stuff but the exams are very hard. The lab was really cool though. I would find another professor if possible.

This class was super hard and A LOT of work. Do not take it especially if you have no interest in geology (like me) and know nothing about it prior to the class. The pop quizzes/tests are almost ridiculous and do not follow lecture very well. Also, the semester long project was hard. The grading scale is the only good thing.
Him is the reason why UK´s Geology department is ranked amongst the worst 5 schools in the U.S
Do not take this class if you are black or latino.

Very difficult teacher. He expects you to know about geology prior to taking this class. Often makes you feel poor about asking questions after class. Pop quizzes are given and are often very challenging. He is a knowledgable person but struggles to make class appropriate for new students. Overall, I do not recommend him as a teacher.
so rude
The worst professor I have ever taken, he is a sarcastic and impossible grader.

Not the worst class to take. Very possible to get a good grade. However he expects a lot. I felt like he expected people to be GLY majors and I am not. Not a big science guy but he kept it somewhat interesting. Tests are damn near impossible. HW is childish but everything else is alright. good luck

Grading scale s fair. But the tests.. I've found them to be really hard. If you can't memorize almost every word he says in class, your test grades will drop a lot. Labs are pretty easy but kinda boring. Wouldn't recommend the class, but Mining and Civil Engineers, you gotta have it.

He has extremely hard test. The class is easy if you go and just pay attention and do minimal studying. He is not a whole lot of help but is entertaining during lectures. He is strict but has a good grading scale and lets you drop an exam.

He is straight forward. All content from his slides are on his exams. Posts lecture slides on BB, read over those once are twice and you will do well on exams. Has pop quizzes in class, so go to class. I thought his class was fair and he kept lectures interesting with his sense of humor and videos/music etc. I recommend him.

Very good professor. I have taken 2 years of engineering and mathematics courses, and Dr. Ratajeski is easily one of the best professors I have had. The material itself is very easy, and he does a good job of teaching it.  Class gets boring sometimes, but his sense of humor makes class tolerable. I definitely recommend him.

Awesome teacher. Jokes are stale sometimes bu he makes it fun to come to lecture. He is easy to contact for office hours. Puts all of his notes on blackboard which are mandatory to read for tests. Tests can be challenging if you don't attend class. Drops your lowest test score outside of final.

His grading scale is C(65-75),B(75-85), A(85-100) and for good reason. His lectures are extremely boring and dry. He expects you to know entirely too much information in relation to what he actually teaches you. Worst class I've been in so far in college. If you are taking this class to get away from a BIO or Chem class, you're making a mistake.
Horrible painful class. Just because the tests are super hard, he makes them like that on purpose. Expects you to be a geology dictionary. Labs are horribly boring. Avoid if you can

Pretty cool teacher. He really knows his stuff and likes to interact with the class. Drops the lowest test grade and they aren't too awful hard if you study well. Posts the notes online and only gives six pop quizzes just to make you come to class. Lab was pretty easy. 85-100 is A so that helps. I recommend him.

If you study the notes the test are cake! All you need is an 85 in this class to get an A. The homework can be difficult, but doesn't take more than 30 minutes! He's hilarious and tries to make the content fun! Great prof!

Tries to make lectures fun. Succeeds most of the time but tries to hard. Kind of soft spoken. Tests are basically memorization of lectures. Pretty lenient grading system (85-100 is an A) Not a bad class

I took this class online to complete my science requirement. While the material is simple he presents it in a complicated way. He is not a good speaker. He is NOT helpful and will not answer questions. The tests are poorly worded and set to trick you. DO NOT TAKE!

Kent hates students, he will not help you unless you are one of his geology picks. Since geologic event can be interpreted in different ways you may be pursuaded to ask a question about kents interpretation, wrong idea. He will make you feel like a complete idiot if you go against his view. Would be an easy class if the professor wasn't full of him

Sorry, but you have to go to almost all the classes for an A. The material isn't that hard, everything on the test is in the notes that he puts online. It is alot of memorization, but nothing too hard. He is sort of rude when it comes to answering questions, or helping students. Go to the TA for help or questions. Anne is also the best TA for 220!

Not a bad professor. He gives pop quizzes which are pretty annoying and sometimes difficult, but if you go to class, pay attention, and study the study guides he provides before test, you'll get an A.

Had this professor in 220 and he seemed like an okay professor. I have him now for 230, obviously he doesn't enjoy teaching 230 or my perception of him in 220 was incorrect.  Answers every question asked with either "did you read the book" or "didn't I teach you that in 220".  You eventually quit seeking help because you feel stupid.
This professor will not answer your question.  Consider it DIY geology

He was a hard teacher, but I liked his personality... the subject matter got boring a lot. His tests are difficult but not impossible, but those are the main grades you have and he doesn't give any extra credit. Overall I liked him, but I would've rather taken an easier class.
HARD, very very hard. WAY too much information to possibly learn. Tests are just masses and masses of info. I had to withdraw.
Horrible teacher. Does not like students to get good grades.  The first day of class he says how he doesn't expect many A's mostly C's. DO not take this class or any class from him

Very difficult professor. Without going to class you WILL be lost. His biggest fault is that he writes his exams seemingly with intent to confuse and trip up his students. He has a tendency to stoke his ego in his teaching by making obvious how detached he is from the daily workings of the grading process. Not the easy A you think it will be.

Kent is the worst teacher I have ever had.  His powerpoints are useless and his tests do not reflect what is taught in class.  If you ask questions he will try to make you look stupid.  It is sad that all geology majors have to suffer through a year of classes with this guy.  Goodluck.
too much info is taught at a time. texbook is not useful. Teacher assumes this is the only class students are taking.

yes, you do have to work harder than you might expect to earn a decent grade in this class, but he's not a bad teacher. and he's not mean he just doesn't waste time. study the slides (which you can download) and GO TO CLASS, because he loves to pull from lectures. memorize memorize.  DON'T BUY THE TEXTBOOK just borrow the CD from a friend!!!!!!!!!

Not a cake class, but very doable and isnt that hard to get an A. He is extremely organized and provides everything for you. Lecture notes are posted on Blackboard, but additional info is covered in class (so take notes). Tests are fairly easy. I studied about 8-10 hours on each one and got an A. Lab is easy and counts for 35% of grade.

Dr. R is a terrible professor. The average score on all exams were around a 65 and somehow he doesn't notice that his teaching style is the cause. His power points had a lot of geology vocabulary that he wouldn't explain. His tests are very tricky. The only good thing is that the range for is grading is very broad. Do not take him!
Hardest class I've ever taken!!!!!!

this teacher was by far the hardest teacher i had at UK. My friend and I literally made 13 page study guides for each exam, right off the study guide he gave us.. and still struggled with the test. We went in very knowledgable about the material and then once we recieved the test, the information was much different. Hes a nice guy but the test suck

Kent was not helpful to students, and always assumed that the entire class was interested in Engineering.  That, combined with his inability to explain things to his students, and his inability to be in his office, he was terrible.
you don't have to take notes and the lectures are really clear pay attention and look back over the powerpoints and you'll be set, oh and an 85 is an A
hardest class ever! do not take with this teacher! tests are impossible and its hard to understand what he is even talking about in this class..i had to withdraw because it was so hard.

Great Professor. ATTEND CLASS! As long as you go to class, listen, take notes, and print off the slides afterwards you'll have no problem in here. Exams are all multiple choice, and so are quizes, and are very straight foward. And he has a sense of humor, makes the class go by a lot smoother.
He's hott and seems like a good guy but his class is so hard. It's impossible to learn the material, sounds interesting...it's not. Tests and quizzes are impossible. I had to withdraw from his class.

Here's the thing. Maybe he's ok for 110, but you are going to hate 230/235 because of this man. He's the only one teaching it-- sorry about your luck. But stick with geology if you're a major, not all the professors are this unhelpful and rude. Beware if you ask questions in class, he will likely make you feel stupid. Smart guy, not a good prof.

I was told GLY110 was supposed to be easy.. but this class is hard for me because of this professor.  The information is very boring and hard to study. I just really do not like this class.  You need to attend class because he puts things on his test that arent in the notes or in the book- some of the information is what he says in class.

Not a hard class to make a good grade in if you show up and take notes. Don't worry about buying the book- he doesn't use it. Trys to make class interesting but also a stickler on rules. Come to his office hours and he is more than willing to answer any questions you may have.

AMAZING PROF!!!!  he makes rocks funny (which is not easy)!  test are pretty simple if you know your notes (doesnt use textbooks) Just an all around fantastic, funny, and sweet guy who LOVES to teach.

Professor Serhiyenko is great. She explains things very clearly and provides as many examples as you need. She is energetic and keeps your attention while explaining everything you need to know along with some background information that can be helpful. As long as you attend class and keep up, she will make Calc II a breeze for most.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's a good teacher but made mistakes often. Usually the class can correct her little mistakes and typos but sometimes she gets the formulas wrong so just make sure to double check everything. Sometimes the homeworks were so hard I had to give up so maybe get help with them if you need it.

She is a great professor! The homework problems were more difficult than the problems we did in class, but the exam questions weren't bad. The lectures were beneficial. There was lecture participation problems for each lecture, but they weren't due during the lecture. It was a good class, and she didn't make it any more difficult than it had to be.

Great lectures and notes. She'd usually provide simple examples of concepts then put harder examples on homework, which I liked. Good feedback and helpful during office hours. Pretty big difficulty spike near the end of the course though!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Coming into this class I have always done great in math classes, but not so well this one. The first unit is understandable if you practice, but the next 2 made no sense and the lectures did not help at all. She would just say practice problems. She also would do extremely simple problems in class then the homework would be extremely difficult.

If the course were harder I probably would have a worse rating. Not a bad lecturer and the content was for the most part understandable; however, when it came to questions (specifically about convergence) her answers were blatantly unhelpful and felt pretty lazy in the sense that there's no way that the only answer is "It takes practice"

Kristina is a pretty good professor. However the layout of this class is atrocious. Homework are very much practice based while the exams are theory so there is a riveting difference. Final exam was awwwweeful (at least in my opinion). B could be obtained cruising through the course as long as you prepare for the final, an A will require work.

Serhiyenko was an upper tier okay professor. Class ramped up extremely at the end in terms of difficulty. Tests were very difficult and she was not lenient on grading , However she is a good person and is accommodating for office hours. Exams are heavy theory while hmwrk is practical application so be careful

She is super nice and gives detailed lectures while making sure anyone can ask any question, although she is quick to know who watched the lectures and didn't. She helped me a lot so I got an A thankfully. I recommend taking her! If you struggle to understand any foreign accents, then she may not be the best! But I enjoyed her immensely!!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Seriyenko makes her classes extremely enjoyable by balancing their toughness perfectly. I always feel as though I'm fully learning what I should be in the class without being overloaded with unnecessarily long assignments or tests. She gives great lectures and cares about her students more than any other professor I've had.

Dr. Serhiyenko is a good calc 2 professor. She isn't the best, as she often rushes course content and gets tripped up mid-example, but she does a decent job. If you are able to focus for the entirety of her dense lectures, you'll probably like her.

The only negative thing about her is that lecture notes are not accessible online. Other than that, she's a solid choice. She really wants to help you understand and is a very pleasant person to talk to.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Her lectures are alright but she only uses whiteboard/chalkboard. No access to online notes made it a bit annoying but that's what youtube tutors are for, on the bright side she's always helpful in office hours and will go above and beyond to help you out.

As with any calc 2 class, the lectures are very important. Attendance is taken by 3 iClickers at the end of class which I found very helpful. During lecture, she is great about writing everything out on the board and about stopping for questions/ thoroughly explaining the answers. I only had her for 1/2 a semester due to COVID but 10/10 recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Just like any MA114 lecturer, if you don't go to class you won't pass. Other than her slightly messy handwritting, she had really good lectures and would answer any questions students had in class. Only had for 1/2 a semester bc of COVID19 but she was a solid lecturer. She doesn't post lectures or notes online so you MUST be in class to take them.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy
