reviews.comment: I mostly feel bad that she has to teach all of this content in one class (it is way more than one class's worth of content).  Tests pretty difficult.  Being in lectures is very helpful because she works examples out on the board.  Group project was a nightmare because there was little direction provided.

The class itself wasn't too difficult. With a pdf of the textbook and Ctrl-F, most homework assignments were fairly easy. The exams also followed the slides and the textbook fairly well. The lectures were pretty dry, and the group project could be a problem if you're stuck in a bad group.

Lectures are sometimes hard to follow, but overall she teaches the content very well. Homeworks are assigned for each OSI layer and questions are mostly online or straight from the book. Midterms and finals are modeled off of homeworks and reflect the objectives of the class. The group project was not guided super well, but was graded leniently.

Slides are organized and pretty good. Lectures were slow and boring. Having recordings of class was super helpful. The homework is mostly explaining topics in your own words or working examples, I didnt think it was graded too strict and I found it helpful. The group project was rough, very difficult and demonstrating to the TA was a nightmare.

Boring lectures. All assignments could be found on google. She told us critical final exam info the night before the final which was incredibly annoying. If you just do all the homework you should be fine for exams, but I thought this course had a lot of work.

Most of the homework problems are copied from other sources (with attribution) so they are easy to Google. The night before our final exam, we were notified that the Respondus Lockdown browser would be required for the exam. The material is not taught very well in my opinion, but it is a fairly easy A.
She's pretty great.
As long as you come to class and take good notes, this is a fairly easy class

This class is very easy. Show up to every class, take notes, and there will be no issues. The only things you are graded on are the video participations (2 of them) and 4 quizzes, both of which come directly from the lectures. She will tell you exactly what you need to know for the quizzes, and they are all online; class is cancelled on those days.
It is a very enjoyable class, just be ready to be in long lectures and take notes, but overall is easy.
I enjoyed having Professor Kelley McAninch, however the TA's for the course graded everything and didn't go lightly.

Class is lecture heavy. When you have quizzes she cancels class. Participation is every lecture and you get 6 make up participation. If you don't take good notes you will struggle on the quizzes. I didn't get the book and I haven't needed it other then for the vocab definitions on the quizzes. All quizzes are open notes.
Great lectures but you have to go to class or you will miss out heavy. If you pay attention and take lots of notes it will be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof McAninch is pretty good. You need to go to class. You also need to read the textbook because the final paper relies on pulling specific examples from the book. She's not the easiest grader, you will need to work for your grade. The material is not too difficult.
She is a hard grader and this class is super hard if you don't go to class but if you take notes and pay attention you will do fine

Dr. McAninich is a solid choice for COM 101. This is a large lecture class, and there is a lot of material but nothing too difficult. Quizzes are open note. The hardest part is the term paper but if you attend class you will have the information you need.

Her lectures are fairly engaging and help with the exams so I'd  recommend her for that. However, don't take the class if you think you'll ever be absent. She gives you 6 makeup participation days which is nice, but they apply to excused and unexcused absences. When my mom ended up in the hospital, my grade tanked because I was absent visiting her.

i found the lectures super interesting and easy to follow, i never read anything in the textbook and i did well so dont feel pressured about it. As long as you pay attention you should do well, especially because all of the quizzes are open note.
Easy class amazing professor. Does have attendance but you get 6 unexcused absences.

McAninch is very sweet and understanding for her students. She does a great job in lectures when it comes to expanding on topics that may be difficult and provides tons of examples. Very minimal studying is needed outside of class lecture because she provides plenty of material and context that can easily be recalled. Quizzes are open note.

This class is incredibly well structured and thought out.  She works hard to make sure you understand the concepts and are doing well on the quizzes.  She is incredibly caring and I would recommend her for this class.

This class was very lecture heavy but she was always clear and if you attend class and take notes you'll have no problem making an A in the class. All tests and quizzes are taken outside of class and notes/textbook can be used.

Very easy class and a great professor. She was very nice and chill. The only things that mattered were quizzes and participation but had 6 make-ups. The most important thing would be to take good notes during the lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was so easy. If you show up and take notes you will receive an A. The slides are the exams!
She's nice and interacts with the class but her quizzes are very detailed so make sure you take good notes.
easy class for credit
Super easy and a great overall teacher. Show up to class and you will get an A.

Dr. McAninch was really nice in class. She genuinely cares about her students and frequently walks around the lecture hall to check in with her students. The quizzes are really easy and open-note, there are also a few papers that are graded pretty easily. The final isn't cumulative, it is just another quiz. Overall, I would recommend this class.

McAninch cares about all of her students and is probably the nicest professor I have had. The exams, which are open note, are straight from the notes. If you manage not to do well on the exams, she offers forms of extra credit. I strongly recommend COM101 with McAninch if you need a core credit class.

McAninch was one of the best professors I have taken so far! She explains the course content pretty well and had open note exams. She also offers extra credit opportunities to help boost up your grade and course is set up to where younger generations can understand to content pretty easily. I highly recommend McAninch for any COM course!

McAninch is absolutely amazing! The exams are open note, the content isnt too difficult, and the prof does a really good job at explaining content. You can do easy make up assignments for up to 6 missed classes, as there is graded participation.

She was a great professor. I thoroughly enjoyed lectures; it was a simple follow-along with taking notes and interacting with peers/instructors. You have four online quizzes, all open notes, and two papers about a page and a half long. For each lecture, you'll have a participation grade to complete at the end of class.
Such an interesting class!!! She's awesome, I wish I could have her for every class. Such an interesting class too

Amazing professor that related to the younger generations through memes and funny videos! You can really tell that she enjoys what she does and she knows what she is talking about. I would love to take another one of her classes. She made learning easy and fun!
Attend lecture bc of the participations in class, her class is interesting and she presents her lectures in the best way!

She uses a textbook but it's not necessary. You have to go or watch class because there are canvas questions to answer during or after class from the lecture. All exams are open note so you need to take notes. Easy A
Honestly, I loved communication because of her so I took other communication classes, but other prof couldnt beat her level. So I realized it was just Kelly who I really liked.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She was really an amazing professor. She gave multiple extra credit opportunities and her test were straight from material covered in class, and if she didn't say anything about it in class, she said where it would be in the text book. Take her if you can!!!

I loved this professor!!! Her lectures were always so interesting and always had me intrigued to learn more! I always did my readings for the course because the lectures were so interesting and covered concepts I hadnt noticed before in day to day life. Would definitely take again!

participation is only once a week, and you can watch the lectures from home. her TAs grade everything, so its pretty easy to get an A on papers. she really just requires the bare minimum. she's super nice and tries to make the lectures interesting. textbook isn't mandatory, but it was useful on papers when I didn't have good enough notes

I reccomend this class with Professor McAninch to anyone and everyone. Its a easy class with multiple assignments for extra credit. The tests are open note, open book, and you can use google as well. It"s a great class to take to get some credits and not be stressed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is so nice to her students and truly cares about them. Shes a gem. She does everything to help her students succeed. One thing I truly admire about her is her teaching skills. She makes the most boring topic so interesting to listen to. She is made for this field, and other professors definitely need to learn how to teach from Dr. McAninch.
Super sweet! Just go to class and you will pass. She assigns chapters to read but you dont really have to. All quizzes are open note.(at least for this year)

Though this class is mainly lectures, she does a great job keeping you engaged. No homework except reading the chapters (I just wrote down definitions from the chapters and got 100% in that class). Quizzes and papers are open note (at least for my semester), and she posts great study guides. I definitely recommend this class!!
Great teacher. She made the class really fun and enjoyable.

Took this online during summer. Every week you watch three lectures then write on Packback discussion board which is actually fun and easy. You have two tests; they are both open note so you will pass. No need to study for those just fill out study guide beforehand. One paper and project that are easy. She always checks up on students, super nice!

I am a junior and she is by far the best lecturer I have taken. She's funny, makes it relatable and enjoyable. You have to go to class, There's attendance everyday and random participation assignments. Other than that, the exams/quizzes reflect course material well and easy to study for. Highly recommend her and COM 101
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Exams are online, you do have to be in class to pass, but she's such an amazing lecturer that keeps things fun and interesting even for someone who hates COM classes. If you fall behind, she is very caring and will help you get back on track. Strict, but very amazing professor. Wish I could take all my classes taught by her.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I would hands down take another class from Kelly McAninch. She the most passionate prof i have ever had. You do have to do the readings and take good notes in class because she doesn't post her power points but, I didn't find this too hard because she keeps it interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. McAninch and 10/10 recommend you taking her. She is super chill and truly loves her students. Her lectures were always very interesting and I loved just going to her class. She made each day better. Take her if you can!

Overall Dr. McAninch is a good professor. Attendance is required, if you miss make sure you get the excuse her asap. Material is pretty interesting. Only thing I did not like is that there were several guest speakers that she had come in, that tried to teach very liberal and bias material to us that I did not agree with.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's really knowledgable in her field, and keeps her lectures interesting and fun because she's funny. She's easy to approach and a pretty easy grader. There's not a lot of outside-of-class assignments which is good, but if you skip class a lot, it'll be hard to pass the class. She's nice and helpful but knows when you're not trying.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Online exams and no final. As long as you show up and take notes you will get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you're searching for an easy elective, look no further. Fairly interesting material and incredibly easy grading. All of the exams are take-home and are open note/book/internet. The papers (three of them) are sort of tedious, but not bad once you convince yourself to sit down and do them.

McAninch is great. When you're in class, she makes what you're learning interesting to learn about. Some of the papers are hard to write but if you start them ahead of time and actually read what she tells you to read, you'll do fine. Must attend class to take notes, everything from her lectures isn't posted online.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Kelly McAninch truly cares about her students and helping them succeed. Rarely do you ever see students skip class because her "lectures" are so involved and enjoyable. Yes, you will have to write a few papers and do a few speeches (alone and in a group), but she works with you to help you all succeed. The class really has a great time together

She grades presentations like a doctoral thesis, which is super annoying when you have her for a 200 level class that you need to graduate. Plan to have periods in the semester where every class there's a major test/paper/project and then weeks go by without any homework. She doesn't space her assignments out well. Her lectures are fun, though.

Absolutely loved having Dr. McAninch as a professor. This class was one of the best that I have had so far at UK. I definitely recommend this class to anyone. You have to attend lecture to take down all of the notes because she does not post her PowerPoints online. (At least she didn't when I took this class) Great professor + interesting material
She is extremely helpful. As long as you put in the work you will do well.

Ms. McAninich definitely knows her stuff, but the class could be way more entertaining due to the class content. She tries to make it interesting but you'll end up drifting after a while. Pretty easy and interesting class but not as interesting as it could've been.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Ms. M is a very personable professor. She is easy to talk to and grades true to the rubrics. Attend class, participate, and complete the required assignments and UK101 is an easy A. The class feels like a GPA booster more than anything.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: was a tough grader. Papers are tough. Test are still relatively hard even if you do the study guide.
She actually cares.  Dr. McAninch treats you by your name and not as a number like most college professors.

Dr. McAninch made the class enjoyable. If you go to the lectures and read the book, its an easy A. Be prepared to write at least two multiple-page papers, but she grades fair and the assignments aren't something the average college kid can't handle.  Would definitely recommended her to anyone looking to take a COM class!

I really enjoyed her through the past semester. My class was at 8 am and she still somehow made the class enjoyable and interesting. I would highly recommend taking her if you have the chance she really Is there to help her students succeed. If you read the book and go to her lectures you are sure to get an A on tests and in the class!!
She is a very nice lady and her class was very easy.  There is a lot of busy work, which was not fun.  However, she was really easy going, nice, and helpful!

Amazing professor if you are a public health major or not. My second class with him and he was amazing, its a chill class, but if you participate it makes the class more enjoyable as this class discusses films. If you like films in general I think you'll like this class. Bonus points to get on his good side he's a Philadelphia Eagles fan.
Very caring and passionate about the topic. The course is interesting; sometimes the lectures are hard to pay attention to, but he does a good job of engaging the class.
Awesome, caring, and hands on.

Lectures are very boring and you have to take handwritten notes which is so silly, electronics r banned from his room unless you sit in the back then he cant see that. Exams are easy if you take good notes because you can use the notes on the first three exams, the final is pretty tough.
The textbook is not required and if you actually go to class the class will be very easy.

This class will make you rethink life. Great lectures. Let's you use textbooks and notes during the first three exams. But sometimes a question would pop up on the exams that is very hard to find on any material given. Got a good enough grade on them though. Do not skip class!! The in-class reflections are worth A LOT. I got a B because of them.
Was a great personable professor and a great teacher would take again
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Pretty chill. Come to class for attendance quizzes and do your hw.

If I could take professor Kim for genuinely every lecture I'll ever have to take I would. He's lowkey in it for the love of the game. I genuinely still went to class even when it wasn't even a requirement because that's how engaging he made the classes. You have to TRY to get under an A in this class. I yearn to have him again in the future.

He is hands down one of the best professor I've had. He has amazing lectures and he really tries to get his students to want to learn the material. He is also so caring and he wants all of his students to succeed. Finally, he is such a funny teacher and made me want to go to class. 100% recommend you take this!!!!!

Mr. Kim is one of the best professors i've had so far at the University of Kentucky. It is obvious he truly cares for his students and puts time and effort into all of his lectures. His class is easy and attendance isn't mandatory although he includes life lessons in each lecture to keep students engaged and motivated. He is an amazing professor.

Dr. Kim is an amazing professor. He's so funny and engaging that an hour and 15 minutes always flies by. The material is interesting and the assigned work isn't difficult or demanding. I definitely recommend taking him if you have the chance!
He is really awesome, attendance is not mandatory but recommended because he is hilarious and does not make lecture boring.

I can't think of one bad thing to say about this professor. His lectures are awesome and he's super funny. There's 3 projects and then wonderings each week going over the lectures 50 words so really easy, and 2 midterms and a final which are online and open note. He carefully curates everything in order to make sure you succeed, highly recommend!

Dr. Kim is a great teacher who has passion for his job, and truly cares about his students. Although class is not mandatory, going to the lectures is the best way to understand the material. Dr. Kim relates topics to real life examples which allowed me to understand the material more. I would definitely recommend taking any of his classes.

This professor was extremely great! His class is lecture based, however, he does not just talk the entire time. He gives opportunities for students to be involved with the topic that is being taught about. He is very nice and his class is not hard at all, just pay attention and do the work.
I took his PSY 323 class and loved it! I would 100% take another class with him.
Dr. Kim is THE best!! I genuinely look forward to his lectures because you can tell how much he cares about making the class engaging, relevant, and fun.
Took PSY 323, such an amazing professor. Made the content really interesting and I would 100% take another class with him.

I took PSY323 last fall and I really enjoyed the class. Although attendance isn't mandatory, I came to class the majority of the time because Dr. Kim's lectures are very engaging. The work is minimal with a short "wondering" due each week, a few easy (and somewhat fun) projects, and open note exams.
He is funny and a good professor. The only thing that could trip some people up is his grading scale. He usually grade things for more than a few points.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Loved Dr. Kim. I would 100% take his class again.
He's really passionate about what he does, 10/10
Super funny guy who really likes what he teaches, exams are online and open note which is great, lots of extra credit opportunities, links the textbook for free which is also great

I loved Dr. Kim! I found this class to be very interesting and not hard at all. He is hilarious if you do go to lecture, but attendance is not required and he posts the recorded lectures on canvas. Also offered a lot of extra credit!
Extremely kind and enjoyable, loves what he teaches

Super chill and fun guy. Grace period for all projects and open note, online tests. Tries to make it low stress for students, and interacts a lot with students in class, plus has interesting lectures.

Dr. Kim is so easygoing and really cares about his students. He does not require attendance, but his exams are based mainly on lectures. His exams are online and open note, which is so nice. He doesn't believe in textbooks and won't require reading. He is a genuine guy who is very funny. Take him for sure.
Love him and loved the classs

Dr. Kim is a great professor and I would 100% take one of his classes again. His lecture slides for PSY 323 were always very interesting and engaging. There were 3 exams and they were all online and open book. Attendance for this class was optional but I would still recommend attending class for the exams! This class was not homework heavy.

Dr. Kim is such a kind and passionate professor! He genuinely loves psychology and his students, and really wants us to learn. Lectures are fun and super intriguing. Test aren't super difficult if you watch lectures and take diligent notes. Take him if given the chance!

Best professor I've had. He just wants you to be interested in the content so attendance is not mandatory and every lecture is online, exams are open note and not timed so you can use anything from the class including lectures, and the few assignments are super easy. Class is actually interesting too and he is super knowledgable
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Kim is truly an amazing professor. He is willing to work with students and make his class as clear and stress-free as possible. He is very funny and personable. I cannot recommend him enough

Dr. Kim is super lenient and its obvious that his goal is to get students to pass with an A. Tests are online, no time limit, open note. Attendance isn't mandatory. Projects are typically one page papers that you can use the powerpoints to work through. Very clear grading criteria and he offers extra credit all the time.
Good all around. Exams are easy if you study using the guides, projects are pretty reasonable
I loved Dr. Kim. He was super interesting to listen too and posts his lecture guides in case you miss class. Would defiantly recommend!

Dr. Kim is a great teacher who really cares about his work and his students. The biggest thing is to go to class as the exams are very lecture heavy, but besides that if you do the assignments and pay attention, you'll get an A. He is always available to talk and will help you on the projects he assigns.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is the most caring teacher Ive had in college! Definitely take Dr. Kim if you can! The class was simple, easy to understand, and very interesting.
Dr. Kim is so considerate and understanding. I would recommend having him as a professor if possible. Its a non-stressful class and actually interesting!
Matthew Kim was such a good professor! You can tell he really cares about his job and his students. PSY311 with him is an easy A and he makes it fun and easy to learn.

Dr. Kim is one of the best professors I have had. He is understanding and wants everyone to do well in his class. He makes sure all information is presented in an interesting and relatable way to ensure students will learn. The tests in his class were all only 10 qs with two attempts. The bulk of your grade is projects that are fun and easy to do.
Dr. Kilgore is extremely knowledgeable and explains concepts clearly. He is great! The only grades are from four exams, though. If you go to class and pay attention, you will do well!

Dr. Kilgroe was an amazing professor and was very good at explaining difficult topics in a way students can understand. Responds to emails very quickly. The only issue with this class is that the only grade you get is 4 exams, no curve, no extra credit. But he is very lenient and understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Kilgore is extremely caring and knowledgeable about his field. The class is 100% based off of 4 exams (not cumulative) so you need to go to class. He is very accessible outside of class and wants everyone to succeed. Highly suggest this class!
Very funny guy and a good professor. For PHA 200 the only 4 grades are the 4 exams but he prepares you well and has review sessions for them.

Professor Kilgore is a great teacher! The class is definitely difficult, but he makes you eager to learn and he is very passionate about what he is teaching. Exams are the only thing you are graded on which makes the course pretty tough. Attendance isn't mandatory, but I would be lost without attending them. Reading over the slides helps for exams.

Professor Michael Kilgore is one my favorite professors so far. He only has test for grades but he is so passionate about Pharmacology and he makes you want to learn with him. His exams are not that bad as long as you read over his power points sometimes he focuses more on small facts then big one, but overall he was a great teacher!!!

He is an amazing professor and sets his lectures up to be interesting, even if some of the material is difficult. The tests are fair but are the only grades in the class so yo need to do good on each one.

Professor Kilgore is an amazing professor. Class only has four exams and no homework. The best advice is just to attend it and review notes as much as needed. It is not a basic pharmacy class since he really amps up the notes by adding on recent topics. He really knows a lot about Pharmacy and much more. Beneficial to all kinds of medical students.

Beyond being a great professor, Dr. Kilgore is a great resource for those interested in pre-med or pre-pharmacy. I really enjoyed this class and it wasn't very stressful. Exams are straightforward and often include things said verbatim in class. I would highly recommend if you're interested in anything in the medical field.

Dr. Kilgore is a great professor, he's very chill and laid back. The class is only based on 4 exams, which isn't the best, so you really have to study for them. But definitely take it if you are interested in Pharmacy, it was one of the most interesting classes I have taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This was a course based heavily on in-class discussion, so the professor didn't need to do much work. However, he was knowledgeable about every discussion topic and could answer questions well.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Kilgore was the course director and a lecturer for the IBS 603 (Cell Biology & Signaling) course. I took it as an undergraduate and he was highly accommodating. Very inspiring lecture series on mitochondrial membrane transportation and endocytosis. If you're an advanced undergraduate, I would definitely think about taking IBS 603 as an elective

took this class as a free elective and found out it wasn't as bad as I thought it would be. This teacher is the coolest and most chill guy you will ever has a teacher. The class isn't mandatory, but you need to show up to do well on the exams considering the only grades for the class are four exams. Would recommend if interested in pharmacy.

This class consisted of three 300 word written assignments and 3 group presentations, the rest was discussion based participation. Dr. Kilgore genuinely cares about all of his students and encourages a lively discussion. It was difficult to tell how he was grading because he never gave feedback on the presentations. If you participate you get an A.

I took this class because I had an interest in Pharmacology, but he really intensified that interest. His lectures are clear-cut and he takes his exam from his PowerPoint slides (which he does put online for you). He's an incredibly nice man who really cares about his students doing well in his class.

The syllabus clearly states no late work is accepted, and this policy is strictly enforced I had to find that out for myself. With ONLY 8 homework assignments and 3/4 points coming from exams, every grade matters. He is funny but strict, exams are conceptual, tricky, and require deep understanding. He did make the material more understandable.

Take another professor. I passed this class because we finally got tutoring because Prof Kleppe was too busy to help his students. I would attend office hours and he was always rude. The tutor explained everything on the spot. She truly saved me from failing his class cause I scored really well on the final. offer tutoring for the entire class.

He's a good professor. He reads off the slides and doesn't really explain well. You'll definitely have to teach yourself. 75% of your grade comes from the exams. He does give out extra credit throughout the semester.

This is known as a weed out class, so it's expected to be hard but the professor does not help in any way. He knows a lot   about accounting but doesn't know how to teach it. Most of the time if you ask a question you're left more confused than before. Over half the class grade is based on exams.

Take a different professor. I went to every lecture except for two and still had to try to teach myself after every class. Teaches the material like you already have a degree and have worked in accounting for 10 years. He obviously knows a lot about accounting but has no idea how to teach.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This is a difficult class, but Dr. Kleppe makes it manageable! He explains things in a simple, clear way, and provides examples that match what you might see on homework or exams. I would recommend going to class, even though attendance isn't taken, because he will occasionally offers extra credit for going. Exams require studying early to do well!

Great professor when it comes to lectures, however exams are over 75% of your grade in the class. Uses McGraw Hill for the homework which doesn't exactly reflect the lectures and what you need to learn but gives good exam review that he's made and personalized for his exams. Would take him again if given the chance.

Exams are most of your grade and they are somewhat difficult. I stopped going to class and watched the lectures online so I could actually digest the information and take notes. Its impossible to take notes during the lecture in person because there is so much information that he goes over. There is opportunities for bonus points but not many.

He's SUPER knowledgable on accounting so his lectures are super informational, if you can get past how boring the content is. Its notoriously hard, so much content, and boring but I'd say he's the best professor to take it with. Get every point you can on HW and prepare EXTENSIVELY for exams. It's a weed out class, not gonna be easy regardless.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Kleppe is a great guy, but the lectures can just be very boring at times. I'm not sure if its just the way I learn, but I found it hard to retain the information from his slides and I end up learning better with Chat or Gemini. Exams are relatively difficult compared to class content as well. Again, great guy but hard class.

ACC 301 is a hard class. No other way to put it. It's not the most interesting material and is very monotonous and tedious. Kleppe loves accounting. Every class you will spend the entire time reading through a slide presentation that is packed to the brim with information. He is a good professor, and tries his best to make the class enjoyable.
This professor was great and I would definitely take him again. ACC 302 is a hard class already but he made it more understandable. If you take this class make sure

302 sucks no matter who you take. But overall Kleppe isn't awful, you can definitely tell he's a younger professor. His lectures are sorta just the txtbook and the study materials/homeworks look nothing like the exams which made them way more difficult than they needed to be, but he does offer some bonus points in-class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 302 is an extremely hard class, but Kleppe at least tries to make it better. The lectures are dry, and the homework takes an eternity. He gives extremely helpful practice exams though. Study them until you know them like the back of your hand, and do ALL the homework, and you can get a C in the class with only a moderate amount of effort.

The professor is so cool. He is definitely my favorite ACC professor. I'm not majoring in ACC, yet I was able to understand his lectures. The key to succeed in his class is to practice the mock exam + the MULTIPLE CHOSE QUESTION from the STUDY GUIDE for each chapter.

Look, ACC302 is a tough class anyway you cut it, but Kleppe is straightforward with his tests and assignments. Also he curves the class at the end of the year and sprinkles extra credit throughout the semester. He's a good guy and gives his students a chance to make a very hard class manageable

His class is tough, but he gives you all the materials you need in order to succeed. Study what he tells you to and you'll do fine on the exams. He is approachable and genuinely wants you to do well. He is relatable and tries to make his class enjoyable with jokes. He puts in a lot of effort to help his students succeed and you can tell.

Joel is a good guy, but just can not teach and isn't wanting to be a teacher for a career so I can't blame him. He has trouble communicating thoroughly and the homework was a lot tougher than the material we did in class, but the exams reflected a lot from the homework. Definitely had to work for this grade.

I've previously taken College Algebra (known as MA 109) in high school and got a high B in it, but this guy really makes you feel like you don't know the material because he does everything in a different way. He only knows one way to do the problems, and that's the PDF notes. Tries to start a new lesson with 2 minutes left in class...
Expectations are not clear and he cannot teach something in more than one way.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This professor spends way too much time reviewing homework problems that can be reviewed in about 10 minutes. He is an extremely tough grader, and talks down to his students.

Alright, I typically don't take time to come write these things. This guy has confidence in what he's teaching, so he makes mistakes and often rambles. He talks at the class and belittles our knowledge. I'm sure he knows his stuff, but he isn't a good teacher, which is ironic because this class is supposed to teach me how to teach math to children
Attendance is part of the grade. The material is very difficult, but doable. The homework is hard. If you aren't a mathematician the class is less helpful than it could be, almost all theory.
Got tons of stuff to cover, but it's well organized. He might be tough in grading but always willing to help.Good prof, good course.

Dr. Klapper is one of the hardest guys you will take a class from, in the Grad School. His homeworks are terribly hard and he is not very helpful. He also displays this dark egoistic side, often times.

We was extremely hard for assignments and exams, too. He asks the hardest questions in the book for each assignment. That means you cannot solve it without looking on the Internet. Also, he cuts many points from assignments, as well.
very hard homework but the exam is much easier.

Homework is extremely hard, but tests are much less so (not easy, tho). Asking questions helps him see where he hasn't explained enough and then he's very good at filling in the gaps. He's really funny, but there's so much material there's not much time to find that out.

Klapper just does proofs constantly in class, and the material is often rediculous, a TON of it is just theoretical stuff and proofs.  But even though the material is incredibly difficult to comprehend, his tests are usually pretty easy. He takes attendance for every lecture though..so that kinda sucks.  He isnt very clear alot of times as well.

Great teacher. He gives you and question bank before each exam and onl tests you on questions from it. He gives you all the answers in class. All you have to do to get an A is show up, no extra work outside class.

I had tyler for Health Care Ethics and absolutely loved it. Going into medical school this class really helped. Easy to understand and very fair grader. Go to class and listen to what he has to say and there is no reason why you shouldn't get an A. Would definitely recommend taking him if you have he chance.
This class is definitely worth your time.  He is definitely passionate about what the teaches and extends this passion to his students.  LOVED him.
Exams are impossible, but the final was take home, it still took six hours to complete, would recommend taking him if you have the choose.

Tyler is pretty good at this.  I don't know why people say he is a jerk.  He knows the subject and makes sure everyone understands it.  He even gives the test questions a day in advance.  The class is fairly easy.  He's not a phenomenal professor, but you could certainly do worse.

He knows what he's talking about and makes sure majority of the class understands. Go to class or else you will get nothing out of this course. Participate in class, or at least pay attention, and you'll get an A easily. He's very helpful in class if you have any questions. I recommend this course.
Class is good; I learned a lot. But the tests are ridiculous! 8 open responses in 50 minutes! I dropped the class.

The class is RIDICULOUS! Sucks that it is a requirement in the first place, worse when you have a crappy teacher. The stuff we did at the end was practical and useful, but that was the last 2 weeks of the painfully long semester.

I think tyler is really helpful, I'm taking him now for intro to philosophy.  he comes up with clear examples and tries to help us get through the text.  He is really helpful and really willing to meet with you in office hours to discuss things.
If I thought I could use a worse word than jerk I would! This guy is a real piece of work... Try to get anyone else as a TA.

I guess he is sort of a jerk, but he's very helpful during discussion sections.  He'll slow down, go over more proofs, or whatever you need if you just ask.  He's also the only TA that has a study group before tests.
I've never had a worse TA in the three years I've been at UK. What a jerk!!

She is one of my favorite professors I have ever had. She completely changed how I learn by helping me focus on understanding instead of memorizing. Her class structure makes it easy to ask questions, work with classmates, check understanding with worksheets, and get help. She truly loves teaching and helps students succeed in the course.

Gen chem covers a large amount of material very quickly; however, Professor Woodrum makes the subject more comprehensible. You take notes outside of class through videos, and in class, you work in groups to complete worksheets that help with understanding the material. If you have to take gen chem, I recommend trying to take her class.

She makes a hard class a lot easier by having very good pre-lecture videos that are easy to understand and cover the concepts well. The videos do take a while to get through sometimes, but they are worth it.

Loved Dr. Woodrum!! She has lecture videos instead of regular lectures during class, but it's honestly way better because she uses that time to do practice questions and help us with any questions we may have. She's very nice and understanding, if you have the chance to choose Woodrum!!

She made chemistry much easier to comprehend and although taking notes individually before lecture was annoying and took a lot of time, getting to work on assignments in groups during class made the concepts less intimidating.
Dr. Woodrum was probably one of the best chem teachers I've ever had, especially since she made sure that everyone was where they needed to be in their learning. She loves to teach.

Professor Woodrum is an amazing professor. Her approach to teaching is more focused on learning and understanding than just memorization, and she truly wants to help her students succeed. I would definitely recommend her to any students taking Gen Chem, especially if you aren't very confident in your abilities.

Took in the 6-week summer term at UKY. The course moves very fast and covers all the same content as a regular semester nothing is cut but it's totally doable. Dr. Woodrum is an amazing professor who makes the material clear and manageable. I got an A with consistent effort. It's not as bad as people say, especially with a good instructor like her.

Took the 6-week summer term at UKY. The course moves very fast and covers all the same content as a regular semester nothing is cut but it's totally doable. Dr. Woodrum is an amazing professor who makes the material clear and manageable. I got an A with consistent effort. It's not as bad as people say, especially with a good instructor like her.
Prof. Woodrum is a good chemistry teacher with a very structured course. Cons: Makes you work in teams and is a bit nosy.

Absolutely amazing. She is extremely sweet and is always happy to explain things. I loved the way her class was set up, but I can see how some people may not prefer it. I always felt more prepared for exams compared to people with other professors. 10/10 recommend taking her for 105 and 107!

Woodrum is the reason I continued with pre-med. I have adhd and SEVERELY struggled in gen chem before taking her. She's an excellent professor: Simplifies content in her notes and lecture and assists you until you understand. She'll never make you feel stupid for not understanding. Some other chem professors need to take notes from her.
She was absolutely amazing! She really cares about her students and makes traditionally difficult concepts extremely easy to understand.
Expect A LOT of play posits. She's a good professor, and she genuinely cares, but I didn't like the teaching method she used and thought it wasn't that beneficial to me.

Honestly it was really unfortunate because she was a good professor, but CHE 107 is set up for failure it feels.  The exams were purposefully made harder if too many people got a good score, which was frustrating.  But, I truly believe she cared about her students and was passionate about teaching.

She was a really good professor considering the subject at hand.  I am just not a personal fan of the flipped classroom method so I struggled with fully grasping all the material, especially since it was my first time ever taking a chemistry course ever.

Although Chemistry is always a hard course, Dr. Woodrum was by far the best Che professor I have ever taken. She will always help you when needed and explains concepts very well. It's best to watch lecture videos outside of class and focus on applying the concepts you learn in class. By far the vest chemistry teacher at UK, TAKE HER!!!!

Great lecturer and human. This course is set up in a flipped lecture style meaning you watch the lecture videos before coming to class. In class, you work in groups on worksheets that further your understanding of the subject. She makes the topics as easy to understand as it gets. Go to her office hours.

Dr. Woodrum is by far the best chemistry professor for gen chem. Shes very caring, explains concepts well, and easy to talk to. Take note that her class is structured so that you will work in groups of 4 to complete a worksheet, so try to group up with a friend. Gen chem is an incredibly hard course so try to get her or Dr. Nunez.

Chem 101) She's a sweet lady but her teaching style wasn't for me. She throws you into graded assignments BEFORE she lectures about it. Was an unstructured whirl of group projects and hundreds of little homework assignments. Could see why she's popular but I personally felt like she ran the class like a 5th grade class. Not for everyone.

She doesn't really lecture in class. You are supposed to watch videos and do practice problems in class, but they are always the easiest problems, so mandatory class really feels like a waste of time because you don't learn much. But, the video lectures are helpful. All practice in class is done with groups, and she does a lot of group work.

Dr. Woodrum has a flipped classroom style. The canvas looks pretty daunting because she assigns up to 5 video assignments for every lecture but they aren't hard, they're just a lot. Take lots of notes on the videos because that's what you use in class during groupwork. She explains things well and has TA's walking around during lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I had a really difficult time in CHE 105 with the professor I had so I was really worried about 107 but she is absolutely amazing. Try to take her over anyone else. Her flipped classroom style is extremely helpful and she really does try to make sure all her students understand everything to the best of their ability.

Kim Woodrum is an absolute godsend of a professor/human. She is the kindest lady ever and really wants her students to succeed. You watch lectures outside of class time and work in small groups during which is really helpful. Definitely take her for 107 if you have the opportunity!

Woodrum's lectures were interactive and easy to follow. You learn everything with videos and then go over the information in class. The in class work was extremely helpful with understanding the subject. Studying for the exams is a big deal, but if you watch the videos and do the homework you will do fine.

Her class is a lot of work, and lectures are done though videos. Class time is spent practicing material learned in the lectures. She does lots of group work and has several TAs walking around the class to help students.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Woodrum is by far the best chemistry teacher I have ever had. A lot of people say this class was challenging, but as long as you are willing to do the work, it will benefit in your favor! Practice exams are exactly like the tests, so look over those. She always mentions the times of her office hours, so she is very invested in helping you succeed!

Dr. Woodrum is an amazing chemistry professor, take her chemistry section if at all possible! She does give quite a bit of homework and in-class work, but doing these assignments will really help students understand difficult concepts and be successful on the tests. Don't skip class if possible and engage with the lecture videos and you'll do fine!

Dr. Woodrum is nice enough, but to be frank, this class was hell. The homework is unfathomable, all 6 of my other classes put together still didnt have as much work as my CHE105 class did. Dr. Woodrum is not open to helping you out grade wise. During one of the exams, the wifi cut out and my whole class lost 15-20 mins of time we didnt get back.

Professor Woodrum is very friendly and easy to approach. She is probably your best option if you HAVE to take chemistry. Chemistry is a very difficult course, and ALL the material is taught outside of class through pre-made videos. Exams are especially important in this course, as they make up almost your entire grade so make sure to not bomb them.
she covers everything so clearly and makes sure every single one of the 200 kids in lecture understands before moving on
Best 107 professor. Covers the material most thoroughly. Take her if u can.
Woodrum is the best professor for gen chem 2 you can have. Sweet, explains things well, and I always feel well prepared for exams. Will miss her!!!

Dr Woodrum is an amazing teacher. She is really understanding and cares for her students. If you like flipped classrooms, this class is for you! We do a lot of helpful group work in class, and the homework is difficult, but helpful. Overall, a really great teacher
Different way of running classes in my opinion more effective.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: During lecture, there are group activities that help you work out problems you do not understand

I took this class by itself during the summer because I heard it was hard. I am awful at online classes. Unfortunately I don't learn well that way. I tried so very hard because I really needed this class. I hired a private tutor from UK to tutor me 2-3 hours 7 days a week for the weeks leading up to the final. I felt really confident then fail

Kim Woodrum was the first good experience I've had in the chemistry department at UK. She is very caring to her students and created great videos to help the students learn during our virtual semester. BE WARNED! This is a hard class. However, I 10/10 recommend you take Woodrum to get a good grade in the class.

Positive, friendly attitude and makes you feel like she wants you to understand the material. If you're having trouble email her and go to office hours!! She likes to see students at least try and then she helps out. Her lectures are clear and easy to follow, but its still a chem class so you have to put in the effort.

Dr. Woodrum is wonderful. She cares about teaching learning strategies rather than the chemistry alone. She is always available after class for questions on homework, has lengthy office hours, and is overall just the best. Super sweet lady, will go out of her way to make sure you understand. Would recommend her to anyone who needs this class!!
Dr. Woodrum is an angel. She is one of the best chemistry teachers I have come in contact with. She describes the material really well and does a flipped model class when it is an online class.

Woodrum is BY FAR the best teacher in the chem department. Ive struggled with chem in the past, but i finally get it with her teaching. She is so kind and actually explains the concepts in a way that makes sense. If you have the option to take her I would definitely recommend it over the other options.

Kim Woodrum is a godsend in the UKY chemistry department. Extremely friendly, non-intimidating, and helpful. The class itself is very difficult but she does her hardest to make sure all her students have all the resources to succeed and she is more than happy to hold additional office hours to help. 10/10 would take her again and would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: TBH not sure why she's rated so highly. Horrible tests. I had 5 friends drop it bc it was so hard. however, she replaces your worst exam with that section of the final (the only reason i got a B). Also beware bc she smacks her lips before every syllable and it drove me crazy. she's not a horrible person tho, j a horrible class and a hard grader
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: a pure angel.

Dr. Woodrum teaches mainly through playposit videos rather than in lecture, but her class does have mandatory attendance. The playposits are for a grade which is super helpful and are very informative and easily understood. She is very funny and easy to talk to which makes office hours really helpful.

the group work in class (no lectures in time for class) is always done usually by one individual, so the rest of the group does not get any work or experience and she doesnt seem to respond clearly to that. online videos are good, but sometimes you can't access them at any time and the questions are you grade, you dont understand you fail

She is so sweet and it's funny when she cracks a joke and laughs at them. She goes the extra mile by making videos for us to watch and take notes on. It's very easy to find most of her notes, videos, and homework online once you get the hang of all the technology she uses. I'm so happy to have her again for CHE110 next semester.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This is by far the best professor I've seen here at UK. In high school I struggled with Chemistry a lot, but with Ms. Woodrum, it is like a breeze. She understands that students struggle and will help you if you don't. Her lectures are online and you do practice in the class. She makes things a lot easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Woodrum is a great professor. She has easily made chemistry more enjoyable for me. You can really tell that she really wants her students to succeed and that's important when it comes to college. She's thorough with the material and easy to talk to. Glad I have her next semester again!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Mrs. Woodrum is such a good teacher, I didn't ealize it until I took a different chem class. She makes the material easy to understand and makes lectures for this boring material bearable.  Just show up to class, ask for help, and use your book to reinforce the material and you'll do fine
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Woodrum is a great professor overall. She posts her lectures online before the class so when you get into the class, you just work on what was went over in the lectures. The lectures aren't that long either. 20 mins max. She's funny in person, but she likes to spring quizzes on you the day before the quiz so you have to cram studying.

Dr. Woodrum is a great professor. She goes into detail about everything we need to know for the exam. She is always willing to help her students and she's probably one of the best professors in the department.
Dr. Woodrum is a very helpful and willing to work with you one on one professor, as long as you also do your part. If I were to retake CHE 105 I would take her class again without a doubt!
I am so glad I took Dr. Woodrum for CHE 105. She really cares about the students understanding the material, and her notes are GREAT. I would recommend her 100%!

Chemistry is hard no matter the teacher. But Woodrum makes it as easy as she possibly can. She is super funny, and gives a mini "break" halfway through her lectures to allow you to get up move around so you're not so bored. She's also very helpful if you go to office hours. Taking her again next semester.
The class is going to be hard no matter what, but Dr. Woodrum is very helpful and tries her best to describe everything in several different ways to help you understand.

His lectures are incredibly boring and disengaging. He does not provide any kind of study guide for his exams, and when asked what we needed to study he simply said “everything”. His voice is incredibly monotonous, and he would need to leave class every 15-or-so minutes to have a coughing fit. Not much homework, but lectures are hard to remember.
Super sweet man. Happy to help outside of class if you're having difficulties. Boring and long lectures. Exams are online. Attendance is not mandatory. Would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The dude is so incredibly interesting. On the off chance that we were actually talking about astronomy, he won't bore you with the science but rather the significance. You'll hear a lot about how old he is, his dog, and other random facts or memories. Yea the lectures are boring, but he manages to make them so chaotic. 10/10, very entertaining.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very funny and sweet just not a good professor to take an online class for
Wonderful teacher, genuinely cares if the class understands the content.

PSY195 required little effort to pass with an A. As long as you attend class and complete the 1-2 assignments per week, you'll be fine. Prof Knoll is very kind and relaxed when it comes to class and due dates.

Class isn't "mandatory" but he does take away things from the slides so you have some desire to go to class. The class was pretty boring in the sense that we didn't do anything outside of reading from the powerpoint but lab was super fun. Exams are difficult if you don't study so I would suggest coming to the review days in class and studying.
Has a chill personality, funny, ended lecture early everytime

He gives out a study guide before each exam, and the exams reflect that very well. He includes a lot of fun stories in the lectures, and all of the assignments are easy to follow. Would highly recommend.
Dr. Knoll I think did a very good job at trying to make such a bland and boring topic interesting! I would highly recommend him!
One kicka$$ professor and very accommodating.

Dr. Knoll is a good lecturer. He is young which is nice, and his teaching style reflects that. Easy class, test heavy though and must go to class. Lectures can get pretty boring but Dr. Knoll tries to engage when he can. Good professor, would definitely recommend, easy class with him.

Lectures, readings and an assignment due every day. Must participate in at least 8 discussion posts and mandatory labs which add nothing to the content of this course (busy work). Exams are difficult, must be taken on lockdown browser and study guides are useless (if you even get one). Grading is tough. AVOID THIS CLASS IF ITS CONDENSED!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Knoll was a kind person but pretty strict when it came to attendance, especially with the study guide... He most likely will not give you the study guide if you miss the day, regardless of the reason, even with a doctor's note. Be sure to have a friend in class since he has not uploaded the study guide.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is really particular about missing class so make sure you are prepared if you miss class but I really loved his class!

Really easy class. Minimal homework and the content isn't that bad since most of it may just be review of things some students have already learned. He has a lot of good examples for the terms and concepts learned. Tests are multiple choice and easy. He is pretty chill and wants his class to do good and learn as much as they can.

Dr. Knoll is a great person and you can tell it, unfortunately though this class is extremely boring. All we did was slides and notes. If you have to take this class try and enhance your experience by participating in group discussion.

Although I thought a lot of the content was boring, I really enjoyed Dr. Knoll as a professor. He did a great job of explaining topics and would give a study guide before each exam. Lab was pretty easy. I would love to have him for a another psych class!!

Professor Knoll is amazing, I took him for my retake of PSY215 and he did an amazing job at explaining topics. He used IClicker for attendance and it went toward your grade but he truly is an amazing lecturer and professor. The textbook is online and through your tuition, but it was helpful. I hope I can take a class with him again!!

Really laidback and nice guy! Very few homework assignments. Gives a study guide before each exam so you know what to expect. The lab portion is super easy, just a group project/presentation about a mock experiment. As long as you put in some effort there's no reason to not get an A in his class. Would definitely recommend!

He is one of my favorite professors, but he moves very fast. Sometimes we would get through 30 slides in one class. He would only sometimes post the slides to make sure you were present in class, but if you reach out to him, he will help you out. He is very understanding and makes easy exams if you prepare for them.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: By far the best professor I've had at UK. He taught so well and made it to where if you paid attention in class, you were going to pass with a good grade. I absolutely adore him.

Dr. Knoll is a really nice man, but his lectures can be very boring, especially if you've taken PSY100/PSY216. A lot of the material is review, which makes exams very easy. No homework, but there are worksheets & a final group project in lab. Attendance is graded. He's willing to go over exams with you during office hours, which is super sweet:)

Dr. Knoll is a pretty great professor! He's funny and nice, and definitely makes the subject more interesting and easy to understand! Attendance is definitely mandatory. The textbook is helpful but not required. There is a group project in lab but it's not too bad. The 4 exams were pretty easy for me, as long as you study for them you'll do good!

Super approachable, stays after class so you can ask any questions. Gives no homework. Only 4 tests throughout the semester and offers a non-mandatory class the day before to review everything that is going to be on the test. Helps you find lab opportunities as well.

I would recommend taking notes on computer, he moves fast and won't go back until end of class. Attendance is necessary/part of your grade. Lectures are typically about 20 slides. The exams are not extremely difficult, but hard to cram into your brain. Go to his class even on the optional day before a test he will give you topics to study.

Experimental psych is boring but Dr. Knoll makes it super fun. Go to his office hours, they are so helpful. He will tell you that ready the book is not necessary, however reading the chapters and doing the practice tests got me an A on every exam. Very kind and understanding. Never gives homework other than in lab.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Knijff was an amazing teacher! He talked almost exclusively in latin, but this type of immersion is what helps you learn the language faster. He was really helpful and although he expected you to put forth the time to learn the material, it was just an amazing class.

Extremely enthusiastic. He loves the material and encourages students to do similarly. If you ever need help he's more than willing to help you. Pay attention and come to class and you'll ace the class no problem.

Wonderful professor. Genuinely wants his students to get an A and to learn. Will help you as much as he can and make everything crystal clear. If you pay attention and work hard, there's no reason why you shouldn't get an A.

Easily the worst experience I have had in all of my years of school with an instructor. His lectures were the most disorganized, scrambled presentations I have ever seen. In addition, there is no way to study for his exams as the little you do get out of these lectures will not be featured on the exam. AVOID ANY CLASS BY HIM AT ALL COSTS.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class was easy and very manageable. The canvas page was a nightmare for the online section though. Overall, not too bad.
