reviews.comment: He's VERY old fashioned. His canvas page is completely empty and he basically just talks at you and hopes you're paying attention. If you don't go to class, there's zero resources to help you catch up on what you missed. He does not post lecture slides so if you don't attend class and write down everything he says, you're screwed.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class and professor is a joke. He does not present information, he just talk's at you hopes you retain information. Tests are nearly impossible because the slides don't have information, only pictures. If you're looking to take an elective, do not take his classes.

Yeah, he seems super nice and funny and I like him as a person, just not a professor. Its all super confusing and he gets side tracked quite often. Tests are hard, and powerpoints rarely have any info on the other than pictures so If you wanna go back and study what you learned, good luck.

He seems like a great guy, I just wish he wasnt a professor. He goes on constant side tangents and pretty much just talks about stuff that interests him. Is horrible at communicating what is on the tests, which is a MAJOR flaw because the tests are 80% of the grade. He is way more interested in research than teaching.

Very confusing lectures. He's kind of funny, but then you get to his tests and realize he's just been making jokes and not really teaching you anything worthwhile. He'll often go off on meaningless tangents. Likes to flex his physics knowledge, but often messes things up. Missing one assignment will destroy your grade. Just avoid him.

Knauer has a very dry sense of humor which made class entertaining. He would often go off on random tangents that were hysterical. He obviously knows what he's talking about but that doesn't necessarily translate well to students. As long as you go to class, take goo notes, and study hard for exams, you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Knauer is a terrible teacher in physics, the worst teacher I've ever had. His tests are handwritten and messy. They are clearly written right before and he gave problems that we hadn't even learned how to do yet. Extremely disorganized person and oblivious to his terrible teaching skills. It's impossible to know how to do well in the class.

Nice guy, class wasn't of much interest of me but I personally thought he was interesting. Really loves astronomy but isn't necessarily the best professor. I wouldn't take astronomy unless you really love it. I found a way to make a B but it was pretty difficult.
Excellent prof.  Funny and very interesting.  Was always personable.

I rarely skipped class because it was in between two other classes in my schedule and I had nothing better to do than to go. As time went on the number of people that showed up went from about 75 all the way down to 10, it was ridiculous. I am glad I went to class because his online notes sucked and the book was trash. Go to class & pay attention!!

Worst teach I have ever had. He clearly knows his stuff but can not explain what he is talking about. I never knew what to study for the exams and his lectures are kind of entertaining but hard to follow. Like many others have said if you have to take AST take Troland!

He is a pretty terrible professor. Enthusiastic about astronomy but that's all. It seems like going to class only adds to confusion because test questions are unrelated to lectures. Studying is useless because it's impossible to know what will be on tests. Avoid any classes he teaches. Everyone I know who has taken him feels the same. Ruins gpa's

He is a mean, cold person who is openly rude. He refuses to actively interact with students because he thinks he is above it. His lectures are very hard to follow and have no logical pattern. His powerpoints are random and sometimes even irrelevant. I would sell my kidney to get out of his class.

I took Mr. Knauer's physics class this summer. For the final exam, half of the comprehensive material was over 6 chapters of text that he covered in a week and a half. He is not a fair teacher, hard grader as well. Take someone else if you can, you will regret it if you dont.
Mr. Knauer is the worst teacher I've ever had in college. He grades ridiculously hard and does not give partial credit for anything. Do not take this professor ever
Worst teacher I have ever had at UK. The power points had nothing but pictures on them that weren't even relevant to the course material. If you want to take an astronomy class take Troland!
He seems nice and is kind of funny but he is an awful teacher. You have to teach yourself in the class by just reading the book. I would not recommend this teacher.

Nice guy, cracks jokes. But his tests cover large amounts of material that he did not cover in class or assign in readings. I found it really hard to know what to study. I would not take this class if you have a choice.

I'm not sure why people haven't liked him, personally, he is my favorite professor this semester. He cracks jokes that always lighten the mood and make Astronomy 191 fun. He definitely knows what he's talking about, and is always willing to explain or clarify things if you need him to. Definitely have learned a lot from his class.
this guy is probably the worst teacher i have ever had. his lectures are not helpful and he expects you to know 9 chapters of the book for each exam. DO NOT TAKE HIM!

He obviously is knowledgable about the subject, but he can't seem to get the point across clearly during lectures.  His test questions were always so vague, and in a completely different context than what he had taught in class, which got to be a little confusing.  Overall, he's okay, go to lectures and read the book, go to office hours too.

I think he's a nice guy but his class is impossible. I didn't go talk to him til right before the final and I think he gave me a better grade because of it but you  have to go to class, it's hard, very very hard and prolly talk to him if you need help but if not necessary DONT take this class.
He is nice. But, he is not a good professor. His powerpoints don't explain much, you cant hear him in class, and his tests do not really reflect the material. It is one of the hardest classes.
He is very confusing, and most of the stuff on the test is uncovered Its one of the hardest classes i have taken here
This astronomy class was hard, and he seemed to enjoy the fact that he was way over most of the student's heads.
One of the best professors I've had. She's super sweet and understanding. If you're planning to take wrd definitely try to get into her section!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: She is very nice and pretty easy to talk to, but she is a tough grader. She also never specifies what is needed in presentations, and she will deduct points for every little mistake

She is a good person to talk to, but every big assignment I submit, there is always something that needs to be changed. Whether it is something small, like changing the thesis slightly, or having to rewrite the paper over because basically it's not good enough. I would not recommend taking her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Prof answers questions/emails promptly with little regard to tone or professionalism. Assignment comments are usually productive but on a “bad” day, borderline degrading. Enjoyed the material, but felt extremely uncomfortable in class.
She was a great teacher. No complaints. I recommend taking her class.
Very nice and not super nitpicky when it comes to a lot of things. As long as you make an effort you'll do fine in her class.

I genuinely don't know what I am doing wrong, but it just seems like every assignment I submit - there is something negative to say. I could write my little heart out and this professor will tell you its not good enough, or will be extremely nitpicky about word count and other writing aspects.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is the best and most involved professor that i have had all year. I highly recommend to take her class. She gives great advice and actually wants to see her students achieve.
very nice professor and cares about her students. I recommend taking her class.

I LOVED Professor Kohls! She was very caring and understanding of students' situations, needs, etc. She had great lectures and really discussed how to actually write the different types of papers in her class. I really loved this professor. Just put in the effort and you will get an A.
She's so sweet and caring
Very easy class over the summer! She is very accessible and answers all questions! She understand technical errors can happen and that people have lives outside of school. 10/10 recommend!

Writing makes me nervous but Ms. Kohls made us feel supported every step of the way through detailed guidance, availability, and extra flexibility because of COVID. Of course, the lectures are pretty boring, but they're short and she tries to make them as interactive as possible. Not an easy grader, but not difficult either.

The sweetest prov I've ever had. Kind, very accessible. Exams are modified hw questions or bookexamples, and they're open book, so if you know Wangsness well you'll do fine. hws were DENSE but closely matched lectures, so if you read the questions before lecture, you're good. Known to curve grades up for students who are clearly putting in effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This material is hard, which is expected at this level, but his lectures aren't good and match the textbook examples and explanations ~1:1.  He chose a textbook that matches Jackson closer than Griffiths and doesn't provide any additional support.  The homeworks are so hard, and the exams are not much easier.  There are 11 assignments and no MOE.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Korsch is tough but he is the sweetest guy in the department. His exams are hard and his homework is near impossible alone. This class will be a time-vortex, so START ON THE HOMEWORKS EARLY. Exams 2 and 3 are open-book, so make sure you have a physical copy of Wangsness' EM and really know that thing cover to cover.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Korsch is a super smart professor who cares about his students and the material. The course gets progressively harder as you move through topics, as does the hw, but doing the hw is how you'll learn best. He also posts solutions. Exams are a bit easier than the hw, but still hard. Just work with your peers and read Wangsness and Griffiths.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He is very funny and really good at talking. He talks a lot and is lecture heavy. Read the textbook and do practice problems and you will be fine.
He makes lectures interesting and its easy to pay attention. He moves quickly through a lesson, but does several practice problems with the students afterwards. I enjoyed his class

He keeps the whole class interested in the lecture. He wears the same sweater a lot with a hole in the right armpit. Also, he wears nice butt pants and always has casual thursdays. He is extremely helpful outside of class, just don't get caught texting because he WILL call you out. KNECHT IS BITCHIN'

Knecht is extremely helpful and entertaining. The exams are written collectively by all the professors that teach the course so the difficulty of the exams are his fault. He presents the material effectively and prepares his students for the exams.
Great great teacher.  He's very funny and makes sure everything is understood.  He held review sessions before all of the tests on his own time.  Take Knecht -- he is top notch

Good professor. Kept it interesting in class and taught towards the test. Take him if you can. He was always willing to help outside of class and even demonstrate homework problems. Good teacher for a hard class.

He kept it interesting with witty jokes and comparisons to life that made certain things easier to understand. BUT he will make you feel dumb for asking questions and he doesn't explain things as thoroughly as they should be explained. I began attending Dr. Woodrum's class halfway through the semester and found her teaching to be much more helpful.
Great professor!!!
Explains concepts well
definitely the best teacher to get for chem 105! he wsa hilarious and makes chemistry very understandable. favorite teacher of the semester.
Good teacher. Made things interesting and only taught what was need for the test.
he would've been a great teacher if chemistry wasn't such a pain
Only buy book if you plan on doing the problems for each chapter or plan on reading it.

Other than my Chemistry Teacher in High School I never met a teacher who could teach chemistry so well. It was a great and fun way to learn. The test are the same from as other classes and I found myself scoring higher that students with other professors. Even Woodrum. Easy Class, Fun Environment, Take Knect and you will like it.

Excellent. Cleared any doubts I had about my abilities to do chemistry. I felt very confident going into the tests. There were very few times I felt confused in class but reading the textbook cleared everything up. He puts his personality his lectures, makes you laugh, and keeps you interested. Highly recommended

I easily got an A in this class, NOT because it is easy, but because he is a good teacher. I think he explained things very clearly and answered our questions well. He tried to make the material as interesting as possible. I always felt well-prepared for the tests. He's also funny at times. I thought he did a great job teaching us
He is very helpful.  He is also very funny and makes a dull class fun

Loved Dr. Knecht! CHE105 is NOT an easy A, but he makes it enjoyable. Very willing to answer questions in class, by e-mail, and always has his office door open to help. Before test his office is filled w/ students that he's reviewing w/ and answering questions for. He seems to really take interest in his students. I'd advice taking him!
He's hilarious.
Needs help with organization and needs to cover more of the right content instead of giving us random facts that he likes to talk about.

Dr.Knecht was the best teacher I have had at UK! He is very helpful with a subject that is hard. He is willing to do whatever it takes to help you, he will even stay after hours to help with homework. He is a wonderful teacher and makes things interesting!!

He is a very good professor.  He is clear and does a great job at trying to help students understand the material.  He is nice and very approachable.  I really liked having him and would recomend him to anyone who is taking chemistry.  He will make it easier and even enjoyable.  He is one of the best professors i've had at UK.
No Comments
Dr. Knecht is teaching for the first time but he does a wonderful job. He is always available for extra help and he's nice to look at too!

The advanced lab course is very independent, but Dr. Kovash supports the experiments by answering questions or providing hints as to what may be wrong. The manuals can be very long and scattered, but the general idea is always there. Assignments are mock research papers on the experiments, and he grades them very fairly, even if your data is poor.

reviews.comment: The man is a terrible teacher. He clearly knows what he talks about but cannot express it to anyone for the life of him and it almost feels as though he is merely lecturing to himself and seems to be upset when someone is confused or did not grasp something. Be prepared to learn on your own and then hope for a large curve. 50% is normal for tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Worst teacher I have ever encountered. stay away. He rarely goes over examples in class. On the rare occasion that he does, he just shows the answers rather than working the problems out. If you ask questions in class he is demeaning and discourages future questions. Stay away if you can. Unfortunately I had no other option.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He skips steps on problems. His lectures are hard to follow at times. His exam averages are around 45. If you ask him a question in class, he says "think about it" and doesn't answer any more than that. I'm sure he's a nice guy in real life though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Kovash does a great job with PHY 2. Its a content heavy class and its hard content, but he does a great job explaining the content that we had time to discuss in class. He is accessible outside of class and is very understanding. Great proffersor, rough class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I'm typically a B student. But to give you a good representation on this class, the best test score I made was a 59. And I got a C in the class. It's one big I-dunno. Read the book and use ClutchPrep before exams. Also, sit close. He whispers when he lectures.

I really enjoyed Kovash's class. I made a B during midterm, which was tough to pull up, but overall felt as if he was a great teacher. I hate that everyone else on this page didn't like him- he seemed pretty genuine to me. You've got to give more effort as a student. It's college!

Personally, I had no problem pulling a B in this class. Kovash isn't helpful at all, but his grading wasn't too bad. A lot of the work I did was in groups, and if you can connect with some people in the class you'll be fine. Kovash will refuse to answer even the most reasonable questions, and he doesn't lecture, so the book is your best friend.

Unfortunately, if you're a Physics major you HAVE to take his courses (335-535). And for that I am so, so sorry. You will curse the day you chose to be a Physics major when you take this joke of an "educator." If you study rigorously and then merely ask for clarity, he will publicly insult you. 100% invested in watching you fail.

I have yet to actually complete this course, but thought I would leave a review to state that this isn't because of the teaching!  Expect to pay attention in class and give ample time for homework, and don't be fooled by the low credit hour marking.  The professor is clear and gives plenty of opportunity for office hours!
Apparently feels better when he's shown how easy it is for him to do problems, and how difficult it is for students to do them.
This guy is a joke. Your typical never will be as good as he thinks he is and takes it out on someone he has control over.
Grades of a curve, regardless of the number of students or the quality course work. Even if the class is full of A and B-level students, some of them will get Cs and Ds.

Makes the courses he teaches extremely difficult. Other professors in his department are more understanding when people don't understand things and are willing to help and teach the courses way better.

BEWARE! If you have zero prior Japanese knowledge, you will be spending /at least/ an hour on work almost every day. The class is extremely fast paced and there is no room for falling behind. That being said, he is nice enough and pretty patient. If you don't understand a concept, he will explain it with examples. Class exercises get repetitive.
Tanno is very good at making otherwise complicated content digestible to beginners of Japanese. He's very accessible and willing to help anyone who needs it.

Tanno sensei did very well teaching the basics of Japanese. Most activities are fun to do and you get to know lots of new people in class through these activities. Out of my entire schedule, this class was the most enjoyable class of them all. Would definitely recommend!

Tanno-sensei is a good teacher. Pretty funny. JPN 101 is a hard class and expect to do a lot of homework and studying. But, if you put in the work you'll probably be fine. Class is mostly conversational based.  Strongly recommend you have some knowledge of Japanese before you take the class. Will make it so much easier and more enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Such an amazing teacher, and was always so excited for the class when we understood lessons quicker than he thought we would. As long as you stay on top of your work, this class is a breeze, just be ready to be called on during speaking activities to answer a question or repeat a phrase!

He lectures well but he's extremely vague when giving directions. He will gladly tell you that something is wrong and tell you to re-do it but not give you directions on what to correct. He loves to cold call on people all class so if you have anxiety, I would not recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dima was a very nice person, helpful if asked. I didn't really understand what he was saying a lot of the time but he had PowerPoints with all the important points. There were 2 tests, a midterm, a paper, and a group project. Overall, I didn't spend much time if any outside of class studying or working on assignments and still did well.

I am a 4.0 student and this is the only class I have ever had to drop. Dima seems like a lovely person and you can tell he's very interested in the content of his course. Unfortunately, he is extremely quiet and practically whispers in a very thick accent. The group assignment in this class was the most stressful thing I have ever done. Beware.

reviews.comment: very quiet mumbler. I thought if you did the readings on your own you should be able to keep up the class fine.

reviews.comment: The lectures are very boring and very hard to follow. The only grades in the class are test grades. Does not give clear answers and does not go in-depth even when asked. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very knowledgeable about the subject, lectures may be hard to follow only if you are not paying full attention. Pretty lenient grader which is good for how little he grades. Read what he assigns, go to class, and study just the same as any other class, and you will be good.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

Wait and take international relations with a different professor.

reviews.comment: Good professor if interested in the class's subject, but hard to understand if not paying full attention to class and taking good notes. If you do the readings you will probably be fine. Tests are pretty hard
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I enjoyed Dr. Kozlowski's Class. I remembered I missed a couple of assignment's in her class. She opened them up for me. If you can't finish any assignments within a deadline I recommend you reach out to her.
This instructor is horrible, do yourself a favor and take absolutely ANY other instructor.

you can miss 3 classes before your docked a letter grade, my senior level profs arent even like that. more of a liberal arts english course than a WGS. thought I was going to get an A, probs getting a C and losing scholarship money��dont take this course im so upset I spent money on this. read 3 books, never learn about actual WGS. not worth it.

reviews.comment: Very discussion based, not tests or quizzes. There are short writing assignments every once in awhile, but it consists mostly of two projects that aren't bad. I would take it again definitely!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: MaryAnn is probably the worst teacher I have ever had. She grades ridiculously hard and throws in random assignments throughout the semester. If you aren't a feminist, you probably wont get along with her.

MaryAnn is AMAZING! She really knows her facts and is very passionate! You read 3 books and discuss them and then write a short paper on each. No tests, but she expects you to talk and participate in class. The class typically gets very involved in popular culture and is always open to sharing stories and discussing news. She's a true feminist. (:
Amazing teacher and a great person, too. Would absolutely take this course again!

Honestly my favorite teacher I have had while at the University of Kentucky. She actually cares about her students and she's passionate about teaching the class which helps you get interested also. She post all the readings online and you only have 6 or 7 assignments the whole semester and there isn't a final.

Loved her as a teacher! She helped make class open and very comfortable for talking about some touchy subjects. Show up and do the readings, which she provides by email or can be found easily online, and you will get an easy A. Course is interesting and she is very helpful when you need it.

I took Dr. Hains for CLD 230 and she was a great professor. I learned more in her class than many other CLD courses I've been in. She presented material in a very digestible way and you can tell she has a lot of expertise in leadership and theory. She grades very fairly and clearly states her expectations for assignments, making it easy to excel.

Dr. Hains is one of my favorite professors! She is very well versed in the field of leadership and her expertise is super insightful. She cares a lot about her students and their wellbeing and is always willing to be a resource for them. Dr. Hains provides information very clearly and at a reasonable pace. I would definitely take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: She is a tough grader and will NEVER take a late assignment, no matter the excuse.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tests were extraordinarily difficult and nit-picky. Most of the tests were fill-in-the-blank and very specific to lecture material. She did let us have a notecard for the exam, but without that notecard you'd definitely fail. She also never responded to emails, but was easy to talk to in class. She was friendly enough, but I wouldn't take her again

Dr. Hains is quite literally one of the worst professors that I have had since being at UK. She rambles on and on about various power points during class, but none of the material she lectures about is on the exam. She grades exams and presentations very harshly, she is inconsiderate and she is not understanding of absences due to emergencies.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Hains is great but the class wasn't very interesting (had potential though) Show up to class, do the reading and you will be just fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Hains is amazing. She has a bad reputation of being harsh, but she has a no BS attitude. She isn't there to be your friend, she is there to teach. She has been my mentor for a couple years and I have learned so much from her. If you want to earn your grade and actually learn, take Dr. Hains! I can't recommend her enough.

The title of Doctor must've been handed. With no real clear instructions, she tends to grade very harshly. Will assign the same thing every week, and will grade it differently every time no matter the specifics you use. One could add every term into a concept matrix and she'd still find something wrong with it. The textbook is unusable and vague.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I really didn't mind this class. There was a TON of reading and you had to know your stuff. All the tests are open book but they are way harder than it seems. We got to work in groups all semester which was nice. But be prepared to read pages and pages every week. She makes this class a lot harder than it should be in my opinion.

Her last name is Hains now. Talks more about her ex-husband than class material. Your 2 exams are worth 30% of your grade, but she doesn't actually teach what you need to know for the exam in your lectures; the average grade in our class for the first exam was a 50%, and she refused to curve it. Do. Not. Take. Avoid this professor at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: It's Kristina Hains now. Miscommunication, clearly told us on the 1st day that all exams were open book, she even explained that we could print out the notes or use laptops during exams. Two days before exam 1 she said those "words never came out of her mouth", she also tripled the length of a paper from 3-5 pgs as in the syllabus to 10-15 pgs.

I really enjoyed this class. She is not an easy teacher so if you want an easy A don;t bother but her class is so interesting and she is a wonderful teacher. Great discussion and examples in class as well.

This class was so much fun, we worked in groups and had lots of useful class discussions. Open book tests + group tests and assignments. We used the books a lot too. It was a very interesting class. if you work it makes it more interesting because most of the topics are about organizational structure and leadership.
Favorite professor in college. Great real life application and open ended communication. Amazing professor!
Awesome
Great new format. Very interactive, we not only learned a little but helped with real life application. Only class I was upset that I missed all semester. Genuine.

Tought class, not sure why she made it that way as it is undergrad. Very difficult midterm & final - all short answer, essay format. Lots of major projects/work to do! Can only miss two days of class, then you lose points.
she has no idea what she's talking about
For an elective, very hard! Final consisted of a 150 word vocab test and a 4 page single space paper. Avoid if possible
She was a very good prof! Her class was easy, and exams were all online. I really enjoyed her class. Attendance is mandatory to get a good grade, but her lectures were very interesting.
Easiest class for uk core

One thing to note is that this class is offered at 8 am, which is not the easiest time to get up for, but a class that is worth it. Dr. Krizova is very knowledgeable, which makes the lectures entertaining and engaging with useful information. If you like psychology or learning more about relationships in total, I would highly recommend this course.

I took this class to cover a gen ed credit and it sounded better than any other options. She truly cared about us and put our best interests at heart. She was the nicest professor I've had this semester. The work was interesting and wasn't overloading. Would absolutely take her again.

Katarina is amazing, and the content for FAM 250 is very interesting. There is not a lot of work in this class and it's an easy A as long as you show up for class and complete all of the assignments. Not a tough grader at all.  Attendance is taken and it is an 8:00 am class. Would take her again for any class.

This class is great to take but I only missed a few classes and it brought down my grade and this teacher was super understanding but did not help to fix my grade, so it is mandatory to go to class. The course itself is easy as long as you show up and don't miss a single class.

reviews.comment: Very fair and understanding. I very much enjoyed this class. 100% would take this professor again.
Sweetest professor ever. I loved her lectures and she was so understanding. Any class you take with her you will love!
Great class for my 8 am. Easy grader. A lot of extra credit.  Some Zoom meetings. Will change the due dates of assignments if needed. Great lectures. 10/10 teacher.

HIGHLY! Recommend. Professor Krizova was a phenomenal lecturer, and a very easy grader. She was very caring, and handled all of the topics in her class so well. She also offered tons of extra credit and often extended deadlines just because she forgot to remind us of the upcoming assignment. Amazing class, amazing professor.
ton of extra credit, pretty hard not to get an A, a lot of it is common knowledge
Super sweet woman. I would recommend attending class because content is easier to understand when you hear it explained in class. She is very caring, very lenient, and the class is super easy.

Kristel is an amazing professor who exhibit an excellent sense of empathy and quality of teaching.
With more homework from this class, I got a chance to learn more about entrepreneurship skills and know how to use it in my future.

Kudos to her!
Uses a combination of methods and tools to teach entrepreneurship.

Super easy class so far, all I will say however is that the homework is really tedious and annoying, and we have spent the past month conducting interviews that just feel like a waste of time. As someone who aspires to be an entrepreneur I am so far very disappointed with this class and uninterested in taking anymore entrepreneurship classes at UK.
Online classes are always challenging but she always replies to emails and grades assignments quickly.
Attendance is mandatory. But materials could be taught to yourself. Waste of time. Exams/ essays are nothing like content.
Didn't learn much. Material was unoriginal and unchallenging. Professor was mean to students and dismissive of questions. DO NOT TAKE HER CLASSES IF YOU CAN AVOID IT

Dr. Krajny was one of my favorite professors ever. She's very personable, easy to talk to, will answer any question you have. Show up to class tho as attendance matters. But honestly you'll learn from her and she's very real. Hats off to Dr. Krajny
Easy just show up
Dr. Krajny is amazing! She requires attendance so thats the main thing your grade is based on. Her class is really easy as long as you show up.
Though professor
I loved her so much, her classes were always so much fun. She presented normally boring material in fun and exciting ways. I would absolutely take her and this class if you have the opportunity!

Very to the point professor. Very informative, understandable, and useful lectures. Attendance is mandatory because there are very little assignments. 10/10 course. Would take again. All teachers need to be like her!

Shelly Krajny is simply amazing. She is super understanding and always flexible. Even asynchronously online, I feel like I learned a lot from her class! Shes definitely on my list of favorite professors at UK!
The class was online but she graded stuff quick and kept me engaged
Loved her. Best ever
have her right now. she shared a really personal story with us recently and it honestly stuck with me for a few days. means a lot to have professors like her who are real and honest like that

reviews.comment: Here class was awesome! She is by far the best teacher Ive ever had at UK! Take her if you can! You wont regret!

reviews.comment: Take her if you can. even in 3 hour night class she's amazing

reviews.comment: I have her right now for KHP 509. Honestly one of the best classes I've taken. She's so honest and real. Take her if you can
She is so funny and awesome! This class is so easy and you will forsure get an A if you show up and do the few assignments that she assigns.
She's awesome! She's hilarious and makes class fun! She's serious about attendance, but class is so easy! Would for sure take her again!
I didn't really like the class but she is awesome. If you have to take intro to fitnes take it with her. so fun
great for online
My schedule forced me to take this online over the summer but she was so great! grades everything really fast and is easy to get ahold of by email
She's great! Definitely take her. She's nice and so funny! Attendance is important though
She is fairly new here but take her if you can. great class loved having her

reviews.comment: I couldn't find her on here all of her reviews are from when she lived in Ohio because she's new to Kentucky but I had to add her. She's SO fantastic!! The best instructor I've had so far at UK. Take her if you can

She is awesome and this class doesn't take much effort at all. Just show up so you get participation and pay a bit of attention and you can get an A. She is extremely kind and will help with any questions. Really enjoyable class material if you're into AG.
She is an amazing teacher. She is super flexible and this class is quite easy. I would recommend everyone take this course as an elective to help your GPA and the course is interesting.
Krista is an amazing professor who is compassionate to her students and passionate about her department and college.

Dr. Jacobsen is the best professor Ive ever had the pleasure of knowing! Her classes have taught me so much more than I ever thought possible, and she truly loves what she does and only wants the best for everyone around her.

Krista Jacobsen is without a doubt one of my favorite college professors of all time. She is compassionate, willing to work with you, and you can tell she really loves her job. I would take her again in a heartbeat! Seriously, take her classes!

This is without a doubt one of the best teachers at UK, the school should be proud to have her on board. Makes class interesting enough that you want to pay attention, without having to have the threat of an overly challenging exam. DO TAKE HER CLASSES. you won't regret it.

Krista is by far the best professor I've ever had, and I've had MANY. She cares so much about her students, and likes to make things fun and interesting. This woman is incredible. She had made my time at UK much more enjoyable.
This was a great class and very interesting as well. Lotsa fun and a good mix of people! Krista is a good instructor.

This was a very interesting class.  I learned a lot about the topic of sustainable agriculture, and got to meet quite a few interesting people that she brought in for guest lectures.  Was a pretty easy class, but one that I enjoyed to come to.  Had a diverse group and I got to see other points of view as well.
Best teacher i've had so far at UK. She challenged me and I learned about about a field that I previously was not interested in. Definitely recommended

Hands down my favorite course so far at UK, didn't have too much of an interest beforehand but her teaching style was great. She expects that you've completed independent research outside of the class, but thats fine b/c she made the course discussion based rather than a lecture. She's definitely recommended for any Honors Program courses
Very interesting class on introduction to sustainable agriculture. She is very clear and helpful with just about anything. Kentucky should feel lucky to have a professor like her. One of the Best.

He has not been an effective advisor for graduate students. He provides limited and unuseful guidance. His supervision is unclear with sometimes swearing, giving vague direction about research focus. He frequently changes his expectations, even in the final months leading up to students graduation, which creates significant confusion and stress.

I felt that the quality of instruction was not equal to the tuition I paid. Throughout the semester, the explanations were usually unclear, which impacted my ability to fully understand the material and contributed to my final grade of a B. I believe the department should consider reviewing the instructor's teaching ability.

The grading is ok but the quality of teaching is subpar, which doesn't justify the cost of the tuition. I worked with one of his graduate students on a carbon capture project for about month, and they mentioned that he doesn't offer support for ideas. everything he cares with his staff is doe/netl. therefore, no graduate studies with him for sure.

The subject is like this crazy rollercoaster of difficulty, but our professor - Easy peasy. But get this, during our group project presentation, he was just chilling there, eyes glued to his phone like it is the latest Netflix series or something. So, multitasking on a whole new level!
very difficult to understand his talk, his english is not good.
Amazing professor, very professional and caring!
She is one of the best mentors anyone could ask for.
LOVE HER. Made all her content easy to do and understandable. Favorite class of the semester

Grade consists of weekly quizzes from readings and reports every 2 weeks, but the only "hard" part about the class is waking up at 6 AM. The quizzes are easy if you read and there are bonuses. The reports (while sometimes frustrating because of Excel) are generously graded. Easily the nicest teacher I've ever had in college, highly recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor. Makes class interesting, clear presentation of material, and is consistent. Definitely take her class if you can.

ECO473G with Dr. Kusunose has probably been the best experience I've had with a college course in my three and a half years of attending the University of Kentucky. She has cut out regular homework assignments and exams, which I applaud and encourage other professors to do as well, and has instead replaced them with more engaging reports & quizzes.

Dr. K is awesome. Her lectures are super interesting and I really enjoyed going to class even though it was an 8:00AM. The workload is reasonable and she's very approachable. I would definitely recommend her.

such a lovely woman! she cares so much about what she teaches and is very fair in everything she does. weekly quizzes but you know what the questions will be. She is so friendly and tries to make an 8am engaging. loved this class first professor i liked enough to go to a not mandatory 8am class.
One of the best professors I had at UK. I really enjoyed this class. The material was interesting and I learned a lot. I definitely recommend this class and professor!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT--Would take again

reviews.comment: I had Dr. K for Food Policy, and she is hands down one of the best, if not the best, professor I have had at UK. While her class requires you to put forth some effort it is very rewarding and you learn a lot. Dr. K is also extremely passionate and knowledgeable in her field. Take her if you can, great professor and truly inspirational.

Dr. Kusunose is funny, sweet, and overall a good teacher. She explains material very clearly and does not give busy work. She does have weekly reading quizzes but she gives you the questions beforehand. There are also reports but she's a fair grader and always answers questions. I really enjoyed her class and even learned some things.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. K is so sweet! and very approachable. She requires a lot of reading, (weekly reading quizzes over assigned readings) but is a fair grader in other aspects. No exams, just reports due every other week, and a final group project at the end. Very down to earth, and interesting in lecture.
She is awesome! She's a lot of fun and very smart. Taking her class was great, and it isn't very difficult at all as long as you read. There are weekly reading quizes but no tests.
Best prof I ever had! This woman is amazing.
Dr. K knows her stuff with this course. It is not too hard but requires a lot of reading.
Very confusing lectures.  Dr. K needs to do better and explaining the concepts of the subject she is lecturing.

I liked Dr. K's class a lot. I felt like she presented the information in a very systematic way and took a personal interest in us as students. Some the word problems on her tests were tricky, but she gave out lots of bonus points. A very doable  A

First time teaching the course, she really needs to get better with teaching the course. Everyone in the class struggled taking notes. Would not reccomend taking her now. I'm an Econ major, and struggled in her class!

Max is one of the most enjoyable characters I've ever had the chance to learn from. He's not only a very articulate lecturerhe also puts the students ahead of the syllabus and even rewrote the final during quarantine for the sake of students struggling with remote learning. I've learned a ton from Max's classes. He even brought us pie on pi day!

Max is the actual best and anyone who disagrees doesnt value quality teaching. He is patient to answer dumb questions, detailed in his lectures, passionate about the material, and thoughtful in giving homework. His knowledge of the material and the time that he takes to prepare for this course is evident in his teaching. Plus, he actually cares.
Max is brilliant! He doesn't just lecture, he tells us a math story. I really enjoyed going to his class. He is a great guy, too. I think that you will enjoy learning from Max.

Max is a really great professor! He made the content easy to understand and was very helpful in office hours. Very laid-back and easy to ask questions in class. He also puts all his notes online after lecture. Takes attendance every class. Works a lot of examples and is very organized with his notes. I recommend taking him if you can.

Max (yes, he doesn't like to be called Dr. Kutler) is pretty laid back and easy to coexist with, which is nice given the difficulty of the class. On the surface, he seems a bit stuck-up and somewhat of a know-it-all, but do go to office hours; it'll change your views of him. In class, though, he's very focused on getting through the lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: You teach yourself the material and if he doesn't like the way you do it, you get a zero on exams. Exams are so hard and he HARDLY gives partial credit. Do not recommend.

Doesnt really teach the material. Expects you to know what hes supposed to be teaching. No chances for improvement on tests. Highly suggest to have some background of calculus before taking his class.
He is a horrible teacher. Doesnt show you any examples and basically makes you teach yourself

If I could, I would rate this prof a 0. He is the worst professor I have ever had the misfortune of taking. My junior year, all the classes I took left me no choice but to take his section of MA 114. If you have a choice whether to take him or someone else, TAKE ANOTHER SECTION. I taught everything to myself with kahn academy.

His lectures are very boring and he makes many mistakes so it is difficult to get the correct information. There is no graded homework. We were not given the option to not have quizzes so we had a quiz every day. Don't worry though because if you put anything in either question you automatically get a 3/10. Prepare for many 3/10's.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Avoid Kubota like the plague. I had to drop the class due to his poor teaching Students pick if they want quizes, when exams are, and can ask for hwk extensions. Sounds good but he will teach over your head and is awful at explaining it. Chegg couldnt help with the hwk. Its paragraphs instead of questions. Take with someone else, its working for me
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Kubota really challenged me this last semester. There are daily quizzes over material that we are not clearly taught.  Different sections emphasize on different topics, but there is only one exam. Kubota makes many errors on the board as he teaches and never gives examples. He means well and is very nice, but is not a good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: LOOK you run this class. You don't have to go to class. He curves the exams great (36 points for our first one). If you just want to get by the class and not learn a thing hes the guy. Don't take him if you want to learn. DON'T take the quizzes. My stupid class made me and it has hurt my grade dramatically.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Don't have to go to class, he sucks at teaching don't pay any attention to anything he teaches. But the plus side is you can talk him into anything, he always gives extra time on the homework. But he won't fail you

He's a nice guy but he is absolutely horrible at teaching. He is extremely slow, vague, and you basically have to have a PHD yourself to make any sense out of what he's saying. It's hard to see that the lectures, quizzes, homework and tests in this class are even remotely connected.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Kubota is a nice guy. He is willing to help students at almost any time and will schedule "problem sessions" per request. However, there was homework due every class and it was required to be typed up. The homework was all proofs, and we did not say the word "determinant" until the last few weeks of the semester. I spent 10-12 hrs/wk on this class.

You've probably read what other people here have to say about him. It's true, it's all so true. My MA471 (advanced calc/real analysis I) class started with 25 people and ended with 3. However, he is very nice if you talk to him.

The class was 100% read the textbook, homework (5 proofs due every class), and maybe 1-2 days later get a lecture on the section we had already turned in homework for. Expect to do more more than any other class you've taken
Run. A terrible teacher with very little structure to his classes. Homeworks are very difficult with little support coming form the lectures.

HW was assigned every class and worth 66.66% of grade. Often it was over content not yet taught in class. I spent about 15 hours a week on this class and barely eeked out an A. Take matrix with a different professor: he makes an easier math class into a super challenging one. Determinants are avoided at all costs; for that matter so were matrices

First of all, Dr. Kubota is one of the nicest professors around. Be ready to spend time in his office, because he teaches at a level way above the student's comprehension. Reading is essential for passing. The entire class is proofs.
He is horrible. Run away. Don't even try it. Run fast. I  good at math and I had problems with him. I switched sections and now have no problems with cal 4. He is horrible and won't even help you

I am a good student, and a math major. This was the hardest class I've had at UK, and not because of the subject. It was because of the teacher. All the learning I did I did from the textbook or from Kahn Academy- not from Kubota. Class, the book, and the homework are all different. He makes no sense. Worst math experience at UK for sure.

This class started with 30 people, and has been whittled down to five unfortunate souls who can't drop the course.  As one of these five, I can only offer this advice: Avoid Ken Kubota. He's an incredibly kind person, but he will teach way over your head and decline to explain the necessary elementary details of the subject matter.

Well it was a hard class but I ended up with a B.... don't really think I learned anything, it looked like it was going to be awful so I made it pass/fail (so getting a b kinda sucked...) It was his first time teaching the course, and he made it very hard, but in the end he went easy on the grading. So it wasn't that bad in the end.

Absolutely positivity never NEVER EVER take a class with Dr. Kubota. I mean it. Don't do it. Just drop the class on day one and add a new section of the class. Trust me. Worst prof I've had at UK so far, and it's not even close.

DO NOT TAKE KUBOTA FOR ANYTHING EVER. If you walk in and he is your teacher stand up and walk out. He is the worst teacher I have ever had. Impossible to understand, teaches like its a grad course for a computer science major. AWFUL AWFUL TEACHER
Homework and exam material are not covered well in lecture, get more use out of doing problems in the book. The problems he assign are overly complicated.
This is guy is a rockstar and he keeps it real everyday with his big head. However he's a pitiful teacher and i went to maybe half the classes because he's about as boring as it gets.
Got an A in MA113 (Calc I). Got an F in MA114 (Calc II). Thank you Dr. Kubota.
I STRONGLY suggest dropping the class if you have this professor. Not only is he impossible to understand, but his tests are ridiculous. He is by far the worst professor at UK.
The worst prof. at the school.
Good luck following the lesson

Took him for matrix algebra fresh out of High School and got my first B.  As most other people are hinting, he teaches a bit above the level he should, which is the real problem - it is quite obvious that his biggest problem is that he thinks he's either teaching a class of geniuses or graduate students.  He's a nice guy, but do not take him.
terrible class...this is not ma 109...this is insane math that no one has ever heard of...do not take this class...
RUN.  JUST RUN.

It is supposed to be regular college algebra, but its not, its calc. and its really hard. DO NOT TAKE IT WITH KEN KUBOTA, he is the worst teacher ever. Cant understand him, does not help at all, cant teach at all. The worst ever. DO NOT TAKE THIS COURSE WITH HIM.

This class was the most horrible class I've ever had.  All of the homework is online and makes absolutely no sense at all.  This class isn't a fair one.  All of the other Ma 109 classes are actually learning Algebra, we are not.  The Mathskller tutors have no idea what's going on.

By far the worst teacher I have ever had. He can not teach, he doesn't understand the questions you ask him and if he does understand your question you won't understand his responce. Just do yourself a favor and find another teacher or you will have a horrible semester.
You can't understand anything this guy talks about and don't try teaching yourself from the book, because there isn't one, he wrote his own book on the internet and it is just as bad as him
He was awful! You can't understand him and the whole course is on the internet. Dont bother buying your book he tells you that you don't need it.  Awful teacher.

I couldn't understand him in class, couldn't understand his lectures, and don't even bother reading the "textbook" he wrote online...I sure didn't understand it.  I went to class everyday, and went to tutors who also could not read his "tex

Can't understand a word he says. all the homework is on the internet and it's difficult to learn about asymptotes on the Web. I got a D because I didn't understand the web pages and when I asked him for help I couldn't understand him.
She teaches well. Actually learned a lot from one of her projects.
She is a nice teacher. I enjoyed her class.

She gives you handouts that follow the powerpoint, but you have to fill in the blanks so you must go to class.  Doesn't really have a great grading system and the end of the semester gets crammed with final and projects plus new material.

Lecture, recitation & lab are all grouped into one class so there is lots of padding for your grade. He is a very kind professor and clearly loves to teach the class. Exams allow 3 attempts per question and you'll get your grade back right away. His lectures can be a little confusing but he does a lot of practice examples which helps for exam.

Ng is a goated professor. You get 3 attempts on every exam question and the exams are just like the homework. There is a lot of homework for each exam but he prepares you well. an 80 is an A like Ng youre sent from heaven above
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. NG is very knowledgeable about Physics. He shows Passion towards teaching and his students. Truly a very sweet guy. I would rank him higher but for me he was a little hard to understand at times.

nicest man on campus. I hated physics, but I enjoyed listening to him. He's a funny dude and really loves physics and cares for his students. If you don't cheat on the homework, you'll do just fine. *0 and above is an A.

One of the easiest classes ever in my opinion. As long as you can do well in the lab, you're basically guaranteed an A; just know how to read and use Microsoft Excel basically. I believe that exams are taken directly from homework but have different numbers. Make friends with the person you sit next to in lecture, trust me it will help :).
Love Ng. He is OG. Nicest guy on campus. Solid professor if you pay attention. Tests are pretty easy.

Dr. Ng is a very kind and funny professor. He is clearly very passionate about teaching physics and does what he can to make students enjoy the class more. There is a ton of homework but it prepares you for the tests well. I didn't enjoy physics but I wouldn't have wanted any other professor. I would definitely recommend Dr. Ng!!

Dr. Ng is a great professor. He is very obviously excited to teach and will always prioritize his students. He makes sure that the class understands concepts, and is extremely approachable after class or during study hours. The class is a lot of work, but if you just pay attention to the lecture and do the homework, you should do fine.

SO nice and funny. Weekly home works that are long but doable. Exams are cake but the final is by far the toughest exam and a huge shock. I only had a B because I had a tutor. If you're willing to put some time in, you'll do fine. PS it says on his syllabus he upgrades borderline grades but he told several people I know no so don't bet on it.
Decent at teaching. Lecture doesn't always match homework well. There is a lot of homework and it is quite difficult.

NG is an amazing professor very sweet man. Homework and exams are weighted the same, but the exams are fully online and only 6 or so questions. He also drops your lowest exam score. Really great professor definitely try to have him!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I enjoyed his class. There were times when he spent too long on one concept, but overall it wasn't too bad. Homeworks were very long, and worth as much in the gradebook as our texts, so if you take this class please please please don't leave them all for Friday. Tests were not very difficult, but still required study.

He was very sweet and always made lectures enjoyable. He clearly knows what he is talking about and if you do homework and classwork you should pass. He rounded my grade up and is generous with dropping tests and homework.

Dr. Ng is very passionate about physics and you can tell during lectures that he loves talking about it. I didn't find the lectures super helpful, but went for attendance. You need to focus on the HW and ensure that you can work through the problems since the exams are exactly like the HW problems. Take this course with a friend, if you can!

NG is hilarious and his lectures were clear and informative. His tests were very similar to our homework problems, and he allows you three attempts per question/drops your lowest test score. The only thing I wasn't a fan of was the homework, which was always very long and had some pretty difficult problems.
Definitely take professor over Martin. He explains things well and he accurately describes what's going to be on his exams.

He has an accent that can be a little hard to understand sometimes. My class was not curved at all so keep that in mind. The exams were pretty much exactly like the homework so just make sure to actually do it. Also the final exam is way harder than you think. Overall he's not bad.
I love Dr. Ng. He's a ray of sunshine and he curves the hell out of the class.

Dr. Ng is a great professor.  Very passionate about physics and clearly enjoys what he does.  His exams are typically problems that we've done in class or in recitation, but be sure to study the homework.  He always has a smile on his face while lecturing, and it helps that an 80% is an A.  I'm glad I took him for PHY 211.

Professor Ng is hilarious, and he's more passionate about Physics than I previously thought possible. He has a very heavy accent and occasionally I had no idea what he said but he always had a big smile on and made everyone laugh. You probably won't learn anything but at least you won't be miserable. He also rounded my final grade up from 79 --> 80

Exams are worth very little percentage wise so you don't have to worry if you mess up one. Homeworks are worth a lot and tests are basically the same as homework questions so as long as you can do the homework you should be good in his class. As the semester progresses his teaching style becomes annyoing as he spends the whole class doing 1problem
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great teacher and is obviously very knowledgeable and passionate about physics. Pretty funny so his class is also fairly engaging. My only issue is that he very often goes over time, but his teaching is very good.

Ng is the best PHY 231 professor on campus. He has a personality and a smile that makes it so you can't not enjoy his class. The hardest part is the homework, which is worth 35% of the grade, however if you can do the homework, you should be able to nearly ace the exams, which are a lot easier. Passing in PHY 231 is a 50, so passing is pretty easy.

Dr. Ng wasn't a bad professor, but I didn't find his lectures to be valuable. The exams are random HW questions, so make sure to go over those rather than your notes from lecture. Grading scale was by 15, but there was another 211 course that went by 20. If I were to take the course again, I would take the other professor.

Omg Dr. Ng is the sweetest professor Ive ever had. He teaches from the slides and uploads the hand written work for the problems after class. Majority of the PowerPoint slides are homework problems. Make sure to do the hw because the exams are just 5 random homework problems. You take the exams on a computer in person. 10/10 I would recommend

Ng himself was a decent professor, I am really bad at math so I never had a clue what was going on. The TAs for the lab were so mean and I constantly felt stupid leaving them. The recitation TA was so nice and would help with anything including homework.
The exams are very similar to the Homework. If you know the HW then you will be good. He is so nice and funny during lectures. and He has classwork, but they are easy points.

Dr. Ng is a great teacher and PHY 232 will be hard regardless of who you have but he'll do his best not to make it horrible. Granted, I took the class online due to covid (spring '21) so it may be different in person, but his tests very much reflect the homework and the homework does come from what he teaches. You know, the way class should be.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Take Professor Ng for physics 2 if you can! He is very helpful in office hours and wants his students to succeed. Really caring and friendly guy and always has a smile on his face. He's your best option if you want a good grade in the class. Exams are exactly like the homework.

Take this man if you get the chance. Tests are homework problems. Some people complain about a lot of homework, but it's mostly different forms of the same type of question. There are a lot of ways to get points to bolster your test grade too. He really cares about your success and if you are willing to put in the work you will learn and pass.

In PHY 160 an 80% is an A! Professor Ng is a great guy but could be hard to understand sometimes during lecture. If you put in the work for this course you will be fine! Just make sure to go to class to get your points and try to understand what is actually happening during the labs instead of letting your group members carry you. You will survive!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: THE CLASS WAS ACTUALLY PHY 160!! First time taking physics so this was not an easy course. He is hard to understand, he wants to help but ends up just being confusing! He told us you could easily get a C, and no one wants that. good luck :^)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Professor Ng is a fantastic professor. He always has a smile on his face and teaches the concepts thoroughly. The HW was very difficult but the tests he created were based greatly on the HW. As others have said, a 92+ is an A to begin with but he rounds up so that the top 15 get an A. In my section, at least an 89 was an A. Great class/rewarding

Dr. Ng always has a smile on his face & obviously knows the material, but isn't a good prof. You spend so much time on homework that you can't really study the notes or text to get concepts. Luckily, tests are based off homework. An A is a 92% and he will only curve so that the top 10% get an A. Most difficult and un-rewarding class I've ever had.

Dr. Ng's teaching is clear and concise. He'll teach you what you need to and that's that. It's awesome. Also, he wants his students to succeed. Just utilize his office hours and he's more than willing to help with any misunderstandings.

I had him for physics 1 and 2.  He's a great guy.  Always has a smile on his face.  Always willing to help out  outside of class.  He doesn't go into very specific details in lectures; he generalizes ideas a little too much.  But if you put in time outside of class you should be fine.

Good lectures (does a lot of examples). Lots of homework expect to spend 3-4 hours a week. TheExpertTA is a great system though. If you do the homework, you'll ace the tests.  Slight accent but completely understandable if you're paying attention. Take Calc 2 first if you can. The more math background you have the easier the class is.

If you have this professor, anyone you tell will say that they feel so bad for you. His homework is sometimes so hard that graduate students at the Study can't help. To get an A you have to get a 92% even, and even getting a B as a studious student seems very difficult. He doesn't curve tests with points, even though the class average was a 64%.

Dr. Ng is a great person, and wants to see you succeed.  If you go to his office hours he is willing to help, and explains things a little better than in lecture.  The problem is, he is a TERRIBLE lecturer. He is unclear, and his lectures usually only cover very broad, unspecific ideas.  Then the homework and test are nothing like the lectures.
Decent professor. Accent can be difficult to understand.

For the first week or so he is very hard to understand, but then you finally start to get his style. He uses WebAssign for hw, which isn't that bad except for being due every 3-5 days. Gives in class assignments which count for participation and attendance. Recitation quizzes come straight from hw. Exams are a little tougher than expected.
Good man.

Professor Ng is one of the nicest people I've ever met. He cares a lot about his students. He usually writes sample tests before each test to help students prepare. His tests are pretty straight forward and not too tricky. Sometimes his lectures are a little confusing, but it's important to go to class to answer the clicker questions.

Kwan Yi was a great professor for EDF 204. The class consisted of weekly online work and we only met once a week in class in which he would spend the time helping you with your assignments. He is an easy grader and is always willing to work with you. He offers easy extra credit throughout the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT--Would take again

reviews.comment: When you need help, he is always willing to be there. There might be a little language barrier but it is not that bad. He is a nice person and a great professor. He is very organized and is a good online professor.

Gives you very little time to complete his online quizzes and tests, especially when you have to reread his questions multiple times to understand what he means. He never gives you a straight answer, and would not admit that his lecture notes (and therefore some of his quiz questions) were wrong because the book says otherwise. Also, I'm slightly p

I took the course online. There was a bit of a language barrier, so sometimes you have to reread things to really understand them, but overall it's fine. He's a nice guy, and if you come to him with a problem he'll go out of his way to help you.

I don't know if it was the professor or the class, but almost everyone in my class was completely lost the whole semester.  Twice he had to extend assignments because no one understood, even when he tried to explain what was going on.  If you have an opportunity to take anyone else I highly recommend it.
He was a well organized teacher. I believe he has revamped his instruction a bit and is much improved.  The only problem was English, which is sometimes hard to understand.

Yi ran a very organized class.  He posted weekly modules and readings, then gave discussion questions based on those.  Quizzes were straight-forward from modules, as well.  His final exam was of reasonable difficulty, and he was pleasant.

Prof Yi is the worst prof ever.  He needs to learn how to communicate effectively in order to teach this course appropriately.  If this is a core course necessary for obtaining the master's degree then I think UK needs to reevaluate how it is being taught.  This class ruined my perfect GPA and I am not even sure how when assignments weren't graded.
Grammer mistakes in his PowerPoint slides that made it difficult to understand material. Difficult to take online.
Professor Yi does not need to be teaching, especially the online courses.  He is very unclear and he is tardy in posting items to Blackboard.
really good teacher who knows what she is talking about and actually cares about her student. class is actually interesting and you only have 5 assignments the whole semester.

The class is super easy, but worth it. I love teachers who are fairly young because they're still in touch with their students, and she's definitely one of them. She's passionate about her work, entertaining, and a great resource if you go to office hours.

Dr. Kwakye was an amazing professor. I had taken a lot of GWS courses before, but she really helped me to look at things from a different perspective.  The course was engaging and the reading materials were interesting although I didn't really need to buy all of them.

This class is awesome. Dr. Kwayke is one of the best professors at UK. The class material is super interesting and not difficult whatsoever. Readings aren't necessary except for recitation (GWS 201). One test (which is online and easy to use your notes on) maybe two papers max. Lectures are fun and Dr. Kwayke is very opinionated and sarcastic.
Just an overall not great professor, although the class is not difficult.

She is a super easy professor, rarely gives homework and all exams are online. She is bad at giving lectures and goes off topic all the time. She will also really try and push you to add classics as a minor if you don't already have it as one.
She is really nice and wants you to succeed in her class. She will do whatever she can to help you understand and assignments she makes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: She is awesome!
She is very quick to respond to emails and very helpful. The modules are organized well. The tests are the bulk of the grades. Flashcards are a great way to study!
Very nice professor who cares about her students. I've had two of her classes, about to be three. Has good methods, would take again.

Dr. Manning was very prompt in responding to emails, and the units were structured very well. The material was easy to learn given her outline of the course, and by following the recommendations she made I got a 96% in this class. I'm a non-traditional student and hers was the first class I had upon returning to college. 10/10
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: The class wasn't too bad. The only things that are graded are the quizzes and exams, so all the other assignments posted are just busy work that don't actually matter. The exams are worth a lot of your grade, so make sure to study beforehand.

Dr. Manning is such an angel. She is one of the most caring professors and truly wants you to succeed in class. Don't be shy to speak in class, she loves the students to be engaged. The material can be hard to understand but it is very interesting and she does well explaining it. Would take another class with her in a heartbeat!

I was shocked to see the bad reviews for Dr. Manning. I loved her and the class and this isn't my typical subject. She is so caring and easy to reach. She spent a little too much time on announcements and housekeeping at the beginning of class but the discussions were great and she definitely values students' opinions. Pretty easy grader too!

Lots of busy work that fills up your canvas calender that you don't even have to turn in which was very annoying. Besides that it was very easy, you can look up every single assignment and exam because nothing is on lockdown. She's a little odd but super easy class online

this class was easy; only thing required is a "quick check" for each module. every once in a while we would have a short discussion, but maybe three times throughout the class. there is four exams (weighted heavily) but not on lockdown.

the class I took was asynchronous, so she didn't really teach but just assigned chapters to read and take notes on, your whole grade basically depends on 4 exams though, but if you do good on them you will do fine with the class.

Dr. Manning is very sweet and cares about her students. Most of the exams are online and very easy, plus she gives you multiple attempts. She is not strict with deadlines, so if you are interested in greek mythology you will do well. I will study a minor in classics because of her. Also you don't have to buy any books, all the readings are online.

Lectures were pretty boring and there's a lot of assigned readings for homework. As long as you did the course work you could probably get an A. But I reiterate there's A LOT of assigned readings. Recommendation: If you don't have a passion for Greek Mythology and are taking the course as a core req. take something else. For your own sake.

All I can say is, DO NOT TAKE A CLASS WITH DR. MANNING. She does not care about her students and would rather let them fail than help them out. This class is also way harder than it needs to be especially considering it's a 100 level course. I will definitely NEVER take another class where Dr. Manning is the professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Manning does not teach a thing. The class was asynchronous, and she posts a list of topics every week that you're expected to research and take notes on yourself (with no clue what information is important for tests). By exam 1, you're expected to have researched and memorized 120+ topics to take a closed-note exam. Also an awful communicator.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I took CLA331, but that wasn't an option on here. I would suggest you never take a class with this woman. She is horrible at communicating. Several times I emailed her and she either didn't answer my questions, or gave completely unhelpful nonsense as an answer. Attendance "isn't graded", but then she makes in class discussion 35% of the grade.

Dr. Manning is by far one of the worst professors I have ever had. I took CLA 131 last semester with her and she did not answer my emails and when she did they were always snarky or passive aggressive. Her class is only based off of 4 tests, but never fear, you can get up to .5 bonus points if you take her syllabus quiz. Unless you have to, don't.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Manning is so sweet and I loved taking this class with her. If you show up to class, stay engaged, and do the work, you should have no trouble in her courses. She’s very understanding and works hard to ensure that her teaching methods are effective for all students. I am looking forward to taking more courses from her!
Assignments arent hard at all. She is so nice and caring! Very quick to answer to emails.

This class was very difficult. Its online and only based on 4 exams, so no way to get your grade up unless you do good on all exams. You have to teach yourself from the book and even that doesnt help with the questions on the exam. This definitely isnt an easy A. She doesnt go over anything that will be on the exam so youre all on your own.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: There is only 4 exams in this class which makes up your grade so you do not have any other opportunities to boost your grade unless you do well on a test. There are no notes only your text book reading multiple chapters for a test. Not even half of what you read will be on the test.

Our grade was decided by four tests. There were no quizzes or assignments. There were no lectures either, so given the fact that we were teaching ourselves the material straight out of the textbook to prepare for 50 question tests, it was unenjoyable. I reached out multiple times for help but she was VERY rude and sarcastic in her email responses.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: There are really no lectures at all. You basically have to learn everything yourself. The whole class is made up of four exams. I would not take this if you are wanting an easy A. Only time she said anything to us was with the exam was coming up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She was a decent teacher. She was not the clearest when describing assignments. I learned a lot about the subject. The only hard part about her class was the 5 page paper we had to complete, she was not very helpful during that process. She makes you think, which is good. She can have an attitude sometimes but it's easy to ignore.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Does not know how to read the room. Treats all students as though they are 18 year old freshmen. Hands-off approach, four "tests" no lectures. Emails telling you to read chapters, then tests. I thought it would be interesting, I was wrong - I could have read the book on my own and learned more.

EGR 103 is way too much work for a 2 hr class but Dr.L made it the best she could. Even she agreed that there was too much on our plates and did the best she could to help. She is very kind and will help as long as you ask and try. Go to her office hrs if you are truly lost. I would have gotten an A if I didn't have late work. CHOSE HER SECTION!
