Love her! 103 can be chaos due to the often vague assignments (which she has little control over), but she is very considerate. She cares for her students and their wellbeing a lot! She understands students have a lot going on and that we are not always provided the best stuff and can be very lenient when reasonable.
I love her she's my goat. Be ready to walk into live music concerts performed by her. She also tells really interesting stories about herself. She's the best.

GET HER AT ALL COSTS. Professor L has a ton of personality and is truly passionate about teaching engineering. Only reason I didn't get an A was cause of late submissions. Turn everything in on time and you will get an A. Was excited to go to class every time and I didn't go a single class without laughing or smiling.
Such a nice lady who teaches engineering from experience and will help you at all costs. Shes one of those teachers who clearly loves students and teaching in general.

I would take Dr. L a million times again if I could. I had her for EGR 101 and 103. You can tell she truly cares about her students and is VERY approachable. Her office hours are 5-7PM in Pigman which is convenient. She encourages "being adventurous" unlike other profs and is very lenient if you actually show that you care. She is the best!
Awesome professor and even better person. Would recommend her over anyone for 101. Super easy and made the class worry free.
Very kind professor. She has amazing stories to tell and lectures are good. She is honestly just limited by the time given to her. Very caring, good office hours

Professor L was absolutely amazing last semester. She was always ready to help and was so understanding if you ever needed extended time on an assignment. The homework in her class was very easy, as it was only 1 assignment a week. Some took longer than others, but I never spent over an hour and a half on any.
Professor L is the goat 101 professor. The class is hard for the first few assignments but gets much easier as it goes on. She's very understanding and very accessible for help with assignments.

Professor L is the best professor I've ever met. She inspired me to go after my internship goals & stick with engineering. Lectures are hilarious & she always let my class out early because it was on Friday. The class is difficult at first but go to open lab & you'll understand much quicker. It also gets much easier halfway through. Best 101 prof.

Best professor ever! Highly recommend taking her. Prof L cares a lot for her students and it shows. Accessible outside of class and would do her upmost to help you and the team. The project deadlines can be stressful but Prof L is understanding and would move stuff around. Definitely go talk to her if you're stressed.

The absolute best a professor could be, I truly wish I could have more instructors like her. Everything we cover is addressed efficiently and there is more than enough help from the office hours and open lab hours. I cannot thank Professor Letellier enough for her help.
I had Professor L for both EGR102 and 103. She does a great job, and you can tell that she genuinely cares about her students.

Dr. L is one of my favorite professors in the engineering department. The coursework in EGR101 is relatively easy for the most part. Her lectures are helpful and she's always willing to help answer questions. Aside from being a good professor, she's also just an interesting person to talk to with lots of cool experience in the field of engineering.

Professor L is the best prof I've had at uky so far. She's the first one I can tell actually care about us as individuals. I don't think it's possible to do bad in one of her classes if you put in good faith effort. The course was confusing at times but that was more the college's fault than professor L's. Overall amazing.

Letellier is so funny and extremely sweet. She let me turn in late work from the beginning of the semester and helped me get my grade from a D to a B. Her class was tough, but she will answer any questions you have. She is very easy to talk to in her office hours and makes connections with her students.

Super nice and very approachable. Also a very easy grader, so you probably will get an A without stressing too much as long as you do all the assignments. Usually assigns about one, maybe two, assignments a week, so not too much work. Connects with students and genuinely wants you to succeed. One of my favorite UK professors so far.

AMAZING!Best EGR 103 Prof. by far! She's so kind, funny, and accommodating. EGR 103 as a class kinda sucks but that isn't her fault at all. She teaches it as best as possible because the project can be hard. Make sure you get a good group and don't be afraid to get help from open Lab, office hours, or the innovation center. If you can, get Prof. L!

Genuinely one of the best professors I've had, occasionally her instructions are hard to follow but she is so easy to ask questions to and will always give extensions for anything if you just ask! Wonderful and caring professor, have taken two of her classes and would absolutely recommend her!

Professor L is amazing! Her story is really cool and she is one of the smartest people I have spoken too. She makes class fun. The first 2 ish weeks of EGR 101 are hard but after that, it is a breeze.
I absolutely love Professor L! I'm not staying in engineering, but her class was always enjoyable and I always look forward to it.
Love this professor
She isn't a great lecture and doesn't go through the assignments like other professors do for EGR 102. She is a great person, but you doesn't give a lot of direction on the assignments.

This entire class revolves around a single group project, Professor L doesn't actually teach a ton because it's not needed. She's nice and cares and has a corny sense of humor, not good with tech though but that's ok. Get in a group with people you like and this class is something to look forward to.

Professor Letellier was very funny and kind in my EGR 102 classes. She would often come down and sit with my table while we were working and just chat with us about life. She cares about her students and is very knowledgeable in her area of expertise.

I enjoyed Professor Letellier because she was always making sure we were attentive and entertained during class. The class was very easy and she was exceptionally accepting of absences if she is notified and given a reason as to why you were missing class.
Professor Letellier is such a nice and caring person. Her class was a little frustrating as she didn't go over much that was applicable to assignments, really had to rely on TA's for help.

Professor L is one of the best teachers I've ever had. She is super sweet and caring, overall an amazing person. She's extremely understanding when it comes to work and really wants you to succeed. Makes boring classes fun. Truly one of the coolest people I've ever met.
Professor L is the goat

Best Professor Ive had so far- shes very fair and values the effort you put in. If you do your best you can definitely get an A. If you do better than the assignment requires she gives extra credit. Shes the only Professor I would come to for advice outside of school. Does a great job grading group projects.
Very friendly, you can tell that she really cares about her students.

One of the most genuine people at this University, had her for multiple courses. Very down to earth and knows how it is, her classes are not difficult and if you are struggling with something go to the office hours hardly anyone does so you can take advantage of the 1on1 instruction.
Letellier is a really interesting person who cares for every student she teaches
Loved her so much, she helped me out a lot when my group for EGR 103 wasn't helpful. Seriously one of the best professors at UK.

LML is a lovely woman with lots of knowledge from her lengthy engineering career. I love her as a person, but I think the class structure affects people's opinions, considering how unorganized EGR101 is. Oftentimes the class will feel pointless, but LML tries to make it interesting. Great professor, terrible class, but at least it's an easy A.
Great teacher and really enjoyed having her class

EGR 101 is a really easy A if you pay attention and watch the lectures. Prof. L is a gem, one of the best Professors at UK. I actually looked forward to going to this class every Friday. I wish all professors could be like her!

Professor L is the sweetest, she is super genuine in wanting to see her student's succeed and is not afraid to comment on her cheesy and corny jokes in class lol. She is awesome and a fun teacher to learn from!
Dr. L, I couldn't emphasize this enough, she's just simply the best. Choose her class if you can for EGR 101 and/or 103!

Professor L is amazing! EGR 101 is a breeze if you do the assignments and show up to class. She emails back quickly and is easy to talk to. You can tell she really cares about her students' success and will do what she can to make sure you understand the material. If you have the chance, please take her class!

She is super nice. She is super helpful with helping students into Engineering and always has good advice to talk about. She tries her best to make class fun or make jokes and is super flexible with helping.

She tells the best jokes (well, to me anyways. She tells cheesy and punny jokes, which are my style) and she really wants EVERYONE to understand what is happening! Unless you try to, you won't slip through the cracks and she appreciates everyone's insight and feedback! Please take her, especially if you prefer someone who takes their time to teach!

Always has a good pun (all puns are good) for each topic. Has a lot of real-world experience to share and always makes all the topics real and easy to understand. Really cares about making sure everyone is learning and succeeding as much as they can
EGR 103 is a very easy class, and Dr. L makes things even easier. She is very caring and understanding.

Letellier is super sweet, nice, and respectful. She has very interesting stories to tell during class and tries to be relatable and funny. She is laid back and is a very easy A. EGR 101 is an easy class, and should have no difficulty.
Class was boring but shes great

EGR 101 is a terrible class but she made it not as bad. She's a very smart and funny teacher and really cares about her students. Her office hours are also very helpful. Also if you have her for EGR 101 don't skip class because attendance is a big part of the grade.

Professor L is a wonderful presence in the classroom, kind to her students, and extremely knowledgeable about nearly any aspect of engineering. Her ability to answer questions and tell interesting stories allows her to befriend students, and her long career and experience in engineering gives her a vast knowledge of the discipline.

Professor Letellier is really nice and helpful to her students. She can be a little awkward at times, but anyone in engineering is probably going to be a bit awkward. Her EGR 101 class is also really easy. The content is kinda boring, but she tries to engage her students.

Dr. L is literally an angel. Shes always telling jokes and makes the class fun. You can tell she really cares about her students and is always willing to help. If you dont have a background in coding, this class might be a little difficult at first but once you get the hang of it, its not bad.
Professor L is awesome. She is incredibly nice and will give you a good grad if you put forth effort. This class is BS and she made it funny. Ask her about her days working on a nuclear submarine.

Professor L is great. Relates class material to real world applications. I was going through a tough time and she was very understanding and worked with me to ensure I succeeded. If you ask for it, she'll help you with anything. Genuinely cares about her students and teaching. I can't speak highly enough about her. Simply great.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She's like my grandma. Willing to help anytime that you are struggling and is extremely caring  and empathetic as long as you try in her class. Super easy class, everything you need to know she comes straight out and tells you. Wonderful woman.

Professor L is one of the best professors I've had at UK. She genuinely cares about the students, and her real world experience is invaluable. The First Year Engineering program as a whole is pretty disorganized, but her class was easy and fun, and I learned a lot. I had Professor L for EGR 102 and liked her so much that I took her for 103.

Professor L is one of the best teachers I've ever had. Her class is easy and she does her best to make it fun. If you go to her outside of class she will help you with assignments or happily teach you information outside of the curriculum. If you can change your schedule to have her, it will be worth it.
First year the school did EGR 102. Very disorganized class, but it was cool using the arduinos. MATLAB is a pain in the butt to learn.

"Professor L" is excellent. She demonstrated an obvious passion for her students and for the course material, and her real-world experience in the field proved invaluable in instruction. She also provided a great deal of humor which made 4pm Monday lectures much more bearable. One of the best teachers I've ever had, hands down.

I highly recommend taking a class taught by Lauersdorf; the class itself is based on effort (making it fairly easy), and he is a genuinely great professor. If you ever have the time, I also recommend talking to him after class or during his office hours, he has a lot of interesting insight into linguistics and things surrounding linguistics!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is a great teacher, and I would absolutely recommend him! He is passionate about linguistics, and he loves to crack jokes in class. You are expected to read from the textbook and do some assigned problems before every class, but they are pretty simple. Attendance is not mandatory, but attending the lectures is very helpful! Highly recommend!

I love professor lauersdorf. his class is pretty easy. he grades the homework off completion and the exams are take home and have a lot of extra credit on them. he is caring and funny. once you complete your exam, you can meet with him to talk about it and he will give you points back. TAKE HIM, YOU WON'T REGRET IT.

Dr. Lauersdorf explains the material well and assigns work that actually corresponds to the in-class discussions. The exams are not very difficult. Attendance is not technically mandatory but the class is discussion-based so you have to go. Dr. Lauersdorf genuinely cares about both the material and the students. Absolutely recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Lauersdorf is a great professor and one of the best I've had at UK. Enjoyed the class and the material. He gives great feedback and truly cares about his students doing well.

Great guy but the lectures are long and painful. The material isn't all that interesting and often put me to sleep. The exams were take home and the quizzes were super easy. Attendance was supposed to be mandatory but he just stopped. If you need an easy GPA booster take this, if not don't suffer through it.
Lauersdorf in great!
This class is awesome!

I thought this class was going to be awful when I first signed up, but he made the history of the English language actually interesting. Fun is class, lectures are long but worth going to because the material on the exams are exactly what's discussed in class.

I absolutely love Professor Lauersdorf. Take him if you can, if the class interests you. He's passionate about what he teaches and it really helps if the class in into discussions. He's a great professor, you won't regret it. His exams are take-home, but require understanding. Go to class, it's interesting stuff and he explains things well.

SUCH a great professor. SO flexible when it comes to tests and due dates. He makes decisions based off of the majority vote. Do the work and you'll get an A. All he hopes that you get out of the class is that you take what he's taught you and use it in your everyday life. Loved him as a professor.

Took corpus ling and comparative germanics. Easy A if you go to class. Homework is almost always for a completion grade only. Tests are challenging, but always take-home. Lots of fun, hilarious guy and makes everything very clear. Milks class time for every minute, so expect to never ever get out early.

He's fun and gets really into the subject. If you're planning to take his Historical Linguistics class just be careful cause the content is hard. There is a quiz and homework on every chapter. Quiz's are difficult but as long as the homework is turned in it gets full credit. Tests are take-home (but that doesn't make them easy!!!!).
Awesome professor.take him and you will not regret it. Very personable and great fun.
Professor Lauersdorf is a great professor. I wish he taught more classes. The class is an easy A if you just go to class.
He's terrific. I absolutely loved his class. He made it such fun and interesting.My favorite at UK.Take him and you will just enjoy every minute of it

I had this guy for both parts of Intro to Linguistics.  He is goofy as hell and makes jokes that actually promote the concepts he is teaching.  He stuck with the book so it was easy to follow and he sends out emails containing the homework, it's never a lot, usually  just reading. I learned a ton about linguistics from him, highly reccomended.
This man is a Top G. Nuff said.

If you're looking for a FIN 410 class and not sure which professor to choose I suggest professor Oh. He gives plenty of extra credit opportunities and the grading is fair and clear. His lectures are easy to follow and he gives handouts of the slides for each lecture. One of my favorite professors at Kentucky so far.

This professor is the best that I have taken at the University of Kentucky. He cares so much about his students and that is rare. He tries his best to make lectures interesting and is always prepared for class. His exams even match the material we learn in class. He is great and more professors should be like him.

Professor Oh has been one of my favorite professors that I have ever taken. He offers a lot of extra credit opportunities, and is very generous when it comes to exam curves. He gives you Exam prep slides for you to study that basically mimics the exam. He really cares about his students, and he delivers the content adequately. He is amazing.

Mr. Oh was one of the best finance professors I have had. He offers tons of extra credit opportunities that are simple to do if you just apply yourself. His exams are on paper and just a simple 20 multiple choice, circle your answer type exam. He is very accommodating if you have to miss an exam or class, and will always help you out. Great guy!

Dr. Perry has many great explosives courses, but I will say it is CHALLENGING! Please be aware that he will challenge you to bring engineering principles into your work. One of the many challenges of this course is time management since it is asynchronous.
Explains well, and is very helpful with questions.  Tests are fair as long as you pay attention and put in the effort to study.  The lab reports take a lot of time
He knows a lot about rocks!!
Lectures can be boring but this is the easiest math class I have ever taken, more so than High School. He is also super chill and can really ask him anything.

Kyle is absolutely hilarious and a really down-to-earth guy. He makes the concepts taught in the lecture really easy to understand, and he presents them in an engaging way. He's also a movie buff. Don't badmouth Star Wars; he can be very blunt. If you see this man is teaching a recitation and you can take that section of the class, DO SO.
He's great!
Kyle was my TA for both Calc 1 and 2. He's great! Super friendly and really helpful. I ended up learning more from him than from my professors.

He is seriously the best professor I've had and class is not mandatory and he usually lets us out after about 30 mins of lecturing. He is so funny and uses real life situations and genuinely wants to see us succeed and is so helpful. Lots of hands on and easy work. Quizzes and exams are taken online at home and he cancels class all the time.

Mr. Least is genuinely the chillest and best professor I've had so far as a senior undergrad student. He tells students from the jump that attendance is not mandatory and learning is up to them. His lectures are straight to the point, only 20-30 min long, engaging, and hilarious. He hates the textbook and loves teaching real-world lessons. 10/10
One of the best professors I've had. He does a good job of keeping you engaged in class and is very practical and realistic.
straight dawg

Love this man. He's funny and not tough on grading as long as you display some understanding and effort. Two practicals and a few assignments. Cancels class half the time. I wish I could have him for every class.

If I could have her for every class, I would. She is very easy-going and relatively lenient with extensions and late work. Attendance is not mandatory, though it counts for a small percentage of your grade. If you show up and genuinely try, you will pass. She seriously helped me build my public speaking skills and cares for her students deeply.
Brett is a great professor whom I would highly recommend.

Brett was by far one of my favorite instructors I've had. He's straight to the point in his lectures and will make sure you pass the particle exams. Attendance may be optional, but if you don't show up you won't pass. His class is the easiest class you will ever take.

I enjoyed this class! attendance is not necessary but it counts to be in class to hear the information coming from him. Material is not necessarily hard but paying attention to what is taught is important when it comes to exams. Hands on material. He is very understanding and willing to help inside and outside of the class room. Amazing Professor!
He's super chill and laid back. teaches class from experience and enjoys what his teaching. you get two practicums that he prepares you for and a few assignments, with midterm and final.

Brett hands down was the best professor I've ever had. He's funny, and caring, & makes it very very hard to fail the class. Easy grader, lectures are not boring and very interesting. Would take him the rest of college if I could
One of the best profs at UK, i would take any class this man taught. Practice your skills and you will be fine. A+ Prof.

Definitely take this class if you are looking for a chill but super informative class. He tells the best stories, is literally so chill, and really wants everyone to get an A. The way he teaches is to help you in the real world! Take notes, go to class, and you'll easily have an A. He truly makes class so entertaining and fun. 11/10 recommend.

Mr. Least made this a really interesting class to take in an online format. He made it easy to learn how to perform special tests by demonstrating them so that we can practice them on our own. Take notes, practice special tests on a friend/family member, and you have an easy A. I'll gladly take this class again, in-person or online.

Out of all the options for professors for this class, he's probably one of the better options. A lot of your grade relies on doing good on the homework (which the TA grades), and the exams in the class won't really affect your grade at all. Be aware he does laugh at you when you ask questions, but he does eventually give you an answer.

He does not know his own syllabus, I've had to correct him on things a couple of times when it came to my grade. Homework is pretty easy to do well on with follow-along lectures and posted videos (every other homework gives you a step-by-step how to do). Exams were horrible, to say the least. Overall, not my favorite professor, but class is solid.

Wei Li or as he asks you to call him "Mike" was good. Some complain of his impatient or demanding nature, but I disagree, in fairness I came into class very skilled in CAD. Creo Parametric is stupid, straight up most inefficient CAD ever. Mike will answer questions + provide help as needed. Hint: Exams + project don't change, talk to upperclassman.

Lectures extremely fast-paced so be prepared. Videos for assignments are extremely helpful. Material learned in class is absolutely nothing like the exams. Most content covered on exams he didn't teach in class or cover in assignments. If no better professors are available, you will do fine with him, but I would try to get someone else

Professor Li is not afraid to give constructive criticism. He is pretty easy to get along with and likes to see his students do well in the class. He is a pretty straightforward grader once you figure out what he expects on assignments. Homework assignments can take a long time and are expected to be extremely detailed and thorough.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Try to get any other professor. He is rude when you ask him questions, he has both laughed at students and started hitting their computer when they ask a question. He moves extremely quickly through lectures which already were not helpful. The final project we were given about a week and a half to do which was insanely stressful. Do not recommend.

The content taught is so unstreamlined and frankly it makes the content harder to understand than it really is. I don't even show up to class anymore (aside from exams) bc its simply easier to just learn the content on my own. Recommendation: take any other professor

Wei is not a terrible lecturer but he isn't the most gracious with questions. When I have had questions outside of class and attempted to email him he often didn't answer or gave me an insufficient answer. The material is fairly easy, just make sure to turn everything in on time since he has no grace period for even partial credit on late work.

Takes points off for doing things not his way, even if the end result is the same, and is sometimes hard to understand when talking about due dates. Essentially uses PTC/Creo provided videos as teaching material instead of doing it himself. Easy grader, once you understand what he wants.
Can sometimes be hard to understand. But is very easy to get along with and an easy grader. Works through most homework's in class and very willing to help. Good choice.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Yes, it is difficult to understand him but he will go out of his to help you. Attendance not mandatory. Easy A if you actually try on the assignments.
Very hard to understand in lecture.  Does not take attendance and posted powerpoint online so attending class was not necessary, just read the book.

Will go out of his way to help students as much as is possible.  Specializes in management and efficiency.  End goals and understanding over memorization are strongly emphasized.  The grade is secondary to your education.  If you are eager to learn and willing to work with him, your grade will be reflected by that.

He put EVERYTHING on Blackboard; all homework, his lecture slides with the blanks filled in, and he didn't take attendance except for exam days. You actually could have never physically shown up to class if you didn't want too but you would have only had half the time on exams. His English isn't great either. If you e-mail him he'll write you back.

You can not understand him. He does not teach, he reads what is on the slides, which contain too much information. He moves very fast and does not explain. His lectures are long and boring. His tests are timed with about 50 questions and only 30 minutes to answer. He did not curve the exams when the averages were below a 65 percent. Don't take him.

Might as well be independent study. His English is proficient but he trails off and tends to mumble. Exclusively teaches through powerpoints where he crams too much info into a single slide which is sometimes a pain to read. Homework and tests are timed, making homework miss the mark of reinforcing what you learn.

never takes attendance, pretty much just reads the powerpoint for class. For our class, he gave us a lot of help if we complained or asked. For example, he'd post his complete powerpoint lectures online so you didnt have to go to class, and he would give us the option of take-home exams, and he did other things that helped our laziness too. take it

Tries to be helpful and work with the students. Lectures are VERY boring, and largely useless. He reads (in poor english) his powerpoint presentation directly, and then posts the powerpoints on blackboard later. Could be nearly as easily learned independently. Doesn't take attendance except on test days.

THIS IS FOR BIO 152
Dr. Lightfield was kind and caring. It seemed as though she stumbled through the lectures though. This may have been because this is her first time teaching the course but regardless lectures were a little messy. It was not too difficult - entirely multiple choice. she wants you to do well in her class and is very engaging!

I took Dr. L for 152, not 208. This is her first time teaching this course, and she did a wonderful job! Always willing to help, and she let us drop our lowest exam grade at the end of the semester as long as we had a certain percent participation. She also gave us opportunities for 5 extra credit points on all exams. Overall, great professor!

I took her for BIO 152, not BIO 208, but that wasn't an option to select since it was her first semester teaching it and I loved her! She explained and broke down complex topics really well in class and made sure we had all the materials we needed to succeed. You could tell she really cared for her students too.

Attendance matters for in-class questions and occasional in-class quizzes taken in groups. Exams are reasonable if you study hard, and match the content taught in lecture. She could sometimes move too quickly in lectures but always down to answer questions.

Dr. Lightfield is an amazing professor! She is caring and very accessible outside of class. I will say though, her tests are difficult, especially the free-response questions. My tip is to listen closely in class, as a lot of things she says in class show up on exams. Skipping lectures and only reading from the slides won't cut it.

Dr. Lightfield is one of my favs at UK. She genuinely cares about mirco and wants to share her passion with you.  The tests can be hard but she gives ample opportunities to work with you. Quizzes and tests are the only grades. know the material, she provides worksheets and study guides to practice throughout the semester.

Pay attention during lectures and write down the things she says, she gives a lot of helpful info and the powerpoints are not very helpful alone. Use the study guides she provides and the powerpoints to study for the tests. Study a few days before the tests and you will do well on them. Also review the practice questions she provides
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Says to message her outside of class and acts completely unwilling to help or put effort into anything. Acts like she can't be bothered and doesn't care about your grade. The tests are weighted heavy and very tricky worded. Even after studying and knowing the material the tests will trip you up. Definitely worked for a good grade.

Dr. Lightfield is the laziest professors I've ever had. She is extremely disinterested if you approach her as far as bettering your grade, gives no helpful advice and makes exams borderline impossible to get an A in. I would definitely not recommend her for 308. She doesn't curve either. Try to do all the extra credit and do HW with other students
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I would give her a 0 if i could. I got a 89.88% and she did not round up to a 90%. She doesn't respond to emails even when she has a wrong answer on the study guides. She has absolutely no interest in helping students learn and it shows when you ask her for help.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class was amazing and super interesting. Her lectures are NOT just her reading off of a powerpoint, she actually writes things down with you and clearly explains things. Really enjoyed having her as a professor.

Dr. Lightfield is a great professor! This class was very easy compared to genetics. The tests are based heavily on reef questions and study guide questions, so if you practice and know those you should be fine! Quizzes are easy A's because you can work in a group as well.

Dr. Lightfield is a bit awkward, but very nice. She provides study guides for exams, which are helpful if you fill them out as she covers the material in lecture. I always felt very prepared for exams, but when I took them there were always a few questions that I had no idea on. Overall its a pretty easy class; it doesn't require much time.

Dr. Lightfield is great. She will do whatever she can to make sure you pass if you ask her for help throughout the semester. Attendance is VERY important. The tests follow closely to the study guides she gives you. Not an easy class, but that's just the material. Clicker questions and easy homework assignments provide a good grade cushion.

Her lectures are fun and informative, but she doesn't get as detailed in class as the tests are. For me, the tests were hard and I'm normally an A student but couldn't get above an 84 on the tests. She's tricky in her wording of MC questions. Overall a good class though.

I had her for both bio 208 and 380. She really cares about the success of her students. She is very dedicated to helping everyone succeed and is always willing to help you if you make the effort. If you do poorly in this class, it's not because of her but because of yourself. She makes it hard for you not to pass if you make an effort and try.

After taking bio 304 (genetics) I felt that it was easy. The lecture was boring, I felt that she did not help me to understand the material - more often than not, she just said pretty much what was on the slides. I could have done that in the comfort of my futon! She uses clickers daily, so attendance matters.  Wsufficient studying, A is possibe
Great teacher, funny, and you learn, always comes in with a smile, which at 8 am is tough to do sometimes

She's a great teacher. MAKE SURE YOU REVIEW YOUR TESTS WITH HER AFTER THE FACT.  I made the mistake of not doing this after my first test and I lost out on a lot of points. She'll work with you as much as you want, but you'll definitely need to study for the tests. They're very in-depth.

You can tell she's really passionate about what she teaches, and she really tries to help her students however she can.  Everything on the exams is on the study guides.  So if you do the study guides, it's an easy A!!
Her exams are very hard. There is so much material covered and hard to study for. She used Masteringbiology, which is annoying. But she is very nice and helpful.

She is young, but she knows what she is talking about. I thought micro would be awful but it ended up being my most interesting class! It is not easy, but not the hardest class you'll take either. She is a good professor. GO TO CLASS.

One of the worst professors I have ever taken at UK. Seems awkward and intimidated when she teaches, reads straight from the slides, puts the most detailed questions on tests that shouldn't be expected of a 200 level course. Very snobby and seemed very annoyed when she had to answer a students email as well. Pitiful display of professionalism.

Only had her for three weeks so far and it's miserable. We don't do any activities in class and it's very boring. The material could be so fun to learn about because she just reads off the slides. She seems nervous and uncomfortable teaching, which makes the students feel awkward. Do not take it with her.

Very tough grader, 2 papers worth 30% of your grade and she nit picks every sentence in the paper. Tests are on every single little piece of information every talked about or in the book. This class should be an easy A with any other teacher but it is hard to pass with her.

What an incredible and odd professor. He's retired now, so you won't have him, but his lecture style was very eccentric and his exams very difficult. However, I do think everyone who passed through the doors of his evolution class was given a true appreciation for the natural world. They don't make 'em like this anymore.
His lectures are great, go to class and take notes because on the exams he puts things that are not on the book. One of the best professors at UK!

Dr. Krupa is one of the best professors I have ever had. He is extremely passionate about teaching, which is reflected in his lectures. He made learning fun / made it enjoyable to be in lecture. The exams are long and specific, but if you read the textbook and study you will be fine. One of my favorites.
Krupa was such a great professor and I always enjoyed attending his lectures. His tests could be confusing at times but it was nothing too terrible.

Krupa is kind of a wack job but in a good way. He gives crazy examples in class and will ask about the specifics of them on the exam along with any other specific part of any example he gives. He is a great and fun professor though and if you read the book and pay attention you will do great.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Take this professor if you can. At the beginning he may look hard, but the class is life changing
I feel like he likes to be intentionally confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Krupa is great. Calls himself rat bstrd, spends class going on tangents but helps you remember the material with them, bringing in dead birds he finds to class, etc. Highly recommend because he makes a relatively difficult class fun to learn. Read the chapters for the quizzes/exams. Just don't get on ur phone or he'll call u out.

Dr. Krupa is very passionate about his field, he likes to recount his experiences while doing field work. I personally find his stories fun and interesting. He likes to interact with the class and often asks questions during lectures. Lectures aren't mandatory but it's best to because of quizzes. Quizzes are over textbook readings and lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Krupa is a delight to listen to during lectures. He clearly loves his field and students, though he can be a bit myopic when it comes to tests. His tests go over specific examples more than overarching concepts which can be a hassle, but I am convinced that if it were not for that, he would have a much higher rating.

Class is very test-heavy and he hates giving above an 85%. Recitations are more like a lab, but are interesting. He lectures at you the entire time, and then expects you to read the textbook. Tests are a mixture of lecture and reading. If you have good study habits, you'll do fine, but make sure you have the time and energy to put into this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Krupa is definitely one of the most inspirational professors Ive ever had. I actually LIKED going to class. His passion for evolution is contagious and his lectures are always fun and interesting. Hes a funny guy! He likes to give pop quizzes so go to class. Exams are long and detailed. Make sure to look at the graphs in book!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Krupa is one of the best biology professors Ive ever had. Hes so passionate about his career and its so inspirational! Hes so funny and his lectures are so interesting. I feel a million times more intelligent after taking his class. Exams are long and theres a lot of content but youll be okay if you study lots!

This man is so selfish and rude and only bloats about himself. If you want a selfish teacher that would rather see you fail and believe he is a god then this is the teacher for you. Have fun listening to him talk about himself everyday for the rest of the semester. A little compassion and heart will do this guy some good.

Professor Krupa has such a passion for teaching evolution and it really comes through in his lectures. He incorporates lots of funny, personal stories throughout class, and it makes time go by really fast. If you take him for evolution you need to do a lot of textbook reading though and his tests ask super specific content questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: My favorite professor I've had so far. So funny and blunt. His passion for evolution is evident and contagious. I really looked forward to going to class. Go to class. You will regret it if you skip. If you put effort into recitation and show up for class quizzes, you will be fine even though exams are pretty challenging.

I love Krupa!! He loves what he does and is so funny. He cares about his students and tells great stories. He is very detailed oriented so pay attention to the graphs and captions in the book and lecture. Do not miss class though because he is a fan of pop quizzes (they are very easy and he gives you the answers on the board). Favorite class at UK
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors! Most students either love him or hate him. I respect him so much for advocating for evolution. He cares for his students, even though he shows it in an unconventional way.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Man, I love Krupa! He's by far the best professor that I have had at UK. The exams are not hard in comparison to other classes like ochem, just read the book and you'll be fine. He likes to mess with you a little, but honestly if you show up to lecture and read the book, the answers should be straightforward. Quizzes are super easy!

My least favorite bio class I've ever taken here. He likes when students don't do well and his exams are hard for no reason because he doesn't want people to score above an 85. There are quizzes almost every class so even though attendance isn't mandatory, the quizzes make it. Most of your learning is going to be self taught.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Krupa cares about what he's teaching. If you reach out to him, he will help, but he will tell you if he thinks your question is stupid. His lectures are entertaining, and so is he.

Dr Krupa is a super interesting lecturer and made this class super enjoyable. His exams are tricky but with the added recitation points, it can bump your grade up significantly. This is definitely not a class where you can get away with skipping occasionally.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Krupa is extremely knowledgable on the content he teaches. With that being said, his lectures can drag on and go off on tangents that aren't relevant. He doesn't post lectures or use Echos so if you don't go to class, you miss all the info. The recitation gives you a lot of cushion for your grade so it isn't impossible to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This was a very interesting class and Dr. Krupa is an amazing lecturer. There are weekly quizzes on assigned readings from the textbook but they're extremely easy and boost your grade. Make sure to attend every lecture and write down everything he says. Tests are very difficult but if you pay attention to examples given you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Love this class and Dr. Krupa. You absolutely HAVE to go to class but he makes them interesting! There are a lot of quizzes that boost your grade (and bonus questions on most of them). It is definitely doable as long as you show up to class and pay attention.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Jim is great. The exams can be tough, but if you come to every class and do the assigned readings you should be fine. Super interesting lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious

reviews.comment: He was talking about this site in class today so I figured Id review since I know he goes on here now. Hes knowledgeable but his questions on quizzes are super specific and random. Even if you read the entire chapter needed for the quiz that day, some of the questions are way too picky. Read the textbook carefully and look at all images!
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He was callous, uncaring, and arrogant.

Honestly one of my favorite classes. Evolution is not an interesting subject but Krupa makes it interesting. Wish I could take every class from him. However, attendance is mandatory and much of the test content is from lecture. Would highly, highly recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Krupa's lectures are very interesting- which is good because you should write down about everything he says because it will be on the test. The tests are hard but if you put in real effort you will get an A. Never miss class and read in advance-you will pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious

reviews.comment: One of the most interesting lecturers I've ever had. I just can't bring myself to dislike someone that refers to themselves as the "rat bas)tard". You have to go to lecture and read to be prepared for the exams, but Krupa makes it interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Krupa is an amazing professor. His lectures are great and he's so funny. He doesn't take attendance, but you need to be in class to learn the material because he doesn't put PP on canvas. He also has pop quizzes sometimes, but he usually gives you answers. Tests can be tricky, but the study guides he provide tell you everything you need to know.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious

reviews.comment: He is an overall good professor. He likes to give examples in class and those examples will probably be on the test. He gives pop quizzes, but usually, he'll give you the answers for them, they are more to make sure you are coming to lecture. He gives off a tough vibe but he's actually pretty nice one-on-one.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Dr. Krupa is by the far the best professor Ive ever had. He is so passionate about what he does and that carries over into his teaching style. 11/10 professor!!
wow this man is super duper i dont know what i would do without his knowledge A+

Krupa is an amazing lecturer. He does not post the powerpoints from his lectures, and he is a very lecture heavy professor. Be sure to read the textbook before class to understand everything that he is saying. He often uses anecdotes as examples. Be sure to take note of every example in book and that he mentions as they're probably on the test
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Krupa is by far my favorite professor so far. He encourages class attendance, so in order to get notes, you must attend. It is worth it though! He is hilarious and makes evolution interesting. He gives quizzes on the book, but if you read it is very straightforward. Attending class and lab will get you a solid grade. 10/10 would recommend.
Dr. Krupa is phenomenal! His lectures are super engaging and he has hilarious stories. Get ready to read... a lot. But other than that it is a very fun course!

I absolutely loved Dr. Krupa's class. Don't get me wrong, the man is crazy (he eats roadkill, for starters), but he's a complete genius and a great lecturer. He's really gotten me interested in evolution. You MUST have the book for this class: all in-class quizzes are from book material.

Dr. Krupa is one of those teachers you'll never forget. For some that's not a good thing, but for me he is an inspiration. He has taken up the mantle of the many UK professors before him that defended evolution, and I deeply admire that. More objectively, he has an excellent lecture pace, communicates well, and knows how to weave in humor.

This is by far the most entertaining and interesting biology course i have taken in college. Krupa is such a fun guy and relates everything with fun examples that help you remember major concepts. Take notes as he is speaking because not everything on ppts is on the exam. Examples are key!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Lectures are actually pretty interesting. Must read for the quizzes the material is straight out of the book. Doesn't put anything online so you have to go to class, which actually helped me. I definitely recommend taking him.

Such an amazing professor. He literally knows everything and his classes are so interesting. His tests can be tough but as long as you read and study enough you will do fine. Make sure to take note of EVERY example he talks about in class.
He will drown you on the exams but quizzes and discussion can save you. Gave over 15 bonus points all semester enough to bring you to an A at the end if you got low Bs on the exames. Don't give up!
Great lectures, will call you out for cell phones, but must attend! There are 4 exams at 70% class average, so do well on quizzes and homework and keep up with reading.
Great professor! Keeps class very interesting. Just make sure you take notes on specific examples because they will be on the test!

THE BEST LECTURER I've ever had. He really knows his stuff and what makes it more interesting is how he relates everything with his own studies. He is an interesting character and I would totally recommend him.

Dr. Krupa is an amazing professor, but his class is by no means easy. You HAVE to pay attention and read the book. Quizzes are essentially do you remember the definitions of the vocab. He's a funny guy though, he has great stories, and he'll always keep you interested. The recitation is also tons of fun! A pivotal class in my year.

GO TO CLASS! I missed a total of 2 all semester and it REALLY hurt me. He gives pops quizzes and a lot of  information given in lectures  has nothing do to with the big. He is incredibly specific on exams about this material. However, he is one of the most interesting human beings I have ever met and has crazy stories to tell every class.
Great teacher and makes class interesting, however the tests are tough so make sure you study A LOT

Krupa is an amazing lecturer but his tests are just highly specific and downright unfair.  He hates giving good grades (likes to keep his test average at about a 75).  He does have an ego but is hilarious at times.  Bio majors, evolution is required and the only thing I hated about the class was practically being unable to get an A.

Very funny professor. Easy quizzes, hard exams. This course needs a lot of reading. If you get good grades on recitation and the quizzes, your overall grade will go high up. He also drops the 2 or 3 lowest quizzes.
Gives great examples and provides feedback. Assignments truly help to understand the course and material. Participation in class improves the overall experience. Great professor!
Krupa is a very charismatic professor and keeps the class interesting. Favorite prof. to date by far. Just pay attention and stay on top of your work- you'll be fine.

Krupa knows what he's talking about and is genuinely interested in this subject. Exams are really specific, so you must go to all classes (though attendance isn't mandatory) and read everything in the book to do well in the class.
BEST TEACHER I HAVE EVER HAD IN COLLEGE. if i could have him as my lecture for all of my science courses, id be the happiest college student ever.

My favorite teacher of all time. He was so good that I am no longer considering premed but rather a PHD in evolutionary biology. He is a great teacher. Always read the chapters and take notes from the book as well.
Krupa is a great teacher! He outlines clearly what you need to do to get a good grade in his class. READ THE TEXTBOOK!!!

He is by no means a bad professor at all. No reason to hate whatsoever. What I HATE about taking Evolution was his grading policy. He'll take off points on quizzes and tests equivalent to a questions worth if you do not put the right section or ID number. Who does that? Exams are easy as long as you memorize diagrams in class and in the textbook.

Awesome teacher with a true love for teaching and evolution.  Class was always great to go to.  Gives weekly quizzes, but trust me, reading and doing well on the quizzes helps with the tests since quiz questions will be on the test.  Great Professor.  There is a reason hes the only one who teaches Evolution.  Has won awards and it shows.
Krupa has won awards for his ability to teach with stories. Great teacher.  His tests can be subjective, so go to every class!

Awesome professor. Krupa really knows what he's talking about, and his lectures show it. Super interesting, spends a lot of time integrating his own field research. Wish he taught more so I could have him again

Extremely interesting, extremely passionate.  Not an easy class, but he really wants you to do well.  Extra credit points and easy recitation assignments to boost your grade.  If you have an opportunity to take his class, do so.

Very interesting and entertaining, however he gets off track very easily. Weekly quizzes with a lot of possible bonus points. He uses a lot of diagrams and always puts some of them on the tests. Overall I'd say he's a good teacher, though some people don't like him.
Very entertaining. Really passionate about what he teaches. He's very picky about test answers, but also gives out extra points at random. Read the book, attend class and recitation, and it's easy!

I took him for BIO 102 and 103. Great teacher! Very interesting and worth going to class. Even though it wasn't mandatory, you should/need to go to class for a good grade. Only test grades are used, but he gives you a study guide. Def read the books too. Can be a little tricky!
Super easy if you go to class!
Loved this class! Very eye opening. Test are not hard if you read the material.

I took him for 102 & 103. He was funny & made the class interesting. He tells a lot of stories & uses real pictures for descriptions. I had to take an I in the course due to illness & he was very helpful & kind about the situation. Tests can be a bit tricky but it's doable. You must be able to apply the information, not just memorize.

I took Krupa for 103, and although he gets off on tangents frequently and likes calling himself a ratt ****, He's definetly a professor to take. His examples given in class are super helpful and interesting. The books are not a complicated read and help a lot on the exams. overall excellent professor, funny too!

For 102 & 103, take Krupa. He's tricky on exams but read the books, know the ex. questions on the study guide, and the study guide itself then you'll get a nice curve on your grade. He definitely makes the class interesting. Attendance isn't mandatory but you need to go so you have the material. I would buy the Kentucky Class Notes for reviewing.

Do NOT take this professor if you expect an A or B.  VERY unclear about what will be on tests.  Funny guy though and kind of interesting class.  You dont have to go at all if you dont want to.  But if you can get another teacher, thats what I suggest.

Soooo annoying especially if you're stuck with him for 102 and 103. His tests are full of trick questions and by the end of the semester he may or may not curve. Depends on your class. If poss. take someone else.

Fantastic professor.  He teaches the subject in a very interesting manner and I'll never see biology and evolution the same way without him. Almost made me want to switch majors.  Also, really funny guy, highly recommend him.

not a bad teacher. he knows what he's talking about. does not take attendance but going to class helps. he really challenges you bc he doesn't make it obvious what's on the tests. only 3 grades (the exams)
He is completely awesome. If someone doesn't like him, chances are they don't come to class, read the books, or try.

Even though I had a midterm grade with an E, I finished up the class with a C which I think isn't too bad for this hard class.  My advice would be that if you fail your first test, DON'T drop, he WILL curve a lot!  study hard for the tests and read the books!

Dr. Krupa really knows his stuff. You have to go to class to get a good grade but if you write down everything he says to, the tests won't be too difficult. He's a bit crazy but very knowledgable and funny. The only grades are the tests so just study and you'll get an A.

Apparently some people like this teacher, but I absolutely hated the class and the teacher.  Sitting through class was torture, and the tests were unnecessarily confusing.  I am glad to be finished with this class. I recommend taking someone else if possible.  If you must take him, buy the kyclassnotes, they really help.
tests can be hard. final was impossible. that being said, the way he grades makes up for it. go to class and it is an easy b atleast. i got an a and guessed on half the final.

Okay class, I hate biology and I still came out with an A because the tests somewhat hard even if you go to class but the way he grades is SO easy and helpful! Easy readings too. My only complaint is that I think he is insane. He was so excited to have us eat bug suckers...really? I personally think he is immautre although he knows his stuff.

I took him for 103 my freshman year and am now a senior taking him for 102. As a freshman I thought his class was hard but as a senior I'm rocking it. I study about 5 minutes for his test but attend every class and still get Bs on his exams. With the curve and all the freshman in his class any upper classman should be able to ace this class.

Awesome teacher! He is so passionate & LIVES what he teaches. Although attendance isn't taken you have to attend if you want to pass. To me that means he cares that we learn the material. He engages the class and is clear on what needs to be studied. He's fun to listen to. Not enough room on this to explain how great he is. Fantastic teacher!

Krupa will make you want to pull your hair out. The tests are tricky and a bit confusing at times. While the study guide is extremely helpful make sure your taking VERY DETAILED notes. He will include random facts about himself in the tests, so LISTEN! Also, he has a very egotistical personality. You'll either love him or hate him...

I took him for 102 and 103.  I hated his class. for anyone who says his tests "can be a bit challenging" dont know what they are talking about they are VERY confusing.  He says if you come to class, his tests are no-brainers... FALSE i went to evey single class... still got a C.  I hated BOTH of his classes.

It is essential to attend lectures if you want to do well in this class.  Luckily, the lectures are fantastic - he makes fun of everyone and everything, including himself.  Even with a large lecture hall, he manages to get the class involved. Plus there's free candy if you're down with nomming crickets.  Best prof at UK!

This guy is amazing! He's a bit eccentric but extremely funny. I took him for both 102 and 103. No textbook just two short novels, which you can knock out the reading in a day or two. test is from the lecture only. Just know what's on the study guide and you're good. Be sure to read questions carefully on the test! and there's a HUGE curve!!!
Many say he's really though but he takes all his tests right from his lectures. If you go to class and pay attention you will see it again almost word for word on the test.
Oh dear, I did not enjoy his class one bit. He goes off on these rediculous speeches and constantly is talking about how people know nothing and he know everything. Really quite annoying.

He was a pretty good teacher. As long as you go to class and take good notes and read the books, you will be fine. there is no textbook, just two short books. The class is curved, so it really helps if you go to class. He is a pretty entertaining teacher.

I love this guy! Hes a bit eccentric and his lectures are extremely interesting for the most part. The only books you have to buy are 2 novels. Your grade consists of 3 exams which are a bit tricky, but not bad if you read and take notes.

Really great guy, changed the way I look at a lot of things.  He has a real zest for his subject, and he's funny, really quite funny.  I would recommend him to anyone.  Do some of the reading and come to 80% of the class and you'll get an A.
It's not a hard class just have to read and take notes. His tests are tricky though.

Dr. Krupa is very interesting and quite funny.  His tests can be tricky, but the reviews he gives for them cover all of the material on the test.  I got an A and didn't bother reading either of the books, but you must go to class and take good notes to get an A in this class.  One of the best professors I've had though - he's very enthusiastic!
Very interesting teacher. He tells personal stories that make the class fun to attend. If you aren't an idiot, can go to class, you'll get an A/B

This teacher is ludicrous.  He thinks he is better than everyone else and loves to talk about himself.  I took 102 and 103 and have attended every single class for both of them, read all of the books, and studied a week in advance prior to each test... I still got a C in both classes, if you have the option, take another professor!

Not a hard class but you have to attend and take notes. He says the questions from the book are easy and not specific...not so much. Tries to trick you on test, I got an A but the best piece of advice would be to find someone who takes the test before you so they can tell you what is on it.

I would not recommend taking his class. Many people said that you would get a good grade if you attend and read. Well, from my experience that isnt true. I attended every class and read the books. His test are tricky and very hard to understand. If you are looking for a good professor, Dr. Krupa isn't one.

Hes great! I hate science & he really made things interesting & easy to understand!  No textbook, just 2 short books. Easy A if you go to every class & read the books. Hes hilarious & keeps you interested! Curves grades :]

I just feel that he doesn't not care about his students learning. He would rather feel like he is smarter than all of us. Does not really care if we do well. I feel it is impossible to get an A in his class. I go to every class, study, and read the text but still perform at average.  He does not use a textbook so there is nothing to refer back to.
Not a very hard teacher, but also not the easiest.  Must go to class and take notes or just buy the Class Notes.

do not take his class if you have no interest in science at all. I attended every class and studied a lot and still got a b. his tests are hard and not the easiest to study for. also, hes terribly arrogant and likes to talk about how much he is saving the enviroment every class  which becomes very annoying.
Krupa is AMAZING!

he is a little weird, but is very knowledgeable in science, thought his class extremely interesting for most part, he has a problem with students not showing for class and he puts crap on his tests to check that.  I don't blame him for that.  Only need study reasonably and he curves.  Peaked my interest in science when I didn't care at all prior to

Krupa was a very good teacher. Do not take him however if you are dumb or do not enjoy learning. If you pay attention to him, which is easy to do, studying for him is a breeze and the tests which can be hard for some people are easy if you pay attention.

One of the most popular professors on campus!  His classes are so interesting and very easy, if you only pay attention, which isn't hard at all.  Attendance isn't mandatory, but the notes are useful, and the books read are great!
Enjoyed the class, the test were easy and the material was very interesting!  A great class when you just need a natual science credit!
Helpful with any questions you may have ans can be very entertaining!
This class was great! I learned a lot and could comprehend it very easily :-)

this man is great. i find myself thinking and using things that he taught in class very often. he is very interesting but bio 103 is better than bio 102. his test can be tricky but just study. the people saying that he puts surprise things on the test are wrong. he even gives you a study guide and almost every question from it is on the exam.
really funny and entertaining but his tests aren't the easiest. I don't dread going to his class but it's not terrible.
Not a good Prof

I took both BIO 102 and 103 with him. Lectures are enjoyable/entertaining. Tests are multiple choice, but difficult. Go to class and take notes. Ask questions!! He lectures, you listen. Seriously though, GO TO CLASS. Missing one class = missing 6+ questions on a test.

Sarcasm severely gets in the way of teaching. Very difficult to take notes in the class, and notes are crucial. (You would think he would be a little more helpful.) I would absolutely NOT take a class with Krupa again. Disappointing after I had heard such positive things about him previous to having taken this class.
I thought Krupa was a really great teacher.  The class wasn't the easiest, but he kept my attention the entire class.  Krupa was very funny and made biology fun.  I actually miss his class sometimes!

I had Krupa for 102 and 103. He is really passionate and very knowledgeable when it comes to the subject matter. I really enjoyed 103 and only missed the last day of class. For 102 I attended sporadically and got a D. You really must go to class but it is enjoyable and extremely easy if you attend, even if you don't like Biology!

People who say this man is a good teacher and that hes funny are crazy! I wonder if Kruppa just gets on here and makes these things up for himself... 1.hes a bad teacher 2.must go to class 3.tests are hard 4.2 novels 5.thinks hes funny 6.wont answer ur ?s completely... i could go on and on with all negatives about his class...

Horrible teacher! His class is very boring, doesn't know how to teach, rambles on about useless info about his life, tests are way too hard for such a low level class.I went to every single class and I love biology, but still didn't learn a thing. If you're wanting an easy A or to learn, do NOT take him. Worst teacher I've ever had!
Worse teacher ever he is very unclear even going to the classes does not get you an easy A its very hard

Class is pretty easy and interesting, have to go to class and take notes and play close attention, his tests are made so that the people that don't come to class don't do well.  No text book, two novels which are quite interesting, if you go to class he tells you what you need to know from the books on the test
Krupa is the best teacher at UK! I hated science and everything about it until i had him. Go to class and you can get an A. Going to class is fun anyways!!! He cracks jokes half the time! LOVE HIM!

This class is informative, but he frequently gives incorrect information, and, when corrected, ignores you. The left-wing global warming propaganda section is annoying, which he admittedly does after teacher reviews. Fairly easy class, I just can't stand the guy. No textbook, just two novels, one of which is awesome. Tests are a little tricky.

This is one of the easiest classes I've ever taken. There are no textbooks and the books he assigns you don't even really have to read to do well on the exams. Just show up for class, pay attention, study about an hour for each exam and you'll do fine.
Good Class
extremely entertaining!!

Be engaged, ask for help on your papers, and do your best to finish the assigned reading  (there are a few random quizzes) and you should get an A or B.

PHI 315

if you get a good t.a class isnt to bad. dont get phillipia satterwhite for a t.a. if she doesnt like you she wont give you grades you deserve

Dr. Bradley is by far the best professor I've ever had.

awesome prof. with intelligentness.
