Rossi was one of my favorite professors this semester! She's very passionate and informed about her subject. I took this class because it fulfilled a core requirement, but it almost has me rethinking my major. Take this class if you have a chance!

Dr. Rossi's class is not for everyone because it's a mandatory course for everyone in the College of Ag. I frankly didn't care for the study of sustainable ag, soil, etc. (not saying it's not important) - but she makes the course content bearable. She assigns multiple projects and make sure you email her - she almost always helps!
Dr. Rossi was respected and I enjoyed her class. It helped me understand  the backgrounds of all the other students in the College of AG. She's sweet and very approachable!
Super interesting class! As long as you go to class and do the work you should get an A!

Dr Rossi made this class so fun, and knew so much of the topics she taught, I really look forward to having the chance to take more of her classes. If you make even a bit of effort, she will help you in all ways.
This class was fairly easy, but Dr. Rossi requires a lot of public speaking.
Dr. Rossi is very fun and quirky. The material can be a bit boring at times, but she usually manages to make it interesting and fun. She's great and her class is an easy A.
She goes by Dr. Rossi now, but she is an easy teacher and fun. Class isn't usually boring. easy A for sure.
Good class, enjoyed it.  She is very nice, enthusiastic, and "green".  As long as you do your part, it is an easy A.
Great teacher, had a great time in her class.

Dr. McKenzie is an amazing professor! Her lectures are extremely interesting and straightforward. Content covered in class is transferred completely on to exams. She is very engaging and cares deeply for her students. There is a mandatory textbook and sections required to cover outside of class, but she is very clear on what needs to be reviewed.

She is genuinely the most kind and understanding professor, and her grading scale is very fair. There are only 3 exams and she tells you exactly what will be on each exam. There are very limited homework assignments and she tells you what you need to know from the textbook so that you don't have to read every page.

Dr. McKenzie is one of my most favorite professors! She is so kind, quick to help, and always wants the best for you. She will always provide helpful feedback and grades generously. Not a lot of professors go the extra mile, but she does! She brings in a very refreshing and welcoming persona that makes class enjoyable.

Not only one of my favorite professors I've ever had, but one of the best classes I've ever taken. Professor McKenzie makes this class very fun and teaches it in a way that makes you really engaged. She genuinely cares about her students. Exams are also pretty easy, as long as you study and come to class. I highly recommend taking this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Karyn is possibly the best professor I have had throughout my time at UK. I already have more courses registered with her. She gives her lectures in a way that is so easy to remember and understand, and this is coming from somebody who absolutely hates lectures. If you have the opportunity to work with Karyn, you absolutely should.

I cannot say enough good things about Professor McKenzie! She was engaging, relatable, and all around a great person to learn from. Her grading was fair, and she always left great comments to ensure you understood the grade you got. Her lectures were easy to follow and take notes on, which made studying for exams go very smoothly. Highly recommend!

An outstanding professor and the nicest I've had at my time here thus far. Just beyond nice and understanding. The course itself is the easiest I've taken, but she makes it as easy as it can be. 10/10 would take her class again.

Litteraly the best professor to take! I highly recommend! The class work isnt bad at all, there is one group assignment  But again its not bad at all, she works with you to give you feedback and make sure you do great.

I've taken her three tines now! I absolutely love her teaching and she's genuinely the best professor I have ever had. She's so caring and understanding and makes an effort to get to know all her students. Definitely take her!!!
The best professor I have had here at UK. Genuinely cares for her students and always makes an effort to get to know you.
GOAT professor
The most caring professor
She is the greatest professor I have had. She actually cares about her students and is the nicest person ever. Highly recommend taking a class with her.
Jennifer McMullen is one of the best professors I have ever had at UK. I would recommend her to everyone that can take her.

Dr. McMullen is amazing. She cares about her students' entire wellbeing. She ensures that class is engaging and a safe space for students. While this class was a "transition to university" class and pretty easy, I thoroughly enjoyed getting to go each week knowing a professor truly cared about my success!

This class was the easiest class I've ever taken. You know exactly the sort of assignments you'll be having in the class and they're very straightforward. The meetings are necessary for attendance points, but you don't really need them for the assignments since she posts the slides on Canva. She's very kind and gives such great responses as well.

Dr. McMullen is the absolute best! She is so sweet and really cares about all of her students. She does take attendance, but if you have to miss, just email her because she is really good about communication. She makes her labs fun and the material isn't too difficult. I would take all my classes with her if she taught them!

One of the best professors I've had at UK. She is so caring and will work with her students. She really wants the best for everyone and does her best to make classes fun. If you are debating on taking a class with her, do it!!!!

Dr. McMullen is one of the best professors I have ever had. She genuinely cares about her students' success. As long as you come to class, participate, and take good notes to review- you will do great! The tests directly reflected class notes.

Dr. McMullen is an AMAZING professor and person! Her lectures were recorded, assignment instructions were clear. However, she gives great feedback that is very detailed and encouraging. Her class is not hard, if you do the assignments, you will pass. She has become one of my favorite professors on campus. If you can take one of her classes, do it.

Dr McMullen is one of my favorite professors I have ever had at UK. She is a very caring person who loves her job. I would definitely take this class with McMullen over an of the other professors that I know. As long as you go to class and take decent notes you should get a good grade in the class. Love her!

I took her for PSY 325.

I do have my issues but overall a good class. She wasn't as helpful with any study guides or very reachable outside of the classroom but I did learn a lot and did have a lot of good talks in the classroom. Tests were easy, but very disorganized. Every test had questions taken off because they were coded wrong.

She is a great professor! She genuinely cares about helping all her students navigate their career paths and offers amazing resources to help students build their skills and knowledge of what they plan to do. Attendance is mandatory, but you only meet once a week, so it's not a big issue. Sometimes, she can be a little unorganized on Canvas.

She wants to help you succeed. This course helps you prepare to be a psychology major. She is very sweet and understanding, but make sure you are at EVERY class, because it drops a letter grade every time you miss.
My favorite Psychology professor! She lectures a lot but he way of exposing concepts helps students to understand terms. She makes practices quizzes and study guides that are exactly like the test!

She is an AMAZING professor. Her lectures are very interesting and she offers a lot of tools to help you study for exams. The course does have a lot of material so I would recommend using the outlines she gives and taking the practice test. I will be trying to take another one of her classes in the future.

Who doesnt love Dr. Sharrett? She's one of the few prof that gets it. She puts students first and GENUINELY wants us to succeed. You have to take her at least once during your time at UK. Like at this point it should be mandatory. Take her!

Absolutely loved her as a professor. She taught very well and always gives good examples for the content that she relates to real life. If you have the chance to take her for PSY100 DO IT!!! Be prepared to do lab work, but she gives more than a reasonable amount of time to complete everything!

Interesting lectures! She is caring and understanding of her students. Lots of labs to work through and notes weren't finished until right before the exam which was a little frustrating, but the exams are structured well so as long as you pay attention and do the labs you'll be fine. Attendance isn't mandatory but I recommend you go.
Loved her! Attendance is mandatory so select a section with a time that you can actually go to or you will fail.

Absolutely love her. She is funny and active when teaching her lectures. She doesn't only speak to teach but will also have students actively participate in examples of what is being taught. She is understanding and very caring. I would 100% take her again

When I first had her class she scared me but now I think she's great. She respects hard work and clearly loves the subject. We so seriously watched gorillas doing...things, during the sex and gender portion so she's that type of funny. Not someone that likes stupid questions, so be careful, but she's great and works hard to keep everyone informed.

Super funny and excited, loves her job. Cares a lot about students. Sometimes a little disorganized, but not in a way that interferes with the class. She posts some pdfs on canvas that explains everything and helps a lot for exams, that I thought really easy, in general.

Absolutely loved my class with Dr. Sharrett-Field. Shes a great professor that really engages her students in her lectures and is always in a very positive mood. She reminds me of joy from inside out.

I have taken multiple classes with her she is a great lecturer and keeps you entertained during class. the only homework we had were 10 online labs and studying for exams. she also gives practice quizzes before exams and they really help. highly recommend taking her for PSY 100

Love her. Explains concepts well, respects students, has a good sense of humor, easy class, as long as you understand the powerpoints. She provides practices quizzes and uses some of those questions on the exam. As long as your score well on the practices quizzes and labs you'll end with an A.

She was super nice. Good teacher, too, but one of her policies in order to pass PSY 100 was you have to score above 5/10 points on 2 out of 10 of the labs, where the labs are only worth 20% of your final grade. I had to withdraw because of this policy, even though I had a high B in the class at the time. I dont recommend taking her PSY 100 class.
One of the best teachers I have ever had. Makes class so much fun. As long as you study what she gives you its so easy to do well in the class!
I love professor Sharrett-Field. This class was pretty easy as long as you pay attention and do all of the work. Her lectures are interesting and engaging. Would recommend this class!

Dr. Sharrett-Field is an incredible lecturer. The grade is heavily exam based, but material is presented so clearly that I didn't find it difficult to make good grades on exams. Her powerpoint slides are also very well organized. I also found the class material to be interesting. Dr. Sharrett-Field is very easy to learn from, take her classes!

Dr.S is my all time favorite professor she did an amazing job during covid adapting to online schooling and giving students extra time to do assignments due to technological issues. She understands there is a life outside of college and is super respectful. Her exams were open note. I genuinely recommend her to anyone taking PSY100
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Shes amazing! She cares about her students but also the content. She presents it in a fun way to learn as well as many ways to learn like hands on, visual, audio. She also has little aspects like adding a free point that says youre awesome that really makes her the best!

This class is rough. 75% is four exams, 25% easy homework. I hate it when grades are comprised of over 60% on exams! It just feels antagonistic. Sharrett-Field, however, is incredibly engaging and makes this dry material come to life. Just know that you will need to study a lot for this class to succeed. I studied more for this class than before.

She's awesome! Very funny and an all-around great professor. She is obviously very intelligent and knows what she is talking about. There is very little homework, but it is important to stay up-to-date with all the chapters, especially for psychology majors. The grading is highly based on 4 exams. Attendance isn't mandatory, but highly encouraged.
Love her! Funny and caring and actually helps students figure out what they want to do in life post undergrad.

If I could compare this woman to anyone else, it would be Ellen Degeneres, only straight. She's a passionate woman who loves the work she does and it super easy to approach. I was nervous about Psychology and was honestly rethinking my degree when I took her class. She re-inspired my love for psychology and I couldn't ask for a better teacher.

Dr. Sharrett is one of the best professors I've ever had. She is very student oriented and truly cares. Each class she walks in with a smile on her face. Attendance is not mandatory for this course but she does give out extra credit for attending her lectures.

My favorite teacher I've had at UK, super helpful and gives really good lectures. Bonus points for attendance, I enjoyed going to class with her. If you do all the assignments and study thoroughly for exams an A won't be hard to get if you make an effort. Pay attention during lectures

Honestly always looked forward to her class even though it was my only non-mandatory class. Hilarious woman, so laid back, explains things in such an understandable way. Genuinely into what she is teaching, cares about the topics, will stand and answer your questions enthusiastically for half the class if needed. Can't wait to take her again.

Lynda uses her platform as a professor to preach bout her beliefs to her class. She's very unorganized and you never know what her exams are going to be like. Its almost impossible to study for them because theres an overload of material she hardly ever gets to in class. No papers which is nice but would still consider other professors before her.

Dr. Sharrett was absolutely the most wonderful professor I have had at UK. Not only is she hilarious but she actually knows how to teach in a way that helps you understand. She is so passionate about what she does. I have learned so much from her and wish I could take her again!
This is the first time I've actually LOVED a class. It was very interesting. I'm not the kind of person to really care about grades anymore, but I genuinely learned from this class.
Best professor ever. Even though she didn't take attendance she went so in depth in lectures and made coming to class so worth it and fun. Tests were hard but not impossible with a lot of studying.

I only had her for a 1 credit hour class, but she was so sweet. She's really funny and relatable and does a great job of explaining things and making sure everyone in the class understands what is expected of them. For the class I took, attendance was basically your whole grade, so if you take her for 195 definitely do not skip class.

Dr. Sharrett - Field is a wonderful Professor to have. Shes so helpful and her lectures are really interesting. Id recommend coming to class prepared with her slides - they help SO MUCH with her study guides... also pay attention to what she says because her examples are good to know!

Dr. Sharrett was my favorite professor of this semester. Her class is nowhere near easy, but if you take the time to focus and study you should do fairly well. Attendance isnt mandatory, but you do get a few extra credit points if you attend 90% of the lectures per module. She doesnt curve exam grades unless he entire class did extremely poorly.

Amazing class. Took for an elective and an very glad I chose this one. Class is 4 writing assignments and 4 tests. Attendance not mandatory, but if you go you will get extra credit. She tells you exactly what you need to know for exams. She is energetic and funny making lectures interesting! Highly recommend her

l absolutely loved having Dr Sharrett-Field. Psychopharm was my favorite class Ive taken at UK. l used the textbook to read along but you dont have to. She does go a bit quickly through her lecture slides and doesnt allow laptops but if you print your notes before class its very easy to keep up and exams are really fair. Overall an awesome prof

I really enjoyed Dr. Sharrett. She was very understanding when I was sick and she bumped my 89 to an A without me even asking because she truly cares. Great transition class into college. Fun and engaging lectures. Also, her tests are not that hard. Very easy to get Cs on. If you go to class the tests are a lot easier. She's very approachable.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Sharrett. She really knows the material and is passionate about it, which makes it more interesting. She's also pretty fun. She's open to any questions and willing to help you. Attendance isn't mandatory but I suggest going to class if you want to do good on the tests. She makes the lectures fun.
Just be prepared to study for the tests. Don't think its all common sense because it's not. Study hard and you will get an A.

I took her PSY 459 Neuropharmacology as a junior and no bio experience except PSY 312. She made an effort to help psych majors understand the bio material. I love her personally but she doesn't post grades on time and her exams are tough, plus there's no study guide/practice exams, and only 1 hw per exam. I would recommend Hofford for 459 tbh
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Her lectures REALLY help you learn the material. You can tell that she is passionate about what she does too. Outside of class, it is essential for you to study for exams and get your labs done. She releases study guides which helps, but its always better to understand how to use what you learn instead of technical definitions.

Her PSY100 class is a great experience to learn more things, and she will go into detail about anything you ask her about the content in class. Her exams are not that bad, and she is easily understandable.

Great engagement. Classes are very intriguing. Provides all information needed for the exams. Love the energy she brings to each class!!! Definitely looking forward to taking more of her classes in the future!!! Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took this online and easily the best decision ever. It was only 8 weeks long, and it's much easier to work at your own pace. The class is structured fairly. You need to buy the MPL/book though in order to do the homework assignments and read. Exams and homework are worth a lot but it's balanced fair. If you struggle with STEM, take this online!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This was the hardest class that I have ever taken. She is the roughest teacher you could ever have just because her lectures go by so quick you can't even take notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: She lectures way too fast; either choose to take notes or listen because you can't do both. Also her exams are the hardest thing ever, she makes them herself. I took this course in high school and got a A+ now I'm taking it and learning the same information and the highest exam grade i've gotten is a 71%. DO NOT TAKE PSYCH WITH HER!

For the first part of the semester, I showed up and took detailed notes and did very poorly on the exams.  For the second half of the semester, I rarely went to class and read the book before exams and did much better.  I just didn't follow her lectures very well, and she's rude if you go to her office hours.
Great professor. Very funny and entertaining lecture. She didn't take attendance but she made the class enjoyable and made you want to come to class.

Entertaining and enthusiastic lecturer, though sometimes she could go a little overboard and become a bit silly for my tastes, as though she was trying to behave like Stephen Colbert or something. Still beats the alternative of a "Bueller, Bueller" type professor. Class is easy, tests are easy if you study at all. Downside is mandatory attendance.

She's a wonderful teacher, but I would not take her if you're worried about your GPA. Her tests are designed to really insure you understand the subject, past knowing just the key concepts. EXCELLENT teacher, though. And she helps you try to succeed in her class.

Dr. Field is a really good personality, and definitely stimulated my interest in the subject. She may go a little fast during lectures, and her teaching is a little more advanced than normal classes. Exams come from the notes, but if you don't take extra notes in class (she posts powerpoints online, but teaches extra in lecture), you'll do bad.
Made class entertaining almost all the time.

My favorite professor last semester! She makes the content very interesting; she is a dynamic teacher. She offered a ton of bonus point opportunities. Really tries her best to respond quickly to all emails. Studying is essential to doing well on the exams.

FAV PROF!! she ended up getting me so interested in psy that I am now minoring in it. She's so bubbly and walks around the entire auditorium so that your 400 person class seems much smaller. Pretty easy, goes by the book! Much material though. Definitely go out of your way to get her! Plus, she always has the cutest outfits.

My favorite professor this semester! She makes lectures enjoyable and provides several examples so students can develop a good understanding of the material. Lots of bonus and several chances to bring your grade up! Her tests are difficult in the way that you really have to know concepts rather than just memorize terms, but I would take her again!

This professor is the best! She makes everything clear and easy to understand. She's so funny and nice as well. psychology is not my major but it was the only class that i enjoy and love going to among all of my classes. She makes it interesting trust me, you won't regret taking her classes.

I failed the first 2 exams but still came out with an 83. Do the bonus quizzes and make flashcards and you will pass tests easily! Bonus quizzes are used as extra credit so that is nice. After I started passing the class, I really enjoyed it.

She is a very funny teacher and within her lectures, she gives very good examples that relate to the average college life which makes the content much easier to understand.  Do every assignment, attend class, and do all of the extra credit quizzes.  The tests are not easy, however, I recommend studying a week advance.. a little bit each day.
She's entertaining and is very willing to help.

Overall enjoyed the class. I thought for a 100 level class with almost 700 students, her attendance policy was too strict. The lectures are interesting and not just boring power points. There is a lot of material covered. Gives lots of extra credit opportunities. Ended up being .05 away from a B and she wouldn't bump me up.

Overall not a very helpful, hates questions and will only tell you to check the syllabus and to listen more in class. If you take this class and take her hope you get an amazing TA because without them you'll get no help.

First tests were hard, but I think she's caught on to the poor grades and lightened the load. Always positive in class and I personally find the way she does her lectures to be interesting, which is hard to do with so many people. Better off e-mailing your TA for things, keep contact you need with her to office hours.

She is hilarious during her lectures. She gives a lot of material but if you study the key terms and can apply them, then there shouldn't be a problem getting an A. She is so sweet and always open to helping her students!

Yes the lectures are long, but they're interesting. I like Dr. Field. She is really nice and tries to make the lectures as interesting as possible. You don't need the text book if you come to class, but better to be safe than sorry.

Funny, confusing, and hard are three words to describe her. She does clicker questions every class to make you go to them, but i learned just to work on other homework while she's lecturing.  Retaught myself the materials on the test, and if it wasn't for my TA, attendance, and SONA I would of made a C or D

Dr. Sharrett is nice and witty but she's a bit of a hard ass. Don't skip class. She might call you out specifically in lecture, it's awkward. You have about 4 writing assignments (1-2 pages). Psych is interesting so the class isn't boring. Every lecture is straight from the book.

Dr. Sharrett is very entergetic and funny.  She goes out of her way to make sure that students understand the material.  She is great in helping you structure your study skills to learn the material better.  There is tons of opportunities for extra credit points.  Go to class, read, study, and you will do fine.  Favorite professor so far.
Long lectures of power point reading, no insight or teaching. You gotta just print the notes and hopefully teach yourself before the test. Not a good teacher.
Although she is energetic and funny, I learned nothing from this class Her lectures are long and boring, and her tests are impossible even after studying for three hours a day for a week.

She clearly knew the material and was very passionate about it but did not take much responsibility for issues in class or with Blackboard. She consistently has technology issues but has not adjusted any of her practices for them. You can get an A but you have to work hard for it.

I think that Dr. Sharrett is a really great teacher. She is very smart at what she teaches and its sometimes hard to keep up with her when shes using her major terms. Other than that, I love the class. She teaches well, She is very entertaining. She's such an adorable little teacher! She's very helpful if you go to her office hours. Dont skip class

By far, one of the most ignorant professors I have had the misfortune of having. If she's not complaining about her inadequacy to operate technology, she's whining about how students' ask her questions. If you email her, the chances of you getting a response back is practically nonexistent. She is so rude.
very energetic and bubbly, not booring at all, very nice teacher

I took drugs and behavior with Dr. Sharrett. She was awesome, super nice, very helpful and knows the material very well. Four exams, 50 multiple choice questions. Material is a little difficult at times but really interesting class. She uses powerpoints and gives you access to them. Attendance isn't mandatory however it is highly recommended.

Dr. Sharrett is one of my favorite professors at UK so far. She is really excited about what she teaches and that's awesome.  Go to class, especially days where you would expect lots of people to be missing- she likes to give bonus points.  Tests coincide well with the material taught in class, but there is a LOT of material, so you need to study!

Lynda was a very friendly and fun teacher. The only issue I had was that she did not teach in a way that allowed students to understand. She is very knowledgeable in the subject and has trouble bringing it down to the students' level of knowledge. Go to class! She gives extra credit points to those who attend on certain days.

She knows her stuff, and is very educated in what she teaches, the only thing is she doesn't explain things on a level students can understand. She's also unprepared for class consistently. She is very entertaining though, and tries to keep a positive energy (kudos!). You're better off actually attending class FYI!!

I've heard people say Dr. Sharrett is unprepared and unclear when teaching, but those people also expect everything handed to them. Reading before class clears up that problem. Exams are over slides but the textbook is a must if you want in-depth explanations of concepts. Absolutely loved this class and changed my career goals because of it.

She is a really nice lady but not a very good teacher. She tends to either explain things that go over your head or not explain them at all. The class is unstructured and the instructor is always unprepared.
Exams were online and she allowed make-ups for any assignments that were missed. She's super nice and as long as you show any effort/interest whatsoever you will coast to an A

Just take the class—you won't regret it. No one showed up the first two weeks, so it was moved online. As long as you submit the assignments and follow the given criteria, you'll get an A. Super low-effort and straightforward.

Dr. McDonald is an engaging and approachable professor. Lecture attendance is completely optional, but you'll need to attend recitation once a week. The course is graded based on a few assignments and recitation attendance, making it a straightforward and manageable class. If you're looking for an easy A with minimal effort, this is a great option!

ANT 103 is primarily based around a series of papers leading to a final report. Dr. McDonald runs a very clear criteria for this process and is very open to questions. Lectures and assignments at times can become boring or repetitive. However, this is an easy course and she, and her TAs, grade very fairly. Dr. McDonald is a good choice as professor
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This might be the easiest class at UK. You show up to recitation once a week for your attendance points, answer reading questions every week, and take 4 online exams that are incredibly easy to cheat on, meaning you really don't have to pay attention at all. Rating Professor McDonald is tough because the class is almost entirely taught by your TA.

This is a great class to take for the Global Dynamics credit. All the modules are quite easy to understand. The class was hybrid and all the lectures were videos. The tests are directly from the lectures and are open notes. All the content was easy to understand and the TAs are easily accessible. I learned a lot from this class!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: My section was hybrid style so we only had to attend recitations in person. Exams are easy because they are open note, maybe two or three papers. The RQs are super important to get a good grade in this class, but they are not difficult at all. The TAs are great and understanding. Overall great class and professor to take for global dynamics.
Great instructor shes the best to take for ANT 160.

Professor McDonald Is so passionate about what she does, She really tries to make the topics understandable and connects them to everyday things. She genuinely cares about her students and wants them to succeed if you have an opportunity to take one of her classes DO IT.

almost all of our lectures were online and they are very straight forward. all assignments were easy and mostly completion. exams are easy A's since they are exactly what's on the study guides. she very nice and makes the class extremely easy
Easiest UK core class I've ever had. Would definitely recommend her.

mcdonald is a really nice lately. the class is easy and fairly interesting. lectures arent mandatory but recitations are once a week. have to read parts of a book early in the semester, but its not a hard read. no big papers or group projects.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She really cares. It can be a really easy "A" if you want to put in the work. The tests are pretty easy as long as you read the lecture notes and go to discussion.

McDonald is a great professor, as well as person. She is always willing to help (personal or academic) and wants to see her students succeed, all you have to do is put in the effort. Show up to sections, do weekly reading quizzes, occasional homework. definitely recommend

This class is easy if you show up to class. I got an A and didn't put in much effort, but if you don't go to class, you will not do well! She gives you a study guide for each exam, but is useless if you weren't in class to take notes. Lectures were interesting and  never lasted the full 50 minutes so just do the least and at least show up to class!
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. McDonald is great. She is very nice and makes the class easy, if you do the work. Most of the homework is simply for completion and this is a big part of your grade. If you need help, just ask her. She is very willing to help students who are struggling in or outside of class.

She was very unorganized and took forever to post grades on canvas.  She let in too many kids off the wait list because they could not keep the promises she made a lot of the time. With that being said, she loves her subject. I am a fiance major and I took away things from her lecture.  Also she lets class out early by at least 20min each lecture.
Hope she is still teaching, I regret skipping your class. Could have made a best friend. Awesome person.

For this class, you do need to purchase the 2 books listed because you go over them in recitation and the test does have questions from the book on it. Lectures are not mandatory however she does have random In-Lecture Exercises that are worth 20 points each which add to 100 points of your grade. Lectures can kind of be boring but she tries.

Nick is the absolute man! One of the most genuine, coolest, and best teachers I have ever had. Its pretty simple, if you respect him, he respects you. He also does a great job lecturing about the content in the class and will give you reassurance on any classwork you need, he's always there to help. Go to class and lab = easy A.
He is an amazing teacher and an even better person!!!!!! 10/10 recommend

Professor McDowell was genuinely one of the best instructors I have had in my entire four years at UK. Not only does he genuinely care about you and your learning experience but he makes it to where you have every opportunity to get an A. very fun professor, made the class fun.
