Dr. Mirabito sets himself apart from other professors at UK in that he truly cares about his students. He and Dr. O take every measure possible to assure the success of their students. The course material content is very interesting and Mirabito could not have been better (he does not require attendance!).

Dr. Mirabito is a fantastic teacher. Main lecture is through videos before class, class is used for concept practice. He has an funny sense of humor, and is very personable. He is willing to talk after every class and gives every student attention. Do practice exams and you will pass. I would definitely take this professor again.

Attendance wasn't required and you could always join the class meetings on Canvas. I really liked this class because there was no penalty for turning in work late at all. This class is just very heavy on the test grades, but you do get the chance to make up one test at the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed his class. He is a very easy going guy and in BIO148 he does not require attendance, but I would recommend going as he goes over a lot of information in greater detail. There is no late penalty besides the quizzes and if you miss a quiz you can make it up. He wants you to succeed so I recommend taking him.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Mirabito is one of the worst professors I've ever had. He does not teach, he uses google surveys during class. He gives us notes, which are very helpful but he didn't make them. When we did the google surveys and the majority answers were wrong, he wouldn't tell us any info on the correct answer, he said "You're making me look bad".
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: You dont have to go to class to pass just watch the videos and do the notes
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: the best bio professor out there!! awesome lectures, very easy to follow and very fair tests!! 10/10

I had him when it was online, and he was scattered during lecture time, requires you to watch 30-50 minute videos before class. You honestly can just pause the video and write everything down and skip ahead to a next slide. During lecture time, bewary of others making the material more confusing. The exams are exactly like HW/lecture problems

Although this class is very difficult, Dr. Mirabito does a great job teaching it. He talks about how much he loves genetics and you can see it through his lectures. The exams are difficult but he gives tons of past exams so that you can be as prepared as possible during the exams. He teaches through fill in the blank notes which I enjoy a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Mirabito is the best professor I've taken at UK. He has a unique teaching style that throws most students off, but his use of the socratic method when answering questions is actually pretty beneficial. Always ask him questions inside/outside of class because he wants to help you and try to do well on the first 3 tests because the final is hard.

Dr. Mirabito is fun and caring, but the class is really based on four test grades. There's notes and homeworks due for points, which did manage to bring my grade up to a B. The lectures went over test like questions, but all questions are poorly worded and confusing. Okay class and teacher, but be prepared to work a lot and hard.

Dr. Mirabito is great. Genetics is a very tough course and he knows that. He gives you ample opportunity to work for the grade you desire. Tests are extremely hard but the ability to replace them off the final is a huge plus. Make sure you do test corrections and get all the other points available from hw, labs, participation, etc.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Very nice guy and is very accessibly outside of class, but he is very vague when he answers questions and rarely just gives the information clearly. Exams are the same format as practice exams, but he tends to use questions that we never remotely covered how to approach. He does let you replace every single exam if you do better on the final.

Mirabito is kind and accessible, but he does not teach. He plows through problems with no explanation of the rules or foundations, then pulls exam questions out of no where. It's one thing to push students to apply their knowledge, but he does not give students the tools necessary to have a fair shot at doing so. Ask questions EARLY and OFTEN.

Loved him, funny guy. His organization can be kinda funky, so go back and review in an order that works for you. Class is very straightforward if you study smart and pay attention. Classes are live-streamed on echo and exams are all MC, some questions are hard/wordy but nothing unreasonable. Great piazza response times its kinda iconic.

Dr. Mirabito is honestly one of the best teachers I have ever had. He cares so much about his students and genetics. His passion for the subject makes the lectures interesting. Utilizing his office hours is KEY. He did everything he could to help me this semester. Don't be afraid to ask him for help. Genetics is NOT as bad as everyone says.

Dr. Mirabito is awesome. He has a genuine passion for bio, and of course, a very strong knowledge of it. This class is all lectures, but Dr. Mirabito makes them interesting. Hes funny and overall a great choice. This course is tricky and requires a lot of studying, but Mirabito helped me really understand the content.

You either love or hate his teaching style. I hated it, I thought the notes and the lectures were very unorganized. I would be stuck on a homework question and had to scroll through my notes looking for a simple answer to a question I had. I wish he had used a textbook instead, so I didn't have to rely on the messy notes pages for studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: You either love his teaching style or hate it. I hated it, the notes are very messy and unclear, and I thought the lectures were confusing. I wish he had used a textbook more as a resource, I hated having to scroll back through the messy notes pages trying to find information. He is really funny, though, and a really nice person.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Mirabito is amazing! Hes really good at teaching the information in a way that just makes sense. He provides good notes to fill in and learn the material. Theres a ton of practice questions given before tests which help the most. Go to class, know the vocabulary, look at learning objectives, get help, and youll be okay.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: good lecturer who clearly conveys most information, very lecture heavy his classes can be draining at times. overall a solid course and instructor.

One of the worst professors I have ever had. His notes are messy, lectures are unorganized, and if you don't grasp it the first time through you might as well give up. Luckily, I had a good TA that helped me pass the class. Do not take Mirabito unless you have no other option.

Mirabito is an acquired taste. At first I didnt know what to think of him. Give him a chance and youll eventually catch on to how he does things. His lectures can be a little scatter brained but theyre usually funny. He also focuses a lot on helping you understand how to learn best and prepare for tests. Overall I enjoyed having him.

I took bio304 with Mirabito this past summer. He made a miserable fast paced class very enjoyable. It was alot of work, but that is to be expected since the department crammed a 16 week course into 6 weeks. Mirabito is great at simplifying genetics and explaining things in layman terms. I wish I could take him for the rest of my classes at UK.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: You either like him or you hate him. I found his quirky ways pretty funny, & I think he was very confident in his knowledge of the subject. He was very open to explaining his lectures. Be very careful when answering clicker questions, & take advantage of practice exams & homework!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: The bottom line with Pete is you're either going to like him a lot or not at all. My class this semester has had very mixed feedback for him. His teaching style did not mesh well with me at all and I struggled a lot to get the grade I needed, but others thought he was a breeze. It's really about how you learn with this guy. Lots of jokes tho.
Very similar to AP bio. Use the practice exams and visit him in office hours!

The professor is terrible. Ive never experienced something so brutal. He tests you on material we didnt discuss. I did multiple practice exams and got atleast a 78 or higher and studied and took good notes on top of that but when I went in to take the exams I did poorly. The exams are worth 69% of the grade which is a lot. Dont take him!

Dr. Mirabito is an inspiring professor, who knows genetics like the back of his hand. The material is decent, but the exams are designed to make you fail. I am a straight A student, and had no problem with Bio 148, but this was the hardest class I have taken. I understand challenging your students, but he will test you on material you never learned

Genetics is not an easy course and Dr. Mirabito makes sure you work for your grade. Go to his office hours, do the practice problems, and practice exams. He knows it's a difficult course so he lets you replace your exam scores on the final exam. I had a D at midterms and ended up with a B because of the replacement option.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Mirabito is one of my favorite professors! He is kind and funny. He can be sassy in class which is really funny. Go to his office hours!!!!

He is great teacher if you pay attention and do what you are supposed to it will not be as difficult as others have posted. He is funny during lectures but the test questions were very confusing at times.

I am a straight A student and I struggled to pass this class. This is definitely one of the hardest classes I've taken. Mirabito is a good professor and the information itself isn't hard, its the tests. The exams are extremely hard, however you can replace all of your exam scores on the final.
Lectures are long and boring. Easy to fall asleep so bring coffee or something. Tests are hard. Tells jokes sometimes though.

Dr. Mirabito's teaching methods make simple concepts confusing and difficult. His tests are extremely difficult and he does not review at all. I would recommend taking another professor for BIO 148 like O'Quinn.

Dr. Mirabito seems to be a great guy outside of lecture, however his teaching methods make even the simplest of concepts confusing and difficult. His tests are extremely difficult and often require you to guess on half the questions. I would recommend taking another professor for BIO 148.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This is the only class I've ever had to drop. When people would ask questions in class for him to further explain something, he would respond with the exact words he had already used, but just louder. It did not answer the question. His tests are also made just to trick you. Lectures were also extremely boring-- nearly fell asleep every class.

Mirabito is definitely a more challenging teacher than the other BIO 148 teacher, however, he is pretty straightforward with his expectations and how to pass the class. Just pay attention! He lectures with his powerpoints (everything is on the website), then you have 3 tests and a final. My test grades were 82, 82, 86, then a 93 on the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Mirabito gets a bad rep, but he really is good. Go to class, participate in reef questions (you'll usually see those on the test), and go to his office hours/approach him after class. He might seem intimidating, but he really isnt and wants to help students that want to learn. He also makes all expectations clear.

Dr. Mirabito is great!! He truly does care. The problem is that genetics is just a tough class. I had to study ALOT to get an A, but he definitely makes it doable!! Word of advice: you can replace all your exams on the final, but DON'T neglect the semester exams thinking you'll just replace them because you more than likely won't replace any.

Dr. Mirabito is phenomal. He truly cares about his students doing well and makes himself readily available in office hours. I had him for 148 and 304 and am happy I chose to take him for both. Make sure to go to his office hours so he knows you want to do well too! One of my favorite professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He is a very approachable professor, utilize office hours! He is incredibly helpful in a smaller setting. Quizzes are so important for formulating exams so understand what you miss. Participation and homework is fairly graded.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Mirabito is a prof who believes in understanding the material instead of just memorizing things. His lectures were interesting if you like biology - which you better if you're on this path. Also had some funny moments. He did a good job balancing seriousness with humor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: grade based on homework and exams. exams are very difficult because they are laid out in a very strange way that some can't adjust to. Doesnt really explain some of his answers with the exact correct answer, sometimes he will explain without giving you a definite answer
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I loved him! I thought he explained things very well and genuinely cared about student success. It can be homework heavy at times but the homework is quick and easy and is useful for studying for the exam. He also provided lots of practice tests/hw to help you prepare for the exam, I only really did the practice stuff and got A's on the tests
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Genetics is the hardest class I have taken so far at UK. Dr. Mirabito didn't answer class questions. He made you feel like an idiot for even asking them. I feel like he did genuinely want all of his students to succeed but I also feel like he expected too much out of them. His lectures are hard to listen to but participation is mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: He is very lecture heavy and tries to trip you up with the wordings of questions. He does want everyone to succeed and is willing to help you if you go to his office hours. He can be monotone when teaching so it was easy to not pay attention but the material is not difficult to understand.

Dr. Mirabito definitely knows biology, but sometimes explains it in terms difficult to understand for introductory to bio. However, he links several resources on canvas that are extremely helpful to 'dumb it down' so you can understand. Also for his class knowing the info isn't enough, you have to have a good understanding to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The homework is impossible and the office hours are not helpful. He does not answers questions if a student asks during class. If you miss a reef question, your attendance is heavily effected, even if you are there. 10/10 do NOT recommend!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He's so condescending in class and it really irritates me that you can't ask questions but outside of class- he's like a different person. Has LOTS of office hours and tries to help you understand the content. Grade is very well outlined from the beginning. Occasionally he posts multiple homework assignments due before class that seem tedious.

I believe that the students that do not succeed in this class is because they give up, not because of Mirabito himself. Can come off as rude, but loves to help students and makes his grading criteria crystal clear. His tests are not simple memorization like many other classes. He makes you critically think WHICH IS HUGE FOR FUTURE MCAT PERFORMANCE!

I would not recommend this professor. I struggled in this class and when I went to his office hours, he called me stupid for not understanding the concept right away. His office hours are filled with tons of other students, so good luck ever getting to ask your question before he leaves.
I love Dr. Mirabito, I had him both for Bio1 and genetics. He's so smart and has lots of office hours to help students.

There are some really annoying things about Mirabito. He doesn't let you ask questions during lectures and he can come off rude a lot of the time. BUT he puts a lot of effort into helping students understand and is very willing to sit down and work with you. His lectures are terribly boring, but he lets you make up all participation points.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Genetics has been one of the roughest classes I've taken. Its easy to blame professors when classes get intense and your grades suffer but not with Dr. Mirabito.  I feel like he genuinely wants students to succeed. He is great "teacher," meaning he teaches you the subject instead of just describing concepts. He loves genetics and it shows in class.
Dr. Mirabito is THE BEST. He really wants his students to succeed, he loves what he teaches, and he's absolutely hilarious. I had him for Bio 148 and was super excited to have him again for genetics.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Lectures are very important, but he posts all of his lectures online. BIO 304 is easily the hardest class I've ever taken in my life, but Mirabito made making an A possible. He replaces every single exam score with whatever you got on that section in the final. Work hard and you will definitely get an A or a B!

If you take what you learn in his lectures and apply it to his homework, it is really easy to learn from him. He also has a very unique dry sense of humor that spices up lectures and makes them more interesting. Stay on top of the material in this class and an A is attainable.

Bad teacher with an attitude problem.  1) lectures are insanely boring. He makes no sense at all-- information is not organized and doesn't flow well. Needs to learn to organize thoughts.  2) tries to be techy but it works against him.  3) makes rude comments; talks down to us  4) no verbal questions. Using piazza for in class questions sucks
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Mirabito is literally the worst professor out of all of mine. He's hard to understand and he's monotone so it's very easy to zone out. It feels like he doesn't care about his students because everyone will be talking loudly (because they zone out) and he'll just keep lecturing like you can hear a pin drop. Literally awful.

hes INCREDIBLE! by far the coolest prof ever, he knows what hes talking about and hes very clear. Genetics is tough but he makes it extremely understandable and so much fun! do the practice exams and you'll be golden, he also loves when you come to office hours with reasonable questions, he'll put you on the spot if you're not prepared

Great class, but be prepared to work hard. He'll work with you to help you understand material, and seems to be really after a solid understanding and application rather than just memorization. Go to class (that's not optional) and keep on top of the assignments and readings and you'll do fine!

Dr. Mirabito's teaching style isn't something many people are familiar with, but it's this uniqueness that makes him a wonderful professor (in my opinion). He is very well versed in genetics, genomics, and biochemistry and always looks out for his students. He knows the common misconceptions and general reasons students misunderstand genetics.

This was the hardest class I've ever taken. Half of his lectures are spent trying to prove how much he knows. He is not an effective teacher. He claims that he wants you to know all of this information for life, but exams are just all about learning how to master his "games." He is also incredibly demeaning. Avoid at all costs.

Initially I was nervous about having Dr. Mirabito as a professor, but this nervousness was soon put to rest. Dr. Mirabito is honest, funny, down-to-Earth, and willing to help you if you ask for it. He really knows what he is talking about, and I think that as an intro bio student that can be why his concepts are sometimes hard to grasp.

Pretty good professor overall. His lectures can get long and boring at times but he is very good at stopping to answer questions.  I personally don't learn very well in large lectures but the homework was extremely useful. Tests are moderately hard but if you mark down what he goes over and study that material well enough you will be fine.
Lectures were a little boring but that was more of the material than the professor. I plan on taking him again.

His class is tough. Probably the toughest class I have had but with hard work and going to office hours for questions about material, you should do fine. He expects you to know all of the terms and general concepts because his questions are built to test your application of the material. It is hard but he is a great teacher and is willing to help.

Mirabito knows his material, but lectures can be very confusing and hard to engage in. Echo recordings are a life saver. Tests are very difficult and he expects you to know a lot. He is there to help, but his "genetics is the easiest science" mantra makes it difficult for struggling students to approach him.

Mirabito has a unique way of explaining things, and these explanations are often muddled and confusing. His tests reflect his teaching, and so even if you read the book, if you skip class don't expect to do well. His lectures are not engaging. However, he tries to lighten the mood with jokes, and he does seem to care about helping his students.

He's smart.  Like, extremely smart.  This is probably why he thinks that we already know the information, even when we don't.  He's hilarious in class, and if he's sarcastic to you, don't take it the wrong way.  He really is willing to help you if you ask for it. Great professor!

I went to every lecture and still had a hard time understanding. He doesn't really go over stuff in the book, it's more whats on the homework is whats on the test. He expects you to know a lot more than you actually do.

It is irritating that you will never need to know this information again, yet you are graded like your life depends on it. If you read along with the course schedule and attend all of the lectures, it is do-able, otherwise, good luck.
If you can take Osterhage take her. He's really nice and funny, but when he lectures he's not clear. He expects you to know more than you will.

Mirabito is SUPER smart and SUPER organized. If you want to do well, follow the schedule in his syllabus like your life depends on it. I found him generally friendly and approachable. One word of warning: before you ask a question, spend some time thinking it through on your own. He hates distracting questions and may be a bit rough to the asker.

Mirabito's exams are defiantly  tough. His lecturers can be confusing, I mean very confusing if you don't go to class prepared. If you know the material ahead, it's not bad. He has pre-homeworks for that but it didn't really help me because I used to just rush it the last min. However, his whole "final exam replaces all your other exams" helped.

Tough but it is definitely possible to get an A in his class.  He teaches bio 148 which is full of freshman that have not learned how to study or take notes.  His lectures are great- but it is your responsibility to take notes and listen and study and make sure you understand.  The tests are tuff- its more about understanding the question.
Really funny guy but sometimes was unclear. His lectures are a little confusing at times, he tries to explain things in a sort of complicated way. Homework is easy but tests are a little hard.
Her teaching style was organized and easy to follow, which made it easier to stay engaged during lectures.
Miss Pryor is an excellent teacher.

When I tell you she has been one of my favorites so understanding with any situation a student is in. Your attendance is more for bonus compared to actually affecting your grade. Easy to understand, test are open book and online, she makes slides that have minimal explanation yet you still know whats going on but in class she goes deeper into info.

One of the best teachers I've had at UK. Pryor is so caring and personable to her students, her class is structured around the care of students, and I admire her for it. This course had no exams, no class Fridays, sometimes no class Wed. Lectures are very good and a little fast paced, but she always asks if she needs to repeat. Overall recommend.

Pryor makes class material fun and interesting to learn about. She applies material to real world situations in which we regularly pair in groups to complete interesting assignments. All tests are online, and you can use notes to aid you through them, although I rarely needed them since she is so clear and understanding in lectures.
Very laid back professor that wants you to succeed
Super fun and easy class. Just show up and take notes and youll be fine. All exams are open note and super easy

Mika was great this semester, she is super lenient with stuff if you have a good excuse. There is little to no work, lectures are easy and short. Take notes from the lectures and you will get an A. Also, we never had class on Fridays and during holiday or break weeks, no class either.
Very very very nice prof. She gives really good examples and helps you understand the content. The tests come straight from her notes in class so just show up to class and you will pass with 100%.

This course was super easy, and as long as you showed up and did your work, youll get an A. The material was super interesting, and Mrs. Pryor was very knowledgable about the subject matter. She posts lectures online with the power-points, so if you cant make it to class (or dont want to go) you wont get behind.
Very simple class, not a lot of work but interesting content. Teacher is easy grader

Mrs. Pryor is such an amazing professor. I have had 3 classes with her so far, and her classes are always easy and interesting. Just show up and you will do fine. She is so caring and considerate towards students and makes sure that every one is doing well in her class.

Pryor is hands down the best teacher I have had at UK so far! She is very understanding and her exams are so easy if you go to class and take notes. She also is really good at making class interesting!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Mrs. Pryor was a great professor. She always makes sure that all students understand the material. She is an easy grader and teaches thoroughly. If you come to class, you will get an easy A.

As long as you do the assignments, you're good. You'll have a group project at the end of the semester, which should be easy since the groups are big. I don't think attendance was graded that heavily, but she'll always excuse you if you have a problem coming to class, I've found. Great teacher and you can tell she actually cares about her students.
She is iconic honestly. Class is cancelled 85% of the time. Lowkey doesn't answer emails but class is very easy regardless.
An absolute icon. She cancels class a lot and is easy on grading as long as you have a general understanding of what you are talking about.

Professor Mott was a very good teacher for me this semester. She was always available to assist on assignments, and even on the final podcast project. The assignment spread is every week there is a small writing assignment, which tends to be a page or 2, along with the major assignment, which ends up taking 2-3 weeks to finish.
So easy to talk to and reach out to outside of class, WRD 210 itself with him was actually really interesting!

Prof. Pennell gives a lot of lectures, but they are interesting & entertaining. You will learn a lot about social media & the internet, making it a super easy class. Exams were online and easy if you took notes in class. He is caring and super nice and does not use a textbook. Easy class for a required course or elective.

Dr. Pennell was a great teacher, and his class was just as great. Attendance definitely matters, so show up to class! He doesn't give out many assignments or projects, the lectures are short and to the point, and the exams are based on the lectures. Overall, if you have the opportunity to, take the class!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Easy class but attendance is mandatory and you only have 6 grades total. Online and open note tests but they are hard and ask question specifically about lecture.

Professor Pennell teaches this class really well. The class is enjoyable. Show up to class for attendance and then use the lecture slides during the exams. They are outside of class on one day at any time from 6am to midnight. If you put in the effort (which is not a lot compared to most classes) then an A is extremely achievable.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is an easy class and professor. Material is pretty interesting but the lectures can be long. Attendance is important so if you aren't going to show up don't take this class.
Overall, the class doesn't have a lot of work, and the tests are really easy but there are a couple of papers you need to write.
Classes are boring, but you can sit on your phone or do other work. It is super easy as long as you do the work. He is a great guy and it is an easy core class.

Class is insanely boring.. this is a UK CORE class and is 1 hour and 15 mins long.. there is no need to use up all of this time lol. he goes right to 445 and maybe even over sometimes.. it's dragged out .

I learned a lot from this class and the professor. He is easy to listen to without getting bored. Just SHOW UP to lectures and you're good. You will fail the class if you miss more than a few classes (because attendance is such a big part of grading).

This was class a full lecture. I wasn't very interested in the course, but his presentations were pretty funny and made it worth coming to class. The only thing I didn't like was there were a few assignments/exams so even if you gotta B on one of them it would drop your grade. I would take this professor again.
Great class. He was a tough grader, but an easy class to pass overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Pennell was very good at keeping you interested in class. His class was very easy to pass and was just overall great professor. If you just show up, you can pass pretty easily.
Great professor! Actually enjoyed attending class! Interesting lectures, fun assignments. Take this for your UK core!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Pennell is honestly a cool guy. Funny and interesting lectures, makes you want to attend class.

Professor Pennell is AWESOME! Such an easy A and so nice. Class is enjoyable and even though attendance is mandatory its easy. Quizzes are easy and pretty much open note. He is super fun and class is interesting. If you need an easy A TAKE HIS CLASSES!

I really liked Professor Pennell. He was super outgoing and made the class interesting so having mandatory attendance was alright. His lectures were kinda slow but he normally included an in class activity and they often were fun to complete. Its a super easy A, so I recommended this class with him as the professor.

I liked his class, but it was frustrating. He was a funny and interesting professor and you really don't have many assignments, but that is the problem. You have SUCH a little amount of points in the class. It is also hard for him to give u an A on an assignment. He like never gives 100s, he always took a point off of something, which was annoying.
one of the most entertaining classes I have ever taken. He is HILARIOUS, and the lectures are never dry. Pay attention to the lectures and participate, and you'll get an easy A.
Loved this class. Only a few projects, no homework, tests, or quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Class is so easy but exams are actually BS, should be a fun easy A elective but its frustrating
Very fun class, and would definitely take again! We had quite a few projects which was a majority of your grade, but we also have a lot of fun in class activities that boost your grade!
Great mentor

Used this class as more of a study hall. More of a seminar. We all stayed on our laptops while he talked over the slides and made corny jokes. He's really sweet which makes it sad that I didn't pay attention but I think he gets that everyone takes it for an easy A. Great guy 10/10, wish I would've paid attention more cause he's actually really nice

Take this as your humanities class for UK!! Loved this class so much and he made the lectures fun and interesting. This class is solely on social media/memes/etc. You won't regret taking this course. And he isn't bad to look at either. He has an attendance sheet but you can work around that.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Took him for WRD 306, he is an amazing professor.  Very laid back, easy grader, fun classroom atmosphere.  Not to mention, he's pretty attractive so coming to class is actually not terrible.
Great teacher! Laid back.

This professor grades so ridiculous on all projects you do in this course and 75% of your grade are project grades. I went up to him on three separate occasions to help me change my projects and every time he says that it looks good, but here's the catcher, he gave me B's on all of them. Don't ever take this course with this teacher.

I say with caution that I would take another class by Dr. Siddique due to the heavily weighted exams (30% each). However, I feel like I've learned a great deal in this class and understand Dr. Siddique's lecture style. Don't take this class if you struggle on exams. Although he's provided adequate learning meterial, it can be very dense to revise.
Nothing else to say. Get ready to not learn anything.

Who gives a practice exam that doesn't help with preparing for the actual exams? Siddique! The exams are worth 30% of the final grade, and you are only able to get a total of 30 points on the exam. The only good thing, he curves the exams a lot or else I'm sure that most students would fail his classes. It's bad that he teaches core classes.

So frustrating to have no access to outside class material. No book, no recordings, just slides. I managed to find the same slides on another prof's website, and at least those had explanations. The 4-assignments-1-optional grading was weird. They put in 100% for them all, so I still don't know my grade and it's finals week. Needs work for sure.

Dr. Siddique's teaching style is very unhelpful for me. He uses slides for his lectures, and it's hard to understand the topic solely from his slides. He doesn't do any written demonstrations, which I think would help a lot in understanding most of the topics in this class. I rate him a 0/10.
This professor posts homework just hours before it is due and expects it to be done. There are so few assignments for points they are mostly just completion. Save yourselfs from this teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took WRD111 online and it was amazing. She is super nice and understanding. She really cares about her students and wants you to succeed.

Dr. Murray is a PHENOMENAL teacher and person. She is truly so caring and genuinely takes the time to help her students. If I could give one piece of advice for incoming students, just don't procrastinate the final projects. They're easy, but a little tedious. Otherwise, the class is so enjoyable. I took the online section. Such a good teacher!
Seriously one of the nicest professors. Very understanding and accommodating if you just communicate!

I really enjoyed her class & took her WRD 110 class the previous semester. She is very understanding & gives you a lot of lead-way in her classes. The majority of the class throughout the semester is spent working on your final project. Showing up & doing the work will get you the A you want. Her class is easy, & she is always willing to help you.

I really enjoyed her class & took her WRD 111 class the following semester. She is very understanding & gives you a lot of lead-way in her classes. The majority of the class throughout the semester is spent working on your final project. Showing up & doing the work will get you the A you want. Her class is easy, & she is always willing to help you.

very nice professor. as long as you do your work, youll end up with an A, class was done with in november. only bad thing is i bought two textbooks for class and i definitley couldve gotten by without them

[WRD 110 not ENG 191] As long as you do your work on time, you'll get a high A. There are a lot of speeches and essays to write but nothing terrible. We spent the last 6 weeks on a final group project and never had to go to class; the class ended in November. Id recommend her as she's an easy A as long as you do your work.

She's so nice! This was a very low-pressure class, where discussion was at the forefront, but no one was forced to speak. Not speaking meant your participation grade would go down, but it was a relaxed & friendly environment. Some readings are boring, but the class is cake. 95% of your grade is based on effort so there's no reason not to get an A.

Professor Murphy is really nice and remembers student's names, if you email him asking for help on assignments, he will clarify and explain it to you. He is caring and shares feedback for group projects and essays that actually help. He is very strict on rubric but I would highly recommend taking his class.
he's an awesome professor, but he does take off points for the littlest things
Awesome professor!

As a teacher, Murphy is amazing and very understanding; this is more of a critique of the class as a whole. 50% of your grade is based on a group project, so choose your group wisely, or you will be screwed. The class is a total of around 6-7 assignments, so there is little leeway. though if you do mess up Murphy is very good at providing feedback.
As long as you show up to class, the content is not difficult. Put in effort and complete each assignment with effort, and you will easily excel in this class.

Best teacher I've had here. SO kind and can remember the names of his students which sounds stupid but makes you feel like a human again in such a big campus. He grades nicely and tells you exactly what he is looking for which is very helpful. LOVE HIM!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Murphy is overall a great English professor. Every essay we had to do was graded harshly but did thoroughly explain what you did wrong and what you could do better. Would I take his class again? It is a no because there were about 9 assignments in total that was graded, and each was worth 100 points.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very tough grader. Even if you have perfect attendance, you will not receive an 100%. Extremely heavy accent and overall just very tough on the whole class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this class for the global credit, and it is pretty much basic knowledge. He asks for us to Google things for him during his lecture. Attendance is tracked daily but he won't give you an accurate grade for it. exams are essays, which he grades harshly but says he can't always understand what his students are saying because of language barrier

Articles are read for class. He does not have lectures put together so I'm not sure what I should be focusing on while learning. Making a class that size a discussion class is a bad idea because it takes points off of the final grade since I feel like it's impossible to keep track of everyone.
He is an amazing teacher and very helpful during office hours.I would definitely recommend this class for International studies majors.
Great accent, great guy! Super interesting!

Dr. Murtha is an incredible professor, particularly for graduate level students MKT622. He fosters an engaging, informative and respectful environment. He is the only graduate level professor I've had who understands some of his students have full-time, professional level careers. Great content and discussion. I would take him again in a heartbeat!

Murtha has been my favorite professor so far at UK! If you are even thinking about going into sales, you need to take his class. I have genuinely learned so much through his lectures and selling role plays. There is barely any homework, and exams are online with lockdown. He prints out the lecture slides for you which make up the whole exam.

One of my favorite professors I've had so far at UK. He is very engaging and wants to see his students learn how to sell. He is also a just a cool guy in general and very relatable in the sense that he understands students have lives outside of school and doesn't want his class to take yours over.

Dr, Murtha is no doubt the best professor I've had at UK. He's a great guy and very experienced in sales, so lectures were super helpful and entertaining. Participation is mandatory, so come to class prepared on the sales role play days. I learned a lot in this class and highly encourage everyone to take him!

Dr. Murtha is the man. Has real experience with the content he is teaching and knows how important the skills he is teaching us are. Lots of participation but it ends up being fun as you get more familiar with the content. He really does care about you and your success both in the classroom and outside it. Would take him again in a heartbeat!

Brian Murtha is one of the best teachers I've had at UK. He is extremely funny and is always there to answer questions. The exams are a little tough as it is easy to get the information learned mixed up. A lot of in class role play but it isn't that bad and actually helps with personal selling.

Murtha is a fun, chill dude who has lots of sales experience. He lectures one day and the next you spend the whole class role playing which can be annoying if you dont want to go into selling. 5 Pop quizzes and two tests, take Murtha if you can!

This was by far my favorite class at UK. It is extremely applicable and interactive. You have to participate like crazy which was awkward at first but ended up being really helpful and fun. Brian is a pretty laid back guy but is an important person to get to know because he had a lot of influence in the MKT department. Absolutely take this class!

Murtha is a really cool laid back guy. He is very helpful when coming to ask questions. His exams are little harder than expected. His quizzes are almost entirely out of the SPIN book. I would not recommend buying the other book you harldy have to use it.
Great guy! Made selling interesting. Every week you must role play a selling situation which is useful in the real world. There is a lot of speaking in front of class.

Murtha is a really nice guy and always helpful in class. Connects to students through experiences he's had in selling & in college. Tests are pretty easy and lots of points from just attending (Quizzes are easy if you read a little). Have to roleplay through selling scenarios for points though so if you're shy you'll have to get over it. Take him.

Interesting guy but lectures were hard to follow. Frequently would email asking questions and he wouldn't answer. He seemed genuinely interested  in what he taught which was nice. Very lenient grader and easy to pass.

The lectures were interesting and Tad seemed to be very passionate about the environment. We had interactive lectures, like touring UK's coal plant. This course was very easy, he is very flexible with grading and allows late work ALWAYS. He often pushes back deadlines. He is very easy with grading, I received a 97% in the class with little effort.

Tad is very knowledgeable and understanding. The class was sometimes a little disorganized, but his lectures were interesting and I enjoyed our trip to Robinson Forest. Coursework is very manageable and students are given an option for classes online if needed. He is flexible with deadlines and is always willing to assist his students.
Tad was a good teacher to have first semester and class is all online and open note. I would only take this if you have to, and if you do the TA's are both great and help a lot.

This class was very easy but if you want to actually learn anything take another class. He is a sweet prof but I genuinely could not tell you a single thing I learned from this class. His lectures are boring and his powerpoints are just pictures. All the homework assignments and quizzes/tests are open note, final is optional. Easy class but tedious

This class fits the UKCore criteria. This is the only reason why I took this class. You have to be open-minded and study the PowerPoint posted and you'll do fine. The TA was a little interesting, and we had to say our pronouns in each recitation. However, I still managed a positive grade out of this class!

The reason I didn't like this professor was that the lecture was too boring which made everyone hard to pay attention. When I went to class, half of the students were already taking zoom and realized that this class was no meaningful to go in-person because TA already graded the students in zoom which was kind of nonsense. Very regretful I took GEO

Lecture is mandatory but you really don't have to attend mandatory and just join the zoom because you still get the full attendance grade. Recitation is MANDATORY. Must go. Be award of many quizzes that can break your grade down. Plus careful that the projects and quizzes can interrupt and overlap with your other assignments deadline.

Not sure yet for the grade, I have to wait for the actual grade until final. Class topic is interesting because it is realted to global environmental issues. Final Exam is optional & TA is good and kind which is fine. But there is a thing I didn't like about this class. It was the project and quizzes with unexpected deadline. This is first and end.

I took this course because I wanted to graduate 3 years half + to take uk core even though this course was NOT related to my actual major. I really didn't like it. Why? The first reason, unorganized class lectures with many people. Second, boring and less concentration. Third, project that is due right at the end of the day that is overlap final.

TA's are good. She understands students situations or problems when students are struggling with some quiz or issues. Professor Tad is not that worst, he isn't too bad and nice professor but what I felt difficulty in this class was that many numbers of student & less focusing (professor voice is small) with many teeny tiny quizzes except, its ok.

Attendance is mandatory for recitation because of the attendance grade. So you don't have to be in lecture all the time, try to go recitation as much as you can. Course isn't that worst. It is fun and ok. But make sure be careful of tiny tiny little pop quizzes. Those can be annoying and break down or make up your grade percentage.  Good luck.

This course is not that worst, but one thing to know is that it is hard for all of the student who takes GEO 162 that this class has so much small tiny quizzes which can break down or make up the grade. There are 1 TA and 1 professor in the classroom. TA is kind and nice and do best as she can, but professor is boring and small voice. Quiz annoying

This class is okay but one thing to know is that there are many quizzes that can make up or break down your grade. It might be good to find some friends who are good at quiz and do quizzes together, better than doing quiz by yourself. Dr.T is good but his voice is quite small and sometimes I can't hear very much. Somehow feel so sleepy cause boring

Homework is really annoying and can take forever to do depending on the module. He's super chill professor but the lectures are so boring and hard to pay attention to. There is a final exam and paper in the class. Don't skip recitation
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Took his GEO 162 class and I didn't read or watch anything. I looked up some answers but mostly made educated guesses. DO THE EXTRA CREDIT.

This class is easy as long as you go to class and take notes. Find some people to take the quizzes with and it will make your life easy. When I took this class, it was completely online so it was easy to cheat. Mutersbaugh is an understanding professor and makes class as simple as possible. This is a good class to take in get all credits necessary.

This class was very interesting and I learned many things I had no idea about and he really cared about everything he was teaching. My TA was very helpful in explaining things that the class was confused on and also cared about the topics.

Tad is a great person and super cool, however as a lecturer, he can be a bit boring. You can tell he is really passionate about what he's talking about. The topics discussed in class are interesting, and the assignments are easy. Attendance is taken, but only worth a few points. Go to recitation, actually helps. Easy A.

Tad is all over the place, I honestly never know what he's talking about. The TA is really helpful, she basically does everything. The class is an easy A but the project takes a lot of time and the class is insanely boring/unorganized.

This is a class you should take if you want an easy A, but beware the class is very boring . Went from having 5 tests to only 3, and he drops the lowest. I got an A on the first two tests, so I didn't even have to show up to the final. The project at the end is simple and graded very very fairly. Overall, easy class, but very very boring lectures.

Tad is very mellow. I have only went to a few lectures and I have an "A" in this class. He is very unorganized and cancels a lot of things he wants to do. We were supossed to have 6 Exams.. We had 3. His lectures are very unhelpful because he doesn't really go in depth into the material. He goes off topic a lot. Our quizzes suck.

Tad is very enthusiastic about the materials and is definitely willing to answer any questions you have.  However, the class website, lectures, and overall course are very unorganized.  He switches topics often in class and never has a clear main idea.  The TAs are very helpful though.  They are the reason I passed the exams.

I love Tad! Super chill and laid back. Wanna learn more about what he's teaching? He'll certainly answer any questions you have.  Do your readings, participate in class, show respect, and he'll return the favor.
He was very enthusiastic, although, the material was not much of interest. But he was great!

professor very enthusiastic, some of the topics interesting, others not so much. lectures organized and fairly clear, but sometimes the tangents were more interesting than the actual materials we were supposed to cover. My TA helped a lot with the project, which was easy but long and worth a lot of the final grade. tests really easy.

I rarely went to lecture or did the readings and have a B in the class. The class itself was fairly easy, but when I did go to class, I didn't understand what was going on and it didn't help me on the papers, which I found to have little direction and thus time consuming, but the TAs were pretty helpful.

Global Environmental Issues class, as a freshman, was the most pointless class I've ever had in my entire life. The lectures are terribly boring, and he often rambles, although he is very passionate about his teachings. The recitation is also pointless, but the class itself is easy. two tests, one long project thats broken into 3 parts. Worst Class

This course was ehh, OK. You basically have one big assignment throughout the course and thats about 15 pages of writing total. Just try your hardest and you should be fine. Lectures are boring and tests are not awful. There are only 2. Just make sure you actually try.

Tad is the ish, he is real chill and he only gives two test. The test are basically writing short answers and the TA's grade easy. If you hate this class than you are just lazy. Also theres 4 papers but that is basically the grade. If you do them you will get a A like I did.

This was a new course at UK this semester... and you could definitely tell.  Dr. Mutersbaugh is so passionate about the environment, but his lectures are so boring and he rambles about irrelevant topics.  The project/paper is strenuous and tough, but the TA's are pretty helpful.

I feel that Dr.M's lectures are very informative.He is funny, nice, engaging, and very knowledgeable. He does give work, but thats college.Some people are lost because they don't come to class regularly or come and   stare at Facebook the ENTIRE time.Show up, participate, and pay attention and you will do fine.He has very important info to share!!!

Mumbles in lecture, very hard to understand. Reminds me of Toby Flenderson from the Office, which is not a good thing when you are listening to his lecture. He does not have a very useful syllabus, and his lectures seem random and very unorganized

While the class is wildly informative, and Tad does show much passion for what he teaches, it is not an easy class by all means. The one test is next to impossible, while he expects the paper at the end to be over (or near) 20 pages. For a USP course I did not feel like writing a thesis. If you go, pay attention you should be alright.

DO NOT TAKE unless you want to work your ass off on the final project. 20+ pages, way too much & way too involved for a 100 level class. My 500 level classes have long projects, not 100 levels! Ridiculous, hard to understand, boring, terrible lecturer. Expects way too much out of a 100 level, usually elective class. If you take, take Pass/Fail!

Did not stick to the course description at all and that really ticked me off. Didn't really teach us anything. Talked about 3rd world countries.  The class was pointless.  No type of consistancy in the class.  Had one test, one essay, and a massive project-- all over retarded stuff not relating to the course. Class was a joke. Everone hated it.
BBBBOOOORRRRIIINNNGGGG
No Comments
Awesome guy that really cares about helping students achieve and succeed.
Great!

Tad cuts to the bone and makes the material come alive.  His anecdotal teaching style never fails to connect even the most difficult material to real world experiences.  Treat him like a human, talk to him like a friend, and he will enrich your life.

This guy might be the best prof I've ever had.   He really helps you to understand the material and I also learned to look at the world in a new way, which I guess is what college is supposed to be about.  I highly recommend him and he's a cool guy too!

I did not go to class but once a week I got a B.There was one exam in the beginning and you could opt out of the final, if you finished your semester long project.The project was difficult and very vague in what he expected even if you talked to him.

This class is a great class to take to satisfy a USP credit because the teacher is awesome he keeps the material interesting. The papers are not bad you just have to give him exactly what he asks for. I got an A, just go to class!
No Comments

He is ok. I personally liked doing the homework, but I know others disliked how long they can be. I don't like that he would put some parts of difficult homework questions on exams. I recommend aiming to get good grades on the first few exams to maintain a good grade. Studying homework and practice exams is essential.

Last semester I took Physics 1 with Murthy. Even though I got a high B in the course I'm greatly struggling in physics 2 this semester. After speaking with my current professor in physics 2, I am greatly lacking in my prerequisite knowledge due to Murthy's incomprehensible lectures. I'm going to have to drop physics 2 this semester and self study.

reviews.comment: The testing style is unfair for the course; 8 questions hardly cover the material, but somehow, tests include material that wasn't taught. The class is easy enough to learn material through recitations and homework; tests typically follow the same pattern as study guides. Would not recommend rustling in front of him, it makes him very nervous.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Homework's took about 8 hours to complete on average and we had one every week. Our final exam average was a 30. I got an A because a lot of the grade was homework which I just spent a lot of time on and he had to change the grading scale twice in order for enough people to pass. He is a very cool guy and would be an awesome friend but not a prof.
Overcomplicates things and tests over unfamiliar material. Our final averages were 35 and 39. Save yourself and do not take this man's class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Although I did poorly in this course, Murthy was the reason I didn't fail his lectures are good, although sometimes he can move too fast, and he is extremely accessible outside of class since he has 5 hours of office hours a week and prior to exams he has very lengthy office hours. The hardest part is that his exams are very difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He tries but this dude can't teach

He is not as bad as many of the reviews here. He is funny. He has lots of office hours, and always willing to help outside of classroom. His teaching is not comprehensible for beginners. He is a very passionate guy though. Overall a easy class to pass with an A (85%). Obviously if you have a choice choose Gannon. His curves are great tho.

It is clear that Dr. Murthy is knowledgeable in physics and has previously taught graduate students. However, he struggles to teach the basics conceptually to those with little or no background experience. He does curve his class, and his office hours are easily accessible; regardless, you should expect to teach yourself.

He is just not good at teaching. I'll definitely get an A, but only because I have had to teach myself everything on my own. The lectures are quite incomprehensible. He is also quite disrespectful. He has even said to the class, "I expect most of you all to fail on this exam". Like WHAT?! He does have pretty open office hours and does curve though.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I really just don't think that he is good at teaching. I'm definitely going to get an A in the class, but not because of the lectures at all. I have had to teach myself almost everything in the class. Not a fun experience. He's even said to us that "I expect most of you all to fail this exam", and just overall has been quite disrespectful :(
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Very funny guy. That being said, he is also very smart but if you had a choice between him and Gannon, I would pick Gannon. I never had problems with any of the tests but some of the lectures would fall short and not be as intuitive as the previous. Overall, you will pass and should with at least a B. If you got below a B in Murthys, its on you.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: People writing bad reviews got upset they couldn't use GPT for the most recent midterm because of TA's sitting in the back of the lecture room. If you take the practice midterm and just memorize simplified formulas you will pass with a good grade. I love how Murthy marks to help students understand concepts visually. Very cool guy btw!

Great guy. Very fun to talk to. His lectures were very solid in the first two thirds of the semester, but rotational motion, torque, etc. felt a little more rote and unintuitive. Otherwise, I think Dr. Murthy's ratings are plagued with people who enter university as a means to an end and are averse to being pushed out of their comfort zone.

I just got out of taking the last midterm in Murthy's intro to physics course. I had the pleasure of seeing the class before me leave from their midterm and many were in tears from the difficulty of the class and the lack of instruction Murthy provides us with. When I turned in my exam, in tears, Murthy asked me if I checked my answers and laughed.
Today I took the last midterm for my ph

Professor Murthy should not be teaching an intro to physics course. Calculus1 is a corequisite, but he expects you to know integral techniques not learned until Calculus 2. His lectures mostly consist of PowerPoint slides with the problems already worked out and reads directly from them. Difficult pop quizzes in class are 10% of your overall grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I had him as a professor in PHY231. He seems like he would do a better job teaching in a graduate level class, since he teaches things with the assumption that you already know it. He had to change the grading scale both this semester and last semester due to the class average on the tests are consistently in the 50 to 60 range.

Though it was medium difficulty class for me personally, the lectures were really interesting. He was really funny and his explanations were so thorough. He did many demos in class that kept me invested. He also often pushed back the due date for homeworks for the students who ask.

I genuinely don't understand how people can dislike him. Sure, first semester he was not that good since he had not taught in 15 years but now it's not so bad. The majority of people that are mad probably have a 1.5 gpa and are giving him bad reviews. His demos are very interesting.

He makes the lectures enjoyable and he is funny. The only problem is the lengthy homework assignments but he will do any problem that you ask him to in class. The practice exams are identical to the real ones and he makes it easy to pass especially since one gets dropped. 85% is an A so the class isn't as bad as last semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Simply put: He's way too smart to be teaching freshman students
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures overcomplicate topics. Packing up early or even a smirk during lecture will cause him to ("foam at the mouth," his words). Homework's time-consuming but practice exams match actual exams. Exam 3 average was 67% and he remarked it was too easy, and we got too high of a score. Exams are 8 questions, missing one heavily impacts your score.

Professor definitely knows what he is talking about. Just as any other class, if you don't listen to the professor, it will be difficult. homework is light work, and the exams are only 8 questions. He gives you easy points on iclickers and will literally tell you the answers and this is helpful since iclickers are 10% of your grade.

Best and smartest physics teacher I've ever taken. Very funny lectures and if you do work and listen, you will get AT LEAST a B. He's always available for office hours and explains things very well. Remember to ignore air resistance and FN is perPENNdicular to the ground. Make sure to stop rustling at end of the class.

I had professor murthy last semester and I'm taking his class again. Truth be told he was terrible. He has slightly improved this semester but not by much. I'd recommend understanding calculus beforehand because he somehow manages to make the process for derivatives and integrals extremely confusing. Try and avoid him if you want a decent grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Awesome professor with easy class. Class is light if you take it with Professor Murthy.
W professor.

He can't explain any of the concepts effectively. Going to lecture is essentially useless and a large portion of your grade is based on iclicker quizzes that he did not spend time teaching about. Homeworks are 20-25 questions and often have 6-7 parts. Exams are similar to practice exams, though.

He speeds though material and does not explain difficult concepts clearly, found myself watching YouTube videos after almost every lecture. Attendance is mandatory and graded via intentionally misleading and difficult iClicker questions. However, the exams are pretty similar to the practice exams and homework.

Professor will stop class if he sees you talking, no matter what level of noise you speak. Has terrible clicker questions that are not based on previously learned content and does not care if you do poor on the tests. Uses an outdated platform for homework that punishes you for trying more than three times.
Goes too fast, and still can't seem to finish on time. Seems like he genuinely cares about his students which keeps it from being a 1, but teaches like we know what he's talking about.

feel bad for students in fall 2024. heard he was terrible. He is better now. teaching style is difficult to follow. But he has a lot of office hours which I find very helpful. He wants his students to succeed, and I see him trying to do better. His first exam was similar to the study guides. average this time around was 66%. I think he is doable.

reviews.comment: Avoid at all costs.
would not take again
Don't do it

reviews.comment: All the people complaining, get over yourselves. Not everything is going to be taught the way you learn right now. Yea he blew at first but gave several opportunities for full-credit retake exams and nearly tripled his office hours. I hear he's a lot better now, but shame on the 1 of 5s for being too lazy and arrogant to adjust the way they learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: In the beginning it was very hard to learn considering he hasn't taught a class in a long time. However he understood that and changed a lot of things towards the end of the semester. It was too late to improve the classes grade overall but he was very leient. I'm sure he will be fine next semester. Hopefully.

Murthy isn't as bad as people say. While his lectures are sometimes hard to follow, as long as you understand the appliances of physics he is doing you will be fine. Hes a great professor and always cracks jokes in class. He always makes sure that everyone is on the same page whether it be over actual content or structure of the class. He is a very easygoing grader and he understands his students. Definitely recommend taking one of his classes.

She was a good professor have to have an opened mind going into this course

Alexis is a wonderful professor and you should take her if you have the chance. Alexis Hadden cares about her students and always keeps students interested in class. She is young, so she understands her students, but is also respectable. She does not grade too hard either.
