Nenadic is the best professor I've had at UK, and I have 104 credit hrs. She makes class interesting, she's published in her area, she has numerous personal accomplishments in her field, and she's all around nice and a great professor.

Awful teaching! The way she gives feedback's annoying and humiliating. Some of them are unnecessary & will make you feel like a kindergartener. She takes everything personally and comments are quite condescending such as "I have never reviewed anybody's grade in my life, no matter what. So no point in discussion." Very much egotistic, overbearing.
Annoying and unnecessarily long lectures. Everything is on paper, so much homework and attendece is mandatory. Never take her class.

be ready to hate yourself. she is too personal when she leaves comments on assignments. if you have an aspiration to be a writer in the future, do not take this course. she will make you feel terrible about yourself. 
also take at least 8 hours to study for each exam 
papers need to be absolutely perfect 
buy the book
Does not know how to run a rehearsal correctly for the orchestra to improve and is not respectful towards students time.

Nardolillo has done wonders for the music program and its students here at UK. He's a hilarious guy with a lot of stories to tell. Will work you with an intensive schedule and set of programs, but that's probably what you're looking for with 191. Loves making music together. Certainly one of the top university conductors around!
Nardolillo is an amazing director who cares about all of his students! He made this fall season better than I thought it would be. A very great person!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Great orchestra director. Picks challenging rep and has very high standards.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: being in an orchestra is pretty simple. be on time and prepared. If you ask for help he will find out a way to help you. Maestro goes out of his way to provide great opportunities for his students. He brings in great musicians to perform with the orchestra. He might not use exactly descriptive words sometimes but what he is trying to say is clear.
Nardolillo is excellent. Such an incredible orchestra director. Cares so much for all of his students.

Brings in great guest artists and programs large scale repertoire. Due to insufficient score study, rehearsals lack clear direction and the quality of music-making is continually poor. Performances routinely are underwhelming and guest artists have been known to complain about artistic quality. He is a nice person and boasts a pleasant demeanor.

Excellent conductor and leader. He has taken the orchestra to a level most colleges will never see. The orchestra has a recording contract, goes to Carnegie Hall, and plays with the worlds best musicians. Recently: Boston Pops, Itzhak Perlman, and soon Lang Lang. Very excellent program. Great person.

Professor Nardolillo is an acceptable conductor and picks the right literature. I just don't think he's a great teacher or leader. He doesn't speak in specifics during rehearsal; ex. he asks for things to be "drier" or "crispy." I expect more from a tenured professor at a school of music.
He's a great maestro. If you join the orchestra, you truly get opportunities to do things that you may not have been able to do without him. He's truly taken UK's orchestra to an unbelievable level.

Good professor, keeps everything very clear, and the rules are very obvious. He's very nice to people who don't quite get the music. He goes way out of his way to provide incredible opportunities to his students.
Good professor. He can teach the material well. However he does not make the exam and his TA grade the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Overall, he is a good professor. When he teaches in class, he will often skip steps. He always posts his notes on Canvas after class. Attendance does not matter. The only bad part about this class is the TAs. Go to his office hours if you need help, he is overall a good teacher.

His lectures were often easy to understand, but the application of what we learned in lectures was hard to understand. I had to watch a lot of Organic Chemistry Tutor videos to really get it. I could have skipped the lectures, but I didn't. It's an okay class just very hard.
His lectures are easy to follow and if you were confused going to his office hours really helps.

Dr. Stapleton was a knowledgeable and helpful professor. I felt that he always explained things clearly during lectures, plus his pace for going over problems was good. Other friends in MA 123 who didn't have Dr. Stapleton seemed to be more confused. I highly recommend taking his class.

It felt like he was teaching this course the most confusing way possible. Anytime I would meet one of my friend who took MA123 with a different prof., they would show me how to work out problems in a much simpler way. Extremely nice guy, but teaching the class like its not new material for us.

Dr. Stapleton is a great, easy-going professor who enjoys teaching. He is very approachable and is open to answering any questions during lectures. He also builds in "homework days" during the week. The prof is great, but the TAs are god awful. So, take that into consideration.
Dr. Stapleton is a nice guy and, overall, a good teacher. The only problem is he sometimes skips over steps, assuming the class knows what he did. Other than that, zero complaints.

If the exams were up to him, it would be a piece of cake. But the terrible TAs make the exam and base it off a combination of recitation and webwork. First class i actually cried in because I couldn't understand the HW. But he makes lecture doable.

Good professor, posts notes in canvas . There are clicker questions but you can skip if you have a friend to give you the answers. He was a good teacher in general, nothing really stands out. Best I could expect for a calc professor so far

Dr. Stapleton is a great person. He is very funny and he gives good responses when students ask him any questions in class. It might be difficult to understand when he first introduces new material but he will take some examples to simplify it. Also, he responds emails very quickly!
He's amazing!

He's very funny and always tries to relate to his students. He is very easy to talk to and explains concepts thoroughly. I highly recommend him and suggest office hours visits. It's very obvious that he knows what he's doing, despite being young.
Great professor! Definitely will be looking to take more classes with him as I progress in my academic career.

He explains things thouroughly in class and frequently asks is we have questions which is appreciated. He writes out all the class notes clearly during class everyday which means its easy to follow along. He seems to really care about if his students are undersatnding what is going on. I would take his class again.

In my experiences, he's good at explaining why math is the way it is. I took AP Calculus AB in high school. He did good explaining where a lot of the ideas and concepts came from and why they work. But I don't believe he did a good job teaching how to use the new concepts. Or how to do them.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Hes a great professor, really personable and does a good job of explaining things. Also prepares students well for tests by reviewing everything the two classes before the test, and answers any questions during or after class.

Best professor Ive had! Allows plenty of time for clicker questions and any other questions during class. Uploads notes almost immediately when he is done for the day. His lectures are engaging and fairly easy to follow. Always willing to help.
Quite easy class. Just make sure you ask questions if you need, Stapleton will answer any question!

I already took calculus in high school, so this class was pretty easy for me. I really enjoy his lectures though! Gives plenty of time for people to ask questions in lecture, and checks to make sure we get it. He uploads notes after class, that's helpful. He's nice and is self-aware; if I could take him for calc 2 I definitely would.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Best professor I've had. His lectures can be difficult to understand when he first introduces a topic, but he does a great job of providing examples to help you understand. There is homework due before every lecture, but they're usually only 3-5 problems and really help to reinforce the material. Very personable and wants his class to succeed.

Organized very well; you will never have to question what you have to do because it's the same every week: a discussion post over a chapter in the book and a quiz. She gives audio feedback on discussion posts, and quizzes/exams are open-book + open-note. She clearly wants her students to succeed. 10/10
She responds quickly to emails. The class is structured in a way that you can succeed. There are weekly assignments, but they don't take that much time.
This is not a difficult class. Attendance is graded, so go to class. The information was helpful.
Great professor. If you show up and do the reading, it's not that hard to get an A. She's always willing to take your nutritional questions.

Dr. Nehls wants her students to succeed. If you do the reading and go to class, getting an A isn't that hard. She does expect you to be present, and she is always willing to take your nutritional questions.

She'll take off points for things and then not explain why those points were taken away from you. If you email on certain days she won't answer. If she makes a mistake with assignments she'll blame it on the class for not telling her. If I didn't have to take her class I would've dropped it, no reason why an online course was this bad.

Dr. Nehls was very disrespectful to me. She cares way too much about literally nothing. She assigns busy work. The papers she makes you write are easy and on simple topics but she grades them too much. I completed an assignment "too fast" and she though I cheated. She cares way way way too much for an easy class like KHP-151.
Good professor overall, just make sure you pay attention and study.

Profe Neely is an amazing professor. I absolutely loved the class. I actually had his SPA 203 class. It was outstanding work on his part. He made learning the language fun and memorable. If I had the opportunity to take the entire Spanish minor in just his class I would. Amazing!

this guy is the best, so kind and upbeat and teaches spanish in a thorough, easy to understand way. he gives 3 free absences before requiring excuses and is always willing to help w tricky spanish things. takes FOREVER, like actually forever, to grade things.. but definitely take him to make spanish easier!!

Nice, wants you to learn Spanish well. Sometimes he speaks so much Spanish that's its hard to comprehend anything. I think if he just said a few words in English to keep your mind on the subject, it would help out a lot more. However, the class was pretty easy as long as you study for the exams.

Very passionate professor who makes Spanish easy and fun to learn. Every lecture is heavily involved which makes it easier to learn. Would definitely recommend Dr. Neely if you want a more involved and caring professor. Very effective
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class was a 3 hour lecture on Wednesday nights and it was horrible. You aren't allowed to see your grade until the end of the semester cuz she doesn't know how to use canvas. She regularly posts the incorrect info/missing half the info for assignments and doesn't fix it until the day its due. Also so so much reading and homework
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Its obvious Ms. Nelson loves children's lit and this position fits her perfectly. I took her for a night class which was really long and boring but I got a lot out of it. You HAVE to stay on top of your work if you want to do well and get ready to read and review 25+ kids books.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Becky nelson is a good person but a horrid professor. She tells the story of how she just fell into the position by chance and it shows. Her syllabus is unclear and confusing and when you ask for clarification she tells you to check the syllabus. Be prepared to read 30 plus kids books and write reviews. Will accept all work until the last day.
Loved my Children's Literature class with her! Very easy to talk to and you can tell she loves what she does. Would recommend!

She is completely unorganized with her syllabus and is NEVER clear on when assignments are due.  When there are assignments, some of the directions are vague.  Pay VERY close attention if you take this course with her because she is very unorganized with the class.  STAY ON TOP OF EVERYTHING!!!!!!!!!!!

This professor loves books, and teaches a literature course. Her syllabus sucks. It is the most ridiculous syllabus I have ever seen. I almost failed her class because I wasn't turning in the right assignments at the right time. Make sure to print off a copy of the syllabus, and read the assignments several times over. Avoid class if possible.

Prof. Neto was super nice and his class was very easy. There are a few papers but they aren't detailed, otherwise you just have to play guitar pieces for grades, and he is forgiving. You will learn playing and reading/writing music. If you have some light experience with guitar you can pass this class without a second thought.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy class, great & fun professor for intro guitar.

I enjoyed this class, wish I participated more in it. It is easy to get off track from showing up to class, but it is important to make sure you do well. Has a workbook that you turn in pages from. Few exams and a few concert report papers. Easy, fun professor. Sometimes hard to understand, but he explains everything perfectly!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr Melissa Morgan (Newman) is amazing! The labs great and you learn a lot. Attend her class and pay attention to her lectures and you will get A+.

look to your lab assistant to do well. the assistant is lenient, but you must remember that its the professor who gives final grades. the professor is absent many days because she has a 2nd tedious job she is forever reminding people of. the classheavy duty labs 2x week followed by lecture 3x a week. semester long project, lab reports, bogus exams
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Need more Like Dr. Newman

Dr Newman does a great job. Her tests can be difficult but if you show up and study she will teach you what you need to know. She likes give extra credit and have guest speakers. If you want to leave a class actually having learned the material, this is the instructor for you

I went into this class afriad it would be difficult, but it's the easiest lab I've ever taken.  Prof Newman is hilarious and draws all her questions from the reading.  The lab part is a bit unorganized, but not hard as long as you don't leave anything blank.  Take this class!  She loves to give A's and give extra credit and awesome test reviews.

Do anything you can to not take this teacher. He reads off slides without explaining it, and flies through content. The average for the tests would be below 50% and the average for the final was a 36%. I got a 37 even after studying 20+ hours. Do not him for your own mental health's sake.

He seems like a nice guy, but lecture is unhelpful as he reads off his written notes and homework is not anything like the exams. You can get lucky with some exams that end up being similar to the practice ones given, but the final is just brutal. I would try to get another prof in this course if you can.

He is a terrible teacher. Had to adjust his grading scale just so more people could pass because he is that bad of a teacher. Reads directly off slides and flys through material without really expanding upon things. I learned more from five minute YouTube videos than I did sitting in his class for weeks.

If you can help it, NEVER take this man for PHY 211. He is a horrible teacher who should have retired 10 years ago. He is the kind of teacher that reads directly off his slides. He never dives into the WHY of topics, but rather quickly skims over things without really teaching the student how to work with the material.

Dr. Martin is a terrible professor. He uses the same notes that he's used for the last 30 years and hasn't changed anything about them. The exams are nothing like the homework, recitation or lab. He doesn't teach and the class is set up for failure. The average for our final was a 38, the highest score was an 88 and he refuses to curve it.

This is by far the WORST professor at University of Kentucky. Never ever take this teacher for any class, he flys through notes without actually explaining and does not clearly teach anything. If you have the opportunity to take any other professor for physics... take them!

Martin is so funny and yet such a horrible lecturer. Don't plan on learning anything during class meetings. Gives a ton of partial credit on the exams, but the final is MC and very, VERY difficult. Do well on the first exam, it is the easiest by far. I recommend a regular tutor if you aren't a physics person.

The notes are horrendous and borderline impossible to read. He's a funny guy but his exams were brutal. An 80% is an A, but the class average on the final was a solid 45%. It's just unpredictable what will be on the exam. Homework is cake, lab truly depends on the TA, and recitation was easy. Just don't tank the exams whatever you do. They're rough
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Martin is probably one of the worst professors I have ever had. He does not teach in a way that makes anything understandable. His tests are not reflective at all of the material covered in class, on homework, and on practice exams. I went into the final having studied for 24+ hours and it still managed to drop me 7 points from an A to a B.
His notes suck, just reads off of a screen. Recitation is useless. The lab is a pain. Impossible to study for his tests as you don't know what will be on it

Online PHY211 was definitely difficult. Dr. Martin used a projector and hand written notes for lecture, but his notes were pretty helpful in terms of what you need/don't need to know. Tests were HARD, recitation helped, in class clicker-quizzes, and worst of all - lab. I pray lab goes back in person, online SUCKED!

Monica is so sweet and felt like my Mom away from home. She is very personable and is a very easy class to do well in. She will talk about politics and will lean left but during class discussions she will take a nonbiased side. Also has a reading almost every day, but they take like five minutes. Projects are easy, but you need to go to class.
You kind of read alot, but it's nothing crazy. Super easy class, coolest teacher ever.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Monica is very entertaining and connects with her students. She tries to avoid any stress inducing assignments and is very understanding. The class is super easy, we just read articles and talk about them with the class. There are a few big projects but she gives a lot of time to complete them.

She's amazing! I loved this class so much. For my class, she would do reading assignments twice a week where you have to comment on it and the grading scale is a bit scuffed on that, but she usually rounds up. She said she was unsure if she was keeping this. There are 2 group projects that you MUST have good partners for (don't make my mistake).
Love love love her! Her class is fun and her assignments are easy. Definitely recommend taking this class. There's about 3-4 projects but they aren't stressful or difficult.
Monica is amazing. Attendance is a grade but she makes class so much fun. 10/10 would take her class again.

This will be the easiest class you take at UK. The only downside is that it is an hour and 15 minutes. It is super boring and a bit out of the way, but it is a great GPA booster. Ms. Nielson is super nice and cracks lots of jokes. She's very down to earth, too.

Professor Neilson was a great person, but this class was terribly boring. I used it as a study hall every time. But, it was easy and is definitely a GPA booster. Would recommend, just be ready to be bored to death

Monica is amazing. I love her. She is very relatable and laid back. She is also hilarious. This class was actually really interesting and you talk about topics that you can actually relate to. Overall I loved this course and Monica made it 100x better.
I LOVE HER. She is amazing and I always look forward to her class. She is very caring and knows her students. I hope I can have another class with her in the future!
Professor Monica Nielsen is very sweet and caring. You can tell she truly cares about her students. Attendance is mandatory but she gives great feedback and grades fairly.
this class was easy but so pointless, the lectures were pointless and I would just do other homework during class. its an easy gpa booster but the actual class time is very boring.
so amazing and caring. she makes class fun and genuinely just a great person to talk to. I love her
Monica, yes she lets you call her that, is amazing. She's super sweet and understanding. She is helpful and never boring. She grades easily all you have to do is show up and not sleep.

Monica is awesome. She is super approachable and understanding towards students. She remembers college life from when she went to UK so she really seems to get it. She is definitely there to help you and won't let you fail. She is like a mom and I would totally recommend taking her for UK 101! I felt extra prepared after taking her class.

She is a very smart woman, but gets sidetracked easily in her lectures are very hard to follow. Your grade 100% depends on your TA. There are only four quizzes, your midterm, your final, and attendance in your recitation. Not an easy class. You need to work for your grade.

Dr. Brown is super kind but I was not a fan of her lectures. Attendance was not mandatory for lecture and she would often get so side tracked in class. I took this class for UK CORE thinking it was going to be an easy A, but I really had to work for the grade because the tests were nothing like what we actually learned in lecture AND recitation.

Often gets off topic during the lectures and talks extremely fast. has bullet-pointed slides, but if you aren't in the lecture and actively listening to every single word she says, you will not do well on the tests. Overshares and goes off topic of the actual information, then expects us to write at the speed of light to catch all the info.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is a very kind and smart woman, but her class can be difficult to follow. Impossible to get above a 95 on anything. She is very passionate about things she cares about but sometimes this can lead the class off track leaving you feeling unprepared for papers, debates, quizzes, etc. I would not take this class again. Class attendance is key.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: would not recommend. almost impossible to meet her standards. class wasn't even that difficult and the material was not hard but it is basically impossible to get full credit on any assignment, coming from a 4.0 student. graded by very few assignments too, no extra assignments to bring up your grade
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was only graded on 5 things. Every point matters. You won't ever get full credit on something she personally grades so getting an A requires almost perfection.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Had her for HIS 109. Super engaging in lecture, plays videos, fairly interesting. Class was super easy, attendance is only mandatory for recitation. Graded only by a few open book quizzes and open book midterm/final. Also posts slides online, so no need to go to lectures at all. More work came from TA's and recitations than the actual class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Brown is so sweet and caring. Her lectures are fairly interesting although she does get off track sometimes. She engages with the class a lot during lecture which I personally love. Attendance is only required in recitation. Grading was extremely fair/easy but there are very few assignments (most of the grades come from super easy quizzes).
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great person and a good professor. Some parts of her course are very disorganized, but I was able to retain information relatively easily due to her lectures. Course is graded fairly, only have to do 5 assignments out of 12, midterm was easy and she walked you through it (open note), and final was also very easy. Most tedious is weekly assignments.
She engages with the students instead of just talking all class and she always posts the notes so you can keep up outside of the lectures
Gets very off topic and doesn't teach too much in lectures. That being said, tests and quizzes are on canvas and open note so it's super easy.

She is probably one of the most awful professors I have had this year she has to look up half the information she's giving us. She never goes in order for then notes, and she kind of just has a bad personality with students that don't try as hard

Always all over the place. could never stay on topic and barely teaches as is. Will immediately lower a grade if you don't quote the textbook, even if it has nothing to do with the topic. takes attendance every class, but it never counts towards your grade. all reading assignments are basically optional because you only need 2 a whole semester.
Doesn't take attendance and all quizzes/tests are open book, so going to class isn't necessary.

Dr. Nguyen is a very intelligent person.  There were only a few lectures that she gave over the Vietnam War that was boring, however she did her best to make it interesting.  She was always willing to answer questions.  The only downside was not giving more information about upcoming tests.  I would recommend her especially for this class.

Professor Nguyen is incredibly interesting and her lectures are really easy to follow. I had no interest in the Vietnam War before this class but she made it so that I really enjoyed it! Would take her again, no questions asked!
Great Teacher and fun to work with. We need more History professor like this at UK.

I'll be honest, I do not agree with how she does group assignments. I don't think its wise to let students choose their groups. But I really love Brooke and she is so so sweet and caring. She makes it a point to engage in convos with every student and remember details about them. I would take this class again!

I can say confidently that Brooke Nowicki is the nicest professor on Uk's campus. She truly wants to get to know her students and cares for each and every one. She also helps with anything you need school or job wise.
Brooke is my favorite prof at UK so far. Work is easy, and she makes the class really enjoyable. Take her for any Com course!
I love Professor Nowicki! She is by far my favorite teacher I have had at UK. She is super understanding and caring and relates to the class. She grades very fair and gives great lectures.
Brooke is an amazing professor who is willing to help you out when needed. She makes sure that everyone is on the same page when learning about a topic and I loved having her as a professor!

Dr.Nowicki is amazing. I took her class for CIS 220, and she has helped me a lot in building my resume. She has also introduced me to many internship opportunities by attending great career fairs.

She is also so kind and inspiring. I would 100% retake a class taught by her again!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is my favorite teacher I've had at UK! She is so nice and caring, and she makes lectures fun and laid back. As long as you put in the work, you will get an A in this class. HIGHLY recommend!

Easily, my favorite professor, I have had thus far at UK. It is very hard to not do well in this class, she is so easy to listen to and I actually enjoy going to this class. She gives great feedback on papers & speeches. This class is very speech heavy, which I struggled with initially, but she gives great advice and prepares you for everything!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Miss Nowicki is easily one of the best teachers I have ever had. She obviously cares so much about her students and comes to class everyday prepared to help us. As a freshman college was very overwhelming, but she made it easier for me to adjust. Show up to class (you will want to) and you will be fine!! Highly recommend!!

Dr Norris is fantastic!! Knows exactly what art students need. I really felt like he took an interest in my work, even though it was a bit unconventional. Shows off dozens of unique artists over the semester for inspiration and technique. He even takes feedback from students for class direction. Everything about this guy is great.

extremely caring and gives amazing feedback. really clearly cares about his students and is always willing to go over progress and give advice on direction. during critique, he really talks about your work with genuine interest and care, with attention to detail. Amazing professor, probably the best one in the fine arts building.

He is a super nice person and there are a lot you can learn from him. He is flexible with the projects he assigns and is open to discuss with you any ideas you have. He cares about his students and is willing to work outside of class to help them out. 100% recommend!

John is a great professor. He gives you good feedback and taught me a lot about photoshop. I'm sure I would have learned more if all classes were in person, but he did the best with what he had. I enjoyed his class and his projects a lot.

One of the top professors in the math department. Provides guided lectures notes that are easy to follow and figure out on your own and actual lectures were super clear and understandable. If you just go to class, take notes, and pay attention you likely won't have to do much studying outside of class. Super nice and will respond to emails.

Incredible professor helped me prepare for statistics. I will be forever grateful for Mr. Nguyen. He cares about his students succeeding and cares for them and makes everyone feel like they matter and are seen. He is like a gem and a gift to the University of Kentucky. Protect this man at all cost. He loves math and loves to teach.

Dr. Nguyen has been so understanding and helpful when it came to missing certain quizzes due to illness, he's very understanding, and respectful of everyone's personal situation. His lectures are also fantastic I struggle with math but the way he teaches really helped me as he speaks in a calm way with lots of visual examples.

Dr. Nguyen is very well educated and teaches things very well, MA 109 is a fairly simplistic class as is but he always makes sure that everyone is still paying attention and getting all the needed information. He is always willing to set up office hours and answer questions in class if you start to feel lost.

The grading system is probably the worst one ever. There's 5 topics plus 1 for homework. In order to get an A you have to pass all of them. In order to pass a topic you need to get at least a 8/10 on 2 out of 5 quizzes. I didn't get an A because I got all 7s and 7.5s on one topic. If you can get out of taking this class, please do. (Took Fall 2024)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy A if you're fairly decent at math. Dr. Nguyen is not engaging at all and reads off the slides. I didn't go to class, but finished with an A because he sent an email before the exam telling us what would be asked. Would recommend if you need the course credit, but not if you are interested in probability.

Amazing i love him dearly. Lectures can be not as fun, but he does explain everything super super well and posts all slides and examples he does in class. Just do the work on time and study for the quizzes, they are straightforward. He gives information on what's on quizzes. Do your homework, communicate, and listen he's amazing.
Super respectful and genuinely a nice guy who cared about his students. Class made sense too.
He's super nice!! Please if you're having trouble with anything in this class talk to him about he's very understanding.
Dr. Nguyen was very kind whenever I reached out. Very helpful as well. You could tell that he really cared and wanted us to do well.

The class is made for you to pass. If you don't pass that's on you. Dr.Nguyen explains the class from the get go. He goes over simple concepts multiple times allowing for you to really understand it. He's always happy to help if you need it. Very sweet personality.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Nguyen's lectures are super informative with a pretty light info load and plenty of examples. Hw is fairly easy until a few of the later topics, but the exams are straight forward. If you have taken a stats class and/or are generally good at math, this should be a fairly easy A.

Weekly hw and quiz through webwork. Some hw problems can be pretty challenging but the exams are straightforward and graded leniently. A lot of exam problems come from webwork quizzes, take-home quizzes, and problems on the lecture slides. Also very accessible outside of class.
Exams and quizzes aren't bad. Weekly hw but everything you need will be on the slides. He's a really great teacher!

Dr. Nguyen is a good professor and teaches the class very well, however, you need to show up to get a good grade. There is lots of homework and quizzes but nothing that is difficult. This is not a professor who will cause you anxiety.

All you do is take notes then have a quiz on it. The quizzes were often but they are 5 questions max and beyond easy. Homework was not excessive. He's really boring but gives good examples when lecturing. He drops the worst 2 quiz grades. Attendance isn't required but he has class participation grades every class.  Super easy & I passed with a 99

Professor Nguyen was an amazing professor, especially for someone who struggles with math. He explains all the concepts very clearly and makes himself readily available for students who need help. He also has easy extra credit. If you have the chance to have this professor, take it.

If you are taking MA 111, take Dr. Nguyen's class. His lectures are so easy to follow and he truly cares that you fully understand the material he teaching. He tries so hard to make all of his students succeed. If you attend class and do the homework, you are sure to get an A in the class.
Explains clearly during his lessons. Easy to pass class.

Gave great examples of how to use every formula in class, so it was a relatively easy class. My only critique is that his lectures weren't very engaging, as in I just found myself sitting there bored most of the time, although that wasn't much of a problem for me since the content wasn't very hard to understand and attendance is optional anyway.

I'm retaking the class and HOLY SMOKES this guy is so much better than Cidambi. His lectures are super clear, gives good examples, and thoroughly walks through everything. Got a D last semester and now I have 100% in this class because he's a great teacher. Weekly HW which is short, and weekly quizzes that you get 3 attempts at
Dr. Nguyen was very interested in the topics of his lecture. While the class is an easy A, the topics are very cool to anyone interested in various mathematical theories. (Graph Theory, Game Theory)

It is worth pushing off probability until you can take it with him! Ridiculously thorough and detailed lectures, and really cares about his students. Exams covered the material but were never overly hard, and course materials were well organized. He talks slowly, which could be a drawback, but during pandemic times I watched the recordings in 2x.

Take Dr. Nguyen for MA111!!! Lectures are very clear and PowerPoints are posted to Canvas after class Reef purchase is mandatory for participation credit Do your homework and listen to lectures and its an easy A !
Participation on reef mandatory and in class assignments make up the participation grade. Good professor and explains concepts clearly but goes fast during lectures.
2 homework assignments per week, online, some were guess and check. Does NOT explain things well and moves very fast. Most of the class talked over him and we all helped each other pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He is literally the best calculus professor I have taken. He explains every concept step by step and if you do not get it, he will repeat it for you. Genuinely cares about his students doing well in the class. He gives a study guide and the test is basically the study guide. I enjoyed the class and will take again!

Dr. Nguyen is really great. His class is all about powerpoints, word problems, and answering questions on the screen. Don't take the 8am: you will fall asleep. Outside online homework that's deceptively short usually 1-15 questions. You do have to pay for Reef to check into class every time. Would easily take again and I'm not a math person.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This man is the sweetest person on Earth. So many people took advantage of him being more quiet and it was so sad. He truly cares about each of his students. Any time I had a math question, he would email back within minutes with a very detailed explanation. He goes into so much detail about every single problem and is always willing to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Although odd in nature, professor Nguyen is by far one of my favorites! His class is set up to be organized and simple. He strictly follows a test schedule and everything on his exams are on exactly what you learn in class. It's perfect for people who hate or are terrible at math like me, because he goes over the content pretty slow and clearly.

This man is possibly the clearest lecturer I have ever had, and I've had a lot. He speaks as precisely as a textbook reads, is enjoyable to listen to, and his Powerpoints are great. He is also very attuned to student learning and gave additional info answering many questions before they were even asked.

Dr. Nguyen was a pretty good professor. He's kind of an odd character and isn't as authoritative as he should be, but he teaches his material really well and over all his class was extremely easy. Just do the homework he assigns (which is incredibly easy), come to class, and study for his exams and you'll do great in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He is a good professor. Just take notes and go to class and everything will be good.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: One of the easiest math classes I have taken. As long as you show up to do the Reef polling and do the online homework you should get an easy A. Not going to lie he is a little weird, but you get used to it. He explains the material to where it is easy to comprehend. Would definitely take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Tests? Not many--Would take again

reviews.comment: Dr. Nguyen is a fine professor. He tends to go over and over material, so if you struggle in math this may be helpful, otherwise it's time to complete the once-a-week assigned homework. You have to show up to class because he checks attendance with an online program you sign into when you arrive. He genuinely wants his students to learn. Easy A.
Hes a cool guy, just go to class and you will pass with no problem
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Professor Nguyen is very easy to understand when he teaches lessons. The way he talks is a little weird but you get used to it. The class is pretty simple as you are given old exams. Good professor for math classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Easiest math class you can take, best professor for it. He cares about his students. DO NOT MISS class though, you will fall behind fast. Very interesting professor, but he wants you to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Nguyen is really weird, I won't deny that. However, this was the EASIEST math class I've EVER taken. I got an A without hardly any effort. Do the homework (of which there is very little), go to class, and study a little for tests. That's all you have to do. The PowerPoints are self-explanatory. If you do well on exams #1-3, you can skip the final!

Usually I'm not good at math, but I got an A in his class with no problem. Just go class, do the homework, and study a little for the tests and you should be fine. His PowerPoints are super self explainatory which is nice. If you're taking ma111 he's a good choice.

Dr. Nguyen is easily the best professor I've ever had. He is a genius and he can teach math very well, even if that may not be something you're good at. The class goes a bit slow sometimes, so there is plenty of time to do the homework in there that is assigned online twice a week. The material is very clear-cut and the exams are easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Usually math isn't my thing, but this is by far the best professor I have ever had. He makes sure you understand and makes it easy to learn. If you show up, do the work, and pay attention, you will pass!

His lectures often seem really long and that's because he reads off the slides.  It would really help if he worked more examples too.  The homework is often a step up from what is expected on the exams and quizzes.  Overall not that time consuming of a class.  Bonus points for going to class.

Dr. Nguyen has a unique way of speaking and lecturing but don't let this first impression dissuade you from taking his class. He is a really great and incredibly clear professor. The homework can be difficult but they are meant to expand our knowledge of the concepts while the tests evaluated that we understood those concepts (i.e. they were easy).
Easy class if you show up and pay attention and do the homework.

Dorky would be the best way to describe Dr. Nguyen but he does try to engage his students in some ways. His class may be a kind of boring at times but his class is extremely easy. Do h.w and attend class. He makes things easy & understandable for his students.

This is the easiest math I've ever taken in my life. There's weekly/biweekly homework but its online and you have unlimited tries on each question. He has quite a few mini exams and exams but you'll be beyond prepared for them. He also drops a few grades at the end of the semester. There is a group project at the end that's pretty easy.
Not very explanatory at all. Very confusing if you don't know whats going on or if you vaguely know whats going on. Be ready to read the book on your own and re-teach yourself everything.

Hands down, best MA 111 teacher. He's awkward but that's what makes the class enjoyable. There's only 4 exams and 4 mini exams and he drops 1 exam grade and 2 mini exam grades. I would study for 20 minutes before the test and got A's on everyone. Hands down good teacher.
The most boring lecturer ever... but class is extremely easy. Have someone bring your clicker if you can't go and you are sure to pass with an A.

AMAZING PROFESSOR. I will admit he is very awkward, passionate, and dorky. The class made fun of his appearance at the beginning, but we all turned out to love him because he is so easy. If you have questions on the homework and e-mail he will answer right away and basically give you the answer. Sat on my phone all during class and got a 97%.

Literally the easiest math class ever.  The only thing that kind of sucked was his mandatory attendance, but you can just sleep through the class! I just read all the notes online and they were extremely helpful.  He drops two mini-exam grades and one exam grade, so its honestly virtually impossible to fail the class.

You can't understand any of what he is saying. However, on the homework website you can e-mail him about the specific questions and that's when I received most of the help. The class was very easy to me, definitely a easy A.

I like the guy but that mandatory attendance is killing me. especially because of his point system. His lectures are kind of repetitive which makes it hard to focus. I really like the teacher but like most said he also has an accent that is kind of hard to hear but you may always look up at the slides.

You need to reevaluate your life if you're struggling in this class. Test questions are right from the notes. He even drops two quiz grades and one exam grade, so I don't understand how you can't get an A in the class.
Absolutley DO NOT take this class. He gives no clarity when it comes to what is going to be on a quiz or test. I have an A in the class, but no thanks to him. STAY AWAY
I have no clue what he is talking about half the time. Sometimes his accent makes it hard to understand him. He never does examples for us. Worst class
Fine teacher, easy class, hard not to get an A in the class

Nguyen is a very nice guy. He is kinda nervous to teach sometimes because he is slightly unconfident. He is VERY willing to assist his students in ANY way. Email him,  go to office hours. Attendance not required but he has a professionalism grade that will be docked if you miss a lot. Do not go on cell phone in class it will reduce that grade too

Dr. Nguyen is awesome! Ma-111 is a boring subject but, he is extremely clear and very good at explaining what he wants. Tests come directly off of the slides from class and he provides a review. He's lenient with attendance and very helpful in office hours. Definitely take dr Nguyen if you need ma-111

Although this class is a ton of work and stressful, Ms. Norman made it great. She's so funny and sweet. She can be a little stubborn but she cares about her students. She is the only math teacher I have ever in my life had that actually teaches. She does graded exit slips every class. If you study and take notes, you will get an A on the exams.

Carlene Norman was a fine professor. She wasnt very entertaining, but she got her job done and taught us algebra. This class was really easy for me so if youre good at algebra dont hesitate to take this class and get an easy a.

Barely got by with a B. Only way to really do well in MA109 is too take the practice exams over and over to prepare. The Study is way more helpful than this teacher. Overall, my least favorite teacher I've ever had for a class.

If your reading this DO NOT TAKE HER. She is the worst professor I have ever had

She treats her students like theyre still in high school. One kid got up to use the restroom in class and she made him sit back down and wait. She is also very confusing when teaching. reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Absolutely horrible teacher and from what i can find she is not a instructor, only a high school teacher. She is very rude, impatient with students, and is very discouraging in class. Her professional attitude reflects poorly of our campuses educational standards. I have never had a instructor make me feel any more stupid than this one has.

She teaches high school so she thinks it's okay to treat college students like 14 year olds. Some people have different background information when it comes to math, so some may have difficulty and some may not. This is why we are in class. She is not helpful, she makes you feel stupid for asking questions. Don't take her.

Professor Norman definitely knows what she is talking about in terms of mathematics. Unfortunately, she makes you feel bad for asking questions.  She asks for feedback from the class, but as soon as anyone asks for help, she makes them feel stupid in front of the class.  I have to learn everything by myself from Khan Academy or the textbook.

This class is great to learn basic elementary principles, but some concepts can be hard to understand because you haven't seen them since elementary school. Read the textbook well, and you will do fine on the tests. I highly recommend buying the textbook; it is crucial!

She was unclear and did not make time for office hours. I even went to the skellar and of course they didn't see what I needed that for. I would pick another professor unless you are a math wiz and will never have a question to ask.

I recommend taking another professor- she is not clear at in class and when you ask for help she embarrasses you in front of the whole class so you'd rather just figure it out alone.  However, her tests are completely doable- the only problem is that there are not many questions so each is worth like 7-20 pts which is tough.

Everything you could ever want in a math teacher. She's clear, knows the best way to teach the subject, and is just a very nice lady. She is also very clear on the material that will be tested. If you go to class you will pass.

This professor was by far my worst professor at UK. All students come from different backgrounds and have different knowledge on the subject. She pretty much taught herself and when she couldn't explain something she'd say "you know" well… no we don't know, that's why we are in this class. I highly reccommend taking another professor!!!

She was awful. Does not use blackboard. Does not explain solutions well. Does not give you your current grade. Grades pretty hard and does not back up reasons to why she grades the way she does. Nice lady, but not a very good professor.  She made the class way more difficult than it needed to be. Take a different professor!!!!!!

She is very nice, funny, and one of the sweetest professors. Even though she goes over the example problems really quick, she will listen to you and spend time trying to explain until you understand. Unlike other professors, she tries to gives easy questions on exams and she curves a lot, and takes partial credit

I must say that I found this class (MA 201) easy because I was clear about all my elementary school math concepts. if I wasn't, then I would have suffered because I did notice other students in the class suffering. She expects that you know all your elem. school math and that its fresh in your mind. Other than that, she's pretty awesome.

If you can do algebra, this class will be easy. I couldn't, and it was hard. Her tagline when explaining concepts was "open mouth, insert spoon", and gave the impression that she thought a lot of her class was stupid. She often skipped steps or assumed we would know things she did not notate. I earned a D in this course, but got a B in Calculus.
She's awesome!! She was so funny and always kept me laughing while trying to focus on the topic at hand! She did a great job teaching. I recommend her!!

If you have to take 109, she is your best option. She'll take the time to explain if your lost and goes over homework before it is due. She also hangs out in the Mathskeller twice a week if you need additional help.
Most boing class ever!! I can't stand to listen to her. However it is an easy class and you do little work.

Norman is an awesome teacher. Some may say otherwise but you have to ask questions. If you don't participate in class you wont learn from her. She is open to help anyone who asks, but if you don't ask her teaching is hard to catch on to. She is overall a good teacher and is always happy.

Awesome professor. She's easy to relate to and will spend a good half or more of each class answering your homework questions. You don't have to come, but you will lose a few points. I got two A+'s on my exams because she taught it so well. Also, you don't use the textbook AT ALL in that class, just the supplementary notes. I recommend taking her.

We didn't have a book, only group work, in class projects, and homework sets. Her grading was very inconsistent and she often told us to " google" how to do the problems because she got all of her assignments from someone else and did not know how to do them. If she didn't like you, you knew it. The final was a one minute presentation on a randomly drawn topic that day, which was okay but tough to get all the information down to a one minute presentation.
great teacher! will answer any question you have!!

Nice woman, awful at explaining. Skips examples, doesn't explain well. Made this class much harder than it needs to be. I am not bad at math and she was so bad at explaining concepts I had to learn them from my room mate, whom I easily understood them from.

She has to be one of the best teachers I have come across. Just go to class and do the examples with her, and you will know how to do it. She doesnt use the text book but she does use the lecture notes. She will also answer any questions you have regarding the homework, and will work with you on it till you figure it out. I would recommend her!
This by far might have been one of the worst classes i've ever had.It was only once a week, but I dreaded it!

Great teacher. She goes through all the examples in the book and answers any questions you may have. I hate math but she made it not so bad. I ended up with an A. Go to class and let her teach you and its a breeze.

If you are in TEP Dr. Noland is the best professor to learn how to teach health education content from. She is super sweet and caring! She is a hard grader on lesson plans but provides great feedback and chances to redo assignments for a better grade. Work hard for her and she will do everything she can to make sure you succeed!

Dr. Noland is wonderful. She is very sweet and you will learn a lot in her classes. Ive had her for multiple different courses and she is very consistent with her grading. She requires attendance but is understanding if something comes up. I highly reccommend her classes.
She's such a sweet lady, and understands that life happens! There's a lot of extra stuff you have to go to outside of class, but she gives you days off class to make up for it!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Ochuodho explains the material fairly well, but he doesn't give time for students to ask many questions. His quizzes are confusing, and his instruction is not quite clear enough. He gave us a video, journal article, and quiz to do with a quick turnaround near the end of the semester. He makes me feel a little silly when I ask him a question.

By far, this has been the worst class I have taken in my college career. After the first two weeks, Dr.O took an anonymous poll to determine what he could improve on as a teacher. He then took that information and used it to tell the class how they were wrong. He brought this up for four weeks and even printed out some of the responses.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This was the worst class I have taken in my entire career as a student. Dr.O is very vague in the materials he gives you and extremely specific on the tests. For example, he will assign a 400 page article 3 days before a test and expect you to know a specific question from that article on the test. If you are not a forestry major avoid this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I love her as a person and a teacher, but be prepared for quizzes on the booksmovies as well as papers.

Show up to class and participate in the discussions and you will do fine. There is quite a few papers, but she doesn't grade hard at all. She has strong opinions, respect them and she will respect yours. The class isn't hard, but you do have to do the work and read.
I love Dr. Oaks! I think she is a fabulous teacher and keeps her class interesting. Reading is required and so is attending class but she makes it enjoyable.
horrible professor

Easily the most incompetent professor I've had to deal with in terms of providing proper outlines for assignments and communication.  I emailed her multiple times over the during the semester and never received confirmations of anything.  Also, she won't tell you over email if class is cancelled, until you're already in class waiting, or not at all
Horrible teaching.  Grading processes unclear.  Extremely opinionated.

Dr. Oaks is an extreme feminist, and she made me despise high strung feminist such as herself.(even though I a female myself) Her eye rolls to student's opinions, rude remarks, and incomprehensible grading makes her classes barely tolerable. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS.
I was excited about this class, and we did have good classes in the beginning. But the grading scale was terrible and both oaks and Maria were not helpful at all.

Dr.Oaks is a wonderful person and a fantastic professor! I highly recommend taking any class by her. She is thoughtful and opinionated but always polite towards her students and always keeps class interesting. If you enjoy writing, classes are especially interesting and easy because she loves good writing.
I really enjoyed this class and Dr. Oaks is a wonderful teacher. She's very feminist, but also very open to students expressing their own opinions. It's a great learning environment.

Dr. Oaks is a wonderful teacher. She workshops, so it's set up where you really do all the reading and not skim. She directs, so students learn a lot from each other, which is excellent. Great class environment also.

Her grading was awful.  She gives very vague and unspecific grading policies and directions.  Attendance and parcipitation is mandatory and she definately has favorites and very opinionated.  Would not recommend her unless you plan on a lot of sucking up
I did my best to always be polite, but she definitely treated my condescendingly because I was male. Definitely. Other than that, and the fact that the classes never stayed on topic, she was okay.

Class mostly involved discussions of whatever book, poem, or essay we had to read. Graded assignments were fairly easy and the teacher engaged the class to openly express their ideas. Despite what others might say, I did not find her to be an extreme feminist, nor treat the men in class any different than the women. I'd definitely recommend her.

She is an amazing teacher and elderly lady. She knows what she is talking about. Her class is beyond easy, and you barely use the text book; maybe twice a semester, so don't even bother buying it honestly. Her quizzes are group-in-class quizzes. So if you fail this class, you just are an idiot.

this is a workshopping class so it is odd to me (im not an ENG major) but she makes it an okay class. we just have to review and write a couple of papers. i thought we would be reading a lot of ghost stories but they are more like gothic short stories.

Dr. Oaks is fairly easy, but is an extreme feminist. If you say anything negative about a female character and you're male, she won't like you at all. She didn't like it when you didn't agree with her viewpoints. I also thought that she treated the guys in my class differently because she is a feminist. I worked on a project with two people, myself and the other girl got an A and she gave the guy who worked with us a C/D!!! It was the same project! I argued with her and battled for my grade!
it was a little frustrating that this english class might as well have been a gws class. I didn't like her until the last month of class. It's not hard, shes just kind of not nice.

She really does degrade class members but acts like it is a joke. You can score well on all of the quizzes and exams but if you don't suck up you are screwed. If anything take her for English not GWS. Don't take her class if you aren't liberal!!!!! She uses class to preach her ideals and sometimes doesn't even refer to the readings.

Dr. Oaks is kind and fun, but gets waaaay off the topic of the reading.  In fact, rarely must one do the reading to understand the class.  I was very excited about this course, but disappointed by the lack of challenge and easiness of the course.
She doesn't seem very smart, and grades based on her beliefs rather than what the text book says.  Projects are completely pointless and busy work.
No Comments

Very approachable and friendly, and will help you if you go to see her about your paper.  I didn't care for the class itself very much, but that had more to do with the material I think; it's one of those classes that's hard to make interesting.  I imagine that her lit classes are better.

Jan is a great teacher and really fun. However, she is really disorganized, which means she's not always clear on what she wants in papers and it's easy not to do well on them. Everything in class is really discussion-oriented and fun though and you feel like you're not even in class.  She makes the information really interesting!

one of the best classes i've taken at UK.  discussion rather than lecture is nice & allows for student input.  "just teaching the material" would not work for this course--it requires more than one perspective and she does a great job with it.  speak up in class, though, since it helps your grade if she knows you're interested.

i love this class because we can debate about everything that has to deal with women, sexuality, and sex. Its like being in a room with all the ladies from Sex and the City for an hour three times a week. Men are welcome too.

her take home tests are really hard! although during class all you do is gossip, and its really fun

Get the test review from JohnnyPrint (Like half the ?s come from it) & attend regularly to take the quizzes. If you do that you'll be fine. Finished with an A because of regular attendance to get notes.
