Easy A.  Even if you're lazy and don't help with group presentations, you'll still get an A.  Everyone gets an A whether you put forth effort or not. . it's ridiculous!
Extremely easy. 3 exams, optional final. Weekly Wednesday quizzes. textbook not needed at all. get the old exams, can be bought at Johnny Print.

Attendance is not mandatory but almost weekly quizzes. Do well on those to help your grade and a lot of the material on exams is from those. Doesn't always teach from the text and goes through the material fast so attend and pay attention. Get the review test at Johhny Print.
Pretty easy class... gets boring the longer the semester goes.  The quizzes really help your grade, do well on those and sit in the back!

Can be very difficult to understand. He doesn't project himself well. But he condones using old tests to study, and if you have tests from two semesters back, you have every question that will be on this semester's tests. He just picks and chooses from an old question bank. His quizzes also haven't changed in three years. At all. Easy, easy A.

You are allowed to miss an Exam for whatever reason however you have to take the cumulative final to make up for the exam you missed & the final counts. I missed an exam for a University excused absence & he refused to let me make up the exam. I took the VERY HARD cumulative final & did poor. The final grade counted twice so I got a C instead of a

Good professor, he does digress sometimes, but does a good job at explaining the material.  The quizzes are easy and the tests can be if you prepare a little.  Be sure and pick up the old exams he makes available at Johnny Print.
If he was teaching the many different ways to repeat one's self, he would be the most qualified instructor in the universe.

Dr. Officer is awesome. His class is interesting and he really cares. His quizzes are easy and his tests are too if you go to class, or at least look at the old exams he puts at Johnny Print.  Take his class.

Just find someone in the class to do the quizzes with, come to class everyday, and study for like 2 hours before the test (He gives you a previous semesters test at the beginning of the semester) and you will get an A.
No Comments

Very very quiet and doesn't speak up even when asked. Has a very strong accent which makes it very difficult to understand what is being said. When working problems out he doesn't even know what he is doing some of the time, students will correct him because of this. Takes attendance daily for grade.

This was his first time teaching this class but he was very prepared. That being said, he took the class in a different direction than in past years. This class was very proof heavy and covered many different topics. There are 2 exams and a final all of which were take home. He is a fair grader but waited a very long time to give our grades back.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The average for almost all of the assignments was around a 40%-60%. Half of the assignments we were given were left ungraded until today (the day after finals week) so we had absolutely no idea what we needed to improve on until the course was over. Seeing how others have succeeded in this course with different professors, I honestly feel cheated.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Doesn't respond to emails, very quiet and doesn't speak up even when asked, very strong accent

Worst professor i've had so far.  You cannot understand or hear a word he says in lecture even if you sit in the front row.  He doesn't explain anything, exams every 2 weeks and he won't help you even if you ask him.  He answers all his emails rudely and snarky.  Doesn't care about you or your outside of class circumstances. Makes your life awful.

You can barely understand a word he says because he mumbles all of his words and refuses to put on his microphone correctly. His notes also do not match what he writes on the board so you never know which one is correct.

Dr. Ochanine is a great professor if you are learning theory. He is extremely helpful with coursework. Topology is a hard subject but he went out of his way to help the class learn. I could definitely see him being a difficult professor for non theory intensive courses, such as calculus I-IV. If you are a math major, take him!

worst teacher ive ever had for anything. he would not explain anything, and for lecture he just read off proofs that he wrote down before class. he never did examples or showed us any formulas so we had to find them other places or somehow get it from the proofs. the only way i passed this course was because he posted videos by a different professr

Worst professor I have had. Class was on. zoom and he refused to fix his terrible internet connection. Led to him lagging constantly and he would not work out any live examples, but read through messy work he already wrote. When he wasnt lagging, his thick accent, constant mumbling, and uhh and umm every 3 sec, made it impossible to understand

This class was entirely over Zoom, but he was difficult to understand and made no sense. I recommend taking another professor. I had to learn everything from other sources. I didn't like the textbook chosen either. He tried to say everything with words instead of examples and the class was sooo lost.

As a student who has struggled in calc 2 I was extremely nervous for calculus 3. So nervous that the first day of classes I went to his office hours to talk to him. He calmed my nerves and was very helpful thought the semester. Sit in the front of class and write down the examples they are awesome for homework and in recitation.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: As someone who struggled in Calcs 1-3, I was nervous about Calc 4; however, Serge made it a very enjoyable experience. He practically tells you what's gonna be on the exams and gives you practice problems. More often than not, he just copies and pastes 5 practice problems straight onto the exams so there are no surprises. I would highly recommend!

Does not teach- does math at the board. Very soft spoken so if you don't sit in the front row you won't hear him. Textbook used was the most poorly written, most confusing text I've ever had the displeasure of using. Refused to use Canvas until after the first exam so you had no idea what your grade was, and has not used Canvas since.
This professor has a really strong accent so it was really hard for me to understand anything he was saying, especially about course material. I had to learn mostly independently.

Very long, wordy, hard to understand speech with very erratic and hard to follow work on a chalkboard. It would be much easier of a class if he did what all the other profs do and do things step by step with an intro, an example, and an explanation and repeat. Kids get as on exams by reading the book watching vids online and not going 2 class

COULD NOT HEAR HIM FROM THE SECOND ROW FOR LECTURES. Horrible lectures terrible notes and couldn't hear since he wouldnt use a mic and when he did wore it too low. I had a solid A in calc 1 and calc 2 without too much trouble but this I worked my ass off and still got a B since I couldn't hear him what so ever.

Ochanine may be the worst professor I've had at UK so far. The man sounds like he's gargling salt water. You simply cannot understand him. I tried sitting at the front--still impossible to understand. People have asked him to turn his mic up--just louder mumbling. The class itself is also frustrating. It's all based around useless memorization.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: makes puns to keep things entertaining

Seems to know what he's talking about, but is terribly soft-spoken. Tried sitting in the front for the first half of the semester and gave up trying to hear. Sit in the back and take notes from Paul's Online Math notes. Understand all of the practice questions for exams and you'll do well.

He is nice but not very great at explaining. Would do most of a problem, get it wrong, then say "well you get it". Started going to another professor halfway through the year and did so much better on the second half of exams.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He was a nice guy and genuinely cared about students, but I didnt understand much of what was happening during lecture bc he talked so softly and didnt give as much explanation as I would have liked. I had to read the textbook, do all the practice problems assigned (optional), and pay extreme attention in recitation in order to pass this class.

Friendly guy and a nice individual outside of the classroom, but the worst professor I've ever had in my life. Lectures are completely useless. You either teach yourself on your own, or you fail. He doesn't even make the exams you'll be taking, so what he teaches not only makes zero sense, but is COMPLETELY unlike what is on the exams.

Doesn't work out problems, simply shows his work like you are reading it out of a textbook. Not easy to follow along and hard to understand his quiet voice in class. Often shows his notes on the projector for short periods of time and hard to follow along. Ended up attending another lecture to learn material while attending the right recitation
Great teacher, hard class. Do not take his class unless you are willing to work for a good grade. He will help you as much as you can, but there is only so much he can do to help you.
Great class, but hard. If you do the work you should be able to do well.

He was a really good teacher, but his exams were absolutely rediculous. I took him for calc 3, and for his tests he gave absolutely no partial credit. No partial credit in calculus 3? Not smart. The class average was about 40-50%. He was a great teacher, but if you made a single mistake on a test problem, you wouldn't receive any points for it.

The exmaples he does in-class tend to be much more complicated than the exam problems, so when you get to the exam, it's never as bad as you think it will be. Tends to curve pretty heavily in addition to there being bonus up to 125% on every exam. Very engaging.
This class starts out but easy gets to be harder than it should or was in the past. Doesn't assign problems that have similar examples in the book. 1st test easy, 2nd not so much.
THIS BE THE FLYEST PROFESSOR IN ALL THE LAND

Quizzes were really hard (mostly fails)BUT they are only 10% of our grade. Exams were SUPER easy. Homework due every week (25% of grade). The homework is difficult, but it really helps. Buy the book--all hw is from it (and read the sections). Understandable accent. HW just has to be turned in the same day (so if you forget, no worries). GREAT PROF!

I love him! The class itself if pretty easy, but he really explains things well before tests, and quizzes.  He loves what he is teaching, and really wants every student to do well. Tests, homework, and quizzes were all fairly easy. I never studied.

This guy loves math (obviously)! Way too much information for a summer class, but his office hours were very helpful. Accent is understandable and makes for some laughable quotes...think peter sellers as Dr. Strangelove...
I love him! he is great!

Professor Oliphant is the definition of tough but fair. While some of her work feels tedious and boring, she lays it all out for you right at the start of the year. Plus, she takes her lectures slowly, making sure you understand them, and is more than willing to help you out.

Overall, Professor O is definitely not for everyone, but I enjoyed her lectures and found her engaging to listen too. The exams are tricky (3 of them), and there is a group project with multiple assignments that are not to difficult. Attendance is mandatory but overall the class isn't bad.

Oh, where to begin, my glorious queen Becca. You are the light of my career at the University of Kentucky. I can not express through words alone how much I love you. ALL OF THESE NEGATIVE REVIEWS SMELL LIKE DEW DEW.
Such a nice lady! I had her last semester and I came on here to rate her because her score should not be this low!!! Take her if you can

Her canvas and exams are riddled with typos, horrendous organization makes it impossible to find anything in the class files. Her directions for anything are always unclear. She made us take an open response exam on the events of a movie, asking things like what kind of sauce was sold at the beginning (not kidding). DO NOT TAKE HER. I could go on.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: pushes political agenda on students and talks like she hates the USA. if you have to take her its fine but her grading is the worst of any professor I've ever had. Her exams are easy ish. Avoid taking if you can

The assignments are not weighted based on the time/effort put into them. She points out small grammar mistakes, but her PowerPoints are full of misspelled words and incorrect punctuation. She cannot use technology then gets mad at students for her lockdown browser not working when she has the settings wrong. Her feedback is unhelpful and rude.

I LOVE DR. O! She is one of my favorite professors. I see a lot of comments about how she is not tech-savvy but she is honestly not the most unorganized teacher I have had. As long as you regularly check the canvas page and attend class, youll be fine. She is super sweet and funny. Great, great, GREAT professor. Recommend!!
Horrible professor. Don't take her! She assign assignments but doesn't put due date on them. So you can't find them on canvas!!!! miss 8 % of grade because of that.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. O is a sweet old woman who cares about her students and wants them to learn. However, she is the worst online-savvy professor I've had. She has no rubrics on most of her assignments. You gotta read a book and will be tested on it. She's strict on attendance as well. The class was easy but annoying with no guidelines on what we're suppose to do

Dr. O is so funny and you have to just laugh along with her. If you take her too seriously, yeah she's not great. Take notes of all the random facts she drops, fun facts in the announcements and current events, they'll probably be on the exam. Overall, she grades fairly but yes gives no rubric and it's hard to navigate her canvas.

Not tech savvy, no rubrics, contradicting statements and expectations, and all around the worst professor I have ever had. I completed undergrad at UK already and I never had a professor as terrible as she is in the 4 years I spent there. Now I am in grad school and she treats us like kindergarteners. Please avoid!

She's nice and most of the assignments aren't hard but she never provides rubrics so you are constantly confused on what to do, she's nearly impossible to contact outside of class, and she struggles to use Canvas or MH

Grades based on nothing; need to provide expectations and rubrics; rude and unprofessional; didn't learn anything at all as she just reads definitions off of slides; she found success by chance in the 70s and uses dated information;

Dr. O is a great professor who is passionate about the content, tells funny stories about her life, and makes class fun. The only downside is that her Canvas page is pretty disorganized and the assignments can be vague/unclear. However, she is open to criticism and is receptive to constructive feedback.

She was an easy A/B if you tried. Lectures made me wanna hit my head on a nail but attendance is mandatory. She is super annoying on grading and the group project is super tedious and she expects you to know everything about a certain country by the end. shes funny at first, the end i was dreading class every single day and skipped and lost points.

So many reasons but above all she is just a rude person. She wouldn't even let us clap for group presentations at the end of the semester and until the end making every other group feel like the did a subpar job.The grading is impossible to determine since it stays locked on canvas. Her exams consisted of questions regarding her personal life?

Attendance isn't mandatory but she has daily current events that is a big portion of the exam that are not on the slides. She has a great attitude and gives great feedback on papers. She also does a podcast the week of the exam and basically goes through every question on the exam so you know what to study. Love her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Oliphant was hard to communicate with and unclear about grading/assignment criteria at times, but hard to blame her since she's older and everything has switched to online. Overall, grading was based on a series of group papers, a final group project, Connect assignments, and a couple exams. Not a hard class, but lots of busy work that builds up
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor O is an amazing teacher. Her exams consist of 60-75 multiple choice but 45% of the exams are current events, she tells you 3 current events at the beginning of every class and they will be on the exam easy points. There are 2 group projects but they are pretty easy. She also tells you every single question on the exam the week before.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: I'm actually amazed she has bad reviews on here. She lets you out at least 15 minutes early everyday and the class itself is super easy. She gives a review before every exam where she outlines what you need to know for each question. She does take attendance for a grade and there is a group project where you're assigned your groups. HW is easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Why does this professor teach at UK? If you have an issue theres no point of emailing, she will either not respond or reply with a sarcastic to bad so sad attitude. Theres no point in going to her office either, best of luck with this class! Chemistry is easier

Nice person but unorganized & unprofessional. I thought I was taking B&E201, not Politics 101. Lecture is useless, but mandatory. She talks more about surgery and her life in Vietnam and her $14 knee surgery in Thailand. She did not show up to the final exam and if she makes a mistake it is on you not her. This should be an easy A but not with her.

Dr. O seems like a nice person, but as far as teaching goes, it's just not her thing. This class was very unorganized, and grading for group projects was based more off opinion than criteria. She overslept for our final and then got on students for taking too long. Even smart students are struggling in this class because of the odd grading system

Dr. Oliphant is one of the most unprofessional Professors I have had at UK. The schedule of our "hybrid class" was altered constantly and made many students feel confused. She was not present for our final for oversleeping and made students reschedule to take it at another time. Online homework doesn't count for a lot. Lecture is useless but go.

Grades based on opinion and grammar instead of content, you learn more about her personal life than the material, teaches nothing in class, cannot accept fault, unnecessary GPA drop, some of the smartest students don't even have A's, puts questions on the test literally about herself, gives rubrics but criteria is still unclear, would NOT recommend

By far my favorite professor Ive had at UK & also one of the best classes Ive taken. Her lectures are super interesting and based off real life experiences. Dont take her if youre easily offended, but if youre generally open minded then youll probably love her. Class is an easy A if you put in pretty minimal effort but attendance is mandatory
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Oliphant is by far one of the worst professors that the University has employed. She is incredibly unorganized and continuously changes assignments and grading last minute. Do not attempt to email her because she will not respond no matter the circumstances. The lectures in this class are spent talking about Dr. Oliphant's love of socialism.

Don't let the first review of her fool you; she's god awful. I haven't been at UK for long, but she is without a doubt the worst professor I've had in my time here. She is not accessible at all, very obnoxious about her political beliefs, and the entire class consists of her rambling about her time in Vietnam and her $14 knee surgery.

Professor O has a lot of great stories. Her experience abroad really shows through and makes the topic really applicable. Shes very funny and very kind. One of those professors that you know truly care about their students. Exams arent too bad and she even goes through the exam as the review session so you know clearly what to study.

Dr. Park Sarge is very nice, but I had more trouble understanding her content than any of the other professors in PGY 206. Her slides are very unorganized and videos way too long. Prepare to study a LOT for her exams. I ended up getting a good grade, but I had to put in a ton of time and effort. I did take her course online, though.

Genuinely could not love this woman more if I tried. She is so kind, willing to accommodate her students, and is such a funny woman. This class is a bit time consuming with homework assignments, but it is very easy and honestly super interesting. She is passionate about teaching and sharing her wealth of knowledge with students. Please take her!!!

Dr.Park-Sarge is truly one of my favorite professors ever. She is so passionate about the content she teaches and providing support to students. Additionally, as the course director she is super flexible and worked with me a lot while I was balancing working, MCAT studying, and school. She has also been super helpful in providing admissions insight

Genuinely such a wonderful woman. She is really easily accessible outside of class and is always very helpful when answering questions. She also tries to make class enjoyable with jokes and humor, and she is really just a sweet person. Her slides are a little overwhelming and packed with a lot of information, but she explains her material well.

Dr. Park-Sarge is genuinely the best professor I've ever had. She teaches some tough sections but truly gives you ALL the resources you need to be able to do well in this class. She is funny and genuinely cares about the well being of her students as well as their success. She's easily accessible outside of class too for questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr Park-Sarge is a nice lady. She teaches the GI, endocrine, and reproduction parts of this class and her PowerPoint slides are incredibly difficult to read and follow along with. There are too many words on every slide, and information is not very well organized. If you want to an A on her exams, you will have to study VERY hard!!

Dr. Park-Sarge is so caring and kind. She genuinely wants her students to succeed. I'm not a STEM major, but I found this course very interesting. Dr. Park-Sarge is very knowledgable and often went on a tangent during class. She made class fun and engaging and always ended on a positive note. Seeing her always brings a smile to my face.

I LOVE Dr. Park-Sarge so much. I am really going to miss her once the semester is over. You can tell she really cares about her students and what she does. She is so smart and really knows what she's talking about. She's super hilarious as well. So supportive, positive, and overall nice to be around. Just a breath of fresh air honestly.

I've had Dr. Park-Sarge multiple times, including 2 single digit class size courses. She is honestly one of the most influential professors I've encountered in four+ years as an undergrad. She wants you to succeed & is intensely appreciative of those who bring their all to class discussion. Answer questions, give thoughtful insights.  Amazing prof.

HOW TO PASS THIS CLASS BETTER THAN ME: 1. don't wait until the night before the exam to look at the information for the first time BUT IF YOU DO: go through powerpoints and retype everything in your own words until you have a general understanding. 3. STUDY PRACTICE QUESTIONS literally like your life depends on it. nice lady love her fav teacher
Easily one of my favorite professors. Her material is tough but she gives you the materials needed to be successful and is willing to talk through challenging concepts.

Had her for PGY 206/207 in Fall 2021. I absolutely love her. 206 is a very hard course and would highly recommend taking 207 with it as it greatly benefits learning of material. They curve every exam and really want students to succeed, through review sessions and quick responses to question. She is super genuine and really funny in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I had her for PGY 206/207 and her material is by far the hardest science-related material I've ever studied. She packs her slides and you have to know ALL the information she gives you, or you're not going to do well. She's a really amazing prof though, who really tries to relate to students and lets you know she's there for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Park-Sarge is the most caring professor I have had at UK. She is so respectful and kind to all her students. The class is VERY discussion heavy and there are weekly homework & papers; however, if you complete your work on time and participate, there should not be an issue obtaining an A in this class. I would recommend this class to anyone.

Honestly, I think shes my favorite of all the professors so far. She speeds through the lectures and packs them FULL of text and graphics... so it can be overwhelming initially. But she highlights all the important stuff and gives tons of practice questions. If you work hard, youll gain a thorough understanding of her material. Also - shes funny

I LOVE DR. Park-Sarge. She teaches the endocrine portion of 206, and I greatly enjoyed all of her lectures. She's very clear about what you need to know for exams, and she's hilarious! 206 is a breeze as long as you put enough time into it; hopefully you will enjoy it, especially if you're anything pre-healthcare.
Discussion based class- shes super insightful on all things reproductive medicine. Will engage the class. Also gives out candy at the end of the semester

Dr. Park-Sarge is very passionate about educating her students and seeing them succeed. While she is not the type to beat around the bush or caudle her students, you can tell that she is genuinely invested in them. She is one of my favorite professors that I have ever had and I would gladly take her again!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: Dr. Park-Sarge is the single most inspirational woman I have ever met. I have had her for three semesters at this point and I find myself looking for excuses to have her as a mentor and professor as I continue on in my education. The class itself is a challenge but with someone who is so helpful and caring as the course director studying is awesome

I made an account specifically to write about how amazing Park-Sarge is. YES, this class is incredibly difficult. But she is so encouraging and so focused on student success. Everything you learn will be relevant to real life despite the difficulty. To have Park-Sarge teach you is biggest privilege I've had.
Tests are so tough it's ridiculous. Classes are two hours long and hard to pay attention. Good luck.

Park-Sarge is a great professor who really does care for her students' success. The course material is difficult but most definitely relevant. You will have to work for the grade without a doubt. She puts a huge curve on the class at the end of the semester, which was very helpful.

This is the hardest class I think I have taken at UK. Ok-Kyong Park-Sarge is easily the worst professor I have ever had. She is incredibly nice, but she can not teach the material effectively.  Good luck with this class!
This class is not as hard as people make it sound. Watch the lectures... do NOT just read the book. GREAT course to prepare for the MCAT.

This class really isn't that difficult. Do not buy the book. Go to class or watch the echo360s online. I studied about 35 hours before each exam and easily am obtaining an A. As the semester goes on she makes the cut off for an A lower and lower. It is a lot of material but it is very interesting and relevant to PT/pre-med, so you should enjoy it.

Dr. Park-Sarge is very friendly and easy to reach, but I don't consider her helpful. I met with her after each exam to discuss better ways to study and she stuck with, "study an hour everyday before class, go to lecture, study for 2 hours after class and for 5-6 hours a day on the weekend." This class was tough but to study like that is unrealistic
I took several classes, part of which were taught  by Dr Park-Sarge. All were excellent!

I was warned about the toughness of this class and yet nothing could prepare me for this difficulty level. The class has a rotation of instructors as each professor teaches the field in which he/she is an expert in. Every point counts in this class as it is only out of 100 points. There are 4 tests and 10 1 point quizzes. Study every day!

Its evident this is Park-Sagrge's passion. Although the class is riciulously hard, she's super helpful and wants all to succeed. You should definitely have A&P I and II... and PGY 206 before attempting this course!
I would have expected better from a prof who has nothing to but teach a few classes all year.

For a graduate class, it was lenient because there were extra credit points thrown in there. The class itself was really tough though (graduate class) and there are professors who teach their specialty. Disadvantage of having this would be that you have less time to feel comfortable with each exam. Park Sarge was helpful but the class is hard.

Excellent professor and course director. Course has several different teachers that each teach their field of specialty. She is very willing to help with any questions you have and friendly when you go to talk with her. This class is challenging, but if you are interested in the medical field, this class will be the most useful at UK.
She is an excellent professor excellent - my first exam was an F!! and after a walk through and why this was wrong and this right etc... As across the board!

She teaches the introduction and Endocrine Physiology part of the course. Already, I've learned so much in this class about Endocrine Physiology. The class is designed where experts in their field teach their field. She's an excellent professor for Physiology, recommended course!
Great instructor and course director.  I would recommend this class for anyone interested in bodily functions!

The class isn't unnecessarily difficult, and you can do well if you put in the effort. If you ask any questions, though, good luck. She's very knowledgeable, but gets irritated when students ask questions, and her curtness always rubbed me the wrong way. If you have the choice, save yourself a headache and take Burgess for cost/managerial instead.
She should be teaching an 8th grade class the way here course is structured. Has no business lecturing to college students.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She's not as bad as a lot of these ratings, still not good though. The class was just difficult.

People who hate on her are the people who want to be able to do well without going to class or putting in the effort. I'm not good at accounting but her study guides are exactly like the exams, she's straightforward with what you need to know. Def go to class even tho its not required. As long as you try & she sees you're trying you'll pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: 301 is a tough class but Davis is your best bet by far! She cares as long as you do, aka put in some effort to the class and she will help you when/if you ask for it. The study guides are almost exactly like the exams so as long as you study you'll be golden. TAKE HER CLASS
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: had her hybrid course and she didn't have an online lecture, you had to teach yourself. was not accommodating at all and did not reply to emails

Davis can be nice if the sarcastic type of humor is your thing. She does care about students, but can come across as rude with questions. I learned nothing in class and taught it all to myself, but its manageable. The homeworks are long and smartbooks are LONG but its a doable class if you get stuff done (also there is one random essay assignment)

Attended all lectures and studied hard but could not succeed due to the insane amount of information she throws at you in a short period of time. The lectures are similar to homework but she explains terribly and doesnt  answer questions because she just sits behind the computer the whole time. DO NO RECOMMEND!

Don't expect her to be reachable outside of class, and good luck trying to speak with her in class. Her handwriting is illegible and you cannot make sense of her thoughts in class verbally. The way she tales attendance rarely works, and half the time she hides the link in which attendance is taken.

The worst experience I have ever had in a class; She has so much work to complete and provides NO LECTURE, not even a video. The textbook was pieced together from multiple textbooks and was MISSING PIECES. When you tried to ask for help to fill the gaps, your request was denied. Worst professor ever, Do not recommend.

reviews.comment: I would not take a class like this with this professor ever again. She is sassy and not very helpful, if you try to get help outside of class she will probably snap at you. I recommend choosing someone else
ABSOLUTELY AWFUL at her job. She expects the information that she knows is just common knowledge.

Blatantly rude to students asking questions. No regard for students' level of comprehension. Won't benefit from going to class, usually unproductive and all surface level content that doesn't lead to any actual learning.
worst teacher ive had at UK!! extremely rude! avoid
Professor Olajengbesi made German Language class very interesting, though she speaks fast which sometimes made it difficult to catch up, overall I enjoyed the class
She made learning very easy, I admired how she always repeated activities and ensure that we understood

She refuses to speak English in the lowest level of German the university offers. She does not even integrate English into any assignments, videos, or slideshows in class. She moves incredibly fast, and you will not learn much. The spoken interviews and daily homework assignments are luckily very easy though, so passing should be doable.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Had for CLD320 & took again for CLD400. DO NOT TAKE CLD400. Dr.O is super disorganized! Semester has two weeks of work left and he still hasnt graded exam one from Sep. Has no idea what he is doing in the class. Doesnt upload hw until day of bc he forgets or gets busy when he says we will have a week. Material is like marketing 101.

Dr. O. is a lot of fun! Classes were sometimes a little disorganized and he's still working to make the class the best it can be, but on the whole, a very nice professor and I enjoyed taking him! He gives good feedback even if it isn't always timely, and genuinely cares about student success. Lectures were as interesting as he could make them.
Dr. O is fantastic, probably my favorite professor I have had yet. Gives great feedback on assignments and grades in a timely manner. Classes were fairly interesting.

Dr. Olson cares about his students, and works to relate class materials back to real life scenarios. This was his first semester at UK, so he has a few kinks to work out but overall it was a great class. 3 short papers and one final group project make up your entire grade. No exams or quizzes Overall, Dr. O is a great professor that you should take
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. O was great! For being in his first class at UK he did a fantastic job. The course material is interesting and thought provoking, and it's very apparent that he is passionate about teaching and his students' success. I would absolutely recommend him as a teacher. His class made me excited to learn more. A+
Dr. O might be brand new to UK, but he is one of the most relatable professors I've ever had. He's brutally honest when he needs to be, including when it comes to himself.

Dr. Olson is a great resource in Audiology, which is cool when you're surrounded by SLP's. Her lectures are often correcting previous statements, beware. Very cool lab opportunities, but those exams will eat you alive. Do the work and meet with her, she will really try to help you. She even set up observations and helped with grad school for me.
Anne has her good days and her bad days, although most of them are bad. she doesn't really know what she is talking about and offers little help and has trouble understanding other points of view.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The work can be hard, but she gives clear instructions and is always open to talking to students if theres any confusion. Dr. Olson is one of those Im tough because I have high beliefs in your abilities professors. Shes not afraid mention her anxiety, and is always updating her lectures with best practices and latest information. Do the work.
Dr. Olsen is one of the most unorganized professors I have ever had. Most of her lectures she is not even sure what she is talking about.

Boring. Throw-myself-off-a-cliff boring. Make me want to quit the degree boring. It's ALL discussion boards. Seriously. That's it. The few assignments are also, you guessed it, boring. And the guidelines are vague.

Doesn't actually make any effort to teach her class. She just pulls lectures from other speakers rather than coming up with material on her own. All she does is assign readings and grade discussion boards/papers. Paper guidelines aren't clear, either, and then she ends up docking you points for failing to meet her impossible standards. Stay away!
This class is a lot of work and you will have a lot ot read. But overall, she makes herself available to students and the information taught in the course is very interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Given the amount of money students are paying for each UK Graduate School class, I was disappointed by the outdated, sloppily-presented material in this one. I had expected the learning objectives and assignments to be of a higher caliber. I was disappointed to find a course lacking in quality planning or vision.
Awful.  His lectures were extremely boring and utterly useless.  He grades your essays purely on grammar and syntax, as long as you have those down content has little to do with your grade.

Best teacher and class I've had. Organized. Explains well and answers questions thoroughly. Fair grader. It's a demanding class with lots of writing but if you need an upper level writing course take this one.
Easy grader. Not very clear as to what should be included into the papers, but hasn't taken off for content yet.
Dan Omlor does not explain his assignment or offer enough clarity about what is expected, nor does he give enough time for one to complete an assignment
comment
Best English teacher ... promise!
looves him

Kinda goofy..only takes off points for grammar, adresses every one as "Mr. ____ or Miss.___" for the group paper he nominated team captains and they were to choose their members like a dodgeball team on the playground. He is genuinely nice though and carefree about deadlines/attendance.
Sometimes hard to listen to. Always say, OK, NOW! its pretty funny. He does a good job of preparing you to write strong essays and grades very easy.
Nicest professor ever! I learned so much in this class.. just go to class and turn stuff in and you will be fine.

He is very easy if you do your work.  He doesn't really care about deadlines or length of papers.  He is very flexible.  He is slightly biased if you disagree with him, but if you create a well-written essay, he will give you the grade you deserve.
not bad teacher at all. easy just go to class and do the papers. easy grader. class is a killer but try to get involved and it will go quicker.
solid

This class has been my favorite. If you go to classes and the beginning and let him know you are trying its so easy!! He lets you turn stuff in late and grades pretty leniant. The lowest you will make in this class is a C!

Very long and boring, but bring a laptop and chill...does not get on sleepers...alows to turn in late and grades pretty laid back...his classes are usually filled with lectures on his ideas...pretty nice guy overall!

Lots of strong opions, that may bother some. He's nice and will let you turn in a paper late if you need to. He doesn't really care about deadlines or length of paper. IMO one of the easier Eng Teachers at UK...not a bad teacher to have at all!

at first i thought he was brilliant but as the semester goes on you get tired of hearing him talk and realize that he's got some pretty far-out-there ideas.  his class is pretty easy though, as long as you go, and do the papers.
Very knowledgeable. Knows what he's talking about.
No Comments

His exams are very hard and he does not explain why he gives the grades he gives. He seems like he does not like giving high scores and does not follow the syllabus a lot of the time. He treats everyone like bilingual students which can come off as intimidating at first however, he is very caring and does want his students to pass overall.

This teacher was great! Very funny, super helpful and understanding, especially if you miss class. Assigns a lot of VHL, but every course does, and it is not too hard. There are very few tests, and he tells you exactly what is on them and they are easy to understand. I got an A easily.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Makes extremely hard tests and is a tough grader. Does not explain things well. Assumes that students are at his level or bilingual level even when they are not. Participation every day by speaking out loud is necessary or you will be marked absent even if you are present in the class and lose points.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Ovall's lectures are great.  They cut to the most important part of the material in a clear way.  He is a tough grader though and your answers have to be defended with watertight justification.  Really enjoyed his style.

He taught from PDF documents that he wrote and he taught math theory with little teaching in the way of application. I'm graduating with a CS degree and a 3.8 GPA, but I had to drop his class because it was taught for math majors and tailored to them. Of the CS majors in the class, I only know of one that finished and he was doubling in math and CS

Dr. Ovall is an outstanding professor. His lectures are actually interesting and keep you focused as to what you are supposed to be learning. If you need help, don't be afraid to go to his office hours. He is very friendly and great at explaining problems or giving more examples. Also, he can spice up a conversation from time to time with a joke.

This man knows what he's talking about. He doesn't dumb down the content or teach you the easy way out. You will learn in his lecture. He's very helpful, as long as you come to him. He's a pretty cool guy and he can crack a joke every now and then.

Practice, and play well. It will be fine. While he is a tough professor, and expects you to sound good, that is not unfair. If you practice and put the time him he's a nice and mellow guy. 

Yes he can be harsh, but not really when it's not warranted.  He's a nice guy that does care about the program, quality of performances, and you.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Miles is demanding but amazing. Some students complain he's harsh or rude when he holds them accountable for being unprepared. Give me a break! He's firm, hilarious, and gets results, which is exactly what an ensemble needs. Rehearsals aren't therapy sessions. If you practice, you'll really enjoy this ensemble. Give it a go if you love Jazz!

He should not be teaching anyone. He's rude, condescending and cares about nothing but himself. This has been happening for 35 years. You go to school there for the jazz program and hope to have an advocate. Unfortunately, he is a circus promoter, promoting himself. Find a more positive influence who loves jazz and students more than himself.
If you are willing to work, he will give you the tools you need to be successful. There is a reason he is world famous. He's actually a pretty mellow guy if you are prepared.
Miles is a very talented teacher, and while he is very hard on his students, he pushes them to excel and succeed.
He does not care about you unless you play the saxphone. He is often rude,condescending, and apathetic. I DO NOT recommend his ensembles.

Excellent technical player, well-organized band leader. Should not be advising or teaching individuals. Sarcasm, rudeness, little or no instruction on musical expression, very little networking students to opportunities, too much time spent on in-jokes and ego. Teaches technique and scales, not MUSIC.
Miles knows how to work a band, but he's not as comfortable teaching individuals.
No Comments
I don't know how someone can be this rude.
he read a magazine during my AUDITION!  great player, bad person
No Comments

Dr. O was an amazing professor. You get to retake one exam at the end. She truly wants all her students to succeed. She is fun during lectures. She had an echo so you didn't have to actually go in person, but there was PollEv everyday which is like IClicker. This class is pretty easy if you keep up. She also accepted late work.
Very friendly, enthusiastic about the language.  You would have to try pretty hard to get a bad grade in this class.  Tests are extremely easy, most homework is just graded for completion.
Frau O is an excellent professor. She is funny and takes time to help all students understand material. I would take her class again!
Great Professor,  gives real world application of course material.  Engages the class throughout his lectures.

He is a nice guy, and accessible outside of class, but he made ACC 555 very unenjoyable. Lectures were long and boring. Tests were worded very hard. Cases were difficult and opinion-based. He had a very specific idea of what he thought the answer should be, and if your answer wasn't exactly like his, you were wrong. I wouldn't recommend.

Professor Osborne is not good. Attendance is required but his lectures are honestly just a waste of time. He speeds through his lectures, reading straight from his slides and is very bad at explaining the material. Exams are worth 500/600 points and they are very difficult. If you can avoid him, be sure to do so.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Test heavy 500 of 600 points are exams do not take him for acc202
terrible, will not reach you the content and just rambles about nothing. avoid him at all costs
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Osborne is a solid ACC 202 professor. He often gives extra credit randomly during class, so brush up on lecture material prior to so you can snag it. Participation gains you brownie points with him, which can save you come finals time.

He is not as bad as everyone makes him out to be. He is very knowledgeable. Exams are based on PowerPoint slides so get to memorizing! The cases kind of give an insight into some real-world experience which is great since you will probably be going into the workforce soon after taking the course. His lectures are really interesting as well!

If you actually want to learn accounting then take Osborne. If you want to get an A then don't. His lectures are great, but his exams will make you cry. He is funny and asks questions to the class, and he is fair. However,, if you do not put max effort in, your GPA will be dead.

One of the worst professors I have taken. He spits vocab and examples all day and if you ask for help he sits there and confuses you more and acts like you have a masters in ACC. Homework is worth nothing and tests are worth 100pts each and the final is 200 pts. I had an A after the first 2 tests only for the 3rd to drop me to a C-. Hated him
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: That being said the class is difficult and he doesn't necessarily help. Your tests are basically your only grade I failed one and 2 letters. He'll offer help if you're confused then makes his explanation more complicated but acts like you should know it now. He means well and is very knowledgable. The class is extremely fast paced.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Osborne isn't as bad as reviews say. Any ACC202 class takes effort. Homework not due until right before the exam so you can do it whenever. Learns everyones names and really cares. Encourages questions. Randomly calls on people for questions but not if you volunteer and answer ones you know. Answers are usually in the powerpoint online anyways!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is one of the best teachers in Gatton. He relates the majority of the course to real life business, so whether you are an accounting major or not, Osborne is the prof to take. HW is due the night before the exam and he offers a workshop to help students study for the exams (they help a ton). He makes you answer questions in class, not bad though

Osborne is an amazing professor. If you volunteer in class and show you care he will take time to get to know you which helps at the end of the semester. Meeting with him during his office hours helps. If you get to know him and show you care, if at the end of the semester you are borderline, he will round you, he did for me.

Professor Osborne is a great professor. He does call you out to answer questions, but this ended up being really beneficial to learning the material. He does what he can to help you can an A. Gives lots of example exam questions which are so helpful. He knows what he's talking about very well.

Learns everyones name which is nice, attendance is mandatory. Exams are most of the grade and are extremely difficult. Makes you use a basic calculator that makes everything much harder. Practice exams are usually much easier than the actual test. Also does not shut up during the exam, so good luck trying to read a problem when he's still talking.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Osborne is possibly the worst ACC professor. He is very hard to talk to as a student. He wont work with you. Very arrogant and defiantly choses favorites. Test were difficult. First C I ever got in college thanks to this airhead

The lectures are very dry and personally I did not retain much from them. Nearly failed the first exam, but read the textbook for the last three and received As on them and even the final. The textbook and practice exams were key to getting an A in this class.

Cares about you passing and gives good lectures. Don't bother reading the book it was a waste of time - focus on practice exams. Rounded me up at the end because I showed effort. Would definitely take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Osborne really cares about his students, but he isn't a great teacher. He has a very particular mindset about topics and struggles to convey that to students, but there are many extra credit opportunities available throughout the semester and the exams are exactly like the practice questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He really was not that hard if you tried. Don't study from the textbook or terms. HE ONLY TESTS ON PRACTICE QUESITONS!! So dont waste your time trying to learn terms etc.

Knows what he's talking about and is willing to help students whenever they need. Participate in class, go to his office hours, and show that you care and he will be more than willing to bump your grade at the end of the semester if needed. Also offers a lot of extra credit. If you put in effort this class should not be too difficult.

He is probably the best professor you'll be able to find for ACC202. He is really nice and can be pretty funny. The material isn't that exciting but Osborne knows what he is talking about. If you want a good grade you have to put in a good amount of effort. He gives you a lot of materials for exams so you know what to expect on the exams.

Although he spends most of the lecture reading off of slides, you can tell professor Osborne knows what hes talking about. Plenty of extra credit given. He cares about his students and their understanding of the concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I have ever had here at UK. I have learned more in the class than I have in all of my other business classes combined. You must go to class to be successful, but his lectures are SO helpful. He gives a pretty decent amount of extra credit for homework, and for attendance. I would recommend this professor for everyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is a good professor. Accounting is hard, but he knows what he's talking about and tries to help as much as he can. He is an up beat teacher that will keep you engaged though out the class period. He likes active participation and will call on you to answer or for your opinion, but it helps you learn the material better. He is tough but good

He retired from being an auditor and decided to teach but has such an uncomfortable demeanor. I actually partially decided to change my major from accounting because of him. He was the one who made me realize that all of the accounting professors that I have ever had are always awkward, lame, and dry. He's not a bad guy, but he doesn't inspire.
His lectures match my learning style. Its fast paced, but he makes sure that he covers everything. People ask lots of questions, and he thoroughly answers them

Professor Osborne lectures heavy but he is a good professor and if you ever have any questions, he is 100% dedicated on getting you the answer you're looking for. He is a good professor overall but if you don't pay attention, you will fall behind.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Osborne is a nice guy but his class is challenging. He just reads from slides that the textbook provides him. His exams are hard our class average on the first one was a 52%. He offers extra credit but a lot of people struggle with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I really liked osborne!! He cares about his students understanding and wants them to do well in his class. Paying attention in class will help you too well on exams. Go to his workshops they help too! i loved him!!
I love him he cares about his students and loves involvement! he gives extra credit if ppl are doing bad and hosts workshops for the test. gives practice exams and uploads notes

He is a horrible lecturer and an even worse grader. The tests and assignments he gives out rely on subjectivity based on his personal preferences and his experiences.  This could be a great class, but his ineffective teaching makes the class boring at times and frustrating at other times.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Prof Osborne is a really nice guy. He is intelligent, and has an extensive background in accounting. But he is not a great teacher. He just reads off of slides (that the text book makes for him), and your lectures are just going through problem after problem without understanding how any of it works. Tests are rough and there is a lot of hw.

He isn't successful in the classroom. He designs assignments that even he doesn't fully understand. He grades totally subjectively and refuses to give credit to any student that applies the concepts he teaches in a different (but still correct) manner than he does. I would avoid taking him as a professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He has an unclear grading system that largely relies on subjectivity, which is difficult given this is an ACC course. He brings in questionable speakers who don't understand their surroundings when speaking.

I took the once-a-week evening class. This class is straight memorization. There are about 9 powerpoints (ranging from 35-80 slides) and you have a quiz every week. Lectures are long (w/ rambling) and it is mainly him talking but there are some discussion. The tests are difficult since he tests over minute details on the slides and in his lecture.

ACC 201 was a struggle for me, but worked hard and did very well in 202. Osborne has a lot of experience in the field and knows what he's talking about, but maybe not the best teacher. Everyone usually bombs the first test because it's the hardest. There's four exams total and then he drops the lowest one. GO TO CLASS AND ASK FOR HELP!
This class is easy to get behind in. Make sure you are reading the textbook and doing examples after class. The tests are pretty straight forward but I wouldn't describe them as easy.

This was his second time teaching 202, but he does a good job. He learns your name, attendance in class isn't actually mandatory, and his tests are to the point. The only way you won't get an A is if you don't do the homework and don't understand the material. His class is way easier than some of the other accounting classes I've taken.

A debate, paper, 3 exams, attendance, little extra credit. Good news is everything is worth small amounts of points. Debate is only 25.  Nothing can kill your grade.  She's kind of liberal and sympathizes a lot, but great easy class. Do the practice problems in the book!
Meh, not great.
Great teacher. Encourages class discussion on fun topics such as drug use and crime in society.
There is a good amount of lectures, but they are interesting and the work isn't hard if you show up and talk for a minute.

I watched my friends be stressed out with this class all semester and I couldn't have been happier I took it online with Owen. He assigns an article each week and then you have to respond to it in 300-500 words. There is a final project at the end but nothing too bad. This class is definitely the move for fulfilling WRD111.

He wants you to be active in his class (advice, lessons, and opinions, etc.)Nothing you say is ever wrong, it just add flavor to the mix. Its an easy A if you show up and throw in your two cents. He gives a crap, so it's better if you do. Its a fun experience and definitely something I would do again.  Ps: If you get to know him, it's MUCH easier.
He rocks. So chill and makes the class fun.

Professor Horton is one of the only professors that understands his students have busy schedules and lives. There aren't many tests, but if you don't like group projects, do not take this class. The final is basically a documentary that you and a group work on, but it's not outrageously difficult. Would definitely take again!

So he may change this order but Mon: Quiz over movie and discuss a little bit, Wed: Discussion over book chap, Fri: Discuss more of the movie.  WARNING: If you do not talk during class about the movie you won't pass.  The book we had to read was a bore and long to me.  Overall very nice dude.

He's a great guy and easy to get along with. There aren't a ton of assignments just put in a little effort and you'll do fine. The group assignment sounds horrifying but  pick a good group & its actually pretty fun, he gives time during class to do it also. BUT you have to participate, its part of ur grade, he does count it.

Can miss up to three classes. When he brings up the documentary assignment, it sounds like it's going to suck but in reality, it's really fun. Pick the right group members. He's easy to contact and was really easy to get along with.
Love Dr. Osborn! He cares so much about his students and loves what he does. One of my favorite classes :) Lab reports are graded hard but if you study his notes and pay attention you will do well !

Avoid taking this class in the spring if possible, take it with another professor in the fall. Osborn was a mess all semester; his syllabus gave contradicting information about point allocation, none of which actually lined up with what he decided to do in class. His exams and quizzes were not difficult, but there are better professors for 350.
I'm writing this as a first-year med student. This course prepped me so well for the HLK block and I have to say... Dr. Osborn teaches better than some of the professors at my current med school.

Easily my favorite professor at UK. Super informative and knows what he's talking about. Most importantly, he knows why you're in the class (for credit). He's funny and laughs at himself a lot, and if you're an NFL fan, he'll love you. Developed a bond with this guy despite it being a 50 person lecture. Would easily take again.

The BEST professor Ive taken in my years at UK. He loves what he teaches and it shows. Super easy to learn from. Attendance is not mandatory, but if you show up he will guide you through test-like questions so you know pretty much what the test will be like. He teaches with a TEAL style, which also really helps.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This semester he taught using a TEAL method. No textbooks were needed since I learned everything from lecture, and cleared up confusion by watching YT videos. He does provide many online resources. Very engaging lecturer and loves what he does! Take good notes in class and study those and the ppt's for exams and you'll be fine. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. O is an amazing professor. His lectures are super interesting and you will need to attend them in order to do well in the class. I did not use the textbook at all because he gives a lot of online links to helpful resources.

Subject of the class is interesting and great. But his lectures are confusing and complicated. He spends half the semester telling the class we only need to know general concepts and then after the exam gets graded he says we did not do well because we have to know details. Learned more from youtube videos about physiology than I did from him.
Excellent professor. Attendance isn't required but in order to pass you must attend!

An excellent professor. The class is very different compared to most Bio classes at UK. It is based more on problem solving than lecturing. Going to Office hours are very helpful. He likes to joke and be sarcastic, so a thick layer of skin is needed for his humor. Read the book and go to class. Overall it was a pleasant experience

Best. Professor. Ever. He kept the class engaged and was so funny at times. Come to class. Read the text. Bug him when you don't understand things because he's super helpful. He covers everything that'll be on the exam so if you prepare, it's a guaranteed A, just don't be lazy and expect grades to be handed to you. ALWAYS attend class too, trust me

I was actually very excited to take this course because I heard it was very well taught and helpful for MCAT. However, I feel like I barely learned a thing in this class! I would almost consider it a waste of time. If you are interested in physiology not a bio major, pick a different physiology class, like 440G. This class covers the very basics.

Dr. O is a great teacher. He is extremely sarcastic and rude. So if you can't take getting picked on or called out in class don't take him. His exam questions are divided into level 1,2 and 3 difficulty. The level 3 are like MCAT, PCAT, DAT questions. Exams can be tough but fair. Book is optional. Helped a lot of people but I didn't use it.

Dr. Osborn is an amazing professor! He really knows how to get students to think. Exams are a little difficult, but that is the nature of the course. Attend class and study hard for exams and a good grade is possible.

Dr. Osborne is a wonderful professor. He may appear to be overwhelming at first with his interest in picking on his students. But if you have the basic tolerance of a college student, you will like him a lot! He is fun and knowledgeble. He will teach you a lot beyond the text.
Horrible, awful, unpleasant, rude, pompous. Couldn't wait to get out of that class.

Dr. O is awesome! But if you aren't a fan of scarcasm, then  you may not like him. He can be confusing at times but you just have to learn how to read him.  Really interesting guy.  I would definitely take another one of his classes.  He knows his stuff.  Oh, and don't argue with him.  He made a girl in my class cry...
He is one of my favorite profs. He is funny and makes the most boring subjects interesting. He really cares about his students and is very friendly.
What I like about Osborne is he never curve the test. I recommend those who are studying biology to take him....

Dr. Osborne is a great professor, and he knows his material thoroughly.  If you put in the effort, you'll enjoy the class.  He is a very open guy, but he is demanding.  Definitely take the class if you want to become a more critical thinker in college.
Best prof. i've had..very funny and engaging..even invites you to his house for dinner!  Class def. not boring!
Class was very interactive and engaging.  Dr. O is great!
No Comments
Dr. O is great, though he really has high expectations of everyone---which is good, as he's the man to help a person GET to the point where they can meet said expectations.
The Class was challenging and interesting. If you want to learn and have fun doing so, he is the teacher you want. Be prepared to study alot before you take the class.
she's really good but calculus is hard
Lectures are presented well, good professor overall.
Super friendly and helpful! She really knows what she's talking about and is willing to talk you through any problems you're having. Definitely the best math teacher I've had!

She is really nice and explains the topics very well. The textbook is not used in class but it is helpful to work extra problems. The tests are not really hard they are just graded hard. I haven't gone to office hours but I have heard that she can be very helpful.

Dr. Ott is a breath of fresh air in UK's lacking math department. Very nice, sweet, and personable. Always willing to help you understand the material, which she knows forwards and backwards. If you can take her class, do it!

Great teacher who cares about her students! Dr. Ott is so nice and approachable. She's willing to do a lot to help out her students and she is very easy to understand. She explains the math very well.

Very nice and helpful. She encourages questions and class participation and does not make you feel bad if your wrong. You have to go to class to learn beacuse there's no answers or proofs in the textbook and the exams are all proofs.
Great Class!  By far the best teacher I've had at UK!
Definitely take her.  Great teacher.  Very fair and willing to work with you.  Tests/quizzes are straight forward. You will not be disappointed.
Parker is an extremely easy grader, which makes the course significantly less stressful. Show up to class and do the work, you'll be fine.

Her tests are easy but be prepared to learn a lot of the material on your own. She explains things in a way that's more complicated than it needs to be and assumes you know things that you might (most likely probably) don't know, especially with regards to Matlab. She also jumps around a lot which makes think confusing.

I'm not sure she is quite qualified to teach ME 340. The class was easy at the beginning but as the material got more difficult, her lack of knowledge really shined. Constant mistakes on the board and second guessing herself to the point where the students had to help her figure out what was going on.

She is a terrible teacher. Sure, she is a nice person, but that doesn't mean she can teach.  I didnt learn anything from her.  She has to qualify everything she says and the constant asides are exhausting.  Her "upbeat" attitude just makes her seem like an airhead. Very frustrating.
Very easy. Class was interesting and was geared toward student interests, as much as possible.
I totally agree with the previous post. Her positive attitude make the class that much better.

Intro in engineering class: Bound to be boring, labs and computer lessons were a waste of time/effort, but none of that is the prof's fault. Excellent, enthusiastic professor who really cares about her students. They need more like her!

I had him for UK 101. He was incredibly kind and thoughtful. I feel like he definitely tried his best to make this class engaging and fun. A book is required. At the end we got to present all of the art we made that semester. Pretty easy class. Not a hard grader at all. We weren't in class for the whole time most of the time

Take him!! He's an amazing, fair professor. Very open-minded, willing to talk to you about anything in the fine arts department and very knowledgeable about his stuff. I can't wait to take more classes with him. One book is mandatory to buy, participation matters, and just come to class open to discussion.

Matt was a great teacher. Graphic design really isn't for me, but I learned some things that I can use in other disciplines & doing things you aren't comfortable with always stretches your creativity. Matt would know how to get you from a blank piece to what you're trying to get on the screen. My only wish is that there had been more critiques.

Matt is a really knowlegeable guy. He is very young and hip while still maintaining his credibility. He doesnt require attendance in lecture, but "break outsections" (recitations) are required. You work with photoshop and final cut pro which are easy once you catch on to them! Never had to work on assginments outside of class other than fimlming!

Matt is one of the most chill people you will ever meet. He's really nice and laid back. Even though it is photoshop and final cut pro stuff, I never worked on a project outside of class. Its a lot of fun and usually lets out early. He doesn't really care if you're a couple min late to class. Definitely one of my favorite profs at uk!!

Would suggest to take another professor if you are someone who prefers more interesting and relevant lectures. She was a tough grader and super strict about attendance. Would cold call on students. Very lecture heavy and hard to stay interested. Definitely more interesting and relaxed professors for this course

She's such a great professor, you know she cares about her students. She sets you up for success and her class isn't hard as long as you pay attention and put thought into your speeches. She's one of my favorite professors!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is an amazing teacher who follows her dates and makes you aware of quizzes and assignments ahead of time. She is strict on attendance, so make sure if you miss, it's excused. She grades hard, but as long as you pay attention and give yourself plenty of time to do your work, you will have at least a B.

Only 2 exams but they make up around 70% of your grade and are very difficult. Other part of your grade is the case studies which are group projects. Doesn't grade those super strict. Tries to help you understand the content but the content is difficult for most. Study the mock exams, ask questons and it's not too bad.

Professor Manoel seems like a nice person. However, his class is very challenging unless you enjoy high-pressure exams. About 65% of the grade comes from the midterm and final, with the remainder based on cases and quizzes. I would recommend taking a different FIN 405 instructor unless you love a heavy exam-based grading structure.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lectures are incredibly boring, but he tries his best to help you when you have questions. Put in good effort on the cases and you'll get an A. Exams are hard, practice exams are kind of helpful but I would definitely recommend also knowing how to do the problems from the slides and homework.

Nice guy and good teacher, but 65% of your grade is based off of the midterm and final (which are half multiple choice half short answer) so makes it nearly impossible to get a good grade without being an amazing test taker. Wish there was more weight on the other assignments in the class than just exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I loved the class! It is hard transitioning back to in-person learning after the pandemic but Paulo makes going to class fun and quite enjoyable. There are "pop" quizzes on case days but you know ahead of time so no surprise there. Only wish the exam questions are written clearer. I definitely studied hard but the exams are tough.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Easy grader, she is so nice and sweet, gives extra time for projects and exam are online. The guy that gave her a 1 idk what he is talking about she's easy and doesn't make you participate she doesn't really engage but the class was easy she nice and a easy grader thats what we care about.

She requires you to participate and PROVE your attendance to 2 different group fitness classes and a 5k marathon outside of class. She WILL look up your name and time online to ensure you actually completed a 5k. She is a tough grader on participation and engagement, especially on energy for the final group project. She also talks way too much.
She is super kind and understanding, and seems like an all around good person. I would definitely have her as a professor again.
Easy A class. She will just spent the whole class talking will have a powerpoint presentation. Exams are online.
Dr. Pfeiffer is a sweet caring guy! He's a little intimidating at first, but he warms up quick. Responds to emails quickly and will accommodate you for whatever you need!

He is a very nice person, but teaches in weird ways. You should probably skim or know some answers from the reading for each class; he will randomly call on people. The quizzes are kind of tough to get 20/20, but the exams aren't bad.

If you can get past his attitude, he will help you. Reading is absolutely necessary and discussions will be attempted in class; although, he has no idea how to conduct them. He's a very awkward and rude person in general. He isn't very particular about due dates as long as you speak to him about it, he'll take a late paper.

A really odd, exceptionally tall fellow. Long, awkward eye contact is frequent and inevitable. One of our assignments was to eat sandwiches in total silence. Like I said. Weird guy. Easy A if you read Guns, Germs, and Steel. I found it semi-interesting. Be prepared for discussions

Not a bad class.  Definitely have to read most of what he assigns to do alright on the tests though.  It's possible to BS your way through discussions, but not recommended.  The books used are boring and long.  Get used to Guns, Germs, and Steel.  It never goes away. The book has some use for the class topic, but makes for a boring class.

You must read before every class. But if you pay attention during class you will be fine on the exams. Just a few papers, and although he grades hard, you get a draft, so pay attention to his comments and you will be fine. Really nice guy. A little quirky, but cares about his students.

Must read books in order to understand what is happening in class. He's a pretty laid back guy, but his tests are hard. He grades papers randomly and most of the time, I am unsure about what he is asking. Fun class, but not fun tests.

He is a horrible teacher. He is rude and inconsiderate, and he rarely will listen to anyone's opinions if they are not exactly what he thinks. He cannot teach a discussion class, he knows NOTHING about editing papers, and he makes inane comments about grammar that are simply incorrect. I cannot believe he is the head of this track.
He specifically told me that he doesn't know how to teach a discussion based class, but he is the head of the food track for honors?? he is a jerk, and he can't teach our class!

I found Professor Pfeiffer extremely boring and, at time, exceedingly rude. In a discussion class like HON 111, input (even contrary input) should be accepted and considered, not passed by or chastised.

Tended to have an attitude. The course was extremely dependent on the text. The material itself was boring. The tests are all multiple choice, but are difficult. He uses a curve, however, it doesn't always help. He takes attendance randomly and it counts heavily into your grade.

Very nice teacher,laid back, Makes the material interesting. as long as you do the quizzes on BB and go to class, you will pass. many ways to earn points, so no worries! I would highly recommend this class.
Easy class! Go to class, do the readings (not much out of the book) that he assigns every day. When test time comes you will get an A!

If you're considering taking BCH401G online because you've heard it's “easier,” I'd honestly recommend an in person section instead. The course is fully asynchronous with no lectures and you learn entirely from the textbook. There are 38 discussion posts, 4 common exams and a cumulative final, with little to no professor interaction
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: The people leaving poor reviews are likely the students who try to write down everything a professor says. These students fail to prepare for the exams accordingly.
