this class is ridiculously easy. the easiest class ive ever taken in college. i studied for the first test the night before and got an A. go to class and take notes and look over problems given in the book.

this class is ridiculously easy. the easiest class ive ever taken in college. i studied for the first test the night before and got an A. go to class and take notes and look over problems given in the book.

If he talks about something he thinks is important he'll tell you it will be on the test.  If you show up and take notes you should be fine.  Lectures mostly come from the book but he does include outside stuff on quizzes + tests to make sure you go to class.  If you attend and take notes you should be ok.  Ditto on looks. :)
This class is HARD!  The class average almost failed for the first exam but this he is one of the most gorgeous men I have ever seen.
He is a great professor and wants you to succeed. He has a fun sense of humor and cares about his students.
I enjoy lecture-heavy classes so Dr. Pool was perfect for me. Very knowledgeable and nice guy, I would definitely take him again

Very wholesome and sweet man, dressed up as Indiana Jones the first day of class. His lectures really drag on, though. Assignments were a bit confusing sometimes and it didn't feel like an introductory class. You will need the textbook. Attendance is taken. He's a good guy and that goes a long way.

Dr. Pool is an excellent professor. His classes are a little bit lecture heavy but he provides the slides. Myself and others in the class asked some pretty dumb questions but he never talked down to us or made us feel stupid. He gives thoughtful and meaningful responses and will help you if you ask. Be sure to do the study guide and you'll do well.

This is the most boring and useless class you could ever take if it doesn't have anything to do with your major. Professor Pool is the most boring lecturer there is to exist. Everyday I sat through class just scrolling through online shopping websites and thinking about how badly I didn't want to be there. Don't take his class.

a very sweet man, very passionate about his subject. 3 big tests and a project/paper, but gives a big extra credit opportunity if you write an extra paper on a subject you're interested in. a true gem

Dr. Pool is an incredibly sweet man, he's very passionate about what he does and it shows. He assigns a discussion board over a chapter or less in the book once a week. This is very manageable. It only has to be a question or a small comment on the reading. He sometimes will go over in lecture, but all in all he's a kind man who loves what he does.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Mr Pool is so incredibly boring. It didn't matter how well rested I was, I always struggled to stay awake in class. His lectures last forever, and the workload is heavy. He is a very easy grader, however. Do the required reading and papers and earning an A won't be too hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is a very nice guy and shows a lot of enthusiasm for the subject. There is a lot of information taught in class and he posts the PowerPoints. I would not recommend taking this class unless you are an anthropology major. It was difficult and was reading based. He takes attendance every class so you cannot skip.

Dr. Pool is a super nice guy, and knows what he is talking about. Just does not know how to correctly teach information for an introductory class. Unless you are passionate about archaeology, I would not take this class. You show up, and just listen to him lecture off a powerpoint for over an hour, and was super hard to keep up with and learn from.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: For an "introductory" level class, the grading was ridiculously hard. I felt as if though I could never win. If you don't do well on one of the tests don't expect to do well in the class whatsoever.

Archaeology methods and theory is not an exciting subject matter. Dr. Pool tries really hard to spark students' interest in his long lectures and assignments. It's still quite boring, but he's a good teacher.

Dr. Pool is a really great guy and wants his students to do well, but the class was entirely too demanding for a 100 level course. Unless you are genuinely interested in anthropology, I would suggest taking a different class. That being said, he is extremely kind and very helpful when asked, and an A is possible, but be prepared to earn it!

Don't take Dr.Pool unless you are an anthropology major, or you are a goddamn genius. He is extremely intelligent, funny, and excited to teach because.. anthropology is his life...but he forgets that that isn't the case with all of his students. He crams too much info in one semester and his tests are HARD.

One of the most awesome classes I've ever had.  Dr. Pool's very knowledgable.  As my faculty mentor, he's very easily approachable and definitely knows what he's talking about.  He makes the subject interesting and always keeps your attention.
Awesome professor,  tests are difficult, but you get the study guide way ahead of time, and they're very detailed.  Dr. Pool is really interesting and has a funny personality.
Fun and knowledgeable

A helpful, goofy professor that really knows his stuff.  The exams are fair and the syllabus is detailed, and Dr.Pool sticks to it so you always know what to expect.  There is no reason not to make an A in this class because he even gives a 100 point optional extra credit assignment!

Pay attention, fill out the study guide, and you should have no problems.  I'm a freshman in a 300-level class, and I've got a high A.  Very excitable and interesting instructor--he really loves his subject!

Dr. Pool is the man.  He's a little goofy, but he's just a nice southern guy.  As long as you take your time, take good notes, and fill out the studyguide, there's no reason you can't get an A.  Im a freshman, didnt read the text, and still got an A in a level 3 class!

This is a really nice guy. He grades really easily and will always help you. His lectures get a little scattered and will go off and tell irrelavent stories, but if you do the reading, you will be fine.
Paul was so handsome and intelligent but could do better

Quite literally one of the best professors I've ever had. I felt genuinely interested in every single thing he had to say which reflected on my performance in the class. He definitely gives a lot of papers but they are easy if you pay attention in class
Great professor, just need to do your work.
10/10 professor. if you have him consider yourself lucky.
Had him for this and SOC 304. Very funny, laid back, and surprisingly relatable. You can tell he cares a lot about teaching. Would recommend to anyone even slightly interested in sociology.

literally the easiest class and the best professor I have had so far at UK. You have to attend lecture but they are so entertaining that it does not even matter. The readings that are assigned are not really required for your papers. It is a paper heavy class but lets you pick the length and gives credit for including every part of the assignment
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Paul was pretty funny and laid back. The lectures kinda sucked though because they could be pretty boring. No tests/quizzes just weekly writing assignments. If you just try on the assignments you get a good grade in the class. Not a bad prof, just probably is better at teaching higher-level classes.

He was an amazing professor and he's really understanding! I highly recommend taking his class. His lectures are very inclusive because he talks a lot while also showing his lecture notes and drawing things out on the board. He doesn't give exams, and you get to help come up with the assignments.
Paul is a cool and easy teacher. You get 5 free "skips" before your grade is affected. If you try on the papers you'll get a 100. It's an interesting class and he's a very honest guy.

You write about one paper every week in this class but that is all. Otherwise the class is really easy and interesting, and he is an easy grader so as long as you turn the papers in on time, you will be all good!

Paul is the best. He is incredibly knowledgable and honest. This class was really interesting and you learn a lot from him. This class is only out of 100 points. He let us design our own assignments on Fridays, (9 @ 8 points each). No tests. 8 random quizzes (1 point each) during class for attendance. Final writing assignment (20 points). TAKE PAUL

Dr. Sidney was probably one of the best professors I had this semester. She's very nice and her lectures are always clear and keeps you engaged. There are three exams (open-note, online), two short papers, and small weekly assignments. She also gives lots of extra credit opportunities! As long as you study and do the assignments, you'll get an A!
Dr. Sidney was a great teacher and very understanding! All exams are open notes, so as long as you attend lectures, you'll do great!

Dr. Sidney is amazing! Her lectures are engaging and easy to retain. She has lots of opportunity for extra credit. Attendance is optional, but her lectures make you want to come. She takes time to answer questions during lecture.

Dr. Sidney's class has probably been the most stress-free for me this semester. Dr. Sidney is very clear in her requests each week and is very understanding. Lectures were asynchronous this semester and she is really good at explaining concepts. I greatly enjoyed her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Sidney is one of the best professors I have ever had! She makes lectures interesting and takes time to answer each student's questions while covering the content. She's also super nice!!

I absolutely loved this class!! Dr. Sidney is super sweet and cares about her students doing well in the class. The study guides are in line with the exams so if you do those and watch the lecture you should do great on exams. The class work is very manageable and the lectures are super interesting and easy to follow.

Dr. Sidney was amazing during the Pandemic. Her lectures were very clear and as long as you payed attention during lecture and read your book if you were confused or wanted clarity then you should be fine. Dr. Sidney also gave many opportunities for extra credit. I would definitely take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: TAKE HER CLASS! I loved this class and how she taught it. This class was already an interesting subject and instead of drilling us on the information she asked us more how we felt about it and how we would use it in our everyday lives which I think was more useful for us anyways! The exams are straight information we learned.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Sidney was a good professor and cared about her students. However, she doesn't post any notes online, no echoes either; even if you are excused from class. She will just tell you to read the book, and honestly it's not helpful. So go to class and you will be fine. Overall, pretty easy class if you show up and take notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Thickest accent on UK's campus. He tries his best with instructions but you understand every third word. If you don't have a background in guitar I wouldn't take this class. However if you email him for help with things he emails back quickly and is very nice just very hard to understand and grades kinda tough.

Very easy course. Professor's really nice and funny. The only thing you need to do is submit your assignments, which are pretty simple. Always open to help if needed. The other guy who rated him probably failed because he didn't do anything.

Thought I would be taking an easy beginner guitar class…however, despite the content being very new to almost everyone, he grades as if we are graduate students that are taking a masters course for music. Was told in a recent exam, which was the first one, that “You could've done much better.” He isn't better in class either.
Love him so much.

Guys this breaks my heart y'all are hating on him! HE IS SO AMAZING. Go sit in his office hours before the test and don't leave until you completely understand the material, it makes a difference. You also actually need to go to recitation, it is critical for this class! LOVE LOVE LOVE this class I would take it again so fast if I could.

Professor Samanta is overall a good professor, where his issues lie are recitation where sometimes either you end up behind class and in need of catching up or ahead and you sit in class basically doing nothing

He is not the best teacher and can be hard to understand but the class is super easy so it's not bad to teach yourself. Recitation is annoying and the TAs don't do a good job but I'd recommend taking him.

Doesn't post his notes, and on top of that makes his answer keys incredibly confusing. Makes a very easy class (MA 162) more difficult than it has to be. Won't be the end of the world if you have to take him, but try to get someone else.

once you get used to his accent, he's a really good professor and is always happy to answer questions- he also gives partial credit on tests-if you go to class and turn in the work and keep up with the material its very doable

I actually took him for MA162. Professor Samanta is not a bad professor, he is just hard to understand. You can tell he wants you to succeed and the material is not that difficult, but again his accent makes it hard to listen during lecture.

Pretty good professor overall, stutters a bit but probably because he is nervous to be new. Accent is not that bad especially in a smaller class like 261, and even if he is he is very open in office hours if you are struggling. Recommend.
Hard to understand

Dr. Samanta was so nice and understanding! He explains things well and if you have questions, he is super quick to answer them. I didn't enjoy the way the schedule of this class was set up because of the tests and new content overlapping but he made it easier to deal with and made the grading system clear from the beginning!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: could never really understand what he was saying, had to learn everything on my own. Nice guy but when in a big lecture hall I could never understand what he is trying to say, and he explains stuff really weird and confusing when the class is not even that complicated. My friend explained everything better in 5 mins than him in an hour.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. P is the best professor that I had my entire undergraduate semester. He is so inspirational & helpful, & he really just wants you to pass the class. Grades are entirely reliant on the exams, so study consistently. There is no attendance grade, but you don't have access to Echo if you do not attend the lecture. Thank you, Dr. P! You're amazing.

Dr. P has no idea what is going on. TopHat is super buggy and hard to navigate. Grades are very hard to understand and he doesn't update ever exam grades in Canvas. There are multiple professors for this class, so it is very hard to follow the content. Take a class on brain anatomy before you take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing neuro professor and very engaging lecturer. He asks questions and uses real-life examples that make the content click. To do well, don't miss lecture, reread the material right after class, and pay close attention to Top Hat questions because they are great exam review.

I liked this class. Lectures were always very interesting and he did a good job keeping the class's attention. It's not a good idea to skip lectures, though. Missing one can set you back really far. My biggest tip for this class is to have a good handle on brain anatomy beforehand. The content jumps around too much to get a good grasp on anatomy.
Dr. P is a great lecturer and really cares about teaching. The class was fun and interesting. He can be very direct via email but always nice and understanding.

This is a super fun and educational class. Dr. P is great about giving multiple examples of what you are learning and makes lectures very engaging. The course is very test-heavy, but the tests are pretty straightforward, and he makes himself available to answer any questions. I highly recommend taking him and this course.

Dr. P is one of the best professors I've ever had. He is very clear, and his exams reflect his lectures. He loves interaction with students during lectures and gives out prizes for asking questions or giving thoughtful insight. I would take him over and over again if I could!

Teaches a complex subject in a very approachable way and is careful to not overload the class with too much info at once. The whole grade in the class is only 4 exams, but if you make flashcards and study for a few hours before you'll be fine. Also hands out free merch occasionally in class and goes off on lots of side tangents.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Wouldn't let me turn in one missing assignment to push my grade from a 79 to an 80. gave me a C. be sure to have everything submitted before final grades.

Dr. P is a great guy -- funny, charismatic, and nice. He isn't the best at answering questions and he goes off topic a LOT during class. However, the content is genuinely not that difficult to learn and he will try his best to help. Tests are fairly easy but your entire grade is based on the exams, so be prepared for that. Nice guy, good class!

While your entire grade is made up of 4 exams which is scary, I highly recommend taking Dr. P. He is so passionate about teaching subjects like this and he is also hilarious. If he knows you, he will make an effort to call on you by name which shows he cares about his students. Tests were easy, topics were super interesting. Highly recommend!!!

Dr. P is a fantastic professor and a kind genuine person. He actually cares about your performance and encourages asking questions. I went to his office hours because I was struggling, didn't feel judged in the slightest. He will take time to make sure you understand. I was able to get help and back on track. Very fun class.

I thoroughly enjoyed BIO 302. Dr. Prendergast is a great professor and storyteller. He gives a lot of incentive for students to go to office hours, ask questions, or otherwise interact which makes for a very fun class

He's all talk and no action. Promises vanish into thin air. Leaves you hanging, feeling abandoned. Don't trust his false friendship. He's a flake who lets you down every time. Doesn't show up to meetings he scheduled, doesn't answer emails, doesn't keep any promises. He'll offer to help during class, but then becomes unreachable and untraceable!

If you have the chance to take a class with Dr.P, DO IT!! This guy is probably the best professor on the planet. He cares so deeply about his students and tries to help give them every opportunity. Plus, he is very easy to follow in lectures and always makes sure students understand each subject he brings up in class. I would rate him a 100000/10.
Dr. P is the best in the department. He is an amazing lecturer and makes neuroscience so accessible. He is a very fair grader and offers a lot of extra credit.

Dr. P has really changed the game for BIO 302. He never rushes through lectures and will always stop to clear up any confusing material. His class is really interesting, and the exams directly reflect the content from his lectures. He is super funny and approachable, and he is very understanding. Great professor and person. Definitely recommend!

Dr. P is the best lecturer I have had at UK! He makes neuroscience interesting and digestible which is often hard considering how difficult the content is. I would love to take another one of his classes or join his research lab :)

Had Dr. Prendergast for BIO 302 along with other guest professors like Dr. Morganti and Dr. Cherra throughout the semester. They were all amazing and this course really reminded me why I loved learning. I looked forward to these lectures. 10/10 hands down.

Dr. Prendergast is one of a kind! He is clearly very passionate about his field, as well as helping his students. He provides extra credit opportunities throughout the semester. Lectures were recorded, attendance was not mandatory, and tests were taken at home. He is my favorite professor I have had at UK.

I took this class with Dr. Sharett-Field and had to drop out of it with a 'w.' I took this with Dr. Prendergast and easily got an A,. Enough said. He has a ton of extra credit on TopHat questions that are graded based on participation and the exams are also on TopHat, no Zoom or lockdown browser. Know the slides and go to lecture and you're good.
He records all of his lectures, so attendance isn't mandatory. I went maybe 3 times and got an A

Mark was one of the best professors ever. The class itself was hard, but if you go to lectures, take notes, and actually put in study time it will be much easier. The class was graded off of exams, 2 or 3 thought papers, and a group project. Attendance isn't mandatory but I highly suggest going majority of the time.

When Dr. Prendergast taught, the lecture material was easy to understand. But he had two Ph.D students teach a lot and they really didn't know how to effectively teach. Tests were a little tricky, but easy if you study and know the material from the study guide.

Easiest class ever. Mark actually said he doesn't like to give out Cs and Ds. Attractive, nice, easy going. 25 minute presentation and 15 page paper seem intimidating but he is a very easy grader. Dont have to go for almost all of April. No final.

The most amazing professor I had  in my 4 years at UK.  Makes the material interesting and useful.  He is brilliant and extremely knowledgeable  but also very down to earth and cool.  He will go out of his way for you even though he is a busy guy and is a great teacher even though he is a great researcher. He is pretty hot too :)

Mark is a badass. Take any class you can from him.  If you come to class, take notes, you'll do fine, even though the material can be difficult at times.  He provides extra credit opportunities, and is very down to earth/easy to talk to.
Yes, he's very hot, but I think he does very well not letting that get in the way of his teaching.  Can you be hot AND informative?  Take the class!
No Comments
even if this class sucked, i wouldn't remember. simply because dr. p is so hot. so very hot.
Very interesting guy. Young and cute!  Very helpful to his students.  The class is very easy but you learn a lot.
Great professor.  And I thought he was gorgeous.
No Comments
He is very sweet person and he really cares about his students. If you participate you'll do great.

Very sweet man but unfortunately he is not a very good professor. He goes over content very quickly and doesn't really check to see if students understand it, and when asked to explain something he is very vague and restates exactly what he said before.
He has accents but he knows what he is teaching and of course participation matters. I liked his class.
Heavy accent. Very dissconnected from students. Hard to follow notes.
Not very good, nice guy tho
If you participate and work hard then you will pass.
Overall he is a great professor and would definitely take class again if needed.
Large disconnect with studnets.

Overall not a bad person but not a good professor. If you have a question then don't look to him for help because he will not return your emails. During lectures, he couldn't explain clearly questions that students had, went way too fast, and didn't allow time for people to access their iClicker logins before he would stop accepting answers.
He is very nice and caring professor. His lectures were little speed but he would explain if you didn't understand. I recommend to take his class.

I feel bad because it was his first semester teaching here but he was just awful. Sped through all of his lectures at lighting speed and did not explain anything good at all. He has a very strong accent and struggles speaking proper english. I would just recommend switching to a different professor if you have to take this class.

I feel so bad because he is so nice, but he just speeds through lectures. I had to attempt to teach myself everything and it ended awful. I would study hours and weeks for tests. Do not take this class unless you want to teach yourself everything!!!

With or without this professor, this class has ultimately affected me way worse than when I lost both my parents. Absolutely awful teaching and an awful department. Glad I never have to take this class again.
He's caring & genuinely wants his students to learn, which is why it's unfortunate he can't speak English very well. I mostly used other resources to learn. Be prepared for lots of homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: His first year of teaching at UK; he tried his best. he's still learning to explain stuff. went too fast because he taught a tuesday-thrusday class.
Horrible. He is a sweet man but a horrible teacher. he actually cannot explain things and goes WAY too fast

Dr Price is incredibly knowledgeable, experienced, and passionate about herps. He's very funny, almost unintentionally. The class is really hard, you have to identify + know scientific name of every herp species in Kentucky for the lab section. There are 4 field trips at the end that are fun. Zero homework, all grades are exams and lab quizzes.

He takes a little while to warm up, but after the first week or two he's cracking jokes. He's very respectful, you can ask any question and you will get a straight forward and meaningful response. He makes recordings of class and his presentations, which make it easy to take notes or review subjects.

I took his herpetology class, which I can say is the hardest class I have taken as an undergrad and will serve almost no practical purpose in my life, but I would still highly recommend taking it. He really wants to challenge his students and has high expectations. Steve is easily one of the funniest professors I've had in college.
Steven is the GOAT. Great chem prof and very funny

Single handily holds up UK's chem department. Like literally the only good chem professor. Try and get him for all classes he teaches/you need to take. Moves fast, but is manageable if you actually try.

DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS!!! I walked out of class knowing less then when I walked in. I never got above an 80 on a exam. He never curved the exams even though the higest grade was a 67. SO MuCH ALEX and PLaYPODITS

Probably the best CHE professor at Kentucky. Goes quickly over the material, but explains it well enough for you to learn it. Does a good job at teaching undergrad students especially since CHE is a hard course in general.

I took Dr.Presnall as my chem retake, and without a doubt, he's a great professor. He's a funny, wild guy, but taught his lectures and hw videos in a visual, descriptive, yet fun way to help his students better understand our material. He'd even do live demonstrations during lectures to give us real visuals. I'm 100% taking future courses with him!

Although I ended up switching my major due to me not being able to pass chemistry and biology courses, Presnell is a great guy. The material is hard, especially if you're not naturally a science person, but I don't believe that that was his fault. Chemistry sucks at UK, but Presnell at least made sure that the environment didn't feel hostile.
Dr. Presnell was great! He made chem somewhat easier.

Honestly the best teacher I have had throughout my whole entire academic career. Chemistry is hard but he makes it so easy and understandable. If you watch playposits and take thorough notes then do the achieves immediately after you should be ok on the exams and class material. 100% would take a class by steve over and over again!!
Explained the material well but talks a lot.

I mean chemistry is chemistry it is HELL. But he cracks jokes and tries to make the best of it. Def a better professor than the other dude. 100% take Presnell over the other man. Chemistry sucks no matter what but he is a good professor. Watch YouTube videos over it instead and you will pass. Organic Chemist YouTube is key! That is how I passed.

I really enjoyed having Dr. Presenell, and I would definitely recommend. Its a lot of work, but that's chemistry. He was very thorough and also understanding about the difficulty level of the material. He does move a little fast, but I liked that personally. Take notes on the playposits, and ask for help if you need, he is very nice!

SP is a king, I love him!!! Attendance is mandatory. His class time is him going over example problems from playposits (class videos due before class) from the day before, and then a worksheet for your group as well and he goes around to help. Very funny and nice guy, he always tries to help when he can. Exams are easy if you understand classwork.

Class is very test heavy, but that is the chem department. Dr. Presnell wants you to succeed, and truly cares about each of his students. He is super funny and engages well with his students. Attend his office hours!!!

The professor was amazing and ready to answer questions when needed. The material however is HARD and the exams are HARD. This is definitely not an easy class but if you go to the learning center or office hours steven and the TAs are eager to help you succeed. You also MUST go to lecture due to worksheets and iclickers as well as recitation.

Had Steve for Che 109. Very fun guy who likes to make jokes. His classes are very large but his office hours are always available and he is very willing to help. The lectures can be helpful but are usually only there for participation and a worksheet as long as you did the what was required out of class. Highly recommend.

Steve is so quirky and keeps the lecture entertaining.The tests are hard and all but that's up to the department not SP. USE THE BOOK!!! Study the past exams as they are almost the same. There will be a page called "Concepts to memorize", start memorizing the first week. Don't forget it's chemistry! It will be a challenge and most do drop out.Try!

literally my favorite teacher. made difficult concepts understandable, lectures were long but easy to pay attention to because he's entertaining, will crack jokes on purpose and on accident and they WILL be so funny. daily worksheets and iclickers as attendance. grades very much reflect the effort you put into it.
Good at explaining difficult concepts. Pretty funny so he kept lectures engaging, also very supportive and understanding about how tough the class was.

The content came very fast and it was hard to keep up. Also there are videos with questions about them due before each class and some of them are 45+ minutes, so make sure to allot extra time outside of class to do those. Then in class that is what the lecture will be about, so not much learning is done in class.

Steven himself is a good professor, but he doesn't make any of the decisions around our classwork or exams. The coursework is hard, but it's chemistry. He's always ready to help and does his best to be funny or explain things.

Dr. Presnell is a good professor. The lectures are fast, but as far as gen chem professors go he's probably the best you can ask for. The exams are rough, but they're made by the department, not him. He'll will at least tell you what you have to know and teach you enough to succeed, as long as you are willing to study for the tests.

Presnell went way too fast in lectures while also ALWAYS being behind other professors. He was still teaching us content the morning before an exam. CHE 105 is already a difficult weed-out course, and Presnell made it way more confusing. You will always be lost in lecture and need to teach yourself afterwards.

Steve is a pretty chill dude, he just wants you to do well. The CHE109 class is hard but hes there to help you. Hes super funny in class but he makes silly little mistakes sometimes. If you have to take a chemistry class I highly recommend this dude.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Lots of people complained about how fast he went during lectures, but powerpoints and your achieve book are available before class time. if you rely on only lecture time to learn, you will fail. i HIGHLY recommend using your achieve ebook before class it is a life saver. (i barely went to class- BAD idea) but still received a B due to achieve ebook

Dr. Presnell is a caring professor who definitely knows his stuff. He tends to rush through the material, though, and is somewhat negligent to explain concepts behind in-class problems. There were several cases in which I understood the math behind solving a word problem, but had no idea why I was actually solving it.

I struggled a lot in this class, both with the content and the way this teacher taught. It was clear he was very knowledgeable, but the way the lectures were set up was difficult to follow. He goes through the information very fast and does a lot of practice problems, but skips out on the concepts behind them. The lectures can get boring too.

Dr. Presnell is very smart and really knows his stuff. If you go to class and study the lectures and powerpoints you will pass. He tends to go very fast in his lectures, but as long as you stay engaged you can keep up.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you are looking for a Geography Class this isn't it. majority of the time she talks about race and didn't learn anything geography related. She rushes through her lectures and doesn't allow you to take pictures of her slide shows. She only has 6 assignment in the class total including exams and takes her weeks to grade things.

if you wanted a geo class this isn't it, she focuses on race about 90% and geo about 10% of the time in GEOGRAPHY CLASS. she wears a mask that is hard to hear and has a voice that isn't very clear. she also hates when taking pictures of her slides for some reason. The TAs are good and also don't really understand her.

She is introverted and not energetic, which makes her lectures so boring. If you want to learn about geographical terms and the history of many US cities, do not take this professor. This class is a racial justice class and all we learn about is racial discrimination in Atlanta. Recitations were also a joke, but the assignments were very easy.

Lectures for the GEO220 class were really boring and not at all what I expected from this class. There are only a few assignments graded during the semester. Being present for lecture is important because she sometimes gives out extra credit points for the people in attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class gets extremely boring, She goes off topic and doesn't have accessible slides for missed notes. Records lectures but deletes them the same day. I had an Tuesday/Thursday class at 8 am which I struggled to make often but still got a good grade thanks to the TA. If your not good at note taking then it will be hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class overall was not bad. The hole class during my time was graded out of like 50 points. So every point mattered. She offered a live video of the lecture every day to people who did not want to go in person. Attendance is not mandatory but the quiz questions come directly from the lecture slides. Lecture were boring tho so be ready.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, definitely recommend taking one or more of her classes if you’re a geography major or minor. This class in particular was very interesting and very easy, no exams and open note quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. McCutcheon is a very nice person. Her lectures would get very boring to me but that is because I needed this class for the UK core. However if you are passionate about Geography than you would probably like her. My first assignment was graded very harshly but I learned from that and improved. Overall very nice class and I actually learned a lot

Dr. McCutcheon is a great professor. The readings weren't difficult to understand and she gives great lectures. The reading assignments and midterm aren't hard if follow the readings throughout the semester.

It was M/W so attendance was not mandatory, except for the recitation on Friday. We had two big papers to turn in with strong guidelines, but if you followed them exactly you should be fine. There was a lot of reading and a quiz every week. Follow the instructions for everything closely and you'll get at least a B. The exams were pretty easy too.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The class had very few grades. I almost got a B in the class because the 3 assignments were graded harshly. The 2 exams were fairly easy with some studying. The class was in Memorial Hall and she was not very good with her microphone so you could only hear her if you were sitting in the first few rows. The lectures were pretty boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Prats doesn't care about the course content. He wasted all class rambling about Trump and COVID. He changed the syllabus in Nov. and yelled at the class when we were confused. Our grade was 100% exams - I've never had any course like this! Zero opportunity for in-class discussion. Worst prof I've had at UK; do not take under any circumstances.

Professor was very knowledgable of the material but every class was spent talking at us the entire time. There were no presentation to look at or input from students. If you want a discussion based class, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. Students thoughts and opinions on text were not incorporated into class time at all.

He is very knowledgeable and you can tell he is passionate about the topics. But he is very unprofessional when it comes to certain things. Every heard of "there are no stupid questions?" that does not apply with him, he will tear you down if you ask something for clarification. only graded on 3 exams, gets angry quickly, i trulyhated this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Prats fails to provide any grading criteria or even prompts for his classs final projects. He said all the details to the project were in the syllabus; however, the only details included in the syllabus were that it would be discussed in class, which was untrue. When questioned about this, he sent a very passive-aggressive email to the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is clearly extremely knowledgeable in his field, and he does a great job at connecting current and historical events, but his class was pretty frustrating to be in. He couldn't work canvas and he didn't allow any technology in his classroom- even to take notes. We had three exams in the class and that's all that counted toward our final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: ENG191 He has good intentions, but this class is horrible. He rambles for 1.25hrs about his opinion on Donald Trump/COVID (no relation to the content AT ALL). He's easily irritated/gets frustrated if you are confused. Doesn't make any of the assignments clear, but you can easily get an A if you show up. Bearable if you're in a gc w/ other students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: By far the best professor I've ever had at UK - he's so intelligent/knowledgable about so many things, and he genuinely cares about his students and how they're doing in school (which is more than can be said for most profs here). I've taken him for multiple classes, and will take classes just because he's teaching them. Do the reading/work!

As the semester went on he became irritable and angry with students, often over his own mistakes. He is not clear on what he expects in terms of assignments, and does not value his students time. More often than not he would run 5+ minutes over class time and get angry when students would need to leave. Overall, I would try to avoid him.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Prats is such a knowledge person with so many stories to tell. He keeps his classes very old school, so don't be late and respect his no technology policy. He speaks nearly the entirety of class so take notes. At first he may seem unapproachable or stern, but if you show up to class/participate he will know you care. A really good guy.
He truly cares about his students - you just need to put forth the effort.

I love Armando Prats. He is an intelligent man, BUT he grades terribly. Every paper that I have had was graded with like a 65-70% when I know they were good essays. Attendance is basically mandatory because it's a small class on Tuesday's and Thursdays. He doesn't make any assignments clear on what he wants and it messes everybody's grade up.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Prats is incredibly passionate about his students and what he teaches, but he is living proof that tenure should be questioned. He can do whatever he wants, and his lectures prove that. I have taken two classes with him and am so thankful I will never have to take another.  He is a dry, boring lecturer, and he is arrogant and gets angry easily.

Watch a film, take a quiz- repeat. Nothing more or less. Don't buy the book he planned on have quizzes from reading material but he gets too off topic. He spends too much Time talking politics, religion and racism. Overall nice guy and easy class. my best advice is don't take anything g he says to heart or. You'll end up offended. Take home exams2

Dr. Prats is a wonderful, brilliant man - his choice of films is excellent, his lectures are profound, and he's generally a laid-back, awesome guy. Class consisted of super easy MC quizzes, two papers, and a take-home final (a midterm was cancelled due to snow days) with pizza on turn-in day. Grades tough, but comments are very helpful. Great prof!

Dr Prats is an intelligent person, but it was difficult for me to learn from him and I often left class confused. His syllabus was not clear and he was annoyed when several people asked the same question about it as he felt he gave clear details. My grade consisted of attendance, take-home quizzes, a midterm and final (both take-home), and a paper.

I wish I could put into words what it means to learn from Dr. Prats. Some of the comments here are deplorable. If you think ill of Dr. Prats, you are fooling yourself. To learn and study under his genius is–and always will be–privileged fruit. If you find him challenging, you're not trying hard enough.

Prats is so passionate about what he does. His class is actually fun to just be there and listen to him talk about the material. He makes real world connections and wants  students to take something away from that. It's not often you find professors like that! Take his class if you can.
He is the most confusing and dry professor I have ever had. Dropped his class midsemester. When you ask a question he completely gets off topic.
Prats is a great instructor! We had a midterm, final, and a principal project, and that was it! I learned a lot.  I hope to take this man again.  He was so helpful!

Dr. Prats is a wonderful professor. He has been teaching for 38 years yet he is still passionate about the material. I encourage talking to him outside of class, he is very approachable and helpful. Participation is key. He appreciates students who work hard.
This class on Faulkner was great.  He is such a good teacher!

Dr. Prats is undoubtedly one of the most insightful men of his generation. If his students will open their minds to his unique methods and absorb his wealth of insight and knowledge, they will surely prosper. His personal story is by itself worthy of a biography. Few men will ever rise to his level of intellectual ability.

Another great class with Prats.  He is intelligent, kind, helpful, caring, and devoted--all the characteristics of a great professor!  You will learn more in one day with Prats than years with many other professors.
Wonderful professor who challenges students to actually think! Take any class with him you can! Also, meeting with him outside of class is extremely helpful. Easy to talk to.

I would have to say that the film courses I attended were my favorite classes at the University of Kentucky. I made the Dean's List the semester I took Mr. Prats' class. I made an A in his course. I found him very enthusiastic about cinema. I especially enjoyed his comment  about Lady Macbeth making an ideal junior executive's wife.

I had Pratts for several courses, covering both literature and film.  He is an incredible professor and man.  Many people who don't like him never took the opportunity to get to know him outside of class.  He is incredibly helpful, cares passionately about his students' success, and is ultimately honest.  If a teacher "made" me, it was him

Prof. Prats is honestly one of the best teachers/professors/instructors that I have ever, and likely will ever, had the privilege of listening to and talking with. His extensive and in-depth classes really opened my eyes to quite a bit of literature and accompanying analysis. A brilliant man, I will definitely take a course with him again.

He is truly the best English professor I've ever had. He's challenging, but he's brilliant and it made me care a lot more about my work in general because he was tough. He comes across harsh, but he's probably one of the nicest professors I've ever had outside of class.
Prof. Prats doesn't get the reviews he deserves on this website.  He was really nice and very helpful.  I have learned more from this man than any other teacher.  Great class.

When the class first began I thought that I really wouldn't like him, but after I went to his ofice hours to talk to him about a paper, I found him to be a very sweet and helpful person. I though  he was a tough grader but that only made me work harder and I think I am better for it now. Give hime a chance.

Anyone who has had a problem with Dr. Prats simply could not handle the fact that he will challenge you, and thank God for that. He cares deeply for his students and that is why he is tough. I was not an English or Film student but did well in his electives because I responded to his challenges and put in over 100%. He has greatly impacted my life

Ah, what can I say. I'd seen most of the movies, but it was good to get his perspective. I also love debating and he was usually up for that too. I dig his take on Westerns and the apocalypse. Interesting class.
I LOVED this guy!  He has such a zeal for what he is doing and the books we discussed.  That is rare.  It's one of those classes that is hard but you don't mind it!  I highly recommend!

Dr. Prats is one of the most inspiring and intelligent teachers I have had at UK.  He is a teacher you don't want to disappoint.  He was very encouraging and was not that hard of a grader, although, he did make us take a quiz every now and then and they were very hard.  If you are lucky enough to take him as a teacher, do not pass up the chance!!!!
Most arrogant and opiniated teacher i've encountered.  Managed to insult students in every class-- wow, quite an achievement.

Dr.Prats was a tough grader, but he warned us in the syllabus.  There was a lot of writing involved that was all concentrated towards the end of the semester.  Prats seemed to view the students who dominated class discussions as not necessarily the brightest among his students, and drew this information from quiz grades and grades on papers/exams.

The only professor I have ever had who places so much importance on class participation and yet insults the opinions of his students on a regular basis.  That's what I call positive reinforcement!  There's only non-punishment from Prats: he never compliments anything, only fails to criticize, which makes success very difficult in his course.

Come on, guys!  This is ARMANDO PRATS!  Sure, I had his film class a long time ago, but it tattooed my brain.  Prats is not easy.  Prats will find you in class with his dark eyes and demand something from you.  But he breaks you or makes you.  I emerged from that class with an ability to enjoy and understand films that still baffles me. Profound.

I had an extremly tough time with this class.  He pretty told me my work was superficial.  I had a hard time understanding exactly what he wanted out of the written work; he often gave vague and ambiguous writing prompts, and then got upset when we didn't give him what he was looking for.  I enjoy film, but this class was ridiculous.

Prats is a tough nut to crack: he gives uninsightful, tough grades, makes flying "theme" leaps that no one else can agree with or understand, and enjoys talking down to students who aren't as knowledgeable as he is.  He knows a lot about film, but he's a real jerk who doesn't feel any attachment to his students at all.

MY FAVORITE TEACHER EVER!!!! He makes the stories come alive, even if they were written thousands of years ago. He is also very interested in students lives and well-being. You are allowed and often required to give opinions. There is some work, but always in small doses. If you get a chance, take his class, you won't regret it!

I loved Professor Yip. I felt her lecture notes sometimes didn't relate to what you will see on the tests, but study the old practice exams and you'll be okay. She was always very helpful in office hours (use them!) and was willing to help any students who didn't understand. Overall, if you can take her, do it!
Her lectures and notes were so good and so organized. She is also very kind and intelligent, and great to speak to in office hours. Made this awful math class so much better.

I am one of the few who were not a fan of Yip. She gives long, detailed guided notes for her lectures, but most of the information is proofs, random paragraphs, and physics problems that won't appear on tests, leaving you with 50 pages of guided notes and no idea what to study for exams. Professor Leonard on YouTube got me a 97 in Calc 3.

Yip is great at explaining things, she just doesn't have time to explain everything. She sometimes spends too much time on smaller things, and then doesn't have time to do or explain more difficult problems as thoroughly, which comes back to bite you in the homework and recitation problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Phenomenally well-structured lectures with intuitive, accessible explanations for many concepts. Dr. Yip's TA choices, an overlooked trait of many professors, were great. Previous exams and homework are available throughout the entire course.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I like how she put the motivation and application problem for each concepts which is great.

Yip was extremely kind and helped me feel better about going to talk about my grade in office hours. She is understanding and wants the best for her students. Her lecture notes are a little wordy, but I am thankful for them.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Calc 3 is HARD. But she does her best to make it easy, she gives good notes, and responds to e-mails quickly. She's considered one of the best MA213 professors and without her, this class would have been harder than it was. Only thing I'd change would be sometimes she moves incredibly fast, but that's expected due to the sheer amount of content.
Outside of being a very good teacher with lecture notes that are outstanding, she is a very good person that wants everyone to succeed

Dr. Yip is incredibly kind and helpful. I had a super rough semester and was struggling a lot with my workload but she was always accessible outside of class for help and even let me make up some grades. Amazing guided notes provided for every lecture, and videos for every lecture as well. Definitely the best calc 3 professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's nice and has zero accent, which to be fair is about as much as you can ask for in this department. 99% of people think shes awesome but I'm that 1%, her lectures were very quick and hard to follow, my TA unsuccessfully tried to carry me. She's widely considered the best calc 3 prof but not for everyone I guess.
Easily the best professor I've had

Gives guided notes for each lecture that are very well set up. Homework isnt too bad since she explains concepts so well. Grade is almost 70 percent based on exams but its not bad since the exams are just like homework and past exams. Take her if you can

Does a great job explaining concepts, and test material is fair. Homeworks arent ridiculous. She answers every question clearly and without judgement, and makes sure you understand before moving on. Not sure its possible to teach this class better than she.
Dr. Yip's lectures and notes are so insanely helpful that this class felt like a cakewalk. on top of that she is simply a great person and always has time for her students.

Had AMAZING pre-made notes and guided the class through topics very deftly. Clearly put a lot of preparation into each lecture. Lots of homework but it didn't take too long to do since she's really good at explaining topics.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great lectures with provided notes to follow along. Lectures cover enough info to complete almost all of the homework, but you will have to look up some info yourself. Exams very similar (some problems are copied verbatim) to the provided archive of old exams. Easy to understand and accessible outside of class, I would recommend Dr. Yip to anyone!
Amazing Lectures. Would totally recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Yip is a goddess. Seriously, if you're taking upper-level calc, plan your schedule around her sections. She allowed a double-sided 8x11 cheat sheet for every exam, was an excellent lecturer and was great at answering questions. She cares about you and how you do in this course.

Dr. Yip has changed the way I view Calculus as a subject. This is a professor who cares about her students and works hard to make material as easy and understandable as possible. If she taught every class I have to take for my degree from here on out, I would gladly register for them all.

Professor Yip is an amazing Calc teacher. She makes calculus as easy as it possible can. She has great lecture notes and provides lots of extra materials to help her students. She genuinely cares about her students' success.

Dr. Yip is a great calc professortake her class if you get a chance! Her notes are immaculate, with everything outlined on canvas before class so you can just follow along in lecture and fill in the examples. She also is great at answering questions and explaining her work more.
Fantastic teacher! Provided excellent notes for each lecture. They were so helpful in studying. Even through zoom, she promoted asking for help when needed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Angel sent from Heaven. Has godly notes and lectures are really helpful. You have attendance credit but regardless, her lectures are worth the time. She's really nice and cares about your grade. Go to office hours and she will help you a lot.

I took her for Calc 2 and again Calc 3 because I liked her teaching style so much. She has outlined notes already made that you fill in. She usually defines the topic, then works some example problems. She is very clear with everything she does. With the online, she doesn't record her lectures, you have to watch them live.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: In my opinion, she is one of the best professors at UK. Her notes are amazing and the worksheets we did reflected test material. She continued lectures when the class went online. Linear algebra isnt easy, but she made the experience as enjoyable as possible. Do the worksheets and webwork and understand the theorems and you can make an A.

Martha makes the best notes of any teacher I've ever seen and it's not even close. She posts them on Canvas before lecture and you can fill in examples on the notes as she teaches. She is very clear and dilligent about explaining problems and concepts in detail during lecture. She takes her time with each concept and makes them easy to follow.
Fantastic professor. Easy to understand the difficult concepts of calculus 2. I wish she taught physics as well so I could understand that. Definitely worth taking an 8am. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Gives good feedback--Respected

reviews.comment: Calc 2 is hard but Yip makes it a little bit easier. She gives all her students this huge notes document with all the formulas and important information so all we have to do is fill in the examples which helps a ton. She works out all the steps and is open to any question. Im so glad I took her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Respected--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. Has the best notes I've ever seen in a calculus class.

Dr. Yip is an incredible professor, and teaches the content clearly and thoroughly. She uploads lecture notes onto Canvas, and takes attendance through iClicker. Homework is hard, but she makes a difficult class as clear and understandable as possible. She is kind and obviously cares about her students' success. Exams are 70% of grade, 4 total.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Yip is a great teacher, and I would recommend that anyone takes her classes. Her classes may be difficult, but she makes them as easy as she can.
Shes a very good young teacher who explains what you need to know.  Take her if you can.  She gives out practice problem sheets that help a ton with the tests.

Dr. Yip is a great professor. She types her notes and posts them online before class. After class, she will post the solution, with work, on how a certain problem was done in class. Dr. Yip has your best interest at heart and is easy to approach and ask questions. I would take another class taught by her and would recommend her classes.

Martha is a heck of a woman. She made lecture notes that were straight from heaven and that all other students envied. Great in office hours and very personable. Hated the subject but really enjoyed her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great Class

Lecture attendance was mandatory, but lectures were extremely helpful and worth attending. Dr. Yip explained concepts clearly and if you went to lecture and did the assigned homework, you were extremely well prepared for tests. She was also very helpful if you went to office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She has great notes. Calculus 3 is not an easy class, but she will make as easy as it can be. She can easily be reached during her office hours.

Mrs. Yip is very good at responding to questions. She cares about her students and wants us to succeed. She has very good knowledge about this course and i would recommend her to anyone who is planning on taking calculus 3.
Professor Yip does an excellent job of making the material accessible and understandable, and of explaining why without complicating the question.

She works through the examples with you in class and very open to questions during lecture. If there is a question she takes the time to try and understand what the student is asking before answering. She is available outside of class. The only downside is the exams are 80% of the final grade so be sure to study. Definite recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is the best professor you can have. Absolutely take her no matter what

Dr. Yip is a fantastic calculus professor. She goes quickly, so keeping up with notes can be difficult, but she posts the outlines ahead of time, so if you print those and fill them out as she goes, it's much easier. After lecture she also posts the filled in notes online. Tests are tough, but that's the nature of the class. I would recommend her.

Dr. Yip is a very good professor. She is very helpful at her office hours and will treat you kindly. She teaches fairly fast, but puts her notes online so all you have to do is fill them in. The only thing I didn't like is that she leaves out algebra steps in her examples if she thinks it is easy. I would definitely recommend her.

Dr. Yip was only a sub for my consistently terrible teacher, but she was absolutely great. Her lectures were perfect bc she went at a great pace, kept asking if there were any questions, and best of all, her notes were perfectly planned out a full week before the lecture date and were available online. My class literally gave her a standing O

Dr. Pucci is extremely intelligent as well as extremely rude and uncaring. She discourages participation through constant snarky comments and non-constructive criticism, and shows no personal interest in her students well-being. She has a reputation for being the worst professor in the department and having now taken a class with her, I agree.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Be prepared to work harder in her class than any other French prof at UK. Tough but fair. I also suggest meeting her at least once out of class. She can be intimidating during lecture, but a meeting 1 on 1 will show you she is very caring of her students and willing to help. If you do the work, you will learn so much from her.

She can seldom think of the word she wants in English. You will find yourself with notes that are 25% Italian, 25% French, and 100% confusing.  If she feels you did not read she will go out of her way to embarrass you in class; will make you stumble over words repeatedly too. Several ppl in my class went to her office to cry. Her critique is cruel

Least favorite class I've taken at U.K. I'll give Dr. Pucci credit for knowledge of the subject matter, but she is far too unorganized to be so harsh towards students for minute mistakes. Many of my classmates (and I) have been discouraged from talking in class because of how she will make you seem stupid. Inconsistent in grading. DO NOT TAKE.

The biggest disappointment I've had so far with a class. I would never recommend Pucci to anyone. She is very unclear and very inconsistent. The class would be more bearable if it weren't in french the entire time, but still I suggest you avoid taking her at all costs.
Very inconsistent and unclear about what she wants in class. Never follows the syllabus and randomly assigns papers/presentations that she forgets assigning. Don't take her class, you'll regret it.
She has high standards. I think everyone should raise their standards and then students will know how to meet them.
She is very unclear, and very inconsitent in her grading. She grades EVERYTHING very harshly, and conducts class in the most boring way possible. NO ONE in my class likes her or her class.
This prof expects too much out of her students and grades very hard.

Dr. Pucci expects a lot out of her students and as long as you give it to her then she will love you.  Difficult class but I think it will help me in future classes.  She made me become a better writer.  I enjoyed the class.

Daniel is awesome. Super helpful and just a cool guy. He knows his french and has a ton of really cool stories. I thought he was a great Fr-101 professor and would recommend him to others for their first interaction with French.
He's awesome!
Dan is very helpful, fun, and makes class interesting. I highly recommend his class.

Projects are crazy long and require a lot of work. Stephanie is nice but isn't always clear with assignments. Several times we had no idea what was due and when. A couple times she posted assignments online without announcing it so people had no idea it was even on there or that they had to do it.

Professor Quinlan is very cool.  She is modern and liberal in her thinking, and it transfers into her teaching.  She is tough on her initial grading.  I received approximately 80%s on my two major essays which make up a large portion of the grade.  I went to her office hours and edited what she told me and ended up with 100% on both. Recommended!
She's really nice and helps you whenever you need it. Also is awesome because she gives you extensions on assignments. Very great teacher recommend for both CIS credits you have to take!
She is one of the best teachers I have ever had. If you do the work then you will get a good grade.

This is a higher level communications course so I can understand why it is difficult. I am not a very good writer or speaker so this class was difficult for me. You have to give about four speaches and a couple of big essays. Be ready to work hard and you will do good. A very time consuming class.

Professor Quinlan has been an outstanding professor thus far. The class is somewhat challenging but she makes the information easy to understand. If you want to take a CIS class make sure it's with her!

absolutely love this woman! the most lenient and understanding professor I've had at my 4 years of college. class is interesting and you actually learn valuable material. everyone should take this class. students ALWAYS come first. i wish i could take this class again!
The best teacher ever! She rarely kept us for more than 30 mins. Very entertaining class and doesn't really care that much about anything! If I could take her for every english class I would!
Stephanie is awesome!!
very caring professor
man , i love this prof, him and phelan best ones to ever come to uk and best uk will EVER have because since they left the sociology department went to hell.  I love him!!!
No Comments
Very interesting and creative!!
Fantastic teacher. Very engaging and well informed.
Wonderful teacher, very clear about what he expects out of his students, what will be on tests, etc. Learned a lot.
Awesome professor that me or anyone else has ever had!  I had Neil in the '70's when he taught at Clemson, he was such a fox then.  Now, I'm back on the scene.
this guy is a great teacher
Simple tests.  Very clear about what will be on them.
No Comments
No Comments

She made it very clear it was NOT her first time teaching. She's very rude and stressed the importance of not using AI cause she "knows all the tricks." She would teach terms in class then use different terms on tests. She was very lecture heavy and was very disorganized! I dreaded her class because it was long and she speaks very monotone!

You can tell Mia is a new professor. The lectures are hard to follow and understand. She words the questions on the exams very confusing and not similar to what she teaches in class. You have to be able to apply every term you learn in different ways. She also gives you about 150 terms to memorize for each exam.

She has a zero grade policy on late work, but makes her assignments due at 5pm. She acts like students emailing her is an inconvenience and barely responds to said emails. She gives little to no clarification and you have to rush through her notes. Her test preparation is memorizing 100+ terms, so you aren't prepared. I would avoid her class.

I believe she knows what she's talking about for sure, but it just doesn't feel organized(presentation wise). This class always stressed me out only because I felt I couldn't take good notes in time before she'd switch a slide or zoom in on a model. But she is very easy to work with and does respond to emails. But you will definitely hear about it

She makes you feel stupid when you ask a question. Her exams are a joke, especially if you are a psych major. The fact that BIO isn't a prereq for this is wild. She explains things well but it's not what is on the exam. Her terms-to-know sheets for exams are 100+ terms long when the exams are 30-40 questions so you never really know what to study.
She is very full of herself and rude. She acts like you're supposed to already know the material.

Don't bother emailing her with any questions, she'll either respond extremely passive aggressive or won't respond at all. She'll come in the next class day and start off the lecture complaining about students emailing her. Grading system is weird as well, constantly messes up and when students email her about their literal grades(???) she complains

Avoid if you can. Makes a 100 level Psychology class way more difficult than it should be. Proctored quizzes every week, and will not work with you if you have any kind of stuff going on outside of school.
Don't take this class with this professor you will not pass

This professor did not care about her students success. Instead of helping students with simple questions she will wait and leave us confused if no one answers stuff we do not know the answers to. Would constantly show up in a bad mood and all we did was listen to her talk for an hour and a half and it was nearly impossible to retain anything.

If the average score of an entire class never even reaches 80% in a 100 level gen ed class no less, the problem is not with the student but the teaching. If you care about your GPA any other professor will make this more attainable to mantain. It is possible to fail out within the third week with her class structure while completing most activities
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I actually had her as my PSY 216 lab TA, but that wasn't an option on this. She is very sweet and tries to explain the lab homework the best she can, and makes it as easy as she can for a somewhat difficult class. She always let us out early and even surprised us with no homework the last week of class, and made homemade treats for the last class.
She did not specify what quizzes/exams would be over. She was very communicative via email and accessible outside of class. Exams were unnecessarily hard. Extra credit opportunities.
She made it way harder than it had to be. She doesn't put what any material any test or quiz is covering. Study guides don't help. Avoid at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Most Antisemitic human I've ever been in contact with!

Professor Woodcock is an incredible professor that cares deeply about his students. I did very well in his class because I showed up to (not mandatory) lectures and participated. I did not do any of the readings, but asked questions when I was confused and Professor Woodcock did an incredible job in making sure I understood.
Get ready to read... And by READ, I mean upward of 100 pages per week. You learn a lot, but the exams are mind-bendingly HARD. Very hard. You learn, but by the end of the semester you are exhausted.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: His tests are utterly unreasonable. They do not reflect what students know. He writes the most bizarre and abstract multiple choice tests that have 6-7 moving parts and variables. His questions are almost always unclear - he hides the ball and confuses at all times.
Great professor, very hilarious and quirky. He makes it so you can succeed with materials he provides so long as you do the work. Taught me how to think about law as a whole.

I don't understand the bad reviews. Professor Reuning is an incredibly kind person. Yes, the lectures are long and almost always take up the entire class, but they are very interesting. The entirety of the exams are laid out very clear so as long as you study for an hour or two, you will be fine. I personally don't mind this class at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I enjoyed Beecher's class. The tests are tough but if you actually do the notes, you'll do fine. attendance is really important but they're pretty chill about if you need to miss. They're very passionate which makes the class enjoyable and easy to engage.

They make attendance mandatory and the way they grade our exams is so stupid. If you don't say exactly what they want you to say or you meet the sentence minimum and stay on topic they still mark like 6-8 points off and don't explain why. I would NOT take this class again and listen to the other reviews because they are 100% correct.
absolutely not. WILL NEVER take any of their classes again. i can't express this enough - DO NOT TAKE THEIR CLASS
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: MAS 101 was my favorite class! Grades in the class were balanced nicely with small assignments and tests. If you show up to class and pay attention to the lectures then you will get a good grade. The material was very engaging and Beecher was a very fair and kind professor.

The attendance is the worst of it all. Attendance code will tank your grade. In the exams, some of the questions will literally be about a random fact she says in a lecture that nobody will remember cause why would they think it's important. I will say she is accommodating but the attendance is so useless and veryyy lecture heavy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Ummm literally should be such an easy A, yet somehow you get marked off for every little detail on the exams. Such a harsh grader, also attendance is so annoying, it is a code released at the end of class when your trying to leave. Also very annoying pop group discussions that if you miss one will absolute tank your grade. If you take this show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Beecher is a great professor, I had him for MAS101, and now I'm taking MAS304. I saw some bad reviews on them and immedietly had to make an account. Very kind and understandable.

Genuinely cannot stand this class. She does. not. stop. talking. and its very hard to pay attention when she keeps talking about her own experiences and her own life outside of school. When registering for this class I was under the impression that we would be focusing on social media and journalism... We spent 2 months learning about video games.
Attendance is the most annoying thing, she sets a code to unlock an attendance quiz at the very end of class as everyone has to leave. #cantstandher
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took a creative writing workshop with Professor Ritter. Though he is a little hard to access outside of class, it's only because he is so busy, and you can tell he truly cares. He made an effort to get to know every student and was very kind and approachable. He takes his job seriously, but if you do your work, you'll be fine! Take his classes!

Loved Prof. Ritter. I took his ENG 130 class in the fall. He actually cared about his students. I said textbooks required because we had to buy a few books to review during the class, but no actual textbook. Would 100% take again.

Professor Ritter is such a great professor, super down to earth and so caring. Always genuinely cares for each of his students. Class is super fun, no textbook needed. If you get the chance to take his class 100% do it, you will not regret it! One of the nicest professors I have had who actually loves his job!
Mr. Ritter is an awesome professor- some of the group projects were not great, but fun material in class made this a WRD class worth taking. Show up and do your work and you'll get an A!

This review is actually for his APP200 class. Nice guy. Lectures are required but very boring, basically just teaches by slideshows the whole semester. Grades way too harshly for a core class. lots of reading and grades his never ending discussion posts like an essay. Overall the class is very boring, he grades harshly, but is a nice guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Dane Ritter is boring and incredibly pretentious, which makes him the perfect candidate for teaching Appalachian studies.

Dont take this class, take another elective, trust me.
Professor Ritter was a good prof and the class was fairly easy. Gave good feedback!

He was an amazing professor and I rarely found my self not wanting to go to his class. He's a super genuine person and if you show up, speak up and put your self out there you will have no problem with his class.

WRD111 was fairly simple with professor Ritter, although they were never open to any sort of negotiation, or understanding. If you’re going through a hard time, don’t expect him to hear you out or even attempt to reason. If you miss just a few classes, he will force you to drop the course and will give you no warning. His lectures were useless.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Awesome professor. Genuinely a good guy. If you show up to class and complete the few assignments throughout the semester, you will get an A.

Prof. Ritter is an awesome teacher. He cares for all of his students, and is always willing to help. If you try your best, you will make an A. Some of the assignments are a little difficult, so give yourself time to do them and you will succeed. Don't procrastinate, ask for help.
Prof Ritter made the class so much fun to attend. He actually cares about his students. Attendance is required
Awesome teacher. Wish attendance wasnt required because the class was a waste of time, but hes really cool.
One of the best professors I've taken so far. Prof. Ritter is super fun and so relaxed.
He's one of the best teachers at UK. You will learn a lot and not have to be stressed about work load or grades.
