Amazing teacher who actually cares for their students!!! I learned a lot in this class and highly recommend it!

She is a nice professor, and seems to love what she does, but the class itself is horribly boring. Another thing to be aware of is here exams are half multiple choice, half true/false. The true/false questions are a nightmare.

This is more of a law class than a management class. She does a good job explaining topics in her lectures even though they can seem to drag on. Exams are online and proctored. She does offer a 10 point extra credit assignment. Study the lectures for the exams and go over the outlines and you'll be fine.

She is passionate, puts a lot of effort into her lecture videos, and they have a lot of valuable information for exams. The exams though will try and get you because when I took them 35% of the questions were true and false they can be tricky but the questions are worded at least simplistically. There was one extra credit assignment for 10 points!

Professor Davis is awesome. Very knowledgeable about each topic in the class. Exams are online and proctored. Even though it is a law management course it is still very interesting material to learn. Her lectures are very good, and she does a great job of explaining each topic. Overall, she is a great professor and would definitely take her again.

Super easy class, professor is super nice. All of the exams are online (not lockdown browser), super easy A as long as you do your homework. Attendance is taken almost everytime and worth a good amount.

Professor Davis is one of the best professors I've had. Shes extremely kind and genuine and incredibly knowledgeable, she is an experienced attorney. BTW this is a law class, not really a management class. Her lectures were extremely organized and she is very good at explaining concepts and answering questions.

I love Dr Davis! She is so funny and welcoming. She does not take attendance but doesn't post the notes online because she writes them on the board. There aren't many assignments, and the exams aren't too hard but not super easy. I recommend her so, and I loved every minute of this class.

Professor Davis is a chill professor, but her lectures are extremely boring and take twice as long as they should. HWs did not always follow the text or what we covered in lecture. Exams were 67% of the grades. All in all, fine professor but this class is a boring waste of time and one of the harder Gatton requirements. Take it online if you can.
Professor Davis is a great professor. There is little homework so majority of grade is exams on canvas. She brought our evening class snacks often!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor. Has amazing lectures that really contribute to course content. The only difficult thing we're sometimes exams would have applications that were somewhat vague. She engages the class and teaches material very clearly!
Easy class however, lectures tend to be slightly boring because there are no slides to go with them. I still overall enjoyed the class!
Great teacher, easy class, 100% would recommend
No lock-down browser or webcam for exams, you can cheat too easily on her exams. It's a shame because it is important material and she prepares her students well for the exams.

This course was taught asynchronous so there was no interaction with Professor Davis. With that being said, the class was very easy. Davis provides an outline that really helps with lectures. Overall, a solid choice for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was really easy and follows the same pattern as her MGT 340 class. If you show up, take notes, and write down specifics for each topic, you'll get an A in the class when it is exam time. She is also very wholesome and nice, and will genuinely take time to explain things to you if you don't understand them.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: My final grade was 88%, but she gave me A, I love her.

I took this class over the summer online and Mrs. Davis SUCKED at responding to emails. I would email her and she would not respond to questions I had regarding lecture material and exam material questions. The lectures are boring and you're likely to do better by reading and taking notes from the textbook. She recites the textbook anyways.

I took A lot if information on from the lecture session but I would advised not to take this course over the summer because she make it achievable to pass the class but limited time to take the exam like 45mins to do 52 question. Worst class have ever taken online that why i like in class exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Lecture was only useful for the notes and the surprise pop quizzes in my experience. Lectures were pretty boring, but Davis is overall a good professor and offers extra credit which I enjoyed doing. I never visited office hours, but never had a bad experience with her!
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Super long lectures that can get pretty boring. She seems a little uncomfortable when she's teaching which can also cause you to lose focus. Gives out quizzes at the end of class so if you took good notes, you'll be fine. Exams are a little tough. Once classes shifted online, she pretty much stopped teaching all together which made the class harder

Youre tested strictly off the notes you take in class. Easy to get 100% on every homework. Offers extra credit report for attending court. Highly suggest doing it especially if you dont test well. Exams are 50 questions plus 2 extra credit. Easy if you take good notes. Dont skip class unless you know someone who takes perfect notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had Professor Davis for both MGT 340 and MGT 341 and liked her for both. If anything, MGT 341 is easier than 340. The main difference between the two classes is that 341 has a paper that you have to write over a movie you watch during class. Also, the exams have short answer questions, which you don't have in 340. Dismisses students early.

I liked Professor Davis a lot. She actually practices law so she is very good at teaching this topic in an informational and practical manner. The homework comes from the textbook but she only tests you on what is in her lectures, so I would highly recommend going to class, though it is optional. She occasionally gives pop quizzes during class.

I loved her. Her exams are 100% from the lectures (she doesn't have power points or anything) so you have to go to class to get the notes. The exams are pretty straight forward if you study but some questions are difficult. You can easily get 100's on all the homework and she offers extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Becky is amazing!! :) Very friendly and she even gave me a few pointers on how to study for the tests! :) She recommends using flashcards - especially if it's based over class notes. She is wonderful, you won't regret it & I enjoyed having an insight into law
Becky is awesome. She's really funny and caring, and she makes lectures interesting. I think the class was really easy, and I enjoyed her teaching.

The true/false on the tests can be kinda tricky, but if you do the extra credit assignments, you should be feeling absolutely zero stress come finals week. Easy to get an A, yet still an engaging class. I feel like I've learned a lot, and Becky is the one of the sweetest and funniest professors I've had!
Rebecca was a great professor. She is very nice and cares about students. She gives enough extra credits just for students to experience real court.
She's a good teacher. Very clear about exam material. If you come to class and actually study you will get a good grade. She offers extra credit and there aren't any group projects.

i like to compare her class to holbein's 301 class, except she's very friendly professor unlike Holbein's perceived arrogance.  Show up to class, take good notes, and you should do well. I believe lectures are long because she often goes on her soapbox and you can't discern which is test material or not. I'm not super into law so lectures felt long

so sweet and nice! really knows what she is teaching, very clear with what she expects from you and on the tests. easy A if you study and go to class,  even though she doesn't take attendance. No pop quizzes but occasional in class activities.
She is alright. Its easy to get an A, just a lot of memorization for the tests. She is just not a great teacher, she could have done a lot better for the class

Professor Davis is great. Shes kind and clear. I enjoyed her lectures and she made this class very manageable. This class could've been extremely boring but she made  just fine. She gives extra credit - so go to class, take good notes and study them thoroughly. If you do those things - you should do just fine.

She was such a good professor. Her lectures are short and to the point regarding exactly whats on the exam. She doesn't take attendance but taking notes over her lectures are essential for getting a good grade. She is really sweet and helpful, I would definitely take another course if she offered it.

She is an amazing professor. Was straight forward in what she expected from us as students and didn't have any surprises on the exam. Homework was easy and most of the exam was word for word what she says in class. If you watch any law shows, she definitely give insight on what is going on

I was really interested in her material, but I can see how it can be boring. With that being said just stick with it, its important information and she is an easy and sweet teacher to take the class with. She is a lawyer so she is very knowledgeable. Only con, takes her forever to grade things

Becky Davis is a lawyer. MGT 340 was about business law and ethics. Davis is pretty clear in her instructions. She knows her stuff. She writes outlined notes in class as she goes along. Those help with not wasting time reading chapters completely. Her classes aren't exactly entertaining and she jumps right into the lecture after a quick greeting.

Lectures can be long, but you can tell she enjoys what she does and tries to make it fun. Exams are word-for-word from the notes. A few easy pop quizzes randomly during class can catch you if you don't go often. Online homework is really easy. Ask her any questions you have and study your notes and you're set.

Becky is a great professor! Lectures can be long, but she tries to make them interesting. Attendance is optional but she has 5 Pop Quizzes throughout the semester (half of  a test grade). Exams come from the notes and are straightforward. Great professor and really cares about students!

Becky was one of my favorite professors in my college career.  She always made sure questions were answered, and gave very simplified tests.  You will need to come to class to take extensive notes, but she will base her exams entirely off the notes and anecdotal stories/examples she gives to the class.  GREAT PROFESSOR!!!

Great teacher. One of my favorite classes this semester. I don't know what it is but she makes what could be a really boring class pretty interesting. Tests are pretty easy - memorizing 40 flash cards the day before the test got me a 96 on the second exam. Her exams are the notes from class, a book isn't necessary.

Good professor, very tentative. Explains things pretty well, very accommodating and wants you  to do well. Class was pretty boring but she made it more interesting and easy. Typically has ~20 True/False questions.
Class is completely based on lecture notes. Material is really easy and has a real world application. Material is interesting and Davis does a great job of explaining everything. Tests aren't bad.

Attendance isnt mandatory, but you need to go to get the notes.test are simple. make note cards and you should at least get a B. There are random quizzes but she gives you hints so they are easy. I would recommend taking her.
Take her! Tests can be kind of tricky, but lecture is very entertaining. Easy A if you put some effort into studying.
I really liked her class. Tests are simple if you study your class notes for an hour or two before hand. Course material is pretty much common sense. I never used my text book.

Class is easy but a little boring. If you dont get an A in this class you should drop out of the business college. Some kids complained about the tests being hard. The most I studied was an hour and a half before the exam and lowest score was 94. This class is ridiculously easy. TAKE HER!

Tests are ridiculous true/false questions that do not reflect your knowledge of the subject material. She is a very unorganized teacher and makes mistakes on your putting your grades into blackboard frequently so always be sure to double check with her if something looks wrong. This class was  boring, but not hard.
good teacher. boring at times. dont need the book and can get all useful notes just by showing up to class. i thought exams were easy if you studied the night before. i got an a
She's very nice and tries to be helpful in terms of preparing for exams. Learn the notes and you should get an A. She also talks about her pet pig a lot.
Extremely easy. dont' need textbook. Everyone has electronic copy of all the notes. She just started having random quizzes to encourage attendance. Extremely boring but she is very nice

This is the easiest class i've ever had in college. She tells you not to buy the textbook so dont waist your money. The notes are at KYlecturenotes.com and 30 minutes of studying will get you and A. If you dont get an A in this class you need to rethink college.
Great teacher, easy class, and interesting topic. There are 4 exams, 1 easy paper (1-2 pgs), and an extra credit oppurtunity.
Great teacher... provides easy to take notes on the board and lets you know what you really need to study and understand.  Go to class and you can pull an A... no need for the book, just take notes.
She is great. Very easy and the material on the tests are not surprising. If you go to class, take notes, and study those notes you'll have a definite A.

This class is ridiculously easy. The tests include middle school-level matching and fill-in-the-blank. All notes are word-for-word off an outline she puts on the board at the start of class. Textbook is expensive and 100% unnecessary.

Multiple times she didn't show up to office hours I had emailed her about. Would message the entire class on canvas in response to my attempts to talk about my grades. Had to write a rough draft or essay every week by the end of the semester— don't bother looking for a clear rubric or outline. Harsh grader. By far the worst class I have ever taken.
WRD222. Not the smartest person, so I didn't learn much from them. Super easy class, though.

wrd 418 legal writing. dr. rice is super accommodating and understanding. she allows for corrections if most of the class struggled on the assignment. fair and easy grader. there is a textbook, and it is helpful, but you can prob get away with not using it. not strict about attendance but i recommend going to class

Incredibly easy class with a nice professor who cares about the subject and lets students choose what they want to talk about for projects (as well as their own mediums to do so in). Don't expect to be terribly interested or challenged, this is still a 100-level class. Nice to knock out a core requirement.

I added hilarious because it was hilarious to me how much of a dunderhead she was, if you know what I mean. She was a very... simple person, shall I say. And that's ok! It doesn't take an Oppenheimer to pass this class. If you are like me however and are looking to learn something other than the alphabet, I'd stay away from this one.

I really don't want to be rude, but she is just not an intelligent person. Her ability to think, or lack there of, was stunning to me. I don't understand how someone like this can get a job anywhere, let alone in education. I wouldn't let her teach pre-school.

To top it all of, she believes Epstein hung himself! How is that even possible?

Dr. Rice is the sweetest professor! She truly cares about her students and their wellbeing. Her class on conspiracy theories is actually very interesting and not too much work. We had weekly discussion boards and a final video project which involved a proposal, research, storyboarding and video edit. Easy A class, would recommend this as a core.

Dr. Rice is super laid back and I enjoyed her class. There was a lot of room for creativity. Didn't have a ton of readings so when there are some make sure you do them. She doesn't expect too much of you, so really you get out of it what you put into it.

Dr. Rice is an incredibly neat person, but her teaching isn't the best. She wasn't always clear in her lectures, and we spent so much of the semester discussing the same topic, but all we ever did was talk in circles. It was maddening. But the class was easy, and the assignments were actually pretty fun. (And she's an easy grader.)
Very down to Earth, she was easy to talk to and work with.

Dr. Rhodes  has a passion for Special Education and you can tell that through her teaching. She is very knowledgeable about teaching communication and she's always willing to help you. She makes the content easy to understand. I really liked her class!

She is a really boring lecturer.  The content is easy and the tests are easy as long as you study the study guides. But be prepared to fall asleep, the class is long and its hard to pay attention. Attendance isn't really mandatory (the notes are online) but she gives out exit slips one random days so you don't know when you'll miss one.
Dr. Rhodes means well, but the class is pretty boring. She does her best to make it interesting. The class is overall super easy.
Just go to class and pay attention and you'll pass. NO homework ever except 3 blog posts which are super easy. Exams are the same as the study guide. Class can be boring.

Professor Rhodes is absolutely amazing. She's a great person to talk to about developments in the field of Special Education, especially assistive technology, and brings in great guest lecturers who're experts in their fields. If you show up and pay attention, the tests will be a breeze. I'd also highly recommend going to her office hours!!
Very straightforward, easy class. If you show up and listen to the lectures, you'll do well. I always make A's on the exams.

She had a lot of guest lecture which was nice to understand the topics. Her study guides were the same as the exam. The only downside to the class was that lectures were kind of boring and she treated her students like kindergarteners. But a very easy class.

This class is super chill, you just watch plays and take 10 question quizzes after. There is a group project at the end of the year where you create and act out your own play. Lectures are boring but she's really nice
Amazing!! You have to watch a play every week and take a short very easy quiz on it.

Professor Ritter is amazing! There are weekly quizzes over the assigned plays, but they're easy as long as you actually watch them. Most Fridays are "screening days" where she just lets the class watch part of the play, but you don't have to attend class if you watch them on your own time. There's a group performance, but it's fun and easy!

I had Ritter for TA110, which I only took to fill my UK Core for arts. My major has nothing to do with theater, but I can confidently say I enjoyed her class. She is extremely kind, and she actually likes her students which is an extremely important quality in professors. She obviously likes what she teaches, making her lectures engaging.

This teacher is straight up the worst. She will absolutely not help you get your grade up even if you ask her too and for the last project, you have to write about one of the productions you saw. She refused to grade mine because she thought I didn't actually go to the show. Therefore I my final was a 0%.
Q
Y

Attendance was required, but it was only MW and Fridays you have off to watch the required play of the week, but you can watch it whenever. There were weekly quizzes about each play, but they were easy if you paid attention to the play. The midterm and final were online, open note, and easy if you listened in lectures or did her review.
Professor Ritter is SO nice. She is very passionate about what she does and is very detailed in her lectures. A few papers - but she wasn't a super tough grader.

This is the most lecture heavy class I've taken. I took world theatre 1 and was wise enough to skip most world theatre 2 classes. There's just so much reading in this class that it's impossible to stay motivated. As long as you study for the midterm and final, and show up on test days, you'll be ok. Easy to cheat.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Christina's classes are lecture heavy, but her grading is fair and she really cares about her students and the content she is teaching. I would gladly take another of her courses.

Every week we had to watch lecture videos and most of the time we did not even talk about them. You have to read a play or watch a play every week. Most of the times you would have to write a paper over the play, others we would not even talk about it. Attendance is a big part of your grade, so just show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Very easy class. Watch a play every other week since it was moved to fully online and wrote a one page paper, double-spaced about it. Met on zoom once a week. Shes super sweet and understanding! Loved her

Christina's class has provided some of the best discussions that I have been a part of here at UK. She uses PowerPoint, yes, but she almost always focuses her presentation around questions that we should ask ourselves about theatre and its history. You'll be reading lots of plays, but (so long as you like plays) she provides a really nice selection

Good class for an art credit. Quizzes aren't too bad but you do need to read the plays (or watch them on youtube). Write the papers for the plays you see outside off class and you'll pretty much get an A on them. Group project isn't hard but you will need to put effort into it. Barely ever have class on Wednesdays. 3 lowest quizzes are dropped.

ehh the class is a mix. you have the quizzes that you have to do well on, the papers are pretty easy if you see the play. the big project helps a Lott and you just have to act like you know whats going on and pretend you can act

The class as a whole was fun. I am currently sitting at a 78% in the class and I study and participate. The class was canceled about once a week every week. The grading was super tough. She does not give any extra credit opportunities or any extra points. I took this class for fun and it has hurt my GPA more than it has helped.

Take this for Arts and Creativity core! The class is based off of points so try and miss as few points as possible. Every week watch the lecture videos, its not bad at all. No class mondays, wednesdays class is canceled a lot, and fridays you are in lab. TRY HARD in the project. It will boost your grade and do all of the extra credit you can!!!
Pretty easy class. Teacher is very well-versed in the topic and you will learn. As long as you take notes, tests are fine. There is a big group project but it isn't graded harshly.

Dr. Ritter is incredible, she's the kindest professor I've ever had and is so knowledgeable about theater. I found copies of all the plays online for free, and the lecture quizzes are not nearly as hard as others have said. I finished the class with a 99%. The only unfortunate thing is the class has a large group project, but it's easy.

Extremely hard class with it being a 110 class. Weekly quizzes are difficult and require you to really know the material. This class also requires you to see two plays (which is no less than $10), pay for small books, as well as pay for movies. This is not an easy A class what so ever so do not sign up for this class thinking it will be.

Dr. Ritter is absolutely awesome. This class is super easy if you still need your Arts & Creativity core.  You read 6 plays, take quizzes, take 3 online quizzes, design your own play, and a final. It sounds like a lot, but it's very easy. Also kind of interesting.
I took her for my arts credit and it was a pretty easy A outside of the long recorded lecture videos you had to watch every week.

Her lectures are online and extremely boring. We never talk about what we watch in the lecture videos in class and she expected the final to cover everything from the lecture videos.  She never even comes to class, its just the TA so make sure you get a good one.

She is very passionate about theatre and she wants you to be just as passionate as her about it. If you're not a theatre major or do not enjoy theatre, probably not the class for you. Fairly easy class, just make sure you take notes and go to class.

She is very passionate about theatre and her plays are absolutely amazing to go see. Although, in my opinion, she came off as arrogant she was very clear in everything she lectured about. I didn't always enjoy listening to her. She doesn't post lectures online so if you can't make it to class make sure you have a friend that will send you notes.

One of my favorite professors I have had at UK. During lecture you will come to the realization that she is an extremely informed individual and obviously knows a lot about theatre. But through her teaching process she does not come off as arrogant or snooty. Also she graduated with Benedict Cumberbatch if that says anything.

Amazing amazing professor. She's so nice and will help in any way she can. She made the class fun even though the material is kinda boring, but she is definitely passionate about it. Drops two lowest quiz grades, but quizzes are really easy anyway... just read the plays.
Awesome class. Easy, fun, interesting. Dr. Ritter is a great lecturer and is super cool. The group project is fun and not hard at all. Exams are straight from the notes.

If you need an arts core credit, take this class. You have to read 6 plays and take short (pretty easy) quizzes on them. Lowest 2 quiz grades drop. 2 exams. Both are easy if you just copy down the powerpoint slides and memorize them. Her lectures aren't boring, she keeps it interesting. You make a short play with a group for the end of semester.

I enjoyed this class. Dr. Ritter takes material that may seem dry and makes it interesting. In recitation, there are thought provoking discussions. Assignments wise, you'll have to read plays and do a final group project. It shouldn't be too stressful, though. If you do your work, study for the exams, and pay attention, you'll be fine.

She  is one of those professors that loves what she is teaching and it shows through her lectures! She has so much enthusiasm and it makes you want to pay attention and learn in her class. Her TA's are awesome too!!! Andy was the best TA I've ever had and he is one of those people who will always be there to help you when you need it!
She is so nice and interesting to listen to. I loved this class and wish every class was like this.
Class is an easy A. You read plays and have to go see plays and write reviews on them. The class itself is pretty boring.

Pretty easy class. Attendance for lecture is not mandatory but if you want an A, you should probably go.  You read a bunch of plays throughout the semester then get quizzed in lab.  You only act at the end in front of your recitation.  It's not a horrible class, I enjoyed myself.

Dr. Ritter definitely knows her material so expect the midterm and final to be extremely hard.  However, the final project is pretty fun and you'll interact with your TA more than you will with Dr. Ritter.  Also, you have to attend 2 plays and write responses so be prepared for that.
Great professor. Loves theater and makes class interesting.
Very nice and has a passion for theatre. Should pay attention to her, cause the midterm will be pretty tough if you don't.

She knows a lot about what she's talking about. And even though attendance is not mandatory, it is necessary to attend because the mid-term and final is kind of hard. She is very nice and I encourage everyone to take her class.
Her passion of the topic ends up letting you get lost in the lesson yourself. Love her & loved this class!

She is an amazing professor!!  She definitely knows her material and is easy to follow in class.  She is passionate about her work and truly seems to want everyone to succeed.  Show up for class, do the assignments and pay attention and you will be fine.

She definitely knows her stuff. Notes are a little ambiguous, and figuring out what to study can be tricky. If you go to the study sessions, the TA will really help you know what to study. Just read the plays (or Sparknotes) and do the work. Low stress class.
Dr. Ritter is very passionate about her field and it shows. She really knows what she's talking about. Just read the plays and show up to class, the rest is easy.
Ms. Rhenals is so awesome! I love the way she explains things and her powerpoints are very funny. She definitely cares about her students and will help you with anything you need. A++
She is wonderful! The activities from the book are not the greatest, but the ones she comes up with are hilarious. I'm gonna miss her class once it's over.

She plans a lot of group activities so in the morning that kind of sucks. And attendance is mandatory so, on Keeneland days, that also sucks. Other than that, I understood everything she taught perfectly. She makes sure that the grades for the tests are fair and has fun powerpoints to accompany her lessons. I wish I could have her every semester!

Absolutely terrible professor. She's really young, so she doesn't know what she's doing. She teaches like a high school teacher. She can't explain anything. She doesn't prepare you for the tests at all. Class is 90% group activities every single day. She plans the whole class period in 5 minute increments with the activities.

The material itself isn't difficult, but the instructor's approach makes the class more frustrating than necessary. Lectures feel scripted and impersonal, sometimes coming across as condescending. Communication is also an issue, as emails are often unanswered or delayed, which detracts from an otherwise manageable course.

Honestly, this class isn't hard. It's a lot of participating in events which are graded. I will say she isn't always accessible outside of class, even though she says she is. Never replys to emails on time, so I would say the TA is definitely more accessible than her. Please don't be like me and get started on assignments early on in the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: So much flexibility with the assignments. Honestly if you do the work, you can get an A.

The class is not difficult as long as you attend enough classes and are mindful of upcoming assignments. She did not grade toughly and sometimes changed assignments' due dates. She also offered some extra credit assignments. She is, however, not always easily accessible, so I would recommend emailing the TAs or asking her questions in person.
Overall, just a bad person. You learn nothing in her class.
Do not take this professor

Ryessia's lectures were the same as her lectures in B&E150. She cancelled class a lot, not complaining. And when we did have class, she often had a guest speaker. Once again, not complaining. She is not that bad of a professor, however, I will say she does come off as arrogant and condescending in one on one interactions.

I've never done one of these ratings before but I feel compelled at this point. DO NOT, under any circumstances, take her. I am a 4.0 student but this class cost me my first B. She will not grade anything until the last minute, is incredibly rude, and will answer your emails a week later. CIS is a joke class that should be pass/fail

If you think a CIS course could be difficult, usually you'd be wrong. One of the worst teachers I've ever had the experience of, "learning," from. Rude, arrogant, condescending, and harsh, this professor made a level 300 course feel like a 500. The group projects were a joke and we were forced to present in front of a real company. Do not take.
Her ability to introduce some of the most bizarre and unnecessary requirements for a CIS course is beyond insane. This class is a joke
Takes this class way too seriously
She so nice
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Brown is such a genuine and great professor. She is truly passionate about her work and Spanish. She is there and really cares if you need help with the course or otherwise. You have class two days a week and volunteer for 15 hours over the semester to make up for that extra day. Really cool course.

Dr. Brown was one of the nicest professors that I have had. She is always willing to help students and makes her lectures interesting. Dr. Brown would go the extra mile to make sure that her students are doing well.

LOVE this professor. She really loves her students and want them to succeed. I really did not deserve the grade I was given in this class but she is so kind that she knew i was trying. Just give your best effort and she will treat you well.

Dr. Brown is great especially if you show interest in learning the language! She really cares about what she does and is by far the best Spanish professor I have had at UK. I'm a FLIE major, and she has been super helpful with the study abroad process. Her exams are easy as long as you do your homework and keep up with class.

Sra. Brown is such an amazing teacher. She is super understanding and makes you really comfortable to speak Spanish. When it comes to interpersonal speaking, she is easy to talk to and helps you a lot! If you have the chance to have her as a teacher, do it!

Dr. Brown's class is super cool. Lectures on Hispanic Kentucky are interesting. The class had 2 exams (mostly writing prompts), 6 discussion boards, and a big community involvement project. You choose a way to interact with the latino community in KY, get 15 hours, and have a big final project explaining what was learned. Participate in class!

Amazing Professor. She is really kind and definitely knows her stuff. You do have to put in some time for this class, homework, reading, lectures, etc. but she is very understanding and can be lenient.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dra. Brown is extremely nice and an amazing Spanish teacher. She was one of the few professors I had that actually made Zooms interesting and fun. You can tell she cares a lot about the subject material and her students, and she is easy to establish a good relationship with. I highly recommend her to all Spanish students.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Brown is great! She is so funny, caring, and she loves to teach SPA 314. The class is super doable. Homework is a short Canvas quiz before every class and there's one main project you do throughout the semester. There are three exams, and she gives you Quizlets and a study guide with all of the material you need. Absolutely amazing professor!

Dr. Brown is amazing! She really cares about her students and she loves teaching SPA 314, which makes the class amazing. She tells you everything you need to know for tests, you just need to put in the effort to study it on your own. If you work hard in this class, it will be an easy A.
Dr. Ruth Brown is the greatest. She is very helpful and caring.
She tries to make class fun. No exams, just 5 quizzes and you can drop your lowest quiz. She tells you what to study for the quiz and it's an easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: LOVEEEE Dr. Brown. She makes Spanish fun and is always there to help her students. The exams are a little bit tough, but she gives you a study guide and tons of time to ask questions if you are unsure of the material. I was scared to take this bc i hadnt taken spanish since HS, but it was sooo easy!

Dr. Brown went above and beyond to see me succeed in her SPA 315 course. She really cares about her students and tries to make learning fun! If you have the option, have her as your professor and you will be sure to get a good grade AND learn a lot.

Such a wonderful professor, I have taken her 3 semesters. There is always homework ,yet it is fast and easy. Attendance is mandatory, yet class goes by so fast. Exams are simple and there is always a group project somewhere. I barely spoke spanish when I walked in, yet now I have learned so much. One of the best teachers in the department!

I greatly enjoyed her focus on service-learning and passion for the Hispanic community in Kentucky. Her assignments were interesting. Though sometimes it is unclear why she takes off points, she is a fair grader and an easy A.

Dr. Brown is a good professor. Unfortunately, I was somewhat distracted from this because for some reason her American accent while speaking Spanish annoyed me from time to time. But I digress; Dr. Brown teaches an interesting class, gives good feedback and gets the students involved. No major issues, pretty helpful, would recommend.

Ruth is great. There are a lot of assignments and attendance is mandatory, however class is fun. Tests accurately reflect what is taught. She is extremely nicce, organized, and easy to follow. Strongly recommend- especially for freshman!

Dr. Brown is awesome! I love her. Super easy grader, the class is cake. She also speaks very clearly, I can always understand her spanish. Just make sure you keep up with the online homework assignments. She also gives tons of opportunities for extra credit.
Very willing to help her students. If you put in the effort, you will learn a lot.

I took Mrs. Brown for spanish conversation and ahe did a really great Job at making me feel comfortable talking in spanish. Doesnt grade hard at all, just come to class and speak up every now and then and you will probably get an A. No final just oral interviews that take 5 minutes or less alone with her. Great teacher!

Ruth Brown is a wonderful teacher. She cares about the students and wants everyone to learn, understand and speak well. She always helps and would answer any question. She is relateable and just flat out awesome!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Senora Brown is extremely nice and willing to help when you don't understand.  Extensive online homework which is graded, but if completed really helps your grade in the class.  Tests are understandable and are easy if you've done the homework.  She does dock your grade in the participation category if you miss class.  Overall, pretty easy!

Ruth was nice and easy to understand in class because she's American and talks slow.  She is weird about grading - sometimes you don't understand why she counts off for something.  Overall an easy class if you do the online hw and turn everything in on time.  Have to come to class, since it is graded.
He loves to over complicate the most simple topics and is very monotone. Would not recommend taking his courses.
Dr. Brown fails to convey the fundamentals of calculus, often overcomplicating retrospectively simplistic concepts. He also isn't exactly easy to understand during lecture.

Brown is an alright professor. He makes a lot of dry jokes and really likes the number 42. He can be hard to follow in lecture as he skips some steps and dives too deep into theorems and proofs sometimes. Calc 1 will generally be difficult even if you have high school experience. Best of luck!

I thought Brown was funny and a nice person, but not a great teacher. His lectures weren't very useful as he spent the majority of the time doing proofs for various concepts instead of examples. I had already taken calculus in high-school but still struggled and had to teach myself a lot of the material.
Openly addmited to having memory loss. Was by far the worst lecture I have ever had.
Great class if you utilize your resources, download the lecture notes, etc..

Russell Brown from my experience has very poor lectures. The notes are very barebones and hard to follow, along with no or very poor explanations for mathematical concepts. Prepare to learn the subject of Calculus independently of taking him. Highly recommend avoiding at all costs!
Dry lectures, Skips steps, impossible to follow
Terrible at teaching calc 1. Lectures are slow and boring. He is terrible at explaining his work and his handwriting is equivalent to a newborn. Just hope you get a good TA.
good luck.. i changed my major because of this class

I thought Dr. Brown was a solid professor. He teaches several graduate courses, so sometimes he can get carried away with theorems and proofs, but attempting to understand these makes the application easier to understand. Monotone, but very sarcastic. Calc 1 is just a difficult course even if you have calculus experience.
Handwriting is impossible to read. Hope you get a good TA.

Brown is not a very good lecturer. He talks very slow and monotone, which makes it hard to pay attention in lecture. And personally, I stopped going to most lectures because I was learning nothing from them. 
You have about 2-3 homework assignments each week and they are usually 7-10 questions long. I would not recommend Brown.
Cannot teach

If you take this professor, get ready to live at mathskeller or the study, you're going to need all the help you can get. If you can read hiroglifics, you should be good but if you're a normal student, his notes will have no help to you.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He's a nice guy but a terrible professor. He barley explains anything and his handwriting is terrible, his class is just so confusing!!! would not recommend

Dr Brown is a very nice guy, but his class has been very difficult for me. His lectures are very difficult to keep up with as he goes very fast & he makes frequent mistakes. He also does not have the best hand writing which makes it very difficult to understand the content. I wouldnt recommend if you dont already know calc, will def need a tutor.

Dr. Brown is a really nice guy that wants all his students to succeed. His grading is pretty reasonable but his lectures are extremely dry with little to no examples. The class material was extremely difficult as he taught it at a high level by just doing proofs most of the time. Unless you're a math major, you're probably gonna struggle with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Do not take Russel Brown unless you already know how to do calculus to a T. He make mistakes every lecture, does not know how to navigate canvas/online class, and his handwriting is illegible. Heavy webwork assignments, 4 exams, a quiz every week. Get a tutor if you end up with him and want a decent grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Just don't. His handwriting looks like a roller coaster track, his lectures are over complicated, confusing, and they'll put you to sleep. If you are stuck with him then find another learning resource.

This is the worst math professor I have ever had. He shouldn't teach this course. He also has a T.A. Angela Vichitbanda and she is terrible. Make sure she isn't your T.A in any math course because she sucks.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dude is alright but he doesn't explain much well and his handwriting is like reading minecraft enchanting table. He can be funny sometimes though.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had Mr Brown for MA114 and he did a decent job. His lectures were sometimes hard to follow, and he frequently made mistakes when working problems on the board. His sarcasm made the class slightly more enjoyable.
if you're bad in math, don't take this professor. his handwriting is horrible and he drones on in class and you can't learn. he's cool in office hours, but i could never take notes in class.
During lectures he would joke about how bad his teaching is. I highly reccomend other professors, or getting a tutor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Brown knows his stuff, but unfortunately, he isn't very good at communicating it. His lectures are difficult to follow and his notes are full of mistakes. He's a nice guy, but isn't the best math professor. Be prepared to do most of your learning outside of class or in recitation.

I would avoid this professor if possible. He's a nice guy but his lectures are unreadable and difficult to follow. Be prepared to study hard for the exams but even if you do, he'll provide questions he's never taught before. He tries to explains math in a way that only mathematicians would understand. Do NOT take this class.

Dr. Brown is a very smart man, he just has a very hard time getting all of his information to the students. He tries explaining the concepts rather than just giving  the formulas, and he does not do a good job with that. The way he orients his notes are very sloppy and poorly put together. Having someone outside of his lecture to help you is a MUST
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Brown did not help me that much when my test accommodations weren't through.  There is homework every other day in this class. He is very approachable, but he doesn't get information across very well. If you take this course GET A TUTOR.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: If you can, run. Unless you've taken calc for a few years or have a pre calc tutor on the side, he makes learning the basics impossible. He has an attitude about any question you have because he expects you to figure it out for yourself. Not a good freshmen professor at all. BEWARE. And study practice exams, but expect the answer keys to be wrong.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you aren't going into his class with the amount of prior knowledge that he has, or you're not willing to basically teach yourself, you might as well drop it now. Dr. Brown is a very knowledgeable man and knows his stuff. But conveying that to other people? He lacks that skill in every way. I only scooted by because I had AP Calc in high school.

The dude doesn't know how to teach. PERIOD. Wouldn't wish this guy on my worst enemy. Luckily I took Calculus in high school and had an amazing teacher or I wouldn't of had a snowball's chance to pass. Avoid at all costs.

Speeds through the lecture without detail. Gives homework that isnt shown in the book. Good luck reading his handwriting. Expects you to already know what he's talking about and will cover one section ahead of the homework. Pray you have a good TA, because even asking him personally for help, he is very unclear and beats around the bush. Avoid him.

He is not a good teacher. You can tell he is a very smart guy and he knows his material very well but he expects you to be an expert at it too. He is not very helpful at all. He speeds through the lecture without going to depth so the normal human being can actually understand him. Do Not Take MA 113 with him PLEASE

Dr. Brown was nice and funny on occasion.  He knows what he teaches and he isn't bad at doing so, just not great. You'll be fine if you're good at math.  If you aren't, you'll have to work.  Dr. Brown was neither terrible nor excellent.

Taking a class taught by Brown is counter-productive. Makes calculus extremely confusing and abstract to his students with hopes of making himself seem more intelligent. Nice guy, but should honestly be reviewed by board for lack of effective teaching methods. He does nothing but speak in math notation and write notes from the text. Stay away!

I am Mech. Engineering student with a 3.85 GPA, so I'm not a slouch. I am proficient in all areas of math but Brown is a pathetic excuse for a collegiate level educator. Or on any level for that matter. The only way you will be able to understand his lectures is if you've had the class before. He takes pride in being an academic snob.

Nice guy. Sort of funny. Went to office hours always..... not much help. He knows his stuff, but expects you to have a general (and kind of more than general really) knowledge base prior to learning. I would say steer away.

Worst professor in UK! do no take hi class. Beth kelly also teaches ma113 and she is my pick for the best professor for ma113. If you have a choice dont choose his because he is was too smart for his students

Very nice guy. Clearly cares about the subject. Sometimes funny, sometimes not. He really appreciates students who go to his office hours. If you're very good at math, you'll understand his teaching style. If you need a more direct, explained approach, he's a bit tough because he assumes you know a lot already. Take him if you're great at math.

In no ways shape or form did i learn anything from him. The only reason i have a D in the class right now is because of Chegg. I would never recommend this  instructor to anyone that would like to peruse a math career. I have failed my first math class in over 8 years and that is saying something.

He's a nice guy, but his teaching skills are a bit lacking. In class, he tells a theorem and then explains how it was derived in the first place. He rarely gives examples and then expects you to understand how to use it on exams.

prof gave 2 tests bec EVERYONE failed the first test (highest grade was 57%). on 2nd test EVERYONE failed so he curved the grade and said 65% was an "A"  Obviously the prof has no idea that the tests should cover the material we actually studied in class and be reflective of what we've learned.  His assignments are unclear and confusing. run away!

I was told that MA 109 is one of the most dropped/failed classes at UK. So, I gave Prof. Brown a break. I could tell he was a nice person, but when you're teaching a large class of freshmen who don't care - it's gonna be hard to be "interesting" The man was a bit condescending, but whatever. I got a B. Go to class because there's an attendancegrade
Very Easy Class

A little awkward, but a legit professor who makes class fun by jumping on tables and doing random stuff. If you can't learn from this man, its probably because you are still stuck in high school. Not perfect, but not horrible by a long shot. And for the record, I am horrible at math.

Incredibly difficult professor!  His lecture was VERY difficult to understand and I only missed two/three lectures the entire semester plus in office hours he was intimidating and not helpful AT ALL!  Nice guy and knows his stuff just not the best Calc prof

His lectures are the examples out of the book. So if you can read then going to class is pointless. But he randomly takes attendance so you should probablly go. Honestly, who gets paid to read to their students?

his lectures made no sense and i missed over half of them. he is really confusing and expects everyone to "think like a mathematician".  however, he is actually a really nice guy and very helpful and caring if you talk to him one on one. go to lecture, no matter how pointless it seems. and office hours. hope for a good TA thats how i passed.
He was a good professor. His lectures were boring and didn't appear to be helping, but he teaches you exactly what he want on the tests. Not the best, but no too bad either.
Dr. Brown rocks my freaking socks off!

Well, if you're just ok at math, i don't recommend this class.  I received an A, and i thought most of his tests were pretty easy.  Most of my classmates, however, did worse in this math class than any other.  If you do enjoy math, go for it, you will learn much more in this class than with most other professors.

He's in a league of suck all of his own.- one of my classmates said this, and i agree. huge dousche. thinks he's a soccer referee or something. two words: MATHEMATICAL INDUCTION. in a calc 1 class. really. I love math. and this man made me want to change my major. DO NOT TAKE HIM!

Brown was a completely arrogant pompous idiot.  I asked him for help in his office hours and his response was; "I won't do your homework for you."  I made an A in AP Calc in high school but got a 71 on his first test.  He expects everyone to want to be a  mathematician and memorise page-long definitions.
this is the worst teacher that i have ever had. i would get out of the class as fast as possible

This was the hardest calculus 1 class I have ever taken.  If possible, take ma123, it is a lot easier.  Brown is an unorthodox teacher, it is hard to understand where he is going in his lectures.  Tests are unfair.  If you have him GET OUT WHILE YOU CAN!!!
TERRIBLE

She's very nice and grades pretty lightly. It's important to pay attention and read before class because she really wants you to participate. If you don't, she might start picking on you. Overall the class isn't that bad. There are 4 essays, some easy homeworks, discussion posts, and a couple presentations.
She was really good! She cares for her students and will always help outside of class. As long as you try hard, read before class, and study the material a little outside of class you will be fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Rueda's class was challenging but fair. She will push you to improve your grammar, and so brilliantly! The homework is tough, and I didn't always get amazing grades on small assignments but if you can write decently, you will keep an A, but do not take this class if you aren't invested in getting better at Spanish.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Ana is very caring and understanding. She provides practices tests that are very similar to the exams. Every class feels fairly similar which can make it pretty difficult to pay attention. There is homework three times a week. It is easy, but just a pain. You definitely need to buy the books, because you will use them in class and for homework.

Rusty is a nice professor just awkward during lecture. He speak quietly and sometimes mumble so just make sure your are listening well in lectures. He does not expect much, just that you try. Very passionate about linguistics.

The class was very fun, but I was definitely confused on some parts. He's very knowledgeable about the subject, but doesn't always explain it in a way that's easy to understand. I had to do a fair bit of self study to figure out how to actually do stuff, but overall it was a very fair class and still enjoyable.

Barrett is very down to earth and treats you as an adult. If you're late on homework and give him a decent reason, he almost definitely won't knock you any points. His lectures can be kind of dry though.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Warning: Attendance is not required, but you will do very poorly in this class if you are not there for lecture. The books were lowkey useless. Everything you need to know is from the lecture. I mean, he seemed nice enough, but really awkward. My gripe was that he didn't seem very engaging and required FOUR books for this one elective class.

Honestly, a super smart guy, knows so much about languages but sometimes forgets to simplify things. Always down to help, a little all over the place. Kinda clumsy. Gives enough practice in class that I hardly have to study outside of class. You have like 5 homework assignments the whole year

We only have 5 homework assignments for the entire semester, and they're very doable. The first exam that covers morphology is HARD, but he tells you up front that if you're going to study for anything it needs to be that exam. He's funny and awkward and really nice. I definitely recommend if you're into linguistics.

Professor Barrett has a great sense of humor. He would include funny memes and pictures in lecture to keep class interesting. He is very understanding of students and even let me make up an exam I had missed due to a family emergency with no questions asked. The study guides he gives are very similar to the exams so if you do those then you're good

If you have the chance to take a class with Rusty, I highly recommend it. His lectures always make sense and he takes care to make sure everyone understands the content and feels respected. His lectures are right off the PowerPoint, so no need to really take notes. Just pay attention in class and study a bit, and it should be an Easy A! Love him!
Taking this class made a significant positive impact on my life. Thanks Dr. Barrett :)
Rusty's the best!

Pretty easy class overall but the content can be confusing at times. He lectures well but goes really really fast which was frustrating but he posts all the lectures so that helps out. His exams are short answer but the study guides are pretty straight forward. Nice guy, willing to help you if you need it. I would take another one of his classes.

So glad I got to take this class with him. I love the lectures, they were interesting to me. You don't have to go (or b/c he didn't have a TA this semester you didn't), but I would- it helps because he'll answer questions. Gives you a nice review for the midterm/final. Very nice guy.
Rusty is great!  The material is a little confusing at times but if you go to class, he notices and is willing to help you. I also took him for 211 and he was also just as helpful!
Very energetic! Seems a little introverted. More eye contact. Excellent Professor
Great guy who definitely understands that this material is difficult.  He is very funny and very laid back.  Good grading system as well. Take him if you can!
Great guy who definitely understands that this material is difficult.  He is very funny and very laid back.  Good grading system as well. Take him if you can!

This is not a very difficult class and if you show up he will gladly help you. I got A's on all of the tests and hw, if you do not understand the material at first he'll help you learn it. I found the class interesting & even funny sommetimes

I thought this was a very difficult class-I managed to get a C but was afraid of an F. He seems to be a good teacher, kind of quick, but the material itself I just had a hard time with. Attendance is not mandatory, but I def recommend it because he covers a lot in a day.

Linguistics in itself is not the most interesting subject, but Barret does try to keep people interested. He presents the material very effectively and is always available for extra help. He gives lots of hand out (not a lot of note taking!!) and his test are easier than the homework. If you can do the homework you'll get an A. I'd recommend him.

Special Topic: Discrimination in Language. Barrett's first year at UK. Very knowledgable about social linguistics, has done research.  Kind of quirky but once again, can explain everything pretty clearly.  Tests not that hard, gives study guides.  Group project at end of semester. Hands out lots of dittos for you to follow in class, helpful.
Great writing teacher with good taste and great feedback.

He assigns some really great stuff to read, and gives great in-class prompts that leaves you with some really strong pieces for a writing portfolio. Incredibly nice guy who will always give you a chance to recover if you slip. Reviewing everyone's short stories was very fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Gave great reading assignments and did a great job promoting class discussions. Slow grader, but the class was large and his feedback was good so I think that makes up for it.

I worked endlessly and very hard... always did my work because I loved it.. contributed in the critiques did everything I should but never a single positive word out of her. I deserved an A in her classes and go A's in all of my Art classed except hers. I did my best as did others did, but she is a bad teacher.

Knowledgable prof., though marred by her consistent lateness for class.  Never prepares for classes so demands that you fetch and carry for her to cover up her lack of being prepared.  Frequently rude.  A good class though if you can deal with her bad attitude.
Very knowledgable, but frequently rude and demands that you fetch and carry for her due to her constant lack of not being prepared.  Consistently late for classes.  Overall a good class though.
No Comments
RUTH ROCKS!

I love Dr. Rosano. She is so great at what she does, is very kind, and wants to see you succeed. Once you get to know Dr. Rosano and how her class flows, she is the best! She is so knowledgeable about working with horses and does an excellent job at pairing people with class horses. I LOVED this course and found it SO valuable.
She's the best! I love listening to her share her knowledge and she's very kind/understanding. As long as you know the content on the slides, the exams are very straightforward.
Super helpful!

Dr. Rossano can initially come off as super serious but once you get to know her, she is very kind and personable. I enjoyed our labs and she allows us to retake any of our weekly lab tests. The lab test aligned with the pre lab and lectures but the midterm was difficult. Would take another one of her classes.

Big fan of Dr.Rossano. She obviously loves what she does and what she teaches. Very flexible with labs and accommodated me into different labs when I dealt with a personal struggles and emergencies. I have not seen an Ag professor love what they teach as much as she does and it inspires me.

Dr. Rossano is one of my favorite equine professors. There are a lot of details to know in this class and on the exams, but if you study the slides outside of class and pay attention during lecture, you'll do well. The labs are practical information that you will use in your career pursuing equine.

Dr. R does not understand any circumstance and will ask for proof of everything (even death certificates). Her classes are very material-focused and boring most of the time. She knows what she is talking about but is not personable. My biggest problem with her is her lack of understanding and straight up rudeness about any differences.

Dr. Rossano's lectures are all business but she is warm and funny in lab.  I liked ASC 320 labs because everything was hands on and we got to work with horses.  She is also my advisor and helped me use my transfer credits from another school for my degree at UK.  I thought those classes were going to be wasted but she figured it out.  She cares.

Dr. Rossano is a great professor although her lectures do tend to put me to sleep. She cares deeply about her students and horses. Her lectures are easy to follow and all of the lecture content is on the exams. In order to receive a good grade in this class, show up to each lecture and lab and participate.

Dr. R's class often left me and other students feeling confused, lost, and at times embarrassed. She was very strict on grading, Not understanding of life events or issues. Subject is simple if you have experience, she overcomplicates things.
Such an amazing woman who I respect very much. A great professor who really wants you to understand and succeed. Go to class and pay attention and you'll pass.

Go to class and turn in your assignments on time and you'll be absolutely fine! I missed a handful of assignments and even an exam due to work, and she was more than willing to work with me, even offered to switch my lab time to make sure I didn't have conflicts. She really cares about her students and is a genuinely kind lady!!!

This class has some kind of homework assignment about every other week, with them not being too hard or time consuming. You could tell she really wanted us to have career development and gave good feedback. Follow her rubrics and go to class and you will be fine.

Approximately a week wait time for email response, not clear with graded assignments, three week wait list for meeting availability, only focused on research, not very willing with DRC accommodations, does not care much about students.

I grader Professor R hard as the class I had her for was a 1 credit course. She was sweet and some assignments were helpful as it is a career class. However she gave a ton of work and the grading scale was very strange. I've taken 4 credit courses that required less work than this one.

Dr. Rossano is an amazing lady. A fair grader, and she clearly wants to see you succeed in her class. You definitely want to stay on her good side though. Class material is easy to understand and her tests are easy as long as you know the material.

Dr. R is a real queen. I was unable to make one of the labs, and she gave me an assignment I could do so I didn't lose points. She cares about you and you will always laugh when talking to her. Such a nice lady

Dr.R loves students that care about the class and want to engage. If you show up and pay attention you should do well in the class. If you don't understand something she's normally very happy to explain it to you.
Dr. R is very sweet and easy to like. Do what she says and follow the rules and you have an A
Easy class with a great professor.

Dr. Rossano is extremely kind hearted and technologically challenged. She is really understanding and easy to work with. Her lectures can be a bit boring, and are often taught by a grad student working with the class. The material is easy to read and you won't be able to stay awake in class so read before the test but shes a very good.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Rossano. She was approachable and truly cared for her students, despite having 300 of us. Unfortunately the class, was just too large which was not her fault. UK is very money greedy and doesn't care for its professors or students.
Dr. Rossano was very clear in lecture, and the lab papers were pretty simple but homework assignments and tests are graded pretty tough.

She really knew what she was talking about when it came to lecture and even though it was an 8am she was energetic and fun which made it more bearable.  She gives good feedback on lab assignments and explains things if you didn't quite get them and she is always willing to help if you need it.

Dr. Rossano is an extremely nice and knowledgable person, but teaches a very large ASC 101 class. The content isn't easy to pick up especially if you have no animal agriculture background. If you take this class wanting to be a vet for your dog, be prepared to study a lot or change majors.
She is helpful and knowledgeable. Everything is laid out for you, mandatory attendance will get you in trouble if you don't go! Much better than ASC 101
I took her equine management class online. I found the class interesting and easy. All the material was online. She was helpful if I emailed her questions.

I had her for ASC 101 and really disliked her (maybe because it was only offered at 8am) but I've had her for several other equine classes sense then and I really enjoy them. She's interesting and knowledgeable. Recommended!

Had Dr. Rossano for a number of EQM classes and loved it.  She is really nice, and willing to work and help anyone out.  She outlines exactly what she wants from you to get an A... so it's pretty easy to get.

It isn't difficult to get an A in this class if you go to lecture and remember to post what you did in lab to Blackboard.  Lots of easy partipation points, but the tests are kind of hard.  She seems to be having fun teaching and was very kind and helpful when I had questions.

She teaches equine managment but she doesent really know anything about it her specialty is parasites so if you are more intrested in the health aspect shes ok but not managment she posted a picture of a mule instead of a horse and didnt notice! very monotone aswell
Excellent Prof.  Clear expectations, tests are what is expected, no surprises. Clearly enjoys teaching, and is very good at it.

She's a very nice lady. I felt like going to lecture was very beneficial because I could tell what points she emphasized the most and that ended up being on tests. She will throw out extra credit opportunities for those who attend class as well. When the weather is unbearable, she will cancel lab. I also had her for ASC 320.
She is great! Very helpful, clear expectations, overall a fantastic professor.
No Comments

Great instructor! He is incredibly accessible, responds quickly to emails, and is flexible with grading. He truly cares about student success. When my group ran into a project issue, he went above and beyond to help us resolve it without being punitive. Highly recommend for a supportive environment.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I loved Professor Sellin. He was very kind and helpful towards all of his students, and was always willing to work through any issues with assignments. He is very knowledgeable and knows what he's doing. Assignments were pretty easy, and he drops your lowest exam grade at the end of the semester. Take him if you have the chance!

One of the few courses I enjoyed this semester! He helped walk us through all of the assignments, coding, and getting us familiar with any new material. There were a few instances where I had issues submitting assignment or errors with my online assignments, but he was willing to work through the problem and fix my grade if necessary!
fine in class. creepy one on one.

I had Professor Sellin for Engineering 101, 102, and 103; his main goal is clearly success for his students, and he is super understanding. He is available outside of class and is quick with email responses. I would highly recommend taking his classes if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: ( i had him for EGR 101 and 103 but option wasn't available for me to choose)  New to teaching so he struggled a bit last semester, but I took him again this semester for a different class and there was a huge improvement. Very caring and relaxed teacher. If you ever have any problems he is very approachable and friendly.

Genuinely one of the best professors I have ever had. An extremely knowledgeable and experienced person that teaches students so much and makes sure everyone is learning. As far as engineering classes go, he makes it as doable as he can.

Sellin did a fine job considering it's his first year teaching at UK. EGR102 is not a difficult course, and Sellin made it even easier. He leads you through *most* of the circuit building and in-class coding very well if you just pay attention, but you should still prioritize ZyBook. Overall, a fine professor.
Everything was online except 2 in person assignments, however the in person assignments are rough if your not apart of the lab
she chill, very easy microbio class

BEWARE OF THE BEATTIE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! I showed up once for the in-person project and it's a NIGHTMARE. HEAVY on the quizzes and can't even teach what's on those. The lectures are boring and don't reflect what's going on with microbiology. I question how she is still teaching….

I took BIO 208 online over the summer so it was a very different experience than a typical lecture course. Professor Beattie is knowledgable and avaliable for help if you needed it. There are several ungraded activities and readings to help you learn the material. Then your graded is based on 13 assignments and 3 exams on mastering microbiology.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Cares very little about her students.  Painfully boring.  Basically unwilling to inconvenience herself at all with any student questions.  Avoid this professor if you can.
The tests are very difficult and come from material in the textbook, not lecture.
Awful

Attendance was not mandatory, but even it was, it would be pointless to go to class. I never learned anything from lecture, only from the book. The tests come from the book, NOT the lecture. She is a nice lady and she has a lot of reputation in the biological sciences field, but her class is ridiculously hard. Take Osterhage. You'll do better.

She is one of the harder 148 professors but loves when you stay after class with a question or come to office hours. The tests have most of their questions from homework so I just studied my homework and got an A. Difficult but worth it.

Out of the teachers that teach 148, Dr. Beattie is the hard one. I took her because she fit my schedule and I got an A. Read all of the book chapters and studied notes. (I typed everything!) she does reuse questions from old exams, I found out after I took the class and never had the opportunity to look at old exams.

BEWARE OF THE BEATTIE!! Don't even bother going to class, memorize the book. Prepare for the worst on her tests and ask around for old exams. Most of us survived with an A or B after lots of cramming and stressful night but it's possible!

She is a brilliant woman, but a bad professor. Her class is very disorganized and does NOT follow the syllabus. The homework and tests had a lot of information not covered in class. She is hard to understand and doesn't make a lot of effort to help students. It's very hard!!!! Don't take it.
HORRIBLE professor! Do NOT take this class! AVOID at ALL costs! Beattie is a very knowledgeable person but cannot teach. STAY AWAY

You must read the textbook to survive in this class. Her lectures are not relevant to her tests. Test questions are made from the textbook. She does curve the tests some. The class is not impossible. Dr. Beattie is not helpful. Going to office hours does not help. If you don't understand the material, look at the book more.
It's hard, but not impossible. She claims that there is no curve, however, there is a built in curve in her grade scale. Put in the effort and you'll be fine.

This class was only offered with one section at 8am! So naturally I wasn't present most of the time. Ruth seemed nice, but didn't get to know her too well. Your grade is based off 3 exams and a homework grade (worth as much as a test, so do it!). With more studying I could've got an A. But a B was more than fine.
Beattie is a very good teacher.  While her class is difficult, she is very knowledgable and is able to keep a sometimes boring subject very interesting.

She is about 11 different shades of awful. Stopped going to class after the first exam because nothing she taught was helpful, just an overview of the chapters I could do myself. She wants you to know nitty-gritty details that do not make a difference in a entry level class. Avoid her if you can!!

Going to class will not tell you everything that is on the test, but it will help clarify concepts. If you have any questions, Dr. Beattie is more than happy to help you find the answer. The tests are purely based on the text book, so just READ IT.

How to get an A with Beattie: 1. Go to class. 2 TYPE your notes to keep up with her in lecture 3. Study well in advance of test 4. READ THE BOOK, take notes in it, and compare them to your class notes. 5. Use the online tools - do every single activity/quiz that you can on the online thing and review what you get incorrect. Repeat 1-5. Hard work=A

She is an awful teacher. This class is so hard because you have no idea what you should and shouldnt study. I hate this class. Unfortunately you cant avoid taking her because she is the only teacher who teaches this class. If you have to take Bio 208 good luck

I currently have an A, and will most likely receive an A. However, her class has all but turned me into a zombie. I probably studied 100 hours for the last test and got a B. She is unfriendly and aloof in her office hours and unless you read the book and know EVERYTHING, you will probably not do well.
She goes far too in depth with her examples and doesn't lecture about anything thats on the test. Best advice? read the textbook and study off that, NOT lecture notes.

By no means an easy teacher, but her lectures are helpful (even if her voice is a bit dull) and she is extremely clear about what you need to do to pass the class and she means it. No matter how good at biology you think you are. Read the book, go to lecture, and reveiw your notes and you'll be fine.
Yes, read the book! You're in college!
Very boring lecture. Class doesn't really help, merely an overview of the material. Read the book and study hard for the class.

This introductory class material has prepared me for the future biology courses. She is very helpful with questions after class or during her office hours. She really knows her stuff. Lecture notes are merely an overview of the material.  If you want an A, READ THE BOOK AND TAKE YOUR OWN NOTES!

This class was difficult.  I found that by making my own study guide from the text actually helped me more than going to lecture.  Her lecture notes aren't very helpful with exam material. Exam questions are extremely difficult and ask questions about simple concepts in deceiving ways.

Not helpful at all. Since I don't have to take another bio class, this class was uselessly hard. Lectures prepared for nothing, notes don't help whatsoever. Might as well not go to class, and just memorize the entire book and think of hardest ways to ask the most simple of questions.

I took her Intro. to Biology class over 10 yrs ago. It was a challenging course, but it above all others helped to prepare me for my upper-level courses. She made expectations clear early on & set her standards high. Thank you, Dr. Beattie. You inspired me so much that I now am also a biology professor & I begin the 1st day of class much like you.

Lectures aren't very useful for the test. Only supplement what you should teach yourself from the book. An 85 is an A but it's still difficult. Tests are all applying questions so you better know the material. Seems like a nice lady but not the best teacher.
Can be dry but has a helpful grading curve and is very clear about what you need to know. There are definitely worse bio teachers out there. Would not mind taking again.

This class was extremely difficult, I pretty much relied on the book because Dr. Beattie's lecture were more like supplementary material. Also, the one time I talked to her she was very rude and hateful and was no help to me at all.

Great prof! Hard class with a ton of material to learn but Beattie makes it as easy as possible. She has her sh*t together! I got an A in the course and considered changing my major to BIO...that is until I had other BIO profs. Horrible.
