Took her for the new BIO-150 class. Overall she was a great lecturer, knew her stuff, and was always willing to help. Tests were pretty hard, especially as some of the questions are tricky and wordy. I will admit that I didn't read the book as much as I should have. Ended up with an A in the class, but by no means an easy one. If you take her, read
DO NOT TAKE COURSE ONLINE!! It was too much and too hard to teach to yourself... no matter how boring she is i will be getting into her class on campus since shes the only bio 208 teacher

Beattie knows her stuff but her lectures are extremely boring. I went for about the first month and then quit going to class. Just take notes over the textbook, look at the online study area for MasteringBiology, and you'll do fine. An 85% is an A but she makes you work for it.

Very boring class, very boring teacher. coming to class is not mandatory and not needed. Nothing she talks about in class is on the exams. And the exams are EXTREMELY hard. I would not take Beattie if there were any other options.

She is a GREAT professor! Class is not mandatory but you should go because she explains concepts so well. She is very passionate about what she does and you can really tell that she cares about our grades. She is willing to help you when ever. Excellent teacher and sweet person. (She pronounces things oddly in class but I think it is entertaining).
Difficult class, but a nice challenge.  Love the professor strangely.  Made things simple in class.
READ THE BOOK! Her class is very boring, I felt like I taught myself the entire class

Ruth is definitely informative in class, but her lectures arent the only material that impact your exam grade. The information in the text will definitely pop up again on exams. The booklet with review questions and topics to review are also crucial to success. With these tools, the beast of BIO 150 is more kitten than dragon.

Great teacher -- she can be boring but she knows what she is doing.  Pay attention and for the love of God make sure you read the book! Her lectures are very helpful, but it only will cover half of her exams. Read. The. Book.
ridiculously hard class. She is extremely helpful but it doesnt take away from the fact that that class is impossible
ridiculously hard class and she only makes it harder. avoid at all costs
Sort of boring.Tests are tricky and somewhat hard. Teaches very effectively. Presents material very fast so learn to write and or type very fast.
Do not take this class online. It is impossible to learn everything and the exams are Saturdays at 8AM!

Good teacher. Somewhat boring but she is pretty easy to follow. The videos, however, at the end of the semester are pointless. Just walk out if she shows them. Make sure to actually read the book because she pulls quite a bit from it for her tests.

Nothing new to add.  I used the Cliffnotes AP Bio review book to study for the final exam and made an A.  This is a great thing to do if you want to do well in the class without having to read the entire campbell book.

Good teacher. Everything is fair game in the book and the lectures are only for clarifcation and to emphasize the book.  A 85% is an A. Read the book, highlight, and now everything in the chapter unless she says no to.  She is also very willing to help.

Beattie is definitely a character. She is so boring that she becomes somewhat entertaining, and her pronunciation is fun. Her exams are somewhat difficult and require that you read the text as well as understand the notes from lecture. Old exams, if you can find them, are extremely helpful. Sometimes she asks things you would never expect.
She makes bio extremely easy, the way she grades is awesome. You literally only need an 85% in her class to get an A. Love Beattie!

her lecture material has almost been pointless for me. i will end up with an A or high B and it was very difficuklt to know what to read in that awful book! between the second exam and final she assigned 8 chapters i think, maybe more. i didnt like the quality of her teaching skills. knows her stuff though.

Beattie, despite what people say, is a great teacher. How she pronounces certain words can keep me entertained (listen for the word again). Other than that she expects you to read the book and she does her job very well. I learned a lot in this class.

Dr. Beattie is a great teacher. She wants students to learn and apply.  Also she is very nice. Those who complain about her being "hard" or "boring" should learn that college is about learning not being entertained.  Take her class, you will learn a lot.

Great teacher but a little dry. Read the textbook - according to Dr. Beattie, lectures are for clarifying textbook material, not to teach new stuff. Tests are about knowledge application, not just memorization. She wants you to LEARN not just regurgitate info. But an 85 is an A. She's really nice, especially one-on-one.
Good teacher. Her tests were fair and she lectures well. It's a challenging class but I'm glad I had her and not Dr. Cohen.
No Comments
Very old fashioned and difficult to talk to. Doesn't care about student well being. She is very by the book. I would avoid this professor.
Extremely bland and boring teacher and never ever seems to be happy. Always stern and her tests are extremely challenging. If it can be avoided i would not take this teacher

Beatie's tests are in depth, and about 1/6th of the material is not covered in class or in the book I think, although it does benefit you if you go to class, read over notes, and do the reading assingments. Doing all of the homework assignments helped me to keep a B in the class!

I took this class online. It was very difficult, even after reading all chapters and supplements assigned. The only grades that factored into the final grade were tests (there was no homework grade, etc.) so it was extremely hard to do well. I met with Beattie for assistance and she was of no help! You are tested over in-depth matieral not covered.
smoke show
Went to every single grueling 8 am class before the first test got a very low C. Skipped class until the second test got a B. My opinion of the uselessness of the teacher's lecture not the teacher.

Of coarse this class is going to be difficult, its considered the first bio class for any pre-professional track. Therefore, IT IS A WEED OUT CLASS. If you dont have to take it then dont take it, this is not a cake class. Be prepared to put in some effort.Read the text,go to class,study and you will do fine. An A is hard to do, but not impossible
Great professor, provides countless extra materials to assist in learning the subject matter, tests are straightforward and are drawn directly from the material

Hard class, if you didnt have a good background in bio or its been since freshmen year in high school since you learned DNA and cells and junk, do NOT fall behind on reading. The notes alone are not enough. Also do the homework yourself, dont copy someone elses. Learning the hw gives you 10-12 quest. on the test easy. Tests are difficult/tricky.
class is really actually interesting but the tests are difficult. its hard to get a good grade trying to just read over her notes. read the actual material she tells you to.
none

not as hard as everyone says. willing to help & answer questions in office hours especially if she can tell you're putting forth the effort. class is helpful & i would definately recommend reading the chapters she says to in the syllabus. staying caught up with the reading & coming prepared for class is my best advice

One of my favorite professors at UK.  She's crazy smart!  Even though she can be difficult at times, and sometimes boring, she really drives biology into your brain.  Tests can be hard, so make sure you study, and try to go to class at least once a week, it may be the difference between an A and a B, take my word for it.
She is really boring to listen to and her class is boring.  But, if you read the book and study for tests, she is not bad.  Her notes aren't very helpful though.
nice person

I do not remember anything from this class other than the DNA structure.  Dr. Beattie's lectures were boring and did not reflect material on the test. The weekly assignments were the only thing that kept me from having a terrible grade in this class.
honestly she isnt that bad of a teacher...i never went to class and just read the book before the test and easily got an A...notes are pointless though

Dr. Beattie is a very difficult teacher.  Her lectures are interesting and she is a good teacher. However, the tests are difficult and you must read and do Thinkwell.  I didn't get to read for the final and that caused me to get a B.

I liked her class it was very interesting. The best strategy was to make note cards. Overall she was very helpful and fair. However she did require ALOT of studying. I've aced the first two tests so she isn't very hard.

The course I took with Dr. Beattie was difficult.  I studied a lot for the exams, I even read all of the assigned reading from the book, but the tests were not that hard as long as you knew the information from the notes and the assigned reading.  I learned more in her course than I did in some of my upper level bio classes.

Although Dr. B was boring, this class was super easy so there for i liked it! i did AWFUL on all 3 exams and still passed w/ a high c ....
horrible

She's a very difficult teacher.  Her lectures only skim the surface of what is actually on the exams.  The exams are very detailed and require at least two weeks of extreme prepare work.  Definitely keep up with the reading.  She's a very nice lady but an impossible teacher.
It's a pretty tough class. I think the notes are not enough for the test, because some of the questions, i have never came across the terms in the book or notes.
I rarely went to class and I did fine, I would just follow her "questions to ponder before Exam" and just use common sense on the exams. She does give you more than some professors.
Very hard class..Lectures are very boring and very little she teaches is on the test..5 HW assignments, 3 tests, and 1 group project..DR BEATTIE DOES NOT CURVE!!!!

This class is super hard. There is a ton of material and not enough time to cover it all. Tests are over 10 chapters... no kidding! Ruth does help you out a bit with a lower grading scale and some extra credit. STUDY STUDY STUDY and you might get a B

She is a really nice teacher and I actually enjoyed he class.  She gives really good lectures and notes for you to take.  Everything she goes through in class is on the test, but she words the questions really tricky

I don't know where Beattie gets her bad reputation. I didn't study very hard and got an A, no sweat. It probably just comes down to how much you like biology. But in my opinion, this woman spoon feeds you (if you want someone who makes you work a little, take Bonner)

Even though her tests are hard, all you have to do it study and you will do well in her class. She is also very helpfull in her office hours and will answer any question you have. Going to class helps as well. Do the end of the chapter problems and the CD questions.

Dr Beattie is a very nice woman.. People who are talking bad about her probably dont even go to class or sleep through it. You just have to be prepared. Yes her tests are very tricky but still she will help anyone who needs it.  Its a tough class but it wasn't HORRIBLE like many people say.
GET OUT WHILE YOU STILL CAN!!!!!!

Horrible....she is a necessary evil for bio majors.  Tests are very hard and tricky.  Don't even bother studying for the final because she doesn't teach what will be on it.  She takes a lot of her tests questions from the CD that comes with the bio book.

This class was online.  She made the test too hard for a class that doesn't have a lecture.  Test are in the classroom unlike last semester where they were online and easier.  Too much reading.  Lesson learned: don't take this class online...way too hard.

Lets face it, Ruth was the most monotonous teacher in my history of education. 8am class is bad enough but when a female ben stien is teachign the calss consciousness is a near impossibility. the tests were very tough and it was very unclear waht to study.

I found her lectures really interesting. She give great examples and does nice visual representations on  the overhead. The class is hard, because hey, biology is just memorization so she has to spruce it up. If you fall alseep in this class maybe a bio major isn't for you? Read the book and use the CD with it! Help when studying for tests!! ; )
She will raise your grade a letter grade if you go bug her during office hours.

this is possibly the worst class i have ever taken.  this woman breezes through material and then doesn't include any of it on the nearly impossible tests. i studied for 12 hours for one of my tests and still had never seen half of the information on the test anywhere before and got a 66%.  she is a worthless teacher.

this is the worst class ive ever taken. it is soo boring and the tests are impossible.  although dr. beattie is extremly nice and has a somewhat dry sense of humor, it doesnt make up for the class.  STAY AWAAAAYYYYYYY and if u end up in her class, i feel for you.
she is the most uninteresting professor and seems to design the tests to make sur eyou cant get an A

She is a terrible instructor--do not take this class, and if you do bad, don't let this class weed you out and make you think you can't get into med school.  Her teaching is the reason that UK will never be a Top Ten school.

her lectures put you to sleep everyday, and her tests do not even come from lecture notes.  She asks the most random, insignificant facts on the tests, they do not reflect your understanding of lecture and it is extremely hard to get an A on any test STAY AWAY!!

She is strict but very helpful.  I missed a couple of classes in a row and I went to see her during office hours and she printed off her power point notes for me to study with.  Treat her with respect and she will do the same to you.

Seriously the worst teacher I have ever had.She is so boring and unclear in her lectures.Her tests are very difficult and the average is usually a D!She will tell you not to expect the test to come from the notes because she wants you to read the whole book,and fully comprehend it on your own because she sucks at explaining it.

She's cranky, and expects way too much work for a 100 level class. You have to go to class and read EVERYTHING in the textbook to be prepared for the exam. She thinks her class is the most important thing on your agenda and purposely grades hard. She also cannot keep her liberal viewpoints out of a BIOLOGY class. If you can avoid her, stay away.
No Comments

Ugh, what is there to say about this woman that has not already been said? I couldn't stand to attend her boring lectures, so I just read the book the night before the tests. I really dont know how I ended up with a B in that class.

Good teacher, but you MUST read the book, study notes, and use the online quizzes in order to do well. Grade scale is somewhat lenient.

Not an easy class if you are Science challenged. She does know her subject area, and is fairly good at teaching it. Tests are hard, but are easier if you buy the Thinkwell CD. Overall, she is a nice person, approachable, kinda looks like the trekkie kid that got beat up in highschool.

This class is very tough, but i think Dr. Beattie is a very good professor. You can't expect to do well in this class if you have no interest in biology or if u plan to pass the tests solely by going to class or just reading the text...it takes both. You actually have to work for your grade

I really like Dr. Beattie.  She asks some hard questions on the test but it just motivates you to work harder.  Her class is hard, but biology majors should get used to working hard. She is an excellent professor and is very helpful.

I LOVED bio before taking class,but I couldn't even watch Discovery Channel the summer after class.She has a GREAT sci/edu resume,but she doesn't ACTUALLY TRY during lectures.ONce,she said over half class got complex question wrong, she said"I won't go through it with you,you'll figure it out" LAZY!

Three tests, three assignments, one extra credit chance. I got a B-, a C+ on the first two tests, and did the extra credit and ended up with an A. She's SO boring. If you dont go to class your really should read the book, and look at someone's notes for tests...its rough. Good Luck...

HARD AS HELL!!!!
The tests are way too hard.  The questions are tricky to the point where you'd think she's evil.  Sorry if you have to have her!

She is very nice in person and she will help you if you talk to her.  She is one of the smartest people in the Biology Dept.  Don't judge the book by its cover and you will be fine!  I learned ton in this class.  Her exams are challanging!

lectures are for middle school kids, and exams are seriously the most impossible to even get a D on, shoot for a high F.  The final is over 40 chapters with 400 students in the room. She will ruin your gpa. She did mine. 151 is 8 or 9 am so u haveno chanc
I was forced to stop going to class after the first test first because her tests have nothing to do with lecture, and second just the sight of her put me in a bad mood. She is a horrible teacher.
She is the worst, most boring teacher I have ever had.  Her tests were very hard even though the material was not.  Stay away from this professer!!
she is unclear and her tests are impossible!
Class doesn't help.  Her tests are not straight forward at all.  She can't pronounce anything correctly and spells eukaryotes-"eucaryotes"
I didn't know hell could be room temperature.
Don't go to class-nothing she talks about will be on the test.  Tests are over about 10 chapters each time and the final covers about 40 chapters.  Take with Cohen.

Pay attention in class and try your hardest to find old exams.  They are hard to find.  Other than that I did not think this class was too bad, I studied the night before the tests and made B's on them.
do not take this course unless it is a requirement. it is terrible, lectures are over simplified, and tests are over complicated.
She's hard... especially for a level 100 course
She is pretty straight foward.  I don't know why people complain!

Very unclear in lecture, but I missed half the semester for being sick, and she helped me TREMENDOUSLY when it came to completing the course.
She is the worst teacher I have ever had!!  I don't think that anyone in my class passed.  Whatever you do, DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS!!!
Great professor, but tough. Need to be very attentive in class. Study for the final the day you start the class! It is extremely hard.

Wow!  No other profs teaching this course.  I got screwed as I was not able to avoid her.  Sit in the front and she may cut you some slack on late work!  Otherwise, take it at LCC if offered.

Inconsistent.  Tests are not hard, but they ares stupid.  Hard to study when the unimportant will be on the exam.

I don't know how I'm still a science major after this course... 13 A's in a class of over 200 students -- and no curve.  Tests cover rediculous amounts of book material, and very little that was actually covered in class... avoid this woman at all costs!
Dr. Beatie is hard, but fair.  She will teach you how to study
Hard course !

For a calc teacher, lectures were pretty clear and understandable. Especially for calc 3 being a conceptual and intuitive course, explanations were pretty okay. First 3 units were good, last unit not great explanations and not great differentiation between concepts. But pretty passable if you have a good TA, study, and complete webworks.

Dr Hader is the GOAT. I loved this class. He presented the content so clearly and intuitively by solving example problems and clearly explaining the "why we do this" of every concept. He has an awesome sense of humor, and class was always both educational and entertaining.
Had to take a weekly quiz but if you paid attention during class, you passed. AMAZING and I'm not good at math.

I am not great at math, and he made it really easy to understand and even fun. His class is the same every week, which I love, and it is very organized. You do have homework and it is worth a lot of your grade but if you attend the lecture, the homework is easy. He also publishes practice quizzes which are the same format as the test.

Mr. Hader is a good math teacher because he explains things clearly and helps students understand difficult ideas. He's patient, friendly, and always willing to answer questions. His positive attitude makes learning math easier and more enjoyable.

Prof. Hader is great! he's very kind and helpful in and outside of class as well as personable and considerate. He is strict when it comes to respect during lecture—no talking, but he is very polite even when asking students for silence. He wants to see his students pass and will do his best to make sure that happens!

He lectures more than hands-on stuff, which is a huge problem since it's a math class. If you don't understand something, good luck. Asking for help gets you a demeaning tone and 0 help. He is not qualified to be a teacher, especially at the college level. This is not a professor to have if you want to understand the material in class.

Dr.Hader was great! hes a very nice guy and very easy going about grades if you communicate with him, he explains everything super well and gives you alot of practive through homework. alot of work but you actually learn so its easy!

Hader is great and very approachable! I had him for MA 111, and the class was super easy because he explains the concepts very well. A little heavy on homework/participation assignments, but they are all done online and you get unlimited attempts. No tests, but quizzes every week, which are super easy if you keep up with the homework assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Love this guy. The best math teacher you could have probably. He genuinely cares about his students and he overall is just a really nice person who wants you to do well. Quizzes are over what we cover (rare apparently) and the capstones (midterms) are group things you do in a day of class. Easy course and amazing guy
Scott is a very relaxed and easygoing professor. There are a lot of worksheets and quizzes in this class but no exams. There are a lot of formulas and theories to memorize.

Textbook was online with all the practice quizzes. attendance is not mandatory but recommended. everything is online but the quizzes are needed to pass the class. Lots of homework, but very easy work.

reviews.comment: The textbook was online with all
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr Hader was so annoying! We'd ask him basic questions and he couldn't even answer them half the time. He introduced himself to my class saying he had never taught a math class before and it showed at times. He did take time to get to know his students, but if you struggle in math his class isn't one I'd recommend. He can be hard to follow.

His guided notes aren't 100% helpful if you really need help you have to ask him yourself or go to the Mathskeller. He's funny when he's teaching and really wants you to succeed. The practice exams are basically identical to the actual exams.

he was very rude and just did not care about his students and wanting to get to know them!! could not take this class if you have accommodations bc he does not really care about them at all? 0/10 recommend!

Wasn't amazing wasn't bad, he is caring and will re open things ass needed. you dont need to go to class just fill out your participation for the day. Every sections exams are very difficult but you have to take it. if you go to the study it will help a lot there are also retakes.He is a bit hard to follow in class you have to pay attention. v nice
Capstone is so much work. Stephens does a good job of organizing the course.

Goes kinda fast in lectures. HW is unique but easy. He also allows cheat sheets on Exams. The design project in this class is rough. I spent my entire Thanksgiving break on it and even more time before that. It'll be a good experience for senior design tho. Overall, not too hard of a class. The key is to take good, organized notes.
Pretty good and fair professor, but design ain't an easy class, so you'll have to lock in to do well.
Prof. doesn't care about his class or students at all. Is so full of himself and grades super hard just to look good in front of other professors.

Professor Soltis offered a great experience for learning the basics of HR. Having this class until 8:30 at night was painful, but he managed to keep us all engaged throughout class. After every class, we filled out a set of questions to give feedback on course improvements and material we wanted revisited for the final exam. Loved this class!

He doesn't assign homework which is nice overall, however it makes your exams and final project make up the majority of your final grade. He is a nice guy, however his lectures can be pretty boring since he spends most of the 2.5 hours reading from a plain PowerPoint. There was also a lack of guidance for the final project.

Professor Soltis is a great professor! He really knows MGT and HR, and I was worried a 2.5 hour class would be long and boring, but he made the lectures really interesting. His class is graded on very few points, but I liked having a final group debate over a final exam (his final exam is optional). Would take him again!

Soltis is a cool guy but the grading scale is very unfair. The only grades you get outside of exams and the final project is 10 "contribution points" which is pretty much just small assignments after class. I worked so hard in this class and still ended up with a B because of how unfairly the weighting of grades are.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: He's pretty nice. The class is really just based on the tests and the group project at the end. He doesn't take attendance but he does write-ups at the end of some classes that check randomly for attendance. There's no homework and the powerpoints are comprehensive so you really don't need to get the book.

Soltis really knows his stuff. His lectures are great and I enjoyed every single one of them. I am way more interested in HR now because of him. 320 is a good class, there is a final team debate at the end which was really fun. Only negative of Dr. Soltis is that he grades pretty tough so you need to know your stuff for the exams.

Attendance wasn't always mandatory. He assigns, "Write-ups," on random class days that count for attendance. If you miss some of these, he gives you an opportunity at the end of the semester to make some of those points up. Further, he is EXTREMELY critical about short answer questions on his exams and the final debate.

Dr. Soltis is a really cool guy. He was able to make HR a somewhat interesting topic. The class has a team debate project which ended up being pretty fun and interesting. His final exam is optional and is only enough to increase your grade by about 3%. He does a lot of research in this field so try to take this class with him if you get the chance.
the best prof I have had. The class is 2.5 hours but it seems to fly buy with him. review the slides and study for the tests you'll get an A. Great prof overall.

MGT 320 is one of the required classes to take with few professor options. Even thought it was Scott's first year teaching, he definitely knew what he was teaching. He was willing to listen and help students. Since it was presidential election season, he would always encourage students to watch the debates and incorporate them in class.

Like many others have said Ryan's Lectures are tough there not very easy to understand and he can ramble at times, But if you go to his office hours he is 10x better at walking you through stuff and explaining, he really does care about the students and he is very understanding and helpful with explaining things.

Sure, his lectures didnt exactly help, but the exams were not very hard. For the final, he pulled the exact problems from the midterms and changed the questions slightly, so it was easy to prepare for! He is really kind and doesn't mind practically giving you the answer during the exam, so ask for help. Do the iClickers, it's an A vs B difference.

Maclellan's teaching style in front of a large class can be rough, but if you go to his office hours or talk to him one-on-one he is very helpful and encouraging. He cares a lot and wants all his students to do well, and he knows he's more of a researcher than a teacher so he makes sure to make up for obvious gaps in understanding with exam curves.
He's really smart but he doesn't seem to care much about his classes. He explains everything in a way that only experts would understand and his favorite word is trivial lol.

There's not much I can add here that hasn't been said. Really nice guy and you can tell he cares about his students, but just not a good lecturer. I also had to teach myself most of the course material. The final & 3 exams are only worth 55% of your grade, and they are really dumbed down compared to the HWs. In general, I hate Iclicker & ExpertTA

My god it should be illegal to let this man teach. I did not learn a single thing from his lectures. I would be better off studying on my own during that time, but he made us come to class for the iClickers. 350 characters is not enough to describe my hatred. Be prepared to teach yourself the entire course, because this professor sure won't.

He is such a nice guy but a very lacking lecturer. He will include unnecessary information and is usually scatterbrained. He will adjust deadlines if he gets behind, which he will. Does iClicker for attendance. My best advice is to go to the Physics and Astronomy learning center and find good TA's to help explain the concepts.
The lectures were horrible and do not explain course content. Be prepared to teach yourself what you need to know for homework and tests.

Dr. Maclellan teaches his class by reading off slides that are not his (self-admitted), failing to do any examples, and struggling to find the correct answers to his own quizzes and exams. He also has a tendency to describe problems as trivial and skips through supporting work.

Overall was a kind person, but terrible at teaching the content of the course. Every lecture was him reading equations from slides exactly like the textbook. Every exam had typos and problems that he tried to fix mid-exam. Does not work out examples, but when he tried he usually got tripped up and told us he would come back to it later.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's really smart but terrible at teaching. In every exam we had at least 1 typo, and he would get confused by his own problems in class. His exam averages were usually below 60 and he graded on a normal scale (A: 90%, B: 80% etc.)

Dr. Maclellan is a really nice guy but a lacking professor, you can tell he puts minimal effort into teaching the class as he uses the textbook provided slides and doesnt write anything down during class. He explains everything like physics is second nature to us. The textbook is helpful but only to a certain extent.

Only does powerpoint slides in lecture and does not explain how to do everything. He would get his own questions wrong in lecture as well. He is clearly just here to do research for the university and does not care about the education of students.

I learned most of the content by reading the textbook/attending recitation because lectures were useless (I only went for iClicker points). I wouldn't have gotten an A without my TA. The lowest test score is dropped, not including the cumulative final. I would probably take Dr. MacLellan again just because his tests were graded pretty graciously.

He seems like a super nice guy and is insanely smart but is not a great professor. I completely had to teach myself all the material and wouldn't had gotten through it without the textbook or my amazing TA. You definitely can pass and do well, but if you have the chance take a different professor to make it easier on yourself.

MacLellan seems like a nice guy, but he's bad at teaching. He is often unprepared and unexcited about the lecture. He sometimes makes blatant conceptual mistakes in class, and his tests are often full of typos and broken questions. It doesn't seem like he even wants to be a teacher. Leave him to his research; it's evidently his strong suit.

He's a brilliant and nice guy, but teaches like we are grad students. Read the textbook. His notes and examples are based solely on it. His notes are unorganized, so pay attention to the lectures. He loves the word trivial; I like to count how many times he says it. Be sure you can teach yourself and stay ahead on the reading if you take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Whatever you do, don't take Physics II with this man. I have nothing against him as a person, actually on the contrary I think he's quite pleasant and a nice guy. In terms of teaching, he's terrible. You have to learn all the content from the book, and he makes the tests harder than all the other professors while not giving a curve.

He's way too smart to be teaching general physics, lectures are terrible and often make no sense as he flies through them. His teaching style is awful and makes it impossible to learn. He refuses to review any examples and says to get them out of the textbook. When he does work out problems 90% of the time he makes a mistake or gets it all wrong.

I go into lecture, sit there for an hour, and leave with even less knowledge than I had when I entered. MacLellan uses slides provided by the textbook and adds nothing to them. Exam questions come from practice exams and recitation worksheets and are very different from in-class examples.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor McLellan is not good at teaching primarily because it sounds like he's talking to a room of PhD students. I could not grasp 90% of what he was trying to teach. This is the first college class I've gotten a private tutor for and still struggled.

he is a really cool and smart guy. I talked to him about some of the research he was involved in and he is easy to talk to and nice he is just not a great teacher. If you do have him I would say make sure you be responsible and just read out of the textbook a little everyday and do practice problems. Exams look like recitation sheets.
Honestly the material isn't that hard. Just teach yourself with the free textbook and you'll be fine. He doesn't require you to show up to lectures or recitation which is a huge plus.

do not take under ANY circumstances. lectures are very unorganized and he has hard to read notes that do not relate to the homework and the homework is nothing like exams. his demonstrations fail to work most of the time and he makes mistakes on every exam. during the final he continued to make corrections after some students turned it in. 0/5
Lectures are pointless. You're better off with the textbook and someone to ask questions to. Recitations may be worth it depending of the TA.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The course material is intriguing, but the class was extremely disorganized. The professor's notes are alright at best. The tests are brutal because very few questions look like anything you see in class. The homework was typical online homework, and recitations served little purpose. Just one of those classes you have to get through.

Tough class in the first place. Lectures all blended together and he assumes we already know more than we do. He is super helpful in office hours, but wish he would better explain the content with terminology students can understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Lecture notes are worthless. Finishes lecture material with half the class left and scribbles illegible and irrelevant examples on the overhead with markers. Ten question exam worth 100 points with 2 of the questions worth 30 points a piece. Take him if you feel like teaching yourself physics even though he gets paid to.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Honestly, great guy. He's very funny but didn't quite understand that he was teaching earthquakes and volcanos to a room of mainly business majors that needed the credit for UK core. There were many times where the whole class was lost on an assignment and the exams are tough. If you are a geology major, you will love this class.
Idk why it won't let me put this, but I had Prof. Thigpen for EES 150, not 511. Anyway, I loved his lectures and he was a SUPER easy grader.
Excellent professor! Has some kind of obsession with name brand Texas toast though, not sure what that's about.
Good professor, tough class. Exams are difficult with only a small number of questions, so missing a few can mean the difference between an 100% or 60%.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Exams are multiple choice, drops lowest midterm of the three (1st is hardest), attendance mandatory but can be joined through echo 360, he curved our final by 10 points, hws were on expert ta,test prep questions were a good resource, gives u a page to write ur own formulas on for exams

He is very good with his lectures. It would be good to go over his notes for important equations and simplify them before the exams. I found the exams hard because Physics 2 is hard in general, but I wish you could get partial credit for getting close to the correct answer. Other than that, he is very friendly and helpful. Go to his office hours.

His lectures made me feel like i looked up a video on YouTube video on each topic in short. Great at introducing topics and answering questions, always has a smile. Only downside is he goes in depth for proofs instead of going through practice problems for that equation.

I took this in the Spring of 25. Dr. Sanders is a great teacher that actually takes the time to explain concepts. Lectures are recorded and can be accessed online through Canvas. He also does a lot of in class demonstrations to help students visualize concepts. I would definitely try to take his class if you are looking to take Physics II.

Sanders is a pretty good professor, lectures are all accessible online through Echo360, and participation can be done online. The lectures were pretty clear and he's very helpful during office hours. Tests weren't overly difficult either, and got curved if needed.

Overall easy class, pretty interesting at some points. Some of the lectures could have ended within 20 min, but he goes back over himself to expand to 50 so that wasn't my favorite. Overall though good class and amazing professor. Super understanding and creative.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: He is overall a nice guy, easy class. He does kinda just repeat the same thing all lecture for 50 minutes instead of just cutting class early. Class is pretty easy though and sometimes interesting. Work does begin to just feel like busy work, but if you just do it as your supposed to there is no way to do bad if you give effort.

Only take this class if you are a first semester freshman or an arts/creativity major. Content is not that hard but attendance matters SO MUCH and there is an insane amount of homework. Class is mostly freshman architecture majors anyway.

I had him for LA studio he does a pretty good job. Deadlines are not really enforced much, but I recommend keeping up as much as possible since once behind its hard to catch up. Doesn't take attendance but it's studio so you really need to be there a good amount to know what is happening.
Amazing instructor, he really helps you gain creativity and important life skills.
There are mandatory group  presentations every Friday, but overall class is super easy. You have to meet with your group weekly in your own time.

This class is an easy A, but can be a little difficult if you're actually trying to learn something from it and not just get out of it as fast as possible. Ryan is a good professor and cares about his students! Just sometimes isn't the best with being specific about expectations and feedback. This doesn't matter though if you just want an A.

I would highly recommend this class with Ryan. On Mon we go over information, Wed class is online and we have a guest speaker, every Fri you have a super super chill presentation with your group in front of a small group and your TA. The low on canvas for the presentation below 90%. You are graded on discussion posts, attendance, and presentations.
Really laid back. Easy to pass, not a lot of work.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: He is a great teacher and he is willing to help you in any way that he can. I recommend taking his class if you need and easy class.
Ryan was an excellent teacher. You can tell he loves what he does, and he really cares about his students' success.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Hargrove is a great professor! You can tell he really loves what he's teaching about, but most of the people in his class are just there for an easy A so I think that kind of hurts the overall feel of the class. It's really interesting and the final project actually isn't as bad as it seems.

Professor Hargrove is awesome. He cares about students doing well and becoming more creative individuals. You have to show up for class, but if you show up and put effort into the 5 mini projects and one final project, you will have an A. But you have to go to class!

He is a very nice guy and obviously very knowledgeable but he didn't do a very good job at explaining the material and tended to gloss over important topics. I believe he said this was his first year teaching so hopefully with more experience he will improve.
no comment.

He is very smart and knowledgable about engineering things, but when it comes to chemistry, he doesn't know how to explain. He will skip through practice problems, or when he does them, he will do them wrong and then not realize until the very end then skip past them. He doesn't write his own slides so he seems surprised at what's on them.

I had to teach myself everything during this class. Did not work through any example problems, his explanations of concepts were made to be way more confusing that they actually were. Not quick at answering emails, and does not understand any questions you ask him. Take anyone else but him!

Avoid at all costs tbh. He is incredibly smart, but not fit to be a professor yet. He is too inexperienced, and inadvertently flaunts his intelligence by explaining things in abstract or unconventional ways. The slides include plenty of material he says you don't need, yet it's like he has no idea what he will be teaching. Won't email you back.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He seems like a great guy...but not a good teacher at all. He does not work out problems at all and assumes that everyone understands without explaining anything. You have to teach yourself everything so be prepared, take anyone else if you can. His lectures were a waste of time and I could learn more from youtube videos online.

It is very clear that he does not even attempt to look at the slides before class. It really is like we're learning along with him. He rambles a lot, which means we barely cover what we need to before the exams. When doing practice exams and looking at the results, there is feedback that literally just restates the question without any real help.

Dr. Cheng can never focus on a topic for more than a few seconds in lecture. He will not completely work problems out and will just say everyone gets it. Also, he gets the examples or iclicker problems wrong 25% of the time. I have had to teach myself literally everything that wasn't common sense in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Cheng is probably a great guy, but his teaching leaves a lot to be desired. He rushes through the lecture, and instead of working completely through 1 or 2 problems of whatever it is you're learning at the time, he halfway works through them and assumes everyone gets it. Be prepared to teach yourself everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Assumes that students know how to code before coming to this class. Only graded on 5 presentations and attendence. Lecures sound like they are read off a script and he can't answer questions. Doesn't give you enough time for large presentations and doesn't grade off rubric he gives. Prime example of why researchers should not be professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He assumes that students know everything about coding before going into this class. Only graded on 5 presentations and attendence. His lectures sound like they are read off a script and he can't answer questions. Doesn't grade off the rubric. Tries to find ways to take off points on presentations. Prime example of why researchers should not teach.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor is a tough grader. However,an A is possible if you put the work in. Every lecture is SO valuable and you are actually learning things that matter for the industry. You just need to make sure you ask him a lot of questions, show up to class and pay attention, and be prepared for your presentations. Also, tie into Business perspective!

Professor Smith fails to grade off of the rubric he provides. He also has his class based on five presentations, and he gives you direct criticism in front of the whole class expecting that to help you instead of returning a rubric to you. He expects everyone to know mostly everything about business before his class. Good luck with this class...

Samuel Zaruba is an extremely difficult grader and provides limited feedback. This would be okay if he offered a clear idea of what he wanted for the assignments but he does not. He expects you to understand python at an intermediate level before even beginning the class, so good luck. Prime example of why researchers should not be lecturers.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was rough. I don't blame the professor, but he often seemed disengaged and intimidating. The course assumes prior knowledge of Python/R, which many students don't have, making it difficult. While presentation-heavy and challenging, I still appreciated the skills and concepts I learned.

I had an A going into the last presentation. I did the last presentation, and got my grade back for that presentation and I still had an A on canvas and I was expecting to receive an A because I had been to every class. Until a week later, he changes my last presentation grade to a low B so now I got a B for the semester. What a joke
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Zaruba Smith's entire class grade is based off 5 presentations (4 of which are group projects). They aren't too hard but he is super unclear about what he's looking for. He never gives anyone an A+ on presentations and doesn't provide feedback. The rubric in the syllabus is arbitrary. He grades overly hard for not being able to teach properly.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The whole class was graded on group presentations that he would grade very strict. Even though he would not post instructions until a couple days before the presentation (We were supposed to work on these for 2+ weeks). After you present he gives very little feedback onto the grade you received.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: No one in the class ever knew what was going on and if you ask him a question he was no help. This class is strictly graded on presentations and only that (which he grades hard), which there is no actual rubric or instruction for these. He does not understand that students have no coding experience. Do not reccomend!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor does not understand that students do not have as in depth knowledge around this class's core subjects and topics as much as he does. Vaguely explains expectations. Questions asked seemed to be a burden. Very smart guy but too smart for his own good making him not too good at teaching the subjects. 4 group presentations! 1 individual!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Robin obviously wants the best for everyone in her classes, however there was just a ton of busy work (some of which took hours to complete) and I didn't love the way the class was laid out. She taught two lectures all semester, the other classes were just guest speakers, which was a definite change of pace.
She will get you connected outside of class and truly cares for you.

This class could've easily been on zoom considering our guest speakers were primarily on zoom. I was initially excited to take the class but was disappointed and assignments were not explained well in class whatsoever. 
If you have a question/comment or concern, don't email her, you won't get a response. Could be a fun class with a diff prof.

Dr. Robin is one of the best professors. She cares so deeply about her students and she also makes her class fun. EQM106 is mostly group assignments. There are midterm and final assignments but they're easy if you make the time for them. She takes attendance at the beginning of each class.

I had her for EQM 106. She is a great resource to have. she strives for greatness and pushes you to do the same. You get out what you put into this class. The assignments are not helpful but what she says is. Make sure you make a good impression.
Really liked Prof. Robin. Class wasnt always my favorite content, but she still made it interesting and engaging. Make sure you do your pre class readings and assignments and youll do just fine :)
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Group projects

reviews.comment: Be prepared, she does not accept late work. I had to take my roommate to the ER on the day an assignment was due. I spent several hours there, and when I was unable to submit the assignment and tried to explain this to Dr. Sethi, she said that she would not accept late work under any circumstances.

She is probably one of the worst professors I have had. She does not care about your life outside of college and says attendance isn't mandatory but there are random assigned grades. Makes everyone super stressed out and always says to read and will wait all of class until someone answeres.
Probably the worst professor that I have ever had. If you can avoid her do it at all costs. Absolutely impossible to work with and power trips at any moment she can. She needs to be fired.

I have never felt the need to actually “rate” a professor, but felt obligated to share my experience so future students don't have to suffer with her. She refuses any kind of late work, I had to get the ombudsman office involved because she denied an assignment I missed despite having documentation from the university. One experience of many. AVOID

The worst professor in the KHP department. “Did you all read” constantly asked with a condescending tone. No time for group projects even though she promised it. Too many boring guest speakers. Doesn't teach at all. Relies on textbook and guests. No attendance but she will throw pop quizzes on you so that will affect your grade. Avoid if you can
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Gets in her feelings a lot because people show no interest in global sports and doesn't try to get us interested she just gets in her feelings and starts giving pop quizzes. Too many guest speakers. Project were easy group projects were easy. It's a easy class she just gets her in feeling and take it out on the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: SHE WAS AWFUL AVOID AT ALL COST!!! Very rude when you disagree with her forces her political opinions down your throat. She cares about you as a person but when it comes to the course material she will only teacher her opinion. Its easy to pass if you act like you agree with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I was not a fan of this professor. I didn't receive any feedback on any assignment. Also, she is the slowest grader. I hadn't received assignment grades until months later.
Great teacher

Pros: kind, respectful, made students feel included/comfortable to share opinions. BUT: constantly canceled class extremely last minute- (received messages way to class, when seated, and after class started). She was on time to class maybe 3 times all semester. She is not clear in instructions nor knows any American cultural. Does not answer emails

She was nice but lectures were really awkward. She cancelled class constantly and I feel like I learned absolutely nothing in this course. Assignments didn't correlate with the content at all but the class was easy

I hated this class. I love learning about gender and pop culture, so I thought this would be the class for me. Instead, lecture was awkward and disjointed, and class was always cancelled, genuinely to the detriment of the students. She literally said she doesn't know pop culture, so why teach the class? If you don't want to learn, take the class.
I really liked Mrs. Sharma she was really nice and you could tell she cared about her students a lot. Her class was really easy and I recommend taking her.
Confusing content, but as long as you do it youll be fine
Unclear criteria throughout course Very unprepared Don't need to pay attention to lectures Very understanding, just also extremely unprepared
Ms. Sharma is one of the best professors I've had. Super sweet and she's really understanding and caring when it comes to questions and concerns. Highly recommend.

Snehal was a very nice person, and SUPER lenient. Sometimes it could be hard to understand her and what exactly was needed to do on an assignment, but if you reached out to her she was more than happy to explain it more clearly and answer any questions. Do the work, and you'll be fine!

His lectures are  boring, but he is a nice professor and truly does anything for a student. He has a sense of humor and is always willing to hear you out. Exams are easy but long. HE WILL GIVE YOU PARTIAL CREDIT IF YOU EXPLAIN WHY YOU CHOSE AN ANSWER!! He gives real life advice that is useful not just memorize and forget type of info.
Best professor I have ever had without a doubt. He is so funny and makes class so fun!

professor jonathan shepherd is good on teaching and a cool guy, you won't regret having class with him.
*Gives a lot of free points and won't make you have a bad grade

I was never great at anything economics-related and worried about getting a good grade coming into the class, I've gotten A's on both exams. He gives a bunch of extra credit and gives you great grades as long as you try- even if it may be wrong. He understands that most of us are really busy. Only down sides are that the lectures are boring.

He was a really fair grader. Even when I felt like I didn't know anything, I still made good grades on the exams. He always had fun extra credit on the exams like "tell me something interesting" to boost your grade.

Shepherd is truly a great professor. While the class content can get a bit difficult at times, he knows this and tries to make sure you really understand what is being discussed. He's also flexible and relatable. He is really an expert in his field and knows what he's talking about.

He is so charming and good looking it is so hard to not pay attention in class. He is a genuinely interesting and funny guy, and while the subject matter can be confusing at times, he is willing to help you understand. Great guy.

GOAT! Practice exams are almost identical to real exams, usually just with different numbers. Extra credit on every exam. Unlimited attempts on homework. His lectures sometimes get super complicated but you know it won't be on the exam so it's not really a big deal. If you study his practice exams and slides you will get an A.

Genuinely my favorite UK professor so far. You can really tell he genuinely cares about his students, he makes calculus seem like common sense. He does like to go off topic but personally I love professors like that, he has a lot of personality and makes funny jokes.

BEST MATH TEACHER I'VE HAD. Exams are just like the practice tests. His lectures can be a little off topic but if you do good on the exams you don't even have to go to class. I would just do a lot of practice using the practice exams and get typically around a 95!

He is very nice. He teaches everything in terms of science and relates math to how it is actually useful in the real world (science field) in all his lectures, doesn't make it boring at all. There is Echo 360. His exams are easy as they ALL look exactly like the practice exams. He even includes extra credit questions same from practice exams.

He is a very kind and passionate guy, and he knows what he is talking about. He does add a lot of extra unimportant information while explaining certain concepts, but uses it to give students a clearer understanding. Exams are really easy and are simple to study for, since he gives practice exams that are usually identical.
I absolutely love his energy, and he explains the concepts better than any teacher or professor that I have ever had!

He is super sweet. At first it is confusing what he is talking about, but after the first test you realize he tries to make things super simple and the practice tests are actually exactly the same as the real test, besides the numbers. It is a lot of time during the week, but overall he is so sweet and helpful!!

I love the professor. He's funny, kind, and truly wants to see you succeed. Tbh he does sometimes break the topic down to the point where it becomes too much and confusing, but if you say something, he fixes his methods to want the class to like. The test looks JUST like the study guide, so pay attention and study.

I don't know how anyone could give him lower than a 4. You have 2 HWs/week, 1 has unlimited attempts. His practice exams are literally the exact same as his real exams just with different numbers or similar concepts. Every exam has extra credit. He always comes to class full of energy/positivity and goes around the room trying to learn names
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Jack Schmidt is a God send. His exams are identical to the practice exams. The homework is genuinly impossible sometimes, but nothing that your TA or the mathskeller cant explain. Each exam has 10 extra bonus points which came in clutch, so just memorize the practice exams and you will for sure get an A.

Dr. Schmidt is an incredible professor. He cares for his students and wants everyone to learn and succeed. His tests are exactly like practice exams so just practice those and you will be fine. He is not the greatest lecturer and it can be challenging to learn in the classroom but if you just ask questions and talk with him after class he can help

Personally I found the material to not be challenging but that was not because of this professor. I found myself having to explain topics to other students because of the frankly awkward way he teaches. He breaks topics down into TOO many steps to the point where it begins to become confusing. Personally I don't recomend his class.
This teacher goes on tangents and gets off track. What he talks in class about isn't related to the tests or homework at all
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nice and easy class

I don't understand why he has bad ratings, Jack Schmidt is a legend! His math course is primarily focused on STEM majors, So he'll frequently give small tidbits of info that are helpful to those majors. Extremely understanding of student circumstances, and his office hours are a great tool. 11/10 would take again.
Great guy and doesn't overcomplicate anything. Exams are very similar to practice exams. Final was lowkey hard for no reason.
He is super nice and tries to make math as simple as possible. If you are looking for an easy course with a great professor, I recommend it!

Jack is one of the best professors at UK. His practice exams are identical to the actual exams, with just number changes. I had him at 8am and it was easy to follow along and stay engaged with him so early in the morning. He is great at explaining topics, sometimes he gets off on tangents, but they're always very interesting.
Horrible at explaining topics. Don't take this class with this instructor if you want to have a chance at understanding the course material.

If you're looking for an easy calc class to meet your requirements, Jack is the one to take. He is the sweetest guy, but an okay prof. His practice exams are identical to the real exam. He doesn't take attendance, so as long as you can memorize the practice exams before the real exam, then the class is cake. I never got less than 104% on an exam!

I had Jack for 137 and 138 and he was amazing! He truly cares about his students and wants us all to excel in his classes. He makes his exam very similar to the practice exams, which makes them really easy to study for, + 10 extra credit. He also explains hard topics in depth, so you can understand what you are doing and why. I 100% recommend him.

Dr. Schmidt is a very understanding professor who is trying to make the life of a college student enjoyable. He has a very fun personality and explains Calculus 2 in a way that is very easy to understand. His practice exams are very similar to the real exams (which have extra credit questions at the end), and homework is very doable.

Professor Schmidt is a fun and engaging teacher who makes complex math concepts easy to understand. Attend lectures, use the free textbook, and try Unstuck AI for study prep - you'll cruise to an A in this class.
clearly conveys material i would def recommend taking if you need extra help or explanation

By far the easiest class I have taken. He gives lots of examples and makes sure that everyone understands. The exams are practically the exact same as the practice exams, so if you can do everything on the practice exams, then the real exams will be a breeze. He doesn't take attendance, but you should try to go to class so you don't get confused.
Great professor! Really cares about his students and makes learning math fun and interesting.

Amazing professor, made the 8AM class feel like a breeze. However, simply because this is a math class and everything builds off of what you learned the previous day, attendance is required. He's great with teaching and even better with communicating with you. 100% would take another class of his.

Dr. Schmidt is one of the best mathematics professors I have ever had. His lectures are not boring at all. I didn't realize how much I liked math until I had him. He presents the content extremely well and is very helpful when you ask him questions.
very energetic guy and a funny dude all around. He uses examples that are easy to understand. Pop quiz every lecture with no questions to take attendance. Would recommend

Dr. Schmidt is the best professor you can take for a calculus credit. The practice exams are almost identical to the real, so just study that and the class is cake. He gives huge extra credit which helps my grade out so much, I have over a 100%. TAKE HIS COURSE!!

Tests were super easy and all had 10 extra credit points. Had quizzes every thursday in recitation but 2 extra credit points were on those as well. Overall super easy as long as you did the practice exams before the exam.

Professor Schmidt is a great professor! He's pretty funny in class and is great at explaining things. He is always there to offer help to anyone who needs it. He's always in Mathskeller as well if you need any extra help!
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I really like Dr. Schmidt, math has never been my strong suit but he explained things really well and I never went into a test not feeling prepared. your grade will mostly depend on 4 exams though, but if you go to class and do the homework he assigns twice a week you will be fine.

This is the best math professor I've EVER had. He connects the math you're doing with real life examples. I recommend attending lecture as much as you can. I slept through many lectures on accident so I got a little behind. However if you attend all of them, take notes, & ask questions you'll be golden. He's an enjoyable & funny person. TAKE THIS!

Mr. Schmidt is a great teacher.  His only downfall is his grading scale.  I'll break it down, throughout the semester you have 10 topics.  You have 5 small quizzes per topic and 2-3 quizzes a week,  you have to get an 80 or higher on 2/5 of the quizzes to complete that topic.  Each topic you don't complete is -10 pts to your overall grade.
He is the absolute Goat and Top G. My man knows what he's talking about and doing. I would 100% recommend him for sure.

He made this class very easy to understand and was very helpful when it came to difficult topics. I was retaking this class, and he was much easier than my prior professor. I would 100% recommend taking him for MA 137/138 and any other math class he teaches very well.

I would 100% recommend taking Professor Jack Schmidt for MA 110. This class is 77% tests and he gives practice tests that are just like the actual tests so the tests were super easy. I really enjoyed this class and it is an easy A if you do your homework which is 5 questions, twice a week and get good grades on the tests.

he is very funny and engaging in class. he wants to help you learn and provides a lot of examples and how to do the homework. attendance is simply logging onto a website and thats it, so you dont really have to go to class. exams are exactly like the practice exams. he is very funny and a good teacher.

I didn't really like Jack's lectures. He explains EVERYTHING which can be really helpful or sometimes really not. One sec we were doing literal addition and next thing you know ur doing logs and u've already tuned out because of the 1st grade math you were doing before. Nontheless, this class was v easy and exams are the same as the practice tests.

He is a very good professor and cares about his students and their understanding even when teaching in a large lecture hall. He made calculus understandable (and calculus was very hard for me to understand in high school). I would definitely take his class again.

He seems like a genuine guy, but his class was just not set up in a way that could bring the fullest potential of an education. I felt prepared for calculus after, but the homework is unbearably hard and there are some assignments along the way that felt more like busy work than actually being helpful.
Dr. Jack is awesome, is very easy to understand his classes, and he is very cute.

One of the main issues I had with the course was the grading scale. You need all 10 standards at a 10/10 to receive an A. Personally I think it should be 9/10, because that's a 90%. I wish the textbook was an actual step-by-step textbook and not only practice problems, and the slides are confusing out of context. Nice guy who likes space though!

The check marks methods is one of the most stupid things I have ever seen. Does not matter if you get a 19/20, you gonna fail because you are being graded based on a TA determining if he believes you demonstrate proficiency or not. Unfair and Stupid
The grading method is RIDICULOUS. Extremely confusing and trust me you wont learn anything from him. He literally does not know how to teach.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class gives a great chance to learn material to prepare you for calculus without having to worry about grades. All you have to do is complete assignments along the way and then at the end of the course you will have so many chances to redeem checkmarks and get an A, allowing you to skip out on the final and finish the class a few weeks early.

Dr. Schmidt's class was by no means difficult and as someone who had taken Pre-Cal before, I found the course to be very straightforward. The class required little effort (except on quizzes and tests) as the grading system is based on check marks as opposed to actual number grades. I would recommend the course for anyone needing Pre-Cal prep.
Do not hesitate to take his class, one of the best classes and he is an amazing person! His class isn't easy but with his help, you can definitely pass with an A.

He is a very good professor. There is homework everyday but it is the most simple homework and it is very easy to do because of his teaching. He is always happy to help and very kind. Exams were very easy too. I took this class online because he was utilizing zoom due to COVID.

Dr. Schmidt is 100% the most caring and understanding professor I've ever had. He explains things super slowly and clearly which was so helpful for me. MA113 is a very difficult course, but Schmidt will do anything to help his students succeed. I 100% recommend signing up for his course if you need this credit. No other professor compares.

Schmidt was a terrible professor. He always explained things in the most complicated way, when in reality half the work could be done on a calculator. The practice exams are almost identical to the real exams so study those and learn how to do everything on the calculator and you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took Schmidts class in the spring, and it was a breeze before and after moving online. I think this was the first ever math class I was confident in what I knew. Id definitely rework problems outside of class however, as lectures arent very helpful unless you take additional time to practice. Attending recitation is very helpful as well.

There is a lot of WebWork, but each assignment takes less than 15 minutes. Quizzes are fairly easy if you took notes in class. Exams are cake if you know how to do the practice exam. This class is easier than my Honors Pre-calculus class in highschool. Don't sweat this class.

I really enjoyed his class, makes it easy to understand and get an A! Grades are weighted heavier on homework than exams, which is nice if you are a hard worker. The homework also never takes more than 15 minutes! I would definitely recommend taking him!

Nicest professor I had all semester. I keep seeing bad reviews on his page but all you have to do is take notes and crack open the textbook once in a while. Study guides are helpful and I highly recommend taking the practice problems before the test. If you do that you'll get an A, no sweat.
He made material very easy to understand and most exam questions are variations of the online textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The homework wasn't bad. It was counted for completion. The actual class was awful. He explained math in such a complex form when the problems could be solved much simpler. He didn't explain anything well and never seemed to answer questions correctly. He just left you more confused. I ended up spending almost everyday in the math help center

I really had no issues with Jack. He is very caring and accessible. However, his lectures are very information heavy, and sometimes he forgets to teach formulas for problems hes working out. The textbook isnt required, but the test questions come directly from it. Do the work and get a good TA and the lowest youll have is a B.

He is so nice and makes class fun. He also lets you out early a lot. Great teacher and makes thing easy to understand. However, the TAs for this class aren't the best in the world, but it didn't make a difference in my grade.

Jack is a goofy sweet guy and I really enjoyed his class. The lowest grade I got on an exam was a 95 and he gives you exactly want he will be testing on for exams in his practice exams. If you don't show up to class you will probably get lost and the homework is stupid and isn't completely consistent with what is covered in class but it's doable.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: In the beginning of the semester his teaching style was very hard to understand and the lectures seemed very unorganized. However, his teaching recently has been very easy to understand and he is very willing to answer questions and do homework questions on the board. He is also super nice and genuinely cares for his students success

He is really nice IF you get to know him and will root for your success but seriously avoid this class at all costs. His teaching style takes a long time to warm up to. I ended up getting an A but after studying for literally 24 hours for one of his 20 question exams, also do not skip the homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Unorganized
Jack Schmidt is a nice guy, but multiple times in the semester I had to teach myself the content, and ask myself when were we taught this. This class seems very unorganized.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Schimidt is a nice guy but his class is so unorganized. He does extremely easy stuff in lecture then extremely hard stuff on the homework and on the exam there are words and things that he never covered. It's just a cluster and you never know what to expect for the exams. Wouldn't take it again with him.

Prof. Schimidt in my opinion runs his lectures and class in an uninformed and unorganized fashion. As a student of this class, I find that going into the exams was not prepared clearly for the material that was put on this exam. Also, Prof. Schmidt does not seem very caring for his students, he seems more worried about lecturing. DO NOT TAKE

Professor Schmidt cares about his students as long as you show interest in his class. Listens to students feedback and tries to improve. Lots of homework just like every other MA109 course. Always tries to answer questions until you understand it. Sometimes gives confusing explanations but once you adjust to his style its fine.

Jack is a nice guy, he cares about his students, but -and this is a big but- he's a nut job. He teaches a lot effectively but with his own methods that apparently are secrets they only teach to engineers. One of his favorite quotes is "I think this is hard" which I don't like to hear a teacher say. Also it looks like he only owns one shirt.
"adding is hard" -Jack Schmidt
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: If you want to teach yourself the content, take this class. You don't really use the textbook in class but if you want to actually learn anything it is a must have. He teaches content after the homework is due to "confirm you understand the material". Not good at explaining and I usually leave more confused than I come in.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: absolutely awful.

Jack showed compassion in teaching MA 322 to all of us. He connected the content back to real world applications, even asking us our majors to come up with ways to connect it back. He was an excellent teacher and always made sure that we concretely knew the content before going into the exam. If you're gonna take Matrix at UK, take it with Jack.

Jack Schmidt is the real deal. If you're thinking about taking MA322 at UK and are wondering whose class you should take then look no further. Your friends will hate you and your haters will want to be you. He actually cares about and respects his students, to the point that he will shape the content to the majors of his students. 10/10 what a God.
Doesn't explain things fully and kinda makes it harder for you to understand if you dont know how to do the first step in the problem. Teaches the material AFTER you had just taken the exam

Schmidt likes to "teach math as a language" it doesn't make any sense to me the way he teaches it. He's a good guy his teaching just doesn't make sense most of the exams you should be okay on though because they are multiple choice but its still kind of hard also go to class for the reef stuff I still don't know if it goes towards our grade.

He uses his own made up ways of teaching concepts which makes things more complicated than they need to be. Mostly he just made me more confused. However, he is very nice and will meet w you one on one and this sometimes did help me get it at least a little. Final was easier than exams, which I always did worse on than I thought I would
He is very easy to understand in lecture and just an all around kind guy. He knows when we need more guidance and goes the extra mile to help
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Amazing lectures--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: An excellent professor. He teaches well, is entertaining, and is kind of like a crazy dad figure. Me and my roomie called him Schmidty (not to his face) because hes just such a cool person and we loved his lectures. Going to class is essential to understanding whats going on.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Jack is top 5 one of the worst professors I've had. At the time, I was a transfer student at UK when I took the class. I was a junior taking MA 109. He was a nice guy, awful professor. He had a bizarre way of grading for the class making the class weigh heavy on exams. If you didn't do well on exams, bad grade for class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Schmidt is a great professor! He's pretty funny in class so he makes the 8 AM bearable. He's great at explaining things and is always there to offer help to anyone who needs it. He's always in Mathskeller as well if you need any extra help.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Schmidt is an okay professor. His teaching style is different and can be hard to get used to. He makes most things way harder than they actually are.
