I had to go to the study a lot so that I could understand what we did in class. If you're good at math you'll be fine. If not, you might need to reteach yourself or get outside help. He's not too bad

Professor Schmidt is a decent teacher - some of his metaphors might not be understood by everybody in the class, but if you get past that, he knows halfway decently how to teach. If you get an excellent TA, you'll have an awesome time with this class. Not particularly difficult, but you should make an effort of some type to see your grade improve.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I thought he was great! He teaches things differently, but he shows you ways to solve problems that continue to work throughout this course and the next. He's funny, a little sassy and quirky, but everything you'd expect from a math professor. There is a lot of online homework, but that's the same for every section.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great teacher. Easy grader. Would definitely take another class with him.
Uses short hand that makes sense to him but no one else. He is very confusing and truly does not care if you understand or not.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Study the practice exams hard for 2 days and you will make A's. For the homework use mathway and you will be golden. This is a very good choice for MA 109, he is a goober but makes class go by faster.

This professor is not clear and jumps from topic to topic and doesn't care if the class gets it he just keeps moving on. Need to ask a question? You'll get a metaphor that has nothing to do with math and be left confused.

The class itself is very simple with the way he teaches. You will get the hang of what we learn. We have little homework. Do the review quizzes and check your answers the tests are basically identical. He is very quirky but you get used to it. He may rush a little but in the end, you will be fine. His class is more understandable than  other ones.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: He does not explain very well and makes everything more confusing than it has to be. He is not helpful at all with students, and when we ask questions he says he does not understand the question and just moves on.
His examples in class made no sense and most of the time had nothing to do with the homework

Go to class. Do the online homework in class. Study with his given study guides or previous tests a couple of days before the exam and you should be okay. Homework is easy, you get unlimited tries to attempt problems. DO the homework and any extra credit given.
He is not helpful at all.

Mr. Schmidt gets a lot of undeserved critique.  What you need to know is that he is quirky and makes simple problems quite complex.  This means that YOU have to be active in your learning and ask questions and pay close attention.  My MA109 class was filled with kids who spent the class time shopping online and consequently got bad grades.

Try to avoid getting this professor. He does not teach the material, his "notes" that he writes on the board make 0 sense. He overcomplicates the work and makes it impossible to figure out. You will definitely need a tutor or to go to the study with this professor.
Super confusing, makes easy things hard.I payed attention in class everyday but to no avail. i had to teach myself the content outside of class.

Schmidt isn't the worst professor out there, but you could definitely find someone better. He's very quirky. His lectures aren't terribly confusing, but you have to ask questions if you don't understand something. Kind of disorganized and moody as well. If you're nice to him, he'll be nice back.
He does not do a well job at teaching us the material that he includes on the tests.  He understands that the class is struggling, but does nothing to fix the issues.
He is very tough to understand, seems to have "his own way" of doing math and does not care if you understand it or not. Be ready to go to The Study for help often.
This class was literally super hard. It's supposed to be regular college algebra, but he does not explain it at all. Be prepared to go to the Study for extra help.

I really liked his class. He does have a problem with going off on tangents based on student questions, but it's usually at least interesting when he does that.  He explains things well, and always gave two worked practice tests that covered exactly what was on the test (down to the format).
Garbage teacher, don't take. gets off topic and teaches nothing about the homework that is due. He gives homework and never talks about the problems. worst teacher I have ever had.

I'm good at math and I love the subject. But I absolutely HATED his class. I will NEVER take a class by him again. He didn't teach anything, the online notesexplanations were confusing as hell, and even the tutors I went to couldn't properly help me. This is the first time I will say: AVOID him at all costs!!

His lectures are very confusing and if you didn't take calculus in high school it can be hard to grasp the ideas. He doesn't give much background on the ideas and just does examples fast and expects you to know how he did them. You'll hear about "Safari Jack" but he's teaching isn't what he is. Look at past tests for studying.
He doesn't make any clarity on the questions and makes it really confusing.

For the clicker quizzes the questions were never taught that he gave us, so i pretty much just shouldn't of come ever. He is easily one of the worst professors & most disrespectful @ UK. Some of my friends in MA123 with different teachers, & they do so much better on the exams. Thank god for The Study or I would of done terrible.
The teacher was really confusing with his lectures and his homework. Would never recommenced taking this class.

I had him before I switched sections. Not a good lecturer in any sense of the phrase. He rambles and never seems to get to a definitive point about anything. You will learn more in less time with someone else.

Jack didn't really teach. Occasionally you would get lucky and actually learn something from him but not every day. He uses clickers, so you have to sit through the lectures, but you're allowed to miss five total classes.

He is the worst professor that I have ever had at this University because he is unclear and not helpful at all. His entire lecture is clicker questions but he doesn't explain anything before and he doesn't tell you how to work the problems before giving a clicker so if you get it wrong you're screwed. I leave class every day confused and angry.

Dr. Schmidt def knew what he was trying to explain. Smart man, but clear as mud. Ended up going to lecture 50% of the time and learned more on my ownat the study. He always loved to try and please the entire class of 200 (which only about 50 went to), but that's impossible and just took up too much time. Meant well though.

HATED going to lecture. He was all over the place and i could not understand him. He likes to do things the hard way when there is a much easier alternative. I learned more from online notes than writing them myself.

Ole Jack doesn't really teach the course. Don't get me wrong, the guy lectures for 3 hours a week on Calculus and tells rather good jokes in his lectures, but his TAs definitely are the real teachers of the course. Luckily had Calc before college and made this class a breeze, nonetheless, Jack hurt my basis in Calc.

He can be kind of confusing during lecture, but I just go over the notes that are posted online and teach myself. He's very fair with grading by offering bonus in the homework and recitation. He provides old exams to help you study and they are VERY helpful.I'm terrible at math, but he has set this class up in a way that I am doing very well.

He literally makes no sense. There is no textbook and no notes. Common sense math with enough of a twist to challenge you and make you hate your life. Entrance and exit quizzes every day (attendance purposes). 4 exams one dropped and 4 mini-exams throughout the semester.

He's an OK professor. If your good in math you'll probably like him more but if your not then you may have to ask him questions after class. He's pretty funny but sometimes goes off track.  his shortcuts are usually super complicated.  I personally wouldn't take a class taught by him again

I feel like MA 111 is a really easy course that he likes to overcomplicate because he thinks it's way more interesting than it really is.  He'll help you in a heartbeat if you're having trouble understanding (which you probably will).  That help may just be him saying that whatever he told you to do is unnecessary but "fun". No book so thats a plus
He explains material the hard way and gets off track. Would not take another one of his courses again.
Pretty hilarious professor. Knows what he is doing and how to teach it. His shortcuts are complicated though, but overall easy class

He gets on rants but really willing to help students and very approachable. I took him for 109 and found he was better at teaching that. He gets easily frustrated when a class isn't listening. To get a good grade either know the material or make sure he knows your name!

I really struggle with math, but he made his class very manageable. He is the best math teacher I've ever had, and explains material on the most basic level. Very clear and concise, I would certainly recommend him. Great professor!
He is a horrible teacher. He gives you the easiest problems in class, then the homework and tests are impossible. Would never recommend him

If you struggle with math I recommend taking him. He explains thing very well and in a way that's easy to understand. I never used my book once just print off lecture notes. Always come the class before the exam because he gives example that are on the test with just different numbers and make sure you do the old exams.

He is a great teacher. He makes the tests so he teaches what you need to know. He can be confusing at times but you can typically figure it out by looking at the lecture notes. I highly recommend him.

Jack Schmidt is a very strange man.  Yes, he is very confusing and you will often need to go to the study and have them explain the concepts to you. But what is awesome is that his exams are IDENTICAL to the old exams. You can essentially memorize how to do the exams and just change the numbers.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. I was determined to make an A and now will be lucky to maintain my C.  He doesn't explain concepts in a way that is understandable.  Going to class only confused me more.  I just started looking at the online notes.  Definitely do your homework and look at old tests on the course website if you do choose to brave this course

Jack is perhaps one of the strangest professors at the University. MA 111 is in general very easy, but he complicates the computations more than necessary. I received an A in the course, and I would definitely recommend taking another professor.

I know this stuff, it's so easy and I got all the problems right on the hw and the past exams...but no, 40% on the exam. Wtf? Some of exam questions are stuff we never went over in class. And he doesn't curve. Or grade partial credit. It's basically high school math but he ruins it. He has a very nice personality but that's about it.
He makes everything easy.  One of the best professors.  Really encourage y'all to take his class.

He never explains anything, only does examples. The examples on the homework are no longer identical to exams, as in the past. He doesn't explain concepts, so you have no clue how to apply them on the exam if you don't know how to do them prior to his class. Definitely recommend staying away from him in this class if possible.

Mr.Schidmt is a cool guy. If you're in this class, but have already taken Pre-Calc, or Calculus, then it will be such a drag. I've been here for 3 weeks and we just got to Coordinate planes. He is very helpful. But, sometimes if you ask him a question.. he'll give an answer that will confuse the hell out of you. His methods are... different.
This guy made this class a living hell for me. I thought math was easy, until I tried to learn it from his perspective. My TA barley knew English. Do not recommend.

Jack's class is really easy if you come to class and do your homework, but don't expect to pass if you don't. I have never met a professor more willing to help his students. He makes math fun and interesting, even for math dunces like myself. The best part about Jack's classes is how he makes math relevant to the real world. Funny/great guy!

This class was extremely easy, he gives you a study guide that is exactly like the test. He is very goofy and doesn't mind laughing at himself. My only problem was he didn't grade one of our tests until a month later, and would get perturbed every time someone asked about it. I would recommend him especially if you aren't normally good at math.

I have taken him twice and would definitely do it again. I absolutely love him as a person and as a professor. He is very willing to help and genuinely cares about his students. He tries to take the time to get to know everyone. He's fun and goofy and isn't afraid to be himself. He wears a safari hat and often likes to use Pirates in his examples

Entertaining guy. The class is easy. Come to find out it is raelly meant for non math using majors. Being interested in Computer Science, this was a waste of time. As for the professor, he is great and does a good job of making it practical and applicable.

Class is essentially not helpful at all because the study guide is exactly like the test. I am awful at math yet I so far have an A on everything in the class. Take him for anything if you suck at math like me. Dont waste your money on the book unless you want practice problems. Homework is pointless.

Jacks a really nice guy but I feel like just being around him makes me less intelligent. The course is POINTLESS but he turns it into something more difficult than it should be. Definitely don't buy the book, it's never used. Avoid this course & this professor all together. He's really nice but useless to your education.
So. Easy. He's real goofy and it can get kinda annoying at 8am...but not bad, easy A.

Now I hate Math, but this class wasn't bad at all. Jack keeps things interesting with his jokes and upbeat teaching style. In a class of 70 he knew my name and really made an effort to get to know everyone else's name as well. His tests are very fair, and are almost an exact replica of his study guides. Beware though he makes mistakes on his slides

Jack is a nice teacher and extremely goofy. He loves what he does and takes the time to get to know his students. He seems like he would be an awesome middle or high school teacher but he is a confusing professor. He tries to make his class fun and entertaining it is to much. I learned more by teaching my self with the book and study guides.

I suck at math, but I loved Jack's class. He makes math lectures entertaining with funny examples. He really cares about you and will personally tutor you all semester if you need it. If you are a math whiz you probably don't need the book. Really one of the friendliest and most down to earth professors at UK. I highly recommend him.

The guy is just OK. He had a goofy way of explaining everything. My TA was better than him though. He puts all the slides online, so I tended to skip his class and just go to recitation and probably did better for it. Try to get Jonathan Thompson as your TA. He should be teaching the main class over Schmidt. No offense.

jack is goofy.sometimes its funny and sometimes you just arent in the mood.Every now and then he will pass around an attendance sheet for participation,proof that the class is easy.gone through 3 units now,2 super easy one extremely confusing because of his teaching style.He's kind of wacky.i dont know if id pass if he were teaching a harder class.

Jack is a enthusiastic professor that truly is excited about what he teaches, which is a very important quality in a professor. He is very helpful, and loves to help his students. He has a obscure sense of humor that i think many like, but i can see someone finding it somewhat annoying. The class material is easy, and actually helpful in life. B+

Went to class every day and didn't learn a thing from him. The TAs will save your life if you get the right ones. He never teaches you the easy way and spends most of the class rambling. Worst math professor I've ever had at UK. Attendance is mandatory but 3/4 of the class doesn't come anyway. There are no worksheets to complete.Don't buy the book

He is a good teacher that is very approachable and doesn't mind to give you extra help. The course is fairly easy whoever is teaching it but I feel like he made it even easier by teaching shortcuts and methods the other teachers don't teach. Each class you'll be required to complete a worksheet helps with the learning and counts for a small grade.
Fairly good teacher, but he gets distracted very easily and doesn't always know how answer your questions.

AMAZING TEACHER!! He started teaching at bctc and I took his English class. and he was super easy, but not because hes lazy but because he actually makes you like writing. he's super fun and connects to students. if you're taking English then get his class. do not miss this chance.
This is the best teacher at UK! I loved him and his class, best wrd teacher UK has to offer. The class was extremely easy and if you don't take his class your missing out on a easy A.
Collin is super cool and funny. The grading is pretty easy, really just show up and you'll probably be okay.
Super cool attendance not always mandatory. Pretty lenient on grading and assignments.
Very large class so he seemed very nervous when presenting and really doesn't draw in your attention. His exams are worded very difficultly and so you feel like you should get an A but it's hard to.
Great teacher who still has a passion for teaching. Prof Skinner genuinely wants people to succeed. He does expect you to attend and pay attention, but is pretty laid back.
Really awesome teacher with a great attitude. Wants the students to learn and understand; does not expect memorization. Study for the first test!! It's important to do well!! Go to every class.

Proffessor Skinner was amazing.  The class was interesting but Dr. Skinner really cared about the students and was there for everyone in the class.  I would recommend this teacher because he really cared for the students and was an excellent teacher.
This class wasn't really that bad. He seems uninterested in teaching. Make sure you pick a good group for the project.

I loved Dr. Silvestri. He is quite entertaining and is very helpful regarding graduate admissions (which he leads that department) from people I know who've spoken to him. The class is difficult but not insanely difficult, homework's are quite helpful for the exams and he is transparent in what will be tested on the exams. Would recommend!

He did not make his lecture notes accessible, so you had to attend class or get notes from somebody who did attend. However, much of his material came from the optional text, so you could still complete homework questions despite his sometimes questionable handwriting. Grading was super lenient and partial credit was abundant. Project was not bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Dr.Silvestri is a very good professor and taught me a lot of stuff. His exams are really heavily weighted for your total final grade even though he said it was kind of an experiment due to student using chat gpt and stuff.
His lectures are really important and textbook really helps.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Go to class! Some stuff is only covered in class and not in the notes he posts! His lectures were helpful, but I had to pay very close attention. He'd write a lot of important stuff on a tiny whiteboard at the front of a large lecture hall in bad handwriting, so lecture content was VERY easy to miss. Overall, I just wish he used his resources more.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Silvestri is great. Use the textbook whenever you can, didn't realize until studying for finals that his lectures and test material are basically right out of the (outdated) book, so a lot of outside resources won't help you all that much. Dude also has the best fashion sense out there.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Pretty difficult class, if you don't pay attention the entire time your there you will miss something important miraculously, He has recorded lectures but won't post them for some stupid reason. Not all that enjoyable but not the end of the world 6/10

Dr. Silvestri is a great professor and tries hard to make sure students understand the material. However, hw and exams are dependent on lectures, so make sure to attend class. There is also final group project worth a good chunk of the final grade, but it has lots of extra credit making it possible to get 150% on it. Would take Dr. Silvestri again

He literally released a recording of every class on canvas. Good professor, he lets you retake the midterm at the end. And the project worth 25% of total grade has so much extra credit you could get a 150% on it. Gave us 5% bonus on the total grade because 60% of us filled out the TCE. Tests are almost identical to study guide.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Silvestri is a good guy, however, his classes cannot be recommended. He is extremely aggressive with forcing people to come to class, therefore he releases no materials to help study or prepare outside of class. If you don't particularly write down every minuscule detail he covers in class, exams and homeworks will be extremely challenging.
A very nice and caring professor. He is lecture heavy but we always started class late and got out early. Not a tough grader at all, but he still expects you to do the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Quality lecturer, well organized, fair expectations, approachable, responsive to emails. Way better prof than 90% of UK's CS faculty. If this man is not tenured, he should be. If you do badly in this class, you're not trying. 1 of only 2 profs that gave me the flexibility I needed to survive this semester when I had a personal tragedy. Ty Dr. S.

Dr. Silvestri is extremely approachable and willing to explain topics in greater detail to those who are confused. His class is very relaxed as he encourages questions, corrections, and discussion. He understands he doesn't always communicate topics clearly, but always ensures his point is made if it may not be clear. Go to class or you wont pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He keeps class interesting, great professor
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Skaff is super funny, loves all UK sports, and gives answers during the exams. You are not graded on many things so don't forget to do the attendance points. The format of the class gets repetitive but it is an easy class which makes it tolerable. She references the book in class but most people don't buy/rent it and do fine on the exams.

DO NOT BUY THE TEXTBOOK YOU DON'T NEED IT. I went through the whole class with it sitting in my room never opened. You can find the exams online but have to go to lecture to get points in the class. Filled with guest speakers from different careers for you to gain insight which is actually kind of nice.

In this class you will listen to lots of speakers talk about their careers. There are only two exams and Quizlet has good study packets. A lot of people skip class, but it's honestly not worth it. Come to class so you can get all your points and you will have a good grade in the class.

She is infamous in the HHS major for a reason. She is a very rude professor, speaks negatively of her guest speakers, TAs, and colleagues. There are three assignments, a midterm, and a final exam that are essentially the entire grade for this course, yet there will be minimal ways to prepare for any of them. Karen Skaff is an embarrassment of HHS.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT BUY THE TEXTBOOK!!! Big waste of $74! She say's that we have to complete the readings, but I have never opened the book.This class is so unnecessarily long. You just listen to a bunch of presenters from different areas of healthcare and you're supposed to take notes on what they say and do. Midterm was easy, just review the power points.

I have gone to this class three times total and I got a 93. If you took any healthcare classes in high school, you'll be completely fine; don't bother buying the book. The majority of your grade is the midterm and final, but most of the questions are on Quizlet. She did put some completely unrelated questions on the midterm which dropped my grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Skaff is a very nice woman with good intentions, but I have dreaded her classes every day. Do not buy the book that she says you will need to read!!! I did a quick skim on SparkNotes right before the quiz and made a 10/10 and it wasn't ever mentioned again. You will have a 10 min presentation with no visual aid or notes so remember that.

Dr. Skaff is awesome! She will talk for a LONG time in her classes, but you learn a lot about her and different things when she gets off topic. You can tell she is passionate about what she does and that she cares about her students. Skaff's assignments for this class are interesting, but not too difficult.

she talks for hours. usually about stuff that does not pertain to class. I was in a 3 hour class last semester with her and it dragged on forever. She is nice though and cares about her students a lot. she wants to see you succeed.

This was a service learning course. You do a variety of community engagement things (visiting a nursing home and educating kids in rural KY). If you're in HHS, you know Skaff. She's always entertaining

I’m sure Skaff is a nice person but her lectures are horrible. This 3 hr lecture could be 1.5 TOPS if she would just get to the point. She’s horrible with canvas & is very vague on assignments so be prepared to be confused and rely on your TA for most things (shoutout Alyaa). Second semester with her and I hope I never have her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: TALKS for hours. I am in her 3 hour lecture right now, there is still an hour left. I am not quite sure what she is talking about, but her class is easy so you'll be fine.

If you're in HHS, you know Skaff. This 3 hour course, however, is a different breed. I'll probably look back and think this 3 hour course was hilarious, but sitting through it feels like punishment. She lectures drones on and on about any tangent ever. She's a super funny prof and is understanding, but this class was a waste

Skaff makes the midterm and final super easy if you semi pay attention to the guest speakers. Attendance is most of your grade, along with midterm and final. It is the easiest HHS class you could take and requires basically no out-of-class prep time. You really do not need the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Super easy class. You just listen to guest speakers every class and don't even have to pay attention and still do well on the exam. Only thing is that the only grades are attendance, midterm, and final, so you have to do well on those to pass. Overall a pretty easy pass though.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Skaff was a fine professor, although she is definitely old fashionedI think. It can be hard to pay attention sometimes to be honest, but it is SUPER important since LITERALLY 90% of your grade is based on midterm and final exams... But if you actually do a little studying and try to pay attention, the class is not extremely hard to pass at ALL.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class is literally just a midterm and final; she expects you to know a crazy amount of useless information. It was basically an online class because the guests didn't actually speak at the classroom. She gives you no study material and just expects you to know everything from class. She was honestly just rude and inaccessible to me.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class is extremely unorganized. Dr Skaff is very nice and caring, but sometimes can go all over the place in lectures. You may not get the preceptor you want. Easy A if you shadow full amount and go to class.

Skaff is very nice and she has good stories, but wow she can talk. As in all of her classes, lectures drone on with completely unrelated topics for 1-3 hours as she thinks of random topics to rattle about, usually unrelated to ethics. Painful to sit through, but there are good bits of ethics conversation scattered throughout.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Midterm/final are on Quizlet word for word. Attendance quizzes online. Boring. Easy A if you study the quizlets. However, very easy to get lower grades bc there arent many points available.

Ethics has been my favorite college course. She teaches with great examples and all the assignments are easy and super interesting. This course is so beneficial I wanted to go. She is super funny too.

The class was pretty much guest speakers every week. Went to about 4 classes, then just did the participation question from my dorm the rest of the semester. Powerpoint's from the speakers are on canvas, so use those to study. Overall, Professor Skaff was alright. She really didn't do anything in the class besides give us a few answers to  exams.

I'm not a huge fan of Dr. Skaff. She's pretty nice, but she rubs a lot of us the wrong with her attitudes. The class is easy. You don't have to have any background knowledge before the lectures. I'm an MLS major. If you are too, don't take the class. If you're another health science major, you probably have to keep taking her.

People who do not understand Professor Skaff do not have a sense of humor. She has a dry sense of humor so even though it comes off indifferent, she is hilarious. She truly cares about her students and their success. I highly enjoy and look forward to her classes. Take her classes.

Dr. Skaff seems to look out for the best interest of her students, but she can come across as being rude and condescending at times. I do not believe this to be intentional, I just believe that is the way she operates. Her classes are very easy, however, and if you are an HHS student you better get used to her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--CARES ABOUT STUDENTS--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The class was boring, but I did learn more about different occupations in the health field than I knew before. I would recommend this class for HHS students who are not sure in what they want to major in.
Her tests are pretty easy but some questions on the test we never discussed in class. The only grades are two tests and a three question assignment.

This was the most pointless class ever. A different guest lecturer comes in each week and talks about their profession then Skaff tests on something very different. Make sure to do the attendance question every day (can be done from your room) since the class is only 100 points. She tells you the first 10 answers to both the midterm and the final.

Karen Skaff is probably one of the most unhelpful professors that you will run into. She has little to say in terms of how one should study for an exam, tips, etc. Instead, she is condescending and self-absorbed - believing that her HHS class is one of the best classes for an healthcare worker (untrue.)  NO CLEAR GRADING CRITERIA.

Dr. Skaff is a decent professor. However, she is rude and take 30 minutes to say something that could be said in 5. This class is mostly guest speakers so it usually doesn't matter. Just hope you don't need something from her.

You listen to guest speakers every week. Class is only worth 100 points so it is important to go to class to get the attendance point. Midterm is not hard if you study. Only other test is the final. Textbook not necessary, but if you find a cheap one it could be helpful. Not a hard A

It's an easy class but every day someone new comes in to speak and so you just have to take as many notes as you can and hope that you wrote down whats going to be on the exam. hilarious and will respond to your emails in the same day.

This lady is a hoot. While she may not be very clear about what to study for in terms of mid-terms and finals, she will make sure you get an A as long as you try. Guest speakers every week, pretty easy class. It's your choice whether you want to show up or not. It's free attendance points.
Nothing about this class is difficult. She genuinely wants you to succeed and makes it easier than she probably should.
Dr. Skaff isn't a great professor but most of this class luckily was guest speakers. She takes 20 minutes to relay information that you could say in 5 minutes.

Dr. Skaff is fantastic and hilarious. Has a very likeable personality and genuinely cares about her students and their futures in the healthcare field. Easy grader and an easy A class. Take her if you get the opportunity!
Dr. Skaff is great. She basically tells you at the beginning of the semester that she will give you an A if you do your work (there isn't much), and come to class. Great teacher. A+
EASY A!!! If you just show up you get your credit...

Easy A if you go to class. All it is is various guest speakers from different health fields/careers. Most of the time it was an interesting class. She's really nice and helpful. Had a participation point ques at beginning of most classes.
Horrible
easiest class ever.
Can't stay on track.  Useless information throughout course.  Difficult time consuming exams and assignments that were not related to course.  Poor instructor
Easy!  Just go to class and do assignments.
No Comments
easy class...listen to guest speakers, but can get boring....no outside time required...if you are undeclared and thinking about health careers awesome class for you!!!
The LLP class is super easy and she just brings in a bunch of guest speakers. Schyler is a really kind person, but this class is mind numbingly boring.
Schyler is the absolute best!! She is so caring and the class was very easy and very manageable.
Schyler is awesome. She runs the CI LLP and the class is super easy and fun.
Schyler is one of the best professors I have ever had, she is one of the most caring and understanding people you will ever meet. Do not be afraid to reach out to her she gives amazing advice!!

Dr. Simpson is easily one of the best professors Ive taken. Had to take this class for the CI LLP. She is like the UK mom to her LLP students, and is very easy to talk to. Absolute gem, cant say enough about her. Also academic advisor to the LLP kids, which is great to get a relationship with her from day 1.
Very chill professor
Schyler is the actual BEST. Just show up to this class and you will do great. Give Schyler respect and she will give it right back to ya :)
Great professor great class come to class and you will get good grade. Easy if you stay on top of assignments
Great teacher and easy class, just do the work and read the chapter and you should be fine :)

She is a great teacher! I have had her twice and would take another class by her again for sure! She is very understanding and really cares about her students and them achieving a good grade! Schyler is also really good about answering questions, returning emails and being available to meet for office hours. GREAT TEACHER!!!!
Awesome. Hot. Easy. Helpful. Interesting.

Was in a once a week class, so attendance was vital. Is very nice and understanding, especially of group issues. Gives a few book readings over material that she taught the week before, or that is going to be taught that day. Quizzes are very simple and common sense questions. Will work with you on any and all issues. Very nice and fun teacher.

SHe's an awesome teacher. I was in a class that only met once a week, so attendance was a vital part of the class. There was weekly reading, which I rarely did, but she gives thorough class notes. Very energetic. Definitely won't be bored in her class! As long as you do what is asked of you then you will pass. She's fair about things!

That google doc stressed me out so much. So much homework outside of class that is difficult to find in the google doc. She is very hard to reach outside of class and never responds to emails. She at least gave lots of feedback is you ask questions in class. Expect to be at every single class every single second.

She spends all of every class overexplaining instructions she already explained. You have to figure out and do everything yourself, and she's extremely unorganized. The other reviewers aren't lying about the Google Doc. She provides no actual value to the classroom experience and doesn't teach at all. But just do your project and you'll be fine.

Ms. Rolfes isn't a horrible professor, but the class can be unorganized and annoying. I hated the daily schedule that was on a Google Doc and not Canvas. I also hated how the directions of some projects just weren't clear. She is also SUPER slow to grade projects. However, if you ask questions often and stay super diligent, the class isn't so bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Siobhan is a really kind person, but her class feels like a waste of time.  WRD112 is a semester long group project with unclear instruction.  She rambles for over an hour about due dates that are not relevant.  Easy class though, If you get the work done you will be fine.

This class was very easy, I did not think she was a harsh grader at all. Even though attendance is mandatory lectures are a massive waste of time. She can go on about literally nothing for the entire class. If I did not go to any lectures, my grade would be the same because instructions are never clear. Also, don't buy the textbook you wont use it.

None of the assignments are explained. Very unorganized professor and does everything via Google Doc. Makes it so difficult to find the prompts that actually explain what you're supposed to do for the assignment. The whole class is just busy work and group work. Most unorganized professor I've ever seen.

If I advise you anything throughout your time at Kentucky, I advise you to not take her class. 
-She uses a LITERAL GOOGLE DOC for organization. She uses different fonts, colors, and links to stay Organized.
-She adds new content on her Google doc, meaning more rules towards 100 pt. projects a day before it's due.
She makes me want to slam my head.

She talks a lot and organizes her assignments very strange. Nothing is ever uploaded to canvas, everything on google docs, every assignment and due date you have to hunt for.  She is very nice and wants to help but she talks the whole class about the group work we are supposed to do, and then by the end we have less than 10 minutes to work.
Really great professor but attendance is required. Lots of group projects and speeches but overall easy A if you do the work.

DONT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH HER. She misses class/is late which may seem like a break at first but she will still expect you to do the work with your group. She spent an extensive amount of time lecturing and trying to guide us through her google docs schedule that was hard to access and read.
She never put assignment descriptions on canvas. AWFUL

Although her class is fairly easy I wouldn't take it again as the class was extremely uninteresting as we worked on one project the whole semester doing it many different ways, and not the best at answering her emails  It also did not feel as I learned anything from this course besides what I have taught myself outside the classroom
Professor Rolfes is a good teacher in my opinion. She talks a very good amount and often gets off topic but she is an easy grader. Be prepared to ask questions because instructions are never clear.

She talks pretty much the entire class about the schedule that is very clearly available for everyone to see so class feels like a waste of time but participation is required for your grade. She is not a very tough grader and the class is pretty easy just not very engaging.
The entire semester is one big group project. Talks for majority of the class and leaves little time for actual workshop. Takes forever to grade projects.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is a very nice woman but all she does is talk about the schedule and syllabus for the entire hour and a half of class. You barely get any time in class to work on stuff because she rambles on about the schedule for 2/3 of the time. And then when you actually go to do the assignment, the descriptions are very vague and confusing.

The whole semester we worked on one project. You will only use the text book once or twice the whole semester, waste of money. She will miss 5 days out of 10 and still expect you to understand and complete the work by due date. She will go over the next assigment for half of class then you sit and do nothing. Waste of time but she takes attendance.

Basically you have like 10 projects to do throughout the semester and they gradually get harder. She is great, just talks a whole lot. It kinda makes the projects confusing. She is always willing to stay after and answer any questions I have and is very quick as answering emails. If you fail to finish a project on time, she has a grace period.

DO NOT TAKE CLASS WITH HER! Absolutely TRASH. This class is SO painful to go to. All she does EVERY SINGLE class is read the syllabus and waste your time. She takes weeks, I mean WEEKS to grade papers. Keep in mind you won't have feedback on the past papers before you have to submit another. SHE MAKES ME MISERABLE EVERY SINGLE CLASS. DO NOT TAKE!

SAVE YOURSELF I looked at rate my professor and saw that people wanted to bang their heads against the wall and that's what I want to do. I should have listened take it from me. I don't know how she is a proffesor. Everyone in the class could not be more more miserable and bored. It has been painful to sit there it is a waste of time. Dont do it

Easier class, but mainly group work. She doesn’t really offer much assistance with the work either. She was often late to begin the semester, and always talks about future assignments for a large portion of the class. Mrs. Rolfes is a kind hearted person, and means well, but the combo of busy work and extensive talking can be extremely annoying.

Run far away. This class made me want to beat my head against the wall. The whole semester is a group project. All she does it talk about future assignments but never explains them and what she expects from you. She barely offers any help and is terrible at responding to emails. I was so lost the whole semester.
Great professor!

She is a very nice lady, but her class makes no sense whatsoever. All she does in class is talk about future assignments. She never actually teaches you anything. A lot of busy work. Wouldnt suggest taking her. If you want to be bored out of your mind for a semester then go for it.

Wonderful teacher! She is very nice and helps students when they need it. Show up for her class and you'll pass, work hard and you'll pass. There's a lot of homework at times but if you attempt it, she's give you the grade you deserve.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: She is kind, lovely, and helpful. It is really a pleasure listening to her.
Quite possibly the most boring class I have ever taken. You can skip the class and you wouldn't miss anything. Teacher is awkward and rambles a lot.

I would not advise taking her as a teacher for WRD 110. She only talks about future assignments and I have not taken anything away from this class. I'm always bored. There is also a lot of busy work and assignments. I have never opened the books.

Awful teacher. Spends half the class talking about the assignment due next and not teaching. She's really nice suprisingly but is an extremely hard grader. She says "if you do what I ask you get a C, if you do more you get a B, if you do amazing you might get an A." If your grammar isn't perfect prepare to get a grade lower than deserved.

Siobhan is an excellent teacher who is always open to helping students out. I got an A on every essay but I went to her for help and she always helped. Definitely take her class if you want to prepare for college papers, because they only get worse!

This is the most boring class in the entire world. But it's required for all freshman I think. I GET SO BORED IN THERE. She's not a bad teacher but.. I don't know if it's just me, but everything she does annoys me... Take Kandice Gray if you can. I heard she's easy.
Great teacher, just a boring class. She assinged alot of essays that were about boring topics.
just do the work and ask questions when you need help... probably the easiest A I have earned so far in college
awful. very tedious grader. lots of outside work.
awful.
No Comments
He is a fantastic professor. He is super passionate about coaching which makes the class enjoyable. One of my favorite professors at UK!
Easy A with Coach. You show up get the test answers and questions and you'll pass. He is very passionate about his classes so look engaged.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Overall a good professor and would recommend.
Great professor. Content is very clear and he listens to students' concerns. Was a very enjoyable and informative class
Very great professor, cares about what they teach. Was a great class, and one of the professors I have ever had. Super easy and understanding, and the lectures were interesting.

Best professor at the whole school. Super caring and understanding, passionate about her work and students. She goes out of her way to include each student and ensure everyone reaches their full potential. Mostly discussion based learning.

Amazing as both a human being and an instructor. Whether or not you enjoy the material, it will never bore you, and her engaging discussions and lectures enrich the readings tenfold! She let us choose the due date for our final project!
Dr. Sizemore is my favorite teacher at UKY. I would recommend her to absolutely anyone!

Best English professor at UK hands down. Insightful discussions. Cares about students, gives thoughtful feedback and the work assigned is never too challenging. If you take any English class at UK, take one taught by Professor Sizemore!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Sizemore is an amazing prof and person! She deeply cares for her students and class content. She encourages everyone to speak out about their ideas and creates a warm environment. I'm thankful that she was the intro to my major at UK. I'm looking forward to taking another one of her classes!

Dr. Sizemore is a lovely person and is deeply understanding/empathetic. She gave me an extension on our big final because she saw I didnt submit it. For work, all we had was read a novel. The more you participate in class the better, but even that isn't super necessary. By the end of the sem I was often late to class but she was often understanding

Dr. Sizemore is one of the best professor in the University of Kentucky's English department. She is incredibly kind and so engaging in throughout course content. In this course, I was picking up books that I had been wanting to read for a while! The class content is so interesting and she values student feedback. Take her if given the chance!

The perfect score on this site doesn't begin to describe how AMAZING Dr. Sizemore is! Hands down the best professor in the English department, and probably the entirety of UK. You'd be lucky to even hear her speak for ten minutes. Respected, well-spoken, caring, engaging, and all-around the perfect professor, no matter the class content. ENROLL!

Dr. Sizemore is, without fail, the best English Professor I have ever taken at UK! Our Poe Author Study class was unique and enjoyable, and our instructor brought out the best in her students! If you do the reading and engage in class activities, you will thrive!

Dr. Sizemore is the best professor to introduce you into studying English. she understands you'll have more challenging courses and will work with you to figure something out with the few assignments you have. you can talk to her about any questions you have and she's very easy to talk to. def recommend her!!

Dr. Sizemore is one of the best professors at UK! She is kind, engaging, obviously LOVES her work, easy to reach out to, and always energetic. Within weeks, she was encouraging me to publish some of the work I turned in, even when I felt it was inadequate. The class was mandatory and P/F, however I cannot wait to take electives with her! 1000/10!!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: This is the second class I've taken with Dr. Sizemore, and I'm again amazed by this professor! She is so caring and willing to work with students. Even this class which was more lecture based, I still felt engaged and interested. Weekly readings and quizzes, with a single project, and three exams- difficult, but manageable!
She is my favorite professor I have ever had. I cant say enough about her- she is incredibly inspiring and encouraging. Youll miss out if you pass up a chance to take her class.

Dr. Sizemore is the best professor ever--she will help you with anything and everything you need. You have to read and you have to go to class to participate in discussions in order to do well. She is a very fair grader and will help you, or reach out, if she feels you are struggling in a certain area (discussion, papers, etc). Take her!!

I have respected the many of my professors in my college career thus far, but none like Dr. Sizemore. She expects you to read the literature on the syllabus and be able to discuss it in class but is clearly knowledgeable herself while still open to differing opinions. She reaches out to each student to meet their individual needs. A lovely soul.

Dr. Sizemore is quite possibly the best teacher I have ever had. A great group of diverse novels assigned, along with weekly discussion boards, two major papers, a midterm project, and a take home final. Accessible outside of class, super caring, and gives great feedback! Am definitely taking her classes again.
great professor. very passionate and open to new ideas from every student. class is not a cakewalk, but doable if you work hard and participate in discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Sizemore is one of the most amazing Professors I have ever had. She is SO, so caring, and really understood when I was having issues outside of class. None of us did great on an essay so she's letting everyone redo it, and there isn't even any tests. The final is take-home and the mid term is just a fun project. Seriously, take her.

Far and away my favorite professor at UK. Incredibly knowledgeable, engaging, and caring, Dr. Sizemore had our class feeling like a familiar community opposed to just an assortment of random students. She challenges you in assignments to push boundaries of your work and will bring out your potential. You need to participate and work for the A.
Best professor at UK. Take her if you have the chance!

Dr. Sizemore is by far my favorite professor. She's engaging, caring, and makes you feel like a person and not a number. Gives superb feedback. Looking forward to taking her again. Be sure to read, participate, and attend class. Participation is integral.

Dr. Sizemore is a brilliant woman who doesn't need to assert her intellectual dominance over anyone  you listen to her speak, and you respect her right off the bat. She's a wonderful person and instructor, and the diversity of the texts in her ENG 230 class was remarkable. (We read a graphic novel and watched two movies.) Would gladly take again.

Dr. Sizemore is my favorite professor. She makes her courses challenging enough, but her attitude makes it interesting and manageable. I feel like the way she leads class is how a college course is supposed to be. She is so sweet and VERY understanding of student struggles.

Dr. Sizemore is great: funny, nice, and knowledgeable of her subj. The class WAS a bit demanding; readings can be lengthy. They're worth it though because they help with assignments, and she actually makes the material interesting and thought-provoking. She bought us breakfast twice, and she's a smoking hot 40-something. A win-win-win.

I loved Dr. Sizemore! She made the course very interesting and loved to participate & interact with the students. Sometimes the course did get a little tough or overwhelming, but I would take again. One of the best courses and professors at UK I've had so far!

If you have a chance to take Dr. Sizemore, do it. She leads a great class and picks really interesting reads for class. She's very easy to talk to and is willing to work with you. Class participation is a big bulk of your grade, and you're better off if you keep up with the readings. Overall, I loved the class, one of my favorites so far!
Very helpful, very kind professor who will certainly challenge you but will never hold you to unreasonable expectations. Also has great style.

Dr. Sizemore is the best professor I have yet to have at UK. She is always willing to help, and so easy to get ahold of outside of class. Her classes are very interesting, and the books she uses are hard not to read. It's a lot of reading, but as long as you read and go to lecture, you will do fine.

this class is pretty easy, just follow her directions and you'll be fine. She is understanding and overall a great professor. She takes attendance daily a few minutes before class starts so you must be EARLY or her T.A.s will grill you when you tell them you were late and need to be counted present. (only bad part of the class*) but shes great!
Great teacher. Knows her stuff, very helpful. Made for great discussions and great learning. Sizemore Rules, Spencer Drools!
Probably one of the best professors at the university.
She is absolutely flawless. Everyone needs to have her. She's patient, kind, but very intelligent. My all time favorite class so far.

Dr. Sizemore is one of the greatest English professors at UK. Unlike other profs with TAs, she's very involved with students instead of just referring them to a TA. Her lectures are very slow moving, but they are very in-depth. Lots of group work during class time, which got a little old. I definitely recommend her!

Dr. Sizemore is by far one of the best professors I've had. She was very clear with her expectations of the students. She was always available for extra help, and was more than happy to answer any question that was raised. She made the material very interesting and made the students want to learn it. I  recommend taking one of her classes.

High expectations and reading load can be heavy, especially with extra essay readings on top of text, but she is very helpful and explains her assignments, expectations clearly.  She will structure the class how the class wants to be taught by majority (anonymous) vote: more lecture, more discussion in class.

Best English professor at the University, by far. Her enthusiasm and knowledge is unrivaled. Grading is thoughtful, helpful and fair. Facilitates class discussion superbly. All around fabulous professor.

Absolutely wonderful teacher. Extremely helpful, enthusiastic about her work, and professional. Though the workload is large, she will frequently go out of her way to help you out. Perhaps the best English teacher at UK (and I've had a lot of them...)

Great professor.  She is not the easiest considering attendance is mandatory, the workload is heavy at times (esp. the reading), and you have online discussions due every Monday... BUT she is very easy to work with.  Grades fairly (A's on all major assignments), seems like she expects a lot, but it's not as much.  Great instructor; friendly & smart

This class was overall easy, but it has so many papers and group project papers, which can be annoying. had multiple readings and lecture videos, but I don't think I did them at all unless I needed a source for a paper. You make an information science handbook all throughout the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Cares about you as a person, wants you to succeed as a student. Always willing to answer questions; responds to emails quickly. Made the online class feel like in-person, which could be good or bad, depending on opinion. Class is based on several projects - not hard, but require some time. Be prepared to work in a group.

This proffesor gave helpful feedback, especially on consecutive projects. His feedback not only helped me to improve the essays that I turned in specifically for this class, but also allowed me to improve on my writing skills overall. There are many small group projects, unfortunately, but they're not the main assignments in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment:
*This review is for ICT 305: Data Detectives, not COM 101*

- Group discussions every single week
- Projects require a tremendous amount of work
- Projects are boring/tedious
- He ends his emails with "Drink coffee responsibly!".
- Every single time I have emailed him with a question he always responds super passive agressively.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Look forward to weekly lectures, weekly discussion boards, and 3 concept papers. The class is really easy.
Loved him. Actually had great/interesting lecutres. He kept things fun and the assignments weren't hard. Only used the book 1 time and had 2 group projects but both were easy.

Will is very funny and understanding. The only thing I didn't like was he never used slides to lecture. Wrote ALL of his notes on the board so it's hard to keep up. But overall his class was easy. You use the textbook for 252 a lot for reference. Exams are all online.
Will is awesome! I loved his class. He is always willing to help with any questions . He is super responsive to emails as well. He really wants his students to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Will has been by far my favorite professor. He does take attendance so it's important to not skip. However, he is so laid back and wants his students to be interested in the subject. He is always willing to help, explain, and he's young so he can relate to us students on a better level.

Will is the best. He's young so he can relate to the students and how we struggle. He will help you on anything you don't understand. He writes all his notes on the whiteboard but other than that his lecture material is clear and the textbook will also help you a lot during his exams. He is extremely understanding!!!
Will is the man! pretty easy class but you must show up everyday. easy grader on speeches.

Will is very respected and has a good sense of humor. No exams in this class, and only 5 speeches. It is vital to your grade to be prepared for your speeches, as they reflect a large part of your grade. Take notes during his few lectures and you will be fine on quizzes. This class helped my public speaking and confidence a lot.
Lectures are super boring and hard to understand. Class is graded off three  exams, and 14 cumulative homework assignments.
the course is based of 3 exams and are horrible to take.

He gives very long (boring) lectures. However, if you can get yourself to pay attention to them, they help lots when it comes to homework. Almost all of his test questions come from lecture powerpoint notes. Tests are hard, study lots and attend ALL classes.

I took this as a 4 week summer course, and I saw nothing but accounting for the whole month.  Homework would take me between 2-4 hours every night. Smigla presents the material well, and teaches you to think through it logically. He is helpful and returns grades the next day.
Hard class, must read book, hes head of master program and teaches at high level. MUST do hw. Hard intensive course. Would not recommend.
don't take him so boring and hard.
went over homeowkr in class by going around the room asking people what they got. so it helped me do the homework

I found him a difficult but fair teacher. He seems to have vast knowledge of managerial accounting. I went to every class and attempted to pay attention but he is a very monotone speaker. If you ask questions, keep up with the supplimental exercises due at the end of the semester, attempt every homework, and go to EVERY class, An A isn't too hard.

Maybe he teaches 201 different than 202 but i found him really helpful in 202. Managerial accounting is more his field. His classes are a little boring but you dont take notes cause you print them out online. He tells you verbatim what will be on the tests. Maybe hes a really bad 201 professor but for 202 id recommend him
He is useless and hard to understand.  He is very hard and looks down upon those who have a hard time understanding accounting.  Dont take him!
Awful.  Papers for accounting? Doesn't know how to teach ppl who arent as knowledgable as him.  I went to tutoring 3 times a week for hw and I still had to drop.

Impossible class. Mandatory Attendance even though I learned nothing when I went. Lots of Homework. The final is  over the entire text book. Gets his multiple choice ? from standardized accounting tests. Enless you are an accounting major who wants a challenge, don't take this class!

Unless you plan on becoming a CPA, I'd avoid Smigla.  Expect to work AT LEAST 4 hours outside of class per week on incredibly ambiguous homework assignments.  The tests are very difficult, as well.  He also is very condescending to anyone who doesn't understand the material.

Okay so you want to take accouting and you have smigla, well..... get the HELL out of his class, take goldman or cooper, john is the worst teacher ever, half the class failed, tests are diff than h/w and harder than you can imagine. He dosent curve. And his teaching method is reading powerpoints and printing off the h/w and reading it back to you.
No Comments
This guy by far is the worst teacher that i have ever had at UK, hes very monotone, do not take, one of the hardest classes I have ever taken, due to the fact i had to learn in on my own, hes useless
Decent professor, nothing much special

She comes to class late everyday and reads off of the screen the whole lecture. It's super boring. Then we have to do weekly labs that don't relate to the content that much. Even though she is there to help she assumes we should know it and doesn't answer emails often. But this is the first semester STA 300 was taught so maybe she'll get better.

There were 7 homework assignments, and 2 exams. No notes or material are posted on canvas, so attendance is important to succeed in this class. She was very helpful in office hours and is very caring. Lectures can be quite boring at times and sometimes unclear. She is great at answering questions so be sure to ask questions to understand content.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: the most passive aggressive professor i've ever had. She goes through demos way too fast and gets annoyed when you have questions. If you miss even one class and ask what you missed she'll give you attitude. She's also not very clear about due dates which makes turning things in on time very difficult.

This professor comes off as nice,sweet in the beginning, then just starts to become very rude and disrespectful. She only leaves negative comments on assignments and never leaves anything positive. She can have harsh remarks in class that just come off as rude as well. She expects a lot, even though this is a beginner class in the digital artsAS200

She goes very fast with her demos and I've noticed she sometimes catches an attitude with students that aren't caught up with her or ask for help. I think sometimes she forgets she's a professor, but I passed her class so its not too bad, she just needs to work on her communication.

Hannah is probably the most passive aggressive professor I've ever delt with. She starts out really nice at first but its clear she has problems controlling her emotions and the things she says. you learn NOTHING here that you cant learn on youtube, and her teaching is horrible. do not waste your time or money.

I think Hannah is a kinda new professor but imo she does a great job teaching. I took intro to digital fab knowing nothing about 3D modeling and now I'm starting to love it! It's REALLY important that you show up basically to every class, especially in the beginning while you learn the ropes. If you can't put in that time just don't take it T_T

Extremely harsh and expects everyone to come into this level 100 class with years of photoshop experience. Talks down on students who struggle in the class and doesn't offer any help. Would avoid talking and asking if I needed help simply because I was a slower worker. She slanders your projects in front of the class. Do not recommend!!!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: (a-s340)She seems laid-back at first but turns out to be harsh. She has no idea what she wants done for her projects then gets irritated and grades them harshly if you do them "wrong". There are many modules that have nothing to do with our actual projects. If you live by a schedule, forget taking this class, she changes due dates like the weather.
seems chill at first but very abrasive at times for no reason.

ACC 200. She seemed like a nice person, the class was just so boring and I would find myself constantly zoning out. The assignments and tests take a while, I spent over 2 hours on a couple assignments, and so did many others. I don't know how different the other professors are, but if you despise accounting, like me, look into them. (Spring 2025).

Siebs makes THE most boring topic SO engaging, and explains all the concepts super well. You just HAVE to show up for class, attendance isn't mandatory but the information in lectures is important. Showing up and doing the homework easily earns you a B in the class.
Very fun and easy to get along with.

She is a great professor and truly loves what she does. With that being said, if you're looking for an elective, do NOT take  Acc 410. You have homework everyday and have to write it up on the board. The content is incredibly difficult and the only way you learn, is spending hours upon hours reading and doing the practice problems.

Great Professor for a class that can be difficult at times. She explains things very well and loves to connect with her students. One bad thing is she does cold call, so make sure to pay attention. Overall would love to take her again.

Accounting is tough and this is coming from a 4.0 engineering student. Siebs was super kind and her lectures were amazing and focused a ton on practice problems, which were almost identical to the homework assignments. She also was flexible with grades and offered extra credit before the start of every new chapter. Pay close attention in class tho!

One of the best professors I've ever had. Totally recommend Dr. Siebs. She is so knowledgeable and respectful. If you don't skip her lecutres, you can easily get 95% or above. Do all the assignment and totally recommend you doing the extra credit opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class was pretty fast paced, and the material wasnt easy, but she does a pretty good job explaining it. I definitely recommend doing the extra credit when it is offered, because she doesn't curve grades or test scores. You have to be pretty locked in the entire time, so whether or not you go to class and pay attention will determine your grade

One of the best professors I've ever had with the hardest course material I've ever learned. Definitely an insanely difficult course but she makes sure everyone get the material if you put in the effort. Get to know her at office hours, she's super approachable and helpful

Siebs was one of my favorite professors I have had at UK. ACC 410 is a very tough class, but she teaches it in a way that forces you to eventually start to understand it. There is quite a bit of homework, but I have definitely seen worse. If she wasn't the professor, the course would have been much harder. She knows what she is doing.

Dr. Siebenthaler is a wonderful professor! I took the required audit class in 2013 and it was very difficult! I should have been better prepared and worked harder, but I felt proud to earn a B. I learned so much from her and enjoyed her class tremendously. I highly recommend her!

Siebs is a good professor. ACC 202 is a hard class but its easier than 201. She only offers 10 points of Extra Credit all semester and doesn't curve your exams but she is a good lecturer and teaches the material really well. Of all of the 202 professors, I would take her again because she cares and wants you to learn the stuff.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Siebs is awesome. Acc 202 is a pretty boring class but she makes it as enjoyable as possible with her cheesy jokes. The way she teaches allows you to truly understand the material as long as you consistently go to class and do the homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Would take again

reviews.comment: Siebs is one of the best professors I've had at UK. She doesn't curve and you have to earn your grade, but she makes it enjoyable if you're engaged.

Class essentially comes down to the 3 exams. If you fail or do poorly on the 1st it's pretty hard to get a passing grade in this class. She takes attendance but it doesn't have any impact on your grade. Make sure you go to every class or else you won't pass.  Homework is online but different from the material taught in class so be prepared to work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She was the best teacher that I have taken at the University of Kentucky. I learned so much in here class. Make sure you go to every lecture and participate.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Anyone who doesn't like Siebs didn't work very hard in class.  I struggled in the beginning but got it together and did fine in the class once I put in the work (ended up with a B, could've gotten an A if I worked hard all semester).  She's tough you she's great at teaching, makes class enjoyable, and I learned a ton in her class.

I've had Siebs for both Audit and NFP/Gov. I think she's an aspiring comedian. Neither class has been easy, but it is definitely A-able if you put in the work. Aside from the Intermediates her classes have been a couple of the harder accounting courses I've had at UK. If you're looking for an easy accounting elective I would avoid.
Makes class enjoyable. By now your used to the workload, because you're an accounting major. I highly recommend taking her

Hardest class I've had at UK. Siebs is one of the nicest, but toughest professors I've had. Lectures make everything seem really straightforward and understandable, then exams are extremely difficult. She's tough, but in the long run she'll prep you better for the CPA exam, despite the blow to your GPA

Awesome teacher.  Think she is tougher in 403, but in 410 her exams were exactly what we did in class.  If you go to class prepared, and take good notes you will do just fine in the class.  She is hot too.
Excellent instructor. She is hard but it's to your benefit. Doesn't play around, grow up and do your assignment as if it were the real world.

Siebs is really nice and funny, but she's just not that great of a teacher.  She assigns work on stuff she hasn't taught, then grades it as if you are a professional auditor.  Its insane.  The work load for this class is a little much, but  you should be able to get through. Never gotten a 100 on an assignment and dont think i ever will.  Very hard
She understands that students have lives.  Class is easy, she's a babe, it's fine.

Class is relatively easy, so a lot of time is spent in class that isn't very necessary. Largely test-based grade (~65-80% based on Homework and Tests) so I don't think she 'plays favorites' much. Made topic much more engaging, I really enjoyed the class.
Siebs is awesome. Very nice, helpful, and funny. She goes over a lot of examples in class which is nice and relates to the students well. Plus she's not bad to look at.

This class is hard so be prepared to work and tests are concept based and tricky. I recomend her if you are an accounting major.  If you want to get an A you must show up to every class and do the homework she assigns. She plays favorites so show up to every class and participate, it will boost your grade at the end of the semester.
Terrible teacher. Did not learn anything except that she should of picked a different career choice.

This teacher is terrible at teaching. Luckily the material is not that difficult, however test are tricky. She spends most of her time trying to tell jokes and being a comedian instead of a teacher. I'm going into my Junior year and this is by far the worst teacher I have had. UK please have someone sit in and evaluate this pathetic teacher.
Really Nice.  Do your work and show up!

Didn't learn a thing in class except she goes over the homework problems.  Tests are extremely tricky!  Quizzes were simple if you skim the vocab and do the REVIEW PROBLEMS in each chapter. However, try to get someone else, like Cooper. Got to admit this though, she's got  a very sexy ass.
Very nice person. Always willing to help. Moves pretty fast so its important to do home work. test are difficult but fair.
Horrible teacher.  Made the class almost impossible to learn.  Made test and quizzes super hard.  Take another teacher if able to.
Very hard teacher. Do not do homework with friends because she will accuse you of cheating. The only way to learn in this class is by working homework out with friends. She makes this impossible.
I love her.  So much.  Lots of fun and great teacher, but difficult material.  You need to stay on top of it.

She is great person, fun in class, but pretty bad at teaching. You MUST do the suggested HW problems own your own or you will struggle. She expects you to do it even though it is not graded. Tests are very difficult, even if you study. If ACC is your calling you might ace the tests, but for everyone else this class is a struggle.

She is a good teacher but gives very little notes. If you can learn from problems she is a good teacher. There are quizzes that are scheduled at the beginning of the semester. Quzzies are useful and the homework given is vital for a good grade in her class. The downside is no notes at all so u have to read some of the book but overall a she good.

Siebenthaler is horrible. Class attendance is made mandatory by in-class pop quizzes, yet the material is barely taught. She acts derogatorily towards students she doesn't like, and does very poorly explaining topics a second time when asked. Avoid at all costs.

Dr. Snider is a great person and professor. Exams are sort of difficult though (one midterm, one final) because his lectures and PowerPoints go by pretty quickly and they arent posted on Canvas. Exams could be on anything talked about mostly not in the study guide. However, if you do the work on class assignments, he will give you full points.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great teach, got to class get the grade. Very few assignments.
easy class, good guy

He is a very kind, funny, and easy going professor. His class is an easy A all you have to do is show up. All you have to do is read a book, write two papers, and give a couple speeches and he grades super leniently. He is also not too worried about deadlines and doesn't really take off points if you turn something in late.

Mitch is a great teacher. he brings a lot of philosophy into the class, makes everything really interesting. The "textbook" is very difficult to follow but he does a good job explaining what it is talking about. I see that a lot of people say he is a hard grader, but i haven't had any issues with his grading style. Overall, great professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Very cool guy! Made GEN 100 a great experience for me!
He's the man.

Mitch is a really cool guy. Youll look at him more like a student. You don't have to go to any of his classes. You go and just talk about some essay he makes you read or a podcast you listen to. The class is somewhat interesting. The worst part about him is that he is a VERY hard grader and unorganized. He's a cool guy though, not a terrible class.
I had Mitch for my recitation in digital mapping and the guy is very laid back but helpful. He doesn't put a ton of pressure on you and is very easy to get along with.

If there are other professors teaching GEO 172, take the other and not Snider. For an intro course, he sure makes things more difficult and his exams are suppose to be straight-forward but they are not. To do well in the class, go to class, complete all activities, and read the book to do well on exams. May the odds be ever in your favor...

Be ready to handle a lot at once. 4 to 5 pages of notes every class typed out on my computer. HE is a really cool guy though and makes it really interesting. Give you a fair amount of time on the papers, but there is just a lot of stuff that is covered. If you don't know a lot about Geography you should probably not take this class
Lectures are engaging, topics interesting.There are no exams but he will take the time to read what you write! Refreshing to have a professor who is passionate about learning!
