Dr. Summers is one of the funniest professors at UK.  If you have to take a history class, make sure its one of his.

I liked this professor. He was entertaining, and I must say I became a history major because of him. I would not take his glad or a grade for his exams are hard, and you have to take a rectiation course also which was okay, TA was helpful.

His lectures are entertaining but wow his expections are high. You have to read so many books and take essay tests then write a 10 page paper. He grades so hard on short id's so be as specific as you can! He's really helpful and smart but I wish I didn't take his class.

HAHA this guy is redic but overall he is a nice guy/good prof.  His lectures are pretty eventful but you dont have to go.  I never went to class and didnt even buy the text book and I got a B in the class.

This guyis rediculous! Completely hard to follow and his assignments are simply too tedious and take up too much time considering the class. He requires you to read several book then write on them after you take essay tests. Awful!

I absolutely loved this class.  His lectures are always interesting, his sprinting around the room and shouting on top of desks makes sure of that. The tests are hard if you don't study, all essay and short answer.  If you go to lecture and discussion and study, it's an easy A.

This guy is CRAZYYYY!! He runs around, jumps on tables, yells, slams doors, he's out of control. But he makes the lectures VERY entertaining! Tests are difficult though and you HAVE TO STUDY. My TA told me the textbook wasn't necessary so I didn't buy it and have an A in the class, I use wikipedia to look up the identifications from the study guide

Dr. Summers is my favorite professor.  He is really animated and loves history. He made history so interesting. He tells a story thoughout lecture.  Dont get me wrong-his exams are tough if you dont study.  He is not too helpful because he doesnt use email but thats what your TA is for :) He will make you really enjoy history!

If you were going to attend any lecture at UK I would recommend Summers. But, i think he is very overhyped as a professor. He was very unapproachable, he tests you over books that he never discusses. He is very disorganized.It is a great experience to attend his lectures but not if you are expecting organized lectures or essays that make any sense

Dr. Summers is very entertaining and one of the best story tellers I have met, he passionate about the subject and expects his students to be as well. As far as the classwork, you will have 3 papers which are graded fairly easily, and 3 exams including the final, for the exams he gives you a study guide a couple weeks prior to the exam. Great guy.

Do not recommend taking him. His lectures are impossible to comprehend. He talks way too fast, goes off track,and will often mumble thoughts out loud about random things that are absolutely irrelevant to the class. He is very non-understanding and cannot fathom the thought of students doing anything but studying.
Extremely entertaining

Loved him!! I love history though but I still would have liked his class even if i didn't. He is so great in lecture! It was like listening to a story everyday in class. I felt like he knew the people. Oh and he always left every class with a cliff hanger like a new anchor does before a commmercial break. haha. I loved it!
Great professor.
He is crazy, could not follow what he was talking about. lots of papers. Hard to concentrate on what he is talking about because he never stays on track, did not like him.
best teacher. he is hilarious and kind of crazy. but over all a good teacher.
he's good

Nice guy.  Pretty eccentric.  Lecture isn't mandatory but recitation is.  Make sure you read books assigned outside of class- they won't be discussed but they appear on exams.  Exams are all writing, with one question worth half of the exam grade.  Not a difficult class, though.
He is very funny and i could never fall asleep he jumps on tables!  I love his class but some of this TA's are awful!  Sometimes they don't grade fairly.  So just watch the TAs

He is very overrated. He knows his material, but he does not teach it in an effective way. Heis funny and theatrical, but he did not present the facts clearly. We had several books that we had to buy and we never discussed them in class, even though they showed up on the tests. I though that his class was unnecesarily hard and a waste of money.

The guy that jumps on tables.  Slightly eccentric, but he's a nice guy and will have your back if you show the least bit of effort.  His detective assignments aren't tough, in fact, if you get them wrong you still get full credit.  He's kind of predictable with his lectures so you can be tempted to skip class.  I guess I'd recommend him.

Best prof. I've had so far. He is very passionate about his subject, and makes history exciting. He is willing to help in his office hours and holds review sessions before test if we ask for them. I really recommend this class, I learned a lot about US History that I couldn't have from a textbook. Lectures aren't mandatory, but recitation is.
Hard to follow. very weird

The best professor I had, I took the class because the previous semester I would sit outside and listen to his lectures while I waited for my class. He is passionate, and makes history fascinating. The tone of his voice when he lectured about the revolutionary war literally gave me chills, it was so good! I highly encourage you to take his class!!!

I liked Summers. He is very knowledgable about History and wants his students to know everything. However, I would NOT recommend taking this class early in the morning because attendance isn't mandatory so I found myself missing a lot of classes and getting far behind because you cover so much every class. Test are essay style- very long and hard.
I could not understand his lectures because he was too busy trying to make a scene and act crazy. He would often lose my interest the moment i sat down.

Easily one of the best professors at UK. Sometimes his lectures are all over the place, especially if someone asks a completely unrelated question, but overall he ties in the readings and assignments to his lectures. About 4 or 5 books and one text book, all of which were enjoyable reads. One 7-10 page paper, 2 exams, and about 14 assignments.
He made class fun and enjoyable.  I hated history and never learned anything until I was in Summer's class!

He will help you if you need it. He is funny. Most importiantly, he cares what his students get on test. Everyone in the class seems to love him and he is my favorite history teacher at UK. Very easy to get an A and if you fail or get a D its really our own fault, its all lain out in black and white for you. I showed up to 1/2 the classes. 91%

One word to describe Dr summers lectures...EPIC. every class is like a hollywood movie.  I loved watching the little tiny man riverdance on a desk, jump over chairs to answer a question and run up and down the stairs just to shut the door.  What a character.  Super interesting. below avg hardness.  fun class.

he is a very good professor, knows history very well and presents it in an original way, is funny and basically makes history into a story, lectures are almost like a show. Tests are all essays and short answers. Probably the best professor I have had.

His lectures are very unpredictable. If you do not like history or find it boring you will love his class. However if you are a history major or are seeking a deeper knowledge of history it is the wrong class to take. He has a very personal approach to the subject.

This class was a requirement for my major, but I wish I never had to take it. Good luck pre-nursing majors. I used to love chemistry before this class.

I say this with sincerity, if you need a good gpa, dont even bother taking this class with Soult. Shes insanely insecure over criticism of how poorly she teaches the class and does nothing except blame students. The class average is almost failing, which in itself is telling. Talk to your advisor and see if theres any other options you have

Dr. Soult is the worst professor Ive ever had in my life. She teaches things in her lectures and gives us practice problems in our homework that dont match up with the tests at all. I understood the class material and for some reason ended up failing almost every exam because of how she sets them up. Her teaching ability is awful in my opinion.
Its a reversed class a lot of time is dedicated outside of class. If you pay attention and study its not terrible the content is just hard

10/10 would never take her class again. She is so hard to contact outside of class and is totally stubborn when it comes to grading and slip-ups on the students part. Her tests are ridiculously hard and although she knows what she's talking about, she is just plain rude and probably the least understanding person Ive ever met.

If you can take this course anywhere else, do it. This class does not have to be as hard as it actually is, but Soult has been failing for years to properly instruct the class. the tests reflect little to nothing of what has been discussed or in the homework and are worth 75% of your grade. Take this class at bctc because this class is ridiculous

currently taking this course and this is by far the worst taught class i have ever been in. we are forced to learn from 3-10 minute youtube videos, and do a random activity in class. you can study as much as you want and will probably either fail or almost fail. soult does not believe in lecturing and fails at properly teaching this class

Soult gets paid to make videos that dont explain anything in her PlayPosit videos and then stand in lecture and not even lecture. She does not teach very well in my opinion, and her tests are graded heavily.

The way this class is set up is so unhelpful, I barely learned anything and when you ask for help she passes you off to someone else. Shes a very sweet woman , I just cant get with the way this class is taught. It also takes up so much of your time every single day.

Had I not taken AP Chem in high school, I might not have done as well as I did. Dr. Soult is not bad, but if you do not ask her questions directly about content, it can be hard to understand something. There is so much work for this class, so you need to have a schedule to spread it out so you aren't overwhelmed. Tests are worth 75% of grade. Sux.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I was not a fan of the set-up of this class. Class time is a waste and consists entirely of iClicker questions, so you have to go even though the information is basic and repetitive. The material isn't difficult but this in this class, you pretty much have to teach yourself. Homework doesn't align with what we're taught, just frustrating.

I put sooo much time and effort into this class. If I had not gone to office hours I would have done awful. I dont think you should have to go to office hours to do good in a class though. I spent many hours each day doing homework and trying to learn the material. Things were rarely gone over in class to the point where I actually understood it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Participation matters

reviews.comment: If you have the opportunity to have a different professor, take it. I would never recommend Allison Soult, she does not know how to use the flipped classroom setting and then gets upset with the students. Use the TAs provided and the groups you are in to get your questions answered in class because her answers will be vague and unhelpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I could write an entire essay on Prof. Soult. Her favorite saying is "I make it hard on purpose to prepare you". That would be fine and all except her idea of making it hard is not teaching most of the material. I'm doing well in the class but that is from teaching myself. The only upside is a lot of stuff is dropped and reduced at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Soult is a nice lady. She helps, kind of, if you go to office hours. You have to teach yourself and the TA's don't help as much either. Tests are 75% of your grade so if you do bad, you will fail. Even if you study, it's too much material for one test.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This so called instructor is terrible!! She doesnt even teach she posts her lectures online and you have to teach yourself!!! You do iclicker for participation points and the questions are hidden so if youre not in class you cant answer them. Your tests are 75% of your grade. Youll be drowned in homework that barely raises your overall grade!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Soult is always willing to help students. This class has TONS of outside work, like watching videos before class. Come to class, attendance is taken every day with a clicker.

get ready to teach yourself basically everything. the playposits due for homework are extremely vague and not helpful whatsoever, so therefore, you will miss the questions. the flipped classroom is horrible for this type of class because you basically teach yourself everything at home. i wanted to cry everyday during this class. BUY A CHEGG ACCOUNT
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She uses a reverse classroom where you teach yourself the material at home and go to class and do homework and ask questions. There's not enough TA's so chances of getting your question answered is slim to none. Soult spent less than 10 minutes a week teaching us complicated chemistry. Worst class and professor I've ever had

Dr. Soult was wonderful. She really wants you to do good but she believes in students working for their own success. If you solely study the old exams you won't be prepared, doing the practice problems in the back of the online textbook she provides allows you to master the content. I have passed every test with an 85 or higher and I suck @ chem!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: You will put in tons of work outside the classroom for this class. You have to watch videos before class and answer questions about new content as you watch the video and you're graded on it. So if the new content in the video doesn't make sense to you, you're gonna miss questions and get a low grade. Avoid this class if you can.

This is a hard class. chemistry sucks either way, but Dr. Soult has lots of office hours and is always wiling to help. there is a lot of 'busy work' and its annoying, but definitely do it because you need all the points you can get. tests are hard. study with the old exams!! they're just like the real thing
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class has absolutely no instruction. You will teach yourself, with absolutely no help. I studied 40+ hours for each exam and did all of the required homework and went to tutoring and still couldn't get higher than a C on any exams. Exams are 75% of final grade.

This was a flipped classroom which I feel had a lot to do with why Dr. Soult did not teach very well. A majority of assignments and learning was completed outside of class and it was very time consuming. She rarely explained things during class, but she provided an online forum to ask questions in which responses were prompt. An A was strenuous.

She does not teach at all! She makes you watch videos outside of class to teach yourself and the class is very exam heavy with grades. You have to put in a ton of outside work because it is incredibly demanding. I know of so many people, who put in SO much effort for this class without their grade showing it. Avoid this class if you can

This class was tough and you most certainly have to put in work to get the grade you want. She is very easily accessible but seeking outside help may be necessary for success. To do well you have to do a lot outside of the class, especially if chem isn't your strong suit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She didn't teach at all. The class consisted of her sending out videos before each class that were time consuming and hard to understand and doing homework in class (which the homework doesn't help for exams). Also there are only about 26 questions on the exams so you can't miss more than 5 questions to get a B! If you can avoid this class I would.

Doesn't actually teach. You watch videos for homework that replace the lectures but you are graded in the middle of them. Is completely unhelpful if you have questions. I did well but only because I had already taken AP Chem, the rest of the class struggled a lot and for good reason; She doesn't really teach the material at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's an awesome professor! The flipped classroom took some time to get used to but she is always willing to help if you have questions. Its a large class so you do have to put in work to understand the material. Before every test do all the practice exams and the practice questions in the back of the book and you're golden!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Soult is very nice but she doesn't teach at all. She makes you watch videos that are very confusing before every lecture and I personally didn't understand anything she was teaching. I was better off getting a tutor because she wasn't helpful in office hours or in class. Definitely not a very good teacher at all.
I loved having Dr. Soult as a professor! For this semester chem was my favorite class, and she was a big reason why. 10/10 would recommend her as a professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS--Would take again

reviews.comment: This class is not set up in a typical way. You do have to do a lot of outside class work, but she gives in class time for any questions. The tests are not that hard if you study for them. I recommend going over the past exams because some of the same material is on there.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Dr. Soult is someone that has not benefitted me/my education in any way. Her flipped classroom is smart but NOT for chem 103. The sad thing is, she is a nice lady that genuinely believes her methods are beneficial. Nobody else teaches this class so get ready to study 10+ hours a week outside of class to be successful & go ahead and book your tutor!

I think she means well, but she is not a "teacher." You are expected to learn everything on your own. Class time is used to answer a couple general questions that may or may not apply to the current course work. After that, you work with your group on homework and she does zero instructing. I squeezed by, but did not really hang on to concepts.
A lot of outside of class work!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: If you don't like a reverse classroom setting then this class definitely won't be for you. Overall, Soult was a very caring and friendly professor. The exams are weighted very heavily on your grade and you need to study hard to do well, but Soult changes the weight of your worst exam & offers extra credit that you can earn throughout the semester
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Had to teach myself all semester. i am a person who CAN NOT learn this way. very disappointing bc she thinkings a "reversed classroom" works better than a normal classroom. You WILL be teaching yourself. She goes over things but the homework will be things you've never heard of.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Her voice is not pleasing to listen to. She is not a good teacher because we have to do lectures outside of the classroom and homework in class so the level of motivation to go to class at 9am is zero considering I never learn anything new in class. She does REEF so it sucks because you can't miss or it'll hurt your attendance grade.

Dr. Soult has the reverse classroom style which is not for everyone. That's part of the reason why I didn't enjoy her class. In class, she doesn't teach at all and just makes you do assignments. Sometimes she could get a little "snappy" if you go ask for help in office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Soult does have a "reverse classroom" style, but her class is not as bad as other people make it seem. She gives SO many outside resources available for her students. If you take advantage of her resources and study hard for this class then it is easy to get an A or B. I overall enjoy the class and Dr. Soult!

Soult is fine as long as you're willing to spend time actually studying.  The worst part is the lecture system she uses-- you have to watch them outside of class so it's up to you to make sure you know the material.  Otherwise, the concepts aren't difficult and the homework is fairly straightforward.  Just pay attention to the lectures and study.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: get ready to teach yourself chemistry for an entire semester! She does not lecture during class, instead she makes you watch videos outside of class teaching you the lessons then you come to class and work on homework that you never get done during class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Dr. Soult does not teach you Chemistry.  You will watch videos online before coming to class and then you will do the homework in class, which doesn't make much sense to me... I found it helpful to make practice tests over the Sapling Assignments and do the practice problems in the book. I would just suggest not taking Dr. Soult..

I found this course to be challenging but defininteley do able  Dr. Soult makes herself  available 4 hours every week for questions you may have. Its important you understand that during class time we cover the general concept of that unit and its your responsibility to understand ALL of the learning outcome. If you do so y will be successfull.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Her lectures are online and you listen to them before class and take notes on them. When you get to class you work on homework the whole time. She doesnt review the material in class. The material in her lectures are very easy but when you receive the test it is nothing like the lectures.

Dr. Soult is usually very clear in criteria and what is expected from each student and each class. Also, the online textbook is very helpful and old exams provided along with instructional videos. You get what you put into the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class is essentially teaching yourself. She puts videos online that you have to watch/take notes on before class, & then usually doesn't review them in class. Class time is spent working on hw. She tells you what will be on the test, but a lot of times these topics weren't covered in the videos. Super tough, don't take it if you don't have to
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Soult for CHE 105, one of my first college classes, and absolutely loved her! She gives great lectures and helped me outside the classroom with online homework and understanding concepts. Wish I had had her for 107!!

She is a very difficult teacher. Each test's average was in the upper 60s. A good teacher would not have an average so low. She will help you if you go to her office hours (but theres about 20 other students there each time). She scoffed at me whenever I would ask a question which is demeaning because I have never been confident in chemistry.

DO NOT TAKE HER. SHES THE WORSE. I warn you dude  DONT. she does not explain most of the materials in class and count on you to do it by your self. You have to respond correct by using the clicker app, so you can get the attendance score. Incorrect choice mean, you do not have an attendance score for that day. She does not care about her students

She is a very hard teacher. She makes you teach yourself the last chapter and you don't get any new perspectives because she is the person who wrote the book. She is the only CHE 103 teacher otherwise I wouldn't have taken the class. The problems on the test are nothing like what she actually gives you for practice. The tests are tough.
Very hard!

If you go to class, do the homework, and prepare for exams you'll do fine. The people who complain about her do so because they aren't willing to work hard. If you want an A you're going to have to work at it, but it is not by any means impossible! Use the homework and study questions in the book and LEARNING OUTCOMES to study for exams.

Dr. Soult is a great teacher and an even better person. My interest in chemistry was the bare minimum and if I hadn't had her, I probably wouldn't have passed. She tells you exactly what to study and goes through everything on her power points in depth. You obviously have to take some initiative yourself, but she makes it very easy to suceed.
Stern but like able, knowledgeable, ask for help if needed

Soult is very clear with what is expected of you. You will not pass this class by only doing homework and attending class. Highly recommend outlining each chapter in the book and doing the chapter review problems in the book.

The class is tough, she knows what she is talking about but only covers about half of the material she tests you on in class. Definitely go through the text book (which she wrote herself) and work out ALL of the practice problems, the solutions will be posted to canvas.  Go over ALL group work and sapling, nearly all questions are drawn from there.

I think Dr. Soult is an excellent chemistry professor. She was very clear about what would be on exams (i.e. FOCUS ON THE "LEARNING OUTCOMES" IN THE TEXTBOOK). She answered questions 24/7 and I think she does a really good job explaining difficult chem concepts. Do the practice problems in the book to study for exams. Go to class every day.
Awesome professor, definitely my favorite. Although the class is absolute hell, completely unfair, and the worst thing I've ever done, she is a very talented professor. Would not take course again.
Great at explaining concepts.
Pretty good professor. Made chemistry about as clear as it was going to get. Definitely willing to help during office hours. Likes to use technology in lectures. No complaints really.

I thought Dr. Soult was a fine instructor. The people that complain do so because they're lazy. She provides you with so many resources to help you do good on exams, which aren't as hard as she makes them out to be. As long as you pay attention and study you will do fine.

Soult is a nice professor. She is not much help if you haven't done much chemistry. She goes extremely fast through the material and does not give any examples. You should always go to class since your grade is 10% attendance.

Soult is a great person! She is a good teacher for students who have had chemistry before but for me, someone who has very, very little chemistry, I'm lost. She talks extremely fast and doesn't do many examples. The Zaption videos she gives as extra homework is very helpful. On the 3 exams I got a D+, D-, C-. I have to retake CHE 105 next semester.

She is a horrible professor. I taught myself the whole semester. Everything she taught in class is easier than what is actually on the exam. On group work days I was left clueless.  Attendance is mandatory and poll questions are for accuracy. I would never take this class again. Good luck.

She is the worst professor I've ever had. She never teaches the content that's on the test and expects the students to teach it to themselves. When she does teach, she teaches "watered down" versions of things and puts much much harder application on the actual test. She expects you to teach yourself chemistry when many have never had chemistry.

Dr. Soult makes her grading criteria clear, but doesn't really teach. She thinks watching videos can replace her lecturing. Get ready to teach yourself and read a LOT. She says she's there to help you, but will just direct you back to the text/practice problems. Only reason I have an A is because of the Gen Chem Center. Avoid her classes.

Very hard, and is not very understanding. Be prepared to work for your  grade. I would not retake this course with this professor. I would suggest you find a different professor. If you struggle in chemistry, the University of Kentucky offers a CHE 109 and 110. It is CHE  105 but split up in two semesters. The lab is the second semester.
Hard class. Need to study and keep up with it. Exams are hard. There are clicker questions everyday, and they count for accuracy. She was a good professor though

The class is a little tough because it's chemistry, but she makes it so much easier to learn. She does so many examples and is always there to help her students. She is easily my favorite college professor so far! Take her before any other teachers for CHE105

If you want to pass a test, prepare to learn everything on your own. The only reason I'm passing is because I have read the textbook over and over again by myself. She doesn't cover what the tests do in class, and it's really difficult to know what to expect. My advice: learn everything, if at all possible. Class is not helpful besides attendance.

This is a hard class but Dr. Soult really goes the extra mile to make sure that you have covered all the material and you have as much practice as possible before the exams. The exams are fair and if you take her advice for studying you will most likely do well.

During lecture I always felt like I understood everything but the exams are completely different. She always says to do practice problems in the book but the exams are so much harder. It was an ok class, but I don't think she is a good teacher at all.

When studying for tests, USE THE TEXTBOOK. She will have a tab on Sapling that shows everything you need to know and the corresponding section in the textbook. I took notes on those sections before the tests and had no problem getting A's on them. Be sure to come to class and ask questions. She isn't the best but will help if you need it!

Unclear lectures. Assigns HW over stuff you don't even know. Tests are not over stuff taught in the class. Doesn't really care how the class does bc test averages are usually Ds or lower and she doesn't address the issue. Make sure you read the book for extra info.

She doesn't teach well at all. Considering I'm a visual learner and lecture classes are usually hard for me to begin with, but with this class and this teacher it seems impossible to get a good grade. I have been having to teach myself this whole semester and have never had to do that before and its so much harder than you think. Pick another prof.

Hardest class and professor I've had all year. Almost feels like she wanted no one to succeed in this class. Material taught in lectures never corresponded with the exams and three of our five exams were at a D average for the whole class. Incredibly difficult course, if you have to take this class like I did, then just try your best to survive.
Good prof overall. Knows what she's teaching, but you gotta work for it.

Soult was pretty good. I have to agree that she doesn't emphasize what is on the test enough. Her grading system was weird. I had a C at midterm and B for my final grade but didn't get below a B on tests. Her analogies really helped me understand conceptual  components of the class. I would recommend taking her just be sure to read over chapters.

Soult isn't an awful Prof but her class is a nightmare. The test are a foreign language compared to the practice work she gives you. Most of the class averages on the exams were C's or D's and she does not curve. I made above average on all but one exam and still had a C. Participation and homework grades count for virtually nothing.

As long as you pay attention in class, professor Soult will give you everything you need to do well on the exams. Most people don't do well in this class because it is one of their first college courses, but take her advice and practice book problems and do the homework. She's so good at explaining and will clearly answer any questions you have.

Horrible professor and not very nice. Took the class once with her and failed, took it again with a much better professor and did a lot better. Her teaching is awful and she doesn't even cover whats on the test half the time. If you get her, drop and add a different section with Blue or Woodrum.

One of the best options for general chemistry classes.  Not as good as Woodrum, but better than most professors.  Lecture can get kind of boring, but she explains things well enough that you should totally understand it if you actually pay attention.  If you take good notes, the textbook is completely unnecessary.
She was decent. Not bad, not good. Lectures weren't very interested.

Dr. Soult has a structured and informative class. She is very helpful during office hours and beforeafter class. She has lots of clicker questions and optional practice problems. The only disappointment was group days--I would've preferred to have lecture instead of group because the material was new.

Dr. Soult is very open and friendly. I never felt the need to go to her for help, because her lectures are very clear with lots of analogies and examples, but I know that she was always there when students needed her. The textbook is a good guide, but I don't think it's necessary to complete all the problems or anything.

CHE 105 is a difficult course for most because of the amount of content covered, but I felt that Dr. Soult conveyed everything effectively. She takes steps to ease the transition from high school into college more than most professors, like posting videos to Blackboard that explain the algebra of more difficult chemistry problems.
BUY THE BOOK! It helps more than Dr. Soult. She is nice, but you literally have to read everything in the section to get a good grade on the test.

She is very easy to follow. However, when it comes to the tests you'll realize she didn't cover all of it. You really have to read and hope you pick out the right things to remember because when it comes to theories she does not touch them. Other then that she does a good job of teaching and will take questions until everyone stops asking.

The mastering chem assignments are way too long and the lectures get old fast. She does a good job explaining the material though I didn't have any trouble with the material just do the work no matter how tedious it is.
It's a weed out class, just get through it. She's better than most

Her lectures are not specific and the practice problemshomework is completely different from the test questions. You basically have to teach yourself the material. Make sure you do the reading and take your own notes, or you will not understand the tests.
She goes way too fast to keep up. You basically have to teach yourself or hire a full time tutor. Do not ever skip  or she will hate you and you will fail.
Hard class in general no matter what professor.
Shes not bad at the job. But i feel like there was something to be desired. I would have liked a different professor.
She's a great professor and expects students to put in the work

I am no good with chemistry and this class was a breeze for me, She used tons of examples to dumb down the material. She's really nice too and always does her best to help you understand the material.
Tough class obviously. Soult moves fast so keeping up with her and the class is a must. Textbook use is heavy if you want to understand the subject better and practice for the tests.

This was a required course for pre-nursing majors. This class was very easy for me, but a lot of my friends did not feel the same way. You have to basically teach yourself. Make sure you read and understand the book and you will be fine. This was the first textbook I actually read! Also, office hours are very helpful.

Overall, I didn't like her as a professor. She doesn't teach with a whole lot of enthusiasm, and is very hard to follow at times. I never went to her office hours, mainly because I like to teach myself the chemistry content. Be sure to do all the homework assignments and get all extra credit possible. This class is not as easy as CHE 105, for sure.

She moves quickly, but she knows her stuff.  Do not miss class if you can avoid it, and make sure you leave lots of time to do the online homework.  The book gets used somewhat, but you have to have it as a reference for data. Dr. Soult doesn't baby you, but she's not out to crush your spirit either.  Work hard, prepare early, and ask questions!!!
Almost the worst professor I've had. Cannot teach in class so I am paying all this tuition money to teach myself chemistry
Great professor for CHE 105. Moves fast, but you have to keep up with the pace of the class. Very helpful and great at explaining things during review day for tests.

Dr. Soult seems a bit strict in class, but i can understand as the class is primarily freshman.  However she really shines in her office hours. She is extremely helpful and clear, and very personable. She bent over backwards to help me and accommodate me (in particular for a final exam rescheduling issue). Highly recommended.

Good teacher, I have her again this semester for a different class. She's a little twitchy and it's easy to fall asleep, but she puts the print version of her notes online so it's not hard to catch up. You really need the book, but an old edition does just fine.

Dr. Soult is engaging and interested in helping students understand material. The material is inherently not easy but she breaks it down so it is easier to learn. I don't like chemistry but didn't mind it in this class.

This class was HARD. Homework is very time consuming. Soult is very knowledgeable, but moves really fast through notes and will call you out if you're on your phone. Her lectures go "bell to bell" so to speak down to the last second. Use old practice exams, tests are hard. You definitely need to study. Book practice problems are probably helpful.
Tests are hard! With only 25 questions, there is no wiggle room. You either know the material or you don't.
Simply amazing. Weird cell phone rules. She knows her chemistry and is there to teach, listen, and help whenever she can.

Although I received a C in the class, Dr.Soult was a great teacher. The overall chemistry department at UK has an increased level of difficulty. She is very friendly, but professional. She makes jokes in class and tries to keep students interested. Study, USE THE BOOK for practice (VERY HELPFUL), and take good notes. Wants students to succeed
She has a weird phone policy but you'll definitely learn in her class. You have access to old exams and they're extremely similar. Homework is time consuming but pretty easy to get full credit.

Dr. Soult knows chemistry, but for me this class was HARD.  You really have no idea what is going to be on the exams and with only 25 questions, there isn't much room for error. If you go to class, do all the homework, and do the bonus assignments, it will help your grade a lot! Be prepared to work hard.

She knows how to teach the material, but moves VERY quickly. Most students have to learn the material on their own. She can also be demeaning to students, so not many will ask questions in class to clarify material. She will help though if you go to her office hours. Be prepared to study HARD and read the book often.

Dr. Soult is willing to help but moves through material VERY quickly during her lectures. I found it hard to learn during lecture and ended up teaching myself what I could. Be prepared to study if you want to make a decent grade in this class and DON'T take it with multiple demanding science courses.
Good professor but her tests are tricky. So if you're not a good test taker, avoid her course. Other than that it's an interesting class.
It was not bad but its hard if you don't know chem. if you don't know end you go to every class you still won't know it study study study. All I can say.

Soult very obviously cares about her students but she lacks as a teacher. Lectures are dry and homework comes from content in the book, not her lectures which makes some questions nearly impossible. She tends to answer the same questions 5/6 times which is very annoying. She knows chemistry though extremely well and is always helpful w/ questions
A boring professor with weird phone and computer policies. I like her homework policies and she is helpful. There are better options for chemistry 105 though.

She is a good professor. She will allow you to text her if you have questions. She answers questions pretty quickly. She is pretty strict about talking in class which is a good thing because she wants students to learn. She allows you to ask people around you and share answers. Her exams are somewhat hard; you need to study and keep up to do well.

She really knows her material, and although lectures get kind of dry, the tests are very straight forward! If you read the text book and do the practice problems at the end of the chapter, you can easily get atleast a B in the class. Shes very approachable and patient if you have questions, I would definitely recommend her.

i think she is a very good teacher. she relates old material to the new material so you hear it a lot. very helpful when you email with questions. super nice!!!!!! clicker questions are very helpful also. her tests are over the basics and are not tricky at all. class is not very interesting but i don't enjoy chemistry in general.
Very helpful but lectures are kinda dry

Coming from a chemistry major, Soult really knows how to teach the beginner chemistry. Honestly, if youve never taken a chemistry course before, Id recommend her. Ive heard Woodrum is better but youll be able to learn what you have to from Soult just fine.

Dr. Soult is an amazing professor. She is willing to help students during office hours and even makes time outside of office hours for students. I was always in her office with questions. USE YOUR TEXTBOOK! You can't expect an "A" if you don't work at it. Doing the practice problems at the end of each chapter is helpful.

I had Soult for both CHE 105 and 107. She was much better for 105 than 107 in my opinion, but her class was still fairly easy. She is a fair teacher and if you have a problem she is very easy to talk to. The best way to succeed in her class is to read the text book, take practice tests, and watch Woodrum's lectures that are available on iTunes.

Dr. Soult was knowledgeable of the subject matter, but did not know how to teach it. Her lectures were not helpful, I ended up watching Dr. Woodrum's podcasts to understand the material. She felt as if her job was to tell us the information and move on with her life. She could care less about each individual student. I do not recommend her at all.

Dr. Soult was probably the worst professor I have had. I am a nursing major and was required to take this course. The semester before me was also a nursing class. She ended up curving their grades 5% and didnt curve ours. And that was our competition. I ended the course with a 79.8 and she wouldn't round it. She doesnt work well with her students.

Dr. Soult was essentially a high school teacher and not in a good way.  She was a stickler for phones and used every last second of class.  The homework is tedious. Her notes and the material appear easy but the exams end up being very difficult.  It's nearly impossible to make a mistake on the exam and get an A since there are only 25 questions.
The most wonderful professor I've ever had. She always kept me interested in the class and was always willing to help. After having Dr. Soult I changed my major to chemistry.

Overall good professor. She always was available if you have questions, and responded to emails quickly. She does talk very fast,so be ready to take notes. She posts her powerpoints online which is helpful. Make sure you read the textbook while studying,because tests are hard and her lectures dont always cover whats on the test.

She explains things well and asks if you have questions often to make sure you understand everything. Seems more like a high school teacher which makes the transition to college easier. I recommend her, just don't have your phone out during class.

I think she is very helpful. I heard alot of people dont like her, but I dont get why. She explains everything and allows for questions. Make sure to bring your clicker and I would suggest to print out the lecture powerpoints so you dont have to write down every little thing. :)

Soult feels like a high school teacher in a lecturer's shoes. She is all business in the lectures, and she covers the material by the book. She does a pretty good job of explaining the material, though. Don't expect to enjoy the lectures at all, but if you go to them and pay attention the tests aren't too bad.
She explains things really well in lectures and seems willing to help in office hours. I think she is a great professor.
Not the friendliest person in the world.  but, she is clear and helpful whenever you ask a question.  Bring your clicker everyday and DONT TEXT!!

I don't know why everyone doesn't like her. I love her! One of my favorite professors. She makes everything understandable. She does move fast sometimes, but just ask questions and she'll be very helpful. Don't waste her time and DON'T TEXT.

I don't know why everyone hates her. I love her teaching style. I practically live in her office, where she is nice and helpful. She's very patient if you don't understand something. She is easy to follow and makes things simple. Just don't waste her time and DO NOT TEXT IN CLASS. But if you study, you WILL get an A
Not very helpful and can be rude. But her teaching style is not that bad.
She is absolutely TERRIBLE.I would say not to take her but for CHE 103, shes the only teacher. She is not helpful and she makes everything harder than necessary. Good luck

I agree with the comment below...Soult isn't bad, as long as you don't bother her with useless crap. She helped me every time I went to her office. Just approach her nicely, knowing she's strict and doesn't offer any leeway. My lab partner was scared to talk to her and got a B...I got an A.

Don't know what everyone's beef with Soult is...I assume you all failed. She is very strict, & expects no BS. I went to her office many times for help. She's fairly unapproachable, but just brown-nose a bit. Be super nice & respectful since she isn't forgiving. She won't cut you any slack, but if you make a noticeable effort, an A is obtainable.

She is extremely rude and unhelpful. Going to her office was a terrible decision and she tries to be as unhelpful as possible. Probably one of the worst professors in the chemistry department. Has ridiculous rules about leaving class early, even if there is nothing left to do.

VERY rude and unapproachable. Tried to visit her office a couple times when I had questions but eventually never went back. She was much more interested in what she was doing on her computer than anything I was saying. I felt stupid for trying to seek help from her.

I had Soult for 111 and 113. She is not helpful. Very strict about her policies, NO MERCY. Almost impossible to get an A. She firmly believes in a C average. A lot of your grade depends on your lab TA, however. Pay attention to Blackboard and her emails. People miss her deadlines and online quizzes because they don't read Blackboard.
Extremely difficult to obtain an A. Midterm and final exam are written intentionally to be more difficult than lecture exams. Experiments are written vaguely and follow up questions are very diluted.
Horrid teacher.  She will not help you if you are the least bit lost.  She is rude, and acts like she's better than what you're attempting to talk to her about.  Should be FIRED.
Hard class. she is no help at all. She is extremely rude and seems like she hates what she does

The lab manuals that she writes are straight forward in 111, but in 113 they were very foggy because she didn't give us any procedures to our experiments. That was kind of annoying. Overall, the labs are really easy. The lab reports suck but actually are really easy too. The only things that were difficult were the midterm and final in 113.
I think Dr. Soult is wonderful. She is VERY nice and helpful. I think her attitude toward you depends a lot on you and how you approach her. She was NEVER rude to me.
I am not sure why everyone is dogging on Dr. Soult. I only went to her office hours once and she was very helpful and nice.
Wow....the absolute worst teacher at UK. NO joke, she is absolutely terrible. she is mean to her students and extremely condescending if you have a question for her. Seriously, she is the worst.

awful awful awful. she doesnt seem to care that students really struggle with the lab. the entire semester all we did were titrations. the class wouldnt be completely awful if there wasnt a midterm or final. the exams are harder to take than the chem lecture exams. soooo glad to finally be done with the lab!!!
I have never seen her before.  Basically, your TA teaches the lab.  If you have a good TA its awesome.  If you don't you're screwed.  I've heard of people going to talk to her and her not caring.

I am an "A" student, or shall I say I was until taking this class. It is purposefully conducted to screw your GPA. Good TA (Chris Noe) but terrible lab supervisor. I've never even seen her face and yet she's our professor? It doesn't matter how much effort you put into this class,the way that the assignments are graded will ruin your grade.

Terrible lab supervisor. Forces the TA's to grade "drafts" of lab reports without a student having any knowledge or teaching of how to write one. Can ruin a GPA. The online BB quizzes have flaws/inconsistencies & she simply doesn't care. An okay lady, but TERRIBLE at teaching students about lab reports & TERRIBLE at communicating. So disappointing!

Midterm/Final have nothing to do with the labs. You learn NOTHING from the labs- NOTHING. Huge waste of time. Lab reports are a joke. A good TA will save your life/GPA. These lab classes are a joke. I'm pretty sure she tries to fail students by making test questions harder than some on a che107 test. Hope she realizes no one takes her class serious

Dr. Soult must have written the 1 comment that is positive.  Ha ha, that is just what I would expect!  Dragon Lady is polite.  It is true that she is hateful toward students, and really seems to seek out ways of lowering grades.  She takes what could be a really cool experience and makes it miserable! Class average is purposefully held at a C.
the tests are completely dumb and drawn out. its like taking one of the exams for the regular class....never in a million years did i expect a lab to be so terrible!!

My experience with Dr. Soult's is I was asking to make up a lab because I missed due to weather inclination and she didn't look at me, she looked at her computer. Then she turned around to her microwave and started cooking lunch. That is rude.
call her Dr. Salt and see what she does. lol

Yeah, she is not helpful at all! She is rude and if you don't understand the material the first time, then you must be comepletely stupid according to her. If you need help, find a good TA (Chris Noe, Miranda Lange) and get their help. Avoid her at all costs!
Not helpful at all.  If you didn't get something she would look at you like your dumb and that you should have being knowing this for years.  Don't care for her.
if you take gen chem lab you'll likely have her, she is not very personable and really likes to make it difficult on students. If she can aid in lowering your grade, she will.

She will screw you over. I was going to have a guaranteed A in the class and because I missed ONE LAB CLASS she dropped me to a B. She loves to own kids for stupid stuff. Necessary evil though for Chem Lab. All I can say is DO NOT MISS A LAB FOR THE WORLD.
Doesn't go along with CHE 107 at all and the labs are very drawn out and pointless...watch out for tricky exams.

Dr. Soult is awesome: she will help a student FOR HOURS on ANY of the material in CHEM 105/107 OR 115. CHEM 115 (lab) is NOT a breeze -- it requires active application of what is learned in CHEM 105/107 and the tests reflect that. THOROUGHLY prepping for EVERY lab will make the tests much easier. "EASY" TAs are NOT beneficial in prepping for tests.
Evil Dragon Lady from Hell!!! Gets pleasure from making students fail and feel inferior.  If you see her, just run!

Although she was not the actual teacher for this class she is responsible for writing the tests.  The tests suck and you basically have to know the Chang textbook and your lab manual forwards and backwards.  Pray that you get an easy TA for your lab reports because they are the only thing that saved me in this class.

Lots and lots of homework and assignments but they are all open note and his lectures are amazing. He is so engaging with the class. I have genuinely never seen a class so ready to speak and ask questions. He is one of the kindest and most supportive profs I have had.

He is an awesome professor. He is very understanding and a easy to follow lecturer. Typically there is a reading ad canvas assignment weekly, but there is always plenty of time to do it. Highly recommend.

Tim is AWESOME! He's so funny and relatable. Great lecturer and easy to follow.
We had 2 essays and discussion boards about once a week. Only tests were the midterm and final. If you have the opportunity to take a class taught by Tim, take it. You won't regret it!

Tim was a great guy who was very easygoing and easy to work with. He made lectures interesting by using humor and great examples. He does require participation and attendance for this class because it is very much discussion-based. The only bad thing is that grades won't be in until the last week of classes, but he will work with you on grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very easy professor to work with allowing you to re do assignment. mid term and final are online open note which really helps. very easy person to get along with would definitely take this class again.

I'm a phi major, so I've had a lot of profs, and Tim remains one of the best at UK. He's a genius, one of the smartest and funniest guys you'll ever meet, he's literally a teddy bear. He cares about your learning and will accommodate you in any way he can. He has characters like Buford and Darryl to help understand material. he wants you to succeed
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: If there's any professor you should take it's this guy. Tim is a phenomenal teacher and I would feel comfortable taking any class if he were teaching it. He truly goes above and beyond for his students and will even teach past what the class was intended for and in a way that makes the topic interesting. 10/10

He is a great guy and wants you to pass class. I took phi120 and he made the topics in 320 so much more interesting. I wish he was teaching 520 next semester. I would take him again in a heartbeat. The class material was interesting and if you keep up with his lectures then you will succeed in class. He always makes himself available to review work

This has been my favorite class at UK so far! If you go to recitation and pay attention during class, there is absolutely no reason you shouldn't get an A. If you need to take any logic courses, Sundell is the way to go! He makes it so interesting and it honestly isn't even boring!!

Tim is so freaking cool. He shows that he is a real human being that makes cheesy philosophy jokes. His class is all lecture with recitation being up to the TA. There is only a midterm and final, both pretty easy if you look over your notes. Lecture isn't mandatory but you will fall behind if you don't go.

Attendance isn't mandatory in lecture, but if you go to class you don't need to study much at all. Tim shows that he cares that his students pass and tries to not make things more difficult than they need to be. He doesn't require a textbook and always goes over the reading material he assigns. Expects that everyone participates. Recitations help!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Tim is (in my opinion) the best philosophy professor at UKY. I've taken him for 350, 550, and 565.  He's the type of professor that puts the student's first and is available for any questions. His lectures are made obtainable even for a novice in Philosophy. All reading is available online. Auburn is getting a great prof.

Tim is definitely one of the more intellectual professors at UK. His lectures are truly interesting and helpful. Get ready to read, and he definitely likes you more if you speak up in class, but he grades tests and quizzes very fairly, regardless. I would take another class of his.
Why isn't this guy teaching more? His pragmatics class was amazing and I love his enthusiasm.

Tim Sundell is not only one of the most intelligent individuals at this university, he is also probably one of the best professors here in general. His teaching style is beyond effective and his commitment to the subject of logic cultivated an interest in me that I never knew I had. I would undoubtedly recommend him to anyone.

A very good professor overall. He uses an online textbook so you don't have to buy one. I took his introductory logic class and it was fairly simple and easy to understand. If you go to class there is pretty much no homework you have to worry about. Plus, it fulfilled one of my math requirements which was nice.
Tim is an outstanding instructor!  I kind of have a "teacher" crush on him.  He is super nice, funny, and very helpful.  I highly recommend taking any of his classes.

I took this class expecting it to be hard. Logic isn't simple, by any means. But Tim is such a great professor. He makes things very simple and is more than willing to work with you in and outside of class to make sure you're comfortable with the material.  He's really funny and laid-back. I definitely recommend taking him if you can!

Tim was probably my favorite teacher last semester. He explained things very well. The class isn't the easiest, but if you attend lecture and do the homework, the tests are easy. Only two tests, mid-term and final, also a plus. I'd definitely take another class from him if I could.

Tim was awesome. He carefully explained the material in lecture and liked to have open discussions, even in a class of 200. He was more than welcome to go over difficult material until everyone understood it. Go to lecture,and the homework and tests are easy. There were only two exams, the midterm and final. Definitely take Tim if you can!

I've had a lot of professors, and Tim is one of the best. Logic gives some fits, but Tim did very well to explain things and not to alienate the lower half. Also very funny, laid back, and outwardly helpful. I'd recommend him for any class, but especially logic if you think you may struggle. If you don't, its still a very fun class.

Although his class is not a breeze, what inference logic class is?  Compared to my friends who have other teachers in this subject, I definitely think Sundell seems to be the best.  He really explains things in class and does not try to trick you on exams. Go to class, it really helps! no text books at all. exams aren't bad

Prof Summers is a big sweetheart, he's very understanding about missing class and late work. He also really tries to connect with his students. The lectures are pretty boring but I mean...it's art history what do you expect.

I had profesor Summers for A-H 101: visual studies and the class was painfully boring. The lectures are difficult to sit through and I feel like I didn't learn much in the class. It's a lot of reading and a lot of old texts. Pretty rough but not a difficult class and profesor summers has clear grading guidelines.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This professor by far was the worst professor I had ever encountered. He is very unprofessional, no one in my class took him seriously, and he is very egotistical. His feelings are very weak and it shows. Every start to class he would always whine about why no one participated, why no one was enthusiastic about what he taught. It's a big joke.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
I took the entire class pretty much online. Just join the Echo360 each class, the entire thing is lecture. The quizzes are kind of difficult, but I never scored below 22/25. Overall, a pretty easy class, I would definitely take this class if you're trying to cover your Intellectual Inquiry in the Natural/Physical/
Mathematical sciences UK core.

May be hard to understant but very passionate professor. Attendance graded by questions on Echo360 so can tune in anywhere. In-person attendance is never required. You can miss up to a certain number of echo360s and still get full participation credit. Quizzes are open note and can be taken anywhere. No exams. Couldn't recommend this course enough

Overall really easy class. There are 5 quizzes and they are super easy with a study guide provided that lines up exactly. Attendance is mandatory but you can watch lectures online instead of going in person.

Her lectures were very long and she would just yap about absolutely anything she could. Her exams were extremely hard and the labs most of the time did not help. She would randomly call on students and ask them to come to the front of the class to answer a question and if the student got it wrong she would get mad and make you feel horrible. Awful!

She is very nice, but she doesn't explain things in a way that is accessible and struggles to answer questions. I think she forgets that not everyone is a physicist and that this class is strictly to learn some basics we can use in our future ELEMENTARY classrooms. We barely get any points for labs despite them being 3 hours long.

The entire class was lectures.  If you didn't attend class, you didn't know the material.  Tests were super easy.  I would get 100% and finish in less than 10 minutes.  She is nice and cares about her students, but her class could get very boring at times.  Sitting through 75 minutes lectures without breaks or any interaction was tough.

Shes a really nice teacher!! You can tell by the attitude she takes that she really loves astronomy and that shes really passionate in the class. There's only one homework assignment a week and all the assignments are made to help prepare for the tests. She explains everything in simple language to help you understand. She truly is a sweet person.
SHE IS AWFUL, It is her first year and I am barely passing. She is so quiet you cannot even understand a word. Avoid if you can

He likes to talk about himself and his fellow professor Owen lot. He has very high expectations and if you do not meet them you are graded really low. He is completely online, we have done nothing with physically. No models or anything, just abstract cubes and towers. If you aren't locked to your computer then you're not doing enough.

He loves talking about his own work and reasurch and will give lectures for the entire class period about his reasurch and ideas and required readings. He typically goes over the alloted class time when lecturing and during internal reviews the beginning students receive reviews that are extremely long and all other reviews are incredibly rushed.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Fast paced at first, but once we entered the final project towards the middle part of the semester it was great. Looking back I needed to go through all the fast paced experimentation in the first half of the semester. Marty is one of the coolest dudes to talk to and you can tell he really cares about architecture. My favorite studio I've taken

Loves giving readings and assigns multiple 10+ page readings every time. Instructions for projects almost non-existant and sucks at giving clear directions. For studio he likes to talk for AT LEAST 4 hours every time class meets.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He's a tough studio professor, but I learned a lot from him and don't regret taking his class. He'll also teach you a better way to organize your files, it's a pain learning it but it pays off. I recommend him as long as you have extra time to put towards his class. Be prepared for him to be absent sometimes, he helps his wife with her studio.

Look i see 15 awful ratings on Dr. superson but that's silly. If you listen in lecture, take basic bullet point notes, and write according to the instructions she gives you, you will be fine. I had some trouble understanding her sometimes, but she is polite and will explain again. I don't feel like the grading was all that hard, sorry!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This feminist philosophy course was intense in terms of content. Trigger warnings necessary. But, if you can make it through, you'll be both challenged and rewarded. As a woman I feel empowered having taken this course. 3 5-6 pg papers and 2 small core assignments. She is not like these other reviews portray her to be, her class changed my life.
HORRIBLE. HORRIBLE. Avoid at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dropped class when instructor, who also happened to be my advisor, was condescending and rude.  Would not allow me to record the lecture for later transcription.  Required I write on paper, verbatim, as if I were some kind of stenographer.  This was 2004 so laptops were still a bit uncommon.  Just an angry, passive aggressive person. Avoid.

Just do not take any class with her. you're never going to be right in her class even if you write down word for word what she said. it's still wrong. i tried to ask her how i got something wrong on my paper when i wrote down  exactly what she said in lecture, and she told me she never said that and to take better notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Worst class I have ever taken. For your papers, you can write exactly what she said in her lectures and still be wrong. The only advice she will give you is your notes are wrong and take better notes. I am so disappointed in this class and would not recommend it to anyone. Do not take, unless you want to end up dropping.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE. DO NOT TAKE UNLESS YOU WANT TO DROP IT. Over half the class dropped after a few weeks. Your grade is based on 3 papers which are graded extremely hard and based on what she wants even if it is right. Her lectures are hard to follow, and there are no PowerPoints. Avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Id be genuinely ok with this professor if she wasnt extremely rude, condescending, and just straight up a horrible teacher. She goes on tangents for 90% of the class and then berates the entire class when the average of 1 of our 3 assignments ends up being about 65% - instead of.... acknowledging the way it was taught was bad.

reviews.comment: Everything bad about her that I have read on here is completely true. The positive reviewers must have been paid or something because she is so bad at her job.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her lectures are hard to follow by. Absolutely awful lectures to start off with. Your grade in the class is off 3 papers. Also the 3 papers are vey hard with no guidelines and she gives little to no feedback. Never take this class as almost more than half of the class dropped 2 weeks in. She is actually awful and should not be a professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are awful. Extremely hard to keep up with goes off on random tangents. Rarely gets to the point. Wrote our papers on her books and self-written opinion. There is only one opinion to write from and if you do not then expect bad feedback. She is rude and does not care about you or your work. Whatever you do, do not take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: By far the worst professor I've had at the University of Kentucky. Has little to no control of her classroom and for the 500-level feminist philosophy course has students purchase a textbook that she herself edited. Terrible lecturer and you will only be graded on 2 papers and attendance. Take literally any other professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Superson is a really smart woman. All of your grade is based on 3 5-7 page essays and one 1 page essay. You do a lot of reading about feminists and then write papers off of what is lectured in class. She is a really tough grader, but she means well. Her lectures are long but if you engage they can be very interesting. She can be scary at first
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I was in this class when COVID hit. Dr. Superson made the transition to Zoom SEAMLESS. She was also incredibly understanding. She always has been understanding if youre a good student. 2 papers + participationthats all to the grade. Come to class; take notes; and stay off your electronics (yes, even your laptop). Youll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Superson has worked incredibly hard to get where she is. She is not going to hand you an A, and she shouldnt. This was a graduate course. 2 papers @ 40% each and 20% participation  your grade. Go to class. Take notes. Engage. Then, use your notes to write the papers. Ive had Dr. Superson three times. I got an A every time.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: By far the most disrespectful professor I've ever had. She doesn't seem to care about our opinions, so she doesn't want to hear them. Doesn't allow us to interpret the readings any other way either. If it isn't her opinion, she doesn't want to hear it. In short, avoid her if you can

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS W/ THIS PROFESSOR ! She is a super hard grader and there are 3 papers that make up 90% of your grade. Is not helpful and doesn't give any insightful feedback. I barely passed with a low B. She uses a book that she hates and you need to attend every class. She is very lecture heavy and you need to take detailed notes to pass

She is by far the worst professor I have ever had in my life. I am a great student with a great GPA, usually a bad professor doesn't throw me off too much, but she is beyond awful. Doesn't know how to use Canvas, makes you read 50 pages per night, hardly explains things in lecture, doesn't even follow her syllabus. Do not take ever in your life.

Not the worst teacher, but she's definitely not the best either. Her lectures are alright. She's very pessimistic about students' capabilities, dismisses anyone that does not understand, and grades the papers weird. You really have to learn exactly what she's looking for.

This is the most disrespectful teacher I have ever had on UK's campus. I had many health issues and I emailed her all of my excuses yet she still was being disrespectful towards me. She rambles a lot and she isn't fair. She assigns you 3 papers for the entire semester. I don't know how she's still teaching at this university. DO NOT RECOMMEND!

There were three papers, and each was worth 30% of the final grade. The other 10% came from participation. We read one chapter each week, and Dr. Superson basically recapitulated the chapter during each lecture. She was open to questions, and she left good feedback on every paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This class is easy if you show up and put effort into the 3 papers for the semester. The only people who don't like her are the ones who try to argue with her in class. You have to keep in mind that she is not sharing her own opinion but the opinions of philosophers, so don't be an ass and you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She's a complainer, and she does require attendance. She grades so easily though, it's hard not to pass this class. The absolute easiest philosophy class I've ever taken.

This Professor dismisses all opinions shared that do not apply to her own.  Her grading is very unclear.  She refuses to put grades online so the only way of knowing where you stand in her class is by looking at the smiley or frowny faces on the top of your THREE papers for the semester.  Good luck decoding that!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She is the most disrespectful professor I have ever had. She dismisses any thoughts that are outside of her opinion. She argues aggressively. She doesn't give any feedback or rubrics for assignments. She might have been grading on whether or not she liked her students. She rolls her eyes at students. All and all she is the worst professor!

One of the worst philosophy classes I've taken at UK. Dismisses arguments she doesn't agree with, constantly complains about her job, and generally seems annoyed that she has to teach. Unfortunate that this is a required class for the major and she's the only one who teaches it.
Superson is a wonderful professor!  I would take another class with her in a heartbeat.  She is an incredibly intelligent woman.  I learned a lot from her class.
Only surface details and middle school level discussion of the topics. Assignments were a joke, but that's not as difficult to endure as the simplicity. Dr. Hale's healthcare ethics was much better.
I've never been more disappointed by a professor. Avoid.

He sends a lot of emails with a lot of information, but I never read them until before the tests and still got an A in the class. He makes a boring topic fun and he's always up for a conversation about politics and government.

Dr. Swinford was so helpful. He really wants to get to know his students and knows how to help you learn. He is always available to help in his free time and works with you to make sure you understand everything. If you take him, he will change your life.
Super helpful.  One of the best professors I've ever had!

Walking into the class knowing very little about American Politics, I learned a lot from Dr. Swinford! He is incredibly helpful, interesting to listen to, and very straight-forward. Textbook wasn't really used, so going to class is really important. I would take him again if I could!

Dr. Swinford is one of the best professors I have ever had. He should be the ONLY teacher you take PS 101 from. Does not use textbook. Give you lots of chances for bonus points. Genuinely nice, incredibly helpful, tremendously passionate about his subject. SIMPLE CLASS! It's more of a current events class than it is Am. Government.

He's a great teacher who loves the subject. He encourages in-class discussion about political issues and really enjoys helping students succeed. He gives easy assignments and hides extra credit opportunities in some of his emails. He only teaches one class a semester, but try to get into it if you can. Guaranteed to be interesting and easy.

This professor is wonderful. I was concerned midsemester that my grade would be a C and visited him. He told me to have hope and I would raise it. He provides ample review sessions and will help if their are problems! Good Professor overall.

He is an amazing professor who has a lot of passion about what he teaches. Even though he only teaches one class a semester, try to take a class from him! (And don't buy the textbook for this class, it is useless.)

Extremely interesting class and a great teacher. One of the biggest parts of the class was keeping up with the Daily Dose (an email he sends with news stories). He uses this extensively on the tests, and so you get to study and learn about whats going on in politics today (taking it during an election year = win)

Awesome professor! He soo helpful, and he always tells you exactly what's going to be on a test in the class before the test is given. I would recommend taking him, you can tell by being in his class that having his students do well is very important to him!

Great teacher and super helpful. The class can be intimidating since there's so many people but you'll quickly discover Swinford's main goal is to help students succeed. My favorite professor. READ HIS EMAILS ALL THE WAY THROUGH HE'S SNEAKY AND PUTS EXTRA CREDIT OPPORTUNITIES IN THEM!! Come to class and you'll get an A.
Swinford himself is a really cool, helpful teacher and he's pretty funny. The TA's end up doing most of the work and the TA that grades my tests graded hard so i ended up with a b.

Pretty good class. Lectures can be kind of boring, but Swinford is a good teacher and explains concepts well. He makes the TAs do most of the work, but he's a good guy. Just go to class and you'll easily get an A
The Best Teacher at UK. Shouldn't really be an option not to take this class. Don't take Con Law with anyone else. Amazing.

Great guy, great teacher. If you can take a class with him, do it. Really cares about students success and encourages it. You'll painlessly learn alot from material and lectures. He's restored my hope in UK's professors.

Great class with an AMAZING teacher. While he is not actually a part of the PS department he does teach one class a year. He encourages participation and actually provides an environment where everyone can feel comfortable giving opinions and asking questions. Would take him for any PS class.
Great professor! Makes the course interesting and fun.

Professor Swinford is easily in my top 3 as far as professors go at this university. As far as PS professors go he is number 1. His lectures are extremely interesting and his tests are cake. Even if your major has nothing to do with Political Science...please take him.
