Great teacher. Very interesting and entertaining. You take a lot of notes but the class is pretty easy.

Dr. Swinford is one of the most entertaining professors I have had. He is kind, willing to help, and doesn't want you to do bad in the class. Having said that, he does teach and wants to  make sure his students have a connection to current events. With a little studying and regular attendance, you can do well in his class.

He is a really cool guy.  I hated government stuff but I enjoyed him teaching it. You have to come to class, but it isn't bad. He lectures over his powerpoints. To do well, just learn what he reviews the class before the test.
No Comments

Really charismatic guy. Fun to listen to, very engaging. Almost full class every time. Be careful for a subtle liberal spin on the material though, hes sneaky. Very cool guy, but biased, so just be careful. Easy A if you do your work, and you must come to class.
Great professor and researcher

she's so funny and sweet. the class was really easy, but keep in mind you do have to show up every week. one assignment a week, followed by a very easy paper at the end. she's just down right amazing. beware she does have an accent, but i had no trouble understanding her. i wish she taught more classes, i want her to be my professor forever! :)

Dr. Kim is the sweetest! You can tell she cares so much about her students and wants everyone to succeed. Attendance is really important, but there's so little work outside of class (no exams!) and the content is interesting. She's happy to help with anything you might need!
Sweetest woman ever. Easy to pass the class if you show up and try. Attendance is extremely mandatory. No exams or heavy assignments. Highly recommend.

Dr. Kim was absolutely amazing! She never hesitated to help in or outside of class, no matter what was needed.

The only difficult part of taking the course with her is her very heavy accent.

Great teacher. Really cares about her students. Very approachable, kind, and knowledgeable. 195 is an enjoyable class, but really unnecessary for most. Attendance is the majority of grade, along with short assignments (super easy) after each lecture and a final paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super easy. Attendance is only thing that is mandatory and 1 assignment a week that takes 2 minutes to complete.

Love Dr. Kim! She's so funny and supportive. This class was pass/fail, and she makes it clear what will result in a fail. She genuinely wants you to succeed, and she will gladly point you in the direction you need. You want her on your team!

Dr. Kim is the best! She is such a sweetie who really cares about her students' success. The class is super easy- if you go to class, complete VERY short assignments each week, and then turn in the final, 1 page paper, you will pass with ease. 10/10 recommend her!

Truly one of the sweetest professors ever. She wants her students to succeed in the class and life! Only three requirements: attendance & 2 papers (papers are super short and straightforward). Loved coming to her lecture every week! Shes given so much great psychology, UK, and career/life advice!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very nice lady! Has made my experience in psychology here at UK much easier and is always there when I need her. Could not ask for a better teacher or advisor. LOVE HER.

I took PSY 195, which is a pass/fail class. She made the class very enjoyable, even though we met once a week. The class is very easy to pass, you just need to show up and complete the two assignments she has on the syllabus. Both assignments, which are due at the end of the semester, probably took me about an hour each.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Kim is the cutuesttt. she is so sweet and tries to make class cute and fun. 195 isnt a heavy class but if you dont do well you will bring eternal shame to you and your family (a joke she makes). she makes coming to class fun and honestly you dont need to do anything but attend. theres two papers and attedance mandatory and you can pass easily.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Kim is absolutely amazing! She is the funniest professor I have ever had. Her lectures are super funny and you dont have to take notes. There were very few requirements and it was very easy to pass. I hope I get to work with her again in the future! Definitely take her class!

This class is pass/fail, you wont pass if you skip. She has a strict attendance policy but Dr. Kim is adorable! She truly wants her students to succeed, and has high standards for that. Only two assignments but you actually learn a lot about the major in this course.
THE ABSOLUTE BEST EVER.

If you're serious about Psychology, she is your best resource. I feel blessed to have had her as an instructor and as a guide. She's very open and encouraging for you to ask questions, email her, & talk to her after class. She can help lead you to research opportunities and relationships w/professors. Mention her recommendation in emails.

She is so cute! She honestly wants you to listen to her advice and to succeed. Shes very funny and witty. Her class isnt very hard at all, as there is never usually homework. I would recommend her to all psych majors, as she is a good resource to have.
Class is very easy and mostly helpful. No cell phones/laptops at all. Her advice is very helpful, recommend you take this your freshman or sophomore year or it may not be as helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Pass or fail course that was extremely helpful.

Dr. Kim is the BEST!! She's so sweet and tries to teach students what they need in order to be successful as a Psych major. There's basically no homework and as long as you show up and sign your name down you'll pass her class.

Dr. Kim's psychology 195 class is a piece of cake. There are no tests ever. The class simply is there to let you know about the different psychology courses to take. I took it as a freshman and found it to be very helpful in regards to figuring out what classes to take later. There are 4 very easy assignments. No book to buy either, just show up!
Dr. Kim goes above and beyond for her students and she's hilarious. You won't regret taking her class
SO EASY! SHES SO NICE! ONLY 2 ASSIGNMENTS! CLASS IS ONLY ONE DAY A WEEK! LOVE HER!

I absolutely love Dr. Kim! She makes the material fun and interesting. Her PowerPoints are beyond hilarious and she's such a sweet lady. She always makes me laugh every class and is one of my favorite professors that I've ever had.
Awesome professor going to class is the simplest task to pass the orientation for psychology. Just show and you'll pass this class and there were only like 5 assignments due.
Love Dr. Kim! She is incredibly helpful and really cares about her students. Plus she is adorable and makes learning fun!

Had her for psy 195 and 216. She has an accent, so if you can't get past that then don't take her. But if you can, and you want an awesome/funny/interesting professor who genuinely wants you to do well in her class (and in life, she knows everything about grad school and urges you to think about life after college), take her. I loved her class!

Dr. Kim is great! PSY 216 is a difficult class, but she is always so excited that you have to get into it. While attendance is not mandatory, if you don't go, you will fail. Tests were given partial credit even if the problem is wrong. Dr. Kim teaches a variety of classes, and I would recommend taking at least 1!

Great prof! Very helpful. Hard class but as long as you go, do the HW and go to lab you'll be fine.  She is so helpful and really cares about your learning and students in general.  Mostly tests, but also homework and group work in class - so go to class.  It's very hard to catch up if you don't and she gives her notes on handouts. Great teacher!
I was terrified of Stats at the beginning of the semester.  Dr. Kim explained everything so clearly and so well that I actually enjoy the subject now!  Awesome professor, highly recommended.

Amazing professor!!! Really cares about her students and wants all of us to succeed. Taking her 195 class right now and hope to get in her 216 class next semester. She's a really sweet person and keeps the class laughing. I highly recommend taking Dr. Kim!!
She is SO nice!  And very interested in helping any of her students however she can.  I wish I had the opportunity to take more of her classes.

I took 216 in a summer session, and she was extremely helpful and would come early and stay late to help with the (everyday) homework.Difficult topic, but she really wanted us to learn and enjoy the class. Dr.Kim is an excellent professor, and you should definitely take her class!Im awful at math of any sort, and she helped explain it so i got an A

LOVE THIS CLASS!  TAKE IT IF YOU CAN!  This is an internship class so you can do what you want.  You report your experiences once a week and get to hear about other peers' experiences as well.  VERY FUN!  and extremely beneficial to your career!
Invested in your learning and comprehension.  She wants to help you suceed anyway possible!

This is a pretty good class to take EARLY in your college carrer. It gives you a lot of good info about majors in PSY and getting into graduate school. The class is kinda boring sometimes, but its only 50min a week. Its super easy. Dr. Kim is kinda hard to understand sometimes, but shes a really sweet woman.

The text book is not used in class, she gives out notes which you elaborate on and can just as easily study from those rather than the expensive book. The tests are long and require you to study.  However she is a very good teacher and will do everything she can to make sure u do well and stay awake in this boring subject

She's nice, the class is helpful, but it's also boring. Although I now have an internship and research assistant position planned for next semester because of what I learned, I feel like a large part of the class was repetitive and therefore pointless. But at the same time, it's 50 minutes once a week and pass/fail. I can't complain too much :)
The class is very helpful in explaining what is necessary to graduate with a psychology degree. The class can get dull but is very easy to get an A.

I absolutely love Dr. Kim and the way she teaches this class.  She is very helpful in explaining all the in's and out's of being a Psychology major.  I loved the way she taught 195 so much that I am taking her for PSY 216 next semster! Definately take her if you have a chance!

This professor is the real deal and truly cares about her students, three years after taking her class she spent an hour with me teaching me how to get into grad school, very helpful and her husband is a hell of a professor as well, any professor that can
AMAZING professor!  Accent can be a BIT thick at times, but SO helpful!  Wants everyone to succeed and has cute teaching methods that keep things interesting!
She seems very nice and very friendly!
Easy class, Easy teacher. Shes a blast
No Comments
This foreign hottie knows what to tell you.  She gives you the inside scoop on the psychology major.
sit back and enjoy the ride

She is crazy and it's great.  She is always doing weird things, but it makes the class fun and helps with the learning.  She is super nice and she made a difficult subject understandable and fun.  Plus she gives out prizes.
Sweet lady and great prof. Take her as many times as you can.

Adorable person. She was so sweet and her class was 100% usefull. The class educated me on requirements to graduate and ways to make it easier and faster. She tried to make class as fun as possible. You can see her passion for teaching and education.
Best professor ever.
great class, you cant miss more than three classes, turn in your graduation plan on time, or you wont pass.  great teacher love her

Such a nice guy and he loves what he teaches! Only take this class if you are honestly interested in religion and politics and how they work together. There are only two tests, but short multiple choice questions weekly. Read roughly 5- pgs. per week along with a 1-2 page paper about what you read. He drops the two lowest paper grades.

You must be willing to write and read weekly to do well in his class. Your grade on papers will be based on grammar for the most part. He always wants evidence to back up opinions. I enjoyed his class because I was really into the subject but if you are taking it just to fulfill a requirement, I'd suggest taking something easier.

He has retired 2 or 3 times and at one point was a dean.  He loves the subject and it comes easy to him since he has read the books a million times and expects you to be on his level. There is a lot of out of class reading that you can't really avoid. Not the class that I thought I was signing up for.

Nice and means well, but the class is not a discussion/debate class as I thought. Requires a TON of reading and from absolute boring books. Class is listening to him lecture & answering his questions. He will only accept answers that match what he is looking for word-for-word. You better be VERY MUCH into Religion & Politics to survive this class.
Swift is one of the best professors I've ever had. He is extremely intelligent and I highly recommend him.
He is very boring and seems to only want specific answers in a class that is based on opinion. He grades papers based on grammer. Take this class only if you are really really into politics!
Great teacher, very kind.  A good person.  Very knowledgeable and helpful.
A little boring, good intentions
He sparked my interset in Ancient Aegean art!
A little over the hill, but still a good bet.

He has flaws, no doubt, but I respect him as a teacher because he puts alot of effort into our class and most people get frustrated with him simply because they won't give the effort back. This is one of my favorite classes.

I have nothing good to say about Swenson. The amount of work he gives compared to other 203 classes is ridiculous. He grades like a Nazi. He doesn't respond to emails. He is arrogant. I got a B but it wasn't easy and english is typically my best subject. There is homework every single class by the way.

I think the people below either had a bad experience or just didn't put effort into the class. The class required a LOT of your time. There's a lot of homework, but he is worth the tuition fees, he knows what he's talking about and improved my writing immensely. First I hated him, and now I want that class back. An A is easy to get, do the hw.

I wouldn't take him again. He was a nice person but for someone like me who is only taking the class for a USP requirement he made it wayy to difficult. Had a B at the midterm. I enjoyed the class less and less as it went on. The first assignment was the easiest, but it just gets less fun and he gives a lot more work for each paper.

Don't be scared by other comments from people who probably thought ENG 104 would be highschool again. Swenson is tied for my favorite instructor. While the class was not easy, I truly learned and developed from the way he taught. It's also very possible to get "above a C" if you're willing to try. Give him a shot, don't be detoured by the others.
GET OUT NOW. nearly impossible to get above a C.

GET OUT NOW!!!! He is terrible. He has no respect for his students. He thinks a C is a good grade. Hardest english 104 teacher by far. I've never hated a professor so much. he grades like an English 500 class. Take anyone over him.

Very difficult when you have no interest in English and just need it for a USP course. Attendance is required and if you get caught using electronics he will make you leave class and it counts as an absense. Anything above a C in the class takes a lot of work.

He cares about the subject, but is a perfectionist. he makes you hand in a notebook containing all your hwk over the semester, which other classes don't need to do. A very strict teacher. overall, I'd say he's good if your an ENG major, but not if you just need to pass the class- my B was above average in our class, and most people disliked him.

If you want an easy 100% and class to be canceled all the time, take this course. In terms of course work, it was incredibly easy. I was just frustrated because class was always canceled and when we did have class, it felt like it could be sent in an email. He 100% cares for his students and wants them to succeed, but I felt the class was pointless
He cares so much about his students! It's so refreshing, the class is fun and not too much work at all.

Helps his students in need! dont be afraid to reach out to him and explain your situations your in, hes very caring and kind and the best professor i had during my pregancy and wasnt judgemental and cares about his students succeding in college and will help connect you to resources if you need it!
Nicest teacher I've had on any level of education
Sy
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: My favorite teacher by far and he made my first year so much better he is a really good guy and really cares about all of his students and he makes it show to. 10/10 would recommend

Literally the best professor ever. He's so understanding and caring. He helps students whenever he can. The homework for his class is easy. He makes class so fun, literally the best part of my day was walking into his class.
such a nice guy! loves to make jokes and get to know you on a personal level. no test barely any homework. all participation and a few group projects. recommend!!

Dr. Szekely is great! He always has great stories and advice and the work in his class is always fun. It's a little hard to get used to what he assigns, but once you do, you will love it. His class was mostly art, no tests or anything. It's a great class to take online. He's super sweet, understanding, and gives you a great perspective on teaching.
Most caring and amazing teacher at this school! He is really passionate about art and teaching. You will learn a lot and make some fun art projects. 100% recommend!!!
Literally the easiest class you will ever take in your whole life. Definitely take this! You need to know nothing about art just show up and participate! It is actually fun at times!

This is the easiest but most pointless class ever. All you have to do is show up, make some kind of art, and turn in one short reading assignment a week. It's just a useless class because you don't learn much, he basically just rambles about random things while everyone in the class does their art project for the day. He does let class out early!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He is a super sweet teacher, and very understanding. The work is easy, just show up and participate and you're guaranteed an A

While he's a really nice guy, if you HATE artsy fartsy kind of art, do NOT take this class. It pretty much consists of collecting garbage. Yes, I am serious. For example, he brought an old dirty pizza box to class that he had saved from Puccini's becasue he liked the picture on it and saves a collection of PIZZA boxes. This is just 1 example
WONDERFUL TEACHER! If you have to take a art ed class take it from dr Szekely! He really is a genius. I just can't say enough good things about him.
No Comments
AMAZING-need I say more!!

What an amazing Professor!!!  He is an inspiration!  He is not difficult, and you actually WANT to go to class...His books are amazing, and because he wrote them, he believes in what he lectures about.
She breaks down South Asian politics in a way that actually makes sense. Super chill, super smart—definitely one of the best profs I've had
This professor really knows her stuff when it comes to South Asian politics. She make the class interesting and easy to follow

I took PS391 – Politics of South Asia with this professor, and she was one of the best I've had. If you're into international relations or global politics, her class is definitely worth it. She knows her stuff, keeps things engaging, and ties regional issues to the bigger global picture really well
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is an exceptional teacher who makes political science engaging and relevant. Her dynamic teaching style, clear explanations, and real-world examples bring the subject to life. She fosters an inclusive environment, values diverse opinions, and inspires students, especially young women, to think critically and aim for impactful futures

Do not take class with her. Reads off of slides and is disrespectful towards students. Can't ask questions, she will not clarify, and do not question her. Inaccessible; does not hold office hours and will not respond to email, esp when being questioned. Textbook saved me, she does not teach. She is difficult to understand and does not clarify.

Just another grad student reading slides created by a professor with tenure who doesn't even see the students he's supposed to be teaching. Didn't seem to know the material. Very defensive and refuses to help students in class by dodging questions, don't expect to get anywhere with her especially if she is in the wrong.

The lectures were sometimes confusing and hard to follow. But, she did answer questions and provide extra help if needed. Attendance was not mandatory, but there was a quiz every week, not on the same day, so missing class could cause you to miss a quiz.
A little hard to follow her lectures, but she is a kind professor and a fairly easy grader.

This was the first semester he taught 313 (ADV Spanish Language) as a look into bilingualism in the Spanish-speaking world. The content was super interesting and he made the class fun! There were a lot of papers, 2 presentations, and 2 exams, but everything was very simple and straightforward for the most part. Could not recommend him enough!

Prof. Symeonidis is a very nice guy. He is encouraging and kind when students are struggling to articulate their thoughts in Spanish. The class is pretty easy. Some quizzes (which are so dumb and too difficult) but they shouldn't hurt your grade too much if you do everything else. He grades lightly. Coming to class unprepared will piss him off tho.

Professor Symeonidis is sweet and makes class fun. I didn't learn anything in that class though because his lectures are him rambling about something he expects you to have background knowledge of. He is super nice and extremely understanding, but he sometimes lets his opinion on politics shine a little too much when it isn't necessary for SPA330.

An incredibly caring and understanding professor who has always given me the benefit of the doubt; loves to share personal stories and opinions which are often very interesting; fair grader; good teacher and all around good guy. Would highly recommend taking a class with Dr. Symeonidis.
Really enjoyed this class! There was a lot of reading, but he just wants his students to succeed. I learned a lot. He's a great professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Symeonidis is one of the best professors I've had in college and definitely in the Spanish dept. His class is definitely intimidating at first because he is so knowledgeable, seriously the man is brilliant. He truly cares that his students do well. If you pay attention in class and participate, you'll do well. He appreciates participation
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Symeonidis is one of the best professors in this department. He's very kind and understanding, and he wants you to succeed. Get to know him and ask for any help you need: he may seem intimidating and judgmental, but he's not at all! He does his best to ensure that you pass the class with an A, as long as you do the same.

He legitimately wouldn't let us leave after our first test until he read over our answers and made sure they were correct. So easy and you can tell he really cares about the subject which makes lectures better. Don't skip.

Looks intimidating at first but he is very nice and wants his students to succeed. Speaks quickly sometimes, however, he answers all questions clearly and absolutely no question is stupid. Tells you exactly what to expect for exams, just make sure to study. There is no textbook for this class.

Porter's Managerial Accounting class is extremely difficult if you are not spending at least 20 hours/week on Accounting. The lectures are organized into powerpoints that are not any different from reading the book yourself. The online homework you practice with is nothing like the exam problems he gives.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She knows what shes talking about but she forgets that we aren't CPAs like her. She goes really fast and her tests are very hard! Good Luck...
Notes aren't posted online but the textbook is very helpful. The test are hard but she tells you what will be on it so studying isn't impossible.

Awful at making tests/quizzes, when 90% of the class can't finish in the given time allowed, that's a problem. Doesn't post any notes online so you have to jot as fast as you can in class, lucky if you get most of the slide and lucky if you hear anything she says that goes with it!

Dr. Tuttle is an excellent professor who genuinely cares about her students. Her teaching style is engaging, and she explains material clearly and effectively. She creates an inclusive, welcoming classroom and encourages discussion and questions. I would gladly take another class with her.

Dr. Tuttle is the most kind and caring professor I've had. She doesn't take attendance and is very understanding about missing class. You're supposed to do all readings before class then discuss your thoughts in class. I think we had maybe 10 assignments the whole semester and she is not a hard grader at all. Take her if you have the opportunity!

Dr. Tuttle is hands down the best professor I've ever had. She has the most thorough and insightful lectures/ in-class discussions. I love hearing her perspective on different topics because she is extremely knowledgeable. She genuinely cares for her students and those around her in general. I CANNOT RECOMMEND TUTTLE ENOUGH!

This professor is absolutely amazing. I had her course on a semester where I also had very hard classes, like Gen Chem 1 (if you know, you know). Classes were always full of fun, passionate discussions between the entire room over various topics. She is my absolute favorite teacher at UK.

Dr. Tuttle is the best professor I've had so far at UK.  She genuinely cares about what she teaches and leading into thoughtful class discussions.  Not only is her passion for human rights apparent, she also cares about all of her students.

Dr. Tuttle is a wonderful professor. She truly cares about each student. This class had pre-class assigned readings and was discussion based. Dr. Tuttle encouraged students to explore their own opinions and welcomed students expressing themselves. There were a few short writing assignments but no regular homework. Dr. Tuttle is the best!

I highly recommend Dr. Tuttle for HON 252! Although some of the readings were tedious, the discussions in her class truly made me think. Dr. Tuttle's assignments were meaningful and few. The combination of her kind soul and thought-provoking conversations made her a wonderful professor. I couldn't recommend her enough!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Tuttle has the biggest heart and cares more about her students than anyone. She promotes insightful and meaningful conversations, and she is willing to respectfully discuss difficult topics that allow her students to broaden their perspectives. Her class is also an easy A. Please take her if you can!!

This class is entirely discussion based and Tuttle tells the class that she wants it to be guided by the students. Occasionally this suffers because no one read the reading and the discussion was mostly just people making up points. However, if you showed up to class and participated once in a while she was understanding and gave you a great grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: An incredible person who is so nice and definitely cares about her students. She is very understanding and takes late work for full credit. If you participate you will get an A in the class. Sometimes the topics can be a little boring or annoying but she tries her best to make them interesting.
Dr. Tuttle is AMAZING! Make sure you read and come to discussions, but she is very accommodating and gives 100s for everything. She gives everyone an A as long as you try.

I've taken Dr. Tuttle twice now, and am still impressed with her ability to be so empathetic and intelligent in our class discussions. She is genuinely so caring and understanding and is truly a blessing to be in her class. There is a lot of reading but it's interesting and thought-provoking.
Ms. Tuttle is so sweet and understanding of everything. Especially since this is an honors class, the discussions we had are always amazing and she's very progressive and offers great perpsectives.

Dr. Tuttle is an extremely caring and understanding professor. The readings and papers that you are expected to complete are interesting and thought provoking while allowing you to exhibit your own personal feelings and thought processes. 100% would recommend.
I have taken Dr. Tuttle for 3 different classes. She is an awesome professor! She truly cares about students and is very understanding. 10/10 would take again (and again).

loved this class! inclusive for poc/queer folks. no problematic comments/situations, EVER. very surprised at a PWI. high quality discussions that provide in depth analysis. you dont want to miss class!! flexible w/assignments & attendance, even provides zoom option! would love to take more of her classes. wish more grad professors were like her!!!

She is very caring and passionate, however, her HON 140 class is boring and feels pointless. The topics are interesting, but all talk feels very surface level. She relies very heavily on the class to lead discussion, and unfortunately for me, they dont. I recommend another professor for 140, but I would take one of her specialized classes for sure
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Tara Tuttle is probably the most amazing professor I have ever had. She is very relatable and accessible and cares about her students more than anything. She is kind and vulnerable about her experiences and the things she believes in. I will probably reference her class for the rest of my life.

Dr. Tuttle is possibly the nicest, most caring professor ever. She is kind and considerate and respects the fact that students are humans too who are going through things. The class was mostly discussion and she loves when you participate. She's great, I would recommend her to everyone!
She is so welcoming and loving! Would recommend!

Dr. Tuttle is an amazing human and professor. The class was almost all discussions. Participation was highly encouraged, but not forced. She was very understanding and good at answering emails. You have to read articles every night and there were a few papers, but the course was not too difficult overall. She is a great professor. Highly recommend
If you are reading this and have the chance to take Dr. Tuttle's class, I'm sincerely jealous of you. The best professor I have every had. The world needs more of her.

Dr. Tuttle is a fantastic professor! She is so caring and I learned so much from her class. Her section is more work than other professors, but it's definitely worth it. There are readings for every class, which is discussion-based. There are a few big papers, but as long as you participate in and prepare for her class you'll get an A.

Dr. Tuttle is such an amazing and caring person! She cares about her students, and she understands the Honors student perspective. Discussions in class (as this was a seminar) were fun, and somehow she was able to tie them back to gender (unintentionally, I assume) many times! She respects her students, even those with whom she disagrees. 10/10
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Tagavi has very poor handwriting, and it's hard to interpret what he's writing down. He can be very unhelpful when answering questions. His tests are very fair, and if you can get used to his teaching style, he is a good professor. It's important to write down anything he says that might be on the test during his lectures.

There are 3 total exams for the semester, the final is not cumulative and is a 3rd exam. The exam category is 92% and homework is the other 8%. Exams are only 5-7 questions and the questions are not weighted equally. His lecture notes are impossible to read and he can even be hard to understand at times. I would recommend taking another instructor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Tagavi's exam are like jeopardy. The first third of the exam is just vocabulary (and extremely obscure vocabulary). Sometimes his question will be so poorly defined it cannot be understood. He then blames you for it. It does not matter how good you are at heat transfer. Just make sure you pay attention to every word he says like its the gospel.

I took ME321, ME325, and ME530 with Tagavi. BUY THE TEXTBOOK and you will succeed. 
In general, the questions on the homework/exam review ARE the questions he will give. He makes his courses seem difficult during lecture, but he grades exams generously if you are on the right track. If you are lost on a previous topic, he won't explain it anymore.

If you need accommodations, brace yourself. Dr. Tagavi called mine “subjective” and clearly didn't support them—I had to get the DRC involved. He's unprofessional and dismissive. Even without accommodations, beware: his exam questions are often vague conceptual ones barely mentioned in class.

Professor Tagavi honestly isn't that bad. His lectures are pretty awful but the exams are questions straight out of the textbook. He gives homework once or twice a week and if he remembers he will also provide practice problems. there are 3 exams worth 92% of your grade, but if you study the practice problems its not the worst.

The exams were worth 92% of the grade, his notes are almost incomprehensible, and he only wants you to solve problems his way. I memorized something for a problem, and he took off 0.1 point because he wanted me to derive it from an equation and not memorize. He does not change the grading scale or curve exam grades, so people have E's, C's, and D's

You can understand that he used to know things and could speak the language, but you also know the words he says is pure nonsense. His lectures are full of unintelligible scribbles, but good luck learning from anything else because he expects you to do it the same way be bungled 4 times in the lecture perfectly come test time.

I have no words to describe how horrible he is. He never gave accommodations for those who had them, never got a single one of his own problems right, degraded students, called students stupid, never once taught, picks the most niche things to put on his exams, never answers emails, literally is racist and sexist, save yourself the trouble.

At first you might be frustrated, annoyed, wish things were better organized, or all of the above. But if you really try to have some patience, ask questions, and work out problems for yourself to really learn and understand, you'll see he is really helping you be a better student. And he does it while always being kind, respectful, and gentle.
His teaching style is horrendous. He reads off a bulleted list in Microsoft Word without providing any example problems to improve comprehension.
If you are a good student, he is an AWESOME professor. Very helpful and acessible. a lot of extra credit.

Dr.Tagavi is one of the best professors I ever had. If you ask questions, he will answer 1000. He cares about you as a student and just wants you to put effort in. He WILL help you. He is extremely sweet and very smart. 
If you can, take him.

Tagavi is a character and you have to understand him to do well in this class.  His lectures are all over the place and the material itself is very difficult but he actually wants his students to learn.  I am not a hard worker but did well in this class through going to his office hours.  He is actually fair if you build a relationship with him.

Never prepared for a single lecture. Attempts to edit his excuse for notes which don't line up with the textbook (which is the only way you have a shot at actually learning anything in the class) with messy handwriting and frequent mistakes, even on the exams that HE DESIGNS. I'm not sure he actually knows anything about what he's supposed to teach

Tagavi is not only extremely disrespectful when you ask a question, but he is very disorganized with the lectures. He will discuss something for about 20 minutes and then double back and say what we did was not the correct way. He may be the most condescending professor on campus. I recommend to stay as far away from his classes as possible.

Tagavi is the best thermo professor at UK! He was always prepared for class and provides notes for every chapter. Homework and test review are good reflections of exam questions. He was also a fair grader on exams as long as you show your work. Gives bonus point on exams for neatness. He got rid of quizzes this semester so make exams count.

Dr Tagavi gets a bad rap, but I had him for Thermo 1 and 2 and he is by far my favorite engineering professor at UK. He's not the easiest, sometimes makes things more complex than they need to be, and seems unapproachable at first, but you learn so much with him, and realize he's a pretty personable guy once you get past first impressions.

the most disrespectful person. 
This guy has no manner, I'd avoid such a person as much as I can.
Lectures were difficult to follow but test were easy

Three exams that make up 80% of the grade. The exams were very fair. Frequent Pop quizzes. His lectures were not very good and had to learn on my own through reading the book. At first he did not trust students at all, such as using a tablet in class for notes but he came around in the end. Has his funny moments. He's not friendly but professional.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The lectures will not be helpful. If you know how to read the textbook and use YouTube to learn then you can take advantage of the heavily weighted but relatively easier exams. Taking thermo at UK is an L no matter which proff. You chose.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is a awful professor, he always take quiz on class and don't announce before, and quizs take many credits on grade. And his slides contains no formula. Anyway, this is the worst class I have ever taken.
his class is terrible
Clueless guy. Needs to retake the course himself. He teaches my reading solutions in textbook since he can not complete a problem on his own.

Tests have nothing to do with what he "teaches". His lectures are typically him going through 10-20 major topics glossing over major details and literally getting half of it wrong. Homework is directly from the textbook, although he instructs you not to buy one. Of course, you need one because you cannot learn from his classes. Take someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Tends to be very rude in class and will disregard questions. He gives many pop quizzes, which are one question over something he mentioned in passing. And he's not very tech-savvy, which can make class and homework frustrating. Only saving grace is exams weren't that bad. Overall, recommend taking someone else if able.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Tagavi is the worst professor I have ever had. Lectures directly out of the pdf textbook and calls that notes. Never comes to class prepared, other than preparing occasional quizzes. Has terrible computer skills and cannot write on the screen legibly. Makes mistakes often. Test do not match example problems for test review and are worth 80%.

Tagavi's lectures are hard to follow and not in depth enough. He is not great at answering content questions at all. His homeworks are straight out of the textbook but do help for exams. His exams are technically easier than other ME220s but he doesn't prepare you for them. The exam averages are failing and he refuses to curve.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Worst teacher I've ever had, and I suspect the worst teacher I ever will have. Clearly has no respect for his students and is often just wrong when "teaching" us. His tests have little to do with what he teaches, and he'll tell you not to bother with the textbook but you absolutely must in order to pass. He avoids answering questions as well.

One of the most disorganized professors I've ever had. His class isn't that difficult, but the fact that he's so disorganized and unprepared makes the class harder than it needs to be at times. It's as if he tries to get through teaching the material with minimal effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The 3 tags I picked for him are the opposite of what he does. As mean as it sounds, there is no way I could express in words how terrible he is in grading, quizzes, homework, lectures, and how unclear his expectations are. Said numerous times not to email him for anything. Read textbook 4 the exam and he said that was a waste. Avoid!! I wish I did.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Awful professor. LOVES to roast his students for asking reasonable questions during class and fail most of his students. Assigns HW the day before its due. Does NOT teach or explain. Seems like he does not understand the class himself. This is the first class that I have EVER had to drop in my entire life. This class is the reason I am depressed.

He is difficult to understand, extremely abrasive and disrespectful towards students, and lectures using bulleted lists of incomplete info. His syllabus and grading style is highly fluid and depends on what he is feeling that day. I will not take another one of his classes again

Very confusing and hard to follow. His lectures were directly from using examples in the book. Not very helpful and somewhat disrespectful. He was not straightforward with his grading policy nor with returning points when misgraded. Hard to understand and you might as well teach yourself using the textbook
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Overall a bad lecturer. It is obvious he does not prepare topics beforehand and instead mutters barely comprehensible subject matter and "works through" example problems. Will stop class and call you out if you're on your phone. Gets angry easily. Can't answer a question straightforward and is incapable of giving full credit for questions.

This is the most disorganized professor I have ever had. He projects a PDF of the text and tries to remember the subject as he goes. His tests are inconsistent as well as his grading. He prides himself on always listening to students but will maintain egregious positions regardless of any argumentative logic. Avoid if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He literally just goes through the book on a power slide and the entire time he's talking he will almost always say something incorrect and either need to correct himself or be corrected by a student. His test are never the same format and he loves arguing with his students over pretty much anything. Try to avoid him if possible.

He's a nice enough guy, and approachable if you need help. The structure of his test questions can be tricky (I remember the class average for the first test was like 11/20). 90% of your final grade comes from 3 tests, with 2 questions each- so if you slip up on one question and do poorly, there isn't much of an opportunity to bounce back.

Straight forward with what will be on the exam.  I bombed one problem out of two for the second exam, and still managed to pull an A in the course.  If you want help, he's there.  By going to class and doing the homework you should be well prepared for the exam.

Arrogant. Unorganized. Disrespectful. Rude. Obnoxious. Confused. Disruptive to his own lectures. These are some, but not all, ways that I would describe Tagavi. I'm embarrassed to take his class, he's so awful. Get ready to watch him draw the same piston cylinder every class and scratch out some numbers on the board.

He goes over topics decently, but in different ways than his current textbook. Tests are only two questions, but partial credit is given. To be successful you'll need to study your butt off and especially show up for class, not only to see him try and explain the topics, but attendance counts for a small part of your grade.
Tagavi is definitely one of the best engineering professors at UK. Helpful, clear, and focusing on concepts, he makes sure his students know the material and how to apply it.
It's pretty straightforward. If you know your stuff, you'll do well.

Heat Transfer (Summer course) was straightforward.  Examples he did in class were from text, kind of annoying.  Tests were representative of material he covered in class.  I would say he is a "lazy" teacher, but fair.  If you keep up with material, have a brain and do homework you'll be fine in his class

Hard Hard Hard. Likes to be 'better' than his students, will make you feel stupid if you ask a question. Ridiculous tests which he usually has to regrade after the average is a 4 out of 20. Avoid at all costs
like everyone else said
Tough, not always available to answer questions, but fair.
He's smart, tough, but does the job.
Has anyone else gotten a copy of the Theromodynamics Dance Squad video?  I heard Tagavi rocks in it!

Tagavi is a terrible human being.  He doesn't care about his students. He says he cares, but when you voice a complaint, he says you are "nitpicking" and blows you off. He WILL respond to your e-mails ... next year. He WILL get your test grades back to you... after his TA grades them. All he does in class is copy examples straight from solutions.

If he suspects that you don't know the material very well, he will "encourage" you to learn it before helping you understand concepts.  His exams weighed pretty heavily on the final grade.  I had a hard time understanding him - sometimes due to the lousy acoustics in the room but mostly b/c of his sentence structuring. He seems pretty fair overall.

Thermodynamics is a very hard subject. Tagavi seemed to be preoccupied, if you went to his office, he seemed to want you out of there as soon as possible. Last guy had it right, he's makes it seem easier than it ends up being.

He is not as easy as he makes you think he is. He's a pretty nice guy, and cares that students learn the material, but not about students grades. You will end up knowing the material well regardless, but the grade you get depends on how well you mastered his test format. Doing even mediocre on one test will drop you a letter on the final grade.

He's strict but as long as you do your work well and speak in class you'll be fine. He does grade a lot on class participation, but he's very lenient on what you say (can be a question, a statement, literally anything. Just talk in class and you'll get credit). Lectures reflect the reading for before class. I took 376 (wasn't an option)

Lots of reading that's discussed at the end of the week, doesn't post powerpoints, only grades are attendance, 2 papers, and 2 exams. He kind of just mumbles through lectures so just write down the main points, and make sure to study heavy for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: worst professor of all time. He is horrible at grading so you never know where you are in class and posts absolutely nothing on canvas. save yourself and don't take him.

The mid-term and final questions come straight from the lectures, which is pretty straightforward. However, attendance is mandatory, and you can only have two unexcused absences. There is recitation with pop quizzes, and attendance is taken, but they are usually simple. He's a great lecturer and is extremely knowledge on a broad variety of topics.

Taylor mumbles through his lectures to go fast. Reading was given every week but I got an A in the class and never even touched the readings unless it was for the response papers. I didnt take good notes but I copied down the big points he gives and still got Bs on the midterm and final. Easy class but go to lecture and discussion, its for a grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mr. Taylor is an excellent professor. As long as you attend lecture and go to discussion you will be fine. The tests are taken from lecture and discussion notes. He is a great teacher. I loved this class- super interesting and engaging!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Taylor mumbles through his lectures and does not use powerpoints. Electronics are not allowed to take notes. Grades are not put in until they have to be and he does not respond to emails. There are very few assignments that are graded very toughly. The exams are essay questions. You have to read a ton.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great teacher!! -veryyyy understanding. But also very hard class- get ready for hard reading and hard essays. If you still decide to take this class, not a bad choice because the material is very interesting with a great prof. However if you want an A you will have to work for it.

Loved this professor as a person and he does an amazing job on lectures-also really passionate about this subject! But I would not take this class again because there is a lot of tough readings almost like philosophy, and there are two 5-page essays which are brutal. Participation on Thursday recitation with TA is mandatory but lecture is recorded.

The class due to COVID is a lot different than the past. The content is very interesting and overall one of my favorite classes I took content wise. Biggest downfall is the grading of the response papers and the two exams. I felt I was graded pretty tough compared to others which is fine, I got a B but the feedback is a little more to be desired.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall an easy and interesting class. Your grade consists mostly of weekly assignments and a few papers. Not my favorite class but, I would still recommend it as an easy core class.

Took HIS-130, the history of drugs and alcohol. The class was not incredibly difficult, however, you DO need to purchase the required text. Be ready to read A LOT. It was not uncommon to read 40-60 pages of text each week. His lectures were online, due to COVID-19, but they were easy to follow and about 45-60 minutes each.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I took this class for credit and found it very interesting. The reason I chose this class above others is because I am a recovering drug addict and alcoholic and wanted to learn more about the history of alcohol and drugs. I was not disappointed. Dr. Taylor presents all of the information in an unbiased way while still keeping it interesting

Taylor is a funny guy and very nice but his class requires some effort if you want an A. You have to read 4-5 very long articles each week and then you have pop quizzes in recitation that are short answer. If you are not good at writing I do not recommend taking this class. He does end lectures early every time though.

Dr. Taylor was my favorite professor this semester. He is funny, caring and a great professor. He is very considerate. He makes the class really enjoyable. He makes his lectures so easy to follow. There is a decent amount of readings in his class, but it is worth it because what he teaches is so interesting. He's always more than happy to help you.

Dr. Taylors lectures are like no other. He talks quick and does not allow any electronics, but his lectures are always interesting, funny at times, organized and easy to follow. If you ever need help, hes easy to go to. Make sure to always do the readings and pay attention in lectures. By doing that, youll pass and enjoy your time.

Dr. Taylor has been an AMAZING professor at UK. The way he teaches is very understandable and useful. He talks quickly but his information is clear and precise, and he is very clear as to what you should write down. The readings are crucial, there are quizzes, but if you do the reading, they are super easy to pass. I love Dr. Taylor's class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: if you skip class, you will fail. Be prepared for a lot of reading In lab. You will not know your final grade until the course is over. Overall, you have to get used to him, it is a very interesting class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great prof and an interesting class, as a freshman his course material is what stuck the most in my mind (and made the most impact in my life). He allows no electronics in his class, which is a but hard for those who like to take notes on laptops. He talks very fast, so neat notes are not gonna happen. Write main points, not everything he says.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I enjoyed him a lot. Theres a ton of reading every week, and the exams are all essays no multiple choice. Only 2 papers, but overall not too hard of a class. He was an interesting guy to listen too.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Scott Taylor is not only a good looking man, he also cares about his students, and their wellness. He will often start class with a valuable lesson, not pertaining to the lecture, or tell the class about resources at UK that can benefit them. His grading can be hard, and lectures can get tough, but he is one of my favorite teachers here at UK.

The class was incredibly amazing. He did a great job at teaching the content although the tests were difficult because he is looking for such specific information in your written exams. I did not know my grade until the class was over, not even a mid-term grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Taylor is probably the worst professor I've had here at UK. First, he mumbles through half of his lectures and you can ever know what he talking about. In addition, he doesn't put his grades on canvas so you're left wondering and are made to go to office hours. It's ridiculous. Not only him but his TA's are sloppy and unorganized.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I liked Dr. Taylor a lot more than my grade will probably reflect. He is very quirky and has a distinct personality that made the class a lot of fun. No electronics in class, even as a way to take notes, but going back to taking notes on paper wasn't bad. He hardly uses PowerPoints, so you need to write what you think is important. Recommended!
If you do not go to lectures and take detailed notes, it will be difficult to pass this class

She is very smart in her study and an excellent lecturer. I fell behind and she was more than understanding and helped me get back to where I needed to be. A lot of these reviews say the class was too much reading/writing (these people must not be HIS majors. Welcome to a HIS class cause that's what they are)(I took 402 it wasn't an option) 10/10:)

If you think this would be a “fun elective,” this class is catfishing you. Although Whitlock is very knowledgeable about her craft, she has a hard time getting the information out in an understanding, clear, and smooth manner. This class has mandatory attendance,heavily lecture and weekly reading based, lots of handwritten essays, and very chaotic.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: When is the last time you hand wrote an essay? I HATED this course, so much dumb homework and a hard rubric, wanted to skip but attendance is graded. Her Canvas could be SO much easier, seriously if she would not use the dumb features on it, this course would've been ok. Don't take as a "fun elective"(xo an honors student used to earning a grade)

I ended up dropping this class after 2 days. dr. Whitlock is by far the most unorganized professor I have ever seen at UK. The canvas was so difficult to navigate and I found myself running across campus to find four different textbooks. lectures are unorganized and confusing. take this class only if you want no free time because of readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This professor is excellent. The class is a bit difficult but you just need to stay up to date on lectures and go to class.
This class and instructor was a lot of fun. I enjoy the way lectures and assignments were structured. You just need to pay attention and take notes.
If you advocate for yourself and ask for help this professor will give it to you. She truly caring and wants to help her students succeed

Loved Professor Whitlock! Very friendly and funny if you're paying attention. It can seem like a lot of work in the moment but I loved the course. Gave lots of extra credit for in-class participation (raising hand etc.)

Lectures/slides are somewhat unorganised which makes studying for tests or catching up on missed days difficult. You'll be assigned a large amount of homework for discussion groups which gets a little demanding. If you miss a lecture make sure you know someone in the class because you will fall behind.

I took History 332 - Crimes in History in Fall 2023. Dr. Whitlock is an intelligent and understanding professor that has required attendance, readings almost every week, and a presentation. This class, while it was entertaining and something I enjoy, was one of my more difficult class (behind Spanish). Be prepared to write responses & essays.

She is very unorganized and demanding on her test. You will have a discussion reading and read about 30 pages a week, which doesn't sound bad at first until you realize you have a life outside of school. If you miss a lecture, you will get lost very quickly. When she gives an exam you better study or you will fail. She knows her subject well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Her lectures don't make much sense, the assignments are disorganized and confusing. I could not recommend her less.

I took His203 and it was so easy! The books were available either online or at the fine arts library. The readings were typically pretty short and easy to understand.  Overall, she is a great professor, and her lectures go rather quickly so be prepared to type or write fast.
Interesting class and wasn't too difficult. Decent amount of reading but it wasn't hard if you put in the work. Very understanding professor and not too tough of a grader.

She is one of the worst professors I've ever had. During a pandemic she assigned more homework than I've ever done. Listen to everyone on this page when they say her classes are so disorganized. This alone is SO STRESSFUL. For a low level class she graded extremely hard and her requirements are ridiculous. She is impossible to follow in class.
I was lost the entire semester. She did not explain anything.

Whitlock has by far been the most difficult professor Ive dealt with. Her class is so confusing. Each day you enter the class not knowing what to expect, what is due, etc. I learned nothing in HIS 301 even close to what the class was described to accomplish. All coming from an A student in the class. This class is prime breeding ground for anxiety

Tammy Whitlock is a sweet lady who clearly has a passion for history. she does take a long time to get test grades back, but she is an easy grader. she definitely plays favorites and likes those who participate in class more. you can use a front and back page of paper as a cheat sheet on the exams, and gives you the essay questions in advance
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Did not care for this class at all. The amount of homework(mostly reading) was ridiculous for an intro level history course, really any course for that matter. It is unorganized and hard to find assignments also.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I enjoyed Dr. Whitlocks class. The class is a little unorganized but its not so bad that you cant figure out whats going on. Overall the class was pretty interesting and one of the better classes Ive taken at UK.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She is crazy. Makes an assigned seating chart for a class with 150+ students. Obsessed with trying to prove that college is so much different than high school.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: I absolutely love Professor Whitlock. Every single second that she's lecturing, she's having a great time. She just loves sharing what she knows with us! That being said, she had us get two books, Kramer and Cunliffe. Kramer we used a lot. Cunliffe I never touched. She gives cheat sheets and if you have an A by the final you don't have to take it!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: There are so many harsh, negative things I would like to say about this woman, but I will hold myself back from doing so. This person is the most confusing teacher/professor I have ever had. She is so unorganized and not specific at all. I would never recommend this class to anyone. She is nice, I'll give her  that, but that's it. Worst class ever
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This class is a lot of busy work, you have to watch online lectures as well as attend face-to-face lectures. Her lectures are also all over the place and the powerpoints almost never make any sense. Very nice lady and she has her own kind of sense of humor. Overall, the class isn't great but she means well.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Does not know how to lecture and is very unorganized. Would not recommend this class to anyone, definitely avoid her
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Half online Half in person class, good luck getting an A, she doesnt know how to lecture, makes creepy lecture videos with Mac filters, the required website to take notes on is beyond confusing, Avoid this lady
I've had Dr. Whitlock in multiple courses. She is a subject matter expert with a great sense of humor that flies by many in her class. She is tech savvy and always willing to try something new.

Whitlock isn't the important; it's the TA you're given. But the class honestly is not that hard. You can use a "cheat sheet" for all exams and that is a one-way ticket to pass, people. The dissertation can be hard and does require reading and pop quizzes, etc. Hefty paper at the end of semester. Plenty of extra credit opportunities.
She's a horrible lecturer. This should've been an easy class but she makes absolutely no sense. Plus part of the class was online

AWFUL. She is completely unorganized & nothing about her course makes sense. I am in the process of dropping her class because I simply cannot handle it. As someone that enjoys history Whitlock is ineffective & useless as a professor. I never bought the books & made a B on the 1st exam. I hate that her course is required for my major. :(
Dr. Whitlock is a very nice professor.  I would recommend talking with her one on one if you ever have any trouble. She is very reasonable.

Tammy is strange to say the very least. As far as her "teaching" goes she is very hard to follow and the structure of the class is very confusing. She still hasn't put in my extra credit assignment that I completed 2 months ago. She doesn't respond to emails at all.  Would never recommend this class. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS unless it's mandatory.
Incredibly odd teacher -- very quirky. Didn't really match my learning style. Pretty cool material, though.

I'm a history major, so I might be a bit partial, but I thought she was great. She's a little scatterbrained, but honestly she's super nice and super helpful and is really passionate about her subject. Talk to her some one and one , it helps a lot. Also, quick handing your notes will make life a lot easier. The grading is pretty fair, too.

Dr. Whitlock is nice and helpful if you ask her for help. With that said, i wouldn't take the class again. The content was very interesting (think about French Revolution -WW2-Cold War) but her lectures weren't inspiring.   For TAs, i would reccomend Gressang. Her discussions were engaging. Remember to read your materials and engage in discussion.
I loved Professor Whitlock as a teacher. She gave you plenty of time to turn in assignments, and multiple drafts so you could easily make an A.

No. This class is horrible. Definitely take something else for your core. Professor is super weird and off the walls in lecture where no matter how hard you try you cant take any beneficial notes. Exam essays are graded extremely hard and not consistent. Not to mention Professor Whitlock has not responded to one email ive sent her ALL semester....

Terrible. Whitlock was unorganized and unhelpful. Would never recommend anyone to take her class. Literally a joke of a class, and SHE is a joke. A very unfunny one at that, and she needs to learn how to work with people and actually organize things.

I really like Dr. Whitlock. She has an eccentric personality, but she makes the subject of methodology interesting. You do multiple drafts for each assignment, so it is easy to get a good grade. By the end of the class, you'll know CMS pretty well. Her class is focuses on the insanity defense and murder. I highly recommend taking Whitlock.

This class is MISERABLY unorganized. My TA was incredibly unhelpful and graded HARD. Dr. Whitlock is very sweet but is all over the place during lectures. Taking notes is impossible. Do not take this class unless it's required.

Her lectures were all over the place, very hard to follow. Lectures in Memorial hall with 200 people were mandatory. This class caters very much to freshmen. She went over the things in the textbook, but I didn't read it hardly at all. Easy class, not so great professor.
CRAZY LECTURES , SHE IS REALLY DISORGANIZED BUT NICE PROF. THE ASSISTANT TEACHER IS AWESOME !!! NATHAN , I have an A THE EXAMS ARE EASY , you can bring a paper with notes

I loved Dr. T (as I called her). She has a great sense of humor and we got along wonderfully. I couldn't care less about Gender & Empire, but I purposely took the class so I could have her as a teacher again, after loving her 301 course. Her personality reminded me of Tina Fey, and her classes are easy if you do the work.

I feel Dr. Whitlock means well and wants her students to receive a good grade in the course, but she just doesn't know how to lecture.Make sure you attend the discussion sections and get all of your participation points because the tests are killer. Not a good class to take.

It was a really great class especially for history buffs. Dr. Whitlock made class very fun with her sense of humor and an occasional youtube video thrown in here and there. She was very clear with what she taught and very honest. No tricks on exams but make sure to keep up with readings or it will come back to bite you on the exam.

Easy class overall, but not what I expected. Gender studies was not an interest to me whatsoever, but I gave it a shot after the first day. I would try to avoid this class. She is tremendously scatter-brained and hard to follow. But a nice lady. Easy grader. Presentation at the end of semester with a 8-10 pg. paper.
Very interesting and keeps students engaged. She likes to watch youtube videos and that helps to break up class monotony. Class on British history was very fun, and I enjoy her teaching style.

Dr. Whitlock is very nice, sweet and quirky. However, he lectures aren't very well planned out and are difficult to follow. I am currently (though this will change) a history major, and while I adore her as a person, I hated her class (at least at this level) and withdrew, even though I had a C. Not my learning style at all!

I was not interested in history at all, and only took HIS 105 for the core. I did skip lecture a lot, and generally was fine and was able to participate in recitation just fine. Only 3 exams.. was surprised to find out that with an A before the final, the final wasn't required! Fairly easy, just boring and disorganized.
Whitlock is awesome. Definitely take her! Pretty cake, she's always willing to help.
Dr.Whitlock is a great professor. Although her lectures are sometimes hard to follow, she is very clear if you ask specific questions. She goes out of her way to help if you need it.

Dr. Whitlock is an amazing professor! She's super funny and intelligent. Sometimes her lectures are hard to follow but if you read the chapter you'll be fine. She also finds great youtube clips to make things relevent to us. She's really helpful and an easy grader. She says attendance matters but you can miss a few classes be ok.

She's alright and pretty understanding about things, but learning about Roman Britain and Vikings is very dry and boring. However, you don't have to read chapters upon chapters (though you will read) and the one book review you do is not too bad. Tests consist of ID's and 2 essay and isn't bad. She makes a lot of bad history jokes though.
I don't understand her bad rating. Whitlock is an amazing teacher and has a vested interest in how her students are doing.
She has vey organized notes and very knowledgable of the different subjects.

T Whit is pretty amazing. She is extremely knowledgeable in her field, very friendly, funny, and cute as a button. For 301 she gives you the chance to resubmit everything you do and for 105 her exams are very easy. She is a must take for any history student. Highly recommended.

I barely did any work and got a C, I literally didnt turn a paper in at all. Her lectures can leave the topics uncovered but they are pretty interesting. She has a definition list at the beginning of every lecture of what you should try to learn so even if she doesnt cover it you can look it up. I enjoyed this class, fairly easy and fairly enjoyabl

She is impossible to follow. There is over an hour of reading for each class. Lectures are terrible and do not follow any sort of agenda. It is just whatever she feels like talking about while she is talking. I took hist 109 and it was way easier. not what i expected

Dr. Whitlock is a horrible lecturer... she follows no outline, deviates from the texts and syllabus, and flies off on tangents separated by long pauses and frantic walking around the front desk.  Her slides consist of 12pt black text on white, and long lists of ID terms that are your responsibility.  Terrible professor, but TAs are very helpful.

Total cake.  Yeah, she doesn't give too much insight to her ID terms, but people don't get that it's up to you to read about them yourself.  If you had run-of-the-mill high school history, you should get an A, no problem.  It's pretty much a recap.  The tests are simple, the papers are short.  I like that she peppers in some women's history, too.

I really enjoyed her class, the subject matter was a little difficult because of the methodology aspect of the class.  Just make sure to communicate your questions clearly otherwise you might get answerers to questions you did not ask.

She is all over the place! Doesn't explain things very well.....leaves you guessing on how your papers, projects, etc should turn out. Only through email and talking after class with her did I get clarification on things.  She's nice and means well. As far as grading is concerned she is not too harsh. Just make sure you do the assigned readings!

She doesn't follow any kind of outline. Partway through the lecture you just want to bang your head on the desk. She starts off talking about one thing and suddendly she's so off on some wierd tangent it would be more worthwhile to catch up on sleep during class. Her TA was really awesome though.

As long as you do the readings and go to class you should be fine. Her lectures seemed random to me, they didnt follow the readings. But you have to go to class because she gives quizes. I didnt enjoy the class at all. She doesnt explain the ID terms. She does give hints about the essay question for the test.
Not that bad, she's pretty easy to listen to. Just make sure you attend your section meet or whatever. Don't take this class if you don't want to work though.

A kind lady, but very dorky.  Her presentations were nuts, she jumps around constantly so it is very hard to understand what is going on. You need to go to class in order to get the ID terms because that is what her tests are over. Overall, I'd say take any other history class but this one.
Worst professor I've ever had, she rambles on about things that make no sense, she goes off on tangents and will skip around in time 100 years with out anyone knowing it. Terrible professor
She goes off tangent a lot and by the time she's back on task, I am not!

She does not have good lectures and does not relate them at all to the reading material she assigns, which is alot, and she does not go over alot of the identification terms she gives you in the beginning of the class.
She is a little disorganized, but very easy to talk to and very easy to get help from.  She is a good teacher, but expect to work hard for her.  If you are not lazy, take her class!!
She seems like she could be a good teacher but she makes the material harder because it's so unorganized and scattered.
Why cant Dr. Holle teach both ancient and modern European history?
She is very nice and helpful. I think she is kinda cute in a way. She loves her subject and it shows in class.
No Comments
best professor ever
She was a fantastic teacher!  Who ever thought I could find British history so interesting, take her class immediately!
Very caring and understanding, a bit of a tough grader but if you show up to class and put in the work you will be fine. There is also a lot of group work but he makes it fun.

Dr Frey was my favorite teacher this semester. He makes his lectures so fun and was a class I actually looked forward to. Though he is a tough grader, he truly me a better writer and public speaker. He cares a lot about his students and takes time to get to know everyone. Hilarious and very down to earth. Highly recommend taking this course!!

He really cares for his students, and puts their needs over academics! He is a very fair and honest grader, and gives really thorough feedback. 

I will say that (for all CIS 112 classes) there is a considerable amount of group work, and you are required to do 8 hours of community service, which for some reason I was uniformed about lol.

Dr. Frey is great he will remember your name and a lot about you. He remembered something i said at the very beginning of the semester and brought it up towards the end. This class has a lot of public speaking and he will help you become better at public speaking.

Very passionate about the class and is caring about students, and is just a great guy. Harsh grader, but is VERY clear and in-depth about his criticisms, and I really feel like I've learned a lot from his feedback. Incredibly engaging lectures too.

Dr. Frey was pretty cool. CIS112 sucks, feels a bit dumb overall as a class, but Dr. Frey made it a lot more fun. The only thing I wasn't a fan of was how tough on grading he could be sometimes. He certainly won't keep you from getting an A or anything, but for such an easy class he really makes you put in effort.

Really cares about his students. He takes the time to get to know everyone and gives really good feedback. Overall just a really welcoming class especially with his daily pug pics. Highly reccomend to anyone needing an extra credit. The work load isnt that much either, he gives you the answers to the podcast quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Terrell Frey is an amazing teacher and I have taken multiple classes of his. Grades hard,  but allows you to do corrections and is genuinely interested in your well being. Great guy and great class, would recommend to take any of his classes.

I love Dr. Frey. He can have high standards, but is very willing to work with students and will put you before your work. He has very useful feedback, and has very interesting lectures. I am not a speaker, but his class was very easily my favorite.
Ive taken two class with Kody. He is a great guy and an even better professor. He does have very high expectations but is willing to meet and help you with these expectations.

Dr. Frey is by far the best professor I have ever had. He responds to emails SO fast and is always available to help. He really wants his students to succeed and do well. He is very funny and his lectures don't get boring. I took this course online in the summer and it didn't consist of that much work so it was the perfect class to take online.

Dr. Frey is amazing! Honestly the course in general is a hit or miss. I talked to other people who had other professors and they hated the class. But I loved this class because Dr. Frey genuinely cares about each student. He is somewhat tough grading speeches but if you work hard and ask questions you will finish the class with an A.

Honestly the coolest teacher I've ever had, and it seems like he really cares about his students. Also makes class enjoyable while actually teaching you something. Pretty tough grader but always gives good feedback on every assignment.
