However, I'd suggest making sure that you keep on top of the reading assignments and take good notes in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Not very nice, has favorites. Won't give you an A if his life depended on it. Doesn't care to fail you even when you work hard.

Class discussions could be a little dry, but more often than not I really enjoyed it. Dr. Trask is a hilarious and very smart professor, and I would love to take a class with him again. There is a lot of reading, but all of the books for this class were fun to read. Do the reading, go to class, and a high grade is definitely attainable.

Intelligent, sassy, and extremely funny. He has a tough time getting to the point in class, but he values all input and will definitely give you credit for trying. Not an easy grader, but he's definitely fair!  The novels on the syllabus are long, so expect to read every day. The novels are fun to read, don't worry about being bored.

I love Trask beyond words. He can be a little dense or esoteric, but I think it's because he's practically a genius. 2 papers, midterm, final, and a portfoliopresentation combo for this 330. In his others, it's strictly papers and tests. Really think about what you've read and make thoughtful comments. Take extensive notes to get thru the tests.

Trask is difficult because of his inconsistency. His comments on my papers were often strange and difficult to follow, yet any time spent with him one-on-one was useful. Likewise, it was hard to know what comments would actually be acknowledged in class. He is so intelligent that it's hard not to recommend him, but I would only do so tenuously.
Trask is brilliant. He encourages interesting discussion and challenges students to do their best. If you are serious about literature, take one of his classes; you will love it.

Although I don't think the hate toward him by students is warranted, his mood does fluctuate quite a bit from day to day. The biggest thing to remember is that he does not consider 'cookie-cutter' thought worthy of his time. Read the books, put some genuine thought into the class, show up and pay attention and you'll survive.

UK really must have jaded Trask. According to his rating on his Yale profile, he was once a genuine and nice fellar. He seems fed up with University and even more so with his students. I'll admit that some students slack quite a bit, and some just don't belong in his class.Still, I don't think his contempt is warranted.I disagree with the last post

Micheal Trask is really cool! He likes great books, including some of my favorites like NEUROMANCER (it's great, check it out!). I love hanging out in his class and listening to his gems of wisdom. Also, it's funny when he says mean things to the other people in class....

The way he talks, you don't understand him. He says himself that he uses words very few understand, and he claims he's trying to cut back on that. Class sucks because it's like following a foriegn language. The worst is that he never responds to emails. You have to guess whether he got it or not until the next class.
Good guy, if you share similar opinions with him
Highly recommend! Obviously cares a lot about students learning and gives great feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Inspirational--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He would give helpful insight during class and make the class more manageable.

He was incredibly engaging with his lectures, and I felt he was very passionate about what he was teaching, which made the lectures more fun. There are very few assignments and grades that put pressure on your grade, but they were all graded very fairly, and I didn't find them too difficult. He is kind and friendly to all his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I have ever had at UK. Very passionate about his course work and is a great story teller which is perfect for this class. Two research papers and some tests are the only grades which is my only complaint. However, an A+ is very easily achievable.

Definitely one of the better professors at the University of Kentucky. his lectures were decently easy, sometimes they were a little hard to understand. The exams were take home, and he's a easy grader. I would warn though that he doesn't give much guidance on how to write or what to write. so if you cant write without direction look elsewhere.

Dr. Campbell is so funny and a great professor. He makes light of everything, but still very respectful of others. He makes the rather boring class fun by cracking jokes and the class itself is graded by a few assignments so make sure to know that.

Professor Campbell is super nice and overall cares about his students and the content. The content may be a little boring at times but overall easy. You are graded by a few easy papers, participation, and tests. Overall, the class is super easy and I would recommend it

Dr. Campbell was so funny and I really enjoyed his class. Sit close to the front so you hear his side comments lol. There was one midterm and one final. Pretty easy credit. He tells you the final exam question on the first day. Overall great course and prof.

Dr. Campbell is easily one of the funniest professors I have taken. He knows how to connect with the students and you can definitely tell he loves what he does. Attendance mandatory in recitation, but regular lecture is not. One midterm one final. Very easy way to fulfill UK core.

I do not usually like history but love this class and professor! He is very passionate about what he talks about and pulls you in to make lectures engaging. The class is graded on very few things, but he 100% sets you up to succeed as long as you go to class and somewhat pay attention. good course to take if you need to cover a core class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I am not a history person but I LOVE this class and the professor. He is super lenient and you can tell he really cares about the students. As long as you pay attention in the lecture you will be fine.
Great professor. Lectures get long at times but that comes with any sort of lecture. His story telling is superb for his lectures.
Dr. Campbell is a great history professor. The class was research focused, so it was pretty laid back with him being there to help us out if needed. Would definitely take again!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Campbell is a great and caring professor. He gives really useful feedback and is really fun to talk to. You can tell he genuinely cares about his students. 10/10
Loved him. Such a nice man who really cares about the students. He was willing to accommodate us for anything. Not hard at all either.
Professor Campbell is awesome!!! That's it!

The TA's are so good in this class and the papers are also really easy. Only a midterm and final (you get the questions beforehand). The only thing I hated was the book assigned to read by Wendall Berry, was so confusing and did not relate to our classes. However, the TA's understood that, so it wasn't on our test! Overall really easy class!
Good guy, not much homework. Pay attention and youll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Campbell took a time period and class I was dreading and turned it into my favorite course. His grading is clear, tests not too difficult, and he is hilarious. Plenty of videos, tapes, and discussions to keep things interesting and not too much of him talking. Great guy, really cares about his students

You can tell Dr. Campbell is truly passionate about history, but he also cares about current issues. He blends the two together in an entertaining way for those who want to learn more about Kentucky. MW lectures are basically optional, but he does not post notes online so I would go.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: attendance isn't mandatory to lecture, but is for recitation. need lecture material for tests. only midterm, final, and 4 projects included for your class grade. tells you what is on exams. easy class. campbell doesn't talk very loud, so turn your hearing aids up.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Prof. Campbell's class was somewhat difficult because I had never written a 10 pg research paper before. However, he made things much easier by making himself available outside of class and teaching HOW to write about history. His knowledge is impressive and he seems to care about students' improvement. Challenging class, but amazing professor.

Two blue book exams and one paper. Lectures are fascinating and he is supportive of his students. I wish I were a history major so I could take more of his classes (I took both 467 and 468 from him and wish I could take more).

Friendly, excellent guy. His lectures are insanely clear and he gives the exams to you beforehand. The tests make you write, but they're not difficult at all. Don't read the assigned books front to back, just read enough to get the jist of what he wants you to know. If you put in effort, it's an easy A.
Good professor, experience has yielded a lot of knowledge on the topics. Lectures are usually interesting, but tests are writing-intensive and fairly tough.

Professor Campbell did an excellent job teaching HIS 112- the Making of Modern Kentucky. He cares about his students grasping the main points (not at all a stickler for just memorizing dates), and he encourages students to ask questions and become researchers. His lectures are interesting. He provided a study guide for both the midterm and final.

Great class!  I didn't like the first paper which was over a book I could barely understand.  I do like that his review guides were trimmed down as to which ones will be on the exam!  I didn't go to lecture often but still managed to pull my grade up from a B to an A!!!

If you don't at least pull a C out of this class you put forth no effort. He is fabulous and so are his TA's, they are always willing to help you and he literally gives you the study guide with the exact questions he puts on the final and the midterm.

He is a great lecturer and very knowledgeable. He is also very funny and makes the material interesting and thought provoking. I have taken 3 classes with him now and have always enjoyed his class. The general structure consists of a mid-term, final, and one paper. The paper is pretty straight forward; if you put the work in you get a good grade.
Great teacher. Really straight forward tests and grading.
One paper, a midterm, and an exam - if you mess up on one, it can really impact your grade, since there aren't any other graded things at all.  I loved the material, loved the class.
Loved his class! His passion for the subject shines through and makes the material come alive.  Had two papers, a midterm, and a final.
I had Mr. Campbell for HIS 112 and he is a great teacher. His lectures are organized very well and easy to understand. I would definitely recommend taking this course

Awesome professor, great sense of humor, and really connects well with students. His lectures are very clear and he welcomes discussion. Like the previous rater said, he is a hard grader. Really have to know your stuff in order to get an A or even a B. Exams are IDs and essays and mostly come from lectures, with some content from the readings.

Great professor. Lectures are very clear and entertaining. Tests are essay form but are over exactly what we covered. Hard grader though, surprisingly so considering the relatively easy material the class is over; still not sure what an "A" essay is.

Great teacher! One of my favorites at UK, you will have to read and put in effort but an A is very attainable. Attendance isn't required but you'll want to go just because he makes it so interesting, plus his lectures are pretty much verbatim what will be on his test. I didn't work that hard in the class and still feel like a I learned a lot!
Smart and laid back guy. Lectures are crystal clear, and are interesting. ID's and essay form on the exam. 1 research paper to do. Can reach a B if you put some effort into it.
Great professor. Smart and laid back guy.
No Comments
He's was the most interesting professor. He made the class so fun to go to. Essay and ID exams. Kinda tough, but an awesome class and professor.
No Comments
Lectures were interesting...alot of reading
No Comments
No Comments

Dr. Campbell is a really great professor.  He outlines his notes and makes them easy to follow.  His lectures move at a quick pace, but he covers the material effectivly.  Tests are short answer and essay.

Overall unclear grading structure, and a seemingly caring attitude until it became time for competency. Practically every student she evaluated she would find some reason outside of the rubric to fail students. Would not recommend. Would avoid at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I think Dr. Rogers found the class she loves to teach is Med surg 3. I have understood content and felt more prepared for the NCLEX more than I felt a few weeks ago. Some stuff in the class is still very tough, dont get me wrong but she wants to see students succeed.
would not take again. unorganized, nothing was related to questions. It was all over the place.

I love her! Great instructor and very sweet. She will act tough to scare you because it is a weed out class, but do what youre told, be on time and respectful and youre good! Pay attention in class always.
tough grader but is the only lecturer. pretty disorganized sometimes rewatch the lectures because she skips through a bunch

Professor for lecture and for lab. Tough grader when it comes to competency and mastery. Extremely helpful in the lab when learning, makes herself readily available to students. Only complaint is that occasionally she is a bit unorganized and cannot answer pressing questions about testing criteria.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: If it were not for Travis, I would have dropped calc 2. It is by far the hardest class I have ever been in and Travis actually made it easy enough for me to understand. He's a really great guy and super funny when you get him talking. I'd rather him teach the lecture. If you have the chance to have him as a TA... DO IT!

Travis Wheeler was a god-send when it came to Calculus 2. Recitation was essentially a reteaching of course material in a condensed and more understandable fashion. He uses frequent examples and works out the entire problem to show the steps. He is also very understanding and more than happy to answer student questions about homework and exams.

Calc 2 was really hard for me, and without Travis I would've probably failed. Took really hard content and shows ways to effectively proceed & really helps you understand what is going on. He's also an awesome guy and really wants to help in anyway he can. Best and most helpful TA I've ever had, and if you're debating on which TA to have- TAKE HIM.

Travis is a fantastic TA, and I am willing to bet he will make a good professor. I have had him for MA 113 and MA 114. If you respect Travis he will respect you. In MA 113 I was a few points away from getting an A in the class and without me asking him to he argued the grade for me. I didn't get it, but that is the leave to which he cares.

Troland is one of my favorite professors I've ever had! His lectures are fun and engaging and his sense of humor is awesome. Strict attendance policy but he allows you to attend remotely through echo 360.

I love Professor Troland. This is the easiest class at UK. You can attend online, there's no regular assignments just participation questions and 3 non-cumulative exams. He's also the funniest man on Earth.
Dr. Troland is literally amazing. He is so passionate about his work & genuinely cares. He is a really easy grader & all the exams are online ;)
He gives you the option to zoom the class from home if you would like instead of attend. As long as you answer the questions on the zoom it's almost impossible to get a bad grade.

Best professor I've had so far. Very engaged in his studies and hilarious when asking the class questions. He found a way to keep me engaged and coming back every time. 100% recommend Prof. Troland and his class.

Troland was an amazing teacher. You have to watch the lecture to do the participation questions. Tests are harder than you think but as long as you do the extra credit and do good on the final project you will get an A. I recommend this elective.
Sexy. That is the best way to describe Professor Troland. And he really cares about the class. But, mostly sexy.

Dr. Troland is such a sweetheart. I loved that you had the option to attend class through Echo360 if you wanted to. For an astronomy class it really wasn't too bad. Exams are tough and I didn't do that great on them but still ended up with an A. If you attend class and do well on the final project you're fine.

Prof. Troland was quite funny and offered his class on livestream while also offering it in person. You are only graded on participation during class (poll questions), 3 exams, and a project. The exams are no joke, definitely study for those. Overall easy going professor and class, just could get overwhelming at times.

Excellent professor! I'm a math major (switched from engineering, so I've already taken physics) but i had to complete a credit so i took astronomy for non-stem majors - super enjoyable class! minimal math/calculations; much more history of astronomy and broad ideas. He provides opportunities for extra credit; exams are open note! def recommend!

Dr. Troland is amazing! He truly cares about student success. Very approachable & easy to talk to. Provides clear directions for the major project & all tests are a breeze. Do the extra credit; worth 5% extra points! Easy-to-follow lectures, basic attendance quizzes (open notes). AST191 is a fun core class. Easy A, no complaints about Dr. Troland.

HE IS WONDERFUL. troland is hilarious and makes astronomy super interesting! he is also extremely understanding and has a very soothing voice. there are not many assignments so tests are very very important, this class was super interesting and i got to learn a lot about the heavens! would 100% take again.
He is the best!!

Good professor who was a lenient grader and made lectures interesting. Class only had 2 exams, 1 project and attendance as grades and it is unclear what your grade is right til the end but easy class nonetheless

I love this guy. He's so entertaining I actually cried on the last day of class because I was gonna miss him. He gives the option to watch the lecture online, which is nice. Exams are open note! He is old-fashioned though, not many assignments and not much extra credit. Also his attendance grade system in the syllabus is confusing. But he's awesome

He really is passionate about what he is teaching and I love that I could contact him outside of class if I was confused about something. I was not the biggest fan of his TA, however and because of her I failed an assignment initially, because she did not grade it right. Make sure you take good notes, bc you can use them on the exams!

Troland keeps the lectures entertaining and communicates with students frequently. Attendance is graded every day so go. Tests can be challenging but it isn't going to affect your grade a bunch if you study and try. Highly recommend this course and professor troland!

Tom is a really nice guy and also enjoys what he teaches. Lectures can be boring at times but he adds some humor at times to grab students attention. He had the option to attend class online or in person. I would take good notes because his tests are difficult if you do not take good notes. Lecture slides are available for future access if needed.

Troland is cool, I hope everyone gets to have him at some point. I only signed up for this class because I needed an easy elective but ended up really enjoying learning about the solar system. Troland made learning easy and enjoyable. He is hilarious and genuinely cares about his students. He is very likely one of the best professors at UK.

Tom Troland is one of the funniest people you will ever meet. He truly cares about students and does his best to make the lectures interesting even though sometimes the material is hard to understand. He only gives three exams and they are pretty tough; the first one caught the whole class off guard so be prepared!!
Great teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I took AST assuming it would be an easy science credit. This class seemed promising but the TA grades papers so bad. I got an 11/20 on my project because she couldn't see my two predictions even though it's clearly listed. This professor is so bad and so are the TA's. Wouldn't recommend to anyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Course is test-heavy, but there are ample opportunities for extra credit and Mr. Troland is an amazing lecturer. Even when covering dry material his passion for the subject shines through and he always seeks to make it relatable and interesting.

Basically impossible to reach over email and test questions can be misleading and confusing to answer. Content is not difficult but he makes it difficult sometimes. Would recommend another core course besides this one.
He is so sweet!

He's by far the easiest professor to take for anything Astronomy. As long as you get 80% or more in TopHat questions, you'll get 100% in that category. Same for attendance; 80% or more and you get full credit. Besides that, 2 exams and a final, plus one observation, which requires 1 page description. He's very kind, intelligent, and likable.

Mr. Troland is one of the best teachers that I have ever had. I feel privileged just to sit before him in lecture as he shares his intelligence with 150 others. He keeps a light atmosphere in the class and I respect him very heavily.

My favorite professor at UK. I'm excited to take 192, and I'm not even into astronomy, he truly makes this class. You'll have to study for exams, but overall this class is amazing. I actually enjoyed going to this class.

I loved taking astronomy with this guy. He was absolutely hilarious! His class is pretty basic stuff, just pay attention and take notes in his class. Tests were usually more difficult than his lectures. Make sure you study and go to class!

Professor Troland is hilarious and a great lecturer. That being said, 100% of this class is lecture. But, he shows you some cool pictures and doesn't make it all too boring. Tests are harder than you expect. Study!! He tells you the first day that you won't need the book so don't buy it. I would take Troland again, he's awesome.

The class itself was so boring and I hated going to it; however, Troland was hilarious and was constantly telling jokes to keep people involved in the topic. Tests are extremely hard, so you need to study all semester long.

Troland is an awesome guy who is super funny and tries to make lectures fun, but the lectures tend to get tiring. He does not take attendance  but  I found the tests were much easier since I went to class.
He definitely knows what he is talking about and is very funny. He is a great professor and I would love to take another one of his classes!

A great teacher, though a relatively simple course. Still, this course is a great one to take for your core reqs. Professor Troland makes the subject matter immensely more interesting, and is an enjoyable teacher. The exams are easy so long as you pay attention, especially to the questions of the day.
Great professor! Very very funny and stimulated interest in the subject.
Troland is funny, engaging and makes the subject interesting. A must take course for fulfilling Core reqs, but watch out for those exams!

Simply the best professor every. He's super funny and makes the class really interesting. Tests aren't that hard and are all multiple choice. His class is so fun, that I attend his class, even when I'm not enrolled. Please, please, please, please do yourself a favor and take this class.
Be Professor ever!!! Makes class fun

This guy is awesome! Makes class entertaining, while teaching information at the same time. Don't miss out on this guy. Tests can be a little tricky, but if you write down the "Questions of the Day", then it will be an easy class.
I took both AST 192 and 191, and 192 was definitely easier. 192 is a little more boring, but he is still a funny guy and really really knows his stuff. Good to take if you need USP Nat Sci credits.

Take this class. You will not regret it. Fantastic class with a fantastic teacher. I took it my first semester and it was by far my favorite class that semester. I really can't say enough about this class and Professor Troland. Absolutely fantastic class with a hysterical, helpful teacher.
One of my favorite teachers ever! He's funny and keeps class informative and interesting.  He really interacts with the students and makes the whole class seem more interested!  He's great!!
What's not to like about Troland?

Coming from a student who attended every class this semester, Dr. Troland made EVERY class very fun & entertaining! He is consistent in his teaching habits, and is always willing to take as much time needed to fully answer a student's question(s). Your notes are your exams. If you understand that, then you will attend every class. Peace and Bourbon
Awesome teacher. Made the class really funny. Tests aren't too hard just study your notes. And he will always answer a question you have. Great teacher, my favorite so far.
Dr. Troland is the best!! he's so funny!!!!

HILARIOUS. He's my favorite professor. Definitely take this class as an elective or to take care of a science pre-req. He gives short writing questions like once every two weeks which are extremely easy. Attendance isn't mandatory but no one ever wanted to miss! He makes it interesting and enjoyable. TAKE HIS AST 192 CLASS!

Very good professor, very good class to take as an elective. He takes very complicated subject matter and brings it down to a learning level that you can understand for someone who has had no prior experience in this subject matter. If you attend class you are most likely guaranteed an A.
Amazing professor. He's the shizz.

The coolest prof I've had so far. In terms of content, the class can get pretty boring, but Troland always manages to keep you interested. A very funny and entertaining guy. Attendance isn't mandatory, but it's the only way you can get the notes. Tests are fairly easy as well; taken straight from questions in his powerpoints. I highly recommend him

I rarely went to class and got an A.  This is basic science stuff, pretty damn hard to fail.  I skipped his class 5 times in a row and the 6th which landed on a Friday I got **** in class.  The "Random" quizzes are pretty easy to predict.  Find a good wall to cuddle with and take a nap.  Or do like I did and pregrame for Friday night.  BEERONOMY!!
Funny Guy, my favorite professor on UK's campus!
such a good prof definitely take his course!

He does not put the notes online, so you have to go to the class to get them, but as long as you study for the exams it's easy, test q's are straight from pp slides,he's a funny guy but likes to call on you if you have a laptop. take notes on paper.

i have no interest in astronomy and he actually made the class interesting for me. he's very funny but its hard to study for tests because all you have is lecture notes. you have no homework. must go to class for random writing assignments.
love em!

His class was super fun! So funny, I laughed every class. His tests can be hard - super detail oriented and you need to be able to apply concepts. Don't miss too much class because you can miss (12) writing assignments that are random and part of your grade and tests are based on class notes. Do NOT buy the book you won't need it.

LOVE this class. LOVE this professor.  I'm actually shocked that people are saying his exams are hard or tricky-I don't think so at all.  Go to class (it's fun!) and take a bit of time to study and you will do great. As many have said-don't pass up the chance to take a class with Troland.  One of UK's best!
Most fun professor ive ever had. He is a twisted genius and is a suave older guy. Easy class, subject is mildly interesting but you should not go to UK and never experience a Tom Troland class

Great professor. Definitely in my top 3 as far as interesting personal stories and current events. I think the boring class topic is the overall weakness. Even though he manages to be a really great guy, he sucker punches you with hard exams. Be prepared for those.

I took Bad A** Tommy T for both 191 and 192. He is my favorite professor on this campus. He is funny and interesting and really loves teaching. His tests can be tricky, but he gives out 5% bonus on your overall grade...can't beat that.
Best teacher at UK. The only complaint I can think of is his tests. They cover a lot of material.

The penultimate goofy Physics professor you've always wanted to have.  He mentions at the beginning that his teaching is so efficient that you don't need the book, and he's right.  He pauses lectures to go on with a joke all the time, but still manages to cover all the material very clearly. Don't hesitate one second to take this class.

Excellent teacher. The notes given during class are very clear, and he is very clear with what he expects from his students. His tests aren't hard if you go to class and you study a little bit for them. I am taking AST 192 next semester only because he will be teaching the course.

He was a great teacher! He is very funny and that helps keep the class entertaining. His tests are pretty tricky and they were not what I expected. Overall, he was great and I am taking AST 192 next semester.
He's a funny guy and a great teacher. Gets off topic a lot, but it keeps class interesting.

I was an allright class.  He is a great guy and really funny, but the class lulls towards the end.  Tests are kind of hard, you have to know all the stupid little facts and numbers.  Overall a fun class and I learned alot!

Hands down one of my favorite teachers. I took both AST 191 and 192. Very easy class if you go to class and take notes. All questions on the test are on practice tests. He makes class so fun and interesting that it is hard to miss!
He has the most personality out of all professors I have had at UK and he makes every class interesting.

Troland makes learning about astronomy so easy adn fun. If you go to class (which there are in class assignments) he teaches right off power points (which he does not put online)  but he just reads them and if you take notes and are there for the in class review questions from the last class you barely have to study for the tests.
Prof. Troland is soo funny. He keeps you very entertained, very enthusiastic about teaching and encourages questions. But his tests catch you off gaurd, takes time to know the material.
If he was any more badass he'd be chuck norris. BWAHAHA.
Not sure what every one is talking about.  His tests are pretty bogus and catch you off guard.

I've never been in a large lecture classroom that, on a normal day, was more the 60% full. I think it's saying something that this classroom is ALWAYS full, that everyone manages to drag themselves in to attend this class. Immensely enjoyable class, funny, enthusiastic professor. Obviously loves his field and makes you want to love it too.
Amazing teacher, and hilarious.  There's even been a Facebook group devoted to him; "Professor Troland is the****!"  Take him for Astronomy if you ever get the honor.

I highly recommend him.  He makes the subject very interesting and knows how to please his audience.  Very funny guy.  Extremely easy tests and in-class writing prompts (you can use notes for the prompts and it only takes five minutes to answer them).  His notes are very helpful.
Probably the best professor at UK. Very enthusiastic and dedicated. If you don't like him, there's something very wrong with you.
Very good teacher.

I really like this proffessor.  He is crazy and I don't mind going to class.  His tests are pretty hard, but he puts several "Questions for the previous class" that he goes over every day on his tests.
No Comments
best teaher ever!
In four years of college this is the easiest class i have ever taken. there are about 1.5 chapters on each test and all multiple choice a must take!
yay for troland!
don't take his class if you're looking for an easy A, but if you're willing to study, sign up! he's an awesome teacher; you can tell he loves his job. he's great.

Not exactly an easy A, but a relatively easy class.  Troland makes the class fun, and is always very energetic.  I'd suggest him if you're looking to get some science credits out of the way, because it's possible to get an A, and he's a great guy.  He also puts notes online.
Very energetic
take this class

This man is great!  If you go to class and read then it is an easy A (and most importantly to me - got one of my science credits out of the way).  Highly recommended.  He is a very funny man.  Take his class!
Troland is one outstanding prof.  He knows his astronomy, knows how to teach it, knows how to get it across to his students, and knows how to make it an enjoyable experience!
He is a great teacher.  His class is fun, and he gets off onto wild, funny tangents.  His tests are hard if you don't go to class or study.  I wouldn't take any other teacher for astronomy.
He really is one of the best teachers at UK. HE has the ablity to make boring crap fun.
Funny, funny man.  Makes class interesting and has great slides.  Makes astronomy amusing.
No Comments

You definitely need to pay attention and come to class because you need a lot of time to work on the projects given. She is a very caring professor and wants her students to succeed. Offers help whenever needed and grades fairly.

Helen is amazing!!! From the beginning she was very upfront that we could come to her office hours for anything, even if it was just for venting. She is a caring woman, and one of the better professors I have had. She will give you honest feedback on your work. She pushes you to do the best and to go outside of your comfort zone to try new things.

Helen is awesome! Her studio class is full of interesting projects and she is fun and easy to talk to. She will also give you great feedback on your projects and help refine whatever you're working on. She's also very accessible outside of class and responds to emails in a quick and timely manner. Awesome interiors prof!

Helen only taught a couple units for this course and I wish she taught the whole class. She knows so much about design- so make sure you watch her lectures because they will help you on the tests/assignments!
This class was enjoyable and she really knows a lot about the subject.  She is very helpful if you ask.
Very nice person
By far the best professor I've ever had at UK, especially in design.  She cares about your work and progress and gives great feedback. Loves what she does and tries to get you to love it too!

Super smart teacher. She really knows the material and you can tell she genuinely cares about it. She grades hard, but is fair and her midterm and final are super easy because she prepares you for it very well.

She has a good knowledge of the subject matter and tries to make the class interesting.  She is obviously new to teaching and will get better.  Grading is unpredictable, especially on written assignments.  Comments on written work don't always correspond with your grade.

The absolute BEST teacher. She is very informative and extremely helpful. Questions never went unanswered and she went above and beyond to make sure of our understanding. You can tell she is passionate about her job as well. She is a complete necessity for the College of Design's Interior Design program.

The best science class to take to fill your "UK Core" if you are not a STEM major.I loved the ability to join his lectures online and never attended an "in-person" class after the first day. Everyone is required to join his Echo360 so it doesn't matter if your are in the classroom or a different state, the participation counts the same.Only 3 exams
He allows you to attend classes virtually which is really nice, however his tests do not match anything he talks about so I never figured out how to study for them.

Professor T is by far the best professor I have had so far in college. You can tell he is passionate about what he teaches and 40% of your grade is just answering online questions during class. Very easy to attend class either online or in person which is nice. This class is an easy A as long as you attend class.

Professor Troland is amazing. Participation is 40% of the grade but he offers an online option so I ended up physically going to class only once. The other 60% of the grade is 3 online tests that ask the same questions he asks in class which are not too hard. Overall he's a hilarious and amazing guy.
Easy course, entertaining professor. Would recommend to anybody who needs an extra elective or a natural science course to graduate but wants an easy A and to learn something interesting.
Troland makes his lectures interesting and provided that you pay attention to them, you should have no issue with exams.
Doesn't answer emails at all and won't update grades till the end of the semester. I wouldn't recommend taking him to anyone.

Professor Troland is very obviously passionate about what he teaches, and he passes that passion on to his students as much as he can. I took this just to get the credit for it, having no interest in the subject, but his passion and lightheartedness gave me an interest in astronomy I had never had. The class is easy if you show up and pay attention

Dr. Troland is a great guy but his class got to be a little boring. AST 191 is supposed to be for non-STEM majors but it seemed to be taught to a STEM audience. Though I would recommend having a conversation with him outside of class because he's really nice. Just watch out for those exams!

The lectures can be boring at times especially when you're going over physics or geology but the lectures are really straightforward. This was by far the easiest class I've taken in college, if you show up, do OK on the Top Hat answers and study for a few hours the day before exams, you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This class is really boring and difficult if you are not naturally interested in astronomy or physics. He makes it relatively interesting, but it is not exactly enjoyable. However, it is not hard to do well in the course. Studying for the exams is super important, and answering the questions/attendance (online) daily is a huge portion of your grade
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is a really nice guy, but AST 191 is definitly a non-major requirement deal. I took it for my university natural science requirement. Easy A, but pretty boring. But, you do learn some cool stuff about gravity, planets, the unverse, etc.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Trolland is great and I really want to take him again for 192! Attendance and participation are through TopHat and you only need 80% for each to get full credit and participation is worth more than attendance so even if you aren't going to go get on TopHat to do the questions. Also be sure to do the extra credit! Awesome prof!
Incredibly enthusiastic, brings something new every lecture. Truly entertaining. You not only want to learn, you want to hear everything he has to say about everything.

This professor was not helpful. He teaches based off of slides that he refuses to post online. He is constantly off topic, and has made a point to impose his political opinions on his students on multiple occasions. Incredibly dry lectures.

I actually took both AST 192 and AST 191 with Professor Troland. That's how much I liked him. He was knowledgeable on the subject of Astronomy as a whole, he did his best to answer any in-class questions, he was very funny, and he made his lectures interesting. If you are planning on taking either of these classes, I would definitely recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I struggled only because I am not a science person. Awesome professor, hilarious funny old guy who makes bad jokes . Super nice and wants to help you any way he can. Pop-quiz sorts of things throughout the semester despite the fact that attendance is not mandatory so I suggest not skipping. No textbook.
Dr. Troland is hilarious. His class if very informative and a lot of fun. I had him for AST 191, and am planning on taking him for AST 192 next semester. Easy A.
Worst teacher I have ever had. Just shows you pictures and expects you to know the material.

He likes to talk way to much about things besides what he is teaching. He can't seem to concentrate enough to teach class. He puts a joke on every other PowerPoint slide and tries to make the whole class a joke. He is to insecure to actually teach correctly. Also he doesn't post the slides online because he thinks he is such a great lecturer.

I had Professor Troland in the early 80s at UK. The class was an elective for me; I was a marketing major. He was BY FAR the best teacher I ever had.He was tough but so very interesting. He made a grading error on my final and when I went to him, he changed my B to an A but said he had NEVER changed a grade before but I deserved it. Awesome guy!

Troland is awesome! He's hilarious. He throws random funny pics in his PP's to keep your attention. Gives you sample questions before each exam. Asking/answering questions gives you bonus points. No book required. Attendance not mandatory. Take him if you can!
One of the best professors at this University, hands down. If you have the opportunity to take a class with Troland, don't pass it up.

I had him in the early 90's. Glad to see he's still teaching. I had him my freshman year, and I'm so glad, because I learned from his notes how to outline. He made 3D concepts come alive with 2D drawings. A remarkable teacher. And I majored in English!
One of my favorite teachers ever!  He's funny and keeps the class interesting and informative.  I definitely recommend taking him for Astronomy!

GREAT professor! He loves what he does and it shows. He is willing to help if you need it and always answers questions. His lectures are interesting and hilarious. He's not hard in the sense that he'll try and trick you everything from the tests is straight from lecture but you definitely need to study. AMAZING professor take his classes!!

If you attend class and take notes, the class is easy. Volunteering gets you extra credit points, which is nice. Troland is an awesome professor as well! He is hilarious in class, and if you need to talk to him one on one he is more than willing! Great class!

TROLAND IS THE MAN! He is awesome. The class is super easy, although it is extremely interesting! Attendence is mandatory, but the class is usually full because students love listening to his lectures. I know I did. Easy, easy, easy A if you come to class. Tests come straight from lectures. Troland is very nice and very approachable. TAKE HIM!

A walking laugh riot with a real passion for what he teaches. Goes into great detail on his subjects during lectures (tests focus on this). Happy to pause the lecture to answer a student's question. Attendance not taken but strongly advised because he covers alot of material in one day.

A walking laugh riot with a real passion for what he teaches. Goes into great detail on his subjects during lectures. Happy to pause the lecture to answer a student's question. Attendance not taken but strongly advised because he covers alot of material in one day.

Lectures are discussion based but we talk about the texts he assigns as homework and they are extremely confusing. He offers no other explanations for the readings so most of the time you walk into class having literally no idea what is going on. Thankfully, the quizzes are online and open note so it is not difficult to do well in the class.

The class focuses HEAVILY on the readings so make sure you do those. Says he'll do pop quizzes if he suspects that people haven't been reading but I never experienced one of those. Lectures seemed to be repetitive and a little slow towards the end of the semester. He communicates well though, and will help you if you reach out.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Paul-Anthony is a good professor. Throughout the course, you will be required to read many philosophical works that are very interesting. What Paul-Anthony lacks is he grades on a very low point scale and he's not clear with communication. If you miss 1 point, it can take your grade down a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I have ever had. Incredibly understanding and made me enjoy learning Latin even more. Take her if you can, I love her so much!

Prof. Tunberg is one of the best professors I've had while at UK. She really cares about her students and the class sizes are usually pretty small. The classes are easy and well organized and she tells you what will be on quizzes and exams down to the questions themselves. If you have to take Latin, make sure you take her class!

Jennifer is amazing. As long as you have any sort of translation ready for her class, she'll accept it. She's so encouraging and willing to work with students who aren't as confident. Showing up to class is important for passing but she won't deduct if you are absent.
She is so so kind, and she is fluent in Latin to the point of being inspiring. She is not a tough grader on tests, but is tougher on quizzes. She really wants you to succeed.
She is such a lovely lady, she truly loves her students and wants them to succeed. Definitely would recommend and take again!
I adore Dr. Tunberg. Her love of Classics and concern for her students is amazing. She's an easy grader and very helpful.

Dr. Tunberg's love of Latin and the Classical tradition is without equal. She loves her job and genuinely wants her students to do well. She chose excellent texts for us to translate and was very helpful when it came to more difficult passages. She really cares about her students, their success, and their lives. I look forward to having her again!
Dr. Tunberg is an amazing lady. She is incredibly helpful and is a wonderful Latin teacher. I have loved having her for my college Latin career.
Wonderful professor, and incredibly sweet!  As long as you do your homework and show up to class, you will have no problem getting a good grade.  She loves her work and her students.

Very enthusiastic about the material; she genuinely cares about students' learning and is always willing to help. Make sure to take good notes because her tests are very detail-oriented. Other than that though, the class was easy. I had her for 101 and 105 and got A's without reading most of the books.

Very nice person and readings/essays are manageable but the tests are impossible. She will spend every class lecturing and rambling and you are expected to remember EVERY detail. Most students had no clue what to even study for the test. Class wasn't that difficult, but should have been an easy A if it wasn't for the two tests.

Dr.Tunberg is one of the best professors I've had EVER, and definitely the best Honors prof at the school. She is very enthusiastic about what she teaches and is always willing to help a student if they need it. She will always go out of her way to help you succeed. Just go to class and take notes for her tests (which are hard!) and you'll be fine!

I took her for HON 101 and HON 105, and I thoroughly enjoyed both classes! She is very passionate about the subjects and explains them well. The texts were also interesting. She is overall an easy grader when it comes to papers. Take detailed notes for exams, and you will do fine. I got A's in both classes.
wonderful instructor and always willing to help

She was a bit crazy at times, but a REALLY sweet teacher, she is so nice!Her class can be hard especially when she lectures-make sure you pay attention to every detail! Exams were sometimes difficult but essays helped. PARTICIPATE,it helps your grade a lot and she will like you and get to know you more. Easy A but you have to do the work (ie read!)

Dr. Tunberg is the best professor I've had thus far. She genuinely wants everyone to learn and do well in the course. The note-taking is a bit much, and attendance is MANDATORY if you want to do well on her exams. There are no assignments other than a couple of essays. Overall, fairly easy.

Awesome teacher.  She takes interest not only in what she's teaching, but also her students and their grade in  the class.  If you ask questions or for help, she's there to help, always. She answers e-mails promptly, which is hard to find in a teacher.  She has a ton of notetaking, but it's all really interesting.  She has fresh takes on classics.
:D Dr. Tunberg is the most optimistic and friendly professor I have ever met! If you don't mind going to class and doing your work it is very easy to get an "A." HIGHly recommended

Dr. Tunberg is a lovely person, but I found her lectures to be a bit dry at times.  She was not focused on class discussion enough.  If you do take her, be METICULOUS in note-taking.  Her tests were extremely difficult if not prepared.  Overall...fairly easy and an extremely nice person, easy to deal with.
So easy! The material was a bit dry though (she spent a few days talking about how books were made though the ages) at times.

SUPER!!!She's great!!!Because of her I LOVE Homer, Beowulf and all the other things she taught.I still have all my books from her class and I smile whenever I focus on them on my shelf.  As for being easy,I had never read anything like Homer before(public school)she provided a solid foundation

Dr. Tunberg is an unflappable teacher, brimming with enthusiam and optimism. She will not leave a point until every last student understands. She is truly a joy to be taught by. If I had to find any fault, it would be that she isn't "hard" enough, she often will not reprimand students who are lazy.

Jakob was a great Spanish professor. He was really helpful when you didn't understand something and was a pretty lenient grader. The class was usually pretty interesting but it got boring towards the end of the semester. Overall, a great guy,

I forgot to rate last year but I absolutely love Professor Turner (Profe). He is so fun, sweet, and easily flustered by our shenanigans. We took a class picture and he gave us his number if we ever needed anything. I would give a kidney to be in his class again; it was so fun and I learned a lot without too much mental drain. He rocks.

I loved his class! He taught very well and made sure all of his students were going to do well. You get a lot of make-ups on essays and other things. If you are not the best at Spanish, you will still do well in his class. Definitely take his classes!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lots of graded assignments, but he reminds everyone when things are due. Pretty solid choice overall, the tests are easy as they are taken asynchronously and you can resubmit compositions to get points back. Very nice and is understanding as far as not expecting perfect Spanish to be used in class. I would recommend Jakob (profe) to other students.

my favorite professor so far. he's currently a grad student, which IMO makes him very approachable, relatable, and laid back. just become his friend. I looked forward to coming to his class everyday. its very easy to go off topic in his class (in the best way) and you can tell he really cares about his students and loves teaching.

Professor Turner (Profe) is such an amazing teacher. It's not necessarily about your quality of spanish, but the effort you put in. Homework heavy class, but the homework is relatively easy and he is always available to help. Easily my favorite class this semester (SPA211). He's also just adorable and very kind.

Easily the worst professor I've ever had. We stopped him multiple times in class we didn't understand because he'd never explain any of his work, and he'd do examples that class but then he'd revert right back the next class. I wish I'd talked to the Ombud after his class... I will NEVER take his classes again.

Could possibly be the worst teacher that I have had at UK.  Not a bad guy at all, very personable and funny, but absolutely terrible teacher.  Expects you to memorize absolutely everything from his lecture slides!  Tests are HARD!
He won't answer the questions you ask, or actually teach you how to do more than follow his method. His tests and his final have very little correlation. If you have him for class DROP IT ASAP.

Rather than test you on the applications of the material you've "learned", Dr. Tzou finds it entertaining to test you on how well you've memorized his convoluted derivations of various equations. He teaches out of a workbook he wrote that he has posted online, but you still have to buy another $100 textbook for homework problems.
He is facially supportive but does not come through on what he says.
A very dedicated and caring teacher! Great personality too.
Dr. Tyler is one of the most articulate and dedicated professors I have ever had. I cannot imagine anyone having a legitimate complaint about this professor.

Dr. Tyler is the BOOM!!! He is super smart and is an excellent teacher.  He can sometimes go overboard with theory, but he really wants students to learn the material.  One of the best grad teachers at UK!
No Comments

One of my favorite professors at this university. The quality of Tyler's work is so undervalued, and if you get the chance to take a class with him... do it. Even if you are not a fan of philosophy, you will love him. Most of the classes consist of thinking briefly about the reading content and then expanding upon it with personal examples.

You have very few assignments however you are expected to do many readings. Although, you can definitely get away without reading as long as you PAY ATTENTION in class. He will like you more and be more willing to accommodate if you show up! I loved his class, it really made me question society (in a good way lol)

He's great! He will always have feedback to give for any points he took away from any assignment/exam. The exams are a lot of writing, but they are not difficult! If you show up to class, you will have no problem acing this course!

I took a class with Tyler last year and I still think about how much I loved the class! I literally looked on the course catalog to see what other classes he was teaching so I could try to take one because he was such an amazing professor. He made the class interesting, kept everyone engaged, and gave great feedback on papers. Would 100% recommend

I really liked this class! I thought the discussions were interesting and Tyler was great at making thought-provoking questions to deepen the discussion. We are mainly just graded on our essays. The only thing I would say is I felt like he graded kind of hard. I was never able to get a 100 on my essays no matter how much time and effort I put in.

Tyler was literally one of my favorite professor’s I’ve ever had. I looked forward to going to his class every time because he made it so entertaining and the material we talked about was interesting to me. He can be harsh sometimes but he does genuinely care about his students and he’s very understanding.
This professor has to be one of the most nitpicky professors with a lackadaisical rubric. His assignments are poorly written, yet, he goes on huge tangents when grading papers.

Tyler is an AMAZING professor. He explains things perfectly and if you need extra help, he is willing to go above and beyond to make sure you understand. The exams are just like the homework and it's straight to the point.

Tyson is amazing! He is such a great professor and obviously cares about his students. There are no tests, which is awesome, only weekly quizzes that aren't bad at all. Weekly homework with unlimited attempts, so that was easy as well. Overall, easy class with an easy-going professor. Highly recommend Tyson to anyone!!

Took Fin410 in the summer. I was nervous as it was my first 400 level class. He makes the material seem much simpler as he's very good at explaining. Really interested in what his students have to say, willing to spend class time discussing financial related interests. As long as you're going over material before quizzes you should get a good grade
Van Alfen is the legend. One of the coolest professors I've had at UK. No tests just quizzes every Thursday which really helps your grade. Weird style of teaching but he's the man
Dr T inspired me to keep studying finance/Econ and taught me that hard work really does pay off.  Ask about the yaks if he doesn't bring them up.
Prof Van Alfen's yaks are the greatest, he will most likely show pictures of them. He is very nice and likes cats which is a plus. This class is great, would take again.

Good Calc 3 Professor, He doesn't give curves, but he goes over very similar problems to the ones that are on the test during the review lectures, so make sure to show up to those. He has a thick accent, and a bit sporadic writing, but he his a cool guy and if you show up to lectures you'll understand what you need to know.
He's a fine choice for calc iii. He teaches the material well.
Dr. Nagel is a very German with a very german accent to match, so he can at times be difficult to understand, however, he really cares about his students and seems to be pretty chill in general.

Dr. Nagel is one of the best math professors I have ever had. His lectures may be boring to some, but I enjoy learning the theory and proofs behind formulae and concepts. He gives reviews before exams with material that is VERY close to what will be on the actual exam. I look forward to taking more courses with him.
Awesome professor, and GREAT at answering questions.
Always go to class the day before the exams, he gives the exact same problems on the exam. Easy.

Nagel is a very fair professor. He takes attendance every day and has an announced quiz at least once a week. If you do the homework, it's almost impossible to do badly on the quizzes and the practice exams are VERY similar to the exam with some numbers changed around. He's also a great lecturer and encourages participation. Top notch professor!

I'm a C-average student, and also took MA214 with Dr. Nagel, and he has consistently proven to be a clear-cut lecturer. Attending his lectures is essential to passing and his notes are organized; so long as you take them, homework becomes very easy. Example problems in class are the homework problems, and practice exams are identical to the exams.
He takes attendance via a sign in sheet. He does a good job lecturing. He gives plenty of homework, but it is useful because the exams reflect what is on the homework.

Nagel's lecture's are just the proofs for theorems in the textbook, with occasional examples. Don't expect to get as far as the chapter listed in the syllabus, because if Nagel asks a question, he expects an answer and will wait to get it. The plus side? No "application" type problems. Just lots of computation.
If you love theory sign up for his matrix algebra. Worse than all four calc classes together

He is a teddy bear. He is always smiling and laughing, but his accent can get some getting used to. He's no nonsense, and he always started lecturing promptly and finished exactly when he was supposed to. Grades very fairly, and exams are always similar to the homework's. I recommend.

Nagel is a very good professor. He does examples similar to problems given on the exams and homeworks. His accent takes some getting used to but isn't too bad. He always introduces a theorem/topic and then does examples. I felt like this made the class easy to follow. Nagel made all the topics clear and understandable.
Difficult to understand. Spends 75% of class on useless theorems and proofs and then 25% of class squeezing in examples. I would suggest someone else

I had professor Nagel for Calc 1 and then again for matrix algebra and i loved him both times! He is extremely understanding and very helpful. The man is a genius, he is clever and funny, and there isn't a mean or rude bone in his body. I could see some people struggling with his german accent but it really isnt that bad. Highly recommended! =)
Great man! Great Professor.

Wonderful professor. I had to drop MA 322 last semester and I picked it up again with Dr. Nagel. I'm so glad I did because I finally understand matrix algebra now. 1 homework set and 1 quiz per week. Tests are straightforward. Grading is always fair. Nice guy, very helpful. Take him if you have the chance.

Very tough course (weed-out Calc for Engineer Students), with tough grading, written assignments, and no use of the textbook (unless you want to). Nagel, however, is a very smart and sweet man, has a German accent but not a bother. Could have better handwriting.

Good teacher but I don't recommend calc at UK unless you've taken a calc class before. Written assignment that the people in the mathskellar don't know how to solve. Oh and it sucked that my TA said he wasn't strict on attendance, then he failed me for missing 3 classes. " you lie for me I'll lie for you". Guess not.
Nagel is great! So helpful and really knowledgeable on the subject. He is a little hard to understand at first but you get use to it.
Great! Had a deep knowledge of math and could easily explain calc

Best math professor I've ever had. Dr. Nagel is highly intelligible and truely cares about the success of his students. The only negative comment I could make is his writing is sometimes hard to read. Overall: I would recommend Dr. Nagel to every incoming freshman.

Dr. Nagel truly cares about the success of his students.  He will try to help you and accommodate to your needs in any way, even with extra credit when the test average is terrible.  Hearing of some of the other professors, I would definitely recommend Dr. Nagel for Calc 1.

Great teacher. Hard to understand at first but you will get used to him. (PS: his "n"s look like "u"s so be careful when taking notes. He is always happy to clarify anything about the notes or homework in class.

Professor Nagel frequently makes mistakes on the board because he's moving too fast, not because he doesn't know the material. His German accent and handwriting take a bit of time to get accustomed to, but aren't that bad. He's really helpful and knows what he's talking about.

Terrible teacher. This was my first math class at the university, and I was forced to withdraw or else I would have lost my scholarship. He's very difficult to understand, and he likes to ramble and make pointless jokes in class. Add that to the fact that the class is very large, and things become pretty hard. I don't recommend him.

Dr. Nagel is fantastic. His lectures are very well organized and introduce the topic effectively. He's very amiable and patient in and out of class and gives frequent curves on exams. Excellent professor for calculus I, and incidentally looks exactly like an older (live) Graham Chapman.

Dr. Nagel is easily the best professor I have had thus far in my college experience. His lectures are clear, although it takes some time to get used to the accent. If you use his office hours, he will answer all of your questions, and then explain all the reasoning behind what he has told you. I highly recommend.
You gotta love Nagel. All there is to say.

Dr. Nagel is an extremely skilled mathematician and a helpful instructor. His German accent can be difficult to understand at first, but you will soon acclimate. His sense of humor is great, and his ability to explain mathematical phenomena in a non-technical manner will appeal to any student.

Professor Nagel was Awesome! You get to his german vey fast, don't let this scare you. You get to enter your homework as many times as you want until you get an A. The test are very easy to study for, there exactly like old test that he gives you a website to study from. I would recommend taking him.
He is awesome!!! just make sure you are involved in what he is teaching...if you dont, just ASK. He is always willing to help
He is awesome!!!! just make sure you attend class and try to get involved..
Writes his own textbook with his notes. Teaches in a very organized and linear manner. Tells very good jokes. My hero. Passes out gifts every Friday. Dr. Nagel is a Boss!

If you can get through his accent, this class can be very enjoyable, as he seems to genuinely care about the material he is teaching. He goes through a lot of corny jokes, which end up being funny just because they're so corny. For the exams, definitely look through the old exams on the website. It it pretty much identical!

He is a very nice proffessor and very helpful during professor hours. This class is calculus so obviously it will be hard. He does a lot of examples on the board, but his writing maybe a bit messy...but if you say you can't understand then he will rewrite it neatly. Overall he is excellent..and highly recommend him. Tests are not that bad..and ther
He is a very good professor, but sometimes it is difficult to understand him or read what he writes. He tells you exactly what will be on the exams, and always gives a curve (at least 5-10 points).
No Comments

Dr. Turkington is an awesome professor and I would definitely take her class again. The TAs can grade harshly but Dr. Turkington herself is great. Come to her lectures and pay attention, and you should be able to get an A without ever picking up the textbook.

Dr. Turkington is nice and the class is easy, just one or two assignments a week. The TA can grade a little harsh sometimes, and the assignments are weighted heavily so don't skip them. Attendance is only required in recitation, so I skipped lecture a lot and still did fine. If you do go, it is boring and awkwardly quiet.

Doctor Turkington is a brilliant woman and very passionate about her teachings. She cares for her students and wants them to succeed. The assignments and grading depend on the TA. Turkington alone is amazing and I encourage people to take her classes.

The professor is very quiet and difficult to hear in large classrooms. In GEO135, we completed large short-answer-based assignments of 40-50 points each twice a week. The course was primarily based entirely on graphs and statistics, with the majority of the course taught from the textbook and lectures meant to augment the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Clearly a very brilliant women, made class enjoyable and very understanding and flexible.

Professor Turkington is a decent professor honestly and so is her class. Her lectures can be boring and will sometimes end in an awkward silence. Make sure to show up to class and try to take the best notes you can. The homework isnt that hurt just put in the effort and review the study guide for each test. The TA is also a hard grader be aware.

Boring ass lectures but I liked her as a person. She tries to get the class to speak up while teaching but it often leads to multi-minute breaks in speaking with awkward silences. Gave may chance to get points back s if you think you're doing bad, you're not.

Such a wonderful woman as well as a great and caring professor. I hold her in very high regard based upon her extremely caring nature towards her work, class content, and her students. Wants to help and be there for her students in anyway that she can be. Note- she also has an awesome British accent

Dr. Turkington is awesome. She is smart, knows her stuff and is helpful outside of class. Both her and the TA will help with assignments and she gives review sheets for all tests and exams. This is an easy class for natural science credit.

Dr. Turkington is very smart and definitely knows what she is talking about. GEO 135 is supposed to be a natural science core, but It is very difficult for people who are not interested in going into that major. There are not that many assignments, but the assignments are worth a lot of points so it is difficult to get your grade up. Exams are hard
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: While she posts lectures on canvas, TA took attendance everyday and if you skipped one class your grade could drop 10%. Speaks very quietly and sometimes doesn't realize she comes off as rude. She is very sweet outside of class and when talking about lighter topics and loves to help students. If you put forth good effort you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Turkington seems intimidating and her class can be hard because there is no homework and the only assignments are papers from recitation. The slides are mostly pictures and I had a hard time studying until she posted review sheets but if you study those you should be fine. The final is mostly questions from the tests so use those to study!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I don't know if this professor knows what a smile is.  She always comes into class with a nasty look on her face.  Her lectures are extremely boring and I can't seem to focus during them.  She talks very low and I can hardly here her from the front I don't know how people in the back could.  She also takes the long way around explaining things.

Her class is difficult! But her grading scale is fit accordingly. If you attend the lectures you'll do fine. DO NOT MISS AN ASSIGNMENT! or its an automatic D! thats what everyones problem seems to be with this class.
The test are a little hard. The book is used for the final which is helpful. The powerpoint used in class are helpful for studying before the test. Not a lot of busy work which is a plus.

i was skeptical about her class from what i read on this site, but she is a great professor! the class wasn't the easiest, but she goes out of her way to help students and i learned a lot. everything on the quizzes and tests comes straight from her lectures/notes, so don't skip. She is very clear and concise, I definitely recomend her.

Come on guys, this class was not that hard. Turkington is a great prof, one of the best in the department. She is incredibly nice and really cares about the success of her students. Class can get dull on occasion - duh, its school! I've been in far worse classes. This one is definitely worth taking, I learned a lot. I wish more profs were like her!
Horrible, don't take.  I love geography but she makes you want to hate the subject.  Its very easy to fall asleep during class, and teaches WAY above a 100 level class. DONT TAKE!

Dr. Turkington knows what she is talking about.  Lectures mainly from slides, which are posted on BB.  Her accent adds to her charm, and she is always willing to clarify and answer questions brought up in class.  Grading is fair, if you just do the assignment.

class is very very very boring. dims all the lights and talks in voice that with her accent that outs you to sleep.  does not give any type of notes at all just runs through slides and expects you to decide what she thinks is important.  her tests are hard, they reflect nothing covered in class and her study guides are useless
Taught mainly from slides. I had to fight to stay awake. Final exam only, bi-monthly "quizzes" are tests in disguised. Doesn't answer questions fully. Stingy with curves, and ok with extra credit.
Knows her stuff!
No Comments
She just runs through her slides which even being a geography major made me pretty sleepy.  I was able to read the book and get A's on the tests without paying much attention in class.
i loved the material we discussed in the class but it was a tough class. she is a great teacher though and she is very pretty
She's a nice person but it would be nice if she taught on a subject before giving homework on it. :(
Gr8 class I learned so much.  She knows her stuff and is always willing to help...if you feel like slacking best stay away from this class...and maybe college all together  :p
She only gives midterms and finals as grades and thats it. The tests are way to indepth, and over your head
Turkington rocks!!  Best prof here.  She works your ass off but will help you when  you need it and get you through
tests are impossible.  no matter how hard you study you cant get a good grade.  she is stingy with curves too.
great teacher!

She's an Ok teacher. There are quizes online every week, helps keep your grade up because there is only one test and a final. The lectures are somewhat boring, but they really do help on the test. The tests are difficult, so make sure you take good notes and study them. Only buy the book if you don't go to class to take notes.
she is a hard teacher. i expected an easy class but it is not that. the homeworks are very hard.

Dr. Turkington is perhaps my favorite professor.  Having had her for Weather and Climate I couldn't wait to take her special topics class, Global Environmental Change.  She didn't disappoint.  She's intelligent and helpful, and very understanding; if her class seems difficult, take the time to talk to her and it'll solve plenty of problems.
She is such a sweet teacher, very willing to help, but the tests are pretty hard.  Her tests are pretty hard, I went to class everyday and still made a C.  The in class papers are what saved me.
Smoking hott!!!
class is hard, exams are brutal, and she is sometimes hard to understand.
No Comments
No Comments
Shes very helpful and will make time to help you out with anything your having problems with

She is hard if you are unwilling to try.  The papers she gives are really easy.  Listen to what she emphasizes in class for the tests.  The tests involve multiple choice, short answer, and your choice of short essays (good selection).  Don't buy the book if you go to every class.
She is very interested in what she is talking about but it makes no sense. Test are brutal, no matter how hard you study, you cant make a good grade.
Tests are impossible.  Papers in class will help your grade a lot though.

Not a hard class if you show up and READ THE BOOK, but expect to have to study for the tests.  Turkington is well meaning and helpful if you have any questions, but I think the class is doomed to bore you out of your gourd anyway. Oh, yeah...READ THE BOOK!!!!

No one does her justice.  You'll do badly if you skip.  I went almost everyday and I got high A's with very little studying.  Her in-class assignments are so easy, and help with points: you can use notes, books, friends and the prof.  I learned a lot and had fun, despite the 8 am start time.

tests are literally impossible. i study every night for this class and got a 57% and 64% on the 1st 2 tests. i's a joke. do not expect to do well if you take this class. her accent is very hard to understand. if you need a natural science for USP do not waste your time and effort on this class  :o(
I wound up dropping the class because I was failing - and I've never had lower than a B in my life. Very unlcear, very boring, and very "nit-picky" on tests. All-around sucky class.

TERRIBLE! Do not take this course it is impossible. There were 80 students in my class and the class average was a 58. WAY to much material-Each class is on powerpoint and she speaks the entire class period.

He's very nice and wants you to do well in Latin. There are quite a few group compositions that you have to do but he gives you 2 chances to get a good grade on them. The tests are all on google forms which is nice. The only downside is he gives a lot of homework between classes which can take a while. I would totally take his class again!
Interesting personality but class was easy, open note exams. Attendance mandatory.

Dr. V clearly cares a lot about the things he teaches and was more than happy to answer any questions. He did assign a fair amount of homework, but it was manageable. He provided the textbook to students (buying it is not necessary). Attendance is mandatory, as is participation, but he is understanding if you need to miss class.

Lets you use his PowerPoint slides on exams, offers plenty of extra credit opportunities throughout the semester, there are group projects in the weekly discussion sections, but they're pretty easy and can almost always be finished during class.

Took GRK 101 with Dr. Caldesi online and WOW! An amazing professor who made a difficult language manageable to learn! While class participation is mandatory, it was mostly covering questions and making sure students were comfortable with/understood the material. Very generous and caring throughout a difficult semester. Highly recommend!!

Great professor! Enjoyed his teaching style and the use of iClicker to break up the lectures. He gives partial credit even when you get questions wrong, so do attend class. The paper was not easy, but he gives a lot of feedback to help you improve. It'd take some effort to do poorly in this class. Take him!

You can tell he is passionate about the material. This class is widely taken as a core, but he treated it as he would any other class of his. He definitely made it so you had to pay some attention, but exams are open note. There is a final paper which is the hardest part. He offers extra credit throughout the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Valeri is an amazing professor. Attendance is mandatory but he makes it fun. He helps you work through words that you don't understand and just moves forward after instead of ridiculing you for not knowing, which makes everyone in the class forget you asked a "dumb" question instantly. 10/10 would recommend.

I chose this class to fulfill a core requirement. I was expecting the class to be pretty simple and cover the main gods, such as Zeus and Apollo etc. I was far from right, this is one of the hardest classes I've taken. He assigns about 10 pages a reading a night, and a group project every Friday. If you really put in the work, youll get an A.
This class is not too hard. The only grades are the 4 exams that reflect from the material in the textbook. It is very doable to get an A in this course as long as you do well on the exams.

Dr. VCV will make you better, if you do all the work he assigns and study the way he tells you to. His class discussions are stimulating and he lets students argue productively.
