He will always have some suggestion for how you could tweak your translation. Take advantage of his office hours -- he provides excellent individualized instruction.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Phenomenal prof. Readings and class assignments were difficult but enriching. Chose doable passages for exams appropriate for progress in the course. Very particular in his grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. C-V did a nice job setting up a nice course with many instructors coming to class and presenting on various topics. The daily quizzes are a bit of drag, but they help to keep us on track. He gives a lot of feedback especially on the papers and cares a lot about us being successful. Would recommend him and this class.

Dr. CV's Greek Prose Composition is easily the hardest class I have ever taken. His competence, patience, & meticulous feedback on homework and tests, however, make the experience absolutely worth your while. I feel that I am now prepared to read ANYTHING in Greek like never before. Thrilled to take his author-based courses soon.

If you plan to take ancient Greek at UK, this is your guy. Knowledgeable, patient, dedicated, rigorous without feeling overbearing or overwhelming, always available to discuss Greek or anything else for that matter. The language itself is quite difficult but Dr. Caldesi Valeri explains things clearly and makes the class something to look forward to

The class is a fairly easy A, as long as you show up. Attendance is essential to passing-- he gives you all the questions and answers to the tests throughout the lectures. What little work he assigns is easy, and he's not a tough grader. He also offers an insane amount of extra credit-- I finished the class with a 116%.

Great class, awesome teacher! You must show up to class and answer clicker questions, but they're super easy: plus, his lectures are interesting and he's funny. For exams, use the study guides he provides and you'll be fine. Literally, tons of extra credit that will make it difficult not to get at least a B. Would take him again in a heartbeat.
He's a great guy.  I had him for accelerated Latin.  Very challenging course, and he pushed us to our limits, but it one of my favorite courses I have taken.

He is a super nice guy and is funny and interesting during lectures, but the homework is lots of reading and it's tedious.  The tests are not bad if you go through everything on the study guide he gives you.  He is a funny guy to listen to though! I would definitely take his class again.  The class is worth the work if you're interested in it!!
This class is an insane amount of reading that is tested extremely specifically, I would highly recommend taking a different professor or a different UK Core class all together.
Def would take her class again. She does not give a lot of homework, and even if she does, she lets students work on it during classes.
easy class, Dr. V is super caring. I just didn't like the participation grading but I guess that's fair.
Dr. V is amazing! Put in the work to get an A. If you are unclear on an assignment, go to office hours, and she will help you.

Dr. Vs class was not easy, however, if you care about your grades and are ready to work you can be really successful. She gives very good feedback on your papers, writes very detailed rubrics, and responds quickly to emails. Despite a few struggles in the beginning, I was bale to pull my grade from a C to a high A. The #1 rule, FOLLOW THE RUBRIC!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--So many papers

reviews.comment: If you genuinely care about your education, then I 100% recommend taking her class. She's one of the rare, amazing human beings on this planet. She obviously loves her job. However, she's also not handing out free A's. If you want to enjoy your education, and you're comfortable (lazy) with not getting a 4.0, there should be no hesitation.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Vallade is truly the best lecturer at UK. She shows her vast knowledge while making it understandable. The bad ratings here are from lazy students who thought they would slide one past her because she is unbelievably kind; this would be a mistake. She grades by the rubric, she has no favorites, and treats all her students with respect.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. V is a great teacher! She cares about the students and doesn't give you too many assignments at once. I would definitely recommend her! There are no exams in her class, just paper, speeches and homework.

She was very nice. Go to her office hours it is very helpful. I went to ask specific questions about my works cited page and paper and she was very helpful that is was the difference in a B or an A. I got a 97 on her paper. She is a tough grader follow the rubric and you will be fine. The work given is not hard it is just time consuming.

Professor Vallade can be tough, but it's for your best benefit. In the beginning of the semester, she can seem harsh, but you'll get used to it. She genuinely  has interest in every student she teaches and loves seeing her students grow as writers and public speakers. Great professor!

I loved taking her class! I really respected her because she actually cared about her students and tried to teach them, rather than other professors! Would definitely recommend. As long as you show that you care, then she will do what she can to help you succeed!

She has been the most rigid professor I've had so far. Very hard grader.  No flexibility.  Not accessible. When I did meet with her she gave me 3 things to do to bring my grade up.  I did all 3 and they were as good as could be, she gave me one point under what I needed.  She left on maternity leave not allowing ANY time to question any grades.

I agree that she's a tough grader but Dr. Vallade is helpful if you seek it. Go to office hours, she'll work with you. One thing I hated about the class was the unclear and oftentimes confusing instructions regarding assignments (due dates, what's expected, etc.)

DO NOT take CIS with her! She's a tough grader and expects way too much for a core class. She has no mercy on tardiness or absences. Her lectures are absolutely pointless and utterly boring. The only reason I came to class was because she deducts MAJOR points off of your grade if you miss.

I would not recommend taking CIS with her. The class was much harder than it should've been. Grades were harsh and she never gives a clear reason on why she gives you that grade. The assignments for a normal CIS class are intensified and have many extra things that any other CIS class would not have. PS--the word count never aligns with page count.

This is a discussion based class. He wants the class to participate and have conversation. The assignments are doable and very fairly graded, and the amount of work is very manageable. Overall he is a very charismatic and caring professor who just wants you to think deeper about topics like animal ethics and the meaning of science.

Dr. Vanzant is awesome. I had him for AFE100 (GEN100) and the only reason there are so many papers is because he doesn't set up the class, the college of ag does. He is super funny and incredibly down to earth!

Dr.Vanzant is the harshest professor I have ever experienced for the grading process. Most things are participation, but the papers and presentation are what matters. Expectations are always unclear and even after meeting with him and doing what he suggested, I still got a terrible grade. Lectures are pointless and don't help with the assignments.

Dr. Vanzant is super disorganized and is not clear what he wants from his assignments and papers. Nothing we talk about in class has anything to do with what the actual assignments and things we need to do. For example, he never told us what he wanted from our draft papers so the class average was a D on it. We just talk about philosophy and ethics

Be prepared to waste an hour and fifteen minutes each class. Every class is a boring lecture about information you basically had to teach yourself. Hes a tough grader and hard to meet expectations on papers and projects. The class itself might be interesting but chose a different professor if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Vanzant teaches the most interesting class and somehow manages to make it the most unbearable course at UK. Instead of a Capstone, he makes the class Philosophy 101. Lectures are pointless but mandatory for points, expectations are not clear, the readings are unrelated to any topics discussed, and assignments are back-to-back weekly.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: very helpful and cares about his students
Awesome class, he is very funny and makes the class interesting.  Fairly easy homeworks and tests, but you do have to study.  I highly recommend taking Vanzant for any class.
Great professor for this course.

Loved this class for an introduction for the pa profession! She does have attendance quizzes but they are supper easy! You do have a few assignments in here but they are all relevant and not busy work. Love her and I respect her so much! We have many PAs come in and tell us about their specialty and why they went the PA route. Highly recommend

I took this class as a pre PA student and she does an amazing job with having different PA-C coming in and talking about their specialties. The only work you have to do is there is an attendance quiz but you have to read a study on PAs in different lights. There is a Why Statement, resume, and a mental health event you have to attend to.

Dr. Young is an amazing teacher. He opens your mind up to all different types of opinions other than your own. He legitimately is very interested in your opinion but be prepared to give a reason and evidence to back it up. He's very invested in his students and is helpful.He's hilarious and makes class fun. I definitely recommend him.

I took this class to fulfill the gwr and cultural requirement.It was fun and easy. I love dr. vay. He is way cool. Hard at times, but understanding if you talk to him. I recommend you take this class. But be prepared to work. Grades don't come free.

The class is easy once you get a hang of it no thanks to Dr. Young. He is confusing and unforgiving. The only reason I learned in this course is because of my own independent reading. His lectures are recorded on blackboard and most of the class is online group discussion.

I took AA Lit online with Dr. Young, but felt that he had nothing to do with the class. His assistant did everything, but wasn't very helpful. The assignments are unclear and the quizzes are misleading (multiple choice with 3 out of 4 answers usually being technically correct).
If you want a good grade, write a lot and talk a lot. I learned how to write in this class.

I took the class because I wanted to learn black writers from a black male teacher. I  never had one. It was great experience. I am in the army and white and around a lot of other whites who speak negatively about blacks. I enjoyed this class.
Nice guy. Dressed well. Very smart. I enjoyed the class. I learned a lot about black people and culture.

Dr. Young is very self centered.  He frequently references his own writings, which is more annoying than any other teaching habit he has.  He grades things depending on his mood, is very afrocentric, and showed up late for class.  Proof that just because you have a PHD in english doesn't mean you should be teaching. Sucking up is your only hope.

Horrible professor. Very lazy and doesn't care about his students. Didn't even have syllabus done on the first day and still wasn't finished at midterm. Wish he cared about this class half as much as he did his books and performances.
This class was fine. If you hate McGraw-Hill do not take this class. Work wasn't hard; there was just a lot of it, and she doesn't take late work.

I found the exams a bit tough, but everything in class went well enough if you prepared and paid attention. There were lots of in class assignments, so they helped pull my grade back up. She was great outside of class, super friendly, very kind, and happy to make time to talk about assignments. Often, she'll even let you extend the due date.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: RUN THE OTHER WAY
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Sherif was wonderful, and the IS200 course was easy if you do your work, perfect for those looking for something to get core credits out of the way. There are discussion posts and some projects, but she grades off the rubric she gives you, so its nice. I submitted something late too and she didn't notice (or was nice).

I know why ur looking at this class and I'm here to tell you that you will regret taking it. It's so pointless and taught me absolutely nothing. There are so many assignments that are just so stupid you'll have no motivation to do them. You also have to submit so many videos of yourself speaking to discussion boards. Please view this as last resort

This class taught me absolutely nothing, and she made assignments that had really no correlation to the material. However, this class was only taken to fulfill my Creative Arts credit, so I don't mind. However, I wouldn't take again just because this class is poorly organized/constructed and I'd rather have taken a film class probably.
ICT 200 Online.... do the work, put in effort, pass..
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Beginning of the semester started out slow, class picked up after the first few weeks of lecture. She expects you to respond in classroom discussions. I turned in an assignment missing 1/3 of the required material & got a 43/50. She even let me resubmit one assignment that I did not finish on time & I got a perfect score. She knew the material well

This teacher was great in the beginning of the school year. She's very nice but just grades extra hard and terrible. We don't receive many assignments in the class but if you do bad on a paper it will effect your grade tremendously. This class I expected to receive an A or B and received a low grade. #TERRIBLE
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This was a great class, and I learned so much. She is a great professor and cares a lot for her students. There is a lot of homework, but as long as you plan ahead, it is definitely doable. There are a lot of extra credit options, and though she highly encourages attendance, she is understanding when you can't make it to class.

Anna is a blessing to the Russian department at UK. She will push you out of your comfort zone, but she'll go out of her way to help you succeed if you take initiative. Take her Russian singing or Russian radio class on the side if you have time to really improve your speaking skills. It will make her 301 class easier for you.

Anna is a nice teacher who cares about her students. She pushes you to learn Russian in and out of the classroom. That being said, she is also one of the most infuriating profs I have ever had in my time at college. Inconsistent expectations, lack of organization or any sort of lesson plan, and surprise assignments made me kind of hate her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Anna is absolutely the sweetest professor and cares so deeply about the success of her students. She truly wants you to learn Russian and will help you in any way- you just have to take the initiative to reach out! Showing you care about the language and culture and getting involved in the Russian club will really help you get to know her better.

One of the sweetest people I have ever met. Absolutely love her. She does fall victim to the bias at UK though. If you dont have russian heritage, already know the language well or learn language fast, you will fall behind everyone else and be forgotten. Dont skip class, it will ruin you without an excuse. If youre not a favorite, youre nothing
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I only rated her participation mandatory because, for me this was a hard language to learn and if I did not go to class, It would have been harder for me. The text book (Golosa) is still hard to use when learning new things, but the teacher is awesome, funny, native russian speaker. Only thing is sometimes it was hard to know what she is explaining

Anna Viktorovna is such a blessing for the Russian program at the University of Kentucky. She cares about her students so much, and will go the extra mile to ensure their success. She offers extra study sessions before class, and plenty of extra credit opportunities outside of class. She even has cooked home made snacks for us to eat!

Anna Viktorovna is amazing. She really cares whether you learn material or not, and she does everything she can to get you involved. If you're the type that has no trouble completing homework and going to class, you're golden. She gives you plenty of extra credit opportunities to make up any mistakes you make. I wish I had every class with her.

Anna Viktorovna is the best teacher I have had at UK. She is so creative and enthusiastic and makes every class fun and interesting. You won't find anyone else who cares as much about their students and willing to put so much time and effort into helping them succeed. If you get a chance to work with her, take it!

A truly wonderful professor and an even better person. I commuted an hour to and back from every class and she made it worth every minute! I feel sorry for students who don't get the chance to take her class!

One of the best professors I've ever had. Very knowledgeable, really cares about her students, loves to organize activities (including yummy food!) outside of class. Great person, and wonderful professor

By far the most caring teacher I have ever had. She will meet with you any time and has a genuine interest in seeing you succeed. She makes an effort to make class fun--it becomes more like a family. Best class I have ever taken!

Ann Voskresensky Was the most knowledgeable and professional professor that I had the pleasure to know during my time at the University. Although the subject matter was extremely difficult, Anna went to every extreme possible to make learning possible by making it applicable. Beyond her professional responsibilities Anna took a personal interest in
She was great the class its self is difficult but she really tried to help and made classes fun

Anna Viktorovna Voskresensky is by far the best professor I've ever had.  She cares about her students, and truly enjoys teaching.  I used to take Japanese, and I didn't realize how much I was missing in a language professor until I had Anna Viktorovna.

Anna may be the best teacher at the University...The class isn't overly easy but then again you're learning Russian...and you will learn Russian. She makes the class very fun so going to class is easy. Tests are never stressful. This is the way language learning is supposed to be.

Dr. Vos was a very knowledgeable and insightful professor for CPH 202. I loved having her. She offered many extra credit opportunities and was always very kind. I learned that I like learning about public health because of her!
I now avoid taking Dr. Vos at all cost!

Sarah Vos is not a good professor and I hope the staff at UK realizes. The film quizzes are insanely hard and only worth 5 points(2hr movies). She does not answer emails, and belittles students. I got a flat tire on the way to class one time. she refused to excuse it. Film class? No. Be ready for LOADS of other assignments and basically 3 finals.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Cannot stand this professor. She is very patronizing and belittling. She would be better off teaching kindergarten. She makes no technology rules knowing most students take ipad notes. She grades for accuracy and there is no room for different perspectives. If you dont complete an assignment the way she wants word for word she will tank your grade

Dr. Vos is a great professor, however, get ready to do homework. Overall, her homework isn't that hard... it's just time-consuming. I've learned a lot from her lectures and the materials she provides, but she definitely makes students work for a good grade.

I do not recommend taking Dr. Vos in any other CPH classes. She is difficult to work with in a student-professor relationship and continually finds way to belittle and insight difficulty in the learning experience for her classes across the board. If you are able to take other CPH classes without her, do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Vos is a very kind lady but she expects a lot from her students! Be ready to follow along in class and do some additional homework assignments Otherwise, her class was interesting and pretty enjoyable.

She's easy but that's not saying a lot because I have a very high IQ. She has a tendency to belittle people. I wholeheartedly agree with every single negative review on here and I hope both she and the people in charge of her job read all of them.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I think 3 points for typing 200 words is absoeffinglutley ridiculous. And I mean RIDIC!

CPH350 is an important class content-wise, but Dr. Vos falls short of delivering the material. I don't like her teaching style; the work she gives us feels like it's busy work and not meant for us to succeed. As a senior taking her class, this class is meant for freshmen. As she treats upper level students as such, not the best look in my opinion.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: I didn't really mind Prof. Vos all semester, until she released what our final exam would be AFTER almost all teacher evaluations were in. Along with a 50 question exam, and a 300 word reflection, she added a 3 page essay question. If you take her class, be prepared to basically have 3 finals from just her class in the last week of the semester.

Dr. Vos was a great professor. I had her for CPH 202 during the summer online. She gives great feedback on assignments, but you need to do all the work and assignments. You will also have to watch a lot of movies and doing the study guides are great practice for the tests. Also, make sure to take great notes!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Vos is amazing... The exams are so easy, just do the study guide! If you try on the short response question and write a decent amount you will get extra credit! She is very sweet and passionate. This class is a film class, so you do have to watch the films outside of class. Also, the Fridays are always ONLINE!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Advisors say that this class is easy, but be prepared to basically learn class materials outside of class, as well as read a huge article and quiz on it or watch a long documentary before every class. One of the only good things about this class is her TAs and the excess of grades throughout the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Thought this class was going to be very easy going on my schedule but nope. Expect to have a reading or documentary to watch before every single class. There is online Fridays but they are usually long readings that are difficult to keep up with. Lectures tend to get boring and long. NEED to put in a lot of time outside of classroom for good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Very tough grader on everything. Lots of papers.
She is nice and helpful as well. Unfortunately, she thinks Coca Cola will kill you. So there's that.

Good teacher but there's lots of work. She is a difficult grader. You need to put a lot of time into this class to get a good grade. She is helpful, answers your email, office appointments are helpful.
Shes a good teacher for the class though she does put her students through a bit of extra work.

Caleb was one of the best professors I've had. He truly cares about his students and it's evident that he genuinely enjoys teaching. His lectures covered course material but they were delivered in a way that was engaging and entertaining. He was more than willing to answer any questions, class related or not. I loved my time in his class!

Caleb was one of the nicest professors I have ever had. He lectured in an entertaining yet informative way. He also was available before and after class to answer questions or just chat. Caleb was very passionate about the course material which made the class even more enjoyable, I would highly recommend!!

Caleb is one of the kindest & most down to earth professors I have ever had. He does a really good job at making the material easy to learn as well as interesting. He is really easy going & makes the learning environment stress free. Im really grateful I was able to have him as my professor & recommend taking him!

Very good and understanding professor. Grading was a bit messy and unclear in canvas (for me at least). Overall a very reasonably manageable class, tests are not hard if you study for them. Class contains lots of information. Only downside is the power point slides have minimal information so you have to do some outside reading to review.

Loved having Gargi so much decided to take another class with her this semester. Is super understanding and makes sure everyone understands the concepts. Gives super good feedback and can be reached outside of class. You can tell she really cares about what she's teaching and that she cares about her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Inspirational--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Gargi genuinely cares about her students and is always helpful with her feedback or if you need help! I loved having her this semester and I liked listening to her lectures. I am taking her again for another class next semester. 10/10 loved her so much

Gargi is the most caring professor I've had all semester. She really makes sure that we understand the content she is teaching and you can tell she is really passionate about the subject. Your grade is based on three noncumulative exams, attendance, and a research paper but she gives you lots of extra credit so its hard to get a bad grade. Loved it

i would literally d13 for this woman you can tell she genuinely cares about what she teaches. shes open to opinions and is willing to support you speaking out in class. her class does require readings before classes but you can honestly get away with forgetting some of them as long as you go back later for exams and take notes during lectures !
Great

Gargi is very caring and really wants everyone to succeed, especially if you contribute to the class. Tests are hard, but there is a big paper that can really help your grade if you do well on it. Taking notes in class will help a ton as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her lectures are very informative and she always does her best to make them interactive and will do everything she can to make sure everyone understands the concepts. You do have to read and take good notes, but it's not super difficult. She's so sweet and funny and genuinely cares about her students
Gargi is really caring about her students and her lectures are good. Slim to none homework, just go to class and participate. If you study a little bit youll be alright. One of my favorite classes!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I wanted to like this class but having gargi as a ta made it unbearable. She was always a way tougher grader than the other ta and kinda harsh on us in class when we didnt understand the concepts. she also had an accent that made her hard to understand sometimes. she wasn't fair and shouldnt be teaching her own classes yet
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is quite possibly the best professor I have had. Readings are required and the exams are slightly hard but if you study and make sure to go over your exam practice, you'll we'll do very well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Meg is a wonderful human and an amazing professor. So caring and willing to help you out. Gives great feedback on all work and truly takes the time to make sure her students succeed. Has so many resources and so many different ways to access those resources. Very patient and willing to go over concepts until understood. Fair grader. Overall amazing

Wallace was a great professor and knew what she was talking about. She took complex topics and made them easy. Attendance isn't mandatory but teaching yourself the topics would be extremely difficult without her explanations. She shows that she cares about each student and she helps any student that may be confused or lost.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: There is two days of lecture and one day of recitation. she gave really good lectures but her TAs were not very helpful. There are three exams throughout the semester and during recitation youll have 5 pop quizzes and 5 homework sheets due. you must study for the exams because they are graded fairly hard.

Stephen Ware is the best professor that I had. I took his Intro to Game Dev class, and now after graduating, I was working on a personal game and just had to write a review. What a wonderful class. Surprisingly, the classes I learnt the most weren't tutorial ones - it was lectures on game history. Passionate and incredibly knowledgeable! Take it!

One of the best comp sci teachers I've had so far, clearly passionate and speaks very clearly. Projects were tough sometimes but honestly not too bad. Exams were pretty easy. The only bad is the final exam which requires you to memorize 25 pages of content but he gives out exactly whats on it at the beginning of the semester
He makes lectures and assignments interesting and is generous with extra credit opportunities and extensions on projects if it's needed.

Awesome professor that wants students to succeed. Projects vary in difficulty but if you start early you'll have no problems. He also provides benchmark tests for all projects. Drops 1 project out of 5 (lowest grade). Lectures are ok but projects and HW is where you learn the most. Tests were easy, just study the provided guides. Take the class!

Everything is on his course website from the start of the semester, including study guides showing the exact exam questions (with specific variables blank). Amazing professor!

Overall just made the class very easy and enjoyable. Each lecture was something interesting and useful. Projects were graded fairly and plenty of useful feedback was given. You could tell Dr. Ware tried to make this course as non-stressful as possible

Two programming assignments and the option to improve one or do a presentation. He grades clearly and fairly. The class is specifically designed to prepare you to get a job in game dev, but interesting for others. He's well informed and up to date in the field.

Great slides, explains well, good selection of topics. 5 projects in Java that are autograded so you know what you're going to get and he drops the lowest one. About as many written homeworks. One of the best professors in the department, would take again.

Dr. Ware is one of the best professors at UK. He's COVID conscious, gives good lectures, and very helpful in office hours. The projects are strange and take some getting used to, but if you read the descriptions thoroughly you'll get it. Study guides for tests are great and prepare you well. Sets you up for success!

reviews.comment: One of the best professors at UK. He cares about his students and is very understanding. His lectures are amazing. I would definitely recommend taking a class with Dr. Ware.

Dr. Ware is easily one of the best professors I have ever had. His Intro to Game Dev class is one of my favorite classes I have ever taken. He is super engaging and the content he presents is extremely interesting and useful. I would 100% recommend taking one of his classes if you ever get the chance.

Wenk is definitely a very relaxed professor/easy grader, but the derivational portion of the class which is a good bit of the lectures is truly brain numbing, and not completely helpful.
Professor Wenk was single-handedly the best professor I have had at UK. Procedural, clear, knowledgeable. Be ready to take a lot of notes and work hard. Fantastic teacher, would recommend.

reviews.comment: Great lecturer. Fair grader. Extremely knowledgeable.
he has somewhat high standards to meet up.

reviews.comment: The course was asynchronous and easy to follow.

This course was easy and the program we used was easy. He was helpful when it was needed. Easy to pass if you complete the work on time. The quizzes are the same as the assignment you do before so have them open at the same time.

The assignments can take a long time so try and get them done early. He responds very quickly to emails about the homework. On occasion, would give full credit for homework assignments that he got many questions on. The guy even gave me full credit on a capstone project just because I emailed him and asked him for some help. Genuinely a cool guy.

He will give you extra credit for following him on LinkedIn. The quizzes are due once a week and they are the exact same material as the learning modules. Do not wait till the last second to do your assignments they may take you longer than you actually think they will. If you work at a decent pace this course can be done in like 2 weeks.

This professor has an unmatched resume and gives extra credit just for following him on LinkedIn. The only assignments are once a week and are purely excel assignments where you listen, practice, and apply. The quiz on the will almost be 100% accurate to the practice and the exams are open everything.

The bad ratings are dramatic. Welch just conducts the grading but a software is the real "teacher" and it's somewhat time consuming/confusing but honestly still really easy. He would randomly give everyone full credit if enough people emailed ab tech difficulties. So nice in his communication and wanted everyone to just do the assignments and pass.

I think some of the previous ratings are extreme overstatements. The professor really doesn't teach you,rather it's the online software. The online modules do take a bit to get thru, but it's as straight forward as it gets.  You watch an example of what to do and than repeat the exact movements. The capstone projects also reflected the modules well

reviews.comment: Avoid
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is more about his class AN 105 than him as a professor. He seems like a nice guy and he does respond to emails rather quickly however this class is a lot of work for just one credit. The grading is done by a computer so there is no room for errors or points for participation. If you know how to use a computer well this course might be easier.

Pretty simple class. Everything on the test is covered in lecture and notes. Easy homework. Everyone made the exams seem harder than they were, just look over the practice exam that holds like 70% of the test questions verbatim the night before and you'll do well.
He is a cool guy, very nice, and very passionate about his work. He has a soothing voice, kinda makes me tired though.

Go to lecture and pay attention! That will get you good grades on his tests, which are all short answer questions and short essays. I was ill and missed half of the semester and he was so kind, helpful, and accommodating. He has this easy-going, silly personality. For a 300s level biology class, it was very easy. Thought problems were difficult.

One thing to know about Dr. Westneat: he wants you to rely heavily on the examples he gives in class to answer his homework and test questions. This is a really enjoyable class with lots of interesting topics, and he is a very good lecturer.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the most interesting classes I've taken at UK. The class is lecture heavy and you need to go to class to do well on the exams. Dr. Westneat is a good lecturer, but sometimes gets a little off topic when talking about his own research. He really loves birds. If you take this course, it's highly likely to be about 30% bird focused.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I would not suggest Professor Westneat to others. Your entire grade in the class is based off of your four test scores and critiques that aren't the easiest. Not sure that the information presented in class is even reliable information. Overall, tough class and although Westneat doesn't take attendance, you HAVE to go to class to pass.

I was really disappointed with this class. I thought animal behavior would be interesting but it was mostly theories and straight memorization of definitions. If you memorize your notes, you'll get an A.

The class was boring as could be because he took weeks to cover each chapter. I am also not convinced the information presented in class is accurate because it contradicts what I have learned previously about evolution and ecology. But it's an easy class if you just look past the wrong information, learn it, and write it on the exams verbatim.

Behavioral ecology/sociobiology is a good class, and Dr. Westneat makes it interesting. He emails his powerpoints out and you fill in any missing information. They are all you really need to study for his tests, which are very doable if you study. I highly recommend Dr. Westneat and this class, you'll learn a lot about animal behavior!

Dr. Wahrmund was a great professor! Labs were my favorite part because you could tell she was enthralled by her job. I loved how hands on the labs were and they fit in really well with the lecture material. My only complaint was the $90 textbook that was required for the course, but it was very helpful at the end of the day.

Just gives okay lectures. Can be very boring and not very engaging. Test heavy, makes you buy HER textbook that she makes. Probably wouldn't take her class again, but since it's a 101 class, its not super hard.
She gives you all the information and resources you need to do well. I still use her textbook to help me with future classes. She's very knowledgeable and respected.

dr. W is AWESOME! she is funny and caring, and I greatly enjoyed her lectures. I definitely cut myself too much slack with attendance -- but she is very understanding and let me get away with some days. her labs are so fun, once you get past the initial smell... SHOUTOUT to my guy HUGO, he was awesome as well.

Dr.W is a great professor and I would take another one of her classes!
Also shoutout Hugo

Dr. Wahrmund is very good at explaining and doesn't make her lecture's boring. Lab Practices and exams can be hard but as long as you listen in lecture you will be fine. Exams are also very true to what you learn in class. In lab she is very interactive and she is very helpful. She is very stern but if you respect her she will respect you.
Literally so sweet and is very knowledgeable.

Dr. Wahrmund is a fantastic professor. You do have to buy an expensive notebook but you will use it and it is SO helpful. Dr. Wahrmund created the workbook herself and has included an online study guide resource. She genuinely wants her students to pass and is willing to help clarify questions.Provides opportunities for extra-credit within Lab.

I loved class with Dr. Wahrmund. Attendance is mandatory, she'll do random attendance checks in class. Labs are fun and very interesting. She's always willing to answer questions and talk you through things. The tests are basically straight from the activity book.
She is very funny and cares about her students. Lectures are easy and are engaging. Labs are also super fun. She does random attendance quizzes

Wonderful teacher who enjoys animal science and loves what she teaches. ASC 101 is very introductory. I have noticed that students who do not pay attention or participate will not do as well. Tests are super straightforward from the lectures, so you will know all the content without surprises. There are dissections as well.

Dr. W is an amazing prof. Ive had her for ASC 101 and now 380. Her lectures are straight forward and easy to understand and study off of. I had this class online due to scheduling issues however I wish I had taken her lab in person. This is a fun class and is pretty light compared to other ASC 300 courses.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Such an amazing professor with a great personality. Everything is super clear and easy to follow. She's always willing to help outside of class time if you need it. How much effort you put in will reflect the grade you get. You can easily make an A or a B just by showing up and turning in assignments on time.

Dr, Wahrmund is an excellent professor in every way. She truly cares about her students and their success and provides lots of resources to make sure that the class content is understandable and students are well prepared for exams. She gives very engaging lectures and does her best to make the class difficultly low.

Dr. Wahrmund is truly an angel. She is so sweet and makes sure her students are set up for success. Make sure to attend lectures and take good notes in order to get good grades on her exams. If you pay attention and study, this class is a breeze. She does random attendances during her lectures sometimes that count for a grade so don't skip!

This class was hands down my favorite. The labs and lectures are so interesting and Dr.Wahrmund makes them even better! The exams and lab practicals are not hard if you study and pay attention. The TA's are also really nice and will help you through your lab. The class is very well structured and the information is presented clearly.

LOVE her and this class. She is so sweet and very helpful! All the info for the exams are covered in class and on her slides which she posts. Classes and labs are always so interesting. If you make sure to study the material you should do great! Quizzes and exams are multiple choice. She's super approachable and overall just a great professor.
Loved this class. Take notes and pay attention and you will pass. Use the app she gives in the textbook to study along with notes from lectures. Labs are fun also!
Go to class, she is super sweet and understanding, but you have to go to class.

reviews.comment: Dr. Wahrumd is my favorite professor. She super sweet, loves what she teaches, and is very inspirational. Her tests are hard but she provides so many resources. Awesome prof

reviews.comment: She is amazing!! The exams will be something she did go over and all are multiple choice! She answers emails very quickly. She knows the material shes teaching and shows it. (The reason I got a B is because I didnt study for the exams)

LOVE DR. Wahrmund!!! She is one the best teachers ever because she is so passionate about the subject. This class is an easy A if you are willing to learn, do the work, and show up to lab. The labs are always interesting with great TAs and there is TONS of opportunity to get extra credit . If you have a choice, always choose Dr. Wahrmund.

reviews.comment: Super funny and relatable, but don't slack off!

Dr. Wahrmund has been a GREAT teacher. The lectures are seamless and very well presented. She knows the material like the back of her hand. reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors at UK. Her material is very straightforward and she's excellent at explaining topics that may seem a bit intimidating. Very approachable and such a gem of a human. Work hard and your results will definitely reflect it.
Dr. Wharmund is awesome! She knows what she is talking about and even wrote the textbook and so the class flows very well. Show up to class and pay attention and you will have no problem passing!

She's an absolute gem. Definitely in one of my top favorites. Personable, intelligent, and an amazing teacher. Her lectures are just long enough and to the point and the textbook for the class was written by her so everything is accurate and easy to find information. I really loved her, 10/10 would take again.

Dr. Wahrmund has been one of the best professors Ive ever had. She has an amazing personality and will spend extra time with you are not understanding something. All the labs were very fun, and you even get to go on two field trips. Make sure you go to class because it is mandatory.

Overall a fun class and not too hard if you're paying attention.

Dr. Wahrmund's lectures were very interesting!  Be sure to pay attention and read ahead of class, clicker questions sometimes come fast and furious.  The exams can be difficult, but if you supplement notes with the textbook you should be fine.  Dr. Wahrmund really appreciates students who care.

reviews.comment: She is very approachable, she also really cares about the subject so she makes it interesting. You have to attend the labs, and during the labs you fill out a worksheet which she goes over every time. So that's an easy A on all the worksheets. The lectures are always interesting and i enjoy going to them. I would def recommend her to ASC majors.

grades way too hard for no reason, seems like always something is wrong with my work when he grades. hard to get perfect scores, never had a prof like this. had all As all 4 years of college, about to graduate with my 4.0 and ended this class with a B, which ruined that. he truly overcomplicates this class so much.

There is no homework, but all the grades are based on tests, quizzes, and one end of the semester essay. His class overall is not too hard as long as you take lots of notes and pay attention.

Easy grader and cares a lot about participation and attendance to the point of coming off as a little stingy with how little wiggle room he gives. Definitely cares about the material he teaches though, and is easy to listen to.

This class was very easy. All the online work was easy and wasn't graded too hard. My only complaint was mandatory attendance. Additionally, make sure you participate in class. My participation almost kept me from an A
He is a tough grader, only lectures, submission comments make zero sense.
Seems like an alright guy, but makes the class harder than it needs to be. Not very clear with rubrics and grading criteria, lectures and emphasis on what parts are important could be improved upon.

reviews.comment: He's a nice and laidback guy, and he is passionate about philosophy. But I wish he posted the notes onto Canvas b/c I think that would help students a lot.

Dr. Willard-Kyle is extremely knowledgeable about what she teaches. She provided a few extra credit opportunities that went on to our midterm and final exams. I would take her again, she teaches clear and concise. I know many people get tired from her lectures but you have to listen to her words more than her power points. A lot of what she is talking about you can use on the exams in her classroom.

Dr.Willard-Kyle is an amazing professor. You can tell that she is very well informed about the topics she teaches. The classes she teaches are lecture heavy but she gives you a moment to take a breather during lecture which makes it a whole lot less overwhelming.

reviews.comment: She is an absolutely wonderful professor and fantastic human.
She is a beam of light everyone loves her

Dr. Wilson is truly one of the sweetest women I have ever met. I looked forward to Choristers every day last semester, and the atmosphere she created was like no other. She cares about each and every one of her students, knows them ALL by name, and wants them to succeed in and outside of music. She gives the music a deeper meaning. I love her!

Beth is an INCREDIBLE professor. I've been a student in UK Choristers for a year, and I'm enrolled in the class again for this upcoming semester, and I'm very excited. She's very fun, enthusiastic, and overall one of the brightest, kindest, and most caring professors I've ever come across. Make sure you attend class, and you're sure to get an A.

I will never take a class with this professor again. His handwriting is difficult to read as well

reviews.comment: He's a great professor. As long as you show you understand the material in your essays, you'll do well. I would've gotten an A if I'd turned my work in on time. reviews.comment: Dr. White is extremely smart, which is why he is able to present you with material in a way that does not feel like he is reading off of slides while you copy notes. He likes students to engage in the conversation of the material with him, which allows students to gather a better understanding and remember the material easily.

(HIS 351)He spent half of each class complaining about how our generation is lazy and can't do work. Not sure if he even likes his job at this point by the way he conducts himself in class. I've never had a teacher I've disliked before but every class I left frustrated and feeling like I've wasted my money taking his class.

I gave this class most of my time doing outside readings and essays. He doesn't care for students grades and holds them to unachievable standards. I am proud of my work from this class to be lazily and non-reflectively graded. Hope for an A was given up once he changed his syllabus mid-semester bc he "doesn't want anything else to grade." lazy pro.

reviews.comment: The class was decent and even fun at times. I liked his teaching style, very discussion heavy. Make sure you do the readings and do well on the few essays. He offered a lot of extra credit, which ended up really helping my grade. Idk if attendance was mandatory or not, but I showed up to every class, which helped me.

Literally the worst. His lectures are decent and reflect the reading but his grading is absolutely ridiculous. I have a 3.8 GPA and this is the only class I have taken where my papers are given anything lower than a 90. You are setting yourself up for failure if you take one of his courses. Take literally anyone else.

Dr. White is a great person in general, but a horrible professor. He speaks in an open discussion so it's hard to take notes. I never had a professor who takes weeks to grade one paper and grades them harshly. He's never clear on what he asks for regarding the paper guidelines or his overly vague questions. Easy A? Don't pick this class.
COVID will end before Dr. White grades an assignment with the use of any logic.

Dr. White is an intelligent and respectable individual, his facilitation of coursework is not. Dr. White places an immense amount of value on guidelines that are undefined in his assignments. Although the quality of his lectures is sufficient, they do not warrant his neglect of the diligence of students. I hope he makes changes in the future.

Want to spend a semester working hard, attending every class, accurately completing every reading and assignment, and be unfairly penalized for it? Take a class with Dr. White. Dr. White is inept when it comes to grading. The question stems for each assignment will be overly broad, and he will contradict his own guidelines whenever he grades you.

Read before every class and get ready to discuss the readings he set out for the day or you will be clueless in class. Only 6 papers to write, no exams, and no quizzes.
