reviews.comment: Very interesting and well spoken guy, he was a great teacher. He gives few assignments, but they are not hard if you pay attention and put some effort in. He is enjoyable to listen to, and his lectures are informative but notes are not necessary to understand the material/get a good grade. I would recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor White is an incredibly knowledgeable and intelligent professor. HIS 301 is meant to introduce you to historical research, so class meetings were not content-heavy, but even so, the things he said in class were interesting and important. If you don't like reading, don't take this class, and maybe consider a major change. Great professor.

Dr. Whitney was not only a great teacher, but constantly shows a love for engineering and learning. She taught me in my Engineering 103 class what it means to actually engineer something, and helped reignite my love for engineering that other classes had began to stomp out. If yoy need help, ALWAYS ask her, because she does not hesitate.

Whitney is FANTASTIC. She was so funny; her class was interesting for the most part and she was always willing to help during and outside of class. She was extremely nice on the final grade for my group project and was genuinely so caring.

She is caring and well respected. Her lectures are fast paced, but engaging and all of her slides are posted. At times, her instructions can be vague, which makes it hard to complete them, but she does have criteria posted to help. I would take her again.

Professor Whitney is great and wants you to engage with engineering. I took EGR 215 which is 101 and 103 squished into one class. The course had so many assignments that it should have been at least a 4 credit course. The main project of the semester was a ping pong ball launcher project that for my section took me at least 30 hours of work.
she is awesome but the projects sucks. The ping pong ball launcher is so hard to do.

Easy class but hw later on gets really time consuming and will all be required. Expect tons of group work in this class. If you take your time in this class you will do just fine. Material pacing is a little fast or feels off beat, coming from someone who is neurodivergent.
Awesome stories, explanations and everything.
Shes fine, kinda takes everything so seriously tho. Very very easy grader, my final project I turned in would have gotten a C in 4th grade and I got 100%.

Whitney is great for EGR 101. She gives good instructions and will help troubleshoot if you have issues. She explains things thoroughly and often goes over things over and over, which is helpful. She made the class a bit more fun and really just wants you to understand the content but will help you if you don't.

Dr. Whitney is by far the best first year engineering professor at UK. She makes engineering relatable to everyone, even those without an engineering background. She tells stories about her career as an engineer which really help you visualize what it means to be in the field of engineering, and what you need to put forward as a result.

Dr. Whitney is by far the best professor to take for EGR103. It is a semester long project class and she sets it up so that it is very easy to stay on target. Other professors will not do that. She has a lot of experience and really wants you to have fun with the project. Easy class as long as you keep up with your due dates.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. Whitney first and foremost is professional and understanding. She has worked in industry and brings a lot of experience and anecdotes to her lectures. She's caring and will take a lot of time to help you. Once she even sat with me outside while she ate her lunch and answered about 45 min worth of questions for me about succeeding as an engineer

First off, shes crazy. If you want a professor to scream in your ear about mechanical engineering for 80% of the class take her. The class is also pointless, as what you learn in class is middle school math but then look at the homework and it looks like you need a doctorate to complete. But that is across all classes. Decent for the class i guess

For an art professor, her acceptance for subjective analysis is nonexistent. Often made students feel stupid when they asked questions or provided analysis by misinterpreting the statement and responding passive-aggressively. Clearly not a people person. The work itself is easy, but I'd save myself the trouble of listening to rants every week.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: if you are taking this class be prepared to study so much, the exams are actually impossible and you need to know every single thing she teaches in the lectures. she grades extremely hard the class average on most exams was between 60-70%
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Coming from a old history major this class was very history heavy. The teaching is good, assignments were easy and graded on time. The problem is her attitude. She does not care about disablity, or how students feel in her class. Dont even try to go to the bathroom without being called out infront of the whole class. Work 10/10 Teachher 1/10

I took AH 106 and I enjoyed it! Honestly, if you begin her assignments early, study on time, and put in the work, you should do pretty well. She is very eager about art especially the Renaissance which helped me learn. It is a lecture heavy course but she gives resources to use for the unit exams. I recommend AH 106 over 105.

10/10 do not recommend. She makes it way too hard for a 100-level course. Her exams demand a master's level understanding, with five handwritten pages in a timed setting. The exams are based solely on lectures where she goes on aggravating hour-long tangents about the same topic. Her grading is also completely subjective with unattainable standards

You can tell she loves what she does! She is so caring and spunky that it makes learning about art history exciting. Found my love for art renaissance through her. Lots of readings but its worth it because its actually fascinating to learn.

I realized a few weeks in that all of the material is available from an online source. The professor even presented quotes from the videos as if they were her own lecture. The professor provides no leniency. She was irritated that one of my fellow students missed a test due to a death in the family. Shes not a people person! I dreaded emailing her

If you're the slightest bit interested in art history, take this class. Wheeler is an enthusiastic lecturer who is passionate about being an art historian. The tests are difficult, but she is willing to help if you ask. Genuinely enjoyed the content.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Overall a great lecturer, and expects her students to exceed their own expectations. She sets the bar really high. Tests are hard, but very doable with sufficient studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lectures teeter between way too much information at once or spending 30 minutes on one slide. She kind of gets an attitude when someone asks a question she misinterperets. Not to mention the random in-class assignments to "help us", but if you don't know everything in class by name, date, and artist, even ones introduced that day, forget it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I did not enjoy this class. Mentally draining and not a helpful professor.
save yourself the hassle
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Wheeler acts like this a graduate level course of art history majors. This is a 100 level elective. Everyone failed the exams. She is so loud and not helpful.

Kate was not my fave at first, but she is an amazing lecturer and does a great job getting you to care about history that would typically be pretty boring. As long as you study for all those tests, you'll be alright. Your hand will hurt from writing though, 100%.

Even if you have a doctors note she will give you a zero on the assignment and say she “drops the three lowest grades.” that should NOT count excused absences. Very smart/rude when you have questions. Unless you're extremely passionate about art history I would not take her.

This professor taught the information just fine- nothing too special. Her class was hard for me as it was the only class I got a B in this semester. The projects were difficult but if you read the directions WELL and put in the work it should be fine. She did make me like art history which was impressive as I've never like it before.

The way she talks is a bit too enthusiastic or hyper, and throws me off guard. There was a lot of information to write down as quickly as possible, sometimes she goes too fast and doesn't allow laptops to take notes. Attendance is taken everyday and much of the info is not on the tests anyway. At least she posts the slides on canvas.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I loved her class so much I'm taking her again for the next level! She's very enthusiastic and has consistent exams and lecture structures, so it's easy to find what works for you and to continue with that. Sometimes she's a bit snippy if she has to repeat herself. Very strict on no phones/laptops. If you miss class you'll miss a lot of info.

You can tell she is passionate about what she teaches. Attendance is required, but she offers reading materials for missed notes. Exams are easy and have a consistent structure. She makes herself available to students, so take advantage of that. I hated to miss this class. Would take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She was very fun and made class entertaining, even during critique. Feedback was good and personal.
Kiana was a great person to learn from due to the way she is able to connect to students. I enjoyed the course material and the way it was presented.

Kiana was a wonderful professor. She was very clear in her instructions for assignments and I very rarely felt confused. The input she gave was always helpful, and the times I didn't take her advice she was always respectful and chill. She very kind and cared about each us a great deal.

Professor White is one of the most critical professors I've met. I've tried multiple times to reach her favor through my material for projects but she is critical of the smallest details. If you do not create what she wants exactly get ready to fail. She also favors the people who are art majors even more than people taking the class to graduate.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Kiana is nice and clearly cares, but there is an insane show of favoritism and grades reflect it. If you don't go to class, you will fail the course, which I get, but considering it's an art studio class with terrible provided supplies, there should be some leniency. If I had to retake, I would pick someone else. I felt regularly unwelcome.

Katherine Woods is an amazing professor, she provides very thorough instructions and is often flexible. She is also a great resource/mentor. Overall she presents the content of this course in a way that makes a lot of sense, using real world and her own lived experiences. This course isn't hard as long as you pay attention in class.
Amazing professor! She really cares about her students.

Expectations for all students with timelines and due dates for assignments in syllabus were clearly stated and reasonable. Professor was honest and open for feedback and discussion for all assignments. Some difficulties with timely communication among student group members for group assignments due to different work ethics and student schedules.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Intense projects, no leeway, difficult course material

Professor Woods truly cares about her students and supports their success. Her class had exams and group projects, all of which were valuable. I gained knowledge I now use in my internship, built connections, and even secured a summer internship thanks to her course.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Woods was a hard grader, but she always laid the class content out very well. Take the class seriously and you will do good.
Hard grader, long exams, not personable

I learned a lot in this class, however, the class is content heavy. Attendance is mandatory. There are 2 "anchor assignments" that are both worth 20% of your grade. She is a hard grader, especially on grammar. Her midterm was easier than I thought and so was her final. As long as you show up and do your work & know APA, you'll be good.
The professor loves anthropology, and you can tell by his lectures. His lectures are very long and plain at times, but the assignments are very easy. He loves it when his students engage.

Dr. Whitaker is a funny old man, but he is also incredibly intelligent. His lectures are worth attending to take notes, and to listen to his stories about Sri Lanka. He is engaging in them, and wants students to participate. His experience is very interesting and anthropology should get some more love because of this guy.

Professor Whitaker is a sweet old man, his lectures are simple, the way he talks is sort of long and convoluted, but he does not mind if you work on other things while he speaks. Attend lecture, take some notes, and thank him for doing this in his old age. He is such an interesting and intelligent guy, and you can tell he loves anthropology.

Dr. Whitaker is such a good person. His lectures mainly revolve around his field work experiences but do tie to the content. For future exams or papers, I would make sure you're taking notes in class.

If you're looking for an easy class for a credit you need, this is it. Dr. Whitaker talks a lot, but he is genuinely a good guy, and you'll hear all about Sri Lanka. There was one easy assignment per week, plus open-note midterm and final.

Dr. Whitaker is a very sweet and funny guy. His lectures were great and he talks a lot about his field work in Sri Lanka which I found interesting. He's passionate about teaching and cares a lot for students. He brought in some Indian desserts once when we watched a movie. Overall class was pretty simple, just two papers and a 10 page term paper.
This professor is an amazing person. He is hilarious and funny, but very lecture heavy and hard to follow.

Beware- Takes forever to grade and does not follow the syllabus rules, told us one weekly comment would be dropped at the end of semester and never did it. he also doesn't follow his grade breakdown for his weekly comments. he only talks about Sir Lanka and like no other country so it gets repetitive after awhile.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Whitaker is a jolly old man who is VERY passionate about his work. He loves to tell stories about Sri Lanka and places he's been before. We have weekly comments that are 300-500 words and can usually only be accomplished if you read, watch, and listen to his lectures. Easy grader but just tedious.

He really cares and if you talk with him he is super helpful he wants his students to succeed. Put some effort in for class and talk with him. He has done some really interesting trips and you'll get some cool stories from him! Loved Him as a professor.
He's really nice and truly cares about his work. We watched a Bollywood film one class period and he brought us popcorn! He's a sweet old man who enjoys his work!

Dr. Whitaker is the nicest guy and very passionate about his profession. His lectures are a bit confusing and can be a little boring, but the class overall isn't too bad. The assignments are pretty easy and quick, though the midterm and final are a little challenging. The class isn't too much of a time commitment though, and it can be interesting!

More than likely favorite professor at UK. This guy is beyond smart, and entertaining to listen to. He is super passionate about what he teaches and is always open to discussion and others perspectives. Not many other professors like him. Definitely take his class if you have the chance.

Dr. Whitaker is a great guy. The only issue with his class is that he rambles and goes on tangents. There are no PowerPoints. Accessible outside of class, and he's very funny. His class is graded on few things, and often if you miss class you'll miss the criteria for the assignment (he does not use Canvas often, if at all). Would take again, though
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I love this guy. He cares about what he teaches. He's really interesting to listen to. It's really easy to get an A with all of the extra credit he offers. The tests require studying, but they're not too tough. He is excellent. I highly recommend him. Plus, he went to Princeton. So he's pretty smart.

Dr. Whitaker is an outstanding man. Great guy to be around. How to get an A? Offers a lot of extra credit, take advantage of it. He gives study guide for his exams, go back through notes/reading and make your own study guide. His lectures aren't the best but if you pay attention (unlikeme) it will help. Do the reading, its a lot but manageable

Whitaker is by far the best professor I've had at UK thus far. He is extremely knowledgeable but he's also easy to follow. Full of interesting stories and always tries to keep the class entertained. His quizzes are very easy and so are the two papers you have to write. There is a lot of reading, but it's fairly interesting.

Anything anyone says on here that is positive is a lie. Awful professor, doesn't teach you anything. Be ready to learn everything on your own. Good guy but bad at his job. If he is your professor drop now and take it next semester for the better of your gpa and so you dont waste your time
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Dr. Whitaker is full of interesting stories and sure knows his stuff.  He assigns a bit of reading, but it is generally interesting.  Good class, would take again
Requires a lot of reading. However, the class is interesting and Dr. Whitaker is a great professor to take a class with. He is very generous and understandable.

I absolutely loved this course. By far my favorite professor I've ever had. He was incredibly engaging and funny, and though he can be a little scatter brained, if you are paying attention you always know exactly what's going on. I found the quizzes and papers to be quite easy. Great guy and I would love to take another class with him

Dr. Whitaker is really nice, he just rambles and seems disorganized. I had no chance at all of doing the readings because there were WAY too many, yet I somehow managed to pass the quizzes. Saving grace was getting to write a 10 page paper at the end because I love writing, if you don't then this isn't for you.

Expects way too much. Unrealistic amount of reading. EXTREMELY disorganized and unclear about literally everything. Unless you are a total pro of all things South Asian culturesociety, you probably won't do too fantastic in this class. I wouldn't wish this class upon anyone. Worst I've ever taken.

Rambles a ton, just two quizzes which were difficult. no exams. About 80 pages of reading per class (so over 160 pages a week) and you will be expected to memorizeknow everything you read, on the quizzes. Read the syllabus thoroughly because he doesn't really make announcements about anything. Doesn't use blackboard at all. NEED the books.
BIO Buddy was very helpful, so definitely recommend forming a strong one. Exams were manageable if you studied consistently. Lectures were clear and organized, but not very engaging or energetic.

Many of the other reviews for Dr. Wright's 148 class are pretty critical, but honestly, I think she genuinely wants her students to succeed, which is not something you can say about a lot of instructors. She really does want to give students good grades. This is a flipped classroom, so the lecture isn't super helpful, but you def have to go/echo360
Dr. Wright is a nice person and doesn't waste time during class. She is very approachable and willing to answer questions. You will be fine in her class.

She may have a PhD in Biology but she acts like she has no idea what she's talking about. Just today she spent 15 minutes on a single question because she was so confused. Wdym you're confused on it but we will have similar exam questions??? She makes everything so confusing I can't count on my hands how many times she says "wait nvm" every lecture

Going to lecture is kind of useless; it's mainly a lot of practice questions, but that is helpful sometimes because the exams are very wordy. Super accessible outside of class, cheat sheets for every exam, and you can retake an exam at the end of the semester. Participation makes up a large chunk of your grade, so watch the ECHO360 if you don't go.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She just takes content from other professors. All the work is videos at home, then come to class and do participation activities. People ask her questions and she has no idea what the answer is. She gets questions wrong sometimes because it's not hers. Exams are cake as long as you pay attention to the videos.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: If you are not religious, you should consider becoming because you need to pray that you do not have to take this class with her. All you do in this class is poll everywhere, which is review questions from the online lecture you watch before class. She did not actually teach a single concept and the rare time she did, it was taught wrong.DONT TAKE.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst experience ever. Did not teach, had no book and only did poll everywhere in class. The websites would crash almost every day, and I have learned nothing. I highly recommend if you value your time do not take this class. Also, the videos assigned were presented by a different professor, she did not teach.

I had Ms. Wright for Bio 155 this semester. She can seem intimidating at first but is actually very nice and helpful. The class doesn't have exams, so as long as you complete the labs, submit work on time,  complete calibrations carefully, and follow the rubric for lab reports, you will be fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Super easy class. Lectures are on Zoom as well, but you have to participate in the clicker quizzes everyday. Allowed cheat sheets for the exam. Super nice lady, not a hard class at all.
In my opinion, the exams are a lot harder/very different from the practice exams.  The class itself wasn't too much work or very difficult but the exams were hard and weighted very heavily.

Most of the learning for this course is done at home with videos, notes, and practice questions. You are allowed cheat sheets for each exam, and there are plenty of other materials for this class to be easily passable. Stay on top of the work or it will pile up. Lecture has participation/attendance points, but doesn't cover additional content

Dr.Wright is very passionate about what she teaches. Participation is graded, however, it isn't mandatory for her classes. What I liked most about her class was the BIO buddy for exams. She also cares about her students and is always available to help.
Easy class but such a waste of time. I was watching videos that she assigned for the most easy topics. It easy points but then going to class seemed like a waste of time.

This course is set up in a flipped classroom model, which may be a shock to some students. Most of the learning is done at home through a LOT of assignments. It's easy points. Dr. Wright is extremely nice and understanding if you show that you care, but she isn't the best explainer of concepts. Wouldn't mind taking her again. Not a bad class at all
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I absolutely hated this class. It felt like a waste of time and would watch so many videos weekly that are just drawn out. The topics covered in class is so simple and they dumb them down even more. This class should be an easy A, but it will feel more like a chore than actually learning. She was very unorganized and going to class was pointless.

I hated the way she would make you turn the participation and attendance. There was a super confusing program that she used called GradeScope and I was never sure if I was turning in the right document because there was no information about what to turn in, just the participation activity for this day.
She was really nice the few times I went to class. The lecture was not mandatory so I never went since everything was online anyways. You get a cheat sheet on every exam which is nice.

Are the lectures boring and a little unnecessary? Yeah. Was the homework tedious? Absolutely. But all in all, the class was super easy to do well in. You get cheat sheets on the exam and she gives you the opportunity to earn back points and retake exams if you do poorly. She is also just a very sweet person.

I overall really liked the class but the lectures can be inefficient when learning content so mandatory attendance feels almost excessive. Most of notes and homework is done outside class so that is nice because it is self paced with a few due dates.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is the most boring professor. I have always been good at bio classes but she makes the topic so hard to understand. Her lectures are awful and she is not good at explaining at all. We had a sub once and that was the only time I learned. Would NOT recommend taking this class with her look for any other professor.
Dr. Wright was very understanding, one time my submission wouldn't upload and she submitted it after the deadline for me. The class was pretty boring, but you get let out early almost every day.

I had Dr. Wright for her first-semester teaching at UK and she was very caring and understanding of her students. Lectures are presented outside of class through videos that Dr. Osterhage records so attendance is optional and she live streams. You get a double-sided "cheat sheet" for each exam and a 2-page cheat sheet for the final.

Dr. Wright did an okay job teaching my class. Initially, it felt like she didn't know exactly what she was doing, but as the semester went on she seemed more prepared. The pre-lab quizzes were never too hard and the labs weren't too bad. The class is really more of an introduction to biology labs in general, so the content isn't too bad
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: super understanding and kind professor, no late work penalty, in person attendance wasn't mandatory and classes were live streamed. each exam you're allowed a paper front and back and you're allowed one exam retake at the end of the year. it's a laid back class but you will not do well if you don't put in the effort for it.

Professor Wright is amazing! Really accessible out of class, hardest part of this class will be the lab. it is not too bad depending on the TA, but the lab exams can be kind of brutal. Other than that, she only requires attendance at the first lecture of the week, most times, as long as you turn in the homework before the start of the next week.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Wright was a great professor and this class is an easy A if you show up and complete the weekly bookwork.  It's a drawing based class, and the lectures last about 20 mins max and she gives you the rest of the time to work on the bookwork. Only 1 real lecture per week too, the other is optional. The labs were a pain but for the most part easy.

Professor Wright is a great professor who wants you to understand the content and is very willing to help you if don't understand something. She conveys the material very clearly and explains how to complete drawings during lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She gave very good lectures. She walks you through part of the homework during class. I never had to do any work outside of class, There is plenty of class time to finish all homework. There is one assignment per week and one lab. if you don't understand something, she will explain it to you and make sure that you understand.

She is the lead prof for senior design, and she was always super helpful and gave good feedback when my group met with her for help. The grading is definitely tough for this class, but she does her best to make the criteria and expectations clear, and offers help when needed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She was very kind and you could tell she genuinely cared about her students. She offered tons of extra help and office hours. Great teacher and always helpful with questions!
Deeply committed to the subject matter.  Very concerned about students
This was the easiest class i have ever had...she cancels class constantly, if you need a Writing course, this is the perfect choice: CAKE!!
No Comments

This is one of the easiest teachers I've ever had.  There's no midterm and no quizzes, just a one page reflection once a week and several small projects.  She's really funny and very nice, I would definitely recommend taking a class under her.

She has a great personality, and her lectures are very well-organized. She makes difficult content easy to understand. All materials are posted on Canvas after each lecture. She communicates effectively, and you can reach out to her very easily.
I took Dr.Wu's 230 PS class. She is not a bad teacher and I feel like she can be misunderstood sometimes, but once you get used to her class. You'll be fine.

She is not by any means a bad professor. However, On multiple occasions in class I raised my hand to answer a question, was told my answer was wrong, and then shed proceed to explain the "correct answer" which would be nearly exactly what I said but worded differently.

Jingwen was my TA for Polisci. She was a very kind person, but was an absolutely horrible TA. I found NO benefit from her recitations, and if attendance wasn't mandatory, I wouldn't go. She would grade things wrong, and didn't speak English very well, which is a difficult thing to handle when doing writing assignments.
Extremely easy class! He grades east too! My favorite class so far. He's hilarious! We got off topic all the time! :)

Easiest class ever. Docta Hu is the nicest man and if you have an A in the class you don't have to take the final. I made my speeches and powerpoints the day before they were due and recieved 100's. If you're taking GEN 100, DEFINITELY take Dr. Hu.
Hu is the man, if you have him it will definately be one of your better classes. Real chill class.
Very easy! Tried to make class interesting and three major projects that were all easy and you your own topic choice.
She makes the subject way too hard to understand, she is never make sense.

She knows the material, but definitely shouldn't be teaching. Her accent makes it difficult to understand unless you sit in the front and pay close attention. Moderately easy A if you study the night before exams. She recommends the course packet, but doesn't follow it linearly or explain where in it she is. Avoid if you can't teach yourself.
No Comments
This is the absolute worst class I have every had in my entire life. Terrible instruction. Awful class.
loved her anthro course would for sure take her course again she really cares about her students.

She is a great, enthusiastic teacher. The tests and quizzes are easy to do well on, so definitely take this if you need to for a core. Recitation classes can bump your grade down a bit if you miss because they are discussion-based and graded by attendance/participation.

For the first time in my academic career, I was truly passionate about what I was learning in Dr. Worne's class. She makes the topic of discussion, one that I never thought I would take interest in, easy to understand and quickly made her class my favorite. She is extremely helpful and would stay after class to answer any questions.

Great class to knock out a core requirement. Constant easy quizzes and online tests make it easy to manage an A. Lectures are super concise and fairly interesting for a subject I have relatively no interest in. Labs with TAs are simple and helpful. Incredibly nice and understanding. All you have to do to succeed is show up.
she grades pretty easily, labs are easy, tests have some stuff that is never talked about but overall it was pretty good

Great professor! Very enthusiastic about what she teaches and explains the content well. Her TAs are also incredibly responsive and helpful in the Friday recitations. Labs can be challenging but are manageable. Would definitely recommend her and her class!

Dr. Worne is a great professor, very educated and caring. There are lots of assignments so it's easy to rack up points. The TA can be a tough grader on labs but they're not difficult. If you take notes during the lectures, you will ace the exams. The lowest lab and two lowest quizzes are dropped.
This class is very easy. You don't have to attend every lecture but the lab is a little hard. Overall is great and you can get a very easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really liked her and only found the lab assignments to be slightly difficult but she drops your lowest lab grade and your two lowest quiz grades so I found it very easy to pass if do the weekly assignments.

Worne is a nice professor, but she moves very quickly through her lectures. There is a weekly reading quiz each week, but as long as you go to class you will do fine on the quiz. The labs are difficult and recitation is mainly required. But the midterm and final are open note, online. In class attendance is not mandatory and only helps your grade.

I am very bad at science, but I have really enjoyed Dr. Worne's class this semester. She makes learning about new topics very accessible, and I haven't felt unprepared for any of the labs or quizzes. The exams are easy as long as you go to class and take notes. All exams are open note.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Loved Dr. Worne. I am a finance major and still did great in this class because of her. She gives great lectures and posts them on canvas. we have quizzes around every other week. they are 10 questions, and if u do the reading and watch the lectures you'll get 100 every time. Her TA was a tough grader for lab reports, but ask for help and ur good

I will say that ANT230 was hard for me; biology/ the hard sciences arent really my thing  like, at all. However, Dr. Worne is the kindest, smartest, most accommodating professor in the history of ever probably. I literally learned so much in that class!!!

Easy A for me. You don't even need to read the textbook much, her lectures cover everything in depth, but it does help a little with labs. The lectures were relatively short and to the point. I choose to take online labs, and the TA mainly grades to see that you've explained thoroughly. I believe she even accepts late work. Great professors overall
Dr Worne is really cool! She's very knowledgeable and tries to make sure each student has the resources to succeed in class. She's also an interesting lecturer.

The course material was difficult to understand. The class was extremely difficult for me. I barely passed but the name of the game is passing the class so I am not mad. Heather Worne knows a lot about the subject. The only thing that bugged me about her is that she talks way too fast.

This is probably one of the nicest professors I have ever had. She is very sweet and ALWAYS makes time to help her students out. She posts slides on canvas and she tries her best to make sure you understand the content. I am not an ANT major so I am struggling with this class but I love this professor!

This class was taken for a UK core and was taught at basically a 300 or 400 level. Avoid taking this class unless anthropology comes easy to you and it is something you are interested in. I regret taking this as a core class and would much rather have taken a different less difficult class. Core classes should not be this intense or difficult.

Dr. Worne is a great professor. Her lectures are interesting if you enjoy biological Anthropology. If you don't, it may be a little boring for you. Take good notes over the PowerPoints, submit your lab reports on time, and study for the tests and you will be sure to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: SHE IS THE MOST AMAZING PERSON EVER

Heather Worne is one of the smartest professors I think Ive ever had. Lectures move extremely fast! She posts the PowerPoint AFTER class, not before. I personally think this makes it difficult to follow along. I took this class as part of my UK core and I highly recommend only taking this course if it relates to your major! Material is tough!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is an awesome teacher and a fun class. She goes through the powerpoint very fast, but you usually get out of class early. The labs are easy if you just go to lab and do it right. Study for the tests a day or two before and you're good.
Amazing

Dr. Worne's lectures are intense and she goes through the powerpoint very quickly, so write your notes fast (but you will usually get let out of class early as a result). The course itself is difficult, but interesting. Lots of extra credit opportunities are offered to bring up your grade. Worne is very approachable and there to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: I have had Dr. Worne twice and she is one of the most passionate and knowledgable professors I have ever had at UK! She really knows her stuff, so she can lecture really fast, but will stop and slow down to explain things when asked. Also extremely accessible in email and office hours, as is the TA. Highly recommend this course!!

Lectures have a lot of content in them, but she usually lets class out early if she gets through everything (warning: she's a fast talker). In-class powerpoints are posted on  canvas, so it's more helpful to just listen in class instead of taking notes. Read the book before tests and take advantage of office hours!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I took this class for core, it should have been an easy A. The notes were bad and consisted of quotes from the textbook. What she says is on the exams, not the slides. The exams do not cover what you would expect. The labs were graded very hard. The class was taught like a major class, when the majority of students are taking it for core.
She was very approachable and there weren't any assignments  or papers besides the labs and in class video. Overall wasn't that bad of a class

Doctor Worne is very engaging and makes sure not to spend too much time lecturing. There was a lot of hands on activity and she was always available for questions. I learned a lot and quite enjoyed the class!

This is a HARD class. A lot of memorization of time periods, vocab, and so on. That being said, she puts everything you need to know on the powerpoints; don't bother with the textbook. Her study guides are more of an outline than a guide, and she's a tough grader on labs - don't expect to improve after your first one. That being said, I enjoyed it.

Dr. Worne is really nice and knowledgable. I imagine she'd be better in a small, higher level class. In this one, she was unclear and we interacted more with a terrible TA, rather than her. The class was way too hard for an intro course and expected non-majors to be familiar with the subject. I worked really hard and still could not pull off an A.

she's a really great 400 level professor. Not such a great 200 level professor. Her casual acceptance of a D average and her refusal to curve is horrible. She's super knowledgeable, but she doesn't know how to translate that to people who aren't knowledgeable in her field. Plus, the stuff on exams and the stuff on study guides are barely similar.

Easy class, if you pay attention in lectures and do basic studying. She's really a great person, and is really passionate about the class--she took the same one when she was a freshman and it inspired her entire career, so she cares a lot. Really nice, funny. I'd take her again, even though I'm not a science major. I only used the book to study.

Dr. Worne is an extremely helpful instructor and a genuinely nice person. She makes lectures interesting and frequently makes connections between course material and daily life. The course load is very light; as long as you take notes and study a day or two before exams, you will get an easy A. Don't worry about buying the expensive text book.

I had her for human osteology this past semester. Honestly the best professor I have ever had. She is incredibly intelligent and also capable of communicating her knowledge effectively. I would highly recommend her to anyone interested in biological anthropology.

Dr. Worne is one of the best teachers I had. She truly loves teaching and is always interested in improving herself. The class was very interesting and not overly difficult. She is a very nice person and is interested in her students doing well. Really enjoyed her class!!!

Dr. Worne loves to teach and share her passion. She has been one of the best teachers I've ever had in my life. She doesn't try to make it easy, but she does lecture in a way that makes even the most difficult topics easier to understand.
The material was presented in a clear and straightforward way, exams reflected exactly what was taught in class, and Dr. Worne has an excellent knowledge of the subject matter.

Dr. Worne is an amazing professor. She makes you work for a good grade, but she is very fair and offers extra credit. I learned a lot in her class and enjoyed her as a person. Textbook was helpful but not necessary. And lab hours make all the difference.

Dr. Worne is a wonderful professor. She does tend to make her tests and quizzes with more detail than most would, but she never blind sides you. Make sure to take notes in this class because it's pretty intense. If you need help with anything, she is more than willing to take time and help you. Overall great teacher.
Worne rocks. She really knows what she is talking about and is ALWAYS willing to help you if you have questions.

I didn't previously know anything about bio.anthro. but she made all perspectives of bioanthro very clear. Lectures get a little boring sometimes, but you can tell that she is extremely knowledgeable and she is a good person and is willing to do what she can to help. Tests include small details from lecture, so take good notes.
Very Helpful. Knows her stuff. Tests are hard , be prepared to work your butt off.

She is an awesome teacher to have. Her English is not the best, but if you pay attention in the slightest you will be able to figure it out. She will play interesting videos, usually clips from popular TV shows, to help students better understand topics. Answer her questions in class and she will love you. 10/10 take this class.

took the class and regretted it instantly. She is bad at communicating with her students (ironic i know). Be able to sit through an hour and 15 minutes of her talking in the front of the class and trying not to fall asleep. attendance is taken every class. English is her third language so there can be a language barrier.

The exam counts 50 questions and r 50 minutes long. These are very easy questions but if you dont read the book and dont watch the PowerPoint, ull fail for sure.

Dr. Jin is bearable only because of the extra credit he offers. It's not an easy class, but there's so much bonus you're almost guaranteed a good grade. You get a whole 5% just for discussion boards. This is seriously an easy A. Make sure to show up to every class (at the end of each class he gives group work which is worth 20 points and 240 points total at the end of the semester). Test are word for word from the power points. Do not buy the book!!!

He  tried to link sociology to everyday social life, and thus to teach practically. For some topics, he did pretty well. But, it was dull for some other topivs. I know society is important in this class

He should improve his teaching skills.
He is very inexpedient as a professor. Disorganized. He do not what he was doing at the class.

AWFUL AVOID

Great professor! Gives plenty of opportunity for extra credit. Exams will be easy if you pay attention to lectures and fill out class packet.

I am retaking accounting 201 with professor zhao, and its a night and day difference between him and other accounting professors. He seems to genuinely care about your success, teaches the content clearly, and exams are not too hard. Definitely take him if you can.
Ray is a really good teacher, and he give us bonus if we go to class every time.

Ray, is the ideal choice for an ACC 201 class, had to withdraw the first time I took this course, but when I took Ray's class it was much easier.

Also, a ton of bonus points offered.

He takes attendance randomly. You get 20 points throughout the semester for attendance however you are unaware of what days it will be. Extremely helpful to attend anyway because he passes out handouts in class. Homework and bonus available for each chapter covered.

Professor Zhao is great of giving the class handouts and in-class questions that were very reflective of the material covered on the exam. He was always helpful if you had questions. reviews.comment: You must be their for your REEF attendance questions or have people their to send you the answers for a chunk of your grade. Sapling is the worst online homework ever but it also counts as a huge chunk of your grade. The tests are awful, so get ready to do lots of problems. Dr. Yates is extremely nice though and tries his hardest to make chem fun.
If you don't have a previous background in chemistry, you will probably struggle as he teaches very quickly. Be ready to teach yourself the material and take notes at home.

Dr. Yates TEACHES FAST!!!! Lectures  cover almost 80 slides each class and explanations are rushed and broad. If you want a more thorough understanding rely on recitation and at-home studying. Yates tries to lighten the mood with jokes but class is mostly non engaging. Probably spend 4-6 hours a week studying for a decent B.

Dr. Yeets is a good guy, he tries to be funny and he tries to be engaging but he goes through is lecture slides at an incredibly fast pace. He knows what he's talking about but he often talks too fast throughout lecture. Good guy though

If you're looking to cover about 100 slides of notes a lecture well this is your guy. I honestly think it is his goal to get through the entire semester's material in one week. I have to relearn all the material he doesn't teach in class on my own because I can't take notes at the speed of light.

A very approachable teacher. Will continue to work out problems until students no longer have questions. Tries to mix up the monotony of class with simple experients. A great teacher but you still need to keep up by reading the chapters and working out practice problems to receive an A or B.

Yates teaches to the slowest student in the class. He does not assume you know anything. he is thorough. he thinks out loud so you can understand how to solve problems. read text. spend 3-5 hours outside of class on homework per week. formula memorization. practice exams available. use his office hours. he hates cell phones, don't let yours ring.

I'm taking CHE 107 in summer school and realize now how much I got from CHE 105. Yates worked lots of problems, which was useful.  He needs to speak a little loouder, but otherwise is great.  I wish he taught 107 in the summer.

I thought this class would be much tougher than it was. Yates follows the lecture notes most of the time, but he works a lot of problems that aren't there.  I would take CHE 107 with him, but he doesn't seem to teach that--too bad.  The exams are fairly predictable and fair.

He's up front about what is needed to do well in chemistry class and there are no surprises. Good teacher. Good attitude. But do not expect it to be easy as there are almost-weekly homework sets due and the exams require some review. His review sessions are worth the time.

This was my second time taking CHE 105 and my first experience was a wipeout.   This time I almost got an A.  He explains the concepts clearly and provides good online  notes, but the tests are pretty.
Dr. Yates knows the material super well and works lots of problems.  He clearly enjoys teaching and is very helpful.
Very helpful professor who cares about students.

Such a boring professor, and he doesn't teach new material very well. He expects you to understand before you come to class and doesn't spend much time going through practice problems. I only managed to get an A because I had AP chem in high school.
Definitely knows what he's talking about.

Great professor!! he was very helpful in explaining everything. the notes are online so print them out before you come to class and follow along with him.  READ THE BOOK!! that is the key to success in this class. I took this my first semester and had to drop it after the 2nd exam, this semester i have an  A because I read the book and did practice

This guy was boring! He put the notes up on blackboard and during class all he did was read directly from them. Whenever there were practice problems in the notes the step by step process was already filled out which was not helpful to understanding the material. Attendance is not mandatory. Only about half the class shows up after the 1st day.
He's nice, but doesn't explain things well and is super boring.

He has good intentions but is soooo dull to listen to. All he did was read off the powerpoints, so if you dont understand chem by just one read off a powerpoint I would suggest another class. Got through the class by listening to Woodrums pod cast online and the book. Not a good teacher if you are not naturally good at chem!

He's a good guy. Class is dull, but study the powerpoints very thoroughly to get a B or even an A. I tried reading the chapters, but I don't think it's any use. He answers questions and loves chemistry.

Dr Yates probably isn't the best teacher to teach this class but he also isn't the worst. His classes are kinda boring and he tends to make mistakes when working our problems. But he's really nice and open to answering all questions. he also tries to incorporate small experiments to make the class more interesting. Good teacher!!!

Dr. Yates is extremely boring, but very helpful.  If you go to class and attempt to do the homework with the best intentions, you cannot fail.  He is very approachable. One of the best chemistry professors in my opinion.
hard class. but he is a good teacher.
he is a good teacher. i just have a hard time with chemistry. he is interesting and tries to help you out.  one of the better professors in the chemistry department and extremely intelligent
He is a fairly good teacher, especially for the chem dept.
No Comments

I slept everyday in his class. Although his lectures are boring, he is very helpful. Just ask a question and he will give you no problem with solving it. The notes are posted on blackboard, a big plus. Probably one of the better chem teachers, but his experiments in class never seem to work.
The lectures are fun, he makes them interactive so it's hard to fall asleep. He gives a pretty good review for the exams as well.

I didn't actually have many interactions with Dr. Kim, but his lab was very structured and followed the syllabus exactly. All grading is left up to the TAs, but so long as you do the work and follow the rubric you'll be fine. The calculations on reports can be a pain, so I'd suggest starting as soon as possible. Reports can end up over 20 pages.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It's hard to pay attention because he would talk about one thing for 20 minutes on a theory of something or to understand a graph, however, the HWs and exam are heavily based on calculations, and he does not do those. If you want to succeed in this class you should go to his office hours and literally ask what am I supposed to do.

The worst professor Ive ever had. He just reads off his lecture slides for an hour without explaining the problems. He said the midterm would be like the homework, but thats only true if by like the homework he meant it is in some way related to thermochemistry. If you want to have a stress aneurysm, take his class. Otherwise, stay away.

There was only 2 exams (midterm and final) that were worth 70% of the class. After midterms 60% of the class dropped. Not many other grades that will help build up your grade. He is hard to understand and just reads off the slides. say "this is easy, you get this" when reviewing material. Office hours aren't helpful.
He's fine. His English can be hard to understand the class was boring but if you do the homework problems and look at old exams it's an easy A.

Dr. Kim made the first exam way too long, and everyone failed because we didn't finish on time. He then allowed us to drop our last exam score. Lecture isn't helpful. He's very understanding. DO THE SUGGESTED HW PROBLEMS. THEY ARE EXACTLY LIKE THE TEST QUESTIONS. The labs are very laid back and easy. Easy A. DO THE SUGGESTED HW PROBLEMS!!!!!

Dr. Kim is such a nice man. He made the course as easy as possible for us. He is pretty scattered and often repeats himself, but I think that's just because he's nervous and new to teaching. Exams easy and straightforward. Attendance not mandatory or necessary. The lab portion of the class was fairly easy as well. He also does great research.

She's nice and kind and puts in a lot of work to make good presentations for us, she cares and tries to relate to us, i liked how she explained why she was teaching us the way she did, and overall I had a great experience in this class, she did a good job facilitating the group projects we did and all the work felt like it made sense together.

This teacher is super strict.
Her grading makes no sense.
Even if you work hard, you still get bad grades.
She gave me the lowest grade I've ever had.
She forces you to talk in class.
There's a participation grade.
If you don't talk, she takes points off.
I really don't like her class.
It's stressful and not fun at all.

If you dislike group projects, this class will be especially frustrating. Be prepared to put in a lot of effort, as even small mistakes can significantly impact your grade. If you prefer a more structured and transparent teaching approach, this course may not be the best fit.

Ms. Young's course is extremely demanding, with a heavy workload that includes weekly reflections, mandatory office hours, and strict participation requirements. The grading is harsh, and peer reviews are poorly structured. One major issue is that assignment instructions are often vague, making it difficult to understand what she truly expects.

I had her for a discussion and I loved attending her. She's very nice and explains the topics very clearly. She loves it when people participate with her in the discussion. I wish I could have her teach literally everything!

Dr. Young can be dry at times but also has moments where he is truly excited about what he is teaching. Extremely knowledgeable and always willing to provide clarification.

In general the HWs are harder than the exams and paying attention to lectures is key to succeeding in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: John Young is an interesting professor. This is my third class with him and I have always gotten A's in his class. However, his actual teaching ability is abysmally bad. His lectures are extremely monotone and boring, and he doesn't explain anything without using math as a crutch for his explanations, he never explains intuitively.

His undergrad magnetics class is an easy A, but his graduate magnetics class is unbearable. The homeworks are a full-time job and have nothing to do w what was covered in class. I would Ctrl+F words from the homework in the textbook and lecture slides and they were nowhere to be found. For what its worth exams were significantly easier than the hw.

The subject is hard but he does a good job explaining it to where you can understand. Homework takes a few hours to complete but will help you prepare for the exams. Exams are designed to make sure you understand the material and not to trick you or be hard for the sake of being hard.

Professor Young is more lenient than most , he is willing to extend hw deadlines if he notices that most of the class did not completely understand the material. He does a lot of review of topics and does a great job explaining very complicated material in a clear way.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very intelligent professor that gives good lectures, fair homework, as well as fair exams. He runs the course in a good way, my only complaint is how he tends to be rude and makes you feel below him. He scoffed at me when I answered a question incorrectly in class and I quit engaging in his lectures for the rest of the semester because of this.
Excellent Professor. Comes prepared to class and a quick grader. Good communication. He is a serious person. He is also very knowledgeable in his field.

reviews.comment: Read material several times. Matlab skills really help.

reviews.comment: Prof. Young is an outstanding research scholar in Computational Electromagnetics. He teaches high quality courses both Undergrad and Grad in Numerical Electromagnetics, Antennas, Microwaves, Advanced E&M. Be well prepared in Engineering, Physics, and Math fundametals. H.W.'s sometimes long, but very instructive. Exams challenge. Always available

Dr. Yoo started off as a good professor at the beginning, but progressively got worse as the semester went on. By the end of the semester his class was miserable to sit through, and incredibly boring. The entire class is a lecture where he talks the ENTIRE time. Also, so many homework and out of class assignments that he assigns.

I had Dr. Yoo for ISC 321 in the summer. I actually enjoyed going to this class. The course was challenging, but Dr. Yoo taught in a very clear way and made sure everyone understood each concept. He's a pretty cool professor! Our class even went out to Local Taco after our final! I

Really cool guy, and his English is a lot better since the first reviews. He was awesome to have, brought the class redbulls because we were all sleeping and had pizza on fridays. It was a summer class though. Overall, hard class awesome teacher.

going to class is pointless, can't understand what he's saying but he does random in-class assignments that start to add up. only 2- material isn't hard but questions are worded horribly.. so you don't do to well. take the other teacher for this class!

This class seemed pretty easy until the tests.  He tried to trick you by asking questions in different ways- beware!  If this class was not mandator for my major, then I would not have taken it.  However, he is a kind person who truly wants people to succeed.
He speaks broken english, so its really hard to understand what he is saying. his tests are a ****. not very helpful either

Worst prof at UK. He will ramble about unrelated material during class and then assign a project/HW that requires info that we haven't been taught. Does not give PowerPoints or notes - just talks w/o writing anything. He expects you to learn software without giving tutorials or help. Unclear grading criteria, super disorganized, & no schedule. 0/10
He is a very good professor , he wants you to get something away from his class, The material itself in this class is demanding ,

One of the best teachers I have ever had. He is extremely helpful but difficult. Homework and group projects are hard and takes some thinking to complete, and graded appropriatly to how much time and effort put into it. Tests are not as difficult as expected. If your intrested in fluid mechanics, this is a very valuable class
Awful at lecturing, never works examples exams are easier then he may let on.
You must read the book to pass this class with Yost teaching. He doesn't work any examples ever! Tests are easier than I expected though.

Dont let the other reviews scare you the tests are easy if you go over the power points, her hw assignments are graded on participation, i'm not the most studious student and still did good on the exams. The average grade in the class was a high B. She really cares and is super nice and chill. Take this professor for 499 you wont regret it.

I didnt even take this class and know that she straight sucks. Thats how bad it is.
She has terrible tests and doesn't modify her class if everyone is confused. English isn't her native language so lots of things get lost in translation.

One of the most personable professors I've ever had. She isn't a tough grader, but expects you to put forth your best effort on papers and assignments. She's also very opinionated and passionate about the news, which is entertaining. She is definitely a gem, would recommend.

If you have the option to take a class with this professor do it. Grade is based off of homework and exams which weren't hard.

One the best and most helpful professors I've ever had. He cares about his students and makes sure students are engaged in class. He provides you with everything you need to succeed in his class. The exams are very easy as long as you use his materials to study.

Very good guy and even better professor. He is very knowledgeable of the subject and does a great job teaching the material. He jokes around with his students and is by far one of my favorite professors I've had at UK.
Best professor i've had, class is very easy

Professor Mai is one of my favorite teachers I have had over the course of 4 years at UK. The class is very interesting and he takes the time to individually know every student. If you show up and participate you will probably get a 100% in the class. I don't think anyone got lower than a B+ or Low A in the class.
take him if given the chance, possibly my favorite professor at UK. he has a pretty easy class and is super nice. his class can be interesting and he is funny and cares about his students.
Yunke is awesome. He jokes around in class and you usually get out early. Youll maybe have homework twice all year and he is a super nice guy. Easy class great teacher.

reviews.comment: I took Yuming Zhang during spring 2025 and it was terribel. The entire class had to have his final curved because he did not have it relate to the material at all. He did not teach well and he often went on tangents. He would ask vague questions about his material and would give you a 50% if you didn't get it perfectly correct.

This professor does not have any grading criteria for papers, he suggests using Chat-GPT to learn the curriculum, he fails to teach the curriculum from the presentation as he tends to stray off topic every lecture. He grades without care. Half of the final examination had nothing to do with the learnings of the class and he does not seem to care.

Professor has a TA that offers help during his hours which were not available. Professor has mandatory class time that is not during the scheduled time for the class. Harsh grader that asks students to use Chat GPT to work on assignments.

I can barely understand a word he says. Asking a single question can lead to a rabbit hole that lasts for much longer than it should. Tough grader and nothing is clear in the class. He jumps around in his lectures more than a jack rabbit in heat. I'm barely listening during class and just look at the slides.

Dr. Zhang is one of the few professors that I have taken that genuinely wants their students to learn the material instead of trying to fail you. If you dont get the grade you were looking for, ask him if you can redo it. I did, I got the response yes absolutely!. The real challenge for Dr. Zhang is the accent, but its not bad after a few weeks

He is the worst teacher I have ever had. He asks ambiguous questions and expects specific answers. If you don't give the exact answer he wants you get a zero, there is no partial credit. He is not clear when he is teaching, or on his assignments. Homework + projects will take you 15 hours a week minimum. He belittles students in class. He's awful.
The class was horrible! he cant explain anything. You need to read his mind to understand his questions because they usually do not mean what they look like.
Horrible, horrible professor.I got an A in the class, but it was due in no way to either his teaching or his textbook.
The goat of EE power courses

Awesome professor and he has a very good understanding about what he's teaching. This course is a relatively easy course with just 4 papers (each 25%) and it's only offered during the summer term. Be prepared to do a lot of constructive and critical thinking for the papers. Definitely recommend it!

10 homeworks, 3 take home exams, and 1 project. Homeworks can be fairly difficult but you will do fine on exams if you are able to complete them.  If you do the work you will pass.  Matlab coding helps a lot.
Professor Liao has been my favorite professor at UK so far. I am taking every class he offers. He was very response and clarified things well. Very easier grader!

reviews.comment: This course is useless if you've had a single internship. It covers basic software testing and engineering practices. I grade it negatively only because the course was kind of a waste of my time. She was a nice person.

I don't know how Dr Yu is in other classes, but CS498 was an utter waste of time. She spent most class periods just reading slides. Assignments were moderately challenging, but not on important or useful topics. I liked having randomly assigned teammates.

Professor Griffith was a great teacher. He is lax on attendance and really cares about the students. This class was light hearted and fun. The main grades come from like 2 papers and a final project. Overall easy and good class!

Overall, Zach was a great professor. He made class fun and most of the projects were enjoyable. Most of the assignments in this class are papers or group projects. He is a tough grader, but grading papers is largely subjective so I understand. He provides clear rubrics for every project which may be time-consuming, but he is very accommodating.

Zach Griffith is an incredibly personable professor and a lot of fun in class. His uncertainty in himself  makes projects and papers a little unclear sometimes but otherwise a very fun professor and easy to talk to. Always willing to email whenever and meet outside of class for extra help.

If you have to take this class, all I am gonna say is good luck and just expect AND except a passing grade and get done with it. I've lost so much sleep over this class studying for it to not improve anything in the end. You better start praying because you'll need it….. 
Overall he's an okay professor Just not for dendrology.

I hated this class so much and I dreaded every second of it, this guy is funny outside of class and that's about it. This class made me want to kms. Not a difficult class at all. Must read the book and articles and must go to class to pass, though. He doesn't take attendance but you will not pass the tests if you don't go to class. Some of the answers he wants for some questions on the tests are a little off but overall fair teacher.

very unorganized teaching strategies. Wonderful man- very intelligent. I learned many things from him.

fair on ya grades
seems annoyed

PLEASE DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! seriously ruined my gpa and couldn't understand the poor man at all...not a joke. get out of the class..

Worst.Teacher.Ever.By.Far. Runner up light years behind. Barely speaks English after 8 years of practice and teaches one of the most difficult subjects to learn. This is NOT a good combination. STAY AWAY.

Ok so you can't really understand what the man says...but he will boost your test grades and gives a 5 pts added to ur final grade extra credit paper.  His tests tho are pretty much either u know it or are completely screwed.
