reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Shen is very confusing in lecture. He takes a lot of time explaining how theorems were created, but does not explain how to actually use them or go through examples. I taught myself majority of the course. 80% of the course is tests so if you do poorly on one, you're better off dropping. Overall, he is a poor lecturer even though he tries his best.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Shen's class. I found analysis difficult, but he was very good at explaining things both in class and in office hours. Lectures were clear, homework was fairly straightforward and exams were fair.

Shen is a standard lecturing teacher. He lectures straight out of the book, and is very concise with his proofs. He understands the content, so if someone were to make a suggestion, he could explain why that would/wouldn't work. Not a personable professor, but one who know what he's talking about. Homework was simple, and tests were fair.

Ever since number theory, I have been scared of proofs. Yet, I took this class and have absolutely no regrets. Shen is the reason I can write proofs confidently and understand where to start. His lectures follow the book exactly. The hw is identical to class. The exam is just like the hw with textbook problems. Shen is easily accessible too.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Has an accent, but is still pretty understandable. Very nice and open for answering questions. More hit than miss when it comes to explaining the material. Lectures primarily consist of showing where the formulas and concepts you'll be using come from, but this info itself will never be used. Overall, a very approachable guy.

Great professor. Knows what he's talking about and knows how to teach it. I barely payed attention in this class and still got an A. Final was amazingly easy. If you can do calculus, then you will get an A.

Unless you took calculus in high school, dont expect to get a good grade. I'm smart, I worked my butt off, my other classes suffered, and I still was lucky to get a C. The final is ruthless. He said this course is catered towards those who have never taken calculus, that is a stone cold lie. Beware.
Shen was a good teacher, tests weren't easy but they were fair.  Really cares about his students and really knows his stuff.

Shen is AWESOME! Great at conveying his pointand making you understand. His accent didn't seem to be a problem for me or my friends, but it did give us a few good chuckles. He cares about his students doing well, and he is probably the best around.
very bad. i cant get past the accent.
yeahh he knows his material but I cant get past his accent, the accent is really heavy.
Good teacher! Knows what he's talking about...unlike many!
No Comments
Decent teacher, terrible person.  He is rude, and hateful.  The few times I went to his office he was short, didn't want to answer my questions and told me to go even though it was his office hours.
Awesome teacher and great to deal with. He makes you understand the material. He is a pro. 4 stars!
if you go with zhongwei, that's not the wrong way.
great guy.  love the way he pronounces such words as "derivative", "shape", or "Pythagorean theorem".  just don't get caught reading the newspaper in class...he's brutal.

Shen's a pretty good professor.  Never saw him in his office, but he seems nice.  Doesn't really make hard concepts easy, but explains clearly for the most part.  Tests can be difficult, but are never unfair.  Study and do your homework!
No Comments

First time taking Zilis and he is awesome. The class has briefs for every case which seems like a lot but once you get used to it they genuinely help you understand the content. Lots of extra credit points for one thing available, had a friend finish with a 106%.

Dr. Zilis is an exceptional professor who truly cares about student success. He provides insightful, thought-provoking feedback that encourages growth in your work. He is flexible with deadlines and incredibly understanding. If you ever get the chance to take a class with him, do it!
Dr. Zilis is a nice person but his classes are very lecture heavy. Need to put in extra time outside of class to study, but if you need additional help Dr. Zilis is very helpful!
Great guy, entertaining lectures, easy grader. Would definitely recommend him. He also tells a lot of dad jokes which, though cringey in nature, are pretty wholesome.

Took a basic intro to government class with Dr. Zillis, and it was very easy to follow and a very fun class. Dr Zillis is very smart and knows how to relate topics to real world and simplify topics to the right level. Probably best profesor this semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you are taking this class for an easy A or small workload, don't. If you truly appreciate poli sci and want to learn, do! Not as lenient or understanding as some, but I now appreciate this- unlike other professors, he will hold himself to the same standards. Cares about his students, good sense of humor, easy on the eyes. Great at his job.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Probably the most challenging, educational part of this course was the Supreme Court Oral arguments you participate in. Choose your case carefully, and prepare to be graded harshly, even if your team goes first. It's not easy, but if you do the work and prepare, its a lot of fun. Don't expect an A. It's very difficult to achieve.

Professor Zilis is fantastic. He gives long-winded lectures, ones that if you miss you will not pass the class, but they are interesting and gauging. There will be group projects int the class, and he grades a collective effort, so maybe take the class with some hardworking friends. He grades papers in a tough manner, but objective. Loved him!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: As long as you do the assigned reading, you'll do fine. Yes he does have pop quizzes, but he tells you how many at the beginning of the semester. Again, read, you'll be okay. Love his discussion-based format and he really argues devil's advocate so your argument is sold. Learned a lot!

Dr. Zilis is great! He is passionate about what he teaches and always tries to make class interesting. His exams aren't easy, but don't throw any surprises either. My only complaints are that he's vague with assignments and sometimes his grading is unclear. However, he is available to help you and very friendly. I would definitely take again!

Mr. Zilis was by far the best teacher I've had at UK. He is a great lecturer and really cares about the subject. He is always willing to help and will always give you a rubric for any projects. He can be a bit vague at times but he is an easy grader. The test weren't incredibly hard but you should for sure study. Overall he is a great teacher!

Dr. Zilis was one of my favorite professors this semester. He was very knowledgable, had engaging lectures and was likable. The course content was pertinent and incorporated current events. Semester assignments were unique and overall worthwhile.

Zilis is an amazing professor. The way he lectures is really interactive and helpful, definitely keeps your attention. Clearly outlines his expectations for you and puts everything in the syllabus. He could definitely provide more guidance on his assignments, but he's very available for questions and honestly he's a pretty easy grader. He's great!

Professor Zilis is my favorite professor at UK. I search for him for classes. His lectures are extremely clear and the majority of them are actually fun. He likes to be interactive, so read and participate and you'll have a great time. Tests are everything you should know. Nothing extra. But you have to study a lot to be prepared. Love him!

Dr. Zilis is one of the greatest professors I've taken at UK. Lectures are always interesting, and you always know exactly what he expects and is looking for. There's never any guesswork involved with papers or exams, but expect to receive a grade that reflects how much work you've put into the class. He never takes attendance, but you should go.

I have mixed opinions as this course just sucks to take, but I think Ziebart is one of the better professors to teach it. The entire course is a group project where you write a paper roughly once a week, have a quiz about every 2 weeks with a cheat sheet, a final presentation, and a final exam written with a cheat sheet.

David is extremely nice and values every student's opinion. He doesn't just read off the slides, and his lectures are very engaging and easy to follow. This class focuses on group projects and quizzes, so as long as you come to class and participate you should pass with an A.

Professor Ziebart really cares for his students, and you can tell he loves accounting and the material he teaches. Yes the class is boring, but so is accounting. If you can tough through that and actually pay attention you can def get a good grade. I thought he was a very nice professor.
Cool guy! Very Nice!
honestly the hardest accounting class ive ever taken. prof ziebart is super nice but he doesnt know how to teach the material. i was lost the entire semester
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Gotta be honest. Dave is a nice guy don't get me wrong. But he should not be teaching this class whatsoever. He is used to teaching upper-level graduate students but now he comes down to teach sophomore and juniors in 301 and absolutely flies through lecture slides in class expecting us to know everything when we're all lost.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: First time teaching undergrad in 30 years, expects you to understand at a graduate level. Exams and homework did not reflect class lectures. Grades on homework is either a pass or fail. Very nice man, but not a good teacher. Quizzes every other class and average was about a 50% on the majority of the quizzes. Leaned this class through LEAP

I wonder if he has ever given out a 100 to any student. I put so much time and effort into each of my photoshop and web design projects, however I am never met with a grade that seems fitting for my work. The points I lose are often not met with a logical justification as to why I lost them. Harsh grading and unhelpful comments on the rubric :(

This was an elective for me, and I was not really enthusiastic about taking it. But the professor did a very good job in presenting the material, and in getting me involved in assignments. Useful stuff if you are interested in global media.
I liked the course a lot! He was very helpful face to face out of class. Material up to date.

If you are an Economics major interested in government policy, you'd be a fool to not take Dr. Ziliak. He's extremely knowledgeable, his class is interesting, and he really cares about his students. He has had a substantial impact on many government welfare programs and other professors have told me that he is revered in the Economics department.

Super engaging professor & you can tell he's super passionate about what he's teaching. Badass guy who does policy work for the prez and lots of research. HW can be confusing, especially if you've never used R before. Tests are pretty easy and he sets clear expectations for them. Sitting for 2.5 hours can be painful, but he gives you a 10 min break

Ziliak himself is awesome, somewhat soft-spoken but truly cares about his class and his students. If I could I'd give him a 4.5/5 because his homeworks are tough and require you to learn a software that's extremely complex, and makes you do long readings before class. Other than that the class is manageable but can be time consuming at times
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This guy is absolutely amazing. He is the only reason I actually tried in this lab, and honestly, he is the only element that made it fun. If you got him as your TA or instructor for any class, consider yourself blessed. You will have a lot of fun if you try to give your full effort. Super personable and amazing at instructing.
not too bad of a class. really awesome instructor
an awesome instructor. lab did require work but wasn't overwhelming. he was always happy to be there and super accessible through email and office hours:)
Very helpful during the lab and would help you understand the concepts very well. I would recommend him for anyone taking the lab for this class.
Tries his best to explain the concepts covered in the labs. Tended to be better than my actual physics lecturer.
He was my TA for the physics 241 lab and probably was the only reason I understood what was going on or even why I passed the class in general. He's a very generous grader and overall a great guy!
He was my TA for physics 241 and he was extremely kind throughout the semester. He was very good at teaching the material and was a generous grader.
Was a great TA and helped me and my group numerous times throughout PHY241. Great guy and very helpful.

He was a great Lab TA that helped me through Physics 2 through his great instructions through the lab. Even if I would get stuck he would guide me to the answer. I wish he explained some of the other concepts a little deeper but then again he was not the main professor. Hard class that he does very well in.
Great instruction! This instructor made it easy to understand concepts that might be difficult for some.

He is very chill. There is coding in his lab, but if you get put in a good group where someone is a good coder, you can get thorugh this class really easily. He helps every group and even offers extra credit at the end. He is really easy when it comes to grading. There are no exams in his class, only group labs, which are really easy.
Little difficult to understand so just pay full attention

Taught the material from this class very well and would definitely want him as my TA again if I could. Whenever my group and I had a question about the manual or code that was needed, he was very helpful and kind in explaining anything and everything.

Super nice guy, accent makes him hard to understand sometimes, ask him questions during class about your lab work and he will help, really just not a super pleasant class not a whole lot he could have done to make it better but I wish him the best
Elsayed Zidan was a great instructor. He was always well prepared and was also helpful with the lab work.
Mr. Zidan is one of the most helpful instructors I have had. He has a wonderful way of leading you to the answer rather than doing it for you. He won't let you get off easy!
Zidan always helped during physics lab and sometimes gave the class hints on what to do on the difficult parts. He grades fairly and has a clear rubric.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: One of the best TAs, a lot of moments where I was light on my knowledge about something and he would always make sure things were as clear and applicable as possible.

Elsayed ran my Physics 2 lab, overall I enjoyed having him as a TA. Sometimes it took a bit of explaining for him to understand what my group was confused about, but once he realized what we needed help with, his explanations were really helpful! He grades fairly on lab reports, and the rubrics were always very clear about what we should include.

Elsayed taught my recitation for physics and was very helpful in the application of the course content. He is open to questions and will work to explain any misunderstandings. He is also a very kind individual and wants the students to succeed.

An absolutely lovely TA during my PHY242 lab. Extremely willing to help students and explain confusing topics that show up in the experiments. He cares for each and every one of his students. Most importantly, I could easily see his enthusiasm and love for Physics and teaching when he covered the concepts for our lab at the beginning of each class.
Very understanding and does his best to help students understand the topics.
Great Teacher. Helped explain the material well.

Dr. Fei is a good professor. He's been here at UK for more than 20 years. He does have an accent but in general his English is clear and understandable. Projects are difficult but enforcing you to learn things.

Everything is an inconvenience to the students. Didnt use canvas so accessing grades was a pain. Was difficult to understand in class. Test scores couldnt be found online. Youd have to calculate your grade in the class yourself. His study guides accurately portrayed what was on the test but other than that I have little positive to say.

Hw comes from the book but the answers are in the back of the book. Projects were challenging but not devastating. In class labs were easy. Two tests make up 55% of your grade. No clear indication of what to study. Know the hw, most test questions come from hw. Lectures did not really cover project material. Very nice individual. Hard to understand
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Fei is a good guy, but this class is pretty difficult. He spends the entire lecture reading off slides, except for the few labs you have throughout the semester. Homework is not bad, but the exams are very tough. The material comes straight from the slides, which are hard to follow during class.
Very easy!!! All of the exams are online and you take them at home. Lectures can be boring but he's really easy to understand!!
Henry was an overall good professor. His lectures are sometimes boring but the tests are all simple. Very easy A if you come to class because participation matters
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Prof. Zonio's not bad. He's very nice and makes it clear you can always come to him for help. However, I thought the class was a bit too much work for a SOC 101 course. There are reading notes every week that aren't hard, but become tedious after a while. His lectures are sorta boring, but he tries to liven them up with videos. Overall, he's okay.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Prof. Zonio is pretty laid back, especially with attendance. Yes, there are attendance point for the majority of classes, but still doesn't hurt your grade too much. He uses "tokens" for the semester, kind of a high school thing, but it allows you for some extra credit at the end of the semester.

Zonio is a good professor. If you are looking for a sociology class, I suggest you take him. He will make you think socially though so be prepared for that. It starts off kind of boring but after you get through the introduction then it is interesting. You will have notes due every week over articles so be prepared to read. He also shows movies.

Linguistics is just one of those things where you either love it or you hate it, no in between. The content can be dense, but Dr. Shaw does a good job at keeping lectures engaging. The big research project looks intimidating at first, but once you break into it it becomes very manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I dropped this class after the 2nd lecture.She makes every assignment due at 6pm the day before each class. I talked to her about possible due date extensions and she refused to even consider. Then in her office hrs she told me that being sick is not a valid reason to miss class.I haven't heard anything good about this class or her. Don't take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Memorization, memorization, memorization: I don't think it helps, and it really didn't help me understand how to lessen my accent. Lectures served to facilitate memorization with the occasional funny story; I don't think attending was worth it aside from it being mandatory.
Nice but instructions are never super clear

Very nice lady. A little bit condescending at times, but she's French so that's not a surprise. Her French can be a little difficult to understand at times because she speaks very quickly. Don't slack off and you'll be just fine. The material you learn in this class (Phonetics) is immensely helpful for learning French.
i took a discovery seminar class with her(cuisines). She is super sweet. Very scatterbrained. DSP class with her was cake. Really enjoyed her as a professor she is a character.

This professor is great. She will help you learn the material as much as she can and extremely nice. Her class has a very relaxed atmosphere while still being conducive  to learning. Her class kept me awake at 9:30 in the morning. Not many others can do that.
I agree -- probably the best French teacher at UK.
No Comments
Dr. Zubir-Shaw is probably my favorite professor in the French department.  While she does demand a fair amount of work from her students, she is sweet, very helpful and makes class a lot of fun.
She is a great teacher in the French department.  Probably the only French prof that teaches anything useful for real world interaction.
Great teacher.  Not easy, but not overwhelmingly difficult.  No b/s.  You'll learn French language and/or literature without the stereotypical French attitude so many of her co-workers demonstrate.

I really enjoyed her personality and I think she is really insightful when it comes to the stuff we are reading. Both our major papers were creative assignments. She doesnt give great feedback but if you ask her she tries to help in her own way. We had reading quizzes so make sure to actually read everything on time. Only read 4 books.

It was an easy A, if you read and pay attention in class. If you don't show up or read the books, you'll fail. She's really knowledgable in her field and is willing to talk to you about the material after class or during office hours. Doesn't offer extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Has a thick Russian accent, hard to understand sometimes
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Zunshine didn't lecture as much as I hoped she would, but every lecture she gave was engaging and insightful.  The homework load is quite moderate, given that this was a graduate level course, and her expectations were clearly outlined.  Class discussions were fascinating and well led, with my only wish being she had spoken more herself.

She is a sweet lady and really wants you to succeed in her class. There is a ton of reading in this class, though. Exams are identifying quotations with author and title of book as well as identifying what scene in the book the text comes from. Papers are 5-7 pgs. Her accent is a little hard to understand, but you get used to it quickly. Take her.

Really great professor! Super helpful with the readings and any questions I had about the essays (even when I emailed her late at night, she was quick to respond!) And even helped me out when I needed recommendations this semester! A little quirky but makes the class interesting!

I loved Dr. Z! She was extremely helpful with anything you had a question about. The reading was hefty, but I really enjoyed the class discussions. We had two long papers, two exams, and short assignments throughout. Very doable and I think she really makes it interesting. You can tell she loves to teach! Take her if you can.
Great professor!
Zunshine is a great teacher, but be careful, her assigned book might crush you with its weight

I wasn't so keen on the 18th century novel, but Lisa Zunshine turned me around. She is an enthusiastic teacher with a gentle sense of humor that is very endearing. I can't imagine doing badly in this course unless you simply don't read the books or write the required papers.

Dr. Zunshine is a fantastic and progressive teacher. She makes the material revelant and fun and encourages student participation. She doesn't want to just lecture at you, she wants her students to engage with the discussion.  Anyone who can't understand her accent must have their own lang problems.

I think Dr Z is one of UK's best instructors.  Her comments on the literature are some of the most insightful I've heard from a prof, as well as some of the most intellectually accessible.  I have recommended, and will continue to recommend her to anyone.

Very boring teacher. Unless you have talkative students in class, the class is painful. She is very dull and unanimated. You can get by without reading some of the books, and her exams are easy. Class is also bad b/c her accent is hard to understand.
Pretty easy to make an A in the class.  Not much writing or reading involved.
No Comments
She has a great personality, a little difficult to understand at first, but you get used to it quickly. Great material, fun class.
Very informative and lively. Profesor Zupan made this class fun.

i stopped going to this class because she posted lecture notes online, but i ended up getting a C in a class that i should have gotten an A in. I reccomend going to class, even though you will be fighitng to stay awake. although shes not my favorite teacher, the class was interesting and easy if you put in the effort. ]

Everything on the exams comes directly from class notes. She can be hard to understand sometimes but not too bad. If you remain quiet in her class you'll be fine but NEVER walk into class late. She will call you out. If you pay attention and don't question her, class will be an easy A.

This class is pretty interesting and very easy to follow, despite her accent.  She will help if you email her but gets annoyed if you question her knowledge. She can be very rude, but just stay quiet and youll be fine. There is a  6 page papet project due about half way through. tests are straight from notes and discussions.

This professor is knowledgeable, but not about everything as she thinks. If you challenge the way she thinks abut something, even if you are right, she will argue, she makes basic mistakes in English grammar which will affect your grade. I'm sure she does great research, but she is a poor professor, talking down to her students and very negative.

I love Dr. Zupan, though almost no one else did. She's incredibly knowledgeable of the subject, and she is really passionate about it. And it shows. I learned so much through this class, and I feel that her classroom management is impeccable. She's very proper, and expects respect. So either show some respect or get out.

Attendance did become mandatory halfway through.  She tried to be nice and post notes, but unfortunately, attendance dwindled.  I do feel like she took some things a bit too personally and became stricter as the semester went on.  However, I enjoyed her class and had no problems.  Do the work, go to class, and you will learn and do fine.

I'm a GEO major and took this as my regional requirement. Many other students complained about this professor being strict, but she merely required attendance for note taking purposes, and may have taken it too personally when students didn't show. Go to class, take notes, do the assignments like a college student should and you will be fine.

This professor is hard to understand, the tests are too fact-specific, and the course is mechanical. Definitely too much work for a USP class, even a 3 hour one. If you're looking for a USP, take something else.
